title: খৰা
desc: এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো খৰাৰ বিষয়ে এক গভীৰ বুজাবুজি প্ৰদান কৰিবলৈ প্ৰস্তুত কৰা হৈছে, যি এক জটিল প্ৰাকৃতিক পৰিঘটনা আৰু যাৰ ব্যাপক প্ৰভাৱ আছে। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে খৰাৰ মূল ধাৰণা, ইয়াৰ কাৰণ যেনে বৰষুণৰ অভাৱ আৰু জলবায়ু পৰিৱৰ্তনৰ বিষয়ে বিশদভাৱে আলোচনা কৰে। ইয়াত বতৰ বিজ্ঞান, কৃষি, জলবিজ্ঞান আৰু সামাজিক-অৰ্থনৈতিক খৰাৰ দৰে বিভিন্ন প্ৰকাৰৰ খৰাৰ বিষয়েও আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে, যাতে শিকাৰুসকলে এই সমস্যাৰ বিভিন্ন দিশসমূহ বুজি পায়। পাঠ্যক্ৰমৰ এক মুখ্য অংশ হৈছে জল সংৰক্ষণ। ইয়াত পানীৰ ব্যৱহাৰ কম কৰিবলৈ ঘৰৰ ভিতৰত আৰু বাহিৰত কাৰ্যকৰী কৌশলসমূহ শিকোৱা হয়, যেনে লিকেজ মেৰামতি কৰা, পানী-দক্ষ সঁজুলি ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা, আৰু বৰষুণৰ পানী সংগ্ৰহ কৰা। ইয়াৰ উপৰিও, পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে খৰাৰ সময়ত সাহায্য বিতৰণ, সজাগতা সৃষ্টি আৰু চৰকাৰী সংস্থাসমূহক সহায় কৰাত স্বেচ্ছাসেৱকসকলৰ গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ ভূমিকাৰ ওপৰত আলোকপাত কৰে। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰম সম্পূৰ্ণ কৰাৰ পিছত, শিকাৰুসকলে খৰা প্ৰশমন আৰু জল ব্যৱস্থাপনাত অৰিহণা যোগাবলৈ সক্ষম হ'ব।

title: বন্যা
desc: এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো বানপানীৰ বিষয়ে এক গভীৰ বুজাবুজি প্ৰদান কৰিবলৈ প্ৰস্তুত কৰা হৈছে, য'ত ইয়াৰ কাৰণ, প্ৰভাৱ আৰু ব্যৱস্থাপনাৰ কৌশলসমূহ সামৰি লোৱা হৈছে। অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে বিভিন্ন প্ৰকাৰৰ বানপানী, যেনে - নদীৰ বান, আকস্মিক বান, চহৰীয়া বান আৰু উপকূলীয় বানৰ বিষয়ে শিকিব। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে বানপানীৰ আগত, সময়ত আৰু পিছত ল'বলগীয়া সুৰক্ষামূলক ব্যৱস্থাসমূহৰ ওপৰত বিশেষভাৱে গুৰুত্ব দিয়ে, যেনে - জৰুৰীকালীন সামগ্ৰী সাজু ৰখা, সুৰক্ষিত আশ্ৰয়স্থললৈ যোৱা, আৰু বানপানীৰ পিছত ঘৰলৈ উভতি অহাৰ সময়ত সাৱধানতা অৱলম্বন কৰা। ইয়াত পানী বিশুদ্ধকৰণ, খাদ্য সুৰক্ষা, আৰু প্ৰাথমিক চিকিৎসাৰ দৰে গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ বিষয়বোৰো আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে। ইয়াৰ উপৰিও, পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে উদ্ধাৰ অভিযানত ব্যৱহৃত বিভিন্ন কৌশল, যেনে - শুকান আৰু তিতা উদ্ধাৰ পদ্ধতি, আৰু থলুৱাভাৱে উপলব্ধ সামগ্ৰীৰে ভেলা নিৰ্মাণৰ পদ্ধতিৰ বিষয়ে জ্ঞান প্ৰদান কৰে। শেষত, দুৰ্যোগৰ সময়ত স্বেচ্ছাসেৱকসকলৰ গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ ভূমিকা আৰু সমাজত সজাগতা সৃষ্টিত তেওঁলোকৰ অৱদানৰ বিষয়েও আলোকপাত কৰা হৈছে।

title: ବନ୍ୟା
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ବନ୍ୟା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ସମସ୍ତ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଦିଗକୁ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି, ଯାହା ଏକ ସାଧାରଣ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ଅଟେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭରେ ବନ୍ୟାର ସଂଜ୍ଞା, ଏହାର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାର ଯେପରିକି ନଦୀ ବନ୍ୟା, ଆକସ୍ମିକ ବନ୍ୟା, ସହରୀ ବନ୍ୟା ଏବଂ ଉପକୂଳ ବନ୍ୟା ବିଷୟରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହାପରେ, ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ବୃଷ୍ଟିପାତ, ନଦୀବନ୍ଧ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବା ଏବଂ ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ଝଡ଼ ଭଳି ବନ୍ୟାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାରଣଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ କରାଯାଇଛି। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ଜୀବନ, ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି, କୃଷି ଏବଂ ଭିତ୍ତିଭୂମି ଉପରେ ବନ୍ୟାର ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ବନ୍ୟା ପୂର୍ବରୁ, ସମୟରେ ଏବଂ ପରେ ନିଆଯିବାକୁ ଥିବା ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପଦକ୍ଷେପଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଷୟରେ ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଭାବରେ ଜାଣିବେ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଏକ ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ କିଟ୍ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରିବା, ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତର ହେବା ଏବଂ ବନ୍ୟା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛତା ଅଭିଯାନ ସାମିଲ ଅଛି। ଏହା ସହିତ, ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ରାଫ୍ଟ ତିଆରି କରିବା ଏବଂ ଶୁଖିଲା ଓ ଓଦା ଉଦ୍ଧାର ପଦ୍ଧତି ଭଳି ଜୀବନ ରକ୍ଷାକାରୀ କୌଶଳଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଶେଷରେ, ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ପରିଚାଳନାରେ ସ୍ୱେଚ୍ଛାସେବୀମାନଙ୍କର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭୂମିକା ଉପରେ ଆଲୋକପାତ କରେ, ଯାହା ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ସମାଜର ସେବା ପାଇଁ ସଶକ୍ତ କରିବ।

title: ବାତ୍ୟା
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିବଳୟ ଭଳି ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟର ପରିଚାଳନା ପାଇଁ ଏକ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶିକା ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହାର ମୂଳ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି ଜନସାଧାରଣ, ସରକାରୀ କର୍ମଚାରୀ ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱେଚ୍ଛାସେବୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିବଳୟର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଦିଗ ବିଷୟରେ ସଚେତନ କରାଇବା। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିବଳୟର ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ କାରଣ, ଏହାର ପ୍ରକାରଭେଦ, ଏବଂ ଏହାଦ୍ୱାରା ହେଉଥିବା କ୍ଷୟକ୍ଷତିର ବିସ୍ତୃତ ବିବରଣୀ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଏଥିସହିତ, ଭାରତୀୟ ପାଣିପାଗ ବିଭାଗ (IMD) ଦ୍ୱାରା ଜାରି କରାଯାଉଥିବା ବିଭିନ୍ନ ସତର୍କ ସୂଚନା ଏବଂ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଅର୍ଥକୁ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିବଳୟ ପୂର୍ବରୁ, ସମୟରେ ଏବଂ ପରେ କ'ଣ କରିବା ଉଚିତ୍ ଓ ଅନୁଚିତ୍, ସେ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ବ୍ୟବହାରିକ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଲାଭ କରିବେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ସମୟରେ ସଠିକ୍ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେବା ଏବଂ ଉଦ୍ଧାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ ସହଯୋଗ କରିବାର ଦକ୍ଷତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବାରେ ସହାୟକ ହେବ।

title: ସୁନାମି
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସୁନାମି ଭଳି ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟର ମୁକାବିଲା ପାଇଁ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଏବଂ କୌଶଳ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବାକୁ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହା ସୁନାମିର ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ କାରଣ, ଯେପରିକି ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ଭୂକମ୍ପ ଏବଂ ଆଗ୍ନେୟଗିରି ଉଦ୍ଗୀରଣ, ଠାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଏହାର ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ସମୁଦ୍ର ପାଣି ପଛକୁ ଫେରିବା ଭଳି ସତର୍କ ସଙ୍କେତଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବା ଶିଖିବେ। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ କିଟ୍ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରିବା, ପରିବାର ପାଇଁ ଏକ ନିରାପଦ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ଯୋଜନା ତିଆରି କରିବା ଏବଂ ସରକାରୀ ସତର୍କ ସୂଚନା ପାଳନ କରିବା ଭଳି ବ୍ୟବହାରିକ ପଦକ୍ଷେପଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଉପରେ ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଭାବରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହା ସହିତ, ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ନିଜର ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କର ସୁରକ୍ଷା କିପରି ସୁନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରାଯିବ ଏବଂ ରିଲିଫ୍ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ ସ୍ୱେଚ୍ଛାସେବୀମାନଙ୍କର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭୂମିକା ବିଷୟରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ଜ୍ଞାନ ଜୀବନ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବା ଏବଂ ସୁନାମିର ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ କମ୍ କରିବାରେ ସହାୟକ ହେବ।

title: Bhashini and Digital India: Bridging Languages in Citizen Services
desc: Dive into the transformative power of language technology with this comprehensive course on Bhashini. Designed for officials in governance and technology, this program details how India’s AI language platform is revolutionizing public service delivery. The course provides context on why multilingual access is critical for an equitable Digital India and showcases Bhashini's architecture and ecosystem. You will explore a wide range of real-world use cases, from enhancing justice and policing with real-time translation to enabling multilingual access in programs like UIDAI, E-SHRAM, and parliamentary proceedings. Key learning areas include the integration of multilingual chatbots, the development of voice-first interfaces, and the process of building standardized glossaries for consistent communication. Upon completion, you will be equipped to identify opportunities for deploying language technologies to create more inclusive, efficient, and accessible citizen services.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: PM WANI
desc: This course delves into the policy, technology, and implementation of the PM-WANI scheme, a transformative initiative for digital inclusion in India. It begins by establishing the need for public Wi-Fi to complement existing mobile networks and achieve the 'Broadband for All' vision. The course meticulously breaks down the unbundled PM-WANI architecture, detailing the distinct functions and responsibilities of each stakeholder: the last-mile PDO, the aggregating PDOA, the user-facing App Provider, and the coordinating Central Registry. Learners will be guided through the complete lifecycle, from the registration and certification processes on the Saral Sanchar and Central Registry portals to the technical intricacies of the system. This includes a deep dive into the secure authentication flow using WANI tokens, public-key encryption, and the interaction between different network components. The course also covers the business models, revenue opportunities for entrepreneurs, and the crucial role of government bodies like DoT and Local Service Areas (LSAs) in facilitating and scaling the ecosystem.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: ভূস্খলন
desc: এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো ভূস্খলনৰ বিষয়ে গভীৰ জ্ঞান প্ৰদান কৰিবলৈ প্ৰস্তুত কৰা হৈছে, যি ভাৰতৰ বহুতো পাৰ্বত্য অঞ্চলৰ বাবে এক গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ চিন্তাৰ বিষয়। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো ভূস্খলন কি, ইয়াৰ বিভিন্ন প্ৰকাৰ যেনে ঘূৰ্ণনশীল, স্থানান্তৰণশীল, আৰু ধ্বংসাৱশেষ স্খলনৰ পৰিচয় দি আৰম্ভ কৰা হৈছে। ইয়াৰ পিছত, ই ভূস্খলনৰ মূল কাৰণসমূহ, যেনে প্ৰচুৰ বৰষুণ আৰু ভূমিকম্পৰ দৰে প্ৰাকৃতিক কাৰক, আৰু বনাঞ্চল ধ্বংস আৰু খননৰ দৰে মানৱসৃষ্ট কাৰ্যকলাপৰ বিষয়ে আলোচনা কৰে। অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে আসন্ন ভূস্খলনৰ আগজাননীমূলক চিনসমূহ কেনেকৈ চিনাক্ত কৰিব লাগে সেই বিষয়েও শিকিব। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে জীৱন, আন্তঃগাঁথনি আৰু অৰ্থনীতিৰ ওপৰত ভূস্খলনৰ প্ৰভাৱৰ ওপৰত গুৰুত্ব আৰোপ কৰে। ইয়াত বিপদ মেপিং, ভূমি ব্যৱহাৰ পৰিকল্পনা, আৰু সেউজীয়া আৱৰণ বৃদ্ধি কৰাৰ দৰে কাৰ্যকৰী প্ৰশমন কৌশলসমূহৰ বিষয়ে বিতংভাৱে আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে। ইয়াৰ উপৰিও, ভূস্খলনৰ আগতে, সময়ত আৰু পিছত ল'বলগীয়া সুৰক্ষা ব্যৱস্থাৰ বিষয়ে স্পষ্ট নিৰ্দেশনা প্ৰদান কৰা হৈছে। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰম সম্পূৰ্ণ কৰাৰ পিছত, শিকাৰুসকলে ভূস্খলনৰ বিপদসমূহ বুজি পাব আৰু নিজকে আৰু নিজৰ সম্প্ৰদায়ক সুৰক্ষিত ৰাখিবলৈ প্ৰয়োজনীয় জ্ঞানেৰে সজ্জিত হ'ব।

title: সুনামি
desc: এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো সুনামিৰ বিষয়ে গভীৰ জ্ঞান প্ৰদান কৰিবলৈ প্ৰস্তুত কৰা হৈছে, য'ত ইয়াৰ বৈজ্ঞানিক কাৰণৰ পৰা আৰম্ভ কৰি সমাজৰ ওপৰত পৰা প্ৰভাৱলৈকে সামৰি লোৱা হৈছে। অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে জানিব পাৰিব যে কেনেকৈ সমুদ্ৰৰ তলৰ ভূমিকম্পই বিশাল ঢৌৰ সৃষ্টি কৰে যি হাজাৰ হাজাৰ কিলোমিটাৰ অতিক্ৰম কৰিব পাৰে। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোত ভাৰতীয় ৰাষ্ট্ৰীয় মহাসাগৰ তথ্য সেৱা কেন্দ্ৰ (INCOIS) আৰু প্ৰশান্ত মহাসাগৰীয় সুনামি সতৰ্কবাণী প্ৰণালীৰ দৰে আধুনিক সতৰ্কবাণী ব্যৱস্থাৰ কাৰ্যপ্ৰণালীৰ বিষয়ে বিশদভাৱে আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে। ইয়াত এক জৰুৰীকালীন পৰিস্থিতিত ল'বলগীয়া পদক্ষেপসমূহ, যেনে এক জৰুৰীকালীন কিট প্ৰস্তুত কৰা, পৰিয়ালৰ বাবে এক নিৰাপদ স্থানলৈ যোৱাৰ পৰিকল্পনা কৰা, আৰু চৰকাৰী নিৰ্দেশনা পালন কৰাৰ ওপৰত গুৰুত্ব দিয়া হৈছে। ইয়াৰ উপৰিও, দুৰ্যোগৰ সঁহাৰি দিয়াত আৰু পুনৰুদ্ধাৰৰ কামত স্বেচ্ছাসেৱক আৰু ৰাষ্ট্ৰীয় দুৰ্যোগ সঁহাৰি বাহিনীৰ (NDRF) দৰে সংগঠনৰ গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ ভূমিকাৰ বিষয়েও আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে।

title: ଭୂସ୍ଖଳନ
desc: ଏହି ବିସ୍ତୃତ ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଭୂସ୍ଖଳନ ଏବଂ ଏହା ସହ ଜଡିତ ବିପଦ ବିଷୟରେ ବୁଝିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହା ଭୂସ୍ଖଳନର ସଂଜ୍ଞା ଦେବା ସହିତ ଏହାର ଗତି ଏବଂ ବୈଶିଷ୍ଟ୍ୟ ଆଧାରରେ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାରରେ ବର୍ଗୀକରଣ କରିଥାଏ। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଘଟଣା ଏବଂ ମାନବୀୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ସମେତ ଏହାର କାରଣଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପୁଙ୍ଖାନୁପୁଙ୍ଖ ଭାବେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି ଏବଂ ଜୀବନ, ଭିତ୍ତିଭୂମି ଓ ପରିବେଶ ଉପରେ ଏହାର ବିନାଶକାରୀ ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ପରୀକ୍ଷା କରାଯାଇଛି। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଅଂଶ ବ୍ୟାବହାରିକ ଜ୍ଞାନ ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ସର୍ଗୀକୃତ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ବିପଦ ମାନଚିତ୍ର, ବନୀକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରତିରକ୍ଷା କାନ୍ଥ ନିର୍ମାଣ ଭଳି ନିରାକରଣ କୌଶଳ, ଏବଂ ଭୂସ୍ଖଳନ ପୂର୍ବରୁ, ସମୟରେ ଓ ପରେ ନିଆଯିବାକୁ ଥିବା ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଏହା ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ମୁକାବିଲାରେ ସାମୁଦାୟିକ ସ୍ୱେଚ୍ଛାସେବୀମାନଙ୍କର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭୂମିକାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆଲୋକପାତ କରେ। ଏହାକୁ ସମାପ୍ତ କରିବା ପରେ, ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ଭୂସ୍ଖଳନର ବିପଦ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବା, ନିରାକରଣ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ ଭାବରେ ମୁକାବିଲା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେବେ, ଯାହା ସମାଜର ସ୍ଥିରତା ବୃଦ୍ଧିରେ ସହାୟକ ହେବ।

title: High-Speed Rail Development: Context and Impact
desc: Delve into the transformative power of high-speed rail (HSR) and its multifaceted impact on national development. This course examines the critical role of HSR systems in alleviating transportation bottlenecks, fostering economic growth, and enhancing the quality of life for citizens. Using the pioneering Shinkansen in Japan and the developing Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor in India as key examples, the program unpacks the complex interplay between infrastructure, economy, and society. Key learning areas include the historical context of HSR, comparative analysis with aviation and road transport, and the application of advanced analytical models like the Quality of Life (QOL) accessibility method and spatial interaction models. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the benefits of HSR, understand its contribution to sustainable development goals, and evaluate the strategic considerations for implementing such large-scale projects in their own contexts.

title: Types of Merchant Ships
desc: Delve into the world of maritime commerce with this introductory course on merchant ships. With 90% of global trade transported by sea, a comprehensive understanding of the vessels involved is essential for professionals in logistics, trade, and governance. This course offers a detailed overview of the primary categories of ships that facilitate international commerce, ensuring the movement of raw materials, manufactured goods, and energy resources across continents. Key learning areas include the classification of dry cargo ships like general cargo vessels and bulk carriers, the specifics of liquid cargo transport via oil and chemical tankers, and the mechanics of modern logistics with container ships. The course also explores specialized vessels such as Ro-Ro ships for wheeled cargo, livestock carriers, and passenger ships. By the end of this course, learners will be able to identify different ship types, understand their specific functions, and appreciate their collective impact on the global economy and industrial growth, providing a solid foundation for roles within the maritime sector.

title: मजरा टोला से नवीन राजस्व ग्राम निर्माण
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम राजस्व अधिकारियों और संबंधित कर्मियों को मजरा-टोला से एक नया राजस्व ग्राम बनाने की संपूर्ण प्रक्रिया को समझने और निष्पादित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। कई दूरस्थ बसावटें, जिन्हें मजरा-टोला के नाम से जाना जाता है, अविकसित रह जाती हैं क्योंकि वे आधिकारिक राजस्व ग्राम नहीं होतीं, जिससे निवासियों को सरकारी योजनाओं का लाभ नहीं मिल पाता। यह कोर्स इस अंतर को पाटने का ज्ञान प्रदान करता है। इसमें शिक्षार्थी सीखेंगे कि राजस्व ग्राम की आवश्यकता क्यों होती है, इसके गठन के लिए कानूनी आधार क्या हैं, और जनसंख्या, भूमि और दूरी से संबंधित मानदंड क्या हैं। पाठ्यक्रम में जिला सर्वेक्षण अधिकारी की भूमिका, RCMS पोर्टल पर प्रकरण दर्ज करने की प्रक्रिया, और mpbhulekh पोर्टल पर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डेटा स्थापित करने के चरण-दर-चरण मार्गदर्शन को विस्तार से बताया गया है। इस कोर्स को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी इन बसावटों को औपचारिक रूप देकर ग्रामीण विकास और समावेशी शासन में प्रभावी रूप से योगदान करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: Commissioner of Land Records Madhya Pradesh

title: ভূমিকম্প
desc: এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো ভূমিকম্পৰ বিষয়ে এক বিস্তৃত বুজাবুজি প্ৰদান কৰিবলৈ ডিজাইন কৰা হৈছে, য'ত ইয়াৰ কাৰণ, প্ৰভাৱ আৰু নিৰাপত্তাৰ ব্যৱস্থাসমূহ সামৰি লোৱা হৈছে। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে পৃথিৱীৰ গঠন আৰু প্লেট টেকটনিক্সৰ দৰে মৌলিক ধাৰণাৰে আৰম্ভ কৰে, যি ভূমিকম্পৰ মূল কাৰণ। ইয়াৰ পিছত, পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে বিভিন্ন প্ৰকাৰৰ ফল্ট, চেইছমিক তৰংগ, আৰু ভূমিকম্প কেনেকৈ জোখা হয় সেই বিষয়ে আলোচনা কৰে। এক গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ অংশ ভাৰতৰ ভূকম্পীয় অঞ্চলসমূহৰ ওপৰত কেন্দ্ৰিত, যিয়ে অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলক তেওঁলোকৰ অঞ্চলৰ বিপদৰ মাত্ৰা বুজাত সহায় কৰে। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৰ আটাইতকৈ গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ দিশটো হ'ল ব্যৱহাৰিক সুৰক্ষা নিৰ্দেশনা। অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে ঘৰত, বাহিৰত, বা গাড়ীত থকা সময়ত কি কৰিব লাগে সেই বিষয়ে বিতংভাৱে শিকিব। ইয়াৰ উপৰিও, দুৰ্যোগৰ পিছত উদ্ধাৰ আৰু সাহায্য অভিযানত স্বেচ্ছাসেৱকসকলৰ ভূমিকাৰ ওপৰত আলোকপাত কৰা হৈছে। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰম সম্পূৰ্ণ কৰাৰ পিছত, শিকাৰুসকলে ভূমিকম্পৰ সৈতে জড়িত বিপদসমূহৰ বাবে অধিক সাজু হ'ব আৰু নিজকে আৰু নিজৰ সম্প্ৰদায়ক সুৰক্ষিত ৰাখিবলৈ সক্ষম হ'ব।

title: শীতল পৱন
desc: এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো বিশেষভাৱে শীতল প্ৰবাহৰ সৈতে জড়িত বিপদসমূহ বুজিবলৈ আৰু সেইবোৰৰ সৈতে মোকাবিলা কৰিবলৈ প্ৰস্তুত কৰা হৈছে। ভাৰতত প্ৰতি বছৰে শীতকালীন পৰিস্থিতিৰ ফলত বহুতো জীৱন আৰু সম্পত্তিৰ ক্ষতি হয়, সেয়েহে এই বিষয়ে জ্ঞান অৰ্জন কৰাটো অতি জৰুৰী। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমৰ জৰিয়তে, শিকাৰুসকলে শীতল প্ৰবাহৰ সংজ্ঞা, ইয়াৰ কাৰণ আৰু মানৱ শৰীৰত ইয়াৰ প্ৰভাৱ সম্পৰ্কে গভীৰভাৱে জানিব পাৰিব। ইয়াত হাইপোথাৰ্মিয়া, ফ্ৰষ্টবাইট, আৰু অন্যান্য ঠাণ্ডাজনিত আঘাতৰ লক্ষণসমূহ চিনাক্ত কৰা আৰু তাৰ বাবে প্ৰয়োজনীয় প্ৰাক-চিকিৎসালয়ৰ চিকিৎসা প্ৰদান কৰাৰ পদ্ধতিসমূহ বিতংভাৱে আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোৱে কেৱল চিকিৎসাৰ ওপৰতে নহয়, বৰঞ্চ সুৰক্ষামূলক ব্যৱস্থা, যেনে উপযুক্ত পোছাক পৰিধান কৰা, জৰুৰীকালীন কিট প্ৰস্তুত কৰা, আৰু ভ্ৰমণৰ সময়ত ল'বলগীয়া সাৱধানতাৰ ওপৰতো গুৰুত্ব দিয়ে। এই জ্ঞান অৰ্জন কৰি, অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে নিজকে আৰু নিজৰ সম্প্ৰদায়ক সুৰক্ষিত ৰাখিব পাৰিব আৰু দুৰ্যোগ সঁহাৰি কাৰ্য্যকলাপত এক গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ ভূমিকা পালন কৰিবলৈ সক্ষম হ'ব।

title: ଘରୋଇ ଅଗ୍ନିକାଣ୍ଡ ଏବଂ ସୁରକ୍ଷା
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଘରୋଇ ଅଗ୍ନିକାଣ୍ଡରୁ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଏବଂ କୌଶଳ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବାକୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହାର ମୂଳ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି ସାଧାରଣ ନାଗରିକ ଏବଂ ସରକାରୀ କର୍ମଚାରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅଗ୍ନି ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ବିପଦ ବିଷୟରେ ସଚେତନ କରାଇବା। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ଅଗ୍ନି ତ୍ରିକୋଣ, ଅଗ୍ନିକାଣ୍ଡର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ, ଏବଂ ଏହାର ପ୍ରସାରଣର କାରଣଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସରଳ ଭାଷାରେ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ଅଗ୍ନି ନିର୍ବାପନର ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ (ଯଥା ଶୀତଳୀକରଣ, ଅନାହାର, ଏବଂ ଶ୍ୱାସରୁଦ୍ଧ) ଏବଂ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାରର ଅଗ୍ନି (ଶ୍ରେଣୀ A, B, C, D, E) ପାଇଁ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ନିର୍ବାପକ ଯନ୍ତ୍ର ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବା ଓ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବା ଶିଖିବେ। ଏହା ବ୍ୟତୀତ, ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ଭାବେ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ, ଧୂଆଁରୁ ରକ୍ଷା ପାଇବାର ଉପାୟ, ଏବଂ ପୋଡ଼ାଘା'ର ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ଚିକିତ୍ସା ଉପରେ ବ୍ୟବହାରିକ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଶେଷରେ, ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ନିଜ ଘର ଓ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ଷେତ୍ରକୁ ଅଧିକ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ।

title: ಸರಗಳ್ಳತನ ಅಪರಾಧಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದು
desc: ಸರಗಳ್ಳತನವು ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭದ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವ ಗಂಭೀರ ಅಪರಾಧವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಅಪರಾಧಗಳನ್ನು ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟಲು ಮತ್ತು ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಲು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷ ತರಬೇತಿಯ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ಅಂತಹ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಲು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ, ಸರಗಳ್ಳತನದ ಅಪರಾಧದ ಸ್ವರೂಪ, ಅಪರಾಧಿಗಳ ಕಾರ್ಯವೈಖರಿ, ಮತ್ತು ತನಿಖೆಯ ವಿವಿಧ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕಲಿಯುವವರು ಭಾರತೀಯ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಂಹಿತೆ (BNS) ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಕಾನೂನು ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳು, ಪ್ರಥಮ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ವರದಿ (FIR) ದಾಖಲಿಸುವಿಕೆ, ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ, ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕರಣವನ್ನು ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನೈಜ ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಿಮ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್‌ಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ತನಿಖಾ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಈ ತರಬೇತಿಯು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರ ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅಪರಾಧಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ಕೊಡಿಸಲು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

title: Anger Management and Effective Public Interaction
desc: In an environment of citizen-centric governance, the ability of public officials to manage difficult interactions is paramount. Encounters with frustrated or angry citizens can challenge service delivery and erode public trust. This course is designed to provide government employees with the necessary frameworks and tools to navigate these complex situations professionally and constructively, turning potential conflicts into opportunities for positive engagement. The curriculum delves into the psychology of anger and frustration, providing a foundation for understanding citizen behavior. It introduces proven conflict resolution models and communication strategies, including principles of Transaction Analysis, to maintain composure and guide conversations toward a productive resolution. Participants will learn to identify conflict handling modes, practice active listening, and apply de-escalation techniques in real-world scenarios. The course emphasizes building emotional intelligence to better manage one's own reactions and respond with empathy. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to handle aggressive behavior, manage difficult conversations with confidence, and resolve disputes effectively. These skills are directly applicable to roles involving public-facing duties, grievance redressal, and service delivery. By fostering a climate of respect and understanding, participants will contribute to strengthening the relationship between the government and its citizens, ultimately enhancing public satisfaction and reinforcing the principles of transparent and accountable governance.

title: BNSS And CRPC
desc: This detailed module offers an in-depth analysis of the landmark legal reform, the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. The course is structured to provide a comparative understanding between the new BNSS and the erstwhile Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC), 1973, highlighting the evolution of criminal procedure in India. Key learning areas include a thorough review of revised definitions, updated procedures for arrest, bail, and investigation, and the integration of technology such as audio-video electronic means in judicial processes. Participants will learn about the changes in the constitution of criminal courts, the powers of police officers and magistrates, and the updated framework for summons, warrants, and trials. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply the new procedural laws in their professional roles, ensuring compliance and contributing to a more efficient and modern criminal justice administration.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Curves and Gradients in Indian Railways
desc: This course delves into the technical intricacies of railway infrastructure, focusing on the design and application of gradients and curves. It begins by establishing the context of why even ground surfaces are necessary for track laying and how gradients, or the slope of the track, are engineered to manage locomotive power and operational costs. You will learn to distinguish between ruling, momentum, pusher, and station yard gradients, understanding their unique purposes and design constraints. The course then transitions to curves, explaining their necessity in navigating terrain and connecting key locations. Key learning areas include the calculation and purpose of super-elevation (cant) to counteract centrifugal forces, the implications of cant deficiency and excess, and how these factors collectively determine the maximum permissible speed on a track section. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the technical knowledge to analyze track geometry, contribute to route planning, and understand the critical balance between construction costs and operational efficiency in railway engineering.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Disaster Management Part 1 - Legal Framework in Telecom
desc: In an era where connectivity is crucial, ensuring the resilience of telecommunication networks during disasters is a national priority. This course delves into the critical subject of disaster management as it applies to the telecom sector in India, providing essential knowledge for officials involved in infrastructure, planning, and emergency response. The content is structured to build a foundational understanding of why telecom systems fail and what legal and procedural safeguards are in place to mitigate these risks. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the Disaster Management Act (2005) and its implications for the telecom industry. The course explores the government's proactive three-layered approach, which encompasses early warning dissemination, physical strengthening of telecom hardware, and the creation of inherently resilient network architectures. Furthermore, participants will gain in-depth knowledge of the Department of Telecommunications' (DoT) Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), designed to facilitate seamless coordination between various agencies. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute to robust disaster preparedness and response strategies, ensuring the continuity of vital communication services for the public and government.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Disciplinary Proceedings in Government
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the rules and procedures governing disciplinary proceedings within the Government of India. It is designed for public functionaries who are responsible for maintaining discipline and handling vigilance matters. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the constitutional provisions and statutory rules, such as the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, that form the legal basis for disciplinary action. The curriculum delves into the critical stages of the disciplinary process, starting from the preliminary investigation and the drafting of a precise charge sheet. It covers the appointment and role of the Inquiry Officer, the presentation of evidence, and the rights of the charged official to a fair hearing. Furthermore, the course explains the different types of penalties, both minor and major, and the correct procedure for their imposition. It also touches upon the appellate process and judicial review of disciplinary orders. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to manage disciplinary cases effectively, ensuring compliance with legal standards and upholding the principles of natural justice and administrative fairness.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Divisions of MeitY
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and its central role in steering India's digital transformation. As the primary architect of the nation's technology policy, understanding MeitY's structure and functions is essential for any public servant engaged in modern governance. The module begins by introducing the ministry's mandate and its strategic importance in the national context. Learners will delve into the specifics of MeitY's 25 divisions, which are broadly categorized into technical and support functions. The course details the responsibilities of key technical divisions dedicated to high-priority areas such as cybersecurity, the digital economy, artificial intelligence (AI), and IT research and development. It also covers the crucial support divisions responsible for finance, HR, and administration that enable the ministry's operations. Furthermore, the course connects these divisional functions to major national programs like Digital India, e-Governance, and initiatives promoting electronics manufacturing and IT skill development. Upon completion, participants will have a clear understanding of how MeitY drives innovation, formulates policy, and fosters international collaboration to position India as a global powerhouse in information technology and electronics.
org: Ministry of Electronics and Information and Technology Meity
keywords: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

title: DoSJE - Schemes for welfare of Senior Citizens
desc: This module is designed to equip government functionaries with essential knowledge about the welfare schemes dedicated to senior citizens. In the context of a growing elderly population, it is crucial for public servants to be well-versed in the support structures established by the government. The course delves into the specifics of major schemes, including the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY) and the Senior Citizens Welfare Fund, detailing their components and intended impact. Learners will explore the various aspects of these programs, from eligibility criteria to the application process. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to assist and guide senior citizens in accessing their entitlements, thereby contributing to effective and empathetic public service delivery and upholding the government's commitment to social justice for its elderly population.
org: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Drought-Disaster Response Training
desc: Droughts pose a significant and recurring threat to communities, impacting agriculture, water supply, and overall economic stability. This course is designed to equip public service professionals and volunteers with the fundamental knowledge and skills required for effective drought management and disaster response. By understanding the complexities of drought, learners can contribute to building more resilient communities and mitigating the severe consequences of water scarcity. The curriculum delves into the core aspects of drought, starting with its definition, causes, and classification into different types. It provides a comprehensive overview of proactive strategies and precautionary measures that can be implemented before and during a drought. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical water conservation methods, covering both household (indoor) and community-level (outdoor) practices. Participants will also learn about the crucial role of community engagement and how volunteers can be mobilized to spread awareness, promote water-saving habits, and support local response efforts. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to support and implement drought mitigation strategies within their communities, contributing to national disaster resilience.

title: Fiscal Policy: Impact and Significance in the Indian Telecom Sector
desc: This course delves into the principles and application of fiscal policy within the Indian economic landscape, with a specific focus on the telecommunications sector. It is designed for public officials who need to understand the mechanisms of government finance and their real-world impact. The course begins by defining fiscal policy and its essential tools, providing a foundational understanding of how government revenue and expenditure are managed. Participants will learn about the significance of the Consolidated Fund of India (CFI) and the legal framework for fiscal discipline established by the FRBM Act. The core of the course involves a detailed case study on the Indian telecom sector, examining how taxation, regulation, and government spending influence its growth, stability, and contribution to the national economy. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze fiscal policy documents, evaluate the economic consequences of budgetary decisions, and understand the intricate relationship between national financial management and sectoral performance.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Fusion 360 Milling Basics
desc: Embark on a comprehensive journey into the world of CNC machining with this introductory course on 2D milling in Autodesk Fusion 360. Designed for beginners, this program demystifies the process of turning a digital design into a physically machined part. You will learn to navigate the Fusion 360 Manufacture workspace, a powerful environment for creating, managing, and validating machining operations. The course provides detailed instruction on setting up your project, including defining stock material, establishing work coordinate systems (WCS), and building a tool library. Key learning areas include the creation of essential toolpaths for operations like facing, 2D adaptive clearing for efficient roughing, pocketing, contouring, and drilling. You will gain hands-on experience with Fusion 360's powerful simulation tools to verify your toolpaths, detect potential collisions, and optimize performance for accuracy and efficiency. The course culminates in teaching you how to use post-processors to generate the final G-code, making your program ready for execution on a CNC machine. Upon completion, you will have the confidence and skills to independently prepare 2D milling projects for production.

title: Heat Wave-Disaster Response Training
desc: As extreme weather events become more frequent, understanding how to effectively respond to heat waves is a critical competency for public officials, disaster response teams, and community volunteers. This course offers a comprehensive overview of heat wave disaster response, providing the foundational knowledge needed to mitigate risks and protect lives. The curriculum begins by defining what constitutes a heat wave and explains its physiological impact on the human body, emphasizing the critical importance of acclimatization. Participants will delve into practical mitigation strategies and detailed protective measures that can be implemented at both individual and community levels. The course clearly outlines essential do's and don'ts for heat wave safety, creating a simple yet effective guide for action during a crisis. It also explores the vital role that volunteers can play in supporting official response efforts, from disseminating information to assisting vulnerable populations. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize the dangers of heat waves, implement life-saving safety protocols, and contribute effectively to a coordinated disaster response framework, enhancing community resilience against this growing environmental threat.

title: Introduction to Geospatial Mapping and Scientific Planning
desc: In an era of data-driven governance, the ability to interpret and utilize spatial information is a critical skill for public sector professionals. This course provides a foundational understanding of geospatial mapping and its application in scientific planning. It addresses the growing need for officials to leverage technology for more effective resource allocation, project monitoring, and policy implementation. Learners will delve into the core principles of Geographic Information Systems (GIS), including spatial data structures, layered mapping, and geospatial relationships. The curriculum covers the practical creation and use of base maps for location analysis and thematic maps for visualizing data related to demographics, land use, or environmental factors. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to hands-on training with ISRO's Bhuvan geoportal. Participants will learn to navigate its interface, access Web Map Services (WMS), perform spatial analyses like overlays, and download relevant datasets. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these geospatial techniques to support evidence-based decision-making in diverse fields such as rural development, urban planning, and infrastructure management.

title: Introduction to Sequence Stratigraphy
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the principles of Sequence Stratigraphy. It is designed for geology professionals and students seeking to understand how sedimentary basins are filled over geological time. The curriculum begins by defining core concepts, including the significance of base level fluctuations and the creation of accommodation space for sediments. You will learn to differentiate between depositional trends like transgression and regression, understanding their causes and the distinct rock records they produce. The course then delves into the identification of system tracts (e.g., Lowstand, Transgressive, Highstand) and key stratigraphic surfaces, which are essential for correlating rock layers across large areas. By the end of this course, you will be able to analyze stratal patterns to reconstruct earth history and apply these principles to practical challenges in basin analysis and the exploration for natural resources like oil and gas, making it a valuable skill for any geoscientist.

title: Mining Reforms
desc: This detailed course delves into the critical aspects of India's mining reforms, offering an in-depth understanding of the legal and technical requirements for mineral exploration and mine management. The curriculum is structured around the MMDR Act, 1957 and its subsequent amendments, providing learners with the knowledge to navigate the regulatory landscape effectively. Participants will learn the specific parameters for conducting geological surveys, from reconnaissance (G4) to detailed exploration (G1), and how to prepare compliant geological study reports. The course thoroughly covers the components of pre-feasibility and feasibility studies required to convert mineral resources into mineable reserves. A significant focus is placed on sustainable development, with dedicated modules on mine abandonment, reclamation, and rehabilitation. Learners will understand how to formulate and implement both progressive and final mine closure plans, ensuring that mined-out lands are restored for the benefit of local communities and the environment. This program is essential for professionals seeking to ensure their mining operations are compliant, efficient, and sustainable.

title: Navigating Business Cycles: Working Capital Essentials
desc: In 'Working Capital Management: Fundamentals for Business Cycles', participants will gain a thorough understanding of the principles that govern a firm's short-term financial stability. The course begins by defining working capital and its calculation, breaking down the key elements of current assets and current liabilities. It explores different concepts such as gross vs. net working capital and permanent vs. variable working capital, explaining their relevance in different business scenarios. A key focus is placed on the operating cycle—the time it takes to convert investments in inventory back into cash—and how its management is crucial for maintaining liquidity. Learners will understand why effective working capital management is essential for sustaining operations, meeting debt obligations, and seizing growth opportunities. This program is designed for professionals who need to make or understand financial decisions that impact the operational health and resilience of their organization, particularly within the context of changing economic conditions.

title: Orientation Module on Mission LiFE
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of Mission LiFE, a visionary initiative aimed at democratizing the fight against climate change through individual and collective action. It begins by establishing the context of the current environmental crisis and introduces Mission LiFE as a proactive solution. The module delves into the mission's three core pillars: changing demand, supply, and policy. Learners will explore a comprehensive list of 75 simple, measurable, and actionable steps across seven critical themes, including saving energy and water, reducing waste, and adopting sustainable practices. The content is designed to inspire 'Pro-Planet People' by demonstrating how small behavioral changes in daily life can contribute to a larger movement for environmental protection and conservation. By the end of this course, participants will understand their role as trustees of the planet and feel empowered to adopt and promote a more sustainable lifestyle in their communities and workplaces.
org: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

title: Procurement of Works
desc: This course delves into the critical domain of public procurement, with a specific focus on the execution of works. It is designed for government officials who are responsible for managing public funds and ensuring that procurement processes are conducted with the utmost integrity. The course establishes a strong foundation by explaining the core principles of public procurement: transparency, fairness, competition, economy, efficiency, and accountability. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the General Financial Rules (GFRs), which serve as the primary regulatory framework for these activities. The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of procuring works, from initial planning to final execution. It is particularly beneficial for officers in Integrated Finance Divisions (IFDs) and Administration Divisions who must scrutinize proposals and provide financial concurrence. Through practical insights and rule-based guidance, learners will be empowered to examine procurement proposals critically, identify potential issues, and ensure full compliance with established government instructions. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to manage public procurement functions, mitigate risks, and contribute to the efficient use of public resources.

title: Refunds in Customs
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the processes involved in customs refunds. It is specifically designed for departmental officials, tax practitioners, and professionals who manage or oversee refund claims. The content delves into the critical legal and administrative framework established by the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), providing a solid foundation for compliant and effective processing. Key learning areas include understanding the end-to-end refund process, the specific documentation required for applications, the methods for verification and scrutiny of claims, and the strict timelines that must be followed. Participants will learn how to navigate common errors, issue sanction orders correctly, and manage the final payment process. By completing this course, learners will be proficient in handling customs refund cases with accuracy and confidence, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Securing Your Computer System: Essential PC Hardening Techniques
desc: In an era of increasing cyber threats, securing personal and official computer systems is paramount. This course, ""Securing Computer Systems: Essential PC Hardening Techniques,"" offers a practical, step-by-step approach to enhancing system security. The program begins by identifying common vulnerabilities such as default passwords, unpatched software, and poor configurations that attackers exploit. You will then delve into the core components of system defense. The course provides detailed demonstrations on BIOS hardening, covering how to secure the system at its most fundamental level by setting administrator passwords and controlling boot processes. Following this, you will learn to harden the operating system, with a focus on Windows 11. This includes implementing strong password policies, enabling firewalls, managing user privileges, disabling risky features like Remote Desktop, and setting up interactive logon messages. By completing this course, you will be equipped to significantly reduce your system's attack surface and build a more resilient and secure computing environment.

title: Soft Skills
desc: In today's dynamic professional landscape, soft skills are as crucial as technical expertise. This course is designed to build a strong foundation in the interpersonal attributes that foster effective collaboration and personal management. It delves into the core of what makes a professional effective, covering a wide spectrum of skills including communication, teamwork, problem-solving, emotional intelligence, and leadership. The content emphasizes the practical application of these skills in a professional setting, drawing context from large, collaborative organizations like the Indian Railways, where teamwork is paramount. Learners will explore various facets of communication, from active listening to presentation skills, and understand the value of a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and integrity. By the end of this course, participants will be better equipped to navigate complex interpersonal dynamics, contribute more effectively to team goals, and enhance their overall professional persona, paving the way for career advancement and improved workplace harmony.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Technical Resignation and Lien
desc: Navigating career transitions within the government requires a clear understanding of specific service rules. This course delves into the essential concepts of 'technical resignation' and 'lien,' which are critical for any government employee considering a move to another post or department. You will learn to define what constitutes a technical resignation, identify the necessary conditions and prerequisites, and understand the significant benefits it offers, such as the carry-over of past service. The course also thoroughly explains the concept of a lien, clarifying its role in securing your position and rights during a transition. By the end of this program, you will be equipped to confidently navigate the procedural aspects of technical resignations, ensuring you can protect your service benefits and make strategic career choices within the government framework.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Thundering and Lightning-Disaster Response Training
desc: This self-paced course is designed to build foundational awareness about the dangers of thunderstorms and lightning. It begins by explaining the basic science behind these weather events and clarifies the distinction between them. The core of the course focuses on practical and life-saving safety measures, providing a clear guide on actions to be taken before, during, and after a thunderstorm to mitigate risks. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of community involvement, detailing how volunteers can effectively disseminate information, create awareness, and assist in ensuring public safety during lightning and thundering events. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to protect themselves and contribute to their community's resilience against these common natural hazards.

title: Trafficking Slavery and Forced Labour under Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of the provisions against human trafficking, slavery, and forced labour as codified in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. It is designed for legal and law enforcement professionals seeking to understand the new legislative landscape. The curriculum systematically breaks down Sections 143 through 146, covering the core definitions of trafficking, the various forms of exploitation, and the immateriality of a victim's consent. Participants will learn to distinguish between standard and aggravated forms of these crimes, with a particular focus on the stringent penalties for child trafficking, repeat offences, and the complicity of public servants or police officers. The course further clarifies the legal consequences for exploiting trafficked individuals and engaging in habitual slave trading. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in interpreting and applying these crucial legal provisions, enhancing their capacity to uphold justice and protect vulnerable populations under the new criminal code.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Valuation of Inventory
desc: Dive into the essential principles of inventory valuation with this detailed course designed for finance and accounting professionals. The curriculum begins by establishing a solid foundation, defining what constitutes inventory and explaining the crucial role of accurate valuation in determining a company's financial health. You will gain an in-depth understanding of Accounting Standard 2 (AS2), the primary guideline for inventory valuation in India, and learn how to calculate net realizable value. The course systematically breaks down the most common valuation methods: First-In, First-Out (FIFO), Last-In, First-Out (LIFO), and the Weighted Average Cost method. Through clear explanations and examples, you will learn how to apply these techniques and analyze their distinct impacts on the cost of goods sold, profit margins, and tax liabilities. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to select and implement the appropriate inventory valuation method, ensuring compliance and enhancing the accuracy of your organization's financial reporting.

title: ऑनलाइन गेम
desc: आज के डिजिटल युग में, ऑनलाइन गेमिंग मनोरंजन का एक लोकप्रिय रूप बन गया है, लेकिन यह अपने साथ कई गंभीर जोखिम भी लाता है। यह कोर्स ऑनलाइन गेमिंग की दुनिया में छिपे खतरों के बारे में जागरूकता बढ़ाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इसमें विस्तार से बताया गया है कि कैसे गेमिंग प्लेटफॉर्म कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) का उपयोग करके उपयोगकर्ताओं को आदी बनाते हैं और उन्हें वित्तीय नुकसान की ओर धकेलते हैं। आप विभिन्न प्रकार की धोखाधड़ी के बारे में जानेंगे, जिनमें नकली लॉगिन पेजों के माध्यम से अकाउंट हैकिंग, सोशल इंजीनियरिंग, और वर्चुअल आइटम्स के नाम पर होने वाले घोटाले शामिल हैं। यह कोर्स बच्चों पर ऑनलाइन गेमिंग के नकारात्मक मनोवैज्ञानिक और व्यवहारिक प्रभावों पर भी प्रकाश डालता है, जैसे कि अवसाद, चिड़चिड़ापन और पढ़ाई से ध्यान भटकना। अंत में, आपको इन साइबर खतरों से अपनी और अपने परिवार की सुरक्षा के लिए ठोस और व्यावहारिक कदम सिखाए जाएंगे, जैसे कि टू-फैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन का उपयोग, मजबूत पासवर्ड बनाना और बच्चों के स्क्रीन टाइम की निगरानी करना। इसका उद्देश्य आपको एक सतर्क और साइबर-स्मार्ट नागरिक बनाना है।

title: जल सुरक्षा बढ़ानाः जलाशय पूर्णजीवीकरण की प्रक्रिया
desc: भारत अपनी 18% वैश्विक आबादी के साथ, दुनिया के केवल 4% नवीकरणीय जल संसाधनों का उपयोग करता है, जिससे व्यापक जल तनाव उत्पन्न होता है। यह पाठ्यक्रम 'जलाशय पुनर्जीवीकरण' (आर.डब्ल्यू.बी.) मॉडल का विस्तृत अवलोकन प्रदान करता है, जो जल सुरक्षा बढ़ाने के लिए एक समुदाय-संचालित, प्रौद्योगिकी-सक्षम और लागत-प्रभावी दृष्टिकोण है। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि कैसे यह मॉडल, जिसे कई भारतीय राज्यों में सफलतापूर्वक लागू किया गया है, स्थानीय जल निकायों की भंडारण क्षमता को बढ़ाकर और भूजल पुनर्भरण को बढ़ावा देकर जल की कमी को दूर करता है। शिक्षार्थी इस मॉडल के प्रमुख घटकों का पता लगाएंगे, जिसमें वैज्ञानिक स्थल चयन के लिए ओपन-सोर्स डिजिटल उपकरणों का उपयोग, सामुदायिक भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देना और गाद निकालने की प्रक्रिया का प्रबंधन शामिल है। पाठ्यक्रम का समापन शिक्षार्थियों को आर.डब्ल्यू.बी. परियोजनाओं को प्रभावी ढंग से लागू करने और निगरानी करने के ज्ञान से लैस करेगा, जिससे ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में स्थायी जल प्रबंधन और बेहतर कृषि आजीविका में योगदान होगा।
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: नगरेत्तर भूमि सर्वे एवं डिजिटल अभिलेख अद्यतन परियोजना
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम भारत सरकार के डिजिटल इंडिया भूमि अभिलेख आधुनिकीकरण कार्यक्रम (DILRMP) के संदर्भ में भूमि प्रबंधन के महत्व को रेखांकित करता है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य राजस्व प्रशासन से जुड़े अधिकारियों और कर्मचारियों को नगरेत्तर भूमि सर्वेक्षण की आधुनिक प्रक्रियाओं से अवगत कराना है। पुराने और अपूर्ण भूमि अभिलेखों के कारण उत्पन्न होने वाले विवादों को कम करने और भूमि स्वामित्व को स्पष्ट करने के लिए यह आधुनिकीकरण आवश्यक है। पाठ्यक्रम में, प्रतिभागी हाई-रिज़ॉल्यूशन सैटेलाइट इमेजरी (HRSI), GIS टूल्स और डिजिटल मैपिंग जैसी उन्नत तकनीकों का उपयोग करके सर्वेक्षण करने की चरण-दर-चरण प्रक्रिया सीखेंगे। इसमें सर्वेक्षण की तैयारी, प्रशासनिक कार्य, और वास्तविक सर्वेक्षण कार्यवाही, जिसमें स्थल सत्यापन, दावा-आपत्तियों का निपटारा और अंतिम अधिकार अभिलेख का प्रकाशन शामिल है, को विस्तार से कवर किया जाएगा। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, शिक्षार्थी भूमि सर्वेक्षण परियोजनाओं की योजना बनाने और उन्हें निष्पादित करने में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे एक सटीक, पारदर्शी और कुशल भूमि प्रबंधन प्रणाली सुनिश्चित होगी।
org: RCVP Noronha Academy of Administration and Management (RCVPNAAM) Bhopal

title: न्यायालय की अवमानना: एक अवलोकन
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम 'न्यायालय की अवमानना' के महत्वपूर्ण विषय पर गहन जानकारी प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जो विशेष रूप से लोक सेवकों के लिए प्रासंगिक है। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि क्यों न्यायपालिका की अखंडता और अधिकार को बनाए रखना एक कार्यात्मक लोकतंत्र के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। इसमें न्यायालय की अवमानना अधिनियम, 1971 के प्रमुख प्रावधानों को शामिल किया गया है, जिसमें नागरिक और आपराधिक अवमानना के बीच अंतर को स्पष्ट किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी विभिन्न ऐतिहासिक मामलों और न्यायिक व्याख्याओं के माध्यम से सीखेंगे कि कैसे अदालतों ने अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता के अधिकार को अवमानना कानून के साथ संतुलित किया है। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों को अपने आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों का पालन करते समय और सार्वजनिक बयान देते समय संभावित कानूनी नुकसान से बचने के लिए ज्ञान और समझ से लैस करना है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी न्यायिक प्रक्रियाओं का सम्मान करते हुए अपने कर्तव्यों को अधिक आत्मविश्वास और कानूनी स्पष्टता के साथ पूरा करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: बाढ़ प्रबंधन
desc: भारत में बाढ़ एक आवर्ती प्राकृतिक आपदा है, जो हर साल लाखों लोगों को प्रभावित करती है। प्रभावी बाढ़ प्रबंधन जीवन और संपत्ति की रक्षा के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। यह पाठ्यक्रम इसी संदर्भ में डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जो शिक्षार्थियों को बाढ़ प्रबंधन के सभी पहलुओं से परिचित कराता है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत बाढ़ की परिभाषा, इसके विभिन्न प्रकारों और भारत में बाढ़-प्रवण क्षेत्रों की पहचान से होती है। इसके बाद, यह बाढ़ से होने वाले नुकसान के आकलन और जोखिम मूल्यांकन पर चर्चा करता है। पाठ्यक्रम का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा प्रबंधन रणनीतियों को समर्पित है, जिसमें तटबंधों और बांधों जैसे संरचनात्मक उपायों के साथ-साथ भूमि-उपयोग योजना और प्रारंभिक चेतावनी प्रणालियों जैसे गैर-संरचनात्मक उपायों को विस्तार से समझाया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, शिक्षार्थी बाढ़ की चुनौतियों को बेहतर ढंग से समझ सकेंगे और अपने कार्यक्षेत्र में न्यूनीकरण प्रयासों में प्रभावी रूप से योगदान कर पाएंगे।
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

title: भवन निर्माण उपविधियाँ और मानदंड
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों, विशेष रूप से शहरी विकास और लोक निर्माण में शामिल लोगों के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, ताकि उन्हें भवन निर्माण को नियंत्रित करने वाले नियामक ढांचे की व्यापक समझ मिल सके। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात की पड़ताल करता है कि भवन उपविधियां क्यों महत्वपूर्ण हैं, जो स्थानीय अधिकारियों द्वारा सुरक्षा और व्यवस्थित विकास सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बनाए गए कानूनी नियम हैं। यह मानकों पर भी चर्चा करता है, जो राष्ट्रीय भवन संहिता (एनबीसी) जैसे तकनीकी दिशानिर्देश हैं जो निर्माण में गुणवत्ता, सुरक्षा और दक्षता को परिभाषित करते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त, पाठ्यक्रम मानदंडों की अवधारणा को शामिल करता है, जो टिकाऊ शहरी विकास को बढ़ावा देने वाले नीति-आधारित दिशानिर्देश हैं। व्यावहारिक उदाहरणों के माध्यम से, जैसे कि एक इंजीनियरिंग कॉलेज की स्थापना, शिक्षार्थी यह समझेंगे कि कैसे ये तीनों तत्व भूमि उपयोग, डिजाइन, सुरक्षा और पर्यावरणीय विचारों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए मिलकर काम करते हैं। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, प्रतिभागी निर्माण परियोजनाओं की योजना बनाने और उन्हें मंजूरी देने में इन नियमों को प्रभावी ढंग से लागू करने में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे बेहतर और सुरक्षित शहरी वातावरण में योगदान मिलेगा।
org: RCVP Noronha Academy of Administration and Management (RCVPNAAM) Bhopal

title: मध्यप्रदेश नजूल भूमि निर्वर्तन 2020
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से 'मध्य प्रदेश नजूल भूमि निर्वर्तन निर्देश, 2020' के प्रावधानों और प्रक्रियाओं पर केंद्रित है। इसका उद्देश्य राजस्व अधिकारियों को नजूल भूमि के प्रबंधन और निपटान के लिए एक मानकीकृत और पारदर्शी ढांचा प्रदान करना है। पाठ्यक्रम में 9 अध्याय और 148 खंड शामिल हैं, जो नजूल भूमि की परिभाषा से लेकर विभिन्न प्रयोजनों के लिए इसके आवंटन तक के सभी पहलुओं को कवर करते हैं, जैसे कि भूमिहीन व्यक्तियों को कृषि हेतु आवंटन, सहकारी समितियों को आवंटन, और निवेश परियोजनाओं के लिए भूमि का निपटान। इसमें स्थायी पट्टे, पट्टा नवीनीकरण, नीलामी और लाइसेंसिंग की चरण-दर-चरण प्रक्रियाओं की व्याख्या की गई है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह पाठ्यक्रम जिला, संभाग और राज्य स्तर पर गठित त्रिस्तरीय समितियों की भूमिकाओं और जिम्मेदारियों पर भी प्रकाश डालता है। प्रतिभागी भू-भाटक, प्रीमियम दरों के निर्धारण और अपील प्रक्रियाओं से संबंधित वित्तीय प्रावधानों को भी समझेंगे, जिससे वे अपने कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन कुशलतापूर्वक और कानून के अनुसार कर सकें।
org: RCVP Noronha Academy of Administration and Management (RCVPNAAM) Bhopal

title: लक्षित सार्वजनिक वितरण प्रणाली
desc: यह विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों को भारत में लक्षित सार्वजनिक वितरण प्रणाली (टीपीडीएस) के प्रभावी कार्यान्वयन के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान और कौशल से लैस करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम (एनएफएसए), 2013, उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम और आवश्यक वस्तु अधिनियम सहित प्रमुख कानूनी ढाँचों की गहन समझ प्रदान करता है। प्रतिभागी खाद्यान्न की खरीद, वैज्ञानिक भंडारण और उचित मूल्य की दुकानों (एफपीएस) के माध्यम से कुशल वितरण की परिचालन जटिलताओं का पता लगाएंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में लाभार्थी प्रबंधन के महत्वपूर्ण पहलुओं, जैसे पात्र परिवारों की पहचान, ई-केवाईसी की अनिवार्यता, और अपात्र लाभार्थियों को हटाने की प्रक्रिया पर भी ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है। इसके अलावा, यह स्मार्ट पीडीएस पहलों के माध्यम से प्रणाली में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही बढ़ाने पर विशेष जोर देता है, जिसमें ई-पीओएस मशीनों, रियल-टाइम ट्रैकिंग और मोबाइल एप्लिकेशन का उपयोग शामिल है। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा होने पर, शिक्षार्थी खाद्य सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने, लीकेज को कम करने और नागरिक सेवाओं में सुधार के लिए टीपीडीएस का प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधन करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: RCVP Noronha Academy of Administration and Management (RCVPNAAM) Bhopal

title: सामान्य और तनाव की स्थिति के लिए योग अभ्यास
desc: यह व्यापक योग पाठ्यक्रम शिक्षार्थियों को तनाव को प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधित करने और समग्र स्वास्थ्य को बढ़ावा देने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान और कौशल से लैस करने के लिए बनाया गया है। आज के तेज-तर्रार पेशेवर जीवन में, मानसिक और शारीरिक कल्याण बनाए रखना सर्वोपरि है, और यह मॉड्यूल ਇਸ दिशा में एक व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शिका प्रदान करता है। पाठ्यक्रम में विभिन्न प्रकार के योग आसन शामिल हैं, जो débutants से लेकर सभी स्तरों के अभ्यासियों के लिए उपयुक्त हैं। इसमें सूर्य नमस्कार, त्रिकोणासन, और वृक्षासन जैसे प्रमुख आसन शामिल हैं जो शरीर में लचीलापन, शक्ति और संतुलन बनाने में मदद करते हैं। इसके अलावा, पाठ्यक्रम श्वास तकनीकों (प्राणायाम) और ध्यान के महत्व पर जोर देता है, जो तंत्रिका तंत्र को शांत करने और मानसिक स्पष्टता में सुधार करने में सहायक होते हैं। शिक्षार्थी सीखेंगे कि इन तकनीकों को अपनी दिनचर्या में कैसे एकीकृत किया जाए ताकि वे तनाव का बेहतर ढंग से सामना कर सकें और अपनी उत्पादकता बढ़ा सकें। पाठ्यक्रम का समापन योग निद्रा जैसे آرام بخش अभ्यासों के साथ होता है, जो गहरे विश्राम और पुनर्स्थापना को बढ़ावा देता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, शिक्षार्थी अपने शारीरिक और मानसिक स्वास्थ्य की देखभाल के लिए एक स्थायी अभ्यास स्थापित करने में सक्षम होंगे।

title: सेवा में शामिल होने की औपचारिकताएँ: नए कर्मचारियों के लिए मार्गदर्शन
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से केंद्र सरकार की सेवा में नए प्रवेश करने वाले कर्मचारियों के लिए एक व्यापक मार्गदर्शिका है। इसका उद्देश्य नियुक्ति के बाद पूरी की जाने वाली सभी महत्वपूर्ण औपचारिकताओं को सरल और स्पष्ट तरीके से समझाना है। पाठ्यक्रम में, शिक्षार्थी जन्मतिथि की घोषणा और उसमें बदलाव से संबंधित नियमों, विभिन्न शैक्षिक योग्यताओं के सत्यापन की प्रक्रिया, और अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति/अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग/ईडब्ल्यूएस जैसे आरक्षण प्रमाण पत्रों को जमा करने की अनिवार्यता के बारे में जानेंगे। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह पाठ्यक्रम राजपत्रित और गैर-राजपत्रित पदों के लिए आवश्यक चिकित्सा फिटनेस प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त करने की प्रक्रिया पर भी प्रकाश डालता है। शिक्षार्थियों को शपथ और घोषणाओं के महत्व तथा सेवा पुस्तिका (सर्विस बुक) के विभिन्न भागों और उसके सही रखरखाव की प्रक्रिया को भी समझाया जाएगा। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, नए कर्मचारी अपनी सेवा की शुरुआत से ही सभी नियमों का अनुपालन करने में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे एक सुचारू और व्यवस्थित करियर सुनिश्चित होगा।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: অতি বৰষুণ
desc: মেঘ বিস্ফোৰণ এক ভয়ংকৰ প্ৰাকৃতিক দুৰ্যোগ, বিশেষকৈ হিমালয়ৰ দৰে পাৰ্বত্য অঞ্চলত ইয়াৰ প্ৰভাৱ অধিক বিধ্বংসী। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো বিশেষভাৱে জনসাধাৰণ, স্বেচ্ছাসেৱক আৰু দুৰ্যোগ ব্যৱস্থাপনাৰ সৈতে জড়িত ব্যক্তিসকলৰ বাবে প্ৰস্তুত কৰা হৈছে, যাতে তেওঁলোকে এই দুৰ্যোগৰ বিষয়ে সঠিক জ্ঞান আহৰণ কৰিব পাৰে। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোত মেঘ বিস্ফোৰণ কিয় আৰু কেনেকৈ হয়, তাৰ বৈজ্ঞানিক কাৰণসমূহ সৰল ভাষাত বুজোৱা হৈছে। ইয়াৰ ফলত হ'ব পৰা আকস্মিক বান, ভূমিস্খলন আৰু অন্যান্য ক্ষয়-ক্ষতিৰ বিষয়েও বিতংভাৱে আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে। অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে আগতীয়া সতৰ্কবাণী প্ৰণালীৰ গুৰুত্ব, দুৰ্যোগৰ সময়ত কৰণীয় আৰু বৰ্জনীয় কাৰ্য্যসমূহ, আৰু উদ্ধাৰ অভিযানত স্বেচ্ছাসেৱকৰ ভূমিকাৰ বিষয়ে শিকিব। এই জ্ঞানেৰে সজ্জিত হৈ, আপুনি কেৱল নিজৰেই নহয়, বৰঞ্চ আপোনাৰ সম্প্ৰদায়ৰ আন লোকসকলৰো জীৱন ৰক্ষা কৰাত সহায় কৰিব পাৰিব।

title: তাপপ্ৰবাহ
desc: global উষ্ণতা বৃদ্ধিৰ লগে লগে তাপপ্ৰবাহ এক গুৰുত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰାकृतिक দুৰ্যোগ হিচাপে পৰিগণিত হৈছে, যিয়ে জনজীৱন আৰু स्वास्थ्यৰ ওপৰt গভীৰ প্ৰভাৱ পেলায়। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰమটো তাপপ্ৰবাহৰ বিষয়ে সজাগতা সৃষ্টি কৰিবলৈ আৰু ইয়াৰ সৈতে মোকাবিলা কৰাৰ বাবে প্ৰয়োজনীয় জ্ঞান প্ৰदान কৰিবলৈ तयार কৰা হৈছে। ইয়াত তাপপ্ৰবাহৰ वैज्ञानिक কাৰণ, ভাৰতীয় मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) ద్వారా নিৰ্ধাৰিত ಮಾನদণ্ড, আৰু ভাৰতৰ संवेदनशील অঞ্চলসমূহৰ বিষয়ে আলোচনা কৰা হৈছে। শিক্ষাৰ্থীসকলে তাপপ্ৰবাহৰ ফলত হোৱা বিভিন্ন স্বাস্থ্যজনিত समस्या, যেনে হিট ক্ৰмп আৰু হিটষ্ট্ৰোকৰ लक्षण আৰু প্ৰাথমিক চিকিৎসাৰ বিষয়ে শিকিব। পাঠ্যক্ৰమটোত চৰকাৰী সতৰ্কবাণী বুজি পোৱা, व्यक्तिगत স্তৰত 'কৰণীয় আৰু বৰ্জনীয়'সমূহ পালন কৰা, আৰু ঘৰ শীতল ৰখাৰ কৌশলসমূহৰ ওপৰত গুৰুত্ব দিয়া হৈছে। ইয়াৰ উপৰিও, এই পাঠ্যক্ৰమটোৱে স্বেচ্ছাসেৱকসকলক community തലত সজাগতা বৃদ্ধি কৰা আৰু प्रभावित লোকসকলক সহায় কৰাৰ ক্ষেত্ৰত তেওঁলোকৰ ভূমিকা কি হ'ব লাগে, সেই বিষয়ে માર્ગદર્શન দিয়ে।

title: નોંધણી અધિનિયમ ૧૯૦૮
desc: આ કોર્સ નોંધણી અધિનિયમ, ૧૯૦૮ ના દરેક પાસાને ઊંડાણપૂર્વક સમજાવવા માટે તૈયાર કરવામાં આવ્યો છે. તેની શરૂઆત અધિનિયમની મુખ્ય વ્યાખ્યાઓ, જેમ કે 'સ્થાવર મિલકત', 'લીઝ', અને 'સબ-રજિસ્ટ્રાર' થી થાય છે. ત્યારબાદ, તે નોંધણી કચેરીઓની સ્થાપના અને રજિસ્ટ્રાર તથા સબ-રજિસ્ટ્રારની નિમણૂક અને સત્તાઓ વિશે વિગતવાર માહિતી આપે છે. કોર્સમાં કયા દસ્તાવેજોની નોંધણી ફરજિયાત છે (જેમ કે વેચાણ, બક્ષિસ અથવા ગીરો) અને કયા વૈકલ્પિક છે (જેમ કે વિલ) તે સ્પષ્ટપણે સમજાવવામાં આવ્યું છે. આ ઉપરાંત, દસ્તાવેજ રજૂ કરવાની સમય મર્યાદા, નોંધણી અધિકારી દ્વારા તપાસની પ્રક્રિયા, અને નોંધણીનો ઇનકાર કરવાના કારણો પર પણ ચર્ચા કરવામાં આવી છે. શીખનારાઓ નોંધાયેલા દસ્તાવેજોની કાયદાકીય અસરો અને નોંધણી ન કરવાના ગંભીર પરિણામો વિશે પણ શીખશે. આ કોર્સ મહેસૂલ, જમીન રેકોર્ડ અને કાનૂની વિભાગોમાં કામ કરતા અધિકારીઓ માટે અત્યંત ઉપયોગી છે.
org: Sardar Patel Institute of Public Administration (SPIPA)

title: గవర్నెన్స్ కోసం డేటా మరియు ఆధారాల వినియోగంలో కేస్ స్టడీస్
desc: ప్రభుత్వ పాలనలో నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకోవడానికి కఠినమైన సాక్ష్యాల ఆవశ్యకత పెరుగుతున్న నేపథ్యంలో, ఈ కోర్సు విధాన రూపకల్పన మరియు మూల్యాంకనం కోసం ఒక ఆచరణాత్మక మార్గదర్శినిని అందిస్తుంది. ఇది కేవలం సిద్ధాంతపరమైనది కాదు, భారతదేశంలోని వివిధ సందర్భాల నుండి తీసుకున్న నాలుగు వివరణాత్మక కేస్ స్టడీస్‌లో లోతుగా మునిగి తేలుతుంది. అభ్యాసకులు గుజరాత్‌లో పారిశ్రామిక కాలుష్యాన్ని నియంత్రించడానికి థర్డ్-పార్టీ ఆడిట్‌లను ఎలా ఉపయోగించారో, హర్యానాలో పాఠశాల విద్యార్థులలో లింగ పక్షపాతాన్ని ఎలా ఎదుర్కొన్నారో, మరియు మధ్యప్రదేశ్‌లో గృహ హింసపై పోలీసుల ప్రతిస్పందనను ఎలా మెరుగుపరిచారో అన్వేషిస్తారు. ప్రతి కేస్ స్టడీ 'థియరీ ఆఫ్ చేంజ్' ఫ్రేమ్‌వర్క్‌ను ఎలా వర్తింపజేయాలో, రాండమైజ్డ్ కంట్రోల్డ్ ట్రయల్ (RCT)ని ఎలా రూపొందించాలో, మరియు ప్రభావాన్ని ఖచ్చితంగా కొలవడానికి డేటాను ఎలా సేకరించి విశ్లేషించాలో వివరిస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సును పూర్తి చేయడం ద్వారా, ప్రభుత్వ అధికారులు తమ కార్యక్రమాల ప్రభావాన్ని శాస్త్రీయంగా అంచనా వేయడానికి, వనరులను మరింత సమర్థవంతంగా కేటాయించడానికి మరియు పౌరులకు మెరుగైన ఫలితాలను అందించడానికి అవసరమైన నైపుణ్యాలను పొందుతారు.

title: ಆಡಳಿತಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಪುರಾವೆಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಗಳು
desc: ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಧಾರಿತ ನೀತಿ ನಿರೂಪಣೆಯು ಆಧುನಿಕ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಮೂಲಾಧಾರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಲಯದ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ, ಅನುಷ್ಠಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಅನ್ವಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ನೋಟವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಗುಜರಾತ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿನ ಮಾಲಿನ್ಯ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೂರನೇ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆಡಿಟ್‌ಗಳು, ಹರಿಯಾಣದ ಶಾಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಲಿಂಗ ಸಮಾನತೆಯನ್ನು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸುವ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರ ಮೇಲಿನ ದೌರ್ಜನ್ಯವನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಸಹಾಯವಾಣಿಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯಂತಹ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಗಳನ್ನು ಇದು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ, ಬಿಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿನ ಬಡತನ ನಿರ್ಮೂಲನೆ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವ 'ಪ್ರಥಮ್' ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳನ್ನೂ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿತ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳ (RCTs)ಂತಹ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು ನೀತಿಗಳ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಡಳಿತಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯುಳ್ಳ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುವವರು ಅರಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title: വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കം മാനേജ്മെൻ്റ്
desc: വെള്ളപ്പൊക്ക നിയന്ത്രണത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള അടിസ്ഥാന തത്വങ്ങൾ പഠിതാക്കളെ പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനാണ് ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് രൂപകൽപ്പന ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഇന്ത്യയിലെ വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കത്തിന്റെ കാരണങ്ങൾ, വിവിധതരം വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കങ്ങൾ, അവയുടെ ആഘാതം എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ച് കോഴ്‌സിൽ വിശദമായി ചർച്ചചെയ്യുന്നു. വെള്ളപ്പൊക്ക സാധ്യതയുള്ള പ്രദേശങ്ങൾ തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നതിനും, ഘടനാപരവും അല്ലാത്തതുമായ ലഘൂകരണ മാർഗ്ഗങ്ങൾ മനസ്സിലാക്കുന്നതിനും പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് സാധിക്കും. വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കം മൂലമുണ്ടാകുന്ന നാശനഷ്ടങ്ങൾ കുറയ്ക്കുന്നതിനും, ദുരന്തനിവാരണ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾ ഏകോപിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനും, പൊതുജന സുരക്ഷ ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നതിനും ആവശ്യമായ അറിവും വൈദഗ്ധ്യവും ഈ കോഴ്സിലൂടെ നേടാനാകും. ദുരന്തനിവാരണ രംഗത്ത് പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്ന ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥർക്കും ഈ വിഷയത്തിൽ താല്പര്യമുള്ളവർക്കും ഈ കോഴ്സ് ഏറെ പ്രയോജനകരമാണ്.
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

title: 'Namami Gange : A Sustainable Model for River Rejuvenation'
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the 'Namami Gange' program, a critical initiative by the Government of India to restore the ecological and spiritual significance of the River Ganga. The program begins by setting the context, detailing India's water resource scenario, the causes of river pollution, and the historical efforts in Ganga conservation. Learners will delve into the five foundational pillars of the mission: Nirmal Ganga (unpolluted flow), Aviral Ganga (unrestricted flow), Jan Ganga (public participation), Gyan Ganga (knowledge and research), and Arth Ganga (sustainable economic models). The course elaborates on key interventions, including the creation of sewerage infrastructure, industrial effluent management, biodiversity conservation, and community engagement. Upon completion, participants will have a holistic understanding of this integrated river rejuvenation model and its impact on environmental sustainability and water governance.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: National Water Academy Central Water Commission Pune

title: (1) Mining Lease up to Letter of Intent (2) Mining Plan
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the statutory processes involved in India's mining sector. It is structured into two key modules: securing a mining lease and the formulation of a mining plan. Learners will first navigate the legal pathway for obtaining a mining lease, covering the auction process as defined by the Mineral Auction Rules, 2015, and the steps leading to the issuance of a Letter of Intent (LoI). The course thoroughly examines the provisions of the MMDR Act, 1957, and its amendments, providing a solid foundation in the governing legislation. The second part focuses on the practical aspects of preparing a compliant mining plan. It details the necessary components, such as geological reports, environmental management plans, and operational proposals. Participants will learn about the online submission system managed by the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), the scrutiny process, and the criteria for approval. By completing this course, officials and professionals will be equipped to manage the techno-legal documentation and procedures required for lawful and systematic mining operations.

title: 10 DEC 24 TEST COURSE
desc: This course serves as an introductory module on the principles of assessment within the defence sector. It is intended for officers and personnel who are new to the field of evaluation and testing. The curriculum covers fundamental topics, including the purpose of assessments in military contexts, different types of evaluation methods for personnel and systems, and the basic steps involved in the assessment process. While specific tools and classified techniques are not detailed, participants will gain a conceptual understanding of how to approach assessment tasks for capability development and operational readiness. The goal is to equip learners with the foundational knowledge required to explore more advanced topics in testing and evaluation within their respective professional roles.

title: 33/11 के.वी. सब-स्टेशन का संचालन एवं निरीक्षण और रखरखाव
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम विद्युत वितरण प्रणाली में 33/11 केवी सब-स्टेशनों की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका पर केंद्रित है। इसका उद्देश्य सब-स्टेशन के संचालन और रखरखाव से जुड़े तकनीकी कर्मियों को आवश्यक ज्ञान और कौशल प्रदान करना है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत विद्युत प्रणाली की मूल संरचना और सब-स्टेशनों के उद्देश्य से होती है, जिसमें पावर ट्रांसफार्मर, सर्किट ब्रेकर, आइसोलेटर और नियंत्रण कक्ष जैसे प्रमुख उपकरणों की विस्तृत जानकारी दी जाती है। इसमें सुरक्षित संचालन प्रक्रियाओं, परमिट-टू-वर्क सिस्टम और व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरणों के उपयोग पर विशेष जोर दिया गया है। शिक्षार्थी नियमित निरीक्षण, निवारक रखरखाव और उपकरणों के परीक्षण के तरीकों को सीखेंगे ताकि उपकरणों की लंबी आयु और प्रदर्शन सुनिश्चित हो सके। पाठ्यक्रम में सामान्य दोषों का पता लगाने, आपातकालीन स्थितियों से निपटने और विद्युत आपूर्ति को जल्दी से बहाल करने की प्रक्रियाओं को भी शामिल किया गया है।
org: RCVP Noronha Academy of Administration and Management (RCVPNAAM) Bhopal

title: 3D Printing in Fusion
desc: Dive deep into the world of additive manufacturing with this focused course on preparing models for 3D printing within the Fusion environment. The program is structured to provide a robust understanding of why specific design considerations are critical for successful 3D printing. You will learn the end-to-end workflows for two of the most common printing technologies: Fused Filament Fabrication (FFF) and Stereolithography (SLA). Key learning areas include setting up a print job, creating and optimizing support structures, fine-tuning print settings for a balance of speed and quality, and understanding the unique requirements of SLA printing. Upon completion, you will be proficient in simulating, optimizing, and exporting models from Fusion, enabling you to produce high-quality physical prototypes and parts with confidence and efficiency. This course is ideal for designers, engineers, and technicians looking to master the production phase of the digital manufacturing process.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: 4G and 5G Mobile Communication and QoS/QoE
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of fourth and fifth-generation mobile network technologies. It begins by tracing the evolution of mobile communication through the various 3GPP releases, providing context for the significant advancements in 4G and 5G. Learners will gain a deep understanding of the 4G LTE architecture, including the Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and E-UTRAN, and the key technologies that enable its performance, such as OFDMA and MIMO. The curriculum then transitions to 5G, outlining its new network architecture, including the 5G Core (5GC) and gNodeB, and its service goals like eMBB, URLLC, and mMTC. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the concepts of Quality of Service (QoS) and Quality of Experience (QoE). Participants will learn how these metrics are defined, measured through KPIs and Mean Opinion Scores (MOS), and managed within the network to ensure a high-quality user experience for diverse applications, from voice calls to high-speed data and AI-driven services. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze and compare the capabilities of 4G and 5G networks from both a technical and user-centric perspective.

title: 4G and 5G Network Architecture
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of 4G and 5G mobile network architectures, designed for professionals seeking to understand the technological evolution of modern telecommunications. The curriculum begins by outlining the key goals of LTE and its all-IP based architecture, which was designed to significantly increase data speeds and reduce latency compared to 3G networks. You will learn about the fundamental building blocks of 4G, including the E-UTRAN radio network, the Evolved Packet Core (EPC), and the roles of technologies like OFDMA and MIMO. The course then progresses to the next generation, introducing the 5G network architecture. It covers the new 5G core, the gNodeB base station, and the key driving factors such as enhanced mobile broadband (EMBB), massive machine-type communication (MMTC), and ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC). By the end of this course, learners will be able to compare 4G and 5G systems, understand their deployment options, and appreciate their impact on digital communication services.

title: 4G Core Architecture
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the 4G LTE core network, beginning with a brief history of mobile network evolution and the various 3GPP releases that have shaped modern telecommunications. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the Evolved Packet System (EPS) architecture, which forms the backbone of 4G services. The content is structured into four key modules. The first module covers the history and system requirements of LTE. The second module breaks down the 4G network architecture, detailing the functionality of each core entity, including the Mobility Management Entity (MME), Serving Gateway (SGW), Packet Data Network Gateway (PGW), and Home Subscriber Subsystem (HSS). The third module focuses on the various identities used within the network, such as IMSI, GUTI, and C-RNTI, which are crucial for device management and security. The final module provides a practical perspective on how these 4G entities are interconnected and integrated with existing BSNL nodes, referencing the deployment by partners like C-DOT and Tejas. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze and understand the operational framework of a 4G core network.

title: 4G Core Architecture
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of 4G Core Architecture, specifically focusing on the Evolved Packet Core (EPC). It is designed for professionals in the telecommunications domain seeking to understand the transition from legacy circuit-switched networks to a fully IP-based system. The curriculum delves into the key functional entities of the EPC, including the Mobility Management Entity (MME), Serving Gateway (S-GW), Packet Data Network Gateway (P-GW), and the Home Subscriber Server (HSS). Participants will learn how these components interact to manage user mobility, establish data sessions, and ensure seamless connectivity. The course explains the underlying protocols and interfaces, providing a clear picture of data and signaling flows within the network. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to analyze the structure of 4G networks, understand their operational procedures, and appreciate their role in the broader digital communication landscape, which is critical for planning and managing modern telecom infrastructure in the public sector.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 4G RAN Architecture
desc: This in-depth technical course offers a detailed exploration of the 4G LTE Radio Access Network (RAN) architecture, a cornerstone of modern mobile communication. As telecom networks evolve to support high-speed data services, a thorough understanding of the underlying infrastructure is essential for engineers and technical staff. This program is specifically designed to build foundational and advanced knowledge relevant to the deployment and management of 4G networks, such as the nationwide rollout by BSNL. The curriculum begins with an introduction to LTE, highlighting its advantages over legacy 2G/3G systems, such as increased data rates and spectral efficiency. Learners will study the 'flat architecture' concept, focusing on the central role of the eNodeB. The course covers the critical interfaces, including the S1 for core network connectivity and the X2 for inter-eNodeB communication. A significant portion is dedicated to the internal components of the eNodeB, such as the Baseband Unit (BBU) and Remote Radio Head (RRH), and their functions. Upon completion, participants will be able to analyze the LTE frame structure, understand advanced technologies like MIMO and Carrier Aggregation, and grasp the procedures for eNodeB installation and commissioning. This knowledge is directly applicable to roles in network planning, deployment, and maintenance within the telecommunications sector.

title: 5G Air interface - Part 2
desc: This course offers an in-depth technical overview of the 5G air interface, designed for professionals seeking to understand the core components of 5G New Radio (NR). The content begins by explaining why the concept of numerology is central to 5G's adaptability, detailing how variable subcarrier spacing (SCS) and resource blocks are defined by 3GPP standards. You will learn to differentiate between the operational characteristics of Frequency Range 1 (FR1) and Frequency Range 2 (FR2), including their supported bandwidths and specific use cases. The course then delves into the practical application of these principles through carrier aggregation, a critical technology for boosting network capacity and speed. It covers intra-band, inter-band, and dual connectivity scenarios, illustrating how multiple frequency bands are combined to enhance user experience and network efficiency. Upon completion, you will possess a strong foundational knowledge of the 5G air interface, enabling you to analyze and discuss its key technologies in a professional context.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Air interface - Part 3
desc: This course offers an in-depth technical overview of the 5G air interface, a critical component of next-generation wireless networks. The content is designed for technical professionals who need to understand the core mechanics of how 5G achieves its high performance and low latency. The course begins by deconstructing the 5G NR frame structure, explaining the hierarchy of frames, subframes, slots, and symbols. It then delves into the concept of numerology and Sub-Carrier Spacing (SCS), clarifying how their flexibility allows 5G to support diverse services, from mobile broadband to critical communications. Learners will be introduced to the 5G resource grid, the foundational framework for time-frequency resource allocation. A key focus is on scheduling techniques, where the course contrasts traditional slot-based scheduling with the more agile mini-slot based scheduling. You will learn why mini-slots are essential for enabling Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication (URLLC) use cases. Upon completion, participants will have a solid grasp of the architectural and operational principles governing the 5G air interface, enabling them to contribute to network planning, optimization, and innovation.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Air Interface Part 1
desc: As telecommunications evolve towards the fifth generation, a comprehensive understanding of the 5G air interface is crucial for professionals in the sector. This course, 'Fundamentals of the 5G Air Interface: Part 1,' serves as an essential introduction to the technologies that enable 5G's enhanced speed and efficiency. It addresses the importance of spectrum management and the technical parameters that define 5G radio access networks. The curriculum delves into the specifics of frequency allocation, detailing the International Telecommunication Union's (ITU) earmarking for IMT and the distinct characteristics of Frequency Range 1 (FR1) and Frequency Range 2 (FR2). Learners will gain insights into the bandwidths supported in each band, the flexible concept of numerologies that allows 5G to cater to diverse use cases, and the fundamental structure of a resource block. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the key spectrum-related aspects of the 5G air interface. This knowledge is vital for engineers, planners, and policymakers involved in the deployment and regulation of next-generation wireless networks. This course provides the necessary groundwork for understanding the complexities of 5G network performance and capabilities.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G and Satellite Part 1
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of how satellite systems are being integrated into the 5G ecosystem to enhance global connectivity. It begins by defining non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) and referencing key 3GPP standards (Release 15 and 16) that govern this convergence. You will learn about the different types of satellite orbits—Geostationary (GEO), Medium Earth Orbit (MEO), and Low Earth Orbit (LEO)—and their specific implications for 5G network performance. The course thoroughly explores practical use cases, such as providing high-speed backhaul to terrestrial 5G cells in unserved regions, ensuring network resilience during disasters, and enabling massive IoT (mMTC) deployments. Furthermore, it explains the technical architecture of using satellites as a 'bent pipe' or transparent payload, detailing how 5G signals are relayed without modification. Upon completion, you will have a strong foundational knowledge of the synergy between 5G and satellite technology, preparing you for more advanced topics in next-generation communication networks.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G and Satellite Part 2
desc: As 5G technology evolves, integrating it with non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) is crucial for achieving universal connectivity. This course offers a detailed technical exploration of the advanced architectures that enable 5G and satellite integration. It moves beyond basic concepts to dissect specific implementation models and their implications for network performance and service delivery. Key learning areas include the 'regenerative payload' model where the gNodeB is deployed directly on the satellite, the gNodeB split architecture (CU/DU) for flexible deployment, and multi-connectivity scenarios that blend terrestrial and satellite access. The course examines the critical interfaces like XN for mobility, F1 for split architecture, and the Satellite Radio Interface (SRI). Learners will also understand protocol stack implications, PDU session management, and the necessity of adjusting timers to manage satellite-induced latency. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze complex 5G-NTN architectures and contribute to the design and deployment of robust, next-generation communication networks.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Core Architecture Part 1
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the 5G Core (5GC) network, designed for technical professionals and policymakers in the telecommunications sector. The curriculum begins by explaining the context for the evolution from 4G Evolved Packet Core (EPC) to the more flexible and powerful 5G architecture.
