Key learning areas include a deep dive into the Service-Based Architecture (SBA), which allows for modularity and scalability, and an exploration of primary network functions such as the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), and User Plane Function (UPF). Learners will understand the separation of the control and user planes and its significance. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to describe the foundational structure of a 5G network, preparing them for more advanced topics in 5G technology and its application in public services.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Core Architecture Part 2
desc: This advanced technical course provides an in-depth continuation of the 5G Core network, focusing specifically on its Service-Based Architecture (SBA). The curriculum is designed for telecom professionals seeking to master the next generation of mobile networks. The course begins by contrasting the SBA with traditional reference point architectures, highlighting the move towards cloud-native functions and API-based interfaces. You will explore the specific roles of crucial network functions, including the Network Repository Function (NRF), Application Function (AF), Authentication Server Function (AUSF), Network Exposure Function (NEF), and Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF). A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical, real-world scenarios. This includes a detailed analysis of 5G roaming, differentiating between local breakout and home-routed traffic models. Furthermore, the course explains the mechanisms for connecting non-3GPP networks, such as trusted and untrusted Wi-Fi, into the 5G core. By completing this module, you will be equipped to analyze and explain the sophisticated, flexible, and service-oriented nature of the 5G core.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Core Architecture Part 2
desc: As telecommunications evolve towards 5G, understanding its underlying architecture is crucial for professionals in the sector. This course provides a detailed examination of the essential network functions that form the 5G core. Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), which governs user connectivity, mobility, and signaling. The curriculum then explores the Session Management Function (SMF) for session control and IP address allocation, and the User Plane Function (UPF) for data routing and Quality of Service (QoS) enforcement. Furthermore, the course clarifies the roles of the Unified Data Management (UDM) and Policy Control Function (PCF) in handling subscriber data, authentication, and policy enforcement. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to describe the intricate workings of these core components, their interfaces, and their collective importance in building and maintaining robust, intelligent, and efficient 5G networks. This knowledge is fundamental for anyone involved in telecom network planning, operations, or policy.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Core Network Architecture
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the 5G Core (5GC) Network Architecture, a critical component of modern mobile communication systems. The program begins by outlining the high-level 5G system, including the User Equipment (UE), Next-Generation Radio Access Network (NG-RAN), and the core network itself. You will explore the fundamental concepts of PDU sessions, which manage data traffic, and Quality of Service (QoS) flows that ensure service quality for diverse applications. The course then provides a detailed examination of key network functions that form the backbone of the 5G core. You will learn about the specific roles and responsibilities of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), User Plane Function (UPF), Policy Control Function (PCF), and Unified Data Management (UDM). By understanding how these components interact through various reference point interfaces, learners will gain a clear and structured perspective on the operational logic of 5G networks. Upon completion, you will be able to describe the end-to-end architecture and the function of its primary elements, preparing you for more advanced topics in telecommunications.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Identities
desc: This technical course offers an in-depth exploration of the identity management framework in 5G systems, a cornerstone of modern telecommunications security and privacy. The curriculum is designed for telecom professionals seeking to understand the evolution from 4G to 5G identity protocols. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of permanent identifiers like SUPI and PEI, and temporary identifiers like GUTI and 5G-S-TIMSI. The course explains the critical process of concealing permanent identities by encrypting the SUPI to create a SUCI, which is essential for preventing tracking over the air interface. Furthermore, it covers the role of network functions like the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) in allocating and managing these identifiers. Learners will also analyze the identity exchange process during initial network registration and subsequent communications, including the interoperability and mapping procedures required for seamless roaming between 5G and 4G networks. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the security enhancements and operational significance of the 5G identity system.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Link Budget Analysis part 1
desc: This technical course offers a detailed guide to performing 5G link budget analysis. It begins by defining the concept of a link budget and its importance in network design, referencing key 3GPP specifications like TR 38.901. Learners will be guided through the process of identifying and quantifying all potential gains and losses in a communication channel, from cable and foliage loss to antenna gain and transmit power. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to calculating receiver sensitivity using parameters like thermal noise, noise figure, and bandwidth. The course uses a rural macro (RMa) scenario to demonstrate the application of path loss models and breakpoint distance calculations for both uplink and downlink transmissions. By the end of this module, learners will be able to use tools like Excel to conduct their own link budget calculations and evaluate the coverage and performance of a 5G cell.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Link Budget Analysis Part 2
desc: Building upon foundational concepts, this course provides a comprehensive guide to performing 5G radio link budget calculations in complex real-world environments. Participants will learn to navigate the technical specifications and formulas defined by 3GPP standards for critical deployment scenarios such as dense urban macrocells (UMa), street canyons (UMi), and indoor office settings. The course meticulously breaks down the calculation process for key parameters like path loss, breakpoint distance, and receiver sensitivity, differentiating between line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions. Through practical demonstrations using Excel spreadsheets and an online simulation tool, learners will gain hands-on experience in analyzing the impact of variables such as frequency bands (e.g., 7 GHz, 28 GHz), bandwidth, and antenna configurations on network coverage and performance. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to assess uplink and downlink budgets, identify coverage limitations, and make informed decisions for effective 5G network design and deployment.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Network Slicing Part 1
desc: Dive into the transformative world of 5G with this introductory course on network slicing. This session is designed to equip telecom professionals and technology planners with a clear understanding of how 5G networks can be partitioned into virtual, end-to-end networks to serve diverse use cases. The course begins by defining network slicing and explaining its architecture, from the user equipment to the application server. You will learn about the critical role of virtualization in creating isolated, service-specific slices for applications such as V2X communication, smart meters, and enhanced mobile broadband. The curriculum also traces the technology's standardization journey, examining the frameworks developed by ITU-T and the release-wise evolution within 3GPP (Releases 15, 16, and 17). Furthermore, the course clarifies related concepts like Protocol Data Unit (PDU) sessions and Quality of Service (QoS) flows, explaining how they function within a network slice. Upon completion, learners will be able to articulate the principles, operational requirements, and strategic importance of network slicing in the 5G ecosystem.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Network Slicing Part 2
desc: As 5G technology evolves, network slicing has become critical for delivering customized services with guaranteed quality, from enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) to ultra-reliable low-latency communications (URLLC). This advanced course delves into the technical underpinnings of 5G network slicing, moving beyond basic concepts to explore the specific network functions that make it possible. Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the service-based architecture supporting network slices, including a detailed breakdown of the NSSSF for slice selection, the NSSAAF for enhanced security, and the NSACF for admission control. The course also explains how slices are identified and managed using S-NSSAI, and clarifies the relationship between User Equipment (UE), PDU sessions, and simultaneous slice connections. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze the key components and processes that govern the operation of network slices in a modern 5G core network.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Network Slicing Part 3
desc: Building on foundational knowledge of 5G, this advanced course delves into the technical intricacies of network slicing. It addresses the critical challenge of managing simultaneous network access by explaining the Network Slice Simultaneous Registration Group (NSSRG) and its role in UE registration. The curriculum covers the implementation of data rate limitations through the UE-Slice-MBR parameter, a key feature for ensuring Quality of Service. Furthermore, learners will explore RAN slicing, including how Network Slice Access Stratum (AS) Groups facilitate slice-based cell reselection and resource allocation. The course also discusses the interworking of 5G slices with 4G/EPS systems and reviews standardized GSMA templates for deploying services like eMBB and URLLC. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze and understand complex 5G network configurations and their impact on service delivery.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G New Radio - Spectrum Related Aspects
desc: This course delves into the fundamental radio-level specifications of 5G New Radio (NR), providing a detailed examination of how spectrum is utilized to deliver next-generation mobile services. The content is designed for technical professionals seeking to understand the core principles behind 5G network performance. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of Frequency Range 1 (FR1) and Frequency Range 2 (FR2), the various channel bandwidths supported, and the modulation schemes used, such as QPSK and 256-QAM. The course further explores the concept of flexible numerologies and their impact on subcarrier spacing and resource block allocation. Learners will also analyze the mechanisms of Carrier Aggregation (CA) for bandwidth extension and Bandwidth Parts (BWP) for efficient device operation. Upon completion, participants will be able to relate these technical parameters to real-world deployment scenarios, cell sizes, and network capabilities, equipping them with the essential knowledge for roles in telecom engineering, planning, and operations.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G New Radio Frame Structure
desc: Dive deep into the architectural backbone of 5G with this comprehensive course on the New Radio frame structure. The curriculum is designed for technical professionals seeking to understand the intricacies of 5G network operations. The course begins by establishing the foundational concepts of the 5G NR frame, subframe, and slot configurations. It then progresses through detailed modules on each of the defined numerologies (0 through 4), explaining how variations in subcarrier spacing impact slot duration, symbol length, and overall data capacity. Key learning areas include the visualization of the 5G NR resource grid, the calculation of symbols per frame, and the critical differences between slot-based and mini-slot-based scheduling for different use cases like URLLC. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze and interpret the 5G frame structure, enabling them to better understand network planning, resource allocation, and performance optimization in next-generation wireless systems.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Quality of Service
desc: Dive deep into the technical intricacies of 5G Quality of Service (QoS) with this detailed course designed for telecom professionals and network engineers. The program begins by establishing the context of PDU sessions and QoS flows, the foundational elements for traffic management in the 5G ecosystem. You will explore the complete 5G QoS architecture, including the roles of network functions like the User Plane Function (UPF) and Session Management Function (SMF), and how they interact with user equipment and base stations (gNodeB). The course meticulously breaks down different types of QoS flows, including default, Guaranteed Bit Rate (GBR), and non-GBR flows, explaining their specific use cases for applications ranging from general internet browsing to high-demand services like video conferencing and real-time gaming. A significant portion is dedicated to comparing the advanced, flow-based 5G architecture with the bearer-based model of 4G LTE, highlighting key improvements. By the end of this course, you will be able to interpret critical QoS parameters, understand how QoS rules and profiles are constructed, and analyze how traffic is managed in both downlink and uplink directions to ensure a superior and reliable user experience.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Release 17: Enhancements and Advanced Applications
desc: This course provides a practical and comprehensive understanding of 5G enhancements introduced in 3GPP Release 17, the third major milestone in the 5G evolution roadmap. It explains the rationale behind Release 17 and how it expands 5G capabilities to support new devices, deployment scenarios, and advanced use cases. Learners will explore key enhancements, including coverage improvement features, Reduced Capability (RedCap) and Multi-USIM devices, as well as new network capabilities such as Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and 5G Multicast Broadcast Services (MBS). The course also covers network-focused enhancements like network slicing, Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC), private 5G networks, and UE battery life optimization. By the end of the course, participants will understand how 5G Release 17 enables efficient, reliable, and scalable connectivity for industrial, enterprise, and IoT applications.

title: 5G Usage Scenarios and its Key Capabilities
desc: This course delves into the core concepts of 5G technology as envisioned by the ITU for IMT 2020. It moves beyond the simple notion of a speed upgrade from 4G to explore the distinct capabilities that define this new era of connectivity. The curriculum is structured around the three main 5G usage scenarios. You will learn about Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB), which delivers significantly higher data rates for services like ultra-high-definition video and virtual reality. The course then covers Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communications (uRLLC), a critical enabler for applications requiring near-instantaneous response times, such as autonomous vehicles, remote surgery, and industrial automation. Finally, it explains Massive Machine Type Communications (mMTC), which is designed to connect a vast number of low-power devices, forming the backbone of the Internet of Things (IoT) and smart cities. Throughout the module, key performance requirements like peak data rates, spectral efficiency, mobility support, latency, and connection density are explained in a clear and accessible manner, providing a solid foundation for understanding the potential and impact of 5G.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 5G Use Cases
desc: As India embraces the fifth generation of mobile technology, this course offers a foundational understanding of 5G and its profound implications. The curriculum begins by introducing the core technical pillars of 5G: enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) for unprecedented data speeds, ultra-reliable low-latency communication (uRLLC) for real-time control systems, and massive machine-type communications (mMTC) to support the Internet of Things (IoT) at scale. You will learn how these capabilities are not just incremental improvements over 4G but are powerful enablers of innovation. The course then explores practical applications and use cases across a multitude of sectors. Discover how 5G will power precision agriculture, enable remote surgeries in healthcare, create intelligent traffic management for public safety, and drive automation in manufacturing industries. By the end of this course, you will have a clear perspective on the opportunities and changes that 5G technology will bring to governance, business, and society, preparing you to engage with this technological shift.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: 6G Strategies with Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces
desc: This course introduces Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces (IRS) as an emerging solution to key challenges in modern wireless networks. Issues such as signal blockages caused by buildings and obstacles, high path loss at millimeter-wave frequencies, and poor indoor coverage are increasingly affecting connectivity. Traditional approaches, such as deploying additional base stations, often lead to higher costs and increased power consumption. The course explains how IRS enables the propagation environment itself to assist in signal transmission, improving coverage and efficiency. Learners will explore the concept, working principles, and operational mechanisms of IRS in a step-by-step manner. The course also compares IRS with conventional relay and repeater systems, and examines real-world applications, benefits, and challenges associated with large-scale deployment.

title: 6G use cases and capabilities
desc: This course delves into the technical and strategic foundations of 6G, the next frontier in mobile communications. It begins by explaining the role of the ITU and its specific working groups in defining global telecom standards, setting the stage for the IMT-2030 framework. Learners will gain a clear understanding of the multi-year timeline for 6G's evolution, from initial vision to final specification and market deployment around 2030. The core of the course focuses on the expanded capabilities of 6G. It systematically breaks down the six key usage scenarios: Immersive Communication, Massive Communication, Hyper-Reliable Low-Latency Communication, Ubiquitous Connectivity, Integrated AI & Communication, and Integrated Sensing & Communication. For each scenario, the course analyzes the fifteen supporting key performance indicators, such as enhanced data rates, improved spectral efficiency, and new positioning accuracy targets. Finally, it covers the overarching design principles—sustainability, security, ubiquitous intelligence, and connecting the unconnected—that will shape the development and implementation of 6G networks globally.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: A Brief Introduction to Economics
desc: Embark on a journey through the essential principles of economics and their application in governance. This introductory course is designed to demystify concepts that underpin public policy and financial decision-making. You will begin by understanding what economics is, differentiating between microeconomics and macroeconomics, and grasping the core problem of allocating scarce resources. The course then explores the dynamics of the market, examining how buyers and sellers interact, and how the marginal principle guides optimal choices. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding market failures, such as externalities and monopolies, which provides the rationale for government intervention and regulation. You will also be introduced to the strategic world of game theory, learning how it helps in analyzing interdependent decisions, a common scenario in policy and international relations. By the end of this course, you will have a robust conceptual toolkit to analyze economic issues, evaluate policy alternatives, and make more informed, evidence-based decisions in your public service role.

title: A Course on Environmental Social and Governance
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) framework and its transformative impact on the corporate and financial sectors. It addresses the increasing global demand for sustainable and responsible business practices, contextualized with Indian regulatory developments like SEBI's reporting mandates. Key learning areas include the fundamental principles of ESG, methods for assessing corporate performance, and the direct link between strong ESG metrics and financial returns. Learners will analyze how businesses can identify and mitigate ESG-related risks, such as climate change impacts and social accountability challenges. The course also examines the role of investors, financial institutions, and rating agencies in driving the adoption of ESG standards. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply ESG concepts to inform investment decisions, shape corporate strategy, and navigate the evolving landscape of sustainable finance and governance.

title: A COURSE ON TDS UNDER GST ACT
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip government officials, particularly Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs), with the essential knowledge to manage Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) as mandated by the GST Act. The curriculum begins with an introduction to the legal framework of TDS under Section 51 of the CGST Act, clarifying its purpose and applicability. You will learn to identify which entities are designated as deductors, the conditions under which TDS must be deducted, and how to calculate the correct tax amount on payments to suppliers. The course provides a step-by-step guide through the entire compliance lifecycle, covering the online registration process for obtaining a GSTIN, the procedures for filing monthly GSTR-7 returns, and the issuance of TDS certificates (GSTR-7A). Furthermore, it highlights the critical consequences of non-compliance, detailing the interest and penalties applicable for failure to deduct tax, late payment, or delayed filing of returns. Upon completion, you will be proficient in managing all aspects of TDS under GST, ensuring financial accuracy and adherence to statutory requirements.

title: A Deeper Dive into Anti-Drone Defense Systems
desc: This in-depth course provides a thorough exploration of anti-drone defense systems, designed for security and defense professionals. The curriculum establishes a strong foundational context, explaining the growing threat of malicious drones and the importance of robust C-UAS strategies. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of drone detection technologies like radar, RF scanners, and electro-optical sensors, alongside a comparative analysis of kinetic and non-kinetic neutralization methods such as lasers, jammers, and cyber takeovers. Learners will also analyze the significant operational challenges, legal frameworks, and ethical considerations that govern the use of these technologies. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to evaluate and integrate C-UAS solutions into national security and defense networks, preparing them for the future of airspace protection, including advancements in AI and directed-energy weapons.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: A discussion on the Telecommunication Cybersecurity Rules, 2024
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Telecommunication Cybersecurity Rules, 2024, a critical regulatory development for India's digital infrastructure. The discussion provides context on why these rules are essential for securing networks that form the lifeline of the nation's economy. Learners will delve into the key features of the 2024 rules, including the strict six-hour incident reporting timeline, the establishment of the Chief Telecom Security Officer (CTSO) role, and the mandate for Security Operation Centers (SOCs). The course further analyzes the evolution from the 2017 device-focused rules to the current comprehensive network-wide security framework. It also addresses complex issues such as the regulation of Over-The-Top (OTT) services and the challenges smaller operators might face during implementation. By the end of this course, participants will have a clear understanding of the new compliance landscape and the strategic shift towards viewing cybersecurity as an integral component of national security and business operations.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: A Housing Transformation in Ganori Gram
desc: This case study showcases the transformation of 20 Scheduled Tribe families in Ganori Gram Panchayat who, after years of living in forest encroachments without housing rights, gained secure homes through collective action. Led by Sarpanch Mrs. Saralataai Tandale, with support from the Block Development Officer, DRDA Project Director Ms. Sangeetadevi Patil, and others, land was purchased under the Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Gharkul Scheme. Villager Mr. Dadasaheb Jadhav sold 20 gunthas at a fair rate, and Ms. Anuradha Chavan covered registration costs. Using MGNREGA labour, houses were built with sanitation, LPG, and tap water under national schemes. The initiative demonstrates how convergence between local leadership and administration fosters inclusion, dignity, and lasting empowerment.

title: A Murder Case Investigation
desc: Dive deep into the world of modern criminal investigation with this real-life case study of a blind murder solved by the Maharashtra Police. The course meticulously breaks down the investigative journey, starting from the discovery of an unidentified body with only a clothing label as a lead. It demonstrates how investigators utilized digital forensics by tracking the clothing's origin on e-commerce platforms like Flipkart and Amazon, leading to a list of potential customers. You will learn how this data was cross-referenced with mobile tower dumps to zero in on a suspect. The narrative covers the strategic thinking, planning, and execution involved in tracking suspects, establishing motives, and piecing together circumstantial evidence from digital trails. This course is designed to equip law enforcement professionals with a new perspective on crime detection, emphasizing how to think critically and use technology to solve cases that initially seem unsolvable. It showcases the power of scientific investigation and the indelible tracks left by digital footprints.

title: A Primer on High-Speed Rail
desc: This course serves as a detailed primer on the engineering and technology behind High-Speed Rail (HSR). It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the complexities of developing and operating HSR networks. The program begins by establishing the context for HSR, referencing global benchmarks and India's own advancements like the Vande Bharat trains. Key learning areas include a thorough examination of HSR system components, from infrastructure and rolling stock to signaling and power distribution. Learners will delve into the technical challenges, such as managing aerodynamic forces and meeting immense power requirements, and explore the solutions developed by global leaders. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to a comparative study of iconic HSR trains, including the Japanese Shinkansen, French TGV, and German ICE, analyzing their unique design philosophies, such as distributed power versus power car configurations. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze the critical factors in HSR design and appreciate the strategic decisions involved in choosing and implementing this advanced transportation technology.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: A simple stretch to stretch your life
desc: This course addresses the physical strains caused by a modern, competitive lifestyle, particularly for individuals in sedentary or office-based roles. It recognizes that while time is a constraint, personal health cannot be neglected. The program is designed to be a practical guide to basic posture maintenance and physical well-being. The course provides a comprehensive set of stretching exercises covering the entire body. Through clear, live demonstrations, you will learn specific movements for the neck, shoulders, hands, spine, hips, knees, and feet. The content is structured to be self-explanatory, with routines for the upper and lower body, as well as exercises specifically designed for an office environment. By completing this course, learners will be able to apply these simple techniques in their daily lives to relieve muscle stiffness, reduce pain, improve mobility, and maintain a healthy posture. These exercises serve as a foundational tool for long-term health, helping to counteract the negative effects of a busy work life and promoting a greater sense of physical wellness.

title: A Tale of Two Farm Loan Waivers in Maharashtra
desc:
This case presents the policy design and implementation journey of MJPSKY, Maharashtra’s flagship farm loan waiver scheme (2019–20), crafted in response to the operational failures of an earlier waiver (CSMSSY, 2017). The case offers a comparative study of two state-led interventions and explores themes of administrative reform, welfare technology, crisis management, and institutional accountability.

It highlights how political pressure, ground-level feedback, and adaptive leadership led to a redesign of scheme architecture using a reverse-verification model, phased rollout, direct government control of IT systems, and behavioral incentives for credit discipline. 

Ideal for discussions on governance, public policy delivery, and state capacity, the case encourages reflection on moral hazard in welfare, regional disparities in implementation, and the limits of financial relief as a standalone response to agrarian distress.
keywords: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Karj Mukti Yojana
Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Shetkari Sanman Yojana

title: AADHAAR DAKSHTA
desc: This program is designed to equip personnel, particularly from the Department of Posts, with the essential skills and knowledge to function as certified Aadhaar Enrollment Operators and Supervisors. The course begins with an introduction to Aadhaar's role as a foundational digital identity and the structure of UIDAI. It then delves into the practical, step-by-step execution of Aadhaar services, covering new enrollments, various types of data updates (demographic and biometric), and the correct procedures for handling exceptions like missing fingerprints or irises. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to quality assurance, detailing common errors, their prevention, and the associated penalties for non-compliance. Learners will understand how to verify documents, manage the enrollment client software, and ensure a high standard of data accuracy. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to manage an Aadhaar center efficiently, provide excellent citizen service, and uphold the security and integrity of the world's largest biometric identification system.

title: AADHAAR PRARAMBH
desc: AADHAAR PRARAMBH serves as an essential guide for anyone beginning their journey as an Aadhaar enrollment professional. The course delves into the core concepts of Aadhaar, explaining its function as a unique digital identity and its role in facilitating service delivery and financial inclusion under the Digital India initiative. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the legal framework, including the Aadhaar Act 2016, and the organizational structure of UIDAI. The curriculum provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the enrollment and updation processes, covering document verification, biometric and demographic data capture, and exception handling. It emphasizes the critical roles and responsibilities of enrollment operators and supervisors, focusing on maintaining data quality, adhering to security protocols, and avoiding common errors. By the end of this course, learners will be prepared to manage an enrollment station, interact with residents professionally, and ensure compliance with all UIDAI guidelines for a secure and efficient Aadhaar service experience.

title: Absolute Block System
desc: This course is designed to equip railway personnel with the essential knowledge and skills for operating trains safely under the Absolute Block System. It delves into the fundamental principles of block signalling, providing a detailed framework for ensuring the safe and efficient movement of trains. Participants will learn the specific conditions required to grant line clearance, with a focus on Class B stations. The course thoroughly examines the operational differences and requirements when using Two-Aspect Signalling (TAS), Multiple-Aspect Signalling (MAS), and Modified Lower Quadrant (MLQ) systems. Furthermore, it provides in-depth guidance on standard procedures for handling obstructions, conducting shunting operations, and managing block back and block forward movements. By mastering these protocols, learners will be prepared to prevent accidents, maintain operational integrity, and contribute to the overall safety and reliability of the railway network.

title: Absolute Block System
desc: The "Absolute Block System in Indian Railways" course offers a comprehensive examination of a foundational safety protocol in railway operations. In the context of India's vast and complex rail network, ensuring the safe movement of thousands of trains daily is paramount. This course delves into the specific system of working that guarantees only one train occupies a designated 'block section' of track at any given time. Participants will learn the detailed rules for granting 'Line Clear' on both single and double line sections, including the precise 'adequate distance' requirements for different signaling systems. The curriculum covers the inherent safety features, advantages, and operational limitations of the system. Through analysis of the General Rules and practical procedures, learners will be equipped to apply this knowledge to ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable functioning of train movements, making it essential for roles such as Station Masters, Loco Pilots, and other operational staff.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: AC of Train Coach - Roof Mounted Package Unit
desc: This technical course is designed for personnel involved in the maintenance and operation of air-conditioned railway coaches. It addresses the critical need to understand modern AC systems as Indian Railways transitions exclusively to RMPU-equipped coaches. The curriculum delves deep into the refrigeration cycle, breaking down the roles of the compressor, condenser, expansion valve, and evaporator. It further details the specifics of RMPU technology, including different compressor types like scroll and reciprocating, technical specifications, power requirements, and the refrigerants used. The course also covers the governing standards from bodies like RDSO and UIC that ensure safety and performance. Upon completion, learners will have a solid technical foundation to understand, operate, and maintain these essential passenger amenity systems, contributing to a safer and more comfortable travel experience.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Access 2G GSM Air Interface
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the 2G GSM air interface, a critical component in the history of mobile communications. It is designed for technical professionals seeking to understand the foundational principles of cellular networks. The curriculum delves into the specifics of the radio link, including logical and physical channels, the GMSK modulation scheme, and the principles of FDMA and TDMA that allow multiple users to share the spectrum. Participants will learn about the key signaling procedures for call setup, handover, and release. By the end of this course, learners will have a solid grasp of how 2G networks operate at the radio access level, enabling them to better understand the evolution towards modern wireless technologies like 4G and 5G.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Accessibility in the Built Environment
desc: Creating accessible public spaces is a critical aspect of modern, inclusive governance. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of universal design within the built environment, ensuring that public infrastructure serves every citizen equitably. The curriculum is designed for professionals involved in public works, urban planning, and architecture, providing them with the necessary knowledge to design and implement barrier-free environments. Key learning areas include the technical specifications for ramps, lifts, corridors, and accessible restrooms, as well as the importance of anthropometric data in design. Learners will also study the role of tactile and visual signage in aiding navigation and safety. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze existing structures for accessibility gaps and contribute to the planning of new infrastructure that adheres to the highest standards of inclusivity, aligning with national goals like the Accessible India Campaign.

title: Accident Protocol and Role of Comm. Supervisor in Accident Management
desc: This course is designed to equip railway personnel with essential knowledge on handling train accidents effectively. It begins by defining what constitutes a railway accident under official guidelines and explains the importance of a standardized accident protocol. The content delves into the classification of accidents, including consequential, unusual, and miscellaneous incidents, and outlines the specific reporting channels and legal requirements as per the Railways Act, 1989. A significant focus is placed on the role of the Commercial Supervisor at an accident site. The course details their duties, such as providing immediate relief to passengers, managing luggage of the injured and deceased, arranging ex-gratia payments, and coordinating with various railway departments and local authorities. It emphasizes the collective responsibility of all railway officials to save lives, protect property, and restore services promptly, aligning with the national goal of 'Mission Zero Accident'.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Accident Relief Management in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the accident relief management systems vital to Indian Railways' operations. It is designed to equip personnel with the knowledge required to manage and respond to train accidents effectively, prioritizing passenger safety and rapid service restoration. The curriculum covers the strategic deployment of Accident Relief Trains (ARTs) and Self-Propelled ARTs (SPARTs), detailing their classifications, composition, and the strict operational timelines for their dispatch. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the 140-tonne breakdown cranes, covering their components, hydraulic controls, and essential operational procedures such as hoisting, slewing, and propping. Learners will understand the specific techniques for restoring derailed coaches and locomotives, particularly in challenging electrified sections. The course also highlights the critical importance of safety protocols, pre-operational checks, regular maintenance, staff training, and comprehensive documentation to ensure a constant state of readiness and enhance the overall disaster management capabilities of the railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Accounting Procedure of Advanced Accounting Processes
desc: Dive deep into the specialized procedures of advanced government accounting. This course is designed to equip finance and accounting professionals with the necessary skills to manage complex financial operations within the public sector. The curriculum is structured around three critical areas: the accounting of external assistance, the management of Non-lapsable Public Account Funds, and the procedures for write-offs. You will learn why external assistance is vital for technology and social sector projects and how it is accounted for. The course demystifies Non-lapsable Public Account Funds, explaining their creation through cesses and their role in funding specific programs without lapsing at the end of a financial year. Furthermore, you will gain a clear understanding of the principles and approvals required for writing off losses or irrecoverable assets from government books. Upon completion, you will be proficient in handling these advanced accounting tasks, contributing to greater transparency and efficiency in public financial management.

title: Accounting Software
desc: This course is specifically designed for employees of the Income Tax Department to build expertise in digital forensic accounting. In the context of modern tax assessment, where financial records are predominantly digital, this program addresses the critical need for officials to proficiently handle electronic data. The curriculum covers hands-on training with widely used accounting platforms like Tally, ERP, and SAP. Key learning areas include techniques for identifying and extracting relevant financial data, navigating complex file systems to locate hidden or protected information, and preserving the integrity of digital evidence for legal proceedings. Participants will engage with practical exercises and real-world case scenarios to develop competence in managing sensitive financial data. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively assist in digital financial investigations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to legal standards in their field operations, thereby strengthening the tax assessment process.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Accounting Standards
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the critical framework of Indian Accounting Standards (IAS), which govern the preparation and presentation of financial statements in India. The curriculum is structured into modules, systematically covering AS 1 through AS 29. The primary context is to standardize diverse accounting policies and practices, thereby enhancing the reliability and comparability of financial data for stakeholders, including tax authorities. Key learning areas include the disclosure of accounting policies, valuation of inventories, cash flow statements, accounting for fixed assets, leases, amalgamations, and employee benefits. Learners will understand how to apply these standards to practical situations, such as ensuring the correctness of financial statements reported in Income-tax Returns. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to solve practical problems based on the application of Accounting Standards, making them proficient in navigating the complexities of financial reporting and compliance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Accounting Standards -Concept and International Best Practices - IPSAS
desc: This course is designed for finance and accounting professionals in the public sector seeking to deepen their understanding of modern accounting frameworks. It delves into the critical importance of standardized financial reporting for good governance. The curriculum covers the core concepts of International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) and their role in aligning with global best practices. It also provides a detailed examination of Indian Government Accounting Standards (IGAS), with a focus on practical application in areas such as prior period adjustments, capital expenditure, and the preparation of general-purpose financial statements. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to apply these complex standards to produce credible, transparent, and comparable financial reports, thereby strengthening public financial management and accountability within their organizations.

title: Accounting Standards: Concepts and International Best Practices
desc: This course is designed for finance and accounting professionals in the public sector seeking to deepen their understanding of modern accounting frameworks. It delves into the critical importance of standardized financial reporting for good governance. The curriculum covers the core concepts of International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) and their role in aligning with global best practices. It also provides a detailed examination of Indian Government Accounting Standards (IGAS), with a focus on practical application in areas such as prior period adjustments, capital expenditure, and the preparation of general-purpose financial statements.

title: Accounts and Records and Documentation under Goods and Services Tax
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the requirements for maintaining accounts, records, and tax documentation under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) framework. It covers the legal and procedural requirements for maintaining prescribed accounts and records, issuing tax invoices, and handling credit and debit notes in accordance with GST law. The course also explains the requirements for the retention and preservation of records and documents, along with common errors and compliance issues that may arise in maintaining GST-related records. Learners will develop the knowledge and skills required to maintain accurate accounts and records, ensure proper documentation of GST transactions, support audit and compliance requirements, and minimize the risk of non-compliance.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Accounts and Records in GST, Tax invoice, Credit/Debit notes
desc: In the landscape of modern public finance, a thorough understanding of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) is paramount for ensuring fiscal discipline and transparency. This course delves into the foundational elements of GST compliance, focusing specifically on the maintenance of accounts, records, and the correct handling of tax documentation. It addresses the critical need for accuracy in financial reporting within the GST framework, which directly impacts revenue collection and economic governance. The curriculum covers the detailed procedures for managing accounts and records as mandated by GST law. Key learning areas include the rules governing tax invoices, the circumstances for issuing credit and debit notes, and the retention policies for financial documents. Participants will learn to identify common errors and implement best practices to avoid them. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently manage all record-keeping aspects of GST for their respective departments or organizations. This will enable them to ensure full compliance with tax regulations, facilitate smoother audits, and contribute to the overall efficiency and integrity of the indirect tax system. The skills acquired are directly applicable to roles in finance, accounting, and tax administration within the public sector.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Accreditation of Civil Service Training Institutes
desc: This foundational course equips civil service training professionals with a comprehensive understanding of the National Standards for Civil Service Training Institutes (NSCSTI) framework developed by the Capacity Building Commission to standardize and strengthen capacity-building practices across the civil service training ecosystem. The course introduces the eight key pillars of the NSCSTI accreditation framework, with particular emphasis on institutional governance, compliance requirements, and quality assurance mechanisms for civil service training institutes. Participants will gain insights into how accreditation supports systematic improvement in training delivery, promotes accountability, and aligns institutional practices with national capacity-building priorities.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: ACCRUAL ACCOUNTING
desc: This course, 'Introduction to Accrual and Cash Basis Accounting,' is designed to equip government finance professionals with essential accounting knowledge. The curriculum begins by defining accounting and outlining its systematic process, including identifying, recording, classifying, and summarizing financial transactions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to a comparative analysis of cash basis versus accrual basis accounting. Learners will understand the principles of revenue and expense recognition unique to each method and grasp why accrual accounting provides a more accurate depiction of a company's financial health by following the matching principle. The course further delves into the practical application of adjusting journal entries, covering concepts such as prepaid expenses, unearned revenues, accrued revenues, and accrued expenses. Through clear examples and explanations, participants will learn to prepare these entries to ensure that financial reports accurately reflect the economic reality of the period, a critical skill for maintaining transparent and accurate government accounts.

title: Acquisition of Land for Defence Purposes
desc: This course is designed for officials involved in the management of defence estates, offering a detailed examination of the laws and procedures for securing land for national security projects. It provides essential context on why specific legal pathways are chosen, distinguishing between short-term needs like hiring and requisitioning versus long-term acquisition. Key learning areas include the complete lifecycle of land acquisition, from obtaining 'in-principle approval' and forming a Board of Officers, to conducting Social Impact Assessments (SIA) and invoking urgency clauses. The curriculum thoroughly covers the calculation of market value, solatium, and additional compensation, as well as the formulation of Rehabilitation and Resettlement (R&R) packages for affected families. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to advise on acquisition strategies, manage legal proceedings, and ensure compliance with statutory requirements, thereby facilitating the timely and fair acquisition of land for critical defence infrastructure.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: Action Consequent Upon Conviction
desc: This course provides a comprehensive analysis of the actions consequent upon the criminal conviction of a government servant. It delves into the critical legal principles established by landmark Supreme Court judgments, such as R.P. Kapur vs. Union of India and Ajit Kumar Nag v. G.M., which form the bedrock of administrative law in this domain. A key focus is the fundamental difference between the standard of proof in a criminal trial, which is 'beyond a reasonable doubt,' and that of a departmental inquiry, which relies on a 'preponderance of probability.' Participants will learn why an acquittal in a criminal case does not automatically absolve an employee of misconduct charges in an administrative context. The curriculum covers the nuances of initiating and conducting departmental proceedings, interpreting judicial pronouncements, and applying them to real-world scenarios. By completing this course, officials will be equipped to handle disciplinary cases with clarity, uphold administrative justice, and maintain the integrity of public service.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Action Research and Research Studies Scheme
desc: Evidence-based decision-making plays a vital role in ensuring effective, inclusive, and responsive local governance. This course introduces the principles and methodologies of action research as a practical tool for participatory problem-solving, community engagement, and policy refinement at the grassroots level. Designed for induction-level officers, the course aims to build an understanding of how structured research studies and surveys can generate meaningful insights to support informed planning, implementation, and monitoring of development initiatives. It covers the scheme guidelines related to conducting research studies and surveys, including the processes of data collection, stakeholder participation, documentation, and reporting. The course also explains the fundamental parameters of survey design and implementation, along with techniques for analyzing and interpreting survey findings.

title: Active Antenna System
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to Active Antenna Systems (AAS), where antennas and radio units are integrated to significantly enhance wireless network performance and efficiency. In the context of ever-growing data demands, this course explains why AAS is a pivotal technology for the evolution of telecommunications. You will delve into the key learning areas, starting with the evolution from traditional passive antennas to advanced active systems. The course provides detailed coverage of crucial concepts such as MIMO, Massive MIMO, and Full-Dimension MIMO, explaining how they enable superior network capacity and coverage. Furthermore, you will explore various beamforming and spatial processing techniques that allow for intelligent signal direction, interference reduction, and optimized network performance. Upon completion, you will have a solid understanding of how AAS supports multi-user MIMO, boosts spectral efficiency, and functions as a key enabler for 5G and future wireless communications, equipping you with the knowledge to appreciate its impact on the telecom sector.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Acts, Policies and Schemes of MeitY
desc: This training module is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the critical Acts, Policies, and Schemes administered by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). The course delves into the legal architecture that underpins India's digital economy, including the IT Act, Aadhaar Act, and the recent Digital Personal Data Protection Act, explaining their purpose and implications for governance and e-commerce. Participants will gain insights into strategic national policies aimed at strengthening the electronics, software, and cybersecurity domains. Furthermore, the course details key incentive schemes like the Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) and M-SIPS, which are pivotal for promoting domestic manufacturing and attracting investment. By the end of this module, learners will be able to appreciate the integrated approach of these initiatives in driving the Digital India programme and enhancing e-governance service delivery.
org: Ministry of Electronics and Information and Technology Meity

title: Adaptability and Change Management in Postal Operations
desc: In an era of significant transformation, the Department of Posts is redefining its role through major technological, operational, and organizational advancements. This course is designed to empower employees at all levels to confidently manage and adapt to these changes. The curriculum provides a deep dive into the fundamentals of change management, exploring the different types of organizational change and the critical human aspects involved, such as emotional responses and workplace dynamics. Learners will analyze real-world case studies from India Post's journey, including Project Arrow, the IT Modernization Projects (1.0 and 2.0), the Parcel Network Optimization Project (PNOP), and the establishment of India Post Payments Bank (IPPB). The course also focuses on developing essential leadership and communication skills needed to guide teams, engage stakeholders, and overcome resistance.

title: Additional Revenue Opportunities for DISCOMs
desc: In an evolving energy landscape marked by increasing competition and technological disruption, it is crucial for Power Distribution Companies (DISCOMs) to diversify their revenue models. This course provides a comprehensive overview of additional revenue opportunities that move beyond the conventional sale of electricity. It details the strategic value of digital transformation, showing how assets such as customer data from Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), GIS maps, and billing systems can be monetized. The curriculum also covers leveraging physical infrastructure, including converting substations for commercial use, utilizing lamp poles for EV charging and 5G antennas, and offering new energy services. Participants will learn to identify and assess these emerging business models, such as selling rooftop solar systems, promoting electric cooking, and providing battery storage solutions. The course is designed to equip utility professionals with the strategic foresight needed to build resilient, financially sustainable, and customer-centric distribution businesses for the future.

title: Additive Manufacturing
desc: Dive into the world of Additive Manufacturing with this foundational course designed to equip you with essential knowledge of 3D printing technologies. The course begins by establishing the context and need for AM in today's industrial landscape, contrasting it with traditional manufacturing methods. You will learn about the core principles of layer-by-layer fabrication directly from digital designs and explore the most popular technologies driving the industry, such as Power Bed Fusion. The curriculum further details the classification of different AM processes and introduces the concept of Hybrid Additive Manufacturing, which combines additive and subtractive techniques. Upon completion, learners will be able to understand the complete workflow of AM, from a CAD model to a finished part, and recognize its vast applications across various sectors, enabling them to appreciate its role in the future of manufacturing and Industry 4.0.

title: Additive Manufacturing and 3D Printing
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Additive Manufacturing (AM), commonly known as 3D Printing, and its transformative role in modern manufacturing. Learners will explore the fundamentals, principles, and technologies of AM, including an overview of liquid-, solid-, and powder-based material systems. The course covers machine architectures, software tools, and design strategies that enable efficient, high-quality additive fabrication. Participants will gain practical knowledge of Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM), understanding how to create parts optimized specifically for 3D printing processes. The course also highlights government initiatives and policy frameworks, including India’s National Strategy for Additive Manufacturing (NSAM), and examines global trends such as mass customization, distributed manufacturing, and sustainability aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Addressing Gender Gaps in Vaccinations and Immunization: A Life-Course
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the critical role gender plays in the success of public health immunization initiatives. It moves beyond simple sex-disaggregated data to explore how deep-seated social norms and gender dynamics create barriers to vaccine access and uptake for women, men, boys, and girls. The curriculum is structured around a life-course approach, analyzing specific challenges during childhood, adolescence (with a focus on HPV), and adulthood (using COVID-19 as a case study). Learners will be introduced to analytical tools like the socio-ecological model and the 'Journey to Health and Immunization' framework to systematically identify and address gender-related obstacles at the individual, community, and health system levels. By the end of this course, participants will be prepared to integrate a gender perspective into policy-making, program design, and service delivery, ultimately contributing to stronger, more equitable health systems and improved vaccination outcomes for all.

title: Addressing Maternal and Infant Mortality in Meghalaya
desc: Sampath Kumar, Meghalaya's Health Secretary, reflected on the Rescue Mission's two-year success, notably cutting maternal and infant mortality. He tackled challenges of teenage pregnancies and birth spacing, emphasizing State Capability.

title: Adjudication in GST
desc: This course is designed for tax officials to build a strong foundational understanding of adjudication within the GST regime. It addresses the critical need for procedural correctness and legal acumen in tax administration. The course begins by defining adjudication and establishing its legal context, then delves into the specific powers and responsibilities of an Adjudicating Authority. Key learning areas include the complete lifecycle of a Show Cause Notice (SCN), from issuance to response, and the principles of conducting a personal hearing. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical aspects of drafting a clear, reasoned, and enforceable Order-in-Original. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply the general guidelines for adjudicating GST cases, ensuring compliance and upholding the principles of natural justice.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: ADMINISTRATIVE LAW
desc: Designed for government employees, this course demystifies the core concepts of Administrative Law. It addresses the common misconception that administrative authorities have absolute power by detailing their legal limitations and responsibilities. The curriculum begins by defining administrative law and tracing its historical evolution, with references to both French and ancient Indian systems, before focusing on its modern context in India. Key learning areas include an in-depth analysis of the primary sources of administrative law, such as the Constitution, judicial precedents, and statutes. Learners will explore the foundational doctrines of 'Rule of Law' and 'Separation of Powers' that govern administrative actions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to examining the liabilities of the state, differentiating between sovereign and non-sovereign functions through the analysis of landmark judicial cases. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to better understand the legal framework governing their roles, ensuring their actions are compliant, fair, and constitutionally sound.

title: Admissibility and Appreciation of Electronic Evidence
desc: This in-depth session examines the critical legal principles for handling electronic evidence within the Indian judicial system. The course begins by establishing the context, highlighting the exponential rise in digital data and its importance in legal cases. It then delves into the specific provisions of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) 2023, explaining the updated definitions of 'evidence', 'document', and 'electronic record'. A significant portion is dedicated to the conditions for admissibility under Section 63 of the BSA, which replaces the well-known Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the requirements for producing computer outputs, the distinction between primary and secondary electronic evidence, and the critical role of the statutory certificate, including its new format and the requirement for hash values to ensure data integrity. The course also analyzes landmark Supreme Court judgments, such as Anvar P.V. and Arjun Panditrao, to illustrate the judicial interpretation and appreciation of these laws. By the end, participants will be equipped to correctly present, challenge, and evaluate various forms of electronic evidence, from emails and CCTV footage to mobile phone data, in a court of law.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Admn, HR and Establishment practices in BSNL.
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth exploration of the administrative, HR, and establishment procedures that govern the functioning of BSNL and other public sector undertakings. The curriculum is structured to provide clarity on the rules and regulations that impact an employee's career lifecycle and the organization's operational integrity. The course begins by detailing the context of these policies within a government-owned company, emphasizing the importance of structured and compliant HR practices. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of BSNL's Executive Promotion Policy, covering both time-bound and post-based promotions, and the procedural intricacies of the Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC). It further elaborates on the BSNL Transfer Policy and the BSNL Medical Reimbursement Scheme (MRS), explaining eligibility, claims, and procedures. Additionally, the course provides practical guidance on using the CPGRAMS portal for effective public grievance management and ensures awareness of the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (PoSH) Act, outlining what constitutes harassment and the available redressal mechanisms. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently interpret and apply these critical service rules, understand their rights and responsibilities, and contribute to a more efficient and compliant organizational environment.

title: Adopting AI for Cyber Resiliency
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, securing government operations against sophisticated cyber threats is paramount. This course, 'Adopting Artificial Intelligence for Enhanced Cyber Resiliency,' is tailored for public administrators and IT professionals seeking to harness the power of AI for robust security. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of AI, including machine learning models, computer vision, and natural language processing, providing a solid foundation for practical application. Participants will explore real-world use cases and learn to develop a strategic roadmap for AI adoption, from initial planning to full-scale deployment. A significant focus is placed on responsible innovation, covering critical topics such as AI ethics, data sovereignty, and mitigating bias. The course introduces essential security frameworks like the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and Zero-Trust AI Architecture, equipping learners with the tools to build secure, effective, and ethical AI systems. Upon completion, professionals will be prepared to lead AI initiatives that not only defend against cyber threats but also drive efficiency and transformation in public service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Adopting an ecosystem approach to groundwater recharging
desc: The pond rejuvenation project in Udham Singh Nagar, led by Mayur Dixit, applies an ecosystem approach to governance, focusing on intersectoral cooperation, benefit-sharing, and adaptive management to address groundwater depletion caused by encroachment, water-intensive farming, and industrialization.

title: Adopting Sustainable Energy Solutions
desc: As the final installment in the Energy Literacy Training series, this course transitions learners from theoretical awareness to practical application of sustainable energy principles. It addresses the critical need for actionable solutions to combat climate change and reduce dependency on fossil fuels. The curriculum is structured around the 'Avoid-Minimize-Generate' (AMG) framework, providing a clear pathway for sustainable energy management. Key learning areas include strategies for minimizing energy demand through the adoption of energy-efficient appliances and conscious behavior modifications. The course offers a deep dive into generating clean energy locally, with a significant focus on harnessing solar power and demystifying common misconceptions that hinder its adoption. Learners will be equipped with the skills to evaluate their current energy consumption patterns and design effective, localized renewable energy solutions. Upon completion, participants will be capable of developing and committing to measurable action plans, whether for their household, community, or organization. This empowers them to make tangible contributions towards India's national energy goals and global climate commitments, fostering a culture of sustainability and responsible energy stewardship.

title: Advance course on GST registration
desc: GST registration is a fundamental compliance requirement for businesses in India, and navigating its complexities is crucial for legal operation and availing tax benefits. This course delves into the nuances of GST registration, including threshold limits, compulsory and voluntary registration, and the specific procedures for entities like Input Service Distributors (ISD) and e-commerce operators. It provides a step-by-step guide to the application process using forms like GST REG-01, the verification and approval workflow, and the implications of Aadhaar authentication. Furthermore, the course details the processes for amending core and non-core registration details, as well as the legal grounds and procedures for the cancellation of registration by either the taxpayer or the tax officer, and the subsequent process for revocation. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to manage all aspects of GST registration for their organization or clients. They will be able to correctly identify registration liabilities, complete applications accurately, handle amendments efficiently, and navigate the legalities of cancellation and revocation, thereby minimizing compliance risks and ensuring smooth business operations under the GST regime.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Advance Ruling in Customs
desc: This course delves into the legal and procedural framework of Advance Rulings as a key trade facilitation measure by the Government of India. Learners will explore the provisions under Chapter 5B of the Customs Act, 1962, and the role of the Customs Authority for Advance Rulings (CAAR). The content details the entire lifecycle of an advance ruling, from filing an application using the CAR 1 form to the examination, hearing, and pronouncement of the ruling. It highlights the benefits for international traders, such as improved financial planning and supply chain certainty. Furthermore, the course clarifies the admissibility criteria for applications, the binding nature of the rulings on both the applicant and the department, their validity period, and the available appeal process in case of disagreement. This knowledge is crucial for officials and traders aiming to navigate customs procedures efficiently and align with the national objective of enhancing the ease of doing business.
org: National Academy of Customs, Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN)

title: Advance Ruling under CGST Act, 2017
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the provisions for Advance Ruling under the CGST Act, 2017, a critical tool for ensuring tax certainty and fostering a predictable business environment. In a dynamic tax landscape like GST, obtaining clarity on the tax implications of proposed transactions is essential for strategic planning, attracting foreign investment, and minimizing disputes. This program is structured to provide a comprehensive understanding of the entire advance ruling lifecycle. Participants will learn to identify the specific matters for which a ruling can be sought, such as the classification of goods, applicability of notifications, and determination of tax liability. The course details the step-by-step application process, the structure and functions of the Authority for Advance Ruling (AAR) and the Appellate Authority for Advance Ruling (AAAR), and the statutory timelines for pronouncements. Furthermore, it clarifies the procedure for appeals and the conditions under which a ruling may be declared void. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively utilize the advance ruling mechanism to ensure compliance and mitigate risks associated with GST.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: ADVANCED ADMINISTRATIVE LAW
desc: Building on the fundamentals of Administrative Law, this course offers an in-depth exploration of advanced topics critical for public administration. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of delegated legislation, analyzing its necessity in a modern welfare state and the crucial checks and balances that prevent its misuse. You will examine the procedural, judicial, and legislative controls that ensure accountability. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the constitutional framework protecting civil servants, including an analysis of Articles 310 and 311, the doctrine of pleasure, and the role of the Public Service Commission. Furthermore, the course clarifies the privileges and immunities available to the government in legal proceedings, such as notice requirements and the withholding of documents. The final module focuses on the principles of natural justice, including the rule against bias and the right to a fair hearing (Audi Alteram Partem), which are cornerstones of fair administrative decision-making. Upon completion, you will be equipped to apply these legal principles to ensure your administrative actions are just, transparent, and constitutionally sound.

title: Advanced Case Studies in Indigenous Defence Systems
desc: This course delves into the critical subject of defence indigenization, a cornerstone of India's national security and 'Make in India' policy. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the complexities behind developing sovereign defence capabilities. The curriculum moves beyond theory to offer a detailed analysis of real-world projects that have defined India's journey towards self-reliance. Key learning areas include the strategic revival of the Dhanush artillery project, the intricate technology transfer dynamics of the Project 75 Scorpene submarines, the innovative ecosystem behind the PINAKA multi-barrel rocket launcher, and the rapid development of the Zorawar light tank for high-altitude warfare. Participants will explore advanced project management principles, risk mitigation strategies, and the collaborative models between public and private sectors that were pivotal to success. By completing this course, learners will gain a comprehensive perspective on the strategic, technological, and policy frameworks that enable indigenous defence manufacturing, equipping them to contribute to India's defence modernization goals.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Advanced Cloud Connectivity and Security
desc: Cloud computing has evolved from isolated deployments into highly interconnected ecosystems that integrate multiple cloud providers, on-premises data centers, branch offices, remote users, and edge environments. As organizations increasingly adopt hybrid and multi-cloud strategies, establishing secure, reliable, scalable, and high-performance connectivity across these distributed environments has become essential. Traditional networking approaches often struggle to meet the demands of modern cloud infrastructures, where scalability, automation, security, resilience, and centralized management are critical. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced cloud networking and connectivity models, including hybrid cloud networking, multi-cloud networking, Software-Defined WAN (SD-WAN), and Cloud WAN technologies.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Advanced Concepts in SQL
desc: Take your SQL skills to the next level with this in-depth course on advanced query optimization. In today's data-driven world, the ability to write efficient queries that execute quickly is a critical skill for any data professional. This course moves beyond basic SQL to cover the tools and techniques necessary for high-performance database management. You will learn to build custom User-Defined Functions (UDFs) to encapsulate complex logic and create Stored Procedures to automate repetitive tasks, making your code more modular and reusable. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the art of query optimization. You will gain a deep understanding of how indexing works, including clustered and non-clustered indexes, and learn how to apply them to speed up data retrieval. We will also dissect the SQL order of execution, providing insights into how the database engine processes your queries. Finally, you will analyze the trade-offs between JOINs and nested queries, enabling you to make informed decisions for better performance. Upon completion, you will be equipped to write sophisticated, highly optimized SQL code that saves runtime and computational resources.

title: Advanced Course for Buyers
desc: This advanced course is designed for government officials and buyers who are already familiar with the basics of the GeM portal and wish to master its more complex features. The program offers a detailed walkthrough of advanced procurement processes that enhance efficiency and value for money.
