Key learning areas include the end-to-end process of creating and managing custom catalog-based bids for both products and services, conducting thorough bid inspections, and understanding the nuances of BID/RA deployment and transfers. Furthermore, participants will learn how to effectively create and manage forward auctions. Upon completion, learners will be able to leverage these advanced tools to handle complex procurement scenarios, ensure compliance, and maximize the strategic potential of the GeM platform in their official duties.

title: Advanced Course on Revenue Procurement in Defence
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of revenue procurement processes specific to the Indian Defence sector. It is structured to provide officials with advanced insights into the Defence Procurement Manual (DPM) 2009, which governs the acquisition of goods and services. The curriculum addresses the critical need for transparent, competitive, and fair procurement practices to secure the best value for public money.Key learning areas include the complete procurement lifecycle, from the initiation of proposals and tendering to contract conclusion. Participants will learn to manage sourcing and quality control, including the registration and performance assessment of firms. The course covers the nuances of drafting specifications, understanding different types of contracts like rate contracts, and the importance of the 'fall clause'. Furthermore, it details the financial approval process, including the roles of the Competent Financial Authority (CFA) and Integrated Financial Adviser (IFA).Upon completion, officials will be better equipped to handle procurement proposals, manage contracts effectively, and ensure compliance with established financial and procedural regulations, thereby strengthening the integrity of the defence procurement system.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Advanced Defence Procurement: ICT Leasing and Shipbuilding
desc: This course is designed for professionals seeking to master advanced procurement domains within the Indian defence sector. It builds upon foundational knowledge to address the specific challenges of acquiring high-value, technology-intensive assets. The curriculum provides a deep dive into the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020, focusing on specialized areas such as ICT systems, leasing models, and large-scale shipbuilding projects. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of Other Capital Procurement Procedures (OCPP) and implement robust post-contract management to ensure lifecycle governance and operational readiness. The course explains how to manage contractual obligations, mitigate risks, and maintain compliance and transparency. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the strategic skills to oversee complex procurement projects, optimize resource utilization, and contribute effectively to the modernization of India’s defence infrastructure.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Advanced Defence Systems and Future Trends
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of India’s advanced defence systems and emerging trends across naval, aerospace, and land domains. It emphasizes modernization, indigenization, and self-reliance, focusing on critical technologies such as propulsion, electronic warfare, cybersecurity, and emerging innovations like AI, drones, and additive manufacturing (3D printing). Participants will explore shipbuilding, aircraft manufacturing, and armoured vehicle development, alongside applications of Industry 4.0, automation, and digital transformation in defence production. Through case studies of indigenous successes like INS Vikrant, LCA Tejas, and BrahMos, as well as global collaborations, learners gain practical insights into strategies for enhancing competitiveness and contributing to India’s vision of becoming a global defence leader.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Advanced Evolution of Cloud Network Security
desc: The rapid adoption of cloud computing has fundamentally transformed the way organizations design, deploy, and secure their networks. Traditional perimeter-based security models are no longer sufficient in an environment where applications, users, devices, and workloads are distributed across public, private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. Advanced Evolution of Cloud Network Security explores the next generation of cloud security practices, architectures, and technologies developed to address these emerging challenges. The module begins by examining the evolution of network security—from traditional on-premises firewalls and VPN-based models to modern cloud-native, software-defined, and identity-centric security frameworks. It further explores emerging cloud threats, Software-Defined Networking (SDN) security, and micro-segmentation strategies for protecting distributed cloud workloads and networks.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Advanced Government Accounting Procedures
desc: Dive deep into the specialized procedures of advanced government accounting. This course is designed to equip finance and accounting professionals with the necessary skills to manage complex financial operations within the public sector. The curriculum is structured around three critical areas: the accounting of external assistance, the management of Non-lapsable Public Account Funds, and the procedures for write-offs. You will learn why external assistance is vital for technology and social sector projects and how it is accounted for. The course demystifies Non-lapsable Public Account Funds, explaining their creation through cresses and their role in funding specific programs without lapsing at the end of a financial year. Furthermore, you will gain a clear understanding of the principles and approvals required for writing off losses or irrecoverable assets from government books.

title: Advanced Level of Finance Management and Tax Related Concepts
desc: Embark on a journey to financial empowerment with this detailed course on advanced financial management and tax strategies. Designed for individuals seeking to take control of their financial future, this program delves into the core principles of smart saving and investing. You will learn to apply frameworks like the 50/30/20 rule and SMART goals to your savings habits and understand the power of compound interest. The course provides an in-depth look at various investment avenues such as mutual funds, Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs), and the stock market. A significant portion is dedicated to tax-efficient investing, exploring instruments like Public Provident Fund (PPF), National Pension System (NPS), and Equity Linked Saving Schemes (ELSS) to help you legally minimize your tax liabilities. Furthermore, you will learn how to protect your assets and health by choosing the right insurance, manage credit and debit cards wisely to build a healthy credit score, and safeguard yourself from online financial fraud. title: Advanced Procedure for Train Escorting by RPF Personnel
desc: Advanced Train Escorting is a specialized security function of the Railway Protection Force (RPF) aimed at ensuring the safety of passengers, railway property, and train operations. It involves intelligence-based deployment, continuous coach patrolling, threat assessment, and proactive crime prevention using modern technology and standard operating procedures. Escort personnel monitor suspicious activities, prevent theft, robbery, trafficking, and crimes against women, assist passengers, and respond effectively to emergencies such as accidents, fire, and medical incidents. They coordinate closely with the Government Railway Police (GRP), Station Masters, Train Managers, and local law enforcement for timely action. Advanced Train Escorting also emphasizes professional conduct, effective communication, digital reporting, and situational awareness to provide a safe, secure, and passenger-friendly travel environment across the Indian Railways network.

title: Advanced Procedure of Railway Security Management System by RPF
desc: The Advanced RSMS (Railway Security Management System) course is designed to enhance the operational proficiency of RPF personnel in using digital security management tools for railway safety and security. The course covers advanced features of RSMS, including incident reporting, crime data management, train escorting records, asset protection, personnel deployment, intelligence inputs, and real-time monitoring. It focuses on accurate data entry, analysis, report generation, and decision support for effective security operations. Participants learn to integrate RSMS with daily policing activities, improve coordination, ensure data integrity, and support evidence-based security planning. The course strengthens digital competency, operational efficiency, accountability, and proactive security management across Indian Railways.

title: Advanced Satellite Communication Systems and LEO Constellations
desc: The course explains the transformation of satellite communication systems from traditional Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) satellites to modern Low Earth Orbit (LEO) constellations. In GEO-based systems, a single large satellite operates at a high altitude as a stationary communication hub. In contrast, LEO systems consist of multiple smaller satellites working together as a coordinated and distributed network, enabling more dynamic and efficient global connectivity. This evolution represents a significant shift in satellite network architecture, impacting key technical aspects such as orbital dynamics, communication latency, radio frequency link budgets, and network topology. LEO constellations move away from static coverage models and instead enable cooperative, flexible, and scalable communication in space.

title: Advanced Security Operations and Threat Management
desc: This course focuses on the critical role of planning in industrial security management. It introduces learners to the structured planning process, including mission statements, objectives, strategies, policies, procedures, and programmes. Participants will learn how to conduct security audits and apply tools such as vulnerability and risk analysis to identify and prioritise threats. The course explains the concept of five levels of security, ranging from minimum to maximum protection, and addresses the psychological impact of security measures on employees. Real-world case studies from BHEL and Heathrow Airport illustrate best practices in security planning. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to design comprehensive, adaptive security plans that enhance organisational resilience and operational efficiency.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Advancement in Forensic Science
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of forensic science and its critical role within the criminal justice system. It is designed for professionals seeking to grasp how scientific principles are applied to crime investigation. The program begins by defining forensic science and tracing its history, acknowledging key figures and landmark developments in India and internationally. You will delve into the diverse branches of the field, including forensic biology, chemistry, toxicology, questioned documents, and fingerprint analysis. The course thoroughly explains the seven core laws of forensic science, providing the logical framework upon which all evidence analysis is built. Furthermore, it explores the cutting edge of the discipline, covering advancements like DNA fingerprinting, virtual autopsies, forensic engineering, and the use of artificial intelligence in investigations. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to appreciate the scientific rigor behind evidence collection and analysis, understand the capabilities of a modern forensic laboratory, and recognize how technology is transforming criminal justice.

title: Advancing Defence Industry Resilience
desc: This course offers a comprehensive examination of the strategies for optimizing India's Defence Industrial Base (DIB), a critical component of national sovereignty and strategic autonomy. It addresses the importance of building a self-reliant and resilient defence ecosystem in a complex geopolitical landscape. Learners will delve into the core policy reforms shaping the sector, including the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020 and the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, which are pivotal in promoting indigenous manufacturing and private sector involvement. The curriculum explores the transformative impact of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, space-based assets, cybersecurity, and sustainable defence practices. Through an analysis of key initiatives like iDEX, BrahMos, and the C-295 project, the course highlights successful models of technology transfer and public-private partnerships. Participants will also analyze the challenges in DIB optimization, from balancing indigenization with operational readiness to managing budgets and skill gaps. Upon completion, learners will possess a holistic understanding of the policies, technologies, and trends driving India towards becoming a globally competitive and future-ready defence hub.

title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence Systems
desc: This course introduces the emerging paradigm of Agentic AI, where intelligent systems move beyond passive response generation toward autonomous, goal-driven behavior. Unlike traditional AI models that simply respond to prompts, AI agents can perceive their environment, reason about tasks, plan actions, use external tools, and iteratively improve outcomes. The course explains the architecture of LLM-powered agents, including key components such as perception mechanisms, reasoning engines, memory layers, and tool integration. Participants will also explore multi-agent systems, where specialized AI agents collaborate to solve complex problems through coordination, delegation, and shared knowledge. Real-world applications of Agentic AI across domains such as digital services, finance, healthcare, robotics, and enterprise automation are discussed, along with emerging concepts such as agent orchestration, agent swarms, and AgenticOps for operationalizing autonomous AI systems.

It begins by examining the inherent limitations of the waterfall model, particularly in the context of dynamic government IT initiatives where requirements and stakeholder needs can evolve. The curriculum then delves into the core values and principles of the Agile Manifesto, providing a solid philosophical foundation. Learners will be introduced to practical frameworks, with a primary focus on Scrum. Key topics include breaking down projects into manageable 'sprints,' creating and prioritizing a 'product backlog,' writing effective 'user stories,' and understanding the critical roles of the Product Owner and Scrum Master. The course also covers essential Agile ceremonies like daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Upon completion, participants will be able to advocate for and effectively contribute to Agile teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and delivering greater value in their digital governance projects.

Participants will analyze the multifaceted policy frameworks governing the sector, including pricing policies, fertilizer subsidies, and marketing reforms. Key modules address critical contemporary issues such as risk management in the face of climate change, the importance of sustainability, and the implications of WTO agreements on domestic agriculture. The course also highlights the transformative potential of technology, from digital platforms to precision farming, in creating a more efficient, profitable, and resilient agricultural ecosystem. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute to the strategic reorientation of agricultural policies and programs, fostering sustainable growth and securing the livelihoods of India's farmers.

It also covers how computer vision and machine learning can optimize sanitation, waste management, and public health monitoring. Furthermore, the course examines advanced AI models for mitigating urban heat island effects and ensuring nutritional standards in public programs. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to identify opportunities for AI implementation, assess the feasibility of technology-led projects, and contribute to building smarter, more resilient, and citizen-centric cities.

title: AI Models for Governance: Capabilities and Limitations and Responsible
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of AI models and their evolving role in governance. It introduces learners to different AI model families, including classification models, deep learning models, task-specific models, large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, and domain-specific foundation models. The course explores their capabilities and potential applications in areas such as citizen services, complaint management, document processing, translation, speech recognition, agriculture, forecasting, and public service delivery. The course also examines the practical challenges of deploying AI at scale, including adapting models to local and government data, using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning models, managing deployment costs, addressing changing information, hallucinations, bias, monitoring, and human accountability.

title: AI Policies and Governance in India
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of Artificial Intelligence adoption within the Indian governance landscape. It begins by establishing the context of AI's transformative potential and the rationale behind significant government investment in this technology. You will explore the core components of India's national strategy, such as the IndiaAI Mission, and understand its alignment with global policy dialogues like the Global Partnership on AI (GPAI) and principles from the EU AI Act. The curriculum thoroughly examines the complexities of deploying AI systems, focusing on the entire lifecycle from data collection to model deployment and evaluation. Key learning areas include the principles of responsible and ethical AI, strategies for mitigating risks like algorithmic bias, data privacy breaches, and cybersecurity threats. The course also addresses the practical challenges of AI adoption, such as the talent gap, infrastructure readiness, and the need for multi-stakeholder collaboration. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute to discussions on creating a robust, human-centric, and legally compliant AI ecosystem for public service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: AI Regulatory Policies and Implementation Considerations
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of AI regulatory policies and implementation strategies for public administration in India. It begins by establishing a clear context, differentiating between AI and Generative AI and outlining their potential to revolutionize governance. Learners will explore how AI is being leveraged for social good, improving service efficiency, and enhancing transparency in government operations. The curriculum examines key challenges inherent in AI adoption, such as data privacy under the DPDP Act, algorithmic bias, and the need for robust accountability mechanisms. It further details the considerations for procuring AI systems, the importance of high-quality data, and the necessity of continuous monitoring. The course also discusses the balance between fostering innovation and implementing effective regulation, referencing the India AI mission and the development of inclusive, multilingual systems to serve India's diverse population. Upon completion, participants will have a foundational understanding of the ethical, legal, and practical dimensions of integrating AI into public services.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: AI Security: Protecting Intelligent Systems in the Digital Era
desc: This podcast-style course provides a comprehensive introduction to the emerging field of AI Security, focusing on the challenges and strategies involved in protecting artificial intelligence systems from evolving threats. It explores key security risks such as adversarial attacks, prompt injection, data poisoning, model theft, and other vulnerabilities affecting AI models and applications. The course also examines the role of AI governance, compliance, risk management frameworks, and trust mechanisms in enabling secure and responsible AI adoption. Participants will gain insights into threat modeling, secure AI architecture, and practical approaches for designing, deploying, and protecting AI systems in real-world environments. Designed for security leaders, architects, and engineers, this course develops a practical AI Security mindset required to address emerging risks in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and AI-enabled decision systems.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: AI Using Google Bard and ChatGPT for Beginners
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, artificial intelligence is reshaping the professional landscape. This course is designed for beginners and offers a comprehensive introduction to the capabilities of generative AI through two of its most prominent tools: Google Bard and ChatGPT. The program begins by explaining the core concepts of AI and its relevance to modern governance and public service. You will learn to navigate the features of Google Bard, including its ability to draft emails, generate ideas, and create content. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to mastering ChatGPT's powerful Code Interpreter plugin. You will gain hands-on experience uploading data files, instructing the AI to perform complex analysis, generate visualizations like charts and graphs, and clean datasets. The course also addresses the critical aspects of using these tools responsibly, covering privacy concerns and ethical considerations. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently apply these AI tools to automate tasks, derive meaningful insights from data, and ultimately improve your professional effectiveness.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: AI-Enabled Knowledge Management for Governance
desc: The Strategic Knowledge Management in the Digital Era course equips government professionals with the skills to manage, leverage, and transform organizational knowledge using modern digital tools and Artificial Intelligence (AI). It introduces foundational concepts of Knowledge Management (KM), traditional KM strategies, and common organizational challenges such as knowledge silos, fragmentation, and inefficiencies in information sharing. The course further explores advanced technologies including Generative AI, Knowledge AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), highlighting their role in improving knowledge retrieval, decision-making, and service delivery. It also examines AI-driven productivity tools, intelligent content management systems, and personalized public service delivery mechanisms. A strong emphasis is placed on AI governance, data security, ethical considerations, and building trust in AI-enabled systems.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: AI-led Digital Transformation in Urban Governance
desc: As urban environments grow in complexity, innovative solutions are essential for effective governance. This course explores how Artificial Intelligence and digital technologies can address modern urban challenges, making administration more efficient, responsive, and data-driven. It is specifically designed for public officials in urban development and municipal roles who seek to understand and apply these emerging technologies. The curriculum delves into specific AI applications, including automated property tax assessment, AI-powered building plan approvals, and predictive maintenance for road infrastructure. It also covers how computer vision and machine learning can optimize sanitation, waste management, and public health monitoring. Furthermore, the course examines advanced AI models for mitigating urban heat island effects and ensuring nutritional standards in public programs.

title: Air Brake System Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) Coach
desc: Gain an in-depth understanding of the advanced air brake system used in Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) coaches. This course is essential for technical staff seeking to master the braking technology that underpins the safety and performance of India's high-speed rail network. The curriculum begins with the fundamental principles of the twin-pipe graduated release air brake system, detailing its superiority for high-speed operations. You will learn to identify and understand the function of key components, including axle-mounted disc brakes, brake control units (BCUs), and the Wheel Slide Protection (WSP) system. The course draws critical comparisons between LHB and traditional ICF braking systems, highlighting the technological advancements that contribute to enhanced safety and reliability. Furthermore, it covers essential procedures for inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the knowledge to ensure the safe and efficient operation of LHB coaches, contributing directly to the safety and quality of railway services.

title: Air Spring and Failure Indication Cum Brake Application
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the air spring suspension system and the Failure Indication cum Brake Application (FIBA) device integral to modern LHB coaches. The curriculum begins by establishing the context, explaining why air suspension is superior for handling higher loads and enhancing passenger comfort. It then delves into the technical specifics, covering the design and function of essential components such as the top plate, air bellow, emergency spring, load leveling valves, and duplex check valves. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the FIBA system, a critical safety feature. Learners will understand its operational principles, the conditions that trigger it, and the subsequent automatic brake application. The course also equips learners with practical knowledge on the protocols for resetting and isolating the system after a failure, as well as procedures for conducting routine maintenance tests, ensuring the safe and reliable operation of railway assets.

title: Air Supply System in Metro Trains
desc: The pneumatic system is the backbone of modern metro train operations, ensuring safety, reliability, and passenger comfort. This course offers a detailed examination of its design and function. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of why pneumatic systems are indispensable for high-demand urban transit, focusing on their fail-safe characteristics and efficiency. Key learning areas include the identification and purpose of major components like compressors, reservoirs, and delivery lines. You will learn how these components work together to power critical subsystems such as the air braking system, pantograph mechanism, and secondary air suspension. The course further explores the seamless integration of pneumatic hardware with sophisticated electronic control units like the Train Control and Monitoring System (TCMS). By completing this course, learners will be equipped to analyze the complete air supply system, understand its contribution to operational safety, and recognize modern advancements like electro-pneumatic control and real-time diagnostics that define the future of metro technology.

title: AIS (Conduct) Rules, 1968
desc: This foundational course delves into the All-India Services (Conduct) Rules, 1968, a critical framework governing the professional and ethical behaviour of officers in India's premier civil services. The content is specifically tailored for members of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS). The course systematically explains each rule, providing clarity on expected conduct in various official and personal situations. Key learning areas include the general provisions of conduct, integrity, impartiality, and devotion to duty. It also covers specific rules related to gifts, private trade or employment, investment, and communication with the media. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to navigate complex ethical scenarios, ensure compliance with statutory requirements, and uphold the dignity and integrity of the All-India Services. This knowledge is fundamental to fostering a culture of accountability and good governance, reinforcing the trust placed in public servants by the citizens of India.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: AIS (Leave) Rules 1955
desc: Understanding the All-India Services (Leave) Rules, 1955 is crucial for effective human resource management and for AIS officers to manage their entitlements correctly. This course provides a detailed examination of these essential regulations, ensuring that public officials are well-versed in their application. It establishes the context by explaining why these rules are fundamental to the service conditions of AIS members and how they ensure uniformity and fairness in leave administration across the nation.Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of different leave categories such as earned leave, half-pay leave, and extraordinary leave. The curriculum covers the specific eligibility criteria for each, the process for calculating leave balances, and the computation of leave salary. Furthermore, the course delves into procedural aspects like leave application, sanctioning authority, and the consequences of rule violations. Special provisions for officers on probation, on foreign service, or those reinstated after dismissal are also explained in detail, providing a complete operational picture.Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply the AIS (Leave) Rules in various administrative scenarios. This knowledge is directly applicable to roles in establishment sections, HR departments, and for any AIS officer seeking clarity on their own leave entitlements and responsibilities, thereby promoting compliant and efficient administrative practices.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: AIS Discipline and Appeal Rules 1969 Part I Overview and Suspension
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of Part I of the All India Services (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1969, focusing on the critical aspects of overview and suspension. In the context of public administration, maintaining discipline and adhering to established procedures is paramount for good governance. This module is designed to equip officials with a thorough understanding of the legal and procedural framework governing disciplinary actions within the All India Services. Key learning areas include the specific situations that can lead to a service member's suspension, the detailed procedures for issuing suspension orders, and the financial implications and recovery processes during the suspension period. Furthermore, the course delves into the mechanisms for reviewing, modifying, and revoking suspension orders, ensuring that actions are fair and time-bound. Learners will also become familiar with the protocols for reinstatement and the handling of special cases, ensuring they can apply these rules correctly and confidently in their official duties.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: AIS Discipline and Appeal Rules 1969 Part II
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the critical aspects of penalties and disciplinary authorities as outlined in Part II of the All India Services (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1969. In the context of public administration, a thorough understanding of these rules is essential for maintaining accountability, transparency, and integrity within the civil services. This module is designed to equip officers with the necessary knowledge to navigate the procedural and legal framework governing disciplinary actions. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of what constitutes a penalty, the various types of penalties, and specific situations that are exempt from being considered penalties. The course clearly delineates the roles and powers of different disciplinary authorities, explaining who can institute proceedings and impose sanctions. Furthermore, it elaborates on the two primary categories of penalties, providing clarity on their application and implications. Upon completion, learners will be able to correctly interpret and apply these rules, ensuring fair and lawful conduct in disciplinary matters within the All India Services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: AIS Discipline and Appeal Rules 1969 Part IV
desc: This specialized course delves into the critical post-disciplinary proceedings outlined in Part IV of the All India Services (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1969. It is specifically designed for members of the All India Services (IAS, IPS, and IFoS) to provide a comprehensive understanding of the mechanisms for redressal against penalties. The curriculum systematically covers the four key remedies: appeals, revisions, reviews, and memorials. Participants will learn to identify the correct procedures, timelines, and competent authorities for filing an appeal. The course further clarifies the distinct circumstances under which a decision can be subject to revision or review, and by whom. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding the concept of a memorial, its appropriate contents, and the formal process for its submission to the President of India. By completing this course, officers will gain the essential knowledge required to navigate the procedural aspects of administrative justice, ensuring they can effectively utilize the remedies provided under the law to uphold their rights and ensure due process.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: AIS Part III Procedure for Imposing Penalties
desc: Maintaining discipline and integrity within the civil services is paramount for good governance. This course offers a detailed guide to the procedural framework for imposing penalties on government employees, with a specific focus on the All India Services (AIS). It addresses the critical need for officials to understand and correctly apply these rules to ensure fairness, transparency, and legal soundness in disciplinary matters. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of the steps required for imposing major penalties, which differ significantly from the more streamlined procedure for minor penalties. The course also elucidates the necessary actions to be taken upon the submission of an enquiry report, guiding officials on how to proceed based on its findings. Furthermore, it covers the concept of 'common proceedings' for imposing penalties. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the complexities of disciplinary cases, from initiation to conclusion, in a manner that is consistent with the established rules and principles of natural justice.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: AIS Travelling Allowance Rules
desc: This comprehensive course offers a deep dive into the All India Service (AIS) Travelling Allowance (TA) Rules, equipping government professionals with the necessary knowledge to navigate travel-related financial administration. The curriculum places special emphasis on the significant changes introduced by the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), ensuring learners are up-to-date with current regulations. Key learning areas include the core provisions of TA rules, updated pay-based entitlements, and specific guidelines for domestic travel, international tours, transfers, and retirement. The course is structured to provide practical insights for officials responsible for managing or overseeing travel allowances. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply these complex rules, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and sound financial stewardship within their departments.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: All India Services Deputation Guidelines
desc: This course is designed to equip All India Services (AIS) officers with a thorough understanding of the rules and procedures governing deputation. Deputation is a critical aspect of an AIS officer's career, offering opportunities for diverse exposure and professional growth by serving in various central government departments, state governments, and international organizations. A clear grasp of the governing guidelines is essential for ensuring procedural compliance and making informed career decisions. The course systematically covers the core concepts of deputation, detailing the pre-requisites for appointment and the specific regulations for postings within India and abroad. Participants will also gain in-depth knowledge of the provisions concerning pay fixation, allowances, and other entitlements during the deputation tenure. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently interpret and apply deputation rules, effectively manage their career progression, and ensure adherence to the established administrative framework.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Alternative Dispute Resolution
desc: The course on Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) introduces a range of methods used to resolve disputes without resorting to traditional court litigation. The primary forms of ADR include arbitration, mediation, conciliation, and negotiation. These mechanisms are designed to provide faster, cost-effective, and less formal means of dispute resolution, thereby reducing the burden on courts and promoting amicable settlements between parties. The course also explains the legal framework governing ADR in India, which is primarily based on the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. This framework aligns with international standards and facilitates both domestic and international arbitration. ADR is widely encouraged by Indian courts, and provisions supporting it are also embedded in laws such as the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. Institutions like Lok Adalats and mediation centers further strengthen ADR mechanisms by making justice more accessible and efficient.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Alternative Fuel and Hydrogen Based Disruptive Technology
desc: This course provides a detailed examination of alternative fuels and hydrogen-based disruptive technologies, designed for professionals interested in the future of clean energy. It addresses the growing need for sustainable energy sources by delving into the core principles of alternative fuel cells. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundational knowledge, starting with the basic science and moving towards complex applications. Key learning areas include the design and operation of various types of fuel cells, with a significant emphasis on hydrogen technology. Learners will explore the thermodynamics and electrochemistry that govern these devices, understanding how they convert chemical energy into electricity efficiently and cleanly. The course also discusses the practical components of fuel cell systems, their integration into different applications such as transportation and power generation, and the current challenges and advantages associated with their adoption. Upon completion, participants will be able to analyze the role of alternative fuels and hydrogen in the global energy transition. They will be equipped to evaluate the future prospects of these technologies and understand their potential impact on industries and the environment. This knowledge is crucial for policymakers, engineers, and strategists involved in developing and implementing green energy initiatives.

title: Amateur Radio for Communication and Disaster Relief
desc: In an era where conventional communication networks are vulnerable to disruption during natural disasters and emergencies, alternative systems like amateur (HAM) radio become indispensable. This course is designed to build foundational expertise in HAM radio, with a specific emphasis on its application in disaster management and relief efforts. It provides a structured pathway for individuals preparing for the Amateur Station Operator’s Certificate (ASOC), covering the complete syllabus, examination procedures, and licensing requirements. The curriculum delves into the core principles of radio communication, explaining the technical components and operational protocols of amateur radio systems. Learners will gain practical knowledge about selecting and using radio equipment, adhering to regulatory standards, and navigating the licensing process. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to real-world scenarios, demonstrating how HAM radio facilitates vital communication for relief coordination, situational awareness, and emergency response when other networks are down. Upon completion, participants will possess the technical competence and disaster-readiness to operate as skilled and responsible amateur radio operators.

title: Amrit Bharat Station Scheme
desc: Delve into the transformative vision of the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, a landmark project set to redefine India's railway stations. This course offers a detailed examination of the scheme's strategic goals and implementation framework. Participants will learn about the context behind this massive undertaking, exploring why modernizing railway infrastructure is critical for national development. The curriculum covers key learning areas such as the integration of stations with urban landscapes, the adoption of green building standards, and the enhancement of passenger experiences through modern amenities. You will also analyze the benefits, from improved intermodal connectivity to local economic growth, alongside the implementation challenges like budget management and stakeholder coordination. Upon completion, learners will have a thorough understanding of the scheme's scope and its long-term impact on public transportation and urban planning, equipping them with knowledge relevant to large-scale infrastructure projects.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: An Insight into the Advanced Procedure of Arrest for RPF Personnel
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the concept of arrest under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS). While the BNSS does not explicitly define "arrest," Chapter V (Sections 35–62) lays down the legal framework governing the arrest of persons. The course examines the meaning, types, grounds, and procedures of arrest, along with the powers and responsibilities of law enforcement authorities. Learners will also explore the rights of arrested persons, procedural safeguards, and important judicial guidelines, including those laid down by the Supreme Court in the landmark D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal case. The course aims to strengthen legal awareness and promote lawful, transparent, and accountable arrest procedures.

title: An Insight into the Basic Procedure of Arrest for RPF Personnel
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the concept of arrest under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS). While the BNSS does not explicitly define "arrest," Chapter V (Sections 35–62) lays down the legal framework governing the arrest of persons. The course examines the meaning, types, grounds, and procedures of arrest, along with the powers and responsibilities of law enforcement authorities. Learners will also explore the rights of arrested persons, procedural safeguards, and important judicial guidelines, including those laid down by the Supreme Court in the landmark D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal case. The course aims to strengthen legal awareness and promote lawful, transparent, and accountable arrest procedures.

title: An Introduction to Arthashaastra
desc: Delving into one of India's most profound texts on governance, this course explores the enduring wisdom of Chanakya's Arthashaastra. It examines the strategic vision that was instrumental in the formation of the Mauryan Empire, presenting a holistic framework for statecraft that remains highly relevant today. The course is structured to provide a deep understanding of its core components and their application in modern public service. Key learning areas are covered across five distinct modules, beginning with an overview of Arthashaastra's history and structure. You will explore the four foundational Vidyas—Anvikshiki (critical inquiry), Trayi (the three Vedas), Vaarta (economics), and Dandaniti (law and order)—and understand how they form an integrated system of governance. The curriculum also emphasizes the role of Dharma in ensuring ethical decision-making, the principles of Vaarta for economic prosperity, and the application of Dandaniti for maintaining justice and stability. By engaging with these ancient principles, learners will be empowered to apply strategic foresight and ethical judgment to contemporary policy-making and administrative challenges, fostering a more effective and resilient approach to governance.

title: An Introduction to ChatGPT and Generative AI Tools
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, Generative AI stands out as a revolutionary force with the potential to transform public administration. This introductory course is meticulously designed for government officials to demystify this powerful technology. It begins by explaining the core concepts of Generative AI, machine learning, and neural networks, using accessible language. The curriculum then focuses on practical tools like ChatGPT, demonstrating their capabilities for tasks such as drafting policies, generating reports, and enhancing communication. The course will explore real-world use cases relevant to the government context, illustrating how AI can automate routine work, provide data-driven insights, and foster innovation in service delivery. By the end of this course, learners will not only grasp the fundamentals of Generative AI but also be able to identify opportunities for its application in their respective domains.

title: An Introduction to Science Communication
desc: In an era where scientific advancements shape our world, the ability to communicate research effectively to the public is a critical skill for every scientist. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to science communication, specifically tailored for early-career researchers and technical experts. It addresses the fundamental challenge of translating complex scientific information into clear, engaging, and accessible narratives for non-specialist audiences. The course will explore the core principles of effective science communication, from understanding your audience to crafting compelling stories around your research. Through a series of modules, learners will be introduced to various communication strategies and formats. The curriculum also includes practical case studies and assignments to help solidify understanding and build confidence. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the significance of their work to policymakers, journalists, and the general public, thereby increasing the societal impact of their research and fostering greater public trust in science. This course is an essential first step for any scientist looking to enhance their public engagement capabilities.

title: An Introduction to Vermicomposting
desc: In an era where sustainable practices are paramount, this course provides essential knowledge on vermicomposting, a powerful method for converting organic waste into a nutrient-rich soil amendment. It is designed for individuals interested in sustainable agriculture, horticulture, and effective waste management, highlighting the critical role of earthworms in soil ecosystems. The course establishes a strong foundational understanding of why vermicompost is a superior alternative to chemical fertilizers, contributing to both environmental health and agricultural productivity. Participants will delve into the complete lifecycle of vermicompost production. Key learning areas include the scientific principles behind decomposition by earthworms, step-by-step guidance on building and managing a vermicomposting unit, and identifying appropriate organic materials while avoiding harmful substances. The course also analyzes the nutrient profile of vermicompost and its benefits for soil structure and plant vitality. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to produce their own vermicompost and apply it effectively in farming or gardening, turning organic waste into a valuable resource for sustainable cultivation.

title: An introductory module on Forensic Analysis
desc: Forensic analysis is an essential discipline for maintaining transparency and accountability in the corporate and public sectors. This introductory course is designed to equip learners with a foundational understanding of forensic auditing as a tool to combat financial fraud. The curriculum begins by defining fraud and its legal ramifications under the Indian Penal Code, Indian Contract Act, and the Companies Act, 2013. It then explores the various forms of corporate fraud, from skimming and asset theft to complex financial statement falsification, providing real-world context to the theoretical concepts. Learners will be introduced to the complete forensic audit process, including planning, evidence gathering, and reporting. The course details practical tools such as fraud risk assessments, data analysis techniques, and the 'fraud triangle' to help identify and investigate suspicious activities. By the end of this module, participants will be able to appreciate the critical role of forensic audits in legal proceedings and in fostering a fair and just economic environment.

title: An Overview of Air Conditioning in Underground Metro Stations
desc: The Environment Control System (ECS) is a vital component of modern underground metro infrastructure, directly impacting passenger experience and operational safety. This course offers a detailed examination of the design, function, and management of these complex systems. You will explore the primary subsystems, including the centralized chilled water system, air handling units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers, understanding how they work together to maintain optimal station conditions. The curriculum covers the different operational modes—closed, open, and emergency—and explains how the Building Management System (BMS) is used for central monitoring and control. Special emphasis is placed on the smoke management system, a critical safety feature for passenger evacuation during fire emergencies. Furthermore, the course discusses energy efficiency initiatives, such as the use of VFDs and CO2 sensors, and reviews design considerations from past and future metro phases, equipping learners with practical knowledge to apply in real-world scenarios.

title: An Overview of Elevators in Metro Systems
desc: In the context of modern urban transit, elevators are indispensable for ensuring accessibility and managing passenger flow in high-traffic metro stations. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the technical and operational aspects of elevator systems. You will delve into the fundamental components, from traction machines and hoisting ropes to car design and rescue mechanisms. The curriculum places a strong emphasis on safety, covering the various built-in safety features, procedures for failure analysis, and the importance of regular maintenance and commissioning. Participants will learn to identify different types of elevators and understand how to select appropriate systems for various requirements. By blending technical details with practical applications drawn from real-world metro operations, this course prepares professionals to effectively oversee and manage elevator infrastructure, contributing to enhanced passenger safety, comfort, and system reliability.

title: An overview of FCI and its operations
desc: This foundational course serves as an essential introduction to the Food Corporation of India (FCI), a pivotal organization in ensuring the nation's food security. The module is designed to provide a clear understanding of why FCI was established and how it functions. Learners will delve into the history, vision, and mission that guide the corporation. The course outlines FCI's primary mandate, focusing on its major operations such as procurement, storage, and distribution of food grains. It also sheds light on the organization's citizen-centric objectives and its role in maintaining buffer stocks and stabilizing prices. By completing this course, participants will gain a holistic perspective on FCI's structure, its significant contributions to the public good, and the key milestones that have shaped its journey, making it ideal for anyone beginning their career with the organization.

title: An Overview of Fire Systems in Metro Stations
desc: In high-density public environments such as metro stations, robust fire safety systems are not just a regulatory requirement but a fundamental necessity for protecting lives and infrastructure. This course offers a detailed examination of the principles and applications of modern fire safety technology. You will delve into the key learning areas, including the design and function of fire detection and alarm systems, various types of fire suppression technologies, and the complexities of tunnel ventilation for smoke control. The course also covers the importance of adhering to safety codes and standards during the commissioning and maintenance phases. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze system compliance, identify potential challenges in complex environments like tunnels, and apply their knowledge to select appropriate fire systems for different building types. This program provides the essential expertise to contribute effectively to enhancing safety measures in public transit and urban infrastructure projects.

title: An Overview of Forensic Science Divisions
desc: Delve into the scientific core of criminal justice with this introductory course on forensic science. This program is designed to provide a comprehensive overview of the critical branches that support modern criminal investigations. You will explore the interdisciplinary nature of forensics, focusing on its chemical and physical applications. The course breaks down complex topics into understandable modules, covering forensic toxicology for detecting poisons, forensic chemistry for analyzing narcotics and explosives, and forensic physics for accident reconstruction. A significant portion is dedicated to ballistics, explaining how firearms, bullets, and gunshot residue are traced and linked to crime scenes. By understanding these scientific processes, learners will appreciate the importance of meticulous evidence collection, accurate analysis, and objective interpretation. The course aims to build a strong foundational knowledge base, enabling learners to recognize the value of forensic evidence and collaborate effectively with expert teams to ensure scientific accuracy in legal proceedings.

title: An Overview of United Nations Peacekeeping Operations
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the framework of United Nations Peacekeeping Operations, designed for officials requiring a foundational understanding of international security mechanisms. It begins by establishing the context of the UN's creation and its mandate to prevent conflict and foster international cooperation. Learners will delve into the UN Charter, the primary legal instrument that empowers and guides all peacekeeping activities. The course systematically outlines the key actors within the UN system, including the roles of the Security Council, the General Assembly, and specialized departments responsible for deploying and managing missions. A significant portion is dedicated to explaining the command and control structure, detailing the strategic, operational, and tactical levels of authority. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the essential knowledge to appreciate the complexities of UN peacekeeping and its significance in global governance.
org: Centre of United Nations Peace Keeping

title: Analysis of Financial Statements
desc: This course is designed to build foundational expertise in interpreting financial data for informed decision-making. It begins by establishing the importance of financial analysis in a public sector context, where understanding the financial health of public enterprises and partner organizations is critical. You will learn to apply practical techniques like horizontal analysis to track performance over time and vertical analysis to understand the composition of financial statements. The course provides a deep dive into ratio analysis, a powerful tool for evaluating an organization's operational efficiency, liquidity, debt management, and profitability. Furthermore, it specifically addresses key metrics that are vital for stakeholders and investors, including Earnings Per Share (EPS), Dividend Per Share (DPS), and the Price-Earnings (P/E) Ratio. Upon completion, you will be equipped to systematically analyze financial statements, interpret the results, and contribute to sound financial governance and oversight.

title: Anchoring Global Efficiency: Vizag in Top 20 Container Ports
desc: This case study examines how Visakhapatnam Port Authority (VPA) achieved a remarkable turnaround by entering the World Bank’s Global Top 20 Container Port Performance Index (CPPI) in 2024, rising from rank 115 to 19 within a year. Located strategically on India’s eastern seaboard near the Malacca Strait, VPA leveraged strong rail-road connectivity to strengthen its competitive position. The transformation was led by Chairperson Dr. M. Angamuthu, appointed in May 2023, at a time when the port faced ageing infrastructure, procedural delays, and intense competition from private ports. Using the autonomy provided by the Major Port Authorities Act, 2021, the leadership implemented reforms focused on operational efficiency, digitalization, and stakeholder coordination. A long-standing PPP with Visakha Container Terminal Pvt. Ltd., along with ecosystem-wide collaboration, enabled capacity upgrades, improved turnaround times, and greater environmental sustainability.

title: Ancient Indian Civilization: Rural Housing and Town Planning
desc: Discover the timeless wisdom of ancient Indian architecture and urban planning in this comprehensive course. It provides an in-depth analysis of how ancient communities designed and built their environments in harmony with nature. The course begins by exploring rural housing, focusing on the use of locally sourced materials and passive design strategies for thermal comfort and durability. You will learn about the science behind techniques like thatched roofs, mud walls, and the principles of Vastu Shastra.The curriculum then transitions to the remarkable urban planning of ancient cities like Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro. You will study their grid-based street layouts, sophisticated underground drainage and sanitation systems, and the strategic placement of public buildings like granaries and citadels. The course also covers various town topologies mentioned in ancient texts, such as Dandaka, Swastika, and Padmaka. By understanding these historical precedents, learners will be equipped to think critically about modern challenges in housing and urban development, drawing inspiration from India's rich architectural heritage to inform future sustainable practices.

title: Ancient Indian Wisdom in Modern Marketing Practice
desc: This course integrates timeless wisdom from Indian knowledge systems with contemporary marketing practices to foster ethical, sustainable, and effective marketing strategies. Participants will explore value creation through Seva (service), environmental analysis using Pramana and Mandala frameworks, and strategic decision-making guided by Viveka (discernment) within segmentation, targeting, and positioning (STP). The course also delves into product and pricing philosophies rooted in Yajna and Nyaya, along with communication strategies inspired by Vak Siddhi and Rasa theory. Real-world case studies of leading Indian brands and public initiatives reinforce practical applications. By balancing Dharma (ethics) and Artha (economic value), learners will develop purpose-driven marketing approaches that prioritise trust, transparency, and societal well-being.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Andhra Pradesh Pioneers Energy Demand Forecasting Using AI
desc: The Andhra Pradesh Transmission Corporation (APTransco) introduced India's first AI-driven day-ahead electricity forecasting model, optimizing grid operations by predicting demand, incorporating renewable energy, and reducing costs for efficient electricity generation.

title: Anger Management
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of anger as a natural human emotion and provides a structured approach to managing it effectively. The program begins by deconstructing the psychology of anger, explaining the 'fight or flight' response, and the role of stress hormones like cortisol. It details how unmanaged anger can negatively affect personal health, damage relationships with family and colleagues, and reduce professional effectiveness and productivity. The core of the course is dedicated to actionable strategies for anger management. Participants will learn to identify their personal anger triggers through enhanced self-awareness. The curriculum covers scientifically-proven relaxation methods such as deep breathing and box breathing to calm the body's physiological response. It also introduces cognitive tools like the 'Traffic Light Method' and cognitive restructuring to challenge negative thought patterns. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of assertive communication, teaching learners to express their feelings constructively using 'I' statements. This course is designed to empower individuals to take control of their emotional responses, leading to improved mental well-being and more harmonious interactions in both their personal and professional lives.

title: Anger Management at Work Place
desc: In today's high-pressure work environments, managing emotions effectively is a critical skill for personal and professional success. This course on Anger Management at the Workplace delves into the complex nature of anger, providing public servants with the tools to handle this powerful emotion constructively. The program begins by defining anger and its various forms—reactive, passive, chronic, and constructive—before exploring its common triggers, including work pressure, ego, and expectations. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding the physiological impact of anger, detailing how stress hormones like cortisol affect the brain, cardiovascular system, and overall health. Learners will be equipped with a range of management techniques, from self-awareness practices like yoga and meditation to strategic communication methods for expressing emotions without causing conflict. The course also addresses team dynamics, offering guidance for leaders on managing frustration and resentment within their teams. Drawing insights from the Bhagavad Gita, the program concludes by framing emotional regulation within a broader context of personal growth and spiritual wisdom, empowering learners to build better relationships and lead more satisfying lives.

title: Annotating with Text in AutoCAD
desc: Effective annotation is critical for conveying precise information in technical drawings. This course delves into the complete workflow of adding and managing text in AutoCAD. You will learn why clear annotation is essential in professional contexts like architecture and engineering, and how to achieve it using AutoCAD's powerful text tools. The course covers key learning areas such as creating and applying text styles, differentiating between single-line and multi-line text, and advanced formatting options including justification, columns, and line spacing. You will also master the alignment tools to organize text objects neatly within your drawings. Upon completion, you will be equipped to apply these techniques to create highly professional, standardized, and easily understandable technical documents, enhancing the overall quality and communicative power of your designs.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Annual Confidential Report: Kal Phung Leh Pawimawhna
desc:
Annual Confidential Report (ACR) hi Sorkar Department  hrang hrangte’n hnathawktute hna chetzia tehna atana an hman thin official lehkha a ni.

He report hian kum khat chhung hian hnathawktute hnathawh that dan te, an nungchang te, hna an thiam dan te, an rinawmna leh an chetzia hrim hrim a chhinchhiah thin a ni. He report hi a tlangpuiin a chunga thuneitu (reporting officer) in a ziak thin a, chu chu thuneitu sang zawkten an endik leh thin a ni.

ACR hian hnathawktu kaisan (promotion) te, hmun danga sawn (transfer) te, training lak belh ngaite leh hnathawktute hmasawnna kawnga thutlukna siam nan pawl (organization) a pui thin a ni. Hnathawktute hnathawh dan chungchang thuruk vawn tlak a nih avangin, he lehkhapui hi rintlak leh thuruka vawn tlat (confidential administrative document) a ni
org: Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department Mizoram

title: Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR)
desc: The Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR) is a cornerstone of the performance management system in the public sector, directly influencing an employee's career development and the organization's overall effectiveness. This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of the entire APAR lifecycle. It will delve into the regulatory framework governing APARs, including the specific rules and instructions for filling and maintaining these confidential reports. Key learning areas include the methodology for setting targets, conducting objective assessments against those targets, and the significance of the numerical grading system. Participants will learn to navigate the roles of the reporting, reviewing, and accepting authorities, ensuring a fair and transparent evaluation. The course will also address common challenges and best practices in writing and interpreting appraisal reports, enabling officials to use the APAR not just as an evaluation tool but as a mechanism for continuous feedback, performance improvement, and strategic workforce planning. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in managing the APAR process in compliance with official procedures.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR) - Updated
desc: The Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR) is a cornerstone of performance management and human resource development in the public sector. A well-managed APAR process ensures that employee contributions are fairly assessed, developmental needs are identified, and career advancements are based on merit. This course is designed to demystify the APAR process for all government officials, from the employee being appraised to the senior officers responsible for reviewing and accepting the reports. Participants will delve into the fundamental principles and objectives of the APAR system. The curriculum covers the detailed procedures for filling out the APAR form, including setting targets, self-appraisal, and documenting achievements. It clarifies the specific roles and responsibilities of the reporting officer, reviewing officer, and accepting authority, emphasizing the importance of objectivity, timeliness, and constructive feedback. The course will also address common challenges and pitfalls in the appraisal process and provide guidance on handling representations against adverse remarks. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to participate in the APAR process with confidence and integrity. They will be able to complete their appraisals accurately, conduct fair and objective assessments of their subordinates, and use the APAR as a constructive tool for performance enhancement and career planning, contributing to a more efficient and accountable administration.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Annual Performance Appraisal Report (Hindi)
desc: वार्षिक कार्यनिष्पादन मूल्यांकन रिपोर्ट (एपीएआर) पर यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी क्षेत्र में प्रदर्शन प्रबंधन की एक व्यापक समझ प्रदान करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। एपीएआर केवल एक वार्षिक औपचारिकता नहीं है, बल्कि यह एक अधिकारी के करियर की प्रगति, प्रशिक्षण आवश्यकताओं और पदस्थापन के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण उपकरण है। यह पाठ्यक्रम इस मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया के महत्व पर प्रकाश डालता है और बताता है कि यह पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही कैसे सुनिश्चित करता है। शिक्षार्थी एपीएआर से संबंधित मूलभूत नियमों और दिशानिर्देशों को जानेंगे, जिसमें स्व-मूल्यांकन भरने की सही प्रक्रिया, रिपोर्टिंग और समीक्षा अधिकारियों की भूमिकाएं और जिम्मेदारियां, और निर्धारित समय-सीमा का पालन करना शामिल है। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों को एपीएआर प्रक्रिया को आत्मविश्वास और सटीकता के साथ पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान से लैस करना है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, अधिकारी अपने प्रदर्शन का प्रभावी ढंग से दस्तावेजीकरण करने, मूल्यांकन को निष्पक्ष रूप से समझने और अपने करियर के विकास पथ को बेहतर ढंग से प्रबंधित करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Annual Returns and Final Return under GST
desc: This course offers a clear and comprehensive overview of Annual and Final Return requirements under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime for registered taxpayers. It covers the purpose, applicability, and filing procedures for key returns, including GSTR-9, GSTR-9C, GSTR-4, and the Final Return GSTR-10. The course explains relevant provisions of the CGST Act, 2017 and CGST Rules, 2017, providing practical guidance on eligibility, due dates, and the consequences of delayed or non-filing. Learners will gain the knowledge and skills needed to ensure effective compliance with GST return obligations.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Anti Money Laundering
desc: This introductory course is designed to build a foundational understanding of the principles and practices of anti-money laundering (AML). It begins by defining money laundering and tracing its historical context, including its evolution from informal systems like Hawala to a major global financial threat. The course systematically breaks down the three-stage money laundering cycle—placement, layering, and integration—and explains the techniques criminals use to legitimize illicit funds, such as smurfing and creating fictitious accounts. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the legal and regulatory landscape, providing a detailed examination of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002, and the functions of key agencies like the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Enforcement Directorate. Learners will also understand the global standards set by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). By exploring the critical importance of customer due diligence (CDD) and analyzing real-world examples like the ABG Shipyard case, participants will be equipped to recognize the indicators of money laundering and appreciate the measures in place to protect the integrity of the financial system.

title: Anti Money Laundering Policy in India Post
desc: This program offers a detailed guide to the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) policies applicable to the financial services offered by the Department of Posts. The course begins by establishing the context of money laundering, defining 'black money' and outlining the three key stages: placement, layering, and integration. It delves into the critical legal framework, primarily the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002, and explains India's role in the global fight against financial crime, including standards set by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). Key learning areas include the practical application of Know Your Customer (KYC) norms, Customer Due Diligence (CDD) procedures, and customer risk categorization for small savings schemes. Participants will learn how to identify suspicious transactions, understand the requirements for reporting Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR), and adhere to record-keeping mandates. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to apply these principles diligently, safeguarding India Post's financial integrity and contributing to national security.

title: Anti Money Laundering Policy of India Post for PLI/RPLI- English
desc: Money laundering poses a significant threat to the integrity of financial institutions. This course is designed to equip India Post personnel with the knowledge and tools to effectively implement the organization's Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policy for its insurance products. The curriculum delves into the core components of the AML framework, including the Customer Acceptance Policy, Know Your Customer (KYC) norms, and detailed customer identification procedures. Participants will learn to conduct risk assessments, categorize customers, and apply enhanced due diligence for high-risk profiles such as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs). The course also covers the critical processes for monitoring transactions, identifying suspicious activities, and adhering to mandatory reporting and record-keeping requirements. By completing this training, officials will be prepared to safeguard the postal insurance system, ensure regulatory compliance, and contribute to the national effort against financial crime.

title: Antimicrobial Resistance
desc: Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) poses a severe threat to modern medicine, making common infections difficult to treat and increasing the risk of disease, death, and economic burden. This course is designed to equip public health professionals, clinicians, and policymakers with the knowledge to address this growing challenge. The content delves into the definition and global significance of AMR, exploring the factors that accelerate its development, such as the inappropriate use of antimicrobials and poor infection control. It provides a comprehensive overview of India's National Action Plan, highlighting its six strategic priorities, including enhancing awareness, strengthening surveillance, and promoting research. By the end of this course, participants will understand the multifaceted nature of AMR and be prepared to apply effective prevention and control strategies, such as improved hand hygiene and antimicrobial stewardship, within their professional roles to help safeguard public health.

title: APAR Empowering The Karmayogi
desc: This course is designed to empower government employees with a thorough understanding of the Annual Performance Assessment Report (APAR) system. It begins by establishing the context of APAR as a fundamental tool for personnel administration, career planning, and enhancing employee performance. The curriculum systematically breaks down the entire APAR lifecycle, from setting quantitative targets at the beginning of the year to the final submission and review process. Key learning areas include the distinct procedures for gazetted and non-gazetted officers, the specific roles and duties of the reporting and reviewing authorities, and the importance of objective assessment. Learners will explore the detailed structure of the APAR form, including the self-appraisal section, the pen picture, integrity assessment, and the methodology behind the numerical grading system for work output, personal attributes, and functional competency. The course also covers the official timelines for each stage of the process and introduces the SPARROW (Smart Performance Appraisal Report Recording Online Window) platform, detailing its features for efficient and transparent electronic filing. Upon completion, participants will be well-equipped to navigate the APAR process confidently, whether as an appraisee or an assessing officer.

title: Aphasia: Causes and Clinical Management
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to aphasia, a complex condition that impairs a person's ability to communicate. It is designed for the general public, caregivers, and healthcare support staff seeking to understand the impact of aphasia on individuals' lives. The curriculum delves into the neurological origins of aphasia, including common causes like stroke, brain tumors, and injuries, explaining how they disrupt the brain's language centers. Key learning areas include distinguishing between different types of aphasia, recognizing associated physical and emotional difficulties, and understanding the principles of clinical management. Participants will learn about the importance of early intervention with speech-language pathologists and discover practical support strategies, such as using gestures, visual aids, and assistive applications. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to better support individuals with aphasia, fostering more effective communication and contributing to their rehabilitation and overall well-being.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: API and Micro Services Security for Digital Transformation
desc: In today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape, organizations are increasingly shifting from monolithic architectures to microservices-based systems to achieve greater scalability, flexibility, and faster time-to-market. While this transformation enables agile and efficient service delivery, it also introduces significant security challenges that must be effectively addressed to protect sensitive data and ensure system integrity. This course on API and Microservices Security for Digital Transformation is designed for developers, technical teams, and security professionals to build a strong foundation in securing distributed systems in enterprise and digital government environments. It provides both conceptual understanding and practical approaches to securing APIs and microservices, with a focus on real-world implementation in large-scale systems.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: API Setu- A Digital India Initiative
desc: This course delves into the strategic importance and operational framework of API Setu, a key component of the Digital India initiative. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of its foundational principles, which are designed to break down data silos and promote an 'API-first' approach in governance. The curriculum covers the core features of the platform, including its centralized API directory, lifecycle management capabilities, and adherence to Open API specifications like Swagger for self-explanatory and easy-to-use interfaces.
