Through an examination of real-world use cases in education, finance (BFSI), and public service recruitment, learners will see how API Setu streamlines processes, enhances transparency, and reduces costs. By the end of this course, officials will be equipped to appreciate the value of API Setu in building innovative solutions and improving citizen-centric service delivery.
subDomain: Handling Miscellaneous Matters (Car, Residence, Personal Staff etc.)
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: API Setu: Enabling Digital Interoperability in Government
desc: Dive into the architecture and functionality of API Setu, a cornerstone of the Digital India initiative. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the platform designed to streamline and standardize data sharing across government entities. You will explore the context of digital governance and why interoperability is critical for modern public service delivery. The curriculum covers the entire API lifecycle, from publishing and onboarding to monitoring and analytics, emphasizing the platform's robust security, privacy, and compliance standards. Through real-world use cases, you will see how API Setu facilitates seamless integration with foundational services like Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and UPI. By completing this course, you will gain the foundational knowledge required to understand how this pivotal platform accelerates digital transformation and empowers a more connected and efficient government.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Appeal Revision and Review
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the procedural mechanisms of appeal, revision, and review. It is designed for public officials who are involved in or need to understand the handling of disciplinary cases, administrative orders, and grievance redressal. The course begins by defining and differentiating these three critical concepts, clarifying the specific circumstances under which each can be invoked. It delves into the relevant service rules, such as the CCS (CCA) Rules, that govern these processes, outlining the timelines, competent authorities, and procedural formalities involved. Through this course, learners will gain the necessary knowledge to correctly apply these procedures, prepare or examine case files, and ensure that all actions are compliant with legal and procedural standards, thereby strengthening the integrity and fairness of administrative actions.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Appeal, Revision and Review (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम 'अपील, पुनरीक्षण और समीक्षा' की अवधारणाओं की गहन समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जो प्रशासनिक कानून और शासन के महत्वपूर्ण स्तंभ हैं। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों को इन प्रक्रियाओं के सैद्धांतिक और व्यावहारिक पहलुओं से अवगत कराना है। इसमें, आप सीखेंगे कि किसी प्रशासनिक निर्णय से असंतुष्ट होने पर कौन-सा उपाय अपनाना उचित है और प्रत्येक प्रक्रिया के लिए निर्धारित नियम क्या हैं। पाठ्यक्रम अपील, पुनरीक्षण और समीक्षा के बीच के सूक्ष्म अंतरों पर प्रकाश डालता है, जिसमें यह बताया गया है कि कौन, कब और किस आधार पर इनका उपयोग कर सकता है। यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों को अपने निर्णयों को अधिक सावधानीपूर्वक और कानूनी रूप से सुदृढ़ बनाने में मदद करेगा, साथ ही यह सुनिश्चित करेगा कि नागरिकों की शिकायतों का निवारण एक संरचित और न्यायपूर्ण तरीके से हो। इस ज्ञान का उपयोग करके, अधिकारी शासन में सुधार और नागरिक विश्वास को मजबूत करने में योगदान दे सकते हैं।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Appeals and Dispute Resolution under the Customs Act
desc: A fair and transparent dispute resolution system is fundamental to effective customs administration, ensuring legal certainty for both the government and trade stakeholders. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the complete appeals and settlement framework established under the Customs Act. It is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the entire appellate ladder, starting from the initial review by the Commissioner (Appeals) and progressing through the Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT), the High Court, and ultimately, the Supreme Court. The curriculum meticulously covers critical procedures, including the process for filing appeals, the role of the Committee of Commissioners in departmental reviews, and the functions of the Revision Authority. Key legal provisions such as mandatory pre-deposit requirements (Section 129E) and the refund process (Section 129EE) are explained in detail. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply the legal provisions governing customs disputes, effectively manage litigation, and provide informed guidance on navigating the appellate system, thereby upholding procedural integrity and facilitating timely resolution of customs-related conflicts.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Appeals and Review and Settlement under the Customs Act 1962
desc: The Appeal, Review and Settlement of Cases in Customs course provides a structured understanding of the multi-tier appellate system established under the Customs Act, 1962. It explains the procedures for filing and handling appeals before the Commissioner (Appeals), CESTAT, High Courts, and the Supreme Court. The course also covers departmental review mechanisms and the functioning of the Settlement Commission. Through seven well-defined modules, participants gain insights into statutory provisions, legal procedures, documentation requirements, timelines, and relevant case laws. The course aims to enhance officers’ ability to ensure procedural fairness, improve the quality of adjudication, and maintain consistency in customs dispute resolution.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Appeals and Revision and Review under CCS (CCA) Rules 1965
desc: The Central Civil Services (Classification, Control, and Appeal) Rules, 1965, are fundamental to maintaining discipline and ensuring procedural fairness within the Central Government. This course focuses on Part IV of these rules, which details the critical post-decision remedies available to employees. The curriculum provides an in-depth exploration of the legal framework governing appeals, revisions, and reviews. Learners will understand the specific conditions, timelines, and procedural requirements for filing an appeal to a higher authority. The course also clarifies the distinct mechanisms of revision and review, explaining the grounds on which they can be invoked and the authorities empowered to exercise them. By completing this course, participants will be able to confidently identify, assess, and apply these remedies in relevant service matters, contributing to effective grievance redressal and upholding administrative justice.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Application of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Nursing
desc: This course introduces nurses to the ways intelligent technologies are transforming diagnosis, treatment, and patient care. It provides a clear understanding of the basics of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), explaining how these systems analyze healthcare data, recognize patterns, and support clinical decision-making. Learners explore practical applications in medical imaging, personalized medicine, drug discovery, and chronic disease management. The course also covers emerging technologies such as Natural Language Processing (NLP), large language models (LLMs), and virtual reality (VR) for documentation and education. Ethical considerations and responsible use of AI and ML in healthcare are emphasized throughout. By the end of the course, nurses gain practical knowledge of AI-enabled care and are prepared to apply these tools safely and effectively in modern healthcare practice.

title: Application of Google Earth Engine for Water Resources Management
desc: This course provides an introduction to the use of Google Earth Engine (GEE) for water resources assessment and monitoring, emphasizing satellite-based analysis of hydrological events such as droughts, floods, reservoir dynamics, and surface water variability. Participants will learn to leverage cloud-based geospatial tools to generate actionable insights, enabling informed planning and decision-making in water resources management. The course combines theoretical understanding with practical applications, preparing learners to analyze, interpret, and apply remote sensing data effectively for sustainable water resource planning.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: Application of Microwave Remote Sensing in Lineament Extraction
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with specialized knowledge in the application of microwave remote sensing for geological analysis. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of the electromagnetic spectrum, sensor technology, and the unique properties of microwave data, such as its ability to penetrate cloud and vegetation cover. The course delves into the critical parameters that influence radar imagery, including wavelength, polarization, and the dielectric constant of surface materials. Participants will learn about various Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) systems, their data products, and their use in different scientific applications like interferometry (InSAR) and polarimetry (PolSAR). The second half of the course provides a step-by-step guide to lineament extraction, a crucial technique in structural geology for identifying faults, fractures, and other linear features. Learners will discover how to interpret radar images and merge them with optical data using GIS software to enhance mapping accuracy. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these methods for resource exploration, hazard assessment, and comprehensive geological mapping.

title: Application Security Essential for Modern Organisation
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of application security practices required to protect software applications throughout the development and deployment lifecycle. In today’s highly digital and interconnected environment, applications represent one of the primary attack surfaces for cyber threats, making robust application security a critical component of organisational cybersecurity strategy. The course focuses on integrating security into technology, processes, governance, and organisational culture. Participants will learn about secure coding practices, threat modelling, vulnerability management, runtime protections, and security integration within CI/CD pipelines. It also explores the importance of aligning application security initiatives with industry frameworks such as OWASP and NIST, while addressing compliance and governance requirements.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Application Security:Trends and Analysis
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, securing applications has become a paramount concern for national security and effective governance. This session delves into the landscape of application security, offering critical insights for CISOs and IT decision-makers. The course begins by contextualizing the importance of cybersecurity as a foundational pillar for a developed India, highlighting recent cyber-attack trends on government IT and operational technology. Learners will explore the primary motives behind these attacks, from financial gain to causing operational disruption. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical security frameworks, including a detailed look at the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and the 'Shift Left' and 'Shift Right' paradigms for embedding security into the development process (DevSecOps). By the end of this session, participants will understand how to move from a reactive to a proactive security posture, treating cybersecurity not as a compliance task but as a core business enabler that creates and preserves value.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Applications of Isotopes in Water Resources Management
desc: This course introduces the principles and applications of isotopes in water resources management. It covers both stable and radioactive isotopes—such as oxygen-18, deuterium, tritium, and carbon-14—to understand key hydrological processes, including groundwater recharge, flow dynamics, residence time, and surface water–groundwater interactions. The course emphasizes the use of isotope techniques for tracing pollution sources, evaluating aquifer connectivity, assessing evaporation losses, and identifying the origins of salinity. Practical components include sampling strategies, data interpretation, and the integration of isotopic tools with hydrogeological and geochemical methods. By the end of the course, participants will be able to apply isotope techniques to support sustainable groundwater management, water quality assessment, and climate change–related hydrological studies.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: Applied Remote Sensing for Planning and Conservation
desc: This course provides an in-depth overview of remote sensing applications in urban planning, regional corridor mapping, natural disaster management, and forest resources management. It highlights the integration of satellite data with human-tagged and field-sampled data to generate actionable insights. Learners will also gain hands-on exposure to operating the National Database of Emergency Management (NDEM) portal, enabling practical application of remote sensing and GIS for planning, monitoring, and disaster response.
org: Department of Space and ISRO HQ

title: Applying Corporate Strategy in Government Systems
desc: The course equips government officers and public sector managers with practical approaches to applying strategic thinking within rule-bound public institutions. The course demonstrates how corporate strategy concepts can be adapted to government systems by aligning policy intent, strategic priorities, execution mechanisms, and institutional outcomes. It covers key areas such as strategic analysis, stakeholder mapping, organizational alignment, execution challenges, public value creation, performance measurement, and institutional continuity. Through case studies including the Swachh Bharat Mission, Aadhaar and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), GST implementation, ISRO, and OFB corporatization, learners gain insights into how long-term strategies are designed and implemented within legal, financial, political, and administrative constraints.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: APPOINTMENT AND REMOVAL OF DIRECTORS
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the statutory provisions concerning directors under the Companies Act, 2013. It is designed for professionals who need to understand the legal and procedural aspects of corporate board management. The content begins by defining the role of a director and the board, outlining the minimum and maximum number of directors for different types of companies. Key learning areas include the appointment process for first directors, additional directors, and alternate directors, along with the mandatory requirement of a Director Identification Number (DIN). The course delves into specific provisions for appointing woman directors, resident directors, and independent directors, explaining their qualifications and criteria. Furthermore, it covers the critical topics of director disqualifications, the process for removal, and their statutory duties and liabilities. Learners will also gain insights into the regulations governing director remuneration and the mandatory disclosure of interests, ensuring they can navigate the complexities of corporate law and promote ethical governance.

title: Approaches of Sustainable Soil management in Geo-Hydrological, Social
desc: This module delves into the essential principles and practices of sustainable soil management through a participatory lens. It addresses the importance of viewing soil health not just as a technical issue, but as a socio-ecological challenge that requires community involvement. The course begins by revising core concepts of soil health and then explains why community participation is fundamental for the effective governance of land and water resources. Participants will learn how to analyze landscapes and apply geo-hydrological and social frameworks to real-world scenarios. The content is structured to equip learners with the knowledge to facilitate community-led planning for landscape restoration and improved soil health. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to apply these integrated approaches in field situations, contributing to more resilient agricultural systems and empowered local communities.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: Arrest Procedures for Women under BNSS 2023
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the lawful procedure for arresting women under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. It emphasizes key legal provisions, safeguards, and procedural requirements that police officers must follow to ensure dignity, safety, and compliance during arrest and custody. Learners will explore the responsibilities of officers, the timing and presence of female personnel, and protocols to uphold the rights of women while enforcing the law.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Arrest Procedures: Legal Nuances Special Cases and Checklists
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the new procedures governing arrests as stipulated in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. It addresses the critical need for law enforcement personnel to adapt to the updated criminal laws, ensuring that their actions are compliant and just. The curriculum systematically covers the essential steps to be followed by police officers during and after an arrest, providing clarity on complex situations such as arrests made without a warrant, arrests by private citizens, and the special protocols required for arresting women and juveniles. Key learning areas include the rationale for non-arrest, the use of summons, post-arrest obligations like medical examinations and informing family members, and the specific time limits for police and judicial custody. By detailing provisions from special laws like the POCSO Act and the SC/ST Act, the course equips officers with the comprehensive knowledge needed to perform their duties effectively while upholding the rule of law and protecting citizen rights.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Arrest Under Goods And Service Tax Act 2017
desc: This course is designed for tax enforcement officials to build a deep and procedural understanding of arrests under the GST Act, 2017. It addresses the critical importance of balancing enforcement duties with the fundamental rights of individuals. The curriculum begins by establishing a strong foundation in the constitutional provisions that protect citizens, such as Articles 14, 20, 21, and 22, which govern equality, protection from self-incrimination, and rights upon arrest. The course then examines the practical application of these rights through an analysis of landmark Supreme Court directives and official CBIC circulars that guide officer conduct. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of Section 69 (Power to Arrest) and Section 132 (Punishment for Certain Offenses) of the CGST Act. Participants will learn to distinguish between bailable, non-bailable, cognizable, and non-cognizable offenses, and understand the procedural requirements outlined in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. By analyzing a real-world case study, learners will see how these principles are applied in practice, from evidence gathering to producing an arrestee before a magistrate. This will equip them to carry out their duties effectively, legally, and with respect for due process.

title: Art of Effective Writing in Geosciences
desc: Dive into the intricacies of professional scientific writing with 'The Art of Effective Scientific Writing for Geosciences.' This comprehensive course is tailored for professionals in the geoscientific community who wish to refine their ability to communicate complex ideas with clarity and precision. The curriculum is delivered across four modules, starting with the fundamental characteristics of good writing, such as omitting needless words and using a strong, active voice. You will then explore advanced techniques for enhancing sentence structure through strategic use of punctuation and parallelism. The course also provides paragraph-level tips, including the effective use of acronyms and the art of crafting a memorable final sentence. The final module focuses on remodeling the entire science writing process, from pre-writing and drafting to revision, ensuring you can move from data and ideas to a polished, professional publication. By the end of this course, you will be better prepared to write elegant, stylish, and effective scientific papers that successfully convey your research to a global audience.

title: Art of Storytelling
desc: This course, 'The Art of Storytelling,' is designed to equip professionals with the essential skills to communicate with influence and impact. It delves into the core principles of effective narrative construction and delivery, moving beyond theory to practical application. The curriculum begins by deconstructing the 'telling' aspect of storytelling, addressing the common fear of public speaking and offering strategies to build confidence. Learners will be introduced to Aristotle's timeless framework of logos (logic), ethos (credibility), and pathos (emotion), learning how to balance these three appeals for maximum resonance. The course also covers modern communication tools, such as the power of sound bites to encapsulate key messages and the importance of the PAM (Purpose, Audience, Message) framework to ensure your story is audience-centric. By analyzing the distinct styles of master storytellers from various fields, participants will learn to identify their own authentic voice. Upon completion, you will be able to structure your narratives effectively, manage your speaking pace, and deliver concise, precise, and memorable stories in any professional setting, from team meetings to high-stakes presentations.

title: Arthashastra: A Beginner's Guide
desc: Kautilya’s Arthashastra is a comprehensive manual on statecraft that has influenced political and strategic thought for centuries. This introductory course delves into its core concepts, positioning it alongside global classics like Sun Tzu’s The Art of War. The curriculum explores the fundamental principles of governance, economic management, and international relations as detailed across the Arthashastra's 15 books. Key learning areas include Kautilya's pragmatic approach to economic policy, covering agriculture, taxation, and trade. The course also examines the intricate frameworks for diplomacy and foreign policy, such as the 'Mandala' theory of states and the six-fold strategy for international conduct. By analyzing these ancient strategies, learners will be equipped to apply timeless principles of leadership and strategic management to modern challenges in public administration and international affairs.

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
desc: Embark on a journey into the world of Artificial Intelligence with this introductory course. You will begin by understanding the basic definition of AI, as conceptualized by its pioneer, John McCarthy, and learn how it differs from traditional computer programming. The curriculum breaks down the essential elements that constitute intelligence, such as learning from information, reasoning to solve puzzles, and perceiving the world. The course highlights the practical applications of AI that are already a part of our daily lives. Through clear explanations and relatable examples like virtual assistants (Siri, Alexa), predictive text, self-driving cars, and face recognition systems, you will gain a solid understanding of AI's transformative potential. By the end of this course, you will be able to identify key AI technologies and appreciate their growing importance in enhancing performance, accuracy, and safety across various domains.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Good: Innovate Empower and Transform
desc: Dive into the world of Artificial Intelligence and understand how it is fundamentally reshaping our lives, work, and public services. This course offers a thought-provoking exploration of AI's role in driving innovation, empowering communities, and transforming industries. The curriculum provides a balanced perspective, detailing how AI can enhance traditional systems like cybersecurity through proactive threat detection and anomaly identification. It also confronts the critical challenges and ethical dilemmas posed by advanced AI. Key learning areas include the mechanics and risks of deepfakes, the pervasive issue of bias in AI models, the emerging field of machine unlearning to correct errors and protect privacy, and the concept of negation bias where AI fails to understand negative commands. By the end of this course, learners will be better equipped to understand the strategic importance of AI, evaluate its applications and risks, and appreciate the necessity for ethical guidelines and strong governance to ensure AI is developed and deployed responsibly for the public good.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data and Forex Markets
desc: This course provides a practical overview of how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Big Data are transforming foreign exchange (Forex) analysis, monitoring, risk management, and decision support, with particular relevance to the Indian context. The course introduces the fundamentals of Forex markets, including currency pairs, market participants, and the economic, financial, and geopolitical factors that influence exchange-rate movements. It explores how historical price data, inflation, interest rates, trade balances, capital flows, crude oil prices, central-bank communication, news, market sentiment, and transaction data can be integrated to support structured currency-market analysis. Learners are introduced to the applications of machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), real-time data processing, and back-testing for identifying market patterns, analysing sentiment, generating alerts, and supporting probability-based decision-making.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Public Infrastructure Stack
desc: This course delves into the strategic integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a foundational element of India's next-generation Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI). It provides a detailed examination of India's ambition to build a resilient, scalable, and inclusive AI-first ecosystem. The content explores the core components of this vision, including the mission to democratize AI by leveraging National Systems of Records, advanced intelligence, and seamless interaction and integration layers. Learners will understand how datasets, APIs, and workflows are being combined to create domain-specific operating systems for key sectors such as healthcare, education, and agriculture. Furthermore, the course discusses the critical role of AI in policy modeling, fostering smart governance, and enabling personalized public services. Upon completion, participants will have a clear understanding of India's strategic roadmap for accelerating digital transformation and the profound implications of an AI-powered DPI for national development.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Policy
desc: This course provides a practical understanding of how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is influencing public policy and supporting India’s transition from digital governance to intelligent and AI-enabled governance. The course explores how AI can support different stages of the public policy cycle, including problem identification, policy formulation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation, while emphasising that public authority, human judgement, and accountability must remain with government officials and institutions. Participants will be introduced to key elements of India’s emerging AI ecosystem, including the IndiaAI Mission, India AI Governance Guidelines, and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) framework.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Artificial Intelligence Chatbots and Agentic AI

It begins with the core principles of AI and Machine Learning (ML), covering project lifecycles, infrastructure, and key use cases in the public sector. The curriculum then dives deep into the design and application of AI chatbots. You will learn to build and deploy sophisticated chatbots using cutting-edge technologies like Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enabling you to create more responsive and efficient citizen services. Furthermore, the course explores the frontier of Agentic AI, teaching you how to implement intelligent systems capable of autonomous decision-making. With a focus on hands-on exercises and real-world scenarios, you will gain the skills to not only understand but also apply these powerful technologies to solve complex challenges in governance, driving innovation and efficiency within your role.

title: Artificial Intelligence Enabling Education Outreach
desc: This course delves into the pivotal role of Artificial Intelligence in revolutionizing education and professional development. It provides a strategic perspective on how AI is not just a technological tool but a key enabler of widespread educational transformation. The curriculum explores the application of AI in creating personalized learning platforms, AI-powered tutors, and automated assessment systems that enhance learning efficiency. It further examines how the integration of AI with immersive technologies like AR/VR and IoT is fostering new experiential and hybrid learning models. A significant focus is placed on the Indian context, analyzing how AI-driven solutions are designed to overcome regional, linguistic, and socio-economic barriers through innovative, low-bandwidth applications. The course also assesses the critical support from government policies and frameworks, such as NEP 2020 and the IndiaAI Mission, which are paving the way for scalable and equitable AI adoption. Upon completion, learners will have a robust understanding of AI's potential to shape a more inclusive and effective education ecosystem.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Artificial Intelligence for Accessibility and Inclusion
desc: In an increasingly digital world, Artificial Intelligence offers transformative potential to bridge gaps and create a more inclusive society. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the application of AI for accessibility and social good. It delves into how AI-powered technologies are breaking down barriers for people with disabilities and other underserved groups, enhancing their quality of life and participation in society. Learners will explore practical, real-world examples of AI tools that assist with visual, speech, and learning challenges, as well as applications in healthcare, education, and personal safety. The curriculum also addresses the critical ethical considerations and principles of responsible innovation, ensuring that technological advancements are guided by fairness and respect for all individuals. Upon completion, participants will have a strong foundational understanding of how AI can be harnessed to build a more accessible and equitable future.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Everyone
desc: Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries and governance, making a foundational understanding essential for every professional. This course provides an accessible entry point into the world of AI, specifically for those without a technical background. You will learn the core concepts of AI, including how systems like large language models process vast amounts of data to recognize patterns and deliver actionable insights. The curriculum explores diverse real-world use cases, demonstrating AI's practical value across various sectors. A significant focus is placed on the principles of responsible AI. The course delves into the importance of AI governance, security risks like prompt injection, accountability, and ethical guardrails needed for trustworthy adoption. By the end of this session, you will not only grasp what AI is and how it works but also be equipped to critically evaluate its potential and risks, enabling you to participate in discussions and decisions regarding AI implementation in your professional context.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Government Officers
desc: This course introduces government officers to the practical applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in governance and administrative functions without requiring any prior technical background. It provides a foundational understanding of key AI concepts and demonstrates how AI-powered tools can support day-to-day administrative tasks such as drafting official communications, summarising documents, analysing information, and improving overall productivity. The course highlights real-world use cases of AI in governance and explains how these technologies can enhance operational efficiency, support data-driven decision-making, and improve public service delivery. In addition, it emphasizes the responsible and ethical use of AI in government environments, including important considerations related to data privacy, transparency, accountability, and the appropriate use of AI-generated outputs.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Investments
desc: The financial services landscape is rapidly evolving, driven by technological innovation. This course provides a comprehensive overview of how Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning are reshaping investment strategies and risk management. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals of financial markets, including market efficiency, risk aversion, and the risk-return framework. It then progresses to sophisticated asset pricing theories, such as the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and the Fama-French three-factor model, demonstrating their practical applications. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to algorithmic trading, where learners will explore various strategies like Time-Weighted Average Price (TWAP), Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP), and statistical arbitrage. Participants will also learn to apply regression algorithms for portfolio management and performance evaluation using key metrics like the Sharpe ratio and Treynor's measure. By the end of this course, officials will be able to analyze and apply AI-based models to make more informed and efficient investment decisions in a data-centric financial world.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Karmayogis
desc: Artificial Intelligence (AI) can significantly enhance the daily work of government officials. This course introduces practical, easy-to-use AI tools that help you research faster, draft clearer communications, analyse data efficiently, and make more informed decisions. Using relatable examples from government offices, the course explains when to use search engines versus Generative AI, how to craft effective prompts, and how AI can support routine workplace tasks and official communication. It also highlights the principles of safe and responsible AI use. By the end of the course, you will be able to identify opportunities to apply AI in your department and confidently use Generative AI to support smarter, citizen-centric governance.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Public Governance
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, Artificial Intelligence (AI) presents a transformative opportunity for public administration. This course is designed to provide government professionals with the essential knowledge to harness AI for improved governance and citizen services. It addresses the critical need for AI literacy within the public sector, moving beyond theoretical concepts to focus on practical implementation and strategic oversight. The curriculum delves into the fundamentals of modern AI, covering generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and innovative frameworks like RAG, MAS, and LAM. Participants will explore a variety of use cases across key government sectors, including public safety, healthcare, education, and administration, learning to identify opportunities for automation and data-driven decision-making. A significant focus is placed on India's growing AI ecosystem, enabling officers to evaluate and select cost-effective, contextually relevant solutions. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to lead digital transformation projects, critically assess AI vendors, and communicate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. The course fosters a deep understanding of responsible AI adoption, preparing officials to contribute to policy discussions and ensure that AI is deployed ethically and effectively to serve the public good.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Social Good

This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the concept of 'AI for Social Good,' specifically tailored for individuals interested in public sector innovation and social impact. It moves beyond theoretical concepts to explore practical, real-world applications where AI is already making a difference. Participants will delve into how AI-driven solutions are enhancing healthcare through improved disease diagnosis, reshaping education with adaptive learning platforms, and promoting environmental sustainability via smart agriculture and climate monitoring. title: Artificial Intelligence in Disaster Management
desc: In an era of increasing climate-related events, leveraging advanced technology for public safety is critical. This course provides a comprehensive overview of how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming the field of disaster management. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of disaster management principles and the importance of integrated alert systems like SACHET. The curriculum then delves into the core of AI's role, exploring its application in data collection, predictive modeling, and forecasting. Participants will learn about various AI models used for disaster forecasting, geospatial mapping of vulnerable areas, and severity assessment using data from sources like social media, satellite imagery, and historical records. The course also addresses the critical function of effective communication during crises, detailing how AI-powered chatbots and decision support systems can overcome challenges like language barriers and information overload. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to understand and articulate the strategic value of AI in creating more effective, data-driven disaster response plans, ultimately contributing to enhanced community resilience and saving lives.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Finance
desc: This course offers a comprehensive yet accessible overview of Artificial Intelligence for professionals in the financial domain. It is structured into three modules, beginning with a foundational introduction to AI and Machine Learning, explaining their history and core principles like the Turing Test in a jargon-free manner. The course distinguishes between rule-based and data-driven AI, clarifying concepts such as supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning. The second module delves into the specific applications of AI in finance. It explores how traditional and alternative data sources are used to build predictive models for portfolio management, credit scoring, and identifying market trends. You will learn how fintech companies leverage AI to innovate and gain a competitive edge. The final module introduces practical AI tools that can be used in daily professional life to enhance productivity, such as tools for creating presentations, summarizing documents, and analyzing data. By the end of this course, you will have a solid conceptual understanding of AI's role in finance and be aware of the tools that are shaping the future of the industry.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Heritage Preservation
desc: This course provides an introduction to the powerful intersection of Artificial Intelligence and cultural preservation. It addresses the critical need to protect our shared history in the digital age, showcasing how technology can document, restore, and democratize access to cultural assets. Key learning areas include the use of AI for the digital archiving and restoration of historical artifacts, paintings, and manuscripts. You will explore how digital tools like 3D modeling, photogrammetry, and virtual reality are creating immersive educational experiences and preserving sites like Mont Saint Michel. The course also delves into AI's role in documenting and revitalizing endangered languages and the ethical considerations of digital preservation. Upon completion, you will understand how AI enhances cultural accessibility and be inspired to think critically about technology's role in protecting our collective identity.

title: Artificial Intelligence Integration in Microsoft Office 365
desc: In today's digital-first public sector, proficiency with modern productivity tools is essential for effective governance. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the AI-driven capabilities of Microsoft Office 365, designed to elevate daily administrative and collaborative tasks. Participants will move beyond basic functions to explore intelligent features that streamline workflows and improve output quality. Key learning areas include leveraging AI assistants like Editor and Designer in Word and PowerPoint, utilizing cloud storage and sharing with OneDrive, and employing advanced communication tools like Dictate and Microsoft Translator for seamless interaction. A significant focus is placed on fostering inclusivity through accessibility tools such as Immersive Reader and OneNote's Ink to Text feature. Upon completion, learners will be empowered to not only boost their personal productivity but also to promote a more accessible and collaborative digital culture within their teams and organizations, ensuring that services and communications are available to all.

title: Artificial Intelligence: Foundations and India's AI Ecosystem
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Artificial Intelligence (AI), covering its evolution, applications, ethical considerations, emerging technologies, and development in the Indian context. It introduces the fundamental concepts and historical development of AI, from the Turing Test and Dartmouth Conference to AI winters, expert systems, machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI. Learners will explore landmark AI systems such as ELIZA, IBM Deep Blue, IBM Watson, AlphaGo, and ChatGPT, and understand their significance in advancing AI research and real-world applications. title: Artificial Intelligence: Technology Ethics and Impact
desc: In an era increasingly shaped by intelligent systems, understanding the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence is crucial for public sector professionals. This course demystifies core AI concepts, providing a clear overview of Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), and their real-world applications. It explores the complex relationship between AI and culture, analyzing how technology can be adapted to diverse linguistic and social contexts to ensure fairness and inclusivity. title: Artificial Intelligence: Unlocking Potential and Securing Trust
desc: Dive into the world of Artificial Intelligence and understand its profound impact on modern governance and society. This course begins with a journey through the history of AI, from its conceptual origins to the current era of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI. You will gain clarity on fundamental concepts, distinguishing between machine learning, deep learning, and other key buzzwords. The curriculum explores practical applications of AI across diverse sectors such as agriculture, healthcare, and finance, illustrating its potential to drive innovation and efficiency. You will learn about the frameworks for ensuring AI systems are safe, trustworthy, and reliable, addressing critical issues like data privacy, explainability, and ethical governance. title: Artificial Intelligence_L2
desc: In an era where Artificial Intelligence is poised to redefine industries, the ability to formulate a coherent AI strategy is a critical leadership skill. This course is designed for CXOs, divisional heads, and managers who are tasked with driving AI and ML initiatives within their organizations. It demystifies the process of creating a successful AI/ML solution by providing a structured, strategic approach. You will learn why many AI projects fail to deliver on their promise and what differentiates success from failure. The curriculum is built around five core pillars: reimagining business processes for AI integration, understanding the central role of data, accurately estimating business benefits, navigating technology choices, and managing the crucial human aspects of change and adoption. Through expert insights and real-world case studies from sectors like finance, retail, and telecom, you will learn to ask the right questions, evaluate proposals, and guide your teams to conceptualize and execute AI initiatives that are destined for success, whether they are incremental improvements or large-scale transformations.

title: Artificial Source Geophysical Exploration Methods
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of artificial source geophysical methods, essential for mapping and understanding the Earth's subsurface. It begins by establishing the foundational concepts of geophysics, differentiating between natural and artificial source techniques and their respective applications. The curriculum then provides detailed coverage of several critical methods. Learners will study electromagnetic methods like Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), electrical resistivity surveys including various electrode configurations (Wenner, Schlumberger), and the principles of Induced Polarization (IP) for identifying mineralized zones. The course also covers shallow seismic refraction surveys for determining bedrock depth and characteristics. Through this course, participants will gain the ability to select and apply appropriate geophysical methods, interpret the collected data to create subsurface models, and understand their application in economic geology, hydrogeology, and engineering, making it highly relevant for professionals in earth sciences and resource exploration.

title: Ask Our Experts -Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT
desc: This program offers an in-depth exploration of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT. It addresses the critical need to build a robust research and development ecosystem in India's technology sector. The course breaks down the scheme's structure, covering its two phases, financial components, and eligibility criteria for different categories of beneficiaries, including full-time PhD candidates, part-time candidates from industry, Young Faculty Research Fellows, and Post-Doctoral Fellows. Participants will learn about the specific benefits such as monthly fellowships, contingency grants, reimbursement of rent, and support for international conference participation and lab visits. The session also clarifies the application process for both institutions seeking seat allotment and for individual aspirants. By the end of this course, learners will have a clear roadmap on how to engage with the scheme and leverage its resources to advance their research careers and contribute to India's technological growth.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Aspects of Decentralised Wastewater Management
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of decentralised wastewater management, a vital component of modern sanitation and environmental strategy. It begins by establishing the context for decentralised solutions, highlighting their importance in achieving public health goals and compliance with environmental regulations, especially under national missions like the Swachh Bharat Mission. The curriculum delves into various technological options, including septic systems, anaerobic baffled reactors, and nature-based solutions like constructed wetlands, explaining their operational principles, advantages, and limitations. Learners will explore the key stages of planning, designing, implementing, and maintaining these systems effectively. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to assess the suitability of different decentralised technologies for specific local conditions and contribute to the successful execution of sustainable sanitation projects in their communities.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Assessment in Goods and Services Tax (GST)
desc: Assessment is a cornerstone of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system, defining the process of determining a taxpayer's liability. This course offers an in-depth examination of the assessment mechanisms stipulated in the CGST Act, 2017. It is specifically designed for tax professionals and government officers seeking to master the nuances of GST compliance and administration. The curriculum systematically covers the five key types of assessment: self-assessment, provisional assessment, scrutiny of returns, best judgment assessment, and summary assessment. Participants will delve into the specific legal sections (59 to 64) and procedural rules (98 to 100) that govern each type. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently navigate complex assessment scenarios, apply the correct legal provisions, and ensure the accurate determination of tax liability, thereby strengthening the integrity of the GST framework.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Association of American Railroads 'H' Type Tight Lock CBC
desc: This technical course provides in-depth knowledge of railway couplers, with a specialized focus on the AAR 'H' Type Tight Lock CBC system. The program is designed to equip railway personnel with the practical skills needed for safe and efficient coupler management. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of coupler components, the step-by-step process for mounting and dismounting the entire assembly, and the final checks required to ensure operational integrity. Participants will learn to perform crucial safety and maintenance inspections, such as checking knuckle contours, measuring for knuckle nose wear and stretch limits, and using GO/NO-GO gauges for accurate assessment. The course also details anti-creep protection requirements and outlines the specific actions required for CBC Schedule I, II, and III maintenance. Upon completion, learners will be able to ensure that couplers are installed, inspected, and maintained according to the highest safety and reliability standards, contributing directly to the safety of railway assets and passengers.

title: ATAL BHUJAL YOJANA
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Atal Bhujal Yojana, a pivotal initiative by the Ministry of Jal Shakti aimed at addressing India's groundwater crisis. The program begins by establishing the context of groundwater over-exploitation and the critical need for sustainable management practices. Learners will delve into the scheme's core structure, including its two main components: Institutional Strengthening & Capacity Building and the Incentive Component, which are driven by Disbursement Linked Indicators (DLIs). The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of the scheme's implementation, from community-led preparation of Water Security Plans (WSPs) and water budgeting to the convergence of funds from various government programs for financing interventions. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of demand-side and supply-side management measures, the four-tier institutional framework for implementation, and the robust monitoring and evaluation mechanisms. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute effectively to the planning, execution, and monitoring of groundwater governance projects under this national mission.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: Atmanirbharta
desc: Ātmanirbhar Bharat, or a Self-Reliant India, represents a pivotal strategic and philosophical shift in modern governance. This course provides a comprehensive exploration of this concept, moving beyond its common portrayal as mere import substitution. It delves into the core principles of self-reliance as a framework for building national capability, fostering context-aware decision-making, and instilling a profound sense of responsibility within the public service. The curriculum examines the evolution of the Ātmanirbhar Bharat vision from 2020 to 2025, analyzing its application across critical sectors such as defence, technology, agriculture, and digital innovation. Participants will explore major policy initiatives like 'Vocal for Local' and 'Make for the World,' understanding their impact on India’s production landscape and global competitiveness. Through administrative scenarios and case studies, the course highlights how manufacturing, skills, infrastructure, and a resilient mindset are interconnected pillars for national progress. Ultimately, learners will be equipped to integrate the principles of self-reliance into their professional roles, contributing effectively to the national goal of Viksit Bharat @2047 and reinforcing India's position as a confident and capable global leader.

title: Atrocities against Women and Children
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the critical issue of atrocities against women and children, a global problem that transcends cultural and socio-economic barriers. It begins by defining gender-based violence and categorizing its various manifestations, such as domestic abuse, sexual harassment, child marriage, and dowry-related violence. The content delves into the underlying causes, including patriarchal norms and societal inequalities, that perpetuate these acts. Learners will be introduced to the essential legal protections available in India, with a focus on the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (2005) and the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act (2012). The course also examines the profound psychological and social impact of such violence on individuals and families. By the end, participants will understand the importance of preventive measures, the role of law enforcement and society, and the need for gender sensitization to effectively combat these atrocities and foster a secure environment for all.

title: Attached Offices, Statutory Organisations, Autonomous Societies
desc: This course offers an essential understanding of the institutional framework of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), a key driver of India's digital transformation. In an era where technology is integral to governance and economic progress, knowing the structure and function of MeitY is crucial for public officials. The module systematically introduces learners to the different types of bodies operating under the ministry, such as its attached offices, statutory organisations, autonomous societies, and associated companies. By exploring their distinct roles and collective mandate, participants will gain a clear perspective on how this ecosystem contributes to national priorities like digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI development, and semiconductor manufacturing. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to comprehend the landscape of digital governance and technological advancement in India.
org: Ministry of Electronics and Information and Technology Meity

title: Attacking Inequalities in Health
desc: Inequities in health outcomes represent a critical challenge for public health systems worldwide. This course is designed to equip public health professionals, policymakers, and administrators with the knowledge to effectively address these disparities. It delves into the complex interplay of social, economic, and systemic factors that create and sustain health inequalities. Learners will be guided through a systematic analysis of health systems, examining key areas such as financing, service delivery, governance, and human resources to understand their impact on equity. The course emphasizes a practical, evidence-based approach, showcasing successful reforms and interventions from various contexts. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to design, advocate for, and implement policies and programs that promote health equity and reduce disparities within their communities and health systems.

title: Attempt to Murder
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the investigative process for 'Attempt to Murder,' a grievous offense under Section 109 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). In the context of modern policing, a systematic and legally sound investigation is paramount for ensuring justice and maintaining public trust. This program is structured to equip police officers with the critical knowledge and procedural skills required to handle such complex cases from inception to prosecution. Key learning areas include the initial response to an incident, securing and examining the scene of the crime, and the proper collection and preservation of forensic evidence like gunshot residue (GSR) and CCTV footage. Learners will be guided through the intricacies of registering an FIR, drafting essential documents such as site plans and seizure memos, and recording witness statements in accordance with the law. The course also covers the correct procedures for arresting a suspect, managing case diaries, and preparing a robust chargesheet for the court. Upon completion, officers will be proficient in applying these standardized protocols, leading to more effective investigations and strengthening the chain of evidence for successful legal outcomes.

title: Attempts Abetment and Conspiracy under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
desc: This comprehensive course provides an in-depth analysis of the legal principles governing attempts, abetment, and criminal conspiracy under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. It is specifically designed for legal practitioners, law enforcement officers, and public servants who must interpret and apply these new laws. The curriculum systematically breaks down Chapter IV of the BNS, covering the essential elements of abetment (Sections 45–57), including the definition of an abettor, extraterritorial applications, and liability. The course further explores the offense of concealing criminal designs, with a special focus on the duties of public servants (Sections 58–60). Learners will also master the components of criminal conspiracy under Section 61 and learn to distinguish it from abetment. By analyzing the general provisions for attempt (Section 62) alongside sections where attempts are separately punishable, participants will gain the practical knowledge needed to navigate complex criminal cases and ensure proper application of the BNS.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Audio Frequency Track Circuit
desc: This technical course is designed for professionals in railway signalling and telecommunications, offering an in-depth exploration of Audio Frequency Track Circuits (AFTC). The curriculum begins with the basic principles of train detection and differentiates between DC, AC, and Audio Frequency systems. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Bombardier TI-21M AFTC system, covering its essential components such as transmitters, receivers, tuning units, and impedance bonds. Learners will understand the importance of frequency allocation schemes to prevent interference and the process of system calibration using vacant and occupied threshold values. Furthermore, the course explains how AFTC technology is leveraged for Automatic Train Protection (ATP) data transmission, a key feature for modern train control. Upon completion, participants will have a robust understanding of the installation, operation, and safety considerations of AFTC systems, enabling them to contribute effectively to the maintenance and reliability of railway signalling infrastructure.

title: Audio Video recordings in investigation
desc: With the enactment of the new criminal law, the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), there is a critical need for investigating officers to adapt to updated procedures. This course addresses the significant requirement of using audio and video recordings during searches and seizures. It explains the context and importance of this change, detailing how leveraging audio-visual documentation can lead to more reliable and indisputable evidence. Participants will learn the practical application of these rules to secure a clear, objective account of events, thereby reducing legal disputes and strengthening the prosecution's case. Ultimately, this training aims to equip officers with the knowledge to conduct investigations with greater transparency, precision, and accountability, aligning with modern evidentiary standards.

title: Audit and Inspection of Internet Service Providers (ISPs)
desc: This course offers an in-depth overview of the procedures for auditing and inspecting Internet Service Providers (ISPs) in India. It establishes the context by explaining the regulatory authority derived from the Unified License (UL) agreement and Department of Telecommunications (DoT) mandates. The curriculum systematically covers all critical inspection areas, including general corporate information, technical network architecture, security protocols, lawful interception capabilities, financial revenue statements, and customer grievance redressal mechanisms. Learners will be guided through the entire inspection lifecycle, from reviewing the ISP's license and network diagrams to verifying IPDR logs, security audits, and compliance with DoT instructions. The course also outlines the process of preparing and submitting a formal inspection report and managing the subsequent action-taken reports from the ISP. Upon completion, officials will be proficient in ensuring that ISPs adhere to national security standards, licensing conditions, and quality of service benchmarks, thereby strengthening the telecom sector's regulatory framework.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Audit Follow Up and Parliamentary Oversight
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the critical functions of audit follow-up and parliamentary oversight within the public sector. It is designed to equip learners with a clear understanding of the principles and standardized practices that ensure financial propriety and accountability in government operations. The curriculum delves into the fundamental postulates of audit standards, including objectives, transparency, ethics, and quality assurance. Participants will explore the three primary types of public sector audits: financial, compliance, and performance, understanding their unique objectives and methodologies. The course systematically breaks down the audit process into key stages: planning, conducting, evidence collection, documentation, and reporting. It also clarifies essential concepts such as audit risk, materiality, and confidence levels. By the end of this course, learners will appreciate the integral relationship between the audit function and parliamentary oversight, recognizing how audit findings inform legislative scrutiny and drive improvements in public administration.

title: Audit in GST
desc: This course, 'Fundamentals of Goods and Services Tax (GST) Auditing,' is designed to provide a foundational understanding of the critical function of auditing within the GST framework. In the context of public finance, robust auditing is essential for ensuring tax compliance, preventing revenue leakage, and maintaining the integrity of the indirect tax system. This program delves into the complete audit process, starting from the legal provisions under GST law to the finalization of the audit report. Participants will learn to navigate key financial documents such as the Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, and Trial Balance. The curriculum covers the methodology for creating an effective audit plan, techniques for verifying records, and the analysis of financial statements to detect irregularities. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand the systematic process of a GST audit, appreciate the responsibilities of an auditor, and recognize the importance of accurate financial reporting in the GST ecosystem.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Audit of Urban Local Bodies
desc: This digital course on the Audit of Urban Local Bodies offers a detailed examination of the mechanisms that ensure accountability in urban governance. It is specifically designed for officials working within ULBs and audit professionals from Local Fund Audit departments and the C&AG of India. The curriculum delves into the core aspects of municipal administration, including the audit review of essential services like water supply and waste management. Participants will explore the complexities of municipal financial structures, from budgeting and resource mobilization to accounting standards and audit processes. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding the principles and procedures of auditing ULBs, covering compliance, performance, and transaction audits, supported by the C&AG's Technical Guidance and Support (TGS). Through the analysis of real-world case studies, learners will develop the practical skills needed to conduct effective audits. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply robust audit practices, contributing to improved transparency and performance in India's urban local governance framework.

title: Audit Provisions in Customs
desc: Dive into the intricacies of customs compliance with this detailed course on audit provisions. The curriculum is designed to explain the post-clearance verification framework, a critical component of modern customs administration that balances trade facilitation with revenue protection. You will learn about the legal foundation provided by the Customs Act, 1962, and the Customs Audit Regulations, 2018. The course breaks down the three primary types of audits: Transaction-Based Audit (TBA), Premises-Based Audit (PBA), and Theme-Based Audit (ThBA), explaining their specific objectives and procedures. By understanding this risk-based approach, which aligns with World Customs Organization (WCO) recommendations, professionals can better navigate the regulatory landscape, ensure accurate duty payments, and contribute to a more efficient and compliant trade ecosystem. This course is essential for customs officers and trade professionals seeking to master the principles of post-clearance review and strengthen revenue assurance.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Auditing standards and Procedures
desc: This course is designed to equip public officials with a thorough understanding of government auditing processes and accountability mechanisms. It begins by detailing the four essential stages of an audit follow-up, from initial results to the final presentation of reports before the Legislature. A significant focus is placed on the institutional frameworks that support fiscal discipline. Learners will delve into the establishment, constitution, and functions of audit committees, understanding their pivotal role in governance. The course further clarifies the distinct yet complementary functions of the Public Accounts Committee (PAC), which examines government accounts and CAG reports, and the Committee on Public Undertakings (CoPU), which oversees public sector enterprises. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to navigate the audit landscape, contribute to financial compliance, and uphold administrative accountability in their roles.

title: Augmentation of Municipal Revenue
desc: This comprehensive course addresses the critical need for financial self-sufficiency in Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) to support sustainable urban development and effective public service delivery. It provides a deep dive into the principles and practices of augmenting municipal revenue, moving beyond theoretical concepts to offer practical, implementable solutions. The curriculum begins by examining the structure of municipal finance in India, including Own Source Revenue (OSR) like property taxes and user charges, as well as inter-governmental fiscal transfers. Participants will explore the systemic challenges that hinder revenue generation, such as inadequate fiscal powers, inefficient collection mechanisms, and the 'low equilibrium trap' faced by many ULBs. The course then introduces a range of modern strategies for revenue enhancement, including the adoption of the Double Entry Accounting System (DEAS), GIS-based property tax mapping, digitization of payments, and the issuance of municipal bonds. Through an analysis of real-world case studies and policy frameworks like the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, learners will be equipped to design and implement effective financial reforms. Upon completion, participants will be able to develop actionable plans to strengthen the financial autonomy of their municipalities, ensuring long-term fiscal health and improved urban governance.

title: Autism: Understanding and Learning the Spectrum
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth exploration of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) to build awareness and understanding among learners. The program is structured to guide participants through the complexities of ASD, starting with an introduction to its core characteristics, including challenges in social communication and the presence of stereotyped, repetitive behaviors. It addresses the critical need for early identification by outlining key developmental red flags and diagnostic processes. The course systematically tackles prevalent myths and frequently asked questions, providing evidence-based answers to foster an informed perspective. A significant focus is placed on the holistic support system required for individuals with ASD. Learners will discover the functions of a multidisciplinary team—comprising speech-language pathologists, psychologists, and special educators—and the indispensable role of parents and caregivers in the rehabilitation journey. By completing this course, participants will be equipped with the knowledge to support and advocate for inclusivity, helping to improve functionality and quality of life for people with Autism Spectrum Disorder.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: AutoCAD for Beginners
desc: This comprehensive course, ""Foundational AutoCAD Skills for Urban Planning and Design,"" is designed to equip public sector professionals, particularly those in urban local bodies, with the essential capabilities to leverage AutoCAD for their technical drawing needs. In the context of growing urbanization, the ability to create precise and standardized digital plans is crucial for effective urban management, infrastructure development, and public works. This course addresses that need by providing a structured introduction to AutoCAD's core functionalities. Key learning areas include mastering drawing and editing tools such as polylines, arcs, and offsets; efficiently managing reusable content with blocks and block libraries; and creating complex patterns with associative arrays. Participants will also learn to work with precision using object snaps, dynamic input, and various coordinate entry methods. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently author, edit, and manage complex drawings, apply industry-standard techniques to urban design projects, and significantly improve their productivity and accuracy in roles related to urban planning, engineering, and municipal infrastructure management.

title: AutoCAD Quick Start Guide
desc: Embark on your journey into the world of computer-aided design with this comprehensive quick start guide to AutoCAD. This course is essential for aspiring designers, engineers, and architects who need to develop proficiency in creating precise 2D technical drawings. You will begin by familiarizing yourself with the AutoCAD user interface, including the ribbon, command window, ViewCube, and navigation bar, ensuring you can navigate the software efficiently. The curriculum then dives into the core of AutoCAD, teaching you to create and manipulate fundamental geometric objects. You will gain hands-on experience with drawing commands for lines, circles, rectangles, and polylines, as well as modification tools like trim and extend. A significant focus is placed on precision drafting techniques, utilizing features such as Object Snap (Osnap) and Dynamic Input to ensure accuracy in your designs. Furthermore, you will learn how to effectively organize your drawings through layer management and add critical details using annotation tools for multiline text (Mtext) and dimensioning. By the end of this course, you will have a solid foundation to confidently produce and edit professional 2D drawings, setting you up for success in your design projects.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: AutoCAD Sheet Set Manager
desc: This course is designed to elevate your AutoCAD skills by focusing on the Sheet Set Manager, an essential tool for managing complex drawing projects with multiple sheets. The curriculum provides a structured approach to project organization, moving beyond single drawing files to a holistic project-level management system. You will learn the foundational steps of creating a sheet set from scratch or by importing existing drawing layouts, providing immediate structure to your work. Key learning areas include the strategic use of subsets to group related drawings, the process of renaming and renumbering sheets for logical ordering, and the powerful capability to automate title block information using custom properties and fields, which drastically reduces manual updates and errors. Furthermore, the course delves into advanced topics such as defining and applying label and callout blocks linked to named views, creating page setup overrides for consistent publishing, and managing sheet selections for batch processing. Upon completion, you will be able to implement a standardized, efficient workflow for any multi-sheet AutoCAD project, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and improved team collaboration.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Automatic Block System
desc: This course offers a comprehensive examination of the Automatic Block System (ABS), a cornerstone of safe and efficient train management. The curriculum is designed for railway personnel to build a robust understanding of both the technology and the governing rules of ABS. The course begins with the core principles of ABS, detailing the function of block instruments and the role of signalling and interlocking in preventing accidents. Participants will learn to identify and interpret automatic and semi-automatic stop signals, including understanding phenomena like signal flickering. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical procedures, covering line clearing, shunting, and responding to track obstructions. Furthermore, the course places strong emphasis on emergency preparedness. It provides detailed protocols for train operations during signal failures, passing defective signals at 'ON', and managing train movements in restricted or wrong-direction scenarios. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying ABS rules to ensure maximum safety and operational continuity in both normal and critical situations.

title: Automatic Identification System
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Automatic Identification System (AIS) and its pivotal role in enhancing maritime safety and security. The program begins by establishing the context for AIS, explaining why it is a mandatory system under SOLAS regulations for most commercial vessels. Learners will delve into the key learning areas, including the technical operation of AIS, which utilizes Self-Organising Time Division Multiple Access (SOTDMA) on dedicated VHF frequencies. The course differentiates between the types of data transmitted—static, dynamic, and voyage-related—and explains their significance. Furthermore, it covers the various classes of AIS stations, such as Class A and Class B, and the different types of Aids to Navigation (AtoN) stations, including real, synthetic, and virtual. A significant portion is dedicated to the architecture and importance of the Indian National AIS (NAIS) Network, highlighting its function in coastal surveillance and data sharing among agencies like the Navy and Coast Guard. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply this knowledge to better understand vessel tracking, collision avoidance protocols, and the broader framework of maritime traffic management.
org: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships

title: Automatic Train Protection System
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system, a cornerstone of safety and efficiency in modern Mass Rapid Transit Systems (MRTS). The program begins by establishing the context for ATP, explaining the transition from traditional track-side signals to sophisticated in-cab automated systems required for high-speed, high-frequency urban rail networks. Learners will delve into the core architecture of ATP, differentiating between the track-side and train-borne subsystems and understanding how they interact in real-time to ensure safe operations. Key learning areas include the system's critical safety functions, such as preventing over-speeding, maintaining safe distances between trains, monitoring for rollback, and ensuring correct platform-side door opening. By the end of this course, participants will have a solid foundational knowledge of ATP technology, preparing them to appreciate its vital role in the safe and reliable functioning of metro railways.

title: Automatic Train Supervision System
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the Automatic Train Supervision (ATS) system, the advanced technological backbone for managing complex metro rail networks.
