Participants will delve into the core functionalities of ATS, understanding its crucial role in maintaining operational efficiency and safety. The curriculum covers key aspects such as automatic route setting, real-time train regulation, and remote monitoring from an Operation Control Center (OCC). The course also explains the critical interfaces between ATS and other vital signaling sub-systems, including Computer-Based Interlocking (CBI), Automatic Train Control (ATC), and Passenger Information Display Systems (PIDS). By the end of this course, learners will appreciate how this integrated system enables traffic controllers to manage hundreds of daily train trips, ensuring a seamless and punctual journey for millions of commuters.

title: Automotive Goods, Manufacturing Process, Emerging trends E mobility
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the core principles of designing, developing, and manufacturing automotive goods. It covers essential topics such as vehicle systems, component production, and quality control protocols that are critical in the modern automotive landscape. The curriculum is designed to provide participants with a thorough understanding of the latest technological shifts, including the integration of Industry 4.0 in manufacturing and the transition towards sustainable transportation with a special focus on E-Mobility and low-carbon technologies. Learners will explore how these emerging trends are revolutionizing the industry, creating new challenges and opportunities. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped with the knowledge to navigate the evolving automotive sector, making informed decisions that contribute to technological progress and economic growth.

title: Auxiliary Electric System of Metro Trains
desc: This course provides an in-depth examination of the Auxiliary Electrical System (AES) that powers modern metro trains. The reliability of a metro service depends on the seamless functioning of its many subsystems, all of which require stable electrical power. This course demystifies the journey of electricity from the 25 kV AC overhead lines to the various components that passengers and operators rely on. Key learning areas include the power transformation process, the specific functions of the Static Inverter (SIV) in creating a three-phase AC supply, and the role of the Battery Charger Unit (BCG) in providing single-phase AC and critical 110V DC power. Participants will learn to identify the different types of electrical loads, such as HVAC units, compressors, and control circuits. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the foundational knowledge required for the maintenance, operation, and troubleshooting of these vital electrical systems, ensuring safer and more efficient metro rail operations.

title: Avoiding Know Your Customer Frauds and Online Job Scams
desc: In an increasingly digital society, the threat of cyber fraud looms large, affecting citizens from all walks of life. This course is designed to build a strong defense against two of the most common and damaging schemes: Know Your Customer (KYC) frauds and online job scams. It provides a comprehensive overview of how these scams operate, from deceptive phone calls and phishing links to fake job advertisements that lure unsuspecting applicants. The content delves into the psychological manipulation techniques employed by fraudsters, such as creating a false sense of urgency, fear, or authority, to trick victims into compromising their information. Learners will be guided through practical, step-by-step methods for verifying the authenticity of requests and offers, securing their personal and financial details, and recognizing critical red flags. The course also highlights official government advisories and reporting mechanisms, empowering individuals not only to protect themselves but also to assist friends, family, and community members. Upon completion, participants will have the confidence and skills to navigate the digital landscape safely and act as informed advocates for cyber hygiene.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Avoiding Online Shopping Scam and Digital Arrest Scam
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the threat of cybercrime is ever-present. This course is designed to empower government employees with the essential skills to navigate the online environment safely. It specifically addresses two of the most common and deceptive threats: online shopping scams and digital arrest scams. You will learn the key indicators of fraudulent e-commerce platforms, such as unsecured connections, dubious domain names, and unrealistic offers. The course provides actionable strategies to verify the legitimacy of websites and payment gateways, helping you protect your financial information. Furthermore, the course delves into the psychology of digital arrest scams, where fraudsters impersonate law enforcement officials to create panic and extort money. Through dramatized scenarios and expert guidance, you will learn to recognize these intimidation tactics, stay composed, and understand the correct procedures for verification and reporting. By mastering the 'Stop, Think, Act' approach, you will be able to apply critical thinking in high-pressure situations, report incidents through official channels like cybercrime.gov.in, and ultimately build a stronger defense against a wide range of digital threats.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Awareness and Prevention of Cyberattacks
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding and mitigating cyber threats is essential for all government officials. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the cyber threat landscape, breaking down complex topics into understandable categories. You will learn to distinguish between user-level threats like phishing and social engineering, application vulnerabilities, infrastructure-level attacks, and the often-overlooked danger of insider threats. The curriculum delves into the real-world consequences of security breaches, including financial loss, data theft, and erosion of public trust. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge of common defensive tools, techniques, and best practices. This will enable you to contribute to a more secure digital environment, protecting both personal and organizational data from malicious actors and fostering a culture of security awareness within your department.

title: Awareness of Cybercrime and Social Media Investigation
desc: This course video provides an overview of social media crime and modern investigation methods. It begins by examining current social media usage trends and common cyber offences, including cyberbullying, fraud, sextortion, impersonation, and online harassment. The video further explains investigative fundamentals, OSINT techniques, and digital forensics, along with legal procedures for requesting data from social media platforms. It also addresses the preservation of electronic evidence under Section 63(4) of the BSA, the importance of maintaining the chain of custody, and constitutional safeguards related to password recovery and protection against self-incrimination under Article 20(3).
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: AWARENESS ON BASIC IMPORTANT RECORDS OF POST OFFICE
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the basic yet crucial records that form the administrative backbone of the Department of Posts. In the context of promoting transparency and accountability in governance, maintaining accurate records is paramount. This program details the purpose and procedures for managing a wide range of official documents, including the Order Book, Attendance Register, Memo of Distribution of Work, Nominal Roll, Book of Postmarks, Error Book, and Memo of Authorized Balances (MAB). Participants will learn how these records support daily operations, provide evidence of transactions, protect citizens' rights under the RTI Act, and ensure compliance with organizational requirements. By the end of this course, postal employees will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to manage office records in a structured, standardized, and accountable manner, contributing to better administration and decision-making.

title: AWARENESS ON DIFFERENT BRANCHES IN POST OFFICES
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed for new entrants and existing employees of the Department of Posts to build a clear understanding of the organization's structure and workflow. The content systematically explores the different branches of a post office, explaining their individual roles and collective importance. You will learn about the key services offered at direct customer-contact points like the MPCM and Savings Bank counters. The course then delves into the backend operations, detailing the journey of mail and parcels through the Mails, Delivery, Registration, Parcel, and Speed Post departments. Furthermore, it covers the critical functions of support branches such as Treasury, Accounts, and the Savings Bank Control Organization (SBCO). Upon completion, you will have a holistic view of the post office ecosystem, the distribution of work, and the responsibilities of key personnel, enabling you to better understand your role within the larger departmental framework.

title: Awareness on Marketing Concepts
desc: In today's competitive landscape, understanding marketing is crucial for the growth and sustainability of India Post. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental principles of marketing, tailored specifically for the postal sector. Participants will delve into the core components of the marketing mix, known as the 7Ps, to understand how products and services are successfully brought to market. The curriculum covers the critical roles of sales, various forms of advertising, and the power of word-of-mouth publicity. Furthermore, the course highlights the significance of post-purchase activities, such as after-sale support and efficient grievance handling, in achieving customer delight and fostering loyalty. By the end of this course, employees will recognize their vital role as brand ambassadors, equipped with the knowledge to contribute to India Post's vision of becoming the preferred service provider for every citizen.

title: AWARENESS ON POSTAL MANUALS AND POST OFFICE GUIDES
desc: A thorough understanding of organizational rules and regulations is paramount for every government employee. This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to the guiding documents of India Post. It clarifies the primary difference between Post Office Guides, which are designed to assist customers in using postal services, and the various Postal Manuals, which provide the procedural and legislative backbone for employees. Learners will get an overview of the eight key postal manuals, covering areas such as legislative enactments, disciplinary proceedings, establishment matters, mail operations, and administrative functions. The course also touches upon other important rulebooks, including the Financial Handbook and Post Office Life Insurance Rules. By the end of this session, postal employees will be better equipped to find relevant information, perform their duties with accuracy, and uphold accountability in their roles.

title: AWARENESS ON PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed exploration of the products and services provided by the Department of Posts. It is specifically designed for new entrants and existing employees to build a strong understanding of the organization's core offerings. The curriculum is structured to cover the full spectrum of services, starting with traditional mail products like letters, parcels, and book packets, and explaining the distinction between first-class and second-class mail. The course then delves into premium products designed for corporate and retail customers, such as Speed Post, Business Parcel, and Logistics Post, highlighting their value-added features. Furthermore, it provides an essential overview of the financial services portfolio, including various savings schemes, Postal Life Insurance (PLI), and money remittance options. The program also introduces the unique service of philately. Upon completion, learners will be well-versed in India Post's offerings, enabling them to provide accurate information and superior service to customers.

title: AWARENESS ON SAVINGS BANK AND SAVINGS CERTIFICATES
desc: This foundational course is designed for employees of the Department of Posts to build a thorough understanding of the financial products and services that form a core part of India Post's offerings. The curriculum delves into the specifics of numerous national savings schemes, explaining their features, eligibility criteria, interest rates, and tax benefits, enabling employees to provide accurate and tailored advice to a diverse customer base. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) and KYC procedures, highlighting the department's role in maintaining the integrity of the financial system. Furthermore, the course introduces important social security initiatives like the Pradhan Mantri Jan Suraksha Schemes, which are delivered through the postal network. By completing this course, learners will not only be proficient in the operational aspects of these schemes but will also appreciate their role in fostering socio-economic development and financial security for millions of citizens, particularly in rural and remote areas.

title: Awareness on Software used in Post Offices
desc: This introductory course offers a comprehensive overview of the integrated software ecosystem used in the Department of Posts. It begins by explaining the role of the Core System Integrator (CSI) in unifying various postal functions onto a central platform. Learners will explore the specific functionalities of each major application: the Point of Sale (POS) system for handling counter transactions like mail booking and e-payments; the Delivery and Postman Management System (DPMS) for tracking and managing accountable mail; the Finacle Core Banking Solution for managing savings accounts and financial services; and the SAP application which serves as the backbone for accounting, inventory, and human resource management. The course also touches upon specialized software like McCamish for insurance services and the India Post Visibility System (IPVS) for mail dispatch. Upon completion, participants will understand how these technologies interconnect to support the vast operational network of India Post, from customer-facing transactions to centralized data management and reporting.

title: AWARENESS ON TECHNOLOGY USED IN POST OFFICE
desc: This course details the significant technological transformation within the Department of Posts. It begins by outlining the transition from traditional, offline systems like Meghdoot and Sanchaya Post to a modern, integrated digital framework. A central focus is the IT Modernization Project, a large-scale initiative designed to computerize and network all post offices. Learners will explore the project's core components, including the Financial System Integrator (FSI) for banking and insurance, and the Core System Integrator (CSI) which unifies counter operations, mail, finance, and HR through SAP. The course also covers the deployment of the Rural Information Communication Technology (RICT) solution, now known as Darpan, which has digitized over a lakh of rural branch post offices. Upon completion, participants will understand how these technological advancements have revolutionized customer service, enabled financial inclusion, and positioned India Post as a critical platform for delivering government social welfare schemes to the most remote corners of the country.

title: Axle Counter
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Axle Counter system, a cornerstone of modern railway safety and signaling. It is designed for personnel involved in railway operations and maintenance who need to understand how track occupancy is safely monitored. The course begins by establishing the context of train detection and the importance of block signaling in preventing collisions. You will delve into the specifics of the ACS-2000 model, exploring its working principle based on magnetic field deflection, its primary components, and its different operational configurations, including Isolated and Transmission modes. The curriculum highlights the significant advantages of axle counters over conventional track circuits, such as enhanced reliability, lower maintenance, and performance at high speeds. By the end of this course, you will have a solid conceptual and technical understanding of axle counters, enabling you to appreciate their function in maintaining the highest standards of safety in railway networks.

title: Ayushman Bharat - Healthy India for Universal Health Coverage
desc: The case focuses on the challenges and strategies involved in implementing the Ayushman Bharat initiative to establish 1.5 lakh Health and Wellness Centers across India, providing comprehensive primary healthcare through innovative workforce recruitment, capacity building, and performance monitoring.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors - Hindi
desc: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (एबीडीएम) भारत में स्वास्थ्य सेवा के डिजिटलीकरण में एक महत्वपूर्ण छलांग का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से डॉक्टरों और स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदाताओं को इस राष्ट्रीय पहल के उद्देश्यों, संरचना और लाभों से परिचित कराने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम एबीडीएम के मूल निर्माण खंडों, जैसे आयुष्मान भारत स्वास्थ्य खाता (आभा), स्वास्थ्य पेशेवर रजिस्ट्री (एचपीआर), और स्वास्थ्य सुविधा रजिस्ट्री (एचएफआर) की विस्तृत जानकारी प्रदान करता है। यह यूनिफाइड हेल्थ इंटरफेस (यूएचआई) और सहमति प्रबंधक (कन्सेंट मैनेजर) की भूमिका पर भी प्रकाश डालता है, जो एक सहज और सुरक्षित डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र सुनिश्चित करते हैं। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, डॉक्टर यह समझ पाएंगे कि एबीडीएम को अपनी प्रैक्टिस में कैसे एकीकृत किया जाए, रोगी रिकॉर्ड को डिजिटल रूप से कैसे प्रबंधित किया जाए, और बेहतर नैदानिक ​​निर्णय लेने और प्रशासनिक दक्षता के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी का लाभ कैसे उठाया जाए। यह पाठ्यक्रम डॉक्टरों को भारत के डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य सेवा के भविष्य में सक्रिय रूप से भाग लेने के लिए सशक्त करेगा।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors - Tamil
desc: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் டிஜிட்டல் மிஷன் (ABDM) என்பது இந்தியாவின் சுகாதாரப் பாதுகாப்பு வழங்கல் முறையை டிஜிட்டல் மயமாக்குவதற்கான ஒரு புரட்சிகரமான படியாகும். இந்த பாடநெறி மருத்துவர்கள் மற்றும் சுகாதார நிபுணர்களுக்காக பிரத்யேகமாக வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது, இது இந்த மாற்றத்தின் முக்கியத்துவத்தைப் புரிந்துகொள்ள உதவுகிறது. ABDM-இன் அடிப்படைக் கொள்கைகள், அதன் நோக்கம் மற்றும் சுகாதாரத்துறையில் உள்ள அனைத்து பங்குதாரர்களுக்கும் அது வழங்கும் நன்மைகள் பற்றி நீங்கள் அறிந்து கொள்வீர்கள். ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் சுகாதார கணக்கு (ABHA), சுகாதார நிபுணர் பதிவேடு (HPR), மற்றும் சுகாதார வசதி பதிவேடு (HFR) போன்ற முக்கிய கட்டுமானத் தொகுதிகள் விரிவாக விளக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. மேலும், நோயாளியின் ஒப்புதலுடன் சுகாதாரப் பதிவுகளைப் பாதுகாப்பாகப் பரிமாறிக்கொள்ள உதவும் ஒப்புதல் மேலாளர் மற்றும் ஒருங்கிணைந்த சுகாதார இடைமுகம் (UHI) ஆகியவற்றின் செயல்பாடுகளையும் இது உள்ளடக்கியுள்ளது. இந்த பாடநெறியை முடிப்பதன் மூலம், மருத்துவர்கள் ABDM தளங்களில் பதிவுசெய்து, தங்களது மருத்துவப் பணிகளை மேம்படுத்தி, நோயாளிகளுக்கு சிறந்த, தடையற்ற மற்றும் காகிதமற்ற சுகாதார சேவையை வழங்குவதற்கான அறிவைப் பெறுவார்கள்.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors - Telugu
desc: ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ డిజిటల్ మిషన్ (ABDM) భారతదేశ ఆరోగ్య సంరక్షణ రంగంలో ఒక పరివర్తనాత్మక చొరవ. ఈ కోర్సు వైద్యులు మరియు ఇతర ఆరోగ్య సంరక్షణ సిబ్బందికి ఈ డిజిటల్ పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థను పరిచయం చేయడానికి రూపొందించబడింది. ఇది ABDM యొక్క ఆవశ్యకతను మరియు అది ఆరోగ్య సేవలను మరింత అందుబాటులోకి, చౌకగా మరియు సమర్థవంతంగా ఎలా మారుస్తుందో వివరిస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సులో, మీరు ABDM యొక్క ముఖ్య నిర్మాణ అంశాలైన ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ హెల్త్ అకౌంట్ (ABHA), హెల్త్ ప్రొఫెషనల్ రిజిస్ట్రీ (HPR), మరియు హెల్త్ ఫెసిలిటీ రిజిస్ట్రీ (HFR) గురించి లోతుగా నేర్చుకుంటారు. రోగి యొక్క ఆరోగ్య రికార్డులను సురక్షితంగా పంచుకోవడంలో సమ్మతి నిర్వహణ (consent management) యొక్క ప్రాముఖ్యతను కూడా ఇది విశ్లేషిస్తుంది. అదనంగా, ఈ కోర్సు వైద్యులు మరియు ఆసుపత్రులకు కలిగే ప్రయోజనాలను, అనగా మెరుగైన రోగ నిర్ధారణ నిర్ణయాలు, సరళీకృత పరిపాలనా ప్రక్రియలు మరియు అతుకులు లేని సమన్వయం వంటి వాటిని హైలైట్ చేస్తుంది. కోర్సు ముగిసేసరికి, అభ్యాసకులు ABDM ప్లాట్‌ఫారమ్‌లో విశ్వాసంతో పాల్గొనడానికి, దాని సాధనాలను ఉపయోగించుకోవడానికి మరియు భారతదేశ డిజిటల్ ఆరోగ్య ప్రయాణంలో చురుకుగా పాలుపంచుకోవడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉంటారు.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors - Urdu
desc: آیوشمان بھارت ڈیجیٹل مشن (اے بی ڈی ایم) ہندوستان میں صحت کی دیکھ بھال کے منظر نامے میں ایک انقلابی تبدیلی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔ یہ کورس ڈاکٹروں کو اس تبدیلی میں مؤثر طریقے سے حصہ لینے کے لیے ضروری علم اور اوزار فراہم کرنے کے لیے بنایا گیا ہے۔ یہ اے بی ڈی ایم کے پیچھے کے وژن اور مقاصد کو بیان کرتا ہے، جس کا مقصد ایک مربوط ڈیجیٹل صحت کا ماحولیاتی نظام تشکیل دینا ہے۔ شرکاء کلیدی تعمیراتی بلاکس، بشمول آیوشمان بھارت ہیلتھ اکاؤنٹ (آبھا) برائے مریض، ہیلتھ کیئر پروفیشنلز رجسٹری (ایچ پی آر) برائے ڈاکٹرز، اور ہیلتھ فیسیلٹی رجسٹری (ایچ ایف آر) برائے اداروں، کی گہرائی میں کھوج کریں گے۔ کورس میں یونیفائیڈ ہیلتھ انٹرفیس (یو ایچ آئی) اور ہیلتھ کلیمز ایکسچینج (ایچ سی ایکس) جیسے تصورات کا بھی احاطہ کیا گیا ہے، جو باہمی تعاون اور ہموار ڈیٹا کے تبادلے کو آسان بناتے ہیں۔ اس کورس کو مکمل کرنے کے بعد، ڈاکٹرز اے بی ڈی ایم ماحولیاتی نظام میں شامل ہونے، ڈیجیٹل ہیلتھ ریکارڈز کا مؤثر طریقے سے استعمال کرنے، اور ہندوستان میں ایک زیادہ قابل رسائی، سستی اور معیاری صحت کی دیکھ بھال کے نظام میں حصہ ڈالنے کے لیے بہتر طور پر تیار ہوں گے۔

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors _Marathi
desc: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABDM) हे भारताच्या आरोग्यसेवा क्षेत्रात डिजिटल क्रांती घडवून आणणारे एक महत्त्वाचे पाऊल आहे. हा कोर्स विशेषतः डॉक्टर्स आणि आरोग्यसेवा प्रदात्यांसाठी तयार करण्यात आला आहे, जेणेकरून त्यांना या परिवर्तनाचा भाग बनता येईल. या कोर्समध्ये, आपण ABDM चे ध्येय आणि उद्दिष्टे समजून घ्याल. आपण ABDM च्या मुख्य बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्सबद्दल शिकाल, ज्यात ABHA (आयुष्मान भारत हेल्थ अकाउंट), HPR (हेल्थकेअर प्रोफेशनल रजिस्ट्री), आणि HFR (हेल्थ फॅसिलिटी रजिस्ट्री) यांचा समावेश आहे. तसेच, युनिफाइड हेल्थ इंटरफेस (UHI) आणि संमती व्यवस्थापक (Consent Manager) यांसारख्या संकल्पनांची ओळख करून दिली जाईल. सहभागींना ABDM प्रणालीमध्ये नोंदणी कशी करावी, HMIS (हॉस्पिटल मॅनेजमेंट इन्फॉर्मेशन सिस्टीम) कसे निवडावे आणि या डिजिटल इकोसिस्टममध्ये सक्रियपणे कसे सहभागी व्हावे, याचे मार्गदर्शन मिळेल. हा कोर्स पूर्ण केल्यावर, आपण आपल्या क्लिनिक किंवा हॉस्पिटलमध्ये ABDM यशस्वीपणे लागू करण्यासाठी आणि रुग्णांना उत्तम, कागदविरहित आणि सुरक्षित आरोग्यसेवा देण्यासाठी सक्षम व्हाल.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors- Assammese
desc: আয়ুষ্মান ভাৰত ডিজিটেল মিছন (ABDM) ভাৰতৰ স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা পৰিৱেশত এক গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ পৰিৱৰ্তনৰ প্ৰতীক, যাৰ লক্ষ্য হৈছে এক ব্যাপক, একত্ৰিত ডিজিটেল স্বাস্থ্য আন্তঃগাঁথনি নিৰ্মাণ কৰা। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমটো চিকিৎসক আৰু স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা পেছাদাৰীসকলক এই পৰিৱৰ্তনশীল পৰিৱেশ তন্ত্ৰত চলাচল কৰিবলৈ আৰু ইয়াৰ সুবিধা ল'বলৈ প্ৰয়োজনীয় জ্ঞান আৰু দক্ষতাৰে সজ্জিত কৰিবলৈ ডিজাইন কৰা হৈছে। ডিজিটেল সমাধানৰ ওপৰত ক্ৰমবৰ্ধমান নিৰ্ভৰশীল বিশ্বত, আধুনিক চিকিৎসা পদ্ধতিৰ বাবে ABDM বুজাটো গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ, যিয়ে উন্নত ক্লিনিকেল সিদ্ধান্ত গ্ৰহণ, সুশৃংখল প্ৰশাসনিক প্ৰক্ৰিয়া, আৰু উন্নত ৰোগীৰ ফলাফল সক্ষম কৰে। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰমৰ জৰিয়তে, শিকাৰুসকলে ABDM-ৰ মূল স্তম্ভসমূহৰ গভীৰতালৈ যাব। মূল শিকাৰ ক্ষেত্ৰসমূহৰ ভিতৰত আছে ৰোগীসকলৰ বাবে আয়ুষ্মান ভাৰত স্বাস্থ্য একাউণ্ট (ABHA), চিকিৎসা পেছাদাৰীসকলৰ বাবে স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা পেছাদাৰী পঞ্জীয়ন (HPR), আৰু প্ৰতিষ্ঠানসমূহৰ বাবে স্বাস্থ্য সুবিধা পঞ্জীয়ন (HFR)ৰ বিতং অন্বেষণ। পাঠ্যক্ৰমটোত ৰোগীৰ তথ্যৰ গোপনীয়তা বজাই ৰখাত সন্মতি পৰিচালকৰ গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ ভূমিকা, আন্তঃকাৰ্যক্ষমতাৰ বাবে একত্ৰিত স্বাস্থ্য আন্তঃপৃষ্ঠ (UHI)ৰ কাৰ্যকাৰিতা, আৰু স্বাস্থ্য দাবী বিনিময় (HCX)ৰ জৰিয়তে ডিজিটেল স্বাস্থ্য দাবী চম্ভালাৰ প্ৰক্ৰিয়াও সামৰি লোৱা হৈছে। অংশগ্ৰহণকাৰীসকলে এই সেৱাসমূহৰ বাবে কেনেকৈ পঞ্জীয়ন কৰিব, তেওঁলোকৰ অনুশীলনত কেনেকৈ একত্ৰিত কৰিব, আৰু অধিক দক্ষ আৰু ব্যক্তিগতকৃত যত্ন প্ৰদান কৰিবলৈ ডিজিটেল স্বাস্থ্য ৰেকৰ্ড কেনেকৈ ব্যৱহাৰ কৰিব সেই বিষয়ে ব্যৱহাৰিক জ্ঞান লাভ কৰিব। পাঠ্যক্ৰম সম্পূৰ্ণ হোৱাৰ পিছত, চিকিৎসকসকলে ডিজিটেল স্বাস্থ্য বিপ্লৱত আত্মবিশ্বাসেৰে অংশগ্ৰহণ কৰিবলৈ সাজু হ'ব, তেওঁলোকৰ অনুশীলন উন্নত কৰিব আৰু সকলো ভাৰতীয়ৰ বাবে এক অধিক সুলভ আৰু দক্ষ স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা ব্যৱস্থাত অৰিহণা যোগাব।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors- Bangla
desc: এই কোর্সটি বিশেষভাবে ডাক্তার এবং স্বাস্থ্যসেবা পেশাদারদের জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে, যাতে তারা আয়ুষ্মান ভারত ডিজিটাল মিশন (ABDM) এবং ভারতের স্বাস্থ্যসেবা ক্ষেত্রে এর রূপান্তরমূলক প্রভাব সম্পর্কে একটি সম্পূর্ণ ধারণা লাভ করতে পারে। কোর্সটি ABDM-এর মূল ভিত্তি, এর উদ্দেশ্য এবং এটি কীভাবে একটি সমন্বিত ডিজিটাল স্বাস্থ্য পরিকাঠামো তৈরি করছে তা ব্যাখ্যা করে। অংশগ্রহণকারীরা শিখবে কীভাবে আয়ুষ্মান ভারত স্বাস্থ্য অ্যাকাউন্ট (ABHA) তৈরি ও ব্যবহার করতে হয়, স্বাস্থ্যসেবা পেশাদার রেজিস্ট্রি (HPR) এবং স্বাস্থ্য সুবিধা রেজিস্ট্রি (HFR)-এ নিজেদের নিবন্ধন করতে হয়। এছাড়াও, কোর্সটি কনসেন্ট ম্যানেজারের মাধ্যমে রোগীর ডেটা সুরক্ষিতভাবে আদান-প্রদান, ইউনিফাইড হেলথ ইন্টারফেস (UHI) ব্যবহার করে আন্তঃকার্যক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধি এবং হেলথ ক্লেইম এক্সচেঞ্জ (HCX)-এর মাধ্যমে ক্লেইম প্রক্রিয়া সহজ করার বিষয়ে আলোকপাত করে। কোর্স শেষে, ডাক্তাররা তাদের দৈনন্দিন অনুশীলনে ABDM-কে একীভূত করতে এবং উন্নত মানের ও দক্ষ স্বাস্থ্যসেবা প্রদানে এর সম্ভাবনাকে কাজে লাগাতে সক্ষম হবেন।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors- Kannada
desc: ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಿಷನ್ (ABDM) ಭಾರತದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪರಿವರ್ತನಾಶೀಲ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ವಿವರವಾದ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸೇವಾ ಪೂರೈಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ABDMನ ಚೌಕಟ್ಟನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಲು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅಂಶಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗಿ, ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನವು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸುಲಭಲಭ್ಯ, ಕೈಗೆಟುಕುವ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನಾದ್ಯಂತ, ಕಲಿಯುವವರು ABDMನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ತಂಭಗಳಾದ ABHA (ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಗುರುತಿನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ), HPR (ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದ ವೈದ್ಯರ ನೋಂದಣಿ), ಮತ್ತು HFR (ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಲ್ಯಾಬ್‌ಗಳ ನೋಂದಣಿ) ಗಳ ಕಾರ್ಯಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಹೆಲ್ತ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್ ಇನ್ಫರ್ಮೇಷನ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ (HMIS) ಅನ್ನು ABDM ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸುವುದು, ರೋಗಿಗಳ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಡೇಟಾ ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇರುವ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ತಪ್ಪು ಕಲ್ಪನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಕುರಿತು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ, ವೈದ್ಯರು ABDMನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಲು, ಅದರ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ತಮ್ಮ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸುಧಾರಿತ ರೋಗಿಗಳ ಆರೈಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಡಳಿತಾತ್ಮಕ ದಕ್ಷತೆಗೆ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ನೀಡಲು ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors- Malayalam
desc: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) represents a significant step towards the digital transformation of India's healthcare landscape. This course offers an in-depth introduction to the mission, explaining its importance for creating an integrated, patient-centric healthcare system. Participants will learn about the fundamental building blocks of ABDM, including the creation and management of the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) for digital health records, the role of the Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) in verifying medical practitioners, and the function of the Health Facility Registry (HFR). The curriculum also covers the Unified Health Interface (UHI) for interoperability and the Health Claims Exchange (HCX) for streamlined insurance processes. By the end of this course, doctors and healthcare providers will understand the practical benefits of participating in the ABDM ecosystem, such as improved clinical decision-making, enhanced patient care, and administrative efficiency, while also recognizing the critical importance of data privacy and consent management.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors_English
desc: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is set to revolutionize India's healthcare landscape. This course offers a detailed exploration of this transformative national initiative, designed to build a seamless digital health infrastructure. Participants will delve into the fundamental building blocks of ABDM, understanding the purpose and function of the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) for creating portable health records, the Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) for verifying medical practitioners, and the Health Facility Registry (HFR) for authenticating healthcare providers. The curriculum also covers the technological framework, including the Unified Health Interface (UHI) for interoperability and the Consent Manager for ensuring patient data privacy and security. Through practical examples and expert insights, learners will understand how to participate in the ABDM ecosystem, the process for selecting and implementing ABDM-enabled software, and how leveraging this platform can lead to better clinical decision-making, streamlined administrative processes, and enhanced patient care delivery across the country.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors_Odia
desc: ଏହି ਵਿਸਤृत ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ଭାରତୀୟ ସ୍ୱାस्थ୍ୟସେବା landsacpeରେ ଆୟୁଷ୍ମାନ ଭାରତ ଡିଜିଟାଲ ମିଶନ (ABDM)ର ଭୂମିକା ଏବଂ ପ୍ରଭାब ଉପରେ ଗଭୀର ଭାବରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରେ। ଏହା ଡାକ୍ତରମାନଙ୍କୁ ABDMର ਢਾਂਚାਗତ ଉପାଦାନଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବୁଝିବାରେ ସାହାଯy କରେ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ABHA (ରୋଗୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ਵਿਲੱਖਣ ସ୍ୱାस्थ୍ୟ ID), HPR (ଡାକ୍ତର ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱାस्थ୍ୟ ਪੇਸ਼ੇਵਰଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣିତ ରେਜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି), HFR (ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଏବଂ କ୍ଲିନିକ୍ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ରେਜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି), ଏବଂ ସਹਿਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧକ (Consent Manager) ਸ਼ਾਮਲ, ଯାହା ରୋଗୀଙ୍କ ତଥ୍ୟର ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ আদান-ପ୍ରदान ସୁନିଶ୍ਚିତ କରେ। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ABDM ਈਕੋਸିଷ୍ଟମରେ କିପରି ପଞ୍ଜୀକରଣ କରିବେ ଏବଂ ଏଥିରେ କିପରି ಭಾಗವಹନ କରିବେ ତାହା ଶିଖିବେ। ଏହା ସହିତ, ପାଠ୍ୟ크ମଟି ଡਿਜିଟାଲ ଉପକରଣଗୁଡ଼ିକର ବ୍ୟବହାରିକ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ଉପରେ ଆଲୋକପାତ କରେ, ଯେପରିକି ଇଲେक्ट୍ରୋନିକ୍ ସ୍ୱାस्थ୍ୟ ରେକର୍ଡ (EHR) ପରିଚାଳନା, ଟେଲି-ପରାମର୍ଶ, ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱାस्थ୍ୟ ଦାବି ବିନିମୟ (HCX) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଦାବି ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ସରଳ କରିବା। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟ크ମକୁ ସମାପ୍ତ କରିବା ପରେ, ଡାକ୍ତରମାନେ ନିଜର ଅଭ୍ୟାସରେ ଡਿਜିଟାଲ ଟେକ୍ନୋଲୋਜੀକୁ ଆત્મવિਸ਼୍ୱାସର ସହିତ અપનાଇବାକୁ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ରୋଗୀଙ୍କୁ ଉନ୍ନତ ସେବା ਮਿਲିବ ଏବଂ ସେମାନଙ୍କର କାରଯ୍ୟଦକ୍ଷତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇବ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Doctors_Punjabi
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਪਰਿਵਰਤਨ ਦੀ ਮਹੱਤਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਖਾਸ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਆਯੁਸ਼ਮਾਨ ਭਾਰਤ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਮਿਸ਼ਨ (ABDM) ਦੇ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ। ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ABDM ਦੇ ਟੀਚਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦੀ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਨਾਲ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਯੁਸ਼ਮਾਨ ਭਾਰਤ ਸਿਹਤ ਖਾਤਾ (ABHA), ਹੈਲਥਕੇਅਰ ਪ੍ਰੋਫੈਸ਼ਨਲ ਰਜਿਸਟਰੀ (HPR), ਹੈਲਥ ਫੈਸਿਲਿਟੀ ਰਜਿਸਟਰੀ (HFR), ਅਤੇ ਯੂਨੀਫਾਈਡ ਹੈਲਥ ਇੰਟਰਫੇਸ (UHI) ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਸਿੱਖਣਗੇ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਸ਼ਲ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਸਿਹਤ ਈਕੋਸਿਸਟਮ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਾਟਾ ਗੋਪਨੀਯਤਾ, ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ, ਅਤੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀਆਂ (HMIS) ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਰਨ ਬਾਰੇ ਵੀ ਚਰਚਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਡਾਕਟਰ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ ABDM ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ 'ਤੇ ਰਜਿਸਟਰ ਹੋਣ, ਇਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ, ਅਤੇ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਸਿਹਤ ਰਿਕਾਰਡਾਂ ਦਾ ਲਾਭ ਉਠਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਣਗੇ। ਇਹ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੀ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਦੇ ਆਧੁਨਿਕੀਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਰਗਰਮੀ ਨਾਲ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈਣ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੇਗਾ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals - Hindi
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (एबीडीएम) की गहन समझ प्रदान करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है, जो भारत में स्वास्थ्य सेवा वितरण को बदलने के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण सरकारी पहल है। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि क्यों एबीडीएम की आवश्यकता है और यह कैसे प्रौद्योगिकी का लाभ उठाकर एक एकीकृत डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य बुनियादी ढाँचा बना रहा है। प्रतिभागी एबीडीएम के मुख्य बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स के बारे में जानेंगे, जिनमें नागरिकों के लिए आभा (ABHA), डॉक्टरों और नर्सों के लिए एचपीआर (HPR), और अस्पतालों और प्रयोगशालाओं के लिए एचएफआर (HFR) शामिल हैं। पाठ्यक्रम में स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड के आदान-प्रदान के लिए सहमति प्रबंधन के महत्व और विभिन्न स्वास्थ्य अनुप्रयोगों के बीच अंतर-संचालनीयता को सक्षम करने में यूनिफाइड हेल्थ इंटरफेस (यूएचआई) की भूमिका पर भी चर्चा की गई है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह अस्पतालों और क्लीनिकों के लिए एबीडीएम पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में शामिल होने के लिए व्यावहारिक कदम, जैसे कि एबीडीएम-अनुपालक एचएमआईएस (HMIS) का चयन और कार्यान्वयन, और स्वास्थ्य बीमा दावों को सुव्यवस्थित करने के लिए हेल्थ क्लेम एक्सचेंज (एचसीएक्स) के लाभों को शामिल करता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, शिक्षार्थी एबीडीएम द्वारा लाए गए परिवर्तन को अपनाने और रोगी देखभाल में सुधार के लिए इसके उपकरणों का प्रभावी ढंग से उपयोग करने के लिए सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals - Odia
desc: ଆୟୁଷ୍ମାନ ଭାରତ ଡିଜିଟାଲ ମିଶନ (ABDM) ଭାରତର ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟସେବା କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ଏକ ଯୁଗାନ୍ତକାରୀ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଆଣିବାକୁ ଯାଉଛି। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ହସ୍ପିଟାଲ ପ୍ରଶାସକ, ଡାକ୍ତର ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟସେବା ପେଶାଦାରମାନଙ୍କୁ ଏହି ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଇକୋସିଷ୍ଟମକୁ ବୁଝିବା ଏବଂ ଆପଣେଇବା ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ଜ୍ଞାନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବାକୁ ପରିକଳ୍ପନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭରେ ABDMର ମୂଳଦୁଆ, ଏହାର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ଭାରତୀୟ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟସେବାରେ ଏହାର ଗୁରୁତ୍ଵ ବିଷୟରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହାପରେ, ଆପଣ ABDMର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଅଂଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଯେପରିକି ABHA (ରୋଗୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକକ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ପରିଚୟ), HPR (ଡାକ୍ତର ଏବଂ ପେଶାଦାରଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି), HFR (ହସ୍ପିଟାଲ ଏବଂ କ୍ଲିନିକ୍ ପାଇଁ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି), UHI (ସହଜ ଆପଏଣ୍ଟମେଣ୍ଟ ବୁକିଂ ପାଇଁ), ଏବଂ HCX (ଡିଜିଟାଲ କ୍ଲେମ୍ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ ପାଇଁ) ବିଷୟରେ ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଭାବରେ ଜାଣିବେ। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ହସ୍ପିଟାଲଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ପଞ୍ଜୀକରଣ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା, ଏକ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ HMIS (ହେଲ୍ଥ ମ୍ୟାନେଜମେଣ୍ଟ ଇନଫରମେସନ ସିଷ୍ଟମ) ଚୟନ କରିବାର ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶିକା, ଏବଂ ଏହାକୁ ସଫଳତାର ସହିତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ କରିବାର ପଦକ୍ଷେପଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଶେଷରେ, ଆପଣ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସଂସ୍ଥାରେ ABDMକୁ ଆପଣେଇବା ଏବଂ ଏହାର ସୁବିଧା ଯେପରିକି ଉନ୍ନତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଦକ୍ଷତା, ସହଜ ରେକର୍ଡ ପରିଚାଳନା, ଏବଂ ଉତ୍ତମ ରୋଗୀ ସେବା ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals - Telugu
desc: ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ డిజిటల్ మిషన్ (ABDM) పై ఈ ఫౌండేషన్ కోర్సు, భారతదేశంలో ఆరోగ్య సంరక్షణ డెలివరీని డిజిటలైజ్ చేయడానికి రూపొందించబడింది. ఈ కోర్సు ABDM యొక్క ఆవశ్యకత మరియు ప్రాముఖ్యతను వివరిస్తుంది, ఇది దేశవ్యాప్తంగా సమర్థవంతమైన, అందుబాటులో ఉండే మరియు సురక్షితమైన ఆరోగ్య సంరక్షణను అందించడానికి ఒక బలమైన డిజిటల్ మౌలిక సదుపాయాలను ఎలా నిర్మిస్తుందో వివరిస్తుంది. అభ్యాసకులు ABDM యొక్క నిర్మాణాన్ని, దాని ముఖ్య భాగాలైన ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ హెల్త్ అకౌంట్ (ABHA), హెల్త్ ప్రొఫెషనల్ రిజిస్ట్రీ (HPR), మరియు హెల్త్ ఫెసిలిటీ రిజిస్ట్రీ (HFR) గురించి లోతైన అవగాహన పొందుతారు. ABHA ను ఎలా సృష్టించాలి, ఆరోగ్య నిపుణులు మరియు సౌకర్యాలు ఎలా నమోదు చేసుకోవాలి, మరియు సమ్మతి ఆధారిత పద్ధతిలో ఆరోగ్య రికార్డులను సురక్షితంగా ఎలా పంచుకోవాలో ఈ కోర్సు వివరిస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సును పూర్తి చేయడం ద్వారా, అభ్యాసకులు ABDM పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలో పాల్గొనడానికి మరియు రోగులకు మెరుగైన సంరక్షణ, ఆసుపత్రులకు పెరిగిన సామర్థ్యం మరియు విధాన రూపకర్తలకు మెరుగైన డేటా వంటి ప్రయోజనాలను పొందడానికి అవసరమైన జ్ఞానాన్ని పొందుతారు.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals - Urdu
desc: آیوشمان بھارت ڈیجیٹل مشن (ABDM) ہندوستان میں صحت کی دیکھ بھال کی فراہمی میں ایک اہم تبدیلی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔ یہ کورس ہسپتال کے منتظمین اور صحت کی دیکھ بھال کرنے والے پیشہ ور افراد کو اس قومی ڈیجیٹل صحت کے ماحولیاتی نظام کو سمجھنے اور اس میں حصہ لینے کے لیے ضروری علم فراہم کرنے کے لیے ڈیزائن کیا گیا ہے۔ کورس کا آغاز ڈیجیٹل صحت کے بنیادی اصولوں اور ABDM کے وژن سے ہوتا ہے۔ اس کے بعد یہ ABDM کے اہم تعمیراتی بلاکس، بشمول آیوشمان بھارت ہیلتھ اکاؤنٹ (ABHA)، ہیلتھ کیئر پروفیشنلز رجسٹری (HPR)، اور ہیلتھ فیسیلٹی رجسٹری (HFR) کی تفصیلات بیان کرتا ہے۔ شرکاء سیکھیں گے کہ یہ اجزاء کس طرح ایک مربوط صحت کے معلوماتی بنیادی ڈھانچے کی تشکیل کے لیے مل کر کام کرتے ہیں۔ مزید برآں، کورس یونیفائیڈ ہیلتھ انٹرفیس (UHI) اور ہیلتھ کلیمز ایکسچینج (HCX) جیسے تصورات کی وضاحت کرتا ہے، جو باہمی تعاون اور ہموار خدمات کو قابل بناتے ہیں۔ کورس مکمل کرنے پر، شرکاء اپنے اداروں میں ABDM کو اپنانے کے عملی اقدامات کی شناخت کرنے اور ہندوستان کے ڈیجیٹل صحت کے سفر میں مؤثر طریقے سے حصہ ڈالنے کے قابل ہو جائیں گے

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals _Gujarati
desc: આયુષ્માન ભારત ડિજિટલ મિશન (ABDM) ભારતના આરોગ્યસંભાળ ક્ષેત્રને ડિજિટાઇઝ કરવા માટે એક ક્રાંતિકારી પગલું છે. આ કોર્સ હોસ્પિટલ સંચાલકો, ડોકટરો અને અન્ય આરોગ્યસંભાળ કર્મચારીઓને ABDM ઇકોસિસ્ટમને સમજવા અને તેમાં જોડાવા માટે માર્ગદર્શન આપવા માટે રચાયેલ છે. કોર્સની શરૂઆત ડિજિટલ સ્વાસ્થ્યના મૂળભૂત સિદ્ધાંતો અને દર્દીઓ, ડોકટરો અને હોસ્પિટલો માટે તેના ફાયદાઓથી થાય છે. તે પછી, કોર્સ ABDM ના મુખ્ય ઘટકો જેવા કે આયુષ્માન ભારત હેલ્થ એકાઉન્ટ (ABHA), હેલ્થકેર પ્રોફેશનલ રજિસ્ટ્રી (HPR), અને હેલ્થ ફેસિલિટી રજિસ્ટ્રી (HFR) ની ઊંડાણપૂર્વક ચર્ચા કરે છે. સહભાગીઓ હોસ્પિટલ મેનેજમેન્ટ ઇન્ફર્મેશન સિસ્ટમ (HMIS) ની પસંદગી અને અમલીકરણ, યુનિફાઇડ હેલ્થ ઇન્ટરફેસ (UHI) દ્વારા આંતરકાર્યક્ષમતા અને હેલ્થ ક્લેમ્સ એક્સચેન્જ (HCX) દ્વારા ક્લેમ પ્રક્રિયાના સરળીકરણ વિશે શીખશે. આ કોર્સનો ઉદ્દેશ્ય આરોગ્યસંભાળ પ્રદાતાઓને ABDM દ્વારા પૂરા પાડવામાં આવતા સાધનો અને તકોનો ઉપયોગ કરીને તેમની સેવાઓને વધુ કાર્યક્ષમ, સુલભ અને દર્દી-કેન્દ્રિત બનાવવા માટે સશક્ત કરવાનો છે.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals _Marathi
desc: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABDM) हे भारत सरकारच्या आरोग्यसेवा ডিজিটাল करण्याच्या दिशेने एक महत्त्वाचे पाऊल आहे. हा कोर्स रुग्णालयांना आणि आरोग्यसेवा व्यावसायिकांना या मिशनमध्ये सहभागी होण्यासाठी आवश्यक असलेले ज्ञान प्रदान करतो. यामध्ये, ABDM ची रचना, उद्दिष्ट्ये आणि कार्यप्रणाली तपशीलवारपणे स्पष्ट केली आहे. सहभागींना आयुष्मान भारत हेल्थ अकाउंट (ABHA), हेल्थकेअर प्रोफेशनल रजिस्ट्री (HPR), आणि हेल्थ फॅसिलिटी रजिस्ट्री (HFR) यांसारख्या मुख्य घटकांची माहिती मिळेल. तसेच, हेल्थ मॅनेजमेंट इन्फॉर्मेशन सिस्टीम (HMIS) कसे समाकलित करावे, रुग्णांच्या आरोग्य नोंदी सुरक्षितपणे कशा हाताळाव्यात आणि संमती व्यवस्थापनाचे महत्त्व काय आहे, हे शिकवले जाईल. हा कोर्स पूर्ण केल्यावर, रुग्णालयांचे प्रशासक, डॉक्टर आणि कर्मचारी ABDM प्रणालीचा प्रभावीपणे वापर करून रुग्णांना उत्तम, जलद आणि अधिक सोयीस्कर आरोग्यसेवा प्रदान करण्यास सक्षम होतील.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals- Assamese
desc: আয়ুষ্মান ভাৰt ডিজিטেল মিছন (ABDM)ৰ ওপৰত এই விரிவான পাঠ্যক্ৰمটো ভাৰতৰ স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা খণ্ডত ডিজিטেল পৰিৱৰ্তন বুজিবলৈ ইচ্ছুক পেছাদাৰীসকলৰ বাবে तयार কৰা হৈছে। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰمটোৱে ABDMৰ દ્રષ્ટિ, উদ্দেশ্য, আৰু ইয়াৰ মূল నిర్మాణ खण्डসমূহৰ এক গভীৰ ಪರಿಚಯ দিয়ে, যাৰ ভিতৰত আছে ABHA (আয়ুষ্মান ভাৰত স্বাস্থ্য একাউণ্ট), স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা পেছাদাৰী পঞ্জীয়ন (HPR), আৰু স্বাস্থ্য সুবিধা পঞ্জীয়ন (HFR)। பங்கே̀ါসকলে শিকিব কেনেকৈ এই ডিজিטেল পৰিস্থিতিতन्त्रই স্বাস্থ্য अभिलेखসমূহৰ സുരക്ഷിത আদান-প্ৰদান সক্ষম কৰে, যাৰ ফলত উন্নত ৰোগ নিৰ্ণয়, ব্যক্তিগতकृत যত্ন, আৰু क्लिनिकल ফলাফল 향상 হয়। পাঠ্যক্ৰمটোৱে চিকিৎসালয়ৰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ, চিকিৎসক, নাৰ্ছ, আৰু अन्य स्वास्थ्यসেৱা কৰ্মীসকলৰ দৈনন্দিন కార్యप्रवाहৰ ওপৰত ABDMৰ ব্যৱহাৰিক প্ৰভাৱৰ বিষয়ে আলোচনা কৰে, যেনে OPD পঞ্জীয়ন, ৰোগীৰ പ്രവേശന, ഡിസ്ചാർജ്, আৰু दावा प्रक्रिया। এই পাঠ্যক্ৰمটো সম্পূৰ্ণ কৰাৰ পিছত, பங்கே̀ါসকলে তেওঁলোকৰ ಸಂಸ್ಥাত ABDM успешно అమలు কৰিবলৈ আৰু ভাৰতৰ নাগৰিকসকলৰ বাবে স্বাস্থ্যসেৱা প্ৰদান উন্নত কৰিবলৈ ज्ञान আৰু कौशल অৰ্জন কৰিব।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals- Bangla
desc: আয়ুষ্মান ভারত ডিজিটাল মিশন (ABDM) ভারতের স্বাস্থ্যসেবা ক্ষেত্রে একটি যুগান্তকারী পরিবর্তন আনার লক্ষ্যে চালু করা হয়েছে। এই কোর্সটি হাসপাতাল প্রশাসক, ডাক্তার, নার্স এবং অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যসেবা কর্মীদের জন্য বিশেষভাবে ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে, যাতে তারা এই ডিজিটাল ইকোসিস্টেমের সাথে নিজেদের যুক্ত করতে পারে। কোর্সের মাধ্যমে অংশগ্রহণকারীরা ABDM-এর মূল ধারণা, এর স্থাপত্য এবং এটি কীভাবে স্বাস্থ্যসেবা প্রদানকারী এবং রোগীদের মধ্যে সম্পর্ককে সহজতর করে তা বুঝতে পারবেন। এখানে আভা (ABHA) আইডি তৈরি এবং ব্যবহার, হেলথ ফ্যাসিলিটি রেজিস্ট্রি (HFR) এবং হেলথ কেয়ার প্রফেশনাল রেজিস্ট্রি (HPR)-তে নিবন্ধন প্রক্রিয়া, এবং হসপিটাল ম্যানেজমেন্ট ইনফরমেশন সিস্টেম (HMIS)-এর গুরুত্ব নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়েছে। কোর্সটি শেষ করার পর, অংশগ্রহণকারীরা জানতে পারবেন কীভাবে ABDM-এর মাধ্যমে হাসপাতালের কার্যকারিতা বৃদ্ধি করা যায়, রোগীর তথ্যের গোপনীয়তা বজায় রাখা যায় এবং টেলিমেডিসিন ও ডিজিটাল প্রেসক্রিপশনের মতো আধুনিক প্রযুক্তির ব্যবহার করে উন্নত স্বাস্থ্যসেবা প্রদান করা সম্ভব হয়। এই উদ্যোগটি স্বাস্থ্যসেবাকে আরও সহজলভ্য, সাশ্রয়ী এবং রোগী-কেন্দ্রিক করে তোলার পথে একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদক্ষেপ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals- Kannada
desc: ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಿಷನ್ (ABDM) ಭಾರತದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸುಲಭ, ಕೈಗೆಟುಕುವ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿಸಲು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಲಿಯುವವರು ABDMನ ಚೌಕಟ್ಟಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಸೇರಿದೆ. ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಿಷಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ ಹೆಲ್ತ್ ಅಕೌಂಟ್ (ABHA) ರಚನೆ, ಹೆಲ್ತ್‌ಕೇರ್ ಪ್ರೊಫೆಷನಲ್ಸ್ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟ್ರಿ (HPR) ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಲ್ತ್ ಫೆಸಿಲಿಟಿ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟ್ರಿ (HFR) ನಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಲ್ತ್ ಇನ್ಫರ್ಮೇಷನ್ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಚೇಂಜ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕನ್ಸೆಂಟ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ (HIE-CM) ನ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ, ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕರು ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರರು ತಮ್ಮ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ABDM ಅನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಇದರಿಂದಾಗಿ ರೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ ಆರೈಕೆಯನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ತಮ್ಮ ಆಡಳಿತಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals- Malayalam
desc: ആയുഷ്മാൻ ഭാരത് ഡിജിറ്റൽ മിഷൻ (ABDM) എന്ന വിപ്ലവകരമായ പദ്ധതിയിൽ ആശുപത്രികൾക്ക് എങ്ങനെ പങ്കാളികളാകാം എന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആഴത്തിലുള്ള വിവരങ്ങൾ ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് നൽകുന്നു. ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആരോഗ്യ പരിപാലന ആവാസവ്യവസ്ഥയെ ഒരു ഏകീകൃത ഡിജിറ്റൽ ചട്ടക്കൂടിലേക്ക് കൊണ്ടുവരിക എന്നതാണ് ABDM-ന്റെ ലക്ഷ്യം. ഈ കോഴ്‌സിലൂടെ, പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് ABHA ഐഡി ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നതിനും, ആരോഗ്യപ്രവർത്തകരെയും ആശുപത്രികളെയും രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്യുന്നതിനും, ഡിജിറ്റൽ ആരോഗ്യ രേഖകൾ സുരക്ഷിതമായി കൈമാറ്റം ചെയ്യുന്നതിനുമുള്ള നടപടിക്രമങ്ങൾ മനസ്സിലാക്കാൻ സാധിക്കും. കൂടാതെ, ഹെൽത്ത് മാനേജ്‌മെന്റ് ഇൻഫർമേഷൻ സിസ്റ്റം (HMIS) തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നതിനും നടപ്പിലാക്കുന്നതിനുമുള്ള മാർഗ്ഗനിർദ്ദേശങ്ങളും, ഹെൽത്ത് ക്ലെയിം എക്സ്ചേഞ്ച് (HCX) പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോമിന്റെ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളും കോഴ്‌സിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഈ ഡിജിറ്റൽ സംവിധാനം സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ ആശുപത്രികൾക്ക് പ്രവർത്തനക്ഷമത വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കാനും രോഗികൾക്ക് മികച്ചതും വേഗതയേറിയതുമായ സേവനങ്ങൾ നൽകാനും എങ്ങനെ കഴിയുമെന്ന് കോഴ്‌സ് വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals_English
desc: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is set to revolutionize India's healthcare landscape. This course offers a detailed exploration of this transformative initiative, specifically tailored for hospitals and healthcare facilities. It begins by explaining the fundamental vision of ABDM to support universal health coverage through an integrated, efficient, and secure digital ecosystem. Learners will delve into the key components that form the backbone of this mission, including the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA), Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR), and Health Facility Registry (HFR). The curriculum also covers the Unified Health Interface (UHI) for interoperability and the Health Claims Exchange (HCX) for streamlined insurance processing. By the end of this course, hospital administrators and staff will understand the practical steps for adopting ABDM, from selecting a compliant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) to participating in the digital health network. This knowledge will empower them to improve operational efficiency, enhance patient care, and contribute to a more accessible and affordable healthcare system for all citizens.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals_Punjabi
desc: ਆਯੁਸ਼ਮਾਨ ਭਾਰਤ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਮਿਸ਼ਨ (ABDM) ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਸਪੁਰਦਗੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕ੍ਰਾਂਤੀ ਲਿਆਉਣ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਪਰਿਵਰਤਨਸ਼ੀਲ ਪਹਿਲ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਹਸਪਤਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਸਕਾਂ, ਡਾਕਟਰਾਂ, ਨਰਸਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਸਿਹਤ ਈਕੋਸਿਸਟਮ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈਣ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਲੈਸ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਸਿਹਤ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੂਲ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਭਾਰਤ ਲਈ ਇਸਦੀ ਮਹੱਤਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ABDM ਦੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਨਿਰਮਾਣ ਬਲਾਕਾਂ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ABHA (ਵਿਲੱਖਣ ਸਿਹਤ ਪਛਾਣਕਰਤਾ), HPR (ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿਤ ਡਾਕਟਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਡਾਇਰੈਕਟਰੀ), ਅਤੇ HFR (ਸਿਹਤ ਸਹੂਲਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਡਾਇਰੈਕਟਰੀ) ਦੀ ਵਿਸਤ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਿਆਖਿਆ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਪਛਾਣਕਰਤਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਕਦਮ-ਦਰ-ਕਦਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਿੱਖਣਗੇ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ, ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਸਪਤਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ (HMIS) ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਨੂੰ ABDM ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਨ ਦੇ ਮਹੱਤਵ 'ਤੇ ਚਰਚਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਕਾਗਜ਼ ਰਹਿਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਅਤੇ ਡਾਟਾ ਦੀ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਸਾਂਝ ਨੂੰ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ। ਇਹ ਹੈਲਥ ਕਲੇਮਜ਼ ਐਕਸਚੇਂਜ (HCX) ਵਰਗੇ ਉੱਨਤ ਸੰਕਲਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਛੂੰਹਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਬੀਮਾ ਦਾਅਵਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਚਾਰੂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਹਸਪਤਾਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ABDM ਈਕੋਸਿਸਟਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਫਲਤਾਪੂਰਵਕ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰਨ, ਸੰਚਾਲਨ ਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੋਣਗੇ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Hospitals_Tamil
desc: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் டிஜிட்டல் மிஷன் (ABDM) என்பது இந்திய சுகாதாரப் பாதுகாப்பில் ஒரு புரட்சிகரமான படியாகும், இது ஒரு ஒருங்கிணைந்த டிஜிட்டல் சுகாதார உள்கட்டமைப்பை உருவாக்குவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த விரிவான பாடநெறி, ABDM-இன் அடிப்படைக் கொள்கைகள், அதன் நோக்கம் மற்றும் சுகாதார அமைப்பில் உள்ள அனைத்து பங்குதாரர்களுக்கும் அது வழங்கும் நன்மைகள் ஆகியவற்றை ஆழமாக விவரிக்கிறது. பங்கேற்பாளர்கள், தனித்துவமான சுகாதார அடையாளங்காட்டியான ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் சுகாதாரக் கணக்கு (ABHA), சரிபார்க்கப்பட்ட சுகாதார நிபுணர்களின் களஞ்சியமான சுகாதார நிபுணர் பதிவேடு (HPR), மற்றும் சுகாதார வசதிகளின் கோப்பகமான சுகாதார வசதி பதிவேடு (HFR) ஆகியவற்றின் முக்கியத்துவத்தைப் பற்றி அறிந்து கொள்வார்கள். மேலும், நோயாளியின் ஒப்புதலுடன் சுகாதாரத் தரவை பாதுகாப்பாகப் பரிமாறிக்கொள்வது, மருத்துவமனை தகவல் மேலாண்மை அமைப்பை (HMIS) தேர்ந்தெடுத்து செயல்படுத்துவது, மற்றும் இந்த டிஜிட்டல் மாற்றத்திற்குத் தயாராவது எப்படி என்பது குறித்தும் இந்த பாடநெறி வழிகாட்டுகிறது. இந்த பாடத்திட்டத்தை முடிப்பதன் மூலம், கற்பவர்கள் ABDM-ஐ தங்கள் நிறுவனங்களில் வெற்றிகரமாகச் செயல்படுத்தி, மேம்பட்ட நோயாளி பராமரிப்பு, சிறந்த நிர்வாகத் திறன் மற்றும் வெளிப்படையான சுகாதார சேவைகளை வழங்குவதற்கான அறிவைப் பெறுவார்கள்.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs - Bangla
desc: এই কোর্সটি আয়ুষ্মান ভারত ডিজিটাল মিশন (ABDM) এর একটি ব্যাপক পর্যালোচনার জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে, যা ভারতের স্বাস্থ্যসেবা পরিকাঠামোকে রূপান্তরিত করার লক্ষ্যে একটি জাতীয় উদ্যোগ। কোর্সটি ABDM-এর দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি এবং লক্ষ্যগুলি ব্যাখ্যা করে, যার মাধ্যমে একটি কাগজবিহীন এবং সমন্বিত স্বাস্থ্যসেবা ইকোসিস্টেম তৈরি করা সম্ভব হবে। অংশগ্রহণকারীরা শিখবেন কীভাবে আয়ুষ্মান ভারত হেলথ অ্যাকাউন্ট (ABHA) তৈরি ও ব্যবহার করতে হয়, যা নাগরিকদের তাদের স্বাস্থ্য রেকর্ড ডিজিটালভাবে সংরক্ষণ এবং শেয়ার করার সুযোগ দেয়। এছাড়াও, কোর্সটি হেলথকেয়ার প্রফেশনাল রেজিস্ট্রি (HPR) এবং হেলথ ফ্যাসিলিটি রেজিস্ট্রি (HFR)-এর গুরুত্ব নিয়ে আলোচনা করে, যা যাচাইকৃত ডাক্তার এবং স্বাস্থ্যকেন্দ্রের একটি নির্ভরযোগ্য ডেটাবেস তৈরি করে। বিশেষ করে ল্যাবরেটরিগুলির জন্য, এই কোর্সটি ABDM-এ যোগদানের প্রক্রিয়া, এর সুবিধা এবং কীভাবে ল্যাব ম্যানেজমেন্ট ইনফরমেশন সিস্টেম (LMIS) ব্যবহার করে দৈনন্দিন কাজ আরও সহজ ও কার্যকর করা যায়, তা তুলে ধরে। কোর্সটি শেষ করার পর, অংশগ্রহণকারীরা ABDM-এর মাধ্যমে কীভাবে স্বাস্থ্যসেবার মান উন্নত করা যায়, ডেটা সুরক্ষা নিশ্চিত করা যায় এবং রোগী ও স্বাস্থ্যসেবা প্রদানকারীদের মধ্যে সম্পর্ক আরও মজবুত করা যায় সে সম্পর্কে একটি স্পষ্ট ধারণা লাভ করবেন।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs - Hindi
desc: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (एबीडीएम) भारत की स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रणाली में एक क्रांतिकारी परिवर्तन का प्रतीक है, जिसका उद्देश्य एक एकीकृत डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य बुनियादी ढाँचा बनाना है। यह पाठ्यक्रम प्रयोगशाला पेशेवरों को इस राष्ट्रीय पहल की गहन समझ प्रदान करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य के महत्व और एबीडीएम के दृष्टिकोण से होती है, जिसमें बताया गया है कि यह कैसे स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं को अधिक सुलभ, किफायती और कुशल बना रहा है। आप एबीडीएम के मुख्य स्तंभों के बारे में जानेंगे: आयुष्मान भारत स्वास्थ्य खाता (आभा), जो नागरिकों को अपने स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड को डिजिटल रूप से संग्रहीत और साझा करने में सक्षम बनाता है; स्वास्थ्य पेशेवर रजिस्ट्री (एचपीआर), जो सत्यापित डॉक्टरों और नर्सों का एक भंडार है; और स्वास्थ्य सुविधा रजिस्ट्री (एचएफआर), जो अस्पतालों और प्रयोगशालाओं जैसी सुविधाओं को सूचीबद्ध करती है। पाठ्यक्रम में प्रयोगशाला प्रबंधन सूचना प्रणाली (एलएमआईएस) को अपनाने और एबीडीएम पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में शामिल होने के लिए आवश्यक कदमों पर भी प्रकाश डाला गया है। इसमें डेटा सुरक्षा, लागत और कार्यान्वयन से संबंधित आम चिंताओं और मिथकों को भी संबोधित किया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, प्रयोगशाला पेशेवर एबीडीएम द्वारा प्रदान किए गए अवसरों का लाभ उठाने, अपनी सेवाओं को डिजिटल बनाने और बेहतर रोगी देखभाल और व्यावसायिक विकास में योगदान करने के लिए पूरी तरह से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs - Telugu
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), designed to equip healthcare professionals, particularly those in laboratory and clinical settings, with a thorough understanding of India's digital health framework. The program begins by establishing the context for digital health and its importance in modernizing healthcare delivery. It then delves into the specific building blocks of the ABDM ecosystem, such as the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA), Health Professional Registry (HPR), and Health Facility Registry (HFR). Learners will discover how these components facilitate seamless and secure exchange of health information. The course further explains the roles of the Unified Health Interface (UHI) and the Health Claims Exchange (HCX) in enhancing service accessibility and streamlining insurance processes. Practical guidance is provided on how laboratories can prepare for and integrate with the ABDM ecosystem by selecting and implementing compliant Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). Upon completion, participants will be prepared to actively engage with and contribute to India's evolving digital health landscape.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs - Urdu
desc: یہ تفصیلی کورس آیوشمان بھارت ڈیجیٹل مشن (ABDM) اور ہندوستان کے صحت کی دیکھ بھال کے منظر نامے پر اس کے تبدیلی کے اثرات کی مکمل تفہیم فراہم کرنے کے لیے ڈیزائن کیا گیا ہے۔ شرکاء ABDM کے بنیادی مقاصد کا گہرائی سے جائزہ لیں گے، جن کا مقصد مریضوں، ڈاکٹروں، اسپتالوں اور دیگر صحت کی دیکھ بھال کے اسٹیک ہولڈرز کو جوڑنے والا ایک ہموار آن لائن پلیٹ فارم قائم کرنا ہے۔ نصاب میں منفرد 14 ہندسوں پر مشتمل آیوشمان بھارت ہیلتھ اکاؤنٹ (ABHA) کی تشکیل اور فوائد کا احاطہ کیا گیا ہے، جو شہریوں کو اپنے صحت کے ریکارڈ کو ڈیجیٹل طور پر محفوظ طریقے سے ذخیرہ کرنے، رسائی حاصل کرنے اور شیئر کرنے کے قابل بناتا ہے۔ مزید برآں، یہ کورس ہیلتھ کیئر پروفیشنلز رجسٹری (HPR) اور ہیلتھ فیسیلٹی رجسٹری (HFR) کی اہمیت کو صحت کی دیکھ بھال فراہم کرنے والوں کا ایک تصدیق شدہ نیٹ ورک بنانے میں واضح کرتا ہے۔ اس کورس کے اختتام تک، سیکھنے والے اس بات کی تعریف کریں گے کہ ABDM کس طرح صحت کی دیکھ بھال کی فراہمی کو بہتر بنانے، مریضوں کی دیکھ بھال کو بڑھانے، لیبز اور اسپتالوں کے لیے انتظامی کارکردگی کو بڑھانے، اور بہتر صحت پروگرام کی تشکیل کے لیے پالیسی سازوں کو قیمتی ڈیٹا کے ساتھ بااختیار بنانے کے لیے ٹیکنالوجی کا فائدہ اٹھاتا ہے۔

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs _Gujarati
desc: આ કોર્સ આયુષ્માન ભારત ડિજિટલ મિશન (ABDM) ની સંપૂર્ણ સમજ આપવા માટે તૈયાર કરવામાં આવ્યો છે, જે ભારતમાં હેલ્થકેર સેવાઓની ડિલિવરીમાં ક્રાંતિ લાવવા માટેની એક રાષ્ટ્રીય પહેલ છે. આ કોર્સ ABDM ના દ્રષ્ટિકોણ અને ઉદ્દેશ્યોથી શરૂ થાય છે અને તેના મુખ્ય બિલ્ડીંગ બ્લોક્સ જેવા કે ABHA, HPR, અને HFR ની વિગતવાર માહિતી આપે છે. સહભાગીઓ શીખશે કે કેવી રીતે આ ઘટકો એક સંકલિત ડિજિટલ હેલ્થ ઇકોસિસ્ટમ બનાવે છે, જે દર્દીઓ, ડોકટરો, હોસ્પિટલો અને લેબોરેટરીઓ સહિતના તમામ હિતધારકો માટે લાભદાયી છે. કોર્સમાં લેબ મેનેજમેન્ટ ઇન્ફર્મેશન સિસ્ટમ (LMIS) ના અમલીકરણ, ડેટાની ગોપનીયતા અને સંમતિ સંચાલનના મહત્વ અને હેલ્થ ક્લેમ્સ એક્સચેન્જ (HCX) દ્વારા ક્લેમ પ્રક્રિયાને સુવ્યવસ્થિત કરવા જેવા વિષયોને પણ આવરી લેવામાં આવ્યા છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કર્યા પછી, શીખનારાઓ ABDM ના માળખાને સમજી શકશે અને તેમની સંસ્થાઓમાં તેને અપનાવવા માટે તૈયાર થશે, જેનાથી દર્દીઓ માટે વધુ સારી અને સુલભ આરોગ્યસંભાળ સુનિશ્ચિત થશે.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs- Kannada
desc: ಭಾರತದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯನ್ನು ಚಾಲನೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಿಷನ್ (ABDM) ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಲು ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾಲಯಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದಂತೆ ABDMನ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪ, ಅದರ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಲಿಯುವವರು ABHA ಖಾತೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುವುದು, ಹೆಲ್ತ್‌ಕೇರ್ ಪ್ರೊಫೆಷನಲ್ಸ್ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟ್ರಿ (HPR) ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಲ್ತ್‌ಕೇರ್ ಫೆಸಿಲಿಟೀಸ್ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟ್ರಿ (HFR) ನಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಂದಾಯಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು, ಮತ್ತು ರೋಗಿಯ ಸಮ್ಮತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ABDM-ಸಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್ ಇನ್ಫರ್ಮೇಷನ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ (LMIS) ಅನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡುವ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಯಗತಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ಸಹ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಗಮಗೊಳಿಸಲು, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಉಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತದಾದ್ಯಂತ ರೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ, ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಈ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಲು ಸಜ್ಜಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs- Malayalam
desc: This program offers a detailed introduction to the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and its transformative impact on the Indian healthcare landscape, with a special focus on its application within diagnostic laboratories. The course begins by explaining the fundamentals of digital health and the vision behind ABDM, outlining its benefits for all stakeholders, including patients, doctors, hospitals, and policymakers. Participants will gain an in-depth understanding of ABDM's key components, such as the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) for unique health identification, the Healthcare Professional Registry (HPR), and the Health Facility Registry (HFR). The curriculum also covers the roles of the Consent Manager for data privacy, the Unified Health Interface (UHI) for interoperability, and the Health Claims Exchange (HCX) for digitized insurance processing. Through practical examples and step-by-step guides, the course demonstrates how laboratories can integrate with the ABDM ecosystem by adopting a Lab Management Information System (LMIS), addressing common concerns, and preparing for a successful rollout. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to participate in and leverage the ABDM framework to improve operational efficiency and patient care.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs-Assamese
desc: This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and its impact on the Indian healthcare landscape. It begins by establishing the context of digital health and the transformative goals of ABDM. Learners will delve into the key building blocks of the ecosystem, such as the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) for creating portable health records, the Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR), and the Health Facility Registry (HFR). The course offers a special focus on the role of laboratories, outlining the step-by-step process for registration, selection of a Laboratory Management Information System (LMIS), and integration with the ABDM framework. It also covers advanced components like the Unified Health Interface (UHI) and the Health Claims Exchange (HCX), explaining how they facilitate seamless data exchange and interoperability. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the ABDM ecosystem and leverage its tools for improved service delivery.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs_ Marathi
desc: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABDM) भारताच्या आरोग्यसेवा क्षेत्रात डिजिटल क्रांती घडवत आहे. हा कोर्स विशेषतः प्रयोगशाळा आणि संबंधित आरोग्यसेवा व्यावसायिकांसाठी तयार करण्यात आला आहे, जे या परिवर्तनाचा भाग बनू इच्छितात. या कोर्समध्ये, तुम्हाला ABDM चे मूळ उद्दिष्ट, त्याची रचना आणि भारतीय आरोग्यसेवेवर होणारा त्याचा परिणाम याची सविस्तर माहिती मिळेल. तुम्ही आभा (ABHA) म्हणजे काय, ते कसे तयार करावे आणि आरोग्य नोंदी सुरक्षितपणे लिंक करण्यासाठी त्याचा वापर कसा करावा हे शिकाल. तसेच, आरोग्य व्यावसायिक नोंदणी (HPR) आणि आरोग्य सुविधा नोंदणी (HFR) यांसारख्या महत्त्वाच्या नोंदणी प्रक्रियांची माहिती दिली जाईल, ज्यामुळे व्यावसायिकांना आणि संस्थांना डिजिटल ओळख मिळेल. कोर्समध्ये युनिफाइड हेल्थ इंटरफेस (UHI) आणि संमती व्यवस्थापक (Consent Manager) यांसारख्या संकल्पना सोप्या भाषेत समजावून सांगितल्या आहेत, ज्यामुळे आरोग्यसेवा अधिक सुलभ आणि सुरक्षित बनते. हा कोर्स पूर्ण केल्यावर, प्रयोगशाळा ABDM-सक्षम प्रणाली कशी निवडू आणि लागू करू शकतात आणि या डिजिटल बदलाचा स्वीकार करून आपल्या कामकाजात अधिक कार्यक्षमता कशी आणू शकतात, हे तुम्हाला समजेल.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs_ Odia
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ଭାରତୀୟ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟସେବା କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ଡିଜିଟାଲ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଆଣିବା ପାଇଁ ଉଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଆୟୁଷ୍ମାନ ଭାରତ ଡିଜିଟାଲ ମିଶନ (ABDM) ଉପରେ ଏକ ଗଭୀର ବୁଝାମଣା ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ଏହା ବିଶେଷ ଭାବରେ ଲାବୋରେଟୋରୀ ମାଲିକ, ପାଥୋଲୋଜିଷ୍ଟ, ଟେକ୍ନିସିଆନ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରଶାସକମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭରେ ABDMର ମୂଳଦୁଆ, ଏହାର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ଭାରତର ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟସେବା ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଏକୀକୃତ କରିବାରେ ଏହାର ଭୂମିକା ବିଷୟରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏଥିରେ ABDMର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ସ୍ତମ୍ଭଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଯଥା ଆୟୁଷ୍ମାନ ଭାରତ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଖାତା (ABHA), ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ପେଶାଦାର ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି (HPR), ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ସୁବିଧା ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି (HFR)ର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରିତା ଏବଂ ପଞ୍ଜୀକରଣ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ଲାବୋରେଟୋରୀ ପରିଚାଳନା ସୂଚନା ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ (LIMS) ଚୟନ ଏବଂ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ କରିବା, ତଥ୍ୟ ଗୋପନୀୟତା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଭୁଲ ଧାରଣା ଦୂର କରିବା ଏବଂ ଏକୀକୃତ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଇଣ୍ଟରଫେସ୍ (UHI) ଓ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଦାବି ବିନିମୟ (HCX) ଭଳି ଉନ୍ନତ ଉପାଦାନଗୁଡ଼ିକର ମହତ୍ତ୍ଵ ବୁଝିପାରିବେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଶେଷରେ, ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀମାନେ ନିଜ ଲାବୋରେଟୋରୀକୁ ABDM ଇକୋସିଷ୍ଟମରେ ସାମିଲ କରିବା, କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଦକ୍ଷତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବା ଏବଂ ରୋଗୀଙ୍କୁ ଉନ୍ନତ ସେବା ଯୋଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଏବଂ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ହାସଲ କରିବେ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs_English
desc: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) for Laboratories e-Module offers a detailed exploration of India's transformative digital healthcare framework. This course is designed to familiarize laboratory owners, managers, and technicians with the core concepts of ABDM and its significance in modernizing the nation's healthcare delivery system. The curriculum delves into the fundamental building blocks of the mission, including the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA), Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR), and Health Facility Registry (HFR). It provides a step-by-step guide for laboratories on how to prepare for and adopt ABDM, from creating necessary IDs to selecting and implementing an ABDM-compliant Lab Management Information System (LMIS). Furthermore, the course addresses common myths and concerns, explains the functionality of the Unified Health Interface (UHI) and the Health Claims Exchange (HCX), and highlights the tangible benefits for both labs and patients. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to confidently navigate the ABDM ecosystem and contribute to a more integrated, efficient, and accessible healthcare landscape.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs_Punjabi
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਪਰਿਵਰਤਨਸ਼ੀਲ ਪਹਿਲ, ਆਯੁਸ਼ਮਾਨ ਭਾਰਤ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਮਿਸ਼ਨ (ABDM) ਬਾਰੇ ਵਿਸਤ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸਦਾ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗਸ਼ਾਲਾ ਦੇ ਪੇਸ਼ੇਵਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ABDM ਦੇ ਢਾਂਚੇ, ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਭਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਣੂ ਕਰਵਾਉਣਾ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ABDM ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਸਿਧਾਂਤਾਂ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਆਯੁਸ਼ਮਾਨ ਭਾਰਤ ਹੈਲਥ ਅਕਾਊਂਟ (ABHA), ਹੈਲਥਕੇਅਰ ਪ੍ਰੋਫੈਸ਼ਨਲ ਰਜਿਸਟਰੀ (HPR), ਅਤੇ ਹੈਲਥ ਫੈਸਿਲਿਟੀ ਰਜਿਸਟਰੀ (HFR) ਦੀ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਨਾਲ ਚਰਚਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਸਮਝਣਗੇ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚਾ ਸਿਹਤ ਰਿਕਾਰਡਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਹਿਜ ਆਦਾਨ-ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ, ਡੇਟਾ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ, ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਯੂਨੀਫਾਈਡ ਹੈਲਥ ਇੰਟਰਫੇਸ (UHI) ਅਤੇ ਹੈਲਥ ਕਲੇਮਜ਼ ਐਕਸਚੇਂਜ (HCX) ਵਰਗੇ ਸੰਕਲਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਅੰਤਰ-ਕਾਰਜਸ਼ੀਲਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਅਵਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਚਾਰੂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਕੋਰਸ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗਸ਼ਾਲਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ABDM ਈਕੋਸਿਸਟਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਏਕੀਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਨ, ਸੰਚਾਲਨ ਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਕਦਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਣਗੇ।

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Labs_Tamil
desc: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் டிஜிட்டல் மிஷன் (ABDM) என்பது இந்திய சுகாதாரப் பாதுகாப்பில் ஒரு புரட்சிகரமான படியாகும், இது ஒரு ஒருங்கிணைந்த டிஜிட்டல் சுகாதார உள்கட்டமைப்பை உருவாக்குவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த விரிவான பாடநெறி, ஆய்வக நிபுணர்கள் மற்றும் நிர்வாகிகளுக்காக பிரத்யேகமாக வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இது ABDM-இன் தொலைநோக்குப் பார்வை மற்றும் அதன் முக்கியத்துவத்தை விளக்குகிறது. பங்கேற்பாளர்கள், ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் சுகாதாரக் கணக்கு (ABHA), சுகாதார நிபுணர் பதிவேடு (HPR), மற்றும் சுகாதார வசதி பதிவேடு (HFR) போன்ற ABDM-இன் அடிப்படைக் கட்டுமானத் தொகுதிகளைப் பற்றி ஆழமாக அறிந்து கொள்வார்கள். மேலும், இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சூழல் அமைப்பில் ஆய்வகங்கள் எவ்வாறு பதிவு செய்து, தங்களை ஒருங்கிணைத்து, அதன் மூலம் தங்கள் செயல்பாடுகளை நெறிப்படுத்தலாம் என்பதை படிப்படியான வழிமுறைகளுடன் இது விவரிக்கிறது. நோயாளிகளின் பதிவுகளைப் பாதுகாப்பாகப் பகிர்வது, சந்திப்புகளைத் திட்டமிடுவது, மற்றும் ஒட்டுமொத்த நோயாளி பராமரிப்பு அனுபவத்தை மேம்படுத்துவது ஆகியவற்றில் ABDM-இன் பங்கையும் இந்த பாடநெறி எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது. இந்த பாடத்திட்டத்தை முடிப்பதன் மூலம், ஆய்வகங்கள் இந்தியாவின் டிஜிட்டல் சுகாதாரப் பயணத்தில் முழுமையாகப் பங்கேற்கத் தயாராக இருக்கும்.

title: Ayushman Digital Health Mission for Doctors_Gujarati
desc: આયુષ્માન ભારત ડિજિટલ મિશન (ABDM) ભારતના આરોગ્યસંભાળ ક્ષેત્રમાં પરિવર્તન લાવવા માટે તૈયાર કરાયેલ એક ક્રાંતિકારી પહેલ છે. આ કોર્સ ડૉક્ટરો અને આરોગ્યસંભાળ પ્રદાતાઓને આ ડિજિટલ ઇકોસિસ્ટમમાં સફળતાપૂર્વક ભાગ લેવા માટે જરૂરી જ્ઞાન અને સાધનોથી સજ્જ કરવા માટે રચાયેલ છે. કોર્સની શરૂઆત ડિજિટલ સ્વાસ્થ્યના મૂળભૂત સિદ્ધાંતો અને ABDM ના વિઝનથી થાય છે, જેમાં તેના મુખ્ય ઉદ્દેશ્યો અને માળખાકીય ઘટકોની ચર્ચા કરવામાં આવે છે. તમે આયુષ્માન ભારત હેલ્થ એકાઉન્ટ (ABHA) બનાવવા અને તેનો ઉપયોગ કરવા, હેલ્થકેર પ્રોફેશનલ રજિસ્ટ્રી (HPR) અને હેલ્થ ફેસિલિટી રજિસ્ટ્રી (HFR) માં નોંધણી કરવા વિશે શીખશો. આ ઉપરાંત, કોર્સમાં યુનિફાઇડ હેલ્થ ઇન્ટરફેસ (UHI) અને હેલ્થ ક્લેમ્સ એક્સચેન્જ (HCX) જેવા મહત્વપૂર્ણ વિષયોને પણ આવરી લેવામાં આવ્યા છે, જે ઇન્ટરઓપરેબિલિટી અને પેપરલેસ ક્લેમ પ્રક્રિયાને સક્ષમ બનાવે છે. કોર્સના અંત સુધીમાં, તમે ABDM ને તમારી પ્રેક્ટિસમાં અપનાવવા, યોગ્ય HMIS સોફ્ટવેર પસંદ કરવા અને દર્દીના ડેટાની ગોપનીયતા અને સુરક્ષા સુનિશ્ચિત કરવા માટે સક્ષમ બનશો, જેનાથી દર્દીની સંભાળની ગુણવત્તામાં સુધારો થશે.

title: Back Haul Media
desc: This course offers a comprehensive examination of the backhaul media essential for modern mobile communication networks. As mobile data traffic continues to grow with the evolution of 4G/LTE and the emergence of 5G, a robust and efficient backhaul infrastructure is more critical than ever. This program is designed for technical professionals and engineers who need to understand the transport network that connects cell sites to the core network. The curriculum begins by defining backhaul, fronthaul, and backbone networks, clarifying their distinct roles in the overall network architecture. It then delves into the primary technology choices for backhaul, presenting a detailed comparison of fiber-based solutions, various wireless options like microwave and satellite, and their respective advantages in different deployment scenarios. Learners will gain insights into technical specifications, such as frequency bands, data throughput capabilities, and latency considerations. Furthermore, the course addresses advanced topics and future trends, including the impact of network densification, network slicing, and the stringent latency requirements of 5G. It explores innovative architectures like Cloud RAN (C-RAN) and Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) as solutions for optimizing backhaul performance. Upon completion, learners will be able to evaluate different backhaul strategies and understand their implications for building resilient, high-capacity mobile networks.

title: Bail Under Special Legislations
desc: This specialized course is designed for legal and law enforcement professionals seeking to master the complexities of bail under India's special legislations. The content provides a critical examination of why these laws have distinct and more stringent bail provisions compared to the general criminal law codified in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS). Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of bail conditions under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, Maharashtra Control of Organized Crime Act (MCOCA), and the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), among others. The course thoroughly analyzes seminal court rulings, exploring judicial discretion, the 'reverse burden of proof,' and the constitutional principles at play. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively interpret statutory requirements, construct reasoned legal arguments, and navigate the procedural challenges of securing or opposing bail in cases governed by these special acts, enhancing their professional competence in the criminal justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Balance Problems
desc: This course is designed to educate learners about the complexities of the human balance system and the common disorders that affect it. The program is structured into three key modules, each addressing a specific aspect of vestibular health. The first part focuses on Vestibular Migraine, detailing its connection to stress, its prevalence, and management through trigger identification and lifestyle changes. The second module explains Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV), covering how dislodged inner ear crystals cause vertigo and demonstrating the diagnostic and treatment maneuvers used by professionals. The final section tackles the growing issue of balance problems linked to extensive computer and screen use, providing ergonomic tips and simple exercises to mitigate risks like cervicogenic dizziness. Throughout the course, the importance of seeking a professional diagnosis from an audiologist or ENT specialist is stressed, empowering learners to understand their symptoms and pursue effective treatment.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: Balancing Digital Scale and Citizen-Centric Governance: The EPFO Case
desc: This case explores how the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation transformed service delivery through Nidhi Aapke Nikat 2.0, a decentralised, human-centred outreach model that brings services to remote districts, resolves grievances on the spot, and builds trust through direct engagement. As the programme effectively reaches citizens often excluded from digital reforms, EPFO now faces a strategic challenge: sustaining this high-touch model while meeting pressures for digital scale, automation, and cost efficiency. The case highlights the governance trade-offs between AI-enabled systems and personalised interfaces to ensure inclusion.

title: Balancing economic growth and sustainable ecotourism: The case of Dhar
desc: The ‘Nature Retreat and Awareness Camp’ in Chamrod, Dhar Kalan, Punjab, developed by Dr. Sanjeev Kumar, exemplifies participatory natural resource management, promoting ecotourism, ecosystem conservation, and sustainable livelihoods through local engagement and scientific planning.

title: Ballast in Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the essential role of ballast, the unsung hero of railway infrastructure. This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of why ballast is indispensable for the safety and efficiency of Indian Railways. You will learn about the key characteristics that define good ballast, from strength and durability to chemical neutrality, and how these properties contribute to the overall integrity of the track. The course covers the various types of materials used for ballast in India, such as broken stone, gravel, and blast furnace slag, explaining their specific applications. Furthermore, it details the critical aspects of ballast placement, minimum depth requirements for different track types, and common maintenance challenges like fouling and caking. Learners will gain insights into maintenance solutions, including various screening methods, and proper handling and storage techniques, equipping them with the knowledge to appreciate the science behind a stable and reliable railway track.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Bamboo based Composite Technologies
desc: Delve into the innovative field of material science with this detailed course on bamboo composite technologies. As a fast-growing and renewable resource, bamboo offers a sustainable alternative to traditional timber. This program explores the journey of transforming raw bamboo into high-value engineered products. You will learn about the critical primary processing stages, including converting bamboo culms into mats, strips, and crushed forms. The course then proceeds to the secondary processing, explaining the technology behind creating first-generation mat-based composites, second-generation strip-based laminates, and third-generation bamboo lumber. It covers essential technical aspects such as adhesive formulation, hot pressing parameters, and surface finishing. Upon completion, learners will understand the manufacturing principles and be able to identify the diverse applications of these composites in construction, furniture, and interior design, contributing to both industrial innovation and environmental sustainability.
org: Indian Plywood Industries Research and Training Institute (IPIRTI)

title: Bamboo Composites and Processing Techniques
desc: This course focuses on bamboo as a remarkable material in material science, valued for its sustainability, rapid growth, and excellent mechanical properties. Round bamboo is commonly used for handicrafts and various other applications. The course covers the primary processing of bamboo into slivers, strips, and crushed bamboo at common facility centers. These processed materials are then used to manufacture different types of bamboo composites, including mat-based composites from bamboo mats, vertical and horizontal laminates from bamboo strips, and bamboo lumber composites derived from crushed bamboo. Participants will gain insights into the processing techniques and applications of bamboo composites, highlighting bamboo’s potential as a sustainable alternative to traditional timber in furniture, construction, and laminate industries.
org: Institute of Wood Science and Technology- Bengaluru

title: BANK GUARANTEES AND THEIR ENCASHMENT
desc: In the Indian telecom sector, a significant portion of non-tax revenue is generated through license fees. Ensuring the timely and accurate collection of these fees is paramount for national development. This course delves into the primary instrument used by the Department of Telecommunications to enforce financial discipline: the Bank Guarantee. Participants will gain a detailed understanding of the legal and procedural framework governing Bank Guarantees and their encashment. The course differentiates between Performance Bank Guarantees (PBG), which cover violations of service conditions, and Financial Bank Guarantees (FBG), which secure license fee payments. It outlines the specific conditions that trigger an encashment, the step-by-step process for both full and partial invocation, and the binding nature of the department's decisions on financial institutions. By completing this course, officials will be better equipped to manage license agreements and utilize bank guarantees effectively as a tool for ensuring compliance and securing government revenue.

title: Bank Reconciliation in Core System Integration
desc: This course offers a practical guide to the bank reconciliation process as implemented in India Post's Core System Integrator (CSI) environment. It is specifically designed for finance and accounts personnel to build proficiency in crucial financial management tasks. The curriculum systematically walks learners through each stage of the reconciliation workflow, from creating and preparing reconciliation files to uploading them using transaction code ZFF67 and subsequently identifying matched or unmatched entries. A key focus is placed on the second-level reconciliation conducted at the Postal Accounts Office (PAO), which involves a detailed comparison of e-schedules and bank scrolls to ensure precise financial closure. By completing this course, participants will gain a structured, step-by-step understanding of the process, enabling them to promote transparency, consistency, and operational efficiency in their daily work, ultimately strengthening the financial integrity of postal operations.

title: BANK RECONCILIATION STATEMENT
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip learners with the essential skills to prepare and understand a Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS). The curriculum delves into the core purpose of a BRS, explaining why it is a vital tool for financial control and accuracy. You will learn to identify the various reasons for differences between the cash book and the bank passbook, such as unpresented cheques, uncredited deposits, and bank charges. The course provides a step-by-step guide to the reconciliation process, starting from the opening balance to making necessary adjustments for all discrepancies. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently prepare a BRS, ensuring that your organization's financial records are accurate, complete, and aligned with bank statements, which is a crucial function in public financial management.

title: BARCODE AND QR CODE TECHNOLOGY
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of barcode and QR code technology, essential tools in modern data management and digital interaction. The program begins by defining what barcodes and QR codes are, exploring their history, and detailing their structural components. You will learn to distinguish between linear (1D) and matrix (2D) codes, understanding their respective data capacities and use cases. The course delves into the mechanics of barcode scanners and the process of decoding information, providing clarity on how these technologies function in real-world settings. Key learning areas include the application of barcodes for inventory control and product lifecycle tracking, as well as the use of QR codes for financial transactions and linking to digital information. The curriculum also contrasts static and dynamic QR codes and discusses their advantages and potential security risks. Upon completion, you will have the confidence to effectively utilize and discuss barcode and QR code systems.

title: Base Transceiver Station (BTS) Maintenance
desc: This comprehensive course is designed for technical personnel involved in mobile network operations, focusing on the maintenance of Base Transceiver Stations (BTS). The program begins by establishing the context of a BTS, explaining its function, connectivity to the core network, and its evolution from 2G (BTS) to 5G (gNode-B). Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the critical infrastructure at a BTS site, such as power plants, battery banks, and cooling systems. The course delves into the specific hardware, demonstrating various modules like TRX, duplexers, and control cards. A significant portion is dedicated to practical troubleshooting, covering common faults related to power supply, ABIS links, hardware failures, and configuration. Learners will be shown how to use a BTS tester to measure Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) and accurately localize faults in RF feeder cables, ensuring effective network upkeep and performance.

title: Baseline Cybersecurity Controls for MSMEs
desc: As Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) form the backbone of the Indian economy, their digital transformation journey brings both opportunities and significant risks. This course is designed to equip MSMEs with the essential knowledge to defend against a growing landscape of cyber threats. It provides a detailed walkthrough of the 15 Elemental Cyber Defense Controls framework from CERT-In, offering a structured and accessible approach to cybersecurity. Key learning areas include asset management, secure configurations, patch management, access control, incident handling, and data protection. The curriculum emphasizes the importance of creating a security-aware culture through employee training and managing third-party risks. By completing this course, participants will be able to apply a baseline security posture that not only mitigates risks but also maintains customer trust and supports regulatory compliance. This knowledge is crucial for ensuring the long-term resilience and sustainable growth of their business in the digital age.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Basic Components of Mobile
desc: In an era where mobile devices are central to daily life, they have also become critical sources of evidence in cyber-crime and digital forensic investigations. This course is designed to provide law enforcement and investigative professionals with the essential knowledge required to handle mobile-related evidence effectively and ethically. It addresses the growing need for specialized skills in identifying and processing digital evidence from a variety of mobile platforms.The curriculum covers the fundamental components of mobile technology, including different types of devices like smartphones, feature phones, and tablets, along with their associated storage media. Learners will familiarize themselves with common abbreviations and technical terminology used in mobile communication, enabling accurate interpretation of data. A significant focus is placed on the correct forensic procedures for the identification, documentation, and seizure of mobile devices, ensuring that the integrity and admissibility of the evidence are preserved throughout the investigative process.By completing this course, participants will gain the confidence and competence to manage mobile evidence in compliance with forensic best practices. They will be prepared to handle these devices professionally, securing crucial digital information that can be pivotal in solving cyber-crime cases and ensuring justice.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
keywords: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy (SVPNPA)
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Basic Computer Course for New Entrants
desc: Designed for individuals with no prior technical knowledge, this course serves as the first step towards digital literacy in the workplace. It begins by demystifying what a computer is, tracing its evolution through various generations, and outlining its applications in modern society. The course then breaks down the physical components of a computer, providing a clear overview of internal hardware like the CPU, RAM, ROM, and storage drives, as well as external hardware such as keyboards, mice, and printers. You will learn to identify these parts and understand their specific functions within the system. The final modules focus on the software that brings the hardware to life. Learners will gain a solid understanding of the operating system's role as the interface between the user and the machine. The course also covers different types of application software, including general-purpose tools like MS Office and specialized programs, equipping learners with the fundamental knowledge needed to operate a computer confidently and effectively in a professional environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: BASIC COMPUTER TROUBLESHOOTING
desc: In today's digital-first work environment, the ability to resolve basic computer issues is a critical skill for all public service professionals. This course, ""A Guide to Basic Computer Hardware and Software Troubleshooting,"" is designed to empower learners with the fundamental knowledge to confidently manage and maintain their computer systems. The curriculum provides a structured approach to identifying, diagnosing, and solving the most common problems that disrupt daily work, from a PC that won't start to frustratingly slow performance. Key learning areas include troubleshooting power supply units (SMPS), resolving display and boot-up errors indicated by beep codes, addressing issues with RAM and hard disks, and fixing internet connectivity problems. The course also covers essential preventive maintenance tasks, such as cleaning components and managing system files, to prevent future failures. By completing this course, participants will not only be able to solve immediate technical difficulties but also develop a proactive mindset towards system care, ensuring their digital tools remain reliable and efficient.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Basic Concepts of Artificial Intelligence
desc: Embark on a journey to understand the essential principles of Artificial Intelligence.
