This introductory course is designed for professionals seeking to build a clear and comprehensive understanding of this transformative technology. The curriculum begins by defining AI and explaining its importance across various industries, with a special focus on its applications in the public sector. You will explore the key differences between Machine Learning and Deep Learning, demystifying how these systems learn and evolve. The course delves into the exciting field of Generative AI, discussing its capabilities, advantages, and popular tools that are shaping the future. Furthermore, it provides a detailed overview of the IndiaAI Mission, outlining its goals to create a robust AI ecosystem in the country. Upon completion, you will have the foundational knowledge to appreciate AI's potential and its role in driving efficiency, innovation, and citizen-centric services.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Basic Concepts of Aviation Safety Management System
desc: Safety in aviation depends on a systematic and proactive approach rather than relying solely on reactive measures after accidents or incidents occur. This course introduces the fundamental concepts of a Safety Management System (SMS) and the four ICAO components: Safety Policy and Objectives, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. Participants will explore key SMS principles, including hazard identification, risk assessment and management, safety reporting, management of change, safety communication, positive safety culture, and continuous improvement. The course explains how these elements work together as an integrated system and highlights the role of every individual in maintaining safe, efficient, and sustainable aviation operations. The course is also relevant to personnel in other safety-critical sectors where effective safety management is essential to prevent incidents and protect people, assets, and operations, including railways and maritime.

title: Basic Concepts of Ecology
desc: This course introduces the fundamental concepts of ecology and ecosystems, focusing on the structure, functioning, and interactions that sustain life on Earth. It explores how living organisms interact with one another and with their physical environment, emphasizing key processes such as energy flow, nutrient cycling, and ecosystem dynamics. The course highlights the critical role ecosystems play in maintaining environmental balance and supporting sustainable resource management. Learners will gain a foundational understanding of how ecological systems operate and respond to natural and human-induced changes.

title: Basic Concepts of Law
desc: Basic Concepts of Law offers a thorough introduction to the principles, purpose, and structure of the legal system. This course is designed for public servants seeking to build a foundational understanding of the legal environment in which they operate. It clarifies what law is, why it exists, and how it functions to protect rights and ensure justice within society. Key learning areas include the primary sources and classifications of law, distinguishing between substantive vs. procedural and civil vs. criminal law. Participants will also delve into core legal tenets like the rule of law, the doctrine of separation of powers, and principles of natural justice. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to think critically about legal issues, apply basic legal reasoning to real-world situations, and better understand the legal implications of their administrative roles, thereby fostering more informed and compliant decision-making.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Basic Concepts of Signal, Adequate Distance and Signal Overlap
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental concepts governing safety in Indian Railways train operations. It is designed for personnel who require a solid understanding of the technical and procedural aspects of the signalling system. The curriculum begins by defining braking distance and thoroughly examining the critical factors that affect it, such as train speed, load, gradient, and brake power. It clearly distinguishes between normal service braking and emergency braking, explaining how these calculations are vital for designing a safe and efficient rail network. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the concepts of 'adequate distance' and signal overlaps (both block and signal overlaps), which serve as essential safety cushions to prevent collisions and other incidents. Learners will also study the importance of a driver's reaction time and the minimum visibility standards required for different types of signals, like semaphore and color light signals. The course explains the function of warning boards and how sighting committees verify signal visibility. Upon completion, learners will be able to appreciate the intricate relationship between speed, distance, and signalling that underpins the safety and reliability of Indian Railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Basic Course on Health Technology Assessment for Decision-Makers
desc: In an environment of limited healthcare resources and increasing technological advancements, making informed and efficient decisions is paramount. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Health Technology Assessment (HTA), a multidisciplinary process used to evaluate the value of health technologies. The curriculum is structured to guide learners from foundational concepts to practical applications within the Indian context. You will begin by understanding the core principles of HTA, including how to determine the value of a new health intervention. The course then illustrates real-world applications through case studies, showing how HTA informs standard treatment guidelines, health benefit packages, and procurement decisions. Furthermore, you will gain insight into India's HTA ecosystem, learning how to identify relevant topics for assessment and navigate the submission process.

title: Basic Finance
desc: Designed for beginners, this course demystifies the world of personal finance and investing. It provides a structured path for learners to take control of their financial well-being, starting with the fundamental question of 'why invest?'. The curriculum is broken down into manageable modules covering critical areas such as budgeting, saving, and understanding different asset classes like equity, bonds, real estate, and gold. You will learn the practical steps for investing in mutual funds, stocks, and ETFs, and understand the differences between trading and long-term investing. The course also provides crucial guidance on risk management through emergency funds and insurance, and explains the basics of tax calculation and filing in India. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge and confidence to make informed financial decisions, manage your earnings effectively, and build a diversified portfolio aligned with your long-term goals, such as retirement.

title: Basic Indian Sign Language Course in Self Learning Mode - Part 1
desc: This self-paced introductory course provides a comprehensive foundation in Indian Sign Language (ISL) for absolute beginners. It is designed to equip government employees, educators, public-facing staff, and the general public with the essential skills to communicate with Deaf individuals, fostering a more inclusive environment. The curriculum is structured to build skills progressively, starting with greetings, the manual alphabet, and self-introductions. Learners will then explore vocabulary related to daily routines, people, food, colors, numbers, and time. A significant focus is placed on understanding the basic grammatical structure of ISL, including the critical role of facial expressions and body language in conveying meaning. By completing this course, participants will not only acquire practical communication skills but also gain valuable insights into Deaf culture, promoting sensitivity and respect. This course serves as the first step towards effective and meaningful interaction with the Deaf community, enhancing accessibility in public services and daily life.
org: Indian Sign language Research and Training Centre

title: Basic Indian Sign Language Course in Self Learning Mode Part 2
desc: Building upon the foundational knowledge from Part 1, this course delves deeper into the practical application of Indian Sign Language (ISL). It is specifically tailored for government employees, educators, public-facing staff, and anyone interested in fostering a more inclusive society. The course aims to equip learners with the necessary skills to construct simple sentences and engage in basic, meaningful conversations with members of the Deaf community. The curriculum is structured into thematic modules covering a wide range of vocabulary, including fruits, vegetables, animals, professions, transportation, and health-related terms. It also introduces essential grammatical rules and situational conversations, such as interactions between a mother and daughter or a doctor and patient. Through a series of video lessons with Hindi voice-overs and English captions, learners will gain not only linguistic skills but also a greater sensitivity and respect for Deaf culture and etiquette, ultimately contributing to more accessible public services and social environments.
org: Indian Sign language Research and Training Centre

title: Basic information of Citizens' Charter
desc: This program offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of the Citizen's Charter in the context of Indian public administration. The course begins by explaining the fundamental concept of a Citizen's Charter and its importance in creating a more responsive and accountable government. Learners will explore the key components of a charter, including the organization's vision, mission, service standards, and grievance redressal processes. The content delves into the history of the Citizen's Charter, its origins in the UK, and its adoption in India under the guidance of the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG). Participants will understand that while the charter is not legally enforceable, it represents a significant commitment by a department to its citizens. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to appreciate the role of the Citizen's Charter in improving the quality of public services and strengthening the framework of good governance.

title: Basic Introduction of Forensic Science
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental knowledge of Forensic Science. It delves into the origins of the discipline, its core principles, and its vast scope in the contemporary world. The curriculum traces the historical milestones of forensic science, acknowledging key contributors and the establishment of forensic infrastructure in India, such as the Central Forensic Science Laboratories (CFSLs). Participants will gain a clear understanding of how forensic science serves as an indispensable tool in solving complex crimes by linking evidence to criminal activity. The course emphasizes the pivotal role of forensic evidence in the judicial process, from investigation to trial, ultimately strengthening the criminal justice system. By the end of this course, learners will appreciate the significant impact of forensic science on law enforcement effectiveness and the broader goal of maintaining public safety.

title: Basic Life Support-Disaster Response Training
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of Basic Life Support (BLS). It is specifically designed for individuals who may act as first responders during disasters or other emergencies. The curriculum begins by defining the core concepts of BLS and explaining the causes of airway obstruction. Participants will learn and practice the correct procedures for administering rescue breathing and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) to adults, children, and infants, including variations for scenarios involving foreign body airway obstruction. A significant focus is placed on the vital role volunteers can play in emergency situations, equipping them with the confidence and competence to provide immediate, life-saving care. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to effectively assess a victim's condition and apply BLS techniques to stabilize them until professional medical help arrives, making a tangible difference in critical moments.

title: Basic of Access and Core Network
desc: This comprehensive course offers an in-depth overview of the architecture and technologies behind telecommunication transport networks. It begins by defining the fundamental structure of a telecom system, breaking it down into the access, metro, and core networks, and uses a clear road analogy to explain their functions and interconnections. You will learn about the evolution of transport technologies, starting from the Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy (PDH) and moving to the more advanced Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH), Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM), and the highly efficient Optical Transport Network (OTN). The course also covers key concepts and technologies like Multi-Service Provisioning Platforms (MSPP), Converged Packet Access Networks (C-PAN), and Automatically Switched Optical Networks (ASON). Upon completion, you will be able to differentiate between these critical technologies, understand their specific applications in access and core networking, and appreciate the factors driving the need for high-speed, high-capacity network solutions for voice, data, and video traffic.

title: Basic Principles of Management in Government Service (Hindi)
desc: सरकारी सेवा में प्रबंधन के मूल सिद्धांत पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य लोक प्रशासकों को आवश्यक प्रबंधकीय दक्षताओं से लैस करना है। यह पाठ्यक्रम प्रबंधन की प्रमुख अवधारणाओं पर प्रकाश डालता है, जिसमें योजना और प्राथमिकता निर्धारण, संसाधन आवंटन, टीम नेतृत्व और प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन शामिल हैं। प्रतिभागी सीखेंगे कि सरकारी ढांचे के भीतर इन सिद्धांतों को कैसे लागू किया जाए ताकि दक्षता, जवाबदेही और पारदर्शिता को बढ़ावा मिल सके। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर भी जोर देता है कि कैसे प्रभावी प्रबंधन संगठनात्मक उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति और सार्वजनिक सेवाओं के सफल वितरण में योगदान देता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, शिक्षार्थी अपनी टीमों का मार्गदर्शन करने, संसाधनों का बेहतर प्रबंधन करने और अपनी संगठनात्मक इकाइयों के समग्र प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बनाने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से तैयार होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Basic Procedure for Train Escorting by RPF Personnel
desc: Train escorting in Indian Railways may relates to the various type of security provided by the security staff for safe and secure journey of the passengers. This is an important step which stop a number of crimes. It is secured with help of security personnels of RPF/RPSF and GRP. It is operated under the guidelines issued by the DG, RPF. Train Escorting ensure the safety and security of passengers, railway property, and maintaining law and order on trains .It  enhanced Security in Vulnerable route. It gives Protection against nuisance, Trafficking and Anti social element during train journey.

title: Basic Procedure of Railway Security Management System by RPF Personnel
desc: RSMS application software is developed to take care of not only the traditional crimes related to theft of Railway property but also the ones concerning security of Passengers and Passenger area and can even handle responsibilities expected in coming future. RSMS is management information system software that is used to capture all the possible information related to crime. The project involves inter linking of all the levels of RPF working viz the Railway Board, the Zonal Railways, Divisions and Posts. The massaging modules of RSMS envisages implementation of control room messaging system for efficient and reliable flow of information between control rooms at Railway Board, Zones, the divisional level and Post Level. Apart from having normal messaging features like compose, Inbox, Outbox & multiple locations messaging,

title: BASIC RECORDS IN MAIL OFFICES
desc: Proper record management is a cornerstone of operational integrity within the Department of Posts. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the basic records that are fundamental to the daily functioning of mail offices. It is designed to equip postal employees, particularly those in operational roles, with the necessary knowledge to maintain these records accurately and systematically, ensuring compliance with all departmental standards and regulations. The curriculum covers a wide array of essential documents, including the Attendance Register, Nominal Roll, Memorandum of Distribution of Work, Due Mail and Sorting List (DMSL), and various order books. Participants will learn the specific purpose of each record, the correct procedures for their maintenance, and their role in the broader context of mail sorting, dispatch, and delivery. By completing this course, learners will be better prepared to contribute to the efficiency, accountability, and reliability of India's postal services, minimizing errors and ensuring a seamless flow of mail across the network.

title: Basic Search and Rescue-Disaster Response Training
desc: This self-paced course is designed to introduce the fundamental principles and practices of search and rescue operations in disaster-stricken environments. The content specifically focuses on Collapsed Structure Search and Rescue (CSSR), a critical skill for first responders. Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of how a search and rescue team is structured and operates, including the systematic steps for searching and locating trapped individuals. The course details various search techniques and the basic equipment used to carry them out safely and effectively. A significant portion of the training is dedicated to explaining the vital contribution of volunteers and how they can be integrated into victim management protocols. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the essential knowledge to support and participate in basic search and rescue missions, making a tangible difference in emergency situations.

title: BASIC TYPES AND COMPONENTS OF CCTV
desc: This comprehensive introductory course delves into the essential principles of modern surveillance through Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV). It is structured to provide a clear and detailed understanding of both the technology and its practical applications, particularly within security and public safety domains. The course begins by distinguishing between traditional analog and modern digital (IP) CCTV systems, explaining the role of key components such as Digital Video Recorders (DVRs) and Network Video Recorders (NVRs). Learners will be guided through the various types of cameras available, including dome, bullet, PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom), and specialized cameras like ANPR and face recognition systems, analyzing their specific use cases. The curriculum also covers the practical aspects of system installation, detailing the necessary cables, connectors, and power supplies for both analog and digital setups. Upon completion, participants will be able to identify system components, understand their functions, and recognize the appropriate technology for different surveillance needs, making it ideal for security personnel and technical staff.

title: BASICS AND TYPES OF FIRE WITH HANDLING OF FIRE EXTINGUISHER
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to understanding and managing fire emergencies in the workplace. It begins by explaining the fundamental components of fire through the fire triangle (heat, fuel, oxygen) and details the primary causes of fires, such as electrical faults and cooking accidents. The curriculum provides an in-depth look at the five main classes of fire: Class A (ordinary combustibles), Class B (flammable liquids), Class C (electrical equipment), Class D (combustible metals), and Class K (cooking oils). Participants will learn to identify each fire type and understand why certain extinguishing agents are effective while others can be dangerous. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to fire extinguishers. It covers the different types available, their contents, and their specific applications. The course culminates in a practical demonstration of how to operate an extinguisher using the universally recognized PASS (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep) technique. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to respond confidently to fire incidents, ensuring personal safety and minimizing potential damage.

title: Basics of Accounting Concepts
desc: This course introduces learners to the purpose, classification, and foundational concepts of accounting principles. It explains the key principles that ensure consistency, transparency, and reliability in financial reporting, with special emphasis on the accrual, matching, and realization principles. Learners will gain practical skills in applying these principles to accurately recognize revenues and expenses in financial statements.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM)

title: Basics of Accounting, Journal and Ledgers
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the fundamentals of accounting, designed for learners with no prior background in the subject. It begins by defining accounting, its objectives, and its critical role in business and governance. The curriculum is structured into six modules, systematically guiding learners through key concepts. You will learn about essential accounting terminology, the classification of accounts, and the golden rules of debit and credit. The course delves into the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) that govern financial reporting. A significant portion is dedicated to the practical application of these principles, focusing on preparing journal entries for various transactions and posting them to ledger accounts. By the end of this course, you will understand how to maintain accurate financial records, balance ledger accounts, and appreciate the importance of the journal and ledger in creating reliable financial statements for analysis and compliance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Basics of Accounting: Journal Entries and Ledgers
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the fundamentals of accounting, designed for learners with no prior background in the subject. It begins by defining accounting, its objectives, and its critical role in business and governance. The curriculum is structured into six modules, systematically guiding learners through key concepts. You will learn about essential accounting terminology, the classification of accounts, and the golden rules of debit and credit. The course delves into the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) that govern financial reporting. A significant portion is dedicated to the practical application of these principles, focusing on preparing journal entries for various transactions and posting them to ledger accounts. By the end of this course, you will understand how to maintain accurate financial records, balance ledger accounts.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Basics of Administrative Law
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential principles of Administrative Law, designed specifically for government functionaries. It addresses the critical need for public servants to operate within a defined legal and ethical framework. The curriculum begins by defining the nature and scope of administrative law and its relevance in modern governance. A significant portion is dedicated to 'subordinate legislation,' explaining the process by which the executive creates detailed rules under the authority of parliamentary acts, and the legislative and judicial controls that ensure this power is not misused. The course then thoroughly examines the 'Principles of Natural Justice,' including the right to a fair hearing, the rule against bias, and the requirement for 'speaking orders.' Upon completion, learners will be equipped to make legally sound administrative decisions, ensure procedural fairness in their work, and contribute to a more transparent, accountable, and just public administration system, thereby minimizing legal challenges and enhancing public trust.

title: Basics of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to equip learners with a solid understanding of the fundamental principles of Artificial Intelligence (AI). In an era where technology is reshaping governance and public service delivery, a basic grasp of AI is becoming essential for public officials. This course delves into the core concepts of AI, starting with its history and evolution. You will explore the key differences between various types of AI and understand the foundational role of Machine Learning (ML) and data in building intelligent systems. The curriculum covers essential topics such as pattern recognition, knowledge representation, and the basic mechanics of how machines learn from data. Through a combination of theoretical explanations and illustrative examples, the course makes complex topics accessible to beginners. Upon completion, learners will not only comprehend what AI is but also appreciate its potential applications and impact across different sectors. This knowledge will enable you to identify opportunities for leveraging AI in your work and engage more effectively in discussions about technology-driven transformation in government.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Basics of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Defence
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, specifically tailored to their application in the defence landscape. The curriculum begins by defining AI, exploring its historical development, and outlining its primary types and key technological components. You will learn about the pivotal role of machine learning, understanding the distinctions between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, and the function of algorithms in building intelligent systems. The course then transitions to practical applications, showcasing how AI is driving innovation in areas like autonomous vehicles, surveillance drones, cybersecurity, battlefield management, and advanced weapons systems. By the end of this course, you will have a clear perspective on the strategic importance of AI and ML in modern defence, the ethical considerations involved, and the potential for future advancements in military technology.

title: BASICS OF CLIMATE CHANGE: Science Behind Stories
desc: Delve into the essential science of our planet's changing climate. This introductory course is designed to demystify complex concepts, providing a clear and accessible overview for a broad audience, including public officials and concerned citizens. The curriculum begins by defining climate and weather, then progresses to explain the primary drivers of climate change, with a focus on the impact of human activities such as the burning of fossil fuels. You will learn about the six main greenhouse gases designated by the IPCC, their global warming potential (GWP), and how they contribute to the Earth's energy budget. The course also touches upon the Milankovitch cycles, the crucial role of oceans in regulating climate, and the tools used for climate prediction and projection, such as Global Circulation Models. By the end of this course, you will have a solid grasp of the scientific consensus on climate change, enabling you to understand its implications and the importance of global efforts like the Paris Agreement to mitigate its effects.

title: Basics of Cloud Computing
desc: In an era of digital transformation, understanding cloud computing is essential for public service professionals. This course is designed to build a solid foundation in cloud concepts and their practical applications in governance. You will begin by learning the fundamental principles of cloud technology, including on-demand self-service, scalability, and resource pooling. The course delves into the three main service models—Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS)—and compares their suitability for different government applications. Furthermore, it addresses critical aspects of cloud adoption, such as the strategic benefits for efficiency and service delivery, alongside potential risks and security challenges like data breaches and insecure APIs.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Basics of Communication
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental skills of effective communication. It begins by defining communication and its critical role in daily life, particularly within the context of public service. The curriculum is structured into key modules covering the basics of communication, interpersonal dynamics, and group interactions. You will delve into the four main types of interpersonal communication: verbal, non-verbal, listening, and written, learning how to apply each for maximum clarity and impact. The course also addresses modern communication challenges, offering strategies for effective interaction with remote colleagues using digital tools. Furthermore, it explores the mechanics of group communication, covering decision-making techniques like brainstorming, leadership functions, and methods for preventing conflict. By the end of this course, you will have a solid framework for analyzing communication barriers and building more effective, collaborative, and productive relationships in the workplace.

title: Basics of Company Law
desc: With a growing emphasis on good corporate governance, a strong understanding of Company Law is critical for public functionaries. This course introduces the fundamental legal principles and regulatory requirements governing the formation, operation, and dissolution of companies. Participants will examine the structure, management, and administration of companies, including the various types and their defining characteristics. Key topics include the constitutional documents of a company, such as the Memorandum of Association (MoA) and Articles of Association (AoA). The course also delves into the provisions for Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), the roles and responsibilities of Key Managerial Personnel (KMPs), and disclosure obligations. By covering the entire lifecycle of a company from incorporation to winding-up, this course provides the essential knowledge to navigate the legal landscape of corporate entities and ensure effective regulatory compliance.
org: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India

title: Basics of Critical Information Infrastructure
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world, the security of a nation's Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) is paramount. This course is designed for government and PSU employees to build a comprehensive awareness of the systems that form the digital backbone of India's economy and governance. You will delve into the core concepts of what constitutes critical infrastructure and, more specifically, critical information infrastructure, exploring its significance for national security, the economy, and public safety. The curriculum provides a detailed overview of India's legal framework for CII protection, including Section 70 of the IT Act, and draws comparisons with international approaches in the UK and USA. Learners will gain insights into the functions of the National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre (NCIIPC), the criteria for identifying 'protected systems,' and the specific sectors designated as CII in India, such as telecom, power, and banking. The course concludes by outlining the essential responsibilities and security measures that organizations must implement to ensure the resilience and continuous operation of their critical infrastructure, empowering officials to contribute effectively to national cyber defense.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Basics of Disaster Management
desc: India's unique geo-climatic conditions make it one of the most disaster-prone countries in the world. While natural hazards are unavoidable, their impact can be significantly reduced through systematic and proactive disaster management. This foundational course is designed to equip public officials with the core knowledge required for effective disaster risk reduction. The curriculum delves into the disaster management cycle, from mitigation and preparedness to response and recovery. It provides a detailed examination of the Disaster Management Act of 2005, the institutional framework led by the NDMA, and the guiding principles of the Prime Minister’s 10-point agenda. Participants will also gain insights into financing mechanisms for disaster risk mitigation and the importance of international conventions.
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

title: Basics of e-Governance and Digital India
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of e-Governance and the transformative impact of the Digital India initiative. It begins by defining governance and good governance, setting the context for why digital transformation is crucial for effective public administration. The curriculum delves into the key technologies driving this change, from foundational ICTs to emerging innovations like AI, IoT, and Blockchain. A significant focus is placed on the Digital India program, exploring its three core vision areas and nine pillars. Learners will examine practical examples of digital services and platforms such as Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and MyGov. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to understand how technology can be leveraged to create more efficient, transparent, and citizen-centric governance, contributing to the achievement of national objectives and Sustainable Development Goals.

title: Basics of Ecosystem based Disaster Risk Reduction
desc: In an era of increasing climate-related disasters, this course offers a crucial perspective on sustainable and resilient development through Ecosystem-based Disaster Risk Reduction (Eco-DRR). It moves beyond conventional engineering solutions to explore how well-managed ecosystems like forests, wetlands, and mangroves can serve as natural defenses against hazards. This program is designed for officials, planners, and practitioners seeking to integrate nature-based solutions into their work.The curriculum covers a wide array of key learning areas, starting with the fundamental principles of Eco-DRR and its role in climate change adaptation. Learners will delve into specific, field-tested interventions for various challenges, including water harvesting structures for drought resilience, bioengineering techniques like geotextiles and vetiver grass for slope stabilization, coastal protection using mangroves, and urban flood mitigation strategies. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical application of these techniques through government programs like MGNREGS, complete with case studies from India. Furthermore, it introduces the use of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for effective planning, site selection, and monitoring of Eco-DRR projects.Upon completion, participants will be equipped to design, implement, and manage Eco-DRR initiatives that not only reduce disaster risk but also enhance local livelihoods, conserve biodiversity, and contribute to long-term environmental sustainability. This course empowers professionals to champion a more holistic and nature-positive approach to building resilient infrastructure and communities.
org: Kerala Institute of Local Administration - KILA

title: Basics of Effective Communication
desc: This introductory course provides learners with the fundamental knowledge and practical skills required for effective communication in professional and public service environments. It begins by exploring the meaning, importance, and key elements of communication, with a focus on how clear and purposeful communication contributes to effective workplace interactions and service delivery. The course covers essential aspects of interpersonal and group communication, including verbal, non-verbal, listening, and written communication. Participants will learn how to communicate with clarity, build positive interpersonal relationships, and adapt their communication style to different professional situations. The course also addresses the evolving nature of workplace communication, with a particular focus on remote and digital communication. Learners will explore strategies for effective communication with remote colleagues, the appropriate use of digital communication tools, and best practice.

title: BASICS OF FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING
desc: This introductory course, 'Basics of Financial Accounting,' is designed for individuals with no prior accounting knowledge. It establishes a strong foundation by explaining the fundamental role of accounting in business. The course begins by defining accounting and its key processes, from identifying monetary transactions to interpreting financial information. You will learn to differentiate between crucial concepts like capital, assets, liabilities, and drawings. The curriculum systematically guides you through the accounting cycle, starting with recording transactions in a journal using the double-entry system. You will then learn how to classify these transactions by posting them to different types of accounts—personal, real, and nominal—within a ledger. Finally, the course culminates in teaching you how to prepare a trial balance to ensure the arithmetical accuracy of your books. Upon completion, you will have the confidence and skills to manage basic financial records and understand the structure of financial statements.

title: Basics of Financial Planning, Budgeting and Tax Filing
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge and skills for effective personal financial management. It begins by establishing the importance of financial planning as a critical tool for achieving long-term economic security. You will learn to assess your current financial position, set SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound) goals, and develop a structured financial plan. The course delves into various practical budgeting methods, such as the 50/20/30 rule and zero-based budgeting, helping you to prioritize spending and maximize savings. Furthermore, you will gain insights into fundamental accounting concepts, including the interpretation of cash flow statements and profit and loss accounts to monitor your financial health. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to demystifying the Indian tax system, covering topics like tax planning strategies, understanding Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), and a step-by-step guide to filing Income Tax Returns (ITR). Upon completion, you will be better prepared to make informed financial decisions, manage debt, build an emergency fund, and work towards a secure financial future.
org: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

title: Basics of Geomorphology
desc: Embark on a comprehensive journey into the world of geomorphology. This course is designed to introduce learners to the core principles governing the Earth's surface features. You will begin by understanding the historical context of geomorphology, including the influential models of landscape evolution proposed by W.M. Davis and Walther Penck. The course systematically explores the primary geomorphic processes of weathering, erosion, and deposition, and investigates how these forces, driven by agents like rivers, wind, and waves, sculpt the planet's diverse terrains. Each module focuses on a specific environment, from arid deserts shaped by aeolian processes to soluble rock landscapes forming karst topographies, and dynamic coastal zones. The final sessions contextualize this knowledge within India, examining its unique geomorphic landscapes and their potential for geotourism. Upon completion, you will be able to identify and analyze various landforms and appreciate the dynamic processes that continuously shape our world.

title: Basics of Grassing in Landscape Development
desc: A well-maintained green space is a vital component of urban and public landscapes, contributing to environmental health and public well-being. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the practice of grassing, tailored for professionals involved in public works and horticulture. It begins by establishing the context, explaining why grassing is crucial for aesthetic enhancement, ecological balance, and functional benefits like soil conservation. The curriculum systematically details the key stages of developing a lawn, including site selection, trenching, soil dressing, and the application of good earth and manure. It also covers sustainable practices such as using neem oil cake for natural pest control. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the practical knowledge to plan, execute, and maintain vibrant grassed areas, ensuring the longevity and beauty of public landscapes.

title: Basics of health economics
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential principles of health economics, tailored for public sector professionals who are not economists. The curriculum is structured to build your capacity for engaging in strategic health policy discussions. You will begin by exploring the foundational concepts of efficiency and equity, understanding why they are critical for evaluating and improving a health system. The course then delves into the mechanics of healthcare markets, covering supply and demand, and analyzing common market failures specific to the health sector. A significant portion is dedicated to health financing, where you will learn about resource mobilization, risk-pooling mechanisms, and provider payment strategies. Through interactive modules and simulations, you will learn to apply these economic frameworks to real-world scenarios, ultimately enhancing your ability to assist in the design and implementation of more effective and equitable health policies.

title: Basics of Hydrogeology
desc: This introductory course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental principles of hydrogeology. It begins by establishing the context of water's journey through the hydrologic cycle, explaining how water moves above, on, and below the Earth's surface. You will learn to identify the different vertical zones of groundwater, including the unsaturated and saturated zones, and understand their significance. A key focus of the course is to differentiate between various geological formations like aquifers, aquitards, and aquicludes, based on their capacity to hold and transmit water. Furthermore, the course delves into the critical properties of aquifers, such as porosity and permeability, which determine their potential as a water source. Upon completion, learners will have a clear conceptual framework for understanding groundwater systems, enabling them to contribute more effectively to discussions and projects related to water resource management and environmental protection.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: Basics of Insurance and Agricultural Insurance
desc: In an era of increasing climate variability and market fluctuations, managing agricultural risk is paramount for ensuring food security and farmer welfare. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of agricultural insurance as a vital risk mitigation tool. It is designed for officials, agricultural professionals, and farmers who need to understand the landscape of agricultural insurance in India. The curriculum begins with the core concepts of risk, its classification in an agricultural context, and various management strategies. It then delves into the fundamental principles of insurance, explaining key terminologies and the operational mechanics of insurance products. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to specific agricultural insurance schemes, with a detailed focus on the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), weather-based crop insurance, and coverage for livestock and farm infrastructure. Participants will also learn about the historical evolution of agricultural insurance in India, the role of regulatory bodies like IRDAI, and the integration of technology through platforms like the National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP). Upon completion, learners will be equipped to make informed decisions, effectively utilize insurance products, and contribute to building a more resilient agricultural sector.
org: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana PMFBY

title: Basics of Internal Plumbing for Buildings
desc: An effective internal water supply system is a critical component of any modern building, ensuring the health, safety, and convenience of its occupants. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of internal plumbing. It begins by exploring the context of water distribution in buildings and the importance of adhering to technical standards. Key learning areas include the identification and selection of appropriate pipes and materials for different applications, from traditional GI pipes to modern CPVC and PPR alternatives. The course delves into the practical aspects of installation, covering correct pipe laying, alignment, support, and jointing techniques to prevent leaks and ensure long-term durability. Learners will also understand the process of chase cutting for concealed pipework and the essential final step of pipeline testing to guarantee structural integrity. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to support the design, installation, and maintenance of efficient and reliable internal plumbing systems in public and private infrastructure projects.

title: Basics of Marketing
desc: In today's competitive landscape, understanding the fundamentals of marketing is crucial for any organization's success. This course, "Fundamentals of Marketing Strategy and Principles," is designed to provide a solid foundation for anyone new to the field. You will delve into the core concepts that drive successful marketing, starting with the importance of creating customer value and understanding the broader marketing environment. The curriculum systematically breaks down the Marketing Mix, explaining how to strategically combine product, price, place, and promotion. Furthermore, you will learn the critical process of market segmentation, targeting, and positioning (STP) to effectively reach your desired audience. By the end of this course, you will not only grasp the key theories but also be equipped with the analytical perspective needed to develop and evaluate basic marketing plans, making you a more valuable asset in any role that involves public outreach, program promotion, or strategic communication.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Basics of Mobile Access Network
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the fundamentals of mobile access network technology. It begins by establishing the context of a RAN, explaining its critical role in connecting end-user devices to the core telecommunication network. The curriculum is structured into progressive modules, starting with the cellular concept, which is the basic geographical and functional unit of any mobile system. You will explore the specifics of the RF interface using GSM as a case study, understanding how frequencies and time slots are managed. The course then progresses through the architecture of 3G's UTRAN and 4G's E-UTRAN, highlighting the technological shifts such as WCDMA and OFDMA. Key learning areas include network elements like BTS and NodeB, multiple access techniques, frequency spectrum allocation, and the evolution of network architecture. By the end of this course, learners will have a clear, structured knowledge of how mobile access networks have evolved and the principles guiding current and future technologies like Open RAN.

title: Basics of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
desc: Embark on a journey into the microscopic realm with this introductory course on nanoscience and nanotechnology. Designed for learners with a curiosity for cutting-edge science, this program demystifies the fundamental principles that govern matter at the nanoscale. The course begins by defining 'nano' and classifying nanomaterials based on their dimensions. It then explores the fascinating properties of nanoparticles, explaining why their behavior differs so significantly from bulk materials, with a focus on concepts like surface-to-volume ratio and quantum confinement. You will learn about the two primary fabrication approaches—top-down and bottom-up—and discover the physical and chemical methods used to synthesize these tiny structures. The course highlights the transformative impact of nanotechnology through real-world applications, including targeted drug delivery in medicine, enhanced efficiency in solar cells, advanced paints, and innovative uses in nanogeoscience for resource exploration and environmental remediation. Upon completion, you will have a solid grasp of the basics of this revolutionary field and its potential to shape future technologies.

title: Basics of National Income Accounting
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of national income accounting. It is designed for public officials who require a solid grasp of macroeconomic indicators to inform their work in policy-making, financial management, and economic analysis. The course begins by explaining the importance of measuring economic activity and introduces the circular flow of income model to illustrate the interactions between households, firms, and the government. You will delve into the core concepts of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), exploring its definition and significance. The curriculum details the three primary methods for measuring GDP: the output (or production) method, the income method, and the expenditure method. Furthermore, the course clarifies the critical distinction between nominal and real GDP, explaining how inflation is accounted for to provide a true measure of economic growth. You will also learn about related concepts like Gross National Product (GNP) and Gross Value Added (GVA), and how these metrics are used to compare economic performance across sectors and countries. Upon completion, you will be equipped to interpret key economic statistics and understand their implications for governance and national development.

title: Basics of NIB Equipments BNG RPR and OCLAN
desc: This technical course offers a detailed overview of the essential equipment that powers modern broadband networks. It delves into the three-layer architecture of a broadband network: the access, aggregation, and core layers, explaining the role of each. Learners will explore the specific functions of key network elements, such as OCLAN and RPR switches in the aggregation layer, and the critical role of the Broadband Network Gateway (BNG) as a multi-service edge router in the core layer. The course also covers the vital back-end processes, including subscriber authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) managed through RADIUS and LDAP servers. Participants will understand the complete traffic flow, from customer premises equipment (CPE) through the network layers to the global internet, including concepts like VLANs, QinQ, and MPLS. By the end of this course, learners will have a clear understanding of how these technologies integrate to provide reliable and high-quality internet services.

title: Basics of Nutrition Science
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials and field-level functionaries with a comprehensive understanding of public health nutrition in India, in line with the goals of Mission Poshan 2.0. It blends foundational nutrition science with practical strategies for effective policy implementation, empowering participants to strengthen community-level nutrition interventions. The curriculum delves into the nutritional needs across different life stages, with a special focus on the first 1000 days, maternal nutrition, exclusive breastfeeding, and complementary feeding. Learners will be introduced to the Healthy Eating Plate model and practical guidance for encouraging healthy eating practices, while also raising awareness about the risks of foods high in fat, sugar, and salt. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding the operational framework of Mission Poshan 2.0, including the six Anganwadi services and the role of the Supplementary Nutrition Program. Participants will also learn about the functions of the Poshan Tracker application for data-driven monitoring and planning, enabling them to contribute effectively to India's goal of a malnutrition-free future.

title: Basics of Paleontology
desc: Embark on a journey into Earth's ancient past with this introductory course on the basics of paleontology. Designed for beginners, this course demystifies the study of fossils and the history of life on our planet. You will begin by understanding the core concepts, historical background, and various sub-disciplines of paleontology. The course then delves into the world of fossils, explaining their different types, the specific conditions required for their formation, and the various modes of preservation, such as permineralization and carbonization. The final section focuses on biostratigraphy, a critical application of paleontology. You will learn how fossils are used to determine the relative ages of rock layers, understand the concept of biozones, and see how this knowledge is applied to correlate rock strata across different geographical locations. Upon completion, you will have a comprehensive understanding of how paleontologists reconstruct the history of life and its evolution.

title: Basics of Power System
desc: This course is designed to demystify the core principles of electrical power systems for beginners. It begins by establishing a clear connection between the physical concepts of work and energy and their electrical counterparts, power and electricity. You will learn to identify and define key electrical parameters, including voltage (potential difference), current (flow of charge), and power, along with their standard units (Volts, Amperes, Watts). The curriculum delves into the critical distinction between Alternating Current (AC) and Direct Current (DC), explaining how AC is generated using principles like Faraday's Law and the role of frequency in power systems like the Indian grid. A key focus is the power system philosophy, which covers the journey of electricity from generation plants, through high-voltage transmission lines, to the end consumer. You will understand the practical reasons for using step-up and step-down transformers to minimize power loss (I²R loss) over long distances. By the end of this course, you will have a solid conceptual framework to understand how the interconnected national power grid functions.

title: Basics of Project Management
desc: This course provides a foundational understanding of project management, essential for public sector professionals tasked with delivering projects on time and within budget. It is designed to equip learners with the core knowledge needed to navigate the entire project lifecycle. The curriculum covers critical stages, including project initiation, where you will learn to define goals and identify stakeholders. You will explore comprehensive project planning, covering scope definition, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk assessment. The course delves into the execution phase, focusing on team leadership and progress monitoring, and concludes with the procedures for effective project closure. Participants will also be introduced to key knowledge areas such as risk management, project finance, and the work breakdown structure. By the end of this session, you will be empowered with the practical knowledge to initiate, plan, execute, and close projects with greater confidence.

title: Basics of Project Management
desc: This introductory course provides an overview of key concepts involved in planning and delivering projects effectively. It focuses on the importance of a holistic and integrated approach to project planning, with particular emphasis on sustainability. Learners will gain an understanding of the main components that contribute to project costs and explore different project delivery methods used to implement projects successfully. The course provides a practical foundation for understanding how effective planning, cost awareness, and appropriate delivery approaches contribute to successful and sustainable project outcomes.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Basics of Public Policy Research
desc: This course, 'Fundamentals of Public Policy Research,' is designed to equip public functionaries with the essential skills to conduct systematic and impactful research for policy-making. In an era where data-driven decisions are paramount, understanding the principles of research is crucial for addressing complex societal challenges. The course begins by defining research within the context of public administration and policy, distinguishing between research 'for' policy and research 'in' policy. Learners will be guided through the structured stages of the research process, including problem identification, developing a research design, sampling techniques, and methods for data collection and analysis. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring different research strategies, providing a clear comparison between qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods approaches, enabling participants to select the most appropriate strategy for their specific research questions. The final module focuses on the practical skill of communicating research findings effectively through a well-structured research report. Upon completion, participants will be able to undertake a piece of policy research, justify their methodological choices, and contribute to more scientific and evidence-informed public policy.

title: Basics of Public Private Partnership in Highway Projects
desc: This course provides a concise introduction to Public-Private Partnership (PPP) frameworks in highway infrastructure development. It explains the objectives and value proposition of PPPs, with a focus on risk allocation principles and the comparative features of key Indian PPP models, including BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), HAM (Hybrid Annuity Model), and OMT (Operate-Maintain-Transfer). Learners will examine project financing structures involving debt, equity, viability gap funding, and annuity-based payments, along with performance management systems based on key performance indicators (KPIs). The course also outlines the complete procurement lifecycle for concessionaire selection, covering prequalification, RFQ, RFP, bid evaluation, and award processes, and introduces essential provisions of concession agreements and post-award contract management.
org: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

title: Basics of Quantum Technologies
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to quantum technologies and their transformative potential across computing, science, and cybersecurity. Learners will explore the fundamental principles of quantum mechanics, including superposition, entanglement, and interference, and understand how these concepts enable quantum computing. The course examines the quantum computing technology stack, key applications in optimization and scientific simulation, and the emerging field of quantum-safe cryptography. It also introduces post-quantum cryptographic approaches and strategies to prepare for the security challenges posed by future quantum computers.

title: Basics of Railway Coaching Operations
desc: Dive into the essential workings of railway coaching operations with this introductory course. Designed for personnel associated with the railway sector, this program unpacks the complexities of managing a vast network of passenger trains. You will gain a comprehensive overview of the key pillars of coaching operations, from the strategic scheduling of trains and the intricate process of rake linking to the efficient management of railway yards and the importance of periodic maintenance overhauls. The course highlights the critical role of the Control Office in monitoring train movements and mitigating delays to maintain service reliability. Furthermore, it touches upon the integration of modern technologies like RFID and GPS tracking that are revolutionizing the field. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the fundamental knowledge to appreciate how streamlined coaching operations lead to enhanced safety, improved passenger experience, and greater overall efficiency in the Indian Railways network.

title: Basics of Railway Freight Operations
desc: This introductory course delves into the essential aspects of railway freight operations, which form the backbone of India's bulk goods transportation and supply chain. It is designed to provide a comprehensive overview of how Indian Railways manages the massive task of moving key commodities, thereby contributing to economic growth and reducing road congestion. Participants will learn about the strategic importance of efficient scheduling, optimal locomotive utilization, and effective terminal management. The course places a strong emphasis on the digital transformation of freight services, exploring the functionalities of the Freight Operations Information System (FOIS) for real-time tracking and management. Furthermore, it touches upon how predictive maintenance, GPS technology, and AI-driven analytics are being leveraged to improve service reliability, ensure safety, and boost freight revenue. Upon completion, learners will have a clear understanding of the complex, technology-driven ecosystem of modern railway freight logistics.

title: Basics of Remote Sensing
desc: Embark on a journey to understand how we observe our planet from space with this foundational course on remote sensing. This program is designed for beginners, providing a clear overview of why this technology is crucial for modern geosciences, environmental monitoring, and resource management. You will delve into the key learning areas, starting with the physics of electromagnetic radiation and how it forms the basis of all remote sensing data. The course systematically explains the different types of platforms like satellites and drones, their orbits, and the variety of sensors they carry, from multispectral to hyperspectral. You will learn to distinguish between spatial, spectral, temporal, and radiometric resolutions and understand their impact on data quality. By the end of this course, you will be able to recognize common satellite data products like Landsat and Sentinel and grasp how to interpret spectral signatures to identify features on the Earth's surface, preparing you to leverage this powerful technology in your field.

title: Basics of Revenue Procurement in Defence
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the procedural and regulatory framework of revenue procurement as outlined in the Defence Procurement Manual (DPM). It is designed for officials across the Ministry of Defence and Defence Services who are involved in acquiring goods and services. The course establishes the context of public procurement by explaining its core objectives, policies, and the principles of financial propriety as per the General Financial Rules (GFR). Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the tendering process, covering Advertised, Limited, and Single Tender Enquiries, and the criteria for each. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of contract formulation, management, and the legal aspects involved, including standard conditions, liquidated damages, and arbitration. The curriculum also covers specialized topics such as foreign procurement, rate contracts, and the crucial roles of the Competent Financial Authority (CFA) and Integrated Financial Advisors (IFA) in ensuring transparency and accountability. Upon completion, participants will be able to navigate the complexities of defence procurement, apply the correct procedures for sourcing and quality assurance, and manage contracts effectively, ensuring compliance and value for public money.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Basics of Signalling in Kavach
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the complete safety chain in Indian Railways, linking fundamental railway operations to the advanced functioning of the KAVACH Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system. Learners are first introduced to the principles of train movement, operating rules, and the structure of the railway network. The course then explores key signalling equipment, interlocking systems, and their role in preventing conflicting train movements. Emphasis is placed on modern electronic interlocking and its components. The course further explains the architecture of IRATP-KAVACH, highlighting how trackside and onboard elements communicate to prevent Signal Passed At Danger (SPAD), overspeed, and collisions. Learners will understand how Kavach monitors train speed, determines position and direction, generates warnings and SOS signals, and applies static and dynamic speed restrictions to ensure safe operations across the network.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: Basics of Tally Accounting Software
desc: This course provides a basic introduction to Tally and computerised accounting, designed for learners who want to understand the fundamentals of using Tally for financial record-keeping and accounting operations. The course introduces the Tally interface, company creation, ledger and group management, voucher entry, accounting transactions, and basic financial reports. Learners will also gain an understanding of how accounting data is recorded, maintained, and retrieved in Tally. The course provides a foundation for using Tally in routine accounting activities and prepares learners to work with digital financial records in a structured and efficient manner.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Basics of Training Design
desc: In the context of public service, the ability to design and deliver effective training is paramount for capacity building and performance improvement. This course serves as a foundational guide to the systematic process of instructional design. It begins by establishing the context and necessity for structured training design within an organization. Participants will delve into key learning areas, including how to articulate training needs, draft comprehensive design briefs, and break down complex topics into digestible learning units. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the principles of assessment, teaching learners how to create and implement tools to evaluate the impact and success of their training initiatives. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply a structured, end-to-end methodology to design training programs that are not only engaging but also aligned with organizational goals and deliver measurable results.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Basics of Transfer Pricing
desc: This foundational course delves into the essential aspects of Transfer Pricing as stipulated by the Indian Income Tax Act, 1961. It is specifically designed for tax officials to build a strong understanding of the regulations that prevent profit shifting by multinational corporations. The curriculum systematically covers the definitions of International Transactions and Associated Enterprises, the criteria for deeming enterprises as associated, and the crucial concept of determining the Arm's Length Price (ALP). Participants will learn about the mandatory documentation requirements under Section 92D and Rule 10D, which are vital for conducting effective transfer pricing audits. The course also introduces dispute resolution mechanisms, with a special focus on the Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) program, including its procedures, rollback provisions, and compliance requirements. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these legal principles to real-world scenarios, enhancing their ability to scrutinize and assess complex international transactions.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Basics of Vertical Garden
desc: As urban spaces become more condensed, innovative solutions for integrating nature are essential. This course introduces vertical gardening as a sustainable and aesthetically pleasing technique for greening walls and compact areas. It is designed for professionals in public works, horticulture, and urban planning seeking to implement eco-friendly projects. The curriculum provides a comprehensive, step-by-step walkthrough of the entire process. Key learning areas include site assessment, the installation of structural frames and pots, the setup of automated drip irrigation and nutrient delivery systems, and the selection of suitable native plants. Furthermore, the course details long-term maintenance practices, covering pest control, plant health monitoring, and replacement strategies. Upon completion, learners will possess the necessary skills to confidently plan, execute, and maintain a thriving vertical garden, contributing to healthier and more vibrant urban landscapes.

title: Basics on Capital Procurement in Defence
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the fundamentals of capital procurement in the Indian defence landscape, a critical function for maintaining national security and promoting strategic self-reliance. The program is meticulously designed to demystify the complex rules and policies governing defence acquisitions, with a primary focus on the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020. Participants will gain a clear understanding of the procedural framework, from the initial planning stages to contract management and final acquisition. Key learning areas include the various procurement categories under DAP 2020, the emphasis on 'Make in India' and 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat', and the roles of different government bodies in the acquisition process. Upon completion, government officials will be better equipped to interpret and apply the procurement guidelines, ensure regulatory compliance, and contribute effectively to the transparent and efficient modernization of India's defence capabilities. This course is essential for anyone involved in or new to the defence financial management and procurement ecosystem.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Batteries on the Go: Powering Life from Land to Sea
desc: Dive into the world of portable energy with this detailed course on battery technology and its critical role in modern systems. The program begins with the fundamental concepts of energy storage, explaining how batteries convert chemical energy into electrical power. You will learn to distinguish between different battery chemistries, such as lead-acid and lithium-ion, and understand their respective advantages and applications. The course then expands to cover the ecosystem of power management, detailing the functions of inverters for AC/DC conversion, UPS for uninterrupted power, and SMPS for efficient power regulation in electronic devices. A key focus of this course is the application of battery technology in the demanding maritime environment. Learners will gain specialized knowledge on shipboard battery management, including charging procedures, maintenance routines, and the critical role of batteries in emergency systems. The curriculum emphasizes safety, covering hazard identification, risk mitigation, and compliance with international regulations like the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) convention, preparing professionals for safe and efficient operations at sea.

title: Battery Technology
desc: In an era driven by portable electronics and the shift towards sustainable energy, understanding battery technology is more crucial than ever. This course serves as a foundational guide to the world of batteries, designed for professionals seeking to grasp the core concepts. The curriculum begins by explaining the basic structure and types of batteries, providing context with a look at the history and evolution of lithium-ion cells. Participants will learn to evaluate the critical factors that guide the selection of a battery for a specific application, from consumer devices to electric vehicles. Furthermore, the course offers a forward-looking perspective by summarizing the most promising emerging battery technologies and discussing the latest developments in the field. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the essential knowledge to understand and discuss the pivotal role of batteries in modern industry and technological advancement.

title: Beginner Course for GeM Buyer
desc: This comprehensive beginner's course is designed to familiarize government officials with the operational aspects of the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal from a buyer's perspective. The course addresses the critical need for transparency, efficiency, and speed in public procurement by leveraging a unified digital platform. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of the primary and secondary user registration process, profile management, and understanding different user roles. Participants will learn the step-by-step procedures for various procurement methods, including Direct Purchase for low-value goods, L1 Purchase based on the lowest price, and the more formal processes of Bid and Reverse Auction (RA) creation. The course also covers crucial post-procurement activities such as technical evaluation, awarding contracts, and utilizing support features like the GeMmy Chatbot. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in executing fundamental procurement tasks on GeM, ensuring compliance and maximizing value for public expenditure.

title: Behavior Architecture - Understanding Human Behavior
desc: Dive into the complexities of human behavior and discover why conventional approaches to understanding and influencing it are yielding a 90% failure rate in many domains. This course, 'Behavioral Architecture,' moves beyond outdated models to provide a paradigm-shifting framework based on modern neuroscience, behavioral economics, and cognitive science. You will explore the critical 'awareness-action gap' and learn why simply providing information is often insufficient to drive change. The curriculum dissects the core components of decision-making, including the dominance of non-conscious processing, the integral role of emotions in all decisions, the power of context, and the use of mental shortcuts or 'heuristics'. You will be introduced to innovative research techniques like 'EthnoLab' to uncover deep behavioral insights. This course is designed for public sector professionals, leaders, and policy-makers who need to design more effective programs, communications, and change management initiatives by grounding their strategies in a scientifically accurate understanding of how people think, feel, and act.

title: Behavioral Approaches for Maternal and Child Health
desc: This course provides a practical understanding of how behavioral and social science approaches improve maternal and child health outcomes. The first module lays the foundations of Social and Behavior Change, explaining why information alone rarely changes behavior and introducing a systems perspective in which individual, interpersonal, institutional, and policy factors shape health choices, alongside the role of social norms and evaluation. The second module turns to practice, showing how incentives, nudges designed using the EAST framework, and gamification translate behavioral insights into sustainable outcomes, each backed by monitoring and evaluation. Together, the modules equip public health professionals and policymakers to design culturally relevant, evidence-based strategies and foster resilient, people-centred health systems.
keywords: WHO six building blocks of health systems

title: Behavioral Based Safety Strategies for Industrial Environments
desc: The Behavioural Intervention Programme (BIP) provides a practical framework for enhancing workplace safety by addressing the human factors behind incidents. Grounded in Behaviour-Based Safety (BBS) principles, this course moves beyond simple compliance to build a proactive safety culture. Participants will explore why unsafe acts occur and how to correct them through structured observation and positive intervention. Key learning areas include applying established behavioural models like the Iceberg and Swiss Cheese models for incident analysis, mastering a five-step process for safety observations, and delivering effective feedback. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to not only identify at-risk behaviors but also to inspire a shared sense of ownership for safety among peers and teams, leading to a safer and more productive industrial environment.

title: Behavioral Biometrics
desc: Dive into the world of behavioral biometrics, an advanced cybersecurity measure that strengthens digital identity verification. This course explains how the technology moves beyond traditional authentication by continuously analyzing unique user behaviors like keystroke dynamics, mouse movements, and touchscreen interactions. You will learn about the core components, including User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and its pivotal role within a Zero Trust security architecture. The course explores real-world applications, demonstrating how behavioral biometrics can effectively combat sophisticated threats such as account takeovers and synthetic identity fraud in sectors like banking and digital governance. Furthermore, it addresses critical implementation aspects, including navigating privacy concerns, ensuring compliance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, and overcoming integration challenges. Upon completion, you will be equipped to assess the strategic value of behavioral biometrics and advocate for its adoption to build more secure and resilient digital ecosystems.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Behavioural Safety and Safety Culture in Defence Operations
desc: This course builds upon the fundamentals of behavioural safety by introducing advanced concepts that strengthen workplace safety culture in high-risk industrial and defence environments.
