The course covers Behaviour-Based Safety (BBS) observation and feedback systems, psychosocial risks and mental health, leadership engagement, human factors engineering and ergonomics, incident investigation and learning systems, contractor and visitor safety, and the use of digital technologies for behavioural safety. Thru practical workplace scenarios, interactive activities, case studies, and proven safety practices, learners develop the skills to identify unsafe behaviour, provide constructive feedback, foster psychological well-being, investigate incidents, improve workplace design, and leverage digital tools to enhance safety performance. This promotes continuous learning, proactive risk management, and a strong safety culture where every individual contributes to preventing workplace incidents.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Benefits and Rules Applicable During Transfer in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the benefits and entitlements available to railway employees during transfer. It covers key components such as joining time, retention of railway quarters, travel entitlements, transfer passes, and allowances applicable during relocation. The course explains the governing rules, eligibility conditions, calculation methods, and special provisions applicable to different categories of employees. It also includes reimbursement policies for personal effects and vehicle transportation, as well as extensions and exceptions under specific circumstances. Overall, the course enables learners to understand the administrative and financial procedures involved in transfers, ensuring smooth and well-informed transitions between postings.

title: Benefits of Cardiorespiratory endurance training
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of cardiorespiratory endurance training. It begins by defining the cardiorespiratory system and explaining its function in supplying oxygen and nutrients throughout the body. You will learn about key metrics for assessing fitness, including maximum oxygen uptake (VO2 max) and Metabolic Equivalents (METs), and the various tests used to measure them. The curriculum delves into the significant benefits of endurance training, from improving heart health and preventing diseases like diabetes and stroke to reducing stress and enhancing sleep quality. A core focus is on practical application, with detailed guidance on the FITT principle (Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type) to help you design an effective and safe workout plan. The course also includes live demonstrations of essential cardio exercises such as jumping jacks, high knees, burpees, and mountain climbers, complete with instructions on proper form, repetitions, and the importance of warm-up and cool-down periods. This program is designed to empower you with the knowledge and skills to improve your physical fitness and maintain long-term health.

title: Best Achievable Techniques in Dyes and Dye Intermediates
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the dye and dye intermediates manufacturing sector, balancing technical knowledge with crucial environmental considerations. The curriculum is structured to guide learners from foundational concepts to advanced sustainable practices. Initially, the course establishes the context by detailing the fundamentals of dyes, including their classification, nomenclature, and core manufacturing processes. It then delves into the significant environmental issues inherent in the industry, such as water pollution, waste generation, and gaseous emissions. The core of the course introduces learners to Best Achievable Techniques (BAT) and cleaner production strategies as effective tools for mitigating environmental impact. By examining the entire manufacturing lifecycle, participants will learn to identify areas for improvement and apply innovative, sustainable solutions. Ultimately, this course empowers professionals to foster environmentally responsible practices within the chemical industry, ensuring compliance and promoting long-term ecological health.

title: Best Available Techniques in Textile Industries
desc: Delve into the complexities of the textile industry and master the principles of sustainable manufacturing. This course begins by tracing the evolution of textile production, differentiating between natural, synthetic, and blended fibres. You will then explore key manufacturing stages, including spinning, weaving, dyeing, and printing, while critically examining the waste streams and pollution generated by each. The core of the course is dedicated to understanding and applying Best Available Techniques (BATs), a crucial framework for minimizing the industry's environmental footprint through enhanced resource management and pollution abatement. Participants will learn to assess the environmental impact of textile operations and navigate the relevant regulatory frameworks. Upon completion, you will be prepared to recommend and implement sustainable, compliant, and efficient production practices, contributing to a more responsible textile industry.

title: Best Practices around User Safety on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp
desc: In today's digital age, maintaining a safe and responsible online presence is crucial, especially for those in public life. This course delves into Meta's comprehensive framework for ensuring user safety on its platforms. You will explore the foundational Community Standards that govern content and behavior, with a detailed look at policies against bullying, harassment, and exploitation. The curriculum is designed to be highly practical, providing step-by-step instructions on how to use a suite of safety tools. You will learn to secure your accounts with features like Facebook Protect, control your privacy with 'Lock Your Profile' and 'Privacy Checkup', and manage unwanted interactions on Instagram using 'Hidden Words' and 'Limits'. The course also covers the functionalities for reporting harmful content and tracking your reports, empowering you to contribute to a safer online community. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to confidently navigate Meta's platforms, protect your digital identity, and effectively handle negative online experiences.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Best Practices for Connecting with Citizens
desc: In an increasingly digital world, leveraging social media is crucial for effective governance and citizen outreach. This course offers a comprehensive guide for public officials and social impact organizations on utilizing popular social media platforms to build and nurture online communities. It addresses the foundational need for account security, providing actionable steps to protect official pages and information from compromise. The curriculum delves into the art and science of content creation, exploring how to plan a content calendar and develop posts that engage, educate, and excite the audience. Learners will explore various formats, including live videos for real-time interaction, stories for timely updates, and groups for fostering dedicated communities. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to amplifying messages through advertising. It distinguishes between simple post boosting and more advanced campaign management, covering essential topics like ad policies, transparency requirements for social issues, and creative best practices for mobile-first audiences. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to manage their organization's social media presence strategically, enhance citizen engagement, and use paid tools to broaden their reach for public service announcements and campaigns.

title: Best Practices in Contemporary Nursing
desc: This course is designed to equip nursing professionals with advanced knowledge and an in-depth understanding of the evolving healthcare landscape in India. It begins by analyzing the framework of the Indian Nursing Education System and the critical importance of integrating nursing service with education to bridge the theory-practice gap. The curriculum then details specialized, high-impact roles, covering the curriculum, standards, and responsibilities for Nurse Practitioners in Midwifery (NPM), Critical Care (NPCC), and the vital functions of Community Health Officers (CHOs) in Health and Wellness Centres. Furthermore, the course establishes the professional practice standards for psychiatric mental health nursing to ensure quality and ethical care. A dedicated module on Nursing Informatics explores how technology and data analytics are transforming clinical practice, administration, and research.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: Best Practices in Health IT: National and Global Perspectives
desc: Healthcare systems are undergoing rapid transformation through advancements in Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) and digital health innovations. Traditionally, patient information was maintained in paper-based records, which often limited timely access to data, coordination of care, and overall efficiency in healthcare delivery. With the adoption of digital health technologies and Electronic Health Records (EHRs), healthcare organizations can now securely store, manage, retrieve, and share patient information more effectively. These technologies support improved clinical decision-making, enhance continuity and quality of care, streamline healthcare workflows, and reduce administrative burden.

title: Best Practices in Nursing
desc: This course is designed to equip nursing professionals with advanced knowledge and an in-depth understanding of the evolving healthcare landscape in India. It begins by analyzing the framework of the Indian Nursing Education System and the critical importance of integrating nursing service with education to bridge the theory-practice gap. The curriculum then details specialized, high-impact roles, covering the curriculum, standards, and responsibilities for Nurse Practitioners in Midwifery (NPM), Critical Care (NPCC), and the vital functions of Community Health Officers (CHOs) in Health and Wellness Centres. Furthermore, the course establishes the professional practice standards for psychiatric mental health nursing to ensure quality and ethical care. A dedicated module on Nursing Informatics explores how technology and data analytics are transforming clinical practice, administration, and research. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to apply these best practices, contribute to specialized healthcare services, and leverage technology to improve patient outcomes within the Indian public health system.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: Better Prompting Techniques for Beginners
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, mastering the art of communicating with artificial intelligence is a critical skill. This course, 'Effective Prompting Techniques for Artificial Intelligence,' is designed to equip learners with the fundamental principles of prompt engineering. You will learn why a well-crafted prompt is crucial for obtaining accurate and relevant responses from large language models. The curriculum delves into practical strategies for improving your AI interactions. Key learning areas include how to provide specific context to narrow the AI's focus, the power of using examples (zero-shot, single-shot, and few-shot learning), and the importance of clearly stating your desired outcome, tone, and format. You will also explore how to iteratively refine prompts based on initial AI outputs and understand common pitfalls, such as using negative instructions. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently craft superior prompts that unlock the full potential of generative AI tools, enabling you to produce higher-quality reports, communications, and analyses in your professional role.

title: Beyond Concurrence: A Guide to Practical Financial Advisory
desc: This course is designed to move Financial Advisers (FAs) beyond a traditional "concurrence mindset" to become strategic partners. The course focuses on empowering FAs to enable government departments to achieve their targets and outcomes while simultaneously safeguarding public funds. Delivered through an engaging panel discussion format, the course utilises three recurring characters to represent distinct viewpoints: a delivery-focused Programme Division representative, a cautious FA who strictly guards the rules, and a solution-oriented "Practical FA" mentor. Through authentic tension and resolution, the course explores a middle path that prioritises collaboration over strict concurrence and advisory partnerships over mere auditing.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Beyond Liquidation: Navigating Post-Insolvency Pathways under IBC 2016
desc: This course delves into the critical final stage of the corporate insolvency resolution process: liquidation as governed by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) 2016. It is designed for professionals who need to understand the legal and financial mechanics of what happens when a company cannot be revived. The curriculum systematically walks through the entire liquidation pathway, starting with the submission and verification of claims by various types of creditors. It then explains the process of asset monetization and the strict order of priority for distributing the proceeds, ensuring secured creditors, unsecured creditors, and shareholders are treated as per the law. By the end of this course, learners will be able to confidently navigate the procedural requirements of the IBC, understand the roles of all stakeholders involved, and recognize the legal finality of a company's dissolution. This knowledge is essential for ensuring transparent and orderly conclusions to insolvency proceedings.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Beyond Words: Mastering Listening and Nonverbal Communication
desc: In the public sector, communication extends far beyond words. This course, 'Mastering Empathetic Listening and Nonverbal Communication Skills', delves into the subtle yet powerful arts of active listening and interpreting non-verbal signals. It addresses why these skills are often the foundation of trust, influence, and successful leadership. Participants will explore key learning areas including the principles of active listening for building rapport, techniques to observe and respond to body language and facial expressions, and the role of emotional intelligence in navigating complex interpersonal dynamics. Learners will also discover strategies to manage and reduce conflict through improved communication. Ultimately, this course equips government officials to foster greater commitment and collaboration, strengthening their behavioural competencies and contributing to more effective governance.

title: Bharat Net
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the BharatNet project, a critical national infrastructure initiative designed to deliver broadband connectivity to rural and remote areas of India. Initially conceptualized as the National Optical Fiber Network (NOFN), the program aims to empower rural citizens by providing access to digital services in education, health, and finance. The curriculum is structured to walk learners through the project's evolution, detailing the distinct features, budget, and outcomes of Phase I and Phase II, as well as the strategy for the upcoming Phase III saturation. Participants will explore the diverse implementation models, including state-led, private sector partnerships, and PSU-led execution. The course also addresses significant operational aspects, such as network maintenance, the challenge of ensuring network uptime, and the innovative BharatNet Udyami program designed to accelerate last-mile connectivity and utilization. By the end of this course, learners will have a thorough understanding of BharatNet's architecture, its socio-economic impact, and its pivotal role in building a digitally inclusive India.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
desc: The introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) marks a significant shift in India's criminal justice system, moving from the long-standing Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC) to a more modern, victim-focused framework. This course is essential for all police personnel, as it provides a detailed examination of the new powers and procedures for criminal investigation. The curriculum is specifically tailored to the needs of law enforcement, concentrating on Sections 173 to 193 of the BNSS, which are fundamental to the daily responsibilities of an investigating officer. Learners will explore the key differences between the old CrPC and the new BNSS, understanding the legislative intent behind the changes. By the end of this course, officers will be able to confidently apply the updated legal standards to their investigative work, ensuring that all procedures are conducted with precision, legality, and a commitment to the new victim-centric principles of justice. This will enhance their operational effectiveness and ensure compliance with the updated legal landscape.

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita - Flipbook
desc: The introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) marks a significant shift in India's criminal justice system, moving away from the colonial-era Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC) towards a more victim-centric framework. This course is essential for all law enforcement personnel, as it provides a clear and simplified guide to the critical changes affecting police investigations. The content is specifically tailored to police officers to ensure they can confidently navigate the new legal landscape.Learners will delve into Sections 173 to 193 of the BNSS, which are foundational to the investigative process. The course breaks down the powers granted to the police, the revised procedural requirements, and the practical implications for day-to-day duties. By focusing on these key sections, the material equips officers with the necessary knowledge to conduct investigations that are not only compliant with the new law but also uphold the principles of justice and fairness. Upon completion, officers will be prepared to implement the revised processes, ensuring their actions align with the updated legal standards and contribute to a more effective and equitable justice system.

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023: From CrPC to BNSS
desc: This comprehensive module provides an in-depth study of the landmark legal reform introduced through the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, with particular emphasis on its comparison with the erstwhile Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973. The course examines the evolution of criminal procedural law in India and highlights the key changes introduced under the BNSS. Participants will explore revised definitions and provisions relating to arrest, bail, investigation, search and seizure, summons, warrants, and criminal trials. The module also examines the restructured framework of Criminal Courts and the powers and functions of police officers and Magistrates under the new law. A key focus of the course is the integration of technology and electronic communication, including the use of audio-video electronic means in investigation, judicial proceedings, and other procedural processes.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
desc: The introduction of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023 marks a pivotal moment in India's legal history, replacing the colonial-era Indian Penal Code (IPC). This course is essential for officials who need to understand and apply this new foundational law. It provides a detailed examination of the BNS, focusing on the substantive changes that impact criminal investigations and judicial proceedings. The curriculum is meticulously designed to bridge the gap between the old and new legal frameworks, ensuring a smooth transition for law enforcement personnel. Learners will explore the core principles and structure of the BNS, with a special emphasis on the sections that have been added, amended, or removed in comparison to the IPC. The course organizes offences based on their prescribed punishments, a practical approach that directly assists investigating officers in their day-to-day duties. Furthermore, it clarifies the critical link between the BNS and the procedural requirements of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS). Upon completion, participants will be equipped to confidently apply the new penal code, ensuring their investigative processes are compliant, just, and effective in the modern legal environment.

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS)
desc: The enactment of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023 marks a pivotal moment in the evolution of India's criminal justice system. This comprehensive course is designed to provide learners with a thorough understanding of this new legislation, which consolidates and amends the laws relating to criminal offences. It addresses the critical need for legal professionals, law enforcement agencies, and judicial officers to familiarise themselves with the substantial changes introduced by the BNS, replacing the colonial-era Indian Penal Code. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of newly defined offences such as organised crime and terrorism, and modernised provisions for crimes against women and children. The course explores the introduction of new forms of punishment like community service and revised sentencing guidelines. It also delves into gender-neutral language, the inclusion of electronic and digital records as evidence, and the decriminalisation of certain acts. Through a structured review of the Sanhita's chapters, learners will gain a clear perspective on how these changes impact legal practice, police investigation, and judicial proceedings. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply the provisions of the BNS 2023 in their professional roles, ensuring the effective and just implementation of India's modernised criminal law.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम भारत की आपराधिक न्याय प्रणाली में हुए ऐतिहासिक बदलावों की विस्तृत जानकारी प्रदान करता है। इसका उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों, विशेष रूप से कानून प्रवर्तन एजेंसियों के कर्मियों को, भारतीय दंड संहिता, 1860, दंड प्रक्रिया संहिता, 1973, और भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम, 1872 को प्रतिस्थापित करने वाले तीन नए कानूनों से परिचित कराना है। पाठ्यक्रम में इन कानूनों की आवश्यकता, उनके न्याय-केंद्रित दृष्टिकोण और पुराने दंडात्मक ढांचे से उनके अंतर को समझाया गया है। इसमें भारतीय न्याय संहिता के तहत मॉब लिंचिंग और संगठित अपराध जैसे नए अपराधों, भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता के तहत जांच, गिरफ्तारी, जीरो एफआईआर और अभियोजन में प्रक्रियात्मक सुधारों, और भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम के तहत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक व फोरेंसिक साक्ष्य की बढ़ी हुई भूमिका जैसे प्रमुख शिक्षण क्षेत्रों को शामिल किया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, पुलिस अधिकारी अपने दैनिक कार्यों में नए कानूनी ढांचे को प्रभावी ढंग से लागू करने, एफआईआर दर्ज करने से लेकर जांच पूरी करने तक में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे एक अधिक कुशल और जवाबदेह न्याय वितरण प्रणाली सुनिश्चित होगी।

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita : From Sedition to Nation-Building
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the legal evolution concerning offenses against the state in India, culminating in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). It begins by tracing the history of the sedition law under Section 124A of the Indian Penal Code, including its colonial origins and post-independence judicial interpretations. The core of the course focuses on the new legal framework established by Section 152 of the BNS, detailing offenses such as secession, armed rebellion, and subversive activities. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the evidentiary requirements, including mens rea and actus reus, necessary for prosecution under the new law. Specifically designed for law enforcement officers, this course serves as a practical guide for applying these provisions correctly, ensuring actions are aligned with constitutional principles while safeguarding national security. The program aims to build capacity for upholding India's sovereignty, unity, and integrity in both letter and spirit.

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam
desc: The introduction of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) represents a pivotal shift in India's legal landscape, modernizing the principles of evidence for the digital age. This course is meticulously designed for investigating officers and legal practitioners to navigate this new framework. It delves into the specific modifications to the old Indian Evidence Act and explains the newly incorporated sections of the BSA. Learners will explore the updated procedures for handling evidence, particularly electronic and digital records, which are now crucial in investigations. By the end of this course, participants will be able to confidently apply the BSA's provisions, ensuring that evidence collection is robust, legally compliant, and capable of withstanding judicial scrutiny, thereby strengthening the criminal justice process.

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023
desc: आपराधिक न्याय प्रणाली में हाल के सुधारों के साथ, भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम (बीएसए), 2023 को डिजिटल युग की चुनौतियों का सामना करने के लिए पेश किया गया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम कानून प्रवर्तन कर्मियों को इस नए कानून के महत्वपूर्ण पहलुओं से परिचित कराने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम 'दस्तावेज़' और 'साक्ष्य' की संशोधित परिभाषाओं पर प्रकाश डालता है, जिसमें अब इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रिकॉर्ड भी शामिल हैं। इसमें प्राथमिक और द्वितीयक इलेक्ट्रॉनिक साक्ष्य के बीच अंतर, उनकी कानूनी स्वीकार्यता और धारा 63 बीएसए के तहत आवश्यक नए प्रमाणन प्रक्रिया की विस्तृत जानकारी दी गई है। प्रतिभागी अपराध स्थल की वीडियोग्राफी करने, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरणों को जब्त करने, हैश वैल्यू की गणना करने और हिरासत की श्रृंखला (चेन ऑफ कस्टडी) बनाए रखने के लिए मानक संचालन प्रक्रियाओं (एसओपी) को सीखेंगे। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी न्यायालय में इलेक्ट्रॉनिक साक्ष्य की कानूनी वैधता और स्वीकार्यता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से सुसज्जित होंगे, जिससे जांच और अभियोजन की प्रभावशीलता बढ़ेगी।

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 vs Indian Evidence Act, 1872
desc: This in-depth course offers a detailed analysis of the transition from the Indian Evidence Act, 1872, to the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023. The curriculum is structured to provide a granular comparison of the two statutes, highlighting the rationale behind the legal reforms and their impact on the Indian justice system. Learners will delve into the key changes, focusing on the formal recognition and admissibility of electronic records, which modernizes the evidence-gathering process. The course covers new definitions for 'document', 'evidence', and 'confession', and examines their effect on trial procedures. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the updated rules concerning the burden of proof, presumptions of fact, and the examination of witnesses. By the end of this course, officials will be prepared to apply the new legal standards correctly in investigations, prosecutions, and judicial adjudications, ensuring compliance and upholding the principles of a fair trial.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: BIissful Post Retirement Life 2.0
desc: Embark on a journey to redefine your post-retirement years with this comprehensive course on planning for a successful 'Life 2.0'. This program addresses the critical need for proactive planning to ensure a smooth and meaningful transition from professional life. You will explore key concepts and practical frameworks designed to help you understand your personal aspirations and capabilities. The course delves into powerful self-assessment tools, including detailed guidance on conducting a personal SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) analysis and discovering your Ikigai, or reason for being. Through real-world case studies and structured exercises, you will learn to set a new life mission, develop engaging routines, and overcome the challenges of change. By the end of this course, you will have a clear, actionable plan to embrace retirement not as an end, but as the beginning of a new, vibrant chapter filled with purpose and well-being.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Bikes of Bijnor: A waste to wealth public bike sharing programme
desc: The "Bikes of Bijnor" ride-sharing program, initiated by Mr. Vikramaditya Singh Malik, repurposed bicycles abandoned by migrant workers during the COVID-19 pandemic, creating a socially and environmentally beneficial initiative through collaboration between the civil service and municipal administration.

title: Bill Passing _Imprest_Accounts _Audit Inspection
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of fundamental accounting and financial management processes crucial for public sector operations. Participants will delve into the step-by-step procedures for bill passing, from verification to payment authorization, ensuring compliance with financial regulations. The module on imprest accounts covers the principles of managing petty cash, including disbursement, record-keeping, and reconciliation. Furthermore, the course explains the purpose and methodology of audit inspections, focusing on how they serve as a critical tool for verifying financial accuracy, preventing irregularities, and ensuring accountability. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these core financial practices in their day-to-day roles, contributing to efficient and transparent financial administration within their departments.

title: Billing and Customer Care System (BCCS)
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Billing and Customer Care System (BCCS), a critical component of modern telecommunications operations. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the intricate processes that translate network usage into customer revenue. The program begins with an introduction to the BCCS architecture, distinguishing between core and non-core applications. You will delve into the mediation system, learning how it collects, validates, and distributes Call Detail Records (CDRs) from various network elements. The course then proceeds to the rating and billing engines, explaining how usage events are processed, rated according to customer plans, and compiled into invoices. A dedicated module explores the complexities of national and international roaming, including the standards like TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) that enable inter-operator billing. Upon completion, learners will have a thorough understanding of the BCCS data flow and its importance in ensuring accurate billing, effective customer care, and revenue assurance for telecom operators.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: BIM Simplified: A Comprehensive Overview
desc: In the modern construction landscape, Building Information Modeling (BIM) is a critical process for driving innovation and efficiency. This course offers a detailed exploration of BIM, explaining its role in addressing persistent industry challenges like project delays, cost overruns, and poor coordination. You will learn what BIM is, not as a single software, but as an integrated process that creates a digital twin of a physical structure, embedding intelligent data within a 3D model. The course breaks down the BIM lifecycle into distinct phases: planning, design, construction, and operations. It details the specific applications and benefits at each stage, such as early clash detection, 4D/5D simulations for scheduling and cost estimation, and streamlined facility management. By comparing BIM with traditional Computer-Aided Design (CAD), you will gain a clear perspective on why BIM is considered a superior approach for managing complex construction projects. Upon completion, you will be equipped to understand and participate in BIM-driven projects, contributing to better-built environments.

title: Bima DEeP (Prarambh)
desc: This foundational course is designed to provide a detailed understanding of the life insurance products available through the Indian postal system. It begins by differentiating between Postal Life Insurance (PLI), aimed at government and public sector employees, and Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI), designed for rural residents. The content systematically explains the eligibility requirements for individuals, professionals, and various employee groups, ensuring learners can correctly identify potential policyholders.The curriculum delves into the specifics of various insurance plans such as Santosh (Endowment Assurance), Suraksha (Whole Life Assurance), Sumangal (Money-Back Plan), and specialized policies like Yugal Suraksha (Joint Life) and the Children Policy. For each plan, the course details the minimum and maximum sum assured, age limits, loan and surrender facilities, and bonus rates. Through practical examples and clear explanations, learners will grasp the rules governing these financial instruments. The primary objective is to empower postal employees to confidently market these schemes, enhance business for the department, and extend financial security to a wider population.

title: BIMA DEeP (Praveenta - 3)
desc: This detailed training program is designed for Department of Posts employees to master the advanced operational aspects of Postal Life Insurance (PLI) and Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI). The course establishes a strong foundation by explaining the importance of these insurance schemes in the context of public financial services. Key learning areas include a thorough examination of medical and non-medical policy requirements, the complete lifecycle of a policy loan from application to forcible surrender, and the precise methods for calculating surrender and paid-up values. Furthermore, the curriculum delves into the nuances of reviving lapsed policies, converting policy types, and understanding the rights and benefits of policyholders during grace and remission periods. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these complex rules, handling customer processes with accuracy, and ensuring compliance with the Citizen's Charter, thereby enhancing service delivery and customer satisfaction.

title: BIMA DEeP (Praveenta 2)
desc: This course, ""Enhancing Sales Force Effectiveness for PLI and RPLI,"" is designed to empower the sales personnel of the Department of Posts with the knowledge and skills required to excel in the competitive insurance market. The program delves into the critical aspects of the sales lifecycle, providing a structured approach to growing the Postal Life Insurance (PLI) and Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI) business. It addresses the importance of a positive sales mindset and corrects common negative perceptions about selling, reframing it as a value-driven service for citizens. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the PLI/RPLI sales force hierarchy, covering the roles and responsibilities of Development Officers, Field Officers, and Direct Agents. The course offers practical guidance on prospecting customers, categorizing them into cold, warm, and hot leads, and applying the 'Customer Graduation System' to build trust and long-term relationships. Furthermore, it provides robust techniques for handling common customer objections related to price, time, and competition, and strategies for successfully closing sales. Participants will also gain a thorough understanding of the incentive and commission structures, which are crucial for motivation and performance management. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently approach potential clients, effectively communicate the value of PLI/RPLI products, and systematically build a sustainable sales pipeline, thereby contributing significantly to the financial inclusion goals of the Department of Posts.

title: Bima DEeP - Dakshata - 1
desc: This course offers detailed, step-by-step training on the McCamish application, a key component of the Core Insurance Solution (CIS) for India Post. It is designed for counter and CPC staff to master the digital platform for PLI and RPLI services. The curriculum begins with an overview of the system's role in the department's IT modernization, explaining its benefits like improved efficiency, better customer service, and enhanced regulatory compliance. Learners will be guided through the complete lifecycle of an insurance policy within the McCamish system. Key learning areas include new business proposal indexing, data entry procedures, the quality checking process performed by CPC supervisors, and the final approval workflow. The course also covers various methods of premium collection, including online payments via the customer portal and Darpan devices, processing service requests, and the generation and dispatch of policy bonds. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in using the McCamish application to manage all core PLI and RPLI operations, ensuring standardized and efficient service delivery.

title: BIMA DEeP - Praveenta-1
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the standard operating procedures for managing and settling death claims under the Postal Life Insurance (PLI) and Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI) schemes. It is designed to equip postal officials with the knowledge to handle claims efficiently and with sensitivity. The curriculum covers the entire claim lifecycle, starting from the initial intimation and documentation to the final disbursement or rejection. Key learning areas include the classification of death claims (early vs. normal), the specific documentation required for each type (including various Annexures), and the procedural steps for verification, inquiry, and approval. The course also addresses complex scenarios such as policies without nomination, claims involving minors, mortgaged policies, and cases of suicide or murder, referencing relevant sections of the Insurance Act, 1938. Participants will learn about the designated authorities for claim approval based on the sum assured, the rules for succession certificates, and the official timelines for settlement as per the Citizen Charter. By completing this course, officials will be able to ensure timely, accurate, and compassionate settlement of death claims, upholding the service standards of the Department of Posts.

title: BIMA DEep DAKSHTA - II
desc: This comprehensive training program, 'Advanced Administration of Postal Life Insurance and Rural Postal Life Insurance', is tailored for supervisors and administrative personnel seeking to master the complexities of PLI and RPLI operations. The course offers a detailed exploration of the rules and procedures that are critical for ensuring the smooth functioning of postal insurance services. It addresses the importance of timely and accurate claim settlement as a cornerstone of customer trust and business growth, referencing the Citizen Charter and departmental SOPs.Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of the death claim settlement process. This covers the distinction between claims arising within three years of policy inception (early death claims) and those arising later, detailing the specific inquiry and documentation requirements for each. The course provides clear guidance on handling sensitive cases involving suicide, murder, or accidents, and clarifies the procedures for policies without nomination or where legal heirs are involved. It also explains the rules concerning succession certificates and the financial limits for different approving authorities, from Postmasters to Regional Directors.Furthermore, learners will gain proficiency in using the McCamish application, the core IT system for insurance operations. The training covers the end-to-end digital workflow, including proposal indexing, data entry, quality checking by supervisors, and the final approval process. The course also covers the management of the PLI/RPLI sales force, detailing the roles of Development Officers and agents, their incentive structures, and licensing requirements. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently manage all administrative aspects of PLI/RPLI, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and excellent service delivery to policyholders.

title: Bima DEeP-7 (Parangat)
desc: This advanced course is designed to transform learners into experts in managing Postal Life Insurance (PLI) and Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI). It offers a thorough exploration of India Post's life insurance services, which are crucial for providing financial security to citizens across urban and rural areas. The curriculum is structured to build a deep, practical knowledge base for postal employees working at counters and Central Processing Centers (CPCs).The key learning areas cover the full spectrum of PLI/RPLI products, including detailed modules on plans such as Santosh (Endowment Assurance), Suraksha (Whole Life Assurance), and specialized offerings like the Children Policy. Participants will learn the intricacies of policy processing, from initial proposal indexing and data entry to quality checks and final approval within the McCamish IT ecosystem. Furthermore, the course provides extensive guidance on handling all types of policy servicing requests, including loans, surrenders, revivals, and the settlement of maturity and death claims, supported by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the Core Insurance Solution (CIS) to manage policies, ensuring regulatory compliance and delivering excellent customer service. This course will equip them with the necessary skills to confidently address policyholder queries and manage all operational aspects of postal insurance.

title: Bio energy
desc: Delve into the world of bioenergy and understand its pivotal role in shaping India's sustainable energy future. This course begins by analyzing India's energy sector, highlighting the heavy reliance on imported fossil fuels and presenting bioenergy as a viable, renewable alternative. You will explore the fundamental processes of biomass creation, such as photosynthesis and chemosynthesis, and learn to identify various sources of biomass, from crop waste to microalgae. The curriculum then details the key conversion technologies, including thermochemical methods like pyrolysis and gasification, and biological processes like fermentation, explaining how raw biomass is transformed into solid, liquid, and gaseous fuels. The course also covers the material properties and selection criteria for energy crops to ensure efficiency. Finally, it offers a glimpse into the future with emerging innovations, demonstrating how bio-waste can be converted into advanced materials for energy storage and even used to generate electricity directly, paving the way for a circular energy economy.

title: BIO-MEDICAL WASTE MANAGEMENT IN PRIMARY HEALTH CARE CENTERS
desc: This course offers essential training on the systematic management of biomedical waste generated in Primary Health Care Centers. It begins by defining biomedical waste and outlining the significant health and environmental risks associated with improper disposal, including the spread of infectious diseases like HIV and Hepatitis. The curriculum is structured around the Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016, providing a detailed walkthrough of the mandatory four-color coding system for waste segregation (Yellow, Red, White, Blue). Participants will learn the correct procedures for collection, storage, transportation, treatment, and final disposal of different waste categories, including sharps, plastics, and contaminated materials. The course also covers specific protocols for handling COVID-19 and immunization waste, the importance of barcoding for tracking, and the operational standards for equipment like autoclaves. By completing this course, healthcare professionals will be equipped to implement compliant and environmentally sound waste management practices, ensuring the safety of staff, patients, and the community.

title: Biodegradable Waste Management
desc: This introductory course is designed to equip public service professionals with the essential knowledge of biodegradable waste management. It addresses the critical need for sustainable waste solutions in the context of national initiatives like the Swachh Bharat Mission. The curriculum delves into the definition and classification of biodegradable waste, emphasizing its potential as a resource rather than refuse. Key learning areas include an overview of the Solid Waste Management (SWM) Rules, 2016, with a focus on organic waste, practical methods for waste processing like composting and biogas production, and the importance of community engagement for successful implementation. Upon completion, learners will be able to identify appropriate waste management techniques for their communities and contribute to building cleaner, greener, and more resource-efficient public spaces.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Biodegradable Waste Management
desc: This introductory course is designed to equip public service professionals with the essential knowledge of biodegradable waste management. It addresses the critical need for sustainable waste solutions in the context of national initiatives like the Swachh Bharat Mission. The curriculum delves into the definition and classification of biodegradable waste, emphasizing its potential as a resource rather than refuse. Key learning areas include an overview of the Solid Waste Management (SWM) Rules, 2016, with a focus on organic waste, practical methods for waste processing like composting and biogas production, and the importance of community engagement for successful implementation. Upon completion, learners will be able to identify appropriate waste management techniques for their communities and contribute to building cleaner, greener, and more resource-efficient public spaces.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Biodiversity Conservation
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed exploration of biodiversity conservation, tailored for public sector professionals and individuals new to the environmental field. It begins by defining biodiversity and its various levels, establishing a strong conceptual base. The curriculum then navigates through India's specific ecological landscape, highlighting its status as a mega-diverse nation, its distinct biogeographic regions, and the significance of endemism in areas like the Western Ghats and Himalayas. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the critical threats that jeopardize this natural wealth. Learners will gain a deep understanding of challenges like habitat degradation, over-exploitation, pollution, and the severe impact of invasive alien species. The course culminates in a thorough review of conservation methodologies. It covers both age-old traditional practices, such as sacred groves, and modern scientific approaches like national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, and ex-situ methods like seed banks and cryopreservation. Participants will also become familiar with the key legislative and policy instruments, including Project Tiger, the Wildlife Protection Act, and international agreements like the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD), equipping them with the knowledge to support and contribute to India's conservation efforts.
org: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education

title: Biofuels
desc: This course offers a foundational overview of biofuels, a rapidly advancing field within renewable energy. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the transition towards sustainable energy sources. The curriculum begins by differentiating biofuels from fossil fuels and classifying them into various generations. Learners will explore key biofuels utilized in India, such as ethanol, biodiesel, and biogas, along with their practical applications and benefits. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the technical aspects of biofuel production, covering both thermochemical and biochemical conversion processes. Furthermore, the course provides a detailed examination of India’s strategic policy landscape, including the National Policy on Biofuels, its objectives, and recent amendments. Participants will also learn about key government initiatives like SATAT and GOBARdhan. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the role of biofuels in achieving energy security, environmental sustainability, and economic growth, making them valuable contributors to India's clean energy goals.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Biological Emergencies-Disaster Response Training
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world, the threat of biological emergencies, whether natural or man-made, requires a prepared and knowledgeable response force. This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of biological disaster management, tailored for public officials, first responders, and volunteers. It addresses the critical importance of readiness and explains the nature of various biological threats, such as those stemming from diarrheal, respiratory, and mosquito-borne diseases. Participants will delve into the practical aspects of disaster preparedness, learning to identify and implement key precautionary measures to mitigate risks and protect communities. The course details the essential components of a biological disaster emergency kit, ensuring learners are equipped with the right tools. Furthermore, it highlights the significant contributions and responsibilities of volunteers, explaining how they can effectively integrate into official response efforts. Upon completion, learners will be able to define and classify biological disasters, describe necessary safety protocols, and understand their potential role in a coordinated response, thereby strengthening national resilience against biological threats.

title: Biological Treatment of Wastewater
desc: Effective wastewater management is a critical component of sustainable urban development and environmental stewardship. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the biological processes that form the core of modern wastewater treatment. It begins by establishing the context of wastewater generation and its environmental impact, highlighting the importance of treatment. Key learning areas include the characterization of domestic sewage, the vital role of microbial metabolism in breaking down pollutants, and the fundamental differences between aerobic and anaerobic treatment systems. The curriculum delves into the design and operational principles of widely-used technologies, including trickling filters, the Activated Sludge Process (ASP), and the Upflow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (UASB) reactor. Furthermore, the course covers the crucial topic of sludge processing and management. Upon completion, learners will be able to critically analyze different treatment technologies and understand the microbial mechanisms that underpin effective wastewater purification and reuse.
org: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani)

title: Biomedical Waste Handling and Disposal
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of Bio-Medical Waste Management (BMWM), designed to equip healthcare professionals and other stakeholders with the necessary knowledge for responsible waste handling. The curriculum delves into the legal framework governing BMW, providing clarity on definitions and compliance requirements. Key learning areas include the classification of waste into hazardous and non-hazardous categories, the principles of segregation at the point of generation, and the specific do's and don'ts of waste handling to prevent injury and contamination. By exploring the environmental and public health impacts of improper disposal, the course underscores the urgency of adopting best practices. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to implement effective and safe BMWM strategies in their professional roles, contributing to a safer healthcare ecosystem and a cleaner environment.

title: Biosphere Reserves and Integrated Conservation Management
desc: Biosphere Reserves are internationally recognized sites under UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme, designed to promote innovative approaches for reconciling biodiversity conservation with sustainable use of natural resources. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the concept, structure, and significance of Biosphere Reserves in India and globally. Participants will learn about the three-zone system—Core, Buffer, and Transition Zones—which balances strict ecosystem protection with sustainable human activities. The course also covers the criteria and processes for establishing Biosphere Reserves, their role in biodiversity conservation, and the importance of community participation in their management. Special emphasis is placed on monitoring ecological, social, and economic impacts, along with understanding management challenges such as habitat degradation, human–wildlife interactions, and climate change.

title: Blockchain Basics
desc: Embark on a journey to understand one of today's most disruptive emerging technologies: blockchain. This introductory course is designed for beginners with no prior experience, breaking down complex concepts into understandable modules. You will start by learning the fundamental problem blockchain solves—establishing trust and security in digital record-keeping. The curriculum then dives into the technical pillars of blockchain, clearly differentiating between encryption and one-way hashing, and demonstrating how hashing ensures data integrity. Through practical examples, you will see how transactions are structured, hashed, and linked together to form a secure and immutable chain. The course also explores key real-world applications, including cryptocurrencies, Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs), supply chain management, and secure voting systems.

title: Blockchain Concepts
desc: This course offers a structured and comprehensive introduction to the world of blockchain technology. It begins by establishing the context of why blockchain is a significant innovation, explaining its core principles of decentralization, immutability, and transparency. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of blockchain's architecture, covering distributed ledgers, cryptographic hashing, and various consensus mechanisms. The course also examines the practical applications of blockchain, showcasing how it is revolutionizing industries like finance with decentralized finance (DeFi), improving traceability in supply chains, and securing records in healthcare and public administration. Learners will explore the distinctions between public, private, and consortium blockchains and their specific use cases. Furthermore, the course addresses critical challenges such as scalability, security vulnerabilities, and the evolving regulatory landscape. It concludes by looking at emerging trends like Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) and smart contracts, empowering learners to understand and evaluate the potential of blockchain in their professional environment.

title: Blockchain for Secure and Trusted Records
desc: Welcome to the introductory course on Blockchain for Secure and Trusted Records. This program is designed to demystify blockchain technology and showcase its transformative potential for the public sector. You will begin by learning the essential concepts that underpin blockchain, such as distributed ledgers, cryptographic hashing, and consensus mechanisms. The course delves into the mechanics of blockchain, explaining how transactions are created, verified, and added to the chain in blocks, ensuring a high degree of security and immutability. A key focus is on the practical implications for governance, such as the elimination of intermediaries, reduction of fraud, and enhancement of public trust in digital records. Through a series of modules, you will explore various use cases and learn to apply blockchain frameworks to areas of interest within your department or ministry. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to assess the viability of blockchain solutions for improving service delivery and creating more secure and transparent systems of record-keeping.

title: Board Meetings
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the procedures and legal requirements for board meetings within the Indian corporate landscape. It is designed for professionals who need to understand the intricacies of corporate governance to ensure full compliance and operational excellence. The content delves into the Companies Act, 2013, its corresponding Rules, and the mandatory Secretarial Standards (SS-1) that govern board proceedings. Key learning areas include the correct procedures for convening meetings, defining quorum, managing adjournments, and the specific provisions for participation via video conferencing. The course also clarifies the distinct roles and responsibilities of Independent Directors and 'interested directors.' Furthermore, it addresses the additional compliance layer mandated by SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) for listed companies. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in planning, conducting, and documenting board meetings, ensuring their organization upholds the highest standards of governance, transparency, and regulatory adherence.

title: Body weight Management and Exercises
desc: Dive into the essentials of health and fitness with this foundational course on body weight management and exercise. Designed for all public servants, this program addresses the growing importance of maintaining a healthy lifestyle amidst busy work schedules. The course is structured into four key modules. You will begin by learning to define and classify ideal body weight using metrics like Body Mass Index (BMI), understanding its relevance and limitations. The second module examines the common causes of being overweight, from sedentary lifestyles to dietary habits. The third module presents a comparative analysis of various weight management methods, emphasizing the benefits of a balanced approach combining diet and exercise for sustainable results. Finally, the course details the crucial role of different exercises—including cardio, strength training, and High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)—in achieving fitness goals. Upon completion, you will be equipped to take control of your health, prevent lifestyle-related diseases, and improve your overall physical and mental well-being.

title: Boiler Steam And Water Circulation System
desc: This introductory course delves into the essential workings of boiler steam and water circulation systems. It is specifically designed for engineers, technicians, and operational staff in the power generation industry. The course begins by outlining the context of boilers in thermal power plants and their importance for converting thermal energy into electrical power. Key learning areas include the different types of circulation, such as natural and forced, and the critical components involved, including the steam drum, water walls, risers, and downcomers. Learners will understand how these elements work in concert to ensure a continuous and safe flow of steam to the turbine. Upon completion, participants will be able to describe the entire steam and water cycle within a boiler, recognize the factors affecting its efficiency, and appreciate the safety protocols associated with high-pressure systems, enabling them to contribute more effectively to plant operations and maintenance.

title: Book Now Pay Later New Accounting Process
desc: As 'Book Now Pay Later' (BNPL) services become more prevalent, mastering the associated accounting procedures is crucial for financial accuracy and compliance. This course is designed to equip finance and accounting professionals with the specific skills needed to manage BNPL transactions within the SAP environment. The curriculum provides in-depth, practical training on key SAP T-Codes: F-02 for recording customer payments, F-04 for clearing accounts, and FBL5N for analyzing customer line item details and balances. Participants will learn the importance of using correct document types, customer details, and Profit Centers to ensure every transaction is tracked accurately from initiation to settlement. The course emphasizes hands-on application, guiding learners through the financial reconciliation process while strictly following DOC guidelines. Upon completion, you will be proficient in executing the BNPL accounting cycle, ensuring data integrity, supporting financial audits, and contributing to transparent and compliant financial operations within your organization.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Booking of International Mail
desc: In an increasingly connected world, the role of India Post in facilitating international communication and commerce is vital. This course offers an in-depth look at the procedures for booking and dispatching international mail, ensuring that postal employees can provide efficient, secure, and rule-compliant services. It emphasizes the importance of adhering to both domestic and international postal regulations to avoid penalties and ensure timely delivery. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of various international mail services such as Registered Letters, Air Parcels, EMS, and ITPS. The curriculum provides extensive guidance on customs documentation, including the correct usage of CN22, CN23, and Postal Bill of Export (PBE) forms for commercial shipments. It also covers KYC norms, standard addressing protocols, and specific packaging requirements for different types of items. Through practical demonstrations, learners will see how to execute these tasks using the Point of Sale (POS) software. This course is essential for all postal employees, especially Counter Postal Assistants, to enhance their operational skills, ensure customer satisfaction, and maintain the integrity of the international postal network.

title: Booking of Railway Coaches, Trains and Saloons on Full Tariff Rate
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the procedures for booking special trains, coaches, and saloons on Full Tariff Rate (FTR) with Indian Railways. It is designed for personnel involved in commercial and operational roles who need to manage specialized booking requests. The curriculum systematically covers the entire FTR lifecycle, starting with an introduction to the FTR concept and the pivotal role of IRCTC as the single-window booking agency. You will learn the detailed registration process, including advance booking timelines and the management of a Revolving Security Deposit. The course thoroughly explains the financial aspects, detailing how to compute fares, service charges, empty haulage charges, detention fees, and applicable taxes like GST. Furthermore, it clarifies the guidelines for cancellation, refunds, and the necessary documentation for post-tour settlements. By completing this course, you will be equipped to handle FTR bookings efficiently, ensuring adherence to railway policies and providing seamless service coordination.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Boost your productivity with Microsoft Copilot
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Microsoft Copilot, the artificial intelligence companion designed to revolutionize workplace productivity. In an era of digital transformation, mastering AI tools is crucial for public sector professionals to enhance efficiency and service delivery. This program will guide learners through the core functionalities of Copilot, demonstrating how it integrates seamlessly with everyday applications to automate repetitive tasks, generate creative content, and provide intelligent suggestions. Participants will explore practical use cases, such as summarizing documents, drafting emails, and analyzing information within the Microsoft ecosystem. The course will specifically cover how to use Copilot in Microsoft Edge to improve browsing and research. By the end of this training, learners will be equipped to apply Copilot's features to simplify complex tasks, unlock new levels of creativity, and ultimately boost their professional effectiveness, contributing to a more agile and productive work environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Borehole Planning Core Logging and Sampling in Base Metal Exploration
desc: This specialized training program is designed for professionals in the geological and mining sectors, offering in-depth knowledge on borehole planning, core logging, and sampling. The course begins by establishing the context of these activities within the advanced stages of mineral exploration, highlighting their importance in targeting hidden ore bodies. Key learning areas include understanding the parameters for borehole planning, interpreting geological and geophysical data, and the practicalities of drilling. The curriculum then transitions to the meticulous processes of core logging, where participants will learn to identify lithology, structural features, and mineralization. It also covers systematic sampling techniques, core recovery analysis, and data recording for assessing metal content. Learners will understand how to manage common issues like borehole deviation and will be equipped to prepare comprehensive geological sections. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these technical skills to effectively plan and execute mineral exploration projects, contributing to the accurate delineation and evaluation of mineral resources.

title: Bridges and Tunnels in Indian Railways
desc: Indian Railways forms the backbone of the nation's transportation system, but its expansion is often hindered by formidable geographical obstacles like rivers, mountains, and valleys. This course delves into the engineering marvels of bridges and tunnels that make this vast network possible. You will explore the context of why these structures are indispensable for national connectivity and economic development. The curriculum covers key learning areas, including the classification of bridges (such as beam, arch, and cable-stayed) and tunnels (single/double track, cut-and-cover). It examines modern construction technologies like Tunnel Boring Machines (TBMs) and discusses the critical processes of safety inspection, numerical condition rating, and maintenance planning. Upon completion, learners will be able to appreciate the complexities of railway infrastructure projects and understand their contribution to the safety, efficiency, and modernization of Indian Railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Bridging Innovation and Security
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation within governance, securing digital infrastructure is paramount. This course, presented as an insightful podcast, navigates the complex intersection of innovation and security. It begins by establishing the context for why security can no longer be an afterthought but must be a core design principle. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the CIA triad, the practical application of 'Security by Design' and 'Privacy by Design', and a structured approach to threat modeling by defining subjects, objects, and policies. The discussion further explores the security implications of modern technologies like Cloud, IoT, AI, and blockchain. Learners will gain a strategic understanding of how to balance agility with robust security, assess risks from emerging threats, and appreciate the critical need for a skilled cybersecurity workforce. The course equips decision-makers with the conceptual tools to build resilient, secure, and future-ready digital systems for public service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Bridging the Gap During Disasters: Media Messaging and Mitigation
desc: This course examines the critical role of clear, timely, and empathetic communication in disaster management. It highlights how effective messaging—through both traditional and digital media—can reduce panic, guide public action, counter misinformation, and ultimately save lives. Learners will explore the disaster management cycle and understand how strategic communication fosters trust, supports coordinated response efforts, and strengthens community resilience during emergencies and crises.
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM
keywords: Public Information Systems in Disaster Management

title: Broad Guidelines to Investigate Unnatural Death Cases
desc: This course offers a structured and practical framework for police officers investigating cases of unnatural death. It is designed to instill a high degree of professionalism and precision, ensuring that every case is handled with the diligence it deserves, regardless of initial appearances. The curriculum delves into the essential first steps at a crime scene, including its preservation, the proper recording of a dying declaration, and the meticulous collection of evidence through photography and videography. Learners will explore the procedural nuances of conducting an inquest, coordinating with forensic surgeons for post-mortem examinations, and ensuring all documentation is legally compliant. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the human aspect of investigation, guiding officers on how to interact with grieving families with empathy and transparency. By mastering these guidelines, officers will be better equipped to conduct unbiased, systematic investigations that withstand legal scrutiny, build public trust, and ultimately deliver justice for the victims and their families.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Broadsheet Preparation and Maintenance in Postal Accounting
desc: In the realm of public financial management, maintaining accurate and transparent records is paramount. This course delves into the essential practice of preparing and maintaining broadsheets, a cornerstone of financial accountability within Postal Accounts. It addresses the critical need for precision in government accounting to ensure compliance and prevent financial discrepancies. By focusing on this key procedural skill, the course helps officials uphold the integrity of public financial systems and contribute to good governance. Key learning areas include a comprehensive overview of the structure, formats, and purpose of various broadsheets. The curriculum places special emphasis on managing suspense and advance accounts, detailing the use of standard formats like ATM-129 and MSO(T)-86/87. Learners will be guided through reconciliation procedures for transactions involving Railways, Defence, and RBI Suspense, among others. The course also covers the alignment of broadsheet figures with ledger entries, the application of correct transfer entries, and the importance of monthly compliance. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in managing broadsheets, ensuring their records are accurate, compliant, and audit-ready. This will enable them to enhance financial transparency and contribute effectively to the robust financial management of their department.

title: BS-VI Vehicle Training (भारत स्टेज-6 वाहन प्रशिक्षण)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम भारत स्टेज VI (BS-VI) वाहन प्रौद्योगिकी की व्यापक समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। भारत में बढ़ते वायु प्रदूषण के संदर्भ में, यह पाठ्यक्रम BS-VI मानकों के महत्व और उनके कार्यान्वयन की आवश्यकता पर प्रकाश डालता है। शिक्षार्थी एग्जॉस्ट गैस ट्रीटमेंट सिस्टम (EGT/ATS) की जटिलताओं में गहराई से उतरेंगे, जिसमें इसके मुख्य घटक जैसे डीज़ल ऑक्सीडेशन कैटलिस्ट (DOC), डीज़ल पार्टिकुलेट फ़िल्टर (DPF), और सेलेक्टिव कैटेलिटिक रिडक्शन (SCR) शामिल हैं। पाठ्यक्रम इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कंट्रोल यूनिट (ECU) और सेंसर की भूमिका को स्पष्ट करता है जो इस उन्नत प्रणाली का प्रबंधन करते हैं। एक महत्वपूर्ण खंड रीजनरेशन प्रक्रिया के लिए समर्पित है, जिसमें स्वचालित और पार्क रीजनरेशन दोनों के लिए चरण-दर-चरण निर्देश दिए गए हैं, जो DPF के स्वास्थ्य को बनाए रखने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। इसके अतिरिक्त, पाठ्यक्रम में AdBlue (DEF) के उचित उपयोग और संभालने सहित आवश्यक देखभाल और रखरखाव प्रथाओं को शामिल किया गया है। व्यावहारिक प्रदर्शनों के माध्यम से, शिक्षार्थी इन प्रणालियों के सुरक्षित और कुशल संचालन को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए व्यावहारिक कौशल प्राप्त करेंगे, जिससे çevresel अनुपालन और वाहन प्रदर्शन में योगदान होगा।

title: BSNL Accounting Rules and Procedures
desc: This course delves into the critical financial framework of BSNL, a key player in India's telecommunications sector. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the intricacies of public sector undertaking (PSU) accounting within a dynamic industry. The curriculum begins with an introduction to BSNL's core accounting principles, emphasizing transparency, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. You will explore key financial procedures, including the budgeting process, expenditure approval mechanisms, and revenue recognition policies. The course also examines the technological backbone of BSNL's financial operations, such as its ERP systems, and analyzes the company's tariff and pricing strategies. Further, it covers the significance of financial reporting, auditing processes, and cost control measures. By the end of this course, learners will have a thorough understanding of how BSNL navigates its financial landscape to ensure stability, growth, and sustained service excellence, equipping them to appreciate the connection between sound financial practices and operational success.

title: BSNL Crop Policy
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the BSNL Comprehensive Renting Out Policy (CROP) 2020, designed for officials involved in administration, finance, and asset management. The program is structured to provide a clear understanding of how BSNL aims to generate revenue by leasing its underutilized built-up spaces. Key learning areas include the identification of rentable properties, the classification of eligible tenants such as public organizations and private entities, and the specific conditions for leasing. Participants will learn about the delegation of financial powers for approving rental agreements, the procedures for incurring expenditure on property renovation, and the provisions for rent-free periods. The course also breaks down the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), covering space audits, fair rent assessment, publicity methods, and the execution of lease deeds. A dedicated module explains the rules for renting residential accommodations to individuals, including employees and retirees, ensuring learners can confidently apply this policy in their official duties.

title: BSNL Land Monetisation Policy
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the BSNL Land Monetisation Policy, designed for officials involved in asset management. The program begins by establishing the context behind the policy, stemming from the Union Cabinet's revival plan for BSNL. It systematically covers the essential rules and guidelines, including the roles of DIPAM, the Group of Ministers (GOM), and the necessity of Presidential approval for high-value transactions. Key learning areas include the different models of monetization, the step-by-step procedure for identifying and selecting land parcels, conducting legal due diligence, and the process of asset valuation to determine fair market value. The course also clarifies the specific roles and responsibilities of various internal BSNL units, from the Business Area to the Board of Directors, as well as external oversight committees. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the procedural and regulatory landscape of land monetization within BSNL.

title: BSNL Mission Karmyogi
desc: The 'Mission Karmayogi: Core Professional Skills for BSNL Executives' program is designed to equip leaders within Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited with the essential behavioural skills required for navigating the dynamic telecom landscape. This course provides a holistic development journey, focusing on enhancing both personal and professional effectiveness. Key learning areas include mastering leadership and coaching techniques to build and inspire high-performing teams, and implementing robust strategies for planning and result orientation. Participants will learn to embrace and manage organizational change, cultivate a deep sense of customer centricity using empathy and design thinking, and foster a culture of accountability. The curriculum also covers personal growth modules on emotional intelligence, stress management, and impactful communication. By the end of this course, executives will be better prepared to lead with vision, manage their teams effectively, and drive a culture of excellence and service within BSNL.

title: BSNL Mission Karmyogi Training for Executives
desc: Embark on a transformational journey with this in-depth course on Mission Karmayogi, tailored for executives within the public sector. This program is designed to equip you with the skills and mindset needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving governance landscape. The course begins by introducing the vision and objectives of Mission Karmayogi, explaining its critical role in preparing civil servants for future challenges. You will explore a wide array of key competencies through dedicated modules. Key learning areas include mastering change management, developing effective leadership and team management skills, fostering a culture of ownership and accountability, and applying coaching techniques to mentor your team. Furthermore, the curriculum covers vital soft skills such as empathy, emotional intelligence, and impactful communication to enhance service delivery and stakeholder relationships. You will also be introduced to practical frameworks like Design Thinking for creative problem-solving and the RATER model for achieving customer centricity. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to embody the spirit of a 'Karmayogi,' driving positive change and excellence within your organization.

title: BSNL Procurement Process with SAP Modules
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the procurement and financial management processes essential for professionals in Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). It establishes a strong foundation by detailing the core principles of public procurement policies, drawing from government manuals and CVC guidelines to ensure transparency and fairness. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of various tendering methods, including open, limited, and negotiation routes, and the critical role of platforms like the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and the Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP). The curriculum delves into the complete tendering lifecycle, from preparing bid documents and managing bid security to the evaluation of technical and financial bids.
