A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical implementation of these procedures within the SAP ERP environment. It provides a detailed walkthrough of the Material Management (MM) module, covering key transactions like Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts (MIGO), and Service Entry Sheets (SES). Furthermore, it connects these procurement activities to the financial backend through the SAP Financial Accounting and Controlling (FICO) module, explaining how liabilities are created and payments are processed. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to manage procurement cycles efficiently, ensure regulatory compliance, and leverage SAP for seamless process execution.

title: BSNL Products and Services
desc: This introductory course offers a detailed exploration of the products and services provided by BSNL, a leading telecommunications service provider in India. The program is structured to build a clear understanding of the entire BSNL ecosystem, starting from traditional wireline and mobile services to advanced digital solutions. A significant focus is placed on Fiber to the Home (FTTH) technology, where participants will learn about its architecture, high-speed capabilities ranging from 2 Mbps to 300 Mbps, and its role in delivering a suite of services like IPTV, video telephony, and bandwidth-on-demand. The course also covers various mobile value-added services, including the practical steps for using features like call forwarding, call waiting, and conference calling. By the end of this course, learners will be well-versed in BSNL's offerings, enabling them to better understand the telecom landscape and effectively communicate service details to customers or stakeholders.

title: BSNL WiFi Service as Public Data Office (PDO)
desc: Dive into the transformative PM-WANI (Prime Minister's Wi-Fi Access Network Interface) scheme and discover how BSNL is spearheading its implementation. This course explains the critical need for this initiative, focusing on its goals to reduce unemployment and close the digital gap in India. You will learn about the ecosystem of stakeholders, including Public Data Offices (PDOs), PDO Aggregators, and app providers. The curriculum breaks down the three distinct partnership models offered by BSNL, detailing the investment requirements (CAPEX/OPEX), roles, responsibilities, and revenue-sharing structures for each. By the end of this course, you will understand the procedural and financial prerequisites for becoming a BSNL Wi-Fi partner, enabling you to evaluate this opportunity to launch a business and contribute to the vision of a digitally empowered India.

title: Budget
desc: In the realm of public administration, sound financial management is paramount for effective governance and national development. This course, 'Fundamentals of Government Budgeting Processes,' offers a comprehensive overview of the critical role that budgeting plays in translating government policies into tangible outcomes. It is specifically designed for public functionaries who need to understand the intricacies of managing public funds with prudence and integrity. The course delves into the entire budgetary lifecycle, starting with the principles of budget formulation, including estimating receipts and expenditures. It examines the legislative procedures for budget approval, the mechanisms for fund allocation, and the protocols for expenditure management as outlined in the General Financial Rules (GFR). Learners will also gain insights into the importance of fiscal responsibility, the structure of government accounts, and the audit process that ensures accountability. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to contribute to the financial planning of their departments, ensure compliance with fiscal regulations, and uphold the principles of transparency in public spending.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Budget (Hindi)
desc: यह विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी बजट की जटिलताओं को सरल बनाने और लोक सेवकों को इसके प्रबंधन के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान से लैस करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत बजट के परिचय से होती है, जिसमें इसके संवैधानिक प्रावधानों और अर्थव्यवस्था में इसकी भूमिका पर प्रकाश डाला गया है। इसके बाद, यह बजट निर्माण की पूरी प्रक्रिया को शामिल करता है, जिसमें विभिन्न मंत्रालयों और विभागों से अनुमान एकत्र करना, राजस्व और व्यय का विश्लेषण करना और अंतिम बजट दस्तावेज़ तैयार करना शामिल है। शिक्षार्थी विभिन्न प्रकार के बजटों, जैसे राजस्व बजट और पूंजीगत बजट, के बीच अंतर करना सीखेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में राजकोषीय नीति के महत्वपूर्ण पहलुओं, जैसे घाटा प्रबंधन, सार्वजनिक ऋण और सरकारी व्यय के प्रभाव का भी विश्लेषण किया गया है। इसमें बजट के कार्यान्वयन और निगरानी की प्रक्रियाओं पर भी ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है, ताकि यह सुनिश्चित हो सके कि आवंटित धन का उपयोग कुशलतापूर्वक और प्रभावी ढंग से हो। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी सरकारी वित्तीय संचालन की एक मजबूत समझ विकसित करेंगे और बजट से संबंधित मामलों पर सूचित निर्णय लेने में सक्षम होंगे। यह उन्हें राजकोषीय पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करने में भी मदद करेगा, जो सुशासन के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Budget and Related Activities
desc: Understanding the intricacies of government budgeting is crucial for ensuring the effective and transparent allocation of public resources. This course offers an in-depth examination of the fundamental principles and practices of budgeting within the governmental framework. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the key terms, structural components, and features of a public budget. The course delves into critical documents, including the Detailed Demands for Grants, providing clarity on their purpose and content. A significant focus is placed on the entire budget cycle, outlining each step from initial formulation and legislative approval to final execution. Learners will also understand the procedural aspects of how budgetary allocations are issued to ministries and departments. Designed for government officials, financial managers, and administrative professionals, this course provides the essential knowledge required to confidently navigate and manage budgetary processes, contributing to improved fiscal discipline and governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Budget Documents and Presentation and Approval of the Budget
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Union Budget of India, a critical instrument of the nation's financial administration. It is specifically designed to provide a clear and structured understanding of the entire budgetary process for government officials. The curriculum begins with the conceptual framework of the Union Budget and the administrative machinery involved. Learners will delve into the intricacies of budget formulation, both at the ministry level and within the Ministry of Finance, following the official schedule of preparation. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the various budget documents laid before Parliament, explaining their purpose and interconnections. Furthermore, the course meticulously outlines the parliamentary procedures involved in passing the budget, including general discussions, scrutiny by committees, voting on Demands for Grants, and the final passing of the Appropriation Bill.

title: Budget Documents, Presentation and Passing of Budget
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Union Budget of India, a critical instrument of the nation's financial administration. It is specifically designed to provide a clear and structured understanding of the entire budgetary process for government officials. The curriculum begins with the conceptual framework of the Union Budget and the administrative machinery involved. Learners will delve into the intricacies of budget formulation, both at the ministry level and within the Ministry of Finance, following the official schedule of preparation. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the various budget documents laid before Parliament, explaining their purpose and interconnections. Furthermore, the course meticulously outlines the parliamentary procedures involved in passing the budget, including general discussions, scrutiny by committees, voting on Demands for Grants, and the final passing of the Appropriation Bill. The content is structured to be accessible even to officers without a prior background in finance, ensuring they can confidently grasp all essential aspects of budget formulation and execution.

title: Budget Execution and Monitoring
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the critical processes of budget execution and monitoring in the public sector. It is designed to equip government officials with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of public financial management. The curriculum covers the complete lifecycle of budget execution, from the initial appropriation to final expenditure. Key learning areas include the legal and administrative framework, with a special focus on the revised guidelines for 'New Service' and 'New Instrument of Service' as per Ministry of Finance directives. Participants will learn to analyze expenditure, manage fund re-appropriation, and utilize Management Information Systems (MIS) for effective tracking and reporting. By the end of this course, learners will be proficient in applying financial rules to ensure compliance, accountability, and optimal utilization of public funds, thereby contributing to sound fiscal governance.

title: Budget execution and Monitoring
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the critical processes of budget execution and monitoring in the public sector. It is designed to equip government officials with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of public financial management. The curriculum covers the complete lifecycle of budget execution, from the initial appropriation to final expenditure. Key learning areas include the legal and administrative framework, with a special focus on the revised guidelines for 'New Service' and 'New Instrument of Service' as per Ministry of Finance directives. Participants will learn to analyze expenditure, manage fund re-appropriation, and utilize Management Information Systems (MIS) for effective tracking and reporting. By the end of this course, learners will be proficient in applying financial rules to ensure compliance, accountability, and optimal utilization of public funds, thereby contributing to sound fiscal governance.

title: Budget formulation in Government of India
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the budget formulation process in the Government of India, a cornerstone of public financial management. It begins by establishing the context of the annual budget, not merely as a financial statement, but as a critical instrument for implementing the government's economic and social policies. You will learn about the complete lifecycle of budget preparation, including the roles of various ministries and the Ministry of Finance in this collaborative effort. The curriculum details the key activities involved, such as the estimation of revenues and expenditures, analysis of macroeconomic indicators, and the consolidation of data into a cohesive budget document. By the end of this course, learners will have a clear understanding of how government spending priorities are determined, the significance of the parliamentary approval process, and how the budget translates national objectives into actionable financial plans. This knowledge is essential for any official involved in or affected by public financial management and governance.

title: Budget Formulation in the Government of India
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the budget formulation process in the Government of India, a cornerstone of public financial management. It begins by establishing the context of the annual budget, not merely as a financial statement, but as a critical instrument for implementing the government's economic and social policies. You will learn about the complete lifecycle of budget preparation, including the roles of various ministries and the Ministry of Finance in this collaborative effort. The curriculum details the key activities involved, such as the estimation of revenues and expenditures, analysis of macroeconomic indicators, and the consolidation of data into a cohesive budget document. By the end of this course, learners will have a clear understanding of how government spending priorities are determined, the significance of the parliamentary approval process, and how the budget translates national objectives into actionable financial plans.

title: Budgetary Control in the Department of Posts
desc: This course aims to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of budgetary control and expenditure classification within the Department of Posts. It focuses on the practical aspects of budget execution, monitoring, and the use of the computerized budget module for effective financial management. Learners will gain the ability to analyze budget allocation, re-appropriation, and financial discipline while ensuring compliance with established financial rules and transparency requirements. The course also emphasizes the evaluation of budget reports and the development of effective strategies for efficient fund allocation and expenditure tracking. Overall, the course is designed to strengthen financial management capabilities and promote accountability and transparency in budget utilization within the Department of Posts.

title: Budgetary System in Government
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of India's public budgetary framework. It begins by establishing the constitutional foundation for financial procedures, referencing key articles that shape the entire budget cycle. The curriculum systematically breaks down the process, from the initial preparation of budget estimates to the final stages of expenditure and audit. Participants will learn about the critical 'Demands for Grants' for various ministries, with a specific focus on the Ministry of Defence, and understand the mechanisms of financial control and reporting. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical aspects such as the principles of re-appropriation, its limitations, and the competent authorities involved. Furthermore, the course highlights the indispensable role of audit in ensuring financial propriety, accountability, and the effective utilization of public resources. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in navigating the complexities of government budgeting and accounting, enabling them to contribute to sound financial management and governance.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Budgeting in Defence
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the principles and practices of budgeting within the Ministry of Defence. It is designed for officials seeking to understand the complete lifecycle of the defence budget, a critical component of national fiscal policy and security preparedness. The curriculum begins with the constitutional basis for financial procedures in India, including the Annual Financial Statement and Demands for Grants. Learners will then delve into the specific processes of the defence budget, covering its preparation, categorization through code heads, and distribution. Key learning areas include the mechanisms for controlling defence expenditure, the rules governing re-appropriation of funds, and the integral roles of the Finance Division and Audit in ensuring fiscal discipline. The course also features an analysis of a recent Defence Budget to provide practical context and concludes by addressing common challenges in budget execution. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in the nuances of defence budgeting, enabling them to contribute effectively to financial management within the department.

title: Building a Psychologically Safe Workplace
desc: A thriving and innovative workplace is built on a foundation of psychological safety. This course offers a comprehensive exploration of how to cultivate an environment where every team member feels secure enough to take interpersonal risks, share ideas, and voice concerns. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of psychological safety, highlighting its direct impact on team dynamics, employee engagement, and overall organizational success within the public sector. Participants will learn to identify the key behaviors that either support or undermine a safe workplace culture. The course provides actionable strategies for leaders and team members to foster open communication, encourage constructive feedback, and build a high-trust, inclusive atmosphere. By completing this course, you will be equipped to champion a culture of psychological safety, leading to enhanced collaboration, greater innovation, and sustained high performance in your team and organization.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Building AI Prototypes for Government
desc: Building AI Prototypes for Government – From Idea to Interactive Demo using No-Code Tools introduces a practical framework for rapidly creating AI-powered prototypes without writing code. Through three government use cases—Self-Help Groups, teachers, and government officials—you will learn how to define problems, identify users, design AI capabilities, create effective meta prompts, and generate interactive prototypes using no-code AI tools. The course demonstrates how prototypes help validate ideas, gather stakeholder feedback, refine requirements, and secure buy-in before investing in software development, enabling faster and more citizen-centric innovation in government.

title: Building Climate Resilience in Agriculture Systems
desc: This course delves into the urgent need for climate action within the agricultural sector. It begins by establishing the fundamental science of climate change and its direct consequences for global food systems, including impacts on soil health, water availability, and food security. The curriculum thoroughly examines how agricultural activities contribute to climate change through greenhouse gas emissions from livestock, crop production, and land use changes. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring actionable solutions. Learners will analyze key strategies for building resilience, such as mitigation techniques to reduce emissions and adaptation measures to cope with existing climate impacts. The course covers modern approaches like Climate-Smart Agriculture, regenerative agriculture, and natural farming. It also navigates the complex landscape of policy, finance, and innovation, highlighting the roles of national and international governance bodies in promoting sustainable practices. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to contribute to informed decision-making and support the transition to a climate-resilient agricultural future.

title: Building Climate Resilient Healthcare Systems
desc: In an era of increasing climate volatility, healthcare systems face unprecedented challenges. This course provides a detailed examination of the nexus between climate change and public health, designed for officials and planners tasked with safeguarding community health. It begins by establishing the context, outlining how extreme weather events, rising temperatures, and ecological disruptions directly and indirectly affect health outcomes and strain healthcare infrastructure. The curriculum then delves into key learning areas, presenting the WHO's Operational Framework for Building Climate Resilient and Low Carbon Health Systems and the strategic objectives of India's National Action Plan for Climate Change and Human Health. Learners will explore practical strategies for risk assessment, mitigation, adaptation, and cross-sectoral collaboration. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to apply these principles to develop and implement robust action plans, ensuring their health systems can effectively anticipate, respond to, and recover from climate-related crises, thereby protecting vulnerable populations and promoting long-term public health.

title: Building Indigenous AI and India's Information Future
desc: This course focuses on the dual objectives of inclusive information access and responsible AI development. It highlights Digital India BHASHINI, an initiative aimed at overcoming the literacy, digital, and language divides that prevent citizens from accessing and benefiting from government services. Leveraging over 350 AI models, the platform enables translation across text, audio, and video formats in more than 36 languages, making information widely accessible. The course also explores Google’s framework for responsible and innovative AI development, built on five key pillars: Policy, Safety Filters, Testing, Mitigations, and Metrics & Monitoring. Additionally, the course emphasizes the importance of content authenticity and transparency through technologies such as SynthID for imperceptible watermarking and digital signatures to verify content origin. Overall, the course highlights how safety, trust, and accountability are integrated across the AI lifecycle.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Building Materials and their Measurements
desc: This course is designed to provide essential knowledge in civil engineering for personnel involved in field-level construction and maintenance projects, such as those in the forest services. It begins by introducing the fundamental building materials that form the backbone of any construction project. Participants will delve into the geological and chemical classifications of stones, the properties of different types of bricks, and the critical role of sand, lime, and cement. The course further explains the composition and application of mortar, mass concrete, and reinforced cement concrete (RCC), including standard proportions and mixing guidelines. By understanding the characteristics of good materials and the correct methods for their measurement and use, learners will be able to ensure the quality, durability, and safety of rural infrastructure like buildings and roads. This practical knowledge is crucial for efficient project execution and effective resource management in public works.

title: Building Resilient Cybersecurity Systems
desc: In an era of increasing digital threats, securing government IT infrastructure is paramount. This course is designed to equip government officials and IT professionals with the knowledge to build and maintain resilient cybersecurity systems. The curriculum delves into the core tenets of modern cybersecurity architecture, emphasizing a proactive, layered defense strategy. Key learning areas include the principles and implementation of Zero Trust Architecture, secure network design, segmentation strategies, and robust mobile device management to mitigate Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) risks. Through the analysis of high-profile case studies such as the SolarWinds and WannaCry attacks, learners will gain a practical understanding of threat vectors and effective response strategies. The course also covers the practical configuration of essential security tools like firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS). Upon completion, participants will be prepared to design, implement, and manage standards-aligned cyber defense systems that protect critical government data and services from sophisticated attacks.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Building Sports Ecosystem in Odisha through Private Public Partnership
desc: This case study highlights Odisha's transformation into a national sports hub, driven by leadership, public-private partnerships, and infrastructure development, leading to significant improvements in athlete performance and grassroots participation.

title: Business Development Activities in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the business development activities transforming Indian Railways' freight operations. Faced with a significant decline in its freight market share, Indian Railways has launched a series of strategic reforms to regain its competitive edge. This program delves into the core components of this transformation, starting with the context of why these changes are critical for the organization's future. Key learning areas include the structure and objectives of the newly formed Business Development Units (BDUs), a detailed exploration of the Freight Business Development Portal and its role in creating a customer-centric experience, and an analysis of key tariff reforms and private investment policies like LSFTO and GPWIS aimed at attracting new business. Upon completion, learners will understand how these initiatives integrate to create a more efficient, transparent, and commercially-driven freight ecosystem, enabling them to contribute effectively to the goal of increasing railways' modal share.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Business Development Products
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the suite of business development products available through India Post. In an era of digital transformation and competitive logistics, India Post is expanding its offerings beyond traditional mail services. This program details these modern solutions, which are crucial for government officials and postal employees to understand. The curriculum covers key product categories such as parcel services, e-commerce logistics, and other value-added offerings designed for business clients. Participants will learn how these services function, the target customer segments they serve, and their strategic importance to India Post's revenue and relevance. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to identify customer needs and effectively communicate the value of India Post's business solutions, contributing to the organization's commercial success.

title: Business Process Management
desc: In today's dynamic public sector, operational efficiency is paramount for delivering high-quality citizen services. This course, 'Foundations of Business Process Management and Lean Principles,' provides a comprehensive introduction to the methodologies that drive organizational excellence. It is designed for government officials seeking to understand and implement process improvements. The course delves into the synergy between BPM, which provides the framework for managing processes, and Lean, which offers the tools to eliminate waste and maximize value. Key learning areas include identifying the eight types of waste (DOWNTIME), applying the 5S methodology for a more organized workplace, visualizing process flows with Value Stream Mapping (VSM), conducting root cause analysis using the 5-Why technique, and implementing small, continuous improvements through Kaizen. By the end of this course, learners will be able to analyze their own operational environments, identify opportunities for enhancement, and apply these powerful tools to create leaner, more agile, and customer-focused government processes, ultimately contributing to superior governance and public value.

title: Business to Business Marketing
desc: This course delves into the strategic and operational aspects of modern B2B marketing, designed for professionals seeking to master organizational marketing. The curriculum begins by establishing the fundamental differences between consumer and business buying processes, providing context for the unique challenges and opportunities in the B2B space. You will learn to navigate complex market structures, apply sophisticated segmentation criteria, and identify high-value customer profiles by leveraging firmographic, technographic, and behavioral data. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to actionable targeting strategies, including inbound, outbound, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), and channel partnerships. It also provides practical knowledge on qualifying leads through established frameworks like BANT and CHAMP. By the end, learners will be equipped to design, execute, and optimize multi-touch B2B marketing campaigns, using analytics to measure success and drive sustainable business growth in institutional, government, or industrial contexts.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Butterfly Diversity and Identification
desc: Delve into the vibrant world of butterflies and uncover their critical role in our ecosystem. This course is structured to guide beginners through the fascinating aspects of butterfly diversity and identification, with a special focus on the Indian subcontinent. You will begin by understanding the immense value of butterflies—from their aesthetic appeal that has inspired art and literature, to their crucial ecological functions as pollinators and indicators of environmental health. The course explores the significant threats butterflies face, such as habitat loss and climate change, and discusses effective conservation strategies, including the legal protections offered by the Indian Wildlife Act of 1972. The second part of the course provides practical knowledge for identification, covering the six butterfly families found in India, their life cycles, and morphological features. You will also learn to navigate challenges in identification caused by seasonal variations, polymorphism, and mimicry. By the end of this course, you will be able to not only identify common butterflies but also appreciate their importance and the need for their conservation.
org: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education

title: Cadre Review of Central Civil Services
desc: This comprehensive course offers an in-depth exploration of the cadre review mechanism, a critical component of human resource management in the Government of India. The program is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of why and how cadre structures are reviewed to maintain a healthy, efficient, and responsive civil service. Participants will delve into the fundamental principles that govern the review process, including the key considerations for formulating effective proposals and the procedural steps involved. The course clarifies the distinct roles and responsibilities of the various authorities in the review process, from proposal initiation to final approval. It emphasizes the importance of a well-structured cadre for career progression and organizational effectiveness. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to understand and contribute to the intricate process of administrative restructuring and cadre management within the Central Civil Services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Cancellation and Revocation of GST Registration
desc: This detailed course delves into the critical processes of cancellation, suspension, and revocation of GST registration as governed by the CGST Act. It is designed for tax professionals and business owners to navigate the legal framework confidently. The course begins by outlining the specific reasons and conditions that warrant a cancellation, distinguishing between applications made by the taxpayer and actions taken by the department. Learners will be guided through the step-by-step procedures, including the submission of relevant forms such as GST REG-16 and responding to show-cause notices. A key focus is placed on understanding the implications of registration suspension, where a taxpayer cannot issue tax invoices or claim refunds. Furthermore, the course explains the mechanism for revocation of a cancellation order, detailing the application process and necessary compliance actions. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to handle the end-to-end process of GST registration changes and fulfill all post-cancellation obligations, including the filing of the final return (GSTR-10).
org: National Academy of Customs, Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN)

title: Cancer Prevention: A Dialogue with Oncologist
desc: In response to the rising incidence of cancer in India, this course offers essential knowledge to empower civil servants in safeguarding their health. It begins by contextualizing the cancer problem in India, explaining the population's susceptibility and the urgent need for preventive action. The curriculum delves into practical, evidence-based strategies for risk reduction, covering critical lifestyle modifications. Key learning areas include understanding the link between a sedentary office life and cancer, the impact of diet choices, and the dangers of tobacco and alcohol. Learners will be guided on recognizing early warning signs (red flags) and the importance of screening. Furthermore, the course highlights the powerful roles of a balanced diet, regular physical activity, and yoga in building resilience against disease. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to make informed decisions for a healthier lifestyle and encourage a culture of wellness in their workplace.

title: Cantonment Board Account Rules, 2020
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Cantonment Board Account Rules (CBAR), 2020, a pivotal reform in the financial administration of India's Cantonment Boards. The curriculum is designed to provide a clear understanding of why the shift from the century-old cash-based system to an accrual-based accounting framework was necessary. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of the shortcomings of the previous system and the significant benefits of the new accrual-based model, such as improved financial transparency, accurate asset and liability tracking, and robust budgetary control. Participants will learn to navigate the 11-digit Chart of Accounts, understanding the logic behind function codes and object codes for precise financial classification. The course also covers critical procedures for budget preparation, expenditure management, works accounting, fixed asset capitalization, and inventory management as prescribed under CBAR 2020. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these rules, ensuring compliance and fostering a more accountable and efficient financial ecosystem within their respective Cantonment Boards.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: Cantonments Act - 2006 - An overview
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Cantonments Act, 2006, designed to equip officials with a thorough understanding of the legal and administrative framework for cantonment governance. The content begins with the historical context of cantonment legislation, explaining the need for the 2006 Act to promote greater democratization and financial autonomy. Key learning areas include the constitution and categorization of Cantonment Boards, the roles and responsibilities of their members and key executives, and the procedures for elections and meetings. The course further elaborates on the mandatory and discretionary functions of the Boards, covering essential municipal services such as sanitation, water supply, public health, and town planning. It also details the financial aspects, including powers of taxation, management of the Cantonment Fund, and procedures for contracts and property management. Upon completion, learners will be able to interpret and apply the provisions of the Act to ensure effective, lawful, and citizen-centric administration within cantonment areas, aligning their actions with the statutory duties and regulatory controls outlined in the legislation.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: Capacity building in Southern Railway: IT Cell initiative
desc: The establishment of an IT Cell by Mr. Vinayan in Southern Railways in December 2017 exemplifies the optimal use of limited resources, focusing on internal capacity building, adaptive management, and innovation to enhance system efficiency without external reliance.

title: Capacity Building of Civil Defence and of Organisations and Individual
desc: In the critical moments following a disaster, a coordinated and knowledgeable community response can save countless lives. This course provides essential training for citizens and volunteers to become a vital link in the emergency response chain. The program delves into the core functions of civil defence services, including communication, rescue, first aid, and welfare, explaining how individuals can actively support these efforts. Structured around 18 short, impactful films, the course illustrates practical actions for various emergencies, from fires and blackouts to handling unexploded ordnance and managing social media responsibly. Participants will learn how to report incidents correctly, assist vulnerable populations, perform basic first aid, and support organized evacuations. By completing this module, learners will be prepared to contribute meaningfully to disaster management efforts, fostering a culture of safety and preparedness within their communities and strengthening the nation's ability to withstand crises.

title: Capital Budgeting: Assessing Viability and Financial Feasibility
desc: In today's economic landscape, making sound investment decisions is crucial for organizational growth and sustainability. This course, 'Capital Budgeting: Techniques for Project Viability and Financial Feasibility,' is designed to equip public sector professionals with the essential skills for evaluating long-term projects. It provides a structured approach to financial appraisal, moving from foundational principles to practical application. The course begins by establishing the importance of capital budgeting and the concept of the time value of money. Learners will then dive into the three primary techniques for project evaluation: Net Present Value (NPV), which determines a project's profitability; Internal Rate of Return (IRR), which identifies the discount rate at which a project breaks even; and the Payback Period, which measures risk and liquidity. Through clear explanations and a practical example, participants will learn to apply these financial tools to assess project viability, compare different investment opportunities, and make data-driven recommendations. This course will empower you to analyze financial soundness and ensure that capital resources are allocated to projects that maximize value and align with strategic objectives.

title: Capital Goods
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the capital goods sector, a cornerstone of industrial and economic growth. It begins by defining capital goods and explaining their importance as the assets used to produce consumer products and services. You will delve into the diverse manufacturing processes that are fundamental to the creation of these durable items, from initial design to final assembly. The course provides a detailed overview of the primary sub-sectors that constitute the capital goods industry. Learners will explore the specifics of Machine Tools, Textile Machinery, Earthmoving & Mining Machinery, Heavy Electrical Equipment, Plastic Machinery, and Process Plant Equipment. Upon completion, you will have a clear understanding of the structure of the capital goods industry and its critical contribution to the national manufacturing ecosystem, preparing you to better comprehend its role in policy and industrial development.

title: Capital Market Cyber Resilience: Lessons from BSE and ICCL
desc: In an era of increasing digital threats, the resilience of financial market infrastructure is paramount. This course offers a unique opportunity to learn from the leaders securing India's top exchanges. It delves into the complex challenges and sophisticated solutions required to protect national-scale market institutions. Key topics include the implementation of active-active architectures for zero downtime, hardening APIs for trading and market data, and aligning security practices with SEBI’s Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF). Learners will gain a deep understanding of the unique threats faced by capital markets, such as algorithmic trading risks and DDoS patterns, and learn from the practical experiences of BSE and ICCL in incident response, red-team exercises, and kill-chain detection. This course is essential for cybersecurity professionals, financial regulators, and IT personnel seeking to understand and implement robust security in high-stakes financial environments.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Carbon Management and Climate Action for Organizations
desc: This introductory course provides a comprehensive overview of carbon and its management within organizations of all types. Participants will learn why carbon management is critical in the context of climate change and sustainability, and how organizations can take practical steps to measure, monitor, and reduce their carbon footprint. The course introduces key terminologies, frameworks, and approaches used in carbon management, helping learners understand the contours of this emerging field. It also emphasizes the role of organizational leadership in driving climate action and encourages participants to implement effective strategies to mitigate climate change impacts through informed decision-making. Designed for beginners, this course equips participants with both conceptual understanding and practical tools to integrate carbon management into organizational operations, policies, and strategies.

title: Carbon Trading
desc: In an era of increasing climate consciousness, understanding the economic tools for environmental management is crucial. This course delves into the critical concepts of carbon pricing and carbon markets, explaining their role in global and national climate change mitigation efforts. You will begin with an overview of carbon pricing mechanisms, building a strong foundation of essential terminologies and principles. The curriculum then explores the architecture of carbon markets, contrasting the Indian context with global systems. A significant focus is placed on the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), where you will dissect its Compliance and Offset Mechanisms to understand how they incentivize emissions reductions. By blending theoretical knowledge with practical insights, this course prepares learners to make informed decisions, develop effective strategies, and engage in meaningful discussions about leveraging market-based instruments for a sustainable future. It is ideal for public sector officials, environmental professionals, and anyone interested in the intersection of finance and climate policy.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Cardiac Arrest and Basic Life Support: A Lifesaving Guide
desc: Cardiac Arrest and Basic Life Support: A Lifesaving Guide is an interactive e-learning course designed to build competence and confidence in handling cardiac emergencies. The course establishes a foundational understanding of the human respiratory and circulatory systems and explains the critical difference between clinical and biological death, highlighting the narrow window for effective intervention. Participants will be guided through step-by-step demonstrations of high-quality CPR for adults, children, and infants, ensuring they can adapt their response to the situation. Additionally, the course provides clear instructions on operating an Automated External Defibrillator (AED), a vital tool in restoring normal heart rhythm. Through realistic scenarios and practical guidance, this course moves beyond theoretical knowledge to prepare learners to take immediate and correct action. Upon completion, individuals will be equipped not just with skills, but with the readiness to save a life by effectively activating emergency services and providing crucial support until professional help arrives.
org: Mahatma Gandhi State Institute of Public Administration Punjab

title: Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip individuals with the knowledge and skills to perform Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) effectively. The program begins by establishing the critical importance of CPR in situations of cardiac arrest, where immediate action can be the difference between life and death. It delves into the risk factors associated with heart conditions, distinguishing between unchangeable factors like genetics and changeable ones like lifestyle habits. Key learning areas include the systematic 'CAB' approach: checking for Circulation, ensuring a clear Airway, and assessing Breathing. The course provides detailed, step-by-step instructions and demonstrations on performing chest compressions and rescue breaths for adults, children, and infants, highlighting the differences in technique for each age group. Learners will be able to identify the signs of a successful resuscitation and understand the protocol for activating Emergency Medical Services (EMS). Upon completion, participants will be prepared to respond confidently and correctly in a cardiac emergency, potentially saving a life.

title: Case Studies in the Use of Data and Evidence for Governance
desc: Dive deep into the principles of evidence-based governance with this insightful course developed by J-PAL South Asia. Through a collection of detailed case studies, you will witness how government officers, researchers, and practitioners have collaborated to tackle some of India's most pressing issues, from environmental pollution and gender inequality to educational deficits and poverty. The curriculum is structured around core conceptual modules, each featuring a mini-documentary that breaks down a specific policy challenge and the innovative, evidence-driven solution developed to address it. You will learn to construct a 'Theory of Change' to guide policy design, understand the nuances of accurate measurement and data collection, and grasp the fundamentals of impact evaluation, including the gold-standard methodology of Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs). By the end of this course, you will not only understand the 'what' and 'how' of evidence-based policy but also be inspired to apply these frameworks to drive meaningful and sustainable change within your own sphere of work.

title: Case Study Writing for Policy and Practice
desc: This is a practical course designed to help learners document, analyze, and communicate real-world experiences through compelling and evidence-based case studies. Case studies are more than narratives—they are powerful tools for learning, decision-making, advocacy, and knowledge sharing. When developed effectively, they can showcase successful interventions, highlight challenges, inform policy, attract funding, and support the replication of best practices. This course takes participants through the complete case study development process, from identifying and structuring key elements to refining and presenting polished outputs. Learners will explore the seven core components of effective case studies—problem, context, stakeholders, challenges, innovation, outcomes, and lessons learned—and learn how to transform field experiences into coherent and impactful narratives.

title: Cash Book and Bank Book
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential practices of cash and bank book management for public officials. It begins by establishing a strong foundation in basic accounting and bookkeeping principles, covering the recording of transactions, the rules of debit and credit, and the concepts of journals and ledgers. The curriculum is structured into four distinct modules for a progressive learning experience. Learners will delve into the specifics of cash books, understanding their features and different types. The course then explores bank books, including handling overdrafts and differentiating them from cash accounts. A key focus is placed on the practical skills of reconciliation, including managing three-column cash books and petty cash. Through a combination of theoretical concepts, multiple-choice questions, and practical case studies, participants will gain the confidence to maintain accurate and compliant financial records, a cornerstone of good governance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: CASH FLOW STATEMENT
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge to understand and interpret cash flow statements. It begins by establishing the importance of cash flow analysis in the broader context of financial reporting, alongside the balance sheet and profit and loss statement. You will learn to distinguish between cash flows from operating, investing, and financing activities, which is fundamental to evaluating a company's financial health. The course details the two primary methods for preparing the statement—the direct and indirect methods—with a focus on calculating cash flow from operating activities. Through practical examples, you will gain the ability to analyze how cash is generated and utilized within an organization. Upon completion, you will be able to confidently read and analyze a cash flow statement to make informed assessments of a company's performance, sustainability, and financial stability.

title: Cash Flow Statement in Financial Analysis
desc: Dive deep into the principles of financial analysis with this focused course on the Cash Flow Statement, tailored for professionals in government and public sector organizations. The curriculum is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of why cash flow is a more reliable measure of liquidity than profit. You will learn to navigate the regulatory landscape, including the Companies Act, 2013, and Indian Accounting Standards (IndAS), ensuring compliance in financial reporting. The course covers both the direct and indirect methods for preparing the statement and breaks down the classification of cash flows into operating, investing, and financing activities. Through practical examples and case studies relevant to PSUs, you will learn to interpret cash flow data to assess organizational health, evaluate profit quality, and make informed decisions related to budgeting, investment, and strategic restructuring. Upon completion, you will be equipped to use cash flow analysis as a powerful tool for effective financial governance.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Cash Management in India Post
desc: This program offers detailed, step-by-step instructions on managing cash flow across the India Post network using the SAP financial system. The course covers the complete lifecycle of cash transactions, from initiation to approval and acknowledgement. Key learning areas include processing excess cash remittances from a Sub Office to a Head Office, managing cash transfers from a Branch Office to an Account Office, and handling cash requests from a Branch Office. Furthermore, it details the procedures for withdrawing cash from and remitting cash to banks, including the generation of necessary documentation like ACG11 reports. The training focuses on the practical application of SAP transaction codes such as ZFFV50 and ZFI_BOCR, making it essential for personnel in roles like Treasurer and Postmaster. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in executing these critical financial tasks, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in postal operations.

title: Cash on Delivery
desc: This e-learning program is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the Department of Posts' Cash on Delivery (CoD) service. The course begins by defining the CoD facility and identifying who is eligible to use it, emphasizing the requirement of a contractual agreement for bulk customers. It delves into the specific operational conditions, including the monetary limits and the calculation of service fees based on the value of the consignment. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the updated billing mechanism for Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) credit customers. It explains the transition from upfront fee deductions to a consolidated monthly invoice system, outlining the billing schedules, payment due dates, and penalties for late payments. Furthermore, the course clarifies the process for high-volume customers who can opt for fortnightly billing and the procedures for advance deposit customers. By the end of this session, participants will be able to confidently navigate the CoD service's framework, ensuring compliance and efficient management of payments and deliveries.

title: Cast Steel Snubber Bogie (Casnub Bogie)
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of Cast Steel Snubber (CASNUB) Bogies, a critical component in the Indian Railways' rolling stock fleet. The program is structured to build a strong foundational understanding, starting with the salient features and functional uses of bogies in train operations. Participants will learn to identify and differentiate between various bogie models such as the 22W, 22W Retrofitted, Cast Steel Snubber (M), 22NLM, and 22HS. The course meticulously breaks down the anatomy of the bogie, covering key components like the adapter, side frame, bolster with PU side bearer, springs, spring plank, and axle. A dedicated segment explains the parts and functionality of the high-performance friction wedge, which is crucial for ride quality and stability. Furthermore, the course addresses important operational practices, such as the correct packing procedures required to maintain proper buffer height, ensuring both safety and performance. Upon completion, learners will possess the technical knowledge required for the inspection and maintenance of CASNUB bogies.

title: Casting and Molding Process
desc: This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of essential manufacturing techniques, specifically casting and plastic molding. It addresses the importance of these processes in modern industry, covering how they contribute to production efficiency and product quality. Key learning areas include a detailed exploration of the casting process, from method selection to identifying and mitigating common defects. The curriculum also covers the evolution and classification of plastics, followed by an in-depth look at various plastic molding methods. Participants will learn to analyze the critical factors—such as material science, cost-effectiveness, and production scale—that determine the choice between casting and molding. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the practical knowledge to better understand and contribute to manufacturing optimization and quality improvement within their operational context.

title: CAT and Appointment of its Members Chairperson
desc: Delve into the essential framework of the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT), an institution established to provide swift and inexpensive justice to public servants regarding their service matters. This course explains the context behind CAT's creation and its importance in reducing the burden on regular courts. You will learn about the tribunal's composition, the powers vested in it, and the specific jurisdiction it holds over personnel issues. The curriculum thoroughly covers the appointment mechanisms, qualifications, and conditions of service for the Chairperson and Members of the CAT, including their tenure and reappointment provisions. By completing this course, learners will be able to differentiate CAT's procedures from those of civil courts and gain a robust understanding of its function within the Indian administrative and legal landscape. This knowledge is vital for officials in administrative, HR, and legal roles to ensure proper adherence to service rules and effective management of litigation.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Catalogue Management for Sellers on GeM
desc: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has transformed public procurement in India, creating a transparent and efficient ecosystem for buyers and sellers. For sellers, mastering the platform's catalogue management features is essential for success. This course is designed to equip vendors with the practical knowledge needed to navigate GeM's catalogue functionalities with confidence. It begins by demystifying the vendor assessment process, explaining potential exemption scenarios and the necessary documentation to streamline registration. The core of the course focuses on product catalogue management, providing step-by-step guidance on uploading products, securing brand approvals, and utilizing the cloning feature to save time and effort. Furthermore, participants will learn the distinct procedures for creating and managing service catalogues, a crucial aspect for service-based vendors. Upon completion, sellers will be proficient in maintaining compliant and attractive catalogues, enhancing their ability to connect with government buyers and participate effectively in the national public procurement landscape.

title: Cataract Awareness: Protecting Your Vision
desc: Cataract is a major public health issue in India, responsible for a significant percentage of preventable blindness. This course provides a clear and essential guide to understanding this common eye condition. It begins by explaining the basic anatomy of the eye and how a cataract forms and impairs vision. Learners will explore the various risk factors, including aging, diabetes, and UV exposure, and learn to recognize the key symptoms that necessitate a medical consultation. The curriculum details the entire clinical pathway, from initial diagnosis and pre-surgical assessments like biometry to the specifics of modern, highly successful phacoemulsification surgery and intraocular lens (IOL) options. A key focus of the course is to address and correct widespread misconceptions, such as the belief that cataracts must 'ripen' before surgery. It also provides crucial guidance on post-operative care and recovery. By equipping learners with this knowledge, the course empowers community health workers, caregivers, and the general public to advocate for early intervention, contributing to the national effort to eliminate avoidable blindness.

title: Causes and Prevention of Electrical Fires
desc: Electrical fires pose a significant threat to property and life. This course is designed to provide a comprehensive overview of how to mitigate these risks effectively. Participants will delve into the technical causes of electrical fires, such as arcing faults, poor connections, and the misuse of appliances, learning to recognize warning signs before they escalate. The curriculum emphasizes the critical role of preventive measures, including regular system inspections, proper load management, and the installation of protective devices like circuit breakers and Residual Current Devices (RCDs). Furthermore, the course offers crucial guidance on emergency response. Learners will be trained to select and safely use the correct type of fire extinguisher for electrical fires, specifically Class C or CO2 models. By completing this course, participants will be empowered to create safer environments by developing and applying robust electrical safety protocols, ultimately protecting assets and personnel from the devastating impact of electrical fires.

title: CCS (CCA) Rules 1965
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965, a cornerstone of administrative law for government employees in India. Understanding these rules is crucial for maintaining discipline, accountability, and procedural fairness within the civil services. The curriculum delves into the salient features of the CCS (CCA) Rules, clarifying their scope and applicability to various central government posts. Key topics include a detailed definition of suspension, the specific circumstances under which it can be imposed, and a thorough examination of the different minor and major penalties. Upon completion, participants will be able to describe the fundamental aspects of the rules and understand their implications, ensuring they can operate with a clear awareness of their rights and responsibilities within the governmental framework. This foundational knowledge is essential for all new officials beginning their careers in public service.

title: CCS (CCA) Rules part 1- CCS CCA Rules - An Overview and Suspension
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth exploration of the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965, a cornerstone of administrative governance in India. Understanding these rules is critical for public servants to ensure procedural fairness, maintain discipline, and uphold the integrity of the civil services. The course begins by defining key terminology and explaining the classification system and constitution of the CCS (CCA) Rules. Participants will learn to identify the specific entities and employee categories to which these rules apply or are exempt. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the concept of suspension. It covers the various circumstances leading to suspension, including deemed suspension, and clarifies situations where suspension is deemed desirable. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the applicable rules, allowances, and entitlements for an official during a period of suspension. Furthermore, the course addresses practical administrative procedures, such as the creation of a charge sheet, and examines the complexities of voluntary retirement and resignation during suspension. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate and apply these essential service rules correctly in their official duties.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: CCS (CCA) Rules Part IV - Appeals, Revision and Review
desc: The Central Civil Services (Classification, Control, and Appeal) Rules, 1965, are fundamental to maintaining discipline and ensuring procedural fairness within the Central Government. This course focuses on Part IV of these rules, which details the critical post-decision remedies available to employees. The curriculum provides an in-depth exploration of the legal framework governing appeals, revisions, and reviews. Learners will understand the specific conditions, timelines, and procedural requirements for filing an appeal to a higher authority. The course also clarifies the distinct mechanisms of revision and review, explaining the grounds on which they can be invoked and the authorities empowered to exercise them. By completing this course, participants will be able to confidently identify, assess, and apply these remedies in relevant service matters, contributing to effective grievance redressal and upholding administrative justice.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: CCS and CCA Rules Part - II
desc: This course, ""Disciplinary Proceedings and Penalties under CCS and CCA Rules,"" offers an in-depth exploration of the disciplinary framework governing Central Government employees. It is designed for officials who need a comprehensive understanding of the procedural and legal aspects of imposing penalties as stipulated by the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules. The content provides critical context on why a clear understanding of these rules is essential for maintaining discipline, fairness, and administrative propriety within public service. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of minor and major penalties, a clear explanation of actions that do not constitute a penalty, and the identification of the competent authorities for initiating disciplinary proceedings and imposing penalties. The course systematically describes the two main categories of penalties, ensuring learners can differentiate between them and understand their respective implications. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to handle disciplinary cases with procedural correctness, ensuring compliance with established service rules. This knowledge is directly applicable to roles in administration, establishment, human resources, and vigilance, enabling officials to make informed and legally sound decisions in matters of employee conduct and discipline.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: CCS LTC Rules
desc: The Leave Travel Concession (LTC) is a vital component of the benefits package for Central Government employees, yet navigating its regulations can be challenging. This course is designed to demystify the Central Civil Services (CCS) LTC rules, providing a clear and structured guide for both employees and administrative personnel. A thorough understanding of these rules is essential for ensuring compliance and the smooth processing of travel claims, which contributes to employee welfare and administrative efficiency. The curriculum delves into the core principles of the LTC scheme, covering eligibility criteria, travel entitlements based on pay scales, and the specific procedures for availing the concession. Learners will explore the practical aspects of booking travel, processing claims, and managing advances. Furthermore, the course addresses special cases, including the implications of service breaks, concessions for travel to the North-Eastern Region, and the rules governing leave encashment. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to confidently apply the LTC rules, whether for personal travel planning or for processing claims in an official capacity, ensuring adherence to all procedural requirements.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: CCS LTC Rules 1988
desc: This detailed course is designed to equip Central Government employees and administrative officials with a thorough working knowledge of the CCS (LTC) Rules, 1988. The material systematically breaks down the key components of the rules, starting from their applicability and scope to the specific entitlements based on pay levels. Key learning areas include the distinction between hometown and all-India LTC, the conditions for carrying over concessions, and special provisions for various employee categories like deputationists and re-employed pensioners. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently interpret and apply the LTC rules, process claims accurately, ensure compliance, and effectively address queries from employees. This knowledge is essential for both beneficiaries seeking to avail their entitlements correctly and for administrative staff responsible for managing these processes.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: CCTNS - Lessons in Managing Large Technology Projects in Indian Police
desc: This case study examines the Crime and Criminal Tracking Network Systems (CCTNS), conceptualised by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 2009 under the National e-Governance Plan to digitally connect all police stations in India, digitise crime records, and enable real-time information sharing and decision-making. While CCTNS aimed to replace fragmented, manual record-keeping with a unified technology-driven system, its initial implementation (CCTNS 1.0) faced significant challenges, including delays, design gaps, and coordination issues across Centre–State and multi-stakeholder arrangements. Despite repeated setbacks, the project was revived with renewed focus. The case highlights the ongoing need for police workflows that resolve criminal identity and enable data analytics—objectives now linked to the upcoming CCTNS 2.0.
keywords: Crime and Criminal Tracking Network Systems (CCTNS)

title: CDM Cells Data Mining and Data analysis
desc: This foundational course delves into the ecosystem of corporate data managed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA). It is designed for officials who need to understand the vast data repository generated through corporate filings under the Companies Act. The curriculum begins by outlining the types of data MCA holds, from annual financial statements and returns to event-based disclosures. Learners will gain a clear understanding of key concepts such as Company Master Data and the Corporate Identification Number (CIN).The course then focuses on the Corporate Data Management (CDM) scheme, an initiative to create an in-house data mining and analytics facility. Participants will learn about the activities of the CDM cell, including compliance monitoring, data quality management, and the development of portals like the CDM portal and CSR exchange. Upon completion, learners will be able to appreciate how data analytics and business intelligence are leveraged to provide insights to internal and external stakeholders, thereby strengthening corporate governance and regulatory oversight.

title: CDOT MAX NG (CACU) OVERVIEW
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the C-DOT MAX NG Central Access Control Unit (CACU), a key component in the evolution of public telecommunication networks from TDM to IP-based systems. The program begins by setting the context of this technological shift, highlighting the need for Voice over IP (VoIP) and converged services. Learners will explore the physical and functional aspects of the CACU chassis, including the specific roles of critical hardware like the Self-Manager (SLM), NGTJ, and MLS cards. The course delves into the system architecture, illustrating how the CACU replaces legacy modules and aggregates traffic for the IP/MPLS network. Furthermore, it covers practical aspects such as IP addressing requirements for the chassis, physical installation considerations, and connectivity with other network elements. Upon completion, participants will have a solid foundational understanding of the CACU's role and functionality within the C-DOT MAX NG ecosystem.

title: CDR Clarity
desc: This introductory course, 'Introduction to Call Detail Record (CDR) Analysis,' is designed for professionals seeking to understand the fundamentals of telecom data. The curriculum begins by defining what a Call Detail Record is and breaking down its essential fields and structure. Participants will learn why CDRs are crucial for the functioning of a modern telecommunications provider, particularly in the context of a public sector undertaking like BSNL. The course will explore the complete lifecycle of a CDR, from its generation in the network to its application in various systems. Key learning areas include the use of CDRs for accurate customer billing, resolving customer inquiries through data analysis, and monitoring network performance. Learners will understand how analyzing this data contributes to revenue assurance, fraud detection, and overall operational efficiency. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret basic CDR information and appreciate its strategic value in improving service delivery and business intelligence within the telecom industry.

title: CEIR- Block Your Lost/Stolen Mobile
desc: In an era where mobile phones are central to our daily lives, protecting the personal data they contain is of utmost importance. The loss or theft of a mobile device poses a significant risk of data misuse. This course is designed to equip citizens and officials with the practical knowledge to navigate the Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) system, a crucial government tool for mobile security. The curriculum provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the SancharSaathi portal's CEIR services. You will learn the complete procedure for blocking a lost or stolen mobile handset, including the necessary prerequisites like filing a police complaint and having the required documents ready. The course also explains how to unblock a device once it is found and how to track the status of your service request using the generated Request ID. Furthermore, the course covers the 'Know Your Mobile' (KYM) application, an essential tool for verifying the authenticity and status of a mobile device using its IMEI number before purchase. By completing this course, you will be able to confidently use the CEIR platform to safeguard your mobile device and personal information, contributing to a safer digital ecosystem.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Cell Filled Concrete Pavement
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of Cell Filled Concrete Pavement (CFCP) technology, a key innovation for enhancing rural connectivity in India. It addresses the challenges of conventional road construction, such as high costs and material scarcity, by presenting CFCP as a durable, economical, and labor-intensive solution. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with practical knowledge on the entire implementation process. Key learning areas include understanding the structural mechanics of CFCP, the specifications for materials like recycled HDPE/LDPE cells and M30 grade concrete, and adherence to design standards such as IRC 44 and MORD specifications. Participants will learn the step-by-step construction process, from subgrade preparation to compaction and curing, and master the critical quality control tests required to ensure long-term performance. Upon completion, learners will be able to effectively plan, execute, and oversee CFCP projects, contributing to the creation of sustainable and low-maintenance rural road networks.

title: Cellular Concept GSM Architecture and GSM Radio
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the core technologies that underpin mobile networks. It begins with the fundamental cellular concept, explaining how geographic areas are divided into cells to enable frequency reuse and increase user capacity. You will learn about key techniques like cell splitting and sectoring. The course then provides an in-depth analysis of the GSM architecture, detailing the roles and functions of its primary components, including the Mobile Station (MS), Base Station Subsystem (BSS) with its BTS and BSC, and the Network Switching Subsystem (NSS) with the MSC and associated databases like HLR and VLR. Participants will also gain a clear understanding of crucial GSM identities such as IMEI, IMSI, and TMSI, which are vital for network operation and security. The final section focuses on the GSM radio interface, covering the principles of FDMA and TDMA, frequency bands, and the structure of physical and logical channels used for transmitting voice and data. Upon completion, learners will have a robust technical understanding of how GSM networks are structured and operate.

title: Cement Treated Base
desc: Enhancing rural connectivity requires the construction of durable and cost-effective roads. This course provides an in-depth understanding of cement-treated and cement-stabilized pavement layers, a critical technique in modern road engineering. It begins by establishing the foundational concepts of cement stabilization, detailing the appropriate materials, mix design procedures, and the advantages and limitations of this method. The curriculum then moves to practical applications, focusing on pavement design specifically for rural roads. Participants will learn the step-by-step construction process for creating cement-treated or cement-bound layers. A significant emphasis is placed on quality control and assurance aspects to guarantee the performance, longevity, and sustainability of the pavement. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to effectively plan, design, and oversee the construction of high-quality cement-treated road bases.

title: Central Civil Services (CCA) Rules 1965: An Overview and Suspension
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth exploration of the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965, a cornerstone of administrative governance in India. Understanding these rules is critical for public servants to ensure procedural fairness, maintain discipline, and uphold the integrity of the civil services. The course begins by defining key terminology and explaining the classification system and constitution of the CCS (CCA) Rules. Participants will learn to identify the specific entities and employee categories to which these rules apply or are exempt. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the concept of suspension. It covers the various circumstances leading to suspension, including deemed suspension, and clarifies situations where suspension is deemed desirable. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the applicable rules, allowances, and entitlements for an official during a period of suspension.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules 1964
desc: This foundational course delves into the critical provisions of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, which form the bedrock of ethical governance and professional integrity for government employees. The content is structured to provide a clear and systematic understanding of the expected conduct in public life. Key learning areas include maintaining absolute integrity, devotion to duty, political neutrality, and impartiality. The course details specific regulations concerning the acceptance of gifts, private trade or employment, investment protocols, and management of personal assets and liabilities. It also addresses crucial topics such as the prohibition of sexual harassment at the workplace, restrictions on media interaction, and the importance of confidentiality. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to navigate complex professional situations with confidence, ensure compliance, and uphold the highest standards of conduct expected of a civil servant, thereby contributing to a more transparent and accountable administration.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Central Deputation and Foreign Service: An Overview
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of the rules and regulations concerning central deputation and foreign service. It addresses the critical need for clarity on how temporary transfers are managed, which is essential for both administrative personnel and officers planning their career progression. The curriculum delves into the specifics of central and non-central staffing schemes, detailing the appointment process managed by the Civil Services Board and the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC). Participants will learn about the mandatory 'cooling-off' periods that follow deputation and their strategic implications. Furthermore, the course clarifies the distinct terms and conditions for foreign service, which are governed by administrative ministries and the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT).
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Central Deputation and Foreign Services
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of the rules and regulations concerning central deputation and foreign service. It addresses the critical need for clarity on how temporary transfers are managed, which is essential for both administrative personnel and officers planning their career progression.
