The curriculum delves into the specifics of central and non-central staffing schemes, detailing the appointment process managed by the Civil Services Board and the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC). Participants will learn about the mandatory 'cooling-off' periods that follow deputation and their strategic implications. Furthermore, the course clarifies the distinct terms and conditions for foreign service, which are governed by administrative ministries and the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT). Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate the procedural landscape of deputation and foreign service, ensuring compliance and informed decision-making.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Central Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme (CGEGIS)
desc: The Central Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme (CGEGIS) is a cornerstone of the social security framework for public servants in India. This course is designed to demystify the scheme, providing clear and detailed information that is crucial for every Central Government employee. Understanding CGEGIS is not just about financial planning; it is about ensuring that employees and their families are aware of the protections and benefits they are entitled to throughout their service and beyond. The program will guide learners through the core components of CGEGIS, starting with its purpose and scope. Key learning areas include a step-by-step explanation of how the scheme functions annually, the specific subscription rates applicable to different employee groups, and a thorough breakdown of the insurance coverage. A significant focus is placed on the benefits associated with career milestones like promotions and the critical support provided to families in the unfortunate event of an employee's death. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate the provisions of the CGEGIS, manage their contributions effectively, and understand the claims process, ensuring they can fully leverage this important welfare measure.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management
keywords: Central Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme

title: Central Government Health Scheme CGHS and Central Services MA Rules
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) and the Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, which are fundamental components of the welfare measures for government employees. The content is structured to provide officials, particularly those in administrative and human resources roles, with the necessary knowledge to correctly interpret and apply these regulations. Key learning areas include a comparative analysis of CGHS and CS(MA) rules, detailed breakdowns of eligibility criteria for employees and their dependents, the scope of medical coverage, and the procedures for outpatient and inpatient treatment. The course also covers the process for reimbursement of medical expenses and the functionalities of the CGHS wellness centers and empanelled hospitals. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently manage medical claims and provide accurate guidance to fellow employees, ensuring compliance and efficient utilization of these essential health benefits.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies Procedures and MSCS Act
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act, 2002 (as amended in 2023), including its structure, objectives, applicability, and key provisions governing multi-state cooperatives in India. Learners will gain insights into the powers and functions of the Central Registrar of Co-operative Societies (CRCS) and the statutory procedures related to registration, amendment of bye-laws, restructuring, conversion, and liquidation of societies. The course also covers governance frameworks, including the roles and responsibilities of members, boards, and chief executives. In addition, the course explains financial safeguards, audit and compliance requirements, dispute resolution mechanisms, and enforcement provisions such as inquiry, inspection, surcharge, penalties, and recovery of dues. Special emphasis is placed on liquidation, appeals, and review procedures.

title: Central Secretariat Functionaries - Role of an ASO
desc: Designed for new entrants and aspiring officials, this course delves into the specific operational landscape of an Assistant Section Officer (ASO) in the Central Secretariat. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundation in the essential day-to-day tasks that drive government administration. Key learning areas include the fundamentals of noting and drafting, correct procedures for file and records management, and the importance of adhering to the Central Secretariat Office Procedure Manual. Participants will learn how their role directly supports policy formulation and execution by ensuring that information flows correctly and decisions are documented accurately. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary procedural knowledge and confidence to perform their duties effectively and contribute meaningfully to public service.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Central Secretariat Functionaries - Role of an ASO (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम एक सहायक अनुभाग अधिकारी (एएसओ) के महत्वपूर्ण कार्यों पर प्रकाश डालता है, जो केंद्रीय सचिवालय के प्रशासनिक ढांचे में एक मौलिक भूमिका है। सार्वजनिक शासन के संदर्भ में, एएसओ मंत्रालयीन संचालन की रीढ़ होते हैं, जो फाइलों की सावधानीपूर्वक प्रोसेसिंग, नोटिंग, ड्राफ्टिंग और स्थापित प्रक्रियाओं का अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं। सरकारी कामकाज में दक्षता और जवाबदेही बनाए रखने के लिए इस भूमिका को समझना सर्वोपरि है। मुख्य शिक्षण क्षेत्रों में केंद्रीय सचिवालय की संरचना, कार्यालय प्रक्रिया नियमावली, नोटिंग और ड्राफ्टिंग के सिद्धांत, ई-ऑफिस सहित फाइल प्रबंधन प्रणाली, और एक एएसओ को सौंपे गए विशिष्ट कर्तव्य शामिल होंगे। पाठ्यक्रम आचरण नियमों और अंतर-विभागीय समन्वय के महत्व पर भी प्रकाश डालेगा। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा होने पर, शिक्षार्थी सचिवालय की प्रक्रियात्मक परिदृश्य में आत्मविश्वास से काम करने में सक्षम होंगे। वे आधिकारिक पत्राचार को संभालने, रिकॉर्ड को कुशलतापूर्वक प्रबंधित करने और नीति निर्माण एवं कार्यान्वयन प्रक्रिया में प्रभावी ढंग से योगदान करने के लिए सुसज्जित होंगे। यह कार्यक्रम एएसओ के रूप में अपनी यात्रा शुरू करने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए एक अनिवार्य मार्गदर्शिका है, जो इस महत्वपूर्ण लोक सेवा भूमिका में उत्कृष्टता प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक स्पष्टता और कौशल प्रदान करता है।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Central Secretariat Functionaries - Role of an Assistant Section Officer (ASO)
desc: The Assistant Section Officer (ASO) serves as a critical link in the administrative machinery of the Government of India's Central Secretariat. This course is meticulously designed to provide a thorough understanding of this essential role, which forms the backbone of policy implementation and office procedure. It addresses the importance of the ASO in ensuring the smooth functioning of government ministries and departments by handling files, drafting communications, and maintaining records according to established protocols. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the ASO's position within the Central Secretariat's structure, their core functions and duties as prescribed by the Manual of Office Procedure (MOP), and the specific actions required of them as dealing officers. The course also delves into the professional conduct and virtues expected of an ASO, such as diligence, integrity, and attention to detail. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently articulate their role, apply procedural knowledge to day-to-day tasks, and contribute effectively to the goals of their respective departments. This program is indispensable for functionaries preparing to take on or excel in the role of an Assistant Section Officer.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Centre for e- Governance Karnataka- Innovative Digital Solutions
desc: Delve into the transformative digital solutions implemented by the Centre for e-Governance in Karnataka. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the state's multi-layered data foundation, which is revolutionizing public administration. You will learn about the 'Kutumba' project, a state social registry that enables 'suo motu' service delivery and eliminates ineligible beneficiaries, and 'Mahiti Kanaja', a public information portal that enhances transparency and reduces the need for RTI applications. The session also covers the state's Data Policy, which establishes a clear framework for data classification, sharing, and governance, including the innovative 'e-Sahamathi' platform for secure, consent-based data exchange. Through practical examples and use cases, such as the rapid rollout of welfare schemes, you will understand how these integrated digital ecosystems improve efficiency, empower citizens, and position Karnataka as a leader in data-driven governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: CERT-In and Fundamentals of Cyber Hygiene
desc: In an era of increasing digital threats, maintaining robust cyber hygiene is crucial for the security of individuals and government organizations. This course is designed to equip participants with the fundamental knowledge and skills to navigate the digital world safely. It delves into the core aspects of cybersecurity, starting with the importance of proactive safety measures over reactive responses. Key learning areas include the creation and management of secure passwords, the identification and avoidance of phishing scams, the necessity of regular software and system updates, and the principles of secure browsing. The curriculum also explains the functions of the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In), detailing protocols for incident reporting and response.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Chandrayaan 3 - ISRO's Incredible Odyssey into Space
desc: Chandrayaan-3 is a historic milestone for ISRO, making India the first country to land near the Moon’s south pole. This mission demonstrated India’s growing capabilities in space technology, precision landing, and scientific exploration, inspiring national pride and marking a significant step forward in the global space community.

title: Change Management
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, the ability to manage organizational change is a crucial skill for public servants. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of change management, specifically tailored for the context of e-governance projects in India. You will begin by understanding what change management is and why it is vital for the success of government initiatives. The curriculum delves into key areas such as planning for change, identifying and managing resistance, and understanding the significance of people in the change process. It explores practical strategies to ensure smooth transitions, maintain morale, and secure stakeholder buy-in. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the foundational knowledge to support and contribute to change initiatives within your organization, helping to realize the full potential of digital governance for improved citizen service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Change Management
desc: In today's dynamic environment, the ability to manage organizational change is a critical skill for public servants. This course is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of change management principles and their practical application. It begins by defining change management and its importance, particularly within large public sector organizations like the Department of Posts. The curriculum systematically covers the four key types of organizational change: strategic, structural, cultural, and technological. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the human side of change. By examining the principles of neuropsychology, learners will gain insight into why employees may resist change and how to address these concerns proactively. You will be introduced to influential frameworks such as Kotter's 8-Step Change Model and the SCARF model to develop a structured approach to leading transitions. Upon completion, you will be better prepared to anticipate challenges, communicate effectively, and guide your teams toward embracing new processes and innovations, ultimately contributing to a more agile and resilient organization.

title: Change Management in Digital Transformation
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, successful digital transformation hinges on more than just implementing new systems; it requires effectively managing organizational and behavioral change. This course is designed for public sector professionals to navigate the complexities of this process. It provides a deep dive into why many digital projects fail due to neglecting the 'human factor' and offers a structured framework for leading successful transitions. Key learning areas include understanding the psychology of change, applying proven models to guide the process, and developing robust strategies for stakeholder engagement, communication, and training. Participants will explore real-world examples from both public and private sectors, learning how to anticipate and mitigate resistance, build consensus among leaders, and measure the impact of change initiatives. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to champion digital adoption, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and ensure that technology-driven projects deliver their intended value for citizens and the government.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Change Management in Digital Transformation Project
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, successfully managing digital transformation is crucial for modern governance. This course delves into the practical realities of implementing large-scale IT projects within the Indian public sector. It moves beyond theory to offer a comparative analysis of landmark projects: the successful Aadhaar initiative, the challenged digital overhaul of India Post, and the mixed results of the India Post Payments Bank (IPPB). Participants will dissect the core elements that drove success, such as strong leadership, agile contracting, and in-house technical expertise, while also learning from failures caused by poor change management, over-reliance on external consultants, and weak governance structures. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with a strategic framework to plan, execute, and lead digital transformation projects effectively, ensuring they deliver value, operate efficiently, and achieve their intended public service outcomes.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Changing Negative Self-Talk for Effective Self-Leadership
desc: In the demanding environment of public service, maintaining a positive and resilient mindset is crucial for effective leadership. This course provides government officials with the essential tools to overcome the common barrier of negative self-talk. It begins by establishing the context of why self-leadership is a foundational skill for professional growth and impactful governance. Key learning areas include techniques for identifying automatic negative thoughts, methods for reframing them into empowering beliefs, and strategies for building lasting self-confidence and resilience. Participants will explore how a cultivated positive mindset directly translates into improved clarity, stronger decision-making, and the ability to lead with conviction. Ultimately, this course empowers officials to unlock their full potential and drive positive outcomes in their roles.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Changing Role of Consumers
desc: In today's digitally transformed world, the relationship between power distribution companies (Discoms) and their consumers is undergoing a fundamental change. This course provides a comprehensive overview of this evolution, contextualized within the Indian power sector's journey towards enhanced consumer services. Participants will explore the shift from traditional utility operations to a modern, consumer-centric model. Key learning areas include understanding the heightened expectations of digitally savvy consumers, the emergence of 'prosumers' with decentralized energy generation, and the critical role of technology in this new paradigm. The course delves into practical strategies and digital touchpoints, such as virtual help desks, mobile applications, and WhatsApp-based services, that Discoms can implement to improve engagement, streamline processes like new connections and grievance redressal, and ultimately boost consumer satisfaction. By the end of this module, learners will be equipped to contribute to their organization's transition into a responsive, efficient, and future-ready digital utility.

title: Charges Amendments and Joint Trials Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the legal principles and procedures for framing criminal charges under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. The content is crucial for legal and law enforcement professionals adapting to India's new criminal laws, ensuring that charges are framed correctly to uphold justice. Key learning areas include a deep dive into Sections 234 to 247 of the BNSS, covering the form of charges, joinder of multiple charges, and the court's power to alter charges during a trial. The course also contrasts these new provisions with the previous Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) to highlight significant changes. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to draft legally sound charges, understand the procedural safeguards for the accused, and navigate the complexities of joint trials and convictions for lesser offenses, thereby contributing to fairer and more efficient criminal proceedings.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Chargesheet under CCS(CCA) Rules 1965
desc: This course delves into the procedural intricacies of handling disciplinary proceedings within the government framework. It begins by contextualizing the process with Article 311 of the Constitution, which provides protections to civil servants. The curriculum focuses on the practical aspects of drafting and issuing a chargesheet, covering the entire lifecycle from obtaining approval from the disciplinary authority to the final issuance. Key learning areas include distinguishing between major and minor penalty proceedings, formulating clear and unambiguous articles of charge, and annexing the necessary supporting documents. The course also highlights the significance of adhering to the principles of natural justice to ensure a fair inquiry. By referencing key Supreme Court rulings, learners will be equipped to draft legally robust chargesheets that can withstand judicial scrutiny, thereby strengthening administrative integrity.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: ChatGPT and Generative AI Tools for Government Officials
desc: In an era of digital transformation, government officials are increasingly required to process vast amounts of information and deliver services efficiently. This course, 'Harnessing ChatGPT and Generative AI for Public Administration,' is designed to equip non-technical officials with the skills to use powerful AI tools in their daily work. The curriculum provides a comprehensive overview of how generative AI can be a transformative assistant for administrative tasks. Key learning areas include mastering prompt engineering to extract and summarize information from lengthy policy documents, utilizing AI for rapid data analysis and visualization to support evidence-based decisions, and streamlining the creation of reports, presentations, and multilingual communications. The course also instills a critical mindset, teaching officials to assess the reliability and potential biases of AI-generated content.

desc: In an era of digital transformation, government officials are increasingly required to process vast amounts of information and deliver services efficiently. This course, 'Harnessing ChatGPT and Generative AI for Public Administration,' is designed to equip non-technical officials with the skills to use powerful AI tools in their daily work. By the end of this program, learners will be prepared to confidently and responsibly integrate generative AI into their workflows, boosting productivity and enhancing the quality of public service delivery.

title: ChatGPT and Generative AI tools: An Introduction
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, Generative AI stands out as a revolutionary force with the potential to transform public administration. This introductory course is meticulously designed for government officials to demystify this powerful technology. It begins by explaining the core concepts of Generative AI, machine learning, and neural networks, using accessible language. The curriculum then focuses on practical tools like ChatGPT, demonstrating their capabilities for tasks such as drafting policies, generating reports, and enhancing communication. The course will explore real-world use cases relevant to the government context, illustrating how AI can automate routine work, provide data-driven insights, and foster innovation in service delivery. By the end of this course, learners will not only grasp the fundamentals of Generative AI but also be able to identify opportunities for its application in their respective domains, paving the way for more efficient, responsive, and future-ready governance.

title: Checklist of Items During the Audits
desc: Designed to strengthen internal audit capabilities, this course offers a practical, structured approach to verification and compliance. It provides a detailed checklist of critical documents and records that are reviewed during internal audits, with a specific focus on the context of a government ministry. The curriculum is built around key audit areas, including the verification of financial records, expenditure tracking, procurement and tender documentation, employee service books, HR files, asset registers, and statutory filings like GPF and income tax. Participants will gain valuable insights by analyzing real-world case studies of common audit challenges, such as missing service records and irregular procurement. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to apply a systematic checklist, identify areas of non-compliance, and implement best practices to fortify internal controls, thereby promoting a culture of transparency and accountability in public service.

title: Chemical Emergencies -Disaster Response Training
desc: In an increasingly industrialized world, the risk of chemical emergencies poses a significant threat to public safety and the environment. This course, 'Disaster Response Training for Chemical Emergencies,' is designed to build essential awareness and preparedness among first responders and community volunteers. It provides a comprehensive overview of what constitutes a chemical emergency, its potential causes, and its far-reaching impacts. Participants will learn to identify the signs and symptoms of exposure to hazardous chemicals and understand the immediate precautionary steps required to ensure personal and public safety. The course explicitly details the crucial role volunteers can play, empowering them with the knowledge to support professional response teams like the NDRF. By the end of this training, learners will be better prepared to act responsibly and effectively during a chemical crisis, contributing to a more coordinated and successful disaster management operation.

title: Child Rights with Special Focus on Juvenile Justice System
desc: Protecting children and upholding their rights is a fundamental responsibility of a just society. This course addresses the critical need for public officials and stakeholders to be well-versed in the legal and social mechanisms designed for child welfare, particularly in light of challenges like child abuse and exploitation. It provides a foundational understanding of the principles and laws that govern child protection in India. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of child rights, exploring their evolution and social context. A significant portion is dedicated to the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015, breaking down its components and the distinct systems for children in conflict with the law and those in need of care. The course also covers various forms of exploitation, their consequences, and the legal remedies available. It highlights the specific roles and responsibilities of stakeholders, including police, judicial officers, and child welfare committees. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to interpret and apply child protection laws in practical scenarios. They will be able to contribute to a rights-based approach to child welfare, fostering better coordination between different service providers. This knowledge is essential for anyone involved in policy implementation, social work, law enforcement, or judicial processes concerning children, enabling them to act decisively and effectively to safeguard the rights and well-being of every child.
org: Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration (LBSNAA)

title: Circular Economy and Plastic Waste Management Regulations
desc: This course explores the concept of a circular economy as a strategic and sustainable solution to the growing challenge of plastic waste management. It moves beyond traditional waste disposal methods and focuses on a systems-based approach aimed at eliminating waste, extending material life cycles, and promoting resource efficiency. The course is grounded in the Plastic Waste Management (PWM) Rules, 2016, along with subsequent amendments, with special emphasis on Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). It provides a comprehensive understanding of the plastic value chain, including the production, consumption, segregation, collection, recycling, and final processing of plastic waste. Learners will examine the challenges posed by different categories of plastics, particularly single-use and multi-layered plastics, along with the regulatory and policy frameworks designed to manage them.

title: Circulating Fluidized Bed Combustion Boiler Technology
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Circulating Fluidized Bed Combustion (CFBC) Boiler Technology, focusing on clean energy generation, operational efficiency, and environmental compliance. It covers the evolution, principles, system architecture, key components, operational aspects, instrumentation and control systems, safety mechanisms, maintenance, and troubleshooting of CFBC boilers. The course is designed specifically for power sector professionals to build strong conceptual clarity along with practical operational knowledge of modern CFBC systems used in thermal power generation.

title: Citizen Centric Services
desc: This course delves into the operational framework for leveraging the Department of Posts' network for delivering citizen-centric services. It is designed for officials in government departments and managers in private entities who wish to partner with the Department of Posts. The content provides essential context on how this initiative enhances public access to services and fosters public-private collaboration, as sanctioned by Regulation 174 of the Post Office Regulations 2024. Key learning areas include a step-by-step guide to the proposal submission and approval process, the critical elements of formal agreements, and the management of inventory. Furthermore, the course offers a detailed breakdown of the financial aspects, including the structure of commissions, service charges, GST implications, and the procedures for payment settlements. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the procedural requirements for establishing a service delivery partnership with the Department of Posts, ensuring transparency and regulatory compliance.

title: Citizen Centric Services Marketing in Government
desc: This course empowers government and public sector professionals to effectively apply service marketing principles to citizen-facing programs and institutional outreach. It highlights the unique nature of services, various service quality frameworks, citizen-centric design, multichannel service delivery, service branding, and communication strategies. Using real-world examples from Indian governance—such as Passport Seva Kendras, Ayushman Bharat, Common Service Centres (CSCs), and digital platforms—the course illustrates how professional service marketing can enhance trust, satisfaction, transparency, and adoption of public services. It integrates technology, internal marketing, grievance redressal, and performance measurement to create a seamless and comprehensive citizen experience. Participants will be equipped to design, deliver, communicate, and continuously improve public services, thereby strengthening public perception and governance outcomes.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Citizen Service Delivery through Mana Mitra WhatsApp Services
desc: In an increasingly digital world, governance is evolving to become more accessible, efficient, and citizen-centric. This course introduces Mana Mitra – WhatsApp Governance, a Government of Andhra Pradesh initiative that delivers government services directly to citizens through simple WhatsApp interactions. Traditionally, accessing government services required physical visits, paperwork, and navigating complex administrative systems, which posed challenges, especially for rural and underserved communities. Mana Mitra transforms this experience by leveraging a platform millions already use, enabling citizens to access services anytime, anywhere, in real time. By the end of this course, learners will understand how digital platforms like WhatsApp can enhance the accessibility, efficiency, and inclusiveness of government services.

title: Civil Defence Services (नागरिक सुरक्षा सेवाएँ)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम भारत में नागरिक सुरक्षा के महत्वपूर्ण ढांचे की विस्तृत समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह बताता है कि कैसे नागरिक सुरक्षा संगठन आपातकालीन स्थितियों और आपदाओं के दौरान नागरिकों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कार्य करता है। पाठ्यक्रम मुख्यालय सेवाओं, संचार, वार्डन सेवाओं, हताहत सेवाओं, अग्निशमन, बचाव, और आपूर्ति श्रृंखला प्रबंधन सहित विभिन्न प्रभागों के कार्यों का गहन विश्लेषण करता है। शिक्षार्थी जानेंगे कि ये सभी सेवाएं संकट के समय जीवन और संपत्ति की रक्षा के लिए कैसे समन्वय करती हैं। यह पाठ्यक्रम आम नागरिकों, स्वयंसेvकों और सरकारी अधिकारियों को आपदाओं के लिए तैयार रहने, प्रभावी ढंग से प्रतिक्रिया करने और समुदाय के लचीलेपन में योगदान करने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान से लैस करेगा। इसका उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों में सामाजिक जिम्मेदारी की भावना पैदा करना और उन्हें अपने समुदायों को सुरक्षित बनाने में सक्रिय भूमिका निभाने के लिए प्रेरित करना है।

title: Civil Engineering Department in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Civil Engineering Department's functions and organizational structure across the Railway Board, zonal, and divisional levels of Indian Railways. It provides foundational knowledge on why this department is critical for the safety, efficiency, and expansion of the rail network. Key learning areas include an in-depth look at the Permanent Way (P-Way), covering its components like rails, sleepers, ballast, and fittings, alongside modern maintenance practices such as ultrasonic flaw detection. The course also explains the role of engineering workshops, the classification and safety features of level crossings, and the complex engineering required for bridges and tunnels in varied terrains. Furthermore, it details the standards for turnouts and crossings that enable flexible train movement and underscores the mandatory approval process by the Commissioner of Railway Safety (CRS) for all new projects. Upon completion, learners will have a robust understanding of the technical and procedural aspects of railway civil engineering.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Classification of Expenditure and Earnings on Indian Railways
desc: This course introduces the principles, structure, and rules governing the classification of expenditure and earnings in Indian Railways. Learners will explore the distinction between capital and revenue expenditure, the classification of earnings under Abstracts X, Y, and Z, and the importance of accurate classification for budgeting, accounting, and auditing. The course covers the 8-digit coding structure for capital and revenue expenditure, including Major Heads, Plan Heads, sources of funds, and Object Heads. Learners will apply classification rules to practical transactions, identify Plan Heads and funding sources, and understand common misclassification errors along with their audit implications.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM)

title: Classification of Goods
desc: This comprehensive course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and methodologies for the classification of goods under the Indian Customs Tariff, which is based on the World Customs Organization's (WCO) Harmonized System (HS) Nomenclature. Participants will learn the logical structure of the tariff, understanding how goods are systematically arranged from raw materials to finished products across 21 sections and 98 chapters. The curriculum emphasizes the critical role of Section Notes, Chapter Notes, and the General Rules for Interpretation (GIR) in ensuring uniform and precise classification. Through a detailed examination of the tariff schedule and its legal underpinnings, learners will develop the capability to correctly identify the appropriate tariff item for a wide range of products. This is a fundamental skill for the accurate assessment of customs duties, implementation of trade policies, and monitoring of controlled goods. The course is designed to empower customs officers, trade professionals, and government officials to navigate the complexities of tariff classification, thereby ensuring regulatory compliance and facilitating smoother international trade operations.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Classification of Goods and Services in GST
desc: This detailed course is designed to build a thorough understanding of the classification of goods and services within the Indian GST system. It begins by establishing the fundamental purpose and legal basis for classification, explaining why a structured approach is essential for tax administration and compliance. The course systematically covers the definitions of goods, services, supply, composite supply, and mixed supply as laid out in the CGST Act. A significant portion is dedicated to the practical application of the Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) and the Service Accounting Codes (SAC), providing learners with the tools to categorize items accurately. Furthermore, the curriculum offers an in-depth analysis of the General Rules of Interpretation (GIRs), which are crucial for resolving ambiguities and disputes in classification. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently interpret tax laws, apply the correct classification codes, determine appropriate GST rates, and ensure accurate tax assessment for a wide range of products and services.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Classification of Goods and Services under Goods and Services Tax
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the classification of goods and services under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) framework in India. It introduces the purpose and legal basis of classification and explains its importance in determining the applicable tax rate and ensuring accurate tax administration and compliance. The course covers key concepts and definitions under the CGST Act, 2017, including goods, services, supply, composite supply, and mixed supply. It also focuses on the practical application of the Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) for goods and Service Accounting Codes (SAC) for services. Learners will further explore the General Rules for the Interpretation (GIRs) under the Customs Tariff Act, which provide a structured approach to resolving classification issues and disputes.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Classification of Goods under Customs Tariff
desc: This comprehensive training provides an in-depth understanding of the principles and methodologies used for the classification of goods under the Indian Customs Tariff, which is based on the World Customs Organization’s (WCO) Harmonized System (HS) Nomenclature. Participants will learn the logical structure of the tariff and how goods are systematically classified across 21 Sections and 98 Chapters, from raw materials to finished products. The training emphasizes the importance of Section Notes, Chapter Notes, Heading and Sub-heading structures, and the General Rules for Interpretation (GIR) in ensuring accurate, consistent, and legally appropriate classification of goods. Participants will also explore the tariff schedule and its legal framework to develop the ability to identify the appropriate tariff classification for different products.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Classification of Industrial Sectors Based on Pollution Index
desc: This course provides a comprehensive framework for the classification of industrial sectors to support progressive environmental management in India. It is structured into five modules that cover the evolution of sector classification, followed by a detailed explanation of the methodology, including scoring criteria. Participants will gain insights into the categorisation of sectors based on industrial activities, including new and previously unclassified sectors. The course also highlights incentives for industries adopting environmentally responsible practices and explains the practical application of classification, along with guidelines for regulators. By combining conceptual understanding with practical application, the course equips participants to effectively classify industrial sectors based on the pollution index.

title: Classification of Stations
desc: This course delves into the fundamental principles behind the classification of stations across the vast Indian Railways network. It is designed to explain why and how stations are categorized to meet specific operational and traffic management needs. The course begins by defining key concepts such as 'station section', 'station limit', and 'block section', which form the basis of railway operations. Learners will gain a detailed understanding of the primary station categories: block stations, which control train movement between sections, and non-block stations. The curriculum thoroughly examines the different classes of block stations (Class A, B, and C) and non-block stations (Class D), highlighting their unique signaling requirements, shunting capabilities, and roles in maintaining line capacity and ensuring the safe passage of trains. By the end of this course, participants will be able to appreciate the systematic approach Indian Railways employs to manage its complex network, ensuring both efficiency and safety in train operations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Classification of Stores
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the principles of classifying and managing stores within the Indian Railways system. It establishes the context by explaining why a systematic approach to inventory is crucial for the vast operational needs of the railways, covering everything from daily maintenance to long-term projects. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of stock items (frequently used materials) versus non-stock items (procured on-demand), and the specific roles of sub-categories like ordinary, emergency, surplus, special, custody, and imprest stores. Learners will understand the lifecycle of store items, from procurement and stocking to the identification and disposal of surplus or inactive materials. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these classification and inventory management best practices to enhance operational efficiency, ensure material availability, control costs, and contribute to the seamless functioning of the railway's supply chain.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Classification, Character and Status of Posts
desc: This foundational course delves into the essential principles of post classification in the Indian government. It is designed for public officials seeking to understand the structured hierarchy and categorization of the Union Civil Services. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the criteria that define a post's classification, such as its rank in the pay matrix, whether it is ministerial or non-ministerial, its tenure, and its gazetted status. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of service rules and establishment matters, enabling them to distinguish between different types of posts. By the end of the course, learners will be able to apply this knowledge to identify their own post's classification and understand its implications for their career, responsibilities, and the overall administrative structure. This understanding is crucial for effective functioning and career progression within the civil services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Clearing the Path: Reforming the Right of Way for Digital India
desc: This case study explores how the Department of Telecommunications in India addressed critical Right of Way (RoW) issues hindering telecom infrastructure expansion at state level between 2021 and 2023. The Licensed Telecom Service providers and Infrastructure Providers faced significant delays, complex procedures, exorbitant charges, and non-uniform RoW policies across various Indian states. The COVID-19 pandemic intensified the urgency for resolving these issues due to increased reliance on digital connectivity. Strategic interventions included setting up a dedicated National Broadband Mission (NBM) Directorate, consistent stakeholder engagement, periodic review, progress linked escalation, inclusion of RoW in high-level governmental review meetings (e.g. Pragati Review Meetings chaired by the Prime Minister) and digital monitoring via the GatiShakti Sanchar portal. These steps notably reduced application processing times and significantly decreased application pendency.

title: CLICK N BOOK
desc: This course introduces the 'Click N Book' service, a digital initiative by India Post designed to make postal services more customer-friendly and technologically advanced. The program is structured to provide a clear understanding of how this online portal revolutionizes the way customers interact with postal logistics. You will learn about the simple registration process on the India Post website, which is the first step to accessing this convenient service. The course delves into the core functionalities, such as booking consignments, scheduling pickups for articles, and making payments through a secure online gateway. It also covers the practical aspects and terms of service, including article weight limits, pickup charges, available time slots, and the process for tracking consignments. By the end of this course, you will be fully equipped to use the Click N Book service, appreciating its efficiency and its importance in providing accessible postal solutions for everyone, especially those unable to visit a post office during standard working hours.

title: Client Acquisition Mastery for Marketing Executives
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip marketing executives, particularly within the public sector context of India Post, with the mastery to drive business growth through effective client acquisition. The program establishes a foundational understanding of why client acquisition is critical for increasing revenue, market share, and organizational stability. Participants will delve into a structured, step-by-step approach to attracting and converting customers. Key learning areas include conducting in-depth market research, performing demographic and psychographic analysis, and creating detailed customer personas to guide marketing efforts. The course provides a practical framework for developing powerful value propositions that resonate with customer needs and differentiate services from competitors. Learners will also explore proven strategies for lead nurturing, personalized communication, and building trust to guide potential clients through the decision-making process. Finally, the curriculum underscores the pivotal role of excellent customer service in retaining clients and enhancing brand reputation, ensuring long-term success.

title: Climate and Disaster Resilient Cities Preparedness
desc: This course provides urban administrators, planners, and governance professionals with the knowledge and tools required to develop climate-resilient and disaster-prepared cities. It explores the growing risks posed by climate-related hazards such as urban flooding, cyclones, heatwaves, and other extreme weather events, and highlights the importance of integrating disaster risk reduction into urban planning and development. Drawing on relevant National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) guidelines and urban resilience frameworks, the course covers climate risk and vulnerability assessment, resilience planning, and the implementation of structural and non-structural mitigation measures. Emphasizing preparedness, prevention, and risk reduction, the course enables learners to strengthen urban resilience, minimize disaster impacts, and support sustainable recovery and long-term urban sustainability.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Climate Change and Public Health in India
desc: The course is designed to help government officials and health professionals understand the growing impact of climate change on human health and the measures required to strengthen health system resilience. Climate change is increasingly affecting health outcomes through extreme weather events, rising temperatures, air pollution, food and water insecurity, and the spread of climate-sensitive diseases. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the science of climate change, its direct and indirect health impacts, and the unique challenges faced in the Indian context. Participants will explore the needs of vulnerable populations, the principles of climate-resilient health systems, and the role of surveillance, early warning systems, and preparedness measures in addressing climate-related health risks.

title: Climate Change Learning Through Actions
desc: Climate Change Learning Through Actions offers an in-depth exploration into one of the most pressing global challenges of our time. The course is structured to provide a clear understanding of the science behind climate change, including the causes of global warming and its far-reaching environmental and societal impacts. It is particularly relevant for public sector professionals, as it delves into the national and international policy frameworks designed to address these challenges, offering insights into how governance can drive sustainability. Key learning areas include climate mitigation techniques, adaptation strategies, and the importance of renewable energy. Learners will analyze real-world case studies that demonstrate effective climate initiatives and innovative, eco-friendly solutions. Upon completion, participants will be empowered to apply sustainable practices in their professional and personal capacities, contribute to carbon footprint reduction, and champion climate resilience within their communities and organizations.

title: Climate Resilient Agriculture
desc: Climate Resilient Agriculture (CRA) is a strategic approach to transforming agricultural systems to ensure food security and sustainability in the context of climate change. This course provides participants with a comprehensive understanding of climate science and its impact on agriculture, along with practical, field-level solutions for adaptation and mitigation. It covers climate-smart crop management practices, enabling policy and institutional frameworks, and the role of technology and innovation in strengthening agricultural resilience. Participants will also explore financial mechanisms that support climate adaptation, along with real-world case studies and community-based approaches that demonstrate scalable and sustainable implementation of CRA. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped to design and implement climate-resilient agricultural strategies suited to diverse agro-climatic conditions, with a special focus on Indian agriculture.
org: Department of Agriculture and Farmers welfare

title: Closed Circuit Television: The Vigilant Eyes of Delhi Metro
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) surveillance infrastructure that is critical to the operations and security of the Delhi Metro. In the context of growing urban transport networks, ensuring public safety is paramount. This program explains how DMRC leverages a vast, closed-network of over 13,000 cameras to monitor public areas, manage crowds, and secure strategic locations. Key learning areas include the basic system architecture, from cameras to monitoring stations, and the different types of cameras used, such as Fixed, Dome, PTZ, and IR cameras, along with their specific applications. The course also covers the technological backbone of the system, including network connectivity, Power over Ethernet (PoE), and the digital recording systems like NVRs with RAID storage for data redundancy and retrieval. Upon completion, learners will understand the integral role of CCTV technology in maintaining safe, secure, and efficient operations across the Delhi Metro premises.

title: Cloud Computing Service Models
desc: This course introduces learners to the four major cloud platforms that dominate both global and Indian digital ecosystems: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and NIC–MeghRaj Cloud, India’s national government cloud initiative. The course explains how these platforms serve diverse sectors, including enterprises, research institutions, startups, and government services. Learners will explore the unique strengths, service offerings, and innovations of each platform, gaining insight into their roles in modern digital infrastructure. The course also highlights the transition from traditional on-premise computing to cloud-based solutions, emphasizing scalability, flexibility, cost-efficiency, and global accessibility.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloud Network Security and Zero Trust Architecture
desc: Cloud computing has transformed the way organizations build, deploy, and manage applications, enabling greater scalability, flexibility, and operational efficiency. However, as organizations increasingly rely on cloud platforms, the traditional network security model based on perimeter defences has become inadequate. Modern cloud environments are highly dynamic, distributed, and interconnected, with users, applications, devices, and workloads communicating across multiple locations and platforms. In such an environment, security can no longer rely solely on trusted internal networks. Instead, organizations must adopt a security model that continuously verifies every user, device, application, and workload before granting access.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloud Networking Essentials
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Cloud Networking, covering IP addressing, subnetting, route decision-making, NAT and gateway concepts, load balancers, and network traffic flow. It integrates foundational and advanced networking principles, showing how a single user request travels through a modern cloud environment—from DNS resolution to subnet isolation, NAT-enabled communication, and load-balanced traffic—enabling learners to visualize and manage complex cloud networks effectively.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloud Security
desc: In an era of rapid cloud adoption within the public sector, securing digital assets is paramount. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the critical pillars of cloud security, tailored for government departments and large enterprises. You will delve into the nuances of creating a robust cloud deployment architecture, ensuring data residency, and complying with India’s data protection laws. The curriculum explores the practical implementation of the Zero Trust model, including identity management, micro-segmentation, and device posture validation. Furthermore, the course demystifies the application of emerging technologies like Generative AI in supercharging security operations, from automated threat modeling to incident response playbooks. Learners will also examine future challenges, such as quantum computing's impact on encryption and the rise of AI-generated attacks. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the strategic knowledge to design, implement, and manage a secure, compliant, and resilient cloud ecosystem.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloud Security
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, understanding and implementing robust cloud security is paramount for government and public sector organizations. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices required to secure cloud environments effectively. It begins by addressing common cloud security challenges and the necessity of integrating security without hindering innovation. Learners will delve into the core pillars of a well-architected cloud framework, with a special focus on the security pillar. Key topics covered include establishing a strong identity foundation, ensuring traceability, applying security at all layers, automating best practices, protecting data in transit and at rest, and preparing for security incidents. The course also clarifies the shared responsibility model, outlining the distinct security duties of the cloud provider and the consumer. By the end of this session, participants will be able to strategize and design a comprehensive security posture for their organization's cloud workloads, from initial identification of risks to post-incident remediation.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloud Security: Designing Security Infrastructure
desc: In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, balancing security with the speed of innovation is a critical challenge. This course, 'Designing Secure Cloud Infrastructure for Innovation,' addresses this by offering in-depth strategies for building a secure and resilient cloud environment. The curriculum is structured around the AWS Well-Architected Framework, focusing on the security pillar to provide a holistic understanding of cloud security. Key learning areas include establishing a strong identity foundation with the principle of least privilege, implementing a multi-layered 'defense in depth' strategy, and ensuring data protection through encryption and access controls. The course also covers the importance of traceability through comprehensive logging and monitoring, automating security best practices to respond to events swiftly, and preparing for security incidents with well-defined response and remediation plans. Upon completion, cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and security professionals will be equipped to design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions that accelerate organizational innovation.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloud Services for Governance
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, leveraging cloud computing is essential for modernizing public services. This course offers a strategic and practical guide for government professionals on utilizing cloud technologies to build efficient, secure, and citizen-centric e-governance platforms. The program begins with the fundamentals, demystifying cloud service models like Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS), alongside various deployment models. The course delves into the specific challenges and opportunities within the public sector, covering critical topics such as India's cloud policies (MeitY), data sovereignty, and compliance with national standards like those from CERT-In. Participants will explore robust security frameworks, including identity and access management (IAM), disaster recovery planning, and business continuity strategies tailored for government operations. Through case studies and discussions on frameworks like the National Data Governance Framework Policy, learners will gain the capability to plan, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure, ultimately driving data-driven governance and enhancing public service delivery.
org: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani)

title: Cloud Traffic Management: DNS and Load Balancing and Optimiza
desc: Modern cloud applications are expected to deliver seamless performance, high availability, and uninterrupted user experiences, regardless of user location or fluctuations in demand. Achieving these objectives requires more than simply deploying applications in the cloud. Organizations must intelligently manage how network traffic is routed, distributed, monitored, and optimized across multiple servers, regions, and cloud environments. Cloud Traffic Management focuses on the technologies and practices used to efficiently direct application traffic, maintain service availability during failures, optimize infrastructure resources, and ensure consistent application performance. The course introduces key concepts such as DNS services, traffic routing, load balancing, traffic optimization, and high availability, enabling learners to understand how these components work together in modern cloud networking environments.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cloudburst-Disaster Response Training
desc: Cloudbursts represent a significant natural hazard, capable of causing widespread destruction in a very short period. This course is designed to build awareness and preparedness among government functionaries, disaster response teams, and community volunteers. It begins by explaining the meteorological science behind cloudbursts, detailing how and why they occur. The curriculum then moves to the tangible consequences, illustrating the potential for flash floods, landslides, and infrastructure damage. A key focus of the course is on proactive and reactive measures. You will learn about various mitigation strategies that can be implemented at both community and administrative levels to minimize loss of life and property. The content covers a practical list of do's and don'ts to follow if caught in a cloudburst situation, emphasizing immediate safety protocols. Furthermore, the course underscores the invaluable contribution of volunteers and organizations like the NDRF, outlining how coordinated efforts are critical for effective rescue, relief, and recovery operations. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to understand, prepare for, and respond to cloudburst-related emergencies.

title: Clubbing of Income
desc: This course delves into the critical provisions related to the clubbing of income as stipulated in the Income Tax Act, 1961. It is designed to equip tax professionals and finance officers with the knowledge to identify and correctly handle cases of deemed income. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of Sections 60 through 64, explaining the nuances of income transfer, asset transfer, and their tax implications. Participants will learn to analyze situations involving income transfers to spouses, minor children, and other relatives, and understand the specific exceptions where these clubbing provisions do not apply. By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply these complex legal rules to practical, real-world scenarios, ensuring accurate tax assessment and compliance while upholding the integrity of the tax administration system. This knowledge is essential for anyone involved in direct tax assessment, advisory, or financial planning within the government sector.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Co-treatment of Faecal Sludge and Septage with Sewage at STP
desc: As Indian cities continue to expand, the challenge of managing faecal sludge and septage becomes increasingly critical. This course offers a specialized curriculum focused on co-treatment, an innovative and practical solution for integrated wastewater management. It delves into the technical and operational aspects of combining faecal sludge and septage with sewage for treatment in existing STPs. Participants will learn to assess the feasibility of STPs for co-treatment by analyzing hydraulic and organic loading capacities. The content covers the entire lifecycle, from initial data collection and planning to the design of septage receiving stations, and the implementation of standard operating procedures for effective operation and maintenance. The course is aligned with national programs such as AMRUT 2.0, SBM-U 2.0, and the Smart Cities Mission, empowering urban managers and engineers to implement sustainable sanitation solutions. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to plan and execute co-treatment projects, ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines and contributing to the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation).
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title: Coal and its Exploration
desc: Delve into the world of coal with this detailed e-learning course designed for geology and mining professionals. The program begins by establishing a strong foundation in the genesis of coal, explaining the coalification process and the factors that determine coal rank and quality. You will gain insights into the geological and geographical distribution of India's vital coal resources, providing context for their strategic importance. The course then transitions to the technical aspects of coal characterization. You will learn the procedures for proximate and ultimate analysis, understand the significance of calorific value and coking properties, and explore coal petrography to identify macerals like vitrinite and inertinite. The final modules are dedicated to the systematic process of coal exploration, covering the stages from initial reconnaissance and prospecting to detailed exploration using geological mapping, geophysical surveys, and borehole drilling. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the knowledge to understand coal as a resource and the methodologies used to discover and evaluate coal deposits.

title: Coal Bed Methane and Coal Gasification Technologies
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of coal-based unconventional energy technologies and their pivotal role in India's evolving energy landscape. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the transition towards cleaner and more secure energy sources. The curriculum is structured into four distinct modules covering Coal Bed Methane (CBM), Coal Mine Methane (CMM), Surface Coal Gasification (SCG), and Underground Coal Gasification (UCG). Participants will delve into the core principles of methane generation, extraction techniques, and reservoir management. The course also covers gasification processes, syngas production, and the application of these technologies in creating cleaner fuels and chemicals. Throughout the modules, the course emphasizes national energy targets, regulatory frameworks, environmental considerations, and global best practices. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to analyze the technical, economic, and environmental implications of these emerging energy options, contributing to the strategic and responsible use of India's coal assets.

title: Coal Exploration: An Overview
desc: This comprehensive course offers a foundational understanding of the end-to-end process of coal exploration and resource estimation. It begins by establishing the context of coal's importance in the energy sector and its economic significance. Learners will then delve into the core phases of exploration, examining the key activities involved in identifying and assessing coal deposits. The modules detail geological mapping, surface geophysical methods, borehole drilling, and core logging, explaining the tools and safety practices integral to subsurface exploration. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to developing skills for evaluating and interpreting coal resource data, including the analysis of drilling results to determine coal quality and quantity. The course concludes with an introduction to the Indian Standard Procedure (ISP) for Coal Resource Estimation, equipping participants with the knowledge to apply standardized methods for reporting. Upon completion, learners will have a robust understanding of the entire exploration lifecycle, making this course valuable for anyone entering or working in the mining and energy sectors.

title: Coal Washing and Beneficiation Technologies
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the science and engineering behind coal beneficiation, the critical process of enhancing mined coal quality by reducing impurities like ash and moisture. The curriculum begins by establishing context, covering the fundamentals of coal formation, its various types, and their impact on industrial use. You will delve into key learning areas including essential coal characterization techniques such as proximate, ultimate, and washability analysis, which are vital for selecting effective beneficiation methods. The course details the core unit operations within coal preparation plants, including screening, crushing, classification, and dewatering. A special focus is placed on coal cleaning technologies, particularly gravity-based methods like jigging. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze how coal beneficiation supports sustainable energy goals and apply their knowledge to interpret characterization data for making informed processing decisions, contributing to a more efficient and cleaner energy sector.

title: Code of Conduct for Government Employees
desc: This foundational course delves into the specifics of the Code of Conduct for Government Employees, primarily based on the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964. It is designed to equip public servants with a clear understanding of the standards of behavior and professional ethics required in their roles. The program covers key areas such as integrity, impartiality, political neutrality, and the avoidance of conflicts of interest. Participants will learn to navigate complex professional situations by applying these principles, ensuring their actions align with the highest standards of public service. By the end of this course, learners will be better prepared to uphold the values of the civil service, mitigate risks of misconduct, and contribute to a more transparent and efficient administration, thereby strengthening the foundation of public trust.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management
