title: Code of Conduct Rules for Scientists and Technologists
desc: This program is designed to familiarize Central Government employees with the foundational principles of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964. The course delves into the code of conduct that every government servant is expected to uphold, providing clarity on standards of integrity, impartiality, and devotion to duty. Key learning areas include understanding restrictions on activities such as accepting gifts, engaging in private trade or business, and participating in political activities. It also details actions that require prior permission from the competent authority. Using practical examples, case studies, and interactive quizzes, the course explains how to navigate complex situations involving potential conflicts of interest, management of private affairs, and communication of official information. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to perform their duties with a clear understanding of the ethical and procedural framework, thereby strengthening accountability and maintaining the dignity of public service.

title: Code on Social Security 2020
desc: The Code on Social Security, 2020, consolidates and amends the laws relating to social security with the objective to extend benefits to all employees and workers in both the organised and unorganised sectors. This introductory course is designed to familiarise public officials with its critical aspects. The curriculum delves into the applicability of the Code, explaining which establishments and worker types are covered. It outlines the structure and responsibilities of the National and State Social Security Boards. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to detailing the provisions for various benefits, including provident fund, insurance, maternity benefits, and compensation for injury. Furthermore, the course clarifies the legal framework surrounding employer obligations, offenses, and the corresponding penalties for non-compliance. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to interpret the Code's provisions and understand its role in creating a robust social security system for India's workforce.
org: V V Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) - Noida

title: Code on Wages
desc: This introductory course is designed to familiarize learners with the essential aspects of the Code on Wages. The Code represents a major step in reforming India's labour laws by amalgamating, simplifying, and rationalizing complex provisions of previous wage-related legislation. The curriculum delves into the historical context that necessitated this change and clarifies important terminology used within the new legal framework. Participants will learn about the key features of the Wage Bill, including its applicability and the calculation of wages. The course also details the classification of the four new labour codes to provide a broader context. Furthermore, it outlines the specific offences and penalties for non-compliance and lists the four central labour enactments that have been subsumed by this single, comprehensive code. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand the core principles and structure of the new wage legislation.
org: V V Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) - Noida

title: Cold Mix Technology for Rural Roads
desc: This course provides a detailed understanding of bituminous cold mix technology, an innovative and sustainable method for pavement construction and maintenance. It is designed for civil engineering students, field engineers, and professionals involved in road construction who seek to adopt environmentally friendly and cost-effective alternatives to conventional paving techniques. The course emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical application, focusing on materials, laboratory testing, construction practices, and quality control measures associated with cold mix technology. By the end of the course, learners will have gained a comprehensive understanding of bituminous cold mix technology and its practical applications. They will be equipped with the knowledge required to select appropriate materials, carry out construction operations, and implement effective quality control measures.

title: Cold Wave-Disaster Response Training
desc: This training program is designed to build critical response capabilities for cold wave disasters. The course begins by defining what constitutes a cold wave and exploring its primary causes and effects on human health. It provides an in-depth understanding of cold-related injuries such as hypothermia and frostbite, offering clear, step-by-step guidance on pre-hospital treatment that can be administered by first responders and volunteers. A key focus of the course is empowering learners with the knowledge of preventive measures to protect individuals and communities from the severe impacts of cold waves. Furthermore, the curriculum details the specific roles and responsibilities of volunteers, highlighting how their organized efforts contribute significantly to community safety and resilience during such emergencies. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to act effectively and provide immediate care in cold wave scenarios.

title: Combating Antibiotic Resistance: A Stewardship-Based Approach
desc: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is one of the most serious global public health threats, contributing to millions of deaths worldwide. It occurs when microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites develop resistance to antimicrobial medicines, making standard treatments less effective and increasing the risk of disease spread, severe illness, and death. This self-paced course introduces learners to the fundamental concepts of AMR and the critical role of Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS) in addressing this challenge. AMS is an evidence-based approach that promotes the rational use of antimicrobials to improve patient outcomes, reduce resistance, and strengthen healthcare systems. The course combines video lectures, presentations, reflection activities, and assessments to build a strong understanding of antimicrobial use and stewardship practices. The course is designed for clinicians, nurses, pharmacists, laboratory technicians and public health professionals.

title: Combating the Covid-19 Pandemic in India
desc: The Har Ghar Tikakaran campaign, led by Dr. Veena Dhawan and her team, exemplifies a successful national effort in overcoming challenges during the Covid-19 vaccination drive through unity, determination, and exemplary cooperation.

title: Combustion in Internal Combustion Engines
desc: This course offers an in-depth technical overview of combustion in internal combustion engines, tailored for engineering students and technical professionals. It begins by explaining the fundamental principles of converting chemical energy into mechanical work in both petrol and diesel engines. The core of the course focuses on the four distinct stages of combustion in compression ignition engines: ignition delay, rapid combustion, controlled combustion, and after-burning, illustrated with pressure-crank angle diagrams. A significant portion is dedicated to the function and mechanics of fuel injectors, covering critical concepts like atomization and penetration. Learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of various injector faults, such as leakage, weak springs, and poor atomization, and learn to diagnose their effects, including carbon deposits, increased emissions, and reduced power. The course concludes by emphasizing the necessity of proper maintenance procedures to ensure the reliability and efficiency of marine and other heavy-duty diesel engines.

title: Command Area Development and Participatory Irrigation Management
desc: This course delves into the essential concepts of Command Area Development (CAD) and Participatory Irrigation Management (PIM). It addresses the long-standing challenge of underutilization of irrigation potential in India by presenting a structured approach to water management. Learners will explore the journey of the CAD program from its inception in 1974 to its current form under the PMKSY's 'Har Khet Ko Pani' initiative. The modules detail both structural interventions, such as on-farm development and drain construction, and non-structural interventions like the formation of Water Users' Associations (WUAs) and farmer training. The course highlights the shift towards a participatory model, empowering farmers to take ownership of water distribution and system maintenance. By the end of this course, participants will understand the framework for implementing CAD and PIM, recognize the challenges involved, and be equipped with knowledge of remedial measures to ensure the equitable, efficient, and sustainable use of irrigation water, ultimately improving agricultural output and the socio-economic conditions of farmers.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: North Eastern Regional Institute of Water and Land Management (NERIWALM)

title: Command Logistic and Unmanned Systems in Defence
desc: Delving into the operational backbone of land-based military forces, this course provides a comprehensive overview of command systems, logistics, and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). It addresses the strategic importance of sustaining combat operations through effective supply chain management, troop movement, and robust communication networks. The curriculum highlights India's indigenous progress in defence technology, featuring innovations in logistics vehicles, battlefield communication systems, and the expanding role of UGVs in reconnaissance and support missions. Through an analysis of operational experiences and case studies like Operation Parakram, learners will understand the practical challenges and solutions in managing land systems across diverse and complex environments. This course is designed to equip defence professionals with the knowledge to enhance coordination, mobility, and overall operational effectiveness on the modern battlefield.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Commemorative Postage Stamp
desc: Commemorative postage stamps serve as unique cultural artifacts, celebrating India's rich heritage, significant milestones, and esteemed personalities. This course delves into the official framework governing their creation, from initial proposal to final release. It is designed to demystify the process for all interested individuals, explaining why these stamps are a vital part of national identity. Key learning areas include a step-by-step guide to preparing and submitting a proposal, a detailed review of the evaluation guidelines set by the government, and an understanding of the role played by the Philatelic Advisory Committee. Upon completion, learners will not only appreciate the value of commemorative stamps but also be equipped with the necessary knowledge to contribute a proposal that meets all official requirements, potentially shaping a piece of India's philatelic history.

title: Commercial inspections in Indian Railways
desc: Dive into the essential practices of commercial inspections with this detailed course tailored for Indian Railways personnel. The program establishes the fundamental importance of systematic inspections as a tool for management, control, and operational excellence at railway stations. You will explore the core objectives driving these inspections, from maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and passenger amenities to ensuring staff are well-versed in their duties and safety protocols. A significant focus is placed on the critical area of revenue protection, covering the prevention of ticketless travel, detection of undercharges, and secure cash handling procedures. The course walks learners through the prescribed frequencies and detailed procedures for inspections conducted by Station Masters, Commercial Inspectors, and Officers. You will learn how to meticulously check records, manage public complaints, verify stock, and assess overall station performance. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in completing and submitting comprehensive inspection reports, providing constructive feedback to staff, and contributing directly to the integrity and efficiency of Indian Railways' commercial operations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Common Mistakes during Internal Audit
desc: In the complex environment of public administration, maintaining financial and procedural integrity is paramount. This course offers an in-depth analysis of frequent mistakes identified during internal audits, providing a critical learning opportunity for officials involved in finance, accounts, and administration. The program delves into specific case studies that reveal how seemingly minor errors in areas like pay fixation, procurement outside the Government e-Marketplace (GeM), Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on GST, and incomplete service verification can escalate into significant financial losses and policy violations. By exploring the context and consequences of these mistakes, learners will understand the 'why' behind stringent compliance. Participants will learn to dissect audit observations, identify root causes, and apply recommended corrective actions and best practices. This will strengthen their ability to make sound decisions, ensure robust compliance with government regulations, and contribute to a more efficient and transparent governance framework.

title: Common Mistakes in Construction of Civil Structures
desc: In the field of civil engineering, the quality of construction is paramount to ensuring public safety and the long-term viability of infrastructure. This course delves into the critical subject of common mistakes made during the construction of civil structures, with a primary focus on concrete-related defects. It provides a comprehensive overview of why these issues are a major concern, explaining how they can compromise a structure's design life and lead to significant resource wastage. Key learning areas include the identification and analysis of prevalent defects like honeycombing, cold joints, improper curing, segregation, and premature formwork removal. The curriculum thoroughly examines the underlying causes, from improper vibration and stiff concrete mixes to the use of poor-quality water and incorrect reinforcement placement. By understanding these pitfalls, learners will be empowered to apply preventive quality control measures on-site. The course also covers appropriate remedial methods for existing defects, ensuring that professionals can make informed decisions to maintain structural integrity and contribute to building a resilient and developed nation.

title: Common Myths and Disbeliefs
desc: In an era of information overload, the ability to discern credible facts from pervasive myths is a crucial skill for any public servant. This course is designed to equip you with the essential tools of critical thinking to navigate this complex landscape. You will begin by understanding the nature of common myths, how they originate from cultural stories or outdated information, and why they persist despite contrary evidence. The course delves into the psychology of disbelief and skepticism, analyzing the cognitive biases that make individuals resistant to factual information. Key learning areas include frameworks for evaluating sources, identifying logical fallacies, and applying evidence-based reasoning. By the end of this course, you will not only be able to debunk common misconceptions but also be proficient in promoting accurate knowledge, a vital competency for effective governance and transparent public service.

title: COMMON SIZE STATEMENTS
desc: Gain a critical skill in financial analysis with this in-depth course on Common Size Statements. The program is designed for professionals who need to interpret financial data to make informed business decisions. You will begin by understanding the fundamental importance of financial analysis and the various tools available, with a specific focus on common size statements. The course details the process of creating common size income statements, using revenue as the base, and common size balance sheets, using total assets as the base. Through this vertical analysis method, you will learn to dissect a company's performance, identify its strengths and weaknesses, and spot trends in its cost structure and asset allocation. The curriculum covers both intra-firm analysis (comparing a company's performance over time) and inter-firm analysis (benchmarking against competitors), equipping you with the ability to assess financial soundness and support strategic decision-making for any organization.

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Bangla
desc: সাধারণ যোগা প্রোটোকল (CYP) কোর্সটি आयुष मंत्रालय, ভারত সরকার দ্বারা তৈরি করা হয়েছে, যা সমস্ত স্তরের অনুশীলনকারীদের জন্য যোগের একটি মানসম্মত কাঠামো প্রদান করে। এই কোর্সটি शारीरिक ও मानसिक স্বাস্থ্যের উন্নতির জন্য একটি समग्र दृष्टिकोण प्रस्तुत করে। কোর্সের শুরুতে, শরীরকে आसনের জন্য প্রস্তুত করতে सूक्ष्म व्यायाम এবং चालন क्रिया শেখানো হয়। এরপর, দাঁড়ানো, বса এবং শোয়া অবস্থার বিভিন্ন आसनগুলির সঠিক পদ্ধতি, উপকারিতা এবং সতর্কতা সম্পর্কে বিস্তারিত আলোচনা করা হয়েছে, যার মধ্যে ताड़ासन, त्रिकोणासन, भद्रासन এবং पवनमुक्तासन অন্তর্ভুক্ত। কোর্সটিতে कपालभाति, नाड़ी शोधन এবং शीतली-এর মতো महत्वपूर्ण प्राणायाम কৌশলগুলিও শেখানো হয়, যা শ্বাস-प्रশ্বাস নিয়ন্ত্রণ এবং মানসিক শান্তিতে সহায়তা করে। अंत में, ध्यान অনুশীলনের মাধ্যমে मानसिक एकाग्रতা এবং внутрішিক শান্তি অর্জনের উপর জোর দেওয়া হয়েছে। এই কোর্সটি সম্পন্ন করার পর, المتعلمون একটি সুструктуриਤ যোগা अभ्यास নিজেরা করতে সক্ষম হবেন এবং একটি স্বাস্থ্যকর জীবনধারার দিকে এগিয়ে যাবেন।
org: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY)

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Bodo
desc: Embark on a journey of wellness with this detailed instructional course on the Common Yoga Protocol, thoughtfully delivered in the Bodo language. This session is structured to introduce learners to the core principles of yoga in a clear and accessible manner, making it suitable for all, regardless of prior experience. The course begins with a series of preparatory exercises, including systematic movements for the neck, shoulders, and other major joints to prepare the body for practice. Following the warm-up, you will be guided through a curated sequence of standing, sitting, and lying postures such as Tadasana, Trikonasana, Vajrasana, and Bhujangasana. Each asana is demonstrated with precise instructions to ensure proper alignment and safety. The physical practice is complemented by powerful breathing techniques, including Kapalbhati and Nadi Shodhana Pranayama, which help regulate breath and calm the nervous system. The session concludes with guided meditation and a relaxation phase in Shavasana (Corpse Pose), allowing you to integrate the benefits of the practice. By completing this course, you will gain the skills to perform a balanced yoga routine that enhances physical health, reduces stress, and cultivates mental clarity.
org: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY)

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Dogri
desc: Embark on a journey of holistic well-being with this detailed instructional course on the Common Yoga Protocol. Designed for beginners, this program offers a structured approach to yoga, making it accessible for everyone, including busy public service professionals. The course begins with gentle warm-up exercises for the head, shoulders, and waist, preparing the body for deeper practice. You will then be guided through a series of fundamental standing, sitting, prone, and supine asanas, including Tadasana, Vrikshasana, and Bhujangasana, with clear instructions and precautions for each posture. The curriculum also incorporates vital breathing exercises (pranayama) such as Kapalbhati and Nadi Shodhana to regulate breath and calm the nervous system. The session concludes with guided meditation and relaxation in Shavasana (Corpse Pose), helping to integrate the physical and mental benefits of the practice. By completing this course, learners will gain the confidence and knowledge to practice a balanced yoga routine, leading to reduced stress, improved focus, and enhanced overall health.
org: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY)

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Gujarati
desc: આ વ્યાપક કોર્સ ગુજરાતીમાં કોમન યોગ પ્રોટોકોલ (CYP) માટે વિગતવાર, પગલા-દર-પગલાની માર્ગદર્શિકા પ્રદાન કરે છે, જે યોગના ફાયદા ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ સુલભ બનાવવા માટે આયુષ મંત્રાલય દ્વારા રચાયેલ છે. સત્ર શરીરને ગરમ કરવા માટે સૂક્ષ્મ ವ್ಯಾಯામથી શરૂ થાય છે, ત્યારબાદ તાદાસન, વૃક્ષાસન અને ભુજંગાસન જેવી વિવિધ યોગ મુદ્રાઓ (આસનો) આવે છે. દરેક આસનને સ્પષ્ટ સૂચનાઓ સાથે દર્શાવવામાં આવ્યું છે. કોર્સ કપાલભાતિ અને નાડી શોધન જેવી શક્તિશાળી શ्वास લેવાની તકનીકો (પ્રાણાયામ) તરફ આગળ વધે છે. આ અભ્યાસ માર્ગદર્શિત ધ્યાન અને શાંતિ મંત્ર સાથે સમાપ્ત થાય છે, જે ઊંડા આરામ અને માનસિક સંતુલનને પ્રોત્સાહન આપે છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કરીને, શીખનારાઓ દૈનિક યોગાભ્યાસ માટેના પ્રમાણભૂત પ્રોટોકોલને સમજશે અને શારીરિક તંદુરસ્તી, તણાવ ઘટાડવા અને समग्र સુખાકારી માટે તેના ગહન ફાયદાઓનો અનુભવ કરશે.

desc: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಯೋಗ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ (CYP) ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗೆ ಸುಸ್ವಾಗತ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಯೋಮಾನದ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಭವದ ಹಂತಗಳ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಯೋಗದ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನಗಳನ್ನು ತಲುಪಿಸಲು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆ, ಭುಜ ಮತ್ತು ಸೊಂಟದ ಚಲನೆಗಳಂತಹ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಯಾಮಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದು ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಂತರ, ಕಲಿಯುವವರು ತಾಡಾಸನ, ವೃಕ್ಷಾಸನ, ಮತ್ತು ತ್ರಿಕೋನಾಸನದಂತಹ ನಿಂತು ಮಾಡುವ ಆಸನಗಳು; ಭದ್ರಾಸನ, ವಜ್ರಾಸನ, ಮತ್ತು ವಕ್ರಾಸನದಂತಹ ಕುಳಿತು ಮಾಡುವ ಆಸನಗಳು; ಹಾಗೂ ಮಕರಾಸನ, ಭುಜಂಗಾಸನ, ಮತ್ತು ಪವನಮುಕ್ತಾಸನದಂತಹ ಮಲಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಆಸನಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಆಸನವನ್ನು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮುನ್ನೆಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಅಂತಿಮ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಪಾಲಭಾತಿ, ನಾಡಿ ಶೋಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಭ್ರಾಮರಿಯಂತಹ ಪ್ರಾಣಾಯಾಮ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ ಧ್ಯಾನವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ, ಇದು ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಶಾಂತಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಗಮನವನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕರಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ, ನೀವು ದೈಹಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮತೋಲನವನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸುವಿರಿ.

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Konkani
desc: Embark on a journey into the world of yoga with this detailed instructional course on the Common Yoga Protocol (CYP), delivered entirely in Konkani. The CYP was designed by the Ministry of AYUSH to offer a simple, effective, and standardized yoga routine that can be practiced by anyone, anywhere. This course is structured to be accessible for beginners while still being beneficial for regular practitioners. The session begins with subtle warm-up exercises to improve circulation, followed by a series of standing, sitting, and lying-down asanas. Each posture, from Tadasana (Palm Tree Pose) to Shavasana (Corpse Pose), is demonstrated with clear, step-by-step instructions and information on its benefits and precautions. The course then transitions into vital breathing exercises (pranayama) such as Kapalbhati and Nadi Shodhana, which are essential for regulating life-force energy. It concludes with guided meditation and a peace chant to foster deep relaxation and mental tranquility. By completing this course, learners will gain the confidence and knowledge to incorporate this holistic yoga practice into their daily lives for sustained health and wellness.

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Koshur

Following the warm-ups, the course progresses through a curated sequence of yoga postures (asanas). This includes fundamental standing poses like Tadasana and Vrikshasana to build balance and stability, seated poses such as Vajrasana for posture improvement, and poses performed while lying down, like Bhujangasana and Pawanmuktasana, to enhance flexibility and organ health. The physical practice is complemented by powerful breathing techniques (pranayama), including Kapalbhati for cleansing and Nadi Shodhana for balancing energy. The course culminates in a guided meditation and Shavasana (relaxation), helping to calm the mind, reduce stress, and integrate the benefits of the practice. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to confidently practice a balanced yoga routine that supports long-term health, resilience, and inner peace.

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Tamil
desc: பொது யோகா நெறிமுறை (CYP) என்பது அனைத்து வயதினரும் எளிதில் பின்பற்றக்கூடிய, தரப்படுத்தப்பட்ட யோகாப் பயிற்சிகளின் விரிவான வழிகாட்டியாகும். இந்தப் பாடநெறி, தளர்வுப் பயிற்சிகளுடன் தொடங்கி, கழுத்து, தோள்பட்டை மற்றும் உடல் இயக்கங்களுக்கான வழிகாட்டுதல்களை வழங்குகிறது. நின்ற, அமர்ந்த மற்றும் படுத்த நிலையில் செய்யப்படும் தடாசனம், விருட்சாசனம், வஜ்ராசனம் போன்ற முக்கிய ஆசனங்களை படிப்படியாகக் கற்றுத்தருகிறது. மேலும், கபாலபதி, நாடிசோதனை மற்றும் சீதளி பிராணாயாமம் போன்ற சக்திவாய்ந்த மூச்சுப் பயிற்சிகள் மூலம் சுவாச அமைப்பை வலுப்படுத்தவும், மனதை அமைதிப்படுத்தவும் இது உதவுகிறது. பாடத்தின் இறுதியில், தியானப் பயிற்சி மற்றும் ஆரோக்கியமான வாழ்க்கைக்கான உறுதிமொழி ஆகியவை மனத் தெளிவையும், சமநிலையையும் அடைய வழிகாட்டுகின்றன. இந்தப் பயிற்சிகளைத் தொடர்ந்து செய்வதன் மூலம், அரசு ஊழியர்கள் தங்கள் பணி மற்றும் தனிப்பட்ட வாழ்க்கையில் ஏற்படும் மன அழுத்தத்தை சிறப்பாகக் கையாண்டு, முழுமையான நல்வாழ்வை அடைய முடியும்.

title: Common Yoga Protocol - Telugu
desc: ఈ 'సాధారణ యోగా నియమావళి' కోర్సు, యోగాను తమ దైనందిన జీవితంలో ఒక భాగంగా చేసుకోవాలనుకునే ప్రతి ఒక్కరి కోసం రూపొందించబడింది. ఈ కోర్సు యోగా యొక్క ప్రాథమిక సూత్రాలను మరియు అభ్యాసాలను సరళమైన, సులభంగా అర్థమయ్యే రీతిలో అందిస్తుంది. కోర్సు ప్రార్థనతో ప్రారంభమై, శరీరాన్ని సిద్ధం చేయడానికి సూక్ష్మ వ్యాయామాలతో కొనసాగుతుంది. తరువాత, తాడాసనం, వృక్షాసనం, అర్ధ చక్రాసనం వంటి నిలబడే ఆసనాలు, మరియు భద్రాసనం, వజ్రాసనం, శశాంకాసనం వంటి కూర్చునే మరియు పడుకునే ఆసనాలను ఎలా చేయాలో దశలవారీగా వివరించబడింది. అంతేకాకుండా, కపాలభాతి, నాడీ శోధన, శీతలి మరియు భ్రామరి వంటి ముఖ్యమైన ప్రాణాయామ పద్ధతులు శ్వాసను నియంత్రించడానికి మరియు మనస్సును ప్రశాంతంగా ఉంచడానికి నేర్పించబడతాయి. కోర్సు చివరిలో, ధ్యానం మరియు సంకల్పం ద్వారా మానసిక సమతుల్యతను మరియు శాంతిని ఎలా పొందాలో మార్గనిర్దేశం చేయబడింది. ఈ కోర్సును పూర్తి చేయడం ద్వారా, అభ్యాసకులు తమ శారీరక మరియు మానసిక ఆరోగ్యాన్ని మెరుగుపరుచుకోవడానికి అవసరమైన జ్ఞానాన్ని మరియు నైపుణ్యాలను పొందుతారు.

desc: ഈ കോഴ്‌സ്, ആയുഷ് മന്ത്രാലയം നിർദ്ദേശിക്കുന്ന കോമൺ യോഗ പ്രോട്ടോക്കോളിന്റെ സമഗ്രമായ പരിശീലനം മലയാളത്തിൽ നൽകുന്നു. കഴുത്ത്, തോൾ, കാൽമുട്ട് എന്നിവയ്ക്കുള്ള ലഘു വ്യായാമങ്ങളോടെ (സൂക്ഷ്മ വ്യായാമം) കോഴ്‌സ് ആരംഭിക്കുന്നു. തുടർന്ന്, താഡാസനം, വൃക്ഷാസനം, പാദഹസ്താസനം തുടങ്ങിയ നിൽക്കുന്ന ആസനങ്ങളും, ഭദ്രാസനം, വജ്രാസനം പോലുള്ള ഇരിക്കുന്ന ആസനങ്ങളും, ശലഭാസനം, ഭുജംഗാസനം തുടങ്ങിയ മലർന്നും കമിഴ്ന്നും കിടന്നുള്ള ആസനങ്ങളും പരിശീലിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ശ്വസന നിയന്ത്രണത്തിനായി കപാൽഭാതി, നാഡി ശോധന, ഭ്രാമരി തുടങ്ങിയ പ്രാണായാമ വിദ്യകളും കോഴ്‌സിന്റെ ഭാഗമാണ്. ഓരോ ആസനവും ശരിയായ രീതിയിൽ ചെയ്യേണ്ട വിധവും, എടുക്കേണ്ട മുൻകരുതലുകളും ഇതിൽ വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നു. ധ്യാനത്തോടെയും ഒരു പ്രതിജ്ഞയോടെയും കോഴ്‌സ് അവസാനിക്കുന്നു, ഇത് പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് ശാരീരിക വഴക്കവും മാനസിക ശാന്തിയും നൽകി ഒരു സമഗ്രമായ ആരോഗ്യാനുഭവം പ്രദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

title: Common Yoga Protocol- Punjabi
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ 'ਸਾਂਝਾ ਯੋਗ ਪ੍ਰੋਟੋਕੋਲ' ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਨਸਿਕ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਮਿਆਰੀ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਦਾ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਯੋਗ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਸਿਧਾਂਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਅਭਿਆਸਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਣੂ ਕਰਵਾਉਣਾ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਸੂਖਮ ਅਭਿਆਸਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਰੀਰ ਨੂੰ ਗਰਮ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਖੂਨ ਦੇ ਗੇੜ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋ ਕੇ, ਬੈਠ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਲੇਟ ਕੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਆਸਣਾਂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਤਾੜਾਸਨ, ਵ੍ਰਿਕਸ਼ਾਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਭੁਜੰਗਾਸਨ। ਹਰੇਕ ਆਸਣ ਨੂੰ ਸਹੀ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਵਿਧੀ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਲਾਭਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਪਾਲਭਾਤੀ, ਨਾੜੀ ਸ਼ੋਧਨ ਅਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਾਮਰੀ ਵਰਗੇ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਾਯਾਮ ਵੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਸਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਂਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ, ਧਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਪਾਠ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮਾਨਸਿਕ ਆਰਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਕਾਰਾਤਮਕਤਾ 'ਤੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਹਰ ਉਮਰ ਅਤੇ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਦੇ ਪੱਧਰ ਦੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਢੁਕਵਾਂ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਯੋਗ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਦੀ ਰੁਟੀਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ।

title: Common Yoga Protocol- Sanskrit
desc: Embark on a journey of holistic wellness with this detailed course on the Common Yoga Protocol (CYP). Designed for individuals seeking to integrate the timeless practice of yoga into their daily lives, this program offers step-by-step guidance on a scientifically developed sequence. The course begins with gentle warm-up exercises to prepare the body, followed by a series of standing, sitting, prone, and supine asanas that improve flexibility, strength, and balance. You will learn key breathing techniques, including Kapalbhati, Nadi Shodhana, and Bhramari Pranayama, to regulate vital energy and calm the mind. The session culminates in a peaceful guided meditation to foster inner stillness and awareness. By completing this course, public officials can acquire practical tools to manage stress, improve physical fitness, and enhance mental focus, contributing to greater personal and professional effectiveness.

title: Common Yoga Protocol- Urdu
desc: یہ کورس کامن یوگا پروٹوکول پر عمل کرنے کے لیے ایک تفصیلی، مرحلہ وار گائیڈ کے طور پر ڈیزائن کیا گیا ہے۔ اس کا آغاز گردن، کندھوں اور گھٹنوں جیسی اہم جوڑوں کو تیار کرنے کے لیے ہلکی وارم اپ مشقوں سے ہوتا ہے۔ اس کے بعد، شرکاء کو کھڑے ہونے والے آسنوں جیسے تاڑاسن اور ورکشاسن، بیٹھنے والے آسنوں جیسے وجراسن اور شاشانکاسن، اور پیٹ کے بل لیٹنے والے آسنوں جیسے بھوجنگاسن کے ذریعے رہنمائی کی جائے گی۔ ہر آسن کو درست طریقے اور جسمانی بیداری پر توجہ مرکوز کرتے ہوئے واضح طور پر دکھایا اور بیان کیا گیا ہے۔ کورس میں سانس پر قابو پانے اور توانائی بڑھانے کے لیے کپال بھاتی اور نادی شودھن جیسی اہم پرانایام تکنیکیں بھی شامل ہیں۔ سیشن کا اختتام ذہنی سکون اور توجہ کے لیے ایک رہنمائی شدہ مراقبہ اور عہد کے ساتھ ہوتا ہے۔ یہ کورس سرکاری ملازمین کو روزمرہ کی زندگی میں یوگا کو شامل کرکے تناؤ کو منظم کرنے اور صحت مند طرز زندگی کو برقرار رکھنے کے قابل بناتا ہے۔
