title: Conservation Application for Forests and Natural Landscapes
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of advanced applications in conservation science, tailored for professionals managing India's forests and natural landscapes. In an era of increasing environmental pressures, it is crucial for forest personnel to be equipped with the latest scientific knowledge. This module addresses that need by delving into specialized topics that are critical for effective conservation planning and action. The course is structured into three core units: Conservation Genetics, Ecology of Open Natural Ecosystems, and Restoration Ecology. Participants will begin by understanding the fundamental concepts of each topic before exploring their practical applications. For instance, the unit on Conservation Genetics will explain how genetic tools can inform wildlife management and conservation strategies. The section on Open Natural Ecosystems will shed light on the unique ecological dynamics of grasslands and savannas, which are often overlooked in forest-centric conservation. Finally, the unit on Restoration Ecology will provide frameworks and methods for rehabilitating degraded habitats. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to integrate scientific principles into their daily work, leading to more effective habitat management, wildlife protection, and ecosystem restoration efforts.

title: Conservation Economics
desc: In an era defined by pressing environmental challenges, understanding the economic drivers behind them is crucial for effective policymaking. This course delves into the field of Conservation Economics, offering a comprehensive overview of how economic activities impact the natural world. It begins by outlining the core principles of economic thought and their environmental ramifications, discussing trade-offs between short-term profits and long-term sustainability. The curriculum explores the links between poverty and environmental degradation through impactful case studies like the Minamata disease and the Aral Sea disaster. Learners will then explore practical, nature-based solutions for challenges such as water purification and climate control, demonstrating that conservation can be an economically sound investment. The course culminates in teaching methods for the valuation of ecosystem services, equipping participants with the knowledge to make informed, data-driven decisions that integrate environmental health into economic planning. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to advocate for and contribute to policies that foster a sustainable and resilient future.

title: Conservation Education and Environmental Action
desc: This course promotes environmental awareness, knowledge, and practical skills to encourage responsible action for nature protection. It emphasizes core conservation values—protecting, conserving, respecting, and celebrating nature—to support ecological well-being. Learners will gain an understanding of biodiversity and its critical role in providing essential ecological services that sustain human life, while also exploring ways to contribute to environmental conservation in everyday contexts.
org: Central Academy for State Forest Service (CASFOS) Burnihat (Assam)

title: Conservation Geography
desc: In an era of rapid development, understanding the spatial dynamics of our natural world is more critical than ever. This course, 'Introduction to Conservation Geography: Principles and Applications,' addresses the fundamental challenge of balancing human progress with the urgent need for environmental conservation. It begins by establishing the core principles of geography and biogeography, answering the questions of what lives where and why. The curriculum then transitions to a critical examination of the primary threats facing our planet's biodiversity, including habitat degradation, fragmentation, pollution, and the overarching effects of climate change. Learners will explore real-world case studies that illustrate the complex interplay between resource extraction, infrastructure development, and ecosystem health. A significant focus is placed on practical solutions and modern methodologies. The course details how geographical thought processes, combined with advanced technologies like Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing, and predictive modeling, are being used to design protected areas, manage wildlife corridors, and mitigate environmental risks like forest fires. Upon completion, participants will be able to analyze environmental challenges through a geographical lens and appreciate the role of data-driven strategies in fostering sustainable and conservation-friendly development.

title: Conservation Science for Forests and Natural Landscapes
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of advanced applications in conservation science, tailored for professionals managing India's forests and natural landscapes. In an era of increasing environmental pressures, it is crucial for forest personnel to be equipped with the latest scientific knowledge. This module addresses that need by delving into specialized topics that are critical for effective conservation planning and action. The course is structured into three core units: Conservation Genetics, Ecology of Open Natural Ecosystems, and Restoration Ecology. Participants will begin by understanding the fundamental concepts of each topic before exploring their practical applications. For instance, the unit on Conservation Genetics will explain how genetic tools can inform wildlife management and conservation strategies.

title: Consolidated Instructions on Suspension
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the consolidated instructions on suspension, a critical aspect of administrative discipline within the government. It is designed to equip officials with the necessary knowledge to navigate the complexities of suspension procedures in accordance with established rules and legal precedents. The content addresses the fundamental principles of placing an employee under suspension, including the conditions for deemed suspension and the issuance of suspension orders. The course delves into the specific rules and regulations, such as the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965, that form the basis for these actions. Participants will learn about the calculation and payment of subsistence allowance, the periodic review process mandated to prevent prolonged suspensions, and the procedures for revoking a suspension order. By completing this course, learners will be better prepared to manage suspension cases with procedural correctness, fairness, and transparency. This ensures that disciplinary actions are legally sound and uphold the principles of natural justice, which is vital for maintaining organizational integrity and employee morale in public administration.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Constitutional and Regulatory Framework of Cooperatives in India
desc: Cooperative societies play a significant role in strengthening the economic and social development of communities across India. To ensure their effective, transparent, and accountable functioning, a well-defined regulatory framework is supported by key institutions at both the state and national levels. This course introduces the constitutional and institutional framework governing cooperatives in India. It explains the roles and responsibilities of major regulatory bodies, including the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies (CRCS), State Registrars of Cooperative Societies (RCS), the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD). Together, these institutions ensure transparency, financial stability, regulatory compliance, and sustainable growth of the cooperative sector. The course also highlights how regulatory mechanisms support the overall development and governance of the cooperative movement in India.

title: Constitutional Provisions at Workplace
desc: In the complex landscape of public administration, a thorough understanding of the Constitution of India is indispensable for every government employee. This course, 'Understanding Constitutional Provisions in the Workplace,' is designed to provide a foundational knowledge of the legal principles that shape the rights, duties, and service conditions of public servants. It delves into the core tenets of the Constitution, explaining how articles related to fundamental rights, equality of opportunity in public employment, and directive principles of state policy directly impact the workplace environment. Participants will gain critical insights into the legal framework governing recruitment, promotion, and disciplinary actions, ensuring that all administrative procedures are conducted with fairness and transparency. The curriculum covers essential topics such as the scope of Article 311, which provides safeguards to civil servants, and the role of administrative tribunals in resolving service-related disputes. By completing this course, officials will be better equipped to navigate their roles with legal clarity, uphold constitutional values in their daily functions, and contribute to a more just, equitable, and accountable governance system. This knowledge is crucial for mitigating legal risks and fostering a work culture rooted in the rule of law.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Constitutional Provisions at Workplace- Hindi
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम कार्यस्थल पर संवैधानिक प्रावधानों की एक व्यापक समझ प्रदान करता है, जो प्रत्येक सरकारी कर्मचारी के लिए आवश्यक है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत भारतीय संविधान के मूल सिद्धांतों और शासन में इसकी भूमिका के परिचय से होती है। इसके बाद, यह मौलिक अधिकारों, कर्तव्यों और सरकारी सेवा के संदर्भ में उनकी प्रयोज्यता पर विस्तार से चर्चा करता है। शिक्षार्थी सेवा मामलों से संबंधित संवैधानिक सुरक्षा उपायों, जैसे कि अनुच्छेद 311, और प्रशासनिक न्यायाधिकरणों की भूमिका के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम का समापन कार्यस्थल पर संवैधानिक नैतिकता और मूल्यों को बनाए रखने के महत्व पर जोर देने के साथ होता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, शिक्षार्थी अपने आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन करते समय संवैधानिक सिद्धांतों को लागू करने, सूचित निर्णय लेने और एक विधि-सम्मत और नैतिक कार्य वातावरण में योगदान करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Constitutional Provisions in the Workplace
desc: In the complex landscape of public administration, a thorough understanding of the Constitution of India is indispensable for every government employee. This course, 'Understanding Constitutional Provisions in the Workplace,' is designed to provide a foundational knowledge of the legal principles that shape the rights, duties, and service conditions of public servants. It delves into the core tenets of the Constitution, explaining how articles related to fundamental rights, equality of opportunity in public employment, and directive principles of state policy directly impact the workplace environment. Participants will gain critical insights into the legal framework governing recruitment, promotion, and disciplinary actions, ensuring that all administrative procedures are conducted with fairness and transparency.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Constitutional Provisions Relating to Disciplinary Proceedings - Hindi
desc: इस पाठ्यक्रम को प्रशासनिक और सतर्कता डोमेन में काम करने वाले सरकारी अधिकारियों की जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही की प्रक्रिया में शामिल संवैधानिक सुरक्षा उपायों का गहन विश्लेषण प्रस्तुत करता है। शिक्षार्थी अनुच्छेद 310 और 311 के सिद्धांतों, 'प्रसाद पर्यंत' (doctrine of pleasure) के सिद्धांत और इसके अपवादों के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में उचित जांच प्रक्रिया, सुनवाई का अवसर, और अनुशासनात्मक प्राधिकारी द्वारा शक्तियों के प्रयोग से संबंधित प्रमुख न्यायिक निर्णयों पर भी प्रकाश डाला गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, अधिकारी अनुशासनात्मक मामलों को संभालने, कानूनी त्रुटियों से बचने और प्रशासन में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही बनाए रखने में अधिक सक्षम होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Consultation with Central Vigilance Commission in Disciplinary Cases
desc: This course is designed for public officials involved in vigilance and disciplinary matters, offering a detailed examination of the consultation process with the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) and the legal requirements for obtaining sanction for prosecution. In the context of public administration, adhering to procedural and legal correctness in disciplinary actions is paramount to upholding integrity and ensuring justice. This program provides the necessary knowledge to navigate these complex procedures effectively. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the legal framework, including Section 197 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973, and the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988. The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of obtaining sanction, from the identification and compilation of necessary records to the careful scrutiny of evidence and the final drafting of the sanction order.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Consultation with CVC in Disciplinary Cases
desc: This course is designed for public officials involved in vigilance and disciplinary matters, offering a detailed examination of the consultation process with the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) and the legal requirements for obtaining sanction for prosecution. In the context of public administration, adhering to procedural and legal correctness in disciplinary actions is paramount to upholding integrity and ensuring justice. This program provides the necessary knowledge to navigate these complex procedures effectively. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the legal framework, including Section 197 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973, and the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988. The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of obtaining sanction, from the identification and compilation of necessary records to the careful scrutiny of evidence and the final drafting of the sanction order. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to manage disciplinary cases with greater confidence, ensure compliance with all statutory requirements, and contribute to a more transparent and accountable governance environment. This will enable them to exercise their authority judiciously and prepare legally sound proposals for prosecution.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Consultation with UPSC in disciplinary cases
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the critical process of consulting the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) in disciplinary cases. In the context of public administration, ensuring procedural integrity in disciplinary matters is paramount for maintaining accountability and upholding the rule of law. This program is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge and skills to navigate these complex procedures effectively. Key learning areas include a detailed study of Article 320(3)(c) of the Constitution, the CVC Act, and relevant DOPT instructions that mandate consultation with the UPSC. The course will break down the entire lifecycle of a disciplinary case, from the initial inquiry to the final submission of files to the UPSC for advice. Participants will learn to prepare comprehensive proposals, manage required documentation, and understand the implications of the UPSC's advice. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently manage disciplinary proceedings, ensuring full compliance with regulatory frameworks. This will help in minimizing legal challenges and reinforcing a culture of integrity and discipline within public services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Consumer Commission: Rights and Redressal and Mediation
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of consumer protection, beginning with a recall of its historical evolution and key legislations introduced during the Independence era. It explains the concept of consumer protection, the various ways consumers can be protected, and highlights the major features and aspects of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986 and the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The course introduces e-Daakhil, outlines its background, familiarizes learners with the e-filing process, and explains how cases can be resolved through the platform. Learners will also gain an understanding of consumer welfare, consumer rights, the complaint filing and examination processes, and the concept and applicability of mediation, including its mechanisms, significance, and practical application. Additionally, the course covers the roles and responsibilities of the Registrar, including jurisdictional duties and documentation verification, as well as the process of handling cases.

title: Contempt of Authority and Offences Involving Public Servants
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the legal provisions governing public servants as introduced in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. With the enactment of new criminal laws, it is crucial for every public servant to understand the updated framework that defines their authority, duties, and legal boundaries. The course delves into the specific offences detailed in Chapters XII and XIII of the BNS, including those constituting contempt of lawful authority and those committed by public servants themselves. Key learning areas include the official definition of a 'public servant,' the distinction between different categories of offences, and the procedural safeguards available to officials under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. Participants will analyze provisions related to impersonation, disobedience of legal directives, and misuse of authority. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to navigate their official duties with legal clarity, ensuring compliance while being fully aware of their rights and protections.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Contempt of Court
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the law of Contempt of Court in India, designed for public officials who require a foundational understanding of this critical legal principle. The program begins by defining contempt of court and tracing its historical evolution, establishing why the doctrine is vital for maintaining the authority and dignity of the judiciary. It then delves into the specific Indian context, with a thorough review of the Contempt of Court Act, 1971, explaining the distinctions between civil and criminal contempt. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the nuanced and often-debated relationship between the judiciary's power to punish for contempt and the fundamental right to freedom of speech and expression. The course also touches upon potential reforms aimed at balancing these competing interests, ensuring public trust in the judicial system is upheld while protecting democratic freedoms. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to understand the legal boundaries of public discourse concerning the judiciary.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Contract Labour Act and other Labour laws
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the legal framework governing contract labour in India. It begins by defining the core objective of the Contract Labour Act, 1970, which is to regulate the employment of contract labour and provide for its abolition in certain circumstances. The curriculum systematically breaks down key legal definitions and explains the criteria for the Act's applicability to establishments and contractors, focusing on the threshold of 20 or more workmen. Participants will learn about the distinct responsibilities of the principal employer and the contractor, particularly concerning wage payments, provision of amenities like canteens and drinking water, and maintenance of statutory records. The course also clarifies the interplay between this Act and other crucial legislation, including the Minimum Wages Act, Factories Act, and Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) Act, providing a holistic understanding of labour law compliance.

title: Contract Management
desc: This course is designed to build foundational skills in government contract management, a critical function for ensuring public value and accountability. It delves into the principles and procedures that govern the lifecycle of a contract, from initiation to closure. Participants will explore the official guidelines detailed in the Department of Expenditure's manuals on procurement, providing a robust framework for compliant and effective practices. Key learning areas include understanding the various types of contracts, identifying and mitigating associated risks, and managing crucial components like payment schedules, delivery verification, and final settlement. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to navigate the complexities of procurement, minimize disputes, and ensure that all contractual obligations are met, thereby upholding financial discipline and achieving desired outcomes in government projects and services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Contract Management
desc: In the context of public service, effective contract management is crucial for ensuring transparency, accountability, and the optimal use of public funds. This course is designed for government employees involved in procurement and project management, offering a detailed guide to navigating the complexities of the process. Key learning areas include the foundational principles of public procurement, stakeholder identification, and the creation of essential documents like Detailed Project Reports (DPR) and Expressions of Interest (EOI). Participants will learn the mechanics of bid evaluation, vendor selection, and the critical legal terms that govern contracts. Furthermore, the course covers Service Level Management (SLM) and provides insights into the vendor's perspective, enabling a holistic understanding. Upon completion, learners will be able to manage procurement contracts effectively, mitigate risks, and contribute to the successful implementation of e-governance and other public projects.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Contract Management
desc: In the context of modern governance, effective contract management is paramount for the success of public procurement and large-scale infrastructure projects. This course provides an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices essential for administering government contracts. Learners will be guided through the entire contract lifecycle, starting from need assessment and procurement planning, through to contract creation, negotiation, and execution. The curriculum places a strong emphasis on critical areas such as robust risk and compliance management, diligent performance evaluation, and adherence to key legal frameworks, including the General Financial Rules (GFR) and the Arbitration & Conciliation Act. Participants will learn to proactively identify and handle irregularities and disputes that may arise during contract implementation. By completing this course, officials will gain the practical skills to manage contracts effectively, reduce costs through efficient use of public funds, and ensure that procurement activities are conducted with transparency and accountability. This will empower them to contribute to the judicious use of national resources and support the goals of inclusive growth.

title: Control Working and Control Office and Operations Control Center
desc: The course provides a comprehensive understanding of the pivotal role the Control Office plays in ensuring the safe, efficient, and punctual movement of trains across the Indian Railways network. The Control Office functions as the nerve center of railway operations, coordinating real-time communication between stations, depots, and divisional headquarters to maintain smooth train operations. This course covers control working systems, the structure and functions of various control units, essential communication protocols, and the integration of technology in managing railway traffic. Participants will gain in-depth knowledge of departmental coordination, operational procedures, and the responsibilities of key roles such as the CHC (In-charge), Commercial Control, Operations Control Center (OCC), and the Traction Power Controller.
keywords: Control Working, Control Office and OCC

title: Conventional and Nonconventional Manufacturing Processes
desc: This course provides a detailed exploration of both traditional and modern manufacturing paradigms. It begins by establishing the fundamentals of conventional machining, covering widely-used processes like turning, milling, and drilling that rely on mechanical force. The curriculum then transitions to non-conventional manufacturing, introducing advanced, high-precision techniques essential for contemporary industry. Key areas covered include Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM), laser machining, and sophisticated micro-manipulation methods used for complex materials and intricate designs. The course also integrates principles of quality and efficiency, such as the Deming Cycle, to foster a mindset of continuous improvement. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to differentiate between these manufacturing approaches, understand their respective applications, and evaluate which method is best suited for various industrial requirements, from mass production to specialized, high-tech fabrication.

title: Conversion of Coal to Electricity
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the entire energy conversion chain in a coal-fired thermal power plant, from fuel combustion to electricity transmission. It begins by establishing the context of thermal power's significance in the global and Indian energy sectors. The curriculum then breaks down the complex machinery and processes involved, providing in-depth explanations of boiler systems, steam turbines, and electrical generators. A significant portion is dedicated to the underlying physics, with a focus on thermodynamic cycles, particularly the Rankine cycle, and its practical application in power generation. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the differences and efficiencies of subcritical and supercritical power plant technologies. The course also details the major auxiliary systems, such as the condensate and feedwater circuits, air and fuel handling, and pollution control mechanisms. Upon completion, participants will have a robust technical knowledge of how thermal power plants operate, the function of each major component, and the scientific principles that make large-scale electricity generation possible.

title: Conversion of old CDOT Exchange to CDOT NGN
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of upgrading legacy C-DOT MAX exchanges to the C-DOT MAX Next-Generation (NG) architecture. The content addresses the critical need for telecom operators to evolve their Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) to an all-IP network. Learners will be guided through the technical specifics of the conversion process, including the removal of the old Central Module and the integration of the Central Access Control Unit (CACU). A significant focus is placed on the modification of the subscriber-side Base Module (BM), detailing how it is transformed into a Line Access Gateway Unit (LAGU) by replacing the Base Processor Unit (BPU) and Time Switch Unit (TSU) with advanced NGTJ cards. The course explains how these cards convert TDM voice data into IP packets for communication over the new network using protocols like SIP. Upon completion, learners will have a comprehensive understanding of the hardware, architecture, and functionalities required to successfully migrate existing copper subscriber lines to a future-ready IP/MPLS-based NGN platform.

title: Cooling Water Chemistry and Management in Thermal Power Plants
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Cooling Water Chemistry and its role in the efficient operation of thermal power plants. It covers the fundamentals of cooling water systems, heat transfer, water balance, cycles of concentration (COC), scaling, corrosion, fouling, biofouling, chemical treatment programmes, corrosion control, monitoring techniques, and best operating practices. Through engineering diagrams, practical examples, and industrial case studies, participants will learn how to optimize cooling water performance, improve condenser efficiency, reduce equipment failures, minimize maintenance costs, conserve water, and enhance overall plant reliability and thermal efficiency.
org: UPRVUNL, Panki Thermal Power Station, Uttar Pradesh

title: Core Areas of Artificial Intelligence
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental domains of Artificial Intelligence, designed for learners with no prior background in the subject. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of AI in the modern world and its growing importance in public service and governance. You will delve into the five key pillars of AI: Machine Learning, where algorithms learn from data to make predictions; Deep Learning, which uses complex neural networks for advanced tasks; Natural Language Processing (NLP), enabling machines to understand human language; Computer Vision, which allows systems to interpret visual information; and Speech AI, focusing on voice processing. Upon completion, learners will not only understand the theoretical concepts but also appreciate how these AI components are integrated to build sophisticated, real-world intelligent systems, preparing them to engage with the ongoing digital transformation.

title: Core Foundations of Corporate Finance
desc: This course introduces the fundamental principles of corporate finance, emphasizing how organizations make strategic financial decisions to maximize shareholder value. Participants will explore the core pillars of corporate finance—investment, financing, and dividend decisions—alongside essential capital budgeting techniques. The course provides a strong conceptual foundation, enabling learners to understand the role of financial managers in resource allocation, risk assessment, and value creation. Through practical examples and case studies, participants will gain insights into cost of capital, capital structure, and dividend policy. Designed for professionals and students, this course equips learners with the analytical skills required for effective financial decision-making in corporate settings.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Core System Integration in India Post Accounting
desc: Delve into the significant transformation of India Post through its Core System Integration (CSI) project. This course offers a structured examination of the shift from legacy systems to a modern, integrated digital framework. It begins by setting the context, contrasting the operational inefficiencies of the past with the streamlined, automated workflows of the present. You will explore the complete CSI architecture, including its primary modules for mail operations, HR, and finance, and understand how it automates transaction processing and inventory management. The curriculum places special emphasis on the integration with critical financial platforms—Finacle for banking services and McCamish for insurance—and clarifies how these systems function within the larger ecosystem. Furthermore, the course details the core accounting procedures managed through SAP-CSI, covering reconciliation, reporting, and audit trails. Upon completion, you will have a robust understanding of how this digital modernization has fundamentally enhanced service delivery and operational efficiency across India Post.

title: Corporate Financing
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of corporate financing. It is designed for professionals who need to understand how businesses and public sector undertakings structure their finances to optimize growth and ensure long-term stability. The curriculum begins by exploring the fundamental financial instruments, providing a clear distinction between debt, equity, and hybrid securities. You will learn to identify the characteristics, advantages, and disadvantages of each, enabling you to analyze a company's financial toolkit. The course then delves into the critical process of making capital structure decisions, examining the internal and external factors that guide these choices, such as cost of capital, risk tolerance, and market conditions. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze corporate financial strategies and understand the implications of different financing choices on an organization's performance and valuation, a crucial skill for roles involving financial oversight, project evaluation, and economic policy.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: CORPORATE GOVERNANCE
desc: Corporate governance is the bedrock of institutional integrity and economic stability. This course offers a detailed exploration of its principles and practices, with a special focus on the Indian landscape. It begins by establishing the fundamental concepts of accountability, transparency, and ethical conduct that define robust governance frameworks. The curriculum delves into the evolution of corporate governance, examining key global standards and their adaptation in India, including the roles and responsibilities of the board of directors, the rights of shareholders, and the importance of engaging all stakeholders. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to learning from the past. Through in-depth case studies of the Bhopal Gas Tragedy and the Enron scandal, learners will dissect the anatomy of corporate failures, identifying the systemic weaknesses, ethical breaches, and regulatory gaps that led to disaster. This analysis provides a powerful context for understanding the critical need for stringent oversight, effective risk management, and a culture of integrity. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to recognize indicators of poor governance, understand the legal and regulatory environment, and apply governance principles to foster accountability and responsible conduct within their own professional spheres.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Corporate Social Responsibility
desc: Discover the transformative power of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in this in-depth course tailored for professionals in the public sector. The program explores how businesses, particularly Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), can serve as catalysts for social progress. You will gain a thorough understanding of the CSR legal framework under the Companies Act, 2013, and learn to navigate the specific obligations and opportunities it presents. Key learning areas include the complete lifecycle of a CSR initiative, from strategic planning and stakeholder engagement to project execution and impact assessment. Through real-world case studies, the course provides actionable insights into fostering sustainability and innovation. By the end, you will be equipped to develop and lead effective CSR strategies that not only ensure compliance but also drive meaningful community development and enhance corporate reputation.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Corporate Social Responsibility at South Eastern Coalfields Limited
desc: The “Corporate Social Responsibility at SECL” course provides a comprehensive overview of SECL’s CSR initiatives and their impact on communities. Learners will understand SECL’s key focus areas, transformative projects, and CSR schemes across sectors such as Education and Skill Development, Healthcare Initiatives, Inclusivity and Welfare, and Community Development. The course highlights how CSR strengthens community relations and drives sustainable social change.

title: Corporate Social Responsibility in Government and Telecom
desc: This course provides an in-depth exploration of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) as a strategic function within Indian governance, with a specific focus on the telecom sector and Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs). It begins by establishing the context of CSR under the Companies Act and Department of Public Enterprises (DPE) guidelines, explaining why these regulations are critical for public accountability and sustainable development. Key learning areas include the practical application of CSR in bridging the digital divide, promoting environmental sustainability through green supply chains, and ensuring ethical procurement processes. The course uniquely integrates principles from Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS), demonstrating how traditional wisdom can inform modern, responsible business practices. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze, evaluate, and contribute to CSR initiatives that align with national priorities, drive operational integrity, and deliver tangible community benefits.

title: Corporate Valuation
desc: Gain a robust understanding of how to accurately assess the economic value of a business with this in-depth course on corporate valuation. The program begins by establishing a strong foundation in core financial concepts, including the significance of capital structure, the calculation of weighted average cost of capital (WACC), and capital budgeting techniques. You will learn to apply various sophisticated valuation models, from the dividend discount model (DDM) to the discounted cash flow (DCF) model, to derive a company's intrinsic value. The course also covers the asset-based approach, including book value and adjusted book value methods, and the market approach, which utilizes comparables like P/E and P/B ratios. Furthermore, it introduces the concept of social capital and its impact on valuation. Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze company financials, justify valuation figures, and make strategic decisions relevant to mergers, acquisitions, portfolio investment, and public enterprise management.

title: Corrosion Control of Reinforced Concrete Structures
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of corrosion control in reinforced cement concrete (RCC) structures, with a particular focus on highway bridges. Drawing upon IRC-112:2020 and IRC-SP-80:2009, the course explains the mechanisms of corrosion, its impact on structural deterioration, and practical strategies for prevention, inspection, and maintenance. Designed for engineers and public infrastructure managers, the course equips participants with the knowledge required to ensure the durability, safety, and cost-effective management of RCC bridge structures. Learners will gain insight into preventive measures during design and construction, as well as modern methods for inspection, monitoring, and assessment of corrosion to support effective maintenance planning.

title: Corrosion in Coaches and Wagons and its Prevention
desc: This specialized course delves into the critical subject of corrosion management for Indian Railways' coaches and wagons. It is designed to equip railway personnel with the knowledge to combat the degradation of rolling stock, which poses significant safety and financial risks. The course begins by defining corrosion and its effects on steel structures, then proceeds to identify the primary causes, from environmental exposure to shortcomings in manufacturing and maintenance. Participants will learn to distinguish between vulnerable and non-vulnerable areas in both ICF and LHB coach designs, including specific components like sole bars, trough floors, and underframes. The curriculum provides detailed guidance on standard inspection processes, such as visual checks and hammer tapping, to detect corrosion at early stages. Furthermore, it covers the official repair procedures as per RDSO guidelines and outlines a multi-faceted prevention strategy, encompassing material selection, design improvements, protective coatings, and regular maintenance schedules. By completing this course, learners will be prepared to implement effective corrosion control measures, thereby enhancing the safety, longevity, and reliability of railway assets.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Cortana: Your Smart Digital Assistant
desc: In today's fast-paced digital world, efficiency is key. AI-powered digital assistants have become essential tools for managing complex schedules and information overload. This course focuses on Microsoft Cortana, a powerful assistant integrated into Windows, designed to streamline both personal and professional tasks for government officials and public sector employees. The course provides a step-by-step guide, starting from the initial setup and activation of Cortana. It delves into core functionalities such as creating reminders, managing calendar events, and launching applications using voice commands. Learners will explore how to perform hands-free web searches, send emails, and utilize Cortana for quick calculations and unit conversions. Furthermore, the course addresses important aspects of personalization and privacy, ensuring users can tailor the assistant to their needs while maintaining data security. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently use Cortana to automate routine activities, saving valuable time and reducing manual effort. This skill is directly applicable to improving daily workflow management, allowing for greater focus on strategic and high-priority tasks.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Counselling at Workplace
desc: In today's dynamic professional landscape, supporting employee mental health is paramount. This course provides a comprehensive overview of workplace counselling, establishing its importance for fostering a healthy and productive environment. You will delve into the fundamental concepts, exploring why organizations are increasingly adopting counselling services to address both work-related and personal challenges that impact performance. The curriculum covers various models of implementation, from in-house counsellors to external Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs), allowing you to understand the options available. Key learning areas include the tangible benefits of counselling, such as reduced stress, improved interpersonal relationships, and higher job satisfaction. Furthermore, the course outlines critical considerations for successful implementation, including needs assessment, ensuring confidentiality, and the role of managers in creating a supportive atmosphere. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to advocate for and understand the framework of a workplace counselling program that enhances employee morale, resilience, and overall organizational effectiveness.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Coupling Systems in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the railway coupling systems vital to India's extensive rail network. It begins by establishing the context of why robust coupling mechanisms are crucial for handling heavy loads and high-speed demands, directly impacting operational safety and efficiency. Learners will delve into the key learning areas, including the historical evolution from basic hook-and-chain systems to modern automated couplers. The course covers the specific designs, applications, and maintenance procedures for primary systems like the Screw Coupler, Central Buffer Coupler (CBC), and Schaku Coupler. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply this knowledge to understand how technological advancements in coupling systems contribute to increased hauling capacity, enhanced safety, and the overall modernization of Indian Railways, preparing them for future innovations in the sector.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Courts and Tribunals: Jurisdictions for Establishment Matters
desc: This course provides an overview of the role and functioning of the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) in service matters relating to the Indian Railways. It familiarizes learners with the responsibilities of various railway departments during CAT proceedings, post-order actions, and the legal remedies available thereafter. The course also introduces key judicial bodies relevant to railway administration and explains the use of institutional tools and digital platforms for managing, monitoring, and tracking legal cases to ensure timely compliance with judicial directions.
keywords: Courts and Tribunals: Jurisdiction and Limitation with respect to establishment and Service Matters

title: CPC SOP for PLI/RPLI Operations
desc: This detailed course is designed for officials in the Department of Posts to master the intricacies of PLI/RPLI operations. It provides an in-depth exploration of the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that govern the functions of Central Processing Centres (CPCs), which are crucial for maintaining service quality and consistency across the country. The program addresses the critical need for streamlined processes to ensure timely and accurate service delivery to millions of policyholders. Key learning areas include the step-by-step procedures for handling various service requests, such as corrections or changes in policyholder names, settlement of maturity and survival benefit claims, processing of death claims (including cases requiring inquiry), and the protocol for sanctioning loans against policies. Additionally, the course covers the vital Document Management and Record Retention Policy, ensuring that all physical and digital records are handled securely and in compliance with departmental guidelines. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to execute their duties with precision, reduce processing times, mitigate risks, and contribute to operational excellence within the PLI/RPLI framework.

title: Create Recreational Forest for Benefits of Rural and Urban Population
desc: In an era of rapid urbanization, the development of recreational forests is crucial for enhancing public well-being and promoting environmental stewardship. This course addresses the growing need for well-planned green spaces that serve both communities and ecosystems. It is designed for professionals involved in forestry, urban planning, and environmental management who seek to create sustainable recreational areas for public benefit. The curriculum covers the fundamental concepts of recreational forestry, from initial planning to long-term maintenance. Participants will learn to apply principles of sustainable forest management, ensuring that recreational use does not compromise ecological health. Key topics include conservation education program design, methods for mitigating environmental impacts from visitor activities, and techniques for integrating conservation, recreation, and economic goals into a cohesive management plan. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to develop

title: Create Recreational Forest for Benefits of Rural and Urban Population
desc: In an era of rapid urbanization, the development of recreational forests is crucial for enhancing public well-being and promoting environmental stewardship. This course addresses the growing need for well-planned green spaces that serve both communities and ecosystems. It is designed for professionals involved in forestry, urban planning, and environmental management who seek to create sustainable recreational areas for public benefit. The curriculum covers the fundamental concepts of recreational forestry, from initial planning to long-term maintenance. Participants will learn to apply principles of sustainable forest management, ensuring that recreational use does not compromise ecological health. Key topics include conservation education program design, methods for mitigating environmental impacts from visitor activities, and techniques for integrating conservation, recreation, and economic goals into a cohesive management plan. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to develop and manage recreational forests effectively. They will be able to engage with local communities and stakeholders, fostering a sense of ownership and collaborative stewardship. The skills gained will enable them to contribute to the creation of valuable natural assets that improve quality of life, support biodiversity, and provide educational opportunities for both rural and urban populations.

title: Creation of Posts
desc: Effective public administration relies on a structured and rule-based approach to managing its workforce. The creation and management of posts are foundational to this structure, ensuring that government departments are adequately staffed to fulfill their mandates. This course is specifically designed to provide government officials with a detailed understanding of the principles and regulations that govern the lifecycle of a post in the Central Government. Key learning areas include the formal procedures for creating new posts, the conditions for their continuation, and the process for reviving lapsed posts. The curriculum also thoroughly covers the rules applicable to personnel movements such as transfers, deputations, and absorptions, as well as the formalities associated with resignations. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate complex establishment matters, apply the correct rules to various HR scenarios, and contribute to the smooth functioning of their departments by ensuring all actions related to post management are compliant and procedurally sound.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Creativity and Innovation
desc: In today's rapidly evolving world, the ability to think creatively and innovate is crucial for success in the public sector. This course provides a foundational understanding of creativity and innovation, explaining how these two concepts work together to produce tangible results. You will learn to define creativity as the generation of new ideas and innovation as the process of turning those ideas into practical, value-adding solutions. The curriculum delves into key characteristics of both, offering actionable methods to enhance your creative abilities. Key learning areas include overcoming the fear of failure, committing to creative practices, and using structured techniques like mind mapping and the Six Hats method to analyze problems from diverse perspectives. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with a toolkit to not only generate original ideas but also to foster an environment that encourages innovation, enabling you to contribute to progress and efficiency within your organization.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Crime Scene Management
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the ability to properly manage electronic evidence is paramount for successful criminal investigations. This course provides law enforcement officers and investigators with the foundational knowledge and skills to handle digital evidence effectively at crime scenes. The curriculum establishes the context of why digital evidence is crucial and details its various forms, including computers, mobile devices, and storage media. Learners will be introduced to common forensic tools and techniques for evidence acquisition. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to explaining core digital forensic concepts such as data deletion, wiping, formatting, the use of write blockers, hashing for integrity verification, and the creation of forensic images and clones. The overarching goal is to ensure that all collected evidence is handled according to best practices, preserving its integrity and ensuring its admissibility in legal proceedings. Upon completion, participants will be confident in their ability to secure and manage digital evidence from the crime scene to the courtroom.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
keywords: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy (SVPNPA)

title: Criminal Breach of Trust and Criminal Misappropriation of the Property
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of the offences of criminal breach of trust and dishonest misappropriation of property under the new criminal law framework of India. The content is centered on Sections 314 to 316 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, which have replaced the corresponding provisions in the erstwhile Indian Penal Code, 1860. The primary objective is to equip officials with the knowledge to navigate these complex financial crimes effectively. The curriculum systematically breaks down the key legal elements, definitions, and statutory explanations for each offence. Learners will explore the nuanced differences between criminal misappropriation and criminal breach of trust, a common point of confusion in legal practice. The course uses practical illustrations and discusses landmark judicial rulings to demonstrate how these laws are interpreted and applied, ensuring that participants can connect the legal text to tangible situations they may encounter in their professional roles. By mastering this content, learners will enhance their ability to conduct investigations, frame charges, and contribute to the effective prosecution of these offences, thereby upholding financial integrity and the rule of law.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Criminal Force Assault and Sexual Offences Against Women
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the new criminal laws addressing sexual offences in India, specifically under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. The content is critical for legal and law enforcement professionals adapting to the legislative changes that replace the Indian Penal Code. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of Sections 63 to 79 of the BNS, which define offences like rape, sexual harassment, voyeurism, stalking, and insulting the modesty of a woman. The course thoroughly explains the legal definition of consent, aggravating circumstances, and enhanced penalties for repeat offenders. Learners will explore the procedural aspects, including provisions for victim protection and confidentiality. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply the new legal standards accurately, ensuring the effective administration of justice and upholding the dignity and rights of women and children in society.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Criminal Intimidation Insult Annoyance Defamation
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the specific offences of criminal intimidation, insult, annoyance, and defamation as defined in Chapter XIX of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. The content is structured to provide a clear understanding of the new legal landscape following the replacement of the Indian Penal Code. The course addresses the critical need for law enforcement and legal professionals to be well-versed in these changes for correct application and procedure. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of Section 351 (Criminal Intimidation), Section 352 (Intentional Insult), Section 353 (Statements conducing to Public Mischief), Section 355 (Misconduct by drunken persons), and Section 356 (Defamation), along with its exceptions. Furthermore, it covers the procedural aspects of prosecution for defamation under Section 222 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently interpret and apply these revised laws in their professional duties, ensuring compliance and upholding justice within the new criminal law framework.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Criminal Justice Institutions Defences and Social Offences
desc: This course provides an overview of key areas of criminal and social law, including the role of investigative agencies such as the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), the right of private defence, regulation of labour unrest, offences relating to women and children, and legal provisions governing prostitution. It integrates statutory provisions with real-life case studies to demonstrate how laws operate in practical situations. The course helps learners understand their rights, responsibilities, and available legal remedies, enabling them to respond effectively to threats, injustice, and exploitation. It also promotes awareness of rule of law, ethical conduct, and citizen-centric governance by equipping individuals with practical legal knowledge applicable to everyday scenarios.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Criminal Justice System: Rights and Institutions and Social Impact
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the criminal justice system, focusing on the rights of individuals, the functioning of justice institutions, and the role of law in promoting social change. The course explores key topics such as juvenile justice, bail and anticipatory bail, preventive detention, the rights of the accused, victims, and witnesses, police powers, the hierarchy of criminal courts, and the roles of lawyers and public prosecutors. It also examines how criminal law contributes to social reform and adapts to emerging challenges arising from technological advancements, including cybercrime and digital evidence. Through landmark judgments, practical examples, and constitutional principles, learners will develop an understanding of legal safeguards, individual liberties, accountability mechanisms, and the evolving role of criminal justice in a democratic society.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: CRIMPING AN ETHERNET CABLE
desc: This comprehensive course offers detailed instructions on the essential skill of crimping Ethernet cables. In today's digitally connected world, understanding the physical layer of networking is fundamental for robust IT infrastructure. This course addresses the practical need to create custom-length network cables, which is more efficient and flexible than relying on pre-made cables. Learners will be guided through the entire process, starting with an introduction to the required tools, including the crimping tool, cable stripper, and RJ45 connectors. The curriculum places a strong emphasis on correctly applying the T568B color-coding standard, a critical step for ensuring network functionality. The module breaks down the process into manageable steps: stripping the outer jacket, untwisting and straightening the conductor wires, arranging them in the correct order, trimming them to a uniform length, and securely crimping the RJ45 connector. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently create and test their own straight-through and crossover Ethernet cables, enabling them to effectively support network setup and troubleshooting tasks in any professional environment.

title: Critical Thinking
desc: In any professional role, particularly within the public sector, the ability to make sound, unbiased decisions is paramount. This course, 'Critical Thinking for Effective Decision Making,' is designed to enhance this crucial capability. It moves beyond surface-level advice, delving into the psychological underpinnings of how we think and decide. The curriculum begins by contrasting the fast, intuitive 'System 1' thinking with the slow, deliberate 'System 2' approach, highlighting the strengths and pitfalls of each. You will explore the cognitive structures that shape our reality, including mental frames and schemas, and learn how they can introduce predictable biases into our judgment. The course systematically unpacks key heuristics and biases, such as the anchoring effect, the availability heuristic, the representativeness heuristic, and the fundamental attribution error, using relatable examples and foundational research. By understanding these invisible forces, you will be empowered to analyze problems from multiple perspectives, challenge your own assumptions, and ultimately arrive at more prudent, well-reasoned judgments. This will enable you to improve the quality of your decisions and enhance your effectiveness as a leader and professional.

title: Crop Residue Management
desc: This training module offers essential knowledge for agriculture professionals and farmers on the principles and practices of effective crop residue management. The course begins by establishing the context, explaining what crop residues are and why their management is crucial for preparing fields for subsequent crops. It provides a detailed analysis of the harmful consequences of burning crop residues, including severe air pollution, loss of soil fertility, and destruction of beneficial microorganisms. The legal repercussions of this outdated practice are also clearly outlined. The core of the course focuses on practical and scientific solutions. Learners will explore various methods for managing residues, such as incorporating them back into the soil to create compost, which enhances nutrient availability and soil moisture. It also introduces modern agricultural machinery like rotavators, happy seeders, and zero drills that enable direct sowing and in-situ residue management. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to implement sustainable practices that protect the environment, improve soil health, and increase long-term crop productivity.

title: Crowd Management
desc: The Management of Crowd at Large Congregations course introduces participants to the fundamentals of crowd management, a critical aspect of public safety and disaster prevention in India. This course addresses the significant challenges posed by mass gatherings and emphasizes the importance of proactive planning to avert incidents such as stampedes. It is specifically tailored for administrators, police personnel, and other stakeholders responsible for public order and safety. Participants will explore key theoretical concepts, practical tools, and proven techniques for assessing crowd dynamics, identifying potential risks, and implementing effective control measures. Through case studies and practical examples, learners will be equipped to develop comprehensive crowd management plans, coordinate with multiple agencies, and respond decisively to emergencies. The goal is to empower officials with the confidence and skills needed to ensure the safety and security of the public during large-scale events.
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

title: Crowd Management at Railway Station
desc: Crowd Management at Railway Stations is an essential course designed for officials and personnel responsible for public safety in India's extensive rail network. The course delves into the complexities of managing large crowds, a frequent challenge driven by high population density, diverse travel patterns, and major events like festivals and recruitment drives. It provides a structured approach to proactive and reactive crowd management, covering pre-crisis, crisis, and post-crisis stages. Key learning areas include analyzing crowd behavior, assessing station capacity and infrastructure like foot-over-bridges and platforms, and strategic staff deployment. The curriculum emphasizes the importance of inter-agency coordination, prompt medical aid, and the use of technical aids such as CCTV and announcement systems. By referencing NDMA guidelines and real-world scenarios, this course equips learners with the knowledge to develop and implement effective plans that ensure passenger safety, prevent incidents, and maintain smooth operations at railway stations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: CRS Sanction
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the sanctioning process managed by the Commissioner of Railway Safety (CRS), a crucial statutory function within the Ministry of Railways. The content is designed for officials and engineers involved in railway projects, construction, and operations who need to understand the legal and technical prerequisites for project commissioning. The course will delve into the specific requirements for preparing and submitting proposals for CRS inspection and sanction. Participants will learn about the various stages of the sanctioning process, from initial application to final approval, including the types of documents required and the standards against which projects are evaluated. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the CRS sanction process effectively, ensuring that railway infrastructure projects meet all mandatory safety and regulatory standards before they are opened to the public, thereby contributing to a safer and more reliable railway network.

title: Cultivating Mental Wellness
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip learners with the knowledge and tools to cultivate robust mental wellness. It delves into the core principles of Positive Psychology, moving beyond the mere absence of illness to focus on what makes life fulfilling. The curriculum provides a clear framework for understanding mental health, starting with how to recognize the characteristics of a thriving individual, such as resilience, self-awareness, and a sense of purpose. Participants will analyze the various barriers—including negative thought patterns, stress, and social stigma—that can impede mental well-being. The course emphasizes practical application, offering actionable steps to build positive habits. Key learning areas include the importance of social connections, the benefits of mindfulness, effective stress management techniques, and the power of self-care. Learners will discover how to apply these strategies in their personal and professional lives to not only cope with challenges but also to proactively build a state of enduring mental fitness and contentment.

title: Cultural Sensitization of North Eastern States
desc: Embark on a journey through the rich and diverse landscapes of North East India with this introductory course on cultural sensitization. Designed for government officials, trainees, and anyone new to the region, this program provides a foundational understanding of the 'Seven Sisters': Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura. The course addresses the critical need for cultural awareness, especially for those relocating for work, to ensure smooth assimilation and effective public service. Key learning areas include a state-by-state exploration of history, demography, climate, major festivals, traditional arts, cuisine, and connectivity. By delving into the unique ethnic diversity, including major tribes and their customs, learners will gain valuable insights into the socio-cultural fabric of the region. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to interact with local communities respectfully, appreciate the area's profound heritage, and contribute positively to the region's development.

title: Customer Engagement in Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Projects
desc: Developed as part of the Ministry of Power’s Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), this course addresses the often-underestimated challenge of customer engagement in large-scale technology deployments. It moves beyond the technical aspects of AMI to focus on the human element, which is crucial for project success and sustainability. The curriculum is designed to equip officials from power distribution companies (DISCOMs) with practical strategies and tools for effective consumer interaction throughout the project lifecycle—from planning and deployment to ongoing operations. Key learning areas include understanding consumer psychology, designing multi-channel communication campaigns, managing stakeholder expectations, creating robust feedback and grievance redressal mechanisms, and ensuring data privacy. Through national and international case studies, learners will discover how to proactively manage public perception, mitigate resistance, and transform the utility-consumer relationship from passive to participatory, ultimately leading to enhanced service delivery and consumer delight.

title: Customer Relationship Management in India Post-English
desc: This course is designed to equip India Post personnel with the essential skills for effective Customer Relationship Management (CRM). The program begins by establishing the strategic importance of bulk and contractual customers to India Post's business, highlighting how strong customer relationships drive revenue and service excellence. The core of the course is a practical, step-by-step walkthrough of the SAP-CRM system. Learners will be guided through the entire customer lifecycle management process, from initial registration and account creation to managing contact persons and finalizing contracts. Key learning areas include understanding the specific criteria for contractual customers, the various value-added services like credit facilities and volume-based discounts, and the legal documentation required. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in using the SAP-CRM module to manage customer accounts, ensuring procedural compliance and enhancing the overall customer experience, which is vital for marketing executives and divisional office staff.

title: Customs and Free Trade Agreement
desc: This course on Customs and Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) provides a comprehensive understanding of customs procedures, tariff classification, valuation, and regulatory compliance. It explains the framework and benefits of FTAs, including rules of origin and preferential duty treatment. Learners will gain practical insights into facilitating trade, ensuring compliance, preventing violations, and enhancing efficiency in cross-border transactions within the evolving global trade environment.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Customs Broker
desc: This foundational course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the Customs Broker profession and its regulatory landscape in India. It delves into the essential functions of a Customs Broker, who acts as a vital intermediary between importers/exporters and customs authorities, ensuring the smooth clearance of goods across borders. The course explains the significance of this role in the broader context of supply chain management and international trade facilitation. Participants will be guided through the key provisions of The Customs Act, 1962, and the Customs Broker Licensing Regulations, which govern the activities and responsibilities of these professionals. The curriculum is structured to detail the specific obligations a broker must adhere to, including prohibitions and the consequences of non-compliance such as suspension or revocation of their license. Furthermore, the course outlines the step-by-step process for becoming a licensed Customs Broker, covering educational qualifications, examination requirements, and other necessary formalities. Upon completion, learners will be well-equipped with the knowledge required to understand the customs brokerage field and its legal requirements.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Customs Clearance: Assessment and Duties and Trade Facilitation
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal, procedural, and operational framework governing Customs clearance under the Customs Act, 1962. It covers the significance and types of Bills of Entry, filing requirements, supporting documentation, Customs assessment procedures, examination, and clearance processes. Learners will gain an understanding of Customs duties, exemptions, preferential tariffs, effective tariff rates, and export duties under the Customs Tariff Act, 1975. The course also introduces key digital and trade facilitation initiatives, including ICES/EDI, SWIFT, e-Sanchit, the Risk Management System (RMS), Turant Customs, faceless assessment, and paperless processing. It explains the roles and responsibilities of Customs officers involved in assessment, examination, risk management, compliance verification, and enforcement.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Customs Warehousing under the Customs Act 1962
desc: This course explains the warehousing provisions under the Customs Act, 1962, and how imported goods can be stored in bonded warehouses without immediate payment of customs duty. It covers different types of warehouses, licensing procedures, and the legal framework governing warehousing operations. The course also outlines the processes involved in storing, managing, and clearing goods for home consumption, export, or transfer. Overall, it helps learners understand how customs warehousing facilitates efficient trade and supports better cash flow management.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Cyber and CDR Analysis
desc: This program offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of Call Detail Record (CDR) analysis in modern policing. The course is specifically designed for police investigators and field officers to build confidence and proficiency in using technical data for solving crimes. Learners will explore the fundamental question of 'what is CDR,' its various types (Personal, PSTN, IMEI, IPDR), and the significance of each data column, including Cell ID, IMEI, and IMSI. The curriculum progresses from basic definitions to practical analysis techniques, illustrated through real-world case studies that demonstrate how to track suspect movements and establish connections. A significant focus is placed on the correct procedures for obtaining and handling data, the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for analysis, and the legal requirements for presenting CDR as electronic evidence in court, including the importance of the 65B certificate. Upon completion, officers will be prepared to effectively integrate CDR analysis into their investigative workflow for ordinary crimes.

title: Cyber Contraventions and Cyber Offences
desc: This comprehensive session examines the legal architecture governing cyberspace in India, as established by the Information Technology Act, 2000, and its amendments. The course systematically breaks down the provisions for civil wrongs, known as cyber contraventions, covering acts like unauthorized access, data theft, and the introduction of computer contaminants. It details the process for seeking compensation and the role of the adjudicating officer. Furthermore, the course delves into serious criminal liabilities, or cyber offences, including identity theft, cyber terrorism, violation of privacy, and tampering with computer source documents. It explains the criteria for criminal prosecution, such as dishonest or fraudulent intent, and discusses the associated punishments. Participants will gain a robust understanding of the liabilities of individuals, corporations, and intermediaries, the procedures for investigation and evidence collection, and the jurisdictional scope of the Act. This knowledge is essential for legal professionals, law enforcement, and IT compliance officers to effectively manage cyber risks and apply legal remedies.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Crime Investigation - Basic Course
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the ability to properly handle electronic evidence is crucial for modern law enforcement. This course, 'Introduction to Cyber Crime Investigation,' serves as an essential primer for police officers and investigators who are new to the field of digital forensics. It addresses the critical need for foundational knowledge in managing cyber-related crime scenes.The curriculum begins with the fundamentals, breaking down the components of computers, networks, and mobile devices in an easy-to-understand format. It then progresses to the core of digital forensics, explaining what constitutes digital evidence and the specialized tools used in its acquisition. Participants will learn the correct procedures for seizing, handling, packaging, and documenting digital devices to maintain the chain of custody. Key forensic concepts such as hashing, imaging, cloning, and the use of write-blockers are explained to ensure evidence integrity. Upon completion, officers will be prepared to secure digital evidence effectively, ensuring its admissibility and value in investigations and court.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Cyber Hygiene Essentials
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding and combating cyber threats is crucial for every government official. This course, 'Cyber Hygiene Essentials,' offers a comprehensive guide to navigating the complex landscape of cybersecurity. It delves into the real-world dangers that individuals and organizations face, from sophisticated phishing and ransomware attacks to deceptive social engineering tactics, deepfakes, and digital arrest scams. The program is designed to build practical skills and digital vigilance. Participants will learn not only to recognize these threats but also to implement robust preventive measures. A key focus is on developing the capacity to act as a first responder during a cyber incident, utilizing national resources like the 1930 helpline and the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP). Furthermore, the course provides a clear overview of India’s evolving legal and regulatory environment, including the IT Act 2000 and recent legislative updates, ensuring that learners can operate securely and in compliance with national standards. By the end of this course, you will be empowered to protect yourself and your organization from the pervasive risk of cybercrime.
org: Jagjivan Ram Railway Protection Force Academy (JRRPF)

title: Cyber Rakshak: Fundamentals of Cyber Security for Public Officials
desc: This course provides government officers with a practical understanding of cyber security in India's rapidly expanding digital governance ecosystem. It examines how Digital Public Infrastructure, cloud services, APIs, artificial intelligence, and data-driven governance have transformed public service delivery while increasing cyber risks. The course positions cyber security as a governance responsibility that impacts citizen trust, service continuity, economic growth, and national security. Participants learn key concepts such as vulnerabilities, threats, cyber adversaries, and the principles of Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA). The course also covers cyber resilience, incident response, privacy, compliance, data protection, and responsible data handling. In addition, officers develop essential cyber hygiene skills, including identifying phishing attempts, securing devices and accounts, and reporting incidents promptly, enabling them to contribute for secure system.

title: Cyber Resilience for Bharat
desc: In an era of rapid digitization, ensuring the security and resilience of our national digital infrastructure is paramount. This course offers a comprehensive overview of India's approach to cybersecurity, as detailed by a leading expert from the Data Security Council of India (DSCI).
