The discussion delves into the complexities of securing vast, interconnected systems like Digital Public Infrastructure (DPIs) and India Stack, which form the backbone of the nation's digital economy. Key learning areas include understanding the shift from enterprise-level to ecosystem-level security, the strategic importance of public-private partnerships, and the urgent need for capacity building and skilling in the cybersecurity domain. The course also addresses emerging threats from AI, quantum computing, and converged IT/OT environments, providing a forward-looking perspective on the future of cyber warfare and defense. Participants will learn about the frameworks and strategies being developed to protect critical government services and infrastructure, ultimately understanding how to contribute to a more secure and resilient Digital Bharat.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Resilience in Critical Infrastructure Systems
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world, the security of Critical Infrastructure Systems (CIS) is paramount to national stability and economic continuity. This course addresses the urgent need for enhanced cyber resilience in sectors reliant on Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS). It provides a comprehensive examination of the current threat landscape, highlighting the vulnerabilities of legacy systems and the growing sophistication of cyber attacks like ransomware. The curriculum explores key international security and compliance frameworks, including IEC-62443 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, providing a foundation for building robust defense mechanisms. Learners will gain a deep understanding of governance gaps and the necessity for mandated cybersecurity policies. The course emphasizes the strategic shift towards a Zero Trust Architecture, the role of continuous awareness programs, and the creation of a strong cybersecurity culture. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to better analyze risks and contribute to the development of resilient security strategies for protecting vital national infrastructure.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Scams: Lottery and Phishing Awareness
desc: The course is designed to help learners identify, understand, and respond effectively to common cyber frauds targeting individuals through digital platforms. The course focuses on lottery scams and phishing attacks, explaining how cybercriminals use fake prize notifications, spoofed websites, deceptive emails, and urgent messages to mislead users and steal personal, financial, and banking information. Through practical examples and real-world scenarios, learners will understand the tactics used by fraudsters, including impersonation of trusted brands, manipulation of urgency, and use of malicious links or fake domains. The course also highlights key warning signs that help in early detection of scams. It further promotes safe and responsible digital behaviour by guiding learners on preventive measures, secure online practices, and appropriate response mechanisms, including reporting cyber fraud through official platforms such as cybercrime.gov.in and the National Cybercrime Helpline.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Cyber Scams: Vishing and Quishing
desc: This course equips learners with the knowledge and skills required to identify, prevent, and respond to two of the fastest-growing forms of cyber fraud: Voice Phishing (Vishing) and QR Code Phishing (Quishing). The course explains how cybercriminals impersonate banks, government officials, service providers, friends, or family members to manipulate individuals into sharing sensitive information or authorizing fraudulent transactions. Through realistic scenarios, practical examples, and government-recommended safety practices, learners will develop the ability to recognize social engineering tactics, caller ID spoofing, fake payment requests, malicious QR codes, and urgency-based scams. The course promotes cyber hygiene, secure digital behavior, and timely reporting of cyber incidents to help protect personal information, financial assets, and digital identities.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Cyber Security
desc: In today's interconnected world, understanding and implementing cybersecurity measures is crucial for every individual. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the core concepts of digital safety. It begins by establishing the importance of desktop security, detailing threats such as viruses, malware, and hacking, and explaining protective measures like antivirus software, firewalls, and strong password policies. The curriculum then delves into the prevalent issue of online financial frauds, teaching learners to identify and avoid scams related to job offers, fake advertisements, and OTP theft. Furthermore, the course addresses the unique security challenges of social media, providing guidance on privacy settings, recognizing impersonation, and preventing cyber extortion.

title: Cyber Security  and Strategy
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, understanding the landscape of cyber threats is critical for national security and effective governance. This course delves into the multifaceted world of cyber security, beginning with the core principles of protecting digital assets and infrastructure. Participants will learn about practical defense mechanisms, including network security tools, data recovery techniques, and security audit procedures. The curriculum expands to a strategic, macro-level perspective, examining the nature of cyber warfare, the role of cyber diplomacy, and the structure of national cyber security strategies, with a specific focus on the Indian context, including the Defense Cyber Agency and the National Cyber Security Policy. By analyzing real-world case studies like the Stuxnet attack and discussing emerging threats from AI and IoT, learners will be prepared to analyze vulnerabilities, evaluate risks, and understand the policies designed to protect the nation's critical information infrastructure.

title: Cyber Security (Intermediate level)
desc: In an increasingly connected digital world, understanding and defending against cyber threats is paramount. This course offers a detailed exploration of cybersecurity vulnerabilities, designed for learners with a foundational knowledge of IT systems. It begins by defining what constitutes a vulnerability and examines the root causes, from inherent design flaws in hardware and software to lapses in security policy and human error. The course delves into specific attack vectors, such as buffer overflows and OS command injection, explaining how malicious actors exploit them to gain unauthorized access. A significant portion is dedicated to defensive strategies. You will learn about the critical processes of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), which are used to identify, classify, and prioritize security risks. The course also covers the lifecycle of a vulnerability, from discovery to the development and deployment of patches.

title: Cyber security and Data Privacy: Ethical and Legal Considerations
desc: In an era of rapid digitalization, understanding the ethical and legal dimensions of data is paramount for public officials. This course delves into the core principles of cybersecurity and data privacy, offering a detailed examination of the responsibilities of organizations as data fiduciaries. You will explore the nuances of legal compliance, covering essential regulations like India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, the IT Act, and global standards such as GDPR. The curriculum addresses critical topics including lawful data processing, consent management, data breach notification protocols, and the rights of data principals. Through this course, you will learn to navigate complex ethical dilemmas, implement robust security measures, and ensure your organization's data handling practices are both legally compliant and ethically sound, thereby fostering public trust and safeguarding digital rights.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Security Audit
desc: In an increasingly digital governance landscape, ensuring the security and integrity of public data is paramount. This course, 'Cyber Security Audit Fundamentals and Best Practices,' offers a detailed examination of the essential practice of cybersecurity auditing. It provides the foundational knowledge required to assess and strengthen an organization's defenses against cyber threats. The course establishes the context by differentiating between audits and assessments and highlighting the importance of audits for regulatory compliance, data protection, and maintaining public trust. Key learning areas include a deep dive into the end-to-end audit process, from initial scoping and planning to evidence gathering, analysis, and final reporting. The curriculum explores various audit sampling methodologies, such as random, stratified, and risk-based sampling, enabling learners to select the most appropriate approach. Furthermore, the course reviews globally recognized frameworks like ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and COBIT, alongside national standards from bodies like RBI and SEBI, providing a robust understanding of the compliance landscape. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to participate in or manage cybersecurity audit processes within their departments. They will be able to identify system vulnerabilities, understand risk treatment plans, and contribute to building a more secure and resilient digital infrastructure for public service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Security Audit of Government Websites
desc: This course provides government officials and technical teams with an understanding of the basic cybersecurity guidelines and security requirements to be considered while developing and preparing government websites and web applications for deployment. The course focuses on the OWASP Top 10, a widely recognised baseline for identifying common web application security risks, and relates these concepts to the context of government web applications and cloud hosting in India. Participants will gain an understanding of common vulnerabilities, their potential impact, and the importance of addressing identified security risks before a website or web application is made publicly accessible. The course also introduces the key steps involved in a pre-hosting cybersecurity audit, including Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), security assessment, remediation, and audit certification.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India
keywords: Hosting of Government Websites on Cloud Server

title: Cyber Security Basics
desc: In an era where digital threats are constantly evolving, a strong understanding of cybersecurity is essential for all government employees. This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to the core principles of protecting digital assets. It begins by defining cybersecurity and outlining the modern threat landscape, from network-based attacks like DDoS and Man-in-the-Middle to application and device-based vulnerabilities. You will delve into the world of cryptography, understanding the mechanics of symmetric and asymmetric encryption, hashing, and the role of digital signatures in ensuring data integrity. The course also explains the critical difference between authentication and authorization, covering methods from single-factor to multifactor authentication and the principle of least privileged access. By exploring these topics, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to recognize common cyberattacks, understand their mechanisms, and implement fundamental mitigation strategies to safeguard sensitive government information and infrastructure.

title: CYBER SECURITY BEST PRACTICES FOR AN ORGANIZATION
desc: In an increasingly digital world, safeguarding an organization's network is paramount. This course, 'Cyber Security Best Practices for an Organization,' offers a structured guide to the fundamental pillars of a robust cybersecurity posture. It is specifically designed for network administrators and IT personnel responsible for maintaining network integrity. The curriculum is built around ten core best practices that address the most common security challenges. Key learning areas include the importance of strong, unique passwords, securing all network entry points with tools like firewalls and IDS/IPS, and the strategic value of network segmentation to contain threats. The course also delves into the necessity of defining and enforcing clear security policies, raising employee awareness about social engineering, and the critical role of encryption for all data. Furthermore, it covers practical advice on regular network maintenance, exercising caution with cloud services, implementing proper administrative privileges, and developing a secure policy for employees using their own devices (BYOD). Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these principles to significantly enhance their organization's defense against cyber attacks.

title: Cyber Security Fundamentals and National Initiatives
desc: This course provides an introductory overview of cyber security, covering fundamental concepts such as cyber threats, attack vectors, data protection, and commonly used security tools. It introduces the CIA triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability), types of malware, authentication mechanisms, and basic risk management principles. The course also highlights government cyber initiatives, cyber laws, and emerging trends in the cyber domain, building essential foundational knowledge for a secure digital environment.
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Cyber Security Guide for Government Officials
desc: With the growing reliance on Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in governance, the risk of cyber threats has significantly increased. This course, 'Cybersecurity Best Practices for Government Officials', addresses this challenge by equipping all government employees with the knowledge to protect digital systems. It provides simple, actionable steps to secure official and personal assets, including laptops, PCs, networks, and data. The curriculum covers critical areas such as device hardening, safe web browsing, secure email usage, and identifying risks from removable media. It also offers clear guidance on the responsible use of social media and online financial services. By completing this course, participants will become the first line of defense against cyber threats, fostering a culture of security and resilience across government departments.

title: Cyber Security in the Artificial Intelligence
desc: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming the digital landscape by enabling innovation across various sectors. However, the growing use of AI technologies has also introduced new and sophisticated cybersecurity challenges. AI-powered threats are becoming more advanced, scalable, and difficult to detect, allowing malicious actors to exploit these technologies for fraud, data breaches, misinformation, and other cyberattacks. This course provides an overview of emerging AI-enabled cyber threats and focuses on understanding how these threats operate and the risks they pose to individuals, organisations, and digital infrastructure. Through real-world examples and case studies, learners will explore major AI-related security challenges, including AI-powered voice cloning, exploitation of unsecured AI infrastructure, self-mutating malware, and AI-generated synthetic media.
org: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)

title: Cyber Security in the Internet of Things
desc: The Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed the way we live and work by enabling connected devices and smart systems across various domains, including smart homes, healthcare, transportation, and industrial automation. While IoT technologies offer greater convenience, efficiency, and automation, the increasing number of connected devices also introduces significant cybersecurity risks and challenges. This course has been developed as part of a sponsored project by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), with a focus on understanding cybersecurity best practices for emerging technologies. The course provides an overview of common threats faced by IoT devices and explores real-world examples to help learners understand potential vulnerabilities and risks.
org: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)

title: Cyber Shikshaa Fundamentals
desc: In an era of rapid digitalization, understanding the fundamentals of cybersecurity is paramount for every government official. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the world of cyber threats and digital defense. You will begin by learning to identify common risks such as phishing, malware, and social engineering that can compromise sensitive information. The curriculum covers the core principles of information security, including the significance of data privacy and protection. Participants will be guided on how to apply practical security measures in their daily work, such as creating strong passwords, using multi-factor authentication, and practicing safe browsing habits. By the end of this course, you will have developed a strong security-aware mindset, enabling you to contribute to a more secure digital government ecosystem and protect both personal and official data from malicious actors. This course is the starting point for building a culture of cybersecurity within public service.

title: Cyber Smart: Tackling Social Media Offences
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of social media-related offences and the measures required to safeguard against them in an increasingly digital environment. Participants will explore the evolution, magnitude, and various forms of social media offences, including cyberbullying, phishing, identity theft, impersonation, profile hacking, online frauds, and the misuse of digital platforms for unlawful activities. The course also examines the legal and policy framework governing social media in India, covering key provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, and other important legal obligations relating to data privacy, child protection, and confidentiality. In addition, learners will gain practical knowledge on preventing social media-related offences through secure digital practices, awareness of online threats, responsible online conduct, and adherence

title: Cyber Threats Facing the Nation Creating a Cyber Surakshit Bharat
desc: As India solidifies its position as a global digital powerhouse, cybersecurity has become a paramount pillar of national security and economic stability. This in-depth discussion navigates the complex domain of national cybersecurity, explaining why it is a strategic priority beyond a mere technical issue. The course delves into the most pressing cyber threats targeting India's critical sectors, including finance, defense, and energy, using real-world examples to illustrate their potential impact. Learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of India's defensive architecture, including the coordinated efforts of CERT-In, NCIIPC, and the NCSC. The session further examines the evolving policy landscape, such as the National Cyber Security Strategy and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. It also looks to the future, addressing emerging challenges from AI, quantum computing, and supply chain vulnerabilities, ultimately outlining the vision for a resilient and 'Cyber Surakshit Bharat' through robust governance, public-private partnerships, and enhanced citizen awareness.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Torts, Cyber Contravention and Adjudicating Authorities
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of cyber torts, contraventions, and the role of adjudicating authorities within the Indian legal system. Participants will learn to differentiate between a cyber contravention (a civil wrong) and a cybercrime, understanding the critical role of 'mens rea' or intent. The curriculum delves into key provisions of the IT Act, 2000, such as Section 43, and discusses the evolution of data protection laws, including the replacement of Section 43A with the comprehensive Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. Through the analysis of landmark case laws concerning data breaches, financial fraud, and intermediary liability, learners will gain practical insights into how these laws are applied. The course also clarifies the powers and procedures of adjudicating officers and appellate tribunals like TDSAT, equipping legal professionals, policymakers, and government officers with the necessary knowledge to ensure compliance and handle techno-legal challenges effectively.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cyber Vigilance: What Every Digital Citizen Must Know
desc: In today's hyper-connected world, understanding and navigating the complexities of cyberspace is essential for every citizen, especially those in public service. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the modern cyber threat landscape, moving beyond technical jargon to explore the human element of cybersecurity. It provides critical context on why cyber vigilance is no longer optional but a fundamental responsibility for digital citizenship. The curriculum delves into several key areas, including the psychological tactics used by cybercriminals, the structure and impact of misinformation and disinformation campaigns, and the evolving nature of digital threats. Through an engaging dialogue between a cybersecurity strategist and a former intelligence officer, learners will explore the importance of robust digital hygiene, the concept of cyber resilience, and the challenges faced by cybercrime first responders. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these principles to safeguard their personal and official digital activities. They will gain an informed perspective on proactive cybersecurity, enabling them to better identify potential threats, respond effectively to incidents, and contribute to a culture of security awareness within their organizations and communities. This course is a vital step towards building a more secure and resilient digital India.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybercrime and Digital Forensics
desc: In an era of increasing digital threats, understanding the landscape of cybercrime and the science of digital forensics is crucial for maintaining security and upholding the law. This course delves into the core concepts of cybercrime investigation, beginning with real-world case studies that illustrate the critical need for both technical skill and legal awareness. Participants will explore the evolution of digital forensics, the psychology of cybercriminals, and the distinction between cyber-dependent and cyber-enabled crimes. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Indian legal framework, with a detailed examination of the Information Technology Act 2000 and its provisions related to cyber offenses, privacy, and evidence. The curriculum also covers international standards like ISO 27037 and ISO 27043, which guide the identification, collection, and preservation of electronic evidence. By the end of this session, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to handle cybercrime incidents, understand the reporting mechanisms in India, and appreciate the technical and non-technical skills required for a successful career in digital forensics.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybercrime Investigation
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip professionals with the expertise to effectively investigate, prevent, and respond to cybercrime. The curriculum provides a foundational understanding of the cybercrime landscape, detailing various digital offenses and their impact. Participants will learn the critical preparatory steps for an investigation, including information gathering and adherence to legal frameworks. The course delves into the systematic process of a cybercrime investigation, covering suspect identification, digital footprint analysis, and the meticulous collection and preservation of digital evidence to ensure its admissibility in legal proceedings. Furthermore, learners will explore proactive cybersecurity best practices and preventive strategies to mitigate risks. The final modules introduce the concepts of cyber threat intelligence and analyze emerging trends, preparing participants to anticipate and counter future digital threats in an ever-evolving cyberspace.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Cybercrime Investigation Fundamentals
desc: As cybercrime continues to grow in complexity, it is crucial for law enforcement personnel to be equipped with the necessary skills to combat these digital threats. This foundational course is designed to meet that need, offering a comprehensive introduction to the world of cybercrime investigation. The curriculum covers the essential context of cybercrime, detailing its various forms and the technical terminology investigators will encounter. Participants will learn the critical best practices for digital evidence collection, preservation, and handling to ensure its admissibility in legal proceedings. The course also provides an overview of basic cyber forensic tools and techniques used for analyzing digital evidence. By the end of this training, learners will understand the standard procedures for investigating cybercrime cases in full compliance with established legal frameworks, enhancing their capacity to protect and serve in the digital age.

title: Cybersecurity
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding cybersecurity is no longer optional. This foundational course is designed to equip public service professionals with the essential knowledge to navigate the complexities of the digital domain securely. The program begins by demystifying the internet's architecture and proceeds to build a strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, including the crucial CIA (Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability) triad. You will learn to identify and analyze a variety of cyber threats, from common phishing scams and malware to sophisticated, state-sponsored attacks, illustrated through real-world case studies like Stuxnet. The course details the layered approach to enterprise security, explaining the roles of firewalls, antivirus software, and other key technologies. Furthermore, it provides an overview of the legal framework in India, including the IT Act, to contextualize cybercrime and digital law. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to recognize vulnerabilities, implement basic security practices, and contribute to a more secure digital governance ecosystem.

title: Cybersecurity (Basic Level)
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding the principles of cybersecurity is crucial for protecting organizational and personal assets. This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental concepts of cybersecurity. It begins by establishing the context of security, differentiating between computer, network, and information security. You will explore the critical protection mechanisms that form the basis of any security strategy: deterrence, prevention, detection, and response. The curriculum delves into key technical components of network defense, such as the role of firewalls in filtering traffic, the importance of encryption in safeguarding data, and the function of intrusion detection systems. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the five pillars of information assurance—access control, authentication, confidentiality, integrity, and non-repudiation—which provide a robust framework for securing digital environments.

title: Cybersecurity and E-Governance Risks
desc: As government services become increasingly digitized, understanding and mitigating cybersecurity risks is paramount for public functionaries. This course delves into the intersection of cybersecurity and e-governance, providing a robust framework for protecting digital assets. It begins by contextualizing the importance of Digital India's pillars and the transformation of public service delivery. The curriculum then explores the spectrum of cyber threats, from phishing and ransomware to sophisticated state-sponsored attacks like Stuxnet, using real-world examples such as the AIIMS data breach to illustrate their severe consequences. Key learning areas include foundational security principles like the CIA triad, strategic frameworks like 'Defense in Depth' and the cyber kill chain, and the importance of proactive measures such as incident response planning, continuous monitoring, and promoting user awareness. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze security vulnerabilities, contribute to the development of security policies, and foster a culture of cybersecurity within their organizations to safeguard critical public infrastructure and maintain citizen trust.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybersecurity for Critical Information Infrastructure
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII), examining its sectoral components, threat landscape, and security frameworks. Learners will develop a structured understanding of why certain digital systems are deemed nationally critical and explore strategies to enhance their resilience against modern cyber threats. The course also delves into regulatory and operational frameworks, incident response strategies, and the roles of key stakeholders in maintaining CII security.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals for Government Personnel
desc: In an era of rapid digitalization, securing government infrastructure is paramount. This course is designed to equip public officials with the essential knowledge and strategic mindset required to navigate the complex world of cybersecurity. It begins by defining cybersecurity and deconstructing the myth of absolute security, introducing learners to foundational concepts such as the CIA triad and the DAD (Disclosure, Alteration, Denial) model of adversarial goals. The curriculum delves into practical frameworks for defense, including risk-based security, asset valuation, and the OODA (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act) loop for effective response. Participants will explore the modern threat landscape, covering topics like ransomware-as-a-service, the weaponization of information, and the challenges posed by emerging technologies like AI and quantum computing. The course culminates in a discussion on cyber resilience, highlighting the importance of not just protecting systems, but also ensuring they can withstand, adapt to, and recover from attacks, thereby safeguarding the continuity of digital governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals for Leaders
desc: In an era of rapid digitalization, securing public digital infrastructure is paramount. This course is designed for government leaders and decision-makers, offering a strategic overview of the modern cybersecurity landscape. It delves into the complexities of cyber threats targeting e-governance systems, including advanced persistent threats (APTs), phishing, ransomware, and sophisticated supply chain attacks. The curriculum provides a comprehensive look at key defensive frameworks and models such as the STRIDE and PASTA models for threat analysis, and the Cyber Kill Chain for understanding attack stages. Learners will gain insights into the role of AI in adversarial attacks and the importance of a robust Software Bill of Materials (S-BOM). By the end of the course, leaders will be equipped to ask the right questions of their security teams, champion a culture of cyber hygiene, and develop proactive strategies to protect their organization's critical assets and data, ensuring resilient and secure digital governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybersecurity in Cloud Computing
desc: This course has been developed as part of a sponsored project from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). As digital technologies continue to evolve, cybersecurity has become a shared responsibility among users, manufacturers, and service providers. Emerging technologies such as Cloud Computing, the Internet of Things (IoT), and Artificial Intelligence (AI) introduce new security risks that need to be addressed from the design stage itself. The course provides an overview of cloud computing and cloud security, highlighting common threats and practical measures to protect cloud environments. It emphasises the importance of adopting basic security practices, such as using strong authentication, keeping devices and software updated, limiting unnecessary access, and monitoring system activity. Through awareness and proactive security measures, users can contribute to making emerging technologies safer, more reliable, and more trustworthy.
org: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)

title: Cybersecurity Masterclass: Managing Information and Risk
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, managing information and cybersecurity risks is paramount for government organizations. This comprehensive masterclass, led by a seasoned expert, offers a deep dive into the critical domains of cybersecurity. The course begins by establishing the fundamental pillars of information security—the CIA triad—and explains how to build a robust security governance structure through well-defined policies and risk management processes. Participants will learn the practical steps of asset security, including inventory, classification, and lifecycle management. The curriculum also covers security engineering, network security essentials, and the importance of identity and access management. Furthermore, the course details the operational side of security, including assessment, testing, incident response, and the role of tools like SIEM and EDR. By the end of this session, learners will be able to analyze their organization's security posture, understand major threats like ransomware and phishing, and apply internationally recognized frameworks like ISO 27001 to develop and implement an effective information security management system.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Cybersecurity Phishing and Pharming: Protecting Yourself
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding and defending against cyber threats is crucial for every individual. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to cybersecurity, specifically designed for government employees at all levels. It demystifies the concepts of phishing and pharming, two of the most common methods used by attackers to steal sensitive information. The curriculum delves into the mechanics of various attack vectors, including deceptive emails, spear phishing, vishing, smishing, and emerging threats like QRishing. Participants will learn to recognize the tell-tale signs of a malicious attempt and adopt best practices for digital hygiene. Key learning areas include creating strong passwords, enabling two-factor authentication, verifying sender identities, and avoiding unsafe networks. The course emphasizes practical application, empowering learners to not only protect their own data but also contribute to the overall security posture of their organization. It serves as an essential first step in building a culture of cyber awareness within the public sector.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Cyclone-Disaster Response Training
desc: In an era of increasing climate-related events, understanding how to respond to natural disasters like cyclones is a critical public service skill. This course, 'Cyclone Preparedness and Disaster Response,' offers a comprehensive introduction to the subject, tailored for volunteers and first responders. The curriculum begins by defining cyclones, explaining their scientific causes, and detailing their potential impact on infrastructure and human life. Participants will learn to identify various types of cyclones and understand the official warning systems used for prediction and public alerts. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical, life-saving knowledge. It outlines systematic safety procedures for individuals and communities to implement before, during, and after a cyclonic event. Furthermore, the course highlights the structured role of volunteers within the disaster management framework, explaining their responsibilities and how they can contribute effectively to response and relief operations. By completing this course, learners will be better prepared to act decisively and safely in the face of a cyclone.

title: Cyclone-Disaster Response Training
desc: Cyclones pose a significant and recurring threat to coastal communities, necessitating a well-prepared and informed response from both citizens and public officials. This course is designed to build foundational knowledge and practical skills for effective cyclone disaster management. It provides a comprehensive overview of cyclones, starting with their scientific causes, classification into different types, and the potential impacts on life, property, and infrastructure. Participants will learn to identify and interpret official warning signs and predictions, enabling timely and appropriate actions. A major focus of the course is on detailing actionable safety procedures to be followed before, during, and after a cyclone to minimize risk. The curriculum also emphasizes the critical role of volunteers in disaster situations, outlining how individuals can effectively support official response efforts. Upon completion, learners will be equipped not only to protect themselves but also to act as informed members of their community, contributing to a more resilient society.

title: DAK COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME
desc: The Dak Community Development Programme (DCDP) course is designed to equip postal employees with the knowledge and skills to effectively implement this key government initiative. The program aims to transform India Post into a central hub for Government-to-Citizen (G2C) services, focusing on financial literacy, Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT), and broad access to welfare schemes. This course details the strategic framework of DCDP, covering the planning, execution, and monitoring of community events in both rural and urban areas. Participants will learn about the critical pre-event activities, such as local marketing and data collection, the minute-to-minute schedule for conducting events, and post-event reporting using a dedicated online dashboard. By understanding the focus areas like financial inclusion through POSB and IPPB products, stakeholder engagement, and customer grievance redressal, learners will be prepared to drive community participation and ensure the successful delivery of essential services to every citizen.

title: DAK GHAR NIRYAT KENDRA
desc: The Dak Ghar Niryat Kendra (DNK) initiative is a significant step by the Department of Posts to integrate local producers and MSMEs into the global market. This course is specifically designed to prepare Postal Officials to become key facilitators in this process. It provides the foundational knowledge and practical skills required to operate a DNK effectively. Participants will delve into the critical aspects of international mail handling, including customs regulations, packaging solutions, and documentation. The curriculum covers the entire DNK workflow, ensuring officials can manage operations from start to finish. Key learning areas include mastering the DNK digital portal for registrations and bookings, providing expert guidance to exporters, and troubleshooting common issues to ensure hassle-free service. Upon completion, officials will be fully capable of managing a DNK, empowering local businesses to expand their reach and contributing to the nation's export growth.

title: Dak Ghar Niryat Kendra for Officers- English
desc: This program offers an in-depth exploration of the Dak Ghar Niryat Kendra (DNK), a pivotal initiative by India Post to democratize the export landscape. The course is contextualized within India's broader economic goals, such as 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' and the Foreign Trade Policy 2023, highlighting the post office's crucial role in connecting local producers to global markets. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the operational framework of DNKs, including the digital portal for customer registration, documentation requirements like the Import Export Code (IEC) and GSTIN, and the electronic filing of the Postal Bill of Exports (PBE). The curriculum details the step-by-step process an exporter undertakes, from booking a consignment to customs clearance and international dispatch. It emphasizes the 'hand-holding' approach that officers are expected to provide, covering guidance on packaging, customs formalities, and leveraging benefits. By completing this course, officers will be fully equipped to manage DNK operations, facilitate a seamless export experience for small businesses, and contribute significantly to India's export growth from the grassroots level.

title: Dak Ghar Niryat Kendra for Officers- Hindi
desc: यह व्यापक पाठ्यक्रम डाक घर निर्यात केंद्र (डीएनके) की गहन समझ प्रदान करता है, जो भारत में निर्यात को लोकतांत्रिक बनाने के लिए डाक विभाग की एक महत्वपूर्ण पहल है। यह भारत के व्यापार इतिहास और विदेश व्यापार नीति 2023 और 'एक जिला एक उत्पाद' (ओडीओपी) जैसी नीतियों के पीछे की दृष्टि का संदर्भ स्थापित करके शुरू होता है। शिक्षार्थी स्थानीय कारीगरों, बुनकरों और एमएसएमई को अंतरराष्ट्रीय शिपिंग के लिए एक सरल, सुलभ मंच प्रदान करके उन्हें सशक्त बनाने में डीएनके की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका का पता लगाएंगे। पाठ्यक्रम डीएनके के संपूर्ण वर्कफ़्लो का विवरण देता है, जिसमें पोर्टल पर ग्राहक पंजीकरण और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक पोस्टल बिल ऑफ एक्सपोर्ट्स (पीबीई) की तैयारी से लेकर पैकेजिंग, सीमा शुल्क निकासी और अंतिम प्रेषण तक शामिल है। यह आईईसी, जीएसटीआईएन, और एडी कोड जैसे आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ीकरण की व्याख्या करता है, और बताता है कि कैसे डीएनके कर्मचारी हैंडहोल्डिंग सहायता प्रदान करते हैं। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करके, अधिकारी डीएनके संचालन को प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधित करने, संभावित निर्यातकों का मार्गदर्शन करने और 'आत्मनिर्भर भारत' के राष्ट्रीय मिशन के अनुरूप भारत को एक वैश्विक निर्यात केंद्र बनाने में योगदान करने के लिए सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Data Analysis and Decision Making - I (DADM-I)
desc: Data Analysis and Decision Making – I is designed to equip participants with the initial set of necessary knowledge and tools to analyze and interpret data. In an era where data is ubiquitous, this course serves as a crucial first step for professionals seeking to leverage data for informed choices. The course begins by exploring various methods of data presentation, such as histograms, pie charts, and dendrograms, to build a strong visual and intuitive understanding of data. It then progresses to the core principles of descriptive statistics, covering measures of central tendency, dispersion, skewness, and kurtosis. Learners will gain a solid grasp of probability theory, including concepts of conditional probability and different types of probability distributions, both discrete (like Binomial and Poisson) and continuous (like Normal and Exponential). The course concludes with an introduction to essential forecasting techniques, including weighted averages and exponential smoothing, providing practical skills for predicting future trends. Upon completion, participants will be able to approach data with confidence, perform basic analysis, and use the insights to support their decision-making processes.

title: Data Analysis and Decision Making - II (DADM-II)
desc: Data Analysis and Decision Making – II delves into the sophisticated quantitative models that underpin modern decision science. This course is structured to build upon foundational analytical skills, equipping learners with advanced tools to navigate complex scenarios involving multiple, often competing, criteria. The curriculum begins with an exploration of multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) concepts, including choice theory and the Condorcet paradox. It then progresses to the study of utility functions, enabling the modeling of risk preferences and behaviors such as risk aversion and neutrality. Participants will learn to apply powerful frameworks like the safety-first criteria and stochastic dominance to evaluate decisions under uncertainty. The final modules provide hands-on understanding of goal programming for optimization and a suite of non-parametric MCDM techniques, including the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), TOPSIS, ELECTRE, and VIKOR. Through practical examples in project management, finance, and production, learners will be able to apply these methods to make robust, justifiable, and optimal decisions in public administration and management.

title: Data Analysis and Visualization

title: Data Decryption in Classical Public Key Infrastructure Cryptosystem
desc: This course builds on the previous course, Overview of Public Key Infrastructure in Classical Cryptography, and provides an in-depth understanding of data decryption in a Classical Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) cryptosystem. In this course, encryption and decryption are based on asymmetric key pairs: a public key (shared) and a private key (kept secret). Data encrypted with a recipient’s public key can only be decrypted using the corresponding private key, ensuring confidentiality, authenticity, and integrity of digital communications. Learners will explore the complete decryption process, transforming ciphertext back into plaintext using private keys, and understand the mathematical foundations of classical cryptographic algorithms such as RSA, Diffie–Hellman, and Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC). The course also covers the PKI framework, including the role of trusted Certificate Authorities (CAs) and digital certificates, which bind public keys to verified identities.

title: Data Encryption in Classical Public Key Infrastructure Cryptosystem
desc: In a classical Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) cryptosystem, encryption is based on asymmetric key pairs: a public key (shared openly) and a private key (kept secret). Data encryption is performed using the recipient’s public key, ensuring that only the corresponding private key can decrypt it. This guarantees confidentiality, as only the intended recipient can access the plaintext. Conversely, decryption involves applying the private key to the ciphertext to recover the original data. PKI also supports digital signatures, where a sender encrypts a hash of the message using their private key, and recipients verify it using the sender’s public key. This process ensures authentication, integrity, and non-repudiation. Classical PKI underpins secure communication technologies such as SSL/TLS and digital certificates by providing a trusted framework for key management and secure data exchange.

It explores the growing role of green hydrogen, renewable energy, e-methanol, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS), alternative fuels, electrification, and advanced process technologies in reducing emissions from hard-to-abate industries. The course also examines how Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), digital twins, modelling, simulation, and process optimisation can support hydrogen production, carbon management, energy efficiency, catalyst development, predictive maintenance, and sustainable industrial operations. It highlights India’s decarbonisation priorities, including the Green Hydrogen Mission, SAF targets, emerging carbon markets, and the Net Zero 2070 vision.

title: Decision Making
desc: Effective decision-making is a cornerstone of good governance and public administration. This course is designed to equip government officials with the essential skills to navigate complex choices with clarity and confidence. Participants will explore various decision-making models and frameworks that can be applied to everyday administrative challenges and strategic issues. The content delves into the psychology of decision-making, highlighting common pitfalls like cognitive biases and groupthink, and provides practical techniques to mitigate them. By the end of this course, learners will be able to deconstruct problems, weigh evidence, assess risks, and articulate the rationale for their choices. This will enable them to contribute more effectively to their organizations, ensuring that decisions are not only timely and efficient but also ethical, transparent, and aligned with public service values.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Decoding Net Zero Energy Buildings
desc: This course, 'Principles and Strategies for Net Zero Energy Buildings,' delves into the critical need for sustainable construction in the face of global climate change and rising energy consumption. It begins by establishing the context, highlighting the significant energy footprint of buildings and the inefficiencies of traditional power generation. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of what constitutes a Net Zero Energy Building (NZEB), exploring definitions related to site energy, source energy, cost, and carbon. The core of the course focuses on actionable strategies for achieving net zero status. This includes a detailed look at the integrated design process, passive solar design principles like orientation and shading, and active strategies involving high-performance HVAC systems and smart lighting. The curriculum also covers the pivotal role of renewable energy, particularly solar photovoltaics, and explains Indian and global energy codes and rating systems like ECBC, IGBC, and LEED. Through an analysis of real-world case studies from India and abroad, including a special focus on the railway sector, participants will see these principles in action. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to contribute to the design and development of energy-efficient and environmentally responsible buildings.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Decoding Others
desc: In today's collaborative work environments, the ability to accurately understand colleagues, team members, and stakeholders is a critical skill for success. This course, 'Decoding Others,' moves beyond simple intuition to provide a structured approach to interpreting human behavior. It addresses the common pitfalls of snap judgments and biases by introducing a powerful three-step deduction model: Observe, Infer, and Verify. Participants will learn to systematically analyze both verbal and non-verbal communication, including tone of voice, body language, and even fleeting microexpressions, to gain a more objective understanding of others. The course is built around the comprehensive 'Decoding Triad,' which covers a person's core sensibilities, their unique character and skill strengths, and their preferred work style. Through practical examples and expert insights, learners will discover how to identify behavioral patterns, recognize emotional triggers, and assess individual work preferences using frameworks like the Social Styles Model. By completing this course, professionals will be equipped to build stronger relationships, lead with greater empathy, manage team dynamics more effectively, and adapt their own communication style to foster a more harmonious and productive workplace.

title: Decolonization and Its Impact on The Justice System
desc: Delve into a critical analysis of India's justice system with this course on the impacts of decolonization. The curriculum provides essential context on why the current legal framework, inherited from the British colonial era, faces significant challenges. You will explore how foundational laws like the Indian Penal Code of 1860 and the Code of Criminal Procedure of 1898 were designed for control rather than equitable justice, leading to systemic delays and high costs for citizens. The course then presents a compelling overview of indigenous Indian justice mechanisms, including Nyaya Panchayats and Lok Adalats. These alternative dispute resolution systems offer a model for more accessible, affordable, and community-centric justice. Furthermore, you will be introduced to the philosophical principles of Dharma (ethical duty) and Rta (cosmic order) and their relevance in creating a more just and restorative legal system. This course is essential for understanding the ongoing efforts to reform and Indianize the legal system to ensure it is efficient, fair, and truly serves the people in the journey towards a Viksit Bharat.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Decolonization: Economic Policies Inspired by The Arthashastra
desc: This course delves into the critical need for decolonizing India's economic thought and policy frameworks. It begins by analyzing the detrimental legacy of colonial rule, which established exploitative economic structures and fostered dependence, hindering equitable development. The curriculum challenges the conventional, post-colonial focus on Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as the sole indicator of progress, highlighting its inadequacy in capturing social equity, environmental sustainability, and holistic human well-being. As a powerful alternative, the course presents Kautilya's Arthashastra, a foundational treatise from Indian Knowledge Systems. Learners will explore its sophisticated and balanced approach to economic governance, which integrates the roles of the state, market principles, and social welfare. Key topics include the Arthashastra's perspectives on taxation, trade, administration, and diplomacy. The course connects these ancient principles to contemporary Indian initiatives like Atmanirbhar Bharat and welfare schemes, demonstrating their timeless relevance. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to advocate for a more inclusive, sustainable, and self-reliant economic model aligned with the ambitious vision of Viksit Bharat.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Decolonization: Ethical Dimensions Within Indian Knowledge System
desc: This course delves into the rich ethical frameworks of Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) as a foundation for transforming governance. It addresses the need to decolonize administrative practices by moving beyond colonial-era communication barriers. Learners will explore the principle of Nishkama Karma, which promotes selfless, duty-bound action, and Yajna, the concept of sacrificial leadership for collective welfare. The course introduces Purushartha—the balanced integration of Dharma (ethics), Artha (prosperity), Kama (well-being), and Moksha (liberation)—as a comprehensive model for ethical policy-making. Furthermore, it examines how the colonial legacy of rigid, inaccessible language hinders transparency and citizen engagement. To counter this, the module presents Vaak Shakti, the power of ethical and effective speech, as a vital skill for public servants. By integrating these principles, officials can help build a more transparent, responsive, and people-centric governance model aligned with the vision of Viksit Bharat.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Deductions under Chapter VI A of Income Tax Act
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the tax-saving opportunities available under Chapter VI-A of the Income Tax Act, 1961. It is designed to equip learners with the knowledge to navigate the various deductions that encourage savings, investment, and social welfare. The curriculum covers the most significant deduction sections, including 80C (investments like PPF, ELSS, and life insurance), 80D (health insurance premiums), 80E (interest on education loans), 80G (donations to charitable institutions), and 80U (for persons with disabilities). Learners will understand the specific conditions, monetary limits, and eligibility criteria for each deduction. The course also clarifies the applicability of these deductions under the new tax regime (Section 115BAC), enabling learners to make informed financial decisions and ensure accurate tax compliance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Deen Dayal Sparsh Yojana
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana, explaining its significance as a unique initiative to foster philately among the youth. The program begins by introducing the core purpose of the scheme, which is to reinforce academic learning and provide a relaxing hobby through stamp collecting. It systematically covers the key features of the scholarship, including the amount and distribution. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to explaining the eligibility criteria for students, such as academic requirements and the necessity of being part of a school philately club. Furthermore, the course elaborates on the two-level selection process, which involves a written quiz followed by the submission of a philately project. Upon completion, participants will be fully informed about how to apply for and participate in the SPARSH Yojana, making it a valuable resource for students, parents, teachers, and postal department officials involved in its implementation.

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana on Due Diligence
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) and its due diligence framework for effective programme implementation, compliance management, and quality assurance. It introduces the objectives, eligibility criteria, programme structure, and operational framework of DDU-GKY, enabling learners to understand how rural skilling initiatives are designed and implemented. The course explains the project onboarding and approval process, along with the key due diligence principles applied across various stages, including mobilisation, counselling, training delivery, and placement. In addition, the course covers monitoring and inspection mechanisms, with a focus on the roles and responsibilities of the PIA Quality (Q) Team, as well as the use of digital platforms such as Kaushal Bharat and ERP systems for compliance tracking and performance monitoring.

title: Deendayal AntyoDaya Yojana National Urban Livelihoods Mission
desc: This course delves into the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM), a pivotal initiative by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs aimed at tackling urban poverty. The program is designed to provide public officials and development practitioners with a thorough understanding of the challenges faced by India's urban poor. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of DAY-NULM's components, such as social mobilization, capacity building, skill training, and support for street vendors. The course also covers the financial frameworks, funding patterns, and the mission's integration with other national schemes to create a robust ecosystem for sustainable livelihoods. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the mission's structure, assess its operational impact, and understand its strategic importance in creating inclusive and resilient urban communities.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Deep Dive into BIM
desc: Building Information Modeling (BIM) has become a critical framework for modern infrastructure projects, enabling greater efficiency, cost savings, and lifecycle management. This comprehensive course offers a deep dive into the core principles and practical applications of BIM within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand and implement standardized BIM practices in their projects. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of the BIM project lifecycle, including all stages from pre-design to operations and asset management. You will learn to identify the various roles and responsibilities within a BIM team, understand the importance of Levels of Detail (LODs), and explore the benefits of BIM as illustrated by the MacLeamy Curve. The course also details the creation and implementation of a BIM Execution Plan (BEP), quality control workflows, and data management strategies. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply BIM methodologies to streamline project delivery, improve interdisciplinary collaboration, and manage complex building and infrastructure data effectively.

title: Deep Tech and India
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of Deep Tech, exploring technologies built on significant scientific and engineering advancements. It delves into the core concepts of Deep Tech, distinguishing it from conventional innovation by its potential for high impact and long-term development cycles. The curriculum covers a wide array of transformative fields, including Artificial Intelligence, quantum computing, biotechnology, robotics, green energy, and advanced communications like 6G. Learners will gain a clear understanding of how these technologies are being harnessed to solve critical societal challenges related to climate change, healthcare, national security, and energy sustainability. A key focus of the course is on India's strategic vision for becoming a global Deep Tech leader. It examines the Draft National Deep Tech Startup Policy (2023) and other government initiatives designed to foster a vibrant ecosystem for research, development, and investment. Furthermore, the course analyzes India's role in international technology alliances such as the Quad and I2U2, and its bilateral collaborations with key partners. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to appreciate the strategic importance of Deep Tech and its implications for India's economic growth and geopolitical standing.

title: Defeating the Black Fever: India's Strategic Win against Kala Azar
desc: India’s long-standing battle against Kala-azar persisted despite substantial resources and strategic programmes under NKEP. In 2021, Mr. Rajiv Manjhi identified that program success hinged on behavioural change and direct community involvement. Through innovative, locally adapted solutions—such as mud-house crack sealing, intensified surveillance, targeted vector management, health worker training, and rural evening awareness sessions—the programme enhanced effectiveness and public engagement. These measures significantly strengthened disease control efforts and marked a pivotal shift toward achieving national Kala-azar elimination.

title: Defence Accounts Department
desc: The effective financial management of the defence sector is critical for national security and fiscal prudence. This introductory course is designed to demystify the organization responsible for this mandate: the Defence Accounts Department (DAD). It provides a foundational understanding of why the DAD exists, its core mission, and its integral position within the Ministry of Defence's ecosystem. Participants will delve into the department's organizational structure, from the apex office of the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) down to the various field offices like Principal Controllers (PCDA) and Controllers (CDA). The course specifically clarifies the distinct roles and responsibilities of these key authorities and explains the pivotal function of Principal Integrated Financial Advisers (PIFA) and Integrated Financial Advisers (IFA) in providing financial counsel to the armed forces. By exploring the department's functions—spanning payments, accounting, and internal audit—learners will grasp how the DAD ensures financial discipline and accountability. This knowledge is essential for any official interacting with the defence establishment, enabling them to understand the financial procedures and institutional framework that govern one of the nation's most vital sectors.

title: Defence Acquisition Strategies and Industrial Partnerships
desc: This course is designed for professionals engaged in defence procurement, policy-making, and industry. It delves into the critical aspects of modern defence acquisition, providing a robust understanding of the strategies that underpin India's goal of self-reliance. The curriculum is structured around the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020, offering detailed insights into procedural requirements for different acquisition categories. Key learning areas include the nuances of 'Buy (Indian)', 'Buy and Make', and the acquisition of systems developed by DRDO and DPSUs. The course also covers the Fast Track Procedure (FTP) for urgent operational needs and explores strategic partnership models aimed at revitalizing the domestic defence industry. Participants will learn to apply these strategic approaches to procurement planning, fostering effective collaboration between public and private sectors. Ultimately, the course empowers learners to contribute to building a modern, efficient, and resilient defence industrial base for the nation.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: DEFENCE EXPORT IMPORT PORTAL
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of India's evolving defence landscape, centered on the government's 'Make in India' and self-reliance objectives. It is designed to familiarize participants with the critical components of the defence ecosystem, including procurement policies, indigenization initiatives, and the strategic push towards becoming a major defence exporter. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Defence Export-Import (EXIM) portal, explaining its functionalities and role in streamlining trade. Learners will examine the key regulatory bodies governing the sector, understand the procedures for obtaining export authorizations for SCOPET items, and analyze the impact of recent policy reforms. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the foundational knowledge to support India's defence production goals, contributing to both national security and economic growth.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Defence Industry Foundations and Research and Development
desc: This course provides a strategic overview of India’s defence manufacturing ecosystem, procurement frameworks, and R&D initiatives. Participants will gain insights into the dominance of Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs), the pivotal role of DRDO, and the growing involvement of private sector players. Key topics include the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020, offset obligations, and innovation schemes like iDEX and TDF. Learners will also explore critical technologies such as propulsion systems, armour, and electronic warfare, alongside emerging trends in automation and digitalization. By understanding policy reforms, regulatory compliance, and collaborative models, participants will develop the skills to build indigenous capabilities and support India’s vision of self-reliance in defence production and technology development.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Defence Marketing And Strategies
desc: “Defence Marketing and Strategies” provides a comprehensive introduction to the specialized field of marketing within the defence industry. The course addresses the critical need for strategic marketing in a sector characterized by long procurement cycles, complex government regulations, and high-stakes decision-making. It explores the fundamental principles of defence marketing, highlighting how they differ from conventional commercial marketing. Learners will delve into the process of strategic planning, understanding how to align marketing efforts with organizational goals and government requirements. The curriculum covers key areas such as identifying market opportunities, managing stakeholder relationships, and adhering to the legal and ethical frameworks governing defence contracts. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to develop and implement effective marketing strategies for defence products and services, positioning their organizations for success in a competitive global market.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: DEFENCE OFFSET MANAGEMENT WING
desc: This detailed course offers an in-depth exploration of India's defence procurement framework, with a specific focus on the Defence Offset Management Wing (DOMW) and the associated guidelines under the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020. The program is designed to provide a thorough understanding of why defence offsets are a critical component of capital acquisitions, aimed at fostering an internationally competitive domestic defence industry and augmenting research and development capabilities. Participants will examine the entire lifecycle of offset management, from the initial applicability and scope to the various avenues for discharging obligations, such as direct purchase, investment in defence manufacturing, and Transfer of Technology (ToT). The course meticulously breaks down the roles and responsibilities of key entities, including the vendor, the Indian Offset Partner (IOP), and the DOMW. Learners will gain practical insights into the submission and evaluation of technical and commercial offset proposals, the calculation of offset credits using multipliers, and the legal and contractual framework, including penalties for non-compliance. Upon completion, participants will be well-equipped to manage, implement, and monitor defence offset contracts, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and alignment with India's strategic objectives for self-reliance in the defence sector.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Defence Procurement Operations: Evaluation And Foreign Acquisition
desc: Defence Procurement Operations: Evaluation and Foreign Acquisition is the third course under NADP’s DPM 2025 Programme. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of defence procurement procedures related to tender evaluation, contract management, and the foreign acquisition of goods and services. The course covers the preparation of Request for Proposal (RFP) documents, technical and commercial bid evaluation, contract formation, standard and special contract clauses, and the management of contract amendments. It also explores foreign procurement strategies, including Government-to-Government (G2G) procurement, open international tendering, foreign exchange management, quality assurance of overseas suppliers, customs procedures, technology transfer, and procurement risk management.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Defence Research and Development Organisation Procurement Guidelines
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the procurement framework for goods and services under the DRDO Procurement Manual 2025. It explains how DRDO ensures timely, transparent, and efficient acquisition of essential items required for scientific projects, while promoting indigenisation, MSME participation, and procedural clarity. The course covers the complete procurement lifecycle, including demand initiation, specification formulation, bidding processes, Request for Proposal (RFP) drafting, evaluation mechanisms, expenditure sanction, and contract finalisation. It also highlights flexible provisions for urgent, low-value, and specialised procurements to support fast-paced R&D environments. By the end of the course, learners will gain a clear understanding of how DRDO balances innovation, compliance, and accountability to achieve value-driven procurement outcomes aligned with national priorities.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Defence Strategic Procurement: Rate Contracts and Indigenization
desc: Defence Procurement Operations: Evaluation and Foreign Acquisition is the Fourth course under NADP’s DPM 2025 Programme. The course covers rate contracts for repetitive procurement of consumption items, supplier performance management, maintenance and repair procurement, Annual and Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts (AMC/CMC), Service Level Agreements (SLA), and spare parts management. It further explores indigenisation strategies, technology transfer, supplier capability assessment, quality assurance, risk management, and procurement procedures that promote indigenous defence manufacturing under the Defence Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025. Participants will develop the skills to manage specialized procurement efficiently while supporting transparency, value for money, lifecycle cost optimization, and the national vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat in defence production.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Defence Works Procedure 2020: An Overview
desc: This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of the Defence Works Procedure (DWP) 2020, a critical framework for all infrastructure and capital works projects within the defence sector. The content is structured to build a clear and logical understanding of the entire works lifecycle, from conception to execution. Participants will begin by learning the strategic objectives of the DWP 2020 and the basic principles that ensure efficiency, transparency, and quality in defence works. The curriculum delves into the specific classifications of works, along with the prescribed scales and specifications that guide project development. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the financial aspects, covering the formulation of the Annual Works Programme and associated budgeting. Finally, learners will walk through the procedural steps required for processing major capital works projects. Upon completion, participants will be well-versed in the DWP 2020, enabling them to contribute effectively to the planning and management of defence infrastructure in compliance with established protocols.

title: DEFORESTATION
desc: This course delves into the multifaceted issue of deforestation, providing a foundational understanding of its drivers and far-reaching consequences. It begins by defining deforestation and systematically exploring its primary causes, from agricultural expansion and logging to mining and urbanization. The curriculum is structured to highlight the critical importance of forests in maintaining ecological balance and sustaining life. Learners will analyze the severe environmental impacts, including the loss of biodiversity, disruption of water cycles, and acceleration of climate change. The course also examines the socio-economic effects on communities, particularly indigenous populations, and discusses health issues and threats to food security linked to forest loss. Furthermore, it presents a range of solutions and preventive measures. These include sustainable forest management practices, reforestation and afforestation initiatives, and the role of legal and policy frameworks. By the end of this course, participants will have a clear perspective on the urgency of the problem and the collective actions required to protect our planet's vital forest resources for future generations.

title: Deformability Characteristics of Rock Mass
desc: This course provides an overview of the deformability characteristics of rock masses and the methods used for their evaluation. It explains the fundamental differences between intact rock and rock mass, introduces the concept of rock mass deformability, and discusses the various methods available for measuring and evaluating deformability characteristics. The course also highlights the importance of modulus of deformation, modulus of elasticity (unloading modulus), and Young’s modulus in the design and analysis of dams, tunnels, foundations, and other underground structures where understanding the ground response to applied loading is essential. Various deformability measurement methods are covered in detail and broadly classified into three categories: surface measurement, large-scale testing, and drill-hole testing. The course provides an understanding of the principles, applications, and procedures associated with each of these testing methods.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: Central Soil and Materials Research Station (CSMRS)

title: Delegation of Financial Powers to Defence Services 2021
desc: This module offers an in-depth examination of the Delegation of Financial Powers to Defence Services (DFPDS) 2021, a critical framework for financial governance within India's defence sector. The course begins by establishing the context for the 2021 revision, highlighting its objectives of empowering field units, improving operational readiness, and increasing the ease of doing business. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the restructured financial schedules (ASP, NSP, AFSP, ISP) and their alignment with budgetary heads. The course thoroughly explains the expanded scope of procurement powers, covering everything from goods and equipment to annual maintenance contracts and services. It provides crucial insights into the procedural dynamics between the Competent Financial Authority (CFA) and the Integrated Financial Advisor (IFA), including the process for sanctioning, handling competitive and single tendering cases, and the formal procedure for a CFA to overrule an IFA's advice. Upon completion, officials will be equipped to navigate the DFPDS 2021 framework confidently, ensuring compliant and efficient financial management and procurement within their formations.

title: Delegation of Financial Powers to Defence Services-2021
desc: The Delegation of Financial Powers to Defence Services 2021 (DFPDS-2021) is a critical framework that empowers field formations and enhances operational preparedness by decentralizing financial authority. This course provides an in-depth examination of these revised financial powers, which supersede the 2016 delegation. It is designed for officials who need to understand and exercise financial authority within the defence ecosystem. The curriculum covers the conceptual framework of DFPDS-2021, including the structure of various schedules of powers for the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Integrated Defence Staff. Key learning areas include the definitions and procedures for procurement, the roles of the Competent Financial Authority (CFA) and Integrated Financial Adviser (IFA), guidelines for non-procurement powers such as write-offs, and the process for handling audit objections. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the DFPDS-2021 guidelines, make informed financial decisions, and ensure procedural compliance in all expenditure, thereby contributing to greater efficiency and accountability in defence financial management.
