Upon completion, learners will have a deep understanding of the architecture and principles of a successful digital identity system.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: DPI: Empowering India and the Global Digital Economy
desc: This course delves into the concept of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and its pivotal role in building inclusive, secure, and scalable digital economies. It is designed for public officials, policymakers, and technologists seeking to understand the framework behind successful digital transformation. The curriculum begins by defining DPI and its fundamental characteristics, such as interoperability, open APIs, and security by design, explaining how these elements foster innovation and public value at a population scale. Learners will explore India's pioneering journey with the India Stack, analyzing the architecture and impact of foundational platforms like Aadhaar for identity, UPI for payments, and DigiLocker for credentials. The course also situates DPI in a global context, covering the G20 framework, India's leadership in promoting DPI for the Global South, and the collaborative efforts to establish shared digital systems worldwide. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to appreciate the strategic importance of DPI in delivering equitable public services and driving national development.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Drafting a Consent Notice and Cookie Policy under the DPDPA 2023
desc:
This course provides a comprehensive, practice-oriented understanding of drafting consent notices and cookie policies under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) and the Draft Rules, with a specific focus on Government and PSU Data Fiduciaries. Participants will gain a clear understanding of the legal and operational requirements for valid consent notices, including their role in ensuring transparency, enabling data principal rights, and establishing accountability in personal data processing. The course explains the conditions under which consent notices are required under Section 5 of the DPDPA, as well as the lawful bases where consent is not necessary. It also explores practical drafting techniques for notices that are legally compliant, user-friendly, and accessible in languages specified under the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India. 

Target Audience: Data Protection Officers (DPO)
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Drafting in Plain Language
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to drafting legal and legislative documents in plain language. It addresses the critical need for clarity and accessibility in governance, ensuring that laws are understandable to the citizens they affect. Participants will explore the context of why plain language is essential for building trust and reducing legal disputes. The curriculum covers key learning areas, including techniques for eliminating jargon, using active voice, and simplifying sentence structures without sacrificing legal precision. It also details how to logically organize documents, from titles and definitions to procedures and sanctions, to enhance readability. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these principles to create clear, effective, and citizen-friendly legislation. This skill is fundamental to fostering a transparent and efficient public administration framework, contributing to the vision of a people-first governance model.

title: Drafting Privacy Notice and Data Processing Agreement under DPDPA 2023
desc:
This course covers the drafting of Privacy Notices and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) and the DPDP Rules, 2025.
It begins by distinguishing a Privacy Policy (an internal governance document) from a Privacy Notice (a public-facing disclosure), clarifying that under the DPDPA framework, organisations are required to provide Privacy Notices that meet statutory transparency obligations. The course then examines the legal requirements under Sections 5, 6, 8(9), and 11 of the DPDPA and Rule 3 of the DPDP Rules, 2025. It covers mandatory disclosure requirements such as categories of personal data collected, purposes of processing, rights of the Data Principal, grievance redressal mechanisms, and language accessibility requirements, including availability in languages listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Drainage in Urban Roads and Maintenance
desc: Urban roads face continuous traffic, rainfall, and environmental stresses that gradually weaken pavements. Inadequate drainage is a major cause of premature deterioration, leading to potholes, cracking, erosion, flooding, and unsafe travel. Effective drainage removes surface and subsurface water, protecting pavement strength and serviceability. This course introduces urban road drainage principles, including surface and subsurface systems, stormwater management, drainage components, design considerations, common failures, and urban flooding. It also covers sustainable solutions such as bioswales, permeable pavements, tree pits, blue-green corridors, and smart catch basins. Learners explore road maintenance across its lifecycle, including preventive, routine, periodic, special, and emergency activities. Topics include road inspection, condition assessment, pavement distress identification, and links between drainage deficiencies and pavement failures.

title: Drawing Automation
desc: This course provides a comprehensive guide to mastering drawing automation features within modern CAD software. It is designed for designers, engineers, and technicians who want to transition from manual drafting to an efficient, automated documentation workflow. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of drawing automation and its importance in professional design. You will explore key functionalities such as auto-dimensioning, where you will learn to activate the tool, adjust its output, and apply strategies for various view types. The course then delves into customizing the automation environment, covering how to modify settings, manage templates for consistency, and control which components are included in drawings. A significant portion is dedicated to creating complete, automated drawing sets for complex assemblies. You will learn to generate sheets for each component, add exploded views with balloons, and insert detailed parts lists or Bill of Materials (BOM) tables. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to implement a fully automated drawing creation process, saving valuable time and ensuring high-quality, standardized technical documentation.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: DRDO DPM 2025: Design and Development and Fabrication Contracts
desc: This course introduces the core principles and procedures governing Design, Development, and Fabrication (DDF) Contracts under the DRDO Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025. It explains how DRDO collaborates with capable industry partners to design, engineer, and fabricate specialized defence equipment while effectively managing technical uncertainties and evolving operational requirements. Learners gain a clear understanding of the nature and scope of developmental and fabrication contracts, vendor identification and selection, intellectual property rights (IPR) safeguards, cost estimation methodologies, Request for Proposal (RFP) formulation, bidding and evaluation processes, and contract monitoring mechanisms. The course provides a structured and practical perspective on how DRDO ensures innovation, accountability, transparency, and value for money, while advancing national objectives such as indigenisation, Make in India, and Atmanirbhar Bharat.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: DRDO DPM 2025: International Procurement of Scientific Equipment
desc: This course explains the special provisions and procedures for procurement of scientific equipment from foreign sources under the DRDO Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025. It highlights the rationale for relaxations provided under the General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017 to address the specialised requirements of defence and scientific research organisations. The course covers the end-to-end process of foreign procurement, including demand processing, bidding and evaluation of foreign offers, handling of Indian agents, and projection and management of foreign exchange. It also explains payment mechanisms, insurance arrangements, shipping procedures, customs clearance, duty exemptions, inland transportation, and acceptance of imported stores. In addition, the course outlines procedures for export of items not repairable in India and special provisions applicable to equipment imported for trials, testing, or training purposes.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: DREAM App: Transforming DREAM into Reality
desc: The e-learning course “DREAM App: Transforming DREAM into REALITY” is designed for officers of the Department of Posts to build the capability to effectively utilize the DREAM (Digital Rural Enterprise Application for Mobile) platform under IT 2.0, in alignment with the Union Budget 2025–26 vision. The course focuses on transforming rural Branch Post Offices (BOs) from traditional service points into financially sustainable and revenue-generating enterprise units. It introduces the integrated digital capabilities of the DREAM platform across postal, financial, logistics, and citizen-centric services, enabling end-to-end rural service delivery enhancement. Participants will learn structured business development using the RSBT (Rural SO/BO Transformation) framework, along with strategies for rural marketing, service diversification, KPI-based performance monitoring, and operational efficiency improvement.
keywords: DREAM App: Transforming DREAM into Reality

title: Drive Smart: A Guide to Safe and Efficient Vehicle Driving
desc: This course is designed to enhance the skills and safety awareness of personnel responsible for operating government vehicles. It begins with foundational knowledge, detailing the steps for a thorough general check-up before any journey, including verifying fluid levels, tire pressure, and system indicators. The curriculum then progresses to ensuring driver comfort and control by demonstrating how to properly adjust seats, mirrors, and familiarize oneself with dashboard functions and pedals. The core of the course focuses on practical application, offering instruction on advanced driving techniques such as parallel parking, merging in heavy traffic, and navigating steep inclines. A significant emphasis is placed on fostering a culture of safety through defensive driving strategies, respecting speed limits, and maintaining safe distances. Furthermore, the course equips drivers with the confidence to manage common roadside problems by providing step-by-step guidance on tasks like changing a tire, addressing an overheating engine, and handling a dead battery, ensuring operational readiness and personal safety.

title: Drive Test Tools and Parameters of 2G, 3G and 4G
desc: This comprehensive program delves into the technical intricacies of mobile network performance analysis through drive testing. It is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the tools and parameters essential for optimizing 2G (GSM), 3G (WCDMA), and 4G (LTE) networks. The course begins by introducing the fundamental concepts of drive testing, including the setup, required equipment, and data collection processes. Participants will learn to interpret key performance indicators (KPIs) and radio frequency (RF) parameters specific to each generation of mobile technology. Key learning areas include analyzing signal strength (RSRP, RSCP), signal quality (RSRQ, Ec/No), interference levels (SINR), and handover success rates. The curriculum emphasizes practical application, guiding learners on how to use drive test data to troubleshoot common network problems such as dropped calls, coverage holes, and poor data throughput. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to conduct effective drive tests, analyze log files, and implement optimization strategies to enhance network performance and ensure a high-quality user experience.

title: Driving Digital Governance in the era of 'Industry 4.0'
desc: Embark on a journey through the evolution of industrial revolutions to understand the context of Industry 4.0 and its profound impact on digital governance. This course provides a detailed examination of key frontier technologies that are reshaping the public sector landscape, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), Big Data, Blockchain, and Quantum Computing. You will learn how these technologies are moving from hype to widespread adoption and how they can be leveraged to create more responsive, secure, and efficient government services. The curriculum delves into the practical applications of these technologies in enhancing citizen engagement, ensuring data integrity through decentralization, and enabling real-time monitoring for better decision-making. Using the successful implementation of Estonia's 'X-Road' as a case study, the course highlights the principles of a successful digital governance framework. It also critically discusses the associated challenges, such as data privacy, cybersecurity threats, and the digital divide, while outlining strategic approaches for establishing clear policies, fostering collaboration, and investing in training to drive successful digital transformation in government.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Driving Successful Technology Adoption in the Public Sector
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, the successful implementation of new technologies is paramount for modernizing public services. This course offers a comprehensive guide for public sector professionals and policymakers on navigating the human side of technological change. It delves into the complexities of why user resistance occurs, presenting analytical frameworks to diagnose and address cultural, behavioral, and institutional barriers. The curriculum covers key learning areas such as analyzing adoption challenges through real-world caselets, applying multilevel resistance models, and developing robust strategies to enhance user engagement. Learners will discover how to design and execute inclusive implementation plans that not only reduce friction but also align technology initiatives with overarching strategic goals. By the end of the course, participants will be empowered to lead change, mitigate risks, and drive the successful adoption of emerging technologies like AI, ensuring that innovation translates into tangible improvements in public administration and citizen services.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Driving Sustainability through Policy and Governance
desc: In an era of increasing environmental challenges, integrating sustainability into governance is no longer optional but essential for future-ready public service. This course delves into the scientific foundations of sustainability, moving beyond buzzwords to provide actionable insights for government officials. It begins by establishing the context of interconnected natural cycles and the finite nature of planetary resources, explaining why current 'extract-use-discard' models are inherently unsustainable. The curriculum covers critical topics such as the distinction between replenishable and non-replenishable resources, the hazards of toxic and non-biodegradable waste, and the principles of a circular economy. Through case studies on water management, agriculture, and product lifecycles like lighting technology, learners will see the real-world consequences of unsustainable practices. Ultimately, participants will be empowered to analyze policies through a sustainability lens, advocate for closed-loop systems, and drive the adoption of practices that ensure economic viability, social equity, and environmental responsibility in public administration.

title: Drone Applications for Civil Administration
desc: As drone technology matures from recreational use to a critical tool for governance, this course equips public sector professionals with the necessary knowledge to leverage its potential. The curriculum delves into the fundamentals of drone technology, its operational mechanics, and its diverse applications across various civil sectors. Participants will examine real-world case studies from India and globally to understand successful implementation strategies and best practices. Key learning areas include sectoral applications in disaster response, infrastructure monitoring, precision agriculture, and healthcare logistics. The course also covers the essential legal and regulatory frameworks governing drone usage in India. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to identify opportunities for drone integration within their domains, leading to more efficient, responsive, and effective public service delivery.

title: Drone Based or Aerial Surveillance of Forest Areas
desc: In an era where technology plays a crucial role in environmental management, the use of drones for aerial surveillance offers unprecedented capabilities for monitoring vast and often inaccessible forest areas. This course is designed to provide public officials, particularly those in forestry and environmental protection, with a comprehensive introduction to the technology that powers these unmanned aerial systems. Understanding the operational principles of drones is the first step towards leveraging them effectively for tasks such as wildlife tracking, fire detection, and preventing illegal activities. The curriculum delves into the essential components that make up a drone, from the propellers that provide lift to the electronic speed controllers that manage power. You will learn about the forces acting on a drone, such as lift, drag, and thrust, and the principles of aerodynamics that ensure stable flight. The course differentiates between various drone types, including fixed-wing and rotorcraft (like quadcopters), explaining their respective operational advantages. Furthermore, it covers the function of onboard sensors for collecting environmental data and highlights the critical need for regular maintenance to ensure mission readiness and longevity of the equipment. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the technical knowledge to better assess, procure, and oversee the use of drone technology in their field operations.

title: Drone Evolution and Applications
desc: Delve into the dynamic world of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) with this in-depth course on drone technology. As drones become integral to modern governance and industry, understanding their capabilities and regulatory environment is crucial for public sector professionals. This course provides a foundational and forward-looking perspective, starting with the evolution of drones and a breakdown of their key components and classifications. You will explore a wide array of applications, from enhancing national security and precision agriculture to revolutionizing logistics and environmental monitoring. The curriculum also covers cutting-edge innovations such as AI-powered flight, autonomous swarming, and 5G connectivity, which are reshaping the future of aerial systems. A significant focus is placed on the governance aspect, analyzing India’s 2024 drone policy and the Digital Sky Platform. By the end of the course, you will be equipped to analyze the drone ecosystem, understand its challenges, and appreciate its potential to drive efficiency and innovation in public service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Drone Policy and the Digital Sky Platform in India
desc: This course delves into the transformative world of drone technology and its strategic importance for modern governance. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of UAV components, types, and their wide-ranging applications in sectors such as defense, agriculture, logistics, and environmental monitoring. The curriculum is specifically tailored to the Indian context, providing a detailed examination of the national regulatory framework, including the landmark Drone Policy of 2024 and the functionalities of the Digital Sky Platform. Learners will explore how this digital infrastructure facilitates automated registration, airspace management, and compliance. The course also addresses the integration of cutting-edge technologies like Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, and 5G, which are reshaping drone capabilities. By analyzing the domestic drone industry against global benchmarks, participants will be equipped to assess key challenges, such as component dependency and workforce readiness, and to envision future trends like autonomous systems and urban air mobility.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

desc: In an era where technology plays a crucial role in environmental management, the use of drones for aerial surveillance offers unprecedented capabilities for monitoring vast and often inaccessible forest areas. This course is designed to provide public officials, particularly those in forestry and environmental protection, with a comprehensive introduction to the technology that powers these unmanned aerial systems. Understanding the operational principles of drones is the first step towards leveraging them effectively for tasks such as wildlife tracking, fire detection, and preventing illegal activities. The curriculum delves into the essential components that make up a drone, from the propellers that provide lift to the electronic speed controllers that manage power. You will learn about the forces acting on a drone, such as lift, drag, and thrust, and the principles of aerodynamics that ensure stable flight.

title: Drug Abuse and Related Laws in India
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances as defined and regulated under India’s Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985. It is specifically tailored for public officials to understand the complexities of drug regulation, misuse, and its profound impact on individuals and society. The program integrates legal knowledge with health and enforcement perspectives to support evidence-based decision-making in drug control and prevention efforts. Key learning areas include the legal distinctions and enforcement challenges related to cannabis; the regulated system of licit opium cultivation and its diversion risks; the science behind heroin addiction and evidence-based rehabilitation methods; and the international trafficking routes and enforcement difficulties associated with cocaine. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to effectively interpret and apply the NDPS Act, understand the characteristics of major narcotic substances, analyze the cycle of addiction, and appreciate the critical role of rehabilitation in managing substance use disorders within a public policy context.

title: Duties of Directors
desc: Effective corporate governance is a cornerstone of a robust economy, and directors are at the heart of this framework. This course provides an in-depth examination of the duties and responsibilities of directors, specifically focusing on the legal standards codified in Section 166 of the Companies Act, 2013. It is designed for current and aspiring directors, senior management, and legal professionals who need to navigate the complexities of corporate leadership with integrity and diligence. The curriculum delves into the seven key duties, including acting in accordance with the company's articles, promoting its objects for the benefit of all members, and exercising due care and skill. Participants will learn to differentiate between statutory and fiduciary responsibilities, understand the importance of exercising independent judgment, and recognize situations that could lead to a conflict of interest. The course also clarifies the prohibition against making undue gains and the non-assignability of a director's office. By completing this course, learners will be better equipped to uphold the highest standards of corporate governance, ensure legal compliance, and contribute to the long-term success and ethical standing of their organizations.

title: Duties Powers and Conditions of Service  - DPC  Act - 1971
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the pivotal sections of the CAG's DPC Act, 1971, which forms the bedrock of public audit in India. The program is designed to equip officials with the knowledge required to navigate the complexities of government auditing. Participants will delve into Section 16 (Audit of Receipts), Section 17 (Audit of Store and Stocks), and Section 18, which grants the CAG extensive powers to inspect records and demand information. Furthermore, the course clarifies the distinct audit mandates for Government Companies and Corporations under Section 19 and other authorities or bodies under Section 20. Upon completion, learners will be able to effectively apply these legal provisions in their professional roles, contributing to enhanced transparency, accountability, and financial propriety in the public sector.

title: Duty Drawback Scheme
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the Duty Drawback Scheme, a vital component of India's trade policy. It is designed for officials involved in customs, revenue, and trade facilitation to ensure correct application of the law. The curriculum begins by defining Duty Drawback and its objectives, grounded in Sections 74 and 75 of the Customs Act, 1962. Participants will learn to distinguish between drawback on re-exported goods and drawback on materials used in exported products. The course meticulously covers the rules, procedures, and documentation required to file a claim, along with the conditions for eligibility. It also addresses complex aspects such as the calculation of drawback rates, interest payments on delayed claims, and specific cases where drawback is prohibited. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to process drawback claims efficiently, ensure compliance, and support the government's objective of promoting exports.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Dynamic Pricing System in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Dynamic Pricing System adopted by Indian Railways for passenger fares and goods traffic. It explains the concept, objectives, and operational significance of dynamic pricing as a demand-responsive pricing mechanism designed to optimise capacity utilisation, improve revenue realisation, and enhance operational efficiency. The course covers key dynamic pricing initiatives implemented by Indian Railways, including the Flexi Fare Scheme, Suvidha Train Pricing, Busy Season Charges, Development Charges, and Congestion Charges applicable to passenger and freight operations. Learners will understand how these pricing mechanisms are applied based on factors such as demand, capacity availability, seasonal variations, and operational requirements.

title: Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS)
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the advanced technical principles of Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS), a pivotal technology for the evolution of mobile networks. It addresses the critical challenge of deploying 5G services efficiently by leveraging existing 4G LTE spectrum, thereby accelerating 5G coverage expansion without the immediate need for new spectrum acquisition. The curriculum is designed for technical professionals seeking to understand the mechanics of 4G/5G coexistence. Key learning areas include a detailed comparison of 4G LTE and 5G NR frame structures, the concept of OFDM numerology, resource block allocation, and the role of control and reference signals like CRS, PSS, and SSS. Learners will analyze different methods for implementing DSS, including CRS rate matching and the use of Multicast-Broadcast Single-Frequency Network (MBSFN) subframes, evaluating the trade-offs of each approach. The course concludes by examining real-world deployment options and case studies, providing a holistic view of how DSS is being implemented in commercial networks. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze and understand the technical complexities of deploying 5G over existing LTE infrastructure.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: e- Vivechana app : An initiative by MP Police Department
desc: Delve into the digital transformation of law enforcement with this detailed presentation on the e-Vivechana app. The course explains the context behind its development, building upon the CCTNS (Crime and Criminal Tracking Network System) to bring investigation processes directly to the crime scene. You will learn about the app's core modules, including the digital case diary, photography and videography with time-stamping, and crime detail forms. The session demonstrates how this technological aid eliminates subjectivity, reduces human error, and strengthens the chain of evidence for judicial scrutiny. Furthermore, it showcases how the collected data can be used for analytical purposes, such as creating heat maps for crime-prone areas, leading to more effective and data-driven policing strategies. This course is essential for understanding the practical application of technology in improving governance and public safety.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: E-Commerce and E-Contracts
desc: This comprehensive session offers a deep dive into the evolving legal landscape of digital transactions in India. The course begins by defining e-commerce and e-contracts, outlining their various forms, such as B2C, B2B, and different types of online agreements like click-wrap and browse-wrap. It then provides a detailed examination of the primary legal statutes, including the IT Act 2000, the Indian Contract Act 1872, the Consumer Protection Act 2019 and its E-commerce Rules of 2020, and the new Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. Participants will analyze critical legal issues, including intermediary liability, data protection and privacy, intellectual property infringement, cross-border jurisdiction, and consumer grievance redressal. Through the discussion of landmark judicial pronouncements and hypothetical case studies, learners will understand how to apply these legal principles to real-world scenarios, making it essential for legal professionals, policymakers, and administrative officers involved in e-governance and digital regulation.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: E-Governance and IT Security-Best Practices
desc: In an increasingly digital world, securing government operations is paramount. This course, 'E-Governance and IT Security: Best Practices,' is specifically designed for government officials to address the critical intersection of digital governance and information technology security. It establishes the context for why robust IT security is not just a technical requirement but a foundational pillar of modern public administration, particularly for sensitive departments like the Ministry of External Affairs. The curriculum delves into key areas including fundamental cybersecurity measures, principles of data protection, and systematic risk management. Participants will learn to identify common vulnerabilities and threats in e-governance systems and understand the best practices required to mitigate them. The course covers the implementation of security protocols and the creation of resilient digital frameworks to safeguard government data and services.

title: E-Governance and IT Security-Best Practices
desc: In an increasingly digital world, securing government operations is paramount. This course, 'E-Governance and IT Security: Best Practices,' is specifically designed for government officials to address the critical intersection of digital governance and information technology security. It establishes the context for why robust IT security is not just a technical requirement but a foundational pillar of modern public administration, particularly for sensitive departments like the Ministry of External Affairs. The curriculum delves into key areas including fundamental cybersecurity measures, principles of data protection, and systematic risk management. Participants will learn to identify common vulnerabilities and threats in e-governance systems and understand the best practices required to mitigate them. The course covers the implementation of security protocols and the creation of resilient digital frameworks to safeguard government data and services. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these security best practices in their daily work, contributing to a more secure, trustworthy, and effective digital governance environment. They will understand the severe consequences of security lapses and be prepared to uphold the highest standards of IT security in their official capacity.

title: E-Learning Modules on Basics of the Underwater World (Part-1)
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the multifaceted world of Underwater Domain Awareness (UDA), establishing its critical importance in the contemporary geopolitical landscape, particularly within the Indo-Pacific region. The program is structured to provide a foundational understanding of the UDA framework, covering its four key pillars: maritime security, blue economy, environmental sustainability, and science and technology. Learners will explore the unique acoustic and environmental characteristics of tropical waters and their strategic implications for naval operations and resource management. The course contextualizes UDA within India's key policy initiatives, including the SAGAR vision, Sagarmala, and Atmanirbhar Bharat, highlighting the need for indigenous capability development. Participants will analyze pressing sustainability issues such as acoustic habitat degradation, illegal fishing, and marine pollution, and examine the role of digital transformation, marine spatial planning, and effective governance in addressing these challenges. Upon completion, learners will possess a robust, multi-disciplinary understanding of the underwater domain, enabling them to contribute to strategic planning and policy-making in maritime affairs.

title: E-Learning Modules on Basics of the Underwater World (Part-2)
desc: This course provides an in-depth exploration of advanced concepts in Underwater Domain Awareness (UDA), building upon foundational knowledge to tackle complex, real-world maritime challenges. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with a sophisticated understanding of the underwater environment, particularly the unique characteristics of tropical waters like the Indian Ocean Region. Key learning areas include the underwater data analytics framework, acoustic propagation principles, and the intricacies of channel modeling and simulation. Participants will study the design, development, and application of underwater robotics, such as AUVs and ROVs, and analyze the challenges of their deployment. The course also addresses the critical issues of acoustic habitat degradation and the role of digital transformation in enhancing coastal livelihoods. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze complex underwater data, evaluate sensor and platform performance, and apply the UDA framework to strategic problems in defense, scientific research, and sustainable economic development.

title: e-Payment
desc: This introductory course delves into the operational framework of the e-Payment service as mandated by PO Order No. BD/01/2024 (D). The primary goal is to enable postal staff to effectively handle bill collections for a wide range of clients, thereby enhancing citizen convenience. The course begins by outlining the service's objectives and scope, detailing the types of payments that can be processed, such as electricity bills, school fees, and taxes. It then walks learners through the step-by-step process for a new organization to register as a biller, including the creation of a Biller ID and credentials. Furthermore, the course explains the various payment methods customers can use, including cash, cheque, and the India Post Payments Bank (IPPB). Finally, it clarifies the process of transferring collected funds to the biller, including the deduction of service charges and GST, ensuring a clear understanding of the end-to-end workflow and financial responsibilities.

title: e-Post
desc: This course delves into the operational framework of India Post's e-Post service, designed to bridge the digital divide by offering a modern, flexible, and cost-effective communication solution. The program begins by establishing the context of e-Post as an alternative to traditional mail, detailing its function of converting digital messages into physically delivered mail. Key learning areas include a step-by-step guide to the registration process for both individual (prepaid) and corporate customers, including wallet recharges, online payment methods, and agreement formalities for businesses. Participants will learn about the service's versatile features, such as one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-one messaging, multi-language support, and bulk sending capabilities for corporate users. The course also explains the billing system, GST implications, and the final delivery process, from downloading and printing at the destination e-Post center to delivery by designated staff. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively utilize and manage the e-Post service for personal or organizational communication needs.

title: e-Ustad: Negotiation Skills
desc: In today's complex society, law enforcement officers require skills that extend beyond traditional enforcement. This course on Negotiation Skills is designed to meet that need, equipping police personnel to handle arguments, de-escalate tense situations, and collaborate with diverse communities. The program provides a structured approach to transforming officers into effective mediators and communicators. Key learning areas include the fundamentals of negotiation, the critical role of verbal and non-verbal communication, and the importance of cultural competence. Participants will explore practical guidelines for first responders in crisis scenarios such as hostage situations, emphasizing active listening and emotional intelligence. The course also delves into proven conflict resolution models and de-escalation techniques tailored for law enforcement contexts. Ultimately, learners will be able to apply these skills to prevent conflicts from escalating, minimize harm, and build community trust through peaceful, non-violent solutions.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: e-Ustad: POCSO Act
desc: Child Sexual Abuse (CSA) is a grave and under-reported crime that violates the fundamental rights of children. This course offers an in-depth examination of India's primary legislation to address this issue: The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012. The curriculum is structured to build a thorough understanding of the Act's purpose and application. You will begin by exploring the historical context and legislative intent that led to the POCSO Act's enactment. The course then delves into the definitions of various sexual offences against children, the profound impact of abuse, and the key legal provisions, including the age of consent. A significant focus is placed on a child-centric approach, outlining the rights of a child victim during legal proceedings. Furthermore, the course details the specific roles and responsibilities of police in reporting and responding to POCSO cases and identifies the support services available for victims. This program is essential for law enforcement and other officials to ensure justice for young victims and hold offenders accountable.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: e-Ustad: Soft Skills and Communication Skills
desc: In today's complex society, the effectiveness of police personnel extends beyond technical proficiency to include a high degree of interpersonal skill. This course is designed to address this need by providing a comprehensive foundation in soft skills. It explores why these skills, including communication and emotional intelligence, constitute a significant portion of career success and are indispensable for building public trust and ensuring safety. The curriculum is structured into six distinct modules covering the fundamentals of soft skills and leadership, advanced communication techniques for public interaction, the application of emotional intelligence in policing, practical time and stress management strategies, and methods for maintaining a sustainable work-life balance. Through this course, police personnel will be equipped with the necessary tools to enhance their professional conduct, improve collaborative efforts, and engage more effectively with the diverse communities they serve, leading to better law enforcement outcomes.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: e-Verification Scheme 2021
desc: The e-Verification Scheme, 2021, represents a significant step towards a technology-driven tax administration system in India. This course delves into the operational framework of this pivotal scheme, explaining its importance in promoting transparency and voluntary compliance. You will explore the key sources of financial information the scheme utilizes, including Statements of Financial Transactions (SFTs), TDS/TCS statements, and GST data. The curriculum details the end-to-end process, from how data is collected and shared with taxpayers via the Compliance Portal to the steps required to confirm, dispute, or update information in an Income Tax Return. Furthermore, the course clarifies the consequences of discrepancies and non-responses, such as the issuance of notices, penalties, or potential litigation. By completing this course, officials will be equipped to navigate the digital verification process effectively, ensuring accurate tax reporting and contributing to a more efficient and transparent tax ecosystem.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: E-waste disposal
desc: As electronic devices become increasingly integral to our daily lives, the challenge of managing e-waste grows in parallel. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the foundational knowledge to address this pressing environmental issue. It delves into the entire lifecycle of electronic waste, from its generation to its hazardous impact if not managed correctly. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the circular economy as a sustainable alternative to the traditional linear model of 'take-make-dispose'. The course details the key provisions of both global and national legal frameworks that govern e-waste, emphasizing the importance of compliance and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). Furthermore, it explores innovative strategies, technological advancements, and skill development initiatives that are shaping the future of e-waste management in India. This program will empower learners to contribute to policy-making and implementation efforts aimed at creating a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable environment.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: E-way Bill System under GST Law - Part 1
desc: This foundational course delves into the legal and procedural framework of the E-way Bill system, a cornerstone of GST compliance for the movement of goods. The curriculum is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the statutory provisions under the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017, and the corresponding rules. Participants will learn about the specific conditions that necessitate the generation of an E-way bill, including consignment value thresholds and types of goods movement. The course covers the entire lifecycle of an E-way bill, from its generation in FORM GST EWB-01, consolidation, and cancellation procedures, to the rules regarding its validity period and extension. It also explains the roles and responsibilities of suppliers, recipients, and transporters in this process. Furthermore, the course elaborates on the legal consequences of non-compliance, including provisions for the detention, seizure, and release of goods and conveyances, as well as associated penalties. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to correctly interpret and apply E-way bill regulations, ensuring effective tax administration and enforcement.
org: National Academy of Customs, Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN)

title: Early Death Claim Settlement for PLI and RPLI
desc: This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the end-to-end process for settling early death claims within the Department of Posts. It is designed to equip postal employees with the necessary knowledge to handle these sensitive cases according to the prescribed departmental guidelines. The curriculum covers the distinction between early and normal death claims, the complete procedure for claim submission, and the crucial step of investigation to verify claim authenticity. Participants will learn about the roles and responsibilities of various authorities, from the initial scrutiny at the post office level to the final decision by the sanctioning authority. Furthermore, the course elaborates on the process for claimants to appeal a rejected claim, ensuring transparency and adherence to customer service standards. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in managing the entire lifecycle of an early death claim, contributing to improved service delivery and customer trust.

title: Earth Observation with Remote Sensing Technologies
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of remote sensing technologies. It introduces the key requirements for effective remote sensing applications, including the necessary equipment, selection of electromagnetic spectral windows, and data processing techniques. The course also explores hyperspectral, thermal, and microwave remote sensing, highlighting their applications, advantages, and limitations. Learners will gain practical insights into how these technologies are applied to study the Earth, including environmental monitoring, geological mapping, and disaster management.
org: Department of Space and ISRO HQ

title: Earthing System
desc: This course offers foundational knowledge on the principles and practices of electrical earthing, an essential process for ensuring safety in any environment with electrical installations. It is designed for personnel who work with or near electrical and telecommunication equipment, providing them with the necessary understanding to prevent electrical hazards. The course begins by defining earthing and its historical context, explaining why it is crucial for protecting human life and maintaining the stability of sensitive equipment. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of different earthing methods like plate, pipe, and rod earthing, complete with procedural instructions for proper installation. Participants will learn about the applications of earthing across various infrastructures, from transmission lines and substations to residential buildings and heavy industries. The course also specifies the standard earth resistance values for different locations. A vital component of this training is a module on electric shock and the correct first aid procedures to be administered in an emergency. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize the importance of effective earthing and understand the procedures required to implement it safely.

title: Earthquake-Disaster Response Training
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental knowledge and skills required to respond effectively to earthquake disasters. It begins by defining what an earthquake is, explaining its causes, and detailing its potential impact on infrastructure and communities. A key focus of the module is understanding India's seismic zones, enabling learners to recognize the specific risks associated with their region. The core of the training is dedicated to practical safety procedures. Participants will learn actionable steps for preparedness before an earthquake, survival techniques during the event, and crucial safety measures to take in the aftermath. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of community involvement by elucidating the significant role volunteers play in immediate post-disaster scenarios. It provides guidance on how to assist in rescue efforts, such as safely evacuating and moving injured victims, thereby empowering individuals to become valuable assets in emergency response and contribute to saving lives.

title: Earthquake-Disaster Response Training
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to build critical knowledge and skills for responding effectively to earthquake-related disasters. Recognizing the unpredictable nature of seismic events, the program emphasizes the importance of proactive preparedness for all citizens, particularly those involved in public safety and community service. The course provides a foundational understanding of what causes earthquakes, their potential effects, and an overview of India's seismic zones, enabling learners to appreciate the specific risks in different regions. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to detailing actionable safety procedures. Learners will be guided through the essential steps to take before, during, and after an earthquake to protect themselves and others. The training also illuminates the vital function of volunteers in the immediate aftermath of a disaster. It outlines practical methods for assessing situations and safely moving injured or trapped individuals to secure locations. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to handle earthquake emergencies and contribute to building a more disaster-resilient community.

title: Earthquakes: Causes, Measurement, and Distribution
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration into the science of seismology, focusing on the causes, measurement, and distribution of earthquakes. It is designed for individuals seeking a foundational understanding of geological hazards. The course begins by defining what an earthquake is and illustrating its potential impact on life, property, and the environment. You will learn about the primary drivers of earthquakes, from the movement of tectonic plates along fault lines to volcanic eruptions and human-induced activities. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the methods of measuring earthquakes. You will learn to differentiate between magnitude and intensity, and understand the application of the Richter and Modified Mercalli scales. The course also maps out the world's major earthquake belts, such as the Circum-Pacific 'Ring of Fire,' explaining the geological reasons for their high seismic activity. Upon completion, learners will be able to interpret basic earthquake data and appreciate the role of seismological monitoring in disaster preparedness.

title: Earthwork in Railway Projects
desc: Proper earthwork is the foundation of any railway project, ensuring the stability and longevity of the entire track structure. This detailed technical course is designed to equip engineering professionals with the essential knowledge for executing and managing earthwork for railway embankments. The course begins with preliminary site activities, including clearance and setting out, before delving into the core principles of soil compaction. You will learn about the factors affecting compaction, the importance of Optimum Moisture Content (OMC) and Maximum Dry Density (MDD), and how to conduct field compaction trials to establish project-specific parameters. The curriculum provides an in-depth look at various quality control methodologies, including the core cutter method, sand replacement method, and the use of nuclear density gauges. Furthermore, the course covers the crucial EV2 plate load test for assessing layer stiffness and discusses modern techniques for slope compaction and erosion control using vegetation and geosynthetics. Upon completion, learners will be able to supervise earthwork operations, ensure adherence to RDSO specifications, and implement robust quality assurance protocols in railway infrastructure projects.

title: EB IT Tool - Prabal Plus
desc: This course offers an in-depth guide to the Prabal Plus IT tool, designed to replace traditional Excel-based reporting and consolidate enterprise business activities into a single, web-based solution. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals of lead management, covering the five key stages: capturing, enrichment, qualification, distribution, and nurturing. Participants will learn to navigate the Enterprise Business Portal to store and manage information about users, leads, and opportunities, and to generate critical reports like the sales funnel analysis. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Prabal Plus software itself. It details the process for managing user creation, leads, quotations, sales orders, and contracts. Furthermore, the course explains its powerful service assurance capabilities, including its role as a single window for fault escalation across services like MPLS, Vsat, and dark fiber. Learners will also be introduced to modern interaction methods, such as the integrated Telegram bot and the 'Ask Probel' intelligent chatbot, enabling them to efficiently retrieve information and manage tasks. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in using the Prabal Plus suite to improve operational efficiency and customer service delivery.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Eco Friendly Management of Disease- Pests and Soil Microorganisms
desc: Delve into the science of sustainable agriculture with this detailed course on managing crop health through eco-friendly methods. The curriculum is designed to provide a strong foundation in the principles of using nature-based solutions to combat pests and diseases, moving away from conventional chemical inputs. You will learn about the fundamental differences between synthetic pesticides and organic biopesticides, with a special focus on the application of biological control agents such as Trichoderma. The course covers key techniques including the use of bio-inoculants, bio-priming, and composting to foster a healthy soil ecosystem. Through practical insights and expert guidance, learners will understand how to implement these strategies to increase nutrient efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and ultimately boost crop yields in a sustainable manner. This program is ideal for anyone looking to apply effective, natural, and scientifically-backed methods in modern crop cultivation.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: Economics Frameworks
desc: This course introduces foundational economic frameworks that shape strategic and operational decision-making in both public and private contexts. It equips learners with essential microeconomic tools to understand how markets function, how prices are determined, how costs behave, and when government intervention becomes necessary. Through core concepts such as supply and demand, diminishing marginal utility, cost behaviour, profitability analysis, market failure, public goods, and Pareto optimality, learners develop an economist’s lens for analysing efficiency, incentives, and overall impact. Drawing on intuitive explanations and real-world Indian examples, the course strengthens participants’ ability to evaluate policies, pricing decisions, resource allocation, and welfare outcomes with analytical clarity and practical relevance.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Economics of Climate-Resilient Development
desc: In an era of increasing climate volatility, integrating economic viability with resilience is crucial for sustainable development. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the economics of climate-resilient development, designed for public sector professionals. It begins by establishing the context of climate change, outlining observed and projected impacts that render 'business-as-usual' approaches obsolete. The curriculum then delves into a practical framework for proactive climate risk management. You will learn how to frame the problem, identify specific climate risks, and determine a range of potential adaptation options. A key focus is on the economic dimension, covering methods to cost, select, and prioritize the most effective adaptation strategies, even when faced with future uncertainties. The course concludes with a practical policy scenario, allowing you to apply the learned concepts to design a robust and economically feasible climate-resilient development plan, ensuring that public investments are both sustainable and impactful.

title: Ecosystem Services and External Financing
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of ecosystem services and the financial frameworks designed to support their preservation. It is specifically tailored for professionals, such as forest officers, involved in project development. The curriculum begins by defining ecosystem services and explaining their critical importance for human well-being and economic stability. Learners will delve into the principles of project appraisal, learning how to evaluate the environmental impacts and benefits of new initiatives. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding major international and national funding sources. This includes a thorough review of the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the Global Environment Facility (GEF), and NABARD’s Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF). By examining these mechanisms, participants will gain practical insights into securing and managing funds for projects that balance development needs with long-term ecological sustainability

title: Ecosystem Services and External Financing
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of ecosystem services and the financial frameworks designed to support their preservation. It is specifically tailored for professionals, such as forest officers, involved in project development. The curriculum begins by defining ecosystem services and explaining their critical importance for human well-being and economic stability. Learners will delve into the principles of project appraisal, learning how to evaluate the environmental impacts and benefits of new initiatives. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding major international and national funding sources. This includes a thorough review of the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the Global Environment Facility (GEF), and NABARD’s Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF). By examining these mechanisms, participants will gain practical insights into securing and managing funds for projects that balance development needs with long-term ecological sustainability, ultimately contributing to climate mitigation and adaptation efforts.

title: Edge Artificial Intelligence: Thriving Possibilities and Opportunities
desc: This course introduces Edge AI, a paradigm that combines artificial intelligence with edge computing to enable real-time data processing and decision-making closer to the source of data generation. As digital ecosystems generate massive volumes of data from connected devices, Edge AI enables faster, more efficient, and more secure processing without relying solely on centralized cloud infrastructure. The course explains how AI models are deployed on edge devices to support applications requiring low latency, such as smart cities, healthcare monitoring, and autonomous systems. It highlights the key drivers of Edge AI, including IoT proliferation, miniaturization, and advancements in AI hardware. Participants will also explore the benefits of Edge AI, including reduced latency, improved scalability, enhanced data privacy, and optimized bandwidth usage, along with challenges related to security, cost, and system complexity.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Effective Communication
desc: In any professional environment, effective communication is the cornerstone of success, driving collaboration, productivity, and positive organizational outcomes. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the essential skills to communicate with clarity, impact, and purpose. It addresses the critical need for clear and empathetic interaction in governance, where stakeholder engagement and service delivery depend on mutual understanding. The curriculum delves deep into the foundational elements of the communication process. Learners will analyze the complete communication cycle, including the roles of the sender and receiver, message construction, and the importance of feedback. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to recognizing and dismantling communication barriers, from linguistic and cultural differences to emotional and psychological noise. Participants will also gain a profound understanding of non-verbal communication, learning to interpret body language, gestures, and proxemics to better understand underlying messages. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply practical techniques for active listening, assertiveness, and adapting their communication style to various audiences. These skills will empower them to build stronger professional relationships, lead teams more effectively, resolve conflicts constructively, and ultimately contribute to a more collaborative and efficient work environment.
org: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad

title: Effective Communication
desc: In any professional environment, clear and effective communication is the cornerstone of success. This course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental skills required to communicate with impact and clarity. It begins by establishing the context of why communication is a vital professional activity, second only to breathing. The curriculum delves into the basics of communication theory and explores what makes communication effective versus ineffective. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical, job-oriented skills. Participants will learn the art of drafting professional correspondence, including structured emails, formal letters, and accurate meeting minutes—tasks that are central to many government and corporate roles. By the end of this course, learners will not only understand the theory but will also be able to apply these skills to improve their daily workflow, enhance professional relationships, and contribute more effectively to their organization's goals.

title: Effective Communication for Citizen-Centricity
desc: In the public sector, clear and empathetic communication is the cornerstone of effective governance and citizen-centric service delivery. This course is designed to equip government functionaries with the essential skills to communicate with clarity, confidence, and courtesy. It delves into the core principles of communication, covering verbal, non-verbal, and written methods, and explains how these skills are critical for building trust and fostering positive relationships with citizens and colleagues. Participants will explore the '4 Cs' of effective communication: being Clear, Complete, Correct, and Courteous. The curriculum also addresses the importance of assertiveness, empowering officials to value their own perspective and make sound decisions, including when to say 'No' respectfully. Through real-life examples, the course demonstrates nine practical ways to enhance communication effectiveness, such as being empathetic, firm, facilitating, and inclusive.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Effective Communication in Government Service
desc: This course equips government officials with the knowledge and practical skills required to communicate effectively in the workplace. It highlights the importance of effective communication in governance, decision-making, teamwork, coordination, and public service delivery, while also addressing common communication mistakes and organizational, interpersonal, and technological barriers. Learners will explore practical techniques for structuring clear and purposeful messages, practicing active listening, selecting appropriate communication approaches, and fostering effective collaboration. Through relatable workplace scenarios, the course emphasizes communication that is clear, concise, complete, courteous, timely, and purposeful. The course demonstrates how effective communication can improve coordination, reduce misunderstandings, enhance organizational efficiency, strengthen accountability, and build public trust.

title: Effective Communication: The Cornerstone of Great Leadership
desc: Effective communication is an indispensable quality for any great leader. This course provides a comprehensive guide to mastering the art of communication in a professional leadership context. You will learn the importance of not just speaking, but listening effectively to make a real impact. The curriculum delves into practical techniques for steering dialogues, ensuring that conversations remain productive and aligned with your objectives. It addresses the common pitfalls of leadership communication, such as appearing dictatorial or insensitive, and offers strategies to build rapport and connect with team members without prejudice. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to handling interpersonal challenges, including how to skillfully convince superiors, manage conflicts before they escalate, and respond constructively to both praise and criticism. To support these skills, the course integrates simple breathing and meditation techniques designed to reduce stress, improve focus, and foster the mental balance necessary for clear and composed communication. Upon completion, you will be better equipped to lead with confidence, empathy, and influence.

title: Effective management of urban services in cities through ICCC
desc: In an era of rapid urbanization, the effective management of city services is a critical challenge for public administrators. This course addresses this need by providing a comprehensive overview of Integrated Command and Control Centers (ICCCs), the technological backbone of modern smart cities. It explores why ICCCs are fundamental to enhancing urban governance, enabling centralized monitoring, and facilitating data-driven decision-making to improve the quality of life for citizens. Participants will delve into the core objectives and structural components of ICCCs, gaining a deep understanding of the platform's key layers and their functions. The curriculum covers how these centers are utilized to streamline a wide range of municipal and non-municipal services, from traffic management to emergency response. Through the examination of real-world use cases, learners will see the practical application and benefits of ICCCs in addressing complex urban challenges. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the foundational knowledge required to contribute to urban planning, city management, and the development of smarter, more resilient cities.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Effective Prompt Engineering For Public Servants
desc: Generative Artificial Intelligence is rapidly changing the landscape of public administration. For public servants in India, the ability to effectively harness these powerful tools is no longer optional but a core competency for modern governance. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to prompt engineering, the art and science of instructing AI to generate outputs that are not only useful and accurate but also responsible and aligned with public service values. You will move beyond basic queries to understand the principles of constructing sophisticated prompts that maximize the potential of large language models. The curriculum covers a range of practical techniques, from setting the right context and tone to using constraints and asking for specific formats. Learners will engage in hands-on activities to practice writing prompts for common government tasks, such as drafting official correspondence, summarizing complex policy documents, and brainstorming solutions for public challenges. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to critically evaluate AI-generated content, iteratively refine your prompts for optimal results, and confidently integrate generative AI into your daily work to boost efficiency and improve the quality of public service delivery.

title: Effective Science Communication for Public Engagement
desc: In an age of information overload, the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts clearly is essential. This comprehensive course is designed to equip scientists, researchers, and educators with the skills to translate their work for the public. Through a structured approach, participants will explore the fundamentals of science communication, from crafting compelling narratives to designing impactful visuals and leveraging social media for broader reach. The course emphasizes the importance of creating informed citizens capable of making evidence-based decisions, a cornerstone of effective governance. Learners will gain a deep understanding of the science communication landscape and acquire practical tools to share research compellingly, foster public discourse, and build trust in scientific evidence.

title: Effective Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
desc: Effective governance depends not only on sound policies and programmes but also on the ability to engage meaningfully with stakeholders. Every government officer, regardless of department or function, interacts with diverse stakeholders while designing policies, implementing schemes, resolving grievances, coordinating across ministries, or delivering public services. The ability to identify key stakeholders, communicate effectively, and build trust is critical to achieving successful outcomes. This course is designed to address the practical realities of public service. It provides participants with the knowledge and tools required to systematically identify, analyze, and engage stakeholders across various governance contexts. Through three modules, learners will explore stakeholder mapping and prioritization techniques, develop context-specific engagement strategies, and strengthen communication skills that promote transparency, accountability, collaboration, and public trust.

title: Effective Techniques To Manage Stress
desc: This course, 'Effective Techniques for Managing Stress,' is designed to equip public servants with essential skills to navigate the pressures of modern professional and personal life. It addresses the common formula for stress: having too much to do with too little time and energy. The program moves beyond theory, offering practical, accessible tools for immediate application. Key learning areas include guided meditation practices that promote deep relaxation and de-focusing from daily pressures, and specific Pranayama techniques such as Kapalbhati and Nadi Shodhan, which are demonstrated to help regulate emotions and enhance vitality. The course also features wisdom talks that encourage a shift in perspective, helping learners to reframe challenges and reduce worry. By the end of this course, participants will not only understand the mechanics of stress but will have a personal toolkit of mental hygiene practices to foster sustained well-being, improve mental clarity, and enhance their overall effectiveness in their roles.

title: Effective Time and Task Management
desc: In today's fast-paced professional environment, mastering time is crucial for success and well-being. This comprehensive course is designed to equip public sector employees with practical strategies for superior time management. You will delve into the core principles of productivity, starting with how to set meaningful and structured goals using the SMART criteria. The course then explores powerful prioritization tools, including the Urgent/Important Matrix (Eisenhower Technique), to help you focus on what truly matters. A significant portion of the training is dedicated to overcoming common productivity barriers like procrastination and distractions. You will learn to apply the Pomodoro Technique for sustained focus and discover how to leverage technology, such as calendars and task management apps, to your advantage.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Effective Time Management
desc: In today's fast-paced professional environment, effective time management is a critical skill for all public servants. This course delves into the principles of time management, tracing its origins and highlighting its modern-day relevance. Participants will begin by understanding the core benefits of managing time, including stress reduction, enhanced efficiency, and increased output, which are essential for taking control of professional duties. The course then addresses common obstacles to effective time management, such as disorganization, the inability to decline requests, and frequent interruptions, providing strategies to overcome them. A key feature of this program is the introduction to Covey's Quadrant, a powerful tool for prioritizing tasks by categorizing them as urgent, important, both, or neither.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Efficiency: Competency Framework
desc: In the landscape of modern public administration, efficiency is a cornerstone of effective governance and is crucial for building a responsive, citizen-centric state. This course delves into the 'Efficiency' competency framework, providing a detailed examination of what it means to be efficient in a governmental context. It addresses the critical need for public officials to achieve desired outcomes and deliver services promptly while judiciously using public funds and resources. The course is structured to provide a deep understanding of the twelve competencies that form the pillar of efficiency. Key learning areas include optimizing administrative processes, minimizing waste, and maximizing both productivity and effectiveness across all government functions. Participants will explore concepts such as results orientation, innovative thinking, and strategic planning. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to analyze their own work processes, identify areas for improvement, and apply principles of efficiency to enhance service delivery, thereby strengthening citizen trust and contributing to a more capable and productive public sector.

title: Efficient Spectrum Utilisation for Terrestrial and Satellite Services
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of spectrum utilisation techniques for the efficient management of limited radio frequency (RF) spectrum resources in both terrestrial and satellite communication systems. It introduces the concepts of spectrum utilisation and spectrum efficiency, highlighting their importance in meeting the growing demand for wireless connectivity, supporting technological innovation, and achieving national strategic objectives. The course explores key techniques used to enhance spectrum efficiency in terrestrial and satellite services, including frequency reuse, beam shaping, high-throughput satellite technologies, and dynamic spectrum access. Learners will also examine regulatory frameworks, international standards, and best practices governing spectrum management.

title: Efficient Use of Water Resources
desc: Increasing water demand, scarcity, and the impacts of climate change pose significant challenges to sustainable development in India. This course on “Efficient Use of Water Resources” provides a comprehensive understanding of water availability, demand patterns, and the urgent need to improve Water Use Efficiency (WUE) across sectors. The course begins with an overview of the water cycle and India’s water resources scenario, followed by a detailed look at the policy and institutional frameworks that support efficient water management. It then examines sector-specific strategies to enhance efficiency in irrigation, domestic, and industrial water uses. The course concludes by highlighting best practices, ongoing initiatives, and emerging technologies, while emphasizing integrated water resources management, community participation, policy reforms, and technological innovation.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: National Water Academy Central Water Commission Pune

title: Efficient Water Management in Agriculture through Micro-Irrigation
desc: Efficient Water Management in Agriculture through Micro-Irrigation (EWM-MI) is a comprehensive course designed to equip learners with knowledge and tools to address one of India's most pressing agricultural challenges — water scarcity. With only 4% of the world’s freshwater resources and 17% of the population, India must adopt efficient water use practices to sustain agricultural growth and food security. Micro-irrigation, or precision irrigation, plays a pivotal role by optimizing water use, enhancing crop productivity, and reducing resource wastage. This course explores the science and practice of water management, micro-irrigation technologies, government policy frameworks, innovative automation systems, renewable energy integration, and real-world success stories. Learners will also gain insights into national flagship schemes such as 'Per Drop More Crop', the Micro Irrigation Fund, and other GoI initiatives that support micro-irrigation adoption.

title: eGovernance Life Cycle
desc: In an era of digital transformation, understanding the complete lifecycle of e-governance projects is crucial for public sector officials. This course offers a holistic and structured exploration of the e-Governance Life Cycle (eGLC), designed to equip government employees with the necessary knowledge to manage digital initiatives from conception to completion. It addresses the importance of reform and transformation in government business functions and how e-governance can significantly enhance public service delivery. The curriculum delves into the key stages of the eGLC, covering strategy development, current state assessment, future state definition, and detailed implementation planning. Participants will learn about the practical aspects of project execution and operations, including the critical roles of a Project Management Unit (PMU) and effective change management. By the end of this course, learners will be able to identify key challenges in e-governance implementation and apply actionable strategies to successfully develop, deploy, and maintain robust e-governance solutions, thereby contributing to a more efficient, transparent, and citizen-centric government.
