org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: eKYC Implementation and Aadhaar Data Handling
desc: This training module is designed to equip government officials, particularly those in the Department of Posts, with the essential knowledge and skills for managing the eKYC process and handling sensitive Aadhaar data. The course addresses the critical need for information security in an increasingly digital governance landscape. It begins by explaining the implementation of eKYC in POSB operations and the overarching security framework. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the 'Do's and Don'ts' for different stakeholders: Requesting Entities performing authentication, Offline Verification Seeking Entities (OVSEs) conducting local verification, and Enrolment Agencies managing enrolment and updates. The course also covers guidelines for the general public to promote awareness and safe practices. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply UIDAI's guidelines, ensure compliance with the Aadhaar Act, and contribute to maintaining public trust by safeguarding citizens' personal information.

title: Election Administration and Management Course for Returning Officers
desc: This course is designed to strengthen the legal and procedural competence of Returning Officers (ROs) in the scrutiny of nomination papers. It provides a comprehensive understanding of the constitutional and statutory framework governing the qualifications and disqualifications of candidates under Articles 84, 102, 173, and 191 of the Constitution of India, along with the relevant provisions of the Representation of the People Act, 1951. The course emphasizes the correct determination of candidate eligibility with reference to the date fixed for scrutiny of nominations, in accordance with Section 36 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, and clearly distinguishes this from the date of filing of nomination. It covers constitutional and statutory qualifications, requirements relating to oath or affirmation, and the principal grounds of disqualification, including holding an office of profit and disqualification arising from criminal convictions.
org: India International Institute of Democracy and Election Management (IIIDEM)

title: Electric Locomotive Operations: Technical Concepts and Practices
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the technical and operational aspects of electric locomotive operations in Indian Railways. It covers the organizational structure and functional hierarchy associated with loco operations, along with key concepts of train dynamics such as tractive effort, adhesion, haulage capacity, and stalling. The course also examines major operational performance indices, manpower planning, crew management, crew links, and regulatory requirements related to crew deployment. Learners will gain an understanding of inspection systems, safety monitoring mechanisms, crew alertness assessment, and driving techniques. In addition, the course highlights the role of the loco operation branch in accident investigation and safety management. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped with the knowledge required to understand the operational, technical, and safety dimensions of electric locomotive operations in Indian Railways.

title: ELECTRIC VEHICLE AND ITS EFFECT ON OUR ECO-SYSTEM
desc: Dive into the world of electric mobility with this introductory course on Electric Vehicles and their effect on our ecosystem. Designed for public officials and anyone interested in sustainable technology, this course provides a foundational understanding of the EV landscape in India. You will begin by exploring the history of electric vehicles, their fundamental definition, and the pressing need for their adoption to combat climate change and reduce dependency on fossil fuels. The curriculum details the different types of EVs—Battery Electric (BEV), Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV), and Hybrid (HEV)—and breaks down their main components, from electric motors to advanced lithium-ion batteries and charging systems. Furthermore, the course analyzes the significant benefits of EVs, including lower running costs and reduced noise pollution, while also addressing the primary challenges such as limited charging infrastructure and high initial costs. A key focus is placed on the Indian government's strategic efforts, including the FAME India scheme and GST reductions, to create a robust EV ecosystem. By the end of this course, you will have a clear perspective on India's vision for a sustainable, electric-powered transportation future.

title: Electric Vehicle Basics
desc: Dive into the essentials of electric mobility with this comprehensive course on Electric Vehicle Basics. The program begins by differentiating between the primary types of EVs—BEVs, HEVs, and PHEVs—and examines their operational mechanics and environmental impact, including a crucial discussion on tailpipe versus well-to-wheel emissions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the charging ecosystem, providing an in-depth analysis of AC and DC charging, the various charging levels, and the global standards for connectors such as J1772, CCS, GBT, and Chademo. You will also learn about the sophisticated communication and safety protocols, like PLC and CAN bus, that govern the interaction between the vehicle and the charging station. The course contextualizes this technical knowledge by touching upon government initiatives like the FAME scheme, the importance of grid stability, and the future of battery technology, offering a holistic view for professionals involved in transport, energy, and urban planning.

title: Electrical and Mechanical Facilities for Passengers at Metro Stations
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the electrical and mechanical (E&M) infrastructure that underpins the daily operations of a modern metro rail system. Learners will gain a detailed understanding of the core E&M functions, from power distribution hierarchies—normal, essential, and uninterruptible power supply (UPS)—to the machinery that facilitates passenger movement, such as lifts, escalators, and travelators. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the complex environmental control systems (ECS) and tunnel ventilation systems (TVS) required for maintaining air quality and managing heat in underground environments. Furthermore, the course thoroughly examines the multi-layered fire detection, alarm, and suppression systems, including hydrant, sprinkler, and gas-based solutions, crucial for ensuring passenger safety. By completing this course, participants will be able to recognize and explain the purpose and basic functioning of these integrated systems, appreciating their collective importance in delivering a safe, efficient, and comfortable experience for metro commuters.

title: Electrical Codes and Standards for Metro Systems
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of the fire and life safety requirements essential for modern metro stations. The curriculum is centered on the National Building Code (NBC) Part 4 and the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 130 standard, which are the cornerstones of safety in transit systems. The course explores why these standards are critical, detailing their role in preventing fire-related incidents and ensuring the life safety of millions of daily commuters. Key learning areas include the specific design provisions for fire protection, mandatory egress requirements for both elevated and underground stations, and the integration of fire detection and suppression systems. Participants will also learn about effective evacuation strategies and emergency management protocols tailored to the unique environment of metro infrastructure. By completing this course, professionals will be equipped to conduct fire risk assessments and apply these critical national and international standards to design, build, and maintain safe, compliant, and resilient metro systems.

title: Electrical Engineering in Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the intricate world of electrical engineering that powers the Indian Railways. This course offers a detailed examination of the Electrical Department's functions and its contribution to one of the world's largest railway networks. You will explore the history and development of electric traction in India, from early DC systems to the modern 25 KV AC standard. The curriculum covers key areas such as traction power supply from substations, overhead equipment (OHE) design, and the role of remote control systems like SCADA. Furthermore, the course sheds light on the manufacturing of high-power electric locomotives at plants like CLW and MELP, the complexities of crew management for safe train operations, and the essential maintenance procedures for both locomotives and coaches. By completing this course, you will develop a strong foundational understanding of the electrical ecosystem that underpins the Indian Railways, making it a more energy-efficient and modern mode of transport.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Electrical Safety and Protection
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of electrical safety, designed for individuals working in environments with potential electrical hazards. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of electrical principles, such as circuits, current, and voltage, and explains how these relate to common workplace risks. The curriculum provides critical knowledge on the severe effects of electric shock on the human body and the dangers posed by electric arcs, grounding failures, and overloaded circuits. A significant focus is placed on practical safety measures and regulatory compliance. Participants will learn essential safety rules, including the critical Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedure for de-energizing equipment and the function of Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (GFCIs). The course thoroughly covers the selection, inspection, and use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), from insulated gloves and boots to safety harnesses. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to identify electrical hazards, implement robust safety protocols, and select the appropriate protective gear, fostering a culture of safety and minimizing the risk of electrical accidents in their workplace.
org: Yantra Institute of Technology and Management

title: Electrical Systems Requirements
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of designing and maintaining energy-efficient electrical systems in compliance with the Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC). The program begins by establishing the importance of energy efficiency for sustainability and operational cost reduction. Learners will explore the mandatory ECBC requirements for essential electrical equipment, including transformers, motors, and diesel generator sets, with a focus on efficiency standards and loss measurement. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical energy management techniques, covering systematic metering and monitoring strategies to manage consumption effectively. Participants will also learn to analyze and improve power quality by implementing automatic power factor correctors and harmonic filters. The curriculum connects these technical requirements to broader policy goals, such as the Indian Railways' energy efficiency action plan, providing a real-world context for application. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to audit, design, and manage electrical infrastructure that is efficient, reliable, and compliant with national energy conservation standards.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Electronic Surveillance and Legal Issues
desc: This course delves into the complex intersection of technology, law, and fundamental rights concerning electronic surveillance in India. It is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the legal mechanisms that authorize and regulate the interception, monitoring, and decryption of information. The curriculum begins by establishing the constitutional context, focusing on Article 19 (Freedom of Speech and Expression) and Article 21 (Right to Privacy), and how they are balanced against national security needs. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of Section 69 of the IT Act, the newly enacted Telecommunications Act 2023, and the associated Interception Rules. The course critically analyzes the principles of legality, necessity, and proportionality established by the Supreme Court in the K.S. Puttaswamy case, which are now central to any surveillance action. By exploring the roles of various government agencies, procedural safeguards, and oversight committees, learners will be equipped to ensure that surveillance activities are conducted responsibly, transparently, and in strict adherence to the rule of law, thereby preventing misuse and protecting citizens' civil liberties.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Electronics Fundamental with Autodesk Fusion
desc: This course offers a foundational exploration of electronics, designed for individuals seeking to build practical skills in circuit design and analysis. The curriculum is structured to provide a solid understanding of electrical theory, starting with the essential relationship between voltage, current, and resistance as defined by Ohm's Law. Participants will learn to work with fundamental electronic components, understanding their functions and how to select them for specific applications. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to hands-on design workflows. Learners will be guided through the process of creating electronic schematics, a critical skill for representing circuit logic. They will then translate these schematics into physical Printed Circuit Board (PCB) layouts, learning about trace routing and preparing designs for manufacturing. The course also incorporates modern simulation tools, allowing learners to test and validate their circuit designs in a virtual environment before prototyping. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in analyzing simple circuits, designing schematics, developing PCB layouts, and integrating electronic designs into 3D models. This skill set is highly valuable for roles in electronics design, product development, and engineering, providing a strong basis for more advanced studies or professional projects in the technology and manufacturing sectors.

title: Electronics Infrastructure (EI) for Indigenous Research and Technology
desc: This course delves into the strategic roadmap for establishing a robust electronics infrastructure to bolster India's indigenous research and technology capabilities. It addresses the critical need to move from import dependency to self-reliance by focusing on key high-tech domains. Learners will explore the future of biomedical engineering with compact MRI/CT scanners and brain-computer interfaces; the evolution of telecommunications with 5G/6G testbeds and massive MIMO; and the advancements in high-performance computing through GPUs, TPUs, and neuromorphic chips. The course also provides a detailed examination of the semiconductor industry, covering everything from sub-nanometer transistor technology and 3D ICs to the challenges in fabrication, packaging, and establishing a domestic wafer fab ecosystem. Furthermore, it highlights the application of these technologies in strategic sectors like defense, including cognitive radars and electronic warfare systems. By the end, participants will understand the collaborative framework required between academia, industry, and government to nurture innovation, promote R&D careers, and build a thriving startup environment for indigenous product development.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: ELECTRONICS WASTE MANAGEMENT IN INDIA
desc: This course offers a comprehensive examination of the challenges and solutions surrounding electronic waste in India. It begins by defining e-waste and detailing its sources, from household gadgets to industrial equipment, and quantifies its growing volume. The curriculum delves into the severe environmental consequences, such as soil and water pollution from hazardous materials like lead and mercury, and the associated public health risks. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to India's legal and regulatory framework, providing a thorough analysis of the E-waste Management Rules, 2022, and the concept of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), which holds manufacturers accountable for the entire lifecycle of their products. Learners will compare the operations of the formal recycling industry with the hazardous practices of the informal sector, as illustrated by a case study on Moradabad. The course concludes by exploring effective management strategies, including advanced sorting technologies, biotechnological approaches, and the promotion of a circular economy to minimize waste and conserve resources, empowering participants to contribute to sustainable e-waste solutions.

title: Elevated Viaduct construction in DMRC
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the engineering principles and construction practices behind elevated metro viaducts. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the complexities of large-scale urban transport infrastructure projects. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of metro construction in India, highlighting the achievements of the DMRC. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of substructure components such as bored pile foundations, pile caps, and piers, detailing their construction using hydraulic rigs and cast-in-situ methods. The course then moves to the superstructure, analyzing different configurations like I-girders, U-girders, and segmental box girders, explaining their specific applications, transportation, and erection processes. Special attention is given to the role of elastomeric bearings in load transfer, the significance of post-tensioning, and advanced techniques like balanced cantilever construction. Upon completion, learners will be able to recognize the various components and sequences involved in building a metro viaduct and appreciate the technical considerations for ensuring structural integrity and operational safety.

title: Eligibility Assessment
desc: Comprehensive capacity-building course on Eligibility Assessment published on iGOT Karmayogi.

title: Embedding Corporate Governance in Government Organisations
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of corporate governance tailored for government organizations and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). It addresses the growing need for transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct in public administration. The curriculum delves into the fundamental concepts of corporate governance, exploring its significance in enhancing organizational performance and building public trust. Key learning areas include an examination of various governance codes, regulatory frameworks such as SEBI regulations, and the specific guidelines issued by the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE). The course also discusses real-world challenges in implementing good governance and equips learners with the knowledge to apply principles of ethical decision-making. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to contribute to a culture of integrity and compliance within their organizations, ultimately leading to more effective and responsible governance.

title: Embracing Change
desc: In today's volatile and uncertain world, the ability to adapt to change is a critical skill for personal and professional success. This course, 'Embracing Change,' is designed to equip learners with the mindset and tools to navigate life's inevitable challenges effectively. It provides a deep dive into understanding the psychological responses to change, failure, and setbacks, helping individuals identify and overcome common cognitive distortions that hinder growth. The curriculum is structured to differentiate between mistakes, setbacks, and failures, offering tailored strategies for each. Key learning areas include the 'Failure Checklist' for learning from missteps, the 'Three A's' framework (Accept, Assess, Act) for problem-solving setbacks, and techniques for building long-term resilience and grit. Learners will also explore the importance of creating a robust support system and seeking opportunities for growth even in adversity. By the end of this course, participants will be better prepared to face challenges with confidence, turn failures into learning experiences, and build a resilient character capable of thriving in any environment.

title: Emergency Detrainment Door System
desc: This course offers a detailed guide for railway personnel and technical staff on the Cab Detrainment Door system, a critical component for passenger safety. The curriculum is structured to build confidence and competence in handling emergency evacuations. You will delve into the key components of the system, including door panels, ramp covers, gas springs, safety poles, and limit switches, understanding the function of each part. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the step-by-step manual operation procedures for opening the door and deploying the emergency ramp safely. Furthermore, the course covers the interpretation of system feedback from the Train Control Management (TCM) system and the correct procedures for restoring the door and ramp assembly after an evacuation. By completing this training, you will be proficient in managing detrainment scenarios, ensuring the highest standards of safety and operational readiness are maintained.

title: Emergency procedures as part of Disaster Management Plan M-3 (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी और औद्योगिक क्षेत्रों में काम करने वाले पेशेवरों के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जिन्हें आपदा प्रबंधन और आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया की ठोस समझ की आवश्यकता है। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि एक अच्छी तरह से संरचित आपातकालीन प्रक्रिया क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है, जो न केवल जीवन की रक्षा करती है बल्कि महत्वपूर्ण बुनियादी ढांचे को भी सुरक्षित रखती है। इसमें आग और रिसाव के लिए कार्य योजनाओं, क्लोरीन रिसाव जैसे रासायनिक खतरों के लिए विशिष्ट प्रोटोकॉल, और बांध टूटने जैसी बड़े पैमाने की घटनाओं के लिए प्रक्रियाओं सहित प्रमुख शिक्षण क्षेत्रों को शामिल किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी आपात स्थिति के दौरान संचार सुविधाओं का उपयोग करने और सड़क सुरक्षा दिशानिर्देशों का पालन करने के व्यावहारिक पहलुओं को भी समझेंगे। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, प्रतिभागी अपनी संगठनात्मक आपदा प्रबंधन योजनाओं में प्रभावी ढंग से योगदान करने, जोखिमों का मूल्यांकन करने और आपातकालीन स्थितियों में त्वरित और सूचित कार्रवाई सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Emergency procedures as part of Disaster Management Plan Module 3
desc: In any high-risk industrial environment, a robust disaster management plan is critical to protecting personnel, assets, and the surrounding community. This course focuses on the practical application of emergency procedures that form the backbone of such a plan. Participants will explore the specific action plans required for events like fires, hydrogen (H₂) and chlorine leakages, and structural failures such as an ash dyke breach. The curriculum details the established protocols for hazard control, outlines the use of communication facilities during a crisis, and clarifies road safety guidelines for emergency situations. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand and contribute to the execution of emergency response strategies, ensuring operational readiness and minimizing the impact of unforeseen disasters.

title: Emerging Legal and Ethical Issues in Large Language Models
desc: As Artificial Intelligence, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, becomes increasingly integrated into our daily lives, understanding its legal and ethical implications is crucial for public sector professionals. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the pressing issues at the intersection of AI, law, and ethics. Key learning areas include the fundamental workings of LLMs, the data privacy risks associated with their massive data consumption, and the potential for inherent bias and 'hallucinations' to cause real-world harm. The discussion also delves into significant cybersecurity threats posed by and to AI systems. Learners will gain a clear understanding of how global and national regulatory bodies are responding to these challenges. The course analyzes the frameworks of the EU AI Act and India's DPDP Act, 2023, explaining their core principles of transparency, consent, and accountability. By the end of this course, participants will be better equipped to navigate the complexities of AI governance and contribute to the responsible adoption of this transformative technology.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Emerging Tech and Security in India's Supply Chain Revolution
desc: In an increasingly digital world, modernizing India's supply chain is critical for economic growth and resilience. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the technologies driving this revolution. You will explore the foundational role of the Internet of Things (IoT) in creating transparent and automated logistics, from asset tracking to warehouse management. The curriculum delves into how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data analytics are used to optimize routes, predict maintenance needs, and manage inventory with unprecedented accuracy. Furthermore, the course explains how blockchain technology can establish trust and traceability in sensitive sectors like pharmaceuticals and agriculture. It also navigates the complex landscape of implementation, covering security concerns and regulatory compliance with laws such as the DPDP Act 2023. By examining real-world case studies and future trends like 5G and digital twins, this course equips public sector professionals to lead and support the development of a secure and innovative logistics framework for India.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Emerging Technologies and National Security
desc: This course explores the transformative role of emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Web 3.0, in modern policing and national security. It examines how AI acts as a force multiplier by analyzing large datasets, linking criminal records, and supporting investigations through tools such as facial recognition, big data analytics, and OSINT. The course also highlights the challenges posed by Web 3.0, including anonymity, cryptocurrencies, and encrypted platforms. Participants will gain an understanding of risks such as deepfakes, false linkages, data overload, and privacy concerns, along with strategies and best practices, including human oversight, specialized training, and robust governance frameworks, to ensure effective and ethical use of these technologies in law enforcement and security operations.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Emerging Technologies and Security
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, technologies like 5G, AI, and IoT offer unprecedented opportunities but also introduce significant cybersecurity threats. This course offers a detailed exploration of these risks, providing a crucial perspective for professionals in the public sector. The curriculum begins by contextualizing the importance of security in modern technological frameworks, discussing why legal measures alone are insufficient. Key learning areas include an in-depth analysis of vulnerabilities in 5G/6G architecture such as network slicing, the dangers of data poisoning and model inversion in AI systems, security weaknesses in IoT edge devices, and the systemic risks in blockchain technologies like 51% attacks. The course also looks ahead to the challenges posed by quantum computing to current encryption standards.

title: Emerging Technologies in 5G Mobile Communications - Part 1
desc: As digital transformation accelerates across the public sector, understanding the technologies that power it is crucial. This course, 'Introduction to 5G Mobile Communication Technologies,' offers a comprehensive overview of the fifth-generation wireless technology that promises to revolutionize connectivity. Participants will delve into the intricacies of 5G system architecture, learning to distinguish between the new 5G core in Standalone (SA) mode and the overlay approach of Non-Standalone (NSA) mode. The course explains how 5G achieves its high-performance targets of high data rates and low latency through key innovations, including Massive MIMO, multi-edge computing, and Open RAN. Furthermore, it clarifies the importance of the 5G spectrum and how the system maintains access agnosticism by integrating non-3GPP technologies like Wi-Fi. Upon completion, learners will have a solid technical foundation to understand the capabilities of 5G and its potential impact on governance, citizen services, and national infrastructure.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Emerging Technologies in 5G Mobile Communications - Part 2
desc: As 5G networks become integral to our digital infrastructure, understanding the underlying technologies is crucial for professionals in the telecommunications sector. This course provides an in-depth examination of the key advancements that define 5G capabilities. Participants will explore the core radio technologies that deliver higher speeds and lower latency, including Massive MIMO, beamforming, small cells, Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB), and Open RAN. The course details how 5G systems integrate with other networks, such as non-3GPP Wi-Fi and satellite systems, to ensure ubiquitous connectivity. Furthermore, it addresses the critical aspects of network management, covering Quality of Service (QoS) frameworks to prioritize traffic and Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS) for efficient use of radio frequencies. Learners will also be introduced to the role of AI and ML in optimizing network performance, preparing them to contribute to the deployment and management of next-generation communication systems.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Emotional Intelligence
desc: In the dynamic and often high-pressure environment of public service, Emotional Intelligence (EI) is a fundamental skill for personal and professional success. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles of EI and its practical application in the workplace. It addresses why understanding and managing emotions is critical for government employees to navigate challenges, build resilience, and foster positive interactions with colleagues and citizens. The curriculum is structured around the four core pillars of Emotional Intelligence. You will begin by developing self-awareness to recognize your own emotional triggers and patterns. Next, the course covers self-management techniques to control impulsive feelings and behaviors, manage stress in healthy ways, and stay motivated. You will then explore social awareness, learning to understand the emotions, needs, and concerns of other people. Finally, the course focuses on developing social skills and relationship management to communicate effectively, influence others, resolve conflicts, and work collaboratively in a team. Upon completion, you will be equipped with practical strategies to enhance your EQ, leading to improved decision-making, stronger leadership capabilities, and greater job satisfaction.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Emotional Intelligence
desc: In the demanding field of law enforcement, technical skills alone are not enough. This course on Emotional Intelligence (EI) addresses the critical human element of policing. It provides a foundational understanding of how emotions impact thoughts and behaviors, offering a scientific framework based on psychology to navigate complex situations. The curriculum is structured around key pillars of EI, including developing acute self-awareness, mastering self-regulation under pressure, and cultivating empathy to de-escalate conflicts and build community trust. Participants will explore practical strategies for managing work-related stress, improving interpersonal relationships with colleagues and the public, and making more balanced and rational decisions. By the end of this course, police officers will not only understand the theory of emotional intelligence but will also be equipped with actionable techniques to apply these skills in their daily duties, leading to enhanced personal resilience, improved team collaboration, and a more positive and effective approach to policing.

title: Emotional Intelligence: Developing Strong People Skills
desc: This course on Emotional Intelligence (EI) is designed to equip government professionals with essential interpersonal and emotional competencies. In today's complex work environment, the ability to understand and manage one's own emotions, as well as recognize and influence the emotions of others, is paramount for effective leadership and collaboration. This program provides a foundational understanding of why EI is a critical driver of performance and positive workplace culture. Participants will delve into the five key pillars of emotional intelligence: developing robust self-awareness of one's own feelings and biases, applying self-regulation to manage impulses and adapt to change, harnessing intrinsic motivation to pursue goals with persistence, exhibiting empathy to foster better teamwork and stakeholder relations, and utilizing social skills for effective communication and conflict resolution.

title: Emotional Intelligence: Developing Strong People Skills
desc: This course on Emotional Intelligence (EI) is designed to equip government professionals with essential interpersonal and emotional competencies. In today's complex work environment, the ability to understand and manage one's own emotions, as well as recognize and influence the emotions of others, is paramount for effective leadership and collaboration. This program provides a foundational understanding of why EI is a critical driver of performance and positive workplace culture. Participants will delve into the five key pillars of emotional intelligence: developing robust self-awareness of one's own feelings and biases, applying self-regulation to manage impulses and adapt to change, harnessing intrinsic motivation to pursue goals with persistence, exhibiting empathy to foster better teamwork and stakeholder relations, and utilizing social skills for effective communication and conflict resolution. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to build and sustain positive professional relationships, lead with greater compassion, and contribute to a more resilient and collaborative public service environment.

title: Empathy in Policing: A Victim-Centered Approach
desc: This course provides a comprehensive framework for integrating empathy into modern policing. It moves beyond the concept of empathy as a soft skill, repositioning it as a core competency for effective law enforcement and community trust-building. The curriculum delves into the psychological state of victims, their rights, and their specific needs during interactions with police. Participants will explore how an officer's initial response can significantly impact a victim's long-term perception of the justice system, either by providing support or by causing secondary trauma. Key learning areas include compassionate communication, active listening, and conducting sensitive interviews while maintaining professional boundaries. The course uses practical examples to demonstrate how to avoid common pitfalls like victim-blaming and how to interact with diverse and vulnerable populations. By completing this course, officers will be equipped to apply a victim-centered approach that upholds dignity, strengthens procedural justice, and improves public trust in policing.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Empowering Connectivity
desc: Gain a thorough understanding of ITI Limited, India's first Public Sector Undertaking in the telecommunications field. This course details the journey of ITI from a departmental factory in 1948 to a modern, multi-unit enterprise contributing to India's technological advancement. You will be introduced to the company's core business operations, including its manufacturing plants in Bengaluru, Naini, Raebareli, Mankapur, and Palakkad, and their specialized product lines ranging from digital switches and encryption devices to IoT and smart energy meters. The course also highlights ITI's significant contributions to national security through its defense products and its role in executing large-scale turnkey projects. By exploring the company's R&D capabilities, management structure, and future roadmap, learners will appreciate ITI's strategic importance in achieving a self-reliant and digitally empowered India.

title: Empowering Tomorrow: Digital Transformation and Initiatives of DoP
desc: Dive into the future of postal services with this detailed course on the digital initiatives of the Department of Posts. The program is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the department's modernization journey, focusing on practical, technology-driven changes. You will learn about the expansion of digital banking services, including net banking, mobile banking, NEFT/RTGS capabilities for POSB accounts, and the launch of the Mahila Samman Savings Certificate. The course also covers the role of India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) and its Fincluvation platform in fostering financial inclusion. Furthermore, it explores the integration of services with national digital ecosystems like DigiLocker for PLI/RPLI policies, online NPS facilities, and the expansion of Post Office Common Service Centers (POCSCs). You will gain insights into enhancements in the parcel business, integration with the GeM marketplace, the adoption of UPI for digital payments, and the strategic vision behind the IT Modernization Project 2.0. Upon completion, you will be well-equipped to navigate and leverage these new digital tools and services, contributing to a more efficient and citizen-centric postal network.

title: En Uru - The Tribal Heritage Village of Wayanad
desc: En Uru - The Tribal HeritThe case highlights Mr. Nair's initiative in Wayanad, Kerala, to uplift the economically marginalized scheduled tribe community by establishing En Uru, a model heritage village that generates income through tourism while providing employment and training for local tribes.age Village of Wayanad Infographic

title: Enabling Excellence in Governance Processes through Quality Tools
desc: This course is designed to equip civil service officials with the foundational principles and practical tools of quality management to foster excellence in governance. It moves beyond theory to provide actionable frameworks that can be immediately applied to public sector workflows. You will explore a comprehensive toolkit, including Check Sheets for data collection, Flowcharts for process mapping, Fishbone Diagrams for root cause analysis, and statistical tools like Histograms and Pareto Charts for data-driven prioritization. The course also delves into powerful continuous improvement methodologies such as 5S for workplace organization, Poka-Yoke for mistake-proofing, and the collaborative approach of Quality Circles. The primary objective is to build confidence and empower officials to identify inefficiencies, reduce process variations, and ultimately enhance citizen-centric service delivery. By completing this course, you will not only learn to use these tools but also cultivate a sustainable mindset for quality and continuous improvement in your professional environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Enabling inclusive governance: The case of Rail Divyang Saarthi
desc: The development and implementation of the Rail Divyang Saarthi app by Ahmedabad Division of Western Railways showcases how technology, combined with clear policies and inter-departmental coordination, can enhance accessibility and reduce wait times for People with Disabilities in obtaining railway concession cards.

title: Enabling Social Change
desc: Enabling Social Change provides a comprehensive exploration into the dynamics of social transformation, tailored for professionals in governance and development sectors. The course addresses the critical question of why this topic is important by highlighting the need for leadership that goes beyond policy implementation to foster genuine community well-being. Key learning areas include the application of the CASOTi framework (Context, Action, Stakeholders, Outcomes, Timelines) to navigate complex challenges and design sustainable initiatives. It also delves into the concepts of 'Swabhava' (personal nature) and 'Swadharma' (public duty), encouraging learners to align their personal values with their professional responsibilities. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply practical tools for project assessment, engage meaningfully with diverse communities, and make ethical decisions in complex scenarios. This course will equip you to lead with purpose and drive change that is both impactful and sustainable.

title: Encadrement and Decadrement Procedures in Central Secretariat Cadres
desc: This beginner-level course equips senior-level establishment professionals with comprehensive knowledge of encadrement and decadrement procedures governing Central Secretariat cadres (CSS, CSSS, CSCS). The course addresses policy evolution, current approval frameworks, procedural requirements, documentation requirements, and post-encadrement administrative management following DoPT guidelines and Office Memorandums. The course emphasizes adherence to prescribed procedures and proper stakeholder coordination.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Endpoint Security and Identity Security
desc: In an era of digital transformation where organizational perimeters are dissolving, securing endpoints and identities has become paramount. This course is designed for government functionaries and security officers to address these critical challenges. It begins by contextualizing the modern threat landscape and the limitations of traditional perimeter-based security. The core of the course is dedicated to the Zero Trust architecture, explaining its foundational principles: never trust, always verify; grant least privilege access; and assume breach. Participants will learn to apply these principles across the six pillars of a modern security strategy: identities, devices, applications, infrastructure, network, and data. The session provides in-depth knowledge on identity security, covering multi-factor authentication (MFA), identity governance, and smart, risk-based access controls. It also covers endpoint security, detailing how to enforce device compliance, restrict access from vulnerable devices, and leverage automated investigation and remediation to counter sophisticated attacks. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to design and implement a more robust, resilient, and intelligent security framework for their organizations.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Energy Bill Monitoing
desc: In an era of rising energy costs, effective energy management is crucial for organizational sustainability. This course is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge and skills to monitor, analyze, and optimize electricity consumption. It begins by establishing the importance of energy conservation and introduces the fundamental components of an electricity bill, such as connected load, contract demand, maximum demand, and power factor. Learners will explore a variety of actionable strategies for cost reduction, from simple administrative changes like tariff conversion (no-cost measures) to technological interventions like installing demand controllers (low-cost measures) and capacitor panels (high-cost measures). The course provides a systematic approach to analyzing historical billing data to right-size contract demand and avoid penalties. By the end of this program, participants will be empowered to implement a robust energy monitoring framework, make data-driven decisions, and contribute directly to their organization's financial health and environmental goals.

title: ENERGY CONSERVATION
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of energy conservation and management within the context of India's Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs). It establishes the strategic importance of energy efficiency as a cornerstone of the nation's commitment to the Paris Agreement and its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs). Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the Energy Efficiency Action Plan, covering key areas such as the implementation of energy-efficient technologies, the integration of renewable energy systems like solar power, and the principles of green building design through codes like ECBC and Eco Niwas Samhita. The curriculum also addresses the transition towards sustainable transport with electric mobility and the role of systematic energy audits in identifying and acting on conservation opportunities. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these principles within their organizations, contributing to enhanced operational efficiency, cost savings, and the achievement of national sustainability objectives.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Energy Conservation Building Code - HVAC System Requirements
desc: In response to India's rapidly growing construction sector and the increasing demand for effective cooling, this course delves into the critical area of energy efficiency in buildings. It is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC) and its specific provisions for HVAC systems. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals, covering building heat transfer, factors affecting thermal comfort, and strategies for heat avoidance. It then proceeds to detail the mandatory ECBC requirements for ventilation, equipment efficiencies, controls, and system balancing. The course further explores the prescriptive requirements for chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and economizers, including the alternative compliance path of total system efficiency. A dedicated module on super-efficient and low-carbon cooling technologies, such as geothermal systems, radiant cooling, and evaporative cooling, provides insight into the future of sustainable building design. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply ECBC standards to optimize HVAC system performance, reduce energy consumption, and contribute to the development of green infrastructure.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Energy Efficiency in Existing Buildings
desc: In an era of rising energy costs and ambitious climate targets, improving the energy efficiency of existing infrastructure is a national imperative. This course is designed to equip officials with the technical knowledge and strategic framework needed to lead successful energy retrofitting projects. The curriculum begins by establishing the context, highlighting why energy efficiency in buildings is crucial for both financial savings and achieving net-zero emissions goals. You will learn the step-by-step methodology of an Investment Grade Energy Audit (IGEA), from initial data collection and site analysis to identifying and recommending viable Energy Conservation Measures (ECMs). The course then delves into practical implementation, evaluating different retrofit and financing models such as performance contracting through ESCOs. Finally, you will master the principles of Measurement and Verification (M&V) using established protocols to accurately measure, verify, and report the impact of your energy-saving initiatives, ensuring accountability and demonstrating tangible results.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Energy Efficiency in Public Buildings
desc: Energy efficiency in public buildings is a critical component of sustainable governance, offering a direct path to reducing operational costs, minimizing environmental impact, and meeting national climate objectives. This course provides a structured approach for public sector professionals to master the complexities of energy efficiency initiatives. It is designed to move beyond theoretical knowledge, equipping learners with the practical skills, tools, and program management expertise needed to successfully lead these projects. Participants will delve into the entire process of an energy efficiency program, covering crucial stages such as initial opportunity identification, technical assessment, project development, and strategic implementation. The curriculum, structured across several modules, addresses key concepts including energy audits, non-capital strategies, public procurement for EE, and effective operation and maintenance. Upon completion, learners will be capable of developing and executing robust energy efficiency programs tailored to their specific organizational context, thereby driving tangible energy savings and promoting a culture of sustainability within their departments.

title: Energy Efficiency Policy and Action Plan in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Indian Railways Energy Efficiency (EE) Policy and Action Plan issued by the Railway Board, with a specific focus on non-traction electrical loads. The policy is aligned with Indian Railways’ Net Zero commitments and outlines strategic measures to reduce energy consumption, improve power quality, and promote sustainable infrastructure. The course explains the five key action areas of the EE Policy: sustainable buildings, cloud-based data monitoring and management systems, energy-efficient equipment and appliances, power quality improvement, and capacity building and awareness. Through structured modules, learners gain insights into integrating energy efficiency in both existing and upcoming railway buildings, monitoring electrical assets through online dashboards, adopting BEE 5-star rated appliances and low-carbon cooling technologies, and improving power quality using power factor correction and harmonic filtering solutions.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Energy Management
desc: In an era of rising energy costs and increasing environmental regulations, effective energy management has become a strategic imperative for all organizations. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the knowledge and tools to implement robust energy conservation programs. The content delves into the 'why' and 'how' of energy management, starting with its core objectives of minimizing costs without compromising quality and reducing environmental footprints. Participants will learn to differentiate between passive actions, such as performance assessment and SMART goal setting, and active actions like implementing action plans and evaluating progress. The course provides a structured framework for identifying energy wastage, conducting energy audits, and applying practical solutions ranging from simple behavioral changes to significant technological upgrades like retrofitting with LEDs or implementing intelligent building management systems. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to champion energy efficiency, contribute to their organization's financial health, and support national sustainability goals.

title: Energy Resources, Economics and Sustainability
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the complex interplay between energy resources, economics, and environmental sustainability. It begins by establishing the scientific basis for global warming, analyzing historical and current CO2 emission trends and their direct correlation with fossil fuel consumption. Learners will understand the Kaya identity as a framework for dissecting the factors driving emissions. The course provides a comparative analysis of national energy strategies, highlighting India's unique position, challenges, and ambitious net-zero targets in contrast to other major global players. A significant portion is dedicated to evaluating the future of energy, with detailed case studies on the economic viability and environmental impact of emerging technologies. Through discussions on green hydrogen production, life cycle assessments, and various grid-level energy storage options like pumped hydro and batteries, participants will gain a nuanced understanding of the technological and policy-driven solutions required to transition towards a secure and sustainable energy system.

title: Energy Transitions to Tackle Climate Change
desc: In an era defined by climate urgency, transforming our energy systems is paramount. This course delves into the core strategies for navigating the global shift from fossil fuels to sustainable energy. It begins by establishing the fundamental connection between energy consumption and climate change, outlining the scientific basis and the international commitments driving the need for action. You will explore the diverse portfolio of clean energy solutions, including solar, wind, green hydrogen, and advanced energy storage systems. The curriculum further examines the crucial role of policy, regulation, and finance in accelerating this transition, drawing on examples from India and across Asia. A significant focus is placed on enhancing the resilience of energy infrastructure against increasing climate-related threats. Upon completion, you will have a robust understanding of the technological, economic, and governance dimensions of the energy transition, equipping you to contribute to sustainable development and climate action within the public sector.

title: Engineering Properties of Rocks and Soil
desc: This comprehensive e-learning course from the Geological Survey of India Training Institute (GSITI) delves into the essential engineering properties of rocks and soil. The curriculum is designed for professionals who need to evaluate geological materials for construction purposes. The course begins with an introduction to engineering geology, followed by a detailed examination of the physical properties of rocks. Key topics include methods for testing crushing strength, transverse strength, shear strength, tensile strength, porosity, permeability, and density. You will learn how factors like mineral composition, texture, and water content influence these properties. The second part of the course shifts focus to soil as an engineering medium. It covers critical soil properties such as grain size distribution, Atterberg limits (liquid, plastic, shrinkage), soil phase relationships, and shear strength. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to assess the suitability of rock and soil for specific engineering applications, contributing to safer and more economical construction projects.

title: English Vocabulary: Commonly Misused and Confused Words
desc: This course is divided into three modules and is designed to help learners understand commonly confused words in the English language. These words are frequently used in everyday communication but are often misused or used interchangeably due to their similar meanings, pronunciation, or spelling. Such incorrect usage can lead to misunderstandings and, at times, embarrassing situations. The course provides clear explanations of each word along with contextual examples to illustrate its correct usage. It is suitable for a wide range of learners, including students, teachers, teacher educators, professionals, and anyone who speaks or writes in English. By focusing on accuracy and appropriate word choice, the course aims to strengthen learners' vocabulary and improve their ability to communicate effectively in both spoken and written English. Mastery of correct word usage will enable learners to express their ideas with greater precision, confidence, and clarity.
org: Camp Office of Basic Education Lucknow, School Education Department, Uttar Pradesh

title: Enhancing Central Public Sector Enterprises Governance Practices
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the regulatory and operational framework governing Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) in India. It is designed for professionals seeking to navigate the complex landscape of public enterprise management. The curriculum addresses the importance of robust corporate governance structures and ethical practices as the foundation for organizational success. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of personnel and HR policies, financial management procedures, and the role of internal vigilance in promoting transparency and accountability. The course also demystifies the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) system, explaining its function in performance evaluation and incentive structures. Furthermore, it provides practical guidance on fulfilling Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) obligations and adhering to transparent procurement policies, including guidelines from the CVC and DPE. Through this course, learners will gain the skills to effectively manage CPSE operations, ensuring a balance between regulatory compliance, performance targets, and public accountability.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Enhancing Gender Integration in Scaled and Sustained Government Health
desc: This course is designed to advance the understanding and application of gender integration in public health. It addresses the critical need to create health systems that are equitable and responsive to the diverse needs of all genders. The curriculum begins by establishing a foundational understanding of key concepts such as gender, sex, and intersectionality, explaining why these are crucial for effective health policy. The core of the course is an in-depth exploration of three distinct government health initiatives where gender integration was successfully scaled and sustained. Learners will analyze a policy-level change with the legalization of safe abortion in Nepal, an institutional transformation within a tertiary hospital in the Philippines, and a systemic shift through the integration of gender in medical education curricula in India. By examining the contextual factors, catalysts, and mechanisms that drove success in these cases, participants will be equipped with the knowledge and strategies to champion and implement gender-transformative change in their own work, ultimately fostering greater health equity and equality.

title: Enhancing Microsoft Documents with Artificial Intelligence
desc: This foundational course provides a comprehensive introduction to the artificial intelligence features integrated into Microsoft 365 applications, designed to boost productivity and creativity. The curriculum focuses on practical, real-world applications that are crucial in modern professional and academic settings. Learners will explore how to use OneNote to effortlessly capture and convert text from images, making information gathering seamless. The course delves into PowerPoint's AI-powered Designer, which offers professional design suggestions to create visually stunning presentations with minimal effort. Additionally, participants will master the advanced spelling and grammar checking tools in Microsoft Word to ensure their written communications are clear, correct, and impactful. The course also covers speech recognition for hands-free content creation and explores customization options to improve accessibility. By the end of this training, learners will be equipped to integrate these intelligent tools into their daily workflow, leading to greater efficiency and higher quality outcomes in their projects and tasks.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Enhancing Public Services Through Design Thinking
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Design Thinking, empowering public service professionals to tackle complex challenges with an innovative, human-centered approach. It delves into the five distinct stages of the Design Thinking process, starting with building deep empathy for citizens to understand their needs and pain points. Learners will then progress to defining problems, brainstorming creative ideas, and developing low-cost prototypes to test potential solutions. The curriculum emphasizes the importance of an iterative mindset, using user feedback gathered during the testing phase to refine and improve service delivery. Through practical examples and conceptual frameworks like empathy mapping, participants will gain the skills to move beyond traditional administrative processes. The course is designed to equip officials to become change-makers who can foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and citizen-centricity within their departments, ultimately leading to more effective and responsive governance.

title: Ensuring AI Governance of India
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the strategic and practical considerations for integrating Artificial Intelligence into public governance. It addresses the fundamental question of how government entities can effectively plan, implement, and manage AI projects to enhance citizen services and internal efficiency. The discussion moves beyond the hype to focus on the real-world challenges and success factors. Key learning areas include the methodology for identifying high-impact AI use cases, the art of framing a business problem as a technical AI problem, and the crucial differences between AI-driven and AI-assisted solutions. The course delves into the complexities of data management, from collection and preparation to the importance of training, validation, and evaluation datasets. It also highlights why AI projects require a different management approach than traditional IT projects, emphasizing the need to account for research, iteration, and potential feasibility issues. By the end of this course, learners will be better equipped to contribute to AI strategy, evaluate project proposals, and understand the lifecycle of AI implementation in a governance context.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Environment and Sustainability at South Eastern Coalfields Limited
desc: This course highlights SECL’s commitment to sustainability through three key pillars: Sustainable Development, Eco-Tourism Promotion, and Green Coal & Clean Energy. The company focuses on strong environmental management by adopting green mining technologies, implementing strict air-quality monitoring systems, and undertaking large-scale afforestation using the Miyawaki technique. SECL also promotes water conservation by treating and reusing approximately 800 lakh kilolitres of mine water annually, benefiting more than 61,000 people for industrial, domestic, and agricultural purposes. In addition, the company has transformed abandoned mining areas into productive spaces such as Ananya Vatika Eco-Restoration Park and the Kenapara Eco-Tourism site, which also support local community livelihoods.

title: Environmental Planning
desc: In an era of rapid development, understanding the principles of environmental stewardship is crucial for effective governance. This course offers an in-depth exploration of Environmental Planning, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), and the vital connection between Forests and Livelihoods. It is designed to equip public functionaries with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of sustainable development. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals of environmental planning, covering its goals, elements, and processes. It then delves into the specifics of EIA, detailing its history, key components, regulatory frameworks like the EPA 1986, and the steps for assessing development projects. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the socio-economic importance of forests. Learners will examine how forests support local livelihoods through produce, services, and ecotourism, and learn about community-based programs for sustainable enhancement. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to analyze environmental impacts, ensure regulatory compliance, and contribute to adaptive strategies that harmonize conservation efforts with development goals, fostering long-term environmental and social well-being.

title: eOffice Learning Resources 2025
desc: This course offers a structured and practical guide to the eOffice File Management System (eFile), an integral component of digital governance in India. It is designed to empower government officials and staff with a thorough understanding of the platform's digital workflows. The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of office files, from creation to dispatch. Key learning areas include navigating the eOffice portal, managing inward correspondence through the Receipt module, processing digital files with notes and annexures, and preparing official communications in the Draft module. Participants will also learn to use Digital Signature Certificates (DSC) and eSign for secure document authentication. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to confidently utilize the eOffice platform, streamline administrative tasks, and contribute to a more efficient, transparent, and paperless government workplace.

title: EPABX System
desc: This course offers detailed, step-by-step training on the installation, programming, and maintenance of EPABX systems. It is designed for personnel responsible for managing internal telecommunication infrastructure, particularly within government and security organizations. The curriculum begins with the basics, explaining what an EPABX is, its various types, features like call transfer and conferencing, and its primary components such as CPU cards and extension line cards. The course then moves into the practical aspects of installation, covering premise inspection, planning a wiring layout using MDFs and Krone modules, and the physical wiring process. Learners will gain hands-on knowledge of programming the EPABX, including how to connect it to a computer, assign IP addresses, and configure extension numbers and names through a web interface. Finally, the course emphasizes the importance of regular maintenance, providing common tips for visual inspection, cleaning, power supply checks, and configuration backups to ensure the system's longevity and optimal performance. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to manage an organization's internal telephone network effectively.

title: EPF Act and Schemes
desc: This course is designed to provide a detailed understanding of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act of 1952, a cornerstone of social security in India. The content addresses the critical need for officials to be well-versed in the legal frameworks that govern employee retirement and insurance benefits. Key learning areas include the applicability of the Act to various establishments, the specific rates of contribution for the Provident Fund, Pension Fund (EPS), and the Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI) scheme. Furthermore, the course elaborates on eligibility criteria, benefits available under each scheme, and the procedures for compliance and recovery. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently handle matters related to EPF, ensuring adherence to statutory duties and safeguarding employee welfare.

title: EPFO - Recovery Manual
desc: This detailed manual serves as an essential resource for officials handling the recovery of statutory dues for the EPFO. It begins by tracing the evolution of the recovery machinery within the organization, establishing the context for the current legal and procedural landscape. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the roles and functions of Recovery Officers and Enforcement Officers, who are at the forefront of enforcing compliance. The course meticulously breaks down the processes for attachment and sale of both movable and immovable properties, providing step-by-step guidance and referencing the specific legal forms required for each action. Furthermore, it covers advanced recovery methods such as the appointment of a receiver for a defaulter's business and the sensitive procedures for the arrest and detention of a defaulter. By consolidating the provisions of the EPF & MP Act, 1952, the Income Tax (Certificate Proceedings) Rules, 1962, and relevant civil codes, this course equips officers with the necessary knowledge to conduct recovery actions uniformly, judiciously, and effectively, ensuring the integrity of the provident fund system.

title: ePost office
desc: In an era of digital transformation, the Department of Posts has introduced the ePost Office portal to make its services more accessible to citizens. This course is designed to familiarize postal employees with this crucial e-commerce platform. It begins by explaining the purpose and benefits of the ePost Office, highlighting its role in modernizing postal services. The curriculum provides a step-by-step guide on the customer registration and login process. Learners will be walked through the procedures for purchasing various products, such as unique philately items and Gangajal, directly from the portal. A dedicated segment explains the process of acquiring an e-IPO, a convenient digital method for paying RTI fees. By completing this course, staff will be empowered to confidently guide customers in using the portal, thereby enhancing citizen satisfaction and contributing to the department's digital outreach and revenue generation.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: ePrisons Application
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the operational knowledge required to effectively use the ePrisons application. In the context of digital governance, this platform is critical for enhancing efficiency and transparency within the criminal justice system. The curriculum covers the core functionalities of the ePrisons portal, starting with an overview of its services like e-Mulakat for managing visitor requests and the integrated dashboard for monitoring prison statistics. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the prisoner induction process, detailing both manual data entry and the preferred ICJS admission method, which ensures data consistency by fetching information directly from the CCTNS system. Furthermore, learners will explore the Bail Order Management System, which facilitates rapid and secure communication of bail orders from courts to prisons. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in navigating the ePrisons ecosystem, managing prisoner data accurately, and utilizing its features to support timely and effective justice administration.

title: Equity : Competency Framework
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of 'Equity,' a cornerstone of the Mission Karmayogi competency framework designed to enhance the capabilities of India's civil services. The curriculum is structured around four essential behavioral competencies that are vital for modern, citizen-centric governance. Participants will first learn the principles of 'Consultation and Consensus Building,' understanding how to engage stakeholders effectively to create inclusive policies. The module on 'Decision Making' covers the process of making sound, evidence-based judgments that serve the public interest. Subsequently, the course examines 'Empathy,' highlighting its role in understanding citizen needs and delivering compassionate service. Finally, the principles of 'Delegation' are discussed, focusing on how to empower teams, manage workloads, and build organizational capacity. Through this course, public servants will gain a clear understanding of how to apply these equitable practices in their daily roles to promote fairness, transparency, and efficiency in governance, ultimately contributing to a more responsive and effective administration.

title: Erection of Boiler and Auxiliaries Module
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the erection process for industrial boilers and their auxiliaries within a thermal power plant context. The curriculum is designed to build a strong foundational knowledge base, starting with the core principles and operational dynamics of boilers. It addresses the critical importance of this equipment in power generation and the complexities involved in its installation.Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the major components of a boiler system, understanding their functions and interdependencies. The course systematically walks through the entire erection lifecycle, from initial planning, scheduling, and defining responsibilities to the practical aspects of transportation, pre-installation inspections, and proper storage of components. Participants will learn the necessary preparations and checks required to ensure a safe and efficient erection process.Upon completion, learners will be able to understand the key procedures and considerations for boiler installation projects. This knowledge is essential for engineers, technicians, and project managers involved in the construction and commissioning of power generation facilities, enabling them to contribute effectively to project success.

title: ESG-In the Financial Eco System
desc: In an era where responsible business practices are paramount, understanding the impact of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors is crucial for financial professionals. This course offers a foundational perspective on ESG, detailing how these non-financial metrics are reshaping the investment landscape. You will delve into the specific considerations for each pillar: analyzing environmental risks like climate change, evaluating social factors such as labor standards and community relations, and assessing corporate governance structures. The course will equip you with the knowledge to integrate ESG analysis into portfolio construction, understand key rating systems and reporting frameworks like SASB, GRI, and TCFD, and recognize the opportunities in sustainable investments. Through real-world case studies from India, you will see how successful ESG integration can drive long-term value and contribute to a more sustainable global economy.

title: Essential Digital Skills for Everyday Life
desc: In today's digital-first world, digital literacy is a fundamental skill for both personal efficiency and effective public service delivery. This course is designed to bridge the digital divide by providing foundational knowledge and practical skills to navigate the digital landscape confidently. Learners will begin with the basics of smartphone usage and explore essential applications for communication and productivity. A significant focus is placed on ensuring online safety, teaching participants how to identify cyber risks, protect personal information, and practice good cyber hygiene. The course then progresses to the critical area of digital finance, covering secure online banking, UPI payments, and methods to avoid common digital frauds. The final module is dedicated to empowering learners to interact with government services digitally. It provides step-by-step guidance on using key platforms such as the Aadhaar portal for updates, DigiLocker for secure document storage, and the UMANG app for accessing a wide range of citizen-centric services. Upon completion, participants will be fully capable of managing their digital presence securely and independently accessing essential online services.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Essential Tools for Monitoring and Management for Everyone
desc: Dive into the world of everyday data science with this comprehensive program designed for government officials. This course demystifies data analysis by using a tool you already know: Microsoft Excel. You will learn how to handle real-world data from schemes like MGNREGA and PMGSY, starting with cleaning and preparing your datasets. The curriculum covers key analytical techniques, including descriptive statistics, PivotTables for data segmentation, and methods for ranking and creating composite indices. Furthermore, you will master the art of data communication by creating effective visualizations such as histograms, column charts, and scatter plots. The course also teaches you how to build professional presentations in PowerPoint and automate personalized communications with Mail Merge. Upon completion, you will be able to confidently translate complex data into clear reports and presentations, supporting evidence-based policy and enhancing program monitoring and evaluation within your department.

title: Essentials of ISO 27001:2022  for Data Protection Officers
desc:
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, the international standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). It explains the rationale for ISMS adoption through the principles of Due Care and Due Diligence, and introduces the CIA triad—Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability—as the foundation of information security. The course covers the evolution of the standard, its seven mandatory clauses (Clauses 4–10), and Annex A controls comprising 93 controls across four themes: Organisational (37), People (8), Physical (14), and Technological (34). It also highlights key changes from the 2013 version, including 11 new controls, 57 merged controls, 1 split control, 23 renamed controls, and the introduction of 5 new control attributes. 
Target Audience: Data Protection Officers, Data Privacy Team
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Essentials of Monitoring and Evaluation for Programmes and Policies
desc: In an era of evidence-based governance, the ability to effectively monitor and evaluate public programmes and policies is a critical competency for public officials. This course offers a structured and practical guide to Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL), designed for professionals involved in the planning, implementation, and oversight of development initiatives. It addresses the fundamental need for accountability and continuous improvement in the public sector by equipping learners with the necessary skills to measure impact and drive results. The curriculum delves into the complete program and project cycle, from initial situational and gap analyses to final impact assessment. Participants will gain hands-on experience with key industry-standard tools and frameworks, including Logic Models, Logical Frameworks (LFA), Results Frameworks, and the Theory of Change. Upon completion, learners will be capable of designing robust MEL systems, applying evaluation techniques to assess program performance, and integrating data-driven insights to refine strategies.
