This will empower them to not only improve the effectiveness of their programs but also to foster a culture of transparency and evidence-based decision-making within their organizations.

title: Establishment Review of Branch Post Office
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the procedures for conducting an Establishment Review of Branch Post Offices, a critical administrative function within the Department of Posts. It is tailored for officials responsible for human resource management, operational efficiency, and administrative oversight. The program begins by establishing the context and necessity of establishment reviews, focusing on objectives like evaluating productivity, assessing workload, and justifying manpower. It outlines the official periodicity for reviews of different office types and the importance of maintaining systematic records.Participants will gain practical knowledge of the entire review lifecycle, from data collection to final analysis. The course provides a step-by-step breakdown of the standardized norms and point-based methodology used to calculate the workload for various postal roles, including Branch Postmasters and Assistant Branch Postmasters involved in delivery and mail conveyance. It details which official documents and registers to use for data extraction and how to compile statistics accurately.Upon completion, learners will be able to independently conduct an establishment review, calculate workload points, determine the appropriate TRCA slabs for GDS employees, and take informed decisions on manpower augmentation, reduction, or redeployment. This will equip them to ensure optimal staffing and operational efficiency across the Branch Post Office network, contributing to better governance and service delivery.

title: Establishment Review of Departmental Post Office
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the procedures for conducting establishment reviews within the Department of Posts. It is designed to provide officials with a systematic understanding of how to assess the operational and financial health of post offices. The curriculum is structured into key modules covering the introduction to establishment reviews, detailed processes for clerical and delivery establishments, supervisory role analysis, and the critical calculation of income and cost to determine financial viability. Participants will learn to collect and analyze statistical data, apply standardized norms and time factors, and calculate work hours versus staff hours. Upon completion, learners will be capable of preparing evidence-based proposals for staff augmentation, reduction, or redeployment, thereby contributing to the overall efficiency, productivity, and modernization of the postal network.

title: Establishment Review of Divisional Office
desc: This specialized course offers an in-depth understanding of the procedures for conducting an Establishment Review in a Postal Divisional Office. It is designed for officers who need to master the methodologies for ensuring optimal staffing and resource utilization. The course begins by explaining the purpose and periodicity of establishment reviews, emphasizing their role in enhancing productivity and justifying manpower. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to the practical application of the Staff Inspection Unit (SIU) formula. Learners will be guided through step-by-step calculations to assess the workload for clerical staff, the Divisional Superintendent, and the aggregate workload for determining the need for an Assistant Superintendent or potential bifurcation of the division. Key learning areas include analyzing various official records like the Classified List of Post Offices and Permanent Establishment Registers, applying specific coefficients to different operational units, and interpreting the results to make informed administrative recommendations. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to conduct a full establishment review, justify staffing decisions with statistical evidence, and contribute to the strategic management of postal operations.

title: Ethical AI: Navigating Security and Privacy in the Digital Era
desc: In an age driven by digital transformation, understanding the complexities of Artificial Intelligence is crucial for effective governance. This course offers a deep-dive into the evolving landscape of AI, addressing the significant ethical, security, and privacy challenges it presents. You will explore the technological progression of AI, from basic machine learning to sophisticated deep learning and generative models. The curriculum covers key security vulnerabilities, including adversarial attacks, data poisoning, and model inversion, and introduces protective measures like the AI Bill of Materials. Furthermore, the course examines pressing ethical and privacy issues such as data consent, algorithmic bias, and the right to autonomy, contextualized through case studies like the Sadhguru deepfake incident. Learners will also gain an understanding of the global regulatory environment, including GDPR and emerging AI-specific laws, preparing them to navigate the legal and liability concerns associated with AI-driven systems. Ultimately, this course equips public functionaries with the knowledge to advocate for and apply secure, ethical, and responsible AI innovation.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Practice
desc: As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly embedded in the public and social sectors, it is vital to develop a solid understanding of how AI works and how to use it ethically and effectively. This course provides a comprehensive overview, starting with the foundational principles of AI and its real-world applications in governance and social impact initiatives. It delves into the critical social implications of AI, including algorithmic bias, privacy issues, and the unintended consequences of poorly governed systems. Participants will learn to critically evaluate the benefits and risks associated with AI technologies. The curriculum covers leading ethical principles, global governance models, and regulatory frameworks, equipping learners with the necessary tools and methods to implement AI responsibly. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to champion the ethical use of AI, ensuring that technology serves the public good while safeguarding against potential harms.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Practice
desc: As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly embedded in the public and social sectors, it is vital to develop a solid understanding of how AI works and how to use it ethically and effectively. This course provides a comprehensive overview, starting with the foundational principles of AI and its real-world applications in governance and social impact initiatives. It delves into the critical social implications of AI, including algorithmic bias, privacy issues, and the unintended consequences of poorly governed systems. Participants will learn to critically evaluate the benefits and risks associated with AI technologies. The curriculum covers leading ethical principles, global governance models, and regulatory frameworks, equipping learners with the necessary tools and methods to implement AI responsibly. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to champion the ethical use of AI, ensuring that technology serves the public good while safeguarding against potential harms.

title: Ethical Use of Artificial Intelligence
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, understanding the ethical implications of Artificial Intelligence is crucial for responsible governance. This course is designed to provide public service professionals with a structured understanding of AI ethics, its challenges, and the evolving regulatory landscape. The curriculum delves into the core principles of fairness, accountability, and transparency, using real-world case studies to illustrate concepts like algorithmic bias, data privacy, and the societal impact of AI on jobs and public discourse. Participants will explore significant concerns, including the misuse of AI for deepfakes, misinformation campaigns, and autonomous weaponization. Furthermore, the course examines key international and national frameworks, such as the OECD AI Principles, the EU AI Act, and India's own strategic initiatives for ethical AI. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to critically assess AI systems and contribute to the development of policies that ensure AI is deployed ethically and for the public good.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Ethics and Decentralization in Governance and Public Administration
desc: This course provides a critical examination of India's administrative systems, tracing the influence of colonial-era practices on modern governance. It addresses the persistence of excessive formalism, rigid hierarchies, and a lack of public responsiveness inherited from the past. As a powerful alternative, the course introduces the concept of Rajadharma, a framework for ethical, service-oriented leadership rooted in public welfare (Loka-Kalyana). A key focus is on the detrimental effects of over-centralization, which often stifles local initiative and bureaucratic efficiency. Learners will explore the principles and practical applications of decentralized governance through indigenous models like Panchayati Raj and Gram Swaraj, which empower grassroots participation. The course argues for a renewed administrative approach, one that integrates India's cultural ethos (Sanskriti and Riti) to create a system that is not only efficient but also culturally aligned and truly people-first, contributing to the vision of Viksit Bharat.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Ethos : The first Pillar
desc: This foundational course introduces the principles of Mission Karmayogi and the Competency Framework designed to reform the Indian Civil Services. The primary focus is on 'Ethos,' the first and most crucial pillar that defines the character and guiding values of a civil servant. The course systematically breaks down this pillar into five essential competencies that are vital for effective governance and public administration. Key learning areas include 'People First,' which emphasizes citizen-centric service delivery; 'Strategic Thinking,' for effective policy formulation and long-term planning; 'Organizational Awareness,' to navigate institutional dynamics; 'Commitment to the Organization,' for aligning personal efforts with public goals; and 'Leading Others,' to inspire and motivate teams. Through a series of detailed video lectures, participants will gain a clear understanding of how these values translate into actionable behaviors. Upon completion, civil servants will be better equipped to embody the spirit of public service, enhance their professional effectiveness, and contribute meaningfully to national development.

title: Evaluating Investment Proposals Through Capital Budgeting Techniques
desc: In the context of public administration and finance, making sound investment decisions is paramount for effective resource management and achieving strategic objectives. This course is designed to equip officials with the essential skills to evaluate investment proposals through robust capital budgeting techniques. The program begins by establishing the foundational concepts and importance of capital budgeting in the public sector. Participants will delve into key methodologies such as Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and the Payback Period, learning to compare their respective strengths and weaknesses. Through practical application, learners will be able to analyze investment opportunities, assess financial feasibility, and make informed recommendations. The course also addresses the complexities of capital rationing and the critical role of post-investment audits in ensuring financial discipline and continuous improvement. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to contribute to prudent financial planning and project appraisal within their organizations.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Evaluation of Evidence
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the critical process of evaluating evidence in administrative and departmental inquiries. It begins by establishing the context, explaining why a structured approach to evidence evaluation is fundamental to upholding fairness, transparency, and the rule of law in public administration. Participants will learn to identify and categorize different types of evidence, including documentary, oral, and circumstantial, and understand the standards for their admissibility and relevance. The curriculum delves into the core principles of natural justice, such as 'audi alteram partem' (hear the other side) and 'nemo judex in causa sua' (no one should be a judge in their own cause), and their practical application during an inquiry. By the end of this course, learners will be proficient in weighing evidence, assessing the credibility of witnesses, and formulating reasoned conclusions that are logical, impartial, and capable of withstanding scrutiny. This will enable them to conduct inquiries and make decisions with greater confidence and integrity.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Evaluation of Evidence (Hindi)
desc: प्रशासनिक और अनुशासनात्मक मामलों में प्रभावी शासन और न्याय के लिए साक्ष्य का उचित मूल्यांकन एक आधारशिला है। यह विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम शिक्षार्थियों को साक्ष्य मूल्यांकन से जुड़ी जटिलताओं को समझने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान और कौशल से लैस करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम प्राकृतिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों पर प्रकाश डालता है जो सभी जांचों का मार्गदर्शन करते हैं। इसमें साक्ष्य एकत्र करने, उनकी जांच करने और उनके महत्व का विश्लेषण करने की प्रक्रिया शामिल है। प्रतिभागी सीखेंगे कि पूर्वाग्रहों से कैसे बचें और केवल विश्वसनीय और प्रासंगिक जानकारी के आधार पर तर्कपूर्ण निष्कर्ष पर कैसे पहुंचें। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी विभागीय जांच, सतर्कता मामलों और अन्य अर्ध-न्यायिक कार्यों को अधिक आत्मविश्वास और सटीकता के साथ संभालने में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे उनके संबंधित विभागों में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Everyday Electricity: Smart Use and Safety for General Audience
desc: This foundational course is designed to empower individuals with the knowledge to use electricity safely and efficiently in their daily lives. In an increasingly connected world, understanding the basics of electricity is no longer just for technicians but a vital life skill for everyone. The course demystifies electrical concepts, starting with the basics of circuits, conductors, and insulators, and progresses to practical, real-world applications. Key learning areas include identifying common household electrical risks, understanding the roles of safety devices like fuses and circuit breakers, and interpreting appliance power ratings to manage consumption. Participants will learn how to read their electricity bills, calculate energy usage, and implement strategies to reduce costs. The course places a strong emphasis on sustainability, exploring how to minimize energy waste from 'phantom loads' and make informed choices about energy-efficient technologies like LED lighting and 5-star rated appliances. By the end, learners will be equipped to create a safer, more energy-efficient home environment.

title: Evidence in Public Policy
desc: In an increasingly complex world, grounding public policy in solid evidence is essential for good governance. This course provides a comprehensive overview of how to effectively use evidence—including data, information, and credible research—to inform and improve the entire policy lifecycle. The curriculum is designed to explain why evidence-based approaches are crucial for avoiding unintended consequences and enhancing the likelihood of achieving desired societal outcomes. Key learning areas include identifying and assessing different types of evidence, understanding its application in policy design, and leveraging it for robust monitoring and evaluation. Participants will learn to build a strong case for policy interventions, ensuring they are efficient, effective, and aligned with citizen needs. This course is ideal for officials who wish to move beyond intuition-based decisions and adopt a more systematic and impactful approach to public policy.

title: Evidence-based Policy Making
desc: In an era of complex governance challenges, making sound, evidence-based decisions is more critical than ever. This course is designed for public sector professionals seeking to move beyond intuition and self-evident truths to a more rigorous, analytical approach to policy making. You will delve into the core principles of using evidence, learning to identify and analyze the multiple causes behind 'wicked problems' like malnutrition and pollution. The course introduces the 'ABCD-X' framework, a systematic method for decision-making under uncertainty, which helps in projecting outcomes and justifying interventions. Participants will also explore the critical challenges of measurement, including issues of time, scale, dynamics, and the Jevons Paradox, to avoid common pitfalls in policy evaluation. By understanding concepts like complex adaptive systems, you will learn to anticipate unintended consequences and design interventions that are robust and effective. This course will empower you to build a scientific and systematic habit of mind for tackling the most pressing public policy issues.

title: Evolution and Application of Artificial Intelligence
desc: This course delves into the transformative world of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its growing importance in public administration. It begins by establishing the context for AI in governance, explaining why understanding this technology is crucial for modern public servants. You will explore the historical journey of AI, from early rule-based systems to today's sophisticated deep learning and large language models. The curriculum covers key technical concepts, including the distinction between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, providing a solid foundation for non-technical professionals. Through an examination of practical case studies, the course demonstrates how AI can be applied to enhance public service delivery, optimize administrative processes, and inform policy development. A significant focus is placed on the ethical dimensions and policy implications of AI, preparing participants to navigate the complexities of deploying these powerful tools responsibly and effectively. By the end, learners will be equipped to think critically about AI's role in creating more efficient, equitable, and responsive governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Evolution and Overview of Public Financial Management System
desc: This course is designed to familiarize learners with the Public Financial Management System (PFMS), a critical IT initiative by the Controller General of Accounts, Ministry of Finance. The program delves into the journey of PFMS, highlighting its transformation into a cornerstone of India's public finance architecture. You will gain a clear understanding of why PFMS is essential for improving accountability, transparency, and efficiency in government financial transactions. The curriculum is structured into two main parts: the evolution of PFMS and an overview of its key modules. You will explore how these modules facilitate crucial operations such as electronic payments, budgeting, accounting, and the seamless execution of Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT) for both Central and State Governments. Upon completion, you will be equipped to appreciate the role of PFMS in digital governance and its impact on the nation's financial management ecosystem.

title: Evolution and Overview of the Public Financial Management System
desc: This course is designed to familiarize learners with the Public Financial Management System (PFMS), a critical IT initiative by the Controller General of Accounts, Ministry of Finance. The program delves into the journey of PFMS, highlighting its transformation into a cornerstone of India's public finance architecture. You will gain a clear understanding of why PFMS is essential for improving accountability, transparency, and efficiency in government financial transactions. The curriculum is structured into two main parts: the evolution of PFMS and an overview of its key modules. You will explore how these modules facilitate crucial operations such as electronic payments, budgeting, accounting, and the seamless execution of Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT) for both Central and State Governments. Upon completion, you will be equipped to appreciate the role of PFMS in digital governance and its impact on the nation's financial management ecosystem.

title: Evolution and Principles of the Cooperative Movement in India
desc: The cooperative movement in India gained formal recognition after the Cooperative Societies Act of 1912 and has since played a significant role in promoting rural entrepreneurship, livelihood generation, and inclusive economic development. This course explores the historical evolution of the cooperative movement in India, its guiding principles, and its economic model based on collective ownership and mutual benefit. It highlights major success stories such as AMUL, which links millions of milk producers through thousands of cooperatives, ensuring fair returns and empowering rural communities, especially women entrepreneurs. The course also discusses key organizations such as SUMUL, KRIBHCO, IFFCO, and Lijjat Papad, which have contributed significantly to rural development, agricultural growth, and women’s empowerment. Through these examples, learners will understand how cooperatives function as sustainable economic models that strengthen livelihoods and promote equitable development.

title: Evolution from 1G to 5G Mobile Communications
desc: Embark on a journey through the history of mobile telecommunications with this detailed course on the evolution from 1G to 5G. The program begins by exploring the analog voice systems of 1G and the introduction of digital voice with 2G (GSM). It then delves into the shift towards mobile data with 3G, highlighting the introduction of the packet-switched domain alongside the circuit-switched core. You will learn about the significant leap to mobile broadband with 4G LTE, understanding its all-IP Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and the introduction of Voice over LTE (VoLTE). The course culminates with an in-depth look at 5G, explaining its unified, future-proof platform designed for enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB), ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC), and massive machine-type communication (mMTC). Key architectural concepts, such as the move to a Service-Based Architecture (SBA), network slicing, and new components like the G-NodeB, AMF, and UPF, are explained in detail, providing a clear picture of the technology that powers our connected world.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Evolution of Mobile Technologies - 1G to 5G
desc: Gain a thorough understanding of the pivotal advancements in mobile technology over the past four decades. This course delves into the historical and technical evolution of mobile networks, starting with the analog systems of 1G and progressing through the digital revolution of 2G (GSM), the introduction of mobile data with 3G, and the all-IP networks of 4G (LTE). You will explore the core architectural components of each generation, understanding how they were designed and how they paved the way for their successors. The curriculum culminates with an in-depth look at 5G, covering its advanced service-based architecture (SBA), key performance indicators, and its transformative potential across various economic sectors. Upon completion, you will be able to articulate the key differences between each generation and appreciate the complex systems that power modern mobile communication.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Ex-Gratia Payment During Accident in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the compensation and ex-gratia payment system in Indian Railways, designed to support passengers during times of distress. The curriculum is centered on the legal provisions of the Railways Act, 1989, with a specific focus on Sections 124 and 124-A, which define the administration's liability for accidents and untoward incidents. Participants will learn to distinguish between different types of incidents, such as train collisions, derailments, and accidents at level crossings, and understand the corresponding compensation structures. The course elaborates on the revised compensation amounts effective from 2016, including specific payment scales for death, grievous injuries, and simple injuries. It also covers the procedural aspects of payment disbursement, from immediate cash relief to electronic transfers, ensuring that officials can effectively manage and expedite claims. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to navigate the rules and apply the correct procedures for providing timely financial relief to victims, upholding the railway's commitment to public welfare.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Examination of Freight Stock and Brake Power Certificate in Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the revised procedures for freight train examination as mandated by the Indian Railway Board. It is designed to enhance the safety and operational efficiency of freight movements across the network. The curriculum delves into specific examination patterns, including intensive end-to-end, premium, and close circuit (CC) rake examinations, while phasing out older practices. Participants will learn about the updated responsibilities for post-loading and post-tippling checks, which are now primarily conducted by guards and drivers. The course also covers the critical role of the Brake Power Certificate (BPC), detailing the standards for different rake types and the process for its issuance. By completing this module, railway personnel will be equipped to apply standardized inspection protocols, ensure mechanical fitness of rolling stock, and maintain the high safety standards essential for reliable freight transportation.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Examination of Legislative Proposals for Drafting Bills and Ordinances
desc: This course is designed to equip officers of the Legislative Department with the knowledge and analytical skills required to effectively examine legislative proposals and assist in drafting Bills and Ordinances. Participants will gain insight into the entire legislative formulation process, from the initiation of proposals to their conversion into draft legislation. The course covers core drafting principles, procedural stages, and techniques for revising and finalizing drafts to ensure legal clarity, consistency, and alignment with legislative intent. Through interactive examples and case-based discussions, learners will understand how legislative proposals evolve into precise and enforceable statutory instruments. This course bridges the gap between policy formulation and legislative drafting, enhancing participants’ proficiency in producing high-quality, constitutionally sound legislative output.

title: Executing Large Scale Digital Transformation Projects
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, government officers are increasingly called upon to lead complex digital transformation initiatives. This course offers a strategic roadmap for navigating the entire lifecycle of a large-scale government IT project. It begins by establishing the context for digital projects in governance, from responding to national incidents to enhancing citizen services. You will learn the art of crafting a compelling concept note that secures institutional buy-in and funding. The curriculum delves into the practicalities of execution, covering essential topics such as building and managing multi-disciplinary teams, effective stakeholder engagement across agencies, and understanding the nuances of government procurement, including RFPs and contract management. Furthermore, the course addresses critical technical considerations like data maturity assessment, planning for scalability, managing technology obsolescence, and embedding ethical principles and data privacy into project design. By the end of this program, you will be empowered with the knowledge and leadership mindset required to drive digital transformation projects from concept to successful implementation, ensuring they deliver lasting value to citizens and the nation.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Exercise Physiology - Intermediate
desc: Delve into the science of exercise physiology to understand its profound impact on athletic training and performance. This course is designed for aspiring coaches, physical education professionals, and athletes seeking a scientific foundation for their training regimens. You will begin by exploring the basic applications of exercise physiology in sports, understanding how the body adapts to physical stress. The curriculum systematically breaks down the components of physical fitness, distinguishing between health-related attributes like cardiorespiratory endurance and skill-related abilities such as power and coordination. A key focus is on practical performance assessment, with detailed modules on conducting and interpreting results from standardized tests like the Yo-Yo and Beep tests, including their relationship with VO2 max. By the end of this course, you will be able to apply physiological principles to develop more effective, evidence-based training programs and better evaluate athletic potential.

title: Exercise Physiology : Beginner
desc: This introductory course delves into the essential principles of exercise physiology, offering a comprehensive overview for beginners. The curriculum begins by distinguishing between anatomy and physiology and detailing the body's hierarchical organization, from atoms and molecules to complex systems like the cardiovascular and respiratory systems. You will gain a detailed understanding of cellular biology, including the roles of the cell membrane, nucleus, mitochondria as the 'powerhouse,' and other vital organelles. The course then progresses to explain the four primary types of animal tissues—epithelial, connective, muscular, and nervous—and their specialized functions. A significant portion is dedicated to exploring the various branches of physiology, culminating in a focused look at exercise physiology. Furthermore, learners will analyze the concept of homeostasis, understanding the positive and negative feedback mechanisms the body uses to regulate temperature, blood sugar, and other variables. Upon completion, you will have a solid scientific foundation for understanding the human body's response to exercise.

title: Exit and Withdrawal Norms under NPS
desc: This detailed module is designed to equip government subscribers with a thorough understanding of the exit and withdrawal regulations of the National Pension System (NPS). The course systematically breaks down the complexities of closing an NPS account under different circumstances, such as normal retirement on superannuation, premature exit from service, and unfortunate events like the subscriber's death or disappearance. Key learning areas include the calculation and allocation of accumulated pension wealth, the mandatory requirement for purchasing an annuity, and the rules for withdrawing the remaining amount as a lump sum. The course also clarifies the tax implications of these transactions. Furthermore, it covers the specific conditions and limits for making partial withdrawals from the NPS account during service for purposes like higher education, marriage, or medical emergencies. By the end of this course, learners will have a clear and actionable knowledge of their rights and options under the NPS, enabling effective long-term financial planning and ensuring a smooth transition during retirement or exit from service.

title: Expansion of MMS Services in DOP
desc: In an era of booming e-commerce and evolving logistical needs, the Department of Posts is significantly enhancing its operational backbone, the Mail Motor Service (MMS). This course details the strategic expansion of MMS, explaining why these changes are crucial for maintaining service relevance and efficiency. You will explore the core components of this transformation, including the establishment of the Road Transport Network (RTN) to reduce dependency on rail and air transport, and the functioning of Nodal Delivery Centers (NDCs) designed to expedite parcel delivery in urban areas. The curriculum also covers the role of MMS in providing specialized services such as bulk customer pickups and operating mobile post offices. Furthermore, the course highlights key technological advancements, from GPS tracking for real-time vehicle monitoring to the adoption of CNG vehicles and modern workshop equipment. Upon completion, you will have a clear understanding of how the Mail Motor Service is evolving into a more robust, technologically advanced, and integral part of India's postal network.

title: Explainable Agentic Artificial Intelligence
desc: This course introduces Explainable Agentic AI (XAAI), an emerging paradigm that combines the autonomy of agentic AI systems with the transparency of explainable AI. As AI systems increasingly make independent decisions, understanding how and why these decisions are made becomes critical for trust, safety, and accountability. The course explains how agentic AI systems operate through perception, reasoning, planning, and autonomous action, and highlights the importance of making these processes interpretable to humans. It introduces key explainability techniques such as feature attribution methods, SHAP, LIME, and counterfactual explanations, along with advanced approaches including knowledge graphs and symbolic reasoning.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Exploration Overview and Classification
desc: Embark on a detailed journey into the world of mineral exploration, the critical first step in the mining value chain. This course explains why exploration is essential and how it systematically progresses through various stages (from G4 to G1) to identify promising mineral deposits. You will learn about the primary techniques employed, including geological mapping, geophysical surveys, and geochemical sampling, and how the data from these methods are gathered and interpreted. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding the classification of mineral resources into Inferred, Indicated, and Measured categories, based on geological confidence. Furthermore, it covers the crucial criteria for converting these resources into economically viable Probable and Proven reserves. By analyzing real-world contexts, you will gain the ability to interpret exploration data, support resource evaluation, and understand the factors that drive feasibility studies, equipping you with a solid foundation in mineral exploration principles.

title: Exploring Costing Life Cycles
desc: Dive into the principles of Life Cycle Costing (LCC) and learn how to assess the long-term financial implications of any project or asset. This course moves beyond traditional accounting methods by providing a holistic view of all expenses incurred throughout an asset's entire lifespan. You will learn to identify and analyze costs across various phases, including the introduction, growth, maturity, and decline stages of a product's life. The curriculum covers the key characteristics and stages of LCC, from market research and design to manufacturing and product support. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to apply LCC techniques to optimize costs, enhance control over manufacturing expenses, and make strategic decisions that secure both immediate profitability and long-term sustainability. This knowledge is invaluable for anyone involved in financial planning, project management, and public procurement.

title: Exploring Development: The Idea and Its Aspects
desc: In an era of global integration and economic growth, understanding the fundamentals of development is crucial for effective governance. This course offers a deep dive into the core principles and perspectives of development, its processes, and its outcomes. It begins by defining development beyond mere economic metrics, encompassing social equity, environmental sustainability, and institutional strength. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear framework for analyzing the evolving roles of key development actors: the government (Sarkaar), the market (Bazaar), and civil society (Samaaj). Participants will explore how these three pillars interact to shape development trajectories and contribute to national goals. By connecting theoretical concepts to India's strategic objectives, such as becoming a world leader by its centenary, the course equips civil servants with the foundational knowledge needed to contribute meaningfully to the nation's transformative journey.

title: Export Clearance Procedures and Customs Compliance
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the export clearance process under Customs. It covers the legal framework governing exports, the key documents required for clearance, and the responsibilities and functions of Customs authorities. Participants will gain practical knowledge of the electronic filing process, the different types of shipping bills, and the norms and procedures for the examination of export goods. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to navigate export clearance procedures efficiently, ensuring compliance with regulations and smooth facilitation of international trade operations.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)
keywords: Export Clearance Procedures and Customs Compliance

title: Export Controls and Their Enforcement
desc: In an era of globalized trade, managing the export of strategic and dual-use goods is paramount to national and international security. This course offers an in-depth examination of India's robust export control system, designed to prevent the proliferation of Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) and their delivery systems. It provides a foundational understanding of why strategic trade management is critical and how India aligns with global non-proliferation efforts through various international regimes and treaties. The curriculum is structured to provide a holistic view, starting from the international legal frameworks and moving to India's specific legislative architecture, including the WMD Act, 2005, the Customs Act, 1962, and the Foreign Trade (Development & Regulation) Act, 1992. Learners will explore the intricacies of the SCOMET list, gaining practical knowledge in commodity identification across various sensitive categories such as nuclear materials, toxic chemicals, and aerospace technologies. Furthermore, the course details the operational aspects of enforcement, covering the role of Customs, risk management systems, profiling and targeting techniques, and inter-agency cooperation. Upon completion, officials will be equipped to effectively enforce export controls, identify suspicious consignments, understand complex licensing procedures, and contribute to safeguarding India's security while facilitating legitimate trade.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Extreme Poverty Identification Process (EPIP): Government of Kerala
desc: This case examines the Government of Kerala’s Extreme Poverty Identification Process (EPIP) - a multidimensional, decentralised, and community-driven effort to eliminate extreme poverty by identifying “invisible poor” households and developing customised micro-plans for their rehabilitation. The initiative relied on Local Self-Governments (LSGIs), Kudumbashree networks, technology-enabled surveys, and interdepartmental convergence. Over two years, the program lifted 62.78% of identified households out of extreme poverty while institutionalising participatory planning and integrated service delivery.

title: Eye Donation and Eye Banking
desc: This course aims to enhance awareness about eye donation and cornea transplantation among the non-medical population. It provides a basic understanding of the importance of eye donation, the process involved in eye banking, and the role of cornea transplantation in restoring vision. The course also addresses common myths and misconceptions related to eye donation while highlighting the facts and benefits associated with it. Participants will gain knowledge about donor eligibility, storage of retrieved corneas, and different types of corneal transplantation procedures.

title: Facilities for Commuters in Delhi Metro
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the facilities and amenities that define the commuting experience on the Delhi Metro. It examines how a modern Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) is designed and managed with a focus on passenger satisfaction and operational efficiency. The curriculum delves into the core principles of metro station design, including passenger flow, cleanliness, and customer care services. It highlights the importance of inclusive infrastructure, covering accessibility for differently-abled individuals and seamless last-mile connectivity through feeder buses and other transport modes. Furthermore, the course details the robust safety and security frameworks, from CCTV surveillance and fire suppression systems to advanced signaling and platform safety measures. It also covers technological integrations like automated fare collection, smart cards, mobile QR ticketing, and real-time information systems. Upon completion, learners will understand the multifaceted operations of a world-class metro system and be able to appreciate the planning required to deliver a superior public transit service.

title: Factors for Comparability Analysis
desc: This course is designed to equip tax professionals with the essential knowledge and skills to conduct effective comparability analysis in transfer pricing. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the legal provisions in the Income Tax Act, 1961, and associated rules governing the computation of the Arm’s Length Price (ALP). Learners will explore the entire comparability process, from understanding the taxpayer's business and identifying controlled transactions to the selection of the most appropriate method. Key learning areas include the five critical factors of comparability: characteristics of property or service, Functions Performed, Assets Employed, and Risks Assumed (FAR) analysis, contractual terms, economic circumstances, and business strategies. Through practical examples and case studies, participants will learn how to construct datasets, apply statistical tools like the range and median, and make necessary adjustments. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently analyze and determine the ALP for complex cross-border transactions, ensuring adherence to national and international tax standards.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Factory Acceptance Testing of Stationary Kavach System
desc: This course provides a structured and practical understanding of the Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) for the Kavach system, which serves as the final quality assurance stage before equipment is dispatched for field installation. The course explains how various Kavach components are tested in a controlled factory environment to ensure reliable performance under simulated real-world railway operating conditions. Learners are introduced to the objectives, scope, and methodology of FAT, including safety compliance, system integration checks, and functional validation. The course highlights the critical role of FAT in early defect detection, risk mitigation, and ensuring system reliability prior to field commissioning. Organized into two focused units, the course explains what is tested, how it is tested, and why FAT is essential for ensuring the safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance of the Kavach system before deployment.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: Faculty Development Programme
desc: This course offers a deep dive into the principles of effective teaching and course design, tailored for government officers transitioning into faculty roles. It addresses the critical need for high-quality internal training by empowering subject matter experts to share their knowledge systematically and engagingly. The program moves beyond traditional instruction, focusing on a learner-centric approach suited for experienced adult professionals. Key learning areas include understanding the psychology of adult learners (andragogy), defining clear learning outcomes, and structuring a coherent course outline. Participants will gain hands-on experience in developing their own case studies, leveraging digital classroom technologies like Mentimeter and Qualtrics, and even using AI to create instructional content. Furthermore, the course covers methods for assessing training effectiveness and impact evaluation, ensuring that the learning delivered translates into measurable improvements in capacity and performance across government functions. By the end of this program, learners will be prepared to design, deliver, and evaluate high-impact training that builds a more skilled and capable civil service.

title: Faecal Sludge Management
desc: This foundational course on Faecal Sludge Management (FSM) offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices required for effective sanitation service delivery. As India progresses towards comprehensive sanitation coverage under the Swachh Bharat Mission, the need for safe and sustainable management of faecal sludge has become paramount. This program is structured to build the capacity of officials and practitioners to address this challenge head-on, moving beyond just toilet construction to the entire sanitation value chain. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the technical, social, and financial aspects of FSM. The course covers key topics such as the characterization of faecal sludge, appropriate containment technologies, methods for safe emptying and transportation, and a range of treatment options from simple, low-cost solutions to more advanced mechanical systems. It also examines the policy and institutional frameworks necessary for successful FSM implementation, including business models for service delivery and strategies for community engagement. By the end of this course, participants will be able to analyze local sanitation challenges, identify suitable FSM solutions, and contribute to the development of city-wide or regional sanitation plans. The knowledge gained will empower them to improve public health outcomes, protect water resources, and promote a circular economy through the safe reuse of treated sludge.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Fair Compensation and Land Acquisition Act 2013
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013, a landmark legislation that reformed India's approach to land acquisition. Designed for government officials, legal professionals, and development practitioners, the program details the critical shift from the outdated 1894 Act to a more equitable and transparent system. The curriculum is structured across five modules, covering the entire lifecycle of land acquisition. Key learning areas include the mandatory Social Impact Assessment (SIA) process, the step-by-step procedures for acquisition from notification to award, and the detailed methodology for calculating fair compensation, including market value and solatium. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the comprehensive Rehabilitation and Resettlement (R&R) entitlements for affected families, special safeguards for vulnerable communities and agricultural land, and the institutional framework for monitoring and grievance redressal. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to implement the Act's provisions, ensuring that development projects are balanced with social justice and the welfare of affected citizens.

title: Family Pension under NPS
desc: This course is designed to educate central government employees on the critical aspects of family pension and nomination as per the latest regulations. It delves into the specifics of Rule 10 of the CCS (Implementation of NPS) Rules, 2021, which was introduced to provide a safety net for the families of government servants who pass away early in their service. Learners will explore the two distinct choices available for family pension: opting for benefits under the traditional old pension scheme or receiving the accumulated corpus from the NPS account. The course clarifies the default provisions that apply if an employee does not make an explicit choice, highlighting the 15-year service threshold. Furthermore, it provides a step-by-step guide on the nomination process, including how to make a valid nomination, the legal definition of 'family' for both male and female subscribers, and the procedure for updating nominations after marriage. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped to understand their entitlements and make crucial financial decisions to secure their family's future.

title: Farming Systems Approach (FSA) - English
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the Farming Systems Approach (FSA), a critical strategy for modernizing Indian agriculture. It addresses the pressing need for vertical agricultural expansion due to shrinking land availability and a growing population. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of FSA, presenting it as an integrated system fatores that combines soil, water, crops, livestock, and other farm resources to maximize productivity and net income on a sustainable basis. Key learning areas include the analysis of existing farming systems, the principles of enterprise diversification, and the development of economically viable models tailored to different agro-ecological situations. Learners will explore how FSA helps mitigate risks from climate change, improves soil health, and ensures year-round income flow. The course also outlines the extension strategies required to promote FSA, emphasizing the importance of farmer participation, market linkages, and the continuous refinement of technology to build resilient and prosperous farm households.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: Field Identification of Important Timbers of India
desc: India is home to more than 1600 timber-producing wood species, and no two wood species are identical in their anatomical structure, much like human fingerprints. Before timber is used for any specific application, proper identification is essential to ensure its optimal utilization and performance. In the absence of external features such as bark, leaves, flowers, or fruits, timber identification is carried out through the study of internal or anatomical structures. These microscopic characteristics play a vital role in determining the species as well as the properties of wood. This course covers the identification of selected hardwoods and softwoods based on features such as pore arrangement, parenchyma type and pattern, ray visibility, presence of gum ducts, transition from earlywood to latewood, and presence of resin canals. Timber identification also has important applications in dendrochronology, dendroclimatology, paper and pulp industries, and in preventing illegal timber trade.
org: Institute of Wood Science and Technology- Bengaluru

title: FIELD IDENTIFICATION OF IMPORTANT TIMBERS OF INDIA
desc: This comprehensive course provides an in-depth exploration of timber identification, a specialized discipline within wood science and technology. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of plant and wood classification, distinguishing between hardwoods (angiosperms) and softwoods (gymnosperms). The curriculum then delves into the critical anatomical features used for identification, covering both gross structures visible to the naked eye or a hand lens—such as bark, sapwood, heartwood, and growth rings—and minute structures like pores, parenchyma, and rays that require closer examination. The course highlights the practical importance of accurate identification in various fields, including forestry, trade, and forensic science, to prevent the adulteration of valuable timbers like Teak and Rosewood with lower-grade substitutes. Through detailed descriptions and comparisons of commercially important Indian timbers such as Sal, Gurjan, Deodar, and Chir, learners will develop the practical skills needed to analyze wood characteristics and confidently determine a timber's species in a field setting. This knowledge is essential for ensuring the efficient and economical application of wood resources.
org: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education

title: File management in AutoCAD
desc: Maintaining the health of your drawing files is crucial for any AutoCAD professional. This course offers a comprehensive guide to essential file management and maintenance tasks that ensure project stability and optimal software performance. You will delve into the practical application of AutoCAD's built-in utilities designed to prevent data loss and corruption. The course systematically covers the 'Purge' command to remove redundant data like unused blocks and layers, significantly reducing file size. You will learn to use the 'Audit' command to diagnose and fix errors within a drawing, preserving its integrity. Furthermore, the course provides detailed instructions on the 'Recover' and 'RecoverAll' commands to salvage corrupted files and their external references, a vital skill for any user. You will also explore the Drawing Recovery Manager and learn to implement effective backup strategies. Upon completion, you will be equipped to manage your AutoCAD files proactively, leading to a more streamlined, secure, and efficient design process.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Filing of APAR and AIPR through SPARROW
desc: This course is designed to provide government officials with a detailed understanding of the procedures for filing Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APAR) and Annual Immovable Property Returns (AIPR) through the SPARROW portal. The Annual Performance Appraisal Report is a critical tool for evaluating an officer's performance, identifying potential, and forming the basis for career advancement. Similarly, the Annual Immovable Property Return is a mandatory declaration under the Conduct Rules, essential for maintaining transparency and integrity in public service. This program will systematically guide learners through the objectives and functionalities of the SPARROW (Smart Performance Appraisal Report Recording Online Window) platform. Participants will learn the step-by-step process for submitting both APAR and AIPR electronically, ensuring compliance with government regulations. Upon completion, officials will be proficient in using the SPARROW portal, understand the significance of these reports, and be able to manage their official filings accurately and on time, contributing to a more efficient and accountable administrative system.

title: Finance and Accounts
desc: Understanding the principles of finance and accounting is crucial for maintaining transparency, accountability, and efficiency in public administration. This course offers a comprehensive overview of financial management tailored for the government context. It begins by differentiating between finance and accounting, focusing on their application in governmental affairs. Learners will delve into the intricacies of the government budget, understanding how it reflects national priorities and manages anticipated income against expenses. The course thoroughly examines the standards of financial propriety that every government official must adhere to when handling expenditure and payments. Furthermore, it illuminates the critical role of audit in ensuring operational integrity and accountability. Participants will also gain practical knowledge of the various methods for procuring goods and services as per government regulations, and will become familiar with the eligibility criteria and rules for travel allowances. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to handle financial matters in their official capacity, contributing to sound financial governance.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Finance for Non-finance professionals (FNFP)
desc: This foundational course is designed to demystify the world of finance for non-finance professionals. It begins by establishing accounting as the language of business, breaking down core terminology and principles in a simple, accessible manner. Participants will learn about the primary types of business structures—manufacturing, merchandising, and service—and the two fundamental methods of financing: debt and equity. The curriculum then dives deep into the core components of financial reporting. You will master the basic accounting equation (Assets = Liabilities + Owner's Equity) and understand its significance. The course provides a detailed walkthrough of the three main financial statements: the Balance Sheet, which presents a snapshot of financial position; the Income Statement, which details profitability over a period; and the Statement of Cash Flows, which tracks cash movements. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to analyze a company's financial health using key liquidity and solvency ratios, enabling you to contribute more effectively to financial discussions and strategic decision-making within your organization.

title: Finance: Learning Beyond the Basics for Directors
desc: Designed for board members and senior leaders, this course delves into the nuanced responsibilities of financial stewardship at the director level. It addresses the critical need for directors to possess more than a superficial understanding of their company's finances. The course begins by examining the Pyramid Saimira case, where directors faced penalties not for fraud, but for failing to act on clear warning signs. Key learning areas include practical red flag analysis, such as identifying discrepancies between reported profits and actual cash flows, scrutinizing rapid asset growth, and understanding the risks associated with related-party transactions. Participants will learn how to interpret different types of audit opinions and engage with auditors as a crucial part of the governance process. Ultimately, this module equips directors with the skills to ask prudent, judgment-based questions, thereby strengthening financial governance, ensuring accountability, and mitigating personal legal risks.

title: Financial Administration
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the financial administration framework in the Government of India. It establishes the context by explaining the historical evolution of government financial management and the critical need for transparency and accountability in public spending. Key learning areas include the principles of budgeting, mechanisms for expenditure control, government accounting procedures, and the auditing process. The curriculum delves into the specific roles and responsibilities of authorities like Financial Advisers and Chief Controllers of Accounts, and details the functioning of the Integrated Financial Adviser (IFA) scheme. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with practical knowledge to navigate government financial systems, manage reporting requirements, and apply best practices for sound financial management, thereby contributing to more effective public service delivery.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Financial Analysis and Regulatory Practices
desc: This course focuses on financial analysis, risk management, and regulatory practices essential for effective corporate governance. Participants will explore working capital strategies, business valuation techniques, and hedging mechanisms to mitigate financial risks. The course also covers international corporate finance, management of intangible assets, and welfare-oriented investments through the Social Stock Exchange. Special emphasis is placed on compliance with corporate accounting standards for PSUs and interpreting financial statements to support strategic decision-making. Designed for finance professionals, this course blends theory with practical applications, equipping learners to navigate complex financial environments, ensure regulatory adherence, and optimize corporate performance in a globalized economy.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Financial and Debt Markets in India
desc: In the dynamic landscape of the Indian economy, a thorough understanding of financial markets is essential for effective decision-making. This course is designed to equip financial professionals, corporate decision-makers, and individuals with the critical knowledge to navigate India's complex financial system. The curriculum begins by introducing the various types of financial products available, explaining how to align them with specific organizational or individual financial objectives. It then provides a detailed examination of the Indian capital markets, covering the activities and key instruments such as stocks, bonds, and mutual funds, and their contribution to the economy. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Indian Government Securities (G-Sec) market, exploring its mechanisms, its importance for government borrowing, and its function as a safe investment avenue. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to analyze market components and utilize financial products effectively to achieve their strategic financial goals.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Financial Awareness and Management in the Public Sector
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to finance, budgeting, costing, taxation, and project evaluation, with a practical focus for both finance and non-finance professionals. It demonstrates how effective financial management underpins planning, accountability, transparency, and the efficient use of resources—especially within public sector organizations. Participants will learn the financial cycle, key concepts, financial statements, and performance ratios, alongside budgeting processes and cost-control methods. The course also covers project evaluation techniques, including Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and payback period, as well as public financial management practices, taxation, and advanced costing tools. Overall, the course builds financial awareness, enabling employees to make informed decisions that enhance organizational sustainability and performance.

title: Financial Effects of Penalties
desc: This course delves into the critical subject of penalties within the framework of Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965. When disciplinary procedures conclude with a finding of guilt, the imposition of a penalty becomes necessary. This module specifically focuses on the five minor penalties, offering a comprehensive analysis of their financial consequences for a government employee. The course addresses prevalent ambiguities in the interpretation of the rules, particularly the distinction between penalties with 'cumulative' and 'non-cumulative' effects, which often leads to incorrect implementation. Learners will explore the nuances of each minor penalty, understand how they are calculated, and see their direct impact on pay and allowances. By the end of this course, officials responsible for establishment and vigilance matters will be equipped to apply these rules accurately, ensuring fairness and procedural correctness in disciplinary administration.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Financial Inclusion for Viksit Bharat 2047
desc: Delve into the strategic framework of Viksit Bharat 2047 and understand India's ambitious journey towards becoming a developed economy. This course explores the core pillars shaping this transformation, including policies to attract foreign direct investment (FDI) and the strengthening of key financial institutions. You will learn about the pivotal role of the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) and GIFT IFSC in fostering financial innovation and integrating India with global capital markets. The discussion also covers the significant opportunities this vision creates for MSMEs, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and private enterprises. Furthermore, it examines strategies to engage the NRI/PIO diaspora for investment, position GIFT IFSC as a global asset management hub, and enhance human capital through world-class education. Upon completion, you will have a comprehensive understanding of the multifaceted economic strategies driving India's long-term growth and development.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Financial Insights:Trading,Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet
desc: This foundational course, ""Understanding Financial Statements: Trading, Profit & Loss, and Balance Sheet,"" is designed to demystify the language of business and finance for public sector professionals. In today's governance landscape, a clear understanding of financial health is crucial for accountability and effective decision-making. This course provides the essential knowledge to read and interpret key financial reports.The curriculum systematically breaks down the three primary financial statements. You will learn how the Trading Account is prepared to determine gross profit or loss by matching revenues with direct costs. Subsequently, the course delves into the Profit and Loss Account, explaining how it incorporates all indirect expenses to reveal the net profit or loss of an entity. Finally, you will master the components of the Balance Sheet, understanding how it presents a snapshot of an organization's assets, liabilities, and equity at a specific point in time. Through practical examples and clear explanations, this course will empower you to analyze financial data, understand an organization's performance, and contribute to sound financial management.

title: Financial Instruments and Models in the Renewable Energy Sector
desc: In today's rapidly evolving energy landscape, a strong grasp of financial models and instruments is critical for advancing renewable energy projects. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the financial concepts and practices that underpin investments in solar, wind, hydro, and bioenergy. It addresses the key drivers and barriers in the renewable energy market, providing a solid foundation in sector-specific finance. Key learning areas include a detailed study of financial instruments such as debt, equity, and tax credits; project financing techniques and deal structuring; and valuation models for assessing project viability. The course also delves into risk management strategies tailored to the unique challenges of the renewable sector, including regulatory and market dynamics. Furthermore, it explores the growing field of sustainable and impact investing, with a focus on green bonds and other green financing mechanisms.

title: Financial Instruments and Models in the Renewable Energy Sector
desc: In today's rapidly evolving energy landscape, a strong grasp of financial models and instruments is critical for advancing renewable energy projects. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the financial concepts and practices that underpin investments in solar, wind, hydro, and bioenergy. It addresses the key drivers and barriers in the renewable energy market, providing a solid foundation in sector-specific finance. Key learning areas include a detailed study of financial instruments such as debt, equity, and tax credits; project financing techniques and deal structuring; and valuation models for assessing project viability. The course also delves into risk management strategies tailored to the unique challenges of the renewable sector, including regulatory and market dynamics. Furthermore, it explores the growing field of sustainable and impact investing, with a focus on green bonds and other green financing mechanisms. Upon completion, learners will possess the practical skills to analyze renewable energy ventures from a financial perspective, make informed investment decisions, and effectively contribute to the financing and management of sustainable energy initiatives.

title: Financial Management in CSIR
desc: This module is designed to provide a foundational understanding of financial management as it applies to the unique operational context of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR). The course addresses the critical importance of sound financial practices in managing public funds and achieving research objectives. Participants will delve into the core components of financial administration, starting with the basics of budgeting and accounting systems specific to CSIR. The curriculum walks learners through the entire project finance cycle, from identifying sources of funds and detailing expenditure components to preparing and submitting a well-structured project proposal. Key learning areas include the formal process for project appraisal and approval, techniques for effective project monitoring and control, and the procedures for project audits and financial reporting. Upon completion, learners will be able to navigate the financial procedures of CSIR with confidence, contributing to better resource management, enhanced accountability, and the successful implementation of scientific projects.

title: Financial Risks And The Fraud Triangle in Forensic Accounting
desc: In the specialized environment of defence finance, identifying and mitigating financial risks is paramount. This course delves into the unique challenges faced in this sector, from geopolitical instability to supply chain disruptions and cybersecurity threats. It establishes a clear distinction between traditional auditing and the investigative approach of forensic accounting. A central focus is the Fraud Triangle, a critical framework that helps professionals understand the pressures, opportunities, and rationalizations that can lead to fraudulent activities. The course also explores the concept of the 'accidental fraudster' and how systemic vulnerabilities can inadvertently enable financial irregularities. Participants will learn to assess weaknesses in key areas such as contract management and cybersecurity. Ultimately, this course equips learners with the analytical tools and forensic techniques necessary to detect, prevent, and address financial misconduct, thereby safeguarding the integrity of defence financial systems.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Financing Climate Action
desc: In an era defined by the urgent need for climate action, understanding the financial mechanisms that support this transition is paramount. This course delves into the multifaceted world of climate finance, providing a foundational understanding of its importance, evolution, and current landscape. Learners will explore the distinction between mitigation and adaptation finance, analyze the flow of funds from public and private sources, and examine the roles of key international bodies like the UNFCCC, GCF, and the World Bank, as well as India's national policy framework, including the role of the RBI and SEBI. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the dual nature of climate risk—physical risks from extreme weather and transition risks from shifting to a low-carbon economy. Participants will learn to identify these risks and evaluate strategies to enhance the resilience of financial institutions. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of climate finance and contribute to building a sustainable and climate-resilient economic future.

title: FinTech in India: Growth Story and Regulatory Framework
desc: Dive into the transformative world of financial technology with this detailed course on India's FinTech revolution. The program begins by tracing the evolution of FinTech, contextualized by national initiatives like the Jan Dhan Yojana, Aadhaar, and UPI (JAM Trinity) that created a fertile ground for digital financial services. You will explore the primary segments driving this change, including digital payments, peer-to-peer lending, InsurTech, and WealthTech, understanding their impact on economic efficiency and inclusion. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the regulatory environment, covering the functions of key regulators (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI) and essential legislation like the Payment and Settlement Systems Act. It also covers modern regulatory tools such as sandboxes and e-PRAVAAH. By analyzing the challenges of data privacy, cybersecurity, and credit risk, learners will gain a balanced perspective on how to foster innovation while safeguarding consumer interests and financial stability.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Fire in Train
desc: This course is designed to equip railway personnel with the essential knowledge and skills to manage fire emergencies effectively. Given the significant risks that fires pose to passenger safety, railway assets, and operational continuity, a structured understanding of response protocols is critical. The curriculum delves into the classification of fires, identification of potential hazards across different train components like passenger coaches and electric engines, and the principles of fire safety in a railway environment. Participants will learn step-by-step procedures for fire detection, containment, and extinguishment. The course emphasizes the practical application of these skills, covering special scenarios such as fires involving traction electrical equipment. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to implement swift isolation techniques, utilize firefighting equipment correctly, and maintain clear communication channels, ultimately contributing to a safer railway network for everyone.

title: Fire prevention and detection
desc: This comprehensive course offers foundational training in fire prevention and safety, a critical skill for ensuring security in both professional and personal environments. The program begins by establishing the context of fire safety, explaining why it is not a natural disaster but a preventable event. Key learning areas include a thorough examination of the common causes of fire, such as electrical faults and improper storage of flammable materials, and the science behind the fire triangle (heat, fuel, oxygen). Participants will learn to classify fires into different categories (Class A, B, C, D) and understand which extinguishing agents are effective for each. The course details the functionality of modern fire detection technologies, including smoke detectors and alarm systems, and provides practical, step-by-step instructions on how to select and operate various fire extinguishers. Upon completion, learners will be capable of implementing preventative measures, assessing fire risks, and responding confidently and correctly during a fire emergency, thereby enhancing workplace and community safety.

title: Fire Safety and Fire Extinguisher Management
desc: This course equips learners with the knowledge and skills to understand fire hazards and respond safely and effectively during fire emergencies. It covers the science of fire, including the fire triangle, stages of fire development, and fire classification under Indian Standards. Learners explore portable fire extinguishers, their components, operating principles, extinguishing agents, colour coding, ratings, capacities, and applications. The course also introduces fixed fire suppression systems and their use in specialised environments. A key focus is selecting the appropriate extinguisher based on fire type, workplace hazards, building characteristics, and electrical risks. Learners also gain practical guidance on the safe operation, inspection, accessibility, and maintenance of fire extinguishers to ensure they remain ready for use during emergencies.

title: Fire Safety in Healthcare Facilities
desc: Healthcare facilities present unique and complex challenges for fire safety due to the presence of vulnerable patients, high-value equipment, and combustible materials. This course is designed to equip healthcare professionals, administrators, and support staff with the critical knowledge and skills to manage these risks effectively. The curriculum delves into the fundamental causes of hospital fires, different fire classifications, and the proper use of fire suppression equipment like extinguishers and alarm systems. A significant focus is placed on proactive and reactive strategies, including the development and implementation of robust fire safety and evacuation plans, with special attention to patient prioritization and movement challenges. The course also covers the importance of regulatory compliance with codes like the National Building Code (NBC) 2016 and the necessity of conducting regular mock drills to test and refine emergency procedures. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to lead fire safety initiatives, mitigate risks, and foster a resilient safety culture within their facilities.
org: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

title: First Aid in Indian Railways
desc: This foundational course provides Indian Railways personnel with the critical competencies needed to act as effective first responders in a variety of emergency situations. The curriculum is tailored specifically to the railway environment, addressing the unique challenges faced on platforms, moving trains, and in operational yards. Learners will begin by understanding the golden rules of first aid, the basics of human anatomy, and how to properly assess an emergency scene. The course then delves into practical, step-by-step guidance for managing common medical issues, including severe bleeding, burns, fractures, electric shocks, and heat exhaustion. It also covers life-saving techniques such as CPR and the recovery position. Furthermore, the program emphasizes emergency preparedness, detailing the contents and proper use of a standard railway first aid kit and the importance of knowing emergency contacts.
