The curriculum begins by outlining a progressive, age-appropriate structure for students from pre-nursery to Class 12, emphasizing the development of fundamental motor skills, physical literacy, and a lifelong passion for active lifestyles. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the role of yoga in sports. You will learn how yogic practices can improve mental focus, flexibility, and energy conservation for athletes, as well as how specific asanas and pranayama techniques can be used as effective tools for post-exercise recovery. The course also highlights the medicinal value of regular exercise in preventing chronic diseases and promoting mental health. Furthermore, it provides practical guidance on fostering creativity within physical education and systematically planning, implementing, and evaluating school sports events to ensure they are engaging and impactful for all students.

title: Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules (FRSR) Part-III- Leave Rules
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to build proficiency in the Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules (FRSR) Part-III, which governs the leave entitlements for Central Government employees. Understanding these rules is essential for proper human resource management and for employees to be aware of their rights and duties. The course delves into the specifics of numerous leave types, such as Earned Leave, Half Pay Leave, Commuted Leave, Leave Not Due, and Extraordinary Leave. It also provides detailed guidance on special provisions, including Maternity, Paternity, and Child Care Leave, as well as Study Leave and other miscellaneous categories. Through twelve detailed modules, learners will explore factsheets, case studies, and key questions to master the application of these rules in various service-related scenarios. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply leave rules, ensuring compliance and effective administration within their departments.

title: Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules Chungchang Sawi Hawnna
desc: India rama Sorkar hnathawkte service dinhmun leh kalhmang khuahkhirhtu innghahna pui ber chu Fundamental Rules leh Supplementary Rules (FR & SR) te hi an ni. Hengte hian hlawh, hlawh pun (increment), chawlh (leave), deputation, hna atanga chawlhtir lailawk (suspension), hna atanga chawlh kumhlun (retirement) leh service kaihhnawih thil dang chungchang dante a keng tel a ni. Sorkar department hrang hranga hnathawktute inrelbawlna (personnel administration) kawngah thil kalpui dan inangtlang (uniformity), rorelna langtlang (transparency) leh mawhphurhna fel tak (accountability) a awm theih nan FR & SR hi hman a ni. He dan hian service record vawn that dan te, hlawh bituk (fixation of pay) dan te, leh service atanga hamthatna hrang hrang awm theite khuahkhirhna kalhmang a ruahman bawk a ni. Hnathawktute (human resource) hlawhtling taka inrelbawl nan leh Sorkar service dan (regulations) tha taka zawm a nih theih nan FR & SR hriatchian hi thil pawimawh tak a ni
org: Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department Mizoram

title: Fundamentals of Accident Enquiry in Railways
desc: The course provides an overview of railway accident enquiry procedures and the institutional framework involved in investigating train accidents. It explains the roles and responsibilities of key stakeholders, including the Commissioner of Railway Safety (CRS), Divisional Railway Manager (DRM), other railway officers, supervisors, and enquiry committees. The course covers essential aspects such as classification and causes of railway accidents, relief and passenger safety measures, and the legal framework under the Railway and Commission of Enquiry Act, 1952. It also introduces documentation standards, reporting requirements, and the process of preparing enquiry reports to ensure systematic and transparent investigations.

title: Fundamentals of Brick Masonry
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the essential principles and practical applications of brick masonry. It is designed for those seeking to build a strong foundation in construction techniques. The program begins by covering the critical preparatory stages, including surface preparation, scaffolding, and accurate measurement to ensure structural integrity. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to mastering different bonding patterns, with a special focus on the widely-used English bond for its strength and stability. Participants will also learn about the importance of proper jointing and curing to achieve long-lasting results. The curriculum extends to more advanced and aesthetic applications, such as creating exposed brickwork for decorative finishes and constructing various types of arches, including gauged, circular, and flat designs. Learners will understand the use of centering and shuttering in arch construction and how to add ornamental features like mouldings and cornices. Furthermore, the course addresses the practical challenge of seamlessly joining new brickwork with existing structures, a vital skill in renovation and extension projects. Upon completion, learners will possess a well-rounded grasp of both the structural and decorative aspects of brick masonry.

title: Fundamentals of Change Management
desc: In today's dynamic environment, the ability to manage change is a fundamental leadership skill. This course, 'Fundamentals of Organizational Change Management,' is designed to equip public sector professionals with the knowledge and tools to effectively lead transformations. The program delves into why change management is crucial, exploring its key processes, different dimensions, and various sources, from structural shifts to strategic reinventions. Participants will learn to identify and analyze different types of change, such as structural, process, and cultural, and understand the internal and external triggers that necessitate them. A significant focus is placed on the practical aspects of implementation, including the six-step change process, developing a shared vision, and overcoming common barriers like resistance and fear. Through concepts illustrated by real-world examples, such as the cautionary tale of Kodak, learners will understand the importance of adaptability and proactive leadership. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to not only manage change but to champion it, fostering a collaborative and motivated environment ready for future challenges.

title: Fundamentals of Cloud Computing and Cloud Services
desc: This skill-oriented course is designed to provide participants with foundational knowledge and practical skills in cloud computing technologies and services. The course offers a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing concepts, architectures, deployment models, and service strategies, with a strong emphasis on real-world applications and implementation. Participants will learn how cloud computing and virtualization technologies can be integrated to optimize organizational IT resources, improve operational efficiency, and support scalable digital infrastructure. The course covers the setup, management, and maintenance of cloud-based environments and introduces learners to key cloud service models, including SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS. In addition, the course focuses on designing and deploying scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud solutions tailored to business and organizational requirements.
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Fundamentals of Cloud Computing with Amazon Web Services
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Cloud Computing, covering fundamental concepts, service models, deployment models, and core infrastructure components such as compute, storage, networking, and security. It offers practical exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help learners understand real-world cloud implementation. The course builds a strong foundation in cloud architecture, scalability, high availability, and security best practices. Participants will gain hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing cloud-based solutions using AWS services. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to build secure, scalable, and resilient applications in a cloud environment.
keywords: Cloud Deployment Models (Public, Private, Hybrid, Community)

title: Fundamentals of Computer Systems and Internet Technologies
desc: In an era driven by information technology, a strong grasp of computer and internet fundamentals is essential for every public servant. This course is designed to build that foundational knowledge from the ground up. It begins by defining basic concepts like data and information, then traces the historical evolution of computing through its five distinct generations. Learners will gain a clear understanding of a computer's anatomy, covering both the physical hardware components—such as the CPU, memory, and storage—and the software that brings them to life, including system and application software. The course delves into the crucial role of operating systems, with a special focus on their functions like process management, memory allocation, and file organization, using examples from Windows and Ubuntu. Finally, it expands to the global network, explaining the structure of the internet, computer networks (LAN, WAN), key protocols like TCP/IP, and how to navigate the World Wide Web using browsers and search engines. Upon completion, learners will possess the essential vocabulary and conceptual framework to confidently use digital tools and technologies in their daily work.
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Fundamentals of Contract Management
desc: This course introduces the fundamentals of contract management and administration, explaining how agreements between parties create legally enforceable obligations. It emphasizes that a contract establishes a set of rights and duties, and in case of a breach, the aggrieved party may seek damages or specific performance. The course covers how agreements become legally enforceable under the Indian Contract Act and highlights their importance in business activities and economic development.

title: Fundamentals of Crowd Management
desc: Crowd management is a critical responsibility of public service, as it directly affects citizen safety, public order, and trust in governance. Government officials frequently encounter crowd situations during festivals, public events, transport operations, protests, emergencies, and disaster responses. When such situations are not managed effectively, they can escalate rapidly, leading to panic, injuries, or even loss of life. This course is designed to provide government officials with a foundational and practical understanding of crowd management, with a focus on prevention, preparedness, and humane response. It helps learners understand how crowds behave differently from individuals, while also highlighting the psychological and physical risks involved. The course further emphasises the importance of proper planning, coordination, communication, and ethical conduct in managing crowd situations.

title: Fundamentals of Crowd Safety and Risk Management
desc: Crowds are a routine part of public life, from festivals and religious gatherings to transport hubs and service delivery points. Ensuring their safety is a vital responsibility of government officials. This course provides a systematic, prevention‑focused approach to crowd management, showing how risks develop gradually when conditions go unmanaged and how early identification, structured assessment, and effective planning can prevent incidents before they escalate. Through concise, practice‑oriented modules, learners will understand the difference between crowd presence and crowd risk, recognise early warning signs, categorise risks, and apply practical tools to assess and plan effectively. The course emphasises anticipation over reaction, planning over emergency response, and people‑centred governance over force‑based control, enabling safer and more dignified public participation.

title: Fundamentals of Cybersecurity
desc: In an increasingly digital world, securing information and systems is paramount for the effective functioning of public services. This course, 'Fundamentals of Cybersecurity,' offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential concepts that underpin digital security. It begins by defining cybersecurity and outlining the current threat landscape, helping learners understand the various actors and motivations behind cyberattacks. The curriculum delves into specific types of attacks and discusses proactive cyber safety practices to mitigate risks for individuals and organizations. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring and comparing two critical security paradigms: the traditional perimeter-based model and the modern, more resilient zero trust security model. Upon completion, participants will have a robust conceptual framework to better understand cybersecurity risks, appreciate the evolution of security strategies, and contribute more effectively to creating a secure digital ecosystem within their organizations. This foundational knowledge is crucial for any public official operating in a technology-driven environment.

title: Fundamentals of Defence Procurement and Policy Principles
desc: This course provides a comprehensive foundation in defence revenue procurement, covering policies, principles, processes, and operational practices. It introduces learners to the structure and applicability of DPM 2025, legal frameworks, and stakeholder roles, followed by detailed understanding of procurement principles such as transparency, fairness, competition, economy, and accountability. The course further explores sourcing strategies, vendor evaluation, quality assurance, procurement lifecycle stages, and tendering and contract management. Through structured workflows and practical insights, learners develop the capability to execute procurement processes efficiently, ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks, and support defence readiness through effective and ethical procurement practices.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Fundamentals of Energy Modelling
desc: This course offers a deep dive into the principles and practices of energy modelling, designed for professionals involved in policy, planning, and economic analysis. The curriculum is structured across eight modules, beginning with the significance of energy resource quality, including concepts like energy density, power density, and Energy Return on Energy Investment (EROI). Learners will then master energy accounting frameworks, understanding how to balance supply and demand in a manner similar to financial accounting. The course progresses to advanced topics in energy demand forecasting, contrasting descriptive indicators with detailed factor analysis and econometric modelling, including regression, panel data, and input-output models based on the Leontief matrix. A dedicated module addresses how to model the environmental impacts of energy systems, such as greenhouse gas and particulate emissions. Finally, participants will be introduced to the Long-term Energy Alternative Planning (LEAP) system, a powerful software tool for creating and analyzing integrated energy scenarios, providing a practical foundation for real-world application.

title: Fundamentals of Engineering Scale Plan for Railway Projects
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Engineering Scale Plan (ESP), including its structure, components, and practical applications in railway engineering. It covers essential aspects such as basic plan details, line capacity, and platform specifications. The course also explains the application of specific conditions in projects involving new lines, doubling, and gauge conversion (GC). In addition, learners are introduced to miscellaneous and conventional symbols used in ESP, enabling accurate interpretation and effective application of engineering drawings in real-world project scenarios.

title: Fundamentals of Enterprise Risk Management
desc: This course on Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) aims to impart the knowledge and skills required to manage risk within the organisation. The risk needs to be identified, assessed, monitored, and communicated effectively to achieve the desired objectives. The course explores the role of ERM in strengthening governance, enhancing accountability, improving decision-making, and building organisational resilience. It introduces participants to internationally recognised frameworks such as ISO 31000, Risk Maturity Models, COSO, and COBIT. The course presents examples from real-world scenarios. Further, participants will study emerging trends such as AI-driven risk analytics and technology-enabled risk monitoring. By the end of the course, participants will be able to evaluate organisational risks, develop strategies to mitigate them, and contribute towards effective governance by improving accountability and responsiveness.

title: Fundamentals of Fire Theory and Firefighting
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential principles of fire safety and emergency response. It begins by establishing the context of fire theory, explaining why a scientific understanding of combustion, heat transfer, and fire behavior is critical for anyone involved in safety and emergency services. Participants will delve into key learning areas, including the fire tetrahedron, different classes of fires (A, B, C, D, K), and the processes of conduction, convection, and radiation. The course details how to analyze a fire situation and choose the appropriate extinguishing method, whether it be cooling, smothering, starvation, or chemical inhibition. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply this knowledge to real-world scenarios, confidently selecting and using firefighting equipment to control and extinguish fires, thereby minimizing damage and protecting lives and property. This training is fundamental for building a solid foundation in professional firefighting and workplace safety.
org: Yantra Institute of Technology and Management

title: Fundamentals of Gemmology
desc: Embark on a scientific journey into the world of gemstones with this fundamental course. Designed for beginners, this program lays the groundwork for understanding the core principles of gemmology. You will learn to define and classify various gemstones, from precious stones like diamonds, rubies, and emeralds to a wide array of semi-precious gems. The course delves into the critical physical and optical properties, such as specific gravity, refractive index, color, and luster, which are used for identification. You will explore the techniques of gem testing, learning to differentiate between natural, synthetic, and treated stones. Furthermore, the course provides an overview of lapidary, the craft of cutting and polishing gems, explaining how different cuts like brilliant, step, and cabochon are used to enhance a stone's beauty. By the end of this course, you will have the foundational knowledge required for more advanced studies in gemmology and mineralogy, making it ideal for aspiring geologists, gemologists, and professionals in the mining and jewelry sectors.

title: Fundamentals of Generative Artificial Intelligence
desc: Dive into the essential components of generative AI in this comprehensive introductory course. You will explore the critical role of diverse, large-scale datasets in training sophisticated models and understand why data quality directly impacts AI performance. The course breaks down the massive computational power required, explaining the function of GPUs, TPUs, and cloud platforms in both training and deploying AI systems. Furthermore, it unpacks the 'recipe' behind the magic, introducing key algorithms like neural networks, transformers, and diffusion models that enable machines to generate text, images, and other novel content. Using an intuitive analogy of ingredients (data), a stove (compute), and a recipe (algorithm), this course makes complex technology accessible. Learners will also examine practical considerations for adoption, including compute costs, data governance, and the principles of responsible AI, equipping them to evaluate and engage with this transformative technology in a public sector context.

title: Fundamentals of Geographic Information System
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the fundamentals of Geographic Information Systems (GIS). It begins by establishing the context of GIS, explaining its importance in various sectors for planning, analysis, and decision-making. Participants will delve into the theoretical underpinnings of GIS, including the critical differences between raster and vector data models, and how geographic phenomena are translated into digital formats. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the principles of cartography and geodesy, covering coordinate systems, map projections, and the concept of datums like WGS 1984, which are essential for ensuring data accuracy and interoperability. Learners will then transition from theory to practice, with detailed demonstrations on how to handle geospatial data using the ArcGIS software suite. The course provides step-by-step guidance on georeferencing scanned maps, performing on-screen digitization to create vector features (points, lines, and polygons), editing spatial data, and managing it within a structured geodatabase. Ultimately, participants will learn to compose professional-quality maps, complete with titles, legends, scales, and grids, and export them for reporting and analysis. This course empowers learners to confidently manage and visualize geospatial data from creation to final output.

title: Fundamentals of Government Office Procedures and Communication
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge and skills for operating effectively within a government office. It establishes a strong foundation by explaining office organization, efficient workspace management, and the principles of structured official communication. The curriculum delves into various forms of correspondence, such as letters, memos, and U.O. notes, and clarifies key procedural terminology including Dak, diarising, noting, and drafting. Learners will explore the step-by-step process of Dak and file management, from receipt to final documentation. The course also outlines the distinct roles of dealing hands, section officers, and other functionaries, emphasizing procedural compliance and the use of digital tools to enhance efficiency and transparency. Upon completion, participants will be well-prepared to navigate administrative workflows with confidence and precision.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Fundamentals of High Frequency Radio Communication
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to radio waves and electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation, with a particular focus on the High Frequency (HF) band (3–30 MHz). It covers the fundamental principles of electromagnetic wave generation, propagation characteristics, and the historical evolution of radio communication technologies. Learners will explore the behavior of HF radio waves, including their interaction with the ionosphere and the various propagation mechanisms that enable long-distance communication. The course examines key concepts such as sky wave propagation, critical frequency, skip distance, and ionospheric variability. It also addresses practical aspects of HF communication, including circuit design considerations, antenna systems, noise, interference, multipath propagation, absorption, fading, and overall system reliability.

title: Fundamentals of Indigenous Defence Project Management
desc: Mastering the fundamentals of defence project management is critical for achieving self-reliance in India's strategic sectors. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the unique challenges and opportunities within indigenous defence projects. It delves into the core of India's defence acquisition ecosystem, providing clarity on the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020, procurement structures, and the strategic considerations that drive national defence capabilities. The curriculum is built around real-world case studies, including the Indigenous Aircraft Carrier (IAC) and the Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Tejas. By analyzing these complex projects, learners will explore best practices in managing timelines, costs, and the evolution from design to delivery. Participants will gain actionable insights into process improvements, strategic planning, and how to apply principles of indigenous design and manufacturing. The course aims to foster a mindset of accountability, transparency, and operational excellence, empowering officials to contribute effectively to India's defence indigenization goals.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Fundamentals of Industry 4.0 and 5G Technologies in Manufacturing
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of Industry 4.0 and its synergy with 5G technology, specifically tailored to the manufacturing context. It addresses the critical need for modernizing industrial processes to maintain global competitiveness. The curriculum delves into the core components of Industry 4.0, including the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), big data analytics, and robotics. It further explains the foundational aspects of 5G technology, highlighting its unprecedented speed, minimal latency, and capacity for massive device connectivity. Participants will learn how these technologies converge to create 'smart factories' capable of real-time monitoring, data-driven decision-making, and sophisticated automation.

title: Fundamentals of Land Systems in Defence
desc: This introductory course is designed to build a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles of land systems within the defence sector. It addresses the strategic necessity of land-based military capabilities and their role in modern warfare and national security. The curriculum delves into the historical development of land systems, providing context for their current technological state. Key learning areas include a detailed classification of systems, covering the operational roles and features of armoured fighting vehicles, artillery platforms, and advanced infantry equipment. The course also highlights the synergistic relationship between these components in combined arms operations. By exploring India's contributions and the overall evolution of these technologies, learners will develop a solid foundation for advanced topics in defence technology, procurement, and strategic planning, making it essential for professionals entering the defence and security domain.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Fundamentals of Leadership
desc: In the dynamic environment of public service, strong leadership is crucial for driving progress and achieving organizational goals. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles of effective leadership. It begins by examining the timeless qualities of great leaders and how their vision and actions can inspire change. Learners will delve into the practical aspects of leadership, including how to define and communicate clear goals, create a shared vision, and motivate followers to take ownership. A key focus of the course is on team management, covering strategies for allocating tasks based on the unique competencies of each member and fostering a collaborative environment by sharing leadership responsibilities. Furthermore, the course introduces the ACS (Assessment, Challenge, Support) model as a powerful tool for self-assessment and personal growth.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Fundamentals of Mapping Techniques in Granite-Greenstone Terrain
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth exploration of geological mapping techniques, specifically tailored for the complex granite-greenstone terrains characteristic of Precambrian cratons. It addresses the critical need for accurate geological maps in resource exploration, civil engineering, and environmental science. The course begins with the basics of geological fieldwork, including safety protocols and the proficient use of essential tools like the Brunton compass and GPS for collecting structural data. Learners will delve into the theoretical and practical aspects of cartography, understanding map scales, symbols, and toposheet interpretation. The curriculum systematically covers the identification and measurement of planar and linear structures, the significance of bedding-cleavage relationships, and the interpretation of folds and faults. Specialized modules are dedicated to mapping techniques in distinct geological settings: basement gneisses, granites, and volcano-sedimentary rocks, with a case study on India's Chitradurga Greenstone Belt. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to conduct systematic geological surveys, analyze complex structural data, and construct accurate geological maps and cross-sections, forming a vital skill set for any professional geologist.

title: Fundamentals of Medical Geology
desc: Delve into the interdisciplinary field of Medical Geology to understand the critical relationship between the Earth's materials and public health. This foundational course provides a comprehensive overview of how natural geological factors and elements influence the well-being of humans, animals, and plants. The curriculum begins with the history and core concepts of medical geology, introducing the dose-response principle that differentiates a remedy from a poison. You will learn to classify elements based on their biological roles—from essential nutrients to toxic heavy metals like lead, arsenic, and mercury—and explore their pathways from the geosphere to the biosphere. The course examines specific diseases caused by elemental imbalances and discusses the concept of 'geotoxigens'. Furthermore, it highlights the practical application of this science through the National Geochemical Mapping Program, demonstrating how geological surveys help identify and manage environmental health risks. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to appreciate the profound impact of our geological environment on health and disease.

title: Fundamentals of Office Procedures
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government employees with a thorough understanding of essential office procedures. It delves into the protocols and standards that define how staff work together in a hierarchical system, ensuring operational consistency and efficiency. The curriculum covers the core functions performed by different office sections, with a special focus on the meticulous maintenance of registers such as the stamp account, receipt, distribution, and dispatch registers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the File Management System, explaining how to properly handle collections of papers on specific subjects. Learners will also master the art of 'noting,' which is the critical process of writing remarks on files to facilitate sound decision-making.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Fundamentals of Optical Mineralogy
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of optical mineralogy, designed for geologists and earth science professionals. It establishes the foundational knowledge required for mineral identification through the analysis of their optical properties. The course begins with the principles of the polarizing microscope and the behavior of light in crystalline substances, covering topics such as plane-polarized and cross-polarized light, refractive index, pleochroism, and birefringence. Participants will delve into the complexities of crystal chemistry and the systematic classification of silicate minerals, which constitute the majority of the Earth's crust. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical identification techniques, including the interpretation of interference colors using the Michel-Levy chart, determining extinction angles, and analyzing interference figures to distinguish between uniaxial and biaxial minerals. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently identify common rock-forming minerals in thin sections, a crucial skill for petrological studies, geological mapping, and mineral resource assessment.

title: Fundamentals of Pay Fixation in Government Service
desc: Pay fixation is a cornerstone of public service administration, ensuring that every government employee is compensated correctly according to prescribed rules and regulations. This foundational course delves into the intricate details of pay fixation, providing a robust understanding of the governing principles. It is designed for officials who handle establishment, human resources, and financial matters, aiming to build their capacity for accurate and compliant salary management. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including the application of Fundamental Rules (FR) and Supplementary Rules (SR), understanding pay bands and grade pay, and the correct methods for calculating pay upon initial appointment, promotion, and under the Modified Assured Career Progression (MACP) scheme. Participants will learn to navigate various scenarios, such as stepping up of pay and handling pay anomalies.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Fundamentals of Plastering in Construction
desc: This comprehensive course introduces the essential concepts and techniques of plastering, a critical skill in the construction industry. It is designed for professionals seeking to build a strong foundation in creating protective and decorative coatings for walls and ceilings. The course begins by outlining the core purposes of plastering in enhancing structural durability and appearance. You will delve into the key learning areas, including the distinction between cement and gypsum plasters, understanding their compositions, benefits, and appropriate applications. Furthermore, the course emphasizes safety and efficiency by covering various scaffolding methods used in plastering work. A significant portion is dedicated to the importance of meticulous surface preparation to prevent defects and ensure a long-lasting bond. Learners will be guided through the detailed application procedures for both cement and gypsum plaster, focusing on techniques to achieve a smooth, professional

title: Fundamentals of Plastering in Construction
desc: This comprehensive course introduces the essential concepts and techniques of plastering, a critical skill in the construction industry. It is designed for professionals seeking to build a strong foundation in creating protective and decorative coatings for walls and ceilings. title: Fundamentals of Program and Project Management
desc: This course, NICPP Level 0, is designed to equip professionals with the fundamental knowledge and skills required for the successful execution of infrastructure projects and programs. It provides a foundational overview based on the Indian Infrastructure Body of Knowledge (InBoK), enhanced with allied concepts and global best practices. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of both program and project management, guiding learners from the initial project conception phase through to final close-out. Key learning areas include understanding the programmatic approach to large infrastructure projects, familiarizing with international standards for managing interfaces, changes, and risks, and applying practical project management tools. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to contribute effectively to program design, handle strategic project execution aspects, and monitor key performance indicators like cost, schedule, and quality, ensuring the successful delivery of project outcomes.

title: Fundamentals of Project Management
desc: This course provides a foundational understanding of project management principles, processes, and practices required for the effective planning and execution of infrastructure projects. It introduces learners to the complete project lifecycle, from project conception and initiation through planning, execution, monitoring and control, and final closure. The course covers essential areas of project management, including project scope, objectives, scheduling, cost and budget management, quality management, risk management, change management, contract and procurement strategies, engineering coordination, supply chain management, health and safety, and stakeholder management. Participants will also learn how to apply practical project management tools and techniques to support effective planning, resource allocation, team coordination, performance monitoring, and decision-making. Emphasis is placed on managing key project parameters such as cost, time, scope, quality, risk, and resources.

title: Fundamentals of Public Policy
desc: This course delves into the essential principles and practices of public policy, offering a robust framework for analyzing how governments address societal issues. It begins by establishing the foundational concepts of policy formulation, including guiding principles, stakeholder analysis, and the mechanisms that drive desired outcomes. Learners will explore the critical role of counterfactual thinking—examining alternative scenarios to rigorously evaluate a policy's true impact. A central part of the course involves an in-depth analysis of the RAND Corporation's 'Cocaine Case,' which serves as a practical example of applying demand-supply frameworks and cost-benefit analysis to a complex public problem. Furthermore, the course introduces the 'Even Swap' method, a powerful tool for making structured, transparent trade-offs between competing policy alternatives. Upon completion, participants will be adept at deconstructing policy problems, synthesizing evidence, and formulating well-reasoned recommendations, making them more effective in their public service roles.

title: Fundamentals of Public Policy
desc: This introductory course is designed for professionals seeking to understand the essential principles of public policy and its critical role in modern governance. The curriculum begins by defining public policy and illustrating its relevance in everyday life, from traffic laws to public health. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the economic foundations of policy intervention. You will learn to identify and analyze various market failures, such as the challenges in providing public goods, the societal costs of negative externalities, and the market distortions caused by adverse selection and moral hazard. The course uses fundamental economic concepts like demand, supply, and surplus to explain how policy choices are evaluated. Through a series of real-world and theoretical examples, learners will grasp the complexities of policy design, implementation, and enforcement. By the end of this course, you will have a structured framework for thinking critically about public problems and the potential of policy to create desirable societal outcomes.

title: Fundamentals of Public Procurement through GeM
desc: Dive into the mechanics of modern public procurement with this detailed course on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). The curriculum begins by establishing the fundamental purpose and scope of public procurement within the governmental framework. You will explore the operational structure of the GeM portal, gaining clarity on the distinct roles, responsibilities, and obligations for both buyers and sellers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical application of the General Financial Rules (GFR) and navigating various procurement methods available on GeM, including direct purchase, e-Bidding, and Reverse Auctions (RA). The course also covers critical procedural aspects such as bid security, performance security, liquidated damages, and the extension of delivery periods.

title: Fundamentals of Radio Direction Finding
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the essential principles of Radio Direction Finding (RDF), a pivotal technology in modern wireless communications. It addresses the importance of RDF in various critical applications, including signal intelligence, spectrum monitoring, maritime and aviation navigation, and search and rescue operations. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundational understanding, starting with the basic properties of electromagnetic waves and their propagation. Learners will delve into the complete architecture of an RDF system, identifying the role of each component from the antenna to the display unit. The course covers various types of RDF antennas and explains fundamental direction-finding techniques, such as amplitude comparison, phase interferometry, and Doppler methods, using clear explanations and real-world scenarios. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to describe the working principles of RDF, recognize its key components, and understand its operational relevance in both civilian and defense contexts. This knowledge serves as an essential stepping stone for junior RF engineers and technical professionals seeking to advance their expertise in radio communication and signal tracking technologies.

title: Fundamentals of Satellite Communication
desc: This foundational course delves into the essential concepts and technologies that underpin modern satellite communication. It begins by tracing the history and evolution of satellite systems, highlighting their critical role in enabling global connectivity. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of key technical areas, including the principles of orbital mechanics, different satellite classifications, and launching techniques. Learners will explore the intricate design of satellite subsystems, such as transponders, antennas, and power systems, as well as the architecture of ground-based earth stations. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing signal behavior, covering topics like frequency bands, signal propagation, link budget calculations, and the effects of atmospheric conditions like rain fade. The course also connects theory to practice by examining a wide range of applications, from television broadcasting and GPS navigation to remote sensing and disaster management. Upon completion, participants will possess the necessary knowledge to analyze the operation and application of satellite communication networks.

title: Fundamentals of Satellite System
desc:
This course introduces the core concepts and technical foundations of satellite communication systems, highlighting their role as a key enabler of the modern digital economy. It traces the evolution from early orbital theories to today’s advanced, high-capacity systems, and explains how physics, radio frequency engineering, and ground infrastructure work together to enable global connectivity.

The course also explores how rising data demands from video streaming, cloud computing, and IoT are transforming satellites into complex, multi-layered networks with enhanced processing capabilities. It further emphasizes the role of next-generation satellite systems in bridging the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low-latency connectivity to remote and underserved regions.

title: Fundamentals of Sedimentology
desc: Delving into the 'Fundamentals of Sedimentology', this course offers learners a detailed examination of sedimentary processes and products. The curriculum is structured across several modules, beginning with the classification of sedimentary rocks and the environmental clues they hold. Participants will learn to analyze key sedimentary textures, including grain size, shape, and sorting, to understand transport history and energy conditions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to sedimentary structures, linking bedforms like ripples and dunes to specific flow regimes, which is essential for paleo-environmental reconstruction. The course progresses to the core concepts of facies analysis, applying Walther's Law to interpret vertical rock successions as laterally adjacent depositional environments. It culminates in a survey of major depositional settings, from continental systems like alluvial fans, rivers, and glaciers to shallow marine environments such as deltas and tidal flats. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to interpret sedimentary records to reconstruct Earth's past environments and identify areas with potential for resource accumulation.

title: Fundamentals of Tax Deducted at Source
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal provisions, procedures, and compliance requirements relating to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under the Income-tax Act, 1961. It is designed to help learners understand and effectively manage the complete TDS process, from deduction and collection to remittance, reporting, and issuance of TDS certificates. The course introduces the fundamental concepts of TDS and Tax Collected at Source (TCS) and explains the roles and responsibilities of Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) and other stakeholders involved in TDS compliance. Participants will learn about obtaining and using the Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN), determining applicable TDS provisions and rates for different types of payments, and ensuring timely deduction and deposit of tax with the government.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Fundamentals of the Digital Public Infrastructure Approach
desc: In an era of rapid digital change, Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) has emerged as a foundational element for effective governance and improved public service delivery. This course delves into the core principles of the DPI approach, explaining how it enables scalable, secure, and inclusive digital ecosystems. Participants will journey through the entire lifecycle of DPI implementation, from initial strategic planning and design to procurement, adoption, and governance. The curriculum is structured across six modules, covering key topics such as the different types of DPI, critical attributes for success, and strategies for ensuring privacy and security by design. Through an analysis of success stories like Aadhaar, learners will gain practical insights into how these complex systems are built and managed. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to develop and execute a robust DPI strategy, fostering digital transformation that is both innovative and equitable for all citizens.
org: DPI Academy by Artha Global and eGov Foundation

title: Fundamentals of Tiles and Stone Flooring
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of tile and stone flooring, essential for professionals in the construction and public works sectors. It addresses the importance of proper flooring installation for the durability and safety of urban infrastructure. Key learning areas include a detailed classification of flooring materials, focusing on the properties and applications of pressed ceramic, vitrified tiles, and natural stones such as marble and granite. The course meticulously details the entire installation lifecycle, from preparing the surface and mixing cement mortar to the precise techniques for laying, fixing, pointing, and polishing. Furthermore, it provides critical knowledge on measurement practices and rate analysis, enabling learners to effectively budget and manage flooring projects. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in executing and evaluating flooring work, ensuring it meets both aesthetic standards and technical.

title: Fundamentals of Tiles and Stone Flooring
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of tile and stone flooring, essential for professionals in the construction and public works sectors. It addresses the importance of proper flooring installation for the durability and safety of urban infrastructure. Key learning areas include a detailed classification of flooring materials, focusing on the properties and applications of pressed ceramic, vitrified tiles, and natural stones such as marble and granite. The course meticulously details the entire installation lifecycle, from preparing the surface and mixing cement mortar to the precise techniques for laying, fixing, pointing, and polishing. title: Fundamentals of Time Value of Money
desc: This course covers the concept of the Time Value of Money (TVM) and the factors that influence it, including uncertainty, inflation, preference for present consumption, and reinvestment opportunities. Learners will understand the significance of TVM in investment and capital budgeting decisions and explore concepts such as the Time Preference Rate and the Required Rate of Return. The course also develops the ability to calculate Future Value and Present Value for single cash flows and annuities. In addition, learners will distinguish between ordinary annuities, annuity due, and perpetuities, apply the Rules of 72 and 69, and solve basic numerical problems using standard financial formulas.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM)

title: Fundamentals of Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing
desc: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) Fundamentals is a comprehensive cybersecurity course designed to equip IT professionals, security practitioners, and developers with the essential skills required to identify, analyze, and mitigate security vulnerabilities in organizational systems before they can be exploited by attackers. In today’s rapidly evolving threat landscape, where government e-governance platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud infrastructures are frequent targets of cyberattacks, VAPT plays a critical role in strengthening organizational security posture and protecting sensitive data. This course provides a structured introduction to both vulnerability assessment (VA)—the process of identifying and analyzing security weaknesses through automated tools—and penetration testing (PT)—the simulated exploitation of vulnerabilities to assess real-world risk and impact.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Fundamentals of Wireless Communication Systems
desc: Embark on a detailed journey into the world of modern telecommunications with this expert-level course on wireless communication. This program is structured to provide a robust understanding of the technologies that power our connected world, making it essential for technical professionals in the telecommunications sector. The course begins by establishing a strong foundation, covering the physics of broadband wireless channels, the structure of cellular systems, and advanced topics like fading modelling, delay spread, and Doppler effects. Following this, learners will dive deep into 4G technology, exploring LTE architecture, the Evolved Packet System (EPS), and the specific functions of Layers 1, 2, and 3. The final module transitions to the next generation, introducing the vision and key performance indicators of 5G. Participants will learn about 5G standardization, new radio (NR) requirements, and spectrum allocation, concluding with a comparative analysis of 4G and 5G systems.

title: Fundamentals of Wood Science and Sustainable Utilization
desc: The course introduces learners to the classification, structure, properties, characteristics, and uses of wood, along with its importance in various industries. It also provides an overview of the Indian wood industry and highlights the environmental significance of wood, with emphasis on sustainable wood utilization and responsible resource management. Through this course, learners will develop a basic understanding of wood and its applications, enabling them to better appreciate the importance of wood in industry, research, construction, manufacturing, and environmental sustainability. The course is particularly relevant for officials, researchers, technicians, students, and professionals working with wood and wood-based materials.
org: Institute of Wood Science and Technology- Bengaluru

title: Future of Cyber Security: Strategic Preparedness
desc: As India accelerates its journey towards a digitally-driven economy, understanding the future of cyber security is no longer optional, but a strategic imperative for public officials. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the technological forces shaping the next decade of digital governance. It moves beyond conventional security topics to address the foundational shifts occurring at the hardware, software, and network levels. Participants will learn about the significance of nanometer-scale chip manufacturing, the paradigm shift introduced by 5G and 6G, and the security challenges posed by hybrid architectures involving microservices, containers, and monolithic applications. The course provides a clear analysis of the primary sources of security breaches: vulnerabilities in software and hardware, insecure interfaces, improper configurations, and flawed processes. It highlights the growing threat from unmanaged infrastructure and the sophistication of AI-driven attacks. By examining real-world examples and future trends, this course empowers government officers to move from a reactive to a proactive security posture, enabling them to design resilient systems, implement effective security protocols, and build a culture of cyber preparedness within their organizations.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Future of Digital Governance
desc: This course provides a strategic overview of the future trajectory of digital governance. It addresses the critical need for governments to move beyond conventional e-governance and embrace advanced technological paradigms to meet the demands of a digital-first society. The curriculum delves into the core components of modern digital public infrastructure, including the shift towards AI-driven platforms, the implementation of autonomic (self-managing) systems, and the adoption of DevSecOps for enhanced security and agility. Participants will explore how platform thinking and modular, interoperable stacks enable scalable and resilient service delivery. The course also emphasizes the significance of building a collaborative ecosystem involving government, industry, and academia to foster innovation. Through real-world examples, learners will understand how these technologies can be applied to improve governance, ensure service continuity, and strengthen India's digital sovereignty, ultimately preparing them to lead and contribute to the next wave of digital transformation in the public sector.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Future of Mining in Viksit Bharat 2047
desc: This course offers a comprehensive examination of the mining sector's transformation as a cornerstone of the Viksit Bharat 2047 national vision. It sets the context by linking the sector's strategic importance to India's overarching goals for infrastructure, economic prosperity, technological innovation, and sustainability. Learners will gain detailed insights into significant policy reforms designed to enhance the ease of doing business and attract private investment, ensuring a robust and competitive industry. A key focus is on India's mineral security, covering strategies for accessing critical and rare earth minerals essential for clean energy, electronics, and defence manufacturing. The curriculum also explores the shift towards sustainable and low-carbon mining, aligning with India's climate commitments and circular economy principles. Furthermore, the course highlights the sector's role in social development through employment generation, community engagement, and skill development. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze future trends, understand the regulatory landscape, and strategically align their work with India's ambitious developmental roadmap for the Amrit Kaal.

title: Future-Proofing Cryptographic Security in the Post-Quantum Era
desc: Shor’s Algorithm demonstrates that a sufficiently powerful quantum computer can efficiently factor large integers and compute discrete logarithms—the mathematical backbone of classical cryptosystems like RSA, DSA, and ECC. While classical algorithms require exponential time for these problems, Shor’s Algorithm achieves polynomial-time solutions using quantum parallelism and the Quantum Fourier Transform. This capability exposes current public-key cryptography to potential quantum attacks, highlighting the urgent need for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). PQC develops quantum-resistant schemes, including lattice-based, hash-based, code-based, and multivariate approaches, to secure digital communication, authentication, and data integrity. Shor’s Algorithm thus drives global research, standardization, and adoption of PQC, ensuring robust and sustainable cybersecurity in the emerging quantum era.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: GatiShakti In Indian Railways
desc: The course provides an in-depth understanding of the Gati Shakti Multimodal Cargo Terminal (GCT) Policy, formulated by the Ministry of Railways. This course emphasizes the promotion of rail-based cargo movement through private-sector participation in terminal development. Participants will gain insights into the key components of the GCT policy, including its objectives, eligibility criteria, procedural framework, stakeholder roles, technical requirements, and commercial terms. The course equips learners with the knowledge to implement, manage, and monitor GCTs effectively within the policy framework. It is particularly relevant for railway officials, logistics providers, private investors, and infrastructure planners who are involved in enhancing freight operations and developing multimodal cargo terminals.

title: GeM 'ਤੇ ਖਰੀਦਦਾਰਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਬੋਲੀਕਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਅੱਗੇ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ
desc: ਇਹ ਵਿਸਤ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੋਰਸ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਖਰੀਦਦਾਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲੀਕਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਈ-ਮਾਰਕੀਟਪਲੇਸ (GeM) 'ਤੇ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁਹਾਰਤ ਹਾਸਲ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਦਾ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਜੀਵਨ-ਚੱਕਰ ਦੀ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਨਾਲ ਸਮਝ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ, ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਨਿਪਟਾਰੇ ਤੱਕ। ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ GeM ਪੋਰਟਲ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੁੱਖ ਕਾਰਜਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾਵਾਂ, ਨੀਤੀ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ-ਨਿਰਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਜ਼ਰੂਰਤਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣੂ ਕਰਵਾਇਆ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਾ, ਮਾਪਦੰਡਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਰਚਨਾ, ਬੋਲੀ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਰਣਨੀਤੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਨ ਦੀ ਸਪੁਰਦਗੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ। ਅਸਲ-ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਕੇਸ ਅਧਿਐਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ, ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਵਾਧੂ, ਪੁਰਾਣੇ, ਜਾਂ ਜ਼ਬਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਸਮਾਨ ਦੀ ਵਿਕਰੀ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰਦਰਸ਼ੀ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਯੋਗੀ ਢੰਗ ਵਜੋਂ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਸ਼ਵਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਨਗੇ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਨਤਕ ਖਰੀਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਜਵਾਬਦੇਹੀ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ, GeM 'ਤੇ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਫਲਤਾਪੂਰਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਵੋਗੇ।

title: GeM 'ਤੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਜਾਂ ਨਿਲਾਮੀਕਰਤਾ ਲਈ ਅੱਗੇ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਈ-ਮਾਰਕੀਟਪਲੇਸ (GeM) 'ਤੇ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਲਾਮੀਕਰਤਾਵਾਂ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸਤ੍ਰਿਤ ਗਾਈਡ ਹੈ। ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਖਰੀਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਰਦਰਸ਼ਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਲਈ GeM ਇੱਕ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਪਹਿਲ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਇਸਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਮੁੱਖ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੰਪਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂ ਵਸਤੂਆਂ ਦੀ ਵਿਕਰੀ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਜੀਵਨ-ਚੱਕਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝੋਗੇ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ, ਰਿਜ਼ਰਵ ਕੀਮਤ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਕਰਨਾ, ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਰਣਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਵੀ ਸਿੱਖੋਗੇ। ਕੋਰਸ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਤੁਸੀਂ GeM ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ 'ਤੇ ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਸ਼ਵਾਸ ਨਾਲ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈਣ, ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਵਿਕਰੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਖਰੀਦ ਈਕੋਸਿਸਟਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਪਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਵੋਗੇ।

title: GeM 'ਤੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਈ-ਮਾਰਕਿਟਪਲੇਸ (GeM) 'ਤੇ ਸਫਲਤਾਪੂਰਵਕ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਣ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਹੁਨਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਲੈਸ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ GeM 'ਤੇ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪੈਨ ਅਤੇ ਆਧਾਰ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਖਾਤਾ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਕਦਮ-ਦਰ-ਕਦਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੋਫਾਈਲ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਅਪਡੇਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਮਹੱਤਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣਗੇ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ 'ਤੇ ਦਿੱਖ ਅਤੇ ਭਰੋਸੇਯੋਗਤਾ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹੈ। ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਉਪਭੋਗਤਾ ਖਾਤਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ, ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਡੈਸ਼ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨੈਵੀਗੇਟ ਕਰਨ, ਅਤੇ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੀ ਰਾਸ਼ੀ (caution money) ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਬਾਰੇ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ GeM ਪੋਰਟਲ 'ਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਮੌਜੂਦਗੀ ਨੂੰ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਥਾਪਤ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਣਗੇ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਉਹ ਜਨਤਕ ਖਰੀਦ ਦੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈ ਸਕਣਗੇ।

title: GeM 'ਤੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾਵਾਂ ਲਈ ਕੈਟਾਲਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਈ-ਮਾਰਕੀਟਪਲੇਸ (GeM) 'ਤੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਕੈਟਾਲਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਦੇ ਹੁਨਰ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ GeM 'ਤੇ ਸਫਲਤਾਪੂਰਵਕ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਪਹਿਲੂਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਵਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਖਰੀਦ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਰਜਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ, ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਛੋਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਮੁੱਖ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਤਪਾਦ ਕੈਟਾਲਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਕੈਟਾਲਾਗ ਅੱਪਲੋਡ ਕਰਨਾ, ਬ੍ਰਾਂਡ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਨਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਕੈਟਾਲਾਗਾਂ ਦੀ ਨਕਲ (ਕਲੋਨਿੰਗ) ਕਰਨਾ ਸਿੱਖਣਗੇ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ, ਇਹ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੈਟਾਲਾਗ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ GeM ਪੋਰਟਲ 'ਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਉਤਪਾਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਸੂਚੀਬੱਧ ਕਰਨ, ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਾਰਕੀਟ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਣਗੇ।

title: GeM 'తే వికరేత రాజిస్ట్రేషన్
desc: ప్రభుత్వ ఇ-మార్కెట్‌ప్లేస్ (GeM) అనేది ప్రభుత్వ విభాగాలకు వస్తువులు మరియు సేవలను విక్రయించడానికి ఒక కీలకమైన డిజిటల్ వేదిక. ఈ కోర్సు GeMలో విక్రేతగా విజయవంతంగా నమోదు చేసుకోవడానికి మరియు మీ ఖాతాను సమర్థవంతంగా నిర్వహించడానికి అవసరమైన జ్ఞానాన్ని అందించడానికి రూపొందించబడింది. ఈ కోర్సులో, మీరు GeM ప్లాట్‌ఫారమ్‌లో చేరడానికి అవసరమైన ప్రాథమిక అర్హతలు, పాన్ మరియు ఆధార్ ఉపయోగించి రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ ప్రక్రియను ఎలా పూర్తి చేయాలో దశలవారీగా నేర్చుకుంటారు. మీ వ్యాపార ప్రొఫైల్‌ను నవీకరించడం, అదనపు వినియోగదారులను (సెకండరీ యూజర్స్) సృష్టించడం మరియు నిర్వహించడం వంటి అంశాలపై మీకు స్పష్టమైన అవగాహన లభిస్తుంది. అంతేకాకుండా, విక్రేత డాష్‌బోర్డ్‌లోని వివిధ విభాగాలను ఎలా ఉపయోగించుకోవాలో మరియు కాషన్ మనీ డిపాజిట్ యొక్క ప్రాముఖ్యతను కూడా మీరు తెలుసుకుంటారు. ఈ కోర్సును పూర్తి చేయడం ద్వారా, మీరు GeMలో మీ ఉత్పత్తులను లేదా సేవలను అందించడానికి మరియు ప్రభుత్వ టెండర్లలో పాల్గొనడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉంటారు.

title: GeM पर खरीद प्रक्रिया सर्विस
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों और खरीद पेशेवरों को सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पर सेवाओं की खरीद की प्रक्रियाओं में महारत हासिल करने में मदद करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। सार्वजनिक खरीद में GeM की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका को समझते हुए, यह मॉड्यूल खरीद प्रक्रिया के हर चरण पर विस्तृत जानकारी प्रदान करता है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत GeM पोर्टल पर सेवा श्रेणियों को खोजने और चुनने की मूलभूत बातों से होती है। इसके बाद, यह सीधी खरीद (Direct Purchase) और L1 खरीद जैसी विभिन्न खरीद विधियों का विवरण देता है, जिसमें उनकी applicabilty और प्रक्रियात्मक चरण शामिल हैं। एक प्रमुख फोकस सेवा बोली (Service Bid) के निर्माण पर है, जिसमें आवश्यकता विनिर्देशों को परिभाषित करना, बोलियों का दस्तावेजीकरण करना और प्रासंगिक नियमों और शर्तों को जोड़ना शामिल है। शिक्षार्थी सीखेंगे कि एक प्रभावी बोली कैसे तैयार की जाए जो प्रतिस्पर्धी प्रतिक्रियाओं को आकर्षित करे और मूल्य-के-लिए-धन सुनिश्चित करे। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा होने पर, प्रतिभागी GeM प्लेटफॉर्म पर आत्मविश्वास से नेविगेट करने, खरीद नियमों का पालन करने और अपनी संगठनात्मक आवश्यकताओं के लिए सेवाओं को कुशलतापूर्वक खरीदने में सक्षम होंगे।

title: GeM पर खरीदारों या बोलीदाताओं के लिए अग्रिम नीलामी
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पर फॉरवर्ड नीलामी की कार्यप्रणाली पर एक विस्तृत मार्गदर्शिका है, जिसे विशेष रूप से सरकारी खरीदारों और बोलीदाताओं के लिए तैयार किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य प्रतिभागियों को फॉरवर्ड नीलामी की अवधारणा, इसके महत्व और सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र में इसके अनुप्रयोगों से लैस करना है, विशेष रूप से अधिशेष या स्क्रैप वस्तुओं के निपटान के लिए। यह नीलामी के निर्माण से लेकर अंतिम रूप देने तक, संपूर्ण जीवनचक्र को कवर करता है। शिक्षार्थी GeM प्लेटफॉर्म पर नेविगेट करना, नीलामी के मानदंड और पैरामीटर कॉन्फ़िगर करना, और प्रकाशन के लिए आगे बढ़ना सीखेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में बोली लगाने की रणनीतियों, मूल्य खोज तंत्र और सफल भागीदारी के लिए सर्वोत्तम प्रथाओं पर भी प्रकाश डाला गया है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह नीलामी के बाद की महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रियाओं, जैसे कि पुरस्कार की घोषणा, भुगतान और संपत्ति के हस्तांतरण का प्रबंधन करने पर मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करता है। केस स्टडी और व्यावहारिक अंतर्दृष्टि के माध्यम से, यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी उपयोगकर्ताओं और बोलीदाताओं दोनों को GeM पर फॉरवर्ड नीलामी में आत्मविश्वास से भाग लेने और उनका प्रबंधन करने में सक्षम बनाता है।

title: GeM पर विक्रेता या नीलामीकर्ता के लिए अग्रिम नीलामी
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पर फॉरवर्ड नीलामी प्रक्रिया में महारत हासिल करने के लिए एक विस्तृत मार्गदर्शिका प्रदान करता है। इसे विशेष रूप से उन विक्रेताओं और नीलामकर्ताओं के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है जो सरकारी खरीद इकोसिस्टम में प्रभावी ढंग से भाग लेना चाहते हैं। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि GeM पर फॉरवर्ड नीलामी एक पारदर्शी और प्रतिस्पर्धी तंत्र के माध्यम से सरकारी संपत्तियों या वस्तुओं को बेचने का एक शक्तिशाली उपकरण क्यों है। इसमें नीलामी जीवनचक्र के सभी पहलुओं को शामिल किया गया है, जिसमें नीलामी की तैयारी, GeM प्लेटफॉर्म पर नीलामी बनाना और उसे सूचीबद्ध करना, और बोलियों का प्रबंधन करना शामिल है। शिक्षार्थी मूल्य निर्धारण रणनीतियों, प्रभावी बोली तकनीकों और नीलामी के बाद की औपचारिकताओं, जैसे अनुबंध प्रबंधन और भुगतान प्रक्रियाओं के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा होने पर, प्रतिभागी GeM पर फॉरवर्ड नीलामी में सफलतापूर्वक नेविगेट करने, अपने बिक्री के अवसरों को अधिकतम करने और सभी नियामक आवश्यकताओं का अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करने में सक्षम होंगे।

title: GeM पर विक्रेताओं के लिए कैटलॉग प्रबंधन
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से उन विक्रेताओं के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है जो गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पर अपने उत्पादों और सेवाओं को प्रस्तुत करना चाहते हैं। यह GeM पर सफल होने के लिए आवश्यक कैटलॉग प्रबंधन की संपूर्ण प्रक्रिया पर व्यावहारिक जानकारी प्रदान करता है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत विक्रेता मूल्यांकन की प्रक्रिया और संबंधित छूट प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक दस्तावेजों से होती है। इसके बाद, शिक्षार्थी उत्पाद कैटलॉग बनाने की चरण-दर-चरण प्रक्रिया सीखेंगे, जिसमें कैटलॉग अपलोड करना, ब्रांड अनुमोदन प्राप्त करना और मौजूदा कैटलॉग को क्लोन करना शामिल है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह पाठ्यक्रम सेवा कैटलॉग बनाने और प्रबंधित करने के महत्वपूर्ण पहलुओं को भी शामिल करता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, विक्रेता GeM प्लेटफॉर्म पर अपने कैटलॉग को कुशलतापूर्वक प्रबंधित करने, अपनी दृश्यता बढ़ाने और सरकारी खरीद में प्रभावी ढंग से भाग लेने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान और कौशल से लैस होंगे।

title: GeM में खरीद प्रक्रिया उत्पादों के लिए
desc: यह विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों को गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) की खरीद प्रक्रियाओं में निपुण बनाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम GeM पोर्टल के माध्यम से उत्पादों की खरीद के हर पहलू को शामिल करता है, जिससे सार्वजनिक खरीद में पारदर्शिता और दक्षता सुनिश्चित होती है। इसमें प्रत्यक्ष खरीद (बिना बोली के), L1 खरीद (सबसे कम बोली लगाने वाले से खरीद), बोली निर्माण, और एक मानक बोली को रिवर्स नीलामी (RA) में बदलने जैसी प्रमुख प्रक्रियाओं पर गहन जानकारी दी गई है। शिक्षार्थी सीखेंगे कि इन प्रक्रियाओं को चरण-दर-चरण कैसे निष्पादित किया जाए, जिससे वे आत्मविश्वास के साथ पोर्टल का उपयोग कर सकें। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य प्रतिभागियों को GeM की कार्यक्षमताओं का प्रभावी ढंग से लाभ उठाने में सक्षम बनाना है, ताकि वे अपने संगठनों के लिए सर्वोत्तम मूल्य पर उत्पादों की खरीद कर सकें और सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों (GFR) का अनुपालन सुनिश्चित कर सकें।

title: GeM वर खरेदीदार किंवा बोलीदारांसाठी फॉरवर्ड लिलाव
desc: सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) द्वारे सार्वजनिक खरेदीमध्ये पारदर्शकता आणि कार्यक्षमता आणण्याच्या दिशेने हा अभ्यासक्रम एक महत्त्वाचे पाऊल आहे. हा अभ्यासक्रम विशेषतः खरेदीदार आणि बोलीदारांसाठी डिझाइन केला आहे, ज्यांना GeM प्लॅटफॉर्मवर फॉरवर्ड लिलाव प्रक्रियेत सहभागी व्हायचे आहे. फॉरवर्ड लिलाव हे सरकारी विभागांना अतिरिक्त, कालबाह्य किंवा जप्त केलेल्या वस्तूंची विल्हेवाट लावण्यासाठी एक प्रभावी साधन आहे. या अभ्यासक्रमात, सहभागींना फॉरवर्ड लिलावाचा संपूर्ण जीवनचक्र तपशीलवारपणे शिकायला मिळेल. यामध्ये लिलाव निर्मिती, योग्य पॅरामीटर्स सेट करणे, लिलाव प्रकाशित करणे आणि बोलीदारांचा सहभाग व्यवस्थापित करणे यासारख्या महत्त्वाच्या टप्प्यांचा समावेश आहे. तसेच, बोली लावण्याची धोरणे, किंमत निश्चिती आणि लिलावानंतरच्या प्रक्रिया, जसे की पेमेंट आणि वस्तूंची डिलिव्हरी, यावरही मार्गदर्शन केले जाईल. हा अभ्यासक्रम पूर्ण केल्यावर, सरकारी अधिकारी आणि कर्मचारी GeM फॉरवर्ड लिलाव मॉड्यूलचा आत्मविश्वासाने वापर करून मालमत्तेची यशस्वीपणे विल्हेवाट लावू शकतील आणि सार्वजनिक संसाधनांचे मूल्य वाढवू शकतील.

title: GeM वर विक्रेता किंवा लिलावकर्त्यासाठी फॉरवर्ड लिलाव
desc: सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) हे सार्वजनिक खरेदीसाठी एक महत्त्वाचे डिजिटल व्यासपीठ आहे. हा अभ्यासक्रम विशेषतः GeM वरील 'फॉरवर्ड लिलाव' या वैशिष्ट्यावर लक्ष केंद्रित करतो, जो सरकारी संस्थांना वस्तू किंवा मालमत्ता विकण्याची सुविधा देतो. या अभ्यासक्रमात, सहभागींना फॉरवर्ड लिलावाचे महत्त्व आणि त्याची कार्यप्रणाली समजेल. यामध्ये लिलाव तयार करण्यापासून ते बोली लावण्यापर्यंत आणि लिलावानंतरच्या औपचारिकता पूर्ण करण्यापर्यंतच्या सर्व प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. शिकणाऱ्यांना प्रभावी बोली धोरणे, राखीव किंमत निश्चित करणे आणि GeM धोरणांचे पालन करणे याबद्दल माहिती मिळेल. हा अभ्यासक्रम पूर्ण केल्यावर, विक्रेते आणि लिलावकर्ते GeM प्लॅटफॉर्मचा वापर करून आपल्या संधी वाढवू शकतील आणि सरकारी विक्री प्रक्रियेत आत्मविश्वासाने भाग घेऊ शकतील.

title: GeM वर विक्रेता नोंदणी
desc: गव्हर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) हे सरकारी खरेदीसाठी एक महत्त्वाचे डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्म आहे. हा कोर्स विशेषतः अशा विक्रेत्यांसाठी तयार केला आहे ज्यांना GeM वर आपला व्यवसाय सुरू करायचा आहे. या कोर्समध्ये, तुम्हाला GeM वर विक्रेता म्हणून नोंदणी करण्याच्या संपूर्ण प्रक्रियेची सविस्तर माहिती मिळेल. यामध्ये नोंदणीसाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या पूर्व-आवश्यकता, जसे की पॅन आणि आधार कार्ड, आणि त्यांचा वापर करून खाते कसे तयार करावे हे शिकवले जाईल. नोंदणीनंतर, तुमची विक्रेता प्रोफाइल १००% पूर्ण कशी करावी आणि तिचे महत्त्व काय आहे, हे स्पष्ट केले आहे. तसेच, तुमच्या व्यवसायाच्या गरजेनुसार दुय्यम वापरकर्ते कसे तयार करावेत आणि त्यांचे व्यवस्थापन कसे करावे, यावरही मार्गदर्शन केले आहे. कोर्सच्या शेवटी, तुम्हाला विक्रेता डॅशबोर्डवरील विविध पर्यायांची ओळख करून दिली जाईल आणि सावधगिरीच्या पैशांची (caution money) प्रक्रिया समजावून सांगितली जाईल, ज्यामुळे तुम्हाला GeM वर आत्मविश्वासाने काम करता येईल.

title: GeM वरील विक्रेत्यांसाठी कॅटलॉग व्यवस्थापन
desc: हा अभ्यासक्रम विशेषतः GeM (गव्हर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस) वर नोंदणीकृत किंवा नोंदणी करू इच्छिणाऱ्या विक्रेत्यांसाठी तयार केला आहे. सरकारी खरेदी प्रक्रिया डिजिटल झाल्यामुळे, GeM पोर्टलवर प्रभावीपणे कॅटलॉग व्यवस्थापन करणे व्यवसायाच्या वाढीसाठी अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे. या कोर्समध्ये, आपण विक्रेता मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया आणि त्यासाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या सवलतींच्या कागदपत्रांबद्दल शिकाल. तसेच, उत्पादन कॅटलॉग अपलोड करणे, नवीन ब्रँडसाठी मंजुरी मिळवणे आणि विद्यमान कॅटलॉग क्लोन करणे यासारख्या प्रक्रियांची माहिती दिली जाईल. याव्यतिरिक्त, सेवा-आधारित व्यवसायांसाठी सेवा कॅटलॉग कसा तयार करावा आणि व्यवस्थापित करावा हे देखील स्पष्ट केले आहे. हा कोर्स पूर्ण केल्यावर, आपण GeM पोर्टलवर आपली उपस्थिती यशस्वीपणे व्यवस्थापित करण्यास आणि सरकारी खरेदीच्या संधींचा पुरेपूर फायदा घेण्यास सक्षम व्हाल.

title: GeM ਉਤਪਾਦਾਂ ਲਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਖਰੀਦ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ
desc: ਇਹ ਕੋਰਸ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਖਰੀਦਦਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਈ-ਮਾਰਕੀਟਪਲੇਸ (GeM) ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮਰੱਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ GeM 'ਤੇ ਉਤਪਾਦ ਖਰੀਦਣ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤਰੀਕਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਜਨਤਕ ਖਰੀਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਧੇਰੇ ਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਰਦਰਸ਼ਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਖਰੀਦ (ਬਿਨਾਂ ਬੋਲੀ ਦੇ) ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ, ਇਸਦੇ ਲਾਭ ਅਤੇ ਕਦਮ-ਦਰ-ਕਦਮ ਮਾਰਗਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਪੜਚੋਲ ਕਰਨਗੇ। ਕੋਰਸ L1 ਖਰੀਦ ਵਿਧੀ 'ਤੇ ਵੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਬੋਲੀ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੋਂ ਖਰੀਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ, ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰ ਉਤਪਾਦ ਖਰੀਦ ਲਈ ਬੋਲੀਆਂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਸਿੱਖਣਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਮਿਆਰੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਨੂੰ ਰਿਵਰਸ ਨਿਲਾਮੀ (RA) ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਣ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣਗੇ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਵਿਕਰੇਤਾ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਕੀਮਤਾਂ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਇਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਸਿਖਿਆਰਥੀ GeM ਪੋਰਟਲ 'ਤੇ ਖਰੀਦ ਕਾਰਜਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋਣਗੇ।

title: GeM પર ખરીદદારો અથવા બોલી લગાવનારાઓ માટે ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શન
desc: આ વિગતવાર કોર્સ સરકારી ખરીદદારો અને બોલી લગાવનારાઓને સરકારી ઈ-માર્કેટપ્લેસ (GeM) પ્લેટફોર્મ પર ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શન સુવિધાનો અસરકારક રીતે ઉપયોગ કરવા માટે સક્ષમ બનાવવા માટે તૈયાર કરવામાં આવ્યો છે. આ કોર્સનો મુખ્ય ઉદ્દેશ્ય સરકારી સંસ્થાઓ દ્વારા સરપ્લસ, અપ્રચલિત અથવા સ્ક્રેપ જેવી વસ્તુઓના નિકાલ માટે એક પારદર્શક અને કાર્યક્ષમ પદ્ધતિ પ્રદાન કરવાનો છે. સહભાગીઓને ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શનના જીવનચક્રના દરેક તબક્કામાંથી માર્ગદર્શન આપવામાં આવશે. મુખ્ય શિક્ષણ ક્ષેત્રોમાં GeM પર હરાજીની સૂચિ બનાવવી, હરાજીના પરિમાણોને ગોઠવવા, બોલી લગાવનારાઓ માટે ભાગીદારીની પ્રક્રિયા, સ્પર્ધાત્મક બોલી માટેની વ્યૂહરચનાઓ અને સફળ હરાજી પછીની પ્રક્રિયાઓનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કર્યા પછી, શીખનારાઓ GeM પર આત્મવિશ્વાસપૂર્વક ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શનનું સંચાલન કરી શકશે, નિયમનકારી પાલન સુનિશ્ચિત કરી શકશે અને જાહેર સંપત્તિઓ માટે મહત્તમ મૂલ્ય પ્રાપ્ત કરી શકશે.

title: GeM પર વિક્રેતા અથવા હરાજી કરનાર માટે ફોરવર્ડ હરાજી
desc: આ વ્યાપક કોર્સ સરકારી ઈ-માર્કેટપ્લેસ (GeM) પર ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શનમાં ભાગ લેવા અને તેનું સંચાલન કરવા માટે એક વ્યવહારુ માર્ગદર્શિકા આપે છે. જાહેર ખરીદીની પ્રક્રિયામાં ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શન એક મહત્ત્વનું સાધન છે, જે સરકારી સંસ્થાઓને પારદર્શક અને સ્પર્ધાત્મક રીતે સંપત્તિઓ અથવા માલનું વેચાણ કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે. આ કોર્સમાં, શીખનારાઓ ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શનના સમગ્ર જીવનચક્રને સમજશે, જેમાં ઓક્શનની તૈયારી, ઓક્શન બનાવવું, અને ભાગ લેવો વગેરેનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. તેમાં અસરકારક બિડિંગ માટે અનામત કિંમત નક્કી કરવા, કિંમતમાં વધારો કરવા અને વ્યૂહરચનાઓ વિકસાવવા જેવા મુખ્ય ક્ષેત્રોને આવરી લેવામાં આવ્યા છે. વધુમાં, કોર્સ GeM નીતિઓ, નિયમો અને શરતોનું પાલન, તેમજ ચુકવણી અને ફરિયાદ નિવારણ જેવી ઓક્શન પછીની ઔપચારિકતાઓ પર પણ ભાર મૂકે છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કર્યા પછી, સહભાગીઓ GeM પર ફોરવર્ડ ઓક્શનનો આત્મવિશ્વાસપૂર્વક ઉપયોગ કરી શકશે.

title: GeM પર વિક્રેતા નોંધણી
desc: આ કોર્સ ખાસ કરીને એવા વિક્રેતાઓ અને સેવા પ્રદાતાઓ માટે બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે જેઓ ગવર્નમેન્ટ ઇ-માર્કેટપ્લેસ (GeM) પર જોડાવા માંગે છે. GeM સરકારી ખરીદી માટે એક મુખ્ય પ્લેટફોર્મ હોવાથી, તેના પર વ્યવસાય કરવાની પ્રક્રિયા સમજવી અત્યંત મહત્વપૂર્ણ છે. આ કોર્સમાં, તમને GeM પર વિક્રેતા તરીકે નોંધણી કરવા માટેની પગલા-દર-પગલાની પ્રક્રિયા શીખવવામાં આવશે, જેમાં પાન અને આધારનો ઉપયોગ કરીને નોંધણીનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. તમે તમારી વિક્રેતા પ્રોફાઇલને કેવી રીતે પૂર્ણ અને અપડેટ કરવી તે શીખી શકશો, જે સંભવિત ખરીદદારોને આકર્ષવા માટે જરૂરી છે. વધુમાં, કોર્સ ગૌણ વપરાશકર્તા ખાતાઓ બનાવવા અને તેનું સંચાલન કરવા, વિક્રેતા ડેશબોર્ડની વિવિધ કાર્યક્ષમતાઓને સમજવા અને કોશન મની જમા કરાવવા અને રિફંડ સંબંધિત નાણાકીય પ્રક્રિયાઓને નેવિગેટ કરવા પર વિગતવાર માહિતી પ્રદાન કરે છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કર્યા પછી, તમે GeM પર તમારા ઉત્પાદનો અને સેવાઓની સૂચિબદ્ધ કરવા અને સરકારી ટેન્ડરોમાં ભાગ લેવા માટે સંપૂર્ણપણે તૈયાર હશો.

title: GeM પર વિક્રેતાઓ માટે કેટલોગ મેનેજમેન્ટ
desc: આ વિગતવાર કોર્સ ગવર્નમેન્ટ ઈ-માર્કેટપ્લેસ (GeM) પર સફળતાપૂર્વક વેચાણ કરવા માંગતા વિક્રેતાઓ માટે બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે. આ કોર્સ કેટલોગ વ્યવસ્થાપનના દરેક તબક્કા પર ધ્યાન કેન્દ્રિત કરે છે, જે પ્લેટફોર્મ પર દૃશ્યતા અને સફળતા માટે નિર્ણાયક છે. તમે વિક્રેતા મૂલ્યાંકન પ્રક્રિયા અને તેના માટે જરૂરી દસ્તાવેજો વિશે શીખશો. કોર્સ ઉત્પાદન કેટલોગ બનાવવા, સ્પષ્ટીકરણો સાથે અપલોડ કરવા, અને બ્રાન્ડ મંજૂરી મેળવવા માટે પગલા-દર-પગલાની સૂચનાઓ પ્રદાન કરે છે. આ ઉપરાંત, તે સેવા કેટલોગ બનાવવા અને સમય બચાવવા માટે હાલના કેટલોગને ક્લોન કરવાની તકનીકોને પણ આવરી લે છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કર્યા પછી, તમે GeM પર તમારા ઉત્પાદનો અને સેવાઓને અસરકારક રીતે પ્રદર્શિત કરવા અને સરકારી ખરીદીની તકોનો મહત્તમ લાભ લેવા માટે સક્ષમ બનશો.

title: GeM માં પ્રાપ્તિ પ્રક્રિયા ઉત્પાદનો માટે
desc: આ કોર્સ સરકારી અધિકારીઓ અને ખરીદદારોને ગવર્નમેન્ટ ઇ-માર્કેટપ્લેસ (GeM) પ્લેટફોર્મનો અસરકારક રીતે ઉપયોગ કરવા માટે માર્ગદર્શન આપવા માટે બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે. આ કોર્સ જાહેર ખરીદીના મુખ્ય પાસાઓ પર ધ્યાન કેન્દ્રિત કરે છે, જે સરકારી કામગીરીમાં પારદર્શિતા અને કાર્યક્ષમતા સુનિશ્ચિત કરવા માટે મહત્વપૂર્ણ છે. સહભાગીઓ GeM પર ઉપલબ્ધ વિવિધ ખરીદી પદ્ધતિઓ વિશે શીખશે. તેમાં બોલી લગાવ્યા વિના સીધી ખરીદી, સૌથી ઓછી બોલી લગાવનાર પાસેથી L1 ખરીદી, સ્પર્ધાત્મક બિડિંગ માટે બિડ બનાવવાની પ્રક્રિયા, અને વધુ સારી કિંમત મેળવવા માટે બિડને રિવર્સ ઓક્શન (RA) માં રૂપાંતરિત કરવાની તકનીકોનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. આ કોર્સ પૂર્ણ કર્યા પછી, શીખનારાઓ GeM પોર્ટલ પર આત્મવિશ્વાસ સાથે નેવિગેટ કરી શકશે અને તેમની સંસ્થાકીય જરૂરિયાતો માટે યોગ્ય ખરીદી પદ્ધતિ પસંદ કરી શકશે.

title: GeM સેવાઓ માટે પર પ્રાપ્તિ પ્રક્રિયા
desc: આ કોર્સ સરકારી ઈ-માર્કેટપ્લેસ (GeM) પર સેવાઓની પ્રાપ્તિ માટે એક વ્યાપક માર્ગદર્શિકા છે. સરકારી ખરીદીમાં પારદર્શિતા અને કાર્યક્ષમતા વધારવાના સંદર્ભમાં GeMનું મહત્વ સમજાવવામાં આવ્યું છે. શિખાઉઓ સેવાઓની પ્રાપ્તિ માટેના વિવિધ માર્ગોનું અન્વેષણ કરશે, જેમાં સીધી ખરીદીની સરળ પ્રક્રિયા, L1 પદ્ધતિ દ્વારા તુલનાત્મક ખરીદી, અને જટિલ જરૂરિયાતો માટે બિડ અથવા રિવર્સ ઓક્શન (RA) કેવી રીતે બનાવવી તે સામેલ છે. કોર્સના અંત સુધીમાં, સહભાગીઓ GeM પોર્ટલ પર વિશ્વાસપૂર્વક નેવિગેટ કરી શકશે, તેમની જરૂરિયાતો માટે યોગ્ય પ્રાપ્તિ પદ્ધતિ પસંદ કરી શકશે અને સંપૂર્ણ ખરીદી પ્રક્રિયાને સફળતાપૂર્વક પૂર્ણ કરી શકશે. આનાથી જાહેર ભંડોળનો શ્રેષ્ઠ ઉપયોગ સુનિશ્ચિત થશે અને સેવા પ્રાપ્તિમાં સુધારો થશે.

title: GeM କ୍ରେତାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଅର୍ଡର ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ ଏବଂ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ
desc: ଏହି ବିସ୍ତୃତ ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସରକାରୀ ଇ-ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ (GeM) ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମରେ କ୍ରେତାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଅର୍ଡର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସରଳ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ, ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀମାନେ କ୍ରୟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବା ଶିଖିବେ। ଏଥିରେ କନସାଇନି ରସିଦ ସହ ଗ୍ରହଣ ପ୍ରମାଣପତ୍ର (CRAC) ଜେନେରେଟ୍ କରିବା, ଡେଲିଭରି ଅବଧି ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଁ ଅନୁରୋଧ କରିବା, ଏବଂ ବିଲ୍ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବାର ପଦ୍ଧତି ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଏହା ସହିତ, ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ପବ୍ଲିକ୍ ଫାଇନାନ୍ସିଆଲ୍ ମ୍ୟାନେଜମେଣ୍ଟ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ (PFMS) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ କିପରି ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ଭାବରେ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ କରାଯାଏ ତାହା ମଧ୍ୟ ବୁଝାଇଥାଏ। ସେବା ଅର୍ଡର ପାଇଁ ଇନଭଏସିଂ ଏବଂ କନସାଇନି ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଭଳି ବିଷୟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏଥିରେ ସ୍ଥାନ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ସମାପ୍ତ କରିବା ପରେ, କ୍ରେତାମାନେ GeM ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ କ୍ରୟ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଦକ୍ଷତାର ସହିତ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିପାରିବେ, ଯାହା ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛତା ଏବଂ ସମୟାନୁବର୍ତ୍ତିତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବ।

title: GeM ରେ କ୍ରେତା କିମ୍ବା ବିଡରଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଆଗୁଆ ନିଲାମ
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସରକାରୀ ଇ-ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ (GeM) ରେ ଆଗୁଆ ନିଲାମର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟପ୍ରଣାଳୀକୁ ଗଭୀର ଭାବରେ ବୁଝାଇବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ସରକାରୀ କ୍ରୟ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ନିपटानରେ ପାରଦର୍ଶିତା ଏବଂ ଦକ୍ଷତା ଆଣିବା ପାଇଁ GeM ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭୂମିକା ଗ୍ରହଣ କରେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ, ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀମାନେ ଆଗୁଆ ନିଲାମର ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଜୀବନଚକ୍ର ବିଷୟରେ ଶିଖିବେ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ନିଲାମ ସୃଷ୍ଟି, ପାରାମିଟର ସେଟ୍ କରିବା, ନିଲାମ ପ୍ରକାଶନ, ବିଡିଂ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା, ଏବଂ ନିଲାମ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଏହା ବିଡରମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ରଣନୀତିକ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ ଏବଂ କ୍ରେତାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଭାବୀ ନିଲାମ ପରିଚାଳନା ଉପରେ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ସମାପ୍ତ କରିବା ପରେ, ଆପଣ GeM ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମକୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସର ସହିତ ଆଗୁଆ ନିଲାମ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବାକୁ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ।

title: GeM ରେ କ୍ରୟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଉତ୍ପାଦ ପାଇଁ
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସରକାରୀ ଇ-ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ (GeM) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ ଏବଂ ଉତ୍ପାଦ କ୍ରୟ କରିବାର ବ୍ୟବહારିକ ଦିଗଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଶିਖାଇବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ସରକାରୀ କ୍ରୟ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲୀରେ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛତା, ଦକ୍ଷତା ଏବଂ инклюзивତା ଆଣିବା ପାଇଁ GeM ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମଞ୍ଚ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକramରେ, ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ GeM ਪੋਰਟାଲରେ ਉਪਲବ୍ध ଥିବା ବିଭିନ୍ନ କ୍ରୟ ପદ્ધତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଷୟରେ ଜ୍ଞାନଲାଭ କରିବେ। ଏଥିରେ मुख्य रूप से ଚାରୋଟି ବିଷୟ ଉପରେ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ କ୍ରୟ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିष्ट ମୂଲ୍ୟ ସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସିଧାସଳଖ କ୍ରୟ କରାଯାଇପାରେ; L1 କ୍ରୟ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ କମ୍ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦେଉଥିବା ବିକ୍ରେତାଙ୍କଠାରୁ କ୍ରୟ କରାଯାଏ; ବିଡ୍ ସୃଷ୍ଟି, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ବଡ଼ କ୍ରୟ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ପ୍ରତିଯੋਗिताମୂଳକ ਪ੍ਰਕ੍ਰିୟା ଆରମ୍ਭ କରାଯାଏ; ଏବଂ ରିଭର୍ସ ଅକ୍ସన్ (RA), ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ବିକ୍ରେତାମାନେ ମୂଲ୍ୟ କମାଇବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରତିଯੋਗिता କରନ୍ତି। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଶେଷରେ, ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ GeM ਪੋਰਟାଲକୁ ଆତ୍ମવિશ્વાસର ସହିତ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ନିଜ ବିଭାଗ ପାଇଁ ସଫଳତାର ସହିତ କ୍ରୟ କରିପାରିବେ।
