title: GeM ରେ ବିକ୍ରେତା କିମ୍ବା ନିଲାମଧାରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଆଗୁଆ ନିଲାମ
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସରକାରୀ ଇ-ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ (GeM) ରେ ଫରୱାର୍ଡ ନିଲାମର ଜଟିଳତାକୁ ବୁଝିବା ପାଇଁ ଇଚ୍ଛୁକ ବିକ୍ରେତା ଏବଂ ନିଲାମଧାରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗାଇଡ୍ ଭାବରେ ପରିକଳ୍ପିତ ହୋଇଛି। GeM ସରକାରୀ କ୍ରୟ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଡିଜିଟାଲ୍ ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମ, ଏବଂ ଫରୱାର୍ଡ ନିଲାମ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ ବିକ୍ରୟ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଗତିଶୀଳ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତିଯୋଗିତାମୂଳକ ପରିବେଶ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ, ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀମାନେ ଫରୱାର୍ଡ ନିଲାମର ମୂଳ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ, ଏହାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟପ୍ରଣାଳୀ, ଏବଂ GeM ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ଏହାର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ବିଷୟରେ ଶିଖିବେ। ଏହା ନିଲାମ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା, ବିଡିଂ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାରେ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବା, ଏବଂ ନିଲାମ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ-ଦ୍ୱାରା-ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ସୁଯୋଗକୁ ସର୍ବାଧିକ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ରଣନୈତିକ ବିଡିଂ କୌଶଳ ଏବଂ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ନିର୍ଧାରଣ ପଦ୍ଧତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଷୟରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଆହରଣ କରିବେ। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଶେଷ ସୁଦ୍ଧା, ଆପଣ GeM ରେ ଫରୱାର୍ଡ ନିଲାମରେ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସର ସହିତ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବାକୁ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ।

title: GeM ରେ ବିକ୍ରେତା ପଞ୍ଜିକରଣ
desc: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସରକାରୀ ଇ-ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ (GeM) ରେ ବିକ୍ରେତାମାନଙ୍କୁ ସଫଳତାର ସହ ଅନବୋର୍ଡ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପରିକଳ୍ପନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ସରକାରୀ କ୍ରୟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାରେ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିବା ବ୍ୟବସାୟୀମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ GeM ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମ, ଏବଂ ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ସମସ୍ତ ମୌଳିକ ଜ୍ଞାନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ପଞ୍ଜିକରଣ ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ପୂର୍ବ-ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା, ଯେପରିକି ପାନ୍ ଏବଂ ଆଧାର ସହିତ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଏହା ପଞ୍ଜିକରଣ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପଦକ୍ଷେପକୁ ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ। ପଞ୍ଜିକରଣ ପରେ, ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ବିକ୍ରେତା ପ୍ରୋଫାଇଲକୁ କିପରି ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଏବଂ ଅପଡେଟ୍ କରିବେ, ଯାହା ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନତା ପାଇଁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ତାହା ଶିଖିବେ। ଏହା ସହିତ, ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟକ ଉପଭୋକ୍ତା ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ୍ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ଏବଂ ପରିଚାଳନା, ବିକ୍ରେତା ଡ୍ୟାସବୋର୍ଡର ବିଭିନ୍ନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରିତାକୁ ବୁଝିବା, ଏବଂ ସତର୍କତାମୂଳକ ଅର୍ଥ (Caution Money) ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ସମାପ୍ତ କରିବା ପରେ, ବିକ୍ରେତାମାନେ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସର ସହିତ GeM ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମକୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବାକୁ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ।

title: GeM ରେ ବିକ୍ରେତାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ କ୍ୟାଟାଲଗ୍ ପରିଚାଳନା
desc: ଏହି ବିସ୍ତୃତ ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସରକାରୀ ଇ-ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ (GeM) ରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରୁଥିବା ବିକ୍ରେତାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ବ୍ୟାପକ ଗାଇଡ୍ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ। ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ମୂଳ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି GeM ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ଏବଂ ସେବା କ୍ୟାଟାଲଗ୍ ପରିଚାଳନାର ଜଟିଳତାକୁ ସରଳ କରିବା। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ବିକ୍ରେତା ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା, ରିହାତି ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ କରିବାର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି, ଏବଂ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ଡକ୍ୟୁମେଣ୍ଟେସନ୍ ବିଷୟରେ ଶିଖିବେ। ଏହା ସହିତ, ଉତ୍ପାଦ କ୍ୟାଟାଲଗ୍ ଅପଲୋଡ୍ କରିବା, ବ୍ରାଣ୍ଡ୍ ଅନୁମୋଦନ ପାଇବା, ଏବଂ ବିଦ୍ୟମାନ କ୍ୟାଟାଲଗ୍‌କୁ କ୍ଲୋନ୍ କରିବାର ପଦ୍ଧତିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟକ୍ରମେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମଟି ସେବା-ଆଧାରିତ ବ୍ୟବସାୟ ପାଇଁ ସେବା କ୍ୟାଟାଲଗ୍ କିପରି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରାଯିବ, ସେ ବିଷୟରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶନା ଦେଇଥାଏ। ଏହି ଜ୍ଞାନ ଆହରଣ କରି, ବିକ୍ରେତାମାନେ GeM ରେ ନିଜର ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନତା ବଢ଼ାଇବା ସହିତ ସରକାରୀ ଟେଣ୍ଡର ଏବଂ କ୍ରୟ ସୁଯୋଗଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ଲାଭ ଉଠାଇ ପାରିବେ।

title: GeM இல் கொள்முதல் செயல்முறை தயாரிப்புகளுக்கு
desc: அரசு கொள்முதல் செயல்முறைகளை நவீனமயமாக்குவதிலும், வெளிப்படைத்தன்மையை அதிகரிப்பதிலும் அரசு மின்னணு சந்தை (GeM) ஒரு முக்கிய பங்கு வகிக்கிறது. இந்த விரிவான பாடநெறி, GeM தளத்தில் உள்ள பல்வேறு கொள்முதல் முறைகளைப் பற்றி அரசு அதிகாரிகளுக்கு வழிகாட்டுவதற்காக வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பங்கேற்பாளர்கள், நேரடி கொள்முதல் (ஏலமின்றி) மற்றும் குறைந்த ஏலதாரரிடமிருந்து வாங்கும் L1 கொள்முதல் ஆகியவற்றுக்கு இடையேயான வேறுபாடுகளைக் கற்றுக்கொள்வார்கள். மேலும், ஒரு புதிய ஏலத்தை எவ்வாறு உருவாக்குவது, தொழில்நுட்ப மற்றும் நிதித் தகுதிகளை அமைப்பது, மற்றும் ஏலத்தை வெற்றிகரமாக நிர்வகிப்பது போன்ற நடைமுறை அம்சங்களையும் இது உள்ளடக்கியுள்ளது. போட்டி விலைகளைப் பெறுவதற்காக ஒரு ஏலத்தை எவ்வாறு தலைகீழ் ஏலமாக (Reverse Auction) மாற்றுவது என்பது குறித்தும் விளக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்தப் பாடநெறியை முடிப்பதன் மூலம், கற்பவர்கள் GeM தளத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி தங்கள் துறைக்குத் தேவையான பொருட்களை திறம்படவும், பொது நிதி விதிகளுக்கு (GFR) இணங்கவும் கொள்முதல் செய்ய முடியும்.

title: GeM இல் வாங்குபவர்கள் அல்லது ஏலதாரர்களுக்கான முன்னோக்கி ஏலம்
desc: அரசு மின்-சந்தை (GeM) தளத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி பொது கொள்முதல் மற்றும் சொத்துக்களை அப்புறப்படுத்தும் செயல்முறைகளை மேம்படுத்துவதில் இந்த பாடநெறி கவனம் செலுத்துகிறது. அரசுத் துறைகள் தங்களிடம் உள்ள உபரி, காலாவதியான அல்லது பறிமுதல் செய்யப்பட்ட பொருட்களை வெளிப்படையான மற்றும் போட்டி முறையில் விற்க முன்னோக்கி ஏலம் ஒரு சக்திவாய்ந்த கருவியாகும். இந்த விரிவான பாடநெறி, முன்னோக்கி ஏலத்தின் வாழ்க்கைச் சுழற்சியின் ஒவ்வொரு படியிலும் பங்கேற்பாளர்களுக்கு வழிகாட்டுகிறது. ஏலத்தை உருவாக்குதல், முக்கிய அளவுருக்களை அமைத்தல், ஏலதாரர் பங்கேற்பை நிர்வகித்தல் மற்றும் ஏலத்திற்குப் பிந்தைய நடைமுறைகளை செயல்படுத்துதல் போன்ற முக்கிய பகுதிகளை இது உள்ளடக்கியுள்ளது. பங்கேற்பாளர்கள் விலை நிர்ணய உத்திகள், ஏல விதிகள் மற்றும் இணக்கத் தேவைகள் பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவுகளைப் பெறுவார்கள். பாடநெறியை முடித்தவுடன், அரசு அதிகாரிகள் மற்றும் ஏலதாரர்கள் GeM தளத்தில் முன்னோக்கி ஏலங்களை நம்பிக்கையுடன் நடத்தவும், பங்கேற்கவும், பொது சொத்துக்களுக்கு சிறந்த மதிப்பை உறுதி செய்யவும் முடியும்.

title: GeM இல் விற்பனையாளர் அல்லது ஏலதாரருக்கான முன்னோக்கி ஏலம்
desc: அரசு மின்னணு சந்தை (GeM) என்பது அரசு கொள்முதலில் ஒரு புரட்சிகரமான மாற்றமாகும். இந்த பாடநெறி, GeM தளத்தில் உள்ள முன்னோக்கி ஏலத்தின் நுணுக்கங்களை விற்பனையாளர்களுக்கு அறிமுகப்படுத்துவதற்காக வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. அரசுத் துறைகள் தங்களிடம் உள்ள உபரி அல்லது பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட பொருட்களை விற்பனை செய்ய இந்த முன்னோக்கி ஏல முறை பயன்படுகிறது. இதில் பங்கேற்பதன் மூலம், விற்பனையாளர்கள் தங்கள் பொருட்களுக்கு சிறந்த விலையைப் பெற முடியும். இந்த பாடநெறியில், முன்னோக்கி ஏலத்தை உருவாக்குவது, ஏலத்திற்கான தயாரிப்புப் பணிகள், பங்கேற்பு விதிகள், மற்றும் ஏலம் முடிந்த பிறகு பின்பற்ற வேண்டிய நடைமுறைகள் ஆகியவை விரிவாக விளக்கப்படும். ஏலத்தின் போது விலை நிர்ணய உத்திகள் மற்றும் పోటీயை திறம்பட எதிர்கொள்வது எப்படி என்பது குறித்தும் நீங்கள் அறிந்து கொள்வீர்கள். இந்த அறிவைப் பயன்படுத்துவதன் மூலம், நீங்கள் GeM தளத்தில் உங்கள் வணிகத்தை வெற்றிகரமாக விரிவுபடுத்தலாம் மற்றும் ప్రభుత్వத்தின் வெளிப்படையான விற்பனை செயல்பாட்டில் ஒரு முக்கிய പങ്കാളராக மாறலாம்.

title: GeM இல் விற்பனையாளர் பதிவு
desc: அரசு மின்னணு சந்தை (GeM) என்பது அரசு கொள்முதலுக்கான ஒரு டிஜிட்டல் தளமாகும். இந்த விரிவான பாடநெறி, விற்பனையாளர்கள் மற்றும் சேவை வழங்குநர்கள் GeM தளத்தில் தங்களை வெற்றிகரமாக பதிவு செய்துகொள்வதற்கான படிப்படியான வழிகாட்டுதலை வழங்குகிறது. பங்கேற்பாளர்கள், பான் மற்றும் ஆதார் அட்டையைப் பயன்படுத்தி பதிவு செயல்முறையை எவ்வாறு தொடங்குவது, தங்கள் சுயவிவரத்தை முழுமையாகப் பூர்த்தி செய்வது, மற்றும் இரண்டாம் நிலை பயனர்களை உருவாக்கி நிர்வகிப்பது எப்படி என்பதைக் கற்றுக்கொள்வார்கள். மேலும், விற்பனையாளர் டாஷ்போர்டின் பல்வேறு அம்சங்கள், அதன் பயன்பாடுகள், மற்றும் எச்சரிக்கை பணம் தொடர்பான நடைமுறைகள் குறித்தும் விளக்கப்படும். இந்தப் பாடநெறியை முடிப்பதன் மூலம், கற்பவர்கள் GeM தளத்தில் நம்பிக்கையுடன் செயல்படவும், தங்கள் வணிக வாய்ப்புகளை விரிவுபடுத்தவும் தேவையான அறிவைப் பெறுவார்கள்.

title: GeM இல் விற்பனையாளர்களுக்கான பட்டியல் மேலாண்மை
desc: அரசு மின் சந்தை (GeM) என்பது அரசுத் துறைகளுக்கான கொள்முதல் செயல்முறையை எளிதாக்கும் ஒரு முக்கிய டிஜிட்டல் தளமாகும். இந்த பாடநெறி, GeM தளத்தில் பதிவுசெய்த விற்பனையாளர்களுக்காக பிரத்யேகமாக வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இதில், விற்பனையாளர்கள் தங்கள் தயாரிப்பு பட்டியல்களை எவ்வாறு உருவாக்குவது, பதிவேற்றுவது, மற்றும் நிர்வகிப்பது என்பது குறித்து விரிவாக விளக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பிராண்ட் மற்றும் விற்பனையாளர் ஒப்புதல் செயல்முறைகள், ஏற்கனவே உள்ள பட்டியல்களை குளோனிங் செய்வது, மற்றும் புதிய சேவை பட்டியல்களை உருவாக்குவது போன்ற தலைப்புகள் இதில் அடங்கும். இந்த பாடநெறியின் மூலம், கற்பவர்கள் GeM தளத்தின் செயல்பாடுகளை முழுமையாகப் புரிந்துகொண்டு, தங்கள் தயாரிப்புகளை சரியான முறையில் பட்டியலிட்டு, ప్రభుత్వ கொள்முதலில் தங்கள் பங்கை வலுப்படுத்திக் கொள்ள முடியும். இது அவர்களின் வணிகத்தை விரிவுபடுத்தவும், அரசுடனான வர்த்தகத்தை எளிதாக்கவும் உதவும்.

title: GeM లో విక్రేతల కోసం కేటలాగ్ నిర్వహణ
desc: ప్రభుత్వ ఇ-మార్కెట్‌ప్లేస్ (GeM) భారత ప్రభుత్వ సేకరణ ప్రక్రియలో విప్లవాత్మక మార్పులు తెచ్చింది, విక్రేతలకు తమ ఉత్పత్తులు మరియు సేవలను ప్రభుత్వ విభాగాలకు అందించడానికి ఒక పారదర్శక మరియు సమర్థవంతమైన ప్లాట్‌ఫారమ్‌ను అందిస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సు GeMలో విజయవంతంగా పాల్గొనాలనుకునే విక్రేతల కోసం ప్రత్యేకంగా రూపొందించబడింది. ఇది కేటలాగ్ నిర్వహణ యొక్క అన్ని అంశాలను వివరంగా చర్చిస్తుంది, విక్రేత మదింపు ప్రక్రియ నుండి ఉత్పత్తి మరియు సేవా కేటలాగ్‌లను సృష్టించడం మరియు నిర్వహించడం వరకు దశలవారీ మార్గదర్శకత్వం అందిస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సులో, మీరు ఉత్పత్తి కేటలాగ్‌లను అప్‌లోడ్ చేయడం, బ్రాండ్ ఆమోదం కోసం అభ్యర్థించడం, ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న కేటలాగ్‌లను క్లోన్ చేయడం మరియు సేవా కేటలాగ్‌లను రూపొందించడం వంటి ఆచరణాత్మక నైపుణ్యాలను నేర్చుకుంటారు. ఈ పరిజ్ఞానం GeM ప్లాట్‌ఫారమ్‌ను ఆత్మవిశ్వాసంతో నావిగేట్ చేయడానికి మరియు ప్రభుత్వ కొనుగోలుదారులకు మీ ఆఫర్‌లను స్పష్టంగా మరియు ఆకర్షణీయంగా ప్రదర్శించడానికి మీకు సహాయపడుతుంది. ఈ కోర్సును పూర్తి చేయడం ద్వారా, మీరు ప్రభుత్వ మార్కెట్‌లో మీ వ్యాపార పరిధిని విస్తరించడానికి మరియు మీ విజయావకాశాలను మెరుగుపరచుకోవడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉంటారు.

title: GeM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರು ಅಥವಾ ಬಿಡ್ದಾರರಿಗೆ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜು
desc: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಇ-ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (GeM) ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸ್ವತ್ತುಗಳ ವಿಲೇವಾರಿ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಸರಳಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ, ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲದ ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಯಸುವ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರಿಗೆ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜು ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವವರಿಗೆ GeM ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜನ್ನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿ ನಡೆಸಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಾಜು ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ರಚನೆ, ಹರಾಜಿನ ನಿಯತಾಂಕಗಳ ಸಂರಚನೆ, ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ, ಬಿಡ್ದಾರರ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆ, ಬೆಲೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಹರಾಜಿನ ನಂತರದ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ, ಕಲಿಯುವವರು GeM ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜು ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸದಿಂದ ಬಳಸಲು, ನಿಯಮಾವಳಿಗಳ ಪಾಲನೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸ್ತಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿರುವ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯವಾದ ತರಬೇತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

title: GeM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರ ನೋಂದಣಿ
desc: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಇ-ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (GeM) ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ವೇದಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಸೇವಾ ಪೂರೈಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ GeM ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಲು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರಾಗಿ ನೋಂದಾಯಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಹಂತ-ಹಂತದ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ಯಾನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧಾರ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್‌ನಂತಹ ಅಗತ್ಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯೂ ಸೇರಿದೆ. ನೋಂದಣಿಯ ನಂತರ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ನಿಖರವಾಗಿರಿಸಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ನವೀಕರಿಸುವುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನೀವು ಕಲಿಯುವಿರಿ. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿಯಾಗಿ, ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದು, ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರ ಡ್ಯಾಶ್‌ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನ ವಿವಿಧ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುವುದು, ಮತ್ತು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯ ಹಣಕ್ಕೆ (Caution Money) ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಈ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು ತಮ್ಮ ಖಾತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಖರೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸದಿಂದ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಬಹುದು, ತಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಬಹುದು.

title: GeM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಕ್ಯಾಟಲಾಗ್ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ
desc: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಇ-ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (GeM) ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷತೆಯನ್ನು ತರಲು ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವೇದಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು GeM ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಯಸುವ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ, ನೀವು ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಹಂತ-ಹಂತದ ವಿವರಣೆಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವಿರಿ. ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಕ್ಯಾಟಲಾಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುವುದು, ಬ್ರಾಂಡ್ ಅನುಮೋದನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕ್ಯಾಟಲಾಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ಲೋನ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನೀವು ಕಲಿಯುವಿರಿ. ಇದಲ್ಲದೆ, ಸೇವಾ ಕ್ಯಾಟಲಾಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುವ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಸಹ ವಿವರವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ, ನೀವು GeM ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ಯಾಟಲಾಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸದಿಂದ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ತಲುಪುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title: GeM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು ಅಥವಾ ಹರಾಜುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜು
desc: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಇ-ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (GeM) ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜುಗಳನ್ನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಲು ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಹರಾಜುದಾರರನ್ನು ಸಜ್ಜುಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜಿನ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು, ಅದರ ಜೀವನಚಕ್ರದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಹಂತವನ್ನು ವಿವರವಾಗಿ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಕಲಿಯುವವರು GeM ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಾಜನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ರಚಿಸುವುದು, ಮೀಸಲು ಬೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ವಾತಾವರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಗರಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಬಿಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಳನೋಟಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹರಾಜಿನ ನಂತರದ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಾದ ಪಾವತಿ, ಸರಕುಗಳ ವಿತರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆಗಳ ನಿವಾರಣೆಯಂತಹ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸಹ ಇದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ, ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವವರು GeM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಹರಾಜುಗಳನ್ನು ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸದಿಂದ ನ್ಯಾವಿಗೇಟ್ ಮಾಡಲು ಮತ್ತು ತಮ್ಮ ಮಾರಾಟದ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಕ್ಷತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title: GeM ലെ സംഭരണ ​​പ്രക്രിയ ഉൽപ്പന്നങ്ങൾക്ക്
desc: ഈ കോഴ്സ് ഗവൺമെൻ്റ് ഇ-മാർക്കറ്റ്പ്లేസ് (GeM) പോർട്ടലിലെ ഉൽപ്പന്ന സംഭരണ പ്രക്രിയയെക്കുറിച്ച് വിശദമായ అవగాహన നൽകുന്നു. സർക്കാർ വകുപ്പുകളിലെ கொள்முதல் 담당 ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥർക്ക് GeM പ്ലാตഫോം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് తమ కార్యకలాపాలు సులభతరం చేయడానికి ఇది രൂപകల్పన ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു. ഡയറക്ട് പർച്ചേസ് (ബിഡ്ഡിംഗ് ഇല്ലാതെ), L1 പർച്ചേസ് (ഏറ്റവും കുറഞ്ഞ വിലയ്ക്ക്), ബിഡ് তৈরি ചെയ്യൽ, ബിഡ്ഡുകളെ റിവേഴ്സ് ഓക്ഷനുകളാക്കി മാറ്റൽ തുടങ്ങിയ വിഷയങ്ങൾ ഇതിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. ഓരോ സംഭരണ രീതിയുടെയും പ്രയോசனങ്ങളും, ఎప్పుడు, ఎలా ఉపయోగించണമെന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള நடைமுறைപരമായ సూచనകളും പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് ലഭിക്കും. പൊതു സംഭരണത്തിൽ സുതാര്യത, കാര്യക്ഷമത, സാമ്പത്തിക ലാഭം എന്നിവ ഉറപ്പാക്കാൻ ഈ കോഴ്സ് സഹായിക്കും. കോഴ്സ് പൂർത്തിയാക്കുന്നതോടെ, GeM പോർട്ടലിൽ ആത്മവിശ്വാസത്തോടെയും കൃത്യതയോടെയും സംഭരണ ഇടപാടുകൾ നടത്താൻ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് കഴിയും.

title: GeM ൽ വാങ്ങുന്നവർക്കോ ലേലക്കാർക്കോ വേണ്ടിയുള്ള ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലം
desc: സർക്കാർ വകുപ്പുകൾക്ക് മിച്ചമുള്ളതോ ഉപയോഗശൂന്യമായതോ ആയ വസ്തുക്കൾ വിൽക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള ഒരു പ്രധാന ഉപാധിയായ ഗവൺമെൻ്റ് ഇ-മാർക്കറ്റ്പ്ലേസിലെ (GeM) ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് വിശദമായി പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്ന കോഴ്സാണിത്. പൊതു സംഭരണത്തിലും വിനിയോഗത്തിലും സുതാര്യതയും കാര്യക്ഷമതയും ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നതിൽ GeM-ന്റെ പങ്ക് ഈ കോഴ്സ് വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നു. ലേലം സൃഷ്ടിക്കൽ, അതിന്റെ മാനദണ്ഡങ്ങൾ ക്രമീകരിക്കൽ, ലേലത്തിൽ പങ്കെടുക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള നടപടിക്രമങ്ങൾ, ഫലപ്രദമായ ബിഡ്ഡിംഗ് തന്ത്രങ്ങൾ, ലേലത്തിന് ശേഷമുള്ള പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ ഇതിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. ഈ കോഴ്സ് പൂർത്തിയാക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ, പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് GeM പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോമിൽ ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലങ്ങൾ വിജയകരമായി നടത്താനും പങ്കെടുക്കാനും ആവശ്യമായ അറിവും കഴിവും ലഭിക്കും. ഇത് സർക്കാർ സംവിധാനത്തിലെ വിഭവങ്ങളുടെ മികച്ച വിനിയോഗത്തിന് സഹായിക്കും.

title: GeM ൽ വിൽപ്പനക്കാരനോ ലേലക്കാരനോ വേണ്ടിയുള്ള ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലം
desc: ഗവൺമെന്റ് ഇ-മാർക്കറ്റ്‌പ്ലേസ് (GeM) വഴി ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലങ്ങൾ നടത്തുന്നതിനുള്ള ഒരു സമഗ്രമായ വഴികാട്ടിയാണ് ഈ കോഴ്‌സ്. സർക്കാർ വകുപ്പുകൾക്കും പൊതുമേഖലാ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾക്കും അവരുടെ അധികമുള്ളതോ ഉപയോഗശൂന്യമായതോ ആയ സാധനങ്ങൾ വിൽക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള ഒരു ഡിജിറ്റൽ സംവിധാനമാണ് ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലം. ലേലത്തിനായുള്ള തയ്യാറെടുപ്പ്, GeM പോർട്ടലിൽ ലേലം സൃഷ്ടിക്കൽ, ബിഡ്ഡിംഗ് പ്രക്രിയയിൽ പങ്കെടുക്കൽ, ലേലത്തിന് ശേഷമുള്ള നടപടിക്രമങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു. GeM നയങ്ങൾ, ലേല നിബന്ധനകൾ, വിലനിർണ്ണയ തന്ത്രങ്ങൾ, പരാതി പരിഹാര മാർഗ്ഗങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള പ്രധാന വിവരങ്ങളും ഇതിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് പൂർത്തിയാക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ, പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് GeM പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഫലപ്രദമായി ഫോർവേഡ് ലേലങ്ങൾ നടത്താനും കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യാനും സാധിക്കും.

title: GeM-ൽ വിൽപ്പനക്കാരന്റെ രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ
desc: ഗവൺമെൻ്റ് ഇ-മാർക്കറ്റ്‌പ്ലെയ്‌സ് (GeM) പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോമിൽ വിൽപ്പനക്കാരനായി ചേരാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് വേണ്ടിയുള്ള ഒരു അടിസ്ഥാന കോഴ്‌സാണിത്. സർക്കാർ വകുപ്പുകൾക്കും പൊതുമേഖലാ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾക്കും തങ്ങളുടെ ഉൽപ്പന്നങ്ങളും സേവനങ്ങളും വിൽക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള നടപടിക്രമങ്ങൾ ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് വിശദമായി പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നു. രജിസ്ട്രേഷന് ആവശ്യമായ കാര്യങ്ങൾ, പാൻ, ആധാർ എന്നിവ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് അക്കൗണ്ട് ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്ന വിധം, പ്രൊഫൈൽ 100% പൂർത്തിയാക്കേണ്ടതിൻ്റെ പ്രാധാന്യം എന്നിവ പഠിതാക്കൾക്ക് മനസ്സിലാക്കാം. കൂടാതെ, വിൽപ്പനക്കാരൻ്റെ ഡാഷ്‌ബോർഡിലെ വിവിധ ഓപ്ഷനുകൾ, സെക്കൻഡറി യൂസർമാരെ ചേർക്കുന്ന വിധം, കോഷൻ മണി നിക്ഷേപിക്കുന്നതിനും തിരികെ ലഭിക്കുന്നതിനുമുള്ള വ്യവസ്ഥകൾ എന്നിവയും ഈ കോഴ്‌സിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു. ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് പൂർത്തിയാക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ, GeM പോർട്ടലിലെ എല്ലാ അടിസ്ഥാന പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചും വ്യക്തമായ ധാരണ നേടാനും സർക്കാർ ടെൻഡറുകളിൽ ആത്മവിശ്വാസത്തോടെ പങ്കെടുക്കാനും സാധിക്കും.

title: GEM-ൽ വിൽപ്പനക്കാർക്കുള്ള കാറ്റലോഗ് മാനേജ്മെന്റ്
desc: ഗവൺമെൻ്റ് ഇ-മാർക്കറ്റ്‌പ്ലെയ്‌സ് (GeM) വഴി സർക്കാർ വകുപ്പുകൾക്ക് തങ്ങളുടെ ഉൽപ്പന്നങ്ങളും സേവനങ്ങളും വിൽക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന സംരംഭകർക്കും ബിസിനസുകാർക്കും വേണ്ടിയുള്ള ഒരു അടിസ്ഥാന കോഴ്‌സാണിത്. GeM പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോമിൽ ഒരു വിൽപ്പനക്കാരനായി രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്ത ശേഷം, നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉൽപ്പന്നങ്ങളും സേവനങ്ങളും ശരിയായ രീതിയിൽ പ്രദർശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടത് അത്യാവശ്യമാണ്. ഈ കോഴ്‌സ് അതിന് നിങ്ങളെ സഹായിക്കും. കാറ്റലോഗ് അപ്‌ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുന്നതിനുള്ള നടപടിക്രമങ്ങൾ, ബ്രാൻഡ് അംഗീകാരം നേടൽ, നിലവിലുള്ള കാറ്റലോഗുകൾ ക്ലോൺ ചെയ്യൽ, പുതിയ സേവന കാറ്റലോഗുകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കൽ തുടങ്ങിയ വിഷയങ്ങൾ ഇതിൽ ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുന്നു. വെണ്ടർ അസ്സസ്സ്മെൻ്റിൽ ലഭിക്കുന്ന ഇളവുകളെക്കുറിച്ചും കോഴ്‌സിൽ പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നു. ഈ പരിശീലനം പൂർത്തിയാക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ, നിങ്ങൾക്ക് GeM പോർട്ടലിലെ കാറ്റലോഗ് മാനേജ്മെൻ്റ് പ്രക്രിയയിൽ വൈദഗ്ദ്ധ്യം നേടാനും നിങ്ങളുടെ ബിസിനസ്സ് അവസരങ്ങൾ വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കാനും കഴിയും.

title: GeMలో కొనుగోలుదారులు లేదా బిడ్డర్లకు ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం
desc: ప్రభుత్వ ఇ-మార్కెట్‌ప్లేస్ (GeM)లో ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం ప్రక్రియను నైపుణ్యంగా నిర్వహించడానికి అవసరమైన జ్ఞానం మరియు నైపుణ్యాలను అందించడానికి ఈ కోర్సు రూపొందించబడింది. ప్రభుత్వ సంస్థలు మిగులు లేదా వాడుకలో లేని వస్తువులను పారదర్శకంగా విక్రయించడానికి ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం ఒక ముఖ్యమైన సాధనం. ఈ కోర్సులో, అభ్యాసకులు వేలం సృష్టించడం, పారామితులను కాన్ఫిగర్ చేయడం, మరియు ప్రచురించడం వంటి కీలక దశలను అన్వేషిస్తారు. బిడ్డర్ల కోసం, ఇది వేలంలో పాల్గొనడం, వ్యూహాత్మక బిడ్‌లను సమర్పించడం మరియు వేలం ఫలితాలను అర్థం చేసుకోవడంపై మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తుంది. వేలం అనంతర విధానాలు, ధరల ఆవిష్కరణ మరియు ఉత్తమ పద్ధతులను కూడా ఈ కోర్సు కవర్ చేస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సును పూర్తి చేయడం ద్వారా, పాల్గొనేవారు GeM ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం మాడ్యూల్‌ను విశ్వాసంతో నావిగేట్ చేయగలరు, ప్రభుత్వ ఆస్తుల అమ్మకంలో గరిష్ట విలువ మరియు సామర్థ్యాన్ని సాధించగలరు.

title: GeMలో విక్రేత లేదా వేలంపాటదారుల కోసం ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం
desc: ప్రభుత్వ సేకరణలో పారదర్శకత మరియు సామర్థ్యాన్ని తీసుకురావడంలో ప్రభుత్వ ఇ-మార్కెట్‌ప్లేస్ (GeM) ఒక కీలకమైన వేదిక. ఈ కోర్సు GeMలోని ఒక ముఖ్యమైన సాధనమైన 'ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం'పై దృష్టి పెడుతుంది, ఇది విక్రేతలు మరియు వేలంపాటదారులకు ప్రభుత్వ కొనుగోలుదారులకు వస్తువులను విక్రయించడానికి ఒక పోటీ వాతావరణాన్ని అందిస్తుంది. ఈ కోర్సులో, మీరు ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలం యొక్క ప్రాథమిక సూత్రాలు, దాని ప్రయోజనాలు మరియు GeM ప్లాట్‌ఫారమ్‌లో దాని ఆచరణాత్మక అనువర్తనం గురించి తెలుసుకుంటారు. వేలంపాటను సృష్టించడం, రిజర్వ్ ధరను నిర్ణయించడం, బిడ్‌లను నిర్వహించడం మరియు వేలం అనంతర ప్రక్రియలను పూర్తి చేయడం వంటి దశల వారీ మార్గదర్శకత్వం అందించబడుతుంది. అంతేకాకుండా, పోటీలో ముందుండటానికి ప్రభావవంతమైన బిడ్డింగ్ వ్యూహాలు మరియు ధరల నిర్ణయ పద్ధతులపై కూడా చర్చించబడుతుంది. ఈ కోర్సు GeM విధానాలు మరియు నిబంధనలకు అనుగుణంగా ఉండటం యొక్క ప్రాముఖ్యతను నొక్కి చెబుతుంది. ఈ శిక్షణను పూర్తి చేసిన తర్వాత, మీరు GeMలో ఫార్వర్డ్ వేలంలో నమ్మకంగా పాల్గొనగలరు, మీ అమ్మకాల అవకాశాలను పెంచుకోగలరు మరియు ప్రభుత్వ సేకరణ ప్రక్రియకు సమర్థవంతంగా దోహదపడగలరు.

title: GeMలో సేకరణ ప్రక్రియ ఉత్పత్తుల కోసం
desc: ప్రభుత్వ కొనుగోళ్లలో పారదర్శకత మరియు సామర్థ్యాన్ని పెంచడానికి ప్రభుత్వ ఇ-మార్కెట్‌ప్లేస్ (GeM) ఒక కీలకమైన వేదిక. ఈ కోర్సు ప్రత్యేకంగా ప్రభుత్వ కొనుగోలుదారుల కోసం రూపొందించబడింది, GeM పోర్టల్ ద్వారా ఉత్పత్తులను సేకరించే ప్రక్రియను సులభతరం చేయడానికి ఇది సహాయపడుతుంది. ఈ కోర్సులో, మీరు GeMలో అందుబాటులో ఉన్న వివిధ కొనుగోలు పద్ధతుల గురించి నేర్చుకుంటారు. ప్రత్యక్ష కొనుగోలు (బిడ్డింగ్ లేకుండా), అత్యల్ప బిడ్డర్ నుండి కొనుగోలు చేసే L1 పద్ధతి, మరియు పోటీతత్వ ధరల కోసం బిడ్‌లను సృష్టించడం వంటి కీలక అంశాలు వివరంగా చర్చించబడతాయి. అంతేకాకుండా, ఒక సాధారణ బిడ్‌ను రివర్స్ ఆక్షన్ (RA)గా ఎలా మార్చాలో కూడా ఈ కోర్సు వివరిస్తుంది, ఇది మరింత పోటీతత్వ ధరలను పొందడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది. ఈ శిక్షణను పూర్తి చేసిన తర్వాత, అభ్యాసకులు GeM పోర్టల్‌ను ఆత్మవిశ్వాసంతో నావిగేట్ చేయగలరు, తమ సంస్థ అవసరాలకు తగిన కొనుగోలు పద్ధతిని ఎంచుకోగలరు మరియు ప్రభుత్వ సేకరణ నియమాలకు అనుగుణంగా కొనుగోలు ప్రక్రియను విజయవంతంగా పూర్తి చేయగలరు.

title: Gen AI and AR-VR Fundamentals
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, understanding the tools that shape our future is essential for effective governance. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to Generative AI, Augmented Reality (AR), and Virtual Reality (VR). Participants will delve into the fundamental principles of these technologies, learning how they function and the potential they hold. The curriculum explores a variety of real-world applications, providing insight into how Gen AI, AR, and VR can be leveraged to enhance public services, improve citizen engagement, and drive innovation within the public sector. A significant focus is placed on responsible technology use, with a dedicated module on the importance of protecting one's digital identity and data. By the end of this course, learners will have a solid grasp of these transformative technologies, enabling them to contribute to a digitally empowered and secure governance ecosystem.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: GenAI :Enhancing Public Sector Efficiency
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of Generative AI's impact on public sector operations and service delivery. It is designed to equip public officials with the knowledge to navigate the rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence. The session begins by demystifying core concepts, including large language models (LLMs), reasoning engines, and multimodal capabilities, using live demonstrations of technologies like GPT-4O. Key learning areas include understanding how AI can see, hear, and think to solve complex problems, from analyzing insurance claims to enhancing citizen interaction through conversational agents. The course emphasizes the practical application of these tools to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and foster data-driven policy development. Furthermore, it critically examines the associated challenges, such as hallucinations, ethical implications, data privacy, and the importance of creating responsible AI frameworks. By the end of this course, learners will be able to identify potential use cases for Generative AI within their domains and appreciate the strategic considerations for its successful and ethical implementation in government.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: GenAI for Everyone
desc: Embark on a journey into the world of Generative AI to understand one of the most significant technological disruptions of our time. This introductory course is designed for a general audience, with no prior technical expertise required. It begins by demystifying GenAI, explaining its evolution from traditional AI and the foundational models, like Large Language Models (LLMs), that power it. You will explore a wide array of practical applications, seeing how GenAI is already revolutionizing industries by generating creative content, assisting in complex research, and personalizing user experiences. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the ethical dimensions of AI. You will analyze challenges such as bias, data privacy, and accountability, learning to apply principles of human-centered design and responsible engineering. Learners will also be introduced to practical skills like prompt engineering to effectively interact with AI tools. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the foundational knowledge to navigate the AI-driven landscape, appreciate its potential, and advocate for its ethical use in any professional context.

title: Gender at the Workplace
desc: In today's professional landscape, understanding and addressing gender-related issues is crucial for building fair and effective organizations. This course delves into the core concepts of gender, moving beyond biology to analyze the social and cultural constructs that influence workplace interactions. It is designed specifically for public servants, highlighting why gender neutrality and sensitivity are paramount in a system expected to deliver equitable service to all citizens. Key learning areas include identifying and challenging conscious and unconscious biases, understanding the effects of patriarchy on career progression, and recognizing the subtle dynamics that can marginalize colleagues. Participants will learn to apply principles of empathy and respect in their daily interactions and communications. By the end of the course, learners will be empowered with the knowledge and tools to not only foster a more inclusive personal practice but also to contribute to the development of gender-equitable policies and a healthier organizational culture.

title: Gender Budgeting (Advanced)
desc: This course delves into the advanced principles and practices of Gender Budgeting, designed for officials involved in public finance and policy-making. It moves beyond introductory concepts to provide a robust framework for integrating a gender perspective into the entire budgetary process. Participants will explore the context of why gender-sensitive budgets are crucial for inclusive development and good governance. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the five-step framework for gender budgeting, hands-on application of analytical tools like gender-disaggregated beneficiary assessments and tax incidence analysis, and the methodology for preparing a formal Gender Budget Statement. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to critically appraise policies for their gender impact, advocate for equitable resource allocation, and contribute to a more transparent and accountable public financial management system that actively promotes gender equality.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Gender Budgeting - Basic
desc: This foundational course provides a comprehensive overview of Gender Budgeting, designed for public officials seeking to integrate a gender perspective into fiscal policy and public expenditure. The curriculum begins by clarifying the core concepts of gender and its significance as a development issue, setting the stage for understanding the 'why' behind Gender Budgeting. It then delves into the international recognition and evolution of Gender Budgeting, with a specific focus on its implementation and status within India. Participants will learn about the key institutional mechanisms, including the role of the Budget Circular and the structure of the Gender Budget Statement (GBS). The course also examines the primary objectives of the Gender Budgeting scheme and showcases good practices from both national and state levels. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize the importance of gender-responsive fiscal planning and understand the tools available to analyze and shape budgets for more equitable outcomes.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Gender Equality and Development – Overview
desc: This course offers an essential introduction to the principles of gender equality and its pivotal role in shaping development outcomes. It is designed for public sector professionals seeking to understand the foundational aspects of gender mainstreaming. The course delves into why gender equality is a core development objective, exploring its connections to poverty reduction, economic growth, and improved governance. Throughout the modules, participants will be introduced to key concepts and international frameworks that guide efforts in this domain. The curriculum will touch upon the economic case for gender equality, often referred to as 'smart economics,' and review findings from influential publications like the World Development Report. Learners will analyze the multi-faceted nature of gender disparities and the importance of creating inclusive policies. By the end of this course, participants will be better equipped to recognize the significance of gender in their respective fields and contribute to more equitable and effective public service delivery.

title: Gender Equality and Development: An Overview
desc: This course offers an essential introduction to the principles of gender equality and its pivotal role in shaping development outcomes. It is designed for public sector professionals seeking to understand the foundational aspects of gender mainstreaming. The course delves into why gender equality is a core development objective, exploring its connections to poverty reduction, economic growth, and improved governance. Throughout the modules, participants will be introduced to key concepts and international frameworks that guide efforts in this domain. The curriculum will touch upon the economic case for gender equality, often referred to as 'smart economics,' and review findings from influential publications like the World Development Report. Learners will analyze the multi-faceted nature of gender disparities and the importance of creating inclusive policies.

title: Gender Equality and Energy
desc: This course provides a comprehensive examination of the intersection between gender equality and the energy sector, a crucial area for sustainable development. It addresses why energy access is not gender-neutral and how energy poverty disproportionately affects women and girls, limiting their educational, economic, and social opportunities. The curriculum delves into the specific challenges women face, from the health risks of traditional cooking fuels to their underrepresentation in the energy workforce. Learners will explore the multifaceted benefits of gender-inclusive energy policies, including enhanced economic empowerment for women, improved household well-being, and more effective climate action. The course will equip public officials, policy planners, and development practitioners with the analytical tools to integrate a gender perspective into energy projects and policies. Upon completion, participants will be able to identify gender-specific barriers and opportunities within the energy value chain, advocate for gender-responsive energy solutions, and contribute to creating a more equitable and sustainable energy future for all.

title: Gender Equality and Sensitisation in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides Indian Railways employees with a comprehensive and practical understanding of gender sensitisation and its importance in fostering a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace. The course explores key concepts related to gender, gender roles, workplace realities, unconscious bias, stereotypes, and barriers to equal opportunities. Learners will examine how individual attitudes, behaviours, and organisational culture can influence workplace experiences, employee participation, and organisational effectiveness. The course also introduces government initiatives and provisions for women employees, along with the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) framework. It covers the process for reporting and addressing complaints, the responsibilities of employees, and the role and functions of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC).
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy

title: Gender Inclusion in the National Rural Livelihoods Mission
desc: This course explores the gender dimensions of rural livelihoods with a focus on gender mainstreaming, women’s empowerment, and inclusive development under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM). It examines key concepts such as gender equality, gender equity, gender-based discrimination, social norms, women’s rights, and gender-responsive governance. The course highlights the role of community institutions, including Self-Help Groups (SHGs), Village Organizations (VOs), and Cluster Level Federations (CLFs), in promoting women’s leadership, addressing gender-related challenges, improving access to livelihood opportunities, and fostering social transformation. Learners will also gain insights into gender-sensitive planning, implementation, and monitoring frameworks that support equitable and sustainable rural development.

title: Gender Justice and Child Protection
desc: This course provides an in-depth analysis of the legal reforms concerning offences against women and children as codified in the new criminal laws: the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA). It addresses the critical need for public officials, particularly in law enforcement and the judiciary, to understand and apply these updated statutes effectively. Key learning areas include the structural re-organization of laws into a dedicated chapter, the introduction of new offences like sexual intercourse by deceitful means, and mandatory time-bound procedures for investigations and trials. The curriculum emphasizes victim-centric measures such as the recording of statements by female officers, free medical treatment for victims, and enhanced evidentiary protections that disregard a victim's past character.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Gender Mainstreaming and Gender Sensitization - English
desc: This course delves into the essential principles of gender mainstreaming and its application within the agricultural landscape. It begins by establishing the context of women's significant contributions to agriculture, which are frequently overlooked in official statistics and development planning. The curriculum covers key concepts such as the feminization of agriculture, gender-based division of labor, and the socio-cultural and legal barriers that hinder women's progress. Participants will learn to use gender analysis frameworks to dissect the roles, needs, and constraints of men and women in farming communities. The course further examines the shortcomings of existing support systems, including extension services and financial institutions, and proposes strategies for making them more gender-responsive. By the end, learners will be prepared to advocate for and contribute to the design and implementation of equitable policies that unlock the full potential of all participants in the agricultural sector, thereby strengthening food security and promoting sustainable development.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: Gender Sensitisation
desc: This course on Gender Sensitisation is designed to build fundamental awareness and understanding of gender-related issues within a professional context. It delves into the social and cultural construction of gender, encouraging participants to move beyond binary notions and critically examine how stereotypes shape attitudes and institutions. The curriculum focuses on identifying and mitigating unconscious biases that affect workplace interactions and opportunities. Key learning areas include the differentiation between gender and sex, the impact of stereotypes, the role of empathy in fostering inclusivity, and an overview of legal protections against gender discrimination in India. By completing this course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge and perspective needed to promote respectful behavior, challenge discriminatory norms, and contribute to creating a psychologically safe and equitable environment for all colleagues.

title: Gender Sensitisation
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of gender sensitization. It begins by establishing the fundamental difference between 'sex' as a biological attribute and 'gender' as a socio-cultural construct, explaining how roles and expectations are shaped by family, education, and media. The curriculum delves into the concepts of gender stereotyping, the distinction between equality and equity, and the real-world impact of gender inequality, supported by data from the Gender Inequality Index. The course also touches upon legal frameworks designed to protect and uplift women, such as the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act. By the end of this program, learners will be equipped to recognize and challenge their own biases, advocate for gender-sensitive practices, and contribute to creating a positive, respectful, and equitable professional environment for all.

title: Gender Sensitivity
desc: This course is designed to equip public sector employees with the knowledge and tools to understand and address gender-related issues in the workplace. It provides a structured exploration of gender sensitivity, starting with the core concepts of sex versus gender and how societal norms influence our behaviors and expectations. The program is divided into three key sessions: understanding gender and bias, analyzing gender stereotyping, and implementing organizational strategies for diversity and inclusion (D&I). Learners will explore the real-world impact of issues like the glass ceiling, motherhood bias, and sexual harassment. The course emphasizes practical application, guiding participants on how to identify and mitigate biases in processes like hiring and promotions, use data to track progress, and foster a psychologically safe environment. Ultimately, this course empowers individuals and leaders to champion gender parity, contributing to a more respectful, fair, and productive organizational culture.

title: Gender Sensitivity and Women Empowerment in Indian Railways
desc: This course on Gender Sensitivity and the POSH Act aims to build awareness around gender equality, respectful workplace behaviour, and the prevention of sexual harassment at the workplace. It provides participants with an understanding of the provisions of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act), along with the roles and responsibilities of employees and employers, and the mechanisms available for complaint redressal. The course promotes the development of a safe, inclusive, and professional work environment for all employees. It also provides guidance for railway officials, field staff, and other stakeholders in creating gender-inclusive environments where women feel safe, comfortable, and empowered. Through thoughtful design, improved facilities, and strengthened safety measures, the course supports the creation of a more secure and comfortable experience for female passengers.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy

title: Gender Sensitization - 1
desc: In today's public service, creating an equitable and inclusive work environment is paramount. This course on Gender Sensitization provides a comprehensive introduction to the core principles and practices that support this goal. It addresses the critical need for all government employees to understand and navigate gender-related issues with sensitivity and professionalism. Key learning areas include defining the differences between gender, sex, equity, and equality; identifying and challenging harmful stereotypes and unconscious biases; and understanding the legal frameworks that protect against discrimination and harassment. Learners will explore how gender dynamics influence workplace interactions and decision-making. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to apply principles of gender sensitivity in their daily conduct, communication, and collaboration, contributing to a safer, more respectful, and productive organizational culture that values diversity and promotes fairness for everyone.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Gender Sensitization -2
desc: This course, 'Gender Sensitization - 2', provides an in-depth exploration of gender mainstreaming and gender budgeting as essential tools for equitable governance. Building on basic awareness, this module is designed for public officials who are in a position to influence policy and resource allocation. The course will unpack the concept of gender mainstreaming, detailing the processes required to systematically integrate gender perspectives into all government policies, programs, and projects. It will demonstrate how this approach moves beyond treating gender as a separate issue and instead embeds it into the core functions of public administration. Furthermore, learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of gender budgeting, a powerful method for analyzing government budgets to assess their impact on women and men. The course covers the tools and techniques for preparing and implementing gender-responsive budgets, ensuring that public expenditure promotes gender equality. Upon completion, participants will be capable of identifying gender gaps in public services, advocating for necessary changes, and applying practical frameworks for mainstreaming and budgeting within their respective domains. This will contribute to creating a more just, inclusive, and responsive public service environment.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Gender Sensitization for an Inclusive and Equitable Workplace
desc: In today's public service, creating an equitable and inclusive work environment is paramount. This course on Gender Sensitization provides a comprehensive introduction to the core principles and practices that support this goal. It addresses the critical need for all government employees to understand and navigate gender-related issues with sensitivity and professionalism. Key learning areas include defining the differences between gender, sex, equity, and equality; identifying and challenging harmful stereotypes and unconscious biases; and understanding the legal frameworks that protect against discrimination and harassment. Learners will explore how gender dynamics influence workplace interactions and decision-making.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: General Conditions of Service in Fundamental and Supplementary Rules
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Fundamental Rules (FR) and Supplementary Rules (SR), which constitute the legal framework for service conditions within the Indian government. Understanding these rules is crucial for any public servant, as they govern every aspect of an employee's lifecycle, from appointment to retirement. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear understanding of the purpose, scope, and application of these regulations. Key learning areas include detailed provisions on appointments, pay fixation, leave entitlements, transfers, and deputation. The course also covers the nuances of official conduct, disciplinary procedures, and the rights and responsibilities of government employees. Through practical examples and case scenarios, learners will move beyond theoretical knowledge to gain practical application skills. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply FR and SR in their daily work, handle complex service-related matters, and make informed decisions that align with legal and procedural requirements. This will enhance administrative efficiency, promote transparency, and ensure fairness and consistency in personnel management across government departments.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: General Conditions of Service: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Fundamental Rules (FR) and Supplementary Rules (SR), which constitute the legal framework for service conditions within the Indian government. Understanding these rules is crucial for any public servant, as they govern every aspect of an employee's lifecycle, from appointment to retirement. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear understanding of the purpose, scope, and application of these regulations. Key learning areas include detailed provisions on appointments, pay fixation, leave entitlements, transfers, and deputation. The course also covers the nuances of official conduct, disciplinary procedures, and the rights and responsibilities of government employees. Through practical examples and case scenarios, learners will move beyond theoretical knowledge to gain practical application skills.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: General Data Protection Regulation- Digital Personal Data Protection
desc: In an increasingly interconnected digital world, understanding the legalities of cross-border data transfers is crucial for any organization. This course delves into the critical aspects of international data privacy regulations, with a primary focus on the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You will gain a detailed understanding of the Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA), a process mandated by GDPR to ensure that personal data transferred outside the EU is adequately protected. The course systematically breaks down the six essential steps of conducting a TIA, from mapping data flows to implementing supplementary safeguards. Furthermore, the session draws a comparative analysis with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, highlighting its government-led adequacy framework. Learners will be equipped to assess third-country laws, manage vendor relationships, and document compliance effectively. By the end of this course, you will be able to apply these legal principles to mitigate risks and ensure your organization's data handling practices align with global standards.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: General Exceptions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the general exceptions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. It explores circumstances in which acts do not constitute a criminal offence, including actions taken under legal authority, accidents, prevention of harm, absence of criminal intention, incapacity, insanity, intoxication, consent, good faith, compulsion, and the right of private defence. Through statutory provisions and practical illustrations, learners will gain clarity on how these exceptions operate, enabling accurate interpretation and application of criminal law principles.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: General Financial Rules
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, a critical framework for any official dealing with public funds. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of financial management systems within the central government. Key learning areas include the standards of financial propriety, budget implementation, and government accounting procedures. The course delves into the specifics of procuring goods and services, with a focus on modern digital platforms like the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and the Public Finance Management System (PFMS). Furthermore, it covers the complete lifecycle of government projects, including the management of works, inventory, and contracts. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these rules to ensure all financial transactions are conducted with the utmost integrity, accountability, and efficiency, thereby contributing to robust and transparent governance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: General Life Saving Rules
desc: In any industrial environment, ensuring the safety of all personnel is paramount. This course, 'Fundamentals of General Life Saving Rules for Workplace Safety,' provides the essential knowledge required to prevent accidents and foster a secure workplace. It is designed for all employees to understand and internalize a core set of non-negotiable safety rules that save lives. The curriculum delves into the basic principles of workplace safety, emphasizing hazard identification, risk mitigation, and the importance of procedural compliance. Participants will explore their personal responsibility in upholding safety standards, learning not only to follow the rules but also to encourage colleagues to do the same. A key focus is on proactive intervention, empowering individuals to take corrective action when they observe non-compliance and to exercise their authority to stop work if conditions are unsafe. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently apply these life-saving rules, contributing to a robust safety culture and minimizing the potential for workplace incidents.

title: General Statutory Rules and Orders Made Under Acts in the India Code
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Statutory Rules and Orders (SROs) made under Acts in India, a key aspect of delegated or subordinate legislation. Participants will explore how rules, orders, and regulations—issued under the authority of Parliament or State Legislatures—translate the intent of primary legislation into actionable procedures and administrative frameworks. The course covers the legal foundations, procedural mechanisms, and administrative steps involved in creating, amending, and repealing statutory instruments. Learners will gain familiarity with how these instruments are published, codified in the India Code, and enforced by government departments. By the end of the course, participants will be able to interpret statutory rules and orders accurately, understand their relationship with parent Acts, and apply these skills in legislative drafting, legal analysis, and compliance assessment.

title: Generative AI for Human Resources Professionals
desc:
Generative AI is becoming a practical capability for people-focused functions, including recruitment, employee communication, HR operations, engagement analysis, and workforce decision support. This course helps HR professionals, government department leaders, and Indian Administrative Services officers use large language models responsibly in workplace settings.

Across three modules, learners explore how Generative AI works, its limitations, and effective prompting techniques for HR tasks. Through videos, readings, and quizzes, participants learn to create prompts for hiring, resume screening, interviews, candidate communication, onboarding, compliance checks, HR chatbots, sentiment analysis, and retention insights.

The course emphasizes human judgment, fairness, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI use. Learners examine bias, hallucinations, verification methods, and best practices. No coding is required.
keywords: AI for Strategic HR Functions & Workforce Analytics

title: Generative AI in Public Policy and Governance
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the role Generative AI is playing in revolutionizing public policy and governance. It establishes a foundational understanding of Gen AI, highlighting its unique capabilities in simulating future scenarios and automating complex administrative tasks. The curriculum delves into key application areas, including how AI can refine policy analysis, foster greater public engagement, and enable robust, data-driven decision-making. Participants will explore the use of predictive modeling for anticipating and mitigating crises, such as economic disruptions or natural disasters. Furthermore, the course addresses how AI-generated insights can enhance transparency and help identify and correct biases in public systems. It also covers the critical ethical, legal, and technical limitations of Generative AI, equipping learners to evaluate both its potential and its challenges. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to critically assess and apply Generative AI concepts to improve public service delivery and governance frameworks.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani)

title: Genome Editing Technologies: Principles and Applications
desc: This course introduces the fundamentals of DNA as the blueprint of life and explains how errors or mutations in the genetic code can disrupt protein synthesis and lead to diseases. It further explains how genome editing technologies are used to precisely correct these genetic errors and restore normal biological function. The course highlights applications of genome editing in medicine, particularly in the treatment of genetic blood disorders such as sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia, where defective genes are corrected in patient stem cells and reintroduced to produce healthy blood cells. It also covers therapeutic applications in diseases such as haemophilia, cystic fibrosis, cholesterol disorders (PCSK9), lysosomal storage disorders, and potential interventions for HIV/AIDS through CCR5 gene editing.
org: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

title: Geo Urja E Vidhyut Map of Gujarat
desc: This training program offers an in-depth guide to modernizing electrical distribution management using the Geo Urja platform. The course is designed for professionals in the power distribution sector, providing the necessary skills to transition from paper-based records to a fully digital, dynamic network map. Participants will learn the fundamentals of GPS/GIS technology and its application in creating an accurate, editable digital twin of the electrical grid. Key learning areas include hands-on instruction for the Easy Survey mobile application for field data collection, navigating the DISCOM dashboard for network analysis, and conducting technical feasibility studies for new connections. The curriculum also delves into specialized systems such as the Outage Management System (OMS) for monitoring and reducing downtime, the Meter Data Management System (MDMS) for energy auditing, and the Revenue Management System (RMS) for improving recovery processes. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the Geo Urja suite to improve operational efficiency, ensure accurate data management, and support strategic decision-making within their distribution company.
org: Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Ltd - GUVNL

title: Geographic Information System based Master Plan for Urban Development
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the formulation of GIS-based Master Plans, a key reform under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT). It addresses the challenge of traditional, static master planning by demonstrating how Geographic Information System (GIS) technology enables a more dynamic, data-driven, and efficient planning process. Participants will learn the entire workflow of creating a GIS-based Master Plan, starting from the development of a common digital geo-referenced base map to the final formulation of land use proposals. The course covers key technical aspects, including data collection, creation of thematic layers, spatial analysis, and the integration of attribute data. It is designed to equip town planners and urban managers with the foundational knowledge to oversee and utilize GIS technology for effective land use management, spatial growth management, and informed decision-making in urban development.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Geographical Information System
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip decision-makers and public officials with a thorough understanding of Geographical Information Systems (GIS). It addresses the growing need for data-driven insights in governance by explaining how spatial data can transform planning and service delivery. The course begins with the core concepts of GIS, its evolution, and its components, including hardware, software, and data. Key learning areas include a deep dive into spatial data models, distinguishing between raster and vector representations of real-world phenomena. Participants will learn about the importance of map projections, coordinate systems, and the principles of topology that ensure data integrity. The curriculum also emphasizes the significance of data quality, covering elements like positional accuracy, completeness, and logical consistency.

title: Geographical Information System
desc: This introductory course is designed to build a strong foundation in Geographical Information Systems (GIS) for professionals seeking to harness the power of spatial data. The program begins by establishing the context of GIS in modern governance and its importance for evidence-based planning and analysis. Learners will be guided through the entire GIS workflow, from data acquisition to final output. Key learning areas include a detailed exploration of GIS data structures, where participants will learn to differentiate between vector and raster models and understand their respective use cases. The course covers critical cartographic principles, such as interpreting Survey of India (SOI) toposheets, understanding map projections, and working with scale. Practical processes like digitization, scanning, and georeferencing are explained in detail, highlighting potential errors and methods to ensure data integrity. Furthermore, participants will be introduced to powerful analytical techniques, including the use of Digital Elevation Models (DEM), overlay analysis, and proximity analysis to derive meaningful insights from geographic data. Upon completion, learners will be able to identify the appropriate GIS tools and methodologies for their specific needs and apply them to solve real-world problems, making it a vital skill for roles in urban planning, environmental management, infrastructure development, and public policy.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India
keywords: GIS, Components, scanning, Digitization, Buffer Analysis, DEM, DSM, Applications.

title: Geological Mapping Techniques in Flood Basalt Provinces
desc: Embark on a detailed exploration of geological mapping with this specialized course focused on Flood Basalt Provinces. Designed for aspiring and practicing geoscientists, this program demystifies the complex processes of mapping vast volcanic landscapes like the Deccan Traps. The course is structured into six comprehensive sessions, beginning with an introduction to volcanoes, Large Igneous Provinces (LIPs), and the characteristics of continental flood basalts. You will learn to distinguish various mafic lava flows such as Pahoehoe and A'a, analyze their morphology, and understand their emplacement mechanisms. The curriculum delves into identifying crucial interflow horizons, intrusives like dykes and sills, and other significant geological components. The final sessions consolidate this knowledge by teaching the practical steps of building lithological sections, correlating data across different traverses, and ultimately preparing a professional geological map and cross-section. The course concludes by touching upon advanced multi-disciplinary approaches, including chemostratigraphy, to ensure a holistic understanding of regional geological evolution.

title: Geological Methods Analysis and Evaluation
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the geological methods and evaluation techniques integral to modern coal exploration. It provides the foundational knowledge required to transition from academic principles to practical field application. The curriculum covers the entire process, from initial core drilling and logging to sophisticated laboratory testing for coal quality parameters like ash fusion, grindability, and caking properties. Participants will learn to classify coal into coking, non-coking, and semi-caking types, a critical step in determining its commercial value. A significant focus is placed on seam correlation methods to understand the continuity and structure of coal seams beneath the surface. Furthermore, the course outlines the critical factors affecting mining feasibility, such as overburden ratio, seam thickness, and surface features. By learning to interpret geological maps and cross-sections, participants will be able to build robust subsurface models. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying standard industry practices for reliable coal resource evaluation and strategic mine planning.

title: Geophysical Logging in Mineral Exploration
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip geoscientists and exploration professionals with a robust understanding of geophysical logging techniques. The program begins by outlining the fundamentals of borehole geophysics and its importance in accurately assessing subsurface mineral deposits. You will delve into the operational principles of essential logging tools, including resistivity, gamma, density, and sonic probes, learning how to interpret the data they generate. The curriculum emphasizes practical application, featuring real-world case studies from diverse mineral exploration projects such as coal, potash, and base metals. These examples demonstrate how to integrate log data to refine geological models, correlate strata, and guide mine planning. Furthermore, the course addresses the future of the field by introducing emerging technologies like AI-assisted log interpretation and real-time data analysis. Upon completion, you will be prepared to leverage geophysical logging to enhance exploration efficiency, improve resource evaluation, and contribute to more sustainable mining practices.

title: Geospatial Applications for Geological and Water Resource Management
desc: Effective management of geological and water resources requires timely, spatially detailed information about the Earth’s surface and subsurface. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of how satellite imagery and geospatial technologies are used to interpret drainage patterns, landforms, and erosion, and how these insights inform groundwater mapping, landslide prediction, and mineral exploration. Learners will also explore how hyperspectral remote sensing is used to detect mineral deposits, and how continuous monitoring of water bodies, soil moisture, snowmelt, and evapotranspiration supports irrigation, hydropower, drinking-water security, and planning for floods, droughts, and other hydrological hazards. The course highlights practical applications, national platforms, and tools for geospatial analysis in resource management.
org: Department of Space and ISRO HQ

title: Geospatial Applications in Agriculture and Rural Planning
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of remote sensing applications in atmospheric and marine sciences. It introduces learners to techniques for atmospheric profiling, gas and aerosol measurements, and weather monitoring using visible, infrared, and microwave satellite data. The course also covers ocean parameters such as temperature, colour, winds, waves, and marine hazard monitoring. Learners gain insight into how satellite observations, combined with modelling systems, support climate studies, environmental management, and forecasting of weather and ocean conditions. Practical examples illustrate how remote sensing informs decision-making in meteorology, oceanography, and environmental monitoring.
org: Department of Space and ISRO HQ

title: Geospatial Data Analysis with LiDAR and GNSS
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of LiDAR, GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems), and AI/ML approaches for satellite data analysis. Participants will learn how LiDAR laser pulses are transmitted, how their reflections are received, and the type of information that can be extracted from this point-based data. The course explains how to process vast amounts of LiDAR data and generate digital elevation models for analyzing land features and underwater terrain. Through the example of GPS, learners will understand the planning and processing of GNSS missions, as well as common errors that may occur. The course further explores AI and ML architectures, demonstrating how these techniques can be applied to satellite data for practical use cases such as crop mapping, crop yield estimation, land use/land cover assessment, deforestation monitoring, and ship detection.
org: Department of Space and ISRO HQ

title: Geospatial Data: Threshold values and Negative Attributes
desc: This course provides comprehensive knowledge and skills related to threshold values, negative attributes, and Geospatial Data Standards. Participants will gain a clear understanding of the Geospatial Guidelines and the threshold values required for geospatial data acquisition. The course covers the differentiation of applicability for Indian and foreign entities under NGP-2022, explains key definitions from the guidelines, and analyzes regulations related to negative attributes. Additionally, it addresses geospatial data standards to ensure proper data quality and compliance in geospatial projects. By the end of this course, learners will be able to navigate geospatial data acquisition processes effectively and apply standards and regulations in real-world scenarios.

title: Geospatial Surveying with Ground Penetrating Radar
desc: This course describes the fundamental principles of GPR technology, the working principle of GPR, key components of GPR, applications and advantages of GPR, limitations of GPR, recent advancements in GPR technology, and the procedure and data formats for converting GPR data into GIS.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Geospatial Technology in Forestry and Wildlife Resource Management
desc: In an era where data-driven decisions are crucial for sustainable environmental stewardship, this course offers a comprehensive introduction to Geospatial Technology. It is designed for professionals in forestry, wildlife management, and environmental sciences who need to understand and utilize spatial data. The course begins by defining Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and demystifying its five core components: hardware, software, data, people, and methods. Learners will gain a solid understanding of fundamental cartographic principles, including map scale, legends, and coordinate systems. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the two primary GIS data models, vector and raster, explaining their structures and use cases through practical examples. The curriculum then transitions to demonstrate the power of GIS in real-world scenarios. Participants will examine how this technology is applied for critical tasks such as wildlife habitat mapping, tracking species movement, monitoring forest fires, and conducting comprehensive forest resource assessments. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply GIS concepts for enhanced planning, effective monitoring, and strategic management of vital forestry and wildlife resources.
org: Chandrapur Forest Academy of Administration and Management

title: Gesture Controlled Robot
desc: Embark on a journey into the exciting field of robotics with this detailed course on creating a gesture-controlled robot. Designed for beginners, this program demystifies the process of building complex electronic projects from the ground up. The course begins with an introduction to the Arduino ecosystem, guiding you through software installation and basic programming syntax. You will then progress to more advanced topics, including how to control DC motors using an L293D motor driver module, enabling your robot to move. A key learning area is wireless communication, where you will learn to use an RF transmitter and receiver pair to send commands remotely. The course also provides an in-depth look at using an ADXL335 accelerometer to interpret hand gestures as control inputs. The final modules integrate all these skills, walking you through the complete assembly, wiring, and programming of the robot. Upon completion, you will not only have a working gesture-controlled robot but also a solid foundation in embedded systems and human-machine interaction, with an understanding of its potential applications in fields like defence and automation.

title: Getting Better Responses from ChatGPT and Other AI Tools
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to prompt engineering for government officials seeking to leverage Generative AI tools like ChatGPT. As artificial intelligence becomes integral to modern governance, the ability to communicate effectively with AI is a critical skill. The curriculum begins with the foundational principles of how Large Language Models (LLMs) process prompts, distinguishing this new skill from traditional search queries. Participants will explore the key elements of a well-structured prompt and learn through practical examples how to achieve desired outputs for various administrative tasks. Key learning areas include using AI for summarizing lengthy reports, analyzing datasets for actionable insights, drafting official communications, and supporting complex decision-making processes. The course also delves into advanced prompting techniques to give learners greater control over AI responses.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Getting Started with EI: Importance for Growth in Government Service
desc: In the dynamic and demanding environment of public service, Emotional Intelligence (EI) is a cornerstone of professional success and personal well-being. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to EI, designed specifically for government employees. It begins by defining the core components of emotional intelligence, such as self-awareness, self-regulation, empathy, and social skills. The curriculum then delves into the practical application of these skills to address typical workplace challenges, including stress management, conflict resolution, and effective leadership. Participants will learn how to leverage EI to build stronger relationships with colleagues and citizens, make more balanced decisions, and foster a more positive and productive work environment. Through case studies and reflective exercises, the course aims to equip learners with the tools to not only understand EI but to actively cultivate it for sustained growth in their careers.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Getting Started with Emotional Intelligence: The Foundations
desc: Embark on a journey to understand one of the most critical skills for modern professionals: Emotional Intelligence (EI). This introductory course provides a comprehensive overview of the foundational concepts of EI, designed for individuals at all levels of an organization. You will delve into the origins of Emotional Intelligence, its core components—self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, and relationship management—and learn why it is a powerful predictor of success. The curriculum explores the direct impact of emotions on cognitive processes such as decision-making and problem-solving. It highlights how a higher EI can transform team dynamics, improve communication, and cultivate resilient and inspiring leadership. Participants will learn to recognize their own emotional triggers and develop strategies for managing them constructively. This course serves as the first step towards mastering emotional intelligence, enabling you to build stronger relationships, navigate workplace challenges with greater confidence, and unlock your full professional potential.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Getting Started with Fusion Mechanical Simulation
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the Simulation workspace in Fusion 360, equipping learners with the essential skills to test, validate, and optimize mechanical designs. The curriculum is structured to guide participants through the process of setting up, running, and interpreting various simulation studies. Key learning areas include applying loads, defining constraints, and selecting appropriate materials to accurately model structural, thermal, and dynamic behaviors. The course emphasizes the practical application of simulation to make informed design decisions, identify potential failure points early, and enhance product performance. Learners will explore how to translate simulation results into actionable design improvements, thereby streamlining the development workflow and fostering innovation. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently integrate simulation into your design process, leading to more efficient, cost-effective, and reliable product outcomes.

title: Getting Started with Government e-Marketplace
desc: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has transformed public procurement in India by creating a transparent, efficient, and inclusive online platform. This foundational course is designed to equip government officials and public sector employees with the essential knowledge to effectively navigate and utilize the GeM portal. It addresses the critical need for standardized procurement practices and digital fluency within government departments. The curriculum begins with a detailed walkthrough of the registration process for both buyers and sellers, clarifying the prerequisites and steps involved. It then delves into the administrative structure of GeM accounts, defining the distinct roles and responsibilities of primary and secondary users to ensure proper governance and operational control. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to explaining the different procurement modes available on the platform, such as direct purchase, L1 buying, and reverse auctions.

title: GFR 2017- General System of Financial Management
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough working knowledge of the General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, focusing on the general system of financial management. The curriculum delves into the foundational rules for managing public money, starting with the procedures for assessing and crediting government receipts, dues, and rents. It elaborates on the standards of financial propriety that every officer must uphold to ensure economy and regularity in expenditure. Key learning areas include the specific duties and responsibilities of Controlling Officers in budget management, the complete lifecycle of a financial sanction from its effective date to its potential lapse, and the correct procedures for communicating these sanctions. Furthermore, the course provides clear guidelines on reporting, investigating, and treating losses of public money or property. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these critical rules to maintain financial order, prevent irregularities, and uphold the highest standards of fiscal integrity in their official duties.

title: GFR 2017- Procurement
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the essential knowledge and skills to navigate public procurement according to GFR 2017. It begins with the fundamental principles of public buying, emphasizing economy, fairness, and transparency. The curriculum delves into the specifics of procuring goods, both through the mandatory Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and via other methods like open and limited tenders. Learners will understand the nuances of different bidding systems, including single-bid, two-bid, two-stage bidding, and electronic reverse auctions. The course also provides detailed guidance on the procurement of consulting and non-consulting services, outlining methods for consultant selection such as Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS). Furthermore, it covers the procedures for executing works, from administrative approval to contract management. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in applying GFR 2017 rules to ensure compliance and achieve value for money in all public procurement activities.

title: Ghat Section in Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the remarkable world of India's mountain railways, which stand as monuments to engineering ingenuity and human perseverance. This course offers a detailed exploration of the Ghat sections, explaining their critical importance in the nation's development and connectivity. You will learn about the geographical context and the necessity that drove the construction of these complex railway lines through rugged terrains like the Himalayas and Western Ghats. The curriculum covers the unique engineering features, including steep gradients, narrow gauges, rack-and-pinion systems, and intricate networks of tunnels and bridges. The course also examines the significant challenges faced, such as landslides and maintenance, and the modern solutions being implemented to ensure safety and sustainability. By the end, learners will have a deep appreciation for these heritage railways, their contribution to tourism and regional growth, and the ongoing efforts to preserve them for future generations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: GitHub Copilot: Increasing Developer Productivity
desc: Dive into the future of software development with this in-depth course on GitHub Copilot. Designed for developers at all levels, this program explores how generative AI is revolutionizing the coding landscape. The course begins by explaining the core concepts behind GitHub Copilot, its integration with popular IDEs like Visual Studio Code, and its foundation in large language models. You will learn practical skills through hands-on demonstrations, covering key learning areas such as automated code generation, intelligent suggestions, and converting natural language comments into functional code blocks. The curriculum extends to advanced applications, including using Copilot for debugging, identifying security vulnerabilities, handling errors, and optimizing complex SQL queries for better performance. Participants will also discover how to use the tool to generate test scripts and create comprehensive code documentation, enhancing code quality and maintainability. By mastering GitHub Copilot, you will be able to build high-quality software more efficiently, transforming your development process and embracing a new era of AI-assisted coding.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: GitHub Enterprise
desc: Dive deep into the world of distributed version control with this detailed course on Git and GitHub Enterprise. Starting with the foundational principles of version control, you will learn why Git is the industry standard and how it differs from GitHub. The curriculum guides you through the practical steps of installing and configuring Git on your local machine, mastering essential commands like `add`, `commit`, `push`, and `pull`. You will gain hands-on experience in creating and managing repositories, working with branches to develop features in isolation, and integrating them back into the main project using pull requests and merges. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to collaborative workflows, teaching you how to effectively review code, resolve merge conflicts, and maintain a clean project history. Furthermore, you will be introduced to the power of automation with GitHub Actions, learning to build, test, and deploy applications directly from your repository. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in using Git and GitHub to manage software projects of any scale, fostering innovation and maintaining enterprise-grade standards in a secure environment.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Global Context: Dynamics of Gas Markets
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the global gas markets, designed for professionals seeking a detailed understanding of their operational dynamics. It provides the context for why this topic is critical, examining how supply-demand imbalances, pricing mechanisms, and the interplay of major producers and consumers influence international gas flows. Key learning areas include the analysis of regulatory and governance frameworks that shape global gas trade, and the critical impact of geopolitical developments on supply security and price volatility. Learners will be equipped with the analytical tools to assess market trading practices and risk mitigation strategies. By integrating macro-level perspectives on global energy economics with micro-level insights into market operations, this course prepares participants to navigate the complexities of the international gas industry and identify future trends, including the integration of cleaner energy solutions.
