org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Global Context: Dynamics of Oil Markets
desc: This course provides a thorough understanding of the complex global oil market, designed for professionals seeking to navigate its intricate dynamics. It begins by tracing the historical evolution of oil trade and examining the current market structure. You will explore the fundamental principles of supply and demand, analyzing how geopolitical shifts, economic policies, and global events cause price fluctuations. The course details the strategic roles of key players, from oil-producing nations and consumer countries to influential multinational companies. Key learning areas include an examination of pricing mechanisms, international trade policies, and the regulatory frameworks governing the sector. Furthermore, the curriculum assesses the impact of technological advancements in exploration, production, and supply chain management. It concludes by addressing the critical environmental and sustainability challenges that are transforming the industry, preparing learners to anticipate future risks and opportunities in one of the world's most vital sectors.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Global Data Privacy Laws and Cross-Border Data Flow Management
desc:
This course provides a comparative analysis of global data privacy legal frameworks across the European Union, United States, India, and Saudi Arabia, with a focused examination of cross-border data transfer mechanisms. It explores the EU’s rights-based General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the United States’ sectoral approach (HIPAA, GLBA, COPPA, CCPA/CPRA), India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, and Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). The course compares these frameworks across key parameters such as jurisdiction, legal basis for processing, consent requirements, breach notification obligations, regulatory authorities, penalties, Data Protection Officer (DPO) requirements, and cross-border data transfer rules. It also traces the evolution of EU–US data transfer mechanisms, including Safe Harbor, Privacy Shield, and the EU–US Data Privacy Framework (2023). 
Target Audience: Data Protection Officers (DPOs)
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Goal Setting
desc: This course on Effective Goal Setting is designed to equip government employees with the essential skills to define, pursue, and achieve meaningful objectives. In any professional environment, the ability to set clear goals is fundamental to driving progress and ensuring accountability. This program moves beyond mere desires, teaching a deliberate process for creating actionable plans. Participants will learn from the examples of successful individuals and understand the psychological commitment required for success. The curriculum delves into the renowned SMARTER goal framework (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound, Evaluated, and Reviewed), providing a practical tool for crafting well-defined objectives. You will learn how to break down large ambitions into manageable steps, track progress consistently, and stay motivated despite challenges. Upon completion, you will be able to apply these techniques to your personal development and professional responsibilities, leading to improved performance, greater focus, and more impactful contributions to your organization's mission.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Goal Setting for Workplace Success
desc: In today's dynamic and performance-oriented work environments, the ability to set and achieve clear goals is fundamental to both individual success and organizational effectiveness. This course offers a comprehensive guide to the principles and practices of effective goal setting within a professional context. It begins by exploring the psychological foundations that drive motivation and commitment, providing a strong basis for practical application. Participants will learn the renowned SMART framework to formulate goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. The course then delves into creating actionable roadmaps, breaking down large objectives into manageable steps. Key modules cover techniques for efficient energy management, task prioritization to focus on high-impact activities, and simple yet powerful frameworks for monitoring progress. A significant focus is placed on cultivating a growth mindset, which is essential for overcoming obstacles and adapting to new challenges. By the end of this course, learners will be able to confidently set meaningful goals, align their efforts with strategic outcomes, and build a sustainable path toward continuous professional development and success.

title: Goods and Services Tax Registration Procedure for Departmental Units
desc: This course provides a comprehensive, practical understanding of the GST registration process as applicable to departmental operations, with a focus on units such as the Department of Posts. It guides participants through the complete end-to-end workflow on the GST portal, covering both Part A and Part B of the registration application. Participants will learn how to accurately enter business details, promoter and authorized signatory information, and add authorized representatives relevant to departmental entities. The course also explains how to declare the principal place of business and additional places of business, and correctly fill in the Goods and Services section using appropriate HSN (Harmonized System of Nomenclature) and Service Accounting Codes (SAC). Special emphasis is placed on capturing state-specific requirements, including electricity board details and CA information.

title: Gov.in Secure Intranet
desc: This course provides a comprehensive guide to the Gov.in Secure Intranet, a pivotal digital ecosystem for modern governance. It is designed to familiarize government officials with a one-stop solution that enhances interdepartmental efficiency and streamlines administrative tasks. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals, explaining the portal's purpose and scope as a unified platform. You will learn to navigate the interface and utilize the Single Sign-On (SSO) to access a suite of integrated services, including eMail, eOffice, BharatVC, SPARROW, and Prayas. A key focus is on the application of its AI-powered features, such as language assistance, document summarization, and phonetic search, to simplify complex tasks. By the end of the course, you will be equipped to apply the portal's functionalities to manage tasks, schedule meetings, track goals, and ultimately make more informed, data-driven decisions, contributing to a digitally empowered and productive work environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Governance Sustainability Through Indian Knowledge Systems
desc: Delve into the profound connection between India's ancient wisdom and contemporary public administration with 'Sustainable Governance through Indian Knowledge Systems.' This course provides a comprehensive overview of how foundational principles from texts like the Arthashastra, Ramayana, and Mahabharata can be applied to modern governance challenges. The curriculum is designed to bridge the gap between cultural heritage and practical leadership, offering a unique perspective on ethical decision-making and sustainable development. Key learning areas include the concept of Rajadharma (the duty of a ruler), ethical economic models for long-term stability, and strategies for fostering innovation in infrastructure inspired by classical Indian thought. The course also explores the importance of global partnerships and trade based on the principle of 'Sarbat da Bhala' (welfare of all). By integrating these timeless insights, learners will be equipped to lead with integrity, build resilient public systems, and contribute to a more equitable and sustainable world.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Governance, Risk and Compliance
desc: In an era of increasing digital threats, a robust understanding of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is critical for public sector leaders. This course offers a detailed examination of the cybersecurity landscape in India, tailored for officials responsible for protecting government information infrastructure. The curriculum begins by establishing the context, exploring the national cybersecurity policy, the legal mandates of the IT Act 2000, and the upcoming Digital India Act. It then provides an in-depth look at the operational roles of key national bodies, including CERT-In for emergency response and NCIPC for critical infrastructure protection. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical application of international standards. Learners will understand how to implement an Information Security Management System (ISMS) using ISO 27001, establish a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) with ISO 22301, and manage IT services effectively with ISO 20000. By the end of this course, participants will be able to develop a comprehensive IT governance framework, ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, and lead their organizations in proactively managing cyber risks.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Governing  with Artificial Intelligence
desc: This course, “Governing with Artificial Intelligence,” is the second part of “AI for Public Governance.” Building on the foundational AI concepts introduced earlier, it shifts the focus toward real-world applications. Rather than approaching AI as a purely technical subject, this course presents it as a strategic tool that government leaders and service providers can use to make informed decisions, strengthen institutions, and enhance public service delivery. It emphasizes the responsible integration of AI into governance systems—not only to improve efficiency, but also to foster trust, ensure accountability, build resilience, and create sustainable public value. To make these concepts practical and relatable, the course incorporates real-world use cases, enabling learners to understand how AI is already shaping governance in meaningful ways.

title: Governing Artificial Intelligence
desc: As Artificial Intelligence reshapes public services, establishing robust governance is critical for ensuring its responsible and effective use. This course delves into the essential frameworks for governing AI in the public policy landscape. It addresses the urgent need for public administrators and policy makers to navigate the complexities of this transformative technology. Key learning areas include understanding multi-dimensional governance models, analyzing risks, and ensuring algorithmic accountability and transparency. Participants will explore real-world case studies, such as AI-based recruitment and welfare targeting, to understand the practical challenges and ethical dilemmas involved. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to design and implement AI governance strategies that foster innovation while protecting public interest, ensuring that AI applications in governance are equitable, transparent, and create tangible public value.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Government Accommodations - Hindi
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the policies and regulations concerning government accommodation in India, delivered in Hindi. It is specifically designed for central government employees and administrative staff to build a clear understanding of the entire lifecycle of accommodation allotment. The curriculum covers essential topics such as the General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA) system, eligibility conditions for various types of housing, and the step-by-step application process through the e-Sampada portal. Learners will also be familiarized with the rules for license fee calculation, retention of accommodation under different circumstances, and procedures for cancellation and vacation. By the end of this course, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply these rules, ensuring compliance and effective management of housing-related administrative matters, which is a crucial aspect of employee welfare and establishment functions in the government.
subDomain: Handling Miscellaneous Matters (Car, Residence, Personal Staff etc.)
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Government as a Platform
desc: This course delves into the strategic imperatives behind adopting Government as a Platform (GaaP) to modernize public service delivery. It begins by contextualizing the need for change, addressing the limitations of traditional, siloed government systems and their impact on citizen services. The curriculum then introduces the core concepts of GaaP and Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), using India's own DPI ecosystem, including Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker, as prime examples of successful implementation. Learners will explore how these foundational platforms enable a multi-stakeholder environment, fostering collaboration between government, private sector entities, and startups to drive innovation. The course further examines the transition from platforms to open protocols, as seen with ONDC, to promote greater decentralization and market efficiency. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to appreciate the strategic value of GaaP and DPI in building a resilient, responsive, and digitally transformed government.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Government E Marketplace
desc: This foundational course is designed to familiarize government officials with the operational framework of the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). The curriculum delves into the practical aspects of public procurement, starting with the basics of navigating the GeM portal and understanding its integration with the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). Participants will learn about different procurement methods, including direct purchase, L-1 buying, and the strategic use of e-bidding and reverse auctions, as governed by Rule 149 of the GFR. The course explains critical concepts such as Bid Life Cycle, Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) requirements, performance security, and the creation of Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificates (CRAC). Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently manage the end-to-end procurement process on GeM, ensuring adherence to financial rules, promoting transparency, and achieving value for money in public spending.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Government e-Marketplace
desc: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has transformed public procurement in India by creating a transparent, efficient, and inclusive online platform. This foundational course is designed to equip government officials and public sector employees with the essential knowledge to effectively navigate and utilize the GeM portal. It addresses the critical need for standardized procurement practices and digital fluency within government departments. The curriculum begins with a detailed walkthrough of the registration process for both buyers and sellers, clarifying the prerequisites and steps involved. It then delves into the administrative structure of GeM accounts, defining the distinct roles and responsibilities of primary and secondary users to ensure proper governance and operational control. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to explaining the different procurement modes available on the platform, such as direct purchase, L1 buying, and reverse auctions. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently register their organization on GeM, manage user roles effectively, and identify the appropriate procurement method for their specific needs. This will empower them to execute procurement tasks with greater efficiency, transparency, and adherence to the General Financial Rules (GFR), contributing to better public financial management.

title: Government Financial Management and Integrated Finance Division
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of government financial management, with a focus on the principles governing the management, control, and use of public funds. It introduces learners to the need for an effective financial management system in government and the key principles related to government revenue, expenditure, and financial propriety. The course also covers the conditions to be fulfilled before incurring expenditure from public funds and the procedures for obtaining and issuing financial sanctions. In addition, learners will explore the roles and functions of Integrated Finance Divisions (IFDs) and their contribution to sound financial management, fiscal discipline, and accountable governance. Practical learning through simulations helps participants apply these concepts to real-world government financial management situations.

title: Government Litigation Management and Tribunal Procedures
desc: Government employees who are not legal experts often face challenges when handling court cases, primarily due to a limited awareness of the intricate legal and procedural landscape. This course is designed to bridge that gap by providing a clear and comprehensive overview of government litigation management. The curriculum covers the constitutional provisions governing Central Administrative Tribunals (CAT), the jurisdiction of its various benches, and the step-by-step process of case handling. Participants will learn to define critical legal terminology, understand the structure of applications like OAs and MAs, and master the art of drafting effective replies to legal notices. Furthermore, the course explains common reasons for the rejection of applications and outlines the available options following a tribunal decision. By the end of this program, officials will be better equipped to support their departments in legal matters, ensuring timely and accurate compliance with judicial procedures.

title: Government Process Re-engineering
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of Government Process Re-engineering (GPR) and its critical role in modernizing public administration. It is designed for government employees seeking to understand and apply process improvement methodologies in their work. The curriculum begins with an introduction to GPR and its place within the e-governance project lifecycle. You will learn to define a vision for reform, identify and prioritize services for re-engineering, and prepare detailed process maps to visualize existing workflows. The course delves into techniques for assessing processes, defining problem statements, and conducting in-depth analysis to uncover inefficiencies. A significant focus is placed on managing the human side of change, with modules on change management strategies to ensure smooth implementation. Furthermore, it covers the essential legal and policy frameworks that underpin successful GPR initiatives. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to initiate and contribute to projects that make government services more efficient, effective, and citizen-centric.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Govt Accounting System
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Government Accounting System, with a specific focus on its implementation within the Defence sector. It is designed for professionals working in or aspiring to join the Defence Accounts Department (DAD) and related financial management roles. The course will demystify the complex framework of government accounting, covering everything from basic principles to the specific procedures followed in defence-related transactions. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the roles of key institutions like the CGDA and the processes for budgeting, expenditure tracking, and financial reporting. The curriculum emphasizes the importance of robust accounting practices for maintaining fiscal integrity and supporting strategic decision-making in defence. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the financial landscape of the defence establishment, contribute to effective audit processes, and uphold the standards of public financial accountability. This course is crucial for building a strong foundation in a specialized and vital area of public finance.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Grades of Automation in Metro Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Grades of Automation (GoA) that define modern metro train operations. As urban transit networks evolve, understanding the progressive levels of automation is crucial for engineers, operators, and managers. The course begins by establishing the context of automation in railways, explaining the core principles of Automatic Train Protection (ATP) and Automatic Train Operation (ATO). Learners will be guided through each of the five automation grades (GoA 0 to GoA 4), with a clear breakdown of the roles and responsibilities of both the onboard staff and the signal and train control (S&TC) systems at every stage. Key learning areas include the specific system requirements, safety protocols like Platform Screen Doors (PSD), and operational characteristics for each grade. Upon completion, participants will be able to analyze the technical and safety implications of each automation level, preparing them to contribute to the planning, implementation, and management of advanced metro systems.

title: Grain Analyser
desc: This instructional module offers a comprehensive walkthrough of the AI-based grain analyser, a key technology for modernizing food grain quality control. The course begins by explaining the importance of objective quality assessment in FCI's mission to procure and distribute food grains for national welfare schemes. It then provides detailed, step-by-step instructions on the entire operational workflow, from powering on the device and preparing a sample to executing a scan and generating a final report. Learners will understand how to properly handle grain samples, navigate the machine's user interface, perform single and multiple scans, and retrieve analysis results. By completing this course, officials involved in the food supply chain will be equipped to use this advanced technology to ensure the quality of procured grains, contributing to greater transparency, efficiency, and food security.

title: Gramin Dak Karmayogi
desc: The 'Gramin Dak Karmayogi' program is a transformative learning journey curated specifically for the Gramin Dak Sevaks of the Department of Posts. It aims to build their capacity to effectively deliver a wide array of citizen-centric services, reinforcing their role as a vital link in India's rural landscape. The curriculum is structured to cover three core areas: operational proficiency, customer engagement, and product knowledge. Learners will receive detailed, step-by-step instructions on using critical technology such as the DARPAN Main Computing Device (MCD) for booking articles, managing accounts, and processing transactions, as well as the Postman Mobile App (PMA) for delivery updates. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to soft skills, focusing on developing a positive, service-oriented mindset, effective communication, and sales techniques to promote postal products. The program provides exhaustive knowledge on India Post's offerings, from traditional mail and parcel services to a vast suite of financial products, including Post Office Savings Bank (POSB) schemes, Postal Life Insurance (PLI/RPLI), and the services of India Post Payments Bank (IPPB). Upon completion, a Gramin Dak Sevak will be fully equipped to not only perform their duties with high efficiency but also to act as a financial advisor and a key enabler of financial inclusion in their community.

title: Gramin Dak Sevak Customer Service Skills and Interpersonal Skills
desc: As the primary point of contact for India Post in rural areas, Gramin Dak Sevaks play a crucial role in shaping public perception. This course provides practical guidance to help them excel in this role. The curriculum is designed to build confidence in customer interactions, focusing on clear and respectful communication, active listening, and empathy. Key learning areas include understanding the nuances of rural customer service, developing strong interpersonal relationships, and managing service challenges with patience and professionalism. Through relatable examples and actionable tips, learners will be equipped to apply best practices in their daily work, ensuring a positive and consistent customer experience. Ultimately, this training will enable GDS to not only deliver services efficiently but also to act as trusted community partners, enhancing the value and image of India Post.

title: Gramin Dak Sevak Welfare Schemes
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the welfare measures available to Gramin Dak Sevaks (GDS). It is designed to familiarize learners with a wide range of benefits that support the financial security and well-being of GDS employees and their families, including financial grants, low-interest loans, insurance coverage, and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (SDBS). Participants will gain clarity on eligibility criteria for various welfare schemes, scholarships, and assistance programs based on factors such as service conditions, age, and performance. The course also guides learners through the procedures for applying for financial assistance, loans, and scholarships, enabling them to confidently access available benefits. In addition, it provides insights into the governance and fund management structure at Circle and Regional levels, helping learners understand how welfare funds are administered and monitored.

title: Gramin Dak Sevak: Digital Outreach and Dak Chaupal
desc: In an evolving digital landscape, India Post is transforming its services to better meet citizen needs. This course is designed to equip Gramin Dak Sevaks (GDS) with the essential skills to drive this transformation at the local level. It provides a comprehensive guide to leveraging digital tools, particularly social media, for effective public outreach and business promotion. The curriculum focuses on practical application, teaching GDS how to use platforms like WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram to disseminate information, market postal products, and act as responsive customer service points. A significant component of the course is dedicated to the 'Dak Chaupal' initiative. Learners will understand the strategic importance of these community meetings and acquire the skills to plan and execute them successfully. By organizing these events, GDS can directly engage with villagers, explain various postal schemes, and build stronger community relationships. Ultimately, this training enables GDS to transition from traditional mail carriers to proactive local business promoters and brand ambassadors, playing a crucial role in making India Post the preferred service provider in rural India.

title: Gravity and Magnetic data interpretation
desc: This specialized course offers an in-depth exploration of gravity and magnetic data interpretation, crucial for modern geophysical analysis. The program is structured to build a strong foundational understanding, starting with the principles of the Earth's gravity and magnetic fields and how their variations reveal subsurface density and magnetic susceptibility. Learners will be guided through the complete workflow, from data acquisition and the application of necessary corrections to compensate for various environmental and instrumental effects, to the deduction of meaningful anomalies.A significant portion of the course is dedicated to advanced data enhancement techniques. Participants will explore both space domain filters, such as gradient and derivative maps, and frequency domain filters based on Fourier transformation. These methods are vital for sharpening data to reveal lithological boundaries, structural features, and the depth of anomalous bodies. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to perform qualitative and quantitative interpretation of geophysical maps, correlating data-driven insights with geological realities to support mineral exploration and regional mapping projects.

title: Green Building Concept
desc: This course delves into the essential concepts of sustainable architecture and construction. It begins by establishing the importance of green buildings in the context of climate change and resource depletion. You will learn about the entire life cycle of a green building, from design and material selection to operation and maintenance. The course details practical measures for 'greening,' such as using renewable energy, implementing efficient water and waste management, and selecting sustainable materials. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding green building rating systems, with a special focus on India's GRIHA (Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment) and other global standards like LEED and BREEAM. Through case studies of prominent green buildings, learners will see these principles in action, equipping them to contribute to the development of more sustainable and resilient infrastructure.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Green Hydrogen for Sustainable Future
desc: As global energy demands rise, the transition to clean, sustainable energy sources has become a critical priority. This course offers a detailed exploration of green hydrogen, a transformative solution poised to address pressing challenges like climate change, pollution, and public health. It provides the foundational knowledge required to understand India's push towards a carbon-neutral economy. Key learning areas include the context of CO2 emissions and climate change, a comparison of hydrogen with conventional fuels, and the differentiation between grey, blue, and green hydrogen. The course delves into production technologies such as various electrolyzers and discusses the logistics of hydrogen storage and transportation. Upon completion, learners will grasp how green hydrogen can significantly reduce carbon dependency, contributing to a fossil fuel-free society and a more sustainable and resilient energy infrastructure for the future.

title: Green Revolution to Amrit Kaal
desc: Embark on a detailed exploration of India's agricultural landscape with this course on its transformation from the Green Revolution to the Amrit Kaal era. The curriculum provides essential context on why agriculture remains a cornerstone of the Indian economy and the historical shifts that have defined its progress. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of the pre and post-Independence agricultural scenarios, the drivers and impacts of the Green Revolution, and the composition of food production and trade dynamics. The course then transitions to the future, examining the strategic imperatives for the Amrit Kaal vision. This includes discussions on necessary policy and institutional reforms, the role of agri-tech and digital innovation, and the critical balance between chemical-based and natural farming. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze policy frameworks and contribute to strategic discussions on creating a sustainable, resilient, and prosperous agricultural sector for India's future.

title: Grey Water Management
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of greywater management. It is designed for public sector professionals involved in water resources, sanitation, and rural or urban development. The curriculum begins by defining greywater and distinguishing it from blackwater, outlining its primary sources in households and communities. Participants will delve into the importance of treating and reusing greywater, focusing on its potential to alleviate water scarcity and reduce the pollution of water bodies. Key learning areas include an overview of low-cost and advanced treatment technologies, such as filtration, root zone treatment, and bioreactors. The course also covers the practical applications of treated greywater, including landscape irrigation and non-potable domestic uses. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to assess the feasibility of greywater systems and contribute to the planning and implementation of sustainable water management projects within their jurisdictions.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Grievance Handling Mechanism in India Post
desc: Efficient grievance redressal is a cornerstone of citizen-centric governance. This course delves into the established Grievance Handling Mechanism of India Post, a critical function for maintaining public trust and service quality. It is specifically designed to equip postal staff with the knowledge and skills to manage customer complaints effectively. The course begins by outlining the multiple channels through which customers can submit grievances, including the CPGRAMS portal and Dak Adalats. The core of the training is a detailed walkthrough of the SAP-CSI based Customer Relationship Management (CRM) portal. Participants will learn the end-to-end process, from logging a new complaint and understanding inward/outward complaint flows, to routing it to the appropriate office, and finally, processing the resolution and closure. Furthermore, the course covers how to utilize CRM reports for monitoring pendency and improving overall system efficiency. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in handling grievances in compliance with departmental standards, contributing to a more responsive and accountable postal service.

title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism
desc: In an effort to create a seamless, painless, and faceless tax system, the Income Tax Department has prioritized the effective resolution of taxpayer grievances. This course, 'Grievance Redressal Mechanism,' is specifically designed for field officers to navigate and resolve taxpayer issues efficiently. It delves into the nature of grievances, their root causes, and the robust digital architecture established by the CBDT for their resolution.The curriculum covers the full spectrum of redressal channels, from online portals like CPGRAMS and E-Nivaran to traditional methods such as the Aaykar Seva Kendra and direct complaints to jurisdictional officers. A key focus is on empowering officers to categorize cases correctly and identify the appropriate authorities for swift resolution. The module also addresses how to manage 'sticky' grievances that arise from technical anomalies in systems like ITBA and CPC, emphasizing the importance of inter-departmental communication. By completing this course, officials will be better equipped to enhance taxpayer satisfaction and strengthen the problem-solving capabilities of the department.

title: Groundwater Resource Assessment using GEC 2015 Methodology
desc: India's dependency on groundwater is immense, accounting for over 60% of irrigation and 85% of rural drinking water. To ensure long-term sustainability, scientific and accurate resource assessment is paramount. This course delves into the official GEC 2015 methodology, the current standard for groundwater estimation in India. Participants will explore the key components of this framework, including the computation of dynamic groundwater, recharge from rainfall, and other hydrological factors. The curriculum is designed to equip officials and technical personnel with the knowledge to conduct precise assessments, which are fundamental for effective water resource planning, policy formulation, and sustainable management strategies at the national and state levels. By mastering this methodology, learners can contribute directly to securing India's water future.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: GSM Frame Structure
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the technical intricacies of the GSM frame structure, essential for anyone working in the telecommunications field. The program is designed to build a foundational understanding of how mobile networks organize data for transmission. You will begin by learning to distinguish between various logical channels, including broadcast, control, and traffic channels, and understanding their specific roles. The course then progresses through the hierarchical architecture of the network's physical layer, detailing bursts, TDMA frames, and the assembly of multiframes (both 26-frame and 51-frame types), superframes, and hyperframes. A key focus is on the practical mapping of these logical channels onto the physical frame structures, with specific examples for both full-rate and half-rate traffic. Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze and interpret the core transmission framework of GSM systems, a crucial skill for network engineering, operations, and development roles.

title: GSM RF Channels
desc: This technical course offers an in-depth exploration of GSM network performance management. It begins with a foundational overview of GSM logical and physical channels, which are crucial for understanding the air interface. The curriculum then progresses to the practical aspects of network assessment, detailing the process of conducting RF drive tests and analyzing key performance indicators like RX Level, RX Quality, Bit Error Rate (BER), and Frame Erasure Rate (FER). A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the principles of network optimization and systematic troubleshooting. Learners will be guided through the analysis of Layer 3 messages to diagnose the root causes of prevalent network problems, including access failures, SDCCH/TCH congestion, dropped calls due to radio link failures, and poor handover performance. The course also covers strategies for improving speech quality and balancing cell load. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in identifying network performance bottlenecks and implementing effective optimization solutions to ensure robust and reliable GSM service.

title: GST APPLICABILITY ON GOVERNMENT RELATED ACTIVITIES
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of how the Goods and Services Tax (GST) applies to various government-related activities. It is designed to equip public officials with the expertise to navigate the complexities of GST compliance. The curriculum begins by categorizing government services into three distinct groups: those attracting GST, those fully exempt, and those falling under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM). Key learning areas include the taxability of specific services such as those from the Department of Posts, transport of goods and passengers, and renting of immovable property. The course delves into the nuances of the Reverse Charge Mechanism, explaining when the liability to pay tax shifts to the recipient of the service. It also clarifies the relationship between GST applicability and the annual turnover of a business entity, including the specific thresholds. Furthermore, learners will explore a comprehensive list of exempted services, from activities under constitutional articles to services with minimal consideration. Upon completion, participants will be able to accurately determine GST applicability, ensuring financial compliance and proper tax management within their departments.

title: GST for Urban Local Bodies
desc: The introduction of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) has significantly transformed India's indirect tax landscape, presenting unique challenges and opportunities for municipal governance. For officials in Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), a thorough understanding of GST is crucial for effective financial management, revenue assurance, and legal compliance. This course is designed to equip public functionaries with the specialized knowledge required to navigate the complexities of GST within the urban local government context. The curriculum delves into the fundamental principles of the GST framework, its structure, and key tax slabs. It specifically examines the implementation of GST in municipal services, its impact on budgeting, and the nuances of tax implications and exemptions for ULBs. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing complex issues, such as the distinction between GST on services and local advertisement taxes, supported by relevant legal precedents and constitutional amendments. Participants will learn about essential compliance procedures, including filing, record-keeping, and navigating the regulatory environment. By mastering these concepts, learners will be able to implement best practices for efficient tax management, ensure seamless compliance, and contribute to the financial health and stability of their respective municipal bodies.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: GST Tax Deducted at Source Registration Procedure
desc: This course provides a practical understanding of the Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) Registration Procedure under GST and guides learners through the complete registration process on the GST Portal. Participants will learn how to initiate TDS registration by completing Part A, including entry of PAN details, validation through OTP authentication, and generation of the Temporary Reference Number (TRN). The course further explains how to complete Part B of the application by entering business details, Drawing and Disbursing Officer information, authorised signatory details, office address particulars, and required supporting documents. It also covers document upload requirements, application verification, and submission through Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) or Electronic Verification Code (EVC). By the end of the course, learners will be able to accurately complete and submit a TDS registration application, ensuring compliance with GST requirements and successful generation of an App

title: GST The Story of biggest tax reform in India
desc: This case examines the successful implementation of GST in India, highlighting how diverse stakeholders built consensus, addressed pre-GST complexities, established trust between the centre and states, and integrated a technology-driven system amidst the challenges of digitalization.

title: GST: Basic Concepts and Taxability
desc: This course is designed to provide a clear and structured understanding of the fundamental principles of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India. In the context of public finance and revenue administration, a strong grasp of GST is crucial for officials involved in taxation, audit, and economic policy. The course begins by explaining the 'why' behind GST, detailing the shift to a Concurrent Dual GST model and the significance of the Destination Principle in modern indirect taxation. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of what constitutes a 'taxable event' under the GST regime, the criteria for registration, and the calculation of critical financial metrics like 'aggregate turnover' and 'turnover in a state'. The curriculum specifically addresses the nuances of taxability for Casual Taxable Persons (CTP) and Non-Resident Taxable Persons (NRTP), ensuring learners can correctly apply the rules in diverse scenarios. Upon completion, participants will be able to accurately interpret basic GST provisions, determine tax liability based on turnover, and differentiate between various types of taxpayers, enabling them to handle GST-related matters with greater confidence and precision.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: GST: शासकीय सेवकों के परिप्रेक्ष्य में
desc: भारत में "एक देश, एक कर" के सिद्धांत पर आधारित वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) ने अप्रत्यक्ष कराधान प्रणाली में क्रांतिकारी बदलाव किया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से सरकारी सेवकों के लिए तैयार किया गया है, ताकि वे GST के विभिन्न पहलुओं को समझ सकें और अपनी आधिकारिक जिम्मेदारियों में इसे प्रभावी ढंग से लागू कर सकें। पाठ्यक्रम में GST की शुरूआत, इसके लाभ, और विभिन्न कर स्लैब की विस्तृत जानकारी दी गई है। इसमें सरकारी विभागों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रियाओं जैसे GST पंजीकरण, HSN/SAC कोड का उपयोग, ई-चालान और ई-इनवॉइसिंग की प्रक्रिया, और स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) के नियमों पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह पाठ्यक्रम GSTR-3B रिटर्न दाखिल करने और निविदा प्रक्रियाओं में GST दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन के महत्व को भी स्पष्ट करता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, सरकारी कर्मचारी GST अनुपालन को बेहतर ढंग से प्रबंधित करने, कर संबंधी त्रुटियों से बचने और सार्वजनिक वित्तीय प्रणालियों में पारदर्शिता बढ़ाने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: RCVP Noronha Academy of Administration and Management (RCVPNAAM) Bhopal

title: Guideline for IO on using E-Sakshya App at Scene of Crime
desc: The e-Sakshya App is a digital evidence management application developed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC) to assist Investigating Officers (IOs) in the collection, documentation, and management of evidence at the Scene of Crime (SOC). Designed in alignment with the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023, the application strengthens transparency, accuracy, and legal admissibility of digital evidence within India’s criminal justice system. The app supports standardized, secure, and legally compliant crime scene documentation through the use of modern digital tools.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Guidelines for Empanelment of Respective Media Agencies
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the procedures for empaneling media agencies with the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. It is designed to equip officials with a thorough understanding of how government communication activities are managed through a structured selection process. The curriculum delves into the strategic role of the Nodal Ministry and its media units in ensuring transparent and efficient outreach. Participants will learn to navigate the entire empanelment lifecycle, including identifying eligible agencies, verifying documentation, and assessing them against rigorous financial, technical, and statutory standards. The course also clarifies the legal and regulatory environment that underpins the system, promoting accountability and adherence to national standards. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these guidelines and utilizing the associated digital platforms to manage the empanelment process effectively.

title: Guidelines for Point of Sale and Public Awareness on Jammer Policies
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of regulatory guidelines governing Point of Sale (PoS) operations and jammer policies in the telecommunications sector. It outlines the roles and responsibilities of Licensees and PoS agents in ensuring proper subscriber verification, identity authentication, and regulatory compliance to prevent misuse of telecom services. The course also covers the policy framework for radio frequency (RF) jammers in India, including their types, working principles, and legal restrictions related to manufacturing, procurement, deployment, and usage. It highlights the norms applicable to government agencies, authorized vendors, and examination bodies. Learners will gain insights into compliance requirements, approved procedures, record maintenance, and adherence to security and safety guidelines for lawful and secure operations.

title: Guidelines for Processing Foreign Visits of Government Officers
desc: This foundational course equips Section Officers (SOs) and junior administrative staff with essential knowledge of the procedures and guidelines governing foreign assignments and training for DoPT officers. The course covers the end-to-end workflow—from initial eligibility verification to final approval by the Screening Committee of Secretaries (SCoS). Key topics include delegation requirements, deputation proforma submission procedures, financial considerations such as Travelling Allowance (TA) rules, leave provisions, and critical compliance checkpoints. Through structured explanations and practical guidance, the course enables learners to process foreign visit proposals accurately, efficiently, and in full compliance with applicable rules and approvals.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Guidelines on Information Security Practices for Government Entities
desc: The Guidelines on Information Security Practices for Government Entities aim to establish a robust cybersecurity baseline across ministries, departments, and public sector enterprises in India. Issued by the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In), these guidelines help protect government ICT infrastructure from threats such as ransomware, phishing, and data breaches. The objective is to foster a unified, resilient, and trusted digital environment for governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Guidelines on Service Testing Rollout for DoT Field Units
desc: This course is designed to equip Department of Telecommunications (DoT) field unit personnel with a foundational understanding of the Minimum Rollout Obligations (MRO) framework. It addresses the critical need for standardized and automated compliance in the telecom sector. The curriculum covers the historical context and evolution of MRO guidelines, leading up to the current automated system. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of the Saral Sanchar Portal's MRO module, the specific methodology for MRO compliance, procedures for LSA (Licensed Service Area) verification, and the defined roles and responsibilities of all stakeholders involved. Upon completion, learners will be able to effectively navigate the online compliance system, understand their role in the verification process, and appreciate the benefits of the automated MRO module in enhancing efficiency and transparency in service testing and rollout.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Gyan Post
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Gyan Post service, established under Regulation 92A of the Post Office Second Amendment Regulations. It is specifically designed for postal officials to ensure proper implementation and service delivery. The curriculum begins by defining what constitutes a Gyan Post item, covering eligible content like educational textbooks, materials for competitive exams, and socio-cultural literature. Participants will learn the strict conditions for transmission, including the prohibition of advertisements, regular periodicals, and commercial materials. The course thoroughly explains the operational procedures, such as the requirement for items to be trackable, transmitted via surface mode, and adhere to specified weight limits from 300 grams to 5 kilograms. It also covers the postage rate structure and the process for handling non-compliant packets, which are to be treated as India Post parcel retail products. Upon completion, learners will be fully capable of managing Gyan Post items in accordance with official regulations, ensuring efficiency and compliance within the postal network.

title: Handling Appointment Matters in CS Wing of DoPT
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the procedures for handling appointment matters within the CS Wing of the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT). It is designed for officials who manage or are involved in the recruitment lifecycle for the Central Secretariat Service (CSS) and Central Secretariat Stenographers’ Service (CSSS). The program begins by outlining the different modes of recruitment and clarifies the specific responsibilities of the CS Division versus the Staff Selection Commission (SSC). Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the entire process, including pre-examination planning, the SSC's role in conducting competitive examinations, and the critical post-examination steps managed by the CS Division. Key topics include the allocation of successful candidates, pre-appointment formalities, meticulous document verification, and the consequences of submitting false information. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the complexities of the appointment process, ensuring compliance with all regulations and contributing to the effective staffing of the central secretariat.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Handling CAT Cases
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the legal and procedural framework governing service-related disputes in the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT). It is specifically designed for public servants who are tasked with managing litigation on behalf of their departments. The curriculum addresses the critical importance of handling CAT cases proficiently to uphold government policies and ensure fairness in administrative actions. Key learning areas include a detailed overview of the Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985, the process of drafting and filing counter-replies and rejoinders, marshalling evidence, and understanding the principles of natural justice. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to manage the entire lifecycle of a CAT case, from receiving a notice to implementing the tribunal's final order. This will enable them to formulate robust legal strategies, ensure procedural correctness, and contribute to more favorable outcomes for their organizations, ultimately strengthening the integrity of public service.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Handling CAT Cases- Hindi
desc: सरकारी प्रशासन के संदर्भ में, केंद्रीय प्रशासनिक न्यायाधिकरण (CAT) के मामले एक महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखते हैं क्योंकि वे सीधे तौर पर कर्मचारियों की शिकायतों और सेवा शर्तों से संबंधित होते हैं। यह पाठ्यक्रम इन मामलों को संभालने की जटिलताओं पर एक व्यापक मार्गदर्शिका प्रदान करता है। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों को CAT के अधिकार क्षेत्र, आवेदन दाखिल करने की प्रक्रिया, प्रभावी काउंटर-जवाब तैयार करने और दस्तावेज़ीकरण के महत्व को समझाना है। इसमें केस फाइलों के प्रबंधन, समय-सीमा का पालन करने और सरकारी वकीलों के साथ समन्वय स्थापित करने की रणनीतियों पर भी ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम के माध्यम से, अधिकारी न केवल मुकदमेबाजी से जुड़े जोखिमों को कम करना सीखेंगे, बल्कि वे प्रशासनिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों को बनाए रखने और CAT के समक्ष सरकार का पक्ष मजबूती से रखने में भी सक्षम होंगे। यह पाठ्यक्रम उन सभी अधिकारियों के लिए आवश्यक है जो स्थापना, कार्मिक और कानूनी मामलों से निपटते हैं।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Handling Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) Cases
desc: This course offers a detailed guide on the effective handling of Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) cases, a critical function for maintaining administrative discipline and resolving service-related disputes within the government. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear understanding of the entire litigation lifecycle, from the receipt of an Original Application (OA) to the final order and potential appeals. Key learning areas include interpreting service rules, preparing comprehensive para-wise comments, compiling necessary documentation, and briefing legal counsel. Participants will learn how to navigate the procedural complexities of the CAT, thereby minimizing legal risks and ensuring that the government's position is presented accurately and effectively. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to manage administrative litigation, contribute to timely dispute resolution, and uphold the principles of natural justice in their official capacity.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Handling Central Administrative Tribunal Cases
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal, procedural, and practical aspects of handling service-related disputes before the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT). Designed for government officials responsible for managing litigation on behalf of their departments, the course equips participants with the knowledge and skills required to effectively oversee CAT cases from initiation to final disposal. Participants will gain insights into the provisions of the Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985, the jurisdiction and functioning of CAT, and the principles governing service jurisprudence. The course covers key aspects of case management, including scrutiny of notices, preparation of counter-replies and rejoinders, marshaling of records and evidence, coordination with legal counsel, and compliance with tribunal orders.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Handling Data of Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises
desc: Understanding the vast informal economy is crucial for effective economic governance in India. This course is designed to provide a detailed understanding of the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE), the primary instrument used by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) to measure this sector. The course explains the context and significance of ASUSE in generating reliable data for national accounts and policy-making. Learners will explore the survey's objectives, scope, and methodology, focusing on how it captures the operational and economic characteristics of unincorporated, non-agricultural enterprises across manufacturing, trade, and other services. Key learning areas include the types of data collected—from ownership and employment to ICT usage and financial details—and the primary economic indicators derived, such as Gross Value Added (GVA) and emoluments. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret unit-level ASUSE data effectively, recognize its analytical nuances, and apply these valuable insights to inform policy formulation, academic research, and strategic planning related to India's informal economic landscape. This knowledge is essential for officials involved in economic analysis, planning, and statistical operations.

title: Handling Data with Artificial Intelligence: A Beginners Guide
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the ability to manage and interpret data using intelligent systems is a critical skill for public sector professionals. This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental principles of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its practical applications in data handling. It is designed to equip learners with the foundational knowledge needed to navigate the evolving landscape of technology in governance and administration. Participants will delve into key areas of AI, including data management and visualization, image processing for object classification, and sentiment analysis for interpreting textual data. The course also provides a clear overview of transformative technologies such as Natural Language Processing (NLP), speech recognition, video processing, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Through practical examples, learners will understand how these technologies are integrated into systems that enhance communication, entertainment, and daily life. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to recognize opportunities for leveraging AI, improve data handling efficiency within their roles, and contribute to technology-driven initiatives in the public sector.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Handling Digital Evidence
desc: In an era where crime increasingly involves a digital footprint, the ability to properly handle digital evidence is paramount for successful investigations. This course is designed to equip police officers, forensic investigators, and cybersecurity professionals with the essential skills for managing digital evidence from the crime scene to the courtroom. The curriculum introduces the various types of digital evidence encountered today, from computers and mobile devices to cloud storage. It emphasizes the use of specialized forensic tools to acquire data without compromising its integrity. Participants will delve into best practices for packaging, labeling, and transporting digital evidence to ensure it remains secure and legally admissible. The course also provides a thorough grounding in fundamental digital forensic concepts, including data deletion methods, the critical function of write blockers, integrity verification using hashing, and the procedures for imaging and cloning digital media for analysis. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in managing digital evidence meticulously, bolstering the effectiveness of criminal investigations.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Handling of Complaints
desc: In any democratic society, the effective handling of public complaints is a cornerstone of good governance. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices of grievance redressal in the public sector. It begins by establishing the context of why managing complaints is vital for maintaining transparency and accountability. Learners will delve into the specific procedures and protocols for different categories of complaints, including those made against government officials, ensuring that every case is handled with fairness and due process. The course structure covers the entire lifecycle of a complaint, from receipt to resolution, highlighting the roles and responsibilities of various entities within the government apparatus. By the end of this course, participants will be able to apply these structured methods to their work, leading to more efficient and equitable outcomes. This will not only improve service delivery but also significantly strengthen the bond of trust between citizens and the government.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Handling of Nuclear and Other Radioactive Materials
desc: With India's increasing reliance on nuclear technology, the role of police as frontline defenders in radiological emergencies is more critical than ever. This course is designed to equip police officers with the foundational knowledge and skills required to respond effectively to incidents involving nuclear and radioactive materials. The curriculum provides a comprehensive overview of the legal framework, including the Atomic Energy Act, 1962, and outlines the protocols for inter-agency coordination with bodies like AERB, NDMA, and NDRF. Key learning areas include procedures for escorting radioactive materials, securing and isolating contaminated zones, managing radiological crime scenes, and preventing evidence tampering. Participants will learn to identify potential threats, such as illegal possession or radiological terrorism, and initiate appropriate containment and evacuation measures. Upon completion, officers will be better prepared to handle these high-stakes situations safely, minimizing risks and contributing to national security.

title: Handling Unit Level Data of Annual Survey of Industries
desc: The Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) is a critical tool for understanding the dynamics of India's organized manufacturing sector. This course offers a detailed examination of its structure and function, providing essential context for officials involved in economic governance. You will delve into the legal underpinnings of the ASI, including the Collection of Statistics (COS) Act, 2008, and understand its wide-ranging scope which encompasses manufacturing, repair services, electricity, gas, water supply, and cold storage. Key learning areas include the different units of enumeration used across sectors, such as factories, workshops, and undertakings, and the practical application of concepts like the Joint Return (JR) for consolidated reporting. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in interpreting the methodology of the ASI, enabling them to effectively use its data for evidence-based policy-making, industrial development strategies, and in-depth research, thereby strengthening their contribution to national economic monitoring.

title: Handling Unit Level Data of Household Consumption Expenditure Survey
desc: The Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) is a foundational component of India's official statistical system, providing deep insights into the economic well-being of households. This course is designed to equip researchers, policy analysts, and data scientists with the practical skills needed to work directly with this vital data. You will learn the complete data workflow, starting from how to locate and download official National Sample Survey (NSS) datasets from the MoSPI repository. The curriculum covers the use of Nesstar Explorer for interactive metadata browsing and data exploration. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to hands-on analysis using R, where you will learn to load and manipulate complex data files, link datasets using common identifiers, and apply appropriate multipliers to generate representative state- and sector-level estimates. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in preparing cleaned, analysis-ready datasets, enabling you to contribute to statistical reporting and policy research with confidence.

title: Handover Process in GSM Network
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the handover process, a fundamental mechanism for maintaining call quality and network efficiency in GSM systems. The curriculum begins by establishing the context for handovers, explaining why they are essential for seamless mobility and managing traffic distribution across the network. You will learn about the mobile-assisted technique, where the Mobile Station (MS) measures radio parameters like RX level and RX quality and reports them to the Base Station Subsystem (BSS). The course breaks down the process into three main steps involving the MS, BSS, and Mobile Switching Center (MSC). It further details the specific measurements taken at both the mobile and network ends, including the role of the Slow Associated Control Channel (SACCH). Key handover strategies based on interference, signal quality, power budget, and distance are analyzed to understand how the network makes intelligent handover decisions. Finally, the course differentiates between the four main types of handovers: intra-cell, intra-BSC, intra-MSC, and inter-MSC, clarifying the scope and controlling elements for each. Upon completion, you will have a comprehensive understanding of how GSM networks ensure uninterrupted service for mobile users.

title: Hands-Only Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Guide for Bystanders
desc: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) is a lifesaving technique used to restore blood circulation in a person whose heart has stopped beating. CPR helps maintain blood flow to the brain and vital organs until professional medical help arrives. With rising rates of sudden cardiac arrest and often limited emergency response time, community-based CPR training is essential for reducing preventable deaths. This course equips learners with the essential knowledge and practical understanding required to administer hands-only CPR, detailing the crucial steps of an emergency response, including effective chest compressions. By the end of this course, learners will understand the concept and importance of CPR, know when to initiate and stop CPR, and be able to perform hands-only CPR correctly.
org: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

title: Happiness in Sevā-Bhāva: Lessons from Bhagavad-Gītā
desc: Rooted in the Indian Knowledge System, this course provides a deep dive into the philosophy of the Bhagavad Gita to uncover the principles of lasting happiness. It addresses the fundamental human quest for joy, contrasting the fleeting nature of material pursuits with the profound contentment derived from a life of selfless service (Sevā-Bhāva). The curriculum is structured to build a clear understanding of Dharma, the universal principle of righteousness and sustainability, and its practical application in daily life and work. Key learning areas include the distinction between a service-oriented mindset (Sevā-Bhāva) and a self-centered one (Svārtha-Bhāva), the importance of self-control (Ātma-Samyama), and the cultivation of equanimity (Ātma-Samatva). Learners will explore how these ancient concepts can be applied in the modern context to foster resilience, purpose, and ethical conduct. Ultimately, the course guides participants toward achieving Ātma-Sukha (deep inner happiness) and contributing positively to society, redefining success as a state of inner strength and stability.

title: Haryana Civil Services (Pension) Rules 2016
desc: Navigating the complexities of pension rules can be a significant challenge for government employees approaching retirement. This course is specifically designed to address this by offering a clear and practical guide to the Haryana Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2016. The primary goal is to equip participants with the knowledge needed to understand and apply these crucial regulations without ambiguity. Key learning areas include the conditions for qualifying service, methods for calculating pension and gratuity, and the specifics of various pension types such as superannuation, retiring, and invalid pensions. The course also delves into the provisions for family pension and the rules governing the commutation of pension. Through a series of example-based explanations, learners will gain the ability to accurately calculate their entitlements and make well-informed decisions about their retirement benefits. Upon completion, participants will have a thorough grasp of their pension rights and the procedures involved, ensuring a smoother transition into retirement.

title: Haryana Civil Services (Punishment and Appeal) Rules 2016
desc: This course provides a detailed examination of the Haryana Civil Services (Punishment & Appeal) Rules, 2016, designed for public officials responsible for or subject to these regulations. The content is structured to build a strong foundational understanding of the legal framework governing disciplinary actions within the Haryana Civil Services. Key learning areas include a thorough review of different penalty types, the specific procedures for initiating and conducting major and minor penalty proceedings, and the critical role of constitutional protections. The course delves into the practical aspects of suspension, including deemed suspension and conditions for its validity. Furthermore, it equips learners to identify common procedural defects in departmental enquiries that could impact legal outcomes. A dedicated module also explains the function of complaints committees in addressing cases of sexual harassment, ensuring compliance with both legal and ethical standards. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to manage and respond to administrative proceedings with fairness, transparency, and legal precision.

title: Haryana Civil Services (Travelling Allowances) Rules 2016
desc: This course offers a practical and comprehensive overview of the Haryana Travelling Allowance (TA) Rules, 2016, essential for any government employee involved in official travel. The content begins by establishing the context, explaining the purpose and legal framework of the TA Rules to ensure a solid foundational understanding. It then delves into key terminology, enabling learners to interpret the rules correctly. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to detailing the entitlement rules for different modes of travel, such as road, rail, and air, and how these vary by employee category and the nature of the official duty. Through practical examples, participants will learn to navigate the complexities of TA administration. The course culminates in teaching the practical skills needed to calculate admissible TA claims, covering all necessary components, documentation, and common pitfalls. This ensures that learners can confidently manage TA claims, adhering to all financial and administrative guidelines, thereby ensuring accuracy and compliance in their professional roles.

title: Haryana Civil Services General Provident Fund Rules 2016
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Haryana Civil Services General Provident Fund (GPF) Rules, 2016, a critical component of financial planning for government employees. The content is structured to provide a clear and practical understanding of how the GPF system operates. You will begin by learning the fundamental scope and applicability of the rules, including the specific eligibility criteria for subscription and norms for continuation across different employment scenarios. The course then delves into procedural aspects, such as the process for filing and updating nominations, ensuring your fund is managed as intended. A significant portion is dedicated to the financial mechanics, explaining how interest is calculated and credited to your account. Furthermore, it outlines the regulations and steps for availing both advances and withdrawals, helping you access funds during service when needed. Finally, the course covers the crucial process of final fund settlement upon retirement, death, or other qualifying events. Upon completion, you will be proficient in navigating all aspects of your GPF account in accordance with the 2016 rules.

title: Haryana Civil Services Government Employees Conduct Rules 2016
desc: This course provides a detailed examination of the Haryana Civil Services Conduct Rules of 2016, a critical framework for ensuring integrity and professionalism in public administration. The program is structured to give learners a thorough understanding of their duties and limitations as government employees. It begins by defining the scope and applicability of the rules, establishing a foundation for ethical conduct. Key learning areas include a deep dive into what constitutes misconduct, with specific guidance on prohibited actions to avoid disciplinary issues. The course places special emphasis on sensitive topics such as restrictions on political activities, employment of relatives in private undertakings, and interactions with the media. Furthermore, it clarifies regulations concerning financial transactions, acceptance of gifts, and the declaration of assets and liabilities, promoting transparency and accountability. By completing this course, government employees will be equipped to uphold the highest standards of professional conduct, make sound ethical judgments, and contribute to a more transparent and effective governance system in Haryana.

title: Haryana Civil Services Leave Rules 2016
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Haryana Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 2016, a critical framework for public administration in the state. It is designed to provide government employees, HR personnel, and administrative officers with a thorough understanding of their entitlements and responsibilities concerning leave. The course begins by defining key terms and outlining the general conditions for granting leave. It then delves into specific categories such as Earned Leave, Half Pay Leave, Commuted Leave, Maternity Leave, and Paternity Leave, detailing the eligibility, limits, and competent sanctioning authorities for each. Learners will also examine complex scenarios, including rules for probationers, suspended employees, and re-employed pensioners. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply these rules, ensuring fair and consistent leave management, accurate leave salary calculation, and proper adherence to procedural requirements in their official duties.

title: Haryana Civil Services Pay Rules 2016
desc: Understanding the intricacies of pay structure and progression is essential for professionals in government administration. This course offers a structured and practical exploration of the HCS Pay Rules, 2016, equipping learners to interpret and apply these regulations in real-world scenarios. The content is designed to be clear and aligned with common challenges faced by officials responsible for managing pay and service matters. The course begins with the scope and applicability of the HCS Pay Rules, defining critical terminology like ACP Level, Entry Pay, and Functional Pay. It then delves into the specifics of pay admissibility and the effective dates of pay changes. Learners will examine different types of pay fixation, including those for initial entry, promotions, subsequent appointments, reversions, and modifications. Furthermore, the course clarifies the rules for increments, entitlement conditions, and the procedural impact of withheld increments on pay fixation. Upon completion, participants will be able to navigate the HCS Pay Rules with confidence and precision.

title: Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP / Hindi)
desc: खतरा और संचालन क्षमता (HAZOP) अध्ययन एक संरचित और व्यवस्थित तकनीक है जिसका उपयोग जटिल औद्योगिक प्रक्रियाओं, विशेष रूप से बिजली, रसायन और पेट्रोलियम क्षेत्रों में सुरक्षा और संचालन क्षमता का आकलन करने के लिए किया जाता है। यह पाठ्यक्रम इस शक्तिशाली पद्धति का एक व्यापक अवलोकन प्रदान करता है। शिक्षार्थी एक बहु-विषयक टीम के हिस्से के रूप में HAZOP अध्ययन करने के मूल सिद्धांतों को समझेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में 'गाइड शब्दों' के उपयोग के माध्यम से प्रक्रिया मापदंडों में विचलन की पहचान करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है ताकि संभावित खतरों और परिचालन मुद्दों को उजागर किया जा सके। प्रतिभागी सीखेंगे कि इन विचलनों के कारणों और परिणामों का विश्लेषण कैसे करें, मौजूदा सुरक्षा उपायों का मूल्यांकन कैसे करें और जोखिमों को स्वीकार्य स्तर तक कम करने के लिए अतिरिक्त कार्रवाइयों की सिफारिश कैसे करें। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा करने पर, शिक्षार्थी अपनी संगठनात्मक सुरक्षा प्रक्रियाओं में प्रभावी रूप से योगदान करने और एक सुरक्षित कार्य वातावरण सुनिश्चित करने के लिए सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) of work processes of power plants
desc: This course offers in-depth training on the Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) study, a critical qualitative technique for ensuring process safety in high-risk environments like power plants. The program is designed to equip engineering and operational professionals with the skills to lead and contribute to HAZOP assessments. The course begins by introducing the core principles of the HAZOP methodology, focusing on a team-based, systematic examination of planned and existing processes. Key learning areas include the identification of potential deviations from intended functions, a thorough analysis of their causes and consequences, and the development of effective actions to mitigate hazards. Participants will learn how to manage unresolved issues and ensure that corrective measures are successfully implemented and verified. Ultimately, this course will enable learners to proactively enhance workplace safety, educate teams on potential hazards, and contribute to a robust culture of risk management in power plant operations.

title: Hazard Assessment and Role of Personal Protective Equipment
desc: This course is designed to equip personnel with the essential knowledge and skills for maintaining a safe working environment. It delves into the systematic process of hazard assessment, from identification to risk evaluation using tools like risk matrices.
