The curriculum provides a detailed exploration of various types of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), such as flame-resistant suits, chemical-resistant gloves, and respirators, explaining their specific applications in protecting against occupational hazards like chemical exposures and explosive atmospheres. Participants will learn about crucial regulatory frameworks, including the Factories Act 1948 and Explosive Rules 2008, that mandate safety practices. By the end of the course, learners will be able to implement best practices for PPE selection, maintenance, and training, fostering a culture of safety, ensuring compliance, and significantly reducing the likelihood of workplace incidents.
org: Ordnance Factories Institute of Learning Khamaria (Jabalpur)

title: Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment And Control
desc: In any operational environment, ensuring the safety and well-being of personnel is paramount. This course, 'Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Control,' is designed to equip public sector professionals with the fundamental skills to manage workplace risks effectively. It addresses the critical need for a structured approach to safety management, which is essential for preventing incidents, protecting assets, and maintaining regulatory compliance across various government and industrial operations. Throughout this module, learners will delve into the core principles of the HIRA methodology. Key learning areas include techniques for identifying potential hazards, methods for analyzing and evaluating the severity and likelihood of risks, and strategies for implementing robust control measures. The course will guide participants through practical steps such as creating a risk profiling matrix and executing a thorough hazard analysis. The focus is on building a proactive safety culture rather than a reactive one. Upon completion, participants will be capable of conducting comprehensive risk assessments within their respective domains. They will be able to apply this knowledge to improve safety protocols, contribute to disaster preparedness, and foster a more secure and productive work environment. This training is vital for anyone responsible for operational safety, project management, or workplace supervision.

title: Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment And Control (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम 'खतरा पहचान, जोखिम मूल्यांकन और नियंत्रण' (HIRA) की महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रिया में गहन अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह विशेष रूप से एनटीपीसी जैसे बड़े औद्योगिक संगठनों में काम करने वाले पेशेवरों के लिए प्रासंगिक है, जहाँ सुरक्षा सर्वोपरि है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत विभिन्न प्रकार के खतरों, जैसे कि भौतिक, रासायनिक, और एर्गोनोमिक, की पहचान करने की तकनीकों से होती है। इसके बाद, यह जोखिम मूल्यांकन के तरीकों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, जिसमें शिक्षार्थी जोखिम की संभावना और गंभीरता का विश्लेषण करना सीखते हैं। पाठ्यक्रम का एक प्रमुख हिस्सा नियंत्रणों के पदानुक्रम को समझना है, जिसमें उन्मूलन, प्रतिस्थापन, इंजीनियरिंग नियंत्रण, प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण और व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरण (पीपीई) शामिल हैं। शिक्षार्थियों को एक व्यावहारिक जोखिम मूल्यांकन मैट्रिक्स बनाने और उसका उपयोग करने का तरीका भी सिखाया जाएगा, जो उन्हें जोखिमों को प्राथमिकता देने और प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधित करने में सक्षम बनाएगा। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, आप अपने कार्यस्थल पर एक मजबूत सुरक्षा संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देने, दुर्घटनाओं को रोकने और नियामक अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बेहतर रूप से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Hazards associated with demolition and mitigation procedures
desc: This course is designed to build a strong foundation in safety management for demolition projects. It addresses the critical need for pre-planned and controlled dismantling of structures within the construction and infrastructure sectors. Participants will learn to identify various types of demolition equipment and the principles of correct site setup. The course delves into recognizing a wide range of physical, chemical, and environmental hazards inherent in demolition activities. A significant focus is placed on understanding and complying with both general safety protocols and specific Indian standards that govern demolition. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply effective safety precautions and follow procedural instructions, contributing to a safer work environment and the successful execution of demolition tasks in public and private sector projects.

title: Hazards associated with demolition and mitigation procedures (Hindi)
desc: विध्वंस एक उच्च जोखिम वाली गतिविधि है जिसके लिए सावधानीपूर्वक योजना और निष्पादन की आवश्यकता होती है। यह विस्तृत पाठ्यक्रम विध्वंस परियोजनाओं के दौरान उत्पन्न होने वाले संभावित खतरों की व्यापक समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इसमें विध्वंस स्थल की स्थापना, उपकरणों के सही उपयोग और भारतीय विध्वंस मानकों के अनुपालन जैसे महत्वपूर्ण विषयों को शामिल किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी सीखेंगे कि खतरों का आकलन कैसे करें, जोखिमों को कैसे नियंत्रित करें और आपातकालीन प्रक्रियाओं को कैसे लागू करें। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा करने पर, आप किसी भी विध्वंस स्थल पर सुरक्षा को प्राथमिकता देने, दुर्घटनाओं को कम करने और नियामक आवश्यकताओं का अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करने में सक्षम होंगे। यह ज्ञान उन सभी पेशेवरों के लिए आवश्यक है जो निर्माण, अवसंरचना या औद्योगिक परियोजनाओं में शामिल हैं, जहाँ विध्वंस एक महत्वपूर्ण घटक है।

title: Hazards associated with fall of material
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to address the critical issue of workplace safety, with a specific focus on the hazards presented by falling materials. In many industrial, construction, and operational environments, falling objects are a leading cause of serious injuries and fatalities. This module provides a foundational understanding of why these incidents occur, detailing the various types of material-fall hazards and the spectrum of injuries that can result, from minor bruises to life-threatening trauma. Participants will learn to systematically identify potential risks in their work areas, understand the hierarchy of controls, and implement effective safety measures. The course covers essential topics such as proper material stacking, securing tools and equipment at heights, use of personal protective equipment (PPE), and establishing safe work zones. Upon completion, learners will not only be able to recognize and mitigate these dangers but will also be empowered to contribute to a proactive safety culture, ensuring a secure environment for themselves and their colleagues.

title: Hazards associated with fall of material (Hindi)
desc: औद्योगिक और निर्माण स्थलों पर, गिरने वाली सामग्रियां गंभीर चोटों और घातक दुर्घटनाओं का एक प्रमुख कारण हैं। यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से इन जोखिमों को संबोधित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जो एक सुरक्षित कार्य संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान प्रदान करता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम में, आप सीखेंगे कि गिरने वाली सामग्री से जुड़े खतरों की पहचान कैसे करें, जैसे कि अनुचित भंडारण, असुरक्षित स्टैकिंग, और परिवहन के दौरान होने वाली गलतियाँ। पाठ्यक्रम विभिन्न प्रकार की चोटों की व्याख्या करता है जो हो सकती हैं और जोखिम मूल्यांकन के महत्व पर जोर देता है। आप दुर्घटनाओं को रोकने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण नियंत्रण उपायों को लागू करना सीखेंगे, जिसमें सही व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरण (पीपीई) का उपयोग, सुरक्षित कार्य प्रक्रियाओं का पालन, और नियमित निरीक्षण शामिल हैं। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, आप अपने कार्य क्षेत्र में संभावित खतरों का सक्रिय रूप से पता लगाने और एक सुरक्षित और अधिक उत्पादक वातावरण बनाने में योगदान करने के लिए बेहतर रूप से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Health and well being perspective of naturopathy
desc: Dive into the world of natural healing with this insightful course on the naturopathic perspective of health and well-being. Designed for healthcare workers and individuals interested in holistic wellness, this program explains why naturopathy is crucial for preventing illness and maintaining vitality. You will explore the core concepts of naturopathic care, focusing on how lifestyle choices directly impact your body's innate healing capabilities. The curriculum covers key areas such as the three phases of naturopathic diet—eliminative, soothing, and constructive—and the significance of gut health, detailing the benefits of prebiotics and probiotics. Furthermore, the course provides practical guidance on incorporating yoga, pranayama, and meditation into your daily routine to effectively manage stress and sleeplessness. You will learn how simple, natural practices like proper diet, exercise, sufficient sleep, and fasting can collectively boost your immune system and lead to a healthier, more balanced life. This course empowers you to take control of your health through informed, natural choices.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: Health and Well being Prospective of Yoga
desc: In today's fast-paced world, maintaining a balance between physical and mental health is crucial. This course, 'The Role of Yoga in Health and Well-being,' offers a practical and accessible guide to achieving this balance through the ancient practice of yoga. It is designed for individuals at all levels, including absolute beginners, who wish to integrate wellness practices into their routine. The curriculum covers a structured sequence of yoga practices, beginning with loosening exercises and progressing to standing, sitting, prone, and supine postures (asanas). Each posture is demonstrated with clear instructions and cautions for safe practice. Key learning areas also include vital breathing techniques such as Kapalbhati and Nadi Shodhan Pranayama, which are essential for stress reduction and improving respiratory efficiency. The course culminates in a guided meditation session to foster mental peace and focus. Upon completion, learners will not only have a foundational understanding of various yogic practices but will also be equipped to perform a 30-minute yoga protocol independently, empowering them to take proactive steps towards a healthier and more serene lifestyle.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: Health Outcomes and the Poor
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the intricate relationship between health and poverty, offering essential knowledge for public sector professionals. It addresses the fundamental question of how the health sector can be a powerful instrument for poverty reduction. The curriculum begins by defining key health outcomes and introducing methodologies for their measurement, ensuring a data-informed approach to policy. It then systematically explores the multifaceted factors—social, economic, and environmental—that determine the health status of populations, with a special focus on equity. The final modules are dedicated to analyzing a range of health sector policies and strategic actions that governments can adopt. Learners will gain a deep understanding of how to design, implement, and evaluate interventions that not only improve overall health but also specifically target the needs of the poor. This course is designed to empower officials to make informed decisions that foster healthier communities and contribute to sustainable and inclusive development.

title: Healthcare Data Management for Better Patient Care
desc: This course introduces nurses to the critical role of data in improving care quality, patient safety, and clinical decision-making. It explains how accurate data collection, standardization, and interoperability enable reliable exchange of patient information across healthcare systems. Learners explore key standards such as HL7, FHIR, ICD, LOINC, and SNOMED CT, along with standardized nursing terminologies like NANDA, NOC, and the OMAHA system, to strengthen documentation and care coordination. The course also provides an introduction to basic healthcare analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for measuring outcomes and performance. By the end of the course, nurses understand how standardized and well-managed data supports evidence-based, efficient, and high-quality patient care.

title: Healthcare System in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Indian Railways’ comprehensive and well-structured healthcare system. It delves into the historical context, starting from the Medical Cell's formation in 1955 to the establishment of the Indian Railway Health Service (IRHS), and charts its journey towards becoming a modern, integrated healthcare provider. Participants will gain critical insights into the system's operational framework, including its network of hospitals and health units. The curriculum highlights key technological advancements that have transformed service delivery, such as the UMID card system, QR-based OPD registration, and teleconsultation services. Furthermore, the course explains the standardized procedures for medicine procurement, reimbursement policies for specialized treatments, and the robust first aid infrastructure. Upon completion, learners will possess a thorough understanding of how Indian Railways delivers accessible, efficient, and equitable healthcare to its vast number of beneficiaries nationwide.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Healthcare Systems in India and the Need for Digital Health in Nursing
desc: This course provides an overview of India’s evolving healthcare landscape and emphasizes the growing importance of digital transformation. Learners explore the shift from traditional to modern healthcare systems, including public, private, and alternative models of care, and understand how services are organized across primary, secondary, and tertiary levels. The course highlights the critical role of nurses within the healthcare system, along with key challenges such as inequitable access, affordability, resource constraints, and the rising burden of non-communicable diseases. Emphasis is placed on how digital health solutions—including HMIS, EMR, telemedicine, and national initiatives such as the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)—can bridge gaps, improve quality, and support equitable, patient-centered care.

title: Healthy Ageing: Understanding Challenges and Promoting Well-Being
desc: Population ageing is one of the most significant public health transformations of the 21st century. As life expectancy increases, older adults may experience chronic health conditions, functional decline, mental health challenges, social isolation, ageism, and barriers to accessing appropriate health and social care. Promoting healthy ageing therefore requires a comprehensive understanding of the biological, behavioural, social, environmental, and systemic factors that influence health and well-being throughout the life course. This course provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of healthy ageing. It explores the physical, mental, and social dimensions of ageing, as well as the vulnerabilities and challenges faced by older adults. Learners will examine the impact of ageism, social determinants of health, community environments, and health and social care systems on the well-being, dignity, independence, and quality of life of older adults.

title: Heart in Governance
desc: In the complex world of public administration, technical skills and procedural knowledge are essential, but the human element is what truly defines effective governance. This course, 'The Role of Empathy in Public Service and Governance,' delves into the profound importance of compassion and understanding in the daily work of bureaucrats and public officials. It directly confronts and deconstructs the common stereotype of government officials as being detached or uncooperative, presenting a compelling case for a more people-centric approach. Based on the insights and career experiences of a seasoned bureaucrat, the course provides a visionary perspective on fostering a compassionate work culture. Participants will explore the concept of empathy not as a soft skill, but as a strategic tool for better decision-making, especially when serving the less privileged. Through engaging narratives and practical examples, learners will discover how empathy can transform service delivery, improve team dynamics, and ultimately lead to more meaningful and impactful outcomes in their public service careers. This course is designed to inspire a shift in mindset, encouraging officials to lead with heart and humanity.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Heat Treatment of Ferrous Materials
desc: Heat treatment is a critical process in metallurgy and manufacturing, essential for producing metals with specific properties for demanding applications, from automotive components to industrial machinery. Understanding these principles is vital for engineers and technicians to ensure product quality, durability, and reliability. The course covers the fundamental principles of heat treatment, focusing on ferrous materials. It begins with an analysis of the iron-carbon phase diagram, which is crucial for understanding phase transformations. Learners will explore various heat treatment processes in detail, including annealing, normalizing, hardening, and tempering. The curriculum also examines the selection and impact of different quenching media and introduces surface hardening techniques used to enhance wear resistance. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret metallurgical diagrams and select appropriate heat treatment processes to achieve desired mechanical properties in iron and steel components. This knowledge is directly applicable in roles related to quality control, manufacturing process design, toolmaking, and industrial maintenance. Learners will be prepared to solve practical challenges related to material performance and contribute to enhancing the quality and longevity of manufactured products.
org: Academy of Weapons Technology and Management, Ichapur

title: Helping Employees to Grow
desc: In today's dynamic work environment, a manager's ability to develop their team is a critical driver of organizational success. This course, 'Effective Strategies for Employee Growth and Development,' is designed to equip supervisors with the practical tools and frameworks needed to nurture talent effectively. The program delves into the core principles of employee empowerment, starting with the art of delegation. You will learn to move beyond simple task assignment by understanding a seven-level delegation continuum, enabling you to tailor authority and responsibility to each employee's experience and the task's demands. A key focus is the GROWS coaching model, a structured method for guiding employees through goal setting, reality assessment, exploring options, establishing will, and identifying support. The course also introduces a comprehensive professional development framework, offering a menu of low-cost, high-impact learning opportunities, from on-the-job challenges to mentorship and reflective practices. By completing this course, you will be ableto confidently delegate, coach, and create development plans that foster ownership, enhance performance, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning within your team.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: High Altitude Diseases and Their Management
desc: This course is designed to equip government personnel, particularly those in paramilitary, police, and disaster response roles, with the critical skills to manage high-altitude related illnesses. The content provides a comprehensive overview of the adverse effects of high altitudes on the human body, detailing conditions like Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS), High-Altitude Pulmonary Edema (HAPE), High-Altitude Cerebral Edema (HACE), frostbite, and chilblains. Participants will learn to identify the specific symptoms of each condition and understand the immediate actions required for primary treatment and management. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to preventive measures, emphasizing the importance of proper acclimatization protocols. Furthermore, it introduces practical, non-medical interventions, demonstrating how specific yogasanas and pranayama techniques can enhance respiratory strength, improve circulation, and build resilience against the physiological stresses of high-altitude environments. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to safeguard their health and respond effectively to medical emergencies in mountainous terrains.

title: High Voltage System of Metro Trains
desc: The High Voltage System is a critical component of metro train operations, serving as the interface between the overhead traction power supply and the train’s electrical systems. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of how high voltage is received, measured, monitored, and distributed to ensure safe and reliable train operation. Learners will explore the role and functioning of key high-voltage equipment, including the Pantograph, Potential Transformer (PT), Current Transformer (CT), AC Surge Arrester, Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB), Earth Ground Switch (EGS), and Main Transformer. The course also highlights safety measures such as surge protection, voltage step-down processes, fault isolation, and grounding mechanisms. By the end of this course, participants will gain deep insights into how the high voltage system enables uninterrupted power supply, protects equipment, and ensures the safe functioning of modern metro trains, preparing them for roles in maintenance and operational oversight.

title: High-Speed Trains
desc: As India advances its high-speed rail network, a fundamental understanding of the associated technology becomes crucial. This course is designed to provide a clear and structured overview of high-speed train systems. It begins by defining high-speed rail and outlining its significance in the Indian context. The curriculum is divided into key modules covering the core technical specifications of the trains, including their primary components and advanced propulsion systems. Learners will also explore the sophisticated control and HVAC systems that ensure operational efficiency and passenger comfort. Furthermore, the course details the range of passenger services offered and delves into the critical safety and signalling standards that are paramount for high-speed operations. Upon completion, participants will possess the essential knowledge to appreciate the complexity and innovation behind high-speed trains.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Hill Road Safety and Design Fundamentals
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing safety on hill roads, with particular emphasis on road alignment, gradients, horizontal and vertical curves, slope stability, and drainage systems. It examines how road geometry, terrain conditions, slope behaviour, and water movement impact vehicle stability, visibility, driving conditions, and accident risk in hilly and mountainous regions. The course also introduces practical engineering approaches, traffic safety measures, slope protection techniques, and drainage management practices that help improve road performance and reduce risks associated with landslides, erosion, inadequate drainage, and unsafe roadway conditions. Participants will gain practical insights into maintenance and monitoring practices required for safer and more sustainable hill road operations.
org: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

title: Hindu Law
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of Hindu Law, a cornerstone of personal law in India that has evolved over centuries. It is designed for public officials, legal practitioners, and administrators whose roles involve matters of inheritance, property rights, and family law. The course begins by tracing the historical development of Hindu Law, examining its primary sources like Shruti and Smriti, and defining who is governed by its principles. Participants will gain a detailed understanding of the two major schools of Hindu Law, Mitakshara and Dayabhaga, and their differing views on property and succession. Key topics include the structure and dynamics of the Joint Hindu Family, the powers and responsibilities of the Karta, the rights of coparceners, and the legal frameworks for partition. The course also provides a thorough analysis of the Hindu Succession Act of 1956, including the significant changes introduced by the 2005 amendment regarding women's property rights, and the concept of Streedhan. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to interpret and apply the core principles of Hindu Law in relevant professional contexts.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Hiring Requisitioning and Acquisition
desc: This detailed course is designed for officials involved in the management of defence estates and properties. It provides a thorough examination of the processes for hiring, requisitioning, and acquiring immovable property for defence purposes. The content delves into the specific legal statutes that govern these activities, such as the RAIP Act, 1952, and its 1968 counterpart for Jammu & Kashmir. Learners will gain a clear understanding of the administrative and financial hierarchies, including the specific sanctioning limits for authorities in the Army, Air Force, and Navy, with special attention to the differing powers in Northern and Western Commands. The course meticulously explains the practical steps involved, from the constitution of a station board for hiring accommodation to the complex criteria for approving the de-hiring of properties in sensitive locations like Mumbai. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the procedural and regulatory landscape of defence property management, ensuring compliance and operational readiness.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: History of Forensic Science
desc: Delve into the fascinating history of forensic science and understand its indispensable role in the modern legal framework. This course offers a detailed exploration of the discipline's evolution, beginning with its earliest origins in ancient civilizations and progressing to the cutting-edge scientific techniques of the 21st century. You will learn about the foundational contributions of pioneers like Sir Francis Galton, who developed the fingerprint classification system, and Edmond Locard, who established the world's first forensic laboratory. The curriculum examines the systematic integration of scientific principles into criminal investigations, covering milestones in poison detection, autopsies, and evidence analysis. By the end of this course, you will have a profound appreciation for how these historical developments have created the rigorous, evidence-based methodologies that are fundamental to contemporary forensic science and the administration of justice.

title: HOER (Hours of Employment and Period of Rest Rules)
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the intricacies of the Hours of Employment and Period of Rest (HOER) Rules, a cornerstone of labour law within the Indian Railways. The program is specifically designed for railway personnel, supervisors, and administrative staff who are responsible for ensuring compliance with these vital regulations. The course begins by establishing the context and importance of HOER rules in preventing accidents and ensuring the well-being of employees in a demanding, 24/7 operational environment. Key learning areas include the classification of railway staff (Intensive, Essentially Intermittent, and Excluded), the specific limits on hours of work for each category, and the mandatory requirements for periodic rest. The course will also cover the procedures for calculating overtime pay and the special provisions applicable under different operational circumstances. Through a detailed exploration of these rules, learners will be equipped to correctly interpret and apply the legal framework, manage rosters effectively, and maintain accurate records. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in upholding the HOER regulations, thereby contributing to a safer, more efficient, and legally compliant railway system.

title: HOLISTIC HARMONY : AYUSH APPROCHES FOR WELL-BEING
desc: Dive into the world of traditional healing with this introductory course on AYUSH. This program is designed to provide a thorough understanding of India's rich heritage of holistic health practices, including Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy. The course explains the core philosophies behind these systems, which focus on integrating the mind, body, and spirit to achieve optimal health and prevent illness. Participants will explore the principles of natural remedies, dietary practices, lifestyle adjustments, and mental wellness techniques that form the basis of AYUSH. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with practical knowledge to apply these time-tested principles to enhance their personal health, manage stress, and foster a state of complete well-being. This knowledge is invaluable for public servants seeking to promote a culture of wellness within their communities and personal lives.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Holistic Harmony: AYUSH Approaches to Well-being
desc: This introductory course provides an overview of AYUSH and India’s rich heritage of traditional systems of medicine and wellness. It introduces learners to Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa, and Homoeopathy, highlighting their distinctive approaches to health, wellness, and preventive care. The course explores the fundamental principles, philosophies, and practices associated with these systems, including approaches to healthy living, diet, lifestyle, physical well-being, and mental wellness. Learners will gain an understanding of the holistic approach to health and the importance of maintaining balance and well-being. The course also introduces the role of AYUSH in promoting health awareness, preventive wellness, and healthy lifestyles within the broader national health and wellness framework. By the end of the course, learners will have a foundational understanding of AYUSH and its relevance to personal well-being and public health awareness.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Homicide-Related Provisions Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: The recent overhaul of India's criminal justice system, with the introduction of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, marks a pivotal moment in the nation's legal history. This course is designed to equip legal and law enforcement professionals with a detailed understanding of the new provisions governing homicide. It addresses the critical need for officials to be well-versed in these changes to ensure fair and effective administration of justice. The curriculum delves into the nuances of culpable homicide and murder, drawing a clear comparison between the old Indian Penal Code (IPC) and the new BNS framework. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of BNS Sections 99 to 105, the introduction of new offenses like mob lynching, and the procedural changes in investigation and trial as outlined in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS). The course also covers the judicial process in a sessions trial, timelines for investigation, and the mercy petition procedure for death sentences. Upon completion, learners will be able to accurately apply the new legal standards, navigate the updated procedural requirements in homicide cases, and appreciate the impact of these reforms through the lens of landmark judicial precedents, ensuring procedural correctness and upholding the rule of law.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Hospital Infection Control Plan
desc: The Hospital Infection Control Plan (HICP) is a foundational element of patient and staff safety in any healthcare facility. This course is designed to equip healthcare professionals with essential knowledge and practical skills for effective infection prevention and control. It delves into the primary objectives of an HICP, which is to minimize the risk of infection transmission within the hospital environment. Key learning areas include the seven components of standard precautions, with a special focus on hand hygiene techniques and the correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE). The curriculum also covers critical procedures such as the management of blood and body fluid spills, barrier precautions for different modes of disease transmission (contact, droplet, and airborne), and the role of environmental cleaning. Furthermore, the course introduces the concept of infection surveillance for monitoring and improving control measures. By completing this course, learners will be better prepared to implement and adhere to infection control protocols, contributing directly to a safer healthcare environment and the delivery of high-quality patient care.

title: Hotel Load Converter
desc: This specialized course delves into the engineering and operational aspects of the Hotel Load Converter (HLC) technology integral to WAP7 and WAP5 locomotives. It begins by contextualizing the shift from legacy alternator systems to the advanced Head On Generation (HOG) system, a key innovation in railway technology. The curriculum systematically breaks down the power conversion process, covering the roles of transformers, line side converters, DC links, and voltage source inverters. Participants will learn about the evolution of the technology, from single and dual winding transformers to the development of the space-efficient composite converter, which combines traction and hotel load functions. The course also details the technical specifications, circuit diagrams, and operational parameters of these systems. Upon completion, learners will understand the significant benefits of HOG technology, including fuel savings, reduced maintenance, and enhanced reliability in passenger train operations.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Hours of Work and Period of Rest in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the Railway Servants (Hours of Work and Period of Rest) Rules, 2005, a critical legal framework governing the employment conditions of non-gazetted staff in the Indian Railways. The content is structured to provide a clear understanding of why these regulations are essential for maintaining operational efficiency and employee welfare. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of employment classifications such as Continuous, Intensive, Essentially Intermittent, and Excluded categories, each with distinct statutory duty limits and rest period requirements. The course thoroughly covers the procedures for creating rosters, calculating overtime, and granting compensatory rest. Furthermore, it explains the nuances of preparatory and complementary work, split duties, and the specific provisions for supervisory staff. Upon completion, learners will be able to correctly interpret and apply these rules in their daily work, ensuring legal compliance, preventing disputes, and fostering a fair working environment within the Indian Railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: House Rent Allowance (HRA)
desc: This detailed course on House Rent Allowance (HRA) is specifically tailored for officers of the All India Services (AIS). Understanding HRA is crucial for effective personal financial planning and ensuring full compliance with government service rules. This program delves into the specifics of HRA, starting with the fundamental eligibility requirements for officers at various stages of their careers. Learners will be guided through the precise calculation methodologies, which vary based on the classification of the city of posting. The course also provides clear, step-by-step procedural guidance on how to claim the allowance, including the necessary documentation and forms. Furthermore, it addresses various special cases and scenarios, such as transfers, leave, and other service conditions that may impact HRA entitlements. Upon completion, officers will be equipped to confidently and correctly manage their HRA claims, avoiding common errors and ensuring they receive their rightful benefits.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: HOUSE WIRING
desc: Gain a comprehensive understanding of electric house wiring with this detailed course designed for beginners. Proper electrical wiring is crucial for ensuring safety and the efficient distribution of electricity. This course begins by introducing the core concepts of electrical wiring and its primary components, such as wires, switches, circuit breakers, and sockets. You will learn to distinguish between different wiring methods, including surface, concealed conduit, cleat, and batten wiring, understanding their respective applications, costs, and installation complexities. The curriculum delves into the practical aspects of planning a wiring layout, selecting the correct wire sizes for various appliances, and adhering to critical safety protocols. It covers the importance of earthing and the role of protective devices like fuses and MCBs. The course culminates in a live demonstration, guiding you step-by-step through the process of wiring an electric board. Upon completion, you will be equipped to perform basic electrical connections and troubleshoot common wiring issues, ensuring safe and reliable electrical systems.

title: How to claim Medical Reimbursement in Indian Railways
desc: This course is designed to equip eligible Railway medical beneficiaries with the knowledge to navigate the medical reimbursement process for emergency treatments taken at non-railway hospitals. The content addresses the critical need for clarity on procedures when immediate medical attention is required without prior official referral. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of eligibility criteria for all beneficiary types, a clear definition of a medical emergency as per railway guidelines, and a step-by-step guide to compiling and submitting the required claim forms and supporting documents. The course also explains the internal process, from the initial report to the Authorized Medical Officer (AMO) to the final sanctioning of the eligible amount, including the six-month submission deadline. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently and correctly file for medical reimbursements, avoid common errors, and ensure their claims are processed efficiently and in accordance with the policies of Indian Railways.

title: HOW TO CONFIGURE INTERNET SERVICES IN MOBILE HANDSET
desc: This instructional module is designed to equip learners with the fundamental skill of configuring mobile internet on an Android device. The course begins by explaining the two primary ways to connect to the internet: Wi-Fi and cellular data. It then provides a detailed, screen-by-screen walkthrough of the Android settings menu to locate the mobile network configuration options. The core of the course focuses on the Access Point Name (APN), explaining its importance and demonstrating how to add or edit an APN for a specific provider, using BSNL as a practical example. By the end of this short tutorial, learners will be able to independently set up their mobile data connection, a foundational skill for ensuring digital access and productivity on the go, particularly when automatic settings fail.

title: How to develop content for iGOT Karmayogi platform
desc: This course is designed to empower content creators, subject matter experts, and training managers to develop impactful learning experiences for the iGOT Karmayogi platform. It establishes the foundational knowledge required to produce content that meets rigorous quality standards and contributes effectively to civil service capacity building. The curriculum provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the entire content creation and publication process. Participants will learn to apply the iGOT content framework (WTDET) to structure modules, ensuring an engaging and pedagogically sound learning journey. A significant focus is placed on understanding and tagging functional, behavioural, and domain competencies to align courses with specific job roles and development needs. Furthermore, the course details the use of the Content Quality Scorecard (CQS) and Gate Criteria for self-certification, promoting accountability and excellence. By mastering these principles, learners will be able to create professional, learner-centric, and quality-assured courses that drive performance and support the vision of a future-ready civil service.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: How to Improve Interpersonal Skills in the Workplace
desc: In today's interconnected workplace, professional success is defined not just by technical expertise, but by the ability to effectively interact with others. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the essential interpersonal skills that underpin a thriving work environment. It addresses why skills like communication, empathy, and collaboration are critical for government and public sector professionals aiming to improve team dynamics and service delivery. Key learning areas include understanding the nuances of verbal and non-verbal communication, practicing active listening to foster trust, and applying empathy to appreciate diverse perspectives. The course also covers practical strategies for managing workplace conflicts constructively and regulating emotions during high-pressure situations. Participants will learn how to cultivate a positive outlook and build strong, supportive relationships with colleagues. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these skills to enhance collaboration, boost team morale, and create a more productive and fulfilling workplace for everyone.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: HOW TO LINK WBS WITH ASSET TRANSACTION CODE CJIC
desc: This detailed instructional module walks learners through the essential process of asset capitalization within the SAP environment. The course begins by demonstrating how to check the trial balance using the GR55 transaction to identify amounts lying in 'asset under construction'. It then focuses on the core procedure of using the CJIC transaction code to view and select specific WBS line items that are pending capitalization. Learners will see how to interpret the CJIC report, which displays cost elements, posting dates, and the amounts to be capitalized. The course explains how to initiate the final settlement, which is completed using the CJ88 transaction. By completing this course, participants will understand the crucial link between project expenditures tracked in a WBS and their conversion into fixed assets, which is fundamental for accurate depreciation and financial reporting.

title: How to Live Healthy
desc: Embark on a journey to better health with 'A Practical Guide to Healthy Living'. This course is designed for individuals seeking to improve their physical fitness and mental clarity to better handle the demands of daily life. The curriculum is structured into practical modules that cover essential types of physical activity. You will learn the correct form and precautions for flexibility exercises to improve mobility, endurance exercises like running to boost cardiovascular health, and strengthening exercises such as push-ups and squats to build muscle. The course concludes with cool-down techniques to aid muscle recovery.Beyond physical workouts, this program emphasizes a holistic approach to wellness. It delves into the core components of a healthy lifestyle, providing actionable advice on maintaining a balanced diet, managing stress effectively, ensuring proper sleep, and understanding the importance of regular health check-ups. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge and practical skills to develop a sustainable health regimen, leading to reduced stress, better weight management, and an overall improvement in your quality of life.

title: How to use Smart OTDR
desc: This comprehensive training module is designed to equip learners with the essential skills to operate a Smart Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR) for effective fiber optic cable testing. The course breaks down the complex process of fault measurement into six manageable steps, ensuring a clear and logical learning progression. You will begin by learning the correct procedure for connecting the fiber to the OTDR. The course then delves into critical configuration settings, explaining how to select the appropriate measurement mode (automatic or manual), set laser wavelengths like 1310nm or 1550nm, and adjust parameters such as range and pulse width for optimal results. The training demonstrates how to initiate a fault trace and, most importantly, how to interpret the resulting data displayed on the OTDR screen. Learners will understand how to analyze the trace to identify total fiber length, locate events, and distinguish between a complete fiber break and reflections from connectors or splices. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in using a Smart OTDR to diagnose and pinpoint faults in optical fiber networks, a critical skill for ensuring the reliability of modern communication infrastructure.

title: HRMS and SPARROW Application
desc: In the context of digital governance, mastering HR management tools is essential for efficient public administration. This course is designed to provide government officials with a detailed operational understanding of the HRMS and SPARROW applications. It addresses the critical need for officials to proficiently navigate these digital platforms for their day-to-day administrative and compliance responsibilities. Key learning areas include a thorough walkthrough of the Income Tax Business Application (ITBA) portal, covering modules for leave requests, ID card management, loans, and medical processes. A significant focus is placed on the SPARROW platform, where learners will understand the distinct roles and responsibilities of the Officer, Custodian, Reporting, and Reviewing authorities in the Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR) lifecycle. The course also covers the mandatory filing of Immovable Property Returns (IPR). Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently execute all major HR tasks electronically, ensure timely compliance with service rules, and effectively manage their digital service records, contributing to a more transparent and efficient administrative environment.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: HRMS and SPARROW Applications: A Guide for Income Tax Officials
desc: In the context of digital governance, mastering HR management tools is essential for efficient public administration. This course is designed to provide government officials with a detailed operational understanding of the HRMS and SPARROW applications. It addresses the critical need for officials to proficiently navigate these digital platforms for their day-to-day administrative and compliance responsibilities. Key learning areas include a thorough walkthrough of the Income Tax Business Application (ITBA) portal, covering modules for leave requests, ID card management, loans, and medical processes. A significant focus is placed on the SPARROW platform, where learners will understand the distinct roles and responsibilities of the Officer, Custodian, Reporting, and Reviewing authorities in the Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR) lifecycle.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Human Decision Making and its Biases
desc: In an increasingly complex and volatile world, the ability to make sound judgments is a critical skill. This course delves into the science and art of decision-making, starting with an analysis of the cognitive biases and heuristics that shape our choices. You will explore why human intuition can be unreliable and learn to apply mathematical concepts like probability and Bayes' theorem to approach problems with greater objectivity. The curriculum examines decision-making at individual, group, and organizational levels through compelling case studies, including the jury dynamics in '12 Angry Men' and the systemic failures in the Challenger space shuttle disaster. Participants will learn to navigate ambiguity, evaluate evidence critically, and understand the role of data and algorithms in augmenting human intelligence. By the end of this course, you will have developed a robust framework to counter biases, foster a culture of inquiry, and make more informed, data-driven decisions in your public service career.

title: Human Papillomavirus Vaccination: Prevention and Best Practices
desc:
The Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine is a preventive series of injections designed to protect against high-risk HPV strains that cause cervical, vaginal, vulvar, anal, and throat cancers, as well as genital warts. The vaccine works by stimulating the body to produce antibodies that bind to the virus and prevent it from infecting cells, offering near-100% protection when administered before exposure to the virus.
HPV vaccines have a strong safety record, with over 500 million doses given worldwide. Side effects are typically mild, including soreness, swelling, or redness at the injection site. Fainting can sometimes occur, so it is recommended to remain seated for 15 minutes after the injection.

title: Human Rights in Governance
desc: Human rights are the bedrock of a just, equitable, and citizen-focused public administration. In a diverse democracy, ensuring that every citizen is treated with dignity and respect is not just a legal mandate but a moral imperative for good governance. This course is designed to provide public officials with a deep and practical understanding of human rights principles and their direct application in the governmental context. Learners will delve into the constitutional foundations of human rights in India, examining Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy, and the legal frameworks that support them. The curriculum covers the roles and responsibilities of key institutions tasked with safeguarding these rights. A significant focus is placed on translating principles into action. Participants will explore how to embed ethics, empathy, and inclusion into everyday tasks such as policy implementation, grievance handling, and public service delivery. By the end of this course, government employees will be better equipped to make decisions that are not only efficient but also just, fostering greater trust and partnership between the state and its citizens.

title: Hurt and Grievous Hurt
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the legal framework governing hurt and grievous hurt under the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. With the recent overhaul of India's criminal laws, it is crucial for legal and law enforcement professionals to understand these changes. The curriculum covers the precise definitions of hurt and grievous hurt, distinguishing between them based on severity and intent. Key learning areas include the analysis of offences committed with dangerous weapons, poison, or acid, as well as specific contexts such as acts against public servants, actions under provocation, and offences related to extortion. The course also examines new provisions, such as grievous hurt caused by mob action or resulting in a permanent vegetative state. By referencing specific BNS sections and using practical examples, learners will be equipped to accurately interpret the law, analyze criminal liability, and understand the updated punishments and procedural implications.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Hurt Wrongful Restraint and Confinement Criminal Force and Assault
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the critical provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, focusing on Sections 114 through 136, which pertain to offences against the human body. It is designed for legal and law enforcement professionals who need to understand and apply these newly enacted laws. The curriculum systematically breaks down the definitions, essential elements, and prescribed punishments for offences including hurt, grievous hurt, wrongful restraint, wrongful confinement, criminal force, and assault. The course highlights the significant shifts from the Indian Penal Code, 1860, providing clarity on how judicial interpretations and procedural applications may evolve. Through detailed analysis, learners will be equipped to accurately differentiate between these offences, recognize aggravating factors such as the use of dangerous weapons or acid, and understand their application in scenarios involving public servants or extortion. Ultimately, this program builds the capacity to enforce these laws correctly and effectively within India's reformed criminal justice framework.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: HVCB - High Voltage Circuit Breaker
desc: This detailed technical course is designed for maintenance personnel working with railway electrical systems. It offers an in-depth guide to the maintenance and testing procedures for 130 to KV SF6 High Voltage Circuit Breakers (HVCB). The course begins by explaining the fundamental role of HVCBs in protecting traction power transformers and ensuring system safety. Participants will learn to identify all major parts of the HVCB and understand their functions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to hands-on maintenance protocols, covering visual inspections, cleaning, lubrication, and functional checks of components like heaters, anti-pumping devices, and interlocks. The curriculum thoroughly covers essential diagnostic tests, providing step-by-step instructions for performing Insulation Resistance (IR) tests, static and Dynamic Contact Resistance Measurement (CRM/DCRM), and operating time tests. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to perform scheduled maintenance, execute critical diagnostic tests, analyze the results to ensure equipment health, and adhere to all safety precautions, thereby contributing to the operational integrity of railway power systems.

title: Hydrogen Fuel
desc: This course delves into the significance of hydrogen energy in the context of global decarbonization and energy transition. It lays the foundation by exploring the unique physical and chemical properties that position hydrogen as a promising fuel for the future. You will learn to distinguish between different production pathways, from traditional methods like steam methane reforming to modern green electrolysis, and understand the environmental implications associated with each, signified by the 'green, blue, and grey' color codes. The course also examines the practical applications of hydrogen in industries and fuel cell technologies, alongside the challenges in storage and distribution. A key focus is placed on India's strategic vision, providing a detailed overview of the National Green Hydrogen Mission. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand hydrogen's pivotal role in building a resilient and sustainable national energy infrastructure.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IRIMEE)

title: IBC 2016: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
desc: This course delves into the procedural and legal intricacies of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under India's Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. It is designed for professionals who need to understand the mechanism for handling corporate financial distress. The course begins by setting the context, explaining why the IBC was a landmark reform for the Indian economy, aimed at improving the ease of doing business and resolving bad debt. Key learning areas include the initiation of CIRP, the roles and duties of the resolution professional, the formation and function of the Committee of Creditors, and the formulation and approval of a resolution plan. The course clearly distinguishes the resolution process from liquidation, outlining the triggers and consequences of the latter. Upon completion, learners will be able to navigate the key aspects of the CIRP, understand its impact on creditors and debtors, and appreciate its significance in the corporate governance and financial ecosystem.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: IBC 2016: Mastering Insolvency and Bankruptcy Frameworks
desc: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016, represents a landmark reform in India's economic landscape, creating a unified framework to address financial distress. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of this critical legislation and its implications for businesses, creditors, and financial professionals. You will delve into the core principles of the IBC, examining the entire lifecycle of the insolvency resolution process from initiation to completion. Key learning areas include the legal structure of the code, the functions and responsibilities of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI), the roles of resolution professionals and committees of creditors, and the mechanisms for asset valuation and recovery. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the complexities of the insolvency framework, understand its role in preserving economic value, and recognize its contribution to strengthening India's financial system and improving the ease of doing business.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: ICCC: A Holistic Approach to Tackle Environmental Challenge
desc: Chandigarh's ICCC was conceived to combat growing environmental issues such as air pollution, traffic congestion, water scarcity, and poor waste management. With strong leadership and support under the Smart Cities Mission, the city implemented a technology-driven, data-integrated command center to monitor and optimize urban operations across 25+ services. It evolved through four phases: planning, infrastructure development, real-time integration, and community engagement. The case presents both achievements and challenges—ranging from institutional resistance, financial limitations, and privacy concerns to remarkable successes in traffic management, pollution control, and citizen participation.

title: ICCTEP - Wireless Communication Fundamentals
desc: Embark on a detailed journey into the world of modern telecommunications with this expert-level course on wireless communication. This program is structured to provide a robust understanding of the technologies that power our connected world, making it essential for technical professionals in the telecommunications sector. The course begins by establishing a strong foundation, covering the physics of broadband wireless channels, the structure of cellular systems, and advanced topics like fading modelling, delay spread, and Doppler effects. Following this, learners will dive deep into 4G technology, exploring LTE architecture, the Evolved Packet System (EPS), and the specific functions of Layers 1, 2, and 3. The final module transitions to the next generation, introducing the vision and key performance indicators of 5G. Participants will learn about 5G standardization, new radio (NR) requirements, and spectrum allocation, concluding with a comparative analysis of 4G and 5G systems. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze and understand the architecture and principles of current and future wireless networks.

title: IDENTIFICATION CULTIVATION AND MANAGEMENT OF BAMBOO
desc: With the increasing demand for bamboo in both traditional and modern industries, sustainable cultivation and management have become critical. This course offers a comprehensive exploration of the entire lifecycle of bamboo as a valuable resource. Participants will begin by learning to identify various bamboo species, understanding their unique characteristics and uses. The curriculum then delves into the practical aspects of cultivation, covering propagation methods, soil requirements, and best practices for establishing healthy plantations. A significant focus is placed on intensive silvicultural practices designed to maximize yield and ensure the long-term health of the bamboo forest. By completing this module, learners will be prepared to contribute to the enhancement of bamboo resources, supporting both ecological balance and economic demand through scientific management and sustainable harvesting.
org: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education

title: Identity-Authentication-Authorization-Accounting
desc: In an increasingly digital world, securing information systems is paramount for government operations. This course offers a detailed examination of the core components of access control and IT security. Participants will begin by understanding the concept of digital identity and the processes of identity management (IdM), including single sign-on (SSO) and federated identity. The course then provides an in-depth look at authentication mechanisms, distinguishing between single-factor, two-factor (2FA), and multi-factor (MFA) authentication, and explores the protocols that enable them, such as OAuth and SAML. Learners will also analyze different authorization and access control models, including Discretionary (DAC), Mandatory (MAC), and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), to understand how permissions are granted and enforced. Finally, the course emphasizes the importance of accounting and logging for creating an audit trail, ensuring accountability, and enabling security incident response. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply these principles to design and maintain secure and compliant IT environments.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: IEPF Authority and its related Activities
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority and its activities. The program begins by explaining the legislative foundation of the IEPFA, established under Section 125 of the Companies Act, 2013, and details its composition and mandate. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the authority's primary functions, including the administration of the fund, the process for refunding shares, unclaimed dividends, and matured deposits to investors. The course outlines the specific forms and procedures involved, such as filing forms IEPF-1 through IEPF-7, and the re-engineered online refund process. Furthermore, it highlights the extensive investor awareness and education initiatives undertaken by the IEPFA, including media campaigns, collaborations with partner institutions, and digital outreach through various platforms. By the end of this course, participants will have a clear perspective on how the IEPFA works to protect investor rights and promotes financial literacy across the nation.

title: IGST Refunds in Customs
desc: This comprehensive course provides essential knowledge on managing IGST refunds for exported goods, a critical component of facilitating international trade. It addresses the importance of a seamless refund process for maintaining business liquidity and compliance. The curriculum delves into the technical integration between the GSTN and Customs EDI systems, which is fundamental to the automated refund mechanism. Participants will learn to identify and diagnose common error codes that often delay refunds, and will be guided through the specific steps required for rectification and amendment. The course further explains the procedural aspects of the scrutiny and sanctioning process conducted by customs officials. By completing this module, learners will be equipped to handle the IGST refund lifecycle efficiently, minimize errors, and ensure adherence to the latest customs regulations, thereby contributing to a more streamlined and predictable trade environment.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Immersive Technologies: Augmented and Virtual Reality
desc: This course on Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) is designed to equip learners with a solid understanding of immersive technologies and their transformative potential. Divided into three modules, the course begins with an Introduction to AR/VR, covering key concepts, history, components, and the underlying technologies that enable immersive experiences. The second module provides a Current and Future Industry Perspective, focusing on adoption trends, sector-wise applications, value creation, and case studies that illustrate how AR/VR is used across industries. The final module explores Government Initiatives and Technology Roadmap, detailing public policy frameworks, strategic investments, national programs, and guidelines that foster the growth of AR/VR ecosystems. Through a blend of theoretical insights and applied examples, learners will build a nuanced understanding of how AR/VR can be leveraged for innovation, capacity building, and public service delivery.
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Impact Assessment of Training Programmes
desc: In today's results-oriented public sector, proving the value of training is more critical than ever. This course provides an in-depth exploration of how to design and deliver training programmes that are both impactful and measurable. Moving beyond theoretical concepts, it provides a practical roadmap for embedding evaluation from the very beginning of the design process. You will learn to align learning objectives with robust measurement strategies, ensuring that every component of your training is geared towards a demonstrable outcome. The curriculum covers a range of tools, from real-time polls and scenario-based assessments to post-training reflective journals, enabling you to capture a holistic view of learner engagement, knowledge acquisition, and on-the-job application. By analyzing key performance indicators and implementing continuous feedback loops, you will be empowered to refine and enhance your training initiatives. This course will give you the capability to build a strong case for your training programs, backed by credible data and clear evidence of success.

title: Impact of Hydrological Cycle
desc: This course delves into the critical natural processes of the hydrological cycle, offering a detailed understanding of how water moves through the Earth's systems. It establishes the context by highlighting the limited availability of freshwater and the cycle's vital role in maintaining ecological balance and regulating weather patterns. Key learning areas include an in-depth exploration of the nine major components of the water cycle, such as evaporation, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, and runoff. The course also covers different types of water consumption, including domestic, industrial, and irrigation, and introduces learners to essential technical tools for water management. Participants will learn to apply the water balance equation and utilize three primary methods for measuring average rainfall: the Arithmetic Mean, Thiessen Polygon, and Isohyetal methods. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze water systems and apply scientific principles to support effective water resource management and policy.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: Impact of Mission Shakti in Odisha
desc: The case study examines the impact of Mission Shakti, a government initiative launched in Odisha, India, to promote women-led entrepreneurship and empowerment. The programme has enabled women to engage in income-generating activities, access financial services, and build leadership skills. It has strengthened women’s self-help groups (SHGs) through capacity building, skill development, and financial inclusion. Mission Shakti has empowered women to start and scale businesses, boosting their confidence, financial independence, and participation in social and political spheres. It further emphasizes the importance of community support, policy backing, and sustainable practices in ensuring long-term success, positioning Mission Shakti as a potential model for broader replication.

title: Impact of Sugar
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the adverse effects of high sugar intake. It begins by explaining the basic science of sugar as a carbohydrate and clarifies the crucial difference between naturally occurring sugars and the added sugars that pose significant health threats. The curriculum delves into specific health consequences, detailing how excessive sugar leads to weight gain, obesity, and insulin resistance, a precursor to Type 2 Diabetes. Furthermore, it examines the link between high sugar consumption and increased risks of heart disease, high blood pressure, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. The course also covers the direct impact of sugar on dental health, such as tooth decay and gum disease. By understanding these risks, learners will be better equipped to make informed dietary decisions, reduce their intake of added sugars, and take proactive steps towards a healthier lifestyle, which is crucial for maintaining long-term personal and professional effectiveness.

title: Implementation and Change Management
desc: This course on Implementation and Change Management is designed to equip public sector professionals with the skills to navigate complex organizational transformations. It addresses the critical importance of managing the human side of change to ensure that process improvements are not only implemented but also sustained. The curriculum explores foundational concepts and integrates them with proven methodologies like Lean Six Sigma, Kotter's 8-Step Model, and the ADKAR model. Key learning areas include developing effective communication plans, conducting stakeholder analysis using tools like the RACI matrix, and identifying and mitigating potential risks with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA). Through practical examples and case studies relevant to government operations, such as digitizing services and managing litigation processes, learners will understand how to apply these principles in their own work environments. This course will empower you to lead change initiatives confidently, ensuring that improvements deliver lasting value and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

title: Implementation of National IT Projects in Government Sector
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of the planning, execution, and management of large-scale national IT projects within the government sector. It is specifically designed for technology professionals transitioning into or consulting for public sector roles. The content moves beyond pure technology to address the complex realities of government work, including accountability to Parliament and the public, the necessity of transparent processes like tendering, and the management of multiple, often conflicting, stakeholders. Participants will gain practical insights into preparing concept notes, Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), and Request for Proposals (RfPs), alongside understanding procurement nuances, legal frameworks, and risk management. A significant focus is placed on developing the right mindset, emphasizing patience, perseverance, and effective communication to navigate the government ecosystem. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to lead digital transformation initiatives, manage stakeholder expectations, and successfully deliver high-impact e-governance projects.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Implementation of National Pension System Rules 2021
desc: This course aims to provide an understanding of the option available for employees under the National Pension System (NPS). It also explains the roles and responsibilities of employees, Heads of Office (HoO), Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs), and Pay and Accounts Officers (PAOs) in the process of NPS registration and the remittance of contributions. The course further covers the key events that trigger NPS exit and lead to the closure of an individual’s Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN). It also details the roles and responsibilities of employees, HoOs, DDOs, and PAOs in the processing of exit and pension-related cases under NPS.

title: Implementation of Poshan Abhiyaan in Kokrajhar district, Assam
desc: This case study highlights Ms. Varnali Dekha's innovative six-pronged strategy under the "Poshan" initiative to address nutrition-related challenges and improve the well-being of children in Kokrajhar district, Assam.

title: Implementation of Quality Management System in Medical Devices
desc: This course is designed to equip medical device professionals, regulatory officers, and public-sector stakeholders with the knowledge and practical skills required to design, implement, and sustain a compliant Quality Management System (QMS) within India’s regulatory framework. It bridges policy intent with operational execution by aligning the Medical Device Rules (MDR), 2017 with internationally recognized standards such as ISO 13485. Through a combination of real-world and programmatic case studies, including the Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban (SBM-U) and the Medtronic SynchroMed II recall, learners gain insights into regulatory risks, compliance failures, and system-level interventions required to ensure patient safety. The course emphasizes the end-to-end QMS lifecycle, including documentation, risk management, regulatory approvals, licensing through CDSCO, and post-market surveillance.

title: Implementation of Zero Trust Principles
desc: In an era of sophisticated cyber threats and porous network perimeters, traditional security models are no longer sufficient. This course introduces the Zero Trust security framework, a modern paradigm built on the principle of "never trust, always verify." Through an insightful conversation with a leading practitioner from UIDAI, learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of how to implement this model within a high-sensitivity government ecosystem. The curriculum delves into the core tenets of Zero Trust, including establishing identity as the primary security perimeter, implementing network and application micro-segmentation, and enforcing continuous authentication for all users and devices. It explores UIDAI's real-world security architecture, highlighting the roles of identity governance, encryption-by-design, and robust security controls across a partner ecosystem. Furthermore, the course explains the critical function of AI and machine learning in enhancing security operations, from anomaly detection and behavioral analytics to strengthening DevSecOps workflows. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to evaluate and apply Zero Trust principles to enhance the security posture and resilience of their own digital systems, aligning with modern compliance and governance standards.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India
keywords: BSE, ICCL, Cybersecurity, Capital Markets Security, API Security, CSCRF, SEBI, FMI Security, Market Integrity, Cyber Resilience

title: Implementing Unified Pension Scheme
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively implement the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS). It begins by establishing the context of the UPS as a new option within the National Pension System (NPS), detailing its legal framework and key features such as assured payouts and lump-sum benefits. The curriculum delves into the critical operational aspects, including eligibility criteria for current and future employees, contribution structures for both individual and pooled corpuses, and various investment patterns available to subscribers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the specific roles of Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) and Pay and Accounts Officers (PAOs), outlining the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for migration, verification, and authorization within the CRA system. Through detailed illustrations and scenario-based examples, learners will master the calculation of pension payouts, family payouts, and other financial benefits. Upon completion, officials will be fully prepared to manage the implementation of the UPS, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely service delivery to government employees.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Implications of Internal Security in India
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of India's internal security paradigm, designed for officials seeking to understand the nation's multifaceted security challenges. The program begins by establishing the context of internal security within India's diverse and complex society, highlighting how domestic vulnerabilities can be exploited by both internal and external actors. Key learning areas are structured around the most significant threats: cross-border terrorism, with a focus on its origins and impact on regions like Jammu and Kashmir; the Maoist insurgency in India's hinterland, examining its ideological roots and socio-economic drivers; and the persistent problem of insurgency in the Northeast, exploring its historical background and the strategic importance of the region. The course also discusses the government's multi-pronged approach, involving security measures, development initiatives, and policy-making. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the conceptual tools to analyze security threats and appreciate the integrated strategies required to ensure national stability and well-being.

title: Import and Export through Courier
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of courier-based import and export operations. It covers the procedures involved in handling courier consignments, including the movement of gems and jewellery, applicable duty structures, and the transshipment of goods. The course also explains the roles and responsibilities of Authorized Couriers and outlines the end-to-end process of electronic clearance for courier shipments.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Import Clearance Procedures under the Customs Act 1962
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Indian import customs clearance system and the complete import process from cargo arrival to final customs release. It covers the preparation, documentation, and electronic filing of the Bill of Entry, along with the applicable customs procedures and compliance requirements. Learners will gain practical knowledge of handling different types of imports, including commercial cargo, samples, courier and postal shipments, and imports through land customs stations. The course also explains the procedures and benefits related to re-importation and re-exportation to help businesses avoid double taxation and claim eligible exemptions. In addition, the course introduces the concepts of cargo consolidation and de-consolidation, including the use of master and house documents, the role of consolidators, and customs control mechanisms that ensure efficient and transparent clearance operations.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Import Export through Foreign Post Office
