desc: This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the entire lifecycle of international postal shipments, focusing on the critical role of Indian Customs. It begins by explaining the legal framework, including the Customs Act, 1962, and the Foreign Trade Policy, that governs the import and export of goods via post. Learners will explore the functions of the 28 notified Foreign Post Offices (FPOs) across India, where customs examination, assessment, and clearance take place. The curriculum delves into the practical aspects of the process, such as correctly filling out CN22/CN23 declaration forms for personal items and Postal Bills of Export (PBE) for commercial goods. It also clarifies the rules for prohibited and restricted items, the calculation of customs duties, exemptions for low-value items and gifts, and the procedure for claiming IGST refunds. By completing this course, officials will be equipped to facilitate hassle-free and legally compliant postal trade, enhancing efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.
org: National Academy of Customs, Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN)

title: Importance of Blood Group and DNA in Investigation
desc: This course delves into the critical application of biological sciences in the context of criminal justice. It is designed for professionals who require a foundational understanding of how scientific evidence supports and validates investigations. The curriculum begins with the core principles of forensic serology and biology, detailing the methods for collecting, preserving, and analyzing crucial biological evidence like blood, saliva, and semen. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to DNA forensics, explaining the powerful techniques of DNA profiling and its application in identity verification and paternity testing. Furthermore, learners will be introduced to essential medico-legal procedures, covering the protocols for autopsies, injury documentation, and the emerging field of digital postmortems. The course emphasizes the importance of maintaining the chain of custody and adhering to strict evidence handling protocols. Upon completion, participants will be able to recognize the vital role of forensic experts and appreciate how their contributions in the lab and the courtroom uphold the principles of justice.

title: Importance of Documents and Fingerprints in Investigation
desc: In an era where scientific evidence is paramount to the justice system, this course offers a comprehensive introduction to the critical branches of forensic science. It is designed to equip law enforcement and investigative professionals with the knowledge to effectively utilize forensic tools in criminal cases. The curriculum delves into multiple specialized fields, providing a robust overview of their practical applications. Learners will explore forensic anthropology for analyzing skeletal remains, forensic psychology for understanding brain-based investigative methods, and the intricacies of document examination, including handwriting analysis and advanced techniques like Electrostatic Detection Apparatus (ESDA). Furthermore, the course covers the rapidly evolving domains of computer forensics for handling digital evidence and the timeless science of fingerprint analysis, from latent print development to comparison. Participants will also learn the significance of trace evidence, such as footprints and tire impressions, in reconstructing crime scenes. Upon completion, learners will be able to identify and apply fundamental forensic principles, ensuring that evidence is handled according to scientific and legal standards, thereby strengthening the integrity of criminal investigations.

title: Importance of Surya Namaskar (English)
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the practice and benefits of Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation). It is designed for individuals seeking to incorporate a holistic and energizing routine into their daily lives for improved health and wellness. The content systematically breaks down the twelve-step sequence, detailing the eight core asanas such as Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose) and Parvatasana (Mountain Pose), guiding learners through the correct form and technique for each. The curriculum emphasizes the importance of synchronized breathing with each movement to maximize the physical and physiological benefits. Participants will learn how this practice stimulates the circulatory, respiratory, and digestive systems, enhances spinal flexibility, and aids in stress reduction. The course also provides crucial information on contraindications, advising when the practice should be avoided, such as during pregnancy or by individuals with specific health conditions like hypertension or sciatica. This makes it a safe and effective resource for anyone, including public officials, aiming to build personal resilience and well-being.
org: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY)

title: Important Concepts in Criminal Law
desc: This course provides an integrated understanding of foundational principles in criminal law and evidence, including double jeopardy, self-incrimination, ex post facto laws, natural justice, mens rea, actus reus, burden of proof, and presumption of innocence. It explains the constitutional and statutory foundations of these doctrines under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam. Participants will learn to apply these principles accurately to evaluate criminal liability and ensure procedural fairness in legal contexts.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Imprisonment and Prisoners and Prison Officers
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of punishment, sentencing, prison administration, bail, and post-conviction remedies under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 and the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. It covers the calculation of sentences, imposition of fines, types of imprisonment, solitary confinement, prisoner production, undertrial bail, and mercy petitions, with a focus on statutory limits, procedural safeguards, and judicial discretion. Participants will gain a structured understanding of the legal framework governing post-conviction processes and the operational procedures within the criminal justice and prison system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Improving Health Governance and Service Delivery
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of health systems governance as a critical pillar for sustainable health outcomes. It addresses the growing need for resilient and equitable health systems, particularly in the context of global health challenges. The curriculum delves into the foundational principles of health governance, starting with the World Health Organization's (WHO) six building blocks: service delivery, health workforce, information systems, access to essential medicines, financing, and leadership. Learners will be introduced to the Health System Performance Assessment (HSPA) framework, a vital tool for evaluating and improving system effectiveness. A significant focus is placed on the concept of resilience, equipping public health professionals with the knowledge to prepare for, respond to, and recover from public health crises. The course also emphasizes the importance of localizing governance by adapting global strategies to meet regional and community needs. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to analyze, design, and contribute to governance strategies that enhance health system performance and promote universal health coverage.

title: IMPROVING MODEL SHARE OF INDIAN RAILWAYS
desc: This course provides a comprehensive analysis of the challenges and opportunities in enhancing Indian Railways' share of the freight transport market. Participants will explore the historical context of the declining modal share and understand its broad implications for India's economy, environment, and public safety. The curriculum systematically breaks down the key constraints, including network congestion, lack of business development focus, uncompetitive pricing structures due to cross-subsidization, and last-mile connectivity issues. The course then transitions to a detailed examination of multi-pronged solutions. Key learning areas include strategies for increasing network capacity through dedicated freight corridors, modernizing rolling stock, and developing multimodal logistics parks. It also covers critical policy and pricing reforms needed to create a level playing field with road transport. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to analyze the rail freight ecosystem and contribute to strategic initiatives aimed at making Indian Railways a more efficient, competitive, and sustainable logistics provider.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Improving Outreach and Communication for Viksit Bharat
desc: In an era of rapid information flow, effective communication is a cornerstone of good governance and national development. This course provides a comprehensive framework for government officials to enhance their public outreach and communication capabilities. It delves into the principles of strategic communication, from crafting citizen-centric messages to selecting the most effective dissemination channels. Participants will explore how to leverage digital media and visual storytelling to maximize reach and engagement, ensuring that the purpose and impact of government initiatives are clearly understood by all stakeholders. The curriculum emphasizes a 'Whole-of-Government' and 'Whole-of-Society' approach, aligning communication efforts with national missions like Viksit Bharat and AatmaNirbhar Bharat. Key topics include integrating communication plans into Cabinet Notes, applying lifecycle-based storytelling for schemes, promoting Jan Bhagidari (public participation), and using tools like SAMVAD 2.0 for sentiment analysis. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to build public trust, counter misinformation effectively, and drive more inclusive and transparent governance.

title: Improving Passenger Experience
desc: As one of the world's largest railway networks, Indian Railways is on a continuous mission to enhance the travel experience for its millions of daily passengers. This course delves into the multifaceted strategy behind this transformation. You will explore the foundational importance of passenger safety, covering key initiatives like the Rashtriya Rail Sanraksha Kosh (RRSK), modern signaling systems, and advancements in coach design such as LHB coaches. The curriculum also examines security enhancements, including the role of the RPF and widespread CCTV surveillance. Furthermore, the course details the significant upgrades in passenger amenities, both at stations and onboard trains, and the implementation of robust customer care and grievance redressal systems to ensure a seamless and satisfactory journey. By the end of this course, learners will understand the holistic approach Indian Railways is taking to build a safer, more comfortable, and efficient network for all travelers.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Improving Revenue Department performance through LAKSHYAM
desc: The UP Government developed LAKSHYAM, a comprehensive performance management system for Lekhpals, to enhance accountability and effectiveness through objective KPIs, supervisor feedback, and stakeholder input, piloted in Prayagraj.

title: Improvised Explosive Devices: Safety and Response
desc: In an era of evolving security threats, the ability to respond safely and effectively to Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs) is a critical skill for public safety personnel. This course is designed to build that capability, providing a comprehensive framework for managing IED incidents. The curriculum delves into the technical aspects of IEDs, including their primary components and common classifications such as RCIEDs, VBIEDs, and booby traps. Participants will learn non-negotiable safety rules, including maintaining safe distances and establishing secure perimeters to protect themselves and the public. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the operational procedures for first responders. This includes securing the scene, coordinating evacuation efforts, and following precise communication protocols to ensure a clear and calm flow of information. Using the 2019 Pulwama incident as a case study, the course contextualizes these lessons, demonstrating the real-world consequences of threat recognition and coordinated response. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to act decisively and safely when faced with an explosive threat.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Inclusive Digital Economies and Gender Equality Playbook
desc: Dive into the critical intersection of digital transformation and gender equality with this in-depth course. Co-produced by the Asian Development Bank Institute and the UN Capital Development Fund, this program is structured around a practical 'playbook' designed for policymakers and development practitioners. The course begins by outlining why gender equality is fundamental to building resilient digital economies, highlighting the socio-economic barriers and cultural norms that hinder women's participation. It is divided into four key units: Diagnostics and Research, Women's Skills and Infrastructure, Policy and Regulation, and Innovation. Each unit deconstructs the specific market constraints women face, such as gaps in digital literacy, lack of access to finance and technology, and discriminatory policies. Learners will explore a range of tested interventions and innovative solutions, from leveraging sex-disaggregated data for better policy design to fostering women's entrepreneurship. The ultimate goal is to equip participants with the knowledge and tools to design and implement effective, gender-responsive strategies that not only include women in the digital economy but empower them as active creators and leaders within it.

title: Inclusive Public Finance: Gender Responsive Budgeting
desc: This course introduces participants to the theory and practice of Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB), a transformative approach to public financial management that integrates gender perspectives into fiscal policy. GRB is not about creating a separate budget for women but about ensuring that fiscal systems are equitable, inclusive, and aligned with gender equality and social justice goals. The course encourages participants to critically examine how government spending and revenue policies affect different groups of society. Through the lens of GRB, public finance becomes a lever for correcting historical inequalities, improving accountability, and ensuring that development reaches all sections of society. The course draws on India’s institutional experience with gender budgeting, global frameworks such as the SDGs, and practical tools to help officials embed gender considerations across planning, implementation, and evaluation.

title: Income from Business and Profession under Income Tax Act
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the principles and procedures for calculating 'Income from Business and Profession' under the Indian Income Tax Act. It is designed for tax professionals, finance officers, and business owners who need to ensure accurate tax compliance and effective financial planning. The course begins by defining the scope of business and professional income, with clear examples to differentiate between the two. You will learn to identify and apply rules for allowable deductions, such as rent, salaries, depreciation, and other operational expenses, to accurately compute taxable profits. A significant focus is placed on statutory obligations, including the requirements for maintaining books of accounts under Section 44AA and the criteria for mandatory tax audits under Section 44AB. Furthermore, the course demystifies presumptive taxation schemes (Sections 44AD, 44ADA, and 44AE), offering practical insights into simplifying compliance for eligible taxpayers. Upon completion, you will be equipped to handle PGBP computations confidently, ensuring lawful tax filing and strategic financial management.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Income-tax Act 2025: Understanding the New Direct Tax Framework
desc: The Income-tax Act, 2025 introduces a comprehensive transformation of India’s direct tax framework by replacing the Income-tax Act, 1961 with a simplified, modern, and digitally aligned legislation. Introduced with the objective of improving clarity, reducing complexity, and enhancing ease of compliance, the new Act restructures tax provisions into a more accessible and logically organised framework. The Act significantly reduces legislative complexity by simplifying language, removing redundant provisions, and introducing a streamlined structure with fewer chapters and sections. It replaces the traditional distinction between the “Previous Year” and “Assessment Year” with a unified concept of the “Tax Year,” creating a more intuitive approach to tax compliance. This course provides an in-depth understanding of the key structural and conceptual changes introduced under the Income-tax Act, 2025.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Increasing your Emotional Quotient
desc: In today's demanding professional environment, the ability to manage one's emotions is a cornerstone of resilience and effective leadership. This course offers a comprehensive guide to developing your emotional quotient. It begins by establishing the context of why emotions, if left unmanaged, can hinder personal growth and professional success. You will delve into the patterns behind reactive behaviors and understand the connection between your mind, body, and emotions. The core of the course focuses on practical, time-tested techniques for emotional regulation, including mindfulness, meditation, and specific breathing exercises. You will learn how to transform negative emotional states into sources of strength and clarity. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the tools to respond to situations with composure, build stronger self-confidence, overcome the fear of rejection, and maintain a balanced perspective, ultimately leading to greater well-being and effectiveness in your role.

title: India in a Changing Climate
desc: Climate change poses a critical challenge to India's development, impacting its economy, environment, and society. This course offers an in-depth analysis of India's unique position in a changing global climate. It begins by explaining the fundamental science of climate change and its specific relevance to India's diverse geography and demographics. The curriculum then explores the nation's key vulnerabilities across sectors like agriculture, water security, energy systems, public health, and urban planning, using real-world case studies to illustrate the impacts. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing India's policy landscape, from the National Action Plan on Climate Change to state-level strategies for adaptation and mitigation. Learners will also evaluate India's role and commitments in international frameworks such as the UNFCCC and the Paris Agreement. The course emphasizes the principles of equity and climate justice, preparing learners to contribute to policy analysis and the design of sustainable, resilient development pathways for India.

title: India Post Annual Report 2023-24
desc: This detailed course serves as an official guide to the India Post Annual Report 2023-24, designed to familiarize employees with the organization's multifaceted operations and strategic direction. The content delves into the core functions of the department, providing context on why its services are crucial for national development and last-mile connectivity. Key learning areas include a thorough review of the postal network's expansion, the array of financial services such as POSB and IPPB, and significant advancements in logistics and parcel services. Learners will also explore innovations in citizen-centric services like Aadhaar and Passport Seva Kendras, the impact of Mission Karmayogi on capacity building, and the department's financial performance and vigilance framework. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the key achievements and future outlook of the Department of Posts, fostering a deeper sense of organizational awareness and purpose.

title: India Post Core system Integration to Advanced Postal Technology 2.0
desc: This course provides an overview of India Post’s digital transformation journey, focusing on the evolution from the Core System Integrator (CSI) project to the Advanced Postal Technology (APT) 2.0 platform. It explains the CSI framework, its role in integrating postal operations, key implementation challenges, and the need for technological advancement. The course further explores APT 2.0, a next-generation digital platform designed to enhance operational efficiency through cloud-based infrastructure, automation, improved security, and advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence. It highlights how APT 2.0 strengthens service delivery, improves system reliability, and enables seamless workflows across postal networks.

title: India Post Mail Handling: Bagging and Transmission Process
desc: In a vast and diverse country, the efficiency of the postal system is paramount for communication and commerce. This course provides a comprehensive guide to India Post's updated mail handling and transmission framework, designed to standardize procedures and enhance service delivery. It addresses the critical need for postal staff to be proficient in the latest operational guidelines to maintain the integrity and speed of the national mail network. Learners will delve into the core components of the mail processing chain. The curriculum covers the fundamental classification of mail into accountable and unaccountable categories, detailing the specific bagging protocols for each. This includes the use of TD (To Deliver) and NTD (Not To Deliver) bags, the significance of color-coded labels for different mail types, and the dispatch logic for items routed through National Sorting Hubs, Parcel Hubs, and international exchange offices. The course also clarifies the pivotal role of Railway Mail Service (RMS) offices in the sorting and transit ecosystem. Upon completion, participants will be able to correctly classify, bag, and dispatch mail according to the revised standards. This will lead to a tangible reduction in sorting errors, faster transit times, and improved reliability of mail services. By mastering these procedures, employees will directly contribute to strengthening the operational excellence and public trust in India Post.

title: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB)
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed overview of the India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) and its pivotal role in expanding financial services across India. The curriculum begins by explaining the concept of Payment Banks, tracing their origin to the recommendations of the Dr. Nachiket Mor Committee, and outlining their primary objective of fostering financial inclusion for low-income households and the unorganized sector. Learners will gain an in-depth understanding of IPPB's structure, including its nationwide network that leverages over 1.5 lakh post offices and a dedicated workforce of Postmen and Gramin Dak Sevaks (GDS). The course covers the full spectrum of IPPB's offerings, from basic savings and current accounts to advanced digital services like the Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS), Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT), and the Micro ATM application used for doorstep banking. It also details the specific roles and responsibilities of postal staff in customer onboarding, transaction processing, and cash management. Upon completion, participants will be fully prepared to facilitate IPPB services, thereby empowering citizens with accessible, affordable, and trusted banking solutions.

title: India Post Payments Bank Accounting in Postal Accounts Office
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the accounting processes specific to the India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) as managed by Postal Accounts Offices (PAO). In the context of digital public finance, maintaining accurate and reconciled records across multiple platforms is paramount for accountability and transparent governance. This training addresses that need directly by focusing on the key software and reporting tools used in the department, including Finacle and SAP. Participants will learn the end-to-end process of financial data management, starting from downloading financial reports to performing detailed reconciliations. Key learning areas include methods for identifying and resolving data discrepancies, procedures for verifying General Ledger (GL) entries unique to PAO New Delhi, and the systematic comparison of e-Lekha monthly reports against SAP data. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in these specialized accounting tasks, enabling them to uphold financial integrity and contribute to the efficient fiscal management of the India Post Payments Bank.

title: India Post Payments Bank operations and Accounting
desc: This course is designed to equip personnel with the essential knowledge to manage the financial operations of the India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) within the Department of Posts ecosystem. The curriculum delves into the core accounting procedures, explaining the various heads of accounts and the flow of accounting entries for all types of IPPB transactions. Participants will explore the intricacies of cash management across Branch Post Offices (BO), Sub Post Offices (SO), and Head Post Offices (HO), including the roles and responsibilities of different postal staff. Key learning areas include the reconciliation of cash transactions, the mechanics of sweep-in and sweep-out functionalities, and the accounting for NEFT, RTGS, and UPI payments. The course also covers the calculation and settlement of the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR). Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using systems like Finacle and CSI for reporting and reconciliation, ensuring financial accuracy and compliance in IPPB operations.

title: India Post Website
desc: This program offers a detailed exploration of the India Post website (indiapost.gov.in), a primary digital gateway for the Department of Posts' services. The course is structured to guide learners through every major section of the portal, establishing a strong foundation for both employees and the public. Key learning areas include understanding the homepage layout, using tools like 'Track and Trace' and 'Postage Calculation', and accessing information on premium, domestic, and international mail products. The curriculum also covers crucial citizen-centric services such as Postal Savings Bank schemes, Postal Life Insurance (PLI), and the process for filing Right to Information (RTI) requests. Participants will learn how to find official circulars, recruitment notices, and performance dashboards. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to navigate the website with confidence, enabling them to provide or receive services more efficiently and stay informed about the department's operations and offerings.

title: India's Border
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of India's international borders, providing critical context for their importance in national security, sovereignty, and foreign policy. It delves into the historical formation of modern borders, introducing learners to the academic field of border studies (Limology) and its core concepts. The curriculum systematically covers the different classifications of border disputes—territorial, positional, and functional—and their real-world implications. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the post-independence evolution of India’s frontiers with its neighbors, including Pakistan, China, Bangladesh, Nepal, and others, as well as its maritime boundaries. By analyzing key treaties, historical agreements, and pivotal conflicts, participants will develop a nuanced understanding of the strategic and diplomatic complexities involved. This foundational knowledge is designed to enhance the situational awareness and analytical capabilities of personnel working in border management, national security, and strategic policy roles.

title: India's Dam Safety Act: From Risk to Regulation
desc:
India, home to over 6,000 large dams—many aging and vulnerable—faced longstanding challenges in ensuring dam safety due to fragmented practices and federal complexities. The 1979 Machchhu-2 dam disaster underscored the urgency, but legislative efforts stalled for decades.
The Dam Safety Act, 2021 marks a historic shift by establishing a uniform, legally binding framework for dam safety across India. Overcoming constitutional hurdles, inter-state tensions, and institutional inertia, the Act was enabled by sustained bureaucratic advocacy, legal innovation, and broad stakeholder engagement.
Key features include a four-tier safety structure, mandatory inspections, real-time monitoring, and clear accountability mechanisms—balancing national oversight with state autonomy. 
This case highlights how long-term reform is possible through persistence, adaptive policymaking, and cooperative federalism. It offers lessons for future legislation involving complex governance and public safety systems.

title: India's New Criminal Laws: Key Changes for Public Administration
desc: This presentation provides a comprehensive overview of India’s new criminal laws—the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA)—with a focus on their underlying philosophy, key legal and procedural shifts, and implications for public administration. It highlights the transition towards citizen- and victim-centric justice, technology-enabled processes, digital evidence, time-bound investigation and trial, and strengthened forensic systems. The presentation also examines the role of civil servants and district administration in coordinating police, prosecution, forensic services, judiciary, and citizen-facing mechanisms for effective implementation.

title: India's New Labour Codes: Key Changes and Impact on Employers
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of India’s four New Labour Codes and their implications for employers across sectors. It explains the rationale behind consolidating 29 labour laws into a unified framework and examines key reforms under the Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSH) Code, and Code on Social Security. Through practical explanations and real-world examples, participants will understand changes in wage structures, manpower flexibility, workplace safety, and expanded social security. Designed for HR professionals, compliance officers, PSU executives, and government officials, the course equips learners to proactively manage compliance, costs, and workforce relations in the post-reform labour ecosystem.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: India's Next Wave: A Product Nation
desc: This course provides a high-level strategic overview of India's journey to becoming a product-led economy. It delves into the core policies and initiatives, such as 'Make in India', 'Digital India', and 'Startup India', that are shaping this transformation. Learners will gain insights into the pivotal role of intellectual property (IP) ownership, the necessity of deep-tech research and development (R&D), and the power of public-private partnerships in driving innovation. The discussion also covers the application of GovTech (G2C) models for citizen-centric services, the challenges of cybersecurity in a digital-first world, and strategies for talent development. By the end of this course, participants will understand the multifaceted approach required to build a self-reliant and globally competitive product ecosystem in India, equipping them with the perspective to contribute to policy-making and strategic implementation.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Indian Administrative Services (IAS) Pay Rules
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the Indian Administrative Services (IAS) Pay Rules. In the context of public administration, correct and transparent management of remuneration is crucial for maintaining morale and compliance. This program delves into the core components of IAS pay, starting with the revised pay structure and the pay matrix. It provides detailed instructions on the process of pay fixation, covering scenarios for newly recruited officers as well as those receiving promotions. Furthermore, the course clarifies the rules for the regulation of increments, a key aspect of career progression. It concludes by explaining how an officer's pay is structured according to the specific type of post they occupy. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate and apply the IAS Pay Rules in relevant administrative and financial functions.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Indian Context: Industry Analysis of Gas
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of India's natural gas sector, designed for professionals seeking to understand its strategic importance in the national context. The curriculum addresses why natural gas is a critical component of India's energy mix, its contribution to economic development, and its role as a transition fuel towards a cleaner energy future. Key learning areas include an analysis of domestic production versus LNG import dependency, the development of the National Gas Grid, and the regulatory landscape influencing market dynamics. Learners will explore government initiatives, pricing challenges, and investment opportunities. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to evaluate sectoral strategies and understand the trajectory of India's gas industry within the global energy landscape, enabling them to contribute to policy, planning, and strategic decision-making in the energy domain.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Indian Context: Industry Analysis of Oil
desc: This course provides a detailed exploration of the Indian oil industry's pivotal role in national development. It addresses the complex interplay of factors shaping this critical sector, from its function in supporting economic stability to its vulnerability to external shocks. Learners will delve into the context of India's significant reliance on oil imports and the resulting trade deficits and energy security concerns. Key learning areas include the analysis of demand-supply imbalances, the effects of global price volatility, and the influence of regulatory policies on industry performance. The course also evaluates the strategic shift towards renewable energy and sustainable practices as the industry navigates a changing global energy landscape. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze the sector's challenges and opportunities, preparing them to contribute to strategic planning and policy-making in the energy domain.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Indian Criminal Justice System: From Legal Reforms to Future Justice
desc: This course provides learners with an integrated understanding of the evolving criminal justice system in India and its relationship with human rights, media, globalization, technology, philosophy, and nation-building. The course examines the balance between freedom of the press and fair trial, protection of human dignity and liberty, international cooperation against transnational crime, and the transition from colonial criminal codes to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA). It further explores the future of criminal justice through digital courts, AI-assisted policing, restorative justice, comparative justice systems, and major philosophies of law and punishment. The course enables learners to appreciate criminal justice as a framework for fairness, accountability, dignity, democratic governance, and nation-building.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Indian Economy for Practitioners
desc: Gain a foundational understanding of the Indian economic system with this practitioner-focused course. It begins by exploring India's economic history post-independence, detailing the shift from a state-led model to a market-oriented economy. The curriculum is structured to provide a deep dive into the core sectors that drive the nation's growth. You will analyze the policies and performance of the agriculture sector, the evolution of industrial and manufacturing policies, and the rise of the services sector as a key economic backbone. Furthermore, the course offers a detailed account of the critical banking and financial sector reforms that have shaped modern India's financial landscape. Upon completion, you will be equipped to better understand the structural components of the Indian economy, interpret its growth story, and appreciate the context behind current economic challenges and future prospects.

title: Indian Knowledge System: Perspectives on Public Administration
desc: Gain a comprehensive understanding of ancient Indian political thought and its enduring relevance in the field of public administration. This course provides a detailed examination of governance models that have shaped Indian statecraft for centuries. The curriculum begins with an introduction to 'Rajadharma' and its philosophical underpinnings in texts like the Manusmriti and the epics. The core of the course is a deep dive into Kautilya's Arthashastra, analyzing its detailed prescriptions for internal administration, foreign policy, economic management (Kosha), and law and order (Danda). You will learn about the seven essential elements of a Kautilyan state, from the ruler (Swami) to allies (Mitra), and understand their functions. The course also evaluates how these ancient principles can offer valuable insights for modern leaders, policymakers, and administrators in both public and private sectors, fostering a holistic perspective on governance.

title: Indian Knowledge Systems and Environmental Sustainability
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the role of Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) in promoting environmental sustainability. It establishes the context by connecting India's rich cultural and philosophical heritage to the urgent need for sustainable practices in the modern world. Key learning areas include an exploration of ancient water harvesting techniques, Vedic principles for energy efficiency, and traditional philosophies on mindful consumption and waste reduction. The curriculum delves into indigenous methods for building climate resilience, conserving marine ecosystems, and protecting biodiversity through land management practices rooted in harmony with nature. Ultimately, learners will understand how to integrate this timeless wisdom with contemporary policies and practices. The course empowers public officials and individuals to apply culturally relevant, innovative, and eco-conscious approaches in their personal and professional lives, contributing to India’s sustainable development goals and the vision of a Viksit Bharat.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Indian Knowledge Systems based Pedagogy and Teaching Methodologies
desc: Indian Knowledge Systems based Pedagogy and Teaching Methodologies is a specialized course designed for trainers, government employees, learning and development professionals, and personnel from CTIs/ATIs engaged in training and capacity-building activities, as well as individuals seeking to develop advanced training competencies. The course is structured into four comprehensive modules that explore the philosophical foundations of ancient Indian education, including the concept of Vidyā and the pursuit of holistic human development. It examines classical pedagogical frameworks such as the Gurukul system, the Guru–Shishya Parampara, and the threefold learning process of Śravaṇa (listening), Manana (reflection), and Nididhyāsana (deep internalization), along with contemplative learning approaches based on Chintan.

title: Indian Knowledge Systems in Governance: A Values-Based Approach
desc: This course offers a comprehensive journey into the ethical foundations of governance, drawing from the deep well of Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS). It moves beyond conventional administrative training to connect public servants with the timeless values that have shaped India's civilizational ethos. The curriculum is structured to provide a robust understanding of how principles like duty (Dharma), selfless action (Karma Yoga), and integrity can be applied to address contemporary administrative challenges. Participants will explore key values such as self-reflection (Svadhyaya), collaboration (Sahakaryata), and stewardship (Rajyakarma) as presented in foundational texts like the Vedas, Bhagavad Gita, and Ramayana. The course contextualizes this ancient wisdom within modern frameworks, including the Karmayogi Competency Model, to demonstrate its direct applicability to daily work. By integrating these enduring principles, learners will be equipped to navigate complex ethical dilemmas, enhance institutional integrity, and champion a more value-driven, citizen-centric approach to public service.

title: Indian Partnership Act, 1932
desc: This course offers a structured exploration of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932, designed for officials who need to understand the legalities of partnership-based businesses. The curriculum is divided into four key modules that cover the entire spectrum of partnership law. It begins with an introduction to the Act's structure and objectives, followed by a detailed look at the features of partners and partnerships. Learners will then study the critical aspects of firm constitution, including partnership deeds, registration, and the implications of admitting or retiring a partner. The final module addresses the dissolution of a firm, outlining the rights and liabilities of partners in such events. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret and apply the provisions of the Act, enabling them to handle matters related to partnership firms with legal clarity and confidence, particularly in contexts like tax assessment and regulatory compliance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Indian Railway: Dynamic Assured Career Progression Scheme
desc: The Dynamic Assured Career Progression (DACP) Scheme is a critical framework for the career advancement of medical officers within Indian Railways. This course offers a comprehensive guide to the scheme's policies and procedures, ensuring that officers and administrative staff can navigate its complexities with confidence. Understanding DACP is essential for maintaining transparent and equitable career growth, which directly impacts officer morale and organizational effectiveness. The curriculum delves into the core aspects of the DACP, including the defined promotion hierarchy, specific eligibility requirements for advancement, and the rules governing financial upgradations. Special attention is given to interpreting key Railway Board directives, such as RBE No. 91/2002 and RBE No. 05/2009, which provide the legal and administrative basis for the scheme's implementation. The course also addresses practical scenarios, such as the implications of Extraordinary Leave (EOL) on an officer's progression. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to accurately apply DACP policies, manage related administrative tasks, and provide clear guidance on career progression matters within the Indian Railway Medical Service and Indian Railway Health Service.

title: Indian Railway: Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme
desc: This course provides an in-depth exploration of the Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme (MACPS), a critical component of career management within Indian Railways. It is designed to equip railway personnel with a thorough understanding of the scheme's framework and its practical application. The curriculum delves into the core components of MACPS, including the specific eligibility conditions for financial upgradations, the methodology for pay fixation as per FR 22, and the principles of service reckoning. Participants will learn to identify and address common anomalies and errors that can occur during MACPS implementation. The course also clarifies the pivotal role of the Screening Committee, procedures for handling promotion refusals, and special provisions for cases like medical de-categorization. Furthermore, it explains the interplay between MACPS and other related benefits such as LARSGESS, staff benefit funds, passes, and PTOs. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in interpreting and applying MACPS rules, enabling them to manage their career progression and associated entitlements confidently.
keywords: Modified Assured Career Assured Progression Scheme

title: Indian Railways - Indents and Tendering (English)
desc: Effective procurement is fundamental to the operational efficiency and financial health of a vast organization like Indian Railways. This course offers a detailed examination of the complete tendering and indenting lifecycle, providing officials with the necessary knowledge to manage procurement activities with transparency and accountability. The curriculum begins by outlining the different agencies for purchase and the authority of the Controller of Stores. Learners will delve into the specifics of direct purchasing, including the various tender types such as global, advertised, limited, and single tenders, understanding the value-based criteria for each. The course thoroughly explains the tender finalization process, the role of the tender committee, and the key considerations for selecting a suitable offer. Furthermore, it covers the classification and management of stores contracts, including rate, running, and fixed quantity contracts. A dedicated section on contract administration addresses amendments, delivery extensions, liquidated damages, and risk purchases. The material also touches upon import procedures and the Indian Railways Standard (IRS) Conditions of Contract. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to execute procurement tasks in compliance with established rules, contributing to the smooth functioning of the railway supply chain.

title: Indian Railways - Inventory Management (English)
desc: Gain a detailed understanding of inventory management tailored specifically for the complexities of Indian Railways. This course delves into the strategic importance of managing materials and stores, which form the backbone of railway maintenance, operations, and safety. You will learn the fundamental concepts that govern inventory control, including demand forecasting, stock level optimization, and lead time management. The curriculum explores key functional areas such as the procurement process for goods, scientific warehousing techniques, and efficient distribution logistics to various depots and workshops. Participants will also examine the procedures for the classification, codification, and verification of stock. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to apply best practices in inventory management to enhance operational efficiency, minimize waste, and contribute to the financial health and smooth functioning of Indian Railways, ensuring that the right materials are available at the right place and time.

title: Indian Railways - Leave Rules (English)
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the leave management system within Indian Railways. The curriculum delves into the specifics of the Indian Railways Leave Rules, explaining why a standardized leave policy is crucial for operational continuity and employee welfare in such a large organization. Key learning areas include the classification of leave (e.g., Leave on Average Pay, Leave on Half Average Pay, Casual Leave), conditions for granting leave, and special provisions for different circumstances. Learners will be guided through the procedural aspects of the leave lifecycle, from submission of applications to the final approval and record-keeping. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply these rules in their day-to-day work, handle employee queries effectively, and ensure full compliance with the regulatory framework governing leave.

title: Indian Railways - Organization and Functions of Personnel Department (English)
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the organization and functions of the Personnel Department in Indian Railways. It is designed for officials seeking to understand the critical role of human resource management in one of India's largest public sector employers. The course begins by illustrating the department's hierarchical structure, presenting organizational charts for the Railway Board, Zonal, and Divisional levels. Learners will delve into the nine primary functional areas of personnel management, covering everything from organizational planning and manpower assessment to staffing processes like recruitment, promotion, and separation. Key topics include training and development, compensation administration, employee services and benefits, record-keeping, and the framework for handling labor and industrial relations. By completing this course, participants will gain a clear and structured understanding of the personnel functions that are essential for the efficient administration and welfare of the railway workforce.

title: Indian Railways - Passes And PTOs (English)
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to the Railway Servants (Pass) Rules, 1986, a crucial document for all Indian Railways employees. It begins by outlining the statutory basis of these rules and proceeds to detail the various categories of travel benefits. Learners will explore the specifics of Duty Passes (Gold, Silver, Bronze), Privilege Passes, and School Passes, understanding the distinct entitlements for Group A, B, C, and D employees. The curriculum also thoroughly covers the regulations for Privilege Ticket Orders (PTOs), post-retirement passes, and special provisions for widows and medically challenged retirees. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply the rules concerning their travel benefits, ensuring correct and efficient management of their entitlements.

title: Indian Railways - Provision and Recoupment (English)
desc: This course delves into the essential processes of materials management as applied in the Indian Railways. It begins by contextualizing the role of materials as a key resource in industrial activity and its direct impact on organizational profitability. You will explore the primary functions of a materials management department, from planning and procurement to warehousing, inventory control, and the disposal of surplus or scrap materials. The curriculum focuses on the practical aspects of stores management, detailing the classification of stores into categories such as stock, non-stock, emergency, and surplus. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Indian Railways' systematic approach to inventory, covering the standard nomenclature lists, the 'basic commodity' method for item description, and the eight-digit Price List (PL) number coding system. Upon completion, you will have a strong foundational knowledge of the procedures that ensure materials are available at the right time, in the right quantity, and are accounted for correctly.

title: Indian Railways - Provision and Recoupment (Hindi)
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices of materials and stores management, specifically tailored to the operational context of Indian Railways. It begins by establishing the importance of materials management as a core function for organizational profitability and efficiency, detailing its key components from planning and procurement to warehousing and disposal. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the systematic classification of railway stores, including ordinary, emergency, surplus, and imprest stores, and learn the criteria for each category. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the standard nomenclature system used in Indian Railways. This includes the methodology for describing items, the structure of Price List (PL) numbers, and the 8-digit coding system that ensures unique identification and streamlined logistics. By completing this course, personnel will be equipped to manage railway stores effectively, ensure proper material accountal, and contribute to the financial health and operational readiness of the Indian Railways system.

title: Indian Railways - Returned Stores (English)
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip personnel with a thorough understanding of the rules and procedures governing returned stores and scrap management in the Indian Railways. The content addresses the critical importance of proper material handling to optimize resource use and ensure financial accountability. Key learning areas include the correct preparation and distribution of the Advice Note for Returned Stores (Form S-1539), the process of maintaining departmental registers, and the principles of valuing returned materials, distinguishing between stock and non-stock items. Furthermore, the course delves into the identification and classification of surplus and scrap materials, detailing the role of the Survey Committee in this process. Learners will gain practical insights into the various methods of scrap disposal, such as public auctions, tender sales, and direct sales, including the procedures for lot formation, auction conduct, and the issuance of delivery orders. Upon completion, participants will be able to effectively manage the return, valuation, and disposal of railway stores, contributing to operational efficiency and financial integrity.

title: Indian Railways - Role of Materials Management (English)
desc: This foundational course delves into the detailed functions of materials management as applied within the specific context of Indian Railways. It is designed to equip personnel with the necessary knowledge to navigate the complexities of a large-scale public sector supply chain. The curriculum begins by establishing the strategic importance of materials management for the operational efficiency and financial health of the railways. Key learning areas include the complete lifecycle of materials, from demand forecasting and procurement procedures to inventory management, warehousing, and logistics. The course will also cover the protocols for the maintenance of stock and the systematic disposal of surplus or obsolete materials, ensuring compliance with organizational regulations. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these principles to their roles, contributing to improved resource optimization, cost reduction, and the seamless functioning of railway operations, thereby enhancing overall service delivery and accountability.

title: Indian Railways - Signalling 1 (English)
desc: Railway signalling is the backbone of safe and efficient train movement, and this course offers a comprehensive introduction to its fundamental principles and technologies within the Indian Railways network. It establishes the context by explaining why fail-safe and reliable signalling is critical for preventing accidents and maximizing line capacity. The course provides a detailed examination of key operational equipment and their underlying logic. Learners will study the classification of railway stations and the specific signalling requirements for each. The curriculum thoroughly covers the workings of block instruments, including single and double line systems, token and tokenless operations, and the 'lock and block' principle. Furthermore, it explores the mechanics of point operation, detailing how train paths are set, locked, and detected to ensure route integrity. A significant portion is dedicated to track circuits, explaining how they detect train presence, facilitate route holding, and contribute to overall system safety. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand the intricate systems that govern train movements, interpret signalling procedures, and appreciate the critical safety checks embedded in railway operations. This knowledge is essential for personnel responsible for train control, signal maintenance, and operational safety.

title: Indian Railways - Signalling 1 (Hindi)
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the signalling infrastructure vital to the Indian Railways network. It begins by establishing the context of railway safety, emphasizing the 'fail-safe' philosophy that governs all signalling equipment. Learners will delve into the mechanics and operational logic of key systems, including single and double line block instruments, token and tokenless working, and the principles of 'lock and block'. The course thoroughly explains the operation of points for path diversion, covering mechanical and electrical methods, locking, and detection. Furthermore, it details the application of track circuits for train detection, route holding, and automatic signal control. Upon completion, participants will have a comprehensive understanding of how these interconnected systems work together to prevent collisions, manage train movements, and uphold the highest standards of safety in railway operations.

title: Indian Railways Bio-Toilet System
desc: The Bio-Toilets in Indian Railways course provides railway staff and stakeholders with a thorough understanding of bio-toilets, including their development, components, functioning, and benefits. As part of Indian Railways’ commitment to cleanliness, environmental sustainability, and passenger comfort, bio-toilets are a key element of modern sanitation infrastructure. This course highlights their operational aspects, maintenance practices, and the efforts taken to ensure effective usage across the railway network.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IRIMEE)

title: Indic Reasoning for Modern Governance
desc: Indic Reasoning for Modern Governance is a practical capacity-building course designed for civil servants, administrators, and public officials seeking to strengthen decision-making, policy formulation, and stakeholder engagement through the application of Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS). Drawing primarily from the Nyaya tradition of reasoning, the course translates timeless Indic frameworks into actionable tools for addressing contemporary governance challenges. The course explores how governance outcomes can be improved through greater clarity, rigorous validation of information, precise definition-making, and constructive dialogue. Participants will learn to apply Nyaya's four means of valid knowledge—Pratyaksha (observation), Anumana (inference), Upamana (comparison), and Sabda (authoritative testimony)—to evaluate evidence, test assumptions, and make informed decisions.

title: Individual Performance Management System (IPMS) in BSNL.
desc: This detailed course is designed to equip employees and managers with a thorough understanding of the Individual Performance Management System (IPMS). It explains the critical role of performance management in driving organizational success by aligning individual efforts with corporate goals. The curriculum delves into the practical application of IPMS, starting from the initial planning and goal-setting phase to the final evaluation. Key learning areas include understanding and assigning Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), setting SMART targets, and navigating the digital IPMS portal for submission and review. Participants will learn about the four-part IPMS process involving the employee, controlling officer, and reviewing officer, ensuring clarity and transparency. The course also covers the methodology for score calculation, its direct linkage to the Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR), and strategies to avoid common assessment biases. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the IPMS framework to track performance, facilitate professional growth, and contribute effectively to organizational targets.

title: Induction Course PM SVANidhi
desc: Street vendors are a vital component of the urban informal economy, yet they often face financial exclusion and regulatory challenges. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the policy landscape created to support them. It begins by contextualizing the role of street vendors and delves into the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014, which provides a legal foundation for their rights and regulation. The core of the course focuses on the Prime Minister Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) Scheme. Learners will explore the scheme's key features, including the provision of affordable working capital loans, the step-by-step implementation process involving Urban Local Bodies and lending institutions, and the roles of various stakeholders. Furthermore, the course examines how digital platforms and technology are leveraged to streamline applications, disbursements, and repayments, enhancing the scheme's accessibility and impact. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to better support the street vendor community and contribute to inclusive urban development.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Industry 4.0-Digital Transformation in Manufacturing
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Industry 4.0, focusing on the technologies, opportunities, challenges, and human factors shaping the future of industry and manufacturing. It begins with an overview of the concept and evolution of Industry 4.0, followed by an exploration of the key technologies driving digital transformation, including Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things (IoT), automation, cloud computing, robotics, and advanced data analytics. The course examines the opportunities offered by Industry 4.0, as well as the challenges organizations may face during implementation, including technological, organizational, workforce, and cybersecurity considerations. Learners will also explore the importance of data analytics as a cornerstone of Industry 4.0 and understand how data-driven insights can support better decision-making, efficiency, and innovation.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Industry 4.0-Digital Transformation in Manufacturing
desc: Dive into the next industrial revolution with this detailed course on Industry 4.0 and its impact on manufacturing. This program is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the shift towards smart, automated, and data-driven production environments. The curriculum covers the foundational pillars of Industry 4.0, including cyber-physical systems, IoT, cloud computing, and AI, explaining how they integrate to create a fully connected and intelligent manufacturing ecosystem. Participants will explore real-world case studies to understand the practical implementation of these technologies, learning how to harness them to optimize operations, enhance decision-making, and foster innovation. The course also addresses critical aspects such as workforce adaptation, new skill requirements, and the ethical considerations of digital transformation. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to contribute to and lead digital transformation initiatives within their organizations.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Industry 4.0: Digital Transformation and Smart Manufacturing
desc: his course provides a comprehensive introduction to Industry 4.0 and its transformative impact on modern industries. Learners will explore the historical evolution of industrial revolutions, understanding how mechanization, mass production, and automation have progressively shaped industrial practices and set the stage for the Fourth Industrial Revolution. The course highlights the core enabling technologies of Industry 4.0, including the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML), Big Data and Analytics, Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), Cloud and Edge Computing, Robotics, Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing), and Augmented/Virtual Reality (AR/VR). Through real-world examples, learners will see how these technologies are applied in smart factories, predictive maintenance, digital twins, and real-time analytics to improve operational efficiency, decision-making, and product quality.
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Information in Cognizable Cases
desc: The introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) marks a significant shift in India's criminal procedure, directly impacting the daily operations of law enforcement agencies. This course is specifically designed to equip police officers with a thorough understanding of the new legal provisions concerning the registration of information in cognizable offenses. It provides critical insights into the updated framework for filing a First Information Report (FIR), highlighting key changes from the erstwhile Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC). Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the expanded scope of an FIR, the procedures for lodging an e-FIR and a Zero FIR, and the specific circumstances and steps for conducting a Preliminary Enquiry (PE). Through a series of clear, video-based lessons, participants will learn the precise procedural steps to follow, ensuring that all actions are compliant with the BNSS. Upon completion, officers will be able to confidently and correctly handle the initial stages of a cognizable case, from receiving information to initiating a formal investigation, thereby strengthening the foundation of the criminal justice process.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Information Security - Cyber Crimes, Data Security, Data Mining
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding information security is crucial for all government officials. This course is designed to build foundational knowledge in protecting digital assets and mitigating cyber threats. It begins by defining cybercrime and categorizing its various forms, from hacking and data theft to more sophisticated attacks like ransomware and social engineering. You will learn about the key pillars of information security and the importance of maintaining data confidentiality, integrity, and availability.The course delves into practical data security measures, offering solutions to secure computer systems and personal information. It examines the arsenal of cyber weapons, including viruses, worms, trojans, and botnets, explaining how they work and how to defend against them. Furthermore, it provides an essential overview of the Information Technology Act, 2000, outlining the legal provisions and penalties for cyber offenses. By the end of this course, you will have a fair understanding of information security processes and be better equipped to protect sensitive government data from unauthorized access and disruption.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Information Security Basics
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation in governance, the security of official information is paramount. This course is designed to equip all government officials with the essential knowledge and skills to handle digital and physical data securely. The curriculum begins by defining fundamental concepts, distinguishing between raw data and processed information, and outlining the critical security requirements for data at rest, in transit, and during processing. Participants will delve into the government's official classification framework, including categories like 'Top Secret,' 'Secret,' and 'Confidential,' and understand the handling procedures for each. The course thoroughly covers the three pillars of information security: Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA). It also contrasts the security challenges of paper-based versus digital information and discusses the direct linkage between organizational data protection and national security. By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply a range of best practices to safeguard government information, mitigate risks, and contribute to a more secure digital working environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Information Security Management System (ISMS)
desc: Dive deep into the world of information security with this detailed module on Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). This course is designed to equip professionals with the knowledge to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an organization's security posture. The curriculum begins by defining information as a critical business asset and outlines the modern threats and challenges it faces. It then provides a thorough walkthrough of the ISO 27000 family of standards, with a special focus on the requirements of ISO 27001. You will learn about the evolution from the 2013 to the 2022 version, understanding the key changes in control domains and structure. The course details the practical application of ISMS through best practices, key implementation processes, and the framework for certification. By the end of this module, you will have a robust understanding of how to manage information security risks, apply appropriate controls, and lead your organization towards achieving and maintaining ISO 27001 certification, thereby enhancing trust and ensuring regulatory compliance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Information Security: Governance Risk and Compliance
desc: In an era of digital governance, securing information infrastructure is paramount. This course offers a deep dive into the strategic principles of Information Security, focusing on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). It explains why information is considered a valuable asset and how to protect it using structured methodologies. Key learning areas include the implementation of an Information Security Management System (ISMS) as per ISO 27001, understanding the Zero Trust Architecture mindset, and navigating the legal requirements of the IT Act 2000 and the upcoming Digital India Act. The course also demystifies the roles of critical national agencies like CERT-In and NCIIPC in incident response and protection of critical infrastructure. Participants will learn about developing a Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) for business continuity and resilience. By the end, officials will be prepared to apply these frameworks to safeguard their organization's digital assets, manage cyber threats effectively, and fulfill the strategic responsibilities of a modern CISO.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Information Systems in Healthcare for Nursing Practice
desc: This course introduces nurses to the design, components, and practical applications of digital systems used to manage healthcare information. Learners explore key platforms such as Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Hospital Management Information System (HMIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), telemedicine, and remote patient monitoring (RPM), and understand how these systems support workflows from registration and diagnostics to billing and discharge. Using real-world Indian examples such as Bahmni, eSushrut, and eSanjeevani, nurses learn how integrated, ABDM-aligned systems improve care coordination, reduce errors, and strengthen continuity of patient care. By the end of the course, learners understand how health information systems enhance efficiency, transparency, and patient-centered digital care.

title: Information Technology Act
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the legal architecture of India's digital domain through an in-depth study of the Information Technology Act, 2000. Designed for public officials, it provides the necessary knowledge to operate effectively and legally within an increasingly digital governance framework. The curriculum is structured across several key modules, beginning with an introduction to the Act's features, objectives, and important definitions such as 'digital signature' and 'electronic record'. The course then explores the complexities of internet jurisdiction and the legal validity of e-contracts, providing clarity on cross-border digital interactions. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding various cybercrimes, the associated penalties, and the powers of adjudicating authorities, illustrated with relevant case laws. Furthermore, it examines the procedures for securing electronic records and the functions of regulatory bodies like the Cyber Appellate Tribunal. A dedicated module connects the Act's provisions to the practical implementation of the government's faceless assessment scheme, demonstrating its real-world application in tax administration. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply the IT Act's principles to ensure compliance, security, and legality in their official digital dealings.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Infrastructure Financing
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of infrastructure financing, designed to bridge financial theory with practical application in sectors like transport, energy, and urban development. It begins by establishing the context of infrastructure's economic importance and the evolution of its financing in India, from reliance on budgetary resources to the inclusion of private participation. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of various financing sources, such as public funds, private capital, and contributions from development finance institutions. The course thoroughly examines financial instruments and models like Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs), and Viability Gap Funding (VGF), supported by real-world case studies. Participants will also analyze significant challenges, including funding mismatches, currency risks, and regulatory hurdles. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze complex financing structures, evaluate project viability, and understand the strategic frameworks essential for developing financially sustainable and socially beneficial infrastructure projects.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Infrastructure Financing
desc: Infrastructure development is a cornerstone of economic growth, and securing appropriate financing is critical for project success. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with a clear understanding of the complex world of infrastructure finance. You will begin by exploring the diverse sources of funding, from public budgets and multilateral loans to private equity, and learn to distinguish their characteristics. The curriculum then examines key financing mechanisms, including Public-Private Partnerships (PPP), and details the various financial, operational, and political risks inherent in such large-scale projects. A significant focus is placed on risk management, where you will learn to analyze and develop risk allocation strategies to ensure project viability. Furthermore, the course explains the structure and function of Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) as a vital tool for isolating and managing project-specific risks. Upon completion, you will be better prepared to contribute to the financial planning and oversight of critical infrastructure initiatives.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Infrastructure Financing in Roads and Highways
desc: This course delves into the complex world of infrastructure financing, with a specific focus on the roads and highways sector. As nations strive to bridge infrastructure gaps, understanding sustainable financing is paramount for public officials. This program provides a detailed exploration of the strategies, mechanisms, and institutional frameworks essential for mobilizing and managing financial resources. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of public financing methods, private investment channels, and innovative hybrid models such as the Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) and Toll-Operate-Transfer (TOT). The course also covers the intricacies of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), project structuring, and comprehensive risk management from construction to operation. Participants will gain insights into the roles of key institutions like the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), enabling them to contribute effectively to the planning and execution of financially viable and sustainable road infrastructure projects.

title: Infrastructure Investment Trusts-InvITs
desc: This course delves into the essentials of Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs), explaining their critical role in modern infrastructure financing. As India continues to expand its infrastructure, InvITs have emerged as a vital mechanism, modeled after Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), to attract private capital into operational projects like roads, power transmission, and telecom towers. The curriculum covers the complete lifecycle of an InvIT, from its structural components and asset types to the detailed regulatory guidelines set by SEBI. Learners will analyze the revenue models, distribution mechanisms, and the risk-return dynamics for different investor profiles. Furthermore, the course provides a comparative analysis of InvITs against other traditional infrastructure financing instruments, empowering participants to make informed investment and policy decisions. Upon completion, learners will have a robust understanding of how to leverage InvITs for both capital recycling and long-term investment.

title: Initiation of Proceedings and Commitment of Cases
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of essential procedural changes introduced by the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, designed to modernize India's criminal justice system. The content is critical for legal and law enforcement professionals who must navigate these new laws to ensure both judicial efficiency and the protection of individual rights.
