Ultimately, this course will equip you with the knowledge to recognize and leverage AI opportunities in your work environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
desc: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning are transformative technologies reshaping governance and industry. This foundational course is designed to equip public officials with the essential knowledge to navigate this evolving landscape. The curriculum begins by demystifying AI and ML, clarifying key terminology and the core principles that drive these technologies. You will delve into the main learning paradigms—Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning—through practical examples that illustrate their real-world applications in automation, predictive analytics, and enhancing citizen services. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the AI/ML project lifecycle, from data acquisition and processing to model deployment and evaluation. Furthermore, the course addresses the societal and ethical dimensions of AI, including challenges like algorithmic bias, deepfakes, and misinformation. It underscores the necessity of robust governance, ethical guidelines, and risk management to ensure the responsible and trustworthy adoption of AI. Upon completion, you will have a strong conceptual understanding to engage in discussions about AI strategy and implementation within your organization.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Introduction to Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission for Nursing
desc: This course provides an in-depth overview of India’s national digital transformation in healthcare, with a focus on the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and its vision for a connected, patient-centric digital ecosystem. Learners explore key ABDM components, including ABHA, HPR, HFR, the Consent Manager, UHI, and NHCX, and understand how these tools enable interoperability, secure data sharing, and seamless care delivery. The course emphasizes the role of nurses in accurate digital data entry, patient education, and ethical information sharing. It also introduces major national platforms such as eSanjeevani, CoWIN, Nikshay, the NCD Portal, and PM-JAY to demonstrate the real-world impact of digital health initiatives. By the end of the course, learners gain a clear understanding of how government digital programs are improving access, efficiency, and quality of care across India.

title: Introduction to Banking and Mobile Banking Services
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of modern banking in India. It begins by establishing the legal context, defining 'bank' and 'banking' as per the Banking Regulation Act, and categorizing the various banks operating in the country. Learners will explore the multifaceted legal relationship between a bank and its customers, including roles like debtor-creditor and trustee, and differentiate between principal, subsidiary, and modern banking functions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the digital evolution of banking. It analyzes how services such as RTGS, debit cards, and mobile banking have enhanced operational efficiency and driven financial inclusion. The curriculum also delves into the strategic convergence of the telecommunications and financial sectors, assessing global and Indian trends in mobile banking. By examining the opportunities and challenges, including the integration of Artificial Intelligence, participants will gain the knowledge to appreciate and contribute to the design of effective digital financial strategies for public and private sector organizations.

title: Introduction to Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
desc: The major criminal laws have seen an overall change with the introduction of three new criminal laws viz. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 to replace the existing Indian Penal Code, 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. This course offers a overview of the changes introduced in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and deals with the procedural reforms relating to crime reporting, investigation, prosecution and trial of offences.

title: Introduction To Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
desc: The major criminal laws have seen an overall change with the introduction of three new criminal laws viz. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 to replace the existing Indian Penal Code, 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. This course offers a overview of the changes introduced in the Indian Penal Code and deals with offence and punishment related reforms.

title: Introduction to Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
desc: The major criminal laws have seen an overall change with the introduction of three new criminal laws viz. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 to replace the existing Indian Penal Code, 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. This course offers a overview of the changes introduced in the Indian Evidence Act and deals with the evidence related reforms specifically dealing with admissibility and appreciation of electronic evidence.

title: Introduction to Big Data in Governance
desc: This introductory course delves into the pivotal role of Big Data and analytics in reshaping public administration and service delivery. It establishes the context by explaining why data-driven approaches are crucial for transparent, efficient, and citizen-centric governance in the digital age. Key learning areas include the fundamental characteristics of Big Data (the 5Vs), the complete Big Data lifecycle from collection to visualization, and the four types of analytics: descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive. The course brings these concepts to life with practical examples from Indian governance, such as health data management in ABDM, fraud detection in PMJAY, and urban planning in Smart Cities. Learners will also be introduced to the foundational technologies and tools that power Big Data, including Hadoop, Spark, and Power BI, and see how emerging technologies like AI are further enhancing government capabilities. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to recognize the potential of Big Data to drive smarter, evidence-based policy and improve public service outcomes.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Introduction to Bioinformatics
desc: Dive into the world of bioinformatics and discover how computational approaches are revolutionizing biological research and personalized medicine. This course introduces the core principles of bioinformatics, explaining its critical role in making sense of the massive amounts of data generated by modern biological studies. You will explore foundational topics including genomics, proteomics, and transcriptomics, and understand the structure of biological data from sources like the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) and The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). The curriculum covers essential techniques for data analysis, such as normalization, patient subtyping using machine learning, cell classification, and the application of network science to study gene-gene associations. By the end of this course, you will have the skills to download, process, and analyze biological data, evaluate observations, and apply computational methods to solve problems in both academic research and industry, ultimately bridging the gap between raw data and meaningful biological insights.
org: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani)

title: Introduction to Blockchain Technology and Applications in Power Sector
desc: As the energy sector transitions towards decentralization and increased renewable integration, new technologies are essential for managing grid complexity and creating efficient markets. This course delves into blockchain as a key enabling technology for the future of energy. It begins with the core principles of blockchain, explaining what it is, how it works, and its key features like immutability, transparency, and security. The curriculum then shifts to practical applications in the power sector, with a deep dive into peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading, management of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), renewable energy certificate (REC) tracking, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Learners will explore real-world case studies, including detailed analyses of pilot projects conducted in Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, and Kolkata, to understand the practical implementation, challenges, and outcomes. The course also covers the crucial policy and regulatory frameworks being developed by bodies like NITI Aayog and state commissions, preparing participants to contribute to the adoption of this innovative technology in the Indian power ecosystem.

title: Introduction to Bogie Mounted Brake System for Freight Wagons
desc: This course introduces the Bogie Mounted Brake System (BMBS) used in freight stock. Learners will understand the reasons for transitioning to BMBS and gain knowledge of its brake actuation system. The course covers the major components of BMBS in freight applications, including the bell crank lever and 11-inch brake cylinders with and without hand brake arrangements, supported with visual references for better understanding. It also explains the mounting arrangement of BMBS and the critical bogie dimensions required for proper fitment. In addition, the course discusses the Single Pipe Air Brake System in conjunction with BMBS and emphasizes the importance of effective brake release. Towards the end, learners will explore the design features of Escorts-manufactured BMBS and identify the advantages of implementing the Bogie Mounted Brake System in freight stock.

title: Introduction to Building Bye-Laws
desc: Building Bye-Laws are the cornerstone of regulated urban and rural development, ensuring that all construction activities adhere to standards of safety, health, and sustainability. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to these vital regulations. You will delve into the core objectives of bye-laws, from ensuring structural integrity and fire safety to promoting adequate light, ventilation, and aesthetic harmony. The curriculum covers the classification of different building types, the functions of municipal bodies and development authorities in the approval process, and the definition of critical planning parameters. Learners will gain a clear understanding of concepts like Floor Area Ratio (FAR), setbacks, height restrictions, and open space requirements. This knowledge is essential for civil servants, engineers, architects, and urban planners to ensure that development projects are not only compliant but also contribute positively to the community and environment.

title: Introduction to Cellular IoT: NB-IoT and 5G RedCap
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Cellular IoT technologies, with a focus on Narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) and 5G Reduced Capability (RedCap). It explains how NB-IoT is designed for massive connectivity of low-power devices, enabling long battery life through features such as Power Saving Mode (PSM) and extended Discontinuous Reception (eDRX). The course also highlights NB-IoT’s ability to provide deep indoor coverage and support large-scale deployments, making it suitable for applications like smart metering, environmental sensing, and remote monitoring. In addition, the course introduces 5G RedCap, a technology that bridges the gap between high-performance 5G and low-power IoT solutions. It focuses on moderate data speed, reduced device complexity, lower power consumption, and cost efficiency.

title: Introduction to Central Civil Service Leave Travel Concession Rules
desc: The Central Civil Service (Leave Travel Concession) Rules are a cornerstone of employee welfare provisions for government officials, yet their application can be complex. This course is designed to demystify the CCS (LTC) Rules, 1988, providing a clear and structured guide for officials at all levels. It offers an in-depth exploration of the fundamental components, from scope and definitions to specific procedural requirements, incorporating all significant clarifications issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT). Key learning areas include understanding eligibility and entitlements for different employee categories, the process for declaring or changing a hometown, and the distinction between block year and every-year LTC schemes. The course further details carry-over provisions, rules for declaring destinations, and entitlements for various modes of travel, including air and train. Learners will also be equipped to manage travel advances, process reimbursements accurately, and identify potential irregularities or fraudulent claims. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these rules effectively, ensuring full compliance and proper administration of LTC benefits within their departments.

title: Introduction to Circular Economy
desc: The circular economy is a critical framework for addressing global challenges like resource depletion and climate change. This course offers a detailed exploration of its core concepts, with a special focus on the Indian context. Participants will understand why transitioning to a circular model is essential for modern governance and industry, connecting these practices to national and international sustainability targets. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of India’s circular economy policies, waste management rules, and the operational aspects of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). The curriculum also examines innovative applications in key sectors, such as solar panel recycling, battery reuse, and strategies for managing municipal solid waste and wastewater. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze challenges, leverage policy incentives, and apply circular strategies to foster resource efficiency and promote sustainable industrial operations.
org: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)

title: Introduction to Climate Finance
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of climate finance, a critical component in addressing global climate change. It is structured to provide a dual perspective, covering both international arrangements and ground-level implementation. You will explore the context of historical emissions and the varying capabilities of nations in climate action, leading to an understanding of the global financial support systems for developing countries. The course then narrows its focus to India as a case study, analyzing the landscape of finance for both mitigation and adaptation. Learners will delve into the specific sectors requiring urgent investment, the sources of funding, and the innovative financial instruments being deployed. Furthermore, the curriculum highlights key strategies and levers to scale up capital flows for adaptation measures, equipping participants with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of climate finance and contribute to sustainable solutions.
org: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)

title: Introduction to Cloud Computing
desc: This course serves as the conceptual foundation for the entire cloud curriculum. It introduces the fundamental principles that define cloud computing and situates them within broader technological, economic, and operational contexts. Learners will examine the evolution of computing models and analyze how cloud technologies have reshaped organizational strategies, economic models, and global IT infrastructures. The course explores essential characteristics of cloud systems as defined by NIST, including deployment and service models, the shifting market landscape shaped by major cloud providers, and the implications of cloud computing for scalability, elasticity, reliability, and security. This foundation prepares learners to understand modern distributed systems and their operational and strategic significance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Introduction to Competition Law and Anti-Competitive Practices
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to build a strong understanding of India's competition law framework. It begins by establishing the context of why competition law is crucial for a healthy economy, preventing market distortions and protecting consumer interests. You will explore the key pillars of the Competition Act, 2002, examining its main provisions related to anti-competitive agreements, abuse of a dominant market position, and the regulation of combinations like mergers and acquisitions. The course further details the significant role of the Competition Commission of India (CCI) as the primary enforcement authority, covering its powers of inquiry, investigation, and adjudication. Upon completion, learners will be able to recognize potential competition law risks and understand the practical steps required for legal compliance, making it highly relevant for professionals in legal, compliance, and public policy roles.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Introduction to Computer
desc: In today's digitally-driven world, basic computer proficiency is an essential skill for all public service professionals. This course provides a solid foundation in computer fundamentals, designed specifically for individuals with little to no prior experience. It addresses the need for digital literacy across all levels of government by demystifying technology and building practical skills. Key learning areas include understanding computer hardware, software, and operating systems, as well as mastering common input and output devices. The course places a strong emphasis on hands-on application, with modules dedicated to Microsoft Word for document creation, Microsoft Excel for data management, and safe internet usage for research and communication. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to perform essential digital tasks with confidence, troubleshoot common issues, and leverage technology to enhance their daily productivity and efficiency in a government setting.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
keywords: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Introduction to Computer Networks
desc: In an era of increasing digital crime, a thorough understanding of computer networks is indispensable for law enforcement and cybersecurity professionals. This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental concepts and structures of computer networking, with a direct application to cybercrime investigation. Participants will delve into the core components of network infrastructure, learning the functions of routers, switches, and hubs. The curriculum explores various network types, such as LANs, WANs, MANs, and PANs, and their significance in investigative contexts. A key focus is placed on understanding the internet protocols that govern network communication and the methods used for IP address identification and analysis. By mastering these concepts, learners will be equipped to track network activity, uncover the origins of cyberattacks, and properly handle digital evidence, thereby enhancing their capacity to manage and resolve cybercrime cases effectively.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Introduction to computer Networks - Part 1
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental principles of computer networking. It is designed for individuals seeking to understand the intricate workings of the internet and the technologies that underpin our digital world. The curriculum begins by defining the internet as a decentralized 'network of networks' and explains the critical role of standardized protocols in ensuring reliable communication between diverse systems. You will delve into the core components of network structure, including the network edge where applications run and the network core responsible for data routing. The course contrasts different data transmission models, such as circuit switching versus the more common packet switching, and explains the client-server and peer-to-peer architectures. Furthermore, it details the layered protocol stack (like the TCP/IP model), illustrating how data is encapsulated and transmitted from the application layer down to the physical media. Upon completion, you will have a clear conceptual map of how data travels across the globe, empowering you to grasp more advanced networking topics.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Introduction to Concepts of Sustainable Soil Management
desc: This introductory module delves into the essential principles of sustainable soil management, a crucial topic for ensuring long-term agricultural productivity and environmental health. The course begins by establishing the context of soil sustainability, explaining why soil resources are vital and how they are being degraded by modern agricultural practices. You will explore the dynamic processes of soil formation, its functions, and its role in delivering critical ecosystem services like water filtration and nutrient cycling. The curriculum covers the primary components of soil quality, detailing the physical, chemical, and biological parameters that are monitored to assess soil health. By the end of this course, learners will have a comprehensive overview of soil degradation issues and the knowledge to appreciate sustainable practices, enabling them to apply these concepts in practical, real-world situations related to natural resource management.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: Introduction to Contract Management
desc: This course is designed to build foundational skills in government contract management, a critical function for ensuring public value and accountability. It delves into the principles and procedures that govern the lifecycle of a contract, from initiation to closure. Participants will explore the official guidelines detailed in the Department of Expenditure's manuals on procurement, providing a robust framework for compliant and effective practices. Key learning areas include understanding the various types of contracts, identifying and mitigating associated risks, and managing crucial components like payment schedules, delivery verification, and final settlement. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to navigate the complexities of procurement, minimize disputes, and ensure that all contractual obligations are met, thereby upholding financial discipline and achieving desired outcomes in government projects and services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Introduction to Corporate Social Responsibility
desc: This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). In today's business environment, understanding CSR is crucial for sustainable and ethical operations. This program delves into why CSR is important, covering its key components, different activity types, and the tangible benefits for corporations and communities. Participants will gain insights into the historical development of CSR in India, leading up to its current legal formalization. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to dissecting the CSR provisions within the Companies Act, 2013. Learners will understand the legal mandates, compliance requirements, and strategic implications for companies operating in India. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the fundamental knowledge to contribute to their organization's CSR strategy, ensure legal compliance, and appreciate the role of business in fostering social and environmental well-being.

title: Introduction to Courier Express and Parcel Market
desc: This introductory course offers a comprehensive overview of the Courier, Express, and Parcel (CEP) market, a vital and rapidly expanding component of the national economy. It is designed to equip public sector employees, particularly those within the postal services, with the essential knowledge required to navigate this dynamic industry. The course begins by defining the CEP market and examining its key growth drivers and recent trends, providing context for its increasing importance. Participants will delve into the specifics of CEP customer segmentation, learning to identify and understand the needs of different user groups, from individuals to large enterprises. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the concept of reverse logistics, explaining its processes and its critical role in e-commerce and customer satisfaction. Finally, learners will gain a clear understanding of the strategic vision and objectives of India Post's Parcel Directorate, positioning them to better contribute to its goals. Upon completion, participants will be well-versed in the fundamental principles and strategic direction of the CEP market.

title: Introduction to Cryptography
desc: In an era of pervasive digital communication, understanding how to protect sensitive information is paramount. This course offers a structured journey into the world of cryptography, starting from its foundational concepts and historical evolution. You will learn why cryptography is essential for ensuring confidentiality and integrity, particularly over insecure channels like the internet. The curriculum delves into the mechanics of encryption and decryption, explaining the transition from simple substitution ciphers to complex, modern algorithms. Key learning areas include the distinction between private key (symmetric) and public key (asymmetric) systems, with discussions on prominent algorithms like AES and RSA. The course also analyzes the crucial factors that determine cryptographic strength, such as key length and computational hardness, and examines the emerging security challenges posed by quantum computing. Upon completion, learners will have a solid conceptual grasp of cryptographic principles and their application in securing digital infrastructure.

title: Introduction to Cyber Security
desc: Developed for professionals in the energy industry, this course addresses the urgent need for cybersecurity expertise in modern power systems. The increasing integration of digital technologies like IoT has made power grids prime targets for sophisticated cyberattacks, which can lead to widespread disruption. This course provides a foundational understanding of the unique security challenges facing the sector. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and SCADA architecture, highlighting their inherent vulnerabilities. Learners will explore the step-by-step methodology of cyberattacks through the 'cyber kill chain' model and analyze significant case studies of attacks on global energy infrastructure. The curriculum also covers essential Indian and international regulatory guidelines, such as the CEA (Cyber Security in Power Sector) Guidelines and NERC CIP standards. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to identify threats, understand mitigation strategies, and contribute to building a resilient and secure power grid, aligning with the principles of 'secure by design'.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity Incident Response
desc: In an era of increasing cyber threats, a structured and effective incident response capability is critical for any government organization. This course offers a detailed introduction to the principles and practices of Cybersecurity Incident Response (IR). It is designed to equip public sector professionals with the knowledge to manage security incidents systematically, thereby minimizing operational disruption, financial loss, and reputational damage. The curriculum delves into the complete incident handling lifecycle, covering six critical phases: Preparation, Detection & Analysis, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Post-Incident Activities. Participants will learn how to identify what constitutes a cybersecurity incident, understand its potential impact, and recognize the importance of a well-defined Incident Response Team (IRT). Emphasis is placed on collaboration between technical teams, legal advisors, communication departments, and senior leadership to ensure a coordinated response. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these structured processes to enhance their organization's resilience and cybersecurity maturity, turning reactive measures into a proactive defense strategy.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Introduction to Data Backup and Recovery
desc: In today’s digital environment, organizations face significant risks of data loss due to human error, hardware failure, system issues, and cyber threats. This course provides learners with the knowledge and practical skills required to develop and implement effective data backup and recovery strategies. The course introduces the fundamental principles of data protection and explores different backup methods and storage media, including their advantages, limitations, cost, reliability, and speed. It also covers key storage technologies such as Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID), Storage Area Network (SAN), and Network Attached Storage (NAS), with a focus on their applications in data redundancy, storage, backup, and recovery. Through practical demonstrations, learners will gain hands-on understanding of backup configuration, system imaging, data restoration, and recovery procedures in a Windows environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Introduction to Decision-Making
desc: Effective decision-making is a cornerstone of good governance and public administration. This course is designed to equip government officials with the essential skills to navigate complex choices with clarity and confidence. Participants will explore various decision-making models and frameworks that can be applied to everyday administrative challenges and strategic issues. The content delves into the psychology of decision-making, highlighting common pitfalls like cognitive biases and groupthink, and provides practical techniques to mitigate them. By the end of this course, learners will be able to deconstruct problems, weigh evidence, assess risks, and articulate the rationale for their choices. This will enable them to contribute more effectively to their organizations, ensuring that decisions are not only timely and efficient but also ethical, transparent, and aligned with public service values.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Introduction to Derailment Investigation and Accident Analysis
desc: The course enables participants to identify visible and hidden clues at a derailment site through systematic observation and develop skills in locating and interpreting key evidence such as the point of mount, point of drop, and wheel travel marks. It also covers the correct procedures for joint site inspection, recording, and documentation of derailment parameters, along with an understanding of rail–wheel interaction, vehicle dynamics, and track geometry related to derailments. Further, the course explains track, rolling stock, and operational factors contributing to derailments, statutory guidelines, and safety responsibilities during investigations. It also emphasizes preventive measures to avoid future accidents through accurate cause identification and implementation of corrective actions.

title: Introduction to Design Thinking for Innovation
desc: In an era of complex public sector challenges, 'Introduction to Design Thinking for Innovation' offers a structured framework for creative problem-solving. This course is designed to introduce government professionals to a powerful methodology that places citizen needs at the heart of policy and service design. You will learn why design thinking is crucial for fostering innovation and how its principles can be applied in a science and technology-driven governance landscape. The curriculum covers the complete design thinking lifecycle, including understanding user needs through empathy, defining problems, ideating creative solutions, building prototypes, and testing them. Participants will gain insights into practical tools and techniques that can be immediately applied to their work. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to approach challenges with a more collaborative, experimental, and citizen-centric perspective, driving meaningful improvements in public services.

title: Introduction to Digital Forensics and Digital Evidence
desc: In an era where crime increasingly involves a digital component, the ability to properly handle electronic data is crucial for modern investigators. This course, 'Introduction to Digital Forensics and Digital Evidence,' serves as a comprehensive primer on the subject. It is specifically designed to equip law enforcement and investigative professionals with the core competencies required to manage the digital evidence lifecycle. The course delves into the systematic process of digital forensics, starting from the initial identification and collection of evidence from various digital sources. It emphasizes the importance of preservation techniques to maintain the chain of custody and ensure the evidence remains untampered. Key learning areas include understanding different types of digital evidence, an overview of commonly used forensic tools for acquisition and analysis, and the fundamental concept of hashing to verify data integrity. While not a legal course, it provides the procedural knowledge necessary to ensure that the evidence collected can withstand legal scrutiny. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to apply best practices in digital evidence handling within their investigative roles.

title: Introduction to Direct Taxes
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the framework of direct taxation in India, centered on the Income Tax Act, 1961. It is specifically designed to build foundational knowledge for officials beginning their careers in tax administration. The curriculum traces the historical evolution of income tax in India, from its inception in 1860 to the enactment of the current 1961 Act. Learners will explore the statute's comprehensive structure, which includes 23 chapters and 298 sections, and gain familiarity with its core concepts and common terminologies. The course is organized into four distinct modules covering the Act's history, origin, an at-a-glance overview, and the constitutional pillars supporting it. Through a blend of video lectures, reading materials, and quizzes, participants will develop the basic knowledge required to navigate the complexities of tax law, making it an indispensable resource for new entrants to the Indian Revenue Service and a valuable refresher for experienced officers.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Introduction to Directorate of Standardisation
desc: The Directorate of Standardisation (DoS) is responsible for carrying out standardisation activities across all fields within the Ministry of Defence, under the administrative control of the Department of Defence Production. To support these functions, training is conducted for personnel from various organisations at two dedicated training centres: the Regional Institute for Standards Training (RIST), Delhi, and the Institute for Standards Training (IST), Pune. These programmes focus on standards, codification processes, and related defence standardisation practices. The course provides participants with an understanding of the evolution, organisational structure, and functioning of the Directorate of Standardisation. It also introduces the fundamental principles of standardisation and codification as applied within the defence sector.

title: Introduction to Distributed Energy Resources (DER)
desc: As power systems evolve, the integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) is transforming the grid. This course details the critical transition from traditional, one-way power flow to a decentralized, bidirectional ecosystem. It begins by establishing the context of why power systems require enhanced flexibility, addressing the challenges posed by variable renewable energy (VRE) sources. You will explore the key technologies and strategies being deployed to manage this complexity, including advanced battery energy storage systems (BESS), the role of electric vehicles as virtual power plants (VPPs), and the implementation of smart microgrids. The curriculum also covers the importance of demand-side management through innovative tariff policies and demand response programs. Upon completion, you will understand the operational and policy shifts necessary to build a resilient, efficient, and sustainable power grid capable of supporting a high penetration of renewable energy.

title: Introduction to Drilling Fluids for Mineral Exploratory Drilling
desc: This introductory course provides a comprehensive overview of drilling fluids used in mineral exploratory drilling. It explains the types, properties, and functions of drilling fluids, along with commonly used additives, testing equipment, and water-based mud systems. The course is designed to support safe, efficient, and cost-effective drilling operations by equipping learners with essential theoretical and practical knowledge.

title: Introduction to Drone Technology and Data Processing
desc: This course provides an overview of drone technology, covering the principles of flight planning for different patterns and tasks, along with the roles of responsible agencies. It explains the complete workflow for drone data collection, processing, and analysis, including an introduction to major drone manufacturers and commonly used data processing software. The course offers a step-by-step approach to drone data processing using PIX4D, covering accuracy assessment and key processing outputs such as point cloud data, mesh models, Digital Elevation Models (DEMs), Digital Surface Models (DSMs), and orthomosaic images, along with their practical applications. It also explores the use of drones across diverse sectors and includes high-resolution drone imagery and visual representations of 3D models to support understanding and analysis.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Introduction to Economics
desc: This introductory course is designed to build a strong foundation in economics for public administrators. It delves into the essential principles that govern how societies allocate scarce resources, providing a critical lens for analyzing government policies and their impact. The curriculum begins by defining the core tenets of economics, including scarcity, trade-offs, and opportunity cost, before distinguishing between microeconomic and macroeconomic perspectives. Key learning areas include an exploration of macroeconomic indicators such as Gross Domestic Product (GDP), inflation, and unemployment, and jejich significance for national economic health. The course also examines the concept of the 'invisible hand' and the functioning of market economies. Ultimately, learners will understand why a grasp of economics is indispensable for addressing complex public challenges like poverty, distributive justice, and infrastructure development, enabling them to contribute more effectively to evidence-based policy-making.

title: Introduction to Education Governance and Inclusion
desc: This course designed and facilitated by Pooja Pandey of Sambodhi Research and Communications under the P.A. Sangma Fellowship for Legal and Policy Research, Government of Meghalaya, provides education leaders, administrators, and practitioners with a comprehensive understanding of the transformations shaping India’s education ecosystem. The course situates these changes within the broader context of systemic reforms, decentralization, technology-enabled governance, and the urgent need to foster equity and inclusivity. Participants explore how modern education governance must move beyond compliance-focused approaches to cultivate responsive systems that leverage data, digital technologies, institutional reforms, and multi-stakeholder partnerships.

title: Introduction to Electric Vehicle (EV) and its Supply Equipment (EVSE)
desc: As India accelerates its transition to electric mobility to enhance energy security and meet climate goals, understanding the integration of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is crucial for the power sector. This course, developed under the Ministry of Power’s Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), offers a detailed overview of the EV landscape. It begins with the basics of EV technology, comparing it to internal combustion engines, and delves into critical components like batteries, motors, and the Battery Management System (BMS). The course extensively covers the charging ecosystem, explaining different AC/DC charging mechanisms, global standards such as CCS and CHAdeMO, and communication protocols like OCPP and ISO 15118 that enable smart charging. A significant focus is placed on the impact of EV charging on the distribution grid, addressing issues like load management, power quality, and harmonics. Learners will also be introduced to advanced concepts like Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology and megawatt-scale charging. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to better plan for and manage the integration of EV charging loads, ensuring grid stability and reliability.

title: Introduction to Electronic Interlocking in Railway Signalling
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Electronic Interlocking (EI) systems used in modern railway signalling. It covers the fundamentals of railway signalling, the principles and purpose of interlocking systems, and the evolution of railway signalling technologies from mechanical and relay interlocking to advanced electronic interlocking systems. The course explains the architecture, components, and working principles of EI systems, including route setting, train movement control, fail-safe design philosophy, and Safety Integrity Level (SIL-4) safety standards. It also highlights the practical applications of Electronic Interlocking systems in Indian Railways, enabling learners to understand their role in improving railway safety, reliability, and operational efficiency.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: Introduction to Emerging Technologies
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, understanding emerging technologies is crucial for effective governance. This course offers a practical overview of the cutting-edge tools that are revolutionizing public service delivery. It is structured to demystify complex topics, starting with the core concepts of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing. The curriculum then explores the applications of Drones, the power of Data Analytics for insights, and the interconnected world of the Internet of Things (IoT). Further modules delve into immersive experiences with the Metaverse and AR/VR, and the principles of security and transparency with Blockchain technology. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize how these technologies can solve administrative challenges, streamline processes, and foster innovation.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Introduction to Emerging Technologies
desc: In an era of rapid technological innovation, understanding the potential of emerging technologies is critical for effective public policy and governance. This course serves as a comprehensive introduction for government officials, demystifying complex topics and showcasing their practical application in the public sector. The curriculum covers eight key technologies: Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Internet of Things, Blockchain, and AR/VR. Through a series of short, focused modules, you will learn the fundamental concepts behind each technology and explore real-world use cases relevant to government functions, from improving citizen services and automating processes to enhancing security and resource management. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to identify work-related challenges where technology can offer a viable solution, appreciate the limitations and ethical considerations of their use, and contribute to building a more efficient, responsive, and data-driven government.

title: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence
desc: In the dynamic and often high-pressure environment of public service, Emotional Intelligence (EI) is a fundamental skill for personal and professional success. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles of EI and its practical application in the workplace. It addresses why understanding and managing emotions is critical for government employees to navigate challenges, build resilience, and foster positive interactions with colleagues and citizens. The curriculum is structured around the four core pillars of Emotional Intelligence. You will begin by developing self-awareness to recognize your own emotional triggers and patterns. Next, the course covers self-management techniques to control impulsive feelings and behaviors, manage stress in healthy ways, and stay motivated. You will then explore social awareness, learning to understand the emotions, needs, and concerns of other people.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Introduction to Energy Literacy
desc: In an era where energy consumption is intrinsically linked to environmental sustainability, understanding the fundamentals of energy is more critical than ever. This introductory course is designed to build energy literacy from the ground up, requiring no prior technical expertise. It demystifies the complex world of energy by breaking it down into simple, relatable concepts. Learners will explore the complete lifecycle of energy, from its generation through various sources like fossil fuels and renewables, to its distribution and eventual consumption in our daily activities. The course places a strong emphasis on the environmental consequences of our energy choices, particularly focusing on carbon emissions and their role in climate change. A key component of the curriculum is dedicated to practical application, teaching simple methods to calculate personal or household energy usage. Furthermore, it introduces the potential of sustainable alternatives, with a special look at solar energy and its applications. Upon completion, participants will be equipped not just with knowledge, but with a practical framework for reducing their energy footprint and promoting sustainability within their communities and workplaces.

title: Introduction to Energy Storage Technologies
desc: As India advances towards its clean energy targets, the role of energy storage becomes paramount. This course delves into the fundamentals of energy storage technologies, providing a crucial overview for professionals in the power sector. The curriculum begins by contextualizing the need for storage within modern smart grids, addressing challenges like the intermittency of renewable energy sources and increasing grid stress from electric vehicles. The course covers a wide array of storage options, from mechanical systems like pumped hydro to electrochemical solutions like lithium-ion and redox flow batteries. Participants will explore key applications such as frequency regulation, peak shaving, and voltage support, understanding how these services contribute to grid resilience and can defer costly infrastructure upgrades. The discussion extends to the integration of storage in microgrids and the emerging concept of transactive energy systems, offering a forward-looking perspective on the future of the power grid. By the end of this module, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to appreciate the strategic importance of energy storage and its implementation for a stable, sustainable, and efficient power distribution network.

title: Introduction to Environmental Compliance Verification
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of India's environmental compliance landscape, addressing the urgent challenges of air and water pollution, hazardous waste, and contamination. It provides a foundational understanding of key environmental legislation, including the Water Act (1974), Air Act (1981), and Environment (Protection) Act (1986). Learners will delve into practical methodologies for environmental management, such as classifying industries using the Pollution Index, regulating Grossly Polluting Industries (GPIs), and assessing the performance of environmental infrastructure like STPs and CETPs. The course also covers field inspection procedures, compliance strategies, and the use of real-time monitoring tools like OCEMS and CAAQMS. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to enforce environmental regulations, conduct data-driven compliance verification, and contribute to effective environmental governance.

title: Introduction to Environmental Economics and Policy
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of environmental economics and its application in public policy. It addresses the fundamental challenge of balancing economic development with environmental sustainability, a critical concern for modern governance. The curriculum begins by establishing the principles of market efficiency and then systematically explores the causes and consequences of market failures, such as externalities like pollution and the complexities of managing public goods. Learners will gain a deep understanding of various policy instruments used to mitigate environmental degradation, including emissions taxes, cap-and-trade systems, and subsidies. The course further examines the influence of behavioral economics on environmental decision-making and introduces methods for the economic valuation of unpriced natural resources. By analyzing these economic tools and frameworks, participants will be equipped to evaluate and contribute to the design of effective, evidence-based environmental policies that promote long-term societal well-being and ecological health.

title: Introduction to ERP
desc: This foundational course is designed to introduce the core principles of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and its strategic importance in modern enterprises. The program begins by defining ERP and explaining why organizations, particularly large public sector undertakings, need such systems to harmonize disparate functions and data sources. It delves into the architecture of an ERP system, demonstrating how an organization's structure is mapped onto the software.A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the key modules that form an ERP suite. Learners will receive a descriptive overview of Project Systems (PS), Material Management (MM), Plant Maintenance (PM), Real Estate Management (REM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Finance and Controlling (FICO), and Human Capital Management (HCM). Through the lens of SAP's implementation at BSNL, the course illustrates how these modules manage critical business processes, from procurement and inventory to payroll and project execution. Upon completion, participants will understand the end-to-end processes facilitated by ERP and appreciate its role in driving process standardization and providing a unified view of the organization for strategic decision-making.

title: Introduction to Escalators of DMRC
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the design, function, and safety management of escalators within the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It begins by establishing the context of DMRC's extensive escalator network, the largest in India, and explains their vital role in managing passenger flow. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of an escalator's mechanical and electrical components, from the main drive and truss to the step chains and balustrades. The curriculum emphasizes the numerous safety systems and devices, such as comb plate contacts, emergency stop buttons, skirt brushes, and various sensors, that are crucial for passenger protection. Furthermore, the course details the specific design standards (IS 4591, AN 115, NFPA 130) followed by DMRC, operational best practices, and maintenance considerations. Upon completion, learners will have a solid foundational understanding of escalator technology and its application in a modern urban transit system.

title: Introduction to Fabbrica Italiana de Automobili Torino Bogie
desc: This course covers the key features of the Fabbrica Italiana De Automobili Torino (FIAT) bogie design and provides a detailed understanding of the complete bogie assembly. It explains the primary suspension system, wheel and axle arrangements, and the dimensions of the wheelset, along with an overview of the wheel disc. The course also discusses the secondary suspension and the role of the anti-roll bar. Learners will explore the various parts of the bogie–body connection and understand the principles of force transmission, including longitudinal traction efforts and braking powers. It further highlights the main operational data and speed limits, explains the concept of ride index with a table, and presents a comparison of the salient features of FIAT and Integral Coach Factory (ICF) bogies. Additionally, the course explains the bolster dome upper plate weld and describes the wear of the bogie frame at the control arm rubber joint location.
keywords: Fabbrica Italiana De Automobili Torino (FIAT) Bogie

title: Introduction to Faceless Appeal System in Income Tax Administration
desc: The National Faceless Appeal Scheme, implemented by the Income Tax Department, is designed to make the appellate process transparent, efficient, and unbiased by eliminating physical interaction between taxpayers and tax authorities. Under this scheme, appeals are handled electronically through the National Faceless Appeal Centre (NFAC), using an automated allocation system and a team-based review mechanism. All communications, including notices and submissions, are conducted digitally through the e-filing portal, ensuring a completely paperless process. Hearings, wherever required, are conducted through video conferencing, ensuring adherence to the principles of natural justice. The scheme enhances accountability, consistency, and efficiency in decision-making and represents a significant step toward the digitisation and modernization of India’s tax administration system.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Introduction to Fiber Optic Sensors and Applications
desc: This course introduces the fundamentals of fiber optic sensor technology and its applications in modern measurement, monitoring, and smart infrastructure systems. Participants will explore the working principles of optical fibers, sensor architectures, and various fiber optic sensing techniques for measuring temperature, strain, pressure, and distributed parameters. The course emphasizes the advantages of fiber optic sensors, including high sensitivity, immunity to electromagnetic interference, intrinsic safety, and long-distance real-time monitoring. Through industrial and infrastructure use cases, learners will understand how fiber optic sensors support predictive maintenance, structural health monitoring, power system monitoring, and Industry 4.0 applications, enabling smarter, safer, and more efficient operations.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Introduction to Financial Statements
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to financial statement analysis, tailored for public sector officials responsible for procurement, vendor evaluation, and tender assessment. In the context of modern governance, ensuring the financial viability of suppliers is critical for successful project delivery and responsible use of public funds. This program addresses that need by demystifying core financial documents. Key learning areas include a detailed exploration of the Balance Sheet, Income Statement (Profit & Loss), Cash Flow Statement, and the Statement of Changes in Equity. Participants will learn to interpret essential components like assets, liabilities, revenue, and expenses, and understand the principles of accrual accounting. The course emphasizes the practical application of this knowledge. Learners will be guided on how to connect the information across different statements to build a holistic view of an organization's financial health. Upon completion, officials will be able to confidently evaluate the financial standing of vendors, identify potential risks, and make more robust, data-driven decisions during procurement and due diligence processes, ultimately strengthening the integrity and efficiency of public purchasing.

title: Introduction to Fire Safety
desc: This comprehensive course offers an in-depth introduction to the critical aspects of fire safety. It begins by establishing the scientific context, explaining the fire triangle, phases of fire development, and dangerous phenomena like flashover and backdraft. The curriculum then systematically covers the classification of fires (Class A, B, C, D, and K/F) according to ISO and NFPA standards, ensuring learners can identify different fire types and their specific hazards. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to fire detection, exploring the functionality of manual and automatic systems, including heat, smoke, and flame detectors. Furthermore, learners will gain practical knowledge on fire suppression, understanding the core principles of cooling, smothering, starving, and chemical inhibition. The course details the proper use of various portable fire extinguishers and standard emergency protocols like PASS and FIRE.

desc: This comprehensive course offers an in-depth introduction to the critical aspects of fire safety. It begins by establishing the scientific context, explaining the fire triangle, phases of fire development, and dangerous phenomena like flashover and backdraft. title: Introduction to Free Trade Agreement
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) and their strategic importance in the global economic landscape. It begins by establishing the context of international trade, explaining why FTAs are crucial for economic growth, lower consumer prices, and increased market efficiency. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the components of FTAs, covering goods, services, investment, and intellectual property. The course meticulously differentiates FTAs from Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) and explains the deeper integration found in Customs Unions and Economic Unions. Learners will explore critical provisions such as tariffs, Rules of Origin (ROO), and non-tariff measures like sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) regulations and technical barriers to trade (TBT).

title: Introduction to Free Trade Agreement
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) and their strategic importance in the global economic landscape. It begins by establishing the context of international trade, explaining why FTAs are crucial for economic growth, lower consumer prices, and increased market efficiency. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the components of FTAs, covering goods, services, investment, and intellectual property. The course meticulously differentiates FTAs from Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) and explains the deeper integration found in Customs Unions and Economic Unions. Learners will explore critical provisions such as tariffs, Rules of Origin (ROO), and non-tariff measures like sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) regulations and technical barriers to trade (TBT). By analyzing India's extensive network of FTAs, PTAs, CECAs, and CEPAs, participants will be equipped to evaluate the impact of these agreements on domestic and international trade, making them proficient in the principles of modern trade policy.

title: Introduction to functions and organization of accounts department
desc: This introductory course offers a detailed exploration of the Accounts Department of Indian Railways, a vital component of its vast administrative machinery. The program is structured to provide a clear understanding of why the Accounts Department is crucial for maintaining the financial health and operational efficiency of the railways. Key learning areas include an overview of the department's hierarchical organization, its primary functions such as budget management, expenditure control, pension processing, and adherence to the Railway Accounting Rules (RAR). Learners will be introduced to various financial processes and documentation, including allowances, pay certificates, and performance appraisals. Upon completion, participants will be able to navigate the department's structure and appreciate its role in ensuring financial accountability and supporting the broader objectives of Indian Railways, making them more effective in their respective roles.

title: Introduction to Fusion Drawings
desc: In the fields of engineering, manufacturing, and design, the ability to create clear and accurate technical drawings is crucial for communicating design intent. This course is designed to equip you with the skills to translate complex 3D models into industry-standard 2D drawings using the Autodesk Fusion Drawing workspace. You will begin by exploring the fundamentals of the workspace, learning how to generate base and projected views from your models. The course then delves into practical applications, guiding you through the process of modifying document and sheet settings, customizing title blocks with essential project information, and applying detailed annotations and tables. A key focus is on improving efficiency by creating and saving reusable drawing templates, which standardizes your output and streamlines future projects. Upon completion, you will be proficient in producing comprehensive drawing packages ready for documentation, review, or manufacturing, making you a more effective and capable designer.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Introduction to Fédération Internationale des Ingénieurs-Conseils
desc: This course introduces learners to the FIDIC contract framework and its application in international, MDB-funded, and Indian infrastructure projects. It covers major FIDIC contract forms, contract selection, risk allocation, pricing, roles and responsibilities, claims, payment, and dispute resolution. Learners will also explore the interaction between FIDIC provisions and Indian legal requirements, including delay damages, force majeure, arbitration, limitation periods, and contract enforceability. The course highlights contract customization through Particular Conditions while maintaining FIDIC’s balanced risk allocation and Golden Principles. Through practical examples, learners will develop the knowledge needed to prepare, administer, interpret, and manage FIDIC-based contracts effectively, supporting compliance, reducing disputes, and improving infrastructure project delivery.

title: Introduction to GeM for Buyers
desc: This introductory course is designed to equip government officials with the fundamental knowledge required to operate as a Buyer on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) platform. The course begins by explaining the context and objectives behind GeM, highlighting its role in enhancing transparency, efficiency, and speed in public procurement. Key learning areas include a step-by-step guide to the registration process for both primary and secondary users, understanding the prerequisites, and navigating the user dashboard. Participants will learn about the critical function of a Verifying Authority in the registration workflow. The course also details essential account management tasks such as profile updates, login procedures, and handling account lifecycle events like transfers and deactivations. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to confidently manage their basic buyer responsibilities on the GeM portal, ensuring compliance and effective utilization of the platform.

title: Introduction to Gender and Disaster Risk Management
desc: Disasters do not impact everyone equally; gender inequalities can exacerbate risks for women and girls, while also creating specific vulnerabilities for men. Effective disaster risk management (DRM) requires a deep understanding of these dynamics to build truly resilient communities. This course covers the fundamental concepts of gender, how these roles shape disaster risk, and the different ways women and men cope with and recover from crises. It presents frameworks and practical strategies for integrating gender analysis into the entire project cycle of DRM initiatives, from planning and design to implementation and monitoring. Participants will be equipped to analyze DRM projects through a gender lens, identify potential biases, and propose concrete actions to promote gender equality and empower women. The course uses practical case studies to demonstrate how these principles are applied in real-world scenarios, enabling learners to design more effective and equitable disaster management programs that benefit entire communities and leave no one behind.

title: Introduction to Gender Equality and Social Inclusion in Power Sector
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) as a strategic approach for the modern power and utility industry. It addresses why GESI is essential for sustainable development, moving beyond compliance to create tangible value. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of GESI, presenting a compelling business case supported by research that links diversity with increased profitability and innovation. Key learning areas include analyzing the successes and challenges of GESI implementation through real-world case studies from UK-based companies like Orsted, BP, and Shell. The course distinguishes between internal initiatives, such as creating inclusive HR policies and fostering diverse leadership, and external initiatives focused on community engagement and equitable service access. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with a foundational understanding to advocate for and contribute to embedding a GESI lens within their organization's strategy, operations, and culture, ultimately fostering a more equitable and effective power sector.

title: Introduction to Generative AI for Governance
desc: This course explores the transformative role of generative AI in governance and public administration, combining practical application with ethical guidance for civil servants and policymakers. The first module demonstrates how generative AI tools can streamline the drafting of Terms of Reference, reports, and other key documents—reducing time and cost while improving consistency—and establishes a systematic approach to prompting, iteration, and review in which AI complements rather than replaces human judgment. The second module turns to ethics, distinguishing "AI in governance" from "AI governance" and examining fairness, transparency, safety, privacy, and bias through global and Indian examples. By the end, participants are equipped to apply AI as both a technical tool and a value-driven partner in advancing efficient, inclusive, and citizen-centric governance.
keywords: AI in governance vs AI governance

title: Introduction to Goal Setting
desc: This course on Effective Goal Setting is designed to equip government employees with the essential skills to define, pursue, and achieve meaningful objectives. In any professional environment, the ability to set clear goals is fundamental to driving progress and ensuring accountability. This program moves beyond mere desires, teaching a deliberate process for creating actionable plans. Participants will learn from the examples of successful individuals and understand the psychological commitment required for success. The curriculum delves into the renowned SMARTER goal framework (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound, Evaluated, and Reviewed), providing a practical tool for crafting well-defined objectives. You will learn how to break down large ambitions into manageable steps, track progress consistently, and stay motivated despite challenges.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Introduction to Grants Management for Research
desc: Effective management of research grants is essential for ensuring that public funds are utilized efficiently and responsibly to advance scientific and technological research. This introductory course provides an overview of the research grants management ecosystem within Indian Government funding agencies. Learners will explore the complete lifecycle of a research grant, from identifying funding opportunities and developing proposals to budget management, financial compliance, periodic reporting, and project closure. The course also introduces the roles, requirements, and expectations of funding agencies such as the Department of Science & Technology (DST). By the end of the course, participants will be better equipped to navigate government grant processes, manage funded research projects effectively, and maintain accountability, transparency, and compliance.

title: Introduction to Grants management for Research
desc: Effective management of research grants is crucial for ensuring that public funds are utilized efficiently to drive scientific and technological advancement. This introductory course is specifically tailored to the ecosystem of Indian Government funding agencies, providing a comprehensive overview of the grants management process. Learners will explore the complete lifecycle of a research grant, beginning with identifying funding opportunities and preparing a compelling proposal. The curriculum delves into the key stages of grant administration, including budget management, compliance with financial rules, periodic reporting, and project closure. The course also touches upon the expectations of funding bodies like the Department of Science & Technology (DST). Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to navigate the complexities of the government grant system, manage funded research projects effectively, and ensure accountability and transparency in their work. This knowledge is essential for researchers, project managers, and administrative staff working in academic and research institutions that seek government funding.

title: Introduction to GST and its Constitutional Background
desc: This introductory course is designed to equip learners with a comprehensive overview of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime in India. The program begins by setting the context, detailing the complexities and limitations of the previous indirect tax structure, thereby highlighting the need for this landmark reform. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the constitutional journey of GST, focusing on the key provisions and implications of the One Hundred and First Constitution Amendment Act, 2016. Participants will develop a clear understanding of the Goods and Services Tax Council, including its constitutional authority, composition, and critical role in shaping the tax framework. The course further explains the complete legal and administrative structure of GST, covering essential concepts and compliance mechanisms. By the end of this course, learners will be able to appreciate the rationale behind GST, understand its core components, and recognize its impact on India's economic and fiscal landscape.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Introduction to Haryana Civil Services General Rules 2016
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the Haryana Civil Services (General) Rules, 2016, which form the bedrock of service conditions for Haryana government employees. The curriculum is structured to guide learners through the entire service journey, from initial appointment to retirement. It begins by defining the scope and applicability of the rules, clarifying key terminology, and detailing the conditions for entry into government service, such as age limits and medical fitness. Learners will delve into the core principles of public service, including service obligations, confirmation, and transfer policies. The course further explains the classification of posts, retirement guidelines, and the roles of competent authorities in post creation and fund management. A significant portion is dedicated to the practical aspects of Service Book management, covering correct entry procedures, handling discrepancies, and rules concerning joining time. This foundational program is essential for all government employees, administrative officers, and HR personnel in Haryana to ensure procedural correctness and effective governance.

title: Introduction to Healthcare Data Privacy and Security in Nursing
desc: This course emphasizes the critical importance of protecting patient information in the digital healthcare era. It introduces the core principles of data privacy and data security, explaining how to control access and prevent unauthorized use or breaches. Learners explore common risks, including weak passwords, phishing attacks, and unsecured devices, and study lessons from real-world incidents such as major healthcare cyberattacks. The course reviews key regulations, including India’s DPDP Act (2023), as well as HIPAA and GDPR, clarifying healthcare providers’ responsibilities in safeguarding patient data. By the end of the course, nurses gain a clear understanding of their role in maintaining confidentiality, reporting breaches, and practicing responsible digital conduct to protect patient safety and trust.

title: Introduction to High-Speed Rail Corridors in India
desc: The High-Speed Rail Corridor course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of high-speed rail corridor development, execution of high-speed rail projects, advanced track technologies, safety protocols, and passenger amenities. It covers strategic corridor planning and maintenance, along with modern survey techniques such as LiDAR-based aerial topographic surveys for alignment and land use planning. The course also includes concepts of codal life-based asset replacement, advanced safety systems such as DS-ATC, earthquake detection systems, signalling technologies, and rolling stock operations.

title: Introduction to Hydro-meteorological Instrumentation
desc: The Introduction to Hydro-Meteorological Instrumentation course provides a technical foundation in the principles, deployment, and operation of sensors used to monitor the Earth's atmosphere and water resources. Designed specifically for the Indian context, the course emphasizes the integration of hydrology and meteorology, which is essential for managing life-sustaining resources and mitigating disasters such as floods and droughts in a monsoon-driven climate. Participants learn how to operate both traditional and modern instruments, understand the hydrological cycle, and analyze interactions between rainfall, evaporation, and temperature to assess water budgets. The curriculum covers practical deployment, operation, and maintenance of instruments, including Symons rain gauges, staff gauges, tipping bucket gauges, Acoustic Doppler Current Profilers (ADCP), and piezometers.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

title: Introduction to Imaging and Departmental Systems in Nursing Practice
desc: This course introduces nurses to the core digital technologies that support diagnostic imaging and hospital departmental workflows. Learners explore systems such as PACS, RIS, and DICOM, which enable secure storage, sharing, and interpretation of images from X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and other imaging modalities. The course also covers key departmental systems, including LIS, nursing systems, OPD, IPD, OT, and pharmacy platforms, which streamline operations and enhance team communication. Emphasis is placed on the nurse’s role in patient safety, accurate documentation, and coordinated digital care. By the end of the course, nurses understand how integrated imaging and departmental systems improve efficiency, accuracy, and patient-centered care.

title: Introduction to Indian Knowledge Ecosystem
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the Indian Knowledge Ecosystem (IKE) and its profound relevance in contemporary public service. It delves into the foundational principles drawn from India's rich civilisational heritage, including Vedic, Jaina, and Bauddha thought models. The curriculum is specifically designed for public leaders, demonstrating how ancient wisdom from texts such as the Arthashastra and Nitishatakam can be practically applied to modern public administration, governance, and leadership challenges. Through curated case studies and real-world examples, participants will learn to harness these insights for ethical governance and effective decision-making. By the end of the course, learners will be able to integrate these time-tested principles into their daily roles, fostering a more holistic and effective approach to serving the public and navigating the complexities of a multipolar world.

title: Introduction to Indian Railway Rolling Stock Code
desc: Indian Railways publishes various codes and manuals that serve as guidelines for railway operations. This course provides an introductory overview of the Indian Railway Rolling Stock Code, published by the Railway Board in October 2022. It covers the background, objectives, structure, and key contents of the Code, offering learners a foundational understanding of its purpose and application in railway operations.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IRIMEE)

title: Introduction to Indian Railways Human Resource Management System
desc: This practical course offers a comprehensive guide for Indian Railways employees on the efficient use of the Human Resource Management System (HRMS). The training focuses on empowering employees with self-service tools that enhance transparency and streamline critical HR processes. The curriculum is designed to build confidence and independence in managing personal and professional records digitally. Key learning areas include mastering secure login procedures, navigating the HRMS portal's features, and troubleshooting common issues. The course provides detailed instructions on the complete leave management cycle, from application and tracking to modification and cancellation.
