Learners will also be introduced to practical scaling techniques, including load balancing, caching strategies, and asynchronous processing, with examples drawn from major Indian digital platforms like CoWIN and Poshan Tracker. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the architectural vocabulary and conceptual framework needed to contribute to discussions on digital infrastructure, evaluate technical proposals, and appreciate the challenges of building resilient, citizen-scale digital platforms.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Introduction to the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act 2003
desc: This course provides a practical understanding of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act (COTPA), India’s primary tobacco control legislation. Designed for enforcement officers, health professionals, policymakers, and programme managers, it equips learners with the knowledge and skills required to implement, monitor, and enforce tobacco control measures effectively. The course covers the legal framework of COTPA, the National Tobacco Control Programme (NTCP), and India’s commitments under the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO-FCTC). Learners will explore smoke-free regulations, restrictions on tobacco advertising, promotion and sponsorship, packaging and labelling requirements, compliance monitoring mechanisms, penalties, and enforcement procedures.

title: Introduction to the Department of Defence Production
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the Department of Defence Production (DDP) under the Ministry of Defence, highlighting its pivotal role in strengthening India’s defence manufacturing ecosystem. The programme explains how DDP supports national priorities such as Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat by promoting indigenous design, development, and production of defence equipment and systems. Learners will gain insights into the organisational structure of DDP, its key divisions, Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs), and attached and subordinate offices. The course also explores the Department’s policies, schemes, and initiatives aimed at enhancing self-reliance, encouraging private sector participation, fostering innovation, and strengthening the defence industrial base.

title: Introduction to the Government e-Marketplace
desc: This foundational course is designed to familiarize government officials with the operational framework of the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). The curriculum delves into the practical aspects of public procurement, starting with the basics of navigating the GeM portal and understanding its integration with the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). Participants will learn about different procurement methods, including direct purchase, L-1 buying, and the strategic use of e-bidding and reverse auctions, as governed by Rule 149 of the GFR. The course explains critical concepts such as Bid Life Cycle, Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) requirements, performance security, and the creation of Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificates (CRAC). Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently manage the end-to-end procurement process on GeM, ensuring adherence to financial rules, promoting transparency, and achieving value for money in public spending.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Introduction to the Jan Bhagidari Programme
desc: In an aspirational India, the relationship between the government and its citizens is transforming. This course addresses the critical shift from a provision-based governance model to one of enabling and empowering citizens. It introduces the concept of 'Jan Bhagidari' or Empowered Citizen Partnership, a collaborative framework essential for tackling the nation's complex developmental challenges. The program is designed to provide civil servants with both the vision and a practical, systematic approach to integrate citizen-centricity into their daily functions. Key learning areas include understanding the principles of public partnership, identifying opportunities for citizen engagement, and applying collaborative methods to improve service delivery and policy outcomes. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to act as facilitators of change, working alongside citizens to build a more responsive, inclusive, and progressive future for all.

title: Introduction to the Ministry of Ports and Shipping and Waterways
desc: This foundational course is designed for public officials seeking to understand the structure and purpose of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping, and Waterways. In the context of India's growing economy, the maritime sector is of paramount importance, and this ministry is at the helm of its development. The course delves into the ministry's vision and mission, explaining the strategic objectives that guide its operations. Learners will explore the specific functions of its main divisions, gaining insight into how policies are formulated and implemented across areas like port modernization, coastal shipping, and inland waterway development. Furthermore, the curriculum reviews the ministry's key accomplishments, offering a perspective on its contribution to national progress.
org: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

title: Introduction to the Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Workplace
desc: This course on the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act, 2013) is designed to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of workplace sexual harassment laws, prevention measures, and redressal mechanisms in India. The course focuses on creating awareness about employees’ rights and responsibilities, employer obligations, and the legal framework established to ensure a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace environment. Participants will gain practical knowledge of the POSH Act, including the definition and scope of sexual harassment, the role of Internal and Local Committees, complaint and inquiry procedures, compliance requirements, and safeguards available to all parties involved. The course also highlights best practices for fostering workplace dignity, professionalism, and organizational compliance.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy
org: Bihar Institute of Public Administration and Rural Development (BIPARD) ,Bihar

title: Introduction to the Unified Pension Scheme
desc: This course provides a concise overview of the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) for government employees. It covers eligibility, contribution structure, benefits, withdrawal rules, and integration with the National Pension System (NPS). The course is designed to help learners understand pension entitlements, procedural requirements, and recent policy updates, enabling informed financial planning and ensuring retirement security within the government framework.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Introduction to the World Trade Organization
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the World Trade Organization and its pivotal role in the global economy. It begins by tracing the historical journey from the post-war General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) to the establishment of the WTO, providing context for its creation and mission. You will delve into the core principles of the trading system, such as non-discrimination and transparency, and explore the WTO's primary functions: serving as a forum for trade negotiations, administering trade agreements, and providing a mechanism for settling trade disputes. The course provides in-depth analysis of key agreements, including the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), the Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS), and the Agreement on Agriculture (AoA). A significant focus is placed on the role and concerns of developing nations within this framework, analyzing the provisions for Special and Differential Treatment.

title: Introduction to the World Trade Organization
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the World Trade Organization and its pivotal role in the global economy. It begins by tracing the historical journey from the post-war General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) to the establishment of the WTO, providing context for its creation and mission. You will delve into the core principles of the trading system, such as non-discrimination and transparency, and explore the WTO's primary functions: serving as a forum for trade negotiations, administering trade agreements, and providing a mechanism for settling trade disputes. The course provides in-depth analysis of key agreements, including the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), the Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS), and the Agreement on Agriculture (AoA). A significant focus is placed on the role and concerns of developing nations within this framework, analyzing the provisions for Special and Differential Treatment. Furthermore, the course addresses contemporary challenges facing the WTO, including calls for reform, the rise of digital trade, and navigating global trade tensions, equipping learners to understand the complexities of modern trade governance.

title: Introduction to Trade Analytics
desc: This course provides a concise introduction to trade analytics, equipping learners with the foundational knowledge needed to use trade data for evidence-based decision-making. It explores how trade data, classifications, and analytical tools support trade policy analysis, negotiations, and economic assessment. The course introduces key international data sources, major tariff and non-tariff barrier databases, and core concepts for evaluating free trade agreements and trade policy options. By the end of the course, learners will understand how trade analytics informs policy formulation and strategic trade decisions.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: Introduction to Trade Data Bases
desc: In an increasingly interconnected global economy, access to accurate and timely trade data is crucial for effective policy-making, negotiation, and economic analysis. This course is designed to equip public officials with the knowledge to navigate the complex landscape of international and national trade databases. It offers a detailed overview of the World Trade Organization's (WTO) extensive data resources, such as the WTO Stats Portal, which covers merchandise and services trade, and specialized datasets like the WTO-OECD Balanced Trade in Services (BaTiS) and the Trade in Services by Mode of Supply (TISMOS) databases. Participants will also learn to utilize tools for tariff analysis, including the Tariff Download Facility and Tariff Analysis Online (TAO), and explore databases for non-tariff measures (NTMs) and regional trade agreements (RTAs). The course places a strong emphasis on India-specific resources, detailing the trade data portals of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and the Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics (DGCI&S). By the end of this course, learners will be able to confidently source, interpret, and apply trade data to support policy formulation, monitor economic trends, and contribute to India's strategic trade objectives.

title: Introduction to Trade Remedies
desc: This course provides a clear and structured introduction to Trade Remedies, focusing on how countries use antidumping, countervailing, and safeguard measures to address unfair trade practices and sudden surges in imports. It traces the evolution of trade remedy mechanisms under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) and the World Trade Organization (WTO), highlights existing challenges, and examines ongoing debates shaping global trade governance. Learners gain a concise understanding of the rationale behind trade remedies and how they function within the multilateral trading system.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: Introduction to transmission line survey (course-1)
desc: This introductory course delves into the essential principles and practices of transmission line surveying. It begins by establishing the context and importance of surveying in linking generating stations and substations efficiently. Participants will learn about the preliminary fieldwork required, including how to identify and plot the most direct and cost-effective route using topographical maps and modern digital tools like Google Earth. The course provides a comprehensive overview of the various instruments indispensable for accurate surveying. You will be introduced to the functionality of equipment such as the Total Station, GPS, dumpy level, and ranging rods. By the end of this course, learners will grasp the fundamental procedures and toolsets required to initiate a transmission line survey, forming a solid basis for more advanced studies in power transmission and construction management.

title: Introduction to Types of Postings and  Promotion Related Postings
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of service postings and promotion-related transfers, a critical aspect of public administration and human resource management. It begins by establishing the fundamental concepts and scope of postings as defined by service rules. The curriculum then delves into the specifics of different posting types, clearly distinguishing the features and procedures for regular, officiating, and ad-hoc appointments. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the conditions that govern these postings, the purpose they serve, and the process for their execution. A key focus is placed on the admissible benefits associated with each posting category, providing essential knowledge for administrative staff and officers. Furthermore, the course clarifies how postings are managed in the context of ad-hoc promotions, enabling learners to handle these specific situations with accuracy and confidence. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in the rules and procedures governing service postings, enhancing their effectiveness in establishment and personnel management roles.
keywords: Introduction to Types of Postings and  Promotion-Related  Postings
Posting-Regular, Ad hoc, Officiating, Dual Charge, Tenure

title: Introduction to Vigilance in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the vigilance system in Indian Railways, focusing on its purpose, structure, and functioning. It traces the evolution of vigilance mechanisms and explains the current organizational framework within the Railways. The course also highlights the roles of key external oversight agencies such as the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) and the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) in ensuring transparency and accountability. Learners will gain an understanding of how vigilance practices help prevent corruption, promote ethical governance, and strengthen institutional integrity across railway operations. Designed for officials and stakeholders, the course aims to build awareness of vigilance processes and reinforce the responsibility of public servants in maintaining high standards of honesty and accountability.

title: Introduction to Watershed Management
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of watershed management, a critical discipline for the sustainable stewardship of natural resources. It establishes the foundational understanding that a watershed is the ideal geographical unit for holistic planning involving land, water, and biomass. The curriculum delves into the core concepts, characteristics, and the scientific approach required for effective management. Learners will analyze the causes and consequences of watershed deterioration, including soil erosion, reduced productivity, and water scarcity, and understand the necessity of intervention. The course outlines key management principles such as land use planning according to capability, rainwater conservation, and ensuring adequate vegetative cover. Through a detailed case study, participants will see how these principles are applied in a real-world scenario to achieve environmental restoration, improve water quality, and foster socio-economic development. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to identify watershed-related problems and contribute to planning and implementing sustainable management practices in their respective domains.

title: Introduction to Wheel Slide Protection Systems in Indian Railways
desc: This course introduces Wheel Slide Protection systems, which are critical safety devices used in high-speed Indian Railways trains to prevent wheel locking by dynamically adjusting brake pressure based on wheel–rail adhesion conditions. The course covers comprehensive WSP training for Indian Railways LHB coaches operating at speeds of 160 kmph and above. It includes Faiveley and Knorr-Bremse systems, focusing on their components, testing procedures, and fault diagnosis. Learners will also study adhesion principles, reference speed (Vref), threshold speeds (Vth1 and Vth2), and dump valve pressure control logic. In addition, the course highlights critical maintenance specifications such as sensor gaps (0.9–1.4 mm), phonic wheel torque (30 Nm), and related field-level inspection practices, including fault codes, card precautions, and wiring checks for technicians.

title: Introduction: Basics of Project Management
desc: This course provides a foundational understanding of project management, essential for public sector professionals tasked with delivering projects on time and within budget. It is designed to equip learners with the core knowledge needed to navigate the entire project lifecycle. The curriculum covers critical stages, including project initiation, where you will learn to define goals and identify stakeholders. You will explore comprehensive project planning, covering scope definition, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk assessment. The course delves into the execution phase, focusing on team leadership and progress monitoring, and concludes with the procedures for effective project closure. Participants will also be introduced to key knowledge areas such as risk management, project finance, and the work breakdown structure. By the end of this session, you will be empowered with the practical knowledge to initiate, plan, execute, and close projects with greater confidence and efficiency.

title: Introductory Video: On Campus 'Project Management PPP and Finance'
desc: This comprehensive program is designed for railway officials to master the critical domains of modern infrastructure development: project management, Public-Private Partnerships (PPP), and project finance. In the context of India's rapidly expanding railway network, this course addresses the need for skilled professionals who can navigate complex projects from conception to completion. Key learning areas include a deep dive into the project management lifecycle, with hands-on training in tools like MS Project and Primavera, and methodologies such as Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Critical Path Method (CPM). The curriculum thoroughly covers various project financing models, including Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM), alongside the legal and regulatory landscape governed by the Indian Contract Act and public procurement laws. Participants will analyze real-world case studies, including the PM Gati Shakti initiative and port connectivity projects, to understand the practical challenges and opportunities in railway infrastructure. Upon completion, officials will be better prepared to drive efficient project delivery, manage financial resources effectively, and contribute to the strategic growth of Indian Railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Introductory Video: On-Campus Safety Management Course at IRITM
desc: This program is specifically designed for Safety Officers and managerial staff in the Indian Railways to build a robust safety-first culture. The course addresses the critical importance of safety in one of the world's largest railway networks, providing a foundational understanding of modern safety management systems. Key learning areas include systematic risk assessment, conducting effective safety inspections and audits, and ensuring compliance with all safety regulations. Participants will delve into emergency preparedness protocols, accident investigation techniques, and the management of accident sites. The curriculum also covers the role of modern technologies in enhancing railway safety, with a special focus on innovations like the Train Collision Avoidance System (KAVACH). Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to implement safety protocols, guide their teams, and collaborate across departments such as Engineering, S&T, and Operations to minimize incidents and strengthen overall operational safety.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Introductory Video: On-campus Standardization Processes
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the Standardization of Academic and Administrative Processes (SAAP) for Zonal and Multi-Disciplinary Railway Training Institutes. It addresses the critical need for uniform, high-quality operational standards in public sector training. The curriculum is structured to provide a holistic understanding of institutional management, starting with the principles of standardization, certification, and Service Quality Management Systems (SQMS). Key learning areas include conducting training needs analysis, designing competency-based curricula, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all major functions, from trainee registration to post-training logistics and feedback. Participants will explore methods for evaluating training effectiveness, implementing internal audits, and managing grievance redressal. The course also introduces modern tools, including AI-based monitoring systems and the iGOT Karmayogi platform, to equip training institutes for a tech-driven future. By the end of this program, learners will be prepared to lead and manage the transformation of their institutions, ensuring they are efficient, transparent, and adaptable.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems
desc: In today's digital government landscape, protecting sensitive information and critical network infrastructure is paramount. The increasing use of personal devices and external storage on official networks creates significant vulnerabilities. This course on Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) is designed to provide public officials with the essential knowledge to understand and mitigate these modern cybersecurity threats. It addresses the fundamental need to safeguard data within ministries, departments, and data centers from unauthorized access and malicious activities. Participants will delve into the core principles of intrusion detection, learning to differentiate between various types of intrusions such as system, network, and file system attacks. The course provides a detailed overview of different IDPS technologies, including signature-based detection, anomaly-based detection, stateful protocol analysis, network-based systems (NIDS), and host-based systems (HIDS). It also explains the components that make up an IDPS and compares the reactive nature of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) with the proactive capabilities of Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS). Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize the importance of implementing robust IDPS solutions. They will be able to identify the functions and components of these systems and understand their critical role in a layered network defence strategy. This knowledge will enable them to contribute more effectively to their organization's security posture and make informed decisions regarding network protection.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Inventory Management
desc: This course offers a structured approach to mastering inventory management, a critical function for organizational efficiency and financial health. It begins by establishing the foundational concepts and explaining why effective stock control is essential in a public sector context, particularly for large organizations like the Indian Railways. Participants will delve into practical, data-driven techniques to analyze and manage inventory. Key learning areas include calculating and interpreting the Inventory Turnover Ratio to measure sales and replenishment efficiency, applying ABC Analysis to classify inventory items based on their value, and using VED (Vital, Essential, Desirable) Analysis to prioritize stock based on its operational importance. The course also provides clear strategies for identifying and managing surplus, overstock, and inactive inventory to minimize carrying costs and prevent resource wastage. Through practical formulas, real-world examples, and exercises, learners will gain the skills to implement robust inventory control systems, leading to improved planning accuracy, better cash flow management, and enhanced overall supply chain performance.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Inventory Management in India Post
desc: Designed for postal employees, this course offers a detailed walkthrough of the inventory management lifecycle in India Post. It addresses the critical need for efficient stock control across a vast network of post offices. The curriculum covers the end-to-end workflow, starting from raising a stamp indent from a Head Post Office (HO) to a Postal Store Depot (PSD), followed by the supply and acknowledgement process. It further explains the material movement procedures for supplying inventory from an HO to a Sub Post Office (SO) and from an SO to a Branch Post Office (BO). Participants will learn to use specific SAP transaction codes like ME21N for creating indents and MIGO for goods issue and receipt. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the necessary skills to accurately manage postal inventory, ensuring smooth and accountable supply chain operations within the department.

title: Investigation and Prosecution under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the investigation and prosecution processes under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and the Rules made thereunder. It is designed for Drug Inspectors, regulatory officials, enforcement personnel, and other stakeholders involved in ensuring compliance with drug and cosmetic regulations in India. The course covers the legal and procedural aspects of regulatory enforcement, including the powers and responsibilities of Drug Inspectors, inspection procedures, search and seizure operations, sample collection, evidence gathering, and case investigation techniques. Participants will also learn the processes involved in initiating and conducting prosecutions, including preparation of investigation reports, drafting of complaints, presentation of evidence before courts, and coordination with prosecuting agencies.

title: Investigation of Cybercrime with a Focus on Women and Children
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the threat of cybercrime against vulnerable populations like women and children is a critical concern for law enforcement. This course is designed to equip investigators with the specialized knowledge and skills required to handle such sensitive cases. You will delve into the entire investigative lifecycle, from FIR registration and digital evidence preservation to forensic analysis and charge sheet preparation. The curriculum covers key Indian legal frameworks, including the Information Technology Act, POCSO Act, and Juvenile Justice Act, ensuring all actions are legally sound. Key learning areas include advanced techniques like dark web monitoring and cryptocurrency tracing, alongside crucial victim support practices such as trauma-informed interviewing and coordination with support services. Upon completion, you will be prepared to conduct thorough, effective, and compassionate investigations that bring perpetrators to justice while safeguarding victims.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Investigation of Drowning Death Cases
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the forensic procedures and medico-legal principles essential for investigating drowning deaths. It is designed to equip law enforcement personnel, medical officers, and forensic specialists with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of such cases. The curriculum begins by establishing the context, explaining the different physiological mechanisms of drowning and the resulting classifications. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of external and internal post-mortem signs, the critical differences between antemortem drowning and post-mortem submersion, and the forensic significance of findings like cadaveric spasm and froth. The course thoroughly explains the Diatom Test, covering its procedure, advantages, and limitations in confirming the cause of death.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Investigation of Human Trafficking
desc:
This course provides an overview of human trafficking, including its forms, patterns, and impact. It covers the legal framework under relevant laws and the roles of various agencies involved in prevention, investigation, and prosecution.
The course further explains key investigative procedures, including identification of victims, rescue operations, evidence collection, and inter-agency coordination. It also outlines provisions related to victim protection, rehabilitation, and support mechanisms.
By the end of the course, learners will be able to understand the legal provisions, identify trafficking indicators, and apply appropriate investigative and victim-centric approaches in handling such cases.

title: Investigation of Missing Children Cases
desc: Investigation of Missing Children Cases is a comprehensive e-learning course designed to provide learners with the knowledge and practical approaches required for the effective investigation and management of missing children cases. The course focuses on the legal and institutional frameworks, first-response procedures, recovery mechanisms, use of technology, stakeholder coordination, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) involved in handling such cases. The course highlights the importance of timely action, sensitivity, and coordinated efforts among various stakeholders to ensure the safe recovery and protection of missing children. Through real-life case studies, practical examples, and established best practices, learners will develop an understanding of effective investigation strategies, challenges involved in recovery efforts, and measures to strengthen child protection mechanisms.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Investigation of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Offences
desc: This course offers a comprehensive understanding of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, designed to equip law enforcement and legal professionals with essential procedural competencies. The curriculum addresses the critical importance of combating drug trafficking by providing a deep dive into the legalities and operational tactics required for successful investigation and prosecution. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of the NDPS Act's provisions, a breakdown of penalties for various offences, and a step-by-step guide to the investigative process, emphasizing proper evidence handling and the preparation of charge sheets. The course also examines how evolving judicial interpretations, illustrated through real-life case studies, have shaped the application of the law. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to apply this specialized knowledge to uphold justice, ensure legal compliance, and strengthen their capabilities in the fight against narcotics.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Investigation of Terror Cases
desc: The course on Investigation of Terror Cases offers a comprehensive curriculum for law enforcement, intelligence officers, and security professionals tasked with combating terrorism. In an era of evolving threats, understanding the intricacies of terrorist operations is critical for national security. This course provides the foundational knowledge and practical skills required for effective counterterrorism. Key learning areas include analyzing terrorist ideologies, motivations, and organizational structures. Participants will delve into the complete investigative lifecycle, from initial intelligence gathering and surveillance to post-blast investigation, forensic analysis, and evidence handling. The course also navigates the complex legal landscape, covering case registration, witness protection, and the challenges of cross-border jurisdiction. A significant focus is placed on modern threats, with dedicated modules on cyberterrorism, tracing online activities, and applying digital forensics. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to conduct systematic and legally sound investigations, collaborate with national and international agencies, and contribute to preventing terrorist attacks.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Investigation of Terrorist Financing and Fake Currency Cases
desc: This course highlights that terrorist financing is the lifeblood of terrorism, sustaining recruitment, logistics, propaganda, and violent operations. It explains how terror funds originate from both external sources—such as counterfeit currency, drug trafficking, foreign charities, and state-backed networks—and internal sources, including extortion, illegal taxation, corruption, and criminal overlap within India. Learners gain insight into mechanisms of fund movement, including hawala, cash couriers, trade-based money laundering, formal banking systems, and circulation of Fake Indian Currency Notes (FICN). The course emphasizes investigative and enforcement challenges, such as porous borders, weak oversight, corruption, manpower shortages, and inter-agency coordination gaps.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Investigation Procedures under Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023
desc: With the introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023, the landscape of criminal investigation in India has been significantly updated. This course provides a comprehensive and practical guide for law enforcement personnel to navigate these changes effectively. It delves into the core principles of modern police investigation, emphasizing the critical balance between exercising investigative powers and protecting the rights of the accused. Key learning areas include the procedural requirements for filing and recording incident reports for both cognizable and non-cognizable offences, a detailed study of legal provisions under Sections 175–178 BNSS, and the correct protocols for summoning witnesses, recording statements, and managing confessions. Furthermore, the course covers the legal framework governing searches, seizures, and arrests, highlighting the safeguards that ensure lawful conduct. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in preparing and submitting charge sheets or final reports as per Section 193 BNSS, ultimately fostering greater due process, fairness, and public trust in the justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Investing in Government Schemes
desc: This course is designed to equip government employees and other individuals with essential knowledge on leveraging government-backed savings schemes for effective personal financial management. In the context of public service, maintaining financial discipline is crucial for long-term stability. This program demystifies various investment options, providing detailed insights into their operational mechanics, eligibility criteria, and potential returns. The curriculum covers a wide array of schemes, including the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) for girl child welfare, the Public Provident Fund (PPF) for long-term savings, Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP), National Savings Certificate (NSC), the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) for post-retirement security, and the National Pension System (NPS) for building a retirement corpus. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently compare these instruments, understand their tax advantages, and integrate them into a robust financial plan to achieve their life goals and ensure a secure financial future.

title: Investment Aspects- Domestic Investments (Public and Private)
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of domestic investment within India, examining the mechanisms of capital allocation by both public and private entities. It begins by establishing the context of why domestic investment is a cornerstone of economic sovereignty and resilience, directly impacting infrastructure, healthcare, and industrial growth. Key learning areas include the analysis of public investment in essential services versus private investment as a catalyst for innovation and market expansion. The course specifically explores the framework of Public-Private Partnership (PPP) models, using Indian case studies to illustrate their benefits and operational challenges. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to evaluate the complexities of the investment landscape, understand the synergy between sectors, and contribute to policy discussions aimed at overcoming investment barriers and fostering sustainable economic progress.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Investment Management using Fixed Income Securities
desc: Delve into the world of fixed income securities and master their application in modern investment management. This course explains why these instruments are fundamental for building resilient and predictable financial portfolios, especially in the context of public finance and institutional investment. You will explore the complete spectrum of fixed income products, from government and corporate bonds to municipal and asset-backed securities. Key learning areas include the macroeconomic role of bond markets, sophisticated bond pricing and valuation techniques, and methods for assessing and managing interest rate risk using duration and convexity. Upon completion, you will be able to construct and manage a diversified fixed income portfolio, analyze credit and reinvestment risks, and apply these strategies within a broader financial planning framework to achieve long-term financial objectives.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Investor Education: Smart Investing and Financial Planning
desc: In an increasingly complex economic landscape, mastering personal finance is crucial for long-term security and wealth creation. This course is designed for individuals seeking to elevate their financial literacy beyond basic savings, providing the tools for smart investing and robust financial planning. It addresses the critical need for a structured approach to managing money, aligning financial actions with life aspirations. Participants will delve into the core components of effective financial management. The curriculum covers setting and tracking SMART financial goals, constructing and managing a diversified investment portfolio through strategic asset allocation, and selecting appropriate investment instruments. Furthermore, the course provides essential knowledge on navigating the effects of inflation, interest rates, and taxation on investment returns. A significant portion is dedicated to behavioural finance, helping learners identify and overcome common psychological biases that can hinder sound financial judgment. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to build a goal-oriented investment strategy, make informed decisions based on risk and return preferences, and adapt their financial plans to changing market conditions, ultimately taking confident control of their financial future.

title: IP ADDRESS
desc: Embark on a detailed exploration of IP addressing to master how digital communication is enabled across networks. This course demystifies the technical world of networking, starting with the fundamental question, 'What is an IP address?'. It systematically breaks down the structure of IPv4 and IPv6, explaining their formats, capacities, and the ongoing transition between them. You will learn to classify IPv4 addresses (Class A, B, C, D, E) and understand their specific applications in various network sizes, from small local networks to large-scale enterprise systems. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical skill of IP subnetting. Through step-by-step examples, you will learn how to divide large networks into smaller, more manageable and efficient subnets, a critical skill for any network administrator. Furthermore, the course covers both static and dynamic (DHCP) IP assignment methods, providing the knowledge to configure and troubleshoot network devices effectively. By the end, you will be equipped to manage and troubleshoot basic network configurations with confidence, ensuring smooth and reliable connectivity.
subDomain: Management of information on official websites

title: IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) Part 1
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS), the standardized architectural framework for delivering IP multimedia services. It begins by positioning IMS within the evolution from traditional TDM platforms to Next Generation Networks (NGN), highlighting its role as a Class 5 NGN responsible for access and control. The course delves into the specific deployment of IMS-based core networks across BSNL's zones, providing a real-world context for the technology. Learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of the primary IMS functionalities, including the roles of the Home Subscriber Server (HSS) for data management, the Call Session Control Function (CSCF) for managing communication sessions, and the Advanced Telephony Server (ATS) for value-added services. The curriculum also breaks down the network elements of the IMS architecture, categorizing them into control, database, and interworking elements. Upon completion, participants will be able to recognize the key components and understand the fundamental operations of an IMS network.

title: IPPB--Products and Services
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) and its pivotal role in transforming India's banking landscape. It begins by explaining the context behind IPPB's establishment, addressing the challenge of financial exclusion and leveraging the vast network of the Department of Posts. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of IPPB's core product offerings, including the features and benefits of Premium, Regular, and Basic Savings Accounts. The curriculum delves into the suite of services that promote convenience and accessibility, such as mobile banking, SMS banking, missed call services, and doorstep banking. Furthermore, the course covers various payment systems like IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, and UPI, along with specialized services like Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) facilitation, issuing Digital Life Certificates, and Child Enrolment Lite Client (CELC) services. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the significance of IPPB's 'phygital' model and its contribution to empowering citizens financially.

title: IPVS (India Post Visibility System)
desc: The India Post Visibility System (IPVS) is a critical component of the modernization efforts within the Department of Posts, streamlining mail operations across Railway Mail Service (RMS) offices. A thorough understanding of this SAP-based platform is essential for ensuring the accuracy, speed, and traceability of mail. This course offers a detailed, step-by-step walkthrough of all major IPVS functionalities. Learners will master core transactions such as bag and article handling, from receipt and opening to closing and dispatch. The curriculum delves into specialized procedures for managing transit bags, insured articles, and bulk mail. Furthermore, it provides in-depth training on administrative and monitoring tools, including staff scheduling, set management (opening and closing), maintaining dispatch schedules, and generating various operational reports like mail lists and abstracts. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in using the IPVS application for daily mail operations. They will be able to handle discrepancies, manage errors using the system-based error book, and ensure compliance with standard operating procedures. This proficiency will directly contribute to enhanced operational efficiency, reduced errors, and improved end-to-end visibility in the postal network.

title: Iron and Steel Sector: Statistics and Economic Indices
desc: Gain a comprehensive understanding of the economic drivers of the Indian iron and steel industry. This course provides an in-depth examination of the primary statistical tools used to measure and analyze the sector's health and performance. You will delve into the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) to learn how industrial growth is tracked, and explore the Index of Eight Core Industries (ICI) to understand steel's specific weightage and economic significance. The curriculum also covers the Wholesale Price Index (WPI), explaining its role in monitoring inflation and price trends for steel commodities. Furthermore, the course introduces the Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) as a forward-looking indicator of market sentiment and economic activity. Upon completion, you will be proficient in using these indices to analyze production, consumption, and trade patterns, enabling you to make data-informed assessments of the iron and steel sector's trajectory and its impact on the broader economy.

title: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor: Building Effective Information Security Audits
desc: This course provides a comprehensive and practical introduction to ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditing, with a focus on the knowledge and skills required to plan, conduct, report, and manage Information Security Management System (ISMS) audits. It is designed for government officials, information security professionals, auditors, compliance teams, and others involved in information security governance and assurance. The course covers the key requirements of ISO/IEC 27001, the ISMS framework, Annex A controls, risk-based audit planning, audit scope and objectives, audit evidence, findings, and the complete audit lifecycle. Through practical exercises, real-world scenarios, and structured audit methodologies, learners will develop the ability to evaluate information security controls, identify gaps, assess evidence, document observations, and communicate audit findings effectively.

title: IT Applications in Commercial Department
desc: Dive into the digital backbone of Indian Railways' commercial operations with this introductory course on its essential IT applications. The curriculum is designed to provide a clear overview of the technologies that have revolutionized passenger services and revenue management. You will explore the architecture and features of the Passenger Reservation System (PRS), including the Next Generation e-Ticketing (NgeT) platform, and understand how the Unreserved Ticketing System (UTS) caters to millions of daily commuters through various channels like mobile apps and ATVMs. The course further delves into the National Train Enquiry System (NTES) for real-time train tracking, the Parcel Management System (PMS) for logistics, and the role of e-auctions in commercial contracts. Additionally, it touches upon how data analytics and Decision Support Systems (DSS) are leveraged to analyze passenger data, predict waitlist confirmations, and inform strategic planning. Upon completion, you will have a solid foundational knowledge of the IT ecosystem that drives the Commercial Department, enabling better service delivery and operational excellence.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: ITU/3GPP/TSDSI Standards in Mobile Technology
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the pivotal organizations shaping global and regional mobile communications. It begins by establishing the context of international standardization and its importance for interoperability and innovation. You will delve into the specific roles of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) in global policy and spectrum management, the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's (3GPP) process for developing technical specifications, and the Telecommunications Standards Development Society, India's (TSDSI) contributions to the Indian telecom ecosystem. Key learning areas include the standardization process, compliance requirements, and the impact of emerging technologies like 5G and IoT. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply this knowledge to ensure compliance, foster innovation, and make informed strategic decisions within the dynamic telecom sector.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Jan Bhagidari Program (English)
desc: In an aspirational India, the relationship between the government and its citizens is transforming. This course addresses the critical shift from a provision-based governance model to one of enabling and empowering citizens. It introduces the concept of 'Jan Bhagidari' or Empowered Citizen Partnership, a collaborative framework essential for tackling the nation's complex developmental challenges. The program is designed to provide civil servants with both the vision and a practical, systematic approach to integrate citizen-centricity into their daily functions. Key learning areas include understanding the principles of public partnership, identifying opportunities for citizen engagement, and applying collaborative methods to improve service delivery and policy outcomes. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to act as facilitators of change, working alongside citizens to build a more responsive, inclusive, and progressive future for all.

title: Jan Bhagidari Program (Hindi)
desc: आकांक्षी भारत के बदलते परिदृश्य में, सरकार की भूमिका एक प्रदाता से बढ़कर एक प्रवर्तक की हो गई है, जो नागरिकों को उनकी आकांक्षाओं को पूरा करने में सक्षम बनाती है। यह परिवर्तन केवल तभी संभव है जब सरकार और नागरिक भागीदार के रूप में मिलकर काम करें। यह पाठ्यक्रम 'जन भागीदारी' या सशक्त नागरिक भागीदारी के दृष्टिकोण को प्रस्तुत करता है। यह इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि सिविल सेवकों के लिए अपने काम में नागरिक-केंद्रित दृष्टिकोण अपनाना क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है। पाठ्यक्रम के माध्यम से, आप सीखेंगे कि कैसे जन भागीदारी को केवल एक विचार से एक ठोस कार्य प्रणाली में बदला जा सकता है। यह आपको स्थानीय विकास चुनौतियों का समाधान खोजने, शासन में पारदर्शिता लाने और अंततः एक प्रगतिशील भविष्य के निर्माण में नागरिकों के साथ सहयोग करने के लिए व्यावहारिक अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करेगा। इस यात्रा में शामिल होकर, आप एक ऐसे शासन मॉडल का हिस्सा बनेंगे जो वास्तव में समावेशी और प्रभावी है।

title: Jeevika- Didi Ki Rasoi
desc: JEEViKA, Bihar's Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society, which empowers marginalized women through self-help groups and initiatives like "Didi ki Rasoi," providing healthy institutional meals while generating employment and income.

title: Job Work in GST
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the provisions related to Job Work in GST. In today's competitive industrial landscape, outsourcing specific processes is a key strategy for cost-effective and efficient production. This module is designed to equip learners with the necessary knowledge to navigate the tax landscape of job work. Key learning areas include the specific procedures for sending goods for job work without the immediate payment of tax, the rules governing Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility, and the stipulated timelines for the return of goods. The course delves into the legal framework defined by Sections 19 and 143 of the CGST Act, 2017, ensuring participants can confidently manage compliance, documentation, and tax liabilities for both the principal manufacturer and the job worker. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these provisions correctly in their professional roles, minimizing risks and ensuring adherence to tax laws.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Joining Time on Transfer
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government employees with a clear understanding of the policies surrounding joining time on transfer. The curriculum delves into the fundamental principles and specific provisions that dictate the granting of joining time, ensuring that employees are well-informed of their rights and obligations. The course will cover the context of why joining time is a crucial component of the transfer process, highlighting its role in employee well-being and productivity. Key learning areas include the conditions for admissibility, methods for calculating the duration of joining time for different types of transfers, and the rules concerning pay and allowances during this period. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate the administrative procedures for availing joining time, interpret relevant rules for their specific situation, and ensure full compliance, leading to a seamless transition between postings.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Joint Parcel Product
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the Joint Parcel Product (JPP), an innovative logistics solution under the Rail Gati Shakti project. It is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the service's operational and financial framework. The program begins by introducing the core concepts of JPP, including its target markets in sectors like textiles and furniture, and its key features such as doorstep services and mandatory insurance. Learners will delve into the complete operational workflow, covering first-mile pickup, booking through the Parcel Management System (PMS), secure middle-mile transit by Indian Railways, and last-mile delivery. The course also provides an in-depth explanation of the accounting procedures for both retail and advance customers, including tariff structures, GST application, and payment reconciliation in SAP. Furthermore, it clarifies the claim settlement process for lost or damaged goods, outlining the responsibilities of India Post, Indian Railways, and the insurance provider. Upon completion, participants will be well-versed in the entire JPP lifecycle, enabling them to effectively manage and promote this service.

title: Judicial Decisions under the Right to Information Act 2005
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of key judicial precedents relating to the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005. It is designed particularly for Central Public Information Officers (CPIOs), First Appellate Authorities (FAAs), and other public officials involved in the implementation of the RTI framework. The course examines selected landmark judgments of the Supreme Court and High Courts, focusing on the background of each case, the legal issues involved, the reasoning adopted by the courts, and the practical implications of the judgments. Learners will explore how judicial decisions have shaped the interpretation and application of important provisions of the RTI Act. Key areas include the interpretation of “information,” disclosure and non-disclosure, exemptions under the Act, protection of privacy, public interest, and the balance between transparency and competing legal interests.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Judicial Review and How to Read Judgement - Hindi
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों के लिए न्यायिक समीक्षा की जटिलताओं और न्यायिक निर्णयों की व्याख्या के महत्व को स्पष्ट करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम में, आप शासन में शक्तियों के पृथक्करण के सिद्धांत और प्रशासनिक कार्यों पर न्यायिक जांच सुनिश्चित करने में न्यायपालिका की भूमिका के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम के मुख्य शिक्षण क्षेत्रों में न्यायिक निर्णयों की संरचना को समझना, 'रेशियो डिसीडेंडी' (निर्णय का आधार) और 'ओबिटर डिक्टा' (इतर कथन) के बीच अंतर करना और कानूनी तर्कों का विश्लेषण करना शामिल है। इस ज्ञान का उपयोग करके, शिक्षार्थी यह सुनिश्चित कर सकते हैं कि उनके द्वारा लिए गए निर्णय और नीतियां कानूनी जांच में खरी उतरें, जिससे मुकदमेबाजी का जोखिम कम हो और सुशासन को बढ़ावा मिले। यह पाठ्यक्रम अधिकारियों को अपने कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन अधिक आत्मविश्वास और कानूनी सटीकता के साथ करने में सक्षम बनाएगा।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Judicial Review and Reading a Judgement
desc: In a system governed by the rule of law, judicial review serves as a critical mechanism for holding administrative actions accountable. This course delves into the core concepts of judicial review, explaining its significance within the Indian constitutional framework and its impact on public administration. Learners will be guided through the process of deconstructing a judicial judgement, learning to identify and distinguish between its crucial components, such as the ratio decidendi and obiter dicta. The curriculum is structured to build practical skills for interpreting judicial reasoning, understanding court directives, and assessing the legal validity of government policies and orders. By the end of this course, officials will be better prepared to apply these principles in their work, ensuring that their actions align with legal standards and can withstand judicial scrutiny, thereby fostering good governance and minimizing litigation risks.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Jurisdictional Issues in Cyberspace
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding legal jurisdiction in cyberspace is critical for effective governance. This course delves into the intricate challenges of applying national and international laws to the internet. It begins by establishing the foundational principles of jurisdiction—prescriptive, adjudicative, and enforcement—and analyzes their application in a trans-border digital environment. The curriculum explores various theories of jurisdiction, such as the 'effects test' and 'minimum contact', through the lens of landmark Indian and international case laws, including the Yahoo, Banyan Tree, and Calder v. Jones cases. Participants will examine the extraterritorial provisions of India's Information Technology Act, 2000, and other relevant statutes. The course also covers the role of international agreements like the Hague Convention and Rome Convention in harmonizing legal approaches. Ultimately, learners will be equipped to better understand liability, formulate robust digital policies, and manage contractual and official duties in the evolving landscape of cyber law.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Karmayogi Kshamata Connect
desc: Karmayogi Kshamata Connect is a foundational course aimed at strengthening the capabilities of frontline government functionaries who serve as the vital link between the government and citizens. The course provides a comprehensive understanding of the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047 and emphasizes the importance of Jan Bhagidari in achieving inclusive and effective governance. It also introduces learners to Mission Karmayogi, highlighting the importance of continuous learning and capacity building for improved performance in public service roles. Additionally, the course covers essential aspects of digital safety, including protection from online fraud and safeguarding sensitive information. Learners will also gain basic exposure to emerging technologies and AI tools, enabling them to use digital solutions responsibly and efficiently in their day-to-day work. By connecting these themes to real-life responsibilities, the course aims to enhance and promote accountable governance.

title: Karnataka Sakala Act: Timely and Citizen-Centric Service Delivery
desc: This course provides an in-depth exploration of the Karnataka Sakala Services Act, 2011, and its subsequent Amendment Act of 2014. It is specifically tailored for government officials, administrators, and public stakeholders involved in service delivery within Karnataka. The curriculum is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of the act's objectives, key provisions, and legal framework, which mandates the timely delivery of government services to citizens. Participants will delve into the practical aspects of implementation, including their specific roles and responsibilities, step-by-step compliance procedures, and best practices for meeting service timelines. The course also examines the impact of the 2014 amendments on administrative efficiency and service quality. Through analysis of real-world scenarios, learners will be equipped to apply the act's provisions in their daily operations, reduce administrative delays, and improve overall citizen satisfaction by ensuring accountability and adherence to legal mandates.

title: Kavach - Automatic Train Protection (ATP) System
desc: Designed for railway professionals, this course offers a detailed exploration of the Kavach Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system. The initial modules introduce the basic principles of railway signalling, explaining how various systems work together to ensure safe and efficient train movement. This context is crucial for understanding the significance of an advanced safety system like Kavach. The course then proceeds to an in-depth analysis of Kavach's architecture and features. Learners will discover how it actively prevents collisions, enforces speed limits, and provides warnings to the loco pilot. Furthermore, the course covers the operational aspects of the on-board (Loco) Kavach unit, including the driver-machine interface, various operational modes, and the process of receiving movement authority. Upon completion, participants will have a solid understanding of Kavach's contribution to modernizing railway safety standards in India.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: KAVACH in Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the technical workings of KAVACH, a state-of-the-art safety system transforming Indian Railways. This course explains the fundamental principles of Automatic Train Protection and how KAVACH implements them through an integrated network of trackside, stationary, and locomotive-based units. You will learn how the system uses RFID tags, UHF radio, and GPS to continuously monitor train speed, location, and direction, and how it dynamically calculates and enforces movement authority based on real-time signal aspects and track conditions. The curriculum covers the various operational modes of the Loco KAVACH unit, from full supervision to emergency interventions like automatic brake application. Furthermore, the course highlights the system's fail-safe features, its centralized Network Monitoring System (NMS) for live tracking, and the cryptographic techniques used to ensure secure communication, providing a complete picture of how KAVACH achieves its goal of zero accidents.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Kavach System Maintenance and Troubleshooting
desc: Railway safety relies on systems that operate reliably and without failure. Kavach, India’s indigenous Train Collision Avoidance System (TCAS), is a critical safety technology designed to prevent accidents and enhance train operations. This course provides a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of maintaining, diagnosing, and troubleshooting Kavach systems developed by the three RDSO-approved OEMs: HBL, Medha, and Kernex. Learners will gain detailed insights into the structure, components, and subsystems of station and onboard Kavach units. The course covers fault detection, interpretation of fault codes, wiring and connector verification, system resets, software updates, and proper maintenance procedures. By combining practical knowledge with operational context, this course prepares railway personnel to keep Kavach systems functioning safely, efficiently, and reliably, thereby ensuring continuity and safety in train operations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: Kavach Tower Design
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Kavach towers, covering their purpose, design, construction, and field erection. Learners will explore why Kavach towers are essential for the safe operation of the Train Collision Avoidance System, the types of towers used, and the implementation of both Absolute Section and Auto Section Kavach schemes. The course also details the complete lifecycle of a tower—from initial survey to final erection—ensuring participants gain practical insights into the planning and execution processes involved.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: KAWACH: Child Protection Legal Framework
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of India's child protection ecosystem. It is designed to build sensitivity and equip learners with the knowledge to address the multifaceted issues of child vulnerability. The curriculum delves into critical legal statutes, including the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act (PCMA), and laws concerning child labour and trafficking. Participants will learn to identify different forms of child abuse—physical, emotional, and sexual—as well as neglect and online exploitation. The course highlights the specific challenges faced by migrant children, who are often at a higher risk. Through case studies and practical guidelines, learners will understand the roles and responsibilities of various stakeholders, from law enforcement to child welfare committees. A key focus is on the procedural aspects of reporting abuse and the mechanisms for timely intervention. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to apply effective strategies and foster collaborative efforts to strengthen child protection outcomes in their professional capacities.

title: KAWACH: Ensuring the Protection and Well-being of Children in India
desc: Delve into the critical framework of child welfare with this essential course on ensuring the protection and well-being of children in India. The program is designed to provide a foundational understanding of the multifaceted nature of childhood, examining it through social, legal, and psychological lenses. Participants will explore the specific vulnerabilities and challenges prevalent in the Indian context, emphasizing why children require dedicated safeguarding efforts. The course outlines the key legal provisions and societal structures established for child protection. It further clarifies the specific responsibilities and collaborative actions required from government functionaries and other stakeholders to build and maintain a safe, nurturing environment. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to contribute effectively to the collective goal of enabling every child to grow, thrive, and reach their full potential, in alignment with national child welfare mandates.

title: KAWACH: National Schemes for Child Protection and Development
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the governmental ecosystem designed to protect and nurture children in India. It begins by establishing the context of child rights and the vulnerabilities children face, such as abuse, exploitation, and neglect. The curriculum then delves into the architecture of major national initiatives, including Mission Vatsalya, Mission Shakti, and Mission Poshan (ICDS), detailing their objectives, components, and intended beneficiaries. A key focus is on the principle of convergence, illustrating how coordinated efforts between various departments and schemes can create a robust safety net for children. Through practical examples, the course explains how frontline workers, Panchayati Raj Institutions, and other stakeholders can leverage these schemes and associated budgets for effective on-the-ground implementation. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to contribute to building child-friendly communities by applying their knowledge of these critical government programs and fostering systems of care, coordination, and accountability.

title: KAWACH: Unpacking Child Protection Risks in India
desc: KAWACH: Unpacking Child Protection Risks in India is an essential course designed to build sensitivity and practical knowledge around the vulnerabilities children face. The module addresses the urgent need for informed community action by exploring a comprehensive range of threats, from physical and emotional abuse to modern dangers like online exploitation. It also covers systemic issues such as child labour, trafficking, and child marriage, with a special focus on the unique challenges faced by migrant children. Learners will engage with interactive content, animated videos, and reference materials to develop a clear understanding of their role in the child protection ecosystem. The course moves beyond simple awareness, providing actionable steps to identify at-risk situations, implement preventive measures, and respond effectively to concerns. By completing this module, participants will be better prepared to contribute meaningfully to the safety and well-being of children in their communities and professional capacities.

title: Key Capabilities of 5G
desc: As India rapidly expands its 5G network coverage, understanding the core capabilities of this transformative technology is crucial for professionals across all sectors. This course offers a detailed exploration of 5G, moving beyond a simple upgrade from 4G to explain its revolutionary potential. It is designed to provide a solid foundational knowledge of the technical architecture and performance benchmarks that define the fifth generation of wireless technology. The curriculum is structured around the three main usage scenarios defined by the ITU: Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB), Ultra-Reliable and Low-Latency Communications (uRLLC), and Massive Machine Type Communications (mMTC). You will learn about the specific key performance indicators for each, including peak data rates up to 20 Gbps, latency as low as 1 millisecond, and the capacity to support up to one million connected devices per square kilometer. Upon completion, learners will be able to articulate the distinct advantages of 5G and identify its practical applications, from enabling smart cities and industrial automation to supporting remote surgery and autonomous vehicles. This knowledge will empower public officials to better plan for and leverage 5G in governance, infrastructure, and citizen service delivery.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Key Changes in the Criminal Laws
desc: This course provides an in-depth examination of the recent overhaul of India’s criminal justice system, marked by the introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) in 2023. The curriculum is structured to provide a detailed walkthrough of the significant amendments and new provisions within each act. Participants will explore the context behind these reforms and their intended impact on the efficiency and fairness of legal processes. Key learning areas include the procedural changes in the BNSS concerning arrest, search, and seizure; the reclassification of offences and punishments in the BNS, including new categories like organized crime; and the modernization of evidence law under the BSA, with a focus on the admissibility of digital and electronic records. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently interpret and apply the new legal provisions in their professional roles.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Key Changes in the Criminal Laws
desc: This course provides an in-depth examination of the recent overhaul of India’s criminal justice system, marked by the introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) in 2023. The curriculum is structured to provide a detailed walkthrough of the significant amendments and new provisions within each act. Participants will explore the context behind these reforms and their intended impact on the efficiency and fairness of legal processes. Key learning areas include the procedural changes in the BNSS concerning arrest, search, and seizure; the reclassification of offences and punishments in the BNS, including new categories like organized crime; and the modernization of evidence law under the BSA, with a focus on the admissibility of digital and electronic records. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently interpret and apply the new legal provisions in their professional roles, understanding their practical implications for the criminal justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Key Components of E-Office
desc: In an era of digital transformation, the e-Office suite stands as a cornerstone for modernizing public administration and realizing the vision of a paperless, efficient, and transparent government. This course offers a detailed exploration of the e-Office platform, explaining its significance within the Digital India framework. You will delve into the core components that are reshaping daily official activities. Key learning areas include the File Management System (e-File), which digitizes the entire lifecycle of a file from creation to archival; the Knowledge Management System (KMS), a central repository for seamless document sharing and version control; the 'Work from Anywhere' (WAW) portal for secure remote access; the SPARROW system for streamlined employee performance appraisals; and the Personnel Information Management System (PIMS) for maintaining accurate employee records. Upon completion, learners will understand how each component functions and integrates to create a cohesive digital workplace, enabling them to improve personal productivity and enhance inter-departmental collaboration.

title: Key Concepts Related to Investigation
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the key definitions, powers, and investigative procedures under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. It explains the process of registration of First Information Reports (FIRs), including the newly introduced concepts of Zero FIR and e-FIR, and outlines procedures for investigating cognizable and non-cognizable offences. The course further examines critical procedural concepts such as the distinction between arrest, custody, and remand, differences between an FIR, complaint, and police report, and the contents and submission of police reports. Special emphasis is placed on the use of letters of request and the mandatory role of forensic investigation under the new criminal laws, highlighting reforms aimed at ensuring transparency, accountability, and scientific investigation.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Key Government Initiative -Capital Goods Scheme
desc: The Indian capital goods sector is a critical pillar of the nation's manufacturing ecosystem and a key driver for achieving the 'Make in India' vision. This course, 'Overview of the National Capital Goods Scheme,' offers a detailed examination of this pivotal government initiative, designed to equip public officials with a thorough understanding of its framework and strategic goals. The curriculum begins by identifying the current challenges within the sector and articulating the policy's core objectives. Learners will gain insights into the ten priority sub-sectors covered by the scheme and explore strategies for export promotion. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the significance of effective evaluation and monitoring to ensure successful implementation. The module is designed to familiarize government officials with the ministry's critical role in the national statistical system. It begins by outlining the organizational structure, including the National Statistical Office (NSO) and the Programme Implementation Wing, and explains their distinct mandates. Learners will delve into the processes behind the generation, compilation, and dissemination of official statistics, such as national income estimates, price indices, and large-scale survey data. title: Key Initiative - PLI scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry
desc: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme represents a significant policy initiative by the Government of India to bolster domestic manufacturing and enhance export capabilities. This course is specifically designed to demystify the PLI scheme for the automobile and auto component industry, a critical sector for economic growth and technological advancement. It addresses the strategic importance of promoting advanced automotive technologies (AAT), including electric vehicles and their components, to build a globally competitive and self-reliant industrial ecosystem.
