desc: This course is designed for professionals in the coal industry seeking to deepen their understanding of coal quality and grading. It begins by exploring the fundamental concepts of coal formation and its diverse applications. The curriculum then delves into the technical aspects of coal composition, focusing on key quality parameters like moisture, ash, volatile matter, fixed carbon, and calorific value, which are crucial for determining its industrial utility and market value. Participants will be guided through the standard procedures for coal quality analysis, learning how to interpret test results accurately. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to differentiating between coking and non-coking coal, highlighting their unique characteristics and specific uses in industries such as steel manufacturing and power generation. Furthermore, the course provides a detailed explanation of India's coal grading system, equipping learners with the skills to classify coal based on established quality standards. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently evaluate coal quality, understand industry-specific terminology, and contribute to efficient utilization, procurement, and quality control processes.

title: Knowledge of Standard Legal Terminology
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the importance and application of legal terminology in legal communication and drafting. It highlights the need for clarity, precision, and consistency in the use of legal language across various legal contexts. Learners will be introduced to commonly used legal terms, concepts, and Latin maxims, and will understand their relevance across different branches of law and legal proceedings. The course also explains the role of case law and legal interpretation in shaping the meaning and application of legal terminology. In addition, the course examines how the choice of words and phrasing can influence legal interpretation, rights, and obligations, while also identifying common errors arising from ambiguity or misuse of legal language. By the end of the course, learners will be able to apply accurate and precise legal terminology in drafting and legal communication.

title: KNOWLEDGE ON MoU WITH PSUs
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to the mechanism of Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) within India's Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). It establishes the context of MoUs as vital instruments for performance management, aligning the objectives of PSUs with national priorities. The curriculum delves into the entire lifecycle of an MoU, from drafting and negotiation to final evaluation. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of financial performance indicators such as EBITDA, Return on Net Worth, and CAPEX, alongside non-financial metrics. The course critically examines common issues highlighted in CAG audit reports, such as delays, non-compliance with regulatory provisions, and inconsistencies in target setting. Upon completion, learners will be able to effectively interpret DPE guidelines, analyze PSU performance against MoU targets, and contribute to strengthening corporate governance and transparency within their organizations.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Knowledge on Protocols of Elections to Parliament
desc: This course aims to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of the constitutional, legal, and administrative framework governing elections to the Parliament of India. It familiarises learners with the composition, powers, functions, and electoral processes related to the President of India, Rajya Sabha, and Lok Sabha, along with the role and functioning of the Election Commission of India and the election machinery at various levels. The course also covers key stages of the electoral process, including electoral roll preparation, nomination, campaigning, polling, counting, and declaration of results, while highlighting important provisions related to election management and electoral conduct. Further, it enables learners to understand India’s electoral system in comparison with global democratic practices, promoting a broader perspective on representation, inclusiveness, and election administration.

title: Knowledge Pertaining to Different Types of Underground Mining Methods
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the diverse methodologies used in underground mining, designed for professionals seeking to understand the principles of mineral extraction beneath the surface. The program begins by defining the conditions that necessitate underground mining over surface methods and introduces essential terminology, including 'shaft,' 'stope,' 'adit,' and 'vein.' The core of the course is dedicated to a systematic review of major stoping methods. It covers unsupported methods like shrinkage stoping, sub-level stoping, and room and pillar mining; supported methods such as cut-and-fill and square set stoping; and caving methods including block caving and sub-level caving. For each method, the course explains the operational process, applicability based on ore and rock strength, deposit shape, and depth. Participants will learn to analyze critical factors like production rate, mechanization potential, economic considerations, and geotechnical parameters to make informed decisions. The course concludes by highlighting the future trends in underground mining, emphasizing the move towards safer, cost-effective technologies and advanced automation, ensuring learners can select the most optimized combination of safety, economics, and recovery for any mining project.

title: Knowledge-Driven Data Integration for Mineral Predictive Modelling
desc: This e-training program equips earth science professionals with the essential skills for modern mineral exploration. The course delves into the critical process of mineral predictive modeling, emphasizing a knowledge-driven approach to data integration. Participants will explore the foundational concepts of mineral systems and the systematic process of mineral targeting, from area selection to resource evaluation. Key learning areas include the collection and processing of diverse geoscience spatial data, such as geological, geochemical, geophysical, and remote sensing information. The course provides practical guidance on using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to prepare predictor maps, integrate various data layers, and identify anomalies indicative of mineral deposits. By completing this course, learners will be able to apply these cost-effective and efficient techniques to generate reliable mineral prospectivity maps, validate their models, and ultimately enhance the success rate of mineral exploration projects.

title: Label Distribution Protocol
desc: Gain an in-depth technical knowledge of the Label Distribution Protocol (LDP) and its critical role in modern telecommunications. This course is designed for network professionals seeking to understand the mechanics behind MPLS, one of the key technologies for fast and efficient data packet forwarding. You will learn about the entire lifecycle of a labeled packet, from the initial push operation at the ingress router, through swap operations at core routers, to the final pop operation at the egress router. The curriculum breaks down complex concepts such as the Routing Information Base (RIB), Label Information Base (LIB), and the Label Forwarding Information Base (LFIB), clarifying how these tables are populated and utilized in both the control and data planes. A key focus is placed on the Penultimate Hop Popping (PHP) optimization, explaining how it reduces the load on egress routers and improves overall network performance. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze and troubleshoot LDP operations within an MPLS environment.

title: Labour Laws in a Nutshell
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the essential framework of Indian labour legislation, designed for professionals seeking to navigate the complexities of employee and industrial relations. In an environment of evolving regulations, including the introduction of new Labour Codes, a strong grasp of legal compliance is paramount for organizational stability and growth. The curriculum delves into critical topics such as the regulations governing contract labour, conditions of service, and the legal nuances of outsourcing. Learners will gain a detailed understanding of the Industrial Disputes Act, focusing on the correct procedures for handling terminations, retrenchment, and strikes to prevent legal disputes. The course emphasizes the practical application of these laws to foster industrial harmony and manage workplace conflicts effectively. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret key labour statutes, ensure their organization's compliance with legal requirements, manage risks associated with employee relations, and contribute to a fair and productive work environment. This knowledge is fundamental for HR professionals, managers, and business leaders responsible for maintaining lawful and ethical labour practices.

title: Land Acquisition for National Highway Projects
desc: This course is designed to equip officials with the necessary knowledge to navigate the complexities of land acquisition for National Highway projects. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the National Highways Act, 1956, which forms the legal backbone of the acquisition process. Key learning areas include the importance of accurate land records, the process of due diligence to identify rightful owners and encumbrances, and the creation of a detailed Land Acquisition Plan (LA Plan) with clear timelines. The course also covers the procedures for taking possession of land, the determination of compensation, and the handling of objections from landowners. Furthermore, it clarifies the pivotal role of Detailed Project Report (DPR) consultants in conducting feasibility studies and ensuring all technical and legal requirements are met.

title: Land Acquisition for National Highway Projects
desc: This course is designed to equip officials with the necessary knowledge to navigate the complexities of land acquisition for National Highway projects. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the National Highways Act, 1956, which forms the legal backbone of the acquisition process. Key learning areas include the importance of accurate land records, the process of due diligence to identify rightful owners and encumbrances, and the creation of a detailed Land Acquisition Plan (LA Plan) with clear timelines. The course also covers the procedures for taking possession of land, the determination of compensation, and the handling of objections from landowners. Furthermore, it clarifies the pivotal role of Detailed Project Report (DPR) consultants in conducting feasibility studies and ensuring all technical and legal requirements are met. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply this knowledge to facilitate a smooth, transparent, and legally compliant land acquisition process, contributing to the timely execution of national infrastructure projects.

title: Land Resource Inventory Boosts Farm Yields in Karnataka
desc: The Land Resource Inventory (LRI) is a technology-driven initiative developed under Sujala III to provide farmers with site-specific land data, empowering them to make informed crop choices and improve farm incomes through advanced remote sensing and GIS.

title: Land Survey Emerging Technologies
desc: This course delves into the modern technologies revolutionizing the field of land surveying. It addresses the complexities of surveying large land holdings by introducing a suite of advanced tools. Participants will learn about the practical applications of Electronic Total Station (ETS), Differential Global Positioning System (DGPS), and high-resolution drone and satellite imagery. The curriculum covers the entire workflow, from data collection in challenging terrains to the digitization of survey data into geo-referenced shape files. A key focus is the utilization of an integrated digital portal as a powerful tool for analysis and decision-making. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to leverage these technologies for enhanced land optimization, strategic infrastructure planning, and robust encroachment prevention, ensuring efficient and transparent management of land resources.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: Land Systems in Modern And Future Warfare
desc: This course delves into the dynamic and critical role of land systems in contemporary and future combat environments. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the strategic shifts and technological innovations transforming modern battlefields. The curriculum provides context on why adapting to these changes is crucial for maintaining operational superiority. Key learning areas include the integration of land systems with air, sea, and cyber domains, their application in asymmetric and urban warfare, and the impact of emerging technologies like AI, robotics, and autonomous platforms. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze current military trends, evaluate the effectiveness of next-generation land systems, and anticipate future developments in warfare. This knowledge will enable them to contribute to strategic planning and decision-making in an increasingly complex security landscape.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Landmark Judgement on Constitutional Provisions - Supreme Court
desc: This course delves into the critical role of the Supreme Court in interpreting the Indian Constitution. It is designed for public officials who need to understand the legal landscape that governs their roles and responsibilities. The curriculum will analyze a selection of landmark cases, breaking down the legal reasoning, the constitutional principles at stake, and the subsequent impact on policy and administration. Key learning areas include fundamental rights, the basic structure doctrine, and the separation of powers. By understanding these pivotal judgements, learners will be better equipped to ensure their official actions are in compliance with constitutional mandates, promoting a culture of legal propriety and effective governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Landmark Judgments- RTI Act, 2005
desc: This course delves into the critical legal precedents surrounding the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005. It is designed for public functionaries, particularly Central Public Information Officers (CPIOs) and First Appellate Authorities (FAAs), to deepen their understanding of how the judiciary has interpreted the Act. The curriculum covers a curated selection of landmark judgments from the Supreme Court and various High Courts, explaining the context, legal reasoning, and practical implications of each ruling. By analyzing these case laws, learners will be equipped to handle complex RTI applications with greater confidence and legal precision. The course will clarify nuanced aspects such as the definition of 'information', exemptions from disclosure, and the balance between transparency and privacy, ultimately empowering officials to uphold the spirit of the RTI Act while navigating its legal complexities.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Landmark Supreme Court Judgments on Constitutional Provisions
desc: This course provides an overview of landmark Supreme Court judgments relating to key constitutional provisions and their significance for governance and public administration. It is designed to help public officials understand how the Supreme Court interprets the Indian Constitution and how its judgments shape the functioning of the legislature and executive. Through selected landmark cases, learners will explore important constitutional principles, including Fundamental Rights, the Basic Structure Doctrine, separation of powers, and judicial review. The course examines the legal reasoning behind these judgments and their implications for public policy, administration, and official decision-making. By developing an understanding of these significant judicial pronouncements, learners will be better equipped to perform their duties in accordance with constitutional principles, uphold legal propriety, and contribute to effective and accountable governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Landscaping in Horticulture: Designing with Nature
desc: Dive into the world of landscape design and discover how to transform outdoor spaces into harmonious and sustainable environments. This course provides a thorough introduction to the core tenets of landscaping in horticulture, emphasizing its role in enhancing aesthetic value, promoting biodiversity, and contributing to mental well-being. You will explore the key principles of design such as balance, unity, and rhythm, which are essential for creating cohesive and attractive layouts. The curriculum covers practical, hands-on topics including various methods of plant propagation, understanding the specific nutrient requirements for healthy plant life, and the proper use and maintenance of basic garden tools. You will also learn about different plant training systems to manage and shape growth effectively. By the end of this course, you will have the foundational knowledge to plan and execute simple landscaping projects, whether for a residential garden, a public park, or a commercial space, enabling you to create greener and more beautiful environments.

title: Landslide-Disaster Response Training
desc: This self-paced course offers a comprehensive introduction to landslide disaster response. It begins by establishing the context of landslides as a critical natural hazard and explains the different classifications, their causes, and their devastating impacts on communities and infrastructure. The course delves into practical mitigation strategies designed to reduce landslide risks, providing learners with actionable knowledge. A significant focus is placed on the safety protocols and measures that must be followed before, during, and after a landslide event to ensure personal and public safety. Furthermore, the program elucidates the vital role that trained volunteers and disaster response personnel, such as those from the NDRF, play in a coordinated response effort. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to understand and react to landslide warnings and contribute effectively to community safety and resilience.

title: Landslide-Disaster Response Training
desc: Landslides pose a significant threat to communities in vulnerable regions, making preparedness and effective response critical for saving lives and minimizing damage. This course is designed to build foundational knowledge on landslide disaster management. It begins by classifying different types of landslides, explaining their scientific causes, and detailing their devastating impacts on infrastructure and human life. Participants will learn about proactive mitigation strategies that can be implemented to reduce the risk and severity of landslides, from land-use planning to early warning systems. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical safety measures that individuals and communities should follow before, during, and after a landslide event. Furthermore, the module highlights the indispensable role of volunteers in disaster response, outlining how they can be effectively mobilized and what their key responsibilities are in search, rescue, and relief operations. Upon completion, learners will have a comprehensive understanding of landslide hazards and be better equipped to ensure their own safety and contribute to community resilience.

title: Landslides in India: An Introduction
desc: Delivered by the Geological Survey of India, this introductory course is designed to build a comprehensive awareness of landslide hazards in India. The program is structured into three modules that guide learners from fundamental concepts to practical implications. Initially, the course defines what landslides are, detailing their classification, components, and dimensions. It then provides a detailed overview of the landslide scenario across India, highlighting the most vulnerable regions and explaining the inherent geological causes and human activities that contribute to slope instability. The final module focuses on the primary triggers, such as intense rainfall and earthquakes, that initiate these events. Participants will learn about the severe consequences of landslides, including loss of life, economic disruption, and ecological damage. The course aims to equip government officials, planners, and field personnel with the essential knowledge required for better hazard assessment, risk evaluation, and the formulation of effective mitigation strategies.

title: Large Language Models: Concepts and Applications
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly integral to both individual and organizational workflows. This introductory course demystifies the technology behind models like ChatGPT, offering a comprehensive overview for beginners. The curriculum begins by showcasing the capabilities and diverse use cases of LLMs, providing a clear context for their growing importance. You will delve into the foundational principles of their development, including the mechanics of language generation, the concept of multitask learning, and the process of instruction fine-tuning that makes these models so adaptable. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical application, teaching basic and advanced prompting strategies to interact with LLMs effectively. It emphasizes the importance of crafting clear, specific, and context-rich instructions to achieve desired outcomes.

title: Large Language Models: Concepts and Applications
desc: In an era of rapid technological advancement, Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly integral to both individual and organizational workflows. This introductory course demystifies the technology behind models like ChatGPT, offering a comprehensive overview for beginners. The curriculum begins by showcasing the capabilities and diverse use cases of LLMs, providing a clear context for their growing importance. Finally, the course concludes with a critical discussion on the limitations, risks, and ethical challenges associated with LLM deployment, ensuring learners are prepared for safe, informed, and responsible use of this powerful AI technology.

title: Lawful Interception Architecture of 5G
desc: Dive deep into the technical framework of Lawful Interception (LI) in 5G environments. This course is designed for technical officers and security professionals, offering a detailed examination of the 5G LI architecture. The curriculum begins by defining core terminology such as Content of Communication (CC), Intercept Related Information (IRI), and the significance of a Lawful Interception Identifier (LIID). You will learn about the high-level architecture, identifying key LI components like the Point of Interception (POI), Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF), and the Administration Function (ADMF). The course thoroughly explains the critical processes of provisioning a target for interception based on a warrant and the triggering mechanisms that initiate data capture. It further breaks down the specific roles of network functions like AMF, SMF, and UPF in capturing mobility, session, and content data. Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze and understand the end-to-end process of lawful interception in modern 5G standalone and non-standalone networks, ensuring both compliance and operational effectiveness.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Leadership
desc: In the dynamic environment of public service, strong leadership is crucial for driving progress and achieving organizational goals. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles of effective leadership. It begins by examining the timeless qualities of great leaders and how their vision and actions can inspire change. Learners will delve into the practical aspects of leadership, including how to define and communicate clear goals, create a shared vision, and motivate followers to take ownership. A key focus of the course is on team management, covering strategies for allocating tasks based on the unique competencies of each member and fostering a collaborative environment by sharing leadership responsibilities. Furthermore, the course introduces the ACS (Assessment, Challenge, Support) model as a powerful tool for self-assessment and personal growth. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the foundational knowledge and skills to influence others, lead their teams effectively, and contribute to the success of their organization's mission.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Leadership in Project Management
desc: This course is designed for government professionals seeking to enhance their ability to lead projects effectively. It establishes a strong foundation by exploring the core principles of leadership and their direct application to the structured discipline of project management. The curriculum delves into different leadership models, including transformational, democratic, and servant leadership, providing context for their use in the public sector. Participants will gain a comprehensive overview of the project management lifecycle, covering initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure. The course specifically addresses the challenges inherent in government projects, such as inter-departmental coordination, budget constraints, and ensuring transparency and accountability. Through practical examples and a focus on key leadership qualities like decision-making, communication, and integrity, learners will be equipped to drive project success, manage teams effectively, and deliver value to citizens. By the end of this course, you will be better prepared to navigate the complexities of public sector projects and inspire your team towards achieving strategic goals.

title: Leadership Interventions and Succession Planning at HPCL
desc: The case highlights the positive impacts of leadership intervention and succession planning at HPCL through strategies like T20, T25, and the HP Possible Model, aimed at identifying, training, and preparing potential leaders for seamless company operations.

title: Leadership Lessons from Bhagavad Gita
desc: In an era where leaders face unprecedented pressure, this course offers a unique framework by integrating the profound teachings of the Bhagavad Gītā with proven modern leadership theories. The program delves into the core of leadership effectiveness, moving beyond external strategies to focus on the 'World Within.' Participants will explore how to cultivate self-awareness and emotional clarity by analyzing Arjuna's crisis, providing a powerful metaphor for contemporary leadership challenges. Key learning areas include the practical application of the Incomplete Leadership model to build collaborative and well-rounded teams, and an examination of Jim Collins' Level 5 Leadership, which champions humility and unwavering will—qualities deeply rooted in the Gītā's philosophy. Learners will also master the principles of Karma Yoga (selfless action) and Titikṣā (resilience), enabling them to lead with integrity, courage, and a strong sense of purpose. This course is designed to equip professionals and aspiring leaders with timeless tools to inspire teams and navigate the complexities of the modern workplace with compassion and conviction.

title: Leadership Lessons from the Indian Knowledge System
desc: Delve into a transformative leadership journey that integrates ancient Indian wisdom with modern management practices. This course provides a comprehensive exploration of philosophies from the Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, and other classical texts, translating them into actionable strategies for today's leaders. The curriculum is structured around key themes including ethical governance, holistic decision-making, and the cultivation of intangible qualities like trust and empathy. Participants will analyze frameworks such as the Shakti-Yukti-Bhakti-Mukti model to develop adaptive and situational leadership skills. By examining concepts like 'Tattvamasi' (Oneness) and 'Atmano Mokshartham-Jagat Hitaya Cha' (Self-liberation and world welfare), learners will be empowered to move beyond conventional performance metrics. The course aims to build resilient, self-aware leaders who can inspire teams, foster collaboration, and create sustainable, value-centric organizations.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Leadership Skills for Professionals
desc: In today's rapidly evolving professional landscape, leadership is a critical competency that extends beyond traditional management roles. This course is designed to provide professionals with the foundational knowledge and practical skills to lead effectively in any context. It addresses the importance of leadership in driving both personal growth and organizational excellence, preparing learners to navigate complex challenges with confidence. The curriculum delves into a comprehensive range of topics, including classical and contemporary leadership theories, the development of self-awareness and emotional intelligence, and the enhancement of interpersonal communication. Participants will explore proven strategies for critical thinking, ethical decision-making, and building cohesive, high-performing teams. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to apply robust leadership frameworks to solve real-world problems, set a clear vision, and inspire motivation within their teams. This program empowers professionals to translate leadership theory into actionable strategies, fostering a culture of collaboration and achieving significant career advancement.

title: Leadership Skills for Public Sector Professionals
desc: In today's dynamic public sector, effective leadership is paramount for achieving organizational goals and driving meaningful change. This course is designed to equip current and aspiring leaders with the essential skills to navigate the complexities of government work. It begins by establishing a strong foundation in self-awareness and personal effectiveness, exploring concepts like the learning mindset, resilience, and mindfulness. You will delve into the core of leadership, learning to differentiate between power, authority, and influence, and understanding how to build and motivate high-performing teams through psychological safety and authenticity. The course also addresses the practical challenges of leadership, offering strategies for managing different types of subordinates, making sound decisions by recognizing cognitive biases, and communicating supportively to foster positive relationships. By the end of this course, you will have a robust theoretical and practical toolkit to lead with confidence, adapt your style to various situations, and effectively influence outcomes upward, downward, and laterally within your organization.

title: Leading from Within: Behavioural Strategies for Self-Leadership
desc: In the dynamic environment of public service, the ability to lead oneself is the foundation of effective leadership and professional growth. This course, 'Behavioural Strategies for Developing Effective Self-Leadership,' is designed to equip government officials with the internal tools necessary to navigate complexities and drive personal excellence. It addresses the critical need for proactive self-management to enhance performance and contribute meaningfully to organizational goals. Participants will delve into the core pillars of self-leadership, starting with building profound self-awareness and cultivating a resilient growth mindset. The curriculum covers a range of practical behavioural strategies, including techniques for self-observation, effective goal-setting, and self-reward systems to reinforce positive actions.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

desc: In the dynamic environment of public service, the ability to lead oneself is the foundation of effective leadership and professional growth. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these self-leadership principles to improve their decision-making, manage their professional responsibilities with greater effectiveness, and build the personal resilience required for a demanding public service career. This will empower them to not only achieve their own goals but also to inspire and contribute to a more motivated and impactful public sector workforce.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Leading from Within: Self-Leadership for Public Service
desc: In the dynamic environment of public service, the ability to lead effectively begins with mastering oneself. This course, 'Leading from Within,' provides a comprehensive exploration of self-leadership as the cornerstone of personal excellence and impactful governance. It addresses the critical need for public officials to cultivate self-awareness and personal accountability before guiding teams and implementing policy. The curriculum is designed to move beyond theoretical concepts by focusing on practical application. Key learning areas include understanding the four pillars of self-leadership, developing robust self-management techniques, and mastering the art of setting and achieving meaningful personal and professional goals. Learners will engage with self-assessment tools to identify their strengths and areas for development, fostering a deeper understanding of their own motivations and behaviours. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply these principles to improve their decision-making, enhance their resilience, and manage their responsibilities with greater purpose. This course empowers public servants to build a strong internal foundation, enabling them to lead others with authenticity, confidence, and unwavering integrity.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Leading Others
desc: Embark on a transformative journey to become an inspiring and effective leader. This course is designed for new and aspiring managers who are transitioning from individual contributors to team leaders. It provides a robust foundation in the principles of modern leadership, contextualized for a dynamic professional environment. You will delve into the critical aspects of leading performance by learning to set unambiguous goals using frameworks like Management by Objectives (MBO) and SMART criteria. The course also focuses on leading people, offering strategies to build high-performing teams, foster psychological safety, and create a strong, shared purpose. You will learn to navigate common leadership challenges, including managing conflict, driving change, and motivating diverse team members. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of leading yourself, covering topics like emotional intelligence, persuasion, and upward management to enhance your personal effectiveness and influence. Through practical examples and proven models like the GROW framework for coaching and Lewin's model for change management, you will gain actionable insights to build a resilient, motivated, and successful team.

title: Leading Self
desc: Embark on a transformative journey with 'Leading Self,' a course designed to help you become the best version of yourself. In today's professional landscape, the ability to lead oneself is the cornerstone of effective leadership and personal success. This course delves into the core principles of self-mastery, starting with the fundamental concept that you must lead yourself before you can effectively lead others. You will learn to deconstruct your performance through Timothy Gallwey's 'Performance Equation' (Performance = Potential - Interferences), enabling you to identify and overcome the internal obstacles—such as self-doubt, fear of failure, and imposter syndrome—that hold you back. The curriculum covers essential models for personal growth, including the 'Comfort, Learning, and Panic Zones' to encourage stepping into new challenges, the 'Ladder of Learning' to understand skill acquisition, and the 'Johari Window' to build profound self-awareness. You will also learn the importance of accountability, the art of leveraging feedback for continuous improvement using the AVA approach, and how to set SMART goals to turn insights into action. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with a toolkit of mental models and practical strategies to take charge of your life, expand your potential, and build a sustainable path to personal and professional excellence.

title: Leading The Future : Managing Gen Z
desc: In today's evolving workplace, understanding generational differences is crucial for effective leadership. This course, 'Leading the Future: Effective Strategies for Managing Generation Z,' is specifically designed for public sector leaders and managers navigating the dynamics of a multi-generational workforce. The content delves into the core traits of Generation Z, including their digital fluency, desire for work-life balance, and commitment to diversity and purpose. Participants will explore practical strategies for attraction, engagement, and retention, focusing on creating a flexible and inclusive work culture. The course covers effective communication techniques, modern leadership styles, and best practices for integrating Gen Z into government teams. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to build stronger, more innovative teams, harness the potential of their youngest employees, and foster a collaborative environment that drives public service excellence.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Leading The Karmayogi Way
desc: Embark on a learning journey designed to redefine your perspective on public service through the lens of Mission Karmayogi. This course addresses the critical need for a civil service that is not only competent but also deeply motivated by a spirit of service ('seva bhava'). You will delve into the foundational principles of the Karmayogi philosophy, focusing on introspection and self-awareness as catalysts for professional growth. Key learning areas include understanding the power of personal agency, developing a strong sense of responsibility for outcomes, and learning to respond effectively to the complex challenges of modern governance. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with a renewed sense of purpose and a practical framework for applying the Karmayogi ideals, enabling you to lead with integrity and make a tangible difference in your service to the nation.

title: Leading with Clarity: Svadharma in Public Service
desc: Embark on a transformative journey with 'Leading with Clarity: Svadharma in Public Service,' a course designed to help public servants align their professional roles with their deepest personal values. In the demanding environment of public administration, maintaining a strong sense of purpose is crucial for effective and ethical leadership. This course provides a structured path to uncover your Svadharma—your true calling—by cultivating profound self-awareness. Participants will engage with practical frameworks such as Drig Drishya Viveka and the AARR (Awareness, Acceptance, Reframing, Response) model to observe their thoughts and behaviors non-judgmentally. You will learn to identify and overcome limiting beliefs, build purposeful habits, and connect your personal mission with the broader goal of citizen-centric governance. By integrating these principles, you will not only enhance your personal resilience and fulfillment but also develop the capacity to lead with greater clarity, inspire your teams, and drive meaningful transformation within the public sector.

title: Leading with Collaboration: Sahakaryata in Public Service
desc: “Leading with Collaboration: Sahakaryata in Public Service” provides a comprehensive guide for civil servants to master the art of collaborative leadership. The course establishes the importance of Sahakaryata (co-creation) in today's multi-stakeholder governance landscape, where success depends on cooperation rather than command. It begins by helping learners reflect on their leadership style and understand the critical shift from a 'self-in' to an 'others-in' mindset. Key learning areas include powerful emotional intelligence concepts like the Brahmavihāras and the Aaroha Values Framework, which provide tools to align with diverse stakeholders and build deep, meaningful professional relationships. The curriculum then transitions to practical application, guiding participants through real-world scenarios such as mentoring, delivering constructive feedback, and resolving conflicts. By the end of the course, learners will not only grasp the philosophy but also possess a personalized action plan to implement these collaborative practices, ultimately driving greater efficiency, resilience, and citizen satisfaction in their work.

title: Leave Management System in IT 2.0 Employee Self Service Portal
desc: This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the Leave Management System (LMS) available in the IT 2.0 Employee Self Service (ESS) portal. It is designed to empower Department of Posts employees to handle their leave-related activities with efficiency and autonomy. The curriculum explains why digital leave management is crucial for modern administrative workflows, highlighting benefits like reduced paperwork and increased transparency. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process for submitting new leave applications, withdrawing or shortening existing leave, and converting leave types. Furthermore, participants will learn how to access their real-time leave balances, generate personal leave reports, check holiday lists, and upload necessary documents such as fitness certificates. Upon completion, employees will be proficient in using the ESS portal for all leave management needs, contributing to a more streamlined and accurate administrative process.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Leave Rules
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, which govern the leave entitlements for government employees. It is designed to provide officials with a thorough understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding leave, ensuring both employees and administrative staff can manage leave procedures correctly. The curriculum delves into the specifics of different leave types, including earned leave, half-pay leave, commuted leave, leave not due, and extraordinary leave. It also addresses special provisions such as maternity, paternity, and child care leave. Upon completion, learners will be able to accurately calculate leave eligibility, apply the correct procedures for sanctioning leave, and maintain proper leave accounts. This knowledge is crucial for ensuring administrative consistency, upholding employee rights, and maintaining operational readiness within government departments. The course will empower officials to navigate leave-related matters with confidence and clarity.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Leave Rules (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी सेवा में अवकाश नियमों की एक व्यापक समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश) नियम, 1972 के प्रमुख पहलुओं पर केंद्रित है, जो अधिकांश केंद्र सरकार के कर्मचारियों पर लागू होते हैं। प्रतिभागी विभिन्न प्रकार के अवकाशों के बारे में जानेंगे, जैसे अर्जित अवकाश, अर्ध-वेतन अवकाश, परिवर्तित अवकाश, मातृत्व और पितृत्व अवकाश, और विशेष आकस्मिक अवकाश। पाठ्यक्रम में अवकाश की पात्रता की गणना, अवकाश नकदीकरण के प्रावधान और अवकाश यात्रा रियायत (एलटीसी) के साथ अवकाश को जोड़ने की प्रक्रियाओं का विवरण दिया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, शिक्षार्थी आत्मविश्वास के साथ अवकाश से संबंधित मामलों को संभालने, नियमों की सही व्याख्या करने और अपने व अपने अधीनस्थों के लिए अवकाश का प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधन करने में सक्षम होंगे। यह पाठ्यक्रम सभी स्तरों के कर्मचारियों और विशेष रूप से प्रशासनिक तथा मानव संसाधन भूमिकाओं में काम करने वालों के लिए आवश्यक है।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Leave Rules - Updated
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the updated leave rules governing central government employees. It serves as an essential guide for both employees seeking to understand their entitlements and administrative personnel responsible for managing leave records. The curriculum covers the fundamental principles of leave policies, including the various categories such as Earned Leave, Half Pay Leave, Commuted Leave, and Special Leave. Learners will delve into the specific provisions of the CCS (Leave) Rules, understanding the conditions for granting leave, calculating leave balances, and managing leave accounts. The course explains the procedural aspects, from submitting a leave application to the sanctioning process and maintaining records in service books. By completing this course, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply leave rules, ensuring compliance and preventing administrative discrepancies. This knowledge is crucial for maintaining procedural integrity and supporting the welfare of public servants.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Leave Rules and Management in Government Service
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the updated leave rules governing central government employees. It serves as an essential guide for both employees seeking to understand their entitlements and administrative personnel responsible for managing leave records. The curriculum covers the fundamental principles of leave policies, including the various categories such as Earned Leave, Half Pay Leave, Commuted Leave, and Special Leave. Learners will delve into the specific provisions of the CCS (Leave) Rules, understanding the conditions for granting leave, calculating leave balances, and managing leave accounts. The course explains the procedural aspects, from submitting a leave application to the sanctioning process and maintaining records in service books.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Leave Rules in Indian Railways
desc: This detailed course on 'Leave Rules in Indian Railways' is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the leave policies and procedures that govern one of the largest employers in the country. The program delves into the specifics of the Liberalized Leave Rules, 1949, which is the primary framework for leave management within the organization. The course systematically covers the context and importance of each leave type, from standard entitlements like Leave on Average Pay (LAP) and Leave on Half Average Pay (LHAP) to special provisions such as Maternity, Paternity, Child Care, and Study Leave. It also clarifies complex rules related to Commuted Leave, Leave Not Due, and Extraordinary Leave. Participants will learn the correct protocols for applying for, sanctioning, and encashing leave, as well as the regulations concerning joining time on transfer. This knowledge is crucial for all railway employees for managing their entitlements, for administrators and supervisors for ensuring fair and consistent application of rules, and for aspirants of the Limited Departmental Competitive Exam (LDCE) who require a deep knowledge of these regulations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
desc: This comprehensive e-module is designed to provide Central Government employees with a thorough understanding of the Leave Travel Concession (LTC) rules as per the CCS (LTC) Rules, 1988. The course addresses the critical need for government servants to be well-versed in their entitlements and the procedures for availing them, ensuring transparency and preventing procedural errors. Key learning areas covered include the fundamental concepts of LTC, eligibility requirements after one year of continuous service, and the distinction between hometown and all-India LTC. The module delves into the specifics of block years, the definition of 'family' for LTC purposes, dependency criteria, and the process for declaring a hometown. Participants will also learn about special provisions, such as LTC for new entrants, travel to the North Eastern Region, Jammu & Kashmir, and Andaman & Nicobar Islands, and rules for leave encashment. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently calculate their entitlements, correctly apply for LTC advances, submit claims for reimbursement, and understand the consequences of fraudulent claims, thereby effectively managing their travel benefits.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Leaving No One Behind
desc: The Chikkaballapur district administration in Karnataka was working hard to scale up COVID-19 vaccinations, but without much success. Under the leadership of Dr. C.N. Satyanarayana Reddy, Taluka Health Officer of Chikkaballapur district, strategic collaborations were initiated to accelerate vaccinations for the most vulnerable populations across India in line with the government's mandate of leaving no one behind. Following an understanding of the causes underlying vaccine resistance and implementation challenges in the district, appropriate measures were undertaken to raise awareness and design effective vaccine delivery systems.

title: Left-Wing Extremism and Its Impact on Railways
desc: The course provides a comprehensive understanding of Left-Wing Extremism (LWE), including Maoist and Naxalite insurgencies and their impact on railway infrastructure and operations. The course explores the background and evolution of these movements, the nature and motives behind attacks on railway assets, and their implications for passenger safety, freight movement, and regional development. It also examines threat perceptions, operational vulnerabilities, and the security challenges faced by the railway system. In addition, the course highlights the protection and precautionary measures implemented by Indian Railways and security agencies to safeguard railway infrastructure and ensure safe operations. Finally, it discusses current strategies and future approaches adopted by the government to effectively address and mitigate LWE-related threats to the railway network.

title: Legal Framework for Digital Public Infrastructure
desc: Dive into the essential legal and institutional architecture that powers a modern digital state with this course on India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI). Moving beyond simple digitization, you will explore how a robust legal foundation is paramount for creating secure, scalable, and interoperable digital ecosystems. The curriculum provides an in-depth analysis of India's pioneering 15-year journey, examining the legislative and regulatory evolution from Aadhaar's identity layer to the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) and the comprehensive Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture (DEPA). A significant focus is placed on the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, illustrating how adaptive legal frameworks can foster innovation while safeguarding citizen privacy and constitutional rights. Through this course, you will gain a strong understanding of the principles required to design and implement effective, citizen-centric digital public services, learning why a proactive legal strategy is more critical than technology alone for long-term success and sustainability.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Legal Framework for Lawful Interception
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the legal and procedural landscape for lawful interception in India. It begins by defining core concepts like interception, monitoring, and surveillance, and establishes the context of their necessity for law enforcement and security agencies. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the primary legal instruments, including the Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 (with a focus on Rule 419A) and the Information Technology Act, 2000 (specifically Section 69). Learners will analyze the roles and responsibilities of various stakeholders, including Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), the Department of Telecommunications (DoT), and telecom service providers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to interpreting the constitutional safeguards, guided by landmark Supreme Court judgments like the PUCL and Puttaswamy cases, which mandate a balance between state security and individual privacy. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the complexities of authorizing, executing, and reviewing interception orders in compliance with established legal and ethical standards.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Legal Framework for Lawful Interception of Communications in India
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the legal and procedural landscape for lawful interception in India. It begins by defining core concepts like interception, monitoring, and surveillance, and establishes the context of their necessity for law enforcement and security agencies. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the primary legal instruments, including the Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 (with a focus on Rule 419A) and the Information Technology Act, 2000 (specifically Section 69). Learners will analyze the roles and responsibilities of various stakeholders, including Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), the Department of Telecommunications (DoT), and telecom service providers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to interpreting the constitutional safeguards, guided by landmark Supreme Court judgments like the PUCL and Puttaswamy cases, which mandate a balance between state security and individual privacy.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Legal Framework for Summoning and Testimony and Medical Examination
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the new procedural guidelines established by the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, which modernizes India's criminal procedure. The content is specifically tailored for Investigating Officers and other law enforcement personnel who must navigate these updated legal requirements. Key learning areas include the specific powers and limitations related to summoning persons for testimony, the protocols for requesting and handling documents, and the step-by-step process for conducting medical examinations of victims, ensuring their rights and dignity are protected. Furthermore, the course covers the drafting, issuance, and execution of production orders, highlighting the importance of proper acknowledgment and maintaining a clear chain of custody. By mastering these procedures, learners will be equipped to conduct investigations that are not only effective but also fully compliant with the new legal standards, thereby strengthening the integrity of the criminal justice process and ensuring that evidence collected is admissible in court.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Legal Framework of UN Peacekeeping Operations
desc: This course delves into the essential legal framework that underpins United Nations Peacekeeping Operations, providing crucial knowledge for all deployed personnel. In the complex environments where peacekeepers operate, a firm grasp of international law is paramount for mission success and accountability. The curriculum systematically covers the foundational legal instruments, including the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA), Status of Mission Agreement (SOMA), and Memorandums of Understanding (MoU). Participants will gain a detailed understanding of International Human Rights Law (IHRL), International Humanitarian Law (IHL), and refugee law, learning to distinguish their applications. A significant focus is placed on the Rules of Engagement (ROE) and Directives on the Use of Force (DUF), explaining why they are critical for armed personnel. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these legal principles in operational scenarios, identify potential violations, and respond effectively to protect vulnerable populations and uphold the mandate of the UN.
org: Centre of United Nations Peace Keeping

title: Legal Information Management and Briefing System (LIMBS)
desc: In an era of digital transformation, efficient management of government litigation is paramount for ensuring timely justice and reducing administrative overhead. The Legal Information Management and Briefing System (LIMBS) has been developed as a pivotal web-based application to address these challenges by centralizing case information and streamlining workflows. This course provides a comprehensive exploration of the LIMBS platform, designed for officials and advocates involved in government legal matters. The curriculum begins with a foundational overview of LIMBS, detailing its purpose, key features, and the benefits it offers, such as enhanced transparency and monitoring. Learners will explore the system's progress and impact since its launch. The course delves into specific functionalities, including the FAB (Fee and Bill) Module, which simplifies the process of advocate billing for government cases. It also covers the Advocate Module, outlining the specific actions and benefits available to legal counsels using the system. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the LIMBS portal confidently, manage case information effectively, and utilize its modules for billing and advocacy tasks. This knowledge is directly applicable to roles requiring interaction with government legal systems, enabling users to contribute to a more organized, efficient, and accountable litigation management process.

title: Legislative Functions of the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the pivotal role the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs (MoPA) plays in the Indian legislative system. In a parliamentary democracy, the effective management of legislative business is crucial for good governance, and the MoPA serves as the central coordinating body for these activities. This module is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of the procedures and responsibilities associated with this vital function. Key learning areas include the detailed processes for managing government legislative and non-legislative proposals, private member’s bills and resolutions, and the promulgation of ordinances. The course also covers the Ministry's role in providing secretarial assistance to the Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs (CCPA), coordinating with the Business Advisory Committee (BAC), and managing matters raised during Zero Hour and under Rule 377. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently identify and execute the necessary steps for various legislative matters, understand the lines of coordination with other Ministries and key parliamentary personnel, and appreciate the strategic importance of the MoPA in the functioning of the government.

title: Lekha DEeP-Prarambh
desc: An essential e-learning program for newly appointed and existing staff in the Postal Department, 'Lekha DEeP-Prarambh' serves as a comprehensive introduction to the core functions of the accounts branch. This course is specifically tailored for Postal and Sorting Assistants aspiring to work in accounts, as well as newly appointed accountants in divisional offices and head post offices. The curriculum is systematically divided into three modules. The first module covers fundamental concepts like pay fixation, annual increments, joining time, and the Last Pay Certificate (LPC). The second module delves into the processing of various advances (e.g., HBA, computer) and claims (e.g., LTC, honorarium, bonus). The final module explains the management of crucial employee funds, including the National Pension System (NPS), General Provident Fund (GPF), and payments to GDS and casual labor. Through a series of instructional videos and practical examples, learners will gain the necessary skills to confidently handle basic accounting and financial procedures using the department's CSI SAP software, ensuring compliance and efficiency in their roles.

title: Lekha-DEeP - Dakshta
desc: Designed to enhance the skills of accounts personnel, 'Lekha-DEeP Dakshata' is a detailed e-course on the financial and administrative rules governing the Department of Posts. The curriculum is structured to build proficiency in the day-to-day tasks of an accounts branch. The course delves into the intricacies of pay determination, joining time, and the processing of various advances such as House Building and computer loans. It provides a thorough understanding of claims processing, including Travel Allowance (TA), Leave Travel Concession (LTC), and medical reimbursements. A significant portion is dedicated to fund management, covering the General Provident Fund (GPF) and the New Pension System (NPS), from contributions to final withdrawal. The training emphasizes the practical application of these rules through the Core System Integrator (CSI) SAP platform, guiding users on drawing salaries, processing off-cycle payments, and managing budget statements. By completing this course, participants will be better equipped to ensure financial compliance and streamline accounting operations within their divisions.

title: Lekha-DEeP -Praveenta
desc: Developed for accounts personnel in the Postal and Railway Mail Service, 'Lekha Deep Pravinata' is an advanced e-learning program aimed at achieving mastery in financial and accounting procedures. The course delves into the intricacies of government accounting, starting with fundamental principles and progressing to complex subjects such as pay fixation under the 7th Pay Commission, management of the National Pension System (NPS) and General Provident Fund (GPF), and the complete lifecycle of employee benefits from joining to retirement. Key modules focus on practical application, covering the processing of claims like LTC and medical reimbursements, handling of advances, and conducting audits and bank reconciliations. Participants will also learn to execute these tasks using the CSI SAP system, including salary disbursal, off-cycle payments, and generating essential reports like the Last Pay Certificate (LPC). Upon completion, learners will be proficient in maintaining service books, preparing pension papers, and ensuring full compliance with financial rules, thereby enhancing operational excellence within the department.

title: Level Crossings in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the management and safety of level crossings in the Indian Railways system. It begins by establishing the context of level crossings as critical intersections where road and rail traffic meet, highlighting the inherent risks and the need for stringent safety protocols. Key learning areas include the detailed classification of level crossings based on traffic volume (TVUs) and road type, and the specific design considerations for gates, approach gradients, and safety equipment. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of operational procedures, including the function of warning systems like whistle indicators and rumble strips, and the equipment gatemen use for daily operations and emergencies. The course details the robust inspection and maintenance frameworks, covering the responsibilities of personnel such as Assistant Engineers and Permanent Way Inspectors (PWI). It also explains emergency protection protocols, such as the placement of detonators and signaling. Finally, the course discusses the strategic importance of traffic census data in prioritizing the upgrade of high-density crossings to Road Over Bridges (ROBs) or Road Under Bridges (RUBs), contributing to a safer and more efficient national transport network.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Level-I CSSS Course to Develop Domain Competencies (Part-I)
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip Personal Assistants (PAs) with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in their roles within the government secretariat. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the duties outlined in the Manual of Office Procedure, establishing a strong base for professional conduct. Key learning areas include mastering dictation and transcription, effective telephone etiquette, professional visitor management, and the meticulous handling of confidential documents and files. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical aspects of convening official meetings, covering everything from agenda preparation and venue arrangement to recording and circulating minutes. Furthermore, the course addresses the evolving expectations for PAs, such as proficiency with e-Office, managing work-from-home responsibilities, and developing personal attributes like time management, problem-solving, and proactiveness. By the end of this module, learners will be prepared to provide efficient and effective secretarial support, contributing significantly to their officer's and organization's success.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Level-II CSSS Course to Develop Domain Competencies
desc: This training program is specifically designed to equip Personal Assistants of the Central Secretariat Stenographers Service for their promotion to the role of Private Secretary. The course provides an in-depth understanding of the professional expectations and functions associated with this pivotal position in government administration. The curriculum is structured around the guidelines of the Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedure (CSMOP), covering a wide array of duties. Key learning areas include mastering dictation and transcription, professional telephone etiquette, efficient visitor and appointment management, and meticulous planning of official tours and travel. Furthermore, the course delves into the complexities of handling confidential documents, supporting parliamentary work, and organizing official meetings. Beyond procedural tasks, learners will develop the interpersonal and managerial skills necessary to function as a trusted aide to a senior officer. This includes strategies for effective communication, adapting to different leadership styles, and upholding the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to perform their duties with enhanced efficiency, confidence, and a deep understanding of their role in supporting effective governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Level-III CSSS Course to Develop Behavior Competencies
desc: This course is designed for government officials seeking to strengthen their behavioral competencies by mastering the art of interpersonal skills. It begins by establishing the critical importance of these skills in achieving professional success and personal well-being. The curriculum is structured around the core principles of behavior, breaking it down into Knowledge, Skill, and Attitude (KSA), with a special focus on cultivating a constructive attitude. Participants will engage with powerful psychological tools to foster self-development. The Johari Window model is introduced to help learners enhance their self-awareness by exploring how they perceive themselves and how they are perceived by others. Furthermore, the course provides a detailed walkthrough of Transactional Analysis, explaining the Parent, Adult, and Child ego states to enable a deeper understanding of communication dynamics. Through practical examples and exercises, learners will acquire actionable strategies for improving active listening, assertiveness, empathy, and building genuine rapport, ultimately empowering them to navigate workplace relationships with greater confidence and create a more productive and harmonious environment.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Level-III Training Programme to Develop Domain Competencies
desc: This training program is designed to equip personal staff, including Personal Assistants and Private Secretaries, with the core competencies required for excelling in a government office environment. The curriculum provides a detailed, procedural guide to managing official meetings effectively. You will learn the crucial steps involved before, during, and after a meeting, covering everything from scheduling and venue selection to the preparation of comprehensive agenda folders and the accurate drafting of minutes. Beyond these procedural skills, the course delves into the nuances of the professional relationship between a secretary and their boss. It explores various personality types of superiors and provides practical strategies for fostering a productive, respectful, and efficient partnership. By the end of this course, learners will be better prepared to manage their administrative responsibilities with confidence and navigate interpersonal dynamics to become an invaluable asset to their team and organization.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Level-III Training Programme to Develop Functional Competencies
desc: This foundational course offers a holistic overview of the procedural and regulatory landscape of government functioning. It is structured to build the core skills necessary for every official to navigate the administrative system with confidence and integrity. The program begins with the fundamentals of office procedure, covering the lifecycle of government files from 'Dak' and receipt management to systematic records retention and the transition to e-Office. It then moves to the crucial communication skills of noting and drafting, providing principles and guidelines for creating clear, concise, and effective official documents. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to service rules, offering detailed modules on the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, to instill a sense of propriety and discipline. It also provides practical guidance on handling matters related to CCS (Leave) Rules, Travelling Allowance (TA) Rules, and the calculation of pensionary benefits, which are vital for managing personal and official entitlements. To foster transparency and accountability, the course includes an in-depth module on the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005. By completing this program, learners will be well-versed in the rules and procedures that form the backbone of government administration, enabling them to perform their duties effectively and uphold the principles of good governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Leveraging AI for Security: The case of ASTR
desc: The ASTR case highlights the administrative and ethical challenges of using AI-based facial recognition technology for governance, addressing issues like terrorism in J&K and cybercrime in Mewat, Haryana, through the identification of fake SIM cards.

title: Leveraging Digital and Social Media for Public Service Delivery
desc: In today's digital-first world, mastering online communication is essential for effective outreach and service delivery. This course provides a deep dive into the principles and practices of digital and social media marketing. You will begin by learning how to build a solid strategic foundation, including defining target audiences through buyer personas and visualizing their experience with customer journey mapping. The course then explores the two main pillars of digital marketing: organic and inorganic approaches. You will discover how to create valuable, relevant content that builds long-term trust and engagement. Simultaneously, you will learn to leverage paid strategies like pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, social media promotions, and influencer marketing for immediate visibility and lead generation. A significant focus is placed on the growing role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in marketing, demonstrating how AI-powered tools can be used for precision targeting, content personalization, and automating campaign workflows. By the end of this course, you will be able to design, implement, and evaluate integrated, customer-centric digital strategies that enhance visibility, foster community, and drive meaningful outcomes.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Leveraging Parallel Intelligence for Smart Governance
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, leveraging technology is crucial for effective public administration. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Parallel Intelligence, the synergistic collaboration between Artificial Intelligence (AI) and human intellect in governance. It addresses the critical need for public service professionals to understand and apply AI to enhance efficiency and service delivery. The curriculum delves into the core principles of Parallel Intelligence, demonstrating how AI automates repetitive processes, enabling officials to focus on high-value strategic work, policy design, and complex problem-solving. Through detailed case studies of flagship Indian programs such as Aadhaar, PM-KISAN, DigiLocker, and the Smart Cities Mission, learners will explore practical applications of AI. The course also covers essential topics including ethical AI, data privacy under the Data Protection Act 2023, and strategies for successful technology adoption. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to identify opportunities for AI integration, navigate implementation challenges, and contribute to building a more transparent, responsive, and citizen-centric governance framework for a Viksit Bharat.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Leveraging Technology in Analytics
desc: Dive into the architecture and implementation of FINnet 2.0, a landmark project in leveraging technology for national financial security. This course details the strategic shift from FINnet 1.0, addressing its challenges through the adoption of cutting-edge analytics. You will learn about the core components of the system, including its three main portals for data collection (Fingate), analysis (Fincore), and dissemination (Finex). The curriculum covers key functionalities such as dynamic risk modeling, automated entity and relationship resolution, API-based integration with external data sources, and the use of AI for geo-tagging and case dissemination. Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of how a technology-driven framework can transform financial intelligence operations, improve compliance monitoring, and strengthen collaboration with law enforcement agencies to effectively counter evolving financial threats like money laundering and terrorist financing.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Lifestyle for Environment - LiFE Prarambh Module
desc: This course introduces the 'Lifestyle for Environment' (LiFE) initiative, a global mass movement conceptualized to address the urgent challenges of environmental degradation and climate change. It explains the context behind Mission LiFE, launched at COP26, which advocates for mindful and deliberate utilization of resources over mindless consumption. The curriculum is structured around seven key themes: saving energy, saving water, avoiding single-use plastics, adopting sustainable food systems, reducing waste, minimizing e-waste, and embracing a healthy lifestyle. For each theme, the course presents a series of simple, actionable steps that individuals can integrate into their daily lives. By completing this module, learners will not only understand the principles of an environmentally conscious lifestyle but will also be equipped to act as role models and ambassadors for sustainability, contributing to a collective effort for a healthier planet.

title: Lifting and stabilization-Disaster Response Training
desc: In the chaotic aftermath of a disaster, the ability to safely move debris and rescue victims is paramount. This course is designed to equip volunteers and first responders with the fundamental knowledge and skills for effective lifting and stabilization. You will explore the core principles of mechanical advantage using levers and learn the systematic process of cribbing to secure unstable loads, preventing further injury or collapse. The course provides a detailed breakdown of various patient-moving techniques suitable for both emergency and non-emergency contexts, highlighting the importance of procedural correctness to ensure the well-being of both the rescuer and the victim. By completing this training, you will be prepared to act confidently and competently, making a significant contribution to rescue operations during critical incidents.

title: Lifting and stabilization-Disaster Response Training
desc: In the chaotic aftermath of a disaster, the ability to act effectively can save lives. This course is designed to equip volunteers and first responders with the fundamental skills required for safe and efficient rescue operations. It provides a detailed overview of the principles behind lifting heavy objects and stabilizing structures, which are critical tasks in urban search and rescue scenarios. The curriculum delves into the mechanics of levers and the practical application of cribbing for load stabilization. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the crucial role volunteers play and elaborates on a range of patient-moving techniques suitable for both emergency and non-emergency contexts. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to assist in disaster situations, applying correct procedures to move debris and transport victims without causing further injury.

title: Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) Enroute Troubleshooting
desc: This course provides essential technical knowledge for maintaining the operational integrity and safety of Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) coaches, a cornerstone of the Indian Railways passenger fleet. The curriculum is structured to address the most frequent and critical problems that can occur during transit. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the brake binding phenomenon, from diagnosis to the correct sequence of resolution procedures. It covers the functionality of the Passenger Emergency Alarm Signal Device, ensuring personnel can respond effectively in emergencies. Furthermore, the course details procedures for bypassing BP or FP systems and isolating air spring suspensions, which are critical skills for preventing service disruptions. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to perform en-route troubleshooting confidently, minimizing delays and upholding the highest standards of passenger safety in train operations.

title: Listing on Social Stock Exchange
