desc: The emergence of Social Stock Exchanges (SSEs) in India marks a significant evolution in the landscape of social finance. This course, 'A Guide to Listing on the Social Stock Exchange,' is specifically designed to equip social impact organisations with the necessary knowledge to navigate this new avenue for capital. It addresses the critical need for NPOs and FPEs to understand the framework governing SSEs, which is essential for unlocking social investment and achieving greater operational scale. The curriculum provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the entire listing journey. Key learning areas include understanding the eligibility criteria for different types of social enterprises, the mechanics of fundraising instruments like Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) bonds, and the detailed disclosure and reporting standards mandated by SEBI. By completing this course, participants will be prepared to confidently approach the listing process, ensuring regulatory compliance while positioning their organisation to attract investors and amplify their social mission.

title: LITHIUM FROM EARTH TO ELECTRIC VEHICLES
desc: Embark on an in-depth educational journey to understand the significance of lithium in our rapidly evolving world. This course is meticulously structured to guide you through the complete lifecycle of lithium, from its formation within the Earth's crust to its application in cutting-edge technologies. You will begin by exploring the historical context of lithium's discovery and the geopolitical events that catalyzed its demand. The course then delves into the scientific core, examining the complex geochemistry, mineralogy, and the various types of geological deposits where lithium is found, including pegmatites, brines, and clays. A significant focus is placed on the global distribution of these resources, with a special emphasis on India's emerging potential and its strategic importance for energy independence. Finally, the course connects this geological knowledge to the modern economy, analyzing the escalating demand for lithium in rechargeable batteries, electric vehicles, and other industries. Upon completion, you will have a robust understanding of the lithium value chain and its pivotal role in shaping a sustainable future.

title: Litigation Matters under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006
desc: This course introduces the fundamental legal and procedural aspects of litigation under the Food Safety and Standards Act (FSS Act), 2006. It provides a comprehensive understanding of the legislative framework governing food safety in India, along with the roles and responsibilities of regulatory and enforcement authorities. The course outlines the complete enforcement lifecycle, from inspection and investigation to adjudication and court proceedings, enabling learners to understand how food safety violations are identified, documented, and prosecuted. It also highlights procedural safeguards, principles of natural justice, and compliance requirements that ensure fair and lawful enforcement. Designed for legal officers, enforcement personnel, and administrative officials, the course equips participants with the knowledge and skills required to effectively manage litigation processes under the FSS Act while ensuring regulatory compliance and procedural integrity.

title: Lockout Tagout (LOTO) safety procedure
desc: This course delves into the critical safety protocol of Lockout-Tagout (LOTO), a vital procedure for ensuring workplace safety in industrial and operational environments. The content is structured to provide a thorough understanding of why LOTO is necessary, explaining how it prevents severe injuries by isolating machinery from its energy sources. Learners will be guided through the key procedural steps, from preparation and shutdown to the application of lockout devices and the verification of isolation. The course highlights the importance of LOTO in protecting employees who service and maintain equipment, preventing unexpected energization or the release of stored energy. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to recognize hazardous energy sources, understand the specific requirements for LOTO application, and appreciate its role in creating a secure and compliant work environment, ultimately contributing to a culture of safety and operational excellence.

title: Lockout Tagout (LOTO) safety procedure (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम औद्योगिक सेटिंग्स में एक महत्वपूर्ण सुरक्षा प्रक्रिया, लॉकआउट-टैगआउट (LOTO) पर विस्तृत मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इसका उद्देश्य श्रमिकों को मशीनों और उपकरणों की सर्विसिंग और रखरखाव के दौरान खतरनाक ऊर्जा के निकलने से बचाना है। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि LOTO प्रक्रिया आकस्मिक मशीन स्टार्टअप को रोककर और यह सुनिश्चित करके जीवन कैसे बचाती है कि सर्विसिंग से पहले सभी ऊर्जा स्रोतों को प्रभावी ढंग से अलग और निष्क्रिय कर दिया गया है। शिक्षार्थी ऊर्जा नियंत्रण प्रक्रियाओं के प्रमुख तत्वों, ऊर्जा-पृथक्करण उपकरणों के उचित उपयोग और शून्य-ऊर्जा स्थिति को सत्यापित करने के चरणों का पता लगाएंगे। यह ज्ञान उन सभी कर्मियों के लिए आवश्यक है जो औद्योगिक मशीनरी के साथ या उसके आसपास काम करते हैं, जिससे सुरक्षा नियमों का अनुपालन और कार्यस्थल पर दुर्घटनाओं की रोकथाम सुनिश्चित होती है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने से शिक्षार्थी अपने कार्य क्षेत्रों में LOTO प्रक्रियाओं को आत्मविश्वास से लागू करने और एक सुरक्षित कार्य संस्कृति में योगदान करने में सक्षम होंगे।

title: Long Haul Train Operations
desc: Gain a comprehensive understanding of the complexities involved in long-haul train operations. This course is designed for railway professionals seeking to enhance their knowledge of specialized freight services. The curriculum delves into the critical aspects of managing crack trains—high-priority freight services that are fundamental to improving the efficiency of the entire railway network. You will explore the detailed nomenclature and formation of these trains, alongside the stringent safety protocols that govern their operation. Key learning areas include crew responsibilities, procedures for handling operational abnormalities, and strategies for optimizing the use of rolling stock and personnel. Upon completion, you will be equipped to contribute to safer, more punctual, and highly efficient freight operations, directly impacting the logistical performance and economic viability of railway services.

title: Long Welded Rails: The Backbone of Modern Tracks
desc: This course delves into the principles and applications of Long Welded Rails (LWRs), a critical technology that serves as the backbone of modern railway infrastructure. In the context of expanding high-speed, metro, and freight networks, understanding LWR technology is paramount for ensuring safety, reliability, and efficiency. The course begins by explaining the fundamental concept of LWRs, contrasting them with traditional short rails joined by fishplates, and highlighting the inherent weaknesses of jointed tracks, such as increased wear, maintenance costs, and safety risks like rail fractures. Learners will explore the key benefits of implementing LWRs, including reduced maintenance, enhanced passenger comfort due to a smoother ride, and substantial improvements in overall track stability and safety. The content examines the specific challenges associated with LWRs, such as managing thermal expansion and contraction, and the specialized techniques required for their installation and upkeep. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the importance of LWRs in various railway systems, from urban metros to national freight corridors. They will gain the ability to analyze the technical and operational advantages of this technology and appreciate its contribution to the future development of sustainable and efficient rail transport systems. This knowledge is vital for engineers, planners, and maintenance personnel in the railway sector.

title: Low Carbon Development: Planning and Modelling
desc: This in-depth course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the knowledge and tools necessary for effective low-carbon development planning. It begins by establishing the scientific context of climate change, detailing its impacts on development, and outlining the global imperative for mitigation and adaptation. The core of the course is a detailed exploration of the Energy Forecasting Framework and Emissions Consensus Tool (EFFECT), an open and transparent model designed to analyze and compare greenhouse gas emission growth across various development scenarios. Participants will learn how to apply the EFFECT model to key economic sectors, including power, transport, industry, and household energy use, to identify and prioritize emission reduction strategies. The course emphasizes a practical, hands-on approach to scenario building, data collection, and the interpretation of modeling results. By the end of this program, learners will be able to construct robust reference and low-carbon scenarios, evaluate the economic and environmental costs and benefits of different interventions, and formulate actionable strategies to support their country's transition to a sustainable, low-carbon economy. The curriculum is structured to build capacity for holistic, cross-sectoral thinking, enabling officials to make informed decisions that balance development goals with climate responsibilities.

title: Lower Backache and its prevention
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of lower back health, designed for individuals seeking to prevent or manage common back ailments. The curriculum begins by detailing the anatomy of the vertebral column, explaining the function of vertebrae, discs, and natural spinal curves. It then delves into the causes and types of back disorders, such as lumbar spondylosis and protruded intervertebral discs (PIVD), highlighting the detrimental effects of incorrect posture.A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical application and prevention. Through clear demonstrations, learners will understand the principles of ergonomics and how to maintain correct sitting postures, both with and without supportive equipment like an ergonomic chair. The course culminates in a guided session of seven essential physiotherapy exercises. These exercises are designed to be performed at home to build back strength, increase flexibility, and reduce the risk of chronic pain. By completing this course, learners will gain the knowledge and practical skills necessary to take proactive steps towards maintaining a healthy, pain-free back, which is particularly beneficial for those in sedentary or physically demanding roles."

title: Macroeconomics for Economists
desc: Delve into the core principles that drive modern macroeconomic analysis. This course, 'Microeconomic Foundations of Modern Macroeconomics,' moves beyond traditional aggregate approaches to explain how macroeconomic outcomes emerge from individual-level decisions. You will begin by exploring a static, one-period model to understand labor market dynamics, including the trade-offs between work and leisure and the impact of wages and taxes. The course then progresses to dynamic, intertemporal setups, examining how households make consumption and savings decisions over time and how these choices are influenced by interest rates and fiscal policies, such as government spending and debt, through the concept of Ricardian equivalence. Further modules will illuminate the transmission mechanisms of monetary policy and extend the analysis to a small open-economy context, clarifying the determinants of the current account balance. Upon completion, you will be equipped with a robust theoretical framework to analyze and interpret complex macroeconomic policies and their real-world implications from a micro-founded perspective.

title: Magazine Post
desc: This program offers an in-depth guide to the Magazine Post service, a dedicated logistics solution for magazine distribution in India. The course begins by outlining the service's primary objectives, including providing a reliable delivery system and enhancing tracking capabilities for both senders and recipients. You will learn the specific definition of a 'magazine' as per postal regulations and the mandatory criteria for registration, such as possessing a certificate from the Press Registrar General of India and maintaining a minimum subscriber list. The curriculum covers the entire operational lifecycle, from the initial application and renewal process to the detailed booking procedures, including barcode specifications and subscriber data requirements. Furthermore, the course explains the different payment mechanisms available, such as the advance payment and credit facility (BNPL) options, along with the associated billing and penalty structures. Upon completion, learners will be fully equipped to navigate the Magazine Post system, ensuring compliance and leveraging its features for efficient nationwide distribution.

title: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited: Powering India's Growth
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL) and its pivotal role in India's energy landscape and overall national development. As a Mini Ratna subsidiary of Coal India Ltd., MCL's operations are critical to meeting the country's power generation needs. This program provides the necessary context by discussing India's energy statistics and the continuing importance of coal within the national energy mix. Learners will delve into the specifics of MCL's corporate structure, operational performance, and financial information, enabling them to assess its efficiency and strategic value. The course covers key achievements in production, infrastructure development, including vital road and railway facilities for coal transport, and significant green initiatives. Furthermore, it highlights MCL's extensive Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs and their impact on community development and employment generation. Upon completion, participants will have a holistic understanding of how a major public sector undertaking like MCL balances economic objectives with social and environmental responsibilities to power India's growth.

title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate in Post Offices-English
desc: This e-learning course is specifically developed for Postal Assistants, Supervisors, and other staff within the Department of Posts to facilitate the successful implementation of the Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC) scheme. The MSSC is a significant government initiative aimed at empowering women by encouraging savings and providing them with a secure investment option. This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the entire lifecycle of an MSSC account. Key learning areas include a thorough explanation of the scheme's features, eligibility for opening an account, deposit limits, interest calculation, and conditions for withdrawal and premature closure. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the step-by-step operational workflow within the Finacle software, covering both account opening and closure processes. Upon completion, postal employees will be fully equipped to handle customer transactions accurately, provide clear information to the public, and contribute effectively to this national mission of women's financial inclusion.

title: Mail Guard - Prarambh
desc: This comprehensive introductory program is designed to equip newly appointed Mail Guards with the fundamental knowledge and skills required for a successful career in the Department of Posts. The course delves into the core operational aspects of the Railway Mail Service (RMS), providing a detailed overview of a Mail Guard's duties, from receiving and sorting mail bags to ensuring their secure and timely dispatch. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the departmental hierarchy, the different types of mail offices, and the critical role they play in India's vast postal network. The curriculum explores essential topics such as the use of the India Post Visibility System (IPVS) for tracking and managing mail, the significance of the Citizen's Charter in maintaining service standards, and the various products and services offered by India Post. Additionally, the course touches upon important behavioural aspects like work ethics, punctuality, and teamwork, which are vital for public service. By the end of this training, participants will be fully prepared to handle their responsibilities with confidence, contributing effectively to the department's mission of providing reliable and customer-centric postal services.

title: MAIL MANAGEMENT (PRARAMBH)
desc: This course, 'Fundamentals of Mail Management for Postal Employees', serves as an essential guide to the core operational activities of the Department of Posts. It establishes the context of mail management as a critical function for both communication and commerce, serving millions of retail and corporate customers. The curriculum systematically covers the entire mail flow, including the receipt of bags, processing of articles, sorting, and delivery procedures. Key learning areas include a detailed exploration of mail irregularities and the standardized actions required to resolve them, the structure and strategic use of the PIN code system for accurate sorting, and the correct application of taxation rules for unpaid or insufficiently paid articles. Furthermore, the course explains procedures for handling undelivered articles, the role of the Returned Letter Office (RLO), and the calculation of volumetric weight for parcels. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the procedural knowledge to ensure mail is processed swiftly, securely, and accurately, enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

title: Mail Monitoring Units (MMUs English)
desc: This program is designed to enhance the understanding and effectiveness of monitoring mail and parcel operations across the Department of Posts. It delves into the reasons for establishing Mail Monitoring Units (MMUs), focusing on the need to meet the expectations of new-age customers and improve service quality. The course provides a detailed walkthrough of the three key stages of postal operations: first-mile (booking), middle-mile (processing and transmission), and last-mile (delivery). Participants will learn to utilize a suite of digital tools, including the MMU Dashboard, Tech Operations Reports, CEPT MIS, and SAP's BI tool, to monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and analyze operational data. By understanding the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and reporting mechanisms, learners will be empowered to identify bottlenecks, take corrective measures, and contribute to achieving higher delivery efficiency and accountability within India Post.

title: Mail Monitoring Units (MMUs)
desc: This program is designed to enhance the effectiveness of monitoring mail and parcel operations across all levels of the Department of Posts. It provides a detailed framework for understanding the critical role of Mail Monitoring Units (MMUs) in improving service quality and customer trust. The course begins by establishing the context for MMUs, highlighting the need for better consignment visibility and accountability in a competitive logistics market. Participants will delve into the three core stages of mail operations: booking, processing and transmission, and last-mile delivery. You will learn to utilize a suite of digital tools, including the MMU Dashboard, Tech Operations Reports, CEPT MIS, and SAP's BI tool, to track performance, analyze data, and generate actionable insights. The curriculum covers the specific SOPs, reporting formats, and KPIs essential for effective monitoring. By the end of this course, officials will be equipped to proactively identify issues, guide field staff, and drive continuous improvement in mail delivery efficiency, ensuring India Post remains a preferred choice for customers.

title: Mail Overseer - Dakshta
desc: This course is designed to equip Mail Overseers with the essential knowledge and skills required to effectively manage their responsibilities within the Department of Posts. The curriculum provides a detailed exploration of the Mail Overseer's role, as defined in the Postal Manual, covering the supervision of mail lines, branch offices, and rural postal workers. Learners will delve into the intricacies of mail-related duties, including the handling of accountable articles like registered post, VP, and insured items. The course also offers in-depth modules on financial responsibilities, such as managing cash remittances, verifying savings bank and insurance transactions (PLI/RPLI), and ensuring proper accounting procedures at the branch office level. Participants will learn about the wide array of India Post's products and services and their role in promoting them to enhance business development. Furthermore, the course addresses the use of modern tools like the DARPAN device for digital operations and troubleshooting common field-level issues. By the end of this course, Mail Overseers will be proficient in their day-to-day activities, capable of ensuring operational integrity, and prepared to uphold the service standards of India Post.

title: Mail Products and Services : India Post
desc: India Post has been the backbone of the country's communication for over a century. Understanding its core offerings is fundamental for many government employees whose work involves official correspondence, logistics, and citizen services. This course provides a detailed exploration of the traditional mail products and services that form the foundation of India Post's operations. Participants will gain in-depth knowledge of various mail products, such as ordinary post, registered mail, speed post, and parcel services. The course will cover the specific features, booking procedures, delivery standards, and pricing structures for each service. It will also touch upon value-added services like insurance and acknowledgment of delivery, explaining how they enhance the reliability and security of mail transmission. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently identify and select the appropriate postal service for different official and public needs. This will enable them to manage government correspondence more efficiently, advise citizens on postal services, and appreciate the logistical capabilities of the national postal network.

title: Mainstreaming renewable energy: The case of Rewa Solar Rooftop
desc: The Madhya Pradesh solar rooftop installation case demonstrates how Mr. Manu Srivastva addressed low uptake by de-risking the project, mitigating risks, ensuring transparency, and innovating financing models to meet the state's solar energy production targets under the National Solar Mission.

title: Mainstreaming Social Inclusion in DAY-NRLM
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices for achieving social inclusion under the DAY-NRLM framework. It is designed for mission functionaries to effectively implement strategies that support India's most vulnerable populations. The curriculum is structured across key modules, beginning with the foundational concepts of poverty, vulnerability, and social exclusion. It then delves into specific protocols and interventions for including the elderly, persons with disabilities (PwDs), women in distress, and tribal communities, detailing the formation of special Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and the application of customized norms. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the role of convergence, explaining how to integrate DAY-NRLM activities with other government departments and schemes to provide holistic support. Finally, learners will understand the mechanisms of financial inclusion and livelihood promotion, including the management of the Vulnerability Reduction Fund (VRF) and Community Investment Fund (CIF) to foster economic independence. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to drive inclusive development at the grassroots level, ensuring that the benefits of the mission reach every eligible household.
org: NIRDPR National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj

title: Maintenance and Repair of Flexible Pavements
desc: This course equips participants with the knowledge and practical skills required to identify, diagnose, and address common distresses in flexible pavements. It covers various types of pavement distress, including cracking, rutting, ravelling, and potholes, along with their underlying causes related to traffic loading, material characteristics, drainage conditions, and construction practices. The course introduces methods for visual inspection, basic field measurements, and condition assessment techniques used in pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning. Participants will also gain an understanding of suitable repair and maintenance treatments such as crack sealing, patching, and overlays, with emphasis on improving pavement performance, durability, ride quality, and lifecycle cost efficiency.
org: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

title: Maintenance Block, Types and Rolling Block
desc: Gain a foundational understanding of the essential maintenance practices that keep the Indian Railways network safe and reliable. This course delves into the procedural framework of 'block maintenance,' a critical process where sections of the railway are temporarily closed for upkeep. You will learn why this is vital for a high-density network, addressing wear and tear on tracks, signaling systems, and overhead equipment. The curriculum covers the key types of maintenance blocks, the meticulous planning and inter-departmental coordination required, and the step-by-step process for obtaining and executing a 'line block.' Furthermore, the course introduces the 'Rolling Block Programme,' a modern, progressive approach to maintenance that balances infrastructure health with the need to minimize train disruptions. You will also explore the common challenges faced, such as operational constraints and aging infrastructure, and the technological advancements being adopted to overcome them. This course is essential for personnel involved in railway operations and engineering, providing the knowledge to contribute to a safer and more efficient rail system.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Maintenance of Coaching Trains
desc: This course provides essential knowledge for professionals involved in the upkeep of Indian Railways' coaching stock. It establishes the context of why systematic maintenance is critical for national rail operations, focusing on passenger safety and service reliability. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of maintenance schedules for different train services, from Mail/Express to high-speed Vande Bharat trains, and specific procedures for ICF and LHB coaches. The course explores the distinct functions of primary and terminal maintenance depots, covering critical activities like inspection, cleaning, and component checks. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply best practices in maintenance planning and execution, contributing directly to the operational integrity of the railway network and enhancing overall passenger satisfaction.

title: Maintenance of Land and Building Assets
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the strategic management of land and building assets within a public sector context. It addresses the critical need for government entities to generate value from underutilized properties in a transparent and efficient manner. Learners will begin by understanding the Comprehensive Renting-Out Policy (CROP-2020), detailing the guidelines for identifying vacant spaces, assessing fair market rent, and managing lease agreements. The course then delves into the BSNL Monetization Policy, outlining the robust process for the outright sale or transfer of assets, including the roles of various oversight committees and transaction advisors. A significant portion is dedicated to the CPWD Works Manual, which provides standard procedures for the planning, execution, and maintenance of construction projects, ensuring quality and uniformity. Finally, the course introduces the SAP Real Estate Management (REM) module, demonstrating how to digitally manage property portfolios, from leasing and staff quarter allotment to booking inspection quarters. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in applying these frameworks to maximize revenue, maintain assets effectively, and adhere to established governance standards for public property.

title: Maintenance of SMPS Power Plant
desc: In the telecommunications sector, uninterrupted power is non-negotiable. SMPS power plants are the backbone of this reliability, converting AC mains to the stable -48V DC required by sensitive telecom equipment. This course is designed for technical personnel responsible for ensuring the operational integrity of this critical infrastructure. Participants will gain a deep understanding of SMPS technology, from its fundamental principles of high-frequency switching regulation to its practical application. The course details the architecture of a typical power plant, including rectifier modules, control and monitoring units, input/output protections like LVDs, and battery connectivity. It covers the different operational modes such as float, charge, and boost charging. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to a systematic approach to preventive maintenance. Learners will be equipped with a detailed checklist for routine inspections, fault diagnosis, and parameter setting. Upon completion, participants will be able to effectively maintain, troubleshoot, and configure SMPS power plants, minimizing downtime and extending the life of both the power system and the connected telecom equipment, directly contributing to network resilience and service continuity.

title: Major Risks Covered Under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
desc: This course is designed to strengthen the practical understanding of government officials and stakeholders involved in implementing the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). It provides a comprehensive exploration of the full spectrum of risk coverage offered under the scheme, from sowing to post-harvest stages. Key learning areas include in-depth analysis of Prevented Sowing, Mid-Season Adversity, Localized Calamities, Post-Harvest Losses, and widespread calamities assessed through the Area Yield Index. These concepts are reinforced with real-life scenarios and case studies to ensure practical clarity. The course also highlights the critical role of technology in modernizing PMFBY. Learners will be guided on utilizing tools such as the Crop Insurance App, the 14447 toll-free helpline, NCIP, remote sensing applications, and YES-TECH. This knowledge will empower them to facilitate better farmer support, ensure timely reporting of losses, and strengthen the on-ground implementation of PMFBY processes, ultimately leading to more effective risk management in agriculture.
org: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana PMFBY

title: MAKE IN INDIA DEFENCE PORTAL
desc: Delve into the strategic imperatives of India's defence sector with this essential course on the 'Make in India' initiative. This program is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the policies and reforms aimed at achieving self-reliance in defence production. You will explore the context behind this national mission, examining why indigenous manufacturing is critical for technological advancement and national security. The course breaks down the defence production ecosystem, detailing the functions of key organizations like DPSUs and the increasing participation of private companies. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP), understand application processes, and grasp the regulatory guidelines that govern the sector. By the end of this course, you will have a clear perspective on India's defence modernization journey and be better prepared to contribute to its success.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Make in India Defence Portal: An Introduction
desc: Delve into the strategic imperatives of India's defence sector with this essential course on the 'Make in India' initiative. This program is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the policies and reforms aimed at achieving self-reliance in defence production. You will explore the context behind this national mission, examining why indigenous manufacturing is critical for technological advancement and national security. The course breaks down the defence production ecosystem, detailing the functions of key organizations like DPSUs and the increasing participation of private companies. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP), understand application processes, and grasp the regulatory guidelines that govern the sector. By the end of this course, you will have a clear perspective on India's defence modernization journey and be better prepared to contribute to its success.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Make in India in Railways: PPP-MII Policy and Procurement Guidelines
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017, and its strategic implementation in Indian Railways. The curriculum is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the policy's framework, from its legal basis under the General Financial Rules to its practical application in goods, services, and PPP contracts. Participants will explore the core objectives of promoting domestic manufacturing, boosting employment, and fostering self-reliance. The course highlights the policy's tangible successes, evidenced by increased FDI, improved Ease of Doing Business rankings, and landmark projects like the Vande Bharat trains and INS Vikrant. By analyzing key circulars and guidelines, learners will be equipped to navigate the procurement landscape, understand eligibility and preference criteria, and appreciate the transformative role of 'Make in India' in strengthening the nation's industrial and economic base.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Making Decisions
desc: In today's complex and fast-paced work environment, the ability to make effective decisions is a critical skill for every professional, particularly in the public sector where outcomes can have a significant societal impact. This course is designed to equip learners with the strategies and tools needed to navigate ambiguity and make rational, evidence-based choices. The curriculum begins by establishing a foundational understanding of the decision-making process, covering how to define problems, identify and weigh criteria, and generate alternatives. It then introduces a suite of practical tools, including the Action Priority Matrix, SWOT analysis, Cost-Benefit Analysis, and Decision Trees, to help structure and clarify complex choices. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the psychological aspects of decision-making. Learners will explore System 1 and System 2 thinking, identify common cognitive biases such as confirmation and anchoring bias, and understand the dynamics of groupthink. By mastering these concepts, participants will be able to improve their judgment, make more objective assessments, and effectively communicate the rationale and implications of their decisions to stakeholders, ultimately fostering a culture of accountability and sound governance.

title: Making of Topiary
desc: Embark on a journey into the artistic world of topiary and learn to shape nature into stunning designs. This course provides a comprehensive guide for beginners, detailing the significance of topiary in modern and traditional landscaping. You will learn to identify the necessary tools, from pruning shears to wire frames, and select appropriate plant varieties that respond well to training and trimming. The course breaks down the entire creation process, starting with the preparation of a reinforced base for stability, followed by step-by-step instructions on framing, planting, and shaping. Key learning areas include plant selection, structural preparation with chicken wire and RCC, and the ongoing maintenance required to preserve the topiary's form. By completing this course, you will gain the practical skills and confidence to design, create, and maintain beautiful topiary sculptures, adding a unique and elegant touch to any green space.

title: Management Fundamentals in Government Services
desc: Effective management is a cornerstone of efficient and responsive public administration. This course, 'Management Fundamentals in Government Services,' is specifically designed to introduce government employees to the core theories and practices of management that are critical for success in the public sector. It addresses the unique challenges and opportunities present in a government environment, moving beyond generic management theories to provide contextually relevant insights. Learners will delve into key areas including strategic planning, organizational structuring, effective leadership, and performance measurement. The curriculum covers essential topics such as resource management, decision-making processes, process excellence, and fostering a culture of accountability and service orientation. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to apply these management principles to their daily work, leading to improved team performance, streamlined operations, and enhanced public service delivery. This course serves as an essential building block for officials aiming to grow as effective managers and leaders within the government framework.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Management Information System Portal Management Under PMAY
desc: This course provides a practical introduction to the Management Information System (MIS) portal used under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana–Urban (PMAY-U) mission. Designed for Urban Local Body (ULB) officials and other implementing personnel, it covers the end-to-end workflow of beneficiary and project management on the portal. Learners will gain hands-on knowledge of beneficiary registration, application verification, project data entry, progress monitoring, geo-tagging, and report generation across various PMAY-U verticals such as Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC) and Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP). The course emphasizes accurate data management, transparency, and compliance, enabling officials to maintain data integrity, support effective project implementation, and enhance monitoring and decision-making for achieving the objectives of the Housing for All mission.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Management of Serious Accident in Indian Railways
desc: The Handling of Serious Accidents course provides a comprehensive understanding of the procedures for managing serious railway accidents. It covers the roles and responsibilities of the Accident Relief Train (ART) and Accident Relief Medical Equipment (ARME) during emergency situations, highlighting the importance of rapid response, effective coordination, and timely decision-making. The course emphasizes preparedness through regular mock drills and readiness measures, ensuring that personnel can respond efficiently during emergencies. Learners will also gain insights into the priority movement of relief trains, established communication protocols, passenger and crew safety standards, and operational best practices for rescue, relief, restoration, and accident management. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge and skills required to support safe, coordinated, and effective handling of serious railway accidents.

title: Managing and Leading Teams
desc: Unlock the potential of your team with this comprehensive course on team management and leadership. Designed for public sector professionals, this program delves into the core competencies required for successful collaboration and high performance. You will learn to navigate the natural stages of team development, applying models like Tuckman's framework to guide your team from initial formation to a cohesive, performing unit. The course provides practical tools for personal and team growth, including the Johari Window to build self-awareness and trust, and the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) to leverage diverse personality traits for collective success. Furthermore, you will analyze the critical relationship between team happiness and productivity, and learn to diagnose and resolve the five key dysfunctions that can derail a team, as outlined by Patrick Lencioni. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the skills to provide constructive feedback, delegate effectively, and develop your subordinates, transforming your team into a motivated, committed, and results-oriented powerhouse.

title: Managing Change: Implementing Responsible Data Management
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, the ability to manage data responsibly is a critical competency for any public or social impact organization. This course provides a comprehensive guide to implementing robust and ethical data management systems. You will begin by understanding the core concepts of responsible data, including the data lifecycle, data governance, and the principles of privacy and security. The course delves into practical strategies for assessing your organization's data maturity and developing a strategic roadmap for change. You will learn how to create and implement effective data policies, manage stakeholder buy-in, and mitigate common risks associated with data handling. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to lead the transition to responsible data practices, building trust with citizens and stakeholders while enhancing your organization's operational excellence and legal compliance.

title: Managing Contracts and Procurement
desc: This course is designed to equip senior government officials with the essential knowledge and skills for effective management of contracts and procurement. The curriculum begins with the core concepts of public procurement, its distinction from private procurement, and the guiding principles that ensure transparency and fairness. Learners will explore a variety of procurement models, analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of fixed-fee, time and material, and cost-reimbursable contracts to determine their suitability for different project types, particularly in the context of digital and e-governance initiatives. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical aspects of the procurement lifecycle, from issuing a Request for Information (RFI) to evaluating bids and managing vendors. The session also covers the critical role of Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in defining outcomes and ensuring performance, the nuances of Public-Private Partnership (PPP) projects, and key contractual terms. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to navigate the complexities of public procurement, mitigate risks, and ensure value for public money.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Managing Floods and Droughts
desc: Floods and droughts are recurring natural disasters with severe socio-economic and environmental consequences. Effective management is crucial for ensuring water security, protecting livelihoods, and building climate-resilient infrastructure. This course is designed for public sector professionals involved in water resources, disaster management, and planning, providing them with the essential knowledge to address these challenges systematically. The curriculum is structured across six modules, beginning with the fundamental science behind floods and droughts. It delves into the primary causes, both natural and anthropogenic, and analyzes their wide-ranging impacts on communities, agriculture, and the economy. Learners will be introduced to various monitoring tools and early warning systems. The course emphasizes practical management strategies, covering both structural measures like dams and reservoirs, and non-structural approaches such as floodplain zoning, policy formulation, and community-based preparedness. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to identify and analyze the risks associated with floods and droughts in their respective regions. They will be able to contribute to the development and implementation of effective mitigation and response plans, aligning with national initiatives for disaster risk reduction and water resource management. This course serves as a critical step towards building a skilled workforce capable of managing water-related disasters proactively.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: National Water Academy Central Water Commission Pune

title: Managing Personal Relationships
desc: In our interconnected lives, personal well-being is a cornerstone of professional success. This course delves into the essential skills required to build and sustain healthy personal relationships. It provides a framework for understanding the common pitfalls in communication and offers strategies to foster harmony and mutual respect. The content explores the subtle dynamics of ego and emotion in relationships, providing practical advice on how to navigate disagreements constructively without causing guilt or resentment. Participants will learn to look inward, recognizing how their own mindset contributes to creating either happiness or sorrow. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with valuable insights to enhance their emotional intelligence, improve their interpersonal skills, and cultivate lasting peace and stability in their personal lives, creating a positive ripple effect in all life domains.

title: Managing Power and Politics and Conflict for Effective Leadership
desc: In any professional environment, understanding the dynamics of power, politics, and conflict is crucial for effective leadership. This course offers a comprehensive exploration of these critical elements, providing public sector professionals with the insights needed to operate successfully in high-stakes environments. It addresses why these dynamics exist and how they influence organisational culture and outcomes. Key learning areas include identifying different types of power, applying ethical influence tactics, and navigating workplace politics strategically. The course also provides robust frameworks for conflict resolution, focusing on constructive communication and mediation. Learners will discover how to leverage emotional intelligence and self-awareness to not only manage difficult situations but also to inspire and lead teams toward common goals. Ultimately, this course empowers emerging and established leaders to foster a more collaborative, ethical, and productive work environment, enabling them to lead sustainable organisational change.

title: Managing Workplace Conflict
desc: Conflict is an inevitable aspect of any professional environment, but its outcomes are not. This course provides a comprehensive framework for managing workplace disagreements effectively and transforming them into catalysts for positive change. It begins by establishing the context of workplace conflict, exploring its common sources—from miscommunication and unclear roles to value clashes—and its impact on morale and productivity. Learners will be guided through a step-by-step resolution process that includes identifying the core issue, gathering perspectives, and co-creating viable solutions. The curriculum delves into five distinct conflict resolution styles (avoiding, competing, accommodating, compromising, and collaborating), enabling participants to adapt their approach to any situation. Through practical examples and established models like Susan Glaser’s three-step method, this course equips public service professionals with the tools to build stronger teams, enhance communication, and cultivate a culture of mutual respect and trust.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Manners and Etiquette
desc: As representatives of their organizations, officers must embody the highest standards of conduct. This course is designed to cultivate the professionalism and social grace essential for success. It provides a structured approach to mastering etiquette, beginning with personal manners such as hygiene, grooming, and effective conversation skills. The curriculum then progresses to social and professional settings, covering drawing room etiquette, the protocols for official visits, and the art of hosting and being a gracious guest. Participants will learn to navigate complex social interactions with confidence and finesse. Through practical insights and real-world scenarios, this course will help you refine your interpersonal skills, build a positive professional image, and handle any situation with decorum, ultimately setting you apart as an officer who exemplifies confidence and respect.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: MANTHAN: Building India's Demand-Driven Industry-Academia Bridge
desc:
Manthan is a digital platform launched on 15 August 2022 by the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA) to the Government of India, under the leadership of Professor Ajay Kumar Sood.  It was designed to bridge a persistent structural gap in India's innovation ecosystem: organisations with technical, social, or commercial problems could not easily find research institutions, startups, or innovators with relevant solutions, and vice versa.

The case traces a central dilemma: could a digital platform, even one backed by the institutional credibility of the PSA's office, shift the entrenched behaviours, reliance on personal networks, premier-institution bias, and risk-averse CSR decision-making that had long sustained the industry-academia gap? The case concludes with the platform's most unresolved challenge: despite facilitating thousands of crores in research investment, it faced a one-crore annual maintenance gap that threatened its continuity.

title: Manual Maintenance of Track
desc: This comprehensive training program delves into the essential practices of manual railway track maintenance, a critical function for ensuring the safety and efficiency of rail operations. Based on the authoritative Indian Railway Permanent Way Manual (IRPWM), the course is designed for track maintenance staff and supervisors. The curriculum systematically breaks down complex procedures into manageable, sequential steps. Key learning areas include the complete eight-step process of 'through packing' (conventional maintenance), from opening the road and examining components to aligning, gauging, and packing sleepers. The course also covers the identification and correction of 'slacks' in the track, procedures for systematic overhauling to improve drainage, and specialized tasks such as the annual lubrication of rail joints and the safe lifting or lowering of track sections. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the practical knowledge to execute maintenance tasks meticulously, adhere to safety protocols, and contribute to the overall health and longevity of the railway network.

title: Manufacture and Other Operations in a Customs Warehouse Scheme
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the Manufacture and Other Operations in Warehouse Scheme (MOOWS), explaining its purpose, key features, and advantages over existing export promotion schemes. Learners gain an understanding of the legal provisions under the Customs Act, the procedure for obtaining permission to operate under MOOWS, and the obligations and compliance requirements of approved operators, including proper record maintenance and reporting. The course also covers the process of receiving goods into a Section 65 warehouse, clearing goods for home consumption or export, and the importance of maintaining accurate inventory and documentation. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to operate effectively under the MOOWS scheme, ensuring both compliance and efficient use of bonded manufacturing facilities.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Manufacturing Industry Analysis: Global Scenario
desc: The global manufacturing sector is at a pivotal juncture, experiencing rapid evolution due to disruptive technologies and changing economic paradigms. This course offers an in-depth analysis of this transformation, providing a strategic overview of the global scenario. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the forces reshaping modern production, from interconnected supply chains to the rise of digital factories. Key learning areas include the impact of smart automation and robotics, the application of wearable technology on the factory floor, the development of smart materials, and the revolutionary potential of multi-material 3D printing. The course also explores how Augmented and Virtual Reality (AR/VR) are enhancing design and training, and how light-weighting technologies are driving fuel efficiency and sustainability. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to identify key technological trends, analyze their impact on manufacturing operations, and contribute to strategic decision-making within their organizations, fostering innovation and competitiveness in a global context.

title: Manufacturing Industry Analysis: Indian Context
desc: Delve into the dynamics of India's manufacturing industry with this analytical course. As the nation strives for economic growth, a robust manufacturing sector is paramount. This program explores the historical context and the contemporary landscape, focusing on the pivotal role of digital transformation and automation in enhancing industrial competitiveness. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the sector's structure, including market size, production cycles, and supply-demand economics. The course examines the foreign direct investment (FDI) environment and profiles the key industrial players shaping the market. A dedicated module on Energy Management Systems (EMS) will explain its principles and significant benefits for sustainable and efficient operations. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the Indian manufacturing context, understand its key growth drivers, and appreciate the impact of technology on its future trajectory. This knowledge is essential for professionals involved in industrial policy, economic planning, and business strategy within the manufacturing domain.

title: Manuscript Writing: Advanced Level
desc: This course is designed for researchers and academics seeking to enhance their scientific writing and publication skills. In the competitive world of academic publishing, the ability to present research findings clearly and professionally is paramount. This program provides an in-depth exploration of the entire manuscript preparation process, from initial structuring to final submission. Key learning areas include mastering the standard components of a scientific paper, such as the abstract, introduction, methods, results, and discussion. The course emphasizes the importance of adhering to specific journal guidelines, presenting data effectively through figures and tables, and even creating graphical abstracts to increase visibility. Learners will gain practical insights into writing persuasive cover letters, navigating the journal's editorial checks, and strategically responding to reviewer feedback to improve their manuscript. Upon completion, participants will have the confidence and skills to produce well-structured, high-impact manuscripts that effectively communicate their research to a scholarly audience.

title: Mapping Procedural Rules for Trials in Rape and Sexual Offence Cases
desc: This course offers a comprehensive and practical understanding of the legal procedures and protections for rape and sexual offence trials under India’s newly enacted criminal laws. It is designed to equip legal practitioners, police officers, and judicial officials with a clear grasp of the procedural steps, victim-centric safeguards, and trial requirements that ensure faster and more sensitive justice delivery. The curriculum delves into the context of these legal reforms, explaining why they are critical for the Indian justice system. Key learning areas include the facilitation of immediate complaint registration through Zero FIRs, mandatory protocols for recording victim statements by women officers, and strict timelines for investigation and trial. The course also covers procedures for medical examinations, the importance of in-camera trials for victim privacy, and evidentiary rules that prevent the use of a victim's past sexual history. By completing this course, learners will be proficient in applying the updated legal framework, ensuring compliance and upholding the dignity and rights of victims throughout the judicial process.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Marine Insurance
desc: In an era of globalized trade, maritime transport is the backbone of the world's economy, making marine insurance an indispensable tool for risk management. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the subject, beginning with the fundamental principles such as utmost good faith, insurable interest, and indemnity. It delves into the legal landscape governed by the Marine Insurance Act, 1963, providing clarity on the rights and obligations of insurers and the assured. Participants will learn to distinguish between different types of policies, including voyage, time, and hull insurance, and understand how to assess various marine losses, from partial damages to total loss scenarios. Through the analysis of case studies and key clauses like the 'Inchmaree' and 'Running Down' clauses, learners will be equipped to interpret insurance contracts, evaluate maritime risks, and understand the claims process, making them proficient in navigating the complexities of marine insurance in a professional setting.

title: Marine Mineral Resources
desc: Delve into the world of underwater wealth with this introductory course on Marine Mineral Resources. Presented by the Geological Survey of India, this program is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of the minerals that lie within our oceans. The course begins by defining marine mineral resources and their critical importance to human economic ventures. You will learn to classify these resources based on their location and formation, covering minerals dissolved in seawater like salt and magnesium, surface deposits such as sand, gravel, and polymetallic nodules, and vital sub-surface resources including petroleum and gas hydrates. The curriculum explores the geological processes that create these deposits, from evaporation in ancient seas to hydrothermal activity at black smokers. Learners will gain insights into the composition, economic potential, and current extraction challenges associated with high-value deposits like manganese nodules, cobalt-rich crusts, and massive sulfides. By the end of this course, you will be able to identify different marine mineral types and appreciate their strategic importance as a future resource.

title: Maritime Safety and Communication Systems
desc: This course is designed to provide a thorough introduction to the technologies and procedures governing maritime safety and communication. It establishes the context for why robust communication is critical in preventing and responding to incidents at sea. Key learning areas include a detailed exploration of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), its purpose, and the obligations for vessels. Learners will study primary and secondary distress alerting methods, the functionality of Digital Selective Calling (DSC), and the role of both terrestrial and satellite communication systems. The course also covers critical search and rescue equipment, including the deployment of EPIRBs and the application of SART and AIS SART. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to confidently select and apply the correct communication protocols during distress situations, contributing to coordinated and effective maritime emergency responses and enhancing overall safety at sea.

title: Maritime Zones-United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), often called the 'Constitution for the Oceans.' It is designed for officials who require a basic understanding of international maritime law and its practical implications for national jurisdiction and security. The curriculum systematically breaks down the complex legal framework, starting with the significance of baselines and progressing through each maritime zone: Internal Waters, Territorial Sea, Contiguous Zone, Exclusive Economic Zone, the High Seas, and the Continental Shelf. For each zone, the course clarifies the sovereign rights and duties of coastal states, including rights to resources and the limits imposed by concepts like 'innocent passage.' Using the Entrica Lexie case as a practical example, the course demonstrates how UNCLOS is applied to resolve complex international disputes over jurisdiction. Upon completion, learners will possess a clear and structured knowledge of the legal regime governing the world's oceans, enabling them to better understand and address maritime-related issues in their official duties.

title: Market and Competitive Analysis
desc: In today's rapidly changing environments, the ability to think strategically is crucial for policymakers and public sector leaders. This course addresses the need for structured analytical skills to make informed decisions that drive effective policy and organizational strategy. The curriculum delves into foundational strategic frameworks. You will learn to apply Porter’s Five Forces to assess industry competitiveness, use SWOT and the 7Cs framework for comprehensive internal and external analysis, and leverage the BCG Matrix for portfolio prioritization. The course also covers methods for market sizing, providing a holistic toolkit for strategic evaluation. By engaging with real-world case studies from the Indian context, including the electric vehicle, OTT, and FMCG industries, learners will not just theorize but apply these models to tangible challenges. Upon completion, you will be equipped to dissect complex business and policy problems, develop data-informed hypotheses, and present strategic recommendations with clarity and confidence. This course builds the foundational mindset of a strategic consultant, enabling you to adapt and innovate in any professional setting.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Market Operation and Regulatory Affairs
desc: This course delves into the intricate workings of India's electricity markets, offering a detailed exploration of both operational functions and regulatory frameworks. The curriculum is designed to build a strong foundational knowledge of the principles governing the power sector. Key learning areas include the fundamentals of electricity market design, the legal structure provided by the Electricity Act, 2003, and the specific regulations for power markets. Participants will learn about essential operational processes such as scheduling, despatch, and energy accounting, as well as complex mechanisms like Deviation Settlement, Congestion Management, and Ancillary Services. The course also covers economic and environmental aspects, including transmission pricing, revenue streams for RLDCs, and the Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) mechanism. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the compliance and operational challenges of the modern Indian power grid.

title: Market-Oriented PACS: From Credit to Value Creation
desc: This course explains how India’s Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) can evolve from credit-only cooperatives into Multipurpose, Market-oriented PACS (MPACS) that generate sustainable value for their members. It combines institutional history, governance reform, scheme convergence, and practical market-linkage tools to demonstrate how PACS can integrate input services, storage and processing, aggregation, and digital systems. The course also explores pilot buyer contracts, risk management approaches, and ways to retain cooperative legitimacy while pursuing commercial viability. Through case examples, hands-on exercises, and simple MIS templates, participants will learn to design context-sensitive, revenue-generating MPACS models.

title: Marriage Related Offences Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This comprehensive course provides an in-depth exploration of the legal framework governing marriage-related offences as codified in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. It is specifically designed for legal practitioners, law enforcement personnel, and judicial officers who need to understand and apply these new criminal laws. The curriculum systematically breaks down key offences such as dowry death (Section 80), cruelty by a husband or his relatives (Section 86), bigamy (Section 82), and deceitful cohabitation (Section 81). Learners will delve into the specific elements that constitute each offence, the prescribed punishments, and the procedural nuances required for complaints. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the presumptions related to abetment of suicide and dowry death under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023. Through a comparative analysis with the erstwhile Indian Penal Code (IPC) and the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, participants will gain a clear perspective on how the BNS modernizes and strengthens legal protections for women, ensuring they can effectively navigate and enforce these critical laws in their professional roles.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Marshalling Yards and Freight Terminals
desc: The course is designed to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of the essential functions, classifications, components, and operational significance of railway yards. Learners will explore the layout of marshaling yards, sorting mechanisms, traffic management practices, yard statistics, and the roles and responsibilities of personnel involved in yard operations. The course highlights the critical role marshaling yards play in ensuring the efficient functioning of the Indian Railways freight system. Participants will gain the knowledge necessary to analyze yard operations, optimize freight handling, and understand the operational considerations that govern yard design and management.

title: Massive MIMO and Beam Forming
desc: This technical course delves into the mechanics of Massive MIMO and beamforming, essential for the rollout of 5G and future wireless networks. The program begins with the basics of antenna elements and how their configuration and separation, measured in wavelengths (lambda), impact signal radiation patterns. You will learn how multiple antennas can be used to form highly directional beams, concentrating energy towards specific users to improve signal strength and data rates. The course provides a detailed explanation of beam steering, a technique that dynamically changes the direction of the main beam by adjusting the phase of signals fed to different antenna elements. It also covers the creation of multiple beams to serve several users simultaneously and the strategic use of null steering to minimize interference for non-targeted users. By the end of this course, learners will understand the evolution from conventional MIMO to Massive MIMO, its benefits for network capacity and coverage, and its practical implementation in today's advanced telecommunication infrastructure.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Mastering Accounting Standards: AS 1-29 and Practical Applications
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the critical framework of Indian Accounting Standards (IAS), which govern the preparation and presentation of financial statements in India. The curriculum is structured into modules, systematically covering AS 1 through AS 29. The primary context is to standardize diverse accounting policies and practices, thereby enhancing the reliability and comparability of financial data for stakeholders, including tax authorities. Key learning areas include the disclosure of accounting policies, valuation of inventories, cash flow statements, accounting for fixed assets, leases, amalgamations, and employee benefits. Learners will understand how to apply these standards to practical situations, such as ensuring the correctness of financial statements reported in Income-tax Returns.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Mastering AutoCAD: Beginner's Guide to Essential Tools and Techniques
desc: Embark on your journey to mastering computer-aided design with this foundational course on AutoCAD. In today's engineering and architectural fields, proficiency in AutoCAD is an essential skill for creating precise and professional technical drawings. This course is structured to guide absolute beginners through the core functionalities of the software in a clear, step-by-step manner. Key learning areas include a thorough exploration of the user interface, navigation tools, and setting up a drawing. You will gain hands-on experience with essential drawing tools like Line, Circle, and Polyline, and learn to modify your designs using editing commands such as Move, Trim, and Rotate. The curriculum also covers crucial concepts like layer management for organizing complex drawings and adding annotations for clarity. Finally, you will learn the complete workflow for plotting and exporting your designs to standard formats like PDF. Upon completion, you will be able to confidently produce accurate 2D drawings and have a solid foundation for advancing your CAD skills.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Mastering Feedback: A Leadership Tool
desc: In the context of public service, effective feedback is a powerful, no-cost catalyst for performance enhancement and professional development. This course, designed for government leaders and supervisors, delves into the art and science of giving and receiving feedback. It reframes feedback not as criticism, but as an act of care essential for guiding and developing teams. The curriculum addresses common psychological barriers that prevent open communication and provides structured methods for delivering both appreciative and corrective feedback. Learners will explore techniques to manage difficult conversations and foster an environment where feedback is viewed as a continuous, two-way dialogue for growth. By completing this course, officials will be equipped to build more engaged, accountable, and high-performing teams, driving greater effectiveness in public service delivery.

title: Mastering GIS (Level - 1)
desc: Mastering GIS (Level 1) is designed to equip public sector professionals with the fundamental knowledge and skills to leverage geospatial technology. The course begins by defining GIS, Geomatics, and other key terminologies, establishing a solid theoretical base. It delves into the practical aspects of data acquisition through various modern tools like satellite imagery, aerial photography, drones (UAVs), and LiDAR, explaining how data is captured and linked to specific locations.The curriculum emphasizes the application of GIS in real-world government contexts, such as land administration, urban planning, disaster management, and environmental monitoring. You will learn about the functions of GIS, from basic mapping and visualization to complex spatial analysis. By understanding how to analyze spatial patterns and relationships, you will be prepared to contribute to data-driven policy-making and improve the efficiency of public services. This course is the first step towards mastering a technology that is critical for sustainable development and effective governance.

title: Mastering GIS (Level - 2)
desc: This intermediate course delves into the essential architecture and data structures that power Geographic Information Systems. It begins by systematically breaking down the five critical components of any successful GIS implementation, providing context on how hardware, software, data, human expertise, and methodologies interact. The curriculum then focuses on the lifeblood of GIS: data. You will learn to differentiate between locational (spatial) and descriptive (non-spatial) data and understand their symbiotic relationship. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the vector and raster data models in depth. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to analyze the structure of geospatial datasets, make informed decisions about which data model to use for specific applications, and appreciate the roles of different technologies and personnel in a GIS ecosystem, particularly in the context of public sector applications like land management and urban planning.

title: Mastering Learning: Tools and Techniques That Work
desc: In today's rapidly evolving professional landscape, the ability to learn effectively is a critical skill for all government officials. 'Mastering Learning' provides a comprehensive toolkit to transform how you acquire and retain knowledge. The course delves into the science of learning, explaining concepts like neuroplasticity to show how the brain can be rewired for continuous improvement. You will explore powerful, evidence-based techniques including active recall, spaced repetition, and the memory palace method, which are proven to significantly boost memory retention. The curriculum is structured to provide practical guidance on creating an optimal learning environment by managing distractions and leveraging technology responsibly. You will learn to apply methods like the Pomodoro technique for better focus and chunking for breaking down complex subjects. Furthermore, the course introduces the concept of metacognition and how AI-assisted tools can enhance learning efficiency. By completing this course, you will not only improve your study habits but also gain the confidence to tackle new challenges and foster a mindset of lifelong learning, essential for professional growth in the public sector.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Mastering Negotiations in Multilateral Environmental Agreements
desc: This course provides practical insights into negotiation processes in multilateral environmental forums, focusing on key global issues such as climate change, biodiversity conservation, and land degradation. It is designed to strengthen the capacity of negotiators, policy advisors, and diplomats to effectively represent national interests in international platforms such as the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD), the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD). The course covers the structure and functioning of these agreements, negotiation procedures, and decision-making processes in global environmental governance. It also focuses on practical skills such as coalition building, consensus development, interpretation of negotiation texts, and strategic communication.

title: Mastering Social Correspondence and Etiquette
desc: In today's interconnected professional world, mastering social etiquette is essential for career success and effective networking. This course is designed to equip public officials with the fundamental skills needed to handle diverse social situations with confidence and professionalism. You will delve into the art of social correspondence, learning how to properly issue and respond to formal and informal invitations. The curriculum also provides a detailed guide to dining etiquette, covering everything from table manners and cutlery usage to appropriate behavior at formal dinners. Furthermore, you will learn to interpret and adhere to various dress codes for social events, ensuring you always present yourself gracefully. Upon completion, you will be able to navigate social gatherings seamlessly, project a polished and respectful image, and build stronger interpersonal and professional relationships.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Mastering Techniques to Get Best Response from ChatGPT and other Tools
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to prompt engineering for government officials seeking to leverage Generative AI tools like ChatGPT. As artificial intelligence becomes integral to modern governance, the ability to communicate effectively with AI is a critical skill. The curriculum begins with the foundational principles of how Large Language Models (LLMs) process prompts, distinguishing this new skill from traditional search queries. Participants will explore the key elements of a well-structured prompt and learn through practical examples how to achieve desired outputs for various administrative tasks. Key learning areas include using AI for summarizing lengthy reports, analyzing datasets for actionable insights, drafting official communications, and supporting complex decision-making processes. The course also delves into advanced prompting techniques to give learners greater control over AI responses.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Maternal, Infant and Young Child Nutrition
desc: This comprehensive course on Maternal, Infant, and Young Child Nutrition (MIYCN) is designed for public health professionals, nutritionists, and frontline workers involved in child development programs. It addresses the critical importance of nutrition during the first 1000 days of life, from pregnancy through early childhood. The curriculum provides an in-depth exploration of the two primary categories of nutrients: Type 1 (functional) and Type 2 (growth). Learners will gain a scientific understanding of how deficiencies in these nutrients lead to different forms of malnutrition, including wasting, stunting, and hidden hunger. The course details the clinical signs, metabolic impact, and long-term effects of conditions like Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM). Through detailed explanations and real-world examples, participants will learn to identify the signs of nutrient deficiencies and understand the urgency of appropriate nutritional interventions.

title: Mathematics for Quantum Computing
desc: Embark on a journey into the mathematical core of quantum computing. This course demystifies the abstract concepts that power the next generation of computation. The curriculum begins by establishing the importance of matrix algebra and linear transformations in representing quantum states and operations. You will delve into key topics such as eigenvalues and eigenvectors, which are crucial for understanding quantum measurement outcomes, and explore the significance of Hermitian matrices in designing observables.
