The course thoroughly covers the use of tensor products for modeling multi-qubit systems and the role of complex numbers in describing quantum phase and evolution. Furthermore, it introduces advanced concepts like the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT), a cornerstone of powerful quantum algorithms like Shor's algorithm, and the Schrödinger equation, which governs the time evolution of quantum systems. By the end of this course, you will have the mathematical fluency to interpret quantum mechanics and be well-prepared to tackle more advanced topics in quantum information theory, error correction, and algorithm design.
org: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani)

title: Matters handled by Finance Division
desc: This foundational course is designed to demystify the workings of an Integrated Finance Division (IFD) in a government department. In the context of public administration, sound financial management is critical for transparent and efficient governance. This module delves into the core purpose and structure of the IFD, explaining why it is integral to departmental operations. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the division's primary functions, the specific duties and responsibilities of Financial Advisors, and the procedural manner in which financial matters are handled. Upon completion, learners will have a clear understanding of the IFD's role, enabling them to interact more effectively with financial processes and personnel, and appreciate the division's contribution to departmental objectives.
org: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Matters relating to Pay Module
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to empower government employees by demystifying the complex landscape of pay and promotions. The curriculum addresses the critical need for officials to understand the rules that govern their financial entitlements and career advancement. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the principles for initial pay fixation, the various mechanisms for pay protection during service, and the specific regulations for the grant of regular and special increments. The course also covers the procedural aspects of promotions within the government machinery. Upon completion, learners will be able to accurately interpret and apply these essential service rules, enabling them to manage their own career path effectively and assist in the correct processing of establishment matters, ensuring fairness and transparency in public administration.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Maximizing Employee Productivity
desc: In today's dynamic public service landscape, maximizing employee productivity is essential for effective governance and service delivery. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the factors that drive workplace efficiency and employee performance. It begins by establishing the context of productivity in a government setting, examining how employee attitudes and workplace culture directly impact outcomes. You will delve into different models of productivity and learn to use specific tools to measure and track performance accurately. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical application of these concepts. You will learn how to design and use surveys to evaluate the effectiveness of employee training programs, ensuring that learning translates into tangible results. Furthermore, the course provides a step-by-step guide to creating and managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), a critical tool for addressing performance gaps and supporting employee development. By the end of this course, you will be able to analyze productivity challenges, implement effective measurement systems, and lead initiatives that cultivate a more productive and motivated workforce, ultimately contributing to enhanced public sector performance.

title: MCA - 21 V3
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of MCA 21 Version 3, the flagship e-governance initiative by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. As India advances its digital infrastructure, understanding this platform is crucial for officials involved in corporate regulation and compliance. The program provides essential context on the evolution from previous versions to the current technology-driven framework, highlighting the strategic goals of enhancing transparency, efficiency, and ease of doing business. Key learning areas include the core functional and technological innovations embedded in Version 3, such as AI-powered compliance monitoring, advanced data analytics, automated workflows, and redesigned user interfaces. Participants will gain a robust understanding of how these features strengthen regulatory oversight and streamline corporate processes. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively navigate the MCA 21 V3 ecosystem, appreciate its role in modern corporate governance, and contribute to a more responsive and business-friendly regulatory environment in India.

title: Meaning and Scope of Supply of Goods and Services under GST
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the meaning and scope of supply, a cornerstone of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. Designed for tax professionals and compliance officers, it delves into the critical provisions of the CGST Act, 2017. The course begins by defining key terms such as 'goods', 'services', 'business', and 'consideration' to build a strong foundation. Participants will then analyze Section 7 of the CGST Act, exploring what constitutes a supply, including activities specified in Schedule I (activities treated as supply even without consideration), Schedule II (activities to be treated as supply of goods or services), and Schedule III (activities treated as neither). The curriculum also differentiates between composite and mixed supplies, clarifying how tax liability is determined in each case. Upon completion, learners will be able to correctly interpret and apply the concept of supply, ensuring accurate tax assessment and adherence to India's indirect tax laws.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Measuring the Impact of Marketing Campaign
desc: In an era of accountability and data-driven governance, measuring the true impact of public communication is essential. This course is designed for government officers and communication professionals seeking to build robust evaluation frameworks for their marketing and outreach campaigns. It addresses the critical need to move beyond surface-level metrics and understand the real-world effects of public messaging.The curriculum provides a comprehensive overview of impact assessment, starting with the foundational output-outcome-impact framework. You will learn to select meaningful Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that align with strategic objectives and explore a mix of quantitative and qualitative data collection methods, including surveys, social media analytics, and administrative data. The course uses real-world case studies from major Indian initiatives like Swachh Bharat and the COVID-19 vaccination drive to illustrate these concepts in practice.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Mechanical Engineering Department of Indian Railways
desc: Gain an in-depth understanding of the operational backbone of Indian Railways with this detailed course on the Mechanical Engineering Department (MED). The program is designed for railway professionals and probationers, offering critical insights into the management of rolling stock. You will explore the key functions of the MED, including strategic procurement, technological upgrades through RDSO, and heritage conservation. The course delves into the technical specifics of different rolling stock, such as locomotives, various coach types (ICF, LHB, Vande Bharat), and freight wagons, covering core components like bogies, braking systems, and underframes. It highlights the evolution of design, from conventional to modern systems like distributed traction and microprocessor-based controls. Learners will also understand the importance of structured maintenance schedules, safety certifications like the Brake Power Certificate (BPC), and environmental initiatives, preparing them to contribute to a safer, more efficient, and modern railway network.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Media and Public Outreach in the Panchayati Raj System
desc: This course focuses on strengthening communication strategies within governance systems, particularly at the Panchayat and local administration levels. It emphasizes the role of media as a tool for transparency, awareness generation, and citizen engagement. The course covers traditional and digital media platforms, content creation, public outreach strategies, and the management of official communication channels. It enables officials to effectively disseminate government initiatives, manage public communication, address public perception, and build trust through structured and ethical communication practices.

title: Media Management
desc: In an era of high public scrutiny and rapid information dissemination, effective media management is a critical function for modern policing. This course is designed to equip law enforcement professionals with the strategic communication skills necessary to build public trust and maintain institutional credibility. The curriculum provides a comprehensive overview of media relations, focusing on the importance of clear, ethical, and proactive messaging. Key learning areas include understanding the pivotal role of Public Relations Officers (PROs), developing robust strategies for crisis communication, and effectively countering misinformation across various media platforms. Participants will delve into the practical application of social media for community engagement and public safety initiatives. The course also offers insights into leveraging emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Virtual Reality (VR) for advanced media training and public interaction. Through a focus on practical application and ethical considerations, learners will be prepared to shape public narratives, enhance transparency, and foster a positive relationship between the police and the community.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Medical Attendance Rules for Central Government Employees
desc: The course provides a comprehensive understanding of the policies governing medical facilities and reimbursement provisions for Central Government employees. It explains the eligibility criteria, scope of benefits, and authorized medical services available under the applicable rules. The course guides learners through the procedures for availing medical treatment, submitting claims, and ensuring compliance with documentation and regulatory requirements. It also highlights ethical practices in the utilization of medical benefits and emphasizes transparency in claim processing. In addition, the course covers reimbursement procedures, emergency medical protocols, and the functioning of healthcare systems such as CGHS/EHS. Designed primarily for establishment and administrative officers, it equips learners with practical knowledge to ensure accurate implementation of rules, efficient processing of medical claims, and adherence to prescribed guidelines.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: Medical Benefits and Entitlements for Central Government Employees
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) and the Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules [CS(MA) Rules], which form an important part of the medical welfare provisions available to eligible Central Government employees and their dependents. It is designed to equip officials, particularly those working in administration and human resources, with the knowledge required to understand, interpret, and apply the relevant rules and procedures. The course covers the key features and applicability of CGHS and CS(MA) Rules, eligibility of employees and dependents, scope of medical benefits, and procedures for outpatient and inpatient treatment. It also examines medical reimbursement procedures, processing of claims, cashless treatment facilities, the functioning of CGHS Wellness Centres, and the empanelment of hospitals.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Medical Decategorised Staff Absorption Pay and Seniority in Railway
desc: This course provides an overview of the policies, procedures, and administrative provisions governing the absorption of medically decategorised railway employees into suitable alternative posts. It explains the principles of fair and transparent placement, the priority guidelines followed during redeployment, the process of identifying appropriate alternative employment, and the rules relating to pay fixation, seniority, and service conditions. The course equips learners with the knowledge required to effectively implement these provisions while ensuring compliance with railway regulations and safeguarding employee welfare.

title: Medical Treatment and Attendance Rules in Indian Railways
desc: This program is designed to equip Indian Railways personnel with a thorough understanding of the medical benefits and attendance rules governing their healthcare. The course begins by defining key terms and identifying the categories of beneficiaries, including employees, their families, and dependent relatives. It systematically explains the entitlements for medical attendance, ward accommodation in hospitals based on basic pay, and the scope of treatments covered. Learners will explore the specifics of specialist consultations, reimbursements for treatments at non-railway hospitals, and the process for claiming benefits. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Retired Employees Liberalized Health Scheme (RELHS), outlining its eligibility criteria, conditions, and the contribution structure. Furthermore, it clarifies the provisions for cashless emergency treatment and rules applicable during railway accidents. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate the medical rules to access their entitled healthcare services efficiently and correctly.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Medicinal Plants: Conservation Development and Sustainable Use
desc: This comprehensive training course delves into the critical field of medicinal plant management, covering their conservation, development, and sustainable utilization. The curriculum is designed to provide a thorough understanding of why medicinal plants are vital, not just for traditional medicine but also for the broader national economy. It addresses the significant threats these plants face from over-harvesting and habitat loss, providing a strong case for urgent and effective conservation action. Key learning areas include an exploration of traditional knowledge systems, principles of sustainable use, and specific strategies for both in-situ and ex-situ conservation. Furthermore, the course offers a detailed examination of the regulatory frameworks and policies that govern the conservation and use of medicinal plant resources in the country. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to describe, analyze, and apply sustainable practices, contributing to the long-term viability of medicinal plant populations and their associated economic and cultural benefits.

title: Meditation for Stress Management and Boosting Productivity
desc: In today's fast-paced professional world, stress and anxiety are significant challenges affecting both personal health and workplace productivity. This course, 'Meditation for Stress Management and Enhanced Productivity,' is designed to equip public officials with the tools to effectively manage these challenges. The program is structured into five core parts, supplemented by two bonus sessions, covering the foundational principles of meditation. Participants will begin by understanding stress, its various forms like eustress and distress, and its scientifically-proven impact on chronic diseases and mental health. The course then systematically explains why meditation is a powerful solution, exploring its effects on brain physiology, emotional regulation, and cognitive functions like memory and decision-making. The 'how-to' section provides practical, step-by-step guidance on various meditation techniques, including guided sessions that help learners cultivate mindfulness, awareness, and inner peace. By the end of this course, participants will not only have a deep theoretical understanding but also the practical ability to establish a regular meditation practice, leading to reduced stress, enhanced focus, and a significant improvement in both personal and professional effectiveness.

title: MEETINGS UNDER COMPANIES ACT,2013
desc: This course is designed to equip learners with a detailed understanding of the provisions related to company meetings under the Companies Act, 2013. It begins by defining what constitutes a company meeting and outlines its essential characteristics. The course systematically covers the different kinds of meetings applicable to various company structures, such as shareholder meetings (Statutory, AGM, EGM), meetings of directors, creditors, and debenture holders. Key learning areas include the statutory requirements for convening meetings, notice periods, and the specific business transacted at each. Participants will learn to navigate critical procedural aspects like establishing a quorum, the process of moving from a motion to a resolution, the distinction between ordinary and special resolutions, and the rules for proxy voting and postal ballots. The course also emphasizes the importance of proper documentation, such as preparing an agenda and recording minutes. Upon completion, learners will be able to ensure that their organization's meetings are conducted in full compliance with corporate law, thereby upholding good governance and avoiding legal penalties.

title: Mental Health and Well-Being for a Resilient Workforce
desc: This course is designed to equip participants with practical strategies, tools, and models to enhance mental health and overall well-being in the workplace. It focuses on building resilience, fostering self-awareness, and promoting sustainable well-being practices that support both professional effectiveness and personal balance. Aligned with Mission Karmayogi’s vision of a future-ready, empathetic, and citizen-centric workforce, the course highlights the critical role of mental health in shaping decision-making, workplace interactions, and service outcomes. Participants will explore evidence-based approaches to mental wellness and learn how individual well-being contributes to organisational effectiveness and public value. Through a practical and reflective learning approach, the course encourages participants to prioritise mental health, strengthen resilience, and cultivate habits that support long-term well-being.

title: Mentoring for Effective Human Resource Development
desc: This course provides comprehensive knowledge on the significance of training in human resource development (HRD) and the effective use of mentoring skills following long-duration training interventions. It highlights how well-structured mentoring strengthens the learning outcomes of training programs by providing guidance, support, and feedback to mentees. Participants learn how mentoring fosters personal and professional growth, builds confidence, and enhances skill application in real-world organizational contexts. The course emphasizes how mentoring benefits not only the mentee, who gains guidance and practical insights, but also the mentor, who develops leadership and coaching capabilities. Additionally, organizations benefit through improved employee performance, retention, and knowledge transfer, while training institutes, sponsoring organizations, and policy makers can achieve greater impact from their human resource development initiatives.
org: Mahatma Gandhi State Institute of Public Administration Punjab

title: Mergers and Acquisitions: An Overview
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of mergers and acquisitions (M&A), designed for professionals seeking to grasp the strategic, financial, and legal dimensions of corporate consolidation. The program begins by establishing the context for M&A, explaining why these transactions are a vital tool for corporate growth, market expansion, and competitive positioning. You will explore the primary types of M&A, including horizontal, vertical, concentric, and conglomerate, analyzing the unique strategic rationale and implications of each. The course further examines the underlying theories that explain M&A activities and the various forms of synergies—cost, revenue, and financial—that companies aim to achieve. A significant portion is dedicated to the due diligence process, outlining the critical steps involved in financial, legal, and operational assessments to ensure informed decision-making. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the essential knowledge to understand the M&A landscape and its impact on business strategy and value creation.

title: MeriPehchaan (NSSO)
desc: Delve into the architecture and impact of MeriPehchaan, the unified authentication service integrated with DigiLocker. This course explains the strategic importance of a National Single Sign-On (NSSO) in the context of Digital India. You will explore the challenges of managing multiple credentials for government services and how MeriPehchaan addresses these issues by reducing password fatigue and preventing identity fraud. The curriculum covers key features including multi-factor authentication, verified identity profiles, and the technical standards it is built on, such as OAuth and OpenID Connect. A significant focus is placed on privacy preservation and the platform's alignment with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act's consent management principles. Upon completion, learners will understand how government departments can integrate their applications with MeriPehchaan to improve citizen service delivery, enhance security, and accelerate the move towards seamless, paperless governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: MESS ETIQUETTES AND TABLE MANNERS
desc: This course is designed to equip government and paramilitary personnel with the essential skills of mess etiquette and table manners. In many formal and official settings, proper conduct is a reflection of discipline and professionalism. This program delves into the critical aspects of formal etiquette, starting from the procedures for official and social 'call-ons' to the specifics of dining conduct. Participants will learn about appropriate dress codes for various functions, the correct arrangement and use of table utensils, and the unspoken rules of seating arrangements. The course provides a detailed walkthrough of the 12 fundamental rules of table manners, covering everything from posture and conversation to handling food and interacting with hosts and staff. It also addresses proper conduct within the mess, including communication with colleagues, use of gadgets, and respect for mess property. Through practical demonstrations and clear instructions, learners will gain the confidence to navigate any formal dining or social event with grace and professionalism, upholding the highest standards of conduct expected of an officer.

title: Metallogeny with respect to Plate Tectonics
desc: Delve into the intricate processes that govern the formation of mineral deposits with this comprehensive course on metallogeny and plate tectonics. The program is designed to provide a systematic understanding of how the Earth's crustal movements control the location and type of mineralization. You will investigate the patterns of mineral distribution, exploring why certain deposits are found in specific geological settings. The course examines the Wilson cycle, illustrating how the opening and closing of ocean basins influence ore genesis over geological time. Key learning areas include the study of different tectonic environments, such as intracontinental rifts, mid-oceanic ridges, and subduction zones, and their associated ore types like VMS, porphyry, and epithermal deposits. By the end of this course, learners will be able to analyze the relationship between tectonic events and metallogenic provinces, a critical skill for resource assessment and exploration geology.

title: Methodology of Conducting Accident Enquiry in Railways
desc: This course provides a detailed understanding of accident investigation procedures in railway operations. It enables learners to systematically document and analyze accident site observations, with a focus on accuracy and standard reporting practices. The course covers the importance of site sketches in accident investigation and explains key elements such as the Point of Mount and Point of Drop. It also includes guidelines for preparing proformas related to motive power and locomotives, along with best practices for sketching accident sites and completing Part B documentation. In addition, the course explains the procedural steps followed when an enquiry committee is unable to reach a consensus, including the review and acceptance of reports by the General Manager (GM) and the final disposal process. It equips learners with the knowledge required to effectively manage accident reporting and documentation in railway operations.

title: Methods of Transfer Pricing
desc: This course on Methods of Transfer Pricing is designed to equip participants with a detailed understanding of the legal and practical aspects of determining the Arm’s Length Price (ALP) for international transactions. The curriculum is structured into seven modules that systematically cover the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961, and the corresponding Income Tax Rules. Learners will delve into the two primary categories of transfer pricing methodologies: Traditional Transactional Methods (Comparable Uncontrolled Price, Resale Price, Cost Plus) and Transactional Profit Methods (Profit Split, Transactional Net Margin). Each method is explained with a focus on its advantages, disadvantages, and appropriate application scenarios, supported by practical examples and case studies. The course also addresses the crucial process of selecting the 'Most Appropriate Method' and discusses its legal implications. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in navigating the complexities of transfer pricing regulations and applying these methods to ensure tax compliance and fair valuation in cross-border dealings between associated enterprises.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Metro Rail Policy 2017
desc: As India's urban centers continue to grow, the need for efficient and sustainable public transportation has become critical. The National Metro Rail Policy, 2017, was formulated to address this challenge by providing a strategic framework for the planning and implementation of metro rail systems. This course delves into the key provisions of this landmark policy. Participants will learn about the essential steps in urban mobility planning, the purpose of alternate analysis in evaluating transport options, and the various types of metro rail systems. The course further details the intricate processes of metro project planning, from conception to execution. It also covers crucial financial aspects, including strategies for revenue generation, innovative funding models, and the mechanisms for securing central assistance. Upon completion, learners will have a robust understanding of the policy's objectives and its role in shaping modern urban transit infrastructure in India, enabling them to contribute effectively to transportation projects in their jurisdictions.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Metro Rail Services in India
desc: This course introduces the concept of Mass Rapid Transit Systems (MRTS) and their key benefits in modern urban transportation. It explores the evolution and history of metro railways while highlighting the increasing need for efficient public transport systems in rapidly growing cities. The course also provides an overview of major metro systems in India and examines the future prospects of metro rail development across the country. By the end of the course, learners will have a clear understanding of the role of metro rail in promoting sustainable, fast, and reliable urban mobility.

title: Metro Railway Signalling System
desc: This course provides an overview of railway signalling systems, tracing their historical development and explaining the modern technologies used in metro rail operations. It highlights how signalling systems ensure safe and efficient train movement and explains key components such as interlocking systems, Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC), Automatic Train Supervision (ATS), and data communication systems. The course emphasizes the evolution from early mechanical signalling to advanced computer-based and communication-based control systems, with particular focus on the moving block principle that enables higher train frequency and enhanced safety.
org: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited

title: MICE Industry: Powering Global Business and Networking
desc: This course on the MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) Industry plays a vital role in driving economic growth, tourism development, trade promotion, and international collaboration. It provides a comprehensive overview of the MICE ecosystem, including its structure, key stakeholders, operational frameworks, and its significance in positioning India as a global hub for business events. Designed for government officials and professionals, this course highlights best practices in planning and managing large-scale events, with emphasis on policy support, infrastructure development, digital integration, and stakeholder coordination. It also explores emerging trends, sustainability practices, and India’s growing prominence in the global MICE landscape.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: Microforest
desc: In an era of rapid urbanization and shrinking green spaces, microforests offer a powerful, nature-based solution to restore ecological balance. This course provides a detailed guide to understanding and creating your own microforest. It begins by establishing the context, explaining why microforests are crucial for addressing biodiversity loss, poor air quality, and the impacts of climate change in populated areas. You will delve into the key learning areas, covering the entire lifecycle of a microforest project. This includes the scientific principles behind species and site selection, the importance of soil health and amendments, and the strategic design of multi-layered canopies for rapid growth. The course outlines a clear, step-by-step process for plantation, post-planting care, and long-term maintenance to ensure the ecosystem becomes self-sustaining. By completing this course, you will be equipped with the practical knowledge and skills to plan and implement a microforest project, transforming small plots of land into thriving, biodiverse habitats and contributing to a greener, more resilient future.

title: MicroGoals and OKRs for Personal Productivity
desc: MicroGoals and OKRs for Personal Productivity is a practical eLearning course designed to help learners systematically enhance their personal effectiveness through structured goal-setting. The course introduces two complementary frameworks: MicroGoals, which focus on small, actionable daily or weekly tasks, and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), which provide strategic direction through ambitious, measurable outcomes. Learners will explore how MicroGoals reduce procrastination, build consistency, and generate momentum, while OKRs clarify priorities, track progress, and sustain long-term motivation. Through real-life personal use cases—such as career growth, learning, fitness, time management, and financial discipline—the course demonstrates how these frameworks can be applied outside corporate environments.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Microsoft Excel Advanced
desc: This intermediate-level course is designed to elevate the Microsoft Excel proficiency of government professionals, moving beyond basic functions to master advanced data manipulation and analysis techniques. In an era of data-driven governance, the ability to efficiently process, analyze, and visualize data is a critical skill. This training addresses that need by providing in-depth, practical instruction on Excel's most powerful features. Key learning areas include the automation of repetitive tasks through Macros and the intelligent data entry capabilities of Flash Fill. Learners will dive deep into data analysis, mastering the creation and customization of PivotTables and PivotCharts to summarize and explore complex datasets. The course also covers essential data lookup and reference functions like VLOOKUP, INDEX, and MATCH, which are crucial for integrating data from various sources. Furthermore, participants will learn to create compelling data visualizations with advanced charting techniques and sparklines, and to ensure data accuracy and consistency using robust data validation rules. By the end of this course, officials will be equipped to manage and analyze government data with greater speed, accuracy, and insight, contributing to more effective service delivery and policy-making.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft Excel for Beginners
desc: This comprehensive course provides a foundational understanding of Microsoft Excel, an essential tool for data management and analysis in any professional setting. The curriculum is designed to guide beginners through the core functionalities of the application, starting with navigating the interface, understanding the ribbon menu, and working with worksheets, rows, and columns. Learners will gain hands-on experience with entering, editing, and formatting data, including text, numbers, and currencies. The course delves into the power of Excel formulas, covering essential arithmetic operations such as sum, average, multiplication, and division. It also introduces methods for organizing large datasets through sorting, filtering, and using features like Freeze Panes for better navigation. Furthermore, participants will learn to visualize data by creating basic charts and pivot tables, transforming raw numbers into meaningful insights. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to create, manage, and analyze spreadsheets with confidence, enhancing their productivity and data literacy skills for various official tasks.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft One Drive
desc: In today's digital workplace, efficient file management is crucial for productivity and collaboration. This course offers a complete guide to mastering OneDrive, a powerful cloud storage solution. It is designed to empower government officials with the skills needed to manage their digital files securely and effectively, aligning with the goal of enhancing digital literacy for efficient citizen-centric services. Participants will begin with the basics of setting up an account and navigating the interface. The course then progresses to practical skills, including uploading and organizing files and folders, sharing content with specific permissions, and collaborating in real-time with colleagues. You will learn how to create and manage shared libraries for team projects, set passwords to protect confidential information, and understand the file recovery process using the recycle bin. By the end of this course, you will be able to leverage OneDrive to its full potential, ensuring your work files are accessible, backed up, and securely managed, thereby improving your overall operational efficiency.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft Outlook
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to Microsoft Outlook, tailored to enhance the productivity of government officials. The curriculum begins with the basics, including an introduction to the Outlook interface and setting up a new account. Learners will then dive into the core functionalities, mastering email management through creating, sending, and organizing messages into folders. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to leveraging Outlook's organizational tools. You will learn to effectively manage your schedule using the calendar, set up meetings, and configure out-of-office replies. The course also covers the 'People' feature for contact management and the 'To-Do' list for tracking tasks and reminders. To further enhance efficiency, the training explains how to create and apply rules to automate email sorting and filtering, helping to maintain a clean and organized inbox. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to use Microsoft Outlook not just as an email client, but as a powerful personal organization tool to manage your professional responsibilities effectively.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft PowerPoint Advance
desc: This comprehensive course is designed for users who are already familiar with the basic functions of Microsoft PowerPoint and wish to elevate their presentation skills to an advanced level. The program provides an in-depth exploration of sophisticated features that enhance visual storytelling and audience engagement. Key learning areas include the strategic application of slide transitions and advanced animation techniques, such as sequencing, triggers, and motion paths, to create a seamless and professional flow. Learners will discover how to effectively use SmartArt to represent complex information, processes, and hierarchies visually. Additionally, the course covers essential collaboration and finalization tools, including adding comments for review, using the eyedropper for precise color matching, creating hyperlinks, and recording screen demonstrations directly within PowerPoint. Participants will also learn how to export presentations to PDF and share them via cloud services like OneDrive, ensuring their work is accessible and secure. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently produce polished, high-impact presentations suitable for high-stakes meetings, public reports, and training sessions.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft PowerPoint Beginners
desc: Welcome to this foundational course on Microsoft PowerPoint, tailored for government officials and professionals new to the application. In today's digital workplace, the ability to create clear and persuasive presentations is a critical skill. This course demystifies PowerPoint, transforming it from an intimidating tool into an accessible platform for effective communication. You will begin by understanding the application's interface, learning how to create, save, and navigate through a presentation. The curriculum then dives into the core functionalities, teaching you how to structure content with text, bullets, and layouts. A significant focus is placed on visual storytelling, where you will learn to incorporate and format a wide range of visual aids, including shapes, high-quality graphics, icons, charts for data representation, and even interactive 3D models. You will also explore different presentation views like Normal, Slide Sorter, and Presenter View to efficiently manage and deliver your slideshows. Upon completion, you will be equipped to design, develop, and deliver professional PowerPoint presentations that effectively convey your message and capture your audience's attention.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft Projects for the Web
desc: Dive into the functionalities of Microsoft Project for the Web and transform your approach to project management. This course is designed to get you up to speed with this versatile, web-based tool, starting from the very basics of project creation to leveraging its most powerful features. You will learn to build and organize task lists, set durations, establish dependencies, and structure your project for clarity and success. The curriculum explores how to assign resources, estimate effort, and track progress through various views like Grid, Board, and Timeline, ensuring your projects stay on schedule. Furthermore, the course delves into advanced capabilities such as setting project-level goals, creating executive roadmaps for high-level reporting, and integrating with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Groups for seamless collaboration. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in using Project for the Web to manage schedules, resources, and stakeholder communications, leading to more efficient and successful project delivery in any professional environment.

title: Microsoft SharePoint
desc: Embark on a journey to master the essentials of Microsoft SharePoint. This course is designed for individuals seeking to enhance their digital productivity and collaboration skills within a professional environment. You will learn why SharePoint is a critical tool for modern organizations, moving beyond basic file storage to create dynamic intranet sites for projects and teams. The curriculum covers the practical steps of creating both private Team Sites for close collaboration and broader Communication Sites for engaging with a larger audience. You will gain hands-on knowledge of managing document libraries, publishing news and announcements to keep your team informed, and utilizing lists to track information and manage tasks effectively. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to leverage SharePoint to build a centralized hub for your team's resources, streamline workflows, and foster a more connected and efficient work environment.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft Teams
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials and public sector employees with the essential skills to effectively use Microsoft Teams. In today's digital-first work environment, seamless collaboration is key to productivity, and this program offers a complete guide to mastering this powerful tool. The course begins with the basics of installation and setup, ensuring all users can get started regardless of their technical background. You will then dive into the core functionalities, learning how to manage one-on-one and group chats, create and organize teams and channels for specific projects, and conduct effective online meetings and calls. Furthermore, the course explores advanced features that drive efficiency, such as file sharing and co-authoring, using the scheduling assistant to find mutual availability, and streamlining processes with the approvals feature. Upon completion, you will be able to confidently navigate Microsoft Teams, fostering better communication and collaboration within your department and contributing to a more connected and productive public service.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft Word Advanced
desc: Take your Microsoft Word skills to the next level with this advanced course focused on creating complex, professional, and dynamic documents. This training moves beyond basic text editing to cover the powerful features required in modern administrative and corporate environments. You will learn why these advanced tools are crucial for efficiency and professionalism in document management. The course delves into key learning areas such as the intricate art of table creation and formatting, where you will learn to apply styles, insert formulas for calculations, and manage headers across multiple pages. You will also master paragraph styles for consistent formatting, use the Find and Replace feature for advanced edits, and create visually appealing titles with WordArt. Furthermore, the curriculum covers the integration of multimedia objects like audio and video, and the proper wrapping of text around images. Upon completion, you will be able to confidently build and manage large, structured documents, complete with automated elements like a Table of Figures, and save them in various formats like PDF, ensuring your work is both impressive and distributable.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Microsoft Word Beginners
desc: This foundational course is designed to build functional computer literacy by mastering Microsoft Word. It addresses the need for efficient and professional document creation within the public sector. The program begins with an introduction to the Word interface, guiding learners through the various ribbon menus and their functions. Key learning areas include comprehensive text and paragraph formatting, applying styles, and setting up page layouts for different types of documents. Participants will learn to use powerful proofreading tools like the spelling and grammar checker to ensure accuracy and professionalism. The course also covers navigating large documents, inserting and aligning objects such as pictures and tables, and utilizing collaborative features like Track Changes. By the end of this training, learners will be able to confidently create, manage, and finalize a wide range of official documents, from simple letters to complex reports, thereby improving their day-to-day productivity and contributing to effective citizen-centric service delivery.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Migration from 3G of 4G
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the architectural evolution from 3G to 4G mobile communication systems. It begins by establishing the context of the existing 3G network, detailing the WCDMA architecture, its core network (CS and PS cores), and radio access components like the RNC. The course then transitions to the 4G network, introducing the System Architecture Evolution (SAE) concept and the Evolved Packet Core (EPC). Key learning areas include the functions of new 4G nodes such as the Mobility Management Entity (MME), Serving Gateway, PDN Gateway, and the E-UTRAN's eNodeB, contrasting them with their 3G predecessors. The final module synthesizes this knowledge by outlining the practical migration path, explaining how legacy systems like SGSN and GGSN are upgraded or integrated into the new EPC framework. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze the technical requirements and architectural changes involved in upgrading a telecommunications network to 4G LTE standards.

title: Migration from National Pension Scheme to Unified Pension Scheme
desc: This course is designed to empower Central Government employees to confidently navigate the transition from the National Pension System (NPS) to the new Unified Pension Scheme (UPS). The transition represents a significant policy shift aimed at enhancing post-retirement financial security, and this program provides the necessary knowledge to manage it effectively. The curriculum begins by explaining the core features of the UPS, contrasting it with the NPS to highlight the benefits of a guaranteed monthly pension. It clearly outlines the eligibility criteria, required documentation, and official timelines, ensuring learners are fully informed before starting the process. The course then provides a detailed, practical walkthrough of the online migration procedure on the e-NPS portal. It covers every step, from PRAN entry and Aadhaar-based verification to the final submission of Form A-2 and tracking the acknowledgment. By completing this course, participants will not only be able to execute their own migration seamlessly but also understand the long-term financial advantages of the UPS, enabling better retirement planning.

title: Migration To 5G
desc: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of the transition to 5G mobile communication. It begins by establishing the context for 5G, highlighting the limitations of previous network generations and the global demand for faster, more reliable connectivity. The curriculum delves into the technical specifications and releases standardized by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), which form the foundation of 5G technology. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the 5G network architecture, contrasting it with 4G LTE to explain improvements in latency and efficiency through concepts like flat architecture and Cloud-RAN. The course also covers the three primary phases of 5G deployment: Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB), Massive Machine Type Communication (mMTC) for the Internet of Things (IoT), and Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication (URLLC) for critical applications. Upon completion, learners will understand the fundamental technologies, deployment strategies, and transformative potential of 5G networks.

title: Military Receivable Order (MRO)
desc: This course is designed to build foundational knowledge on the Military Receivable Order (MRO), an essential instrument for managing payments in favour of the Ministry of Defence. The content provides a structured orientation for officials, particularly those new to the Defence Accounts Department (DAD). Learners will explore the complete lifecycle of an MRO, starting from its purpose and key features, moving through its detailed workflow, and concluding with the specific accounting procedures required for reconciliation. The course clarifies the distinct roles and responsibilities of the Defence Accounts Department and its field offices, such as the Principal Controller of Defence Accounts (PCDA) and Controller of Defence Accounts (CDA). Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the necessary understanding to accurately handle and account for MROs, contributing to financial discipline and efficiency within the defence accounting framework.

title: Millets: The Nutritional Power House
desc: Delve into the world of millets, the ancient grains making a modern comeback for their exceptional nutritional and environmental benefits. This course offers a detailed exploration of why millets are considered a nutritional powerhouse. You will learn to identify various types of millets like Jowar (Sorghum), Bajra (Pearl Millet), and Ragi (Finger Millet), and understand their unique properties. The curriculum covers the comprehensive nutritional profile of millets, highlighting their superiority over common cereals in terms of fiber, protein, and micronutrients. The course explains the profound health benefits of incorporating millets into your diet, including their role in managing chronic conditions like diabetes, heart disease, and obesity. Furthermore, it sheds light on the sustainability of millet cultivation, emphasizing their low water usage, pest resistance, and positive impact on soil health, aligning with global efforts for food security and climate action. You will also learn about the Government of India's initiatives to promote these 'Shri Anna' grains, empowering you to make informed dietary choices for personal and planetary well-being.

title: Mine Safety and Risk Management
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of mine safety guidelines and their critical role in preventing accidents, protecting workers, and ensuring safe mining operations. It covers core safety principles, mine environment management, fire and explosion prevention, roof and ground control, drilling and blasting safety, transportation and machinery safety, emergency preparedness, worker health and welfare, and legal and regulatory compliance. Participants will gain practical knowledge to maintain safe working conditions and promote a culture of safety in mining operations.

title: Mineral Potential
desc: This detailed course is designed for professionals and students in the geological sciences, offering an in-depth exploration of mineral prospecting. The program begins by defining prospecting and its various stages, from reconnaissance to detailed exploration. It systematically examines the geological criteria—including lithological, stratigraphic, structural, and mineralogical guides—for locating valuable metallic deposits like gold, copper, bauxite, chromite, and iron. The course also covers non-metallic resources such as diamond, graphite, coal, and glauconite, which is a key source of potash. Special focus is given to the exploration of strategic resources like Platinum Group Elements (PGE) and Rare Earth Elements (REE), discussing their geological environments, deposit types, and economic significance. Learners will understand the practical application of these principles through Indian and global case studies, such as the Kolar Gold Fields and the Bushveld Complex. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in identifying geological indicators and applying systematic prospecting methods to discover and assess economic ore deposits, contributing to national resource security.

title: Minimum Alternate Tax under the Income Tax Act
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) and Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) provisions within India's Income Tax Act, 1961. It addresses the core purpose of these taxes: to create a more equitable tax system where entities availing significant deductions or exemptions still contribute a minimum level of tax. The curriculum delves into the specifics of Section 115JB, outlining the applicability of MAT to companies and AMT to non-corporate taxpayers like LLPs and individuals with adjusted incomes over ₹20 lakhs. Learners will explore the practical aspects of computing 'book profit' and 'adjusted total income,' applying the respective tax rates of 15% for MAT and 18.5% for AMT. The course also covers the crucial mechanism of MAT/AMT credit, explaining how it can be carried forward for up to 15 years and set off against future tax liabilities. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to navigate MAT/AMT regulations, ensure accurate compliance, and make informed decisions in tax planning.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Mining Contracts and Procurement Management
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of mining contracts and the associated procurement processes. Learners will gain insights into various types of mining contracts and the complete contract lifecycle—from identification of work and preparation of estimates to tendering, issuance of the Letter of Acceptance (LOA), contract execution, and closure. The course also emphasizes legal and regulatory compliance, effective management of contract changes and deviations, and dispute resolution, enabling participants to efficiently manage mining contracts in accordance with established procedures.

title: Ministry of Cooperation: Role and Functions and Key Institutions
desc: India’s cooperative movement is a strong socio-economic system that supports livelihoods, strengthens communities, and promotes inclusive development. Cooperatives play a key role in empowering farmers, fishermen, dairy producers, and women-led enterprises by enabling access to markets, financial resources, and opportunities based on collective ownership and democratic decision-making. Over time, small cooperative societies have evolved into one of the world’s largest cooperative ecosystems, supported by the Ministry of Cooperation and strengthened through initiatives such as the National Cooperative Database. Despite significant growth, the sector continues to face challenges related to governance, digital adoption, and professional management. This course explores the evolution, structure, functions, and institutional framework of India’s cooperative ecosystem. It highlights the role of key institutions such as NCDC, NCCT, and VAMNICOM.

title: Ministry of Defence - Know Your Ministry
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth introduction to the Ministry of Defence (MoD) and its pivotal role in safeguarding India's sovereignty. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear understanding of the ministry's organizational architecture and its operational mandate. Participants will explore the specific functions of the five departments that form the ministry's backbone: the Department of Defence (DoD), the Department of Defence Production (DDP), the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO), the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DESW), and the Department of Military Affairs (DMA). The course explains how these departments work in synergy to manage the armed forces, oversee defence production, drive research and innovation, and support veterans. Upon completion, learners will have a solid grasp of the MoD's structure and functions, enabling them to better comprehend its role in national policy and governance.

title: Ministry of Heavy Industries - Know Your Ministry
desc: This foundational course is designed to provide a thorough overview of the Ministry of Heavy Industries and its pivotal role in shaping India's industrial sector. It begins by establishing the context of the ministry, detailing its vision, mission, and primary functions. You will explore the organizational structure, understanding how different components work together to achieve strategic goals. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) and Autonomous Bodies under the ministry's purview, clarifying their objectives and operational responsibilities. Furthermore, the course delves into the various schemes and citizen-centric initiatives spearheaded by MHI, offering learners a holistic view of its policy implementation and public outreach efforts. Upon completion, participants will be well-versed in the ministry's structure and purpose, enabling them to better understand its impact on the national economy and governance.

title: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting - Induction Module
desc: This induction module serves as an essential guide to the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB), the principal communication arm of the Government of India. The course establishes context by explaining the ministry's critical role in disseminating information about government policies and managing the nation's vast media ecosystem. Key learning areas are structured across seven modules, covering the ministry's mandate, vision, and the specific functions of its Information, Broadcasting, Films, and Finance wings. Learners will explore the operations of key bodies like Prasar Bharati, Press Information Bureau (PIB), and the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), alongside the legal frameworks such as the Cable Television Networks Act. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to navigate the ministry's functions and understand its significant impact on media regulation and public discourse.

title: Ministry Of Mines - Legal and Regulatory Framework (Part 9)
desc: This detailed course offers an in-depth exploration of the legal landscape of the Indian mining industry, crucial for officials involved in governance and resource management. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957, and its significant amendments, which introduced a transparent auction regime. It also covers the Offshore Areas Mineral (Development and Regulation) Act, 2002, extending regulatory oversight to India's maritime zones. Participants will analyze the strategic vision of the National Mineral Policy 2019, which emphasizes sustainable mining and economic growth. The course further explains the operational and financial aspects of the sector, including royalty frameworks, licensing procedures, and the role of technology in curbing illegal mining. By examining welfare initiatives like the District Mineral Foundation (DMF) and the Pradhan Mantri Khanij Kshetra Kalyan Yojana (PMKKKY), learners will be prepared to apply this legal knowledge to foster equitable and responsible development in mining-affected regions.

title: Ministry of Mines - Technology and Innovation(Part 6)
desc: Designed for new entrants to the Ministry of Mines, this course delves into the transformative impact of technology on modern mining. It begins by establishing the context of international best practices, focusing on sustainable and responsible operations. Learners will explore a range of cutting-edge technologies, including the use of drones and satellite imagery for surveys and surveillance, AI and data analytics for process optimization, and blockchain for supply chain transparency. The course provides a detailed look at specific Indian government initiatives aimed at modernizing the sector, such as the Mining Surveillance System (MSS) to curb illegal mining, the Star Rating of Mines for promoting sustainable practices, and the adoption of 5G for enhanced connectivity and automation. Upon completion, participants will have a holistic understanding of how technology is shaping a safer, more efficient, and environmentally sustainable future for the Indian mining industry.

title: Ministry of Mines - Understanding of Strategic Minerals (Part-4)
desc: This program is designed to build a foundational understanding of strategic and critical minerals. Learners will explore the key differences between these mineral types and the criteria used for their classification by various nations, including the US, EU, and Australia. The course delves into the complex global landscape of mineral production and refining, analyzing the supply chain vulnerabilities and geopolitical factors that impact mineral security. A significant focus is placed on India's strategic response, covering national policies like the Panchamrit initiative, the role of entities such as KABIL, and the comprehensive three-stage process used by the Ministry of Mines to identify and manage a list of 30 critical minerals. Furthermore, the curriculum explains the concept of mineral endowment, resource assessment, and the status of key mineral reserves in India, such as lithium and cobalt, providing a holistic view of the nation's mineral resource strategy.

title: Ministry Of Mines -Global Context Dynamics of Market Trends (Part5)
desc: This training program offers a deep dive into the international landscape of the mining industry, designed for officials seeking to understand global dynamics. The course begins by establishing a foundation in international best practices for environmental, social, and operational excellence in mining. It then examines key market trends, including the shift towards ESG standards and the surging demand for battery and critical minerals driven by the energy transition. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to the complex regulatory and financial frameworks governing the sector. Learners will explore policies related to Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), and the role of the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) in shaping India's mineral trade. The course also addresses the critical dimensions of geopolitical risks, resource nationalism, and supply chain resilience.

title: Ministry of Mines -Mine of the Future - Digital Transformation(Part 7)
desc: This course delves into the pivotal role of digital transformation in shaping the future of the mining industry. It is designed to provide a thorough understanding of how modern technologies are being integrated into every facet of mining, from exploration to processing. The curriculum begins by defining the 'Digital Mine' and contrasting it with traditional methods, highlighting the shift towards data-driven operations. Key learning areas include the application of automation and robotics, smart sensors and the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI) for predictive analytics, and the use of Digital Twins for simulation and optimization. The course also provides a crucial, context-specific analysis of the challenges faced by the Indian mining industry, such as infrastructure constraints and regulatory hurdles, while outlining the strategic success factors necessary for a successful digital transition. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize the potential of digital technologies to enhance productivity, safety, and environmental sustainability in mining, preparing them for the next generation of industry practices.

title: Ministry Of Mines- Challenges and Opportunities in Mining (Part 10)
desc: This module offers a detailed exploration of the multifaceted Indian mining industry, designed to provide a holistic understanding for professionals entering the sector. The course delves into the critical challenges that shape the industry, including the environmental impact of mining activities like deforestation and pollution, the complexities of regulatory frameworks that can cause project delays, and the socio-economic issues of community displacement and illegal mining. Concurrently, it presents a forward-looking perspective on the vast opportunities available. These include leveraging advanced technologies like AI and automation for enhanced efficiency and safety, the potential for significant infrastructure development, and the capacity to generate employment and boost export earnings. Learners will gain insights into the strategic importance of balancing resource extraction with environmental stewardship and social equity. The course concludes by underscoring the necessity of a collaborative approach to ensure the mining sector's growth is both sustainable and economically beneficial for the nation.

title: Ministry of Mines- Understanding the Mining Industry (Part 3)
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of the mining sector, designed for professionals entering the field. It begins by establishing the context of the mining industry's economic importance and the crucial role of governmental bodies like the Ministry of Mines. The curriculum delves into the practical aspects of mining, providing a clear differentiation between major techniques such as surface, underground, placer, and in-situ mining, outlining the advantages and specific applications of each. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to addressing the environmental responsibilities of the industry, highlighting the necessity of sustainable practices to balance resource extraction with ecological preservation. Upon completion, learners will be able to navigate the complex world of mineral classification, understanding international reporting standards like CRIRSCO, and distinguish between mineral resources and reserves. This knowledge is essential for effective resource management, policy-making, and regulatory oversight in the mining domain.

title: Ministry of Mines-Overview (Part 1)
desc: This foundational module serves as an essential guide for anyone new to the Ministry of Mines. It is designed to provide a clear and structured overview of the ministry's critical role within the Indian government and the national economy. The course begins by detailing the ministry's primary functions, mission, and vision, emphasizing sustainable and transparent mineral resource management. Learners will explore the complete administrative hierarchy, from the Secretary of Mines to the section-level staff, understanding the responsibilities associated with each key position. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to a detailed examination of the various divisions within the ministry, such as Mines 1 through Mines 6, the International Cooperation section, and the Vigilance Cell. It explains their specific roles in exploration, administration, policy formulation, legislative amendments like the MMDR Act, and international collaboration. By completing this course, participants will be well-equipped with the necessary knowledge to navigate the ministry's structure and contribute effectively to its objectives.

title: Ministry Of Mines-Safety, Sustainability, Envr Responsibility (Part8)
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the essential pillars of modern mining: safety, sustainability, and environmental stewardship. It is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the legal and ethical obligations for mining professionals in India. The curriculum begins with an in-depth look at the regulatory guidelines on environmental protection and mine safety, specifically covering Rules 35 to 44 of the MCDR 2017. Participants will learn about the roles of key bodies like the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM) and the Directorate General of Mine Safety (DGMS). Key learning areas include the National Mineral Policy 2019, the implementation of the Sustainable Development Framework (SDF) through the star rating system, social impact assessments, and the procedures for scientific mine closure and rehabilitation, such as Progressive and Final Mine Closure Plans (PMCP & FMCP). Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these principles to ensure compliance, mitigate environmental impact, and contribute to a sustainable and responsible mining ecosystem.

title: Ministry of Mines-Value Chain (Part 2)
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the intricate processes of the mineral resource industry, providing a complete journey through its value chain. The program is designed to build a foundational understanding of how mineral resources are discovered, extracted, processed, and delivered to the market, which is crucial for effective governance and regulation in the mining sector. Participants will begin by learning about geological exploration and development, including survey stages, resource estimation, and feasibility studies. The curriculum then progresses to detailed modules on mining operations, covering both surface and underground techniques, the equipment involved, and principles of blasting and excavation. Following extraction, the course explores ore processing and concentration, detailing methods like crushing, grinding, flotation, and leaching. It further examines the smelting and refining stages used to purify metals, along with essential practices for byproduct recovery, waste management, and emission control. The final module addresses the critical role of logistics and transportation in the mining supply chain. Upon completion, learners will possess a holistic perspective on the mining industry, enabling them to contribute effectively to creating a sustainable and efficient mineral resource sector.

title: Ministry of Parliament Affairs Module 1 - Overview of the Parliament
desc: This course is designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to the Indian Parliament, a cornerstone of the nation's democratic framework. It begins by establishing the constitutional basis of the Parliament, explaining why a deep understanding of its functions is crucial for public servants. The curriculum delves into the specific composition and roles of both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha, highlighting their unique contributions to the legislative process. Key learning areas include the procedures for enacting laws, the mechanisms for parliamentary oversight of the government, and the various powers and privileges granted to its members. Upon completion, learners will have a clear and structured understanding of the Parliament's functions, enabling them to better comprehend its impact on national governance and policy-making. This knowledge is essential for any official whose work intersects with the legislative and administrative processes of the government.

title: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs: History Role and Functions
desc: This foundational course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs. It begins by tracing the historical evolution of the ministry, setting the context for its current role. The curriculum then delves into the ministry's core mission, vision, and the critical functions it performs as outlined in the Allocation of Business Rules. Learners will gain a clear picture of the organizational hierarchy and the specific duties of each division and section, from legislative coordination to managing parliamentary assurances. Upon completion, participants will be able to appreciate the ministry's pivotal role in facilitating the smooth functioning of India's parliamentary democracy and its contribution to effective governance.

title: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs: Overview of Consultative Committees
desc: This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of the role and functioning of Consultative Committees in the Indian parliamentary system. It delves into the procedural framework that governs these committees, which are vital for informal consultations between government ministries and Members of Parliament. The content explains why these committees are constituted and details their specific functions. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process of committee constitution, the logistics of organizing meetings, and the protocols for agenda setting and paper circulation. Learners will also gain practical knowledge about the nomination process for MPs to various committees, councils, and boards, and their entitlements. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the CCMS portal, a digital tool for managing committee affairs. Upon completion, officials will be better equipped to support and engage with the legislative process, ensuring smooth and informed parliamentary business.
subDomain: Submission of briefs, supply of information

title: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
desc: This foundational course is designed to familiarize learners with the core purpose and operational structure of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE). The module begins by tracing the ministry's evolution and outlining its primary objectives in the context of Indian governance. It provides a detailed walkthrough of the organizational hierarchy, clarifying the roles and responsibilities of personnel at various levels. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to explaining the functions of each of the eight specialized divisions within the department, shedding light on how they work to create and implement welfare schemes. Upon completion, learners will have a solid understanding of the ministry's structure and its critical role in advancing social justice, inclusion, and empowerment for Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, senior citizens, and other disadvantaged groups, enabling them to better navigate their roles within the governmental ecosystem.
org: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Ministry of Textiles - Induction Module
desc: This induction module serves as an essential guide to the Indian textile sector and the functions of the Ministry of Textiles. The course begins by establishing the context of the textile industry's significance to the Indian economy. Learners will explore the complete textile manufacturing value chain, from raw materials to finished goods. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to demystifying the role of the Ministry of Textiles, detailing its responsibilities in policy-making, planning, and the execution of crucial schemes designed to foster industry growth and competitiveness. The module also highlights the ministry's adoption of digital tools through its e-Governance initiatives. Upon completion, participants will have a foundational understanding of the textile ecosystem and the governmental framework that supports it, enabling them to effectively contribute to the ministry's objectives.

title: Mission 3000 MT
desc: Delve into the strategic framework of Mission 3000 MT, a pivotal plan by the Indian Ministry of Railways designed to significantly boost freight transportation capacity. This course addresses the context behind the mission, highlighting why increasing rail's logistics share from 27% to over 40% is crucial for India's economic competitiveness and environmental goals. You will explore the primary challenges hindering freight growth, such as network congestion, last-mile connectivity, and rigid policy frameworks. The curriculum details the comprehensive action plan, covering crucial capacity enhancement works, augmentation of rolling stock like locomotives and wagons, and key policy interventions aimed at inducing a modal shift from road to rail. Learners will gain an in-depth understanding of the strategies for infrastructure upgrades, dynamic pricing, improved service delivery, and the adoption of new technologies to make rail freight more efficient, reliable, and customer-centric. This course is essential for officials involved in transportation, logistics, and infrastructure planning.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Mission Karmayogi Guidelines
desc: Mission Karmayogi represents a fundamental shift in civil service capacity building, moving from a rule-based to a role-based HR management system. This course is designed to provide a detailed walkthrough of the official guidelines that govern this transformative initiative. It addresses the critical need for all government entities to understand their part in creating a future-ready civil service. Key learning areas include the strategic vision of the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB), the structure of the iGOT Karmayogi platform, and the operational responsibilities of Ministries, Departments, and Training Institutes. Upon completion, learners will be able to articulate the objectives of Mission Karmayogi, identify their organization's specific duties in its implementation, and contribute to the successful rollout of this national priority program, ultimately enhancing governance and public service delivery.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Mission Poshan 2.0: Policy Guidelines and Anganwadi Services
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the policy framework and operational guidelines of Mission Poshan 2.0. It is designed for officials and frontline workers involved in public health and nutrition. The curriculum begins by tracing the evolution of India's National Nutrition Programme, establishing the context for the launch of Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0. Key learning areas include the core components and objectives of these flagship initiatives, the population norms for Anganwadi Centres, and the range of services they provide. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the Supplementary Nutrition Programme and its significance. A major focus is placed on community mobilization, detailing the 'Jan Andolan' initiative, the role of Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Days (VHSNDs), and the promotion of Poshan Vatikas. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to articulate policy details, analyze program strategies, and understand their role in achieving national nutrition goals.

title: Mission Youth: A Journey to Empowerment
