desc: The case focuses on Dr. Shahid Iqbal Choudhary's Mission Youth initiative in Jammu and Kashmir, launched in 2021 to address youth unemployment and disenfranchisement, successfully securing Rs. 200 crores and driving job creation and youth engagement.

title: Mobile Base Station and its Maintenance
desc: This course offers an in-depth guide to the deployment and upkeep of modern 4G mobile base stations, with a special focus on the Tejas eNodeB systems being implemented in BSNL's Phase IX.2 project. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundational understanding, starting with the evolution of mobile access networks from 2G to 5G. Learners will then explore the detailed architecture and components of the Tejas 4G eNodeB, including the Baseband Unit (BBU), Remote Radio Head (RRH), and associated infrastructure like power plants and antennas. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to practical application, covering the complete installation process, physical connectivity, and transport requirements for linking the Radio Access Network (RAN) to the core network. Participants will also learn critical maintenance procedures for all base station elements, including how to identify and rectify common faults such as high VSWR. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in the operational management and maintenance of 4G base station sites, ensuring network reliability and performance.

title: Mobile Device and SIM Card Forensic Investigation Techniques
desc: This course introduces the importance of SIM card and mobile device forensics in digital investigations. SIM cards store critical information such as IMSI, ICCID, contacts, call logs, SMS messages, and location data, which play a key role in reconstructing events and identifying user activities during investigations. The course also covers essential forensic techniques, including logical acquisition, SIM cloning, JTAG, and chip-off analysis, used for extracting and recovering digital evidence from mobile devices. In addition, it provides an overview of widely used commercial, open-source, and free forensic tools such as Cellebrite UFED, MSAB XRY, Autopsy, and SCRCPY, which support the extraction, analysis, recovery, and presentation of digital evidence. The focus of the course is to ensure forensic accuracy, legal compliance, and the integrity of evidence throughout the investigation process.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Mobile Device Encryption and Forensic Evidence Analysis
desc: This course explores the critical role of encryption in mobile forensics and the challenges it poses during investigations. Learners will understand how secured data on mobile devices can restrict access to crucial evidence and examine techniques to decode or decrypt such information. The course also covers mobile security mechanisms, the process of analyzing encrypted evidence, and how investigators transform protected data into meaningful forensic insights while maintaining legal and procedural compliance.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

Significance of Potential Evidence in Mobile Phone

title: Mobile Devices Operating Systems and Handling at Scene of Crime
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of mobile devices and the techniques required to handle them safely during forensic investigations. It explains the role of mobile operating systems and emphasizes the importance of preserving digital evidence at the Scene of Crime (SOC) without any alteration. Learners will follow the investigative journey from analyzing mobile communications to legally seizing devices as evidence. The course also covers standard crime scene protocols related to mobile devices and provides guidance on effectively investigating them by applying proper OS knowledge and SOC practices to ensure accurate, reliable, and legally defensible results.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
keywords: Mobile Devices Operating Systems and Handling at SOC
Overview of Mobile Communication Systems and Operating Systems

title: Mobile Network Cell Info Codes
desc: Dive into the technical standards that underpin modern mobile communication with this detailed course on network cell information codes. This program is designed for professionals seeking to understand the architecture of 4G LTE networks. The course begins by introducing the concept of Cell Global Identity (CGI) as a unique global identifier for base stations. It then breaks down the components of CGI, including the Mobile Country Code (MCC) for country identification, the Mobile Network Code (MNC) for service providers, the Tracking Area Code (TAC) for location grouping, and the Cell ID (CID) for individual cell identification. Learners will also explore related concepts like Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) and Tracking Area Identity (TAI). The course concludes with a comparative analysis of cell identity structures in 4G (ECI) and 5G (NCGI), highlighting the evolution of these standards to accommodate next-generation network demands. Upon completion, you will be able to interpret these codes and understand their critical role in network operation and device tracking.

title: Mobile Number Portability and eSIM Framework
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Mobile Number Portability (MNP) guidelines and the eSIM framework—two critical components of India’s evolving telecommunications ecosystem. It covers the regulatory, procedural, and technological aspects required to operate in a subscriber-centric environment. The course explains the MNP ecosystem, including key stakeholders, porting procedures, eligibility criteria, and valid grounds for rejection, in alignment with regulations set by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) and governed by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT). The eSIM module explores the functioning of embedded SIM technology, including activation, provisioning, and supporting infrastructure. It also highlights the applications of eSIM in IoT and M2M communications, along with aspects such as portability, switching mechanisms, regulatory compliance, security standards, and current limitations.

title: Mobility Training
desc: In an effort to promote holistic well-being, this course provides a comprehensive introduction to mobility training. It is designed to equip learners with the knowledge and practical skills to enhance their body's functional movement capabilities. The curriculum begins by explaining the importance of mobility for overall health, injury prevention, and improved athletic performance. You will learn to perform a series of foundational exercises, including dynamic stretches, bodyweight movements, and yoga-inspired poses, all demonstrated with a focus on proper form and safety. Key areas covered include neck and shoulder stretches, hip mobility exercises like the butterfly stretch, and functional movements such as squats and lunges. By the end of this course, you will be able to create a simple yet effective mobility routine that can be integrated into your daily life. This training is essential for maintaining physical health, reducing muscle stiffness, and boosting overall energy, enabling a more active and productive lifestyle.

title: Mode of Taking and Recording Evidence in Inquiries and Trials
desc: The introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, has reformed key aspects of India's criminal justice process. This course offers an in-depth analysis of Chapter XXV, specifically Sections 307 to 318, which govern the mode of taking and recording evidence in inquiries and trials. Understanding these procedures is crucial for ensuring that judicial proceedings are conducted with fairness, transparency, and accuracy. The course systematically covers the provisions related to the language of courts, the method of recording evidence in different types of cases (summons, warrant, and sessions trials), and the procedure for interpreting evidence for the accused and their legal counsel. It also details the legal requirements for an interpreter's duties, the necessity of the accused's presence, and the sensitive handling of evidence involving victims of sexual offences. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these legal standards correctly, uphold procedural integrity, and contribute to a more just and efficient judicial system by preventing procedural errors and ensuring the rights of all individuals are respected.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Model Artificial Intelligence Law
desc: This course delves into India's proposed Model AI Law, a forward-looking legal framework designed to balance innovation with accountability in the age of artificial intelligence. It addresses the critical need for a regulatory structure that can manage the complexities of AI while aligning with national strategic goals. Learners will explore the core components of the law, from foundational definitions of 'AI Developer' and 'Foundation Models' to the risk-based 'Negative-List Licensing' system. The curriculum details the specific obligations placed on AI creators and deployers, including requirements for safety audits, algorithmic transparency, and ethical reviews. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the interplay with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, highlighting how data privacy principles are integrated into AI governance. By the end of this course, participants will have a clear understanding of the proposed regulatory landscape, enabling them to navigate compliance, contribute to policy discussions, and apply ethical considerations to AI development and deployment in the public sector.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Modern Tools and Techniques for Nursery
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of contemporary tools and techniques for effective nursery management. It addresses the need for increased efficiency and sustainability in plant cultivation by introducing modern methodologies. Key learning areas include the integration of automation and smart technology to streamline operations, the use of soilless cultivation like hydroponics and aeroponics, and the application of sustainable pest and disease management. Furthermore, the course covers the importance of composting, organic fertilizers, and data management tools for optimizing nursery functions and making informed decisions. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these advanced practices to develop and manage eco-friendly, efficient, and highly productive nurseries, contributing positively to the agroforestry and environmental sectors.

title: Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme (MACPS), a crucial framework for the career advancement of Central Government employees. The program is designed to provide clarity on how the scheme ensures at least three financial upgradations during an employee's service if they have not received promotions within specified timeframes. The course delves into the key features of MACPS, including its applicability, the methodology for pay fixation upon upgradation, and the distinction between this scheme and regular promotions. Participants will learn to interpret the relevant government orders and guidelines, enabling them to accurately assess eligibility for themselves or their colleagues. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to navigate the procedural aspects of MACPS, understand its impact on their career trajectory, and ensure correct implementation within their organizations.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Module 03 - Learn Grammar Basics
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental principles of Marathi grammar, an essential skill for effective communication in regions where Marathi is a primary language. Understanding grammar is the cornerstone of language proficiency, enabling clear expression and accurate comprehension. This is particularly relevant for public officials and individuals who engage with Marathi-speaking citizens, as it fosters better service delivery and trust. The course systematically covers core grammatical concepts, including parts of speech, verb conjugations, sentence construction, and common idiomatic expressions. Through structured lessons, learners will move from basic understanding to practical application. Upon completion, participants will be able to construct grammatically correct sentences, read official documents and general texts with improved understanding, and engage in spoken conversations with confidence. This module serves as a critical stepping stone for anyone looking to achieve fluency in Marathi for professional or personal growth.

title: Module 06 - Grammar and Formal Informal Conversations
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the Marathi language, focusing on practical communication skills for public service professionals. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundation, starting with essential grammar rules that govern sentence structure and usage. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding the nuances of formal and informal conversations, a crucial skill for effective interaction in diverse social and official environments. By exploring contextual language use, learners will be equipped to communicate appropriately and confidently. The primary outcome is to empower officials to read, write, and speak Marathi, thereby improving citizen engagement and administrative effectiveness in Marathi-speaking regions. This program serves as a vital tool for bridging language barriers and fostering better governance.

title: Module 07 - Grammar, Vocabulary and Picture writing
desc: This comprehensive module provides a structured introduction to the Marathi language, focusing on core components essential for effective communication. The course is particularly beneficial for public officials and individuals seeking to work or interact within the state of Maharashtra. The curriculum begins with fundamental grammar concepts, establishing a strong base for constructing correct sentences. It then expands into vocabulary building, covering words and phrases relevant to everyday conversations and professional environments. A unique feature of this module is 'picture writing,' an exercise designed to enhance descriptive abilities and practical application of learned concepts. Upon completion, learners will have significantly improved their ability to read, write, and speak Marathi, enabling them to communicate confidently and effectively with native speakers, thereby fostering better public service delivery and cultural integration.

title: Module 11 - Grammar and Marathi Culture
desc: This module is designed to equip public officials with the necessary linguistic skills to effectively operate in a Marathi-speaking environment. The course begins with the fundamentals of Marathi grammar, focusing on sentence construction and different sentence types to build a strong grammatical foundation. It then transitions to practical application by introducing a curated list of Marathi terms frequently used in the domains of criminal justice and public administration. This specialized vocabulary will enable learners to understand and draft official communications with greater accuracy and confidence. Furthermore, the course touches upon aspects of Marathi culture to provide a richer context for the language. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to engage with citizens and official documents, enhancing their effectiveness and fostering better governance.

title: Monetary Policy: Impact and Significance in the Telecom Sector
desc: This course delves into the critical role of monetary policy in shaping India's economic landscape, with a specific focus on its significance for the telecom sector. Participants will begin by understanding the core concepts, types, and objectives of monetary policy as implemented by the Reserve Bank of India. The curriculum examines the quantitative and qualitative tools used by policymakers to regulate the economy, manage inflation, and ensure financial stability. A key component of the course is the analysis of how monetary policy directly impacts borrowing costs, investment decisions, and the overall financial health of corporations. Through a targeted case study approach, learners will explore the unique challenges and opportunities these policies create for the Indian telecom industry. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze policy announcements and assess their strategic implications for financial planning and market positioning within the telecommunications domain, enabling more informed and forward-thinking decision-making.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Money And Consciousness: Indian Wisdom and Sri Aurobindo's Vision
desc: In a world often driven by material pursuits, this course offers a profound alternative by exploring the spiritual and ethical dimensions of wealth. It delves into the holistic vision of Indian culture, where material well-being is integrated with spiritual growth. The curriculum is built on timeless wisdom from Itihasa, Dharmashastra, and the transformative teachings of Sri Aurobindo, providing a framework for professionals to cultivate a healthy and conscious relationship with money. Learners will examine the concept of money as a universal force that is currently misaligned but can be reconquered for divine and humanitarian work. The course contrasts different attitudes towards wealth—attachment (Rajasik), denial (Tamasic), and balance (Satvik)—guiding participants toward inner renunciation and contentment rather than outer poverty or excessive accumulation. By understanding these principles, individuals can learn to earn and use wealth dharmically, transforming it into a tool for personal fulfillment and societal good.

title: Money Laundering and Whistle Blowing
desc: The course provides a comprehensive understanding of financial crime, asset concealment, fraud detection, and forensic accounting practices. The course examines the stages of money laundering—placement, layering, and integration—and explores how illicit funds are disguised and integrated into the legitimate economy. Learners gain insights into major money laundering cases in India, hidden asset tracing mechanisms, insolvency-based recovery frameworks, and the role of whistleblowers in fraud detection. The course also highlights India's anti-money laundering framework under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), whistleblower protection mechanisms, and forensic accounting techniques used to investigate complex frauds and corruption cases. Through real-world case studies including the PNB Fraud, Bofors Scandal, and defence procurement corruption cases, participants develop skills to identify red flags, strengthen governance, and promote financial integrity.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Monitoring and Evaluation of Climate Mitigation Initiatives
desc: In an era where climate action is paramount, the ability to effectively measure the impact of mitigation efforts is crucial for informed policymaking and resource allocation. This course, 'Monitoring and Evaluation of Climate Mitigation Initiatives,' offers a structured learning path for professionals involved in environmental governance. The curriculum begins by establishing the context, explaining why M&E is critical for climate initiatives and introducing its key concepts. It then details the components of a successful M&E system, drawing on international best practices. The second module focuses on the practical application of this knowledge, guiding learners through the process of designing and implementing an M&E framework tailored for climate mitigation projects. The final module reinforces learning through the analysis of real-world evaluation case studies, highlighting best practices and lessons learned.

title: Monitoring and Evaluation of Climate Mitigation Initiatives

title: Monitoring of Assurances by Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs
desc: This course delves into the essential governmental function of monitoring and fulfilling parliamentary assurances. It is designed for officials involved in legislative processes, policy implementation, and inter-ministerial coordination. The course begins by establishing the context of parliamentary assurances, explaining why their timely fulfillment is crucial for maintaining legislative accountability and public trust. Learners will gain a detailed understanding of the entire assurance lifecycle, from the initial 'culling-out' of promises made by Ministers to the final submission of Implementation Reports. The course meticulously outlines the specific responsibilities of the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs, administrative ministries, and the pivotal oversight role of the Committee on Government Assurances (CGA). A significant portion of the module is dedicated to the practical application of the Online Assurance Monitoring System (OAMS). Participants will learn how this digital platform facilitates a paperless, efficient, and transparent process for monitoring assurances. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively navigate the procedures related to parliamentary assurances, utilize the OAMS portal for monitoring and reporting, and contribute to the accountability framework that underpins India's parliamentary democracy. This will enable them to ensure their respective departments meet their legislative obligations efficiently.

title: Monitoring System of Riding Quality of Metro Track
desc: In the context of expanding urban mass transit systems, ensuring passenger safety and comfort is paramount. This course delves into the technical methods used for monitoring and maintaining the riding quality of metro tracks. It begins by explaining the concept of the Sperling's Ride Index and how track irregularities like bouncing, lurching, and rolling impact the passenger experience. The core of the program focuses on the practical application of the Oscillation Monitoring System (OMS 2000). Learners will be guided through the entire process, from setting up and calibrating the equipment, including accelerometers, to conducting track recordings. The course details how to analyze the collected data, specifically vertical and lateral acceleration peaks, to classify track quality against established standards. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to perform objective assessments of track conditions, identify sections requiring immediate attention, and contribute to the overall safety and service excellence of metro operations.

title: Moral thinking for action: An introduction to values and ethics
desc: This course is designed to equip public officials with the essential tools for robust ethical reasoning and decision-making. It starts by demystifying philosophy, presenting it as a vital skill for examining the foundational assumptions that guide our actions. Learners will delve into the nature of values, learning to distinguish between intrinsic and extrinsic worth and understanding how values are formed and debated in a collective. The core of the course introduces three fundamental approaches to moral philosophy: consequentialism, which judges actions by their outcomes; deontology, which focuses on inherent duties and rights; and virtue ethics, which emphasizes the character of the moral agent. These theoretical frameworks are then brought into the realm of action, with case studies from the Indian tradition, including K.C. Bhattacharya's concept of 'Swaraj in ideas' and the ethical teachings embedded in Indian epics. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to navigate complex moral dilemmas with clarity, intellectual rigor, and a deeper appreciation for the ethical dimensions of public service.

title: Mormugao Port: History and Evolution of the Golden Gateway
desc: This course explores the 140-year legacy of Mormugao Port, widely known as the Golden Gateway of Goa. It traces the port's evolution from its origins in the late nineteenth century through the colonial era to its emergence as one of India's major modern ports. The course examines key historical milestones, including the 1878 Lisbon Treaty between the British and Portuguese Governments, the construction of the Mormugao Port and the connected railway, and the port's role in facilitating trade across the Arabian Sea. It also highlights the transformation of the port following Goa's liberation and the establishment of the Mormugao Port Trust in 1963, showcasing its contribution to India's maritime trade, economic development, and port modernization.

title: Motivation
desc: Motivation is a fundamental driver of success, enabling individuals to change behaviors, develop new skills, and achieve their objectives. This course provides a comprehensive overview of what motivation is and how it can be harnessed to boost efficiency and engagement. Participants will delve into established motivational theories, most notably Maslow's hierarchy of needs, to understand the different levels of human needs that influence our actions. The course emphasizes the power of self-motivation, offering practical tips such as focusing on past successes and tackling challenging tasks first. A key component is a five-step action plan designed to help learners identify personal motivators and de-motivators, both within and outside the work environment. By applying these insights, learners can create a personalized strategy to stay driven, improve performance, and align their actions with their most important goals, leading to greater professional excellence.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Movement Operations in FCI
desc: This foundational course delves into the intricate logistics and supply chain management of food grain transportation at the Food Corporation of India (FCI). It is designed to explain why these movement operations are fundamental to fulfilling the objectives of India's National Food Security Act. The curriculum covers the identification of surplus and deficit states, the strategic use of different transport modes like rail and road, and the meticulous process of creating monthly movement plans. Participants will learn about key operational aspects, including the management of various wagon types, and the financial implications of logistics, such as demurrage, penalty, and rebooking charges. The course highlights FCI's success in improving efficiency and reducing costs over the years, demonstrating how effective planning and monitoring contribute to the nation's food security. Upon completion, learners will have a clear understanding of the scale, complexity, and importance of FCI's movement operations.

title: Multi Protocol Label Switching-MPLS
desc: Dive into the essential principles of Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS), the technology that powers high-speed service provider networks. This course begins by examining the challenges and delays inherent in traditional IP forwarding, where every router must perform a layer-3 lookup. It then presents MPLS as a superior solution that accelerates data packet delivery by using a label-based switching mechanism, effectively operating at 'Layer 2.5'. You will learn about the core concepts of MPLS, including the structure of the MPLS header, the roles of Ingress, Transit, and Egress Label Switching Routers (LSRs), and the formation of Label Switched Paths (LSPs). The course further explains the distinction between the control plane, where protocols like LDP operate, and the data plane, where the actual high-speed switching occurs. By the end of this session, you will understand how MPLS not only improves network speed but also enables critical services like Quality of Service (QoS) for customer traffic prioritization and Traffic Engineering for efficient network resource management.

title: Multi Tasking Karmayogi - Dakshata
desc: The 'Dakshata' e-learning course provides comprehensive advanced training for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) within the Department of Posts, serving as a vital refresher to elevate their skills and proficiency. The program is contextualized within the mission and organizational structure of India Post, emphasizing the critical support role of MTS in both operational and administrative functions. Key learning areas include detailed procedures for mail handling, sorting, delivery, and dispatch, along with the management of various postal products like Speed Post, registered articles, and parcels. The course also covers essential office management tasks such as record preservation, file movement, and the operation of office equipment like computers, scanners, and photocopiers. Furthermore, it instills principles of workplace excellence, covering cleanliness, office upkeep, security protocols, and providing professional hospitality.

title: Multi Tasking Karmayogi - Prarambh
desc: Welcome to 'Multi Tasking Karmayogi - Prarambh,' an essential induction program for Multi-Tasking Staff joining the Department of Posts. This course serves as the first step in understanding the critical support role that MTS personnel play in maintaining the operational backbone of the world's largest postal network. The curriculum is structured to provide a holistic understanding of the department, starting with its rich history, vision, and mission. Learners will delve into the specific duties of an MTS, from mail handling, sorting, and delivery support to office maintenance, record-keeping, and customer assistance. The course also provides a detailed walkthrough of India Post's diverse products and services, including traditional mail, premium products like Speed Post, and financial services such as Postal Life Insurance and Savings Bank schemes. By completing this course, participants will not only grasp their responsibilities but also understand how their contributions align with the department's goal of being the customer's first choice. This program will build the confidence and competence needed to excel in their role and ensure the smooth functioning of their respective offices.

title: Multi-Criteria Decision Systems for Prioritizing Factors
desc: In the complex landscape of public administration, making objective and justifiable decisions is paramount. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Multi-Criteria Decision Systems, focusing on the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Fuzzy-AHP. These powerful methodologies are essential for any professional involved in strategic planning, policy evaluation, or resource allocation where multiple conflicting objectives and stakeholder interests must be balanced. The curriculum is designed to build both theoretical understanding and practical skills. You will learn to deconstruct complex problems into manageable hierarchies of goals, criteria, and alternatives. The course covers the entire process, from performing pairwise comparisons to assess the relative importance of factors, to calculating consistency ratios to ensure the validity of judgments. Through practical examples drawn from governance, such as infrastructure planning and policy selection, you will see how these tools bring structure and transparency to decision-making. Upon completion, you will be equipped to confidently apply AHP-based models to support rational, evidence-based outcomes in your professional role, ensuring that decisions are both robust and defensible.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Municipal Financing in India
desc: In the context of rapid urbanization, the financial health of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) is paramount for sustainable city development. However, many municipalities in India struggle with limited revenue sources and high dependency on government grants, which can impede their ability to deliver essential urban services and infrastructure. This course, ""Municipal Financing in India,"" is designed to address these challenges by providing a thorough understanding of the principles and practices of municipal finance. Organized into five engaging modules, the curriculum covers the entire spectrum of municipal financial management. Participants will delve into core topics such as revenue enhancement strategies, expenditure control, and the intricacies of budget preparation. The course places a strong emphasis on exploring innovative financing mechanisms, including the issuance of municipal bonds, leveraging public-private partnerships (PPPs), and accessing capital markets. Through a series of national and international case studies, learners will gain practical insights into successful financial reforms and project implementation. Upon completion, officials will be equipped to develop robust financial systems, improve project delivery, and steer their cities towards greater fiscal autonomy and resilience.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Murder Culpable Homicide and Mob Lynching
desc: This course introduces key criminal offences affecting human body under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. You’ll learn how the new criminal law defines culpable homicide, murder, voluntarily causing grievous hurt, unlawful assembly and mob lynching through Sections 100, 101, 117(4), 189, and 103 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita respectively. This course is designed to help you understand the elements of the offences, punishments, exceptions and illustrations to understand practical implications.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Musco-skeleton Injuries-Disaster Response Training
desc: In the chaotic aftermath of a disaster, immediate and appropriate medical care is crucial. This course focuses on one of the most common types of trauma: musculoskeletal injuries. It begins with a foundational overview of the human skeletal system, including the structure of bones and joints. Participants will learn to distinguish between open and closed fractures, as well as recognize the symptoms of dislocations, sprains, and strains. The core of the course is dedicated to pre-hospital treatment protocols. It provides clear, step-by-step instructions on how to stabilize injuries, manage pain, and prevent further damage while awaiting professional medical services. By completing this training, learners, particularly volunteers, will be empowered to act confidently and effectively as first responders, playing a vital role in the chain of survival during emergency and disaster response efforts.

title: My Bharat- A Digital India Project
desc: Explore the My Bharat platform, a pivotal Digital India project designed to catalyze youth development and empowerment across the nation. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the platform's objectives, features, and its role in shaping the future of India's youth. You will learn about the transition from the Yuva platform to the more expansive My Bharat, which offers a multilingual, technology-driven portal for personal and professional growth. The curriculum covers key features such as the CV Builder, Experiential Learning Opportunities (ELO), and the 'Volunteer for Bharat' program, which are designed to equip youth with practical skills and a strong sense of civic duty. Furthermore, the course explains how organizations can partner with My Bharat to connect with enthusiastic young talent, thereby advancing their own goals while contributing to social development. By the end of this course, you will have a clear understanding of how to leverage the My Bharat platform for career advancement, community service, and active participation in nation-building.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: MYERS BRIGGS (PERSONALITY) TYPE INDICATOR (ENGLISH VERSION)
desc: Embark on a journey of self-discovery with this detailed course on the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI). Developed to help individuals understand their own and others' personality preferences, the MBTI is a powerful tool for personal and professional growth. This course begins with the history of the instrument, tracing its origins from Carl Jung's psychological theories to its development by Katharine Briggs and Isabel Myers. You will then explore the core of the MBTI: the four pairs of opposite preferences that determine how we gain energy, perceive information, make decisions, and approach life. The curriculum systematically examines each of the 16 personality types, outlining their unique characteristics, strengths, and potential career paths. The final module focuses on the practical application of MBTI insights in the workplace, covering topics such as enhancing team performance, improving communication, managing stress, and developing leadership skills. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to use this knowledge to foster better collaboration and harness individual potential within your organization.

title: MYERS BRIGGS PERSONALITY TYPE INDICATOR (HINDI VERSION)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम मायर्स-ब्रिग्स व्यक्तित्व प्रकार संकेतक (MBTI) की दुनिया में एक गहन यात्रा है, जिसे सरकारी अधिकारियों को आत्म-जागरूकता और पारस्परिक प्रभावशीलता बढ़ाने में मदद करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत MBTI के ऐतिहासिक संदर्भ से होती है, जिसमें कार्ल जंग के मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रकारों के सिद्धांत से लेकर कैथरीन ब्रिग्स और इसाबेल मायर्स द्वारा इसके विकास तक की जानकारी दी गई है। इसके बाद, शिक्षार्थी चार मूलभूत द्विभाजनों का पता लगाएंगे: एक्सट्रोवर्शन बनाम इंट्रोवर्शन, सेंसिंग बनाम इंट्यूशन, थिंकिंग बनाम फीलिंग, और जजिंग बनाम परसीविंग। पाठ्यक्रम का मुख्य भाग 16 अद्वितीय व्यक्तित्व प्रकारों का विस्तृत विश्लेषण करता है जो इन प्राथमिकताओं के संयोजन से उत्पन्न होते हैं। प्रत्येक प्रकार की विशेषताओं, शक्तियों और संभावित विकास क्षेत्रों पर चर्चा की जाती है, साथ ही उपयुक्त करियर पथों के उदाहरण भी दिए जाते हैं। अंत में, पाठ्यक्रम इस ज्ञान के व्यावहारिक अनुप्रयोगों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, यह दर्शाता है कि कैसे MBTI की समझ बेहतर निर्णय लेने, तनाव प्रबंधन, टीम वर्क और नेतृत्व प्रभावशीलता में योगदान कर सकती है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, शिक्षार्थी अपनी और दूसरों की बेहतर समझ से लैस होंगे, जिससे अधिक सामंजस्यपूर्ण और उत्पादक कार्य वातावरण को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।

title: MyGov Platform for Public Participation and Impact
desc: This course offers a deep dive into the MyGov platform, designed to empower government officials in building a more inclusive and people-driven governance model. It begins by establishing the context of participatory governance and the historical significance of MyGov's launch. Learners will explore the platform's architecture, focusing on the three key pillars of engagement: 'Do' for active tasks, 'Discuss' for thoughtful deliberation, and 'Disseminate' for widespread information outreach. The curriculum details the end-to-end process of collaborating with ministries to launch campaigns, from proposal development to social media promotion. A significant focus is placed on data-driven decision-making, demonstrating how to use MyGov's analytics tools to monitor participation, measure campaign impact, and derive meaningful insights. Upon completion, officials will be proficient in using MyGov to foster robust citizen partnerships and enhance the effectiveness of public initiatives.
subDomain: Management of information on official websites
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: myScheme- A Digital India Initiative
desc: This course introduces the myScheme platform, a national e-marketplace for government schemes launched as part of the Digital India mission. The program is designed to equip government functionaries with a thorough understanding of how this digital public infrastructure simplifies citizen access to welfare benefits. Participants will delve into the core objectives of myScheme, including the easy discovery of schemes, simplification of application processes, and transparent tracking of applications. The course covers key features such as personalized search based on demographics, an eligibility check questionnaire, DigiLocker integration for paperless submissions, and a content management system (CMS) for departments to update scheme information. By understanding the operational journey and future prospects of myScheme, including AI-driven interfaces and integration with platforms like UMANG and e-Shram, learners will appreciate its significance in creating a more accessible, efficient, and citizen-centric governance ecosystem.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Narco-Terrorism: Implications for India's National Security
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of narco-terrorism and its critical impact on the security landscape of India. It begins by defining the concept and tracing its global origins, before focusing on the specific challenges India faces. Learners will analyze India's strategic vulnerability due to its geographical proximity to the world's two largest drug production hubs—the Golden Triangle and the Golden Crescent. The curriculum delves into how narco-terrorism has fueled insurgency and conflict in regions such as Punjab and Jammu & Kashmir, providing historical context and contemporary analysis. Furthermore, the course examines the intersection of drug trafficking with other transnational crimes, including human trafficking, counterfeit currency, and the use of darknet marketplaces. Through case studies, it highlights the counter-strategies employed by Indian law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and paramilitary forces. Upon completion, participants will have a robust framework for understanding and addressing this evolving national security threat.

title: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act
desc: This specialized training program is designed to educate police officials on the intricacies of investigating offenses under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act. The course addresses the critical updates and procedural changes introduced by India's new criminal laws—the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA). Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the legal framework governing narcotics-related crimes and learn how to apply these new laws in practical, on-the-ground scenarios. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of offenses, a step-by-step guide to investigation from initiation to conclusion, and best practices for the collection and preservation of evidence to ensure it meets legal standards. Upon completion, Investigating Officers will be better prepared to build robust, evidence-backed cases, navigate the legal complexities of the new acts, and contribute to more effective enforcement against drug trafficking and abuse. The course serves as an essential resource for ensuring that all investigative actions are conducted with precision, legality, and a high standard of professional competence.

title: Nation Branding
desc: In an interconnected world, a nation's brand is a critical asset influencing its economic and geopolitical fortunes. This course delves into the multifaceted discipline of nation branding, examining the strategic levers that shape global perceptions. It begins by defining the core concepts of branding and trust, drawing parallels from the corporate world before applying them to the national context. The curriculum focuses heavily on 'Brand India,' analyzing its evolution from a historical perspective to its current position as a rapidly growing economic power. Key learning areas include the impact of physical and digital infrastructure, the role of foreign direct investment (FDI), the significance of the 'Ease of Doing Business' index, and the power of the global Indian diaspora. Learners will explore how to strategically manage a nation's image to boost exports, attract tourism, and secure a favorable position in the international community. The course equips public officials with the insights needed to contribute to building a powerful and resilient national brand.

title: National and Global Wildlife Conservation Frameworks
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the institutional and legal structures governing wildlife conservation. It is designed for learners seeking to understand the critical intersection of national policy and global environmental commitments. The curriculum delves into the constitutional basis for wildlife governance in India, providing a detailed look at the mandate and functions of the National Board for Wildlife (NBWL) and State Boards for Wildlife (SBWL). You will learn how these bodies contribute to policy formulation, the approval of projects in protected areas, and strategic conservation planning. Furthermore, the course covers major international wildlife conventions and treaties, examining India’s role and commitments within these agreements. By the end of this course, you will have a clear understanding of how national and international frameworks work in tandem to protect wildlife and biodiversity, supporting both local and global conservation goals.
org: Kundal Academy of Development, Administration and Management (Forests), Kundal, Maharashtra

title: National Digital Trust on PKI and Digital Signature - CCA
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the National Digital Trust framework, built upon Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and governed by the Information Technology Act, 2000. The content is designed to provide a clear understanding of why this ecosystem is critical for modern governance, detailing the functions of the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) and the licensed Certifying Authorities (CAs) it regulates. Learners will delve into the key components of this framework, including the different classes of Digital Signature Certificates (DSCs), the distinction between dongle-based DSCs and online eSign, and their specific use cases in government and commerce. The course also demystifies the underlying technology, explaining concepts such as cryptographic hashing (SHA-256), encryption algorithms (RSA, ECC), and the structure of digital certificates. Upon completion, participants will be able to appreciate the legal, technical, and operational aspects of digital signatures, enabling them to confidently utilize and promote these tools for secure, legally valid electronic transactions and record-keeping within the public sector.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: National e-Vidhan Application for Digital Legislatures
desc: This course delves into the National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA), a key component of the Digital India Programme designed to digitize the work of Parliament and State Legislatures. The primary context for this initiative is the push towards creating a 'One Nation, One Application' ecosystem, making legislative processes more efficient, transparent, and accessible. Learners will be introduced to the core concepts behind NeVA, its strategic objectives, and the benefits it offers to legislative members, officials, and the public. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of the NeVA portal, the Digital House Application for in-session activities, the NeVA e-Book repository, and the user-friendly NeVA Mobile App. Upon completion, participants will understand how these digital tools integrate to create a seamless, paperless legislative environment, thereby strengthening democratic institutions through technology.

title: National Frequency Allocation Plan and Spectrum Management
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the National Frequency Allocation Plan (NFAP), a critical component of India's digital infrastructure. The program is designed to provide a clear understanding of why a structured approach to spectrum management is essential for national progress and technological sovereignty. Learners will delve into the key learning areas, including the NFAP's organizational structure, the regulatory guidelines governing spectrum allocation, and its harmonization with international standards set by bodies like the ITU. Participants will learn how the NFAP framework directly supports the rollout of next-generation technologies such as 5G, the Internet of Things (IoT), and advanced satellite communication systems. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to appreciate the strategic implications of spectrum policy and its impact on diverse stakeholders, from government agencies and telecom operators to technology innovators, positioning them to contribute effectively to India's telecommunications landscape.

title: National Health Mission
desc: This foundational course offers an in-depth exploration of the National Health Mission (NHM), the cornerstone of India's public health system. It is designed to provide a clear understanding of the mission's strategic importance in improving health outcomes across the nation. The course begins by outlining the vision and objectives that drive the NHM, providing context for its critical role in the governance of public health. Learners will examine the key pillars of the mission, including the distinct approaches of the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) and the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM). The curriculum details the structure and components of Ayushman Bharat, India's ambitious universal health coverage scheme, and explains the role of National Quality Assurance Standards (NQAS) in maintaining service quality. Furthermore, the course clarifies the financial architecture of the NHM, including the Programme Implementation Plan (PIP) and other financing mechanisms. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to appreciate the complex, multi-faceted nature of the NHM. They will be able to articulate the functions of its various components and understand how they collectively contribute to strengthening India's healthcare delivery system, making it an essential learning resource for anyone involved in public health policy, planning, or implementation.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: National Highway Land Acquisition: Compensation Awards and Legal Cases
desc: This course continues the study of land acquisition for national highway projects, building on the foundational concepts covered in the previous course, “Land Acquisition for National Highway Projects”. Learners are encouraged to complete the previous course to gain a thorough understanding of land records, title/due diligence, and the land acquisition process under the NH Act, 1956. In this course, learners will gain practical insights into key aspects of land acquisition, including determination of compensation, the use of multiplication factors, and relevant provisions of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013. The course also covers compensation for private structures under the NH Act, 1956, and provides guidance on managing court cases and arbitration related to land acquisition disputes. Additionally, learners will explore the Bhoomi Rashi Portal, its features, and its role in streamlining land acquisition and compensation processes.
keywords: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
National Highway Land Acquisition: Compensation Awards and Legal Cases

title: National Infrastructure Pipeline Domains - Part I
desc: This intensive course offers a detailed examination of the National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP), focusing on its core objectives and sectoral components. It is designed for public officials who require a foundational understanding of India's ambitious infrastructure development agenda. The curriculum begins by contextualizing the NIP as a critical driver for economic growth and improved quality of life. Learners will then embark on a systematic exploration of five key domains: Energy, Ports, Civil Aviation, Railways, and Roads. For each domain, the course analyzes the current landscape, highlights significant achievements, identifies pressing challenges, and discusses proposed solutions. By the end of this course, participants will be able to articulate the strategic importance of the NIP, understand the interdependencies between different infrastructure sectors, and appreciate the policy-level thinking behind India's infrastructure vision. This knowledge is essential for officials involved in planning, finance, and project management roles within the government.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: National Logistics Policy
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the National Logistics Policy (NLP), a landmark initiative designed to transform India's logistics sector. The program begins by defining the concept of logistics and establishing the context for the NLP's creation. Participants will delve into the policy's core vision, objectives, and the specific targets set to enhance efficiency, reduce costs from 14% of GDP to single digits, and significantly improve India's standing in the Logistics Performance Index. A key focus of the course is the Comprehensive Logistics Action Plan (CLAP), which outlines the strategic interventions for the policy's effective execution. By understanding the NLP, learners will gain insight into how an integrated, modern, and resilient logistics framework is critical for driving economic growth, boosting trade competitiveness, and achieving sustainable development in India. The course is essential for officials involved in policy, trade, infrastructure, and economic planning.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: National Long Distance Service (NLD Service)
desc: This detailed course delves into the regulatory landscape of National Long Distance (NLD) services in India, based on the Unified License agreement dated March 31, 2023. It is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the legal and operational obligations for NLD licensees. The curriculum systematically breaks down Chapter 10 of the Unified License, starting with the definition of the service area and the full scope of NLD services, including the carriage of inter-circle and intra-circle traffic. A significant portion is dedicated to the complex financial conditions, explaining the calculation of Gross Revenue, Applicable Gross Revenue (ApGR), and Adjusted Gross Revenue (AGR), which are crucial for license fee determination. Furthermore, the course clarifies the rules for network interconnection, security mandates such as monitoring and CLI transmission, and specific technical conditions. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to interpret and apply the key provisions of the NLD service license, ensuring compliance and effective management within the telecommunications framework.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: National Panchayat Awards: Performance and Evaluation Framework
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the National Panchayat Awards framework, including its guidelines, evaluation processes, and role in promoting excellence in grassroots governance. It highlights how Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) are assessed and recognized based on their performance in governance, service delivery, and sustainable development outcomes. The course covers key components such as Localization of Sustainable Development Goals (LSDGs), administrative and technical Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and the Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI) used for performance measurement. It also explains the structure of awards, the online application and participation process through the official portal, and evidence-based evaluation mechanisms. Learners will gain insights into best practices, innovation at the local level, and successful Panchayat initiatives.

title: National Pension System
desc: The National Pension System (NPS) is a critical tool for ensuring financial security in retirement for Indian citizens. This course is designed to demystify the NPS, offering a structured and practical guide for government employees and the general public. You will begin by understanding the core objectives and legal framework that govern the system. The curriculum then delves into the practical aspects, including the architecture of NPS, the functions of key entities, and the distinctions between Tier I and Tier II accounts. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the flexible contribution and investment options, including different asset classes and fund managers, allowing you to tailor your pension fund to your risk appetite. Furthermore, you will gain a clear understanding of the tax implications and benefits at the investment, accumulation, and withdrawal stages. The course concludes by explaining the conditions and procedures for exit, withdrawal, and annuitization, ensuring you are fully prepared to manage your pension wealth effectively. By the end, you will be empowered to confidently navigate the NPS for optimal retirement planning.

title: National Pension System (NPS) (Prarambh)
desc: The National Pension System (NPS) course offers a detailed exploration of one of India's foremost retirement planning instruments. This program addresses the critical need for financial stability in old age by explaining the architecture and advantages of the NPS. Learners will delve into key concepts such as the mandatory Tier I and optional Tier II accounts, understanding their unique features, withdrawal rules, and significant tax benefits under sections 80C and 80CCD(1B) of the Income Tax Act. The course also clarifies the roles of the regulatory bodies like the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) and other entities such as CRAs and Annuity Service Providers. By the end of this course, participants will be able to analyze different investment choices, including equity, corporate bonds, and government securities, and understand the flexibility offered through features like the Auto Choice option and account portability. This will empower them to strategically plan their investments and secure a regular income stream post-retirement through various annuity options.

title: National Pension System: Concepts and Operations and Services
desc: Planning for retirement is an essential part of long-term financial wellbeing, particularly for government employees who contribute regularly to the National Pension System (NPS). While NPS is a mandatory retirement savings mechanism for many employees, understanding how it operates is equally important for making informed financial decisions throughout one's career. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the National Pension System, beginning with its evolution from the traditional pension framework to a defined contribution model. Learners explore the purpose of NPS, the role of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), subscriber eligibility, and the key features that make NPS a transparent, portable, and market-linked retirement solution. The course then explains how the NPS ecosystem functions, covering essential operational components such as PRAN generation, account registration, contribution processing, the responsibilities of nodal offices.

title: National Perspectives on Energy Conservation
desc: With a growing global emphasis on climate action, this course offers a structured learning path into India's strategic initiatives for energy efficiency and clean energy. It is designed for professionals who need to understand and contribute to the nation's sustainable energy transition. The curriculum delves into the foundational concepts of energy efficiency, analyzing key national policies such as the National Green Hydrogen Mission, PM-KUSUM, and the PAT Scheme. Participants will gain familiarity with energy management systems, including ISO 50001, and learn to interpret energy audit processes and performance indicators. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply practical insights and implement energy-efficient strategies in both public and private sector contexts, thereby enhancing national energy security and supporting India's climate commitments.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly
desc: As India's elderly population grows, providing accessible and specialized healthcare becomes a national priority. This course delves into the National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE), launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to address this need. The curriculum is designed to equip officials with a thorough understanding of the programme's architecture and execution. Key learning areas include the NPHCE's core objectives and strategies, the concept of 'active and healthy ageing', and the specific healthcare challenges faced by seniors. The course meticulously explains the operational framework, detailing the package of services and activities at Sub-Centres, PHCs, CHCs, and District Hospitals. Furthermore, it clarifies the financial management structure, covering the process for fund release and utilization. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to contribute effectively to the management and coordination of the NPHCE, ensuring that its benefits reach the intended beneficiaries.
org: National institute of Health and Family Welfare

title: National Research Foundation: Roles and Responsibilities
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), a key initiative to bolster India's scientific capabilities. It begins by establishing the context for the ANRF's creation, emphasizing the critical role of research and innovation in fostering sustainable economic development across various sectors. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the foundation's core objectives, key activities, and the organizational framework designed to execute its mandate effectively. The curriculum delves into the specifics of the ANRF Act, 2023, clarifying the functions of its Governing Board and Implementation Committee. By exploring this legislative and operational structure, learners will be able to appreciate how the ANRF is positioned to transform India's research landscape, promote a culture of innovation, and contribute significantly to the nation's strategic goals.

title: National Savings Certificates Scheme
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the National Savings Certificates (NSC) Scheme, a key government initiative for promoting savings among individuals. In the context of personal financial planning, understanding such secure investment avenues is crucial for achieving long-term financial stability and security. This program is structured to provide a clear and thorough understanding of every aspect of the NSC scheme. Key learning areas include the core features and benefits, different modes of investment, types of accounts, and the procedures for nomination and certificate transfers. The course also covers the guidelines for premature closure and the process of receiving maturity payments. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to make well-informed decisions, confidently leveraging the NSC scheme as a tool for secure savings and effective tax management, contributing to their overall financial well-being.

title: National Savings Monthly Income Scheme
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the National Savings Monthly Income Scheme (MIS), a key financial product for promoting savings and providing regular income to citizens. The curriculum is designed to build a thorough understanding of the scheme's operational framework, starting from its historical context and legal basis under the Government Savings Promotion Act. Key learning areas include the procedures for opening single and joint accounts, rules governing minimum and maximum deposit limits, and the calculation and payment of monthly interest. The course clarifies the conditions for premature account closure and the associated penalties. It also covers the various methods available for interest withdrawal, such as cash, credit to a post office savings account, or through ECS. By the end of this course, learners will be proficient in the standard procedures for managing MIS accounts, ensuring compliance and providing excellent service to depositors.

title: National Transit Pass System
desc: The seamless transit of timber and other forest produce is essential for promoting agroforestry, strengthening the forest economy, and improving the ease of doing business. The National Transit Pass System (NTPS) is a transformative digital initiative aimed at establishing a “One Nation–One Pass” framework by replacing fragmented, manual, and state-specific transit pass systems. This course provides a comprehensive overview and practical walkthrough of the NTPS portal for all stakeholders, including government officials, forest department personnel, timber merchants, transporters, and farmers. It covers the regulatory framework, rules, and procedures governing transit passes, along with the end-to-end online workflow for application, verification, approval, and pass generation. Learners will gain hands-on understanding of system navigation, compliance requirements, stakeholder roles, and key portal functionalities.

title: National Urban Livelihoods Mission: Approaches and Practices
desc: This course positions the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM) not merely as a welfare scheme, but as a strategic program for economic empowerment and fostering inclusive urban growth. It addresses the multi-dimensional challenge of urban poverty by focusing on economic resilience, social inclusion, and sustainability. The curriculum is designed to provide a practical, operational understanding of the mission's core components, which are the primary levers for implementation. Participants will learn the "how-to" of social mobilization through Self-Help Groups (SHGs), facilitating access to credit, delivering market-aligned skill training for employment, supporting the creation of micro-enterprises, and providing essential services like shelters for the urban homeless. The course aims to equip officials with the necessary knowledge to effectively implement these livelihood programs and empower the urban poor.

title: National Working Plan Code
desc: Scientific forest management requires accurate, standardized, and transparent preparation of Working Plans. Traditional methods of Working Plan preparation are often time-consuming, prone to data inconsistencies, and limited in their ability to support real-time monitoring and compliance. To address these challenges, the National Working Plan Code (NWPC) 2023 Mobile and Web App provides a digital platform for streamlined and standardized Working Plan preparation across forest divisions. This course equips forest officials with the knowledge and practical skills required to effectively use the NWPC 2023 Mobile and Web App for scientific forest management. It covers app-based data collection, validation, digital planning workflows, compliance requirements, and the preparation of Working Plans in accordance with the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) and Sathal (Vikas, Samvardhan Evam Prabandhan) Act (VSESA), 2024 Rules.

title: Natural Farming on Principles and Practices
desc: In an era where sustainable agriculture is paramount, this course delves into the essential principles and practices of Natural Farming. It addresses the growing need for farming systems that are both economically viable and environmentally sound. The curriculum is structured to provide a deep understanding of the foundational concepts of natural farming, moving beyond theory to practical application. Key learning areas include the preparation and use of critical components like Jeevamrutha and Bijamrita, soil and moisture management through Acchadana (mulching) and Waaphasa (soil aeration), and holistic crop management without synthetic inputs. Learners will discover how adopting these methods can significantly reduce cultivation costs while enhancing soil fertility and biodiversity. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply natural farming techniques to foster agricultural sustainability, improve farm profitability, and contribute to building climate-resilient food systems, aligning with the national vision for a healthier agricultural sector.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: Natural Farming: Sustainable Agriculture for Farmers
desc: Natural farming has emerged as an important approach for promoting sustainable agriculture by reducing dependence on synthetic fertilizers and pesticides while strengthening soil health, biodiversity, and climate resilience. Supported through the National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF), this approach encourages farmers to adopt locally available biological resources and indigenous agricultural knowledge to build self-reliant farming systems. This course introduces learners to the philosophy, principles, and practical implementation of natural farming. It explains the environmental, economic, health, social, and cultural benefits of adopting natural farming while also addressing the common concerns and challenges faced during the transition from conventional farming. Learners develop an understanding of how field officials can effectively communicate these benefits and support farmers throughout the adoption process.

title: Nature of Checks to be Exercised during Internal Audit
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the checks to be exercised during an internal audit, tailored for a public sector context. It delves into the critical role of internal audits in maintaining financial discipline, administrative integrity, and operational efficiency within government bodies like the Ministry of Mines. Participants will learn to navigate a systematic audit process, from reviewing key documents such as employee service books, procurement files, and asset registers, to verifying transactions and controls. The curriculum highlights real-world examples of common audit lapses, such as missing documentation, verification gaps, and non-compliant payments. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to not only identify these issues but also to implement corrective measures and adopt best practices that strengthen internal controls, ensure statutory compliance, and uphold the principles of good governance and transparency.

title: Navigating Climate Challenges - A Guide for Civil Servants
desc: Climate change is a defining global challenge with profound implications for India. Civil servants are at the forefront of policy-making and implementation, making their understanding of climate issues essential for effective governance and sustainable development. This course is structured into three core modules. Learners will first explore the fundamental science of climate change, distinguishing between weather and climate and understanding the human activities driving it. The second module focuses on climate action, detailing mitigation strategies to reduce emissions across sectors like energy and agriculture, and adaptation measures to build resilience against climate impacts. The final module covers climate governance, examining international frameworks like the Paris Agreement, India's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), and the national and state-level action plans that translate these commitments into reality. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to integrate a climate lens into their respective domains, whether at the national, state, or district level. They will be able to analyze climate vulnerabilities, contribute to the design of climate-resilient policies and projects, and understand their role as climate leaders. This course empowers officials to drive evidence-based climate action, aligning India's development trajectory with its long-term sustainability goals, including the vision of achieving net-zero emissions.

title: Navigating Climate Challenges - A Guide for Civil Servants (Hindi)
desc: यह व्यापक पाठ्यक्रम सिविल सेवकों को जलवायु परिवर्तन की बहुआयामी चुनौती से निपटने के लिए ज्ञान और अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करने के लिए संरचित है। पाठ्यक्रम को तीन मुख्य मॉड्यूलों में विभाजित किया गया है: जलवायु विज्ञान, जलवायु कार्रवाई, और जलवायु शासन। पहले मॉड्यूल में, शिक्षार्थी जलवायु परिवर्तन के पीछे के वैज्ञानिक आधार, इसके कारणों और हमारे ग्रह पर इसके दूरगामी प्रभावों को समझेंगे। दूसरा मॉड्यूल शमन और अनुकूलन की दोहरी रणनीतियों पर केंद्रित है, जिसमें नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा, टिकाऊ कृषि और आपदा-प्रतिरोधी बुनियादी ढांचे जैसे व्यावहारिक समाधानों पर प्रकाश डाला गया है। अंतिम मॉड्यूल जलवायु शासन के परिदृश्य की पड़ताल करता है, जिसमें पेरिस समझौते जैसी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधियों और जलवायु परिवर्तन पर भारत की राष्ट्रीय कार्य योजना (NAPCC) जैसी राष्ट्रीय नीतियों की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका पर चर्चा की गई है। पाठ्यक्रम पूरा होने पर, सिविल सेवक अपनी प्रशासनिक भूमिकाओं में जलवायु-संवेदनशील नीतियों को तैयार करने, लागू करने और मूल्यांकन करने में बेहतर रूप से सक्षम होंगे, जिससे भारत के सतत विकास लक्ष्यों में योगदान मिलेगा। यह पाठ्यक्रम अधिकारियों को जलवायु नेतृत्व अपनाने और एक लचीले भविष्य के निर्माण में सक्रिय भूमिका निभाने के लिए प्रेरित करता है।

title: Navigating Data Protection Compliance in Banking and Financial Service
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to operationalizing data protection compliance in the dynamic BFSI industry. Moving beyond theoretical knowledge, it equips Data Protection Officers and functional leaders with a robust six-cluster framework to integrate DPDP controls across the organization. The curriculum delves into critical areas such as Legal, Information Risk Management (IRM), IT, HR, Vendor Management, and the DPO's office, emphasizing the need for cross-functional collaboration. Participants will learn to implement practical tools like Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), manage vendor-related data processing activities (ROPAs), and establish clear data retention policies. A key focus is on building a pervasive privacy-first culture through a four-tier socialization strategy targeting all organizational levels. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to lead compliance efforts, mitigate risks, and leverage data privacy as a strategic asset to enhance customer trust and business value.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Navigating DPDP: The Future of Digital Governance in India
desc: This policy-focused course delves into the practical implementation of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, within government institutions. It provides a critical examination of the framework's core components, including exemptions for state functions under Section 17 and the delicate balance between citizen rights and public accountability. The discussion addresses significant operational challenges, such as institutional readiness gaps, the enforcement role of the Data Protection Board, and data breach notification responsibilities. Learners will gain insights into managing shared accountability for large-scale digital platforms like Aadhaar and DigiLocker, structuring contracts with IT vendors, and handling cross-border data flows. Furthermore, the course explores the intersection of DPDP with AI-driven automated decision-making and bias in public systems. It concludes by outlining a strategic readiness roadmap to help senior officials strengthen data governance, build institutional capacity, and enhance citizen trust in the evolving digital ecosystem.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Navigating Litigation Channels: From TDSAT to Supreme Court
desc: This specialized course is designed for officials involved in the legal and administrative functions of the telecommunications sector. It addresses the critical need to understand the complexities of litigation involving the Department of Telecommunications (DoT). The curriculum delves into the procedural aspects of telecom litigation, starting from the Telecom Dispute Settlement Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT) and progressing to the Supreme Court. Key learning areas include a thorough examination of significant legal disputes, the jurisdictional roles of various judicial and quasi-judicial bodies, and the foundational principles of natural justice. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with a clear understanding of the procedural framework and strategic considerations necessary to manage and navigate the challenges of the evolving telecom litigation environment, ensuring compliance and effective representation.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Navigating Parliamentary Questions
desc: This course provides a detailed examination of the institutional framework and procedures for managing Parliamentary Questions in India, a critical function of legislative accountability. It is designed for government officials and parliamentary staff who are responsible for ensuring that queries from Parliament are addressed accurately and promptly. The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of a Parliamentary Question, starting from the significance of Question Hour and the different categories of questions, such as Starred, Unstarred, and Short Notice Questions. Learners will delve into the specific rules of admissibility, best practices for drafting clear and concise replies, and the intricate process of coordinating with various Ministries to gather information. Furthermore, the course explains essential administrative actions like postponement, withdrawal, and transfer of questions, as well as the digital submission process. By completing this course, participants will be equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills to manage PQ workflows efficiently, upholding the principles of transparency and accountability in governance.
subDomain: Submission of briefs, supply of information
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Navigating the Digital info Ecosystem: Combating Misinformation
desc: This course explores the growing threats within today’s digital information ecosystem, focusing on the spread of misinformation, disinformation, and malinformation. Learners will examine how algorithm-driven social media platforms and digital systems amplify misleading or harmful content, accelerating the spread of falsehoods and contributing to a global crisis of trust. The course also introduces practical strategies to identify, prevent, and respond to information pollution, equipping participants with the skills to navigate the digital space responsibly, critically, and effectively.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Navigational Telex
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Navigational Telex (NAVTEX) system, designed for personnel involved in maritime communications and safety. The program begins by establishing the context of NAVTEX within the World-Wide Navigational Warning Service (WWNWS) and its importance for ensuring the safety of ships in coastal waters.
