Upon completion, learners will be equipped to accurately identify, differentiate, and apply the legal principles related to mischief, ensuring effective and just enforcement of the new legal framework in their professional roles.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Offences Against Property: Classification Distinction and Punishments
desc: With the introduction of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, and the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, it is imperative for legal and law enforcement personnel to master the new legal landscape. This course provides a comprehensive and structured overview of offences against property under these new laws. It is designed to build a strong conceptual foundation in the legal definitions, essential ingredients, and punishments associated with a wide range of property crimes. Key learning areas include a detailed study of theft, snatching, extortion, robbery, dacoity, cheating, criminal breach of trust, dishonest misappropriation of property, and criminal trespass. A significant focus is placed on distinguishing between similar offences, such as theft versus snatching or cheating versus criminal breach of trust, to prevent ambiguity in application. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to accurately interpret the provisions of the BNS, analyze the nuances of property-related cases, and understand the legal consequences, ensuring correct application of the law in their professional duties.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Offences against Public Tranquillity under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
desc: This course examines criminal liability arising from common intention and common object under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. It provides a structured understanding of the doctrines governing joint and vicarious liability, including the legal principles relating to common intention, common object, and unlawful assembly. The course further covers offences such as rioting, provocation to rioting, affray, and offences involving assault, obstruction, or use of criminal force against public servants during the dispersal of unlawful assemblies or suppression of riots. Special emphasis is placed on offences that affect social harmony and national integration, including promotion of enmity and prejudicial imputations, highlighting their societal impact and enhanced statutory punishments.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Offences Against Public Tranquillity Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
desc: This course provides a comprehensive analysis of key judicial interpretations under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, drawing on recent judgments from the Supreme Court and High Courts. It equips participants with a clear understanding of how courts interpret and apply the new criminal law provisions in practical scenarios. The course covers important topics such as the service of notice and summons, distinguishing executive notices from judicial summons and including gender-neutral service provisions; prison administration and undertrial detention, with guidance on Section 479 and related statutory safeguards; FIR registration and preliminary enquiry, including procedures for electronic, unsigned, and extra-territorial complaints; and police custody and grounds of arrest, highlighting constitutional and statutory standards.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Offences Against Public Tranquillity Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the legal framework governing public tranquillity as established by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. It is designed for law enforcement, judicial, and administrative personnel who need to understand and enforce the new criminal laws. The curriculum begins by contextualizing the importance of maintaining public order and social harmony within the Indian legal system. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of unlawful assembly (Section 189), rioting (Section 191), affray (Section 194), and offences related to promoting enmity between different groups (Section 196). The course meticulously explains the essential ingredients required to constitute each offence, the associated punishments, and the vicarious liability of individuals within a group. Furthermore, learners will explore the procedural aspects, including whether an offence is bailable or non-bailable, compoundable, and which court has the jurisdiction to try the case. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in identifying these offences, understanding their legal ramifications, and applying the correct provisions in practical scenarios, thereby strengthening their capacity to uphold public peace and national integration.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Offences Against the Unborn and Newborn under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of new legal provisions concerning the protection of unborn and newborn children under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. The curriculum focuses specifically on Sections 88 through 92, which establish a robust framework for addressing criminal acts such as inducing miscarriage and causing harm to a fetus. The course explains the critical legal context, including the importance of consent, intent (mens rea), and the specific stage of pregnancy, such as when a woman is “quick with child.” It details the varying degrees of criminal liability and punishment, particularly in severe cases where such acts lead to the death of the woman or child. Furthermore, learners will explore the crucial exception for medical procedures conducted in good faith to preserve the mother's life, distinguishing them from malicious acts. Designed for law enforcement officers, public prosecutors, judicial officers, and legal practitioners, this course equips participants with the necessary knowledge to navigate and enforce these significant new laws effectively in the criminal justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Offences and Penal Provisions under the Customs Act 1962
desc: The course explains what constitutes an offence under the Act, identifies the broad categories of violations related to improper imports and exports, and distinguishes between confiscation of goods and imposition of penalties. Learners will develop clarity on the legal provisions governing confiscation under Sections 111 and 113, and penalties under Sections 112, 114, and related provisions. Topics include cases involving short-levy, false declarations, fraudulent documents, misuse of refunds or input tax credit, and scenarios where liability extends to conveyances, concealment devices, sale proceeds, companies, and responsible individuals. Practical applications cover undervaluation, smuggling, obstruction of Customs officers, and duty evasion. By completing this course, learners will be able to interpret the structured enforcement framework of the Customs Act, 1962, and apply its provisions confidently to ensure lawful and compliant trade practices.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Offences Related to Criminal Trespass Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the new legal framework governing criminal trespass as established by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. With the recent overhaul of India's criminal laws, it is crucial for legal and law enforcement professionals to understand these changes. The course delves into the specifics of Sections 329 to 333, which define and penalize various forms of unlawful entry onto property. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of criminal trespass, house-trespass, lurking house-trespass, and housebreaking, highlighting the essential elements that constitute each offence. The curriculum also provides a comparative analysis against the erstwhile Indian Penal Code, 1860, explaining the rationale behind the legal updates. Through practical examples and interpretations, learners will be equipped to apply these provisions, understand the prescribed punishments, and appreciate how the BNS, 2023 strengthens the protection of property rights against unauthorized intrusion. This knowledge is essential for ensuring correct application of the law in investigation and judicial proceedings.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Offences Relating to Child under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of the legal framework for protecting children under India's new criminal laws, specifically the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. The content is structured to provide a clear understanding of why these legal reforms were necessary and how they strengthen protections for minors. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of offences in Chapter V and VI of the BNS, such as the abandonment of children, concealment of birth, procuration for illicit activities, and various forms of kidnapping, abduction, and trafficking. The course meticulously explains the essential elements of each offence, the prescribed punishments, and the legal implications. It emphasizes crucial updates from the Indian Penal Code, including revised terminologies, expanded age protections, and gender-inclusive language. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply the new provisions in practical scenarios, making it essential for law enforcement, legal professionals, and child welfare advocates.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Offences Relating to Religion and State Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of India's new criminal laws, focusing on offences against the State and religion. Learners will explore the statutory provisions within the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, which replaces the colonial-era Indian Penal Code. The curriculum specifically covers Chapter VII on offences against the State, including waging war, conspiracy, and acts threatening national integrity, and Chapter XVI on offences related to religion, such as defiling places of worship and outraging religious beliefs. The course emphasizes the significance of 'intent' or 'knowledge' as a crucial element for establishing liability under the new legal regime. Through judicial interpretations and case illustrations, it equips law enforcement officers, public officials, and legal practitioners with the necessary knowledge to investigate, prosecute, and adjudicate these sensitive offences, ensuring procedural integrity and the correct application of the law.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Office Ergonomics and Workplace Wellbeing
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of ergonomics within the office environment, designed to enhance employee wellbeing and organizational productivity. It begins by establishing the fundamental concepts of ergonomics, including its classifications and its importance in preventing occupational health issues like Cumulative Trauma Disorders (CTD). The curriculum delves into practical applications, covering optimal workplace design, the elements of organizational structure, and the impact of psychosocial work factors on job satisfaction. Learners will be introduced to key organizational behavior models and motivation theories from Maslow and Alderfer. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to stress management, where participants will learn to identify causes of workplace stress and apply effective reduction techniques. The course concludes with a set of actionable recommendations and guidelines for implementing ergonomic principles, ensuring a safer, healthier, and more efficient work environment. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to transform their workplace by applying these essential principles.

title: Office Procedure
desc: This foundational course delves into the essential office procedures that form the backbone of efficient and transparent government operations. It is specifically designed for public functionaries seeking to develop a strong understanding of the established systems and protocols that govern administrative work. The curriculum will cover critical topics such as the principles of noting and drafting, proper management of official records and files (including e-Office), and the correct handling of official communications (DAK). Participants will learn the importance of adhering to the Manual of Office Procedure, ensuring consistency and accountability in their daily tasks. The course aims to equip learners with the practical skills needed to navigate administrative processes confidently, reduce procedural delays, and uphold the standards of public service. Upon completion, officials will be better prepared to manage their responsibilities with greater precision, contributing to a more organized and effective work environment within their respective departments.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Office Procedure - Updated
desc: In the context of public service, adherence to established procedures is paramount for ensuring transparency, accountability, and efficiency. This foundational course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of standard office procedures as practiced in the Government of India. The curriculum delves into the core components of daily administrative work, providing a structured guide to navigating the governmental ecosystem. Key learning areas include the principles of DAK and file management, the art of precise noting and drafting for official communications, and the protocols for record-keeping and retention. The course also introduces the functionalities of e-Office to align with modern digital governance practices. Upon completion, learners will be able to execute their administrative duties with greater precision, reduce procedural errors, and contribute effectively to the seamless operation of their respective departments. This program is an essential building block for a successful career in government administration.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Office Procedure and Dak Managements
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to the principles and practices of office procedure and Dak management, essential for the effective functioning of any government department. It addresses the critical need for efficiency, consistency, and transparency in public service delivery by detailing the standardized workflows outlined in the Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedure (CSMOP). Participants will learn the complete lifecycle of correspondence management, including the roles of the Central Registry Unit (CRU), proper handling of physical and digital mail, and the specific actions required by Section Officers and dealing hands. The course also covers the transition to digital systems, explaining the functionalities of e-Office for creating paperless, accountable, and streamlined processes. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these procedures to enhance productivity, ensure accountability, and contribute to a more responsive administrative environment.

title: Office Procedures
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government employees with a thorough understanding of essential office procedures. It delves into the protocols and standards that define how staff work together in a hierarchical system, ensuring operational consistency and efficiency. The curriculum covers the core functions performed by different office sections, with a special focus on the meticulous maintenance of registers such as the stamp account, receipt, distribution, and dispatch registers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the File Management System, explaining how to properly handle collections of papers on specific subjects. Learners will also master the art of 'noting,' which is the critical process of writing remarks on files to facilitate sound decision-making. Furthermore, the course details the various instruments of communication used in government, including Letters, D.O. Letters, Office Orders, and Memorandums, enabling participants to choose and draft the appropriate document for any official correspondence.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Office Productivity Tools
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government professionals with the essential skills to effectively use the LibreOffice productivity suite. The curriculum is structured to provide a practical, hands-on learning experience across three core applications. In the word processing module, learners will master LibreOffice Writer, covering everything from creating and formatting documents to advanced features like page setup, headers, footers, and the mail merge wizard for mass communication. The spreadsheet module focuses on LibreOffice Calc, where participants will learn to organize data, perform calculations using formulas and functions like SUM and AVERAGE, and visualize data by creating various types of charts. The final module introduces LibreOffice Impress, teaching learners how to build compelling presentations from scratch. Topics include slide management, inserting tables and images, applying design themes, and using transitions to deliver a polished slideshow. This course will empower you to handle daily office tasks with confidence and greater productivity.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Office Supervision
desc: This foundational course on Office Supervision is designed for aspiring and current supervisors seeking to enhance their management capabilities within a public sector context. The program delves into the essential functions and responsibilities that define an effective supervisor, highlighting their pivotal role as the link between management and employees. Key learning areas include understanding the continuous and delegated nature of supervision, mastering core duties such as task scheduling and performance monitoring, and fostering a positive work environment. Participants will learn to apply practical techniques for motivating teams, ensuring adherence to office procedures, resolving conflicts, and communicating effectively. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the necessary skills to improve office operations, lead with confidence, and drive productivity in their teams, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Official Meeting - Role of Personal Staff
desc: Official meetings are a cornerstone of government functioning, essential for decision-making, policy review, and inter-departmental coordination. The smooth execution of these meetings heavily relies on the meticulous planning and support provided by personal staff. This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the entire meeting lifecycle. It begins with defining the purpose and types of official meetings and proceeds to the practical steps of convening them, including finalizing dates, venues, and participant lists. Learners will gain proficiency in preparing comprehensive agenda folders, managing logistical arrangements like venue setup and hospitality, and ensuring all technical equipment is functional. The training also covers the crucial duties during the meeting and the post-meeting process of drafting accurate and concise minutes, which serve as a permanent record. Upon completion, personal staff will be equipped with the skills to manage official meetings with confidence and professionalism, improving the overall productivity and decorum of official business.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Offshore Area Mineral Grant Procedure
desc: India's offshore regions hold significant mineral wealth, the exploitation of which is governed by a dedicated legal framework. This course offers an in-depth exploration of these regulations, primarily the Offshore Areas Mineral (Development and Regulation) Act, 2002, and its associated rules. The program is designed to clarify the complex procedures involved in granting mineral concessions, from auction prerequisites and bidding parameters to financial obligations like performance security and upfront payments. It details the various types of operating rights, such as composite licenses and production leases, and contrasts the offshore framework with onshore regulations. By examining the roles of central government agencies, eligibility criteria for bidders, and the legal responsibilities of license holders, the course prepares participants to engage confidently with India’s offshore mineral sector. Learners will be equipped to understand and apply the governing principles for responsible and compliant mineral exploration and development.

title: Offshore Area Mineral Potential
desc: Delve into the significant potential of India's offshore mineral wealth with this detailed course. The program is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the types, distribution, and economic value of minerals found within India's vast Exclusive Economic Zone. The curriculum focuses on the critical legal and policy frameworks governing this sector, primarily the Offshore Areas Mineral (Development and Regulation) Act and its recent amendments. Participants will learn about the introduction of the 'Exploration License' in 2023, a pivotal change designed to attract private investment and accelerate exploration. The course breaks down the new auction mechanism, including the concept of reverse bidding, the process for granting licenses, and the revenue-sharing model for exploration agencies. It also covers modern exploration techniques and the strategic goals of the Deep Ocean Mission. This course is essential for government officers, mining professionals, and policy analysts involved in natural resource management, providing the knowledge needed to navigate and contribute to the sustainable development of India's offshore mineral sector.

title: One Health: A Holistic Framework for Health and Sustainability
desc: This course introduces the concept of One Health, a collaborative and multidisciplinary approach that recognizes the interconnectedness of human, animal, plant, and environmental health. It explores the importance of the One Health framework in addressing major global challenges such as zoonotic diseases, climate change, and antimicrobial resistance (AMR). The course also examines the transformative role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, including its applications in disease detection, diagnosis, treatment optimization, genomic analysis, and personalized medicine. Learners will gain insights into how AI-driven technologies can strengthen One Health initiatives through integrated data systems, real-time surveillance, predictive analytics, and global collaboration.
org: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

title: One Nation One Ration Card - Jan Karmayogi course (English)
desc: The One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) scheme is a transformative public welfare initiative aimed at ensuring food security for all citizens, particularly migrant workers and their families. This course is specifically designed to empower field officials who are at the forefront of implementing this critical program. It provides an in-depth exploration of the scheme's core principles, from its primary objectives to the specific eligibility criteria for beneficiaries. Participants will be guided through the essential operational procedures and guidelines that are crucial for ensuring seamless and portable ration distribution across the nation. The curriculum covers key pre-requisites for successful implementation, familiarizing learners with the various facets of the ONORC ecosystem. Upon completion, officials will be equipped with the practical knowledge to manage the distribution process effectively, address beneficiary queries, and uphold the principles of transparency and accountability. This will enable them to play a pivotal role in the successful execution of the ONORC scheme, ensuring that every eligible citizen can access their foodgrain entitlements, regardless of their location.
org: Department of Food and Public Distribution

title: Online Appeal Disposal System under Sakala Act
desc: This training course is designed to guide Designated Officers, Competent Officers, Appellate Authorities, and departmental officials on the complete workflow for the generation, processing, hearing, and disposal of appeals under the Sakala Act. It introduces the newly implemented end-to-end online Appeal Disposal Module, enabling users to understand how appeals are managed digitally in a structured, transparent, and time-bound manner. The course focuses on improving efficiency, accountability, and adherence to statutory timelines in appeal handling.

title: Online Dispute Resolution Mechanism in Securities Markets
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) mechanism, a pivotal reform in the Indian securities market's grievance redressal landscape. It addresses the critical need for an efficient, transparent, and accessible system for resolving disputes between investors and market participants. The curriculum provides a detailed walkthrough of SEBI's SMART ODR portal, covering everything from complaint filing to the conclusion of arbitral proceedings. Key learning areas include the step-by-step processes for online conciliation and arbitration, the fee structures involved, and the legal framework governing the system. Participants will also understand the specific roles, responsibilities, and code of conduct for market intermediaries, ODR institutions, conciliators, and arbitrators. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively navigate the ODR ecosystem, ensure compliance, and leverage this digital platform for timely and fair dispute resolution, thereby strengthening investor confidence and market integrity.

title: Online Investment and Gaming Scam
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the threat of sophisticated cybercrime is ever-present. This course is designed to equip public servants and citizens with the awareness and tools needed to navigate the online environment safely. It provides a comprehensive overview of two major threats: fraudulent investment schemes and online gaming scams. You will learn to identify the hallmarks of Ponzi and pyramid schemes, which often exploit the promise of quick, high returns through unregistered channels and fake mobile applications. The course details red flags such as high-pressure sales tactics and unsolicited offers from unknown groups. Furthermore, it delves into the risks associated with the burgeoning online gaming world, covering threats like virtual asset theft, identity fraud, phishing attacks, and malware hidden in suspicious apps. By the end of this course, you will be able to critically evaluate online offers, implement robust safety measures for yourself and your family, and know the correct procedures for reporting suspected cybercrime, thereby contributing to a safer digital ecosystem for all.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Online Permanent Retirement Account Number Generation
desc: This course is specifically designed to assist Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) employees in navigating the online enrollment process for the National Pension Scheme (NPS)-Lite. The primary focus is on the generation of a Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN), a critical step for securing pension benefits. The curriculum provides a clear, procedural walkthrough of the entire e-NPS registration portal. Key learning areas include understanding the scheme's eligibility criteria, calculating salary deductions (TRCA), and accurately filling out personal, bank, and nominee information. Furthermore, the course covers the necessary steps for uploading required documents and submitting the final form to the designated Collection Centre for verification and approval. Upon completion, learners will be fully equipped to independently and correctly complete their NPS-Lite enrollment, ensuring their inclusion in this vital social security program.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Online Submission Modules of IBM.
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip mining professionals with the necessary skills to navigate and utilize the Indian Bureau of Mines' (IBM) online portals for mandatory data submission. The content is divided into two main sections, focusing on the Drone Data Management System (DDMS) and the online returns submission module. In the DDMS section, participants will learn the specific login protocols for lessees and preferred bidders, the correct nomenclature and format for preparing drone survey data into a single zip file, and the step-by-step process for uploading files and verifying submission status. The second section provides an in-depth walkthrough of the returns portal. It explains how to file monthly (Form F series) and annual (Form G series) returns, detailing the data required for Part 1 (General & Labor) and Part 2 (Production, Dispatches, & Stocks). The course highlights the importance of accurate data entry, including the calculation of ex-mine price, and the process for handling documents that are referred back for corrections. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using these e-governance tools, ensuring timely and accurate compliance with regulatory requirements.

title: Open Data for Policymakers
desc: In an era of digital transformation, Open Data has emerged as a critical component of transparent and effective governance. This course, 'Open Data for Policymakers,' is designed to provide a foundational understanding of this global movement. It addresses the core principles of Open Data, focusing on its potential to unlock significant social and economic value by removing barriers to public information. The curriculum is specifically tailored for public policymakers who are considering or are in the process of establishing an Open Data program, assuming no prior technical expertise.Participants will delve into the key learning areas required to lead such an initiative. This includes a thorough review of Open Data standards, best practices, and the associated legal and policy considerations like data licensing. The course provides a structured framework for conducting an Open Data readiness assessment and developing a comprehensive strategic plan. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to coordinate a multi-agency Open Data program, engage effectively with the data community, and drive data-driven decision-making within the government.

title: Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN)
desc: In the rapidly evolving telecommunications landscape, the move towards open and disaggregated networks is critical for fostering innovation and reducing costs. This course offers an in-depth exploration of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN), a paradigm shift from proprietary, single-vendor systems. It provides the foundational knowledge required to understand the technical and strategic importance of O-RAN in the context of 5G and future mobile networks. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of traditional, virtualized, and open RAN architectures. The course meticulously explains the functional splits of the Baseband Unit (BBU) into the Distributed Unit (DU) and Central Unit (CU), and the role of the Radio Unit (RU). Learners will gain a solid understanding of crucial fronthaul and midhaul interfaces, such as CPRI and the more advanced eCPRI, and their significance in enabling multi-vendor interoperability. Furthermore, the course navigates the complex ecosystem of standards, covering the contributions of 3GPP, the O-RAN Alliance, Telecom Infra Project (TIP), and the Small Cell Forum (SCF). Upon completion, participants will be able to analyze different RAN deployment models and appreciate the benefits of an open, intelligent, and virtualized network architecture.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Opencast Mine Planning and Design
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the intricate process of planning and designing opencast coal mines. It addresses the growing need for skilled professionals who can develop sustainable and economically viable mining projects. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of opencast mining, highlighting its advantages in productivity and safety. Learners will delve into the key learning areas, including the step-by-step mine planning process, which involves interpreting geological data, estimating reserves, and utilizing modeling tools. The course covers the critical decisions in selecting suitable mining equipment and designing essential infrastructure such as drainage systems, power supply, and coal handling facilities. Furthermore, it emphasizes the integration of modern technology, robust safety protocols, and stringent environmental safeguards to ensure responsible operations. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply these principles to enhance planning accuracy, evaluate economic feasibility, and contribute to sustainable resource extraction in the coal industry.

title: Operating Environment of Working Capital
desc: Dive deep into the essentials of managing working capital within a dynamic economic landscape. This course is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of how external financial factors shape a company's day-to-day financial operations. You will explore the core concepts of monetary policy, including the mechanisms and objectives behind controlling the money supply, and understand its direct impact on business liquidity. The course breaks down key instruments used by central banks, such as the repo rate, Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR), and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR), explaining their purpose and effects on the banking system and credit availability. Furthermore, it examines the strategic importance of credit policy, weighing its advantages in boosting sales against the inherent risks of bad debt and bankruptcy. You will also be introduced to various analytical approaches for determining optimal working capital levels, including industry norms and economic modeling, enabling you to contribute effectively to your organization's financial stability and growth.

title: Operating System Installation
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge and practical skills required to install and configure a computer operating system from scratch. The program begins by demystifying the core concepts of an OS, explaining its functions, various types (Desktop, Server, Mobile), and the difference between user and kernel modes. You will gain insight into the computer's boot process, from the Power-On Self-Test (POST) to loading the OS into RAM.The course then transitions into a hands-on, step-by-step guide for installing Microsoft Windows 10, the most widely used desktop operating system. Key learning areas include preparing for installation by creating a bootable USB drive using the Rufus tool, navigating the BIOS/UEFI to set boot priorities, and executing a clean installation. You will learn how to manage disk partitions, format drives, and configure essential post-installation settings such as user accounts and security questions. Upon completion, you will have the confidence and ability to set up a new computer or restore an existing one to a functional state, a vital skill for any IT support or administrative role.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Operation and Maintenance of Effluent Treatment Plants
desc: This comprehensive training program is designed to build technical capacity in the effective operation and maintenance of wastewater treatment facilities. The course addresses the critical need for proper management of Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs) and Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs) to comply with environmental regulations and protect water resources. Learners will gain a foundational understanding of wastewater sources and characteristics, exploring key parameters such as Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), and Total Suspended Solids (TSS). The curriculum delves into the complete treatment lifecycle, covering preliminary, primary, secondary (biological), and tertiary treatment technologies, including advanced systems like membrane filtration for water recycling. Participants will also learn about sustainable sludge management, from generation to disposal or reuse, and the importance of adhering to discharge standards set by bodies like the CPCB and under the EPA Rules. A significant component of the course is dedicated to occupational health and safety, ensuring that plant operators can manage hazards effectively. Through practical case studies, the course demonstrates how to identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions, empowering officials to ensure treatment plants run efficiently, sustainably, and in full compliance with environmental laws.

title: Operation and Maintinace And Sustainability
desc: Effective operation and maintenance (O&M) are fundamental to good governance, ensuring that public infrastructure and assets deliver their intended value throughout their entire lifecycle. Neglecting O&M can lead to premature asset failure, increased long-term costs, and disruptions in public service delivery. This course addresses this critical need by providing a comprehensive overview of best practices in O&M and sustainability for the public sector. The curriculum delves into key areas such as developing maintenance schedules, conducting asset condition assessments, and implementing preventive and predictive maintenance techniques. It also explores the concept of sustainability in a public context, covering financial viability, environmental responsibility, and the social impact of asset management. Participants will learn to analyze the total cost of ownership and make informed decisions that balance short-term needs with long-term strategic goals. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to develop and manage effective O&M plans, apply sustainability principles to their work, and ensure that public assets are managed efficiently, responsibly, and for the maximum benefit of the public.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Operation of Dragline
desc: The Operation of Dragline course is designed to introduce learners to the functioning, performance standards, technical parameters, and maintenance practices of draglines used in opencast mining, specifically within NCL. This course provides a foundational understanding of how draglines contribute to large-scale overburden removal, their operational cycles, and the standards required for safe and efficient mining operations. Learners will also explore both the historical development and modern utilization of draglines in the coal mining industry.

title: Operation of Shramik Special Trains for Migrant Labour amid Covid-19
desc:
The COVID-19-induced lockdown in March 2020 left millions of migrant labourers stranded in various Indian cities. In a historic response, Indian Railways launched "Shramik Special" trains to facilitate their return to their native places, particularly to Uttar Pradesh, India’s most populous state. This massive humanitarian and logistical operation, led by Sanjay Tripathi, DRM/Lucknow and nodal officer from Railways, involved coordination with multiple stakeholders—central and state governments.
This case highlights the challenges of planning large-scale transportation during a public health crisis, including compliance with COVID-19 safety protocols, logistical hurdles in catering, transport, and staffing, and communication bottlenecks. It underscores leadership, real-time problem solving, delegation, and use of technology in public administration. The operation saw the successful movement of over 3 million labourers to Uttar Pradesh via 957 trains.
keywords: Operations of Trains for Migrant Labour

title: Operation Parivartan: Societal change through transformational leaders
desc: Ms. Tejaswi Satpute, Mumbai's Deputy Commissioner of Police, led Operation Parivartan in Solapur, adopting a scientific strategy to disrupt the entire illicit liquor brewing cycle and address its production and distribution challenges with ethical public service principles.

title: Operation Secure Bharat: Responding to A Cyber Crisis
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to personal digital security, designed for individuals seeking to protect themselves from a wide range of online threats. It addresses the critical need for cybersecurity awareness in both personal and professional contexts, especially for public servants handling sensitive information. The curriculum covers fundamental security practices, including securing mobile devices, protecting data on communication apps like WhatsApp, and configuring browser settings for enhanced safety. Participants will learn to identify and respond to various cyber threats, from common phishing attacks to emerging challenges like deepfake scams and digital arrest fraud. The course also delves into the security risks associated with Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Upon completion, learners will be empowered to implement robust security measures, manage their digital footprint responsibly, and utilize official channels for reporting cybercrime, fostering a culture of digital vigilance and resilience.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Operational Efficiency and Improvement
desc: The Operational Efficiency & Improvement course focuses on translating organizational strategy into effective execution by applying proven frameworks that enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and improve performance across operations. Participants are introduced to three widely used operational tools—the Learning Curve, Just-in-Time (JIT) Production, and the Pareto Principle (80/20 Rule)—to demonstrate how organizations can achieve better outcomes with optimal use of resources. Through practical explanations, real-world operational scenarios, and Indian and global case studies, learners understand how experience-driven efficiency, lean inventory management, and focused prioritisation contribute to productivity, cost reduction, and responsiveness. This course equips participants with analytical and execution-oriented thinking to improve workflows, enhance quality, and support sustainable operational excellence across manufacturing, services, and public sector contexts.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Operational Framework of Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System
desc:
This e-learning course provides a comprehensive overview of the Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System (ICJS), a flagship initiative of the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. The course explains the structure, governance, and architecture of ICJS and how it digitally integrates the key pillars of the criminal justice system — Police (CCTNS), 
e-Prisons, e-Prosecution, e-Forensics, and e-Courts.
It highlights the “One Data, One Entry” principle, real-time data sharing, search and analytics capabilities, and the digital case lifecycle from investigation to trial and incarceration. The course also covers ICJS Phase-II and ICJS 2.0, focusing on enhanced interoperability, infrastructure upgrades, and nationwide implementation to enable faster, transparent, and efficient justice delivery
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Operational Safety in 25 kV Overhead Electrification System
desc: Working within a 25 kV Overhead Electrification (OHE) environment presents significant and potentially fatal electrical hazards. This course is designed to equip all authorized personnel, technicians, and supervisors with the comprehensive knowledge required to operate safely in these high-risk zones. The curriculum provides a detailed overview of the dangers inherent in high-voltage AC systems, such as electric shock from direct contact, arc flashes, and induced voltages. It establishes a clear framework for safe work practices, beginning with the fundamental principles of maintaining a minimum two-meter clearance from live wires and understanding all safety signage. Key learning areas include the correct procedures for obtaining a Permit to Work (PTW), the mandatory use of insulated tools and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and the critical process for ensuring equipment is de-energized and earthed. The course thoroughly covers the step-by-step protocol for power shutdown confirmation and the application of discharge rods to dissipate any residual charge. Furthermore, it outlines emergency response procedures, including how to report incidents to the Traction Power Controller (TPC) and the immediate actions to take in case of an electrical accident. Upon completion, learners will be fully prepared to identify hazards, follow authorized safety protocols, and contribute to a culture of safety in electrified rail environments.

title: Opportunities in Digital Health Sector for Nurses
desc: This course explores the expanding roles and career pathways for nurses in today’s increasingly digital healthcare environment. It examines how technologies such as electronic medical records (EMRs), artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telemedicine, and virtual care are transforming nursing practice, education, and leadership. Learners are introduced to emerging roles including nursing informatics specialist, digital health consultant, telemedicine project manager, and health technology trainer. The course also emphasizes essential digital competencies such as telehealth communication, data literacy, interoperability, and ethical management of healthcare data. By the end of the course, nurses gain a clear understanding of evolving digital career opportunities in India and globally, preparing them to become digitally skilled healthcare professionals and leaders.

title: OPTICAL FIBER ANALOG LINK
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of optical fiber analog links, from theoretical principles to practical application. Initially, participants will delve into the fundamentals of optical communication, understanding how electrical signals are converted into light, transmitted through fiber cables, and converted back at the destination. The course covers the physics of total internal reflection and the construction of optical fibers using core, cladding, and coating. Key components like laser diodes, LEDs, and photodetectors are examined in detail. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to a hands-on demonstration of designing and analyzing a functional optical fiber analog link. Using equipment such as a function generator and an oscilloscope, learners will build a link, transmit a signal, and analyze the output waveform to verify its integrity. This practical approach solidifies the understanding of how these systems are implemented and tested in real-world scenarios, including their application in 3G, 4G, 5G, and Radio over Fiber technologies.

title: Optical Fiber Cable Network (O and M)
desc: This course is designed for technical professionals seeking to master the intricacies of modern optical fiber networks. It begins with the foundational principles of optical communication, covering light propagation, fiber structures, and the characteristics of different ITU-T standardized fibers. The course then delves into the practical aspects of network deployment and upkeep, with a significant focus on fusion splicing. Learners will be guided through the entire splicing process, from cable preparation and cleaving to using a fusion splicer and protecting the joint. A major component of the training involves hands-on familiarity with critical testing and diagnostic tools. Participants will learn to operate Optical Time Domain Reflectometers (OTDR), optical power meters, and Visual Fault Locators (VFL) to perform fault localization, measure signal loss, and ensure network integrity. The course also provides a detailed overview of GPON technology, its architecture, and proactive maintenance routines essential for ensuring high-availability services. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing optical fiber cable networks effectively.

title: Optical Fiber Cable Tool Kit Demonstration
desc: This instructional video offers a detailed walkthrough of the standard toolkit used for maintaining optical fiber cables. The course is designed for technicians and field engineers who need to be proficient in handling OFC for installation, repair, and maintenance tasks. It begins by introducing the purpose of each tool, including the cable cutter, outer jacket remover, buffer stripper, aramid yarn scissors, fiber stripper, and the high-precision cleaver. The instructor demonstrates the step-by-step process of preparing a cable: cutting it to length, removing the protective outer jacket and buffer tubes, stripping the color coating from the delicate fiber strands, and finally, making a perfect perpendicular cut with a cleaver to ensure a successful splice. By the end of this session, learners will be able to confidently identify and use each tool correctly, understanding its critical role in maintaining the integrity and performance of the telecommunications network.

title: Optical Fiber Network Maintenance
desc: This technical course offers a detailed guide to the essential skills required for maintaining modern optical fiber networks. It begins by demonstrating the step-by-step process of optical fiber splicing, a critical procedure for repairing and extending fiber optic cables. Learners will be guided through using specialized equipment such as fiber strippers, cleavers, and the fusion arc splicing machine to create low-loss, durable fiber joints. The course then expands to cover the architecture and maintenance of Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) networks. Participants will understand the roles of key network elements like the OLT at the service provider's end and the ONT at the subscriber's premises. A significant portion is dedicated to practical troubleshooting, teaching technicians how to use an optical power meter to diagnose connectivity issues, measure signal loss, and verify that the service is within the specified operational range. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the practical knowledge to effectively install, troubleshoot, and maintain the physical layer of high-speed broadband networks, ensuring reliable service delivery to end-users.

title: Order Processing and Payments for GeM Buyers
desc: This comprehensive course is designed for government officials acting as buyers on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). It provides a detailed walkthrough of critical post-procurement processes to ensure transparency, compliance, and efficiency. The curriculum focuses on the practical application of GeM and PFMS portals for seamless order management. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process for generating Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificates (CRACs), managing final bills, and handling requests for delivery period extensions. Furthermore, the course offers in-depth guidance on using the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) for drafting bills and executing payments. It also covers the specifics of service order invoicing and the consignee review process. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in navigating these essential functions, reducing processing times and ensuring accountability in their procurement responsibilities.

title: Ordnance Factory Balangir: Efficient Production and Procurement
desc: In a landmark reform, the Government of India restructured the century-old Ordnance Factory Board (OFB) into seven Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) on October 1, 2021, to tackle longstanding inefficiencies in defence production. Triggered by repeated CAG reports and expert committee recommendations, the move aimed to improve agility, accountability, and responsiveness to the Armed Forces’ needs. Within this transformation, the Chief General Manager of Ordnance Factory Balangir (OFBL), Shri P.K. Dash, faces a key challenge: enhancing output without compromising on quality or safety, requiring strategic, balanced decision-making.

title: Organisational Change Management-Advanced
desc: In an era of rapid transformation, the ability to effectively manage organisational change is a crucial competency for public sector leaders. This advanced module provides a comprehensive framework for navigating the complexities of change within government departments. The course moves beyond foundational concepts to explore sophisticated strategies for driving sustainable transformation. Key learning areas include crafting powerful change visions, diagnosing and shaping organisational culture, and applying principles from neuroscience to foster a growth mindset among employees. You will learn to facilitate stakeholder engagement through structured collaboration methods like World Cafe and Open Space Technology. Furthermore, the course emphasizes a data-driven approach, teaching you how to leverage change analytics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to monitor progress and ensure alignment with strategic goals. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the advanced tools and strategic insights needed to lead change initiatives that deliver lasting positive outcomes for your organisation and its stakeholders.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Organisational Change Management-Fundamentals
desc: This module is designed to equip government officials with the fundamental principles and practices of Organisational Change Management (OCM). The course establishes the context for why managing change is vital in the public sector, where initiatives like digital transformation, policy reforms, and departmental restructuring have a large-scale impact on citizens and employees. Learners will delve into key theoretical frameworks, including Lewin's three-stage model, Kotter's eight-step process, and the ADKAR model, providing a structured approach to implementing change. The curriculum also focuses on the practical aspects of OCM, such as identifying and managing stakeholders, the critical role of leadership and change agents, and developing effective communication strategies. By understanding the psychological stages of transition, like the change curve, and learning to address resistance proactively, participants will be better prepared to lead their teams through transformation, foster resilience, and achieve desired organisational outcomes with minimal disruption.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Organisational Structure of Police
desc: This course explains India’s policing system, which operates through a dual structure: State Police Forces maintain local law and order, while Central Police Forces and other organizations support national security, specialized operations, and central interventions during emergencies. The course highlights the constitutional provisions that assign policing as a state subject while empowering the Union government to act in extraordinary circumstances. Learners are introduced to the legal evolution of policing, tracing the transition from colonial-era laws (IPC, CrPC, Evidence Act) to the new criminal legislation introduced in December 2023—Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA)—which emphasize a victim-centered and technology-driven justice approach. The course details the hierarchical structure of State Police, recruitment and training mechanisms, and key specialized units.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Organised Crime and Petty Organised Crime
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of India's updated legal stance on organised crime with the introduction of the Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. The curriculum is specifically designed to provide law enforcement officials with a thorough understanding of these critical provisions. The course begins by establishing the context of this legal reform, contrasting the BNS with previous laws like the IPC and MCOCA. Key learning areas include the precise legal definitions of 'organised crime' (Section 111) and 'petty organised crime' (Section 112), the structural elements of a crime syndicate, and the criteria for 'continuing unlawful activity.' It delves into the severe penal consequences, including life imprisonment and property confiscation, and addresses the liabilities of abettors and corrupt public servants. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to identify, investigate, and build strong cases against organised criminal networks, ensuring effective enforcement of the new law.

title: Orientation Course in Defence Finance For Higher Management
desc: This orientation course is designed for senior management to refresh and deepen their understanding of India's defence financial ecosystem. The curriculum details the structure of the Ministry of Defence, including its five core departments, and clarifies the pivotal role of the Ministry of Defence (Finance) and the Financial Advisor (Defence Services). It provides an in-depth look at the Defence Accounts Department (DAD) and its head, the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA), covering their mandate for audit, payment, and accounting for the armed forces. Participants will explore the procedures for revenue and capital procurement, the formulation of the defence budget, and the mechanisms for post-budget vigilance. By the end of this course, learners will be better equipped to navigate the financial landscape of the defence ministry, facilitating quicker, more informed decision-making in matters of national security.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Orientation on Faecal Sludge and Septage Management
desc: As India's urban population grows, managing liquid waste effectively, especially in areas without conventional sewerage systems, has become a critical governance challenge. This course offers a detailed introduction to Faecal Sludge and Septage Management (FSSM), providing a viable and sustainable solution for city-wide inclusive sanitation. It is structured to build the capacity of officials to plan and implement FSSM projects in alignment with key national programs, including the Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U) 2.0 and AMRUT 2.0. The curriculum covers the entire sanitation service chain, exploring the context of urban sanitation, relevant national policies, sanitation systems and technologies, city-level planning approaches, and financial modeling. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to develop comprehensive FSSM strategies for their cities, ensuring improved public health, environmental protection, and the achievement of Sustainable Development Goals 6.2 and 6.3. This knowledge is essential for urban planners, engineers, and administrators working to create cleaner, healthier, and more resilient cities.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title: Orientation on Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban 2.0
desc: This orientation program delves into the strategic framework and operational guidelines of the Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban 2.0. The course is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the mission's core pillars, which are critical for transforming India's urban landscapes. Key learning areas include advanced solid waste management techniques, from source segregation to scientific processing and disposal. It also covers the technical and logistical aspects of used water and faecal sludge management to prevent water pollution and promote resource recovery. A significant focus is placed on the challenging task of remediating legacy dumpsites to reclaim valuable urban land and mitigate environmental hazards. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of behavior change communication, capacity building for municipal staff, and robust citizen engagement to ensure the sustainability of sanitation outcomes. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to contribute to the planning, implementation, and monitoring of SBM-U 2.0 initiatives within their respective urban areas, helping to create cleaner, greener, and healthier cities for all.
org: Regional Centre for Urban and Environmental Studies Lucknow

title: ORMAS Model: Community Cadres for Rural Youth Engagement
desc: Odisha revitalized India’s flagship skill development program, DDU-GKY, which initially struggled with low enrolment, weak awareness, and high dropouts. The Odisha Rural Development and Marketing Society (ORMAS) introduced a structured mobilization model by incentivizing Community Cadres (Gram Rojgar Sevaks, Community Resource Persons, Master Book Keepers) and using mobilisation camps, IEC tools, and community engagement. This approach boosted enrolment, improved training outcomes, and enhanced job retention, demonstrating how community-driven strategies can make national missions more effective.

title: OTN Frame Structure
desc: This course offers an in-depth technical overview of the Optical Transport Network (OTN) frame structure, a critical technology in modern telecommunications. The content is designed to build a strong foundational understanding of how data is organized, mapped, and transported across optical networks. The course begins by introducing the core concepts of data framing and its importance in telecommunications, drawing comparisons to the well-known SDH/SONET framework. Learners will delve into the three main parts of the OTN frame: the Optical Payload Unit (OPU), the Optical Data Unit (ODU), and the Optical Transport Unit (OTU). Each section's overhead bytes and their specific functions for performance monitoring, alarm indication, and protection switching are explained in detail. A significant focus is placed on the Forward Error Correction (FEC) mechanism, including its use of the Reed-Solomon algorithm to improve signal-to-noise ratio and extend transmission distances. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret OTN frame data, understand its role in managing client signals, and appreciate its advantages in building robust and scalable optical transport systems.

title: Over Dimensional Consignment
desc: The transportation of Over Dimensional Consignments (ODCs) is a critical and complex operation within the Indian Railways, demanding strict adherence to safety protocols to prevent accidents and ensure network integrity. This course provides a comprehensive guide for railway personnel tasked with the planning and execution of ODC movements. It begins by defining ODCs and detailing their classification into Class A, B, and C based on clearance dimensions, clarifying the roles of various sanctioning authorities. The curriculum delves into key operational aspects, such as maximum moving dimensions for BG wagons, specific speed and timing restrictions, and mandatory escort requirements. Special attention is given to the unique challenges and precautions necessary when moving ODCs through electrified sections. Furthermore, the course covers the end-to-end procedural framework, including proper packing, loading, shunting techniques, and the correct use of card labels for route approvals. Participants will learn the importance of seamless coordination between the SCR, TPC, and controllers. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying these departmental rules, significantly enhancing operational safety and efficiency in handling ODCs. This will empower them to minimize risks and ensure full compliance in their daily responsibilities.

title: Over Dimensional Consignment Movements
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the procedures and regulations governing the movement of Over-Dimensional Consignments (ODC) on Indian Railways. The transportation of ODC is fundamental to supporting major industrial and infrastructure projects, including the movement of heavy machinery, large structures, and critical defense equipment. This program is designed to equip railway personnel with the necessary knowledge to manage these complex logistical operations safely and efficiently. Key learning areas include the official classification of ODCs into Class A, B, and C based on clearance dimensions; the distinction between gross and net clearance; and the step-by-step process for obtaining sanction from the competent authorities. The course also covers detailed guidelines for loading, lashing, and securing consignments, along with special precautions for movement through electrified territories and protocols for dispatch. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply these procedures to ensure compliance, safety, and operational excellence in handling ODCs.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Overview of Basic Statistics
desc: In an increasingly data-driven world, the ability to understand and utilize statistics is a critical skill for public sector professionals. This course serves as a foundational guide to basic statistical concepts and their practical applications. You will begin by learning the importance of statistics in solving real-world problems and then move on to the methods of data collection, organization, and summarization using descriptive measures, tables, and charts. The course delves into key topics such as measures of central tendency, variability, correlation, regression, and the fundamentals of hypothesis testing. Through clear explanations and practical examples, you will learn to analyze relationships within datasets and interpret the results effectively. By the end of this course, you will have the confidence to apply statistical thinking to evaluate data, make informed judgments, and communicate findings in a clear, non-technical manner, enhancing your analytical capabilities for your role.

title: Overview of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita for Railways
desc: This course offers an essential guide to the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) and its impact on railway law enforcement. As the BNSS replaces the long-standing Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), it is crucial for Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel to understand and adapt to the new legal landscape. The curriculum delves into the key procedural shifts, providing a clear comparison between the old and new laws. Key learning areas include updated protocols for making arrests, conducting investigations, managing trial processes, and adhering to new documentation standards. Participants will learn to apply these BNSS-compliant procedures in real-world railway scenarios, from registering an FIR and creating seizure memos to handling digital evidence. The course is designed to ensure that RPF officers can perform their duties with confidence, upholding legal standards while maintaining security and order across the railway network. Ultimately, it empowers officers to navigate the transition smoothly, ensuring all actions are legally sound and operationally efficient.
org: Jagjivan Ram Railway Protection Force Academy (JRRPF)

title: Overview of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for Railways
desc: This course provides essential training on the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), the new criminal law of India. The content is tailored for personnel of the Railway Protection Force (RPF) to ensure they are well-versed in the legal changes that directly affect their duties. The curriculum begins by outlining the fundamental shifts from the old Indian Penal Code (IPC) to the new BNS, establishing a clear context for the reforms. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of offenses that impact railway safety, the new categorization of crimes, and the practical implications for RPF procedures. Learners will explore how the BNS, along with the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), creates an integrated legal framework for investigation and prosecution. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to apply the new legal standards effectively, ensuring lawful and efficient handling of criminal matters within the Indian Railways.
org: Jagjivan Ram Railway Protection Force Academy (JRRPF)

title: Overview of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 for Field Practitioners
desc: With the enactment of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) in 2023, India has undertaken a monumental reform of its criminal laws, moving away from a colonial legal legacy. This course is specifically designed for field practitioners, particularly police personnel, to facilitate a smooth transition from the Indian Penal Code (IPC) to the new BNS. It systematically breaks down the new legislation, starting with its core objectives of making the justice system more accessible and victim-centric. The curriculum covers critical reforms related to offences against women and children, and introduces new provisions for crimes like mob lynching, snatching, and organised crime. It also examines changes to laws concerning offences against the state, such as sedition. Furthermore, the course explores the revised punishment framework, including the introduction of community service. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the essential knowledge to interpret and apply the BNS, ensuring compliance and enhancing the effectiveness of the criminal justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Overview of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 for Field Practitioners
desc: The enactment of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023, represents a pivotal reform in India's legal system, replacing the colonial-era Indian Evidence Act of 1872. This course is designed to provide field practitioners, including law enforcement and legal professionals, with a thorough understanding of this new legislation. It addresses the critical need for officials to adapt to a legal framework that incorporates technological advancements and modern evidentiary standards. The curriculum is divided into six modules, systematically covering the introduction to the BSA, the revised definitions of evidence, the enhanced role of electronic and digital records, and the updated rules on admissibility. Learners will analyze the key differences between the old and new acts, understand the implications of the 170 new sections, and learn how these changes affect day-to-day legal and investigative procedures. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to apply the BSA, 2023 correctly in their professional duties, contributing to a more efficient and credible justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Overview of BNSS, 2023 for Field Practitioners
desc: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 represents a significant modernization of India's criminal procedure laws. This course is structured to guide field practitioners through this pivotal legal reform. It begins by establishing the historical context and strategic objectives of the BNSS. Learners will then delve into specific changes, including new definitions, amendments to the powers of courts and police, and updated arrest procedures. The curriculum systematically compares the BNSS with the former CrPC, focusing on critical areas such as the registration of FIRs, medical examinations, summoning processes, witness statement recording, and search and seizure protocols. Furthermore, the course details important reforms concerning bail provisions and mercy petitions. A key focus is the introduction of technology, covering trials conducted in electronic mode and revised timelines for legal proceedings. By completing this course, participants will gain a clear and practical understanding of the BNSS, enabling them to apply the new procedures effectively in their professional roles and contribute to a more transparent and responsive justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Overview of Cloud Computing
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the world of cloud computing, designed for professionals seeking to understand its impact on technology and business operations. The curriculum begins by defining cloud computing and contrasting it with legacy on-premise infrastructure, highlighting key advantages like cost efficiency, scalability, global availability, and enhanced security. You will explore the primary working models, including deployment types such as public, private, hybrid, and community clouds, and service models like Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS). The course delves into the underlying technologies that power the cloud, such as virtualization, hypervisors, and service-oriented architecture. Furthermore, it addresses critical aspects of cloud adoption, including planning, security considerations, and potential risks. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the fundamental knowledge to make informed decisions about leveraging cloud technology, understand its architecture, and recognize the major players in the cloud services market.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Overview of Customs
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Customs Act, 1962, and its application in regulating India's international trade. It begins by detailing the administrative hierarchy of Indian Customs and the powers of its officers. Learners will study key legal definitions and provisions governing import and export procedures, including the classification and valuation of goods under the Customs Tariff Act, 1975, and associated valuation rules. The course thoroughly examines prohibitions, enforcement mechanisms, penalties for non-compliance, and the available dispute resolution processes. A significant focus is placed on the transformative impact of technology, particularly the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) system, which streamlines trade by improving transparency, ensuring compliance, and reducing delays. Upon completion, participants will have a solid foundational knowledge of customs law, enabling them to navigate its complexities effectively.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Overview of Data Loss Prevention and Database Activity Monitoring
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of two critical data security technologies: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Database Activity Monitoring (DAM). It is designed to help Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and other security professionals understand how these technologies can be implemented to protect sensitive data, detect security threats, support compliance, and strengthen an organisation’s overall data protection strategy. The course covers the complete DLP lifecycle, including Discovery, Design, Enforcement, and Monitoring, as well as the protection of data in use, data in motion, and data at rest. Participants will explore different DLP solutions, including Network, Endpoint, Email, Cloud, and Behavioural DLP, along with a comparative analysis of leading solutions such as Forcepoint, Symantec, Trellix, Microsoft Purview, and Proofpoint.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Overview of Delhi Special Police Establishment Act 1946
desc: This course provides a foundational overview of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and its legal anchor, the Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act of 1946. It covers the constitution and powers of the DSPE, the processes for appointing its officials, rules around state consent and jurisdiction extension, and the role of judicial intervention. This course is aimed at strengthening the knowledge and competencies of Section Officers and administrative staff.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Overview of DMRC Track Structures
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the track structures that form the backbone of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) network. Designed for engineering professionals and technical staff, it provides essential knowledge for anyone involved in the design, construction, or maintenance of modern urban railway systems. The course establishes a strong context by explaining the importance of robust track infrastructure for a large-scale Mass Rapid Transit System. Key learning areas include a deep dive into the components of both ballasted and ballastless tracks, with a special focus on the various fastening systems like the 336, Eclipse, and Reda 2000, which are critical for track stability, elasticity, and noise reduction. Furthermore, the course elucidates the practical aspects of track construction, such as the top-down method for laying track, and the geometric parameters like super-elevation that ensure safe and efficient train operation. Upon completion, learners will be ableto identify and analyze different track components and layouts, understand their specific applications within the DMRC system, and appreciate the engineering principles that ensure the safety and reliability of metro rail operations.

title: Overview of Drilling Operation in Mineral Exploration
desc: Designed for beginners and early-career professionals, this course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of surface mineral exploration drilling. The curriculum addresses the fundamental question of why drilling is a critical component of the mineral exploration process. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of various drilling techniques such as rotary, percussion, diamond core, and auger drilling, along with their specific applications and limitations in different geological environments. The course also delves into the operational aspects, covering the types of drilling rigs, essential accessories, and the selection and function of drilling fluids. A significant emphasis is placed on adhering to field safety protocols and industry best practices to ensure safe and efficient operations. Upon completion, participants will possess the necessary knowledge to understand and support field drilling activities, making them valuable assets in any mineral exploration team.

title: Overview of DWDM
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) technology, designed for professionals in the telecommunications sector.
