The curriculum begins by explaining the challenges faced by modern telecom networks, such as fiber exhaust and the exponential growth in data traffic, setting the context for why DWDM is a crucial solution. You will learn about the evolution of wavelength division multiplexing, from early two-channel systems to modern dense networks capable of carrying over 160 channels on a single fiber. The course details the core components of a DWDM system, including transmitters, optical amplifiers like EDFA, multiplexers/demultiplexers, and receivers. It also highlights the key advantages of DWDM, such as its independence from data protocol and bit-rate, which allows it to carry diverse traffic like IP, ATM, and SDH simultaneously. Upon completion, learners will have a solid understanding of how DWDM works and its strategic importance in building scalable, high-capacity optical transport networks for the future.

title: Overview of Employee Self Services
desc: In today's digital-first work environment, mastering internal administrative tools is crucial for efficiency. This course offers a detailed, practical guide to the Employee Self-Service (ESS) portal, an integrated SAP platform designed to simplify HR processes for government employees. The training begins with the basics of logging in and navigating the main dashboard, providing a clear overview of all available features.The curriculum delves into specific, high-frequency tasks. You will learn the step-by-step process for managing your work schedule through the 'Working Times' module, including how to apply for different types of leave and check your quota. The course thoroughly covers the 'Benefits & Payment' section, explaining how to submit and track reimbursement claims for medical expenses, travel, mobile bills, and more. Additionally, it demonstrates how to access salary statements, manage personal and family information, and file mandatory returns like Immovable Property Returns. Upon completion, you will be proficient in using the ESS portal for all your routine administrative and financial claim submissions.

title: Overview of Financial Statement
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the core components of corporate financial reporting. It begins by explaining the purpose and interplay of the four key financial statements. You will learn to deconstruct the balance sheet, understanding the classification of assets, liabilities, and equity. The course then moves to the profit and loss statement, detailing how to analyze revenue, expenses, and net profit. A significant portion is dedicated to the cash flow statement, where you will learn to distinguish between operating, investing, and financing activities and understand the crucial difference between profit and actual cash. Furthermore, the course covers the statement of changes in equity and highlights the importance of the 'notes to accounts' for a deeper analysis. By the end, learners will be able to differentiate between standalone and consolidated financials and confidently assess a company's financial stability and performance, a critical skill for anyone in a financial oversight or management role.

title: OVERVIEW OF GENDER SENSITIZATION
desc: This foundational course, 'An Overview of Gender Sensitization and Equality,' is designed to educate all government employees on the principles of gender equality and respect in the workplace. The curriculum delves into the core differences between sex and gender, unpacks the social construction of gender roles, and examines the impact of stereotypes and biases. Participants will explore the serious issues of gender inequality and gender-based violence, including sexual harassment, through clear definitions and illustrative case studies. The primary objective is to change attitudes and behaviors by raising awareness of gender equality concerns. Upon completion, learners will be able to identify discriminatory practices, understand the need for prophylactic measures, and contribute to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment for individuals of all gender identities, aligning with the goal of fostering a more just and equitable public service.

title: Overview of GST Rates, Payment of Tax and Settlement of Funds
desc: This course is designed to offer a detailed understanding of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. It begins by explaining the various GST rates and tax slabs applicable to different goods and services. The curriculum then moves to the practical aspects of tax compliance, covering the procedures for making tax payments and the principles of value addition. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to complex but crucial topics such as the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), the chain of Input Tax Credit (ITC), and the functions of an Input Service Distributor (ISD). Furthermore, it clarifies the transition provisions that were critical during the GST rollout and explains the rules governing the apportionment and settlement of funds between the central and state governments. Upon completion, learners will be well-versed in the key operational aspects of GST, enabling them to ensure compliance and proper financial management within their roles.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Overview of IGST and Place of Supply
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) Act, 2017, a cornerstone of India's GST framework. Designed for tax professionals, finance officers, and business owners, the program clarifies the complexities of tax on inter-state commerce. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the legal provisions governing IGST, including the levy and collection mechanisms as detailed in Section 5, exemptions under Section 6, and the determination of inter-state versus intra-state supplies per Sections 7 and 8. A significant focus is placed on the principles for determining the 'Place of Supply' for both goods (Section 10 & 11) and services (Section 12 & 13), which is essential for correct tax liability assessment. The course also covers the apportionment of tax, zero-rated supplies, and refund procedures, equipping learners with the knowledge to ensure compliance and navigate the IGST landscape effectively.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Overview of IGST Model and Place of Supply
desc: This foundational course delves into the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) model, which governs the taxation of goods and services traded across state borders. The curriculum is designed to provide public officials with a clear understanding of why IGST is necessary and how it functions to create a unified economic market. Key learning areas include the fundamental concepts of inter-state versus intra-state supply, the specific rules for determining the 'place of supply' for various transaction types, and the mechanics of the Input Tax Credit (ITC) system within the IGST framework. Upon completion, learners will be able to correctly interpret and apply IGST provisions, ensure accurate tax calculation and payment, and understand the process of fund settlement between the central and state governments. This knowledge is vital for officials involved in tax administration to ensure compliance and uphold the integrity of the GST system.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Overview of Imports Management
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the principles of import management, contextualized for public sector operations. It begins by defining crucial trade terminologies, including prohibited, restricted, and canalized items. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to demystifying Incoterms 2020, explaining the 11 different rules and how they allocate risks and responsibilities between buyers and sellers, with a focus on terms commonly used in large-scale procurement like FOB, FAS, and CFR. Furthermore, the course provides a step-by-step guide to the Letter of Credit (LC) process, from its issuance to utilization, highlighting it as a secure payment mechanism in import contracts. Participants will learn about the necessary precautions and documentation, such as the Bill of Lading and Airway Bill, required for a successful transaction. Upon completion, learners will be able to interpret and apply these fundamental concepts to manage import activities effectively, minimizing potential disputes and ensuring procedural compliance.

title: Overview of India Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
desc: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), 2023, marks a pivotal moment in the nation's journey towards digital sovereignty and citizen empowerment. In an era of rapid digital transformation, safeguarding personal data has become a critical governance priority. This course delves into the intricacies of the DPDPA, explaining its significance in a country with a vast and growing digital footprint. It provides a detailed examination of the Act's evolution, drawing lessons from global privacy frameworks like GDPR and events such as the Cambridge Analytica breach. Key learning areas include the rights of individuals (Data Principals), the obligations of data-handling entities (Data Fiduciaries), the principles of consent management, and special protections for children's data. The course also unpacks the institutional framework established under the Act, focusing on the powers and functions of the Data Protection Board of India. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand their rights and responsibilities under the new law and appreciate its role in building trust within India's Digital Public Infrastructure, making it essential for public officials, legal professionals, and technology leaders.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Overview of Indian Parliamentary Procedures
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of Indian parliamentary procedures, tailored for government officials. It delves into the critical functions of the Parliament, explaining why a thorough understanding of its procedural rules is essential for effective public administration. Key learning areas include the classification and lifecycle of parliamentary questions, such as Starred and Unstarred questions, and the process of giving and fulfilling parliamentary assurances. Participants will learn how to navigate the procedural requirements for submitting information and preparing responses for their respective ministries. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to support their departments in upholding accountability, ensuring timely and accurate communication with the legislature, and contributing to the smooth functioning of democratic processes.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Overview of Indian Railways Earnings and Expenditures
desc: Gain an in-depth understanding of the financial operations of Indian Railways. This course examines the critical components of the railway's fiscal structure, providing essential context on why robust financial management is vital for this large-scale public enterprise. You will explore the major revenue streams, from traditional coaching and goods earnings to modern Non-Fare Revenue strategies that diversify income. The curriculum also systematically breaks down expenditures, differentiating between revenue-based working expenses and long-term capital investments, with a special focus on analyzing staff-related costs. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze the complete financial cycle of Indian Railways, interpret financial statements, and appreciate the economic drivers behind its operations, making it highly relevant for officials in finance, accounting, and management roles within the public sector.

title: Overview of Indian Railways Project Sanctions and Management
desc: The IRPSM (Indian Railways Projects Sanctions and Management) web application course provides an end-to-end understanding of railway project and works management within a structured digital environment. It covers the complete lifecycle of a project, from proposal creation, scrutiny, vetting, and sanctioning to progress monitoring and reporting. The course explains the roles and responsibilities of key stakeholders at the Division, Zonal, Production Units (PUs), and Railway Board levels, highlighting how each entity processes, verifies, and forwards proposals within the system. It emphasizes the standardized workflow, mandatory financial and technical checks, and real-time online tracking of works, ensuring transparency, accountability, and efficiency across all stages of project execution.
keywords: Indian Railways Projects Sanctions and Management

title: Overview of Infrastructure in Civil Engineering
desc: This introductory course is designed to familiarize learners with the essential components of civil engineering infrastructure within the Indian Railways. It begins by outlining the eleven major static infrastructures, establishing a broad context for the detailed topics that follow. The primary focus is on the railway track itself, breaking it down into its five core components: rails, sleepers, fastenings, ballast, and the underlying formation. The course delves into the practical and theoretical aspects of track design, explaining the necessity and types of curves used to navigate terrain and obstacles. It also clarifies the concept of super-elevation and its role in ensuring train stability and passenger comfort. Furthermore, learners will gain a clear understanding of gradients, their different types, and their significance in railway construction and operation. By the end of this course, participants will have a solid grasp of the fundamental civil engineering principles that govern the world's largest railway networks, preparing them for more advanced studies or roles in railway maintenance and project management.

title: Overview of Internet of Things
desc: The Internet of Things (IoT) is reshaping our world by creating a vast network of interconnected devices that collect and exchange data, driving unprecedented efficiency and innovation. This course offers a foundational understanding of the IoT ecosystem, designed for professionals seeking to grasp its core principles and applications. It begins by defining IoT, tracing its evolution, and breaking down its essential components, from sensors and connectivity protocols to data processing and user interfaces. Learners will delve into the various communication technologies that power IoT, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular, and LPWAN, and learn to identify the factors influencing technology selection. The curriculum thoroughly explores the transformative impact of IoT across diverse sectors like smart cities, healthcare, agriculture, and industrial automation. A significant focus is placed on addressing the inherent security and privacy challenges, providing guidelines for securing IoT systems. Furthermore, the course introduces the OneM2M global standard, explaining its crucial role in achieving interoperability and scalability. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to identify IoT use cases, evaluate technological aspects, and understand the security frameworks necessary for successful implementation.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Overview of IT 2.0 - Internal Mobile App
desc: This course is designed to familiarize learners with the IT 2.0 internal mobile application, a pivotal component of the Department of Posts' digital transformation strategy. The content addresses the importance of modernizing India's vast postal network, especially in rural areas, by equipping postal workers with advanced digital tools. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of the app's salient features, such as its unified interface for mail operations, banking, and insurance, role-based access, and real-time data updates. The course covers essential branch office operations that can be performed through the app, including booking articles, bagging, cash and stamp management, delivery processing, and doorstep services. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in navigating the app to perform their daily duties, contributing to a more efficient, transparent, and responsive postal service for citizens.

title: Overview of Lucknow Metro Train System
desc: Designed for beginners, this course demystifies the complex engineering behind urban rail transit. It begins by explaining the context of modern metro systems and their importance in public transportation. You will delve into the key learning areas, including the core electrical and mechanical systems such as power supply, traction motors, braking mechanisms, pneumatics, and the Train Control & Monitoring System (TCMS). The course also covers the structural elements like the car body, bogies, and the pantograph-OCS interface. Upon completion, learners will be able to appreciate how these diverse sub-systems are integrated to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient transportation for thousands of passengers daily, providing a solid base for further specialization in railway engineering or operations.
org: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited

title: OVERVIEW OF MAIL NETWORK OPTIMIZATION PROJECT
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Mail Network Optimization Project (MNOP), a transformative initiative designed to modernize India Post's mail operations. The program was launched to consolidate and optimize the mail network, improving the quality and reliability of mail services for both individual and corporate customers. Participants will learn about the core concepts of MNOP, including its objectives and significant benefits, such as increased delivery performance and enhanced tracking capabilities. Key learning areas include the strategic mapping of Post Offices to National Sorting Hubs (NSH) and Intra Circle Hubs (ICH), the redesigned inward and outward mail flow, and the mandatory scanning procedures for Speed Post and BNPL articles. The course also covers the 11 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that are crucial for monitoring operational efficiency and driving continuous improvement. Upon completion, learners will have a clear understanding of how MNOP has restructured postal logistics, leading to a more transparent, efficient, and citizen-centric service delivery system.

title: Overview of Manufacturing Industry
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed exploration of the manufacturing industry's landscape, tracing its historical development both globally and within the Indian context. It is designed for public officials who require a solid understanding of the industrial sector's role in economic growth and governance. The curriculum begins by examining the evolution of manufacturing, from its early history to the transformative impact of the Industrial Revolutions, including the current shift towards Industry 4.0. Participants will gain insights into the various sectors that make up the manufacturing domain, understanding their unique characteristics and contributions. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the strategic initiatives launched by the Government of India to promote industrial growth, enhance competitiveness, and foster innovation. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to appreciate the complexities of the manufacturing ecosystem and its strategic importance to India's policy and economic objectives, enabling them to contribute more effectively to industrial development frameworks.

title: Overview of National Pension System and National Pension System Lite
desc: This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the National Pension System (NPS), a critical component of India's social security framework. It addresses the importance of the pension system for government employees and the public, explaining its structure and the roles of its regulatory bodies. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the functions of stakeholders such as pension funds, trustee banks, and Drawing & Disbursing Officers (DDOs). The course also covers the transition from the old pension scheme, eligibility criteria, subscriber responsibilities, and the attractive tax benefits under the EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) regime. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate NPS investment options, understand withdrawal and annuity rules, and appreciate the operational procedures managed by the PrAO, PAO, and DDOs. This knowledge is vital for officials involved in financial management, human resources, and accounts to ensure effective and compliant administration of the pension system.

title: Overview of Oil and Gas Industry
desc: This course offers a foundational exploration of India's oil and gas industry, covering its historical, geological, technological, and policy dimensions. It is designed for professionals new to the energy sector, students, and public officials seeking to understand the fundamentals of petroleum and natural gas. The curriculum begins by explaining the origin and formation of petroleum, including the classification of hydrocarbons and their presence across India's sedimentary basins. You will learn about the evolution of the sector, from early discoveries to the current landscape of exploration and production (E&P). The course details the impact of major government policies like the New Exploration Licensing Policy (NELP), Hydrocarbon Exploration and Licensing Policy (HELP), and the Open Acreage Licensing Policy (OALP) on investment and growth. Furthermore, it highlights key technological advancements that have enabled the extraction of unconventional resources like shale oil and gas. Upon completion, you will have a solid grasp of the sector's structure, challenges, and future opportunities within India's energy strategy.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Overview of optical fibre communication
desc: Dive into the world of high-speed connectivity with this introductory course on optical fibre communication. Designed for those new to the field, this program demystifies the technology that powers the internet, broadband services, and modern telecommunication systems. The course begins by establishing the context, explaining why optical fibre is critical for future-ready infrastructure and its advantages in capacity and security. Key learning areas include the core scientific principle of Total Internal Reflection, the physical structure of optical fibres (core and cladding), and the distinction between single-mode and multi-mode fibres. You will also learn to identify essential system components like transmitters, receivers, various connector types, and the methods for splicing and laying cables. Upon completion, learners will have a solid foundational knowledge of how optical fibre technology works and its practical applications in long-distance communication, Fiber to the Home (FTTH), and even military systems, enabling them to better understand and engage with telecommunication infrastructure projects.

title: Overview of Parliamentary Business
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the essential functions and procedures of the Indian Parliament, designed for public sector professionals who interact with or support the legislative process. Understanding the intricacies of Parliament is crucial for effective governance, policy implementation, and maintaining accountability. The course begins by demystifying the legislative journey of a bill, from its introduction to its enactment as law. It then provides a detailed examination of the Parliamentary Committee system, explaining the distinct roles of various committees and highlighting the critical oversight functions of the Financial Committees. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to the Question Hour, a vital tool for parliamentary accountability. Learners will understand its proceedings and learn the established protocols for how Ministries and Departments must handle parliamentary questions and respond to government assurances.
subDomain: Submission of briefs, supply of information
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Overview of Passes and PTO
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the rules and regulations governing travel benefits for employees of the Indian Railways. It is designed to equip railway servants and administrative staff with a thorough understanding of Passes and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTOs). The curriculum begins by establishing the applicability of these rules and provides precise definitions for 'family,' 'dependent relatives,' and 'attendants' to avoid ambiguity. The course systematically covers the various types of passes available, including Duty, Privilege, School, Residential, Widow, and Special passes, detailing the purpose and conditions for each. Furthermore, it breaks down the entitlement criteria based on employee classifications, such as Group A, B, and C, and specific pay levels. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently identify their entitlements, understand the procedures for different travel scenarios, and correctly apply these essential service rules in their professional capacity.

title: Overview of Policies in Military Nursing Service
desc: Established in 1926, the Military Nursing Service (MNS) holds a distinguished legacy as a cornerstone of the Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS). This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of this unique, all-women service and its critical role in national security and healthcare. The curriculum delves into the foundational history of the MNS and its evolution within the Indian Armed Forces. Key learning areas include the diverse responsibilities of MNS officers, who deliver essential nursing care in tri-services hospitals, during military operations, and on international UN peacekeeping missions. The course also examines the rigorous training and mentoring processes that ensure the highest standards of medical professionalism and leadership. Furthermore, it sheds light on the significant administrative duties performed by MNS officers. Upon completion, learners will have a deep appreciation for the pivotal contributions of the MNS to the health and welfare of military personnel, recognizing its enduring impact on India's defence healthcare infrastructure.

title: Overview of Post Box and Post Bag
desc: Post Boxes and Post Bags are essential services from India Post, offering a secure and private alternative to door delivery for individuals and organizations with significant mail volume. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the operational and regulatory framework governing these services. It delves into the specific conditions outlined in PO Order No. PO/01/2024 (C) and Regulations 46(2) and 47(2) of the Post Office Regulations 2024. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process for applying for a new service, managing renewals, and understanding the fee structure and allotment periods. Furthermore, the course clarifies the procedures for clearing items from the box or bag, the correct format for addressing mail to ensure timely delivery, and the formal process for surrendering the service. Upon completion, participants will be fully equipped to navigate all aspects of Post Box and Post Bag services, ensuring compliance and efficient mail management.

title: Overview of Postal Accounts Office and Its Major Functions
desc: This program offers an in-depth understanding of the Postal Accounts Office and its vital role in public sector financial administration. The course begins by defining Government Accounts and their core components, setting the foundation for understanding public financial management. Learners will be guided through the essential processes of financial reporting, reconciliation, and auditing, which are crucial for maintaining compliance and accountability. The curriculum delves into the specific functions of various sections within a Postal Accounts Office, such as those handling pensions, provident funds, insurance, and budgeting. A key focus is on the Core System Integration (CSI) software, explaining its modules and functionality in digitizing financial operations. Upon completion, participants will possess the knowledge to identify key financial processes, understand administrative roles, and apply best practices in managing government accounts, contributing to a more efficient and transparent financial system.

title: Overview of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), a critical government initiative designed to provide a financial safety net for India's farmers. The program begins by outlining the fundamental objectives and nationwide scope of PMFBY, explaining how it protects agricultural producers against losses from non-preventable natural risks. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the risks covered, such as prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities. A significant focus is placed on the technological backbone of the scheme, detailing innovative systems like Yes-Tech for yield estimation, WINS for weather data, and Cropic for photo-based loss assessment. Learners will also understand the operational aspects, including risk-sharing models, the grievance redressal portal Krishi Rakshak, and the role of the National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP). Upon completion, participants will be able to appreciate the scheme's role in strengthening agricultural resilience and promoting data-driven governance in the sector.
org: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana PMFBY

title: Overview of Public Key Infrastructure in Classical Cryptography
desc: This course introduces Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) in classical and quantum cryptography, explaining how asymmetric key pairs and Certificate Authorities enable secure digital communication through protocols like TLS/SSL. Learners explore PKI’s architecture, authentication, encryption, and data integrity mechanisms, along with the underlying mathematical problems such as integer factorization and discrete logarithms. The course highlights emerging quantum threats, including Shor’s algorithm, and examines Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms being standardized by NIST to address vulnerabilities. It also covers Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and hybrid classical-quantum approaches, providing practical insights for designing quantum-resistant and future-proof secure communication systems.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Overview of Speech and Language Development in Children
desc: The development of speech and language is a critical and complex process in early childhood. This course offers a foundational understanding of how children acquire these essential skills. It is designed to empower parents, caregivers, and early educators with the knowledge to create a supportive learning environment. The curriculum is structured to first introduce the typical developmental timeline and the necessary conditions for healthy speech and language acquisition. You will learn to recognize the early warning signs of potential disorders, enabling timely intervention. The course then transitions to practical application, providing actionable strategies and stimulation techniques that can be integrated into daily routines to foster communication skills. It also outlines clear do's and don'ts for teaching language, ensuring that support is both positive and effective. By the end of this course, you will be better equipped to play an active and informed role in a child's communication development.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: Overview of Swachh Bharat Mission
desc: This introductory course delves into the fundamental aspects of the Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM), a transformative initiative aimed at achieving a 'Clean India'. The program provides a detailed look at the mission's context, its critical importance for public health, and its alignment with sustainable development goals. Key learning areas include the distinct components of SBM-Gramin (Rural) and SBM-Urban, the framework for achieving and sustaining Open Defecation Free (ODF) status, and the strategies for managing solid and liquid waste. Participants will explore the pivotal role of Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) activities and community participation in driving behavioral change. Upon completion, learners will be able to articulate the mission's structure, objectives, and its profound impact on governance and citizen well-being, equipping them to support and contribute to this national endeavor.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Overview of the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund Scheme
desc: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) is a flagship Central Government-backed initiative aimed at transforming India's agricultural landscape by addressing post-harvest losses, enhancing infrastructure, and strengthening value chains. Launched under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat Package, AIF provides medium to long-term debt financing for projects in post-harvest management, storage, processing, logistics, and value addition. This course equips participants with a deep understanding of AIF’s objectives, key features, eligibility criteria, and operational processes. Participants will explore how AIF empowers farmers, FPOs, SHGs, APMCs, and agri-entrepreneurs through 3% interest subvention, credit guarantee support, and project convergence opportunities. By the end of this course, learners will be able to plan, apply, and leverage AIF to drive agricultural modernization, reduce wastage, and increase farmer income.

title: Overview of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed introduction to the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and its critical role in shaping India's digital landscape. Initially established as the Department of Information Technology, its evolution into a full-fledged ministry in 2016 underscores the growing importance of the digital sector. The course delves into MeitY's strategic vision for leading India's e-Development. Key learning areas include the ministry's primary functions, such as formulating national policies for IT, promoting the hardware and software industries, ensuring cybersecurity through agencies like ICERT, and driving digital transactions. Learners will also gain an understanding of the key bodies that support MeitY's mission, including the National Informatics Centre (NIC) and the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). Upon completion, participants will have a clear perspective on how MeitY's initiatives contribute to national growth, e-governance, and digital inclusion for all citizens.
org: Ministry of Electronics and Information and Technology Meity
keywords: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

title: Overview of the New Criminal Laws for Judicial Officers
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the transformative reforms within India's new criminal legal framework. Designed for judicial officers, it provides the essential knowledge required to navigate the updated system effectively. The curriculum covers the core principles and procedural shifts introduced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA). Key learning areas include the restructuring of criminal courts, enhanced use of audio-video electronic means in proceedings, and new protocols for pre-trial, trial, and post-trial stages. The course also details modernized evidence handling, particularly the admissibility of electronic records under BSA, and new sentencing provisions like community service under BNS. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these new laws, ensuring efficient and fair administration of justice in the evolving legal landscape.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Overview of the New Criminal Laws for Prosecutors and Lawyers
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the landmark reforms in India's criminal justice system. It is designed for legal professionals seeking to understand the practical implications of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA). The curriculum delves into the context behind these new laws and systematically breaks down the key changes at every stage of a criminal case, from investigation and arrest to trial and appeals. Key learning areas include new definitions of offences, modifications in trial procedures, updated rules for the admissibility of electronic evidence, and new concepts like community service and enhanced plea bargaining. By completing this course, prosecutors and lawyers will be equipped to apply this critical knowledge to their casework, adapt their legal strategies, and ensure compliance with the new statutory framework, thereby upholding the principles of justice in their professional practice.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Overview of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme
desc: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme launched by the Government of India on 1st December 2018 to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across the country. Under the scheme, ₹6,000 per year is provided in three equal instalments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), enabling farmers to meet agricultural and domestic expenses. With over ₹3.45 lakh crore transferred to more than 11 crore beneficiaries across 18 instalments, PM-KISAN is one of the world’s largest DBT programs. The scheme leverages cutting-edge digital infrastructure, including Aadhaar-based payments, e-KYC verification, a dedicated PM-KISAN portal, mobile applications, and AI-driven grievance redressal. This course provides an end-to-end understanding of PM-KISAN’s objectives, beneficiary lifecycle, payment workflow, state and local governance roles, and emerging innovations, empowering officials to implement and monitor the scheme effectively.

title: Overview of the Right to Information Act 2005
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005, which operationalizes the fundamental right to freedom of speech and expression. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the Act's provisions and practical application. Key learning areas include the definition of 'information', 'public authority', and 'third party'; the step-by-step procedure for filing an information request; and the applicable fee structures. The course delves into the specific roles and responsibilities of Public Information Officers (PIOs), the process for disposing of requests, and the various provisions that exempt certain information from disclosure. Furthermore, it explains the complete appellate process available to citizens and details the penalties and disciplinary actions that can be imposed for non-compliance, ensuring a holistic understanding of the RTI framework.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Overview of Viksit Bharat 2047
desc: Delve into the strategic framework of Viksit Bharat 2047, a landmark initiative to transform India into a developed economy. This course articulates the context behind this national vision, explaining why this is a pivotal moment—the 'Amrit Kaal'—for India's growth. You will explore the six foundational pillars that have underpinned recent progress, such as massive infrastructure investment and pioneering innovation, and the five key strategies designed to propel future development, including leveraging India's demographic dividend and achieving leadership in multiple sectors. The course details the specific economic and social goals, such as achieving a $30 trillion economy and ensuring a high quality of life for all citizens. It clarifies the roles of government, private enterprise, and individuals in this collective mission, offering a clear perspective on the path to building a prosperous, inclusive, and globally respected India by 2047.

title: Overview of Water Resources of India
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed exploration of India's water landscape, designed for public officials seeking to understand the complexities of water resource management. The curriculum is structured to provide a holistic view, beginning with the sources of water like rainfall, rivers, groundwater, and glaciers, and their distribution across the country. Learners will examine the significance of these resources and the challenges posed by over-exploitation, pollution, and climate change. The course covers crucial topics such as water conservation techniques, the importance of wetlands and Ramsar sites, and the legal frameworks governing inter-state water disputes. Participants will gain insights into the various programs and policies implemented by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, including the Namami Gange and Jal Jeevan Mission. Upon completion, learners will have a robust understanding of India's water sector, enabling them to contribute more effectively to policy implementation and sustainable resource governance.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: North Eastern Regional Institute of Water and Land Management (NERIWALM)

title: Overview on Accounting Standards
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip learners with a clear understanding of the accounting standards that govern financial reporting in India. It begins by explaining the concept of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and their importance in creating a uniform and reliable financial language. The course then delves into the four core aspects of accounting standards: recognizing transactions, measuring financial items, presenting information clearly in financial statements, and making necessary disclosures. Participants will explore the significant benefits of standardization, such as enhanced comparability between different enterprises and improved credibility of financial data. The curriculum provides a concise tour of the 27 effective Indian Accounting Standards (AS), covering key areas like inventory valuation (AS 2), cash flow statements (AS 3), revenue recognition (AS 9), and impairment of assets (AS 28). By the end of this course, learners will be able to appreciate the structured framework that ensures financial statements are meaningful, transparent, and useful for informed decision-making in the public and private sectors.

title: Palash: From Commodity to Brand
desc:
Palash, an ambitious state-led initiative launched in 2020 by the Government of Jharkhand through the Jharkhand State Livelihood Promotion Society (JSLPS). Originally grounded in Self-Help Groups (SHGs) focused on thrift and credit, Palash has evolved into a dynamic enterprise platform engaging over 3.2 million rural women across 289,000 SHGs, producing and marketing a diverse portfolio of agricultural, processed, and artisanal goods under a unified brand.

Palash’s growth story is shaped by its transition from informal, subsistence-based production to a structured supply chain that includes 46 Palash Marts, over 150 processing and manufacturing units, and direct-to-consumer strategies via Amazon, Flipkart, and Reliance Retail. The launch of a state-wide digital supply chain system in 2022 further signaled Palash’s ambition to scale with professionalism and precision.

At the heart of the case lies a strategic inflection point 'how should Palash restructure itself for future growth?'

title: Panch Pran and India's Civilizational Reawakening for Viksit Bharat
desc: The Panch Pran (Five Resolves), articulated by Narendra Modi in 2022, provides a visionary framework to guide India’s transformation into a developed nation (Viksit Bharat) by 2047. Rooted in India’s civilizational values and aspirations, the Panch Pran comprises five key commitments: building a developed India, eliminating the colonial mindset, taking pride in India’s heritage, strengthening unity and solidarity, and fulfilling the duties of citizens. These principles seek to foster a confident, inclusive, innovative, and responsible society while reinforcing India’s cultural identity and global leadership aspirations. The vision of Panch Pran is reflected in several governance initiatives, including Mission Karmayogi, Digital India, PM Vishwakarma Yojana, and MyGov. Together, these initiatives promote citizen-centric governance, digital transformation, skill development, participative decision-making, and institutional innovation.

title: PANCHA-KOSHAS: AN INDIAN APPROACH TO SELF-CONCEPT
desc: Delve into the profound wisdom of ancient Indian philosophy with this course on the Pancha Koshas, a comprehensive model for self-concept. This course provides a detailed exploration of the five distinct sheaths (Koshas) of human existence: Annamaya (the physical body), Pranamaya (the vital energy body), Manomaya (the mind), Vijnanamaya (wisdom), and Anandamaya (bliss). The curriculum begins by contrasting this idiographic Indian approach with prevalent nomothetic Western psychological theories, such as the Five-Factor Model, to provide a broader perspective on personality. Learners will discover how to apply the Panchakosha typology as a tool for self-analysis and introspection. The course further elaborates on practical yogic techniques and self-evaluation methods (Sakshatkar) that can be used to cultivate balance and foster development across all five sheaths. By integrating this ancient knowledge, public officials can enhance their self-awareness, manage stress, and achieve a state of holistic well-being, leading to greater personal fulfillment and professional excellence.

title: Paper to Cloud: Best Practices for Migrating Government Legacy Systems
desc: Transitioning from traditional paper-based or outdated digital systems to the cloud is a critical step in modernizing governance and improving public service delivery. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the process, designed specifically for the government context. It begins by establishing the 'why' behind cloud migration, detailing the compelling advantages in scalability, staff productivity, and cost reduction. The curriculum then delves into the practical 'how,' covering essential migration and modernization strategies such as re-hosting, re-platforming, and re-factoring. Participants will explore the core services offered by cloud providers like AWS, including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models, and learn how to navigate challenges related to data security, compliance, and financial management in a pay-as-you-go environment. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to develop a high-level strategy for migrating legacy systems, enabling their organizations to become more agile, resilient, and citizen-centric.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: PARAM Shavak: India's Indigenous Answer to High Performance Computing
desc: PARAM Shavak is an indigenous high-performance computing (HPC) desktop system developed under the National Supercomputing Mission by CDAC, MeitY, and VVDN Technologies. Powered by Rudra, it represents a major step forward in making advanced supercomputing accessible to academic and research institutions across India. Compact, energy-efficient, and cost-effective, PARAM Shavak enables institutions with limited resources to undertake cutting-edge research. By democratizing access to HPC, it helps overcome challenges such as low awareness, funding limitations, and a shortage of skilled professionals. This case study explores the system’s development, implementation challenges, and its contribution to strengthening India’s research ecosystem and advancing digital transformation.

title: Parcel Business in Indian Railways
desc: Gain a foundational understanding of the parcel business, a vital component of Indian Railways' commercial services. This course details the end-to-end lifecycle of parcel transportation, starting with the context of its importance for both household and business logistics. You will learn the key operational steps, including the execution of forwarding notes, examination and marking of parcels, and the weighment process. The curriculum explores the different types of available space, such as brake vans (SLRs), parcel vans (VPUs), and Parcel Cargo Express Trains (PCET), and their specific use cases. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the commercial framework, covering the calculation of parcel rates, demurrage and wharfage charges, and procedures for handling special consignments like Railway Material Consignments (RMC). Furthermore, it examines the evolution of key policies, including the Comprehensive Parcel Leasing Policy (CPLP), providing insights into how these reforms have shaped modern parcel logistics. Upon completion, learners will be able to effectively apply these rules and procedures in their roles within the railway's commercial department.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Parcel Network Optimization Project : PNOP
desc: This course delves into the Parcel Network Optimization Project (PNOP), a pivotal government initiative aimed at modernizing the postal parcel logistics framework. The project was designed to address the growing demands of the e-commerce sector and improve service quality. Participants will gain a detailed understanding of the project's key pillars, starting with the development and upgradation of parcel processing infrastructure to significantly increase handling capacity. The curriculum explores the strategic creation of an All-India Postal Road Transport Network (RTN) to ensure seamless and faster movement of parcels across the country. Furthermore, the course explains the role of newly developed National and Regional transhipment hubs in streamlining sorting and distribution. Learners will also study the plan for expanding the network of Nodal Delivery Centers and the integration of online monitoring systems to ensure real-time tracking, accountability, and enhanced operational control. Upon completion, participants will be able to appreciate the scale, objectives, and transformative impact of PNOP on the national postal service.

title: Parcel Packaging Policy
desc: This program details the essential standards and procedures of India Post's Parcel Packaging Policy. The course begins by establishing the context for the policy, highlighting the importance of robust packaging for protecting articles during transit, ensuring handling convenience, and preventing tampering. It addresses the phasing out of traditional cloth-wrapped parcels and introduces the new mandatory standards designed to align with modern courier and express industry practices. Learners will explore the three primary aspects of the policy in detail: external packaging, including the use of corrugated boxes and BOPP tapes; internal packaging, such as bubble wrap and airbags for cushioning fragile items; and the application of self-adhesive special handling labels to communicate care instructions. The course also covers the establishment and function of Parcel Packaging Units (PPUs) in major post offices, which provide standardized packaging services to customers. Upon completion, participants will understand how to correctly apply these packaging standards to improve the safety, security, and integrity of the parcel delivery system.

title: Parcel Products: India Post
desc: This foundational course is designed to familiarize learners with the complete portfolio of parcel products managed by India Post. The primary objective is to build a clear understanding of the services that form a core part of the department's logistics network. The course begins by categorizing the various parcel products, from standard delivery to specialized and express services. It then delves into the distinct features of each product, explaining their weight and size limits, delivery standards, and tracking capabilities. Participants will also gain a clear understanding of the current pricing models and learn about complementary value-added services such as insurance, Cash on Delivery (COD), and pick-up facilities. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to advise customers, handle inquiries efficiently, and ensure the correct processing of parcels, thereby contributing to improved service quality and operational excellence.

title: Parcel Specific Recent Initiatives
desc: In response to the rapidly growing demand for reliable parcel services, India Post has launched several key initiatives to modernize its logistics framework. This course offers a comprehensive examination of these recent developments, focusing on the strategic creation and standardization of a parcel-specific operational network. Participants will gain an in-depth understanding of the core components of this transformation, including the establishment and upgradation of dedicated Parcel Processing Hubs designed for high-volume sorting and handling. The curriculum also covers the strategic placement of Nodal Delivery Centres to streamline last-mile delivery and the development of a dedicated network of Postal Road Transport Routes to ensure faster and more reliable transit. By the end of this course, learners will be able to articulate the purpose and function of each new initiative and understand how they collectively contribute to a more efficient, standardized, and robust parcel ecosystem. This knowledge is essential for officials involved in postal operations, logistics management, and strategic planning, enabling them to effectively leverage the new infrastructure to improve service quality and operational performance.

title: Parcel Tracker: India Post
desc: In an era of increasing demand for transparent and efficient logistics, the Department of Posts has introduced the Parcel Tracker system to modernize its customer communication and operational oversight. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to this critical tool, explaining its purpose as a new channel for information exchange and an upgrade to legacy systems. The content is designed for personnel involved in postal operations and customer service, providing them with the necessary knowledge to effectively utilize the tracker. Participants will explore the core functionalities of the Parcel Tracker, understanding how it consolidates action points to streamline information flow. The course will cover the practical applications of the system in day-to-day operations, focusing on how it enhances the customer experience by providing timely and accurate updates. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to leverage the Parcel Tracker to improve efficiency, reduce inquiries, and contribute to the overall modernization of India Post's parcel services, thereby strengthening public trust and service quality.

title: PARCELS-DEEP
desc: PARcels-DEeP is a specialized e-learning program aimed at the holistic development of parcel teams within the Department of Posts. This course provides a transformational learning experience by blending critical soft skills with essential operational knowledge. Participants will explore the nuances of professional communication, learning how to express ideas confidently and handle customer interactions with poise. The leadership module empowers employees at all levels to take initiative and inspire their teams, fostering a culture of collaboration and excellence. Furthermore, the course instills principles of effective time management and strong work ethics, which are crucial for enhancing productivity and maintaining high service standards. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to the Parcel Sales Manual, offering a step-by-step guide to the sales process, from identifying potential leads to successful client onboarding and account management. Through practical case studies and detailed procedural guidance, learners will be equipped to not only improve their personal effectiveness but also to significantly contribute to the growth and competitiveness of India Post's parcel services.

title: Pariksha Karmayogi: Capacity-Building Programme for Exam Officials
desc:
The National Testing Agency always envisions in strengthening institutional excellence, building robust examination systems, and continuously enhancing the capacity and accountability of Examination Centre functionaries.  In continuation to this, NTA brings a short course on NTA Examinations: Supervision and Invigilation Excellence. This course aims to foster competence, confidence, and professional integrity among Centre Superintendents and Invigilators by equipping them with the essential knowledge, practical skills, and ethical attitude required for the smooth, fair, and secure conduct of offline OMR-based examinations.

Through structured and practical modules, learners will gain a clear understanding of examination procedures, supervisory responsibilities, and best practices to ensure discipline, transparency, and integrity throughout the examination process. The course also emphasizes decision-making and preparedness for actual examination duties.

title: Parliament at Work
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the essential functions and procedures of the Indian Parliament, designed for public sector professionals who interact with or support the legislative process. Understanding the intricacies of Parliament is crucial for effective governance, policy implementation, and maintaining accountability. The course begins by demystifying the legislative journey of a bill, from its introduction to its enactment as law. It then provides a detailed examination of the Parliamentary Committee system, explaining the distinct roles of various committees and highlighting the critical oversight functions of the Financial Committees. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to the Question Hour, a vital tool for parliamentary accountability. Learners will understand its proceedings and learn the established protocols for how Ministries and Departments must handle parliamentary questions and respond to government assurances. Upon completion, participants will possess the necessary knowledge to navigate parliamentary processes confidently, contribute to transparent governance, and ensure their department's effective compliance with legislative requirements.
subDomain: Submission of briefs, supply of information
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Parliament at Work - Legislative Process
desc: Delve into the core of India's democratic framework with this detailed course on the legislative process in Parliament. Understanding how laws are conceived, debated, and enacted is fundamental for any public servant involved in governance, policy formulation, or administration. This course provides a structured exploration of the entire legislative lifecycle, beginning with the critical stage of introducing a bill in either the Lok Sabha or the Rajya Sabha. It clearly explains the distinction and procedural differences between government bills, introduced by ministers, and private member's bills. Participants will learn about the various stages a bill must pass through, including readings, committee reviews, debates, and voting, before receiving presidential assent to become an Act. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the complexities of parliamentary procedures, contribute more effectively to legislative work, and appreciate the constitutional mechanisms that shape the nation's laws. This knowledge is essential for enhancing procedural compliance and strategic engagement with the legislative branch of government.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Parliamentary Procedures
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of Indian parliamentary procedures, tailored for government officials. It delves into the critical functions of the Parliament, explaining why a thorough understanding of its procedural rules is essential for effective public administration. Key learning areas include the classification and lifecycle of parliamentary questions, such as Starred and Unstarred questions, and the process of giving and fulfilling parliamentary assurances. Participants will learn how to navigate the procedural requirements for submitting information and preparing responses for their respective ministries. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to support their departments in upholding accountability, ensuring timely and accurate communication with the legislature, and contributing to the smooth functioning of democratic processes.
subDomain: Submission of briefs, supply of information
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Part A. Planning : Faecal Sludge and Septage Management
desc: This foundational course, Part A of a two-part series, delves into the critical aspects of planning for Faecal Sludge and Septage Management (FSSM) in India's rapidly urbanizing landscape. Recognizing the gaps in conventional liquid waste management, this program establishes the context for FSSM as a vital component of urban sanitation. It is specifically tailored for government officials, including decision-makers, planners, and engineers, who are tasked with improving sanitation infrastructure and services. The curriculum covers the entire FSSM planning lifecycle, starting with an overview of the urban sanitation crisis and the role of decentralized solutions. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the policy and regulatory frameworks that govern FSSM, including national missions such as the Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U) 2.0, AMRUT 2.0, and the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG). The course details practical, city-level approaches to diagnostics, goal-setting, and strategy formulation. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to initiate and lead the development of comprehensive FSSM plans, aligning local actions with national objectives and contributing to the achievement of SDG 6.2 and 6.3 for safe and sustainable sanitation for all.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title: Part B. Planning : Faecal Sludge and Septage Management
desc: This advanced module, Part B, delves into the practical aspects of planning and executing Faecal Sludge and Septage Management (FSSM) projects. Building on foundational concepts, this course addresses the critical need for robust sanitation infrastructure in urban India. Key learning areas include stakeholder engagement, developing sustainable operation and maintenance (O&M) frameworks, and applying project management principles to city-wide FSSM initiatives. The content is contextualized within major national programs such as the Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U 2.0) and AMRUT 2.0, and considers the financial recommendations of the 15th Finance Commission. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to design and manage FSSM projects that are not only technically sound but also financially sustainable and socially inclusive, contributing directly to achieving Sustainable Development Goal 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation).
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title: Part Modelling with Fusion
desc: This course is designed for individuals seeking to develop foundational skills in 3D design and computer-aided design (CAD) using Autodesk Fusion. In today's engineering and manufacturing sectors, the ability to create precise digital prototypes is crucial for innovation and efficiency. This training provides the essential knowledge to bridge the gap between two-dimensional concepts and three-dimensional realities. Key learning areas include the complete workflow from creating 2D sketches to generating solid 3D models. You will gain proficiency in core parametric modeling tools such as extrude, revolve, and loft, which are fundamental for building geometry. The course also covers critical modification tools like fillet, chamfer, and pattern to refine and perfect your designs. Furthermore, you will be introduced to the flexibility of direct modeling techniques, including press pull and move/copy, for quick and intuitive adjustments. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to create accurate 3D parts, understand the strategic application of different modeling tools, and build a strong foundation for more advanced CAD and product design projects.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Participatory Rural Planning Using Yuktdhara
desc: This course offers a detailed tutorial on using the Yuktdhara portal for effective rural asset planning. It addresses the critical need for data-driven and transparent decision-making in local governance, specifically within the framework of MGNREGS. Participants will learn to navigate the Yuktdhara platform, utilizing its advanced features such as satellite imagery, thematic maps, and automated planning suggestions. The curriculum covers the end-to-end process, from identifying potential works and designing Gram Panchayat Asset Works (GAW) to managing the Gram Sabha approval workflow and synchronizing data with NREGASoft. By completing this course, officials and functionaries involved in rural development will be equipped to implement more efficient, accountable, and participatory planning processes, ultimately contributing to the creation of durable and impactful community assets.

title: Partnership Accounts
desc: This course offers a detailed guide to the specialized field of partnership accounting. It is designed for professionals who need to understand the financial and legal nuances of managing partnership firms in accordance with the Indian Partnership Act, 1932. The curriculum is structured to build knowledge progressively, starting with the foundational concepts of partnership formation, the essential features of a partnership, and the creation of a partnership deed. Learners will then delve into the accounting treatments required during significant changes in the partnership structure. This includes handling the admission of a new partner, which involves calculating new profit-sharing ratios, valuing goodwill, and revaluing assets and liabilities. The course also thoroughly covers the procedures for settling accounts upon the retirement or death of a partner. Finally, it addresses the complete process of firm dissolution, guiding learners on how to prepare a Realization Account, settle liabilities, and close the firm's books. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to prepare and maintain accurate financial records for partnership firms.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Pass Rules in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Railway Servants (Pass) Rules, 1986, a critical component of the benefits provided to Indian Railways personnel. The program is designed to equip employees with a clear understanding of their travel entitlements, ensuring transparency and proper application of the rules. The course begins by defining key terms and categories of passes, such as Privilege Passes, Duty Passes, School Passes, and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTOs). It systematically explains the eligibility criteria for employees across different groups (A, B, C, and D) and pay levels, including specific provisions for family members, dependents, and attendants. Key learning areas include the number of passes available annually, rules for break journeys, travel by mail trains, and procedures for different routes. The course also addresses special circumstances like deputation, judicial separation, and the significant benefits of post-retirement complimentary passes. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently navigate the pass system, ensure compliance, and make informed decisions regarding their travel benefits.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Passenger Business in Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the intricate world of passenger business in Indian Railways, a critical component of the nation's economy and social fabric. This course offers a detailed examination of the systems and processes that facilitate the travel of millions daily. You will learn about the fundamental aspects of railway passenger services, starting with the context of its vast network and diverse user base. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of ticketing mechanisms, from Printed Card Tickets (PCTs) to the advanced functionalities of the IRCTC platform and UTS mobile app. The course covers the passenger reservation system (PRS), the rules governing RAC and Tatkal bookings, and policies for refunds and cancellations. Furthermore, it explains the different classes of accommodation, the principles behind fare calculation, concessions, and the importance of accountability and maintenance in delivering a safe and reliable service. Upon completion, you will be able to analyze how digital transformation is shaping the future of railway passenger services and appreciate the operational complexities involved.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Passenger Detrainment and Evacuation Process in Metro Rail System
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the emergency evacuation and detrainment procedures critical for the safe operation of a modern metro rail system. It is designed to familiarize both metro personnel and the public with the established protocols for handling rare but potentially life-threatening situations. The curriculum delves into the specific roles and responsibilities of key staff, including the Train Operator, Station Controller, and the central Operation Control Center, during an emergency. It covers various scenarios, such as train detrainment due to technical failure, station evacuation in case of fire or smoke, and coordinated responses to security threats. Learners will understand the safety features built into trains and stations, such as emergency exits, communication systems, and ventilation. The course emphasizes the importance of remaining calm, following official instructions, and assisting vulnerable passengers, transforming a potentially chaotic event into a managed and safe process. Ultimately, this training empowers participants to act as informed and prepared partners in ensuring the safety and security of the entire metro network.

title: Passing Danger Signal in Kavach
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Procedure for Passing a Stop Signal at ON within the context of railway signalling systems. Learners are introduced to how signalling ensures safe and efficient train operations in high-traffic railway networks and how modern signalling systems support decision-making during critical situations. The course covers fixed signals and Multiple Aspect Colour Light Signals (MACLS), explaining their types, aspects, indications, advantages, and associated markers. It also explores the Automatic Block Section, illustrating how signal aspects change dynamically with train movements to maintain safe separation between trains. Special emphasis is given to the procedure for passing a stop signal at ON, highlighting the role of the KAVACH system and technology-assisted safeguards that enable controlled and safe train operations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET)

title: Patrolling of Track in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the essential practice of railway track patrolling. It begins by establishing the context of why track maintenance is vital for preventing accidents and ensuring the seamless functioning of a high-speed, high-density rail network. Learners will delve into the core objectives of patrolling, from identifying cracks, ballast deficiencies, and loose fastenings to monitoring tracks during extreme weather. The curriculum systematically covers the different categories of patrolling, including the daily inspections by Keymen and the specialized procedures for monsoon, hot, and cold weather, which address risks like landslides, rail buckling, and fractures. Furthermore, the course addresses the operational challenges faced by patrol personnel and introduces the modernization of this field through technologies like GPS-based tracking. Upon completion, participants will have a strong foundational knowledge of the procedures, tools, and reporting mechanisms that contribute to the safety and integrity of railway infrastructure.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Pay Fixation
desc: Pay fixation is a cornerstone of public service administration, ensuring that every government employee is compensated correctly according to prescribed rules and regulations. This foundational course delves into the intricate details of pay fixation, providing a robust understanding of the governing principles. It is designed for officials who handle establishment, human resources, and financial matters, aiming to build their capacity for accurate and compliant salary management. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including the application of Fundamental Rules (FR) and Supplementary Rules (SR), understanding pay bands and grade pay, and the correct methods for calculating pay upon initial appointment, promotion, and under the Modified Assured Career Progression (MACP) scheme. Participants will learn to navigate various scenarios, such as stepping up of pay and handling pay anomalies. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently process pay fixation cases, audit salary calculations, and address related queries, thereby upholding financial propriety and ensuring equitable treatment of employees across government services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Pay Fixation - Updated
desc: Pay fixation is a cornerstone of personnel administration and financial management in the Government of India. This course offers an in-depth examination of the rules and procedures that govern the determination of an employee's pay. It is designed for officials who handle establishment, finance, and administrative matters, providing them with the essential skills to navigate the complexities of salary calculation accurately and efficiently. The curriculum delves into the core principles of pay fixation as laid out in the Fundamental Rules (FR) and Supplementary Rules (SR). Participants will learn how to correctly fix pay upon initial appointment, on promotion, and under the Modified Assured Career Progression (MACP) scheme. The course will also cover critical topics such as the treatment of special pay, handling of pay anomalies, and the process for stepping up pay to maintain parity among colleagues. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply these regulations, prepare error-free pay fixation statements, and effectively address queries from both employees and audit authorities, ensuring compliance and upholding financial integrity within their organizations.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Pay Fixation for Re-employed Ex-Servicemen
desc: This course offers a structured and comprehensive understanding of the rules, classifications, and methodologies involved in pay fixation for re-employed pensioners in civilian roles. Re-employment after retirement is a common administrative practice, yet determining pay can be complex due to variations in pension types, service backgrounds, and applicable government orders. The course begins with an overview of re-employment policies, including their objectives and legal framework. It then explores the different categories of pensioners, highlighting the specific pay fixation rules for each group. Key learning areas include the principles of pay calculation, the interaction between new pay and existing pension, and the application of relevant government circulars. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to handle pay fixation cases with accuracy and confidence, ensuring fairness and regulatory compliance. This is essential for officials in HR, accounts, and administrative roles who manage the service records of ex-servicemen.

title: Pay, Allowances and Staff welfare
desc: This detailed course delves into the essential financial and welfare aspects of employment with Indian Railways. It is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the Indian Railways Establishment Code (IREC) and recommendations from the Central Pay Commission (CPC). Key learning areas include the calculation and eligibility for Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Travelling Allowance (TA), and Overtime Allowance (OTA). The curriculum also covers special provisions such as the Composite Transfer Grant (CTG) and the administration of the Staff Benefit Fund (SBF). By the end of this course, learners, particularly those in administrative, personnel, and finance roles, will be able to confidently interpret and apply these crucial rules. This knowledge is vital for ensuring accurate compensation, managing employee benefits effectively, and fostering a supportive work environment within the vast network of Indian Railways.

title: Payment Function and Booking of Expenditure
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of payment functions and the procedures for booking expenditure. In the context of public service, managing financial transactions with accuracy and integrity is paramount. This course delves into the critical aspects of public financial management, explaining why robust payment and expenditure systems are essential for transparent and accountable governance. Key learning areas include the various types of government payments, the authorization and sanctioning process, and the operational mechanics of disbursement through platforms like the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). Participants will learn the correct classification of expenditure heads, the importance of timely booking, and the reconciliation of accounts. The course will also touch upon the relevant General Financial Rules (GFRs) that guide these processes. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate the procedures for making official payments and accurately record financial transactions, enabling them to contribute effectively to their department's financial health and ensure compliance with audit requirements.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Payment of Gratuity Under the National Pension System
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the key principles governing gratuity determination and sanction processes. It focuses on the critical factors involved in calculating gratuity, including emoluments and qualifying service, and explains how different types of exit under the National Pension System (NPS) impact gratuity entitlement.
