The course also covers the rules related to nomination, common reasons for invalidation of nominations, and the procedural framework for gratuity sanction. In addition, it highlights provisions related to provisional gratuity, safeguards against delays, and conditions under which gratuity may be withheld, ensuring a clear understanding of employee retirement benefits and administrative processes.

title: Payment of Taxes, Interest, Penalty, Fine and other Amounts
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the entire lifecycle of Goods and Services Tax (GST) payments, a critical function for both tax administrators and businesses. It establishes a strong foundation by explaining who is liable to pay tax, the concept of taxable supply, and the different types of taxes such as CGST, SGST, and IGST. The curriculum delves into the practical mechanics of discharging tax liabilities, providing a detailed walkthrough of the Electronic Liability Register, Electronic Credit Ledger, and Electronic Cash Ledger. Learners will master the process of utilizing Input Tax Credit (ITC) and making cash payments via challans. Furthermore, the course covers the legal and administrative framework under the CGST Act, 2017, including key rules and forms. It also addresses crucial related topics such as the procedure for claiming refunds and the significant consequences of non-payment, including interest, penalties, and potential cancellation of registration. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in navigating the GST payment portal and ensuring full compliance with India's indirect tax regime.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Pension and Gratuity Benefits for Central Government Employees
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of pensionary and retirement benefits available to eligible Central Government employees. It introduces learners to the relevant pension rules and procedures and provides clarity on various retirement benefits and the conditions governing their entitlement. The course covers superannuation pension, retiring pension, family pension, gratuity, and commutation of pension, along with the procedures for calculating and claiming these benefits. Learners will also understand the preparation and submission of pension papers, required documentation, prescribed timelines, and the process for settlement of retirement benefits. The course further addresses common issues and queries related to pensionary benefits and explains the mechanisms available for resolving grievances. By the end of the course, learners will have a clear understanding of the pension framework and will be better equipped to navigate the retirement benefit process accurately.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Pensionary Benefits
desc: This course is designed to demystify the complex landscape of pensionary benefits for government employees. It provides a detailed exploration of the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, offering clarity on various types of retirement benefits. The curriculum covers key topics such as superannuation pension, retiring pension, family pension, and the calculation of gratuity. Participants will learn about the process of pension commutation, the necessary documentation for claims, and the timelines for settlement. The course also addresses common queries and issues faced by retiring employees, equipping them with the knowledge to navigate the procedures confidently. By the end of this program, learners will be well-versed in the framework of pensionary benefits, enabling them to plan effectively for a financially secure retirement.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: People politics and Change
desc: In the complex world of public administration, policy implementation and governance reforms are deeply influenced by political factors and public sentiment. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for any official aiming to drive meaningful and sustainable change. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the interplay between people, politics, and governance. It examines how citizen interest and engagement can shape political agendas and lead to significant shifts in policy. Participants will explore the fundamentals of political economy analysis, learning to identify key stakeholders, their interests, and their influence. The curriculum also covers the strategic importance of coalition-building and effective communication in navigating political environments and mobilizing support for change. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to analyze the political context of their work, anticipate challenges, and develop strategies to foster collaboration. They will gain insights into how to align public interest with policy goals, making them more effective agents of change within the governmental framework.

title: Performance Appraisal In Indian Railways
desc: As one of the world's largest employers, Indian Railways relies on a robust performance management system to maintain efficiency and foster employee development. This course offers a detailed examination of this system, focusing on the Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR). Participants will explore the entire appraisal lifecycle, from self-assessment to the final grading and appeal process. The curriculum is designed to clarify how performance is systematically measured and how these evaluations directly influence crucial HR decisions like promotions, transfers, and career development opportunities. By understanding the mechanics and purpose of the APAR, learners will be better equipped to navigate their own career paths and appreciate the role of performance appraisal in upholding organizational integrity, diligence, and continuous improvement across the vast railway network.

title: Personal and Organizational Value
desc: Values are the core beliefs that guide our actions and decisions. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the concepts of both personal and organizational values and their critical importance in the public sector. You will begin by exploring personal values—such as honesty, commitment, and respect—and how they form the foundation of individual identity and behavior. The course then transitions to organizational values, explaining how these shared principles create a unified purpose and set the standard for professional conduct. A key focus is placed on the context of government service, where organizational values are derived directly from the Constitution of India. Learners will understand why these constitutional values, including justice, liberty, and equality, must take precedence in their professional roles. By the end of this course, you will be better equipped to navigate professional situations by consciously aligning your actions with the ethical framework expected of a dedicated public servant.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Personal and Professional Effectiveness
desc: In today's dynamic work environment, personal and professional effectiveness are crucial for career advancement and personal fulfilment. This course provides a comprehensive framework for improving the skills that drive workplace efficiency and success. It delves into critical areas such as time management, communication, teamwork, and leadership, offering practical tools and techniques that can be immediately applied. The curriculum is structured to facilitate self-discovery, helping you identify your unique strengths and areas for development. Through a series of interactive activities and self-assessment exercises, you will be guided to create a personalized action plan for improvement. By the end of this course, you will not only understand the principles of professional effectiveness but also possess a clear roadmap to enhance your performance, expand your professional network, and navigate your career path with confidence.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

This course provides a comprehensive framework for improving the skills that drive workplace efficiency and success. It delves into critical areas such as time management, communication, teamwork, and leadership, offering practical tools and techniques that can be immediately applied. org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Personal Effectiveness
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of personal effectiveness, a critical skill for success in any professional environment. It begins by establishing a clear definition of personal effectiveness and its importance for both individual growth and organizational success. The curriculum delves into the key pillars of this competency, including taking ownership of your work, executing tasks with purpose and efficiency, maintaining discipline, and embracing learning agility to adapt to a changing world. Participants will explore essential elements such as self-awareness, self-management, emotional intelligence, and time management. The course explains how these skills collectively contribute to building confidence, improving productivity, and fostering a positive professional reputation. By the end of this program, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to assess their own effectiveness, identify areas for improvement, and apply practical strategies to enhance their performance and achieve their career aspirations.

title: Personal Finance
desc: This course offers a foundational guide to mastering personal finances, tailored for individuals seeking to build a secure and stable financial life. It systematically breaks down the core pillars of financial literacy into practical, easy-to-understand modules. The curriculum begins with establishing a financial safety net through emergency funds and appropriate insurance coverage. It then delves into the critical aspects of managing debt responsibly to avoid common pitfalls and using credit wisely. Learners will discover the power of disciplined saving and the mindset required for long-term wealth creation. The course further explores strategic asset allocation, explaining how to invest in various instruments like mutual funds, gold, and real estate to build a diversified portfolio. Finally, it addresses the crucial topic of retirement planning, providing insights on how to prepare for a financially independent post-retirement life. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped to make informed financial decisions, set meaningful financial goals, and take control of their financial well-being.

title: Personal Selling
desc: Dive into the critical aspects of personal selling and learn how to navigate the complexities of today's B2B sales environment. This course is designed to move beyond traditional sales pitches, focusing instead on a customer-centric approach that builds trust and delivers value. You will learn to analyze the customer's unique situation, identify their unconsidered needs, and frame your solution as the key to overcoming their business challenges. The curriculum details a structured seven-step selling process, from prospecting and preparation to handling objections and closing the sale. Key topics include different selling models like consultative and solution selling, the psychology of buyer decision-making, and techniques for creating price uncertainty during negotiations. Participants will gain practical skills to differentiate their offerings, create urgency for change, and foster long-term, mutually profitable customer relationships. This course is ideal for professionals seeking to build a strong foundation in sales and drive sustainable business growth.

title: Personnel Department in Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the intricate workings of the Personnel Department of Indian Railways, the backbone of its vast and diverse workforce. This course offers a detailed examination of the department's critical role in managing over 1.2 million employees. You will explore the context of human resource management within a large-scale public enterprise, understanding its strategic importance in achieving organizational goals. Key learning areas include the hierarchical structure of the personnel department, its primary objectives, and its wide-ranging functional responsibilities such as staffing, compensation, training and development, employee welfare, and industrial relations. The curriculum also covers the implementation of constitutional mandates like social inclusion and reservation policies. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze how strategic HR practices support the safety, efficiency, and modernization of Indian Railways, making it a resilient and forward-looking organization.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Personnel Information System in IT 2.0 Employee Self Service Portal
desc: This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the Personnel Information System (PIS) available on the IT 2.0 Employee Self-Service (ESS) Portal. In the context of digital governance, empowering employees with direct access to manage their own data is crucial for transparency and efficiency. This program is designed to familiarize government personnel with all the features of the PIS module. Key learning areas include navigating the ESSP dashboard, understanding the sections for personal, family, and educational data, and the step-by-step process for submitting updates. Furthermore, the course explains how to file annual property returns electronically and how to access and download important documents like the service book and gradation lists. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the portal, reducing dependency on administrative staff for routine data management and enabling them to maintain accurate and up-to-date personal records with ease.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Perspective on Key Technologies Driving Industry 4.0
desc: Embark on a journey into the future of industry with this insightful course on the key technologies powering Industry 4.0. This program offers a detailed exploration of the fourth industrial revolution, explaining how advanced digital technologies are fundamentally reshaping manufacturing, supply chains, and business models. The course begins by tracing the evolution of industrial revolutions to provide context for the current shift towards cyber-physical systems and automation. You will delve into the core components of Industry 4.0, including Big Data analytics, the Internet of Things (IoT), cloud computing, additive manufacturing (3D Printing), autonomous robots, and digital twins. The content highlights how these technologies enable smart manufacturing, leading to significant improvements in productivity, quality, and operational efficiency. Furthermore, the course addresses the critical importance of horizontal and vertical integration, as well as the paramount need for robust cybersecurity in an interconnected industrial ecosystem. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge to understand the strategic implications of Industry 4.0 and identify opportunities for innovation within your own professional context.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Petroleum  Sector: Challenges for Indian Oil  and Gas Industry
desc: India's oil and gas industry is a cornerstone of its economy, yet it faces a multitude of complex challenges that demand strategic understanding and response. This course offers an in-depth examination of these critical issues, providing learners with a robust framework to analyze the sector's landscape. The curriculum explores the structural vulnerabilities arising from high import dependency and the operational hurdles posed by infrastructure bottlenecks. It addresses the constant exposure to global price volatility and market uncertainties, which significantly impact national energy strategy. Furthermore, the course highlights the growing importance of environmental sustainability and climate commitments, pushing the industry towards greener practices and technological innovation. Participants will evaluate how advancements in technology can drive operational efficiency and competitiveness. A key focus is the strategic integration of renewable energy, which is reshaping the petroleum sector's future. Upon completion, learners will possess a comprehensive understanding of these interconnected challenges, enabling them to contribute to informed policy-making and strategic decision-making within India's evolving energy sector.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Petroleum  Sector: Energy Transition
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the global energy transition, contextualizing its importance for climate change mitigation and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It begins by tracing the history of global energy systems and the current reliance on fossil fuels, establishing the urgent need for a paradigm shift towards sustainable energy. Key learning areas include the principles and potential of various renewable energy technologies, the assessment of their environmental impacts, and the challenges of intermittency. The curriculum delves into the economic aspects of the transition, covering investment models, carbon pricing, and market dynamics. Furthermore, it analyzes national and international policies and regulatory frameworks that are essential for large-scale decarbonization. By integrating these technical, economic, and policy perspectives, this course empowers learners with the analytical skills to contribute to strategic planning for a low-carbon future and make informed decisions in the energy sector.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Petroleum Environmental Management
desc: In an era of increasing environmental scrutiny, effective management of industrial impact is critical, particularly within the petroleum industry. This comprehensive course provides an in-depth understanding of environmental pollution and its mitigation, addressing both general and industry-specific challenges. Participants will begin by identifying the major types of pollution—water, air, land, and noise—and their human-induced causes, from industrial discharge to fossil fuel emissions. The curriculum places special emphasis on the environmental hazards associated with oil and gas operations, covering the causes and consequences of oil spills and exploring modern remediation techniques to minimize ecological damage. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) process, detailing its legal frameworks, clearance requirements, and procedural steps. Furthermore, learners will be introduced to toxicity testing and essential waste management strategies, including recycling and safe disposal. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to evaluate environmental impacts, apply sustainable practices, and ensure regulatory compliance, contributing to more responsible and sustainable industrial operations.
org: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad

title: PF Tariff Rebate (Energy Bill Monitoring)
desc: In an environment of rising energy costs, effective electricity bill management is crucial for organizational financial health. This course is designed to equip engineers, facility managers, and finance officers with the knowledge to significantly reduce electricity expenditures. It begins by deconstructing the components of an electricity bill, focusing on critical elements like contract demand, maximum demand, and power factor. You will learn the technical principles behind power factor, how a low power factor leads to higher costs and equipment damage, and how to implement corrective measures such as installing capacitor panels. The course further explores strategic financial management by analyzing different tariff structures, providing a clear case study on the benefits of shifting from commercial to industrial tariffs. It also covers actionable, no-cost measures like availing prompt payment rebates and refunding security deposits. By the end of this course, you will be able to analyze energy consumption patterns, implement technical and administrative changes, and achieve substantial, sustainable cost savings for your organization.

title: PHILATELIC BUREAUX AND COUNTERS
desc: This course offers an in-depth guide to the functioning of Philatelic Bureaux and Counters, essential components of the postal service dedicated to stamp collectors and enthusiasts. The program begins by outlining the context for their establishment, including the role of the Directorate and the criteria considered, such as local demand and the presence of philatelic societies. Participants will learn the specific functions of a Philatelic Bureau, from selling commemorative stamps and first-day covers to executing mail orders and maintaining a philatelic library. The course clearly delineates the differences between a bureau and a more restricted philatelic counter, covering aspects like the authority to issue special cancellations and manage Philatelic Deposit Accounts (PDAs). Furthermore, it details the administrative and technical oversight provided by the Postmaster, ensuring these units operate effectively. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to manage or work within these specialized postal units, enhancing service quality for philatelists and promoting philately as a hobby.

title: PHILATELIC EXHIBITION
desc: Embark on a journey into the fascinating hobby of philately. This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of stamp collecting and the organization of philatelic exhibitions. You will begin by learning the history of philately in India, from the first 'Scinde Dawk' stamps to modern commemorative issues, understanding their cultural and educational value. The course then delves into the practical aspects of exhibitions, detailing the various levels such as district, zonal, national, and international. You will learn to distinguish between different exhibit classes, including competitive categories like traditional philately and non-competitive displays like the Class of Honor. A significant focus is placed on the operational responsibilities of organizers, covering crucial topics like securing exhibits with tamper-evident seals, managing venue security, and understanding liability and insurance protocols. Upon completion, you will have a thorough overview of what it takes to appreciate and organize a successful philatelic exhibition.

title: Philately (Prarambh)
desc: Embark on a journey into the fascinating world of philately. This course, 'Philately (Prarambh)', is designed to introduce government officials and the general public to the king of hobbies: stamp collecting. You will discover why this hobby has captivated people for over 150 years, serving not just as a pastime but as a window into our nation's culture, history, and achievements. The curriculum begins with the basic definition and history of philately, explaining how postage stamps evolved into cultural ambassadors. You will learn to distinguish between different categories of stamps, such as definitive, commemorative, and special issues, and understand their unique purposes. The course further explores the anatomy of a stamp, the composition of stamp sheets like miniature and souvenir sheets, and the significance of ancillary items such as First Day Covers and special cancellations. By the end of this course, you will have gained foundational knowledge of philatelic products, understood the administrative framework for philately within the Department of Posts, and developed an appreciation for the cultural and educational value of stamp collecting, empowering you to engage with this unique aspect of India's heritage.

title: Physical Fitness
desc: This foundational course offers a detailed exploration of physical fitness as a cornerstone of a healthy and productive life. It begins by defining health and wellness, establishing a clear connection between regular physical activity and improved quality of life. The curriculum delves into the specifics of health-related fitness, including the importance of hydration, sleep, and proper preparation for exercise. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of different body types—ectomorph, endomorph, and mesomorph—and how to tailor fitness goals accordingly. The course systematically covers various types of exercises such as aerobic, isometric, and isotonic, explaining their unique benefits. Key principles of strength training, including progressive overload and specificity, are also detailed. Participants will learn the correct order of a workout, from warm-up and stretching to strength exercises and cool-down. By understanding these fundamentals, learners will be empowered to take proactive steps towards enhancing their physical and mental resilience, boosting energy levels, and reducing health risks.

title: Physical Fitness and injuries
desc: This course, ""Physical Fitness: Understanding, Preventing, and Managing Injuries,"" offers an in-depth exploration of maintaining physical health while pursuing an active lifestyle. It is specifically designed for government officials, with a focus on the needs of uniformed and field personnel. The program begins by laying a foundation in human anatomy and biomechanics, explaining how the body moves and responds to exercise. Learners will then explore the most common types of exercise-related injuries, from sprains and strains to stress fractures, and the factors that contribute to them. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to proactive prevention, covering essential warm-up and cool-down routines, the importance of proper form, and corrective exercises to address muscular imbalances. In the event of an injury, participants will learn to apply immediate first aid using the RICE protocol. The course also details the principles of rehabilitation, nutrition, and progressive exercises to ensure a full recovery. Finally, it addresses the psychological aspects of injury, providing strategies to stay motivated and build resilience, empowering learners to take charge of their physical well-being.

title: Physical Wellness for Remote Working
desc: Modern work culture, especially with the rise of remote and desk-bound roles, often leads to a sedentary lifestyle that can take a toll on physical health. This course is specifically designed to combat the negative effects of prolonged sitting, such as neck stiffness, back pain, and poor posture. It introduces a comprehensive yet simple exercise program that can be performed at home with minimal equipment—just a mat, a chair, and a wall. The routine is broken down into five key segments: a warm-up, mobilization drills, strength activation, targeted stretching, and a cool-down. These exercises focus on improving joint mobility, activating crucial postural muscles in the core and back, and releasing tension accumulated from long hours at a desk. By dedicating just a few minutes each day, learners will not only find relief from common aches but also proactively invest in their long-term health. This program empowers you to take control of your physical wellness, fostering resilience and mindfulness in any work environment.

title: Phytosanitary measures for safe trade
desc: In an era of expanding global trade, protecting national agriculture from foreign pests and diseases is paramount. This course delves into the essential principles and applications of phytosanitary measures designed to mitigate these risks. You will explore the context of the SPS Agreement and the role of International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures (ISPMs) in creating a harmonized global system. The curriculum covers the identification of quarantine pests, the establishment of pest-free areas, and the implementation of specific treatments such as fumigation, irradiation, and heat treatments for various commodities like mangoes, cereals, and wooden packaging. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to understand and apply the necessary procedures and standards, ensuring that agricultural trade is both safe and compliant with international regulations, thereby protecting their country's plant health and economy.
org: National Institute of Plant Health Management (NIPHM)

title: Plagiarism
desc: In any professional or academic setting, maintaining the integrity of your work is paramount. This course, 'Understanding and Preventing Plagiarism,' is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge and skills to produce original and ethically sound content. The program delves into the core concepts of plagiarism, explaining why it is a serious breach of conduct and detailing the potential repercussions for researchers, students, and professionals.The curriculum systematically covers the different forms of plagiarism, from direct copying to improper paraphrasing, and distinguishes between intentional and unintentional acts. You will learn robust, practical techniques to avoid these pitfalls, including the correct methods for citing sources, using quotation marks, and developing the skill of acceptable paraphrasing. Furthermore, the course touches upon the basics of copyright law and its relationship with plagiarism, providing a holistic understanding of intellectual property. By the end of this course, you will be confident in your ability to create and present work that is both original and correctly attributed, upholding the highest standards of integrity.

title: Planning a Research Study: Data Collection Management Analysis
desc: This course is designed for professionals involved in research and program implementation who need to develop robust data handling skills. It addresses the critical steps that follow the initial planning of a research study. You will learn the fundamentals of creating a comprehensive data management plan, covering everything from data entry and coding to secure storage and maintaining confidentiality. The curriculum delves into different types of data and variables, equipping you with the knowledge to structure your datasets effectively. Furthermore, the course introduces basic data analysis techniques, enabling you to interpret summary statistics, tables, and graphs to derive initial insights. Upon completion, you will be proficient in applying best practices for data collection and management, ensuring the integrity and reliability of your research findings.

title: Planning a Research Study: Data Tools Design and Variables Measurement
desc: Effective research is built on a foundation of meticulous planning and precise data collection. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential methodologies required to plan a study and develop reliable data collection instruments. Participants will explore the core concepts of research design, starting with how to identify and operationalize study variables. The curriculum delves into the different types of data, both qualitative and quantitative, and teaches fundamental statistical techniques for summarizing data, including measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and dispersion (range, standard deviation). A significant focus is placed on the art and science of questionnaire design. Learners will gain practical knowledge on formulating clear questions, structuring the instrument logically, avoiding common biases, and the importance of pilot testing. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to design and implement data collection strategies that yield valid, reliable, and accurate results, forming a solid basis for evidence-based analysis and conclusions.

title: Planning of Non-interlocked Working in Indian Railways
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Non-Interlocked (NI) Working in railway operations, with a focus on the procedures followed during minor and major engineering works. It covers the principles, planning, and operational requirements of NI working, including staff deployment, timetable modifications, field-level advance preparations, and the dissemination of information to ensure safe and efficient railway operations. The course also highlights the coordination required among various railway departments and emphasizes compliance with prescribed operational and safety procedures during Non-Interlocked Working. Upon successful completion, learners will be equipped with the knowledge and skills to support and implement NI Working in accordance with Indian Railways' operational standards and safety requirements.

title: Plastic Waste Management
desc: Plastic Waste Management is an essential course designed for public sector professionals tasked with environmental stewardship and urban planning. As plastic consumption continues to rise, the challenge of managing its waste has become a global priority, impacting our oceans, land, and health. This course provides a foundational understanding of the complexities surrounding plastic waste. Participants will delve into the various types of plastics, their sources, and the environmental and socio-economic consequences of improper disposal. The curriculum explores the entire waste management hierarchy, from prevention and reduction strategies to advanced recycling and energy recovery technologies. Key learning areas include the implementation of Solid Waste Management Rules, the promotion of circular economy models, and the role of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). Learners will analyze case studies of successful waste management projects and learn how to design and implement effective local and national policies. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to contribute to sustainable development goals and lead initiatives that transform plastic waste from a liability into a resource.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Platform Business Model
desc: In an era of digital transformation, platform-based business models (PBMs) are fundamentally reshaping how value is created and exchanged. This course is designed to provide government officials with a deep understanding of this paradigm shift, moving beyond traditional 'pipeline' business structures to embrace models built on user interaction and ecosystem development. The curriculum delves into the core mechanics of platforms, exploring critical concepts such as network effects, which drive exponential growth, and the strategic challenges of launching a new platform, including solving the classic 'chicken-or-egg' problem of attracting initial users. Participants will analyze various governance frameworks essential for ensuring trust, security, and equitable participation within a digital ecosystem. The course also covers diverse monetization strategies and the key performance indicators used to measure a platform's success across its lifecycle. By examining successful public digital platforms in India like UPI and DigiLocker, learners will gain practical insights into applying these principles. The ultimate goal is to empower officials to conceptualize, design, and contribute to the development of transparent, scalable, and citizen-centric digital platforms that enhance public service delivery and drive innovation in governance.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Platform Gates
desc: In the context of rapidly expanding urban transit systems, ensuring passenger safety is paramount. This course offers an in-depth examination of platform gate systems, a critical safety infrastructure in metro rail networks. It is designed for technical and operational personnel who are responsible for the daily functioning and maintenance of these systems. The course begins by classifying the four main types of platform doors: Automatic Sliding Doors (ASD), Emergency Escape Doors, Platform End Doors, and Fixed Doors. It then delves into the core components of the control system, explaining the roles of the Platform Gate Central Interface Panel, Local Control Panel, and Emergency Control Box. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the operational logic of the gates. Learners will understand the synchronous opening and closing with train doors under normal conditions. Crucially, the course details the procedures for managing system faults. It explains the concepts of 'Isolation Mode' and 'Bypass Mode,' highlighting the critical differences between them, such as the impact on train speed during platform entry. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently identify system components, understand their interdependencies, and apply the correct procedures for operation and troubleshooting, thereby contributing to a safer and more efficient metro rail service.

title: Platform Screen Door System
desc: Platform Screen Doors (PSDs) are an essential safety and efficiency feature in metro systems worldwide. This course delves into the fundamental aspects of PSD technology, explaining its importance in high-traffic urban rail environments. Learners will explore the primary reasons for their implementation, including the prevention of accidental falls onto the tracks, mitigation of wind from the piston effect of moving trains, and enhanced security. The course differentiates between full-height PSDs, which offer complete environmental separation, and half-height Platform Edge Doors (PEDs), which provide a cost-effective safety barrier while allowing natural ventilation. It also covers the critical interlocking mechanism between the platform doors and the train's saloon doors, a key feature for safe operation. By the end of this course, participants will have a solid understanding of the types, functions, and safety benefits of platform screen door systems as implemented in networks like the Delhi Metro.

title: Plywood Manufacturing Technology (PMT)
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of the plywood manufacturing industry, designed for individuals new to the field. It begins by explaining the necessity of plywood as an engineered wood panel and an alternative to solid timber. The curriculum systematically walks through each stage of production, starting with log storage, hydrothermal conditioning, and the conversion of logs into veneers through rotary peeling and slicing. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the science of adhesives, detailing the formulation and application of phenol formaldehyde (PF) and urea formaldehyde (UF) resins, which determine the plywood's grade, such as moisture-resistant or boiling waterproof. Learners will understand the importance of process control, including veneer drying to specific moisture content, assembly, hot pressing at controlled temperatures and pressures, and post-press stabilization and finishing. The course also references key Indian Standards (e.g., IS 303, IS 710) that govern the quality of different types of plywood, ensuring participants appreciate the link between process, materials, and final product quality.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: Indian Plywood Industries Research and Training Institute (IPIRTI)

title: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan: Vision and Goals
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, a critical initiative aimed at revolutionizing India's infrastructure landscape. It is designed for public officials to appreciate the strategic importance of integrated and holistic planning for national development. The curriculum begins by outlining the aspirational goals behind the master plan, such as achieving a $5 trillion economy and reducing logistics costs. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the plan's six pillars—Comprehensiveness, Prioritization, Optimization, Synchronization, Analytical, and Dynamic—and the seven engines driving economic transformation. A significant focus is placed on the role of the digital platform, a GIS-based tool with extensive data layers that enables seamless coordination among ministries, breaking down traditional silos. Upon completion, learners will be able to articulate the benefits of this approach, including efficient project execution, minimized disruptions, and enhanced multimodal connectivity, positioning them to contribute effectively to India's infrastructure-led growth story.

title: PM Gati Shakti: Economic and Social Development Use Cases
desc: This course delves into the practical applications of the PM Gati Shakti platform for holistic national development. It is designed for officials involved in planning and execution to understand the shift towards integrated, multi-ministerial project management. The curriculum explains the core concepts of the National Master Plan and the critical role of the BISAG-N technology stack in achieving economic efficiency and social equity. Through a series of detailed case studies, participants will explore how the platform optimizes economic infrastructure such as highways, railways, and logistics, by enabling data-driven route selection and gap analysis. Furthermore, the course highlights its application in social infrastructure, demonstrating how to identify optimal locations for schools, Anganwadi centers, and healthcare facilities based on population needs and connectivity. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to leverage the Gati Shakti tool for more effective, coordinated, and timely infrastructure project delivery, contributing to a more connected and resilient India.

title: PM Gati Shakti: Project Life Cycle and Algorithms
desc: Dive into the mechanics of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, a transformative initiative for integrated infrastructure planning in India. This course demystifies the entire project life cycle, from multi-source data collection and validation to generating critical insights for policymakers. You will explore the core technologies that power the platform, including Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing, and AI. The curriculum details the application of powerful analytical tools and routing algorithms, such as Dijkstra's and A*, through practical case studies on urban planning, disaster management, and large-scale infrastructure projects like coastal corridors. By the end of this course, you will grasp how data-driven intelligence is used to optimize project alignments, manage constraints, and execute national development projects efficiently, ensuring better connectivity and resource utilization across sectors.

title: PM Gati Shakti: Understanding the Portal and Tools
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan's digital platform, a critical tool for modernizing India's infrastructure planning. The curriculum is structured to provide a practical, step-by-step walkthrough, starting from the basics of portal access and navigation. Participants will learn to interpret and utilize the platform's extensive data layers, which integrate information from various ministries, states, and other sources. The core of the course is a detailed demonstration of key analytical tools, including the Go/No-Go Area tool for site suitability, the Proximity tool for connectivity analysis, the Dynamic Gap Analyzer for identifying service deficiencies, and the Query Builder for custom data extraction. By mastering these functionalities, learners will be able to conduct comprehensive project analysis, identify potential challenges, and make informed, evidence-based decisions. This course is essential for officials involved in planning, project management, and policy implementation who seek to leverage technology for more efficient and effective infrastructure development.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: PM Gatishakti
desc: This foundational course delves into the strategic framework of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan. It is designed to provide government officials with a clear understanding of why this initiative is critical for India's infrastructure development. The curriculum covers the context behind its creation, addressing the challenges of disjointed planning and execution. Key learning areas include the structure of the Project Monitoring Group (PMG) portal, the roles and responsibilities of different stakeholders, and the digital tools available for data-driven decision-making and efficient planning. Participants will learn how the integration of ministries like roadways, railways, and shipping facilitates seamless connectivity. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to appreciate the principles of integrated planning and contribute to the coordinated execution of infrastructure projects within their respective domains, ultimately supporting the goal of a more competitive and efficient national logistics ecosystem.
org: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan and Indian Railways
desc: The PM GatiShakti National Master Plan represents a paradigm shift in India's approach to infrastructure development, aiming to break down departmental silos and create a unified vision for multimodal connectivity. This course provides a comprehensive overview of this transformative initiative and its profound implications for Indian Railways. It addresses the critical need for coordinated planning to reduce logistical costs, improve project execution timelines, and accelerate economic growth, positioning Indian Railways as a central pillar in this national mission. Learners will delve into the core components of the GatiShakti framework, including its digital GIS-based platform that integrates data from numerous central ministries and state governments. The curriculum covers the development of key railway projects such as GatiShakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminals (GCTs) and Dedicated Freight Corridors (DFCs), explaining how they contribute to a seamless logistics ecosystem. The course also examines the data-driven approach for identifying infrastructure gaps, optimizing resource allocation, and monitoring project progress in real-time. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to align railway projects with the GatiShakti vision, contribute to integrated planning processes, and leverage the platform's tools for efficient and effective infrastructure development, ultimately supporting India's goal of becoming a $5 trillion economy.

title: PM SVANidhi: Empowering Street Vendors Through Financial Inclusion
desc:
The PM SVANidhi Scheme has emerged as a catalyst for inclusive urban entrepreneurship, breaking barriers that previously limited access for marginalized micro-entrepreneurs. With a notable rise in female participation, the scheme has advanced women’s entrepreneurial empowerment, contributing to broader gender equality in urban markets. PM SVANidhi has strengthened the sustainability of small urban businesses.

This caselet explores the scheme’s implementation, the challenges faced in reaching its objectives and outlines the path ahead to further enhance its role in fostering resilient and inclusive urban livelihoods.

title: PM Vishwakarma: Empowering Traditional Artisans
desc: The PM Vishwakarma Scheme is a flagship initiative of the Government of India that aims to strengthen traditional artisans and craftspeople by improving their skills, enhancing access to institutional support, and creating sustainable livelihood opportunities. Implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), the scheme provides an integrated support system that recognizes artisans, builds their capabilities, facilitates financial inclusion, and improves market access through a fully digital and paperless delivery framework. This course introduces learners to the purpose, objectives, governance structure, and operational framework of PM Vishwakarma. It explains how the scheme preserves India's traditional crafts while enabling artisans to transition from informal occupations to sustainable entrepreneurial livelihoods.

title: POCSO Case Investigations: Medical Examination and Age Verification
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the legal and medical responsibilities involved in examining victims and accused in POCSO cases, in line with the POCSO Act, 2012 and BNSS guidelines. The course highlights the importance of timely emergency care, consent, compassionate victim handling, accurate documentation, and standardized forensic evidence collection. It also addresses age determination, including the hierarchy of verification documents, medical tests such as ossification when records are absent, and the legal margin of error recognized by courts. Learners will gain insights into relevant court procedures to ensure child protection when age remains uncertain, emphasizing a victim-centered approach, ethical practices, and compliance with legal standards.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Podcast-Cloud adoption and Data Centre Technology in Government
desc: Dive into the strategic imperatives of modernizing government IT infrastructure through cloud adoption and advanced data center technologies. This course unpacks the reasons why governments are moving towards cloud-first policies to deliver scalable and efficient citizen services. You will explore the nuances of private, public, and hybrid cloud deployments, understanding how they help balance security, data sovereignty, and cost-effectiveness. The curriculum covers significant technological trends, including the transformative power of AI and automation in data center management, the importance of robust cybersecurity measures, and the challenges of migrating legacy applications. Furthermore, it touches upon the future of government tech with insights into sustainability in data centers, edge computing, and the role of 5G. Upon completion, learners will have a comprehensive understanding of the technological landscape shaping modern governance and public service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Point Of Sale Application in India Post
desc: Dive into the operational mechanics of the India Post's Point of Sale (POS) application with this detailed procedural course. Designed for Post Office Assistants and Supervisors, this training breaks down the entire workflow of the Core System Integration (CSI) environment. You will learn the day-to-day tasks, starting from system initialization, data synchronization with the central SAP server, and supervisor functions like day-begin and counter allocation. The course provides step-by-step guidance on a wide array of counter transactions, including booking accountable articles, processing electronic money orders (eMOs), managing stamp and stationery inventory, and handling customer payments. Furthermore, it covers critical back-office operations such as cash and inventory management, transaction authorization, bulk booking uploads, and end-of-day account submission. Upon completion, you will be proficient in navigating both the POS Counter and Back Office modules, ensuring smooth, accurate, and efficient service delivery at post office counters.

title: Police Accountability and Technology in India
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of police accountability in India, covering judicial interventions, statutory safeguards, and technological tools. It focuses on key provisions under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, and explores the integration of digital systems such as e-Sakshya, CCTNS, MedLEaPR, e-Prisons, and NAFIS. The course highlights landmark Supreme Court judgments, procedural safeguards, digital evidence management, and citizen-centric grievance mechanisms, ensuring transparency, legality, and effective oversight in policing.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Police as First Responders in Disaster Management
desc: In the face of increasing natural and man-made disasters, the role of police as immediate first responders is more critical than ever. This course provides an in-depth understanding of the responsibilities and operational procedures for police personnel during emergencies. It begins by contextualizing India’s disaster vulnerability profile and explaining the comprehensive legal structure under the Disaster Management Act (2005). Learners will gain detailed knowledge of the disaster management ecosystem, including the roles and coordinated efforts of the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), and State/District Disaster Management Authorities (SDMA/DDMA). The curriculum focuses on practical, life-saving skills essential for on-ground operations. Key learning areas include primary assessment methods like the ABCDE approach, Basic Life Support (BLS), and the Four-Color Triage system for effective casualty prioritization. Furthermore, the course addresses the complexities of multi-agency coordination, outlining communication protocols and the legal powers available to police. Through procedural explanations, participants will be equipped to make sound ethical decisions and act decisively, ensuring professional and effective crisis management.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Policies and Initiatives of Petroleum and Natural Gas Ministry
desc: This course offers a focused exploration of the legal and regulatory landscape of India's petroleum and natural gas sector. It is designed for professionals, students, and policy enthusiasts seeking to understand the governance structures that shape this critical industry. The curriculum traces the evolution of petroleum legislation, covering key statutes such as the Petroleum Act (1934), the Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, the PNGRB Act, and the Environment Protection Act (1986). Participants will learn about the constitutional provisions that grant Parliament the authority to legislate on petroleum resources. The course also demystifies the roles and responsibilities of key regulatory institutions, including the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH), Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD), and Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS).
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Policies and Initiatives of Petroleum and Natural Gas Ministry
desc: This course offers a focused exploration of the legal and regulatory landscape of India's petroleum and natural gas sector. It is designed for professionals, students, and policy enthusiasts seeking to understand the governance structures that shape this critical industry. The curriculum traces the evolution of petroleum legislation, covering key statutes such as the Petroleum Act (1934), the Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, the PNGRB Act, and the Environment Protection Act (1986). Participants will learn about the constitutional provisions that grant Parliament the authority to legislate on petroleum resources. The course also demystifies the roles and responsibilities of key regulatory institutions, including the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH), Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD), and Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS). By examining the procedural aspects of licensing, environmental clearances, and enforcement, learners will be equipped to analyze the regulatory requirements and challenges across the entire value chain, from exploration to marketing.
org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

title: Policy and Process of Railway Project Sanctions
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the planning, preparation, and execution of railway works programmes. It explains the process of preparing a preliminary works programme and introduces the use of the Law Book and Mini Law Book as essential references for planning and execution. Learners will also understand the classification of various categories of umbrella works, along with the commonly used abbreviations and terminology associated with works programmes. The course further covers the planning and implementation of traffic facility works, highlighting the procedures, documentation, and best practices required for effective execution. By the end of the course, learners will have a clear understanding of the principles, processes, and documentation involved in planning and implementing railway works programmes.

title: Policy on Old Grants
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the intricate details of the 'Policy on Old Grants,' a critical area of defence land management. The program begins by establishing the historical context of these grants, which date back to the British era, and clarifies the fundamental legal principle: the government retains ownership of the land, while the grantee holds rights only to the authorized superstructure. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the governing rules, including the seminal GGO 179 of 1836 and the revised policy of 1995. The course provides practical, step-by-step guidance on key administrative functions performed by Defence Estates Officers. This includes the procedures for property mutation, processing applications for building plan sanctions, and executing the resumption of sites. It also covers the nuances of compensation, arbitration, and the different regulations for lands inside and outside civil areas. By completing this course, officials will be equipped to manage 'Old Grant' properties effectively, navigate complex legal challenges, and ensure compliance with Ministry of Defence directives.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: Population Dynamics and Its Implications on Public Policy
desc: In an era of significant demographic change, understanding the interplay between population dynamics and public policy is essential for effective governance. This course delves into the core principles of demography, examining how trends like declining fertility, increasing life expectancy, and large-scale migration are reshaping societies. It provides a detailed analysis of India's unique demographic position, including the opportunities presented by its 'youth bulge' and the challenges of a progressively ageing population. Participants will explore various scenarios, from leveraging the demographic dividend through skill development and employment policies to creating robust social security and healthcare systems for the elderly. The course emphasizes the use of data and demographic intelligence to inform policy decisions, ensuring that they are responsive to the evolving needs of the population. By the end of this course, learners will be able to critically assess demographic data, analyze its policy implications, and contribute to the design of forward-looking strategies that foster inclusive and sustainable development for all sections of society.

title: POSB Deceased Claim Cases (without Nomination, without Legal Evidence)
desc: This course offers an in-depth procedural training for staff of the Department of Posts, focusing on the settlement of deceased claim cases for Post Office Savings Bank (POSB) and other National Savings Schemes. It specifically addresses the challenging scenario where the deceased has not made a nomination and no legal evidence, such as a succession certificate, is immediately available. The training is critical for ensuring that claims are processed efficiently, transparently, and with empathy, thereby maintaining public trust in the postal banking system.The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the entire claim lifecycle. Key learning areas include identifying the basis for a claim, categorizing cases (with/without nomination, with/without legal evidence), and determining the priority between nominees and legal heirs. It provides detailed instructions on the necessary documentation, including the correct use of Form 13 (Affidavit), Form 14 (Letter of Disclaimer), and Form 15 (Bond of Indemnity). The course also clarifies the financial powers of different sanctioning authorities based on claim value limits, such as the Rs. 5 lakh threshold, and outlines the process for handling special cases and disputes.Upon completion, learners will be proficient in processing these specific types of deceased claims in Finacle, adhering to all relevant SB Orders and procedural mandates. They will be able to guide claimants compassionately through the process, ensure all documentation is correctly verified, and contribute to the timely and lawful settlement of claims, reinforcing the department's role as a reliable provider of financial services.

title: POSB Deceased Claim Cases without nomination but with legal evidence
desc: This detailed training program is designed to equip Department of Posts personnel with the specialized knowledge required to process Post Office Savings Bank (POSB) deceased claim cases where no nomination is present, but the claim is supported by legal evidence. The course addresses a critical aspect of postal banking, ensuring that claims are handled with accuracy, empathy, and strict adherence to procedural guidelines.The curriculum begins by establishing the basis for deceased claims and defining the roles of claimants and legal heirs, including the priority of settlement. It provides a step-by-step guide to processing these specific cases, covering the necessary actions in the Finacle system, such as using the CMRC menu to update the customer's status. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the required legal documents, including probate of will, succession certificates, and letters of administration, and learn how to verify their authenticity. The course also outlines the financial powers of various sanctioning authorities, from Sub-Postmasters to Divisional Heads, ensuring that claims are sanctioned at the appropriate level. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in managing the entire lifecycle of these complex claims, from document submission to final payment, thereby enhancing service delivery and maintaining public trust.

title: Poshan Tracker: A Digital Approach to Better Nutrition Outcomes
desc: Poshan Tracker has transformed the way nutrition, health, and early childhood development services are delivered under the Government of India's nutrition programmes. By replacing manual registers with a real-time digital platform, it enables Anganwadi Workers to record beneficiary information, monitor child growth, deliver nutrition services, and support evidence-based decision-making across multiple administrative levels.This course provides a practical introduction to the Poshan Tracker application, explaining its purpose, architecture, and role within Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0. Learners become familiar with the beneficiary groups served through the platform, including pregnant women, lactating mothers, children under six years of age, and adolescent girls, while understanding how digital verification and beneficiary registration improve transparency and service quality.

title: Post Office Act 2023
desc: This course delves into the transformative Post Office Act 2023, which repeals the outdated 1898 legislation. It begins by establishing the context, highlighting the limitations of the previous Act in the modern era. The course then outlines the key features of the new legislation, which is simpler with only 16 sections and notably removes all penal provisions, reflecting a shift towards a service-oriented framework. Learners will explore the expanded scope of the Department of Posts, which now formally includes banking services, logistics, and other citizen-centric functions like Aadhaar enrollment. The curriculum also covers new governmental powers regarding digital postcodes and postage stamps. Upon completion, participants will have a clear understanding of how this Act enables the evolution of the Indian Post Office into a modern, efficient, and multi-functional service delivery network for the nation.

title: Post Office Kisan Vikas Pathra- Finacle Workflow
desc: This comprehensive course is designed for personnel within the Department of Posts, focusing on the operational procedures for the Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) scheme within the Finacle Core Banking Solution. As the department transitions its banking services to a core banking environment, mastering the Finacle workflow is essential for ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. This program addresses the critical need for standardized handling of small savings schemes, which are a cornerstone of the Post Office's financial inclusion efforts. Learners will be guided through the complete lifecycle of a KVP account. The modules cover the step-by-step process for opening new accounts, including handling deposits via cash, cheque, or transfer from a savings account. It details the procedures for entering nomination details and the crucial verification steps to be performed by a supervisor. Furthermore, the course explains the specific conditions and Finacle workflows for both premature closure and maturity closure of KVP accounts, ensuring that employees can manage customer requests correctly and in line with regulations. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in executing KVP-related transactions in Finacle, minimizing operational errors and improving the overall customer experience for this important government savings instrument.

title: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme - Finacle Workflow
desc: This program is designed to help Department of Posts users understand and master the workflow in Finacle for the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (MIS). As the department utilizes the Core Banking Solution for its banking services, proficiency in Finacle is essential for operational staff. This course offers a practical, step-by-step walkthrough of key processes. Key learning areas include the opening of new MIS accounts, supervisor verification protocols, conditions and calculations for premature closure, and updating accounts for Electronic Clearance System (ECS) mandates. Furthermore, it details the procedure for account closure and the crediting of proceeds to a Post Office Savings Account. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently navigate the Finacle application to manage MIS accounts, reduce errors, and improve the efficiency of customer service at Post Offices.

title: Post Office National Savings Scheme - Finacle Workflow
desc: This program offers detailed, practical training on the Finacle workflow for the National Savings Certificate (NSC) scheme, a key offering of the Post Office Savings Bank. The course is structured to guide users through the entire lifecycle of an NSC account within the Core Banking Solution environment. Learners will begin with the account opening process, covering the operator's role in entering customer data, deposit details, and nomination information using specific Finacle menus like CMIS AOP. The course then explains the critical verification stage, outlining the supervisor's responsibilities in meticulously checking all data against the physical forms to ensure accuracy and prevent errors. Furthermore, the training details the specific rules and procedures for handling both premature and maturity closures of NSC accounts, including the CACC menu for processing payments. By completing this course, Post Office staff will be equipped to handle NSC-related tasks efficiently and accurately, contributing to better customer service and operational excellence.

title: Post Office Public Provident Fund- Finacle Workflow
desc: This program is designed to provide Department of Posts employees with a detailed operational understanding of the Public Provident Fund (PPF) scheme's workflow within the Finacle application. As the department transitions to the Core Banking Solution, mastering these procedures is crucial for seamless and accurate customer service. The course breaks down complex processes into manageable, easy-to-follow video modules. Key learning areas include the end-to-end process of opening a new PPF account, from data entry using the CPFAO menu to the final verification by a supervisor with the CPPFAV menu. It also covers the distinct procedures for handling financial transactions, such as accepting and posting cash deposits (CPPTF) and cheque deposits (CPGTF), including the verification steps for each. Furthermore, the course touches upon the conditions and processes for premature account closure. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in executing and supervising all fundamental PPF account operations in Finacle, minimizing errors and ensuring adherence to the established workflow.

title: Post Office Recurring Deposit - Finacle Workflow
desc: This program is designed to provide Department of Posts personnel with a detailed operational understanding of the Finacle workflow for Recurring Deposit (RD) accounts. As the department transitions to a Core Banking Solution, mastering these standardized procedures is crucial for ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and consistent customer service. The course delves into the practical, step-by-step processes for every major RD transaction. Key learning areas include account opening and verification (CRDOAAC), processing normal deposits and those with default fees (CRDP), managing bulk deposits from MPKBY agents (HAGTXP), and setting up standing instructions (HSSIN). Furthermore, learners will be guided through the procedures for sanctioning and managing RD loans, handling premature closures, and processing maturity payments. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently and correctly navigate the Finacle application to manage the entire lifecycle of an RD account, minimizing errors and adhering to the procedural guidelines of India Post.

title: Post Office Savings Account
desc: The Post Office Savings Account (POSA) is a cornerstone of financial inclusion in India, offering a secure and accessible savings option to millions. This course is designed to provide a detailed and practical understanding of the POSA scheme, making it essential for postal employees and financial literacy advocates. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals, covering eligibility requirements and the step-by-step process of opening an account. Learners will delve into the operational aspects, including rules for deposits and withdrawals, methods of interest calculation, and the procedures for account closure. The course also addresses special circumstances and features such as the handling of silent or dormant accounts, the process of nomination, and the revival of accounts. Furthermore, it provides clarity on the schedule of fees for various services and introduces the convenience of e-banking and mobile banking facilities associated with the POSA. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to manage Post Office Savings Accounts effectively, adhere to regulatory guidelines, and provide accurate information to customers, thereby enhancing service quality and financial literacy.

title: Post Office Savings Accounts Finacle Workflow
desc: As the Department of Posts transitions its banking services to the Finacle Core Banking Solution, it is essential for staff to be proficient in the new digital workflow. This course offers a detailed, step-by-step guide to managing Post Office Savings Accounts within the Finacle application. The curriculum covers the entire account lifecycle, starting from filling Account Opening and KYC forms, creating and verifying Customer Information Files (CIF), and opening various types of savings accounts, including single and joint accounts. Key learning areas include processing financial transactions such as deposits and withdrawals using the CTM menu, managing cheque book inventory and issuance, and handling ATM card requests and replacements. The course also details the specific roles and responsibilities of both the operator (Postal Assistant) and the supervisor, outlining the verification and authorization processes critical for maintaining security and compliance. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate the Finacle system to deliver efficient and error-free postal banking services.

title: Post Office Sr.Citizen Savings Scheme - Finacle Workflow
desc: This program offers detailed procedural training on the Finacle workflow for the Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS), a crucial financial product offered by India Post. The course is structured to provide a practical, hands-on understanding of the entire lifecycle of an SCSS account within the Core Banking Solution environment. Participants will learn the specific Finacle menus and commands required for critical tasks. Key learning areas include the account opening process using the 'CSCAOP' menu, differentiating between various scheme codes (e.g., SCVRS, SCSCM), and correctly handling deposits, interest credits, and tax-related form entries. The course also provides an in-depth look at the rules and calculations for premature closures and the systematic process for final account closure and payment using 'HCACCD'. Upon completion, learners will be able to execute and verify SCSS transactions accurately, reduce procedural errors, and provide efficient and compliant service to senior citizens at the post office counter.

title: Post Office Time Deposit- Finacle Workflow
desc: This program offers comprehensive training on the Finacle workflow for Post Office Time Deposit (TD) accounts. As the Department of Posts transitions to a Core Banking Solution to offer modern banking facilities, it is crucial for staff to be proficient in the new platform. This course addresses that need by providing step-by-step instructions for key TD account operations. The modules cover the entire lifecycle of a TD account, including the opening process using the CMISAOP menu, handling nominations, and linking interest credit to savings accounts. It further explains the critical rules and calculations for premature account closure and demonstrates the procedure for final account closure and payment of proceeds into a Post Office Savings Account (POSA). The course also details the verification process to be performed by supervisors, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently and correctly manage TD account transactions in Finacle, enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

title: Post Office Workflow-Finance and Accounts
desc: This program offers an in-depth exploration of the modernized financial and accounting operations within the Department of Posts. It is specifically designed to equip Postal Assistants and Supervisors with the practical skills needed to navigate the Core System Integrator (CSI) platform, with a primary focus on the SAP Finance and Accounts (F&A) module. The course begins by explaining the principles of the double-entry accounting system and its application within the CSI framework. Learners will receive step-by-step guidance on critical daily tasks, including manual and bulk voucher postings using various transaction codes (T-Codes), managing different types of cash, and handling General Ledger (GL) accounts. Furthermore, the curriculum covers specialized procedures such as issuing cheques, processing payments and receipts, managing sub-office and branch-office accounts, and generating essential financial reports like the Daily Transaction Report (DTR) and Treasurer's Cash Book (TCB). Upon completion, participants will be proficient in executing their financial responsibilities accurately and efficiently, contributing to the seamless financial functioning of the postal system.

title: Postal Accounts Manual(Account submission in PFMS)
desc: This course is designed for officials involved in the financial operations of the Department of Post, offering a detailed guide to the account submission process using PFMS. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of government accounting, contrasting the accrual-based systems used in postal applications with the cash-based requirements of the Government of India. You will learn the end-to-end process of how financial data is captured from diverse platforms into the central SAP system. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical steps required before generating the daily CGA report. This includes performing preliminary checks, monitoring specific General Ledger (GL) codes using SAP T-codes, and identifying and clearing uncleared balances. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to accurately generate and submit DDO-wise daily accounts, ensure financial compliance, and effectively manage the consolidation of monthly accounts within the PFMS framework.

title: Postal Assistants, Savings Bank Control Organisation-DAKSHTA
desc: This course, 'DAKSHTA: Savings Bank Control Organisation Procedures for Postal Assistants', is an in-depth program designed for Postal Assistants working in both SBCO branches and general Post Offices. In the context of the recent merger of PA SBCO and PA Post Office cadres, this training is essential for standardizing skills across the workforce. The course delves into the core responsibilities of an SBCO Postal Assistant, starting from the receipt and general examination of savings bank vouchers to their detailed verification against system-generated reports from the Finacle MIS server. Participants will learn the systematic process of checking for discrepancies, raising and managing objections through the objection register, and handling various financial documents like unused cheques and undelivered passbooks. Furthermore, the course covers the auditing of specific office accounts in Finacle, the application of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) rules, and the principles of record management and preservation. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in executing their duties as auditors within the postal savings bank framework, playing a vital role in upholding financial discipline and preventing embezzlement.

title: Postal Life Insurance (PLI)
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of Postal Life Insurance (PLI), a foundational financial product offered by the Department of Posts, Government of India. The program is designed to familiarize learners with the core aspects of PLI, starting with its historical significance and evolution since 1884. Participants will delve into the various types of PLI schemes, including Suraksha (Whole Life Assurance), Santosh (Endowment Assurance), and Yugal Suraksha (Joint Life Assurance), understanding the unique features, eligibility criteria, premium structures, and maturity benefits of each. The course also explains the underlying policy rules, loan and surrender facilities, and the process for claims. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to identify the target clientele for PLI and articulate its advantages, making them proficient in the fundamentals of this vital public insurance service.

title: Postal Manual Volume I
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip employees of the Department of Posts with a detailed understanding of Postal Manual Volume I. The manual serves as the primary guide for all rules and procedures related to post office operations.
