The curriculum delves into the core legislative framework that governs the postal system, including an in-depth look at the Indian Post Office Act, 2023, the Indian Post Office Rules, 1933, and other significant enactments like the Government Savings Bank Act, 1873, and the Government Savings Certificates Act, 1959. By exploring these regulations, learners will understand the legal basis for services such as mail handling, registration, money orders, and postal banking. The course clarifies the distinction between 'Acts' and 'Rules' and explains their practical application in daily tasks. Upon completion, officials will be better prepared to perform their duties with accuracy, resolve procedural ambiguities, and ensure full compliance with the legal and operational standards of the Indian Post Office, thereby enhancing service quality and accountability.

title: POSTMAN DELIVERY MONITORING
desc: This program is designed to equip postal employees with the essential knowledge and skills required for effective mail delivery monitoring. It delves into the critical day-to-day operations of a post office's delivery department, providing a detailed walkthrough of the entire lifecycle of mail and parcels. The course begins with the fundamental procedures for handling ordinary and accountable articles, including registered mail, parcels, and COD items. It then transitions to the digital tools that underpin modern postal services, offering in-depth training on the Delivery and Postman Management System (DPMS) for backend processing and the Postman Mobile Application (PMA) for real-time field updates. A significant portion is dedicated to the specialized workflows of Nodal Delivery Centers (NDCs) for efficient parcel logistics. Furthermore, the course outlines the crucial role of supervisors in monitoring performance, handling irregularities, and utilizing system-generated reports from TechOps and BI dashboards for data-driven decision-making. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in the standard operating procedures and technological tools necessary to uphold service excellence in India Post.

title: Postman Mobile Application and Dashboard Monitoring
desc: This course offers an in-depth operational training on the Postman Mobile Application (PMA) and its ecosystem. It is designed for postal delivery staff to enhance efficiency, transparency, and accountability in their daily tasks. The curriculum begins with an introduction to the PMA, its benefits, and the critical do's and don'ts for accurate data capture, which is essential for maintaining the integrity of the postal service. Learners will be guided through the step-by-step process of using the application, from scanning and invoicing articles to recording delivery and non-delivery statuses with standard remarks. The course also covers the use of the Nanyatha application for monitoring letterbox clearance. Furthermore, it explains the significance and functionality of the PMA monitoring dashboard, which allows supervisors to track delivery performance in real-time. By completing this course, postal employees will be able to effectively utilize modern digital tools to improve service delivery, reduce customer complaints, and contribute to the digital transformation of India Post.

title: Power Plant Introduction and Maintainance
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of power plant systems and VRLA batteries used in the telecommunications industry. It begins by establishing the fundamental need for a stable DC power source for telecom equipment and outlines the working principles of AC to DC conversion. The curriculum then delves into the specifics of VRLA batteries, covering their internal construction, including the role of the Absorbent Glass Mat (AGM), and the function of safety valves. Learners will understand key technical specifications such as Ampere-Hour (AH) capacity and the C10 rating for optimal battery utilization and longevity. The course also demystifies various critical voltage levels, including open circuit, deep discharge, boost charging, and float charging voltages, explaining their physical significance in battery management. A live demonstration video provides a practical look inside a power plant room, showcasing the layout and components. Upon completion, learners will have a solid technical understanding of power supply systems vital for maintaining telecommunication network resilience.

title: Power System Operation
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the principles and practices of modern power system operation. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand the intricate mechanisms that ensure a stable and efficient electricity supply. The curriculum begins with an overview of power system fundamentals and its core elements. Learners will delve into the critical concept of load-generation balance, which is essential for grid stability. The course thoroughly examines power system stability, reliability, and resilience, providing insights into how to manage and mitigate operational risks. Key modules are dedicated to economic despatch, renewable energy integration, and system monitoring, equipping learners with the knowledge to analyze various power system scenarios. Upon completion, participants will be able to understand the complexities of grid management and contribute to the effective and economic operation of power systems in the context of evolving energy landscapes.

title: Power Traffic and Rolling Block
desc: This course is designed to equip railway personnel with a thorough understanding of Power, Traffic, and Rolling Blocks and their critical role in ensuring safety during maintenance operations. In the context of Indian Railways, the coordinated management of these blocks is essential for maintaining infrastructure like Overhead Equipment (OHE) without disrupting train schedules unnecessarily. The course delves into the key learning areas, starting with the fundamental differences between Traffic and Power Blocks. It covers the various types, such as Emergency, Pre-arranged, and Local Blocks, detailing the standard operating procedures for requesting, sanctioning, and closing them. A significant focus is placed on interdepartmental coordination among the Operating, Electrical, and Engineering departments, highlighting the communication protocols that prevent accidents. Learners will be trained on the correct use of the Private Number system and the Permit to Work (PTW) for authorizing maintenance. Furthermore, the course explains the principles of integrated Rolling Block Planning, a strategy to efficiently manage multiple maintenance tasks. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in applying these procedures to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant maintenance work on the railway network.

title: Powering Innovation: India's Startup Ecosystem
desc: Explore the dynamic world of entrepreneurship with this in-depth course on India's startup ecosystem. The program begins by tracing the global surge in startups and then focuses on India's journey to becoming the world's third-largest startup hub. You will learn about the distinct phases of this evolution, driven by factors such as widespread digital adoption, a large pool of young talent, and growing investor confidence. A key focus is the transformative role of the Startup India programme, which has been instrumental in simplifying regulations, improving access to funding and mentorship, and strengthening IP protection. The course also highlights the tangible economic impacts, including large-scale job creation, attracting foreign investment, and bolstering the MSME sector. Furthermore, it addresses persistent challenges like regulatory bottlenecks, capital access, and skill gaps. Finally, you will explore strategic pathways for future growth, such as fostering innovation in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities and encouraging ventures into high-value domains, to further accelerate India's innovation-driven economy.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: Practicing Excellence
desc: Practicing Excellence provides a comprehensive framework for professionals seeking to elevate their performance beyond meeting expectations to consistently exceeding them. In today's dynamic work environment, the ability to self-regulate, prioritize effectively, and maintain a high standard of quality is crucial for career progression and impactful work. This course moves beyond theoretical concepts to offer actionable strategies for personal and professional development. Learners will explore the critical distinction between success and excellence, understanding that the latter is a continuous journey of improvement, not a final destination. The curriculum is structured around four key pillars: self-governance, self-responsibility, self-knowledge, and self-belief. Participants will learn to apply practical time management tools such as the Eisenhower Matrix for prioritization and the Pomodoro Technique to overcome procrastination and enhance focus. The course also covers developing a robust work ethic, taking ownership, and building resilience to navigate setbacks. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to cultivate habits that foster consistent high performance, drive productivity, and build a reputation for professionalism and dependability in any role.

title: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan
desc: The Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA), launched in 2018, is a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to ensure remunerative prices for farmers’ produce and provide price assurance through structured market interventions. The scheme addresses income volatility by reducing reliance on middlemen, promoting crop diversification towards pulses and oilseeds, and strengthening procurement frameworks. PM-AASHA brings together multiple mechanisms, including the Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), Price Stabilization Fund (PSF), and Market Intervention Scheme (MIS). This course offers a comprehensive understanding of PM-AASHA’s components, MSP formulation, operational workflows, financial systems, roles of central/state agencies, and its wider impact on India’s agricultural economy.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G): An Overview
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G), a flagship rural housing programme aimed at providing affordable, safe, and durable housing to eligible rural households through transparent, efficient, and technology-driven implementation mechanisms. The course explains the vision, objectives, guiding principles, and key features of PMAY-G, along with its role in promoting inclusive rural development and improving the quality of life in rural areas. Learners will gain an understanding of the beneficiary selection process, eligibility criteria, institutional arrangements, and implementation framework adopted under the scheme to ensure transparency, accountability, and effective service delivery. The course also covers the end-to-end implementation process, including beneficiary identification, sanctioning, fund flow mechanisms, Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), house construction, monitoring, and completion procedures.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin: Financial Management and Budgeting
desc: This course provides a detailed understanding of financial management and fund flow mechanisms under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G). It explains the processes of budgeting, fund allocation, Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), State Nodal Account (SNA) operations, and Fund Transfer Order (FTO) mechanisms that ensure transparent, efficient, and timely release of funds to beneficiaries. Learners will gain insights into the use of digital platforms such as the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) and AwaasSoft for financial monitoring, beneficiary validation, accounting, and audit tracking. The course also highlights the importance of compliance, accountability, and risk management in ensuring proper utilization of funds and minimizing financial irregularities. Through case-based examples and system-oriented learning, the course enables participants to understand financial workflows and governance structures that support effective programme implementation.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana: Evolution Innovation and Impact
desc: Delve into the intricate workings of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), a critical instrument for protecting India's farmers against agricultural uncertainties. This course offers an expert-led exploration of the scheme's journey, from its inception to its current technologically-driven framework. You will gain a deep understanding of the context behind major policy reforms, such as making the scheme voluntary for all farmers and rationalizing premium rates to ensure financial discipline. The curriculum focuses on the integration of technology as a transformative force, covering the automated systems of the National Crop Insurance Portal, the technology-based yield estimation (YESTEK), and the 'AIDE' app for doorstep enrollment. Furthermore, the course examines strategies for enhancing stakeholder confidence and farmer engagement through timely claim settlements and dedicated grievance redressal platforms like Krishi Rakshak. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the scheme's effectiveness and its future potential in strengthening India's agricultural ecosystem against climate-related risks.
org: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana PMFBY

title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana: Guidelines and Manuals
desc: This course focuses on the development, standardization, and implementation of guidelines and operational manuals under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY). It provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of the planning, execution, monitoring, and maintenance frameworks required to ensure sustainable, high-quality rural road connectivity. The course emphasizes the importance of standardized procedures, technical specifications, quality assurance systems, and maintenance protocols in delivering durable, all-weather rural roads. Learners will explore key operational aspects such as project planning, contract management, quality control mechanisms, road safety considerations, and asset maintenance strategies. In addition, the course highlights the role of GIS-based planning tools, performance monitoring systems, grievance redressal mechanisms, and reporting dashboards in strengthening programme implementation.

title: Pradhan Mantri PVTG Mission
desc: The Pradhan Mantri PVTG Mission, a flagship program of the Indian Government, is dedicated to enhance the socio-economic conditions of the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) in the country. This case delves into the assessment and resolution of challenges faced by the mission, which has been allocated a budget of Rs. 15,000 crore over three years, commencing in 2023-24. The mission aims to provide critical support in the form of housing, water, sanitation, education, healthcare, and livelihood opportunities, while respecting the cultural integrity of PVTGs. This case offers a comprehensive understanding of the issues faced by PVTGs, and the effectiveness of the mission in addressing these concerns, aligning with broader governmental objectives in accordance with United Nation’s Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs). The case encourages adoption of an empathetic approach and devising of impact-oriented execution strategies.

title: Pre Enrolment Assessment Form - Underwater Domain Awareness
desc: Comprehensive capacity-building course on Pre Enrolment Assessment Form - Underwater Domain Awareness published on iGOT Karmayogi.
org: Maritime Research Center Foundation for Underwater Domain Awareness

desc: Comprehensive capacity-building course on Pre-Assessment published on iGOT Karmayogi.

title: Pre-Hospital protocols in case of a cardiac arrest
desc: Sudden cardiac arrest is a leading cause of death, and immediate intervention is critical for survival. This course addresses the crucial gap in public knowledge about emergency response, providing life-saving skills to any citizen or public servant. It is built on the principle that anyone can be a first responder and make a decisive difference in an emergency, aligning with the goal of building a more resilient and responsive society. The curriculum systematically covers the entire sequence of Basic Life Support (BLS). You will learn to assess an unconscious person, ensure scene safety, and call for emergency help. The course provides detailed demonstrations on performing high-quality chest compressions (CPR), managing the airway, and delivering rescue breaths. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding and using an Automated External Defibrillator (AED), a device that can correct life-threatening heart rhythms. The training also covers the recovery position for a breathing patient and discusses the initial response to a suspected heart attack. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the confidence and competence to act decisively in a cardiac emergency. You will be able to follow established protocols to protect the brain from irreversible damage and support a person's life until medical professionals take over. This knowledge is invaluable not only in a professional capacity, especially for field officers, but also in everyday life, empowering you to be a vital link in the chain of survival.

title: Preferential Traffic Schedule Operations
desc: The course provides participants with a comprehensive understanding of the structure, classification, and operational significance of traffic groups in Indian Railways. The course focuses on the Prioritisation of Goods Traffic, governed by the Preferential Traffic Order (PTO), which ensures that essential commodities are transported efficiently and timely, especially during periods of resource constraints or high traffic demand. Learners will explore the classification of goods, priority rules, operational procedures for implementing PTO, and the overall impact of traffic prioritisation on freight operations and logistics efficiency. By completing this course, participants will gain the knowledge required to effectively manage goods traffic, maintain operational continuity, and optimize resource allocation across the railway network.

title: PRELIMINARY REPORT (For All Loss and Fraud Cases)
desc: Effective management of loss and fraud is crucial for maintaining operational efficiency and public trust. This course addresses the historical shortcomings in reporting by introducing a standardized framework for all preliminary reports on loss and fraud cases. Participants will learn the step-by-step process of preparing and submitting the report, ensuring all necessary information is included. Key learning areas cover the 30-day submission timeline, the structure of the standardized proforma, and the importance of clearly articulating the modus operandi, systemic vulnerabilities, and suggested corrective actions. The curriculum is designed to equip officials with the knowledge to conduct thorough initial reporting, which is the first critical step in the investigation process, enabling the directorate to take swift corrective measures and prevent future incidents. By completing this course, learners will be able to contribute to a more robust and accountable system for managing financial irregularities.

title: Premium Speed Products: Transforming India Post Logistics
desc: This course provides an overview of 24 Speed Post, 24 Speed Post Parcel, and 48 Speed Post, India Post’s premium logistics products designed to offer assured, time-bound delivery services. It covers the operational process, including booking, acceptance, packaging, processing, transmission, delivery, technologyenabled tracking, performance monitoring, customer compensation, and business development. The course aims to equip employees and officers with the knowledge and skills required to ensure service excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth in the premium logistics segment.

title: Preparation of an Investigation Plan for Financial Fraud
desc: In an era of increasing financial complexity, the ability to conduct a thorough and effective fraud investigation is paramount. This course offers a comprehensive framework for professionals tasked with uncovering financial misconduct. It begins by establishing the critical importance of a well-structured investigation plan to ensure that all subsequent actions are methodical and legally defensible. Participants will delve into the specifics of various fraud schemes, learning to identify red flags associated with collateral fraud, fund diversion, and working capital manipulation. The curriculum provides detailed guidance on the entire investigative lifecycle, from initial planning and evidence preservation to documenting findings for prosecution. Key learning areas include techniques for investigating bogus transactions, scrutinizing sanctioning processes, and addressing lapses in due diligence. The course also covers crucial legal aspects, such as navigating the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, and utilizing Letters Rogatory for international evidence gathering. By completing this course, learners will be proficient in creating and executing investigation plans that can withstand legal scrutiny and contribute to upholding financial integrity.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Preparation of Cabinet Notes
desc: Cabinet Notes are the foundation of policy decisions made by the Union Cabinet. A well-prepared note ensures that the Cabinet has all necessary information to make informed decisions, reflecting sound governance and procedural integrity. This course is designed for officials involved in the policy formulation process. The course will cover the entire lifecycle of a Cabinet Note, from conceptualization to final submission. It delves into the specifics of the Government of India's Transaction of Business Rules, 1961, and Allocation of Business Rules, 1961. Participants will learn how to structure a note, articulate policy proposals, present financial implications, and incorporate feedback from inter-ministerial consultations. The role of the Cabinet Secretariat and the Prime Minister's Office in this process will also be explained.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Preparation of Cabinet Notes
desc: Cabinet Notes are the foundation of policy decisions made by the Union Cabinet. A well-prepared note ensures that the Cabinet has all necessary information to make informed decisions, reflecting sound governance and procedural integrity. This course is designed for officials involved in the policy formulation process. The course will cover the entire lifecycle of a Cabinet Note, from conceptualization to final submission. It delves into the specifics of the Government of India's Transaction of Business Rules, 1961, and Allocation of Business Rules, 1961. Participants will learn how to structure a note, articulate policy proposals, present financial implications, and incorporate feedback from inter-ministerial consultations. The role of the Cabinet Secretariat and the Prime Minister's Office in this process will also be explained. Upon completion, learners will be able to draft Cabinet Notes that are compliant with all procedural requirements and are clear, persuasive, and comprehensive. They will gain confidence in navigating the consultation process and will be better prepared to support the machinery of government in its legislative and policy-making functions.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Preparing Effective Detailed Project Reports
desc: A Detailed Project Report (DPR) serves as a comprehensive blueprint for the planning, appraisal, approval, and implementation of infrastructure projects. This course provides participants with a practical understanding of the purpose, structure, preparation, and effective use of DPRs throughout the project lifecycle. The course explores the key components of a DPR, including project background, objectives, scope, feasibility, technical specifications, implementation strategy, cost estimation, budgeting, funding arrangements, project scheduling, timelines, milestones, risk assessment, and contingency planning. Participants will learn how to systematically collect, analyse, and present project information to develop clear, accurate, and comprehensive DPRs. The course also covers approaches to reviewing, managing, updating, and maintaining DPRs in response to changes during the project lifecycle.

title: Presentation Sanitation Systems
desc: Effective sanitation is a cornerstone of public health, environmental sustainability, and overall national development. This presentation on sanitation systems is designed to provide public functionaries with a clear and structured understanding of this vital infrastructure. The course delves into the core concepts of sanitation, covering the entire service chain from waste generation and containment to conveyance, treatment, and final disposal or reuse. Participants will be introduced to a range of sanitation technologies, including conventional sewerage systems, fecal sludge management (FSM), and innovative decentralized wastewater treatment systems (DEWATS). The content also touches upon the operational and management aspects required to ensure these systems are sustainable and effective in the long term. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to contribute to the planning and implementation of sanitation projects, understand the technical and financial considerations involved, and appreciate the role of robust sanitation infrastructure in achieving national goals like the Swachh Bharat Mission. This knowledge is crucial for officials working in urban local bodies, public health engineering departments, and rural development agencies.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Presiding Officer and Polling Officer Training Introduction
desc: This course is an essential guide for government officials appointed as Presiding Officers and Polling Officers for election duty. It is designed to equip them with the knowledge and skills required to manage a polling station effectively and in compliance with the guidelines of the Election Commission of India. The curriculum delves into the critical legal provisions of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, emphasizing the importance of procedural accuracy and the secrecy of the vote. Key learning areas include the meticulous process of receiving and verifying polling materials, the complete operational workflow for Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) and Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) systems, including pre-poll setup, mock poll procedures, and final sealing. The course also provides detailed instructions on the specific duties of each polling officer, voter identification protocols, and the management of statutory forms like Form 17C. Furthermore, it prepares officials to handle special cases such as challenged votes, tendered votes, and voters with disabilities, ensuring they can address any situation with confidence and impartiality. Upon completion, learners will be fully prepared to conduct free, fair, and transparent elections, upholding the integrity of the democratic process.

title: Preventing Cybercrime: AI-based Threats and Measures
desc: As digital transformation accelerates, the threat of sophisticated cybercrime, particularly those leveraging Artificial Intelligence, has become a critical concern for governance and public administration. This course is designed to equip government functionaries and Chief Information Security Officers with the knowledge to navigate this complex domain. The session provides a detailed examination of AI's role in facilitating cybercrimes, covering topics like AI-authored fake news, AI in cyber espionage, and AI-driven financial fraud. Key learning areas include an analysis of high-profile cyber attacks such as the SolarWinds hack and WannaCry ransomware, offering lessons in vulnerability and response. Furthermore, the course explores the legal landscape, discussing the provisions of the IT Act, 2000, and its application to offenses like hacking and data theft. Participants will also look ahead at emerging threats within the metaverse and learn practical, actionable preventive measures to safeguard digital assets and infrastructure, fostering a culture of cyber resilience within their organizations.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Preventing Financial Fraud:  Digital Arrest Scams
desc: This course provides a comprehensive examination of the escalating threat posed by AI-driven digital arrest scams. It delves into the operational mechanics of these frauds, where criminals leverage advanced technology and psychological tactics to impersonate authorities and deceive citizens. Through an analysis of the methods used, including deepfakes and voice cloning, learners will understand the significant emotional and financial trauma inflicted on victims. The curriculum highlights critical gaps in existing cybersecurity protocols and legal systems that criminals exploit. Ultimately, the course is designed to equip policymakers, law enforcement personnel, and the general public with the knowledge to develop and implement robust preventive measures, advocate for necessary AI regulations, and create widespread awareness campaigns to safeguard against this modern form of cybercrime.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Prevention and control methods of ergonomics
desc: In any professional setting, understanding ergonomics is crucial for maintaining employee well-being and operational efficiency. This course is designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to the principles of ergonomics and their application in the workplace. You will explore the connection between work tasks, equipment, and the physical stress they can place on the human body, leading to musculoskeletal disorders. The curriculum covers how to conduct a basic analysis of work and environmental risk factors to identify potential hazards. Furthermore, you will learn about a range of proven prevention and control strategies, from engineering controls to administrative changes. By the end of this module, you will be equipped with the foundational knowledge to contribute to a safer work environment, minimize injury risks, and support a culture of health and safety within your organization.

title: Prevention and control methods of ergonomics (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से कार्यस्थल पर एर्गोनॉमिक्स के महत्व को समझाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। एर्गोनॉमिक्स, या मानव कारक इंजीनियरिंग, का उद्देश्य कर्मचारियों की क्षमताओं और सीमाओं के अनुरूप कार्यों, उपकरणों और कार्यस्थलों को डिज़ाइन करके दक्षता और कल्याण को अधिकतम करना है। इस पाठ्यक्रम में, शिक्षार्थी एर्गोनॉमिक जोखिम कारकों की पहचान करने की प्रक्रियाओं का पता लगाएंगे जो मस्कुलोस्केलेटल विकारों (MSDs) जैसी चोटों का कारण बन सकते हैं। पाठ्यक्रम इन जोखिमों का विश्लेषण करने और उन्हें कम करने के लिए व्यावहारिक समाधान विकसित करने पर केंद्रित है। इसमें इंजीनियरिंग नियंत्रण (जैसे वर्कस्टेशन को फिर से डिज़ाइन करना), प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण (जैसे कार्य रोटेशन), और व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरणों के उपयोग सहित विभिन्न रोकथाम और नियंत्रण रणनीतियों को शामिल किया गया है। इस मॉड्यूल को पूरा करने के बाद, प्रतिभागी अपने कार्य वातावरण में एर्गोनॉमिक सिद्धांतों को लागू करने, चोटों को कम करने और समग्र उत्पादकता और कर्मचारी मनोबल को बढ़ाने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Prevention and Mitigation Measures for Disaster Risk Reduction
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), equipping learners with the essential knowledge to anticipate and manage natural and man-made disasters. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundational understanding, starting with core DRR concepts, hazard identification, and vulnerability assessment. It clearly distinguishes between proactive prevention measures, designed to stop disasters from occurring, and mitigation strategies, aimed at lessening their impact. Learners will analyze the crucial role of technology, including satellite monitoring, AI-powered predictions, and mobile alert systems, in creating robust early warning mechanisms. Through detailed case studies, such as Odisha's cyclone preparedness and community-led conservation efforts, the course demonstrates the practical application of DRR principles. It highlights the importance of policy frameworks, community-based management, and inter-agency coordination, as exemplified by the roles of NDMA and FEMA. By the end of the course, participants will be prepared to develop and implement effective, evidence-based DRR plans that strengthen community resilience and safeguard lives and infrastructure.
org: Mahatma Gandhi State Institute of Public Administration Punjab

title: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 (Amended in 2018)
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, and its 2018 amendment, a critical legal instrument in promoting integrity and transparency in public service. The content is structured to provide a clear understanding of what constitutes an offence by a public servant, the nuances of criminal misconduct, and the procedural aspects of investigation and prosecution. Participants will delve into the powers of Special Judges, the process for sanctioning prosecution, and the provisions related to the attachment and forfeiture of property acquired through corrupt means. By completing this course, officials involved in vigilance, investigation, and legal administration will be better equipped to apply the Act's provisions correctly, uphold the rule of law, and contribute to a culture of good governance within their organizations.

title: Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002
desc: The Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002, is a cornerstone of India's legal framework against financial crime, designed to safeguard the nation's economic integrity. This course offers a detailed examination of this pivotal legislation, explaining its significance in the context of national security and economic stability. Participants will delve into the fundamental concepts of money laundering, including the three stages of placement, layering, and integration, to understand how illicit funds are disguised and moved. The curriculum provides an in-depth analysis of the PMLA's key provisions, covering its scope, objectives, and the powers vested in authorities like the Enforcement Directorate. Learners will study the procedures for attachment and confiscation of property, the penalties for offenses, and the structure of special courts and appellate tribunals. By exploring the Act's alignment with global anti-money laundering standards, this course equips learners with the necessary knowledge to identify, prevent, and address financial crimes. It is designed to enhance the analytical and decision-making capabilities of officials involved in legal, financial, and compliance roles, enabling them to apply the law effectively in practical scenarios.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Prevention of Needle Stick Injury
desc: This module offers a comprehensive overview of preventing and managing needle stick injuries in clinical and laboratory environments. It is specifically designed for healthcare workers, including surgeons, physicians, nurses, laboratory technicians, and housekeeping staff, who are at occupational risk. The course begins by defining NSIs and identifying high-risk professional groups and procedures. It then provides critical information on the diseases that can be transmitted, such as HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C, highlighting the associated transmission risks. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to preventative strategies, emphasizing strict adherence to standard operating procedures, safe handling and disposal of sharps, and avoiding dangerous practices like recapping needles. Furthermore, the module outlines the crucial immediate actions and long-term follow-up required after an exposure, including first aid, counseling, and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). By completing this course, participants will be equipped to minimize the risk of NSIs and respond effectively if an incident occurs, fostering a culture of safety and infection control.

title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace
desc: This course is designed to educate all employees on the critical issue of preventing sexual harassment in the workplace. It provides a detailed examination of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. The content addresses the importance of creating a safe, respectful, and professional environment for all, which is fundamental to organizational health and employee well-being. Key learning areas include a clear definition of sexual harassment with real-world examples, the distinction between 'quid pro quo' and a 'hostile work environment', and the legal obligations placed upon employers. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the complaint mechanism, including the formation and functions of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), the step-by-step inquiry process, and the potential penalties for non-compliance.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace
desc: This course is designed to educate all employees on the critical issue of preventing sexual harassment in the workplace. It provides a detailed examination of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. The content addresses the importance of creating a safe, respectful, and professional environment for all, which is fundamental to organizational health and employee well-being. Key learning areas include a clear definition of sexual harassment with real-world examples, the distinction between 'quid pro quo' and a 'hostile work environment', and the legal obligations placed upon employers. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the complaint mechanism, including the formation and functions of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), the step-by-step inquiry process, and the potential penalties for non-compliance. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to identify inappropriate behavior, understand their rights and duties, and contribute to a culture of zero tolerance for sexual harassment, ensuring a legally compliant and secure workplace.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Prevention of Wildlife Trade and Trafficking
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of biodiversity and its critical role in sustaining human life and maintaining ecological balance. Participants will explore the threats posed by illegal wildlife trade and trafficking, both globally and in India, and learn how these activities contribute to biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, public health risks, and economic impacts. The course covers commonly trafficked species, their uses in illegal markets, and the biodiversity richness of India, with special emphasis on the North-East region. Learners will also gain insight into key wildlife protection laws, including the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972; Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960; and Customs Act, 1962, along with the roles of enforcement agencies and the institutional framework for combating wildlife crime.
org: Central Academy for State Forest Service (CASFOS) Burnihat (Assam)

title: Preventive Detention under COFEPOSA
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the COFEPOSA Act, 1974, a critical legislative tool for maintaining the economic security of the nation. The content addresses the importance of preventive detention in disrupting organized smuggling and foreign exchange rackets, which often operate beyond the reach of normal punitive laws. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of the powers of Central and State governments to issue detention orders, the strict procedural requirements for their execution, and the common grounds on which such orders are challenged or quashed in courts. The course also thoroughly covers the constitutional rights and safeguards available to a detenu under Articles 21 and 22 of the Indian Constitution, the functions of the Advisory Board in reviewing detention cases, and the provisions for temporary release or revocation of orders. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply the legal provisions of COFEPOSA with precision, ensuring that actions taken are both effective in preventing economic crime and compliant with legal and constitutional standards.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Preventive Vigilance
desc: This course introduces the concept of Preventive Vigilance and its importance in promoting transparency and integrity within organizations. It explains the basics of vigilance, preventive measures, and the recommendations of the Santhanam Committee, while also highlighting vigilance-sensitive areas and preventive checks across key departments such as engineering, traffic, stores, personnel, accounts, RPF, and medical services. The course further examines potential areas of corruption, its causes and ill effects, the role of central anti-corruption agencies, and emphasizes ways to contain corruption through effective vigilance practices and systemic improvements.

title: Preventive Vigilance
desc: This course is designed to equip public servants with the essential knowledge and tools to practice and promote preventive vigilance in their work environment. It delves into the core principles of vigilance, moving beyond a reactive, punitive approach to a proactive strategy that strengthens systems and procedures. The program begins by defining corruption and its impact, introducing the role of the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) and the importance of the Santhanam Committee's recommendations. Participants will learn to identify various vigilance angles, such as misuse of discretionary power, conflicts of interest, and financial irregularities. The course details practical tools for preventive vigilance, including surprise checks, process audits, leveraging technology, and simplifying rules to enhance transparency. Through an analysis of real-world case studies, learners will understand how to apply these concepts to their decision-making processes, ensuring fairness, accountability, and the prudent use of public funds. Ultimately, this course empowers officials to build robust, ethical systems that prevent lapses and uphold the principles of good governance.

title: PREVENTIVE VIGILANCE
desc: In an era where transparency and integrity are paramount in public service, this course provides essential knowledge on preventive vigilance. The program begins by establishing the foundational concepts and historical significance of vigilance, from ancient principles to the establishment of modern bodies like the Central Vigilance Commission. Learners will explore the multifaceted nature of vigilance, including detective, punitive, corrective, preventive, and predictive approaches, to build a holistic understanding.The course details practical methods for identifying indicators of misconduct at both individual and organizational levels, with a special focus on high-risk areas like procurement. A significant portion is dedicated to the process of preparing objective and thorough vigilance investigation reports. Furthermore, it outlines actionable measures for strengthening the preventive vigilance framework within an organization, such as implementing robust internal controls, whistleblower mechanisms, and leveraging technology. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to actively promote ethical conduct and contribute to a zero-tolerance environment for corruption in their workplace.

title: Price Benchmarking and Negotiations in Public Procurement
desc: This course is designed to equip government procurement professionals with the essential skills for effective price benchmarking and negotiation. In the context of public service, ensuring value for money and maintaining fiscal discipline is paramount. This program provides a structured approach to evaluating the fairness and competitiveness of prices by comparing them against market rates, industry standards, and historical data. Key learning areas include various methods for price benchmarking, understanding the principles of negotiation in the public sector, and exploring tactics like the Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement (BATNA). The course also examines the role of the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) in promoting price transparency and efficiency. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to conduct informed negotiations, apply robust benchmarking techniques, and make value-driven procurement decisions that enhance financial accountability and safeguard public resources.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Pricing in the Private and the Public Sector
desc: This course delves into the economic theories and practical applications of pricing in both private and public contexts. It is designed for public officials who need to understand market dynamics, regulate industries, or manage public enterprises. The course begins by establishing the foundational differences between private and public sector objectives, using concepts like consumer surplus and social welfare to evaluate outcomes. Learners will explore how private firms in competitive and monopolistic markets use pricing to their advantage, with a detailed analysis of first, second, and third-degree price discrimination. The focus then shifts to the complexities of public sector pricing. You will learn about the challenges of pricing essential services like water and electricity, the rationale behind government intervention, and strategies such as first-best pricing, second-best pricing, and cross-subsidization. Through practical examples, including railways and utilities, the course illustrates how pricing policies can be designed to balance economic efficiency, financial sustainability, and social equity, equipping you to make more informed policy and regulatory decisions.

title: Primavera Cloud Basics
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to Primavera Cloud, a powerful tool for modern project portfolio management. It is designed for professionals who are new to the platform and aims to build confidence in using its fundamental features. The curriculum addresses the critical need for structured project management by guiding learners through the entire project lifecycle within the application, from initial idea and planning to execution and monitoring. Key learning areas include creating a work breakdown structure, adding and updating activities, managing resources, and performing risk analysis. Participants will learn how to leverage dashboards, charts, and reports to gain insights into project health and performance. By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply these skills to streamline communication, enhance productivity, and effectively contribute to project success within their organizations.

title: Primavera Cloud Schedule Management
desc: Dive deep into the functionalities of Primavera Cloud with this detailed course on advanced schedule management. Designed for project managers, planners, and engineers in the public sector, this program offers a practical guide to navigating complex project environments. You will begin by learning how to initiate and structure a project, including creating a detailed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and defining activities. The course then progresses to the core of scheduling, covering how to establish logical relationships between tasks and apply the Critical Path Method (CPM) to generate a realistic project timeline. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to resource and cost management, where you will learn to create cost-loaded schedules, manage budgets, and track expenditures. You will also gain expertise in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating project risks using Primavera's robust risk analysis tools. Finally, the course covers crucial monitoring and control techniques, such as setting baselines, tracking progress, and using Earned Value Analysis (EVA) to measure performance. Upon completion, you will be proficient in using Primavera Cloud to manage large-scale projects efficiently, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget.

title: Principle of Working and Maintenance of Wheel Slide Protection
desc: The Principle of Working and Maintenance of WSP course explores the principles, components, and control logic of Wheel Slide Protection (WSP) systems, with a focus on their application in LHB coaches. Participants will study key topics such as adhesion dynamics, pneumatic and electronic control mechanisms, fault diagnostics, and maintenance procedures. Through a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical insights, learners will gain a thorough understanding of how WSP enhances braking efficiency and ensures compliance with international standards like UIC 541-05.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IRIMEE)
keywords: Principles of Working and Maintenance of WSP

title: Principles and Governance of Cooperative Institutions
desc: This course introduces the foundational principles that guide the governance, management, and sustainability of cooperative organizations. It brings together two important frameworks: the design principles for governing commons developed by Elinor Ostrom and the cooperative principles articulated by the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA). The course examines how these two frameworks complement each other in practice. Through conceptual discussion and practical examples, the course explores how these principles can be applied in the life cycle of cooperatives - from formation and governance to problem-solving and institutional reform. Overall, the course equips practitioners with a conceptual and practical framework for designing, managing, and strengthening cooperatives as effective institutions for collective action and community development.

title: Principles and Structure and Classification of Government Accounting
desc: This course provides a foundational understanding of government accounting and public financial management in India, with a focus on the principles, structure, and classification of government transactions. It introduces the key principles of government accounting, emphasizing financial accountability, transparency, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. The course explains the structure of Government Accounts and the distinction between Revenue and Capital Expenditure. It also focuses on the practical classification of government expenditure using the List of Object Heads under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 2024. Learners will develop the knowledge and skills required to correctly classify government transactions, interpret relevant financial rules, and support the efficient, transparent, and compliant management of public funds.

title: Principles of Natural Justice (Hindi)
desc: इस पाठ्यक्रम में, शिक्षार्थियों को नैसर्गिक न्याय की अवधारणा और सार्वजनिक प्रशासन में इसकी प्रासंगिकता से परिचित कराया जाएगा। पाठ्यक्रम इन सिद्धांतों के ऐतिहासिक विकास और कानूनी आधार पर प्रकाश डालता है, जो भारत में प्रशासनिक कानून का एक अनिवार्य हिस्सा हैं। आप सीखेंगे कि विभागीय जांच, अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही और अन्य प्रशासनिक निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रियाओं में नैसर्गिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों को कैसे पहचाना और लागू किया जाए। पाठ्यक्रम केस स्टडीज और उदाहरणों के माध्यम से यह बताता है कि इन सिद्धांतों का उल्लंघन कैसे एक प्रशासनिक निर्णय को અमान्य कर सकता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, आप अपने आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन करते समय निष्पक्षता और न्याय के उच्चतम मानकों को बनाए रखने, इस प्रकार सुशासन को बढ़ावा देने और मनमानी कार्रवाइयों के खिलाफ व्यक्तियों के अधिकारों की रक्षा करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Principles of Preparation of Financial Statements
desc: This foundational course provides a comprehensive overview of the essential principles for preparing accurate and reliable financial statements. It is specifically designed for professionals who need to understand the language of finance and accounting within a government context. The curriculum delves into the framework of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), explaining how these standards ensure consistency and comparability in financial reporting. Participants will learn to distinguish between key accounting concepts, underlying assumptions, and established conventions that guide the accounting process. The course will cover the practical application of these principles in the creation of financial statements, highlighting their importance for effective financial analysis, decision-making, and maintaining public accountability. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to interpret and contribute to the financial reporting cycle with confidence.

title: Principles of Stratigraphy
desc: Embark on a journey into Earth's history with this foundational course on the Principles of Stratigraphy, presented by the Geological Survey of India. This course is designed for aspiring geologists and earth science professionals, providing the essential knowledge needed to understand and interpret rock layers. You will begin by learning the core definition and significance of stratigraphy. The course then delves into the fundamental principles that form the bedrock of geological analysis, such as the principles of superposition, uniformitarianism, cross-cutting relationships, and faunal succession. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding the Geological Time Scale, breaking down its major divisions like eons, eras, and periods. Finally, you will learn the critical techniques of stratigraphic correlation, including physical and paleontological methods, which are vital for mapping and interpreting geological history. Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze stratigraphic sequences and understand the relative timing of geological events, a crucial skill for mineral exploration and academic research.

title: Principles of Taxation
desc: Gain a comprehensive introduction to the principles that underpin India's fiscal architecture. This course is essential for public functionaries who require a foundational knowledge of taxation. The curriculum begins by tracing the history of taxation, providing context for the current system's structure. It then delves into the modern principles of an effective tax system, including equity, efficiency, and administrative simplicity, drawing from both classical and contemporary economic thought. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the constitutional provisions that distribute taxation powers between the Union, State, and local governments, clarifying the concepts of fiscal federalism and the Seventh Schedule. Learners will also master the key differences between direct and indirect taxes. The final module equips participants with the skills to interpret fiscal statutes using established legal rules and principles, a crucial competency for anyone involved in revenue administration. Upon completion, you will have a robust understanding of India's tax landscape, ready to apply this knowledge in your official duties.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Principles, structure and Classification of Government Accounting
desc: In the specialized field of public financial management, a robust understanding of government accounting is essential for ensuring good governance. This course is designed to equip public officials with the fundamental knowledge required to navigate India's complex financial landscape. It begins by establishing the core principles that underpin government accounting, emphasizing accountability and compliance with legal frameworks. The curriculum then explores the detailed structure of government accounts, differentiating between revenue and capital expenditure. A significant focus is placed on the practical classification of transactions using the official List of Object Heads from the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules, 2024. Upon completion, learners will be able to correctly interpret and apply these financial rules, ensuring that public funds are managed efficiently, transparently, and in strict accordance with the law, thereby strengthening public trust.

title: PRINTERS TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of printer technology, designed for individuals seeking to gain practical maintenance and repair skills. The program is structured to build knowledge from the ground up, starting with the fundamentals of different printer types like dot matrix, inkjet, thermal, and laser printers. The core of the course delves into the mechanics of LaserJet printers. You will learn about the function of critical components such as the paper pickup roller, fuser assembly, logic card, and solenoid, understanding how they work together to produce a print. The main focus is on practical application, with detailed video demonstrations on how to diagnose and resolve the most common faults. Topics covered include solving paper pickup and jamming issues, fixing continuous paper feeding, troubleshooting error indicators, resolving blank page prints, and addressing one-sided printing problems. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently identify printer components, troubleshoot a wide range of hardware issues, and perform basic component replacements, ensuring efficient printer operation.

title: Privacy and Human Rights in the Digital Age
desc: In the era of digital governance, protecting citizen data is paramount. This course is designed to equip government officials with the essential knowledge and skills to navigate the complex landscape of data privacy and human rights. It provides a detailed examination of privacy's legal and constitutional status in India, with a special focus on the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. Key learning areas include understanding the Act's provisions, classifying different types of data, and implementing privacy-by-design principles in government projects. Participants will learn how to build and maintain trust with citizens by creating transparent and secure digital systems. The course emphasizes that robust data protection is not only a matter of legal compliance but also a cornerstone of national security and effective public service delivery. Upon completion, officials will be prepared to champion privacy-centric governance and ensure their digital initiatives respect and protect citizen rights.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Privacy Information Management System under ISO/IEC 27701:2025
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of ISO/IEC 27701:2025, the stand-alone Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) standard. It explains the evolution from the 2019 extension of ISO/IEC 27001 to the 2025 stand-alone certification model aligned with the Annex SL structure. The course covers Clauses 4 to 10, including context of the organization, leadership, planning, support, operation, performance evaluation, and improvement, with a strong focus on privacy-specific requirements. It also explores Annex A controls for PII Controllers (31 controls) and PII Processors (18 controls), along with informative annexes mapped to ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27018, ISO/IEC 29151, and GDPR principles. Learners will gain insights into embedded privacy principles, Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA)-driven risk management, Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), and the roles and responsibilities of the Data Protection Officer (DPO).
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies and Data Protection Practices
desc: This course explores Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) from the perspective of a Data Protection Officer, with a focus on safeguarding personal data in both static and dynamic environments. It introduces the critical distinction between data at rest and data in motion, along with the corresponding technical and organizational safeguards applicable to each. The course examines advanced cryptographic PETs, including Homomorphic Encryption (Partial, Somewhat, and Fully Homomorphic), Secure Multi-Party Computation using Shamir’s Secret Sharing, and Zero-Knowledge Proofs, highlighting their real-world applications in blockchain, authentication, and voting systems. It also covers Federated Learning for privacy-preserving AI model training across decentralized environments and Differential Privacy for protecting individuals in aggregated datasets.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Private 5G Networks and Spectrum Allocation in India
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the policies, regulatory frameworks, and spectrum allocation mechanisms that enable the deployment of private 5G networks, with a special focus on Captive Non-Public Networks (CNPNs). It introduces the strategic importance of private 5G in the context of Industry 4.0 and explains the key technical, operational, and regulatory aspects that differentiate CNPNs from public networks. Learners will explore global regulatory approaches, licensing models, and frequency bands allocated for private 5G deployments. The course also covers India’s evolving policy landscape, including the recommendations of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) and guidelines issued by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT). Through real-world examples, learners will understand how effective policy and spectrum frameworks can drive enterprise transformation, innovation, digitalisation, and sector-specific modernisation.

title: Proactive Disclosure and Compliance Under the RTI Act 2025
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of proactive disclosure obligations as mandated by Section 4 of the Right to Information (RTI) Act. In the context of modern governance, transparency is paramount, and this course addresses why proactive information sharing is critical for public authorities. Learners will delve into the key provisions of Section 4, understanding the principles behind Suo Moto disclosure and its impact on citizen empowerment and reducing the burden of individual RTI requests. The curriculum covers the essential processes, guidelines, and best practices for establishing and maintaining an effective proactive disclosure system. It also examines the legal implications, potential penalties, and consequences of non-compliance. Upon completion, participants will be capable of driving a culture of openness within their organizations, ensuring adherence to RTI obligations, and ultimately reinforcing good governance and public confidence in government institutions.
org: Mahatma Gandhi State Institute of Public Administration Punjab

title: PROACTIVE DISCLOSURES UNDER RTI ACT 2005
desc: This course on 'Proactive Disclosures under the RTI Act, 2005' is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively implement the suo motu disclosure requirements. The curriculum is built around the official guidelines and office memorandums, detailing what information must be made public, including details on procurement, public-private partnerships, transfer policies, budgets, and citizen charters. Participants will learn about the standards for digital publication of information on government websites to ensure it is accessible and user-friendly. The course also covers the critical compliance mechanisms, such as the role of Nodal Officers, procedures for third-party audits, and the importance of integrating transparency into the decision-making processes of a public authority. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently manage and oversee the proactive disclosure of information, strengthening democratic processes and improving the interface between the government and its citizens.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Problem Solving
desc: Effective problem-solving is a cornerstone of success in any professional role, particularly within the public sector where challenges are often complex and multi-faceted. This course is designed to equip learners with a structured and logical framework for tackling problems systematically. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of what constitutes a problem and the mindset required to view them as opportunities. The curriculum delves into key techniques for analysis and resolution. You will learn to apply Robert Harris's 'Stop-it' and 'Mop-it' approaches, conduct a thorough SWOT analysis to assess internal and external factors, and use methods like the 'Five Whys' for root cause analysis and Pareto charts for prioritization. Furthermore, the course outlines a clear, multi-stage decision-making process, from generating and evaluating alternatives to implementing and monitoring solutions. By completing this course, you will be empowered to approach challenges with confidence, using proven methods to arrive at effective, well-reasoned solutions and drive continuous improvement in your work.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Problem Solving
desc: In the dynamic environment of public administration, the ability to effectively solve problems is paramount. This course offers a comprehensive guide to mastering this essential skill. It begins by establishing the context for problem-solving within governance, emphasizing the need for clarity and precision in defining challenges. Learners will explore key analytical techniques, such as root cause analysis and systems thinking, to dissect complex issues and understand their underlying drivers. The curriculum then transitions to solution generation, introducing brainstorming and lateral thinking methods to foster innovation. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the decision-making process, where participants will learn to evaluate potential solutions against objective criteria, assess risks, and select the most viable option. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with a practical toolkit to approach challenges systematically, leading to more robust and sustainable outcomes in their professional roles.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Problem Solving and Decision Making
desc: In the dynamic environment of public service, the ability to effectively solve problems and make sound decisions is paramount. This course is designed to equip government officials with a structured and reliable methodology for navigating workplace challenges. It begins by establishing a clear definition of a problem and the importance of a multi-faceted perspective. You will learn practical techniques to deconstruct complex issues, including the 'what, where, when, who' framework for problem definition and the 'why-why' analysis for root cause identification. The curriculum also delves into the power of divergent thinking to foster creativity and generate a wide range of potential solutions. By mastering the structured problem-solving cycle—from defining the issue and identifying causes to creating, evaluating, and implementing the best solution—you will enhance your analytical capabilities.

title: Problem Solving using Design Thinking in the Government Sector
desc: In an era of increasing complexity, government officials require innovative and structured approaches to address pressing societal issues. This course, 'Problem Solving with Design Thinking for Government Officials,' provides a comprehensive framework for transforming public service delivery. It establishes the context for why a human-centric approach is critical for achieving goals like 'Viksit Bharat' by focusing on grassroots problems. The curriculum is built around the five core phases of Design Thinking: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. Learners will explore practical tools and techniques for each phase, such as empathy mapping, stakeholder analysis, and customer journey mapping, to accurately identify and define challenges. The course details a systematic 10-step process for moving from problem discovery to implementing viable solutions. By the end of this program, participants will be equipped to apply these creative problem-solving skills to their work, leading to the development of more innovative policies, improved citizen engagement, and more efficient government processes.
org: Office of Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM)

title: Procedural Laws (Criminal)
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the procedural laws that form the backbone of the Indian criminal justice system. It is designed to provide learners with a clear and structured understanding of the legal processes involved in criminal cases. The curriculum delves into the importance of procedural law in upholding constitutional principles of justice, fairness, and liberty. Key learning areas include the stages of a criminal case, such as investigation, arrest, bail, the filing of charges, trial proceedings, and the appeals process. Participants will learn about the roles and responsibilities of various actors within the system, including the police, prosecutors, and the judiciary. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply their knowledge to navigate the complexities of criminal procedures, ensuring compliance and contributing to the efficient and equitable administration of justice.

title: Procedure for Conducting the California Bearing Ratio Test
desc: This course provides a detailed understanding of the California Bearing Ratio (CBR) test and its application in pavement design and geotechnical engineering. It explains the principles of penetration testing at 2.5 mm and 5.0 mm and their role in determining soil strength and subgrade support capacity. The course covers the identification and function of key CBR testing equipment, including moulds, spacer discs, surcharge weights, proving rings, dial gauges, plungers, and loading systems. It also guides learners through specimen preparation, compaction, moisture conditioning, soaking, and swelling procedures required for accurate testing. Emphasis is placed on conducting penetration tests, recording load–penetration data, plotting curves, calculating CBR values, and interpreting results for engineering applications. Participants will also learn to prepare complete and standardized CBR test reports.
org: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

title: Procedure for Issuing Detention Orders Against Drug Peddlers
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the PIT NDPS Act, 1988, a crucial legislative instrument for preventing illicit drug trafficking. The content is designed for law enforcement and legal professionals who need to understand the nuances of preventive detention. The course begins by establishing the context, differentiating the preventive nature of the PIT NDPS Act from the punitive measures of the NDPS Act, 1985. Key learning areas include the specific legal grounds for detention, the step-by-step procedure for issuing and executing detention orders, and the constitutional safeguards in place. It further details the composition and authority of the Advisory Board responsible for reviewing detention cases, ensuring that the process adheres to legal standards. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to correctly apply the provisions of the Act, contribute to disrupting organized drug syndicates, and uphold national security while respecting legal due process.

title: Procedure of Asset Master Creation
desc: This comprehensive training module offers an in-depth walkthrough of the asset master creation process in SAP, a critical function for effective asset lifecycle management. The course begins by introducing the standard transaction code, AS01, used to initiate the creation of a new asset. Learners will be guided through selecting the correct asset class and company code, which are fundamental for proper classification and accounting. The curriculum then delves into the specific data required across various tabs, including the 'General' tab for asset description and quantity, the 'Time-Dependent' tab for assigning business area and cost center, and the 'Allocation' tab for service and sub-class details. The course also covers organization-specific fields, such as the 'BSNL' tab for location information, and concludes with the crucial step of setting up depreciation areas and keys. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently and accurately create asset master records, ensuring data integrity and supporting financial transparency and asset accountability within the organization.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Procedures and Legal Safeguards In Criminal Law for Common Citizens
desc: This course provides a practical understanding of essential criminal law concepts that impact everyday life, including motor vehicle offences, post-mortem procedures, evidence, burden of proof, trespass, appeals, and criminal procedure. The course explains how criminal law interacts with civil remedies, citizen rights, and legal safeguards through real-life examples and landmark Indian case references. Learners will explore key legal processes such as FIR registration, investigation, bail, compensation claims, admissibility of evidence, appellate remedies, and protection against false or malicious litigation. It also emphasizes the principles of fairness, accountability, rule of law, and access to justice, enabling learners to better understand their legal rights and responsibilities in daily life.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Process of clearance of Rolling stock on Railway bridges
desc: This comprehensive technical course details the procedures for the clearance of rolling stock on Indian Railway bridges. It addresses the critical need to verify infrastructure suitability when introducing new locomotives and wagons or revising the operational parameters of existing ones. The course begins by outlining the data collection process and the key aspects to study, including speed potential, vertical loads, and longitudinal forces, with reference to RDSO guidelines and the Indian Railway Bridge Rules.Participants will delve into the specific calculations and considerations involved, such as Equivalent Uniformly Distributed Load (EUDL), Coefficient of Dynamic Augment (CDA), and the impact of different loading standards from BGML 1926 to the current 25-ton axle load. The content explains how to analyze these forces for bending moment and shear force, and how to determine the maximum permissible speed for safe operation. It also covers special conditions, such as the dispersion of longitudinal forces and adjustments for the center of gravity. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these engineering principles to ensure that railway bridges can safely support new and upgraded rolling stock, contributing to the modernization and efficiency of the rail network.

title: Process of Recoupment in Indian Railways
desc: In the vast operational landscape of Indian Railways, efficient inventory management is critical for seamless functioning. This course delves into the core principles and processes of recoupment, the system for replenishing stocks to ensure materials are available when needed. It is designed to provide a detailed understanding of the strategic balance between maintaining adequate stock levels and minimizing associated costs. Learners will explore three fundamental recoupment methods: the Maximum-Minimum system, which uses the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) model to find the lowest total cost; the Annual Estimate system for planned yearly procurement based on demand forecasts; and the Fixed Level system for emergency items with irregular demand. The course also differentiates between processes for purchased stores from external suppliers and manufactured stores from railway workshops. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply these inventory management techniques to optimize procurement, control costs, and maintain operational readiness across various railway departments.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Processing Medical Reimbursement Claims for Central Govt Employees
desc: This e-learning course on Processing Medical Reimbursement Claims for Central Government Employees is designed to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of the procedures, guidelines, and compliance requirements involved in processing medical reimbursement claims under the Central Government framework. The course covers the complete workflow of claim processing, including eligibility conditions, documentation requirements, verification procedures, scrutiny, approval mechanisms, and settlement processes. Learners will also gain familiarity with the relevant rules, administrative provisions, and best practices that support accurate, transparent, and timely claim disposal. Through structured modules and practical insights, the course aims to strengthen participants’ ability to process reimbursement claims efficiently while ensuring adherence to applicable government norms and procedures.

title: Processing of Deceased Claim Cases with Nomination
desc: This program is designed to equip personnel of the Department of Posts with the specialized knowledge required for handling deceased claim cases with nomination for National (Small) Savings Schemes. The course addresses the critical need for efficiency and empathy in claim settlements, providing staff with a robust understanding of the procedural and regulatory framework. Key learning areas include the definition of a deceased claim, categorization of cases, the chronology of relevant SB Orders, and the specific documents required, such as Form-11 and KYC proofs. The training details the process of verifying and updating records in Finacle using the CMRC menu, and clarifies the financial powers of different sanctioning authorities. Participants will also learn to navigate complex scenarios, such as determining the priority between a nominee and a legal heir. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in executing the end-to-end claim settlement process, upholding the department's commitment to exceptional and compassionate customer service during a challenging time for claimants.

title: Proclamation and Attachment under New Criminal Laws: Procedural Rules
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of Chapter VI of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, focusing on the processes to compel appearance.
