It meticulously breaks down the provisions related to Proclamation and Attachment (Sections 84–89) and other critical rules regarding judicial processes (Sections 90–93). The curriculum is designed to equip learners with a detailed understanding of how the criminal justice system ensures the presence of accused individuals. Key learning areas include the step-by-step procedure for issuing a proclamation, the legal framework for attaching property of absconding persons, and the rights of individuals to file claims or objections. Furthermore, the course clarifies the appellate procedures against orders rejecting property restoration and the court's discretionary powers to issue warrants. By completing this course, legal and law enforcement professionals will be better prepared to apply these new criminal laws correctly, ensuring that enforcement actions are both lawful and just.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Procurement in GeM
desc: Dive into the mechanics of modern public procurement with this detailed course on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). The curriculum begins by establishing the fundamental purpose and scope of public procurement within the governmental framework. You will explore the operational structure of the GeM portal, gaining clarity on the distinct roles, responsibilities, and obligations for both buyers and sellers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical application of the General Financial Rules (GFR) and navigating various procurement methods available on GeM, including direct purchase, e-Bidding, and Reverse Auctions (RA). The course also covers critical procedural aspects such as bid security, performance security, liquidated damages, and the extension of delivery periods. By completing this course, you will be proficient in using the GeM platform for transparent and efficient procurement, from understanding enabling provisions to executing transactions like Push Button Procurement. This knowledge is essential for ensuring financial propriety and operational excellence in public sector purchasing.

title: Procurement in Indian R and D Organisations
desc: This module is specifically designed to equip officials and scientists within India's R&D sector with the essential knowledge for compliant and efficient public procurement. In a research-intensive environment, acquiring goods and services in a timely and transparent manner is critical. This course provides the foundational understanding to navigate this process effectively. Learners will delve into the fundamental principles of public procurement as mandated by the General Financial Rules (GFRs), exploring each phase of the procurement cycle from planning to contract management. A key focus is placed on the unique aspects of scientific procurement, contrasting it with general procurement to ensure procedural accuracy. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently manage procurement tasks, understand the responsibilities of all stakeholders, and ensure financial propriety in their organizations.

title: Procurement of Goods and Services
desc: In the context of public administration, efficient and transparent procurement is a cornerstone of good governance. This course, 'Procurement of Goods and Services through Government e-Marketplace (GeM)', is designed to provide a thorough understanding of modern public procurement practices. It addresses the critical need for officials to master the GeM platform, a key initiative for transforming government purchasing. The curriculum delves into the intricacies of the GeM portal, covering everything from registration and vendor selection to placing orders and managing contracts. Key learning areas include understanding different procurement methods for goods and services, adhering to General Financial Rules (GFR), ensuring compliance with public procurement policies, and utilizing GeM's tools for competitive bidding and direct purchasing. Participants will learn how to navigate the platform to streamline procurement workflows, reduce timelines, and enhance transparency. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently manage the end-to-end procurement lifecycle on GeM. They will be equipped to make informed purchasing decisions, ensure financial propriety, and contribute to a more agile and accountable procurement ecosystem within their organizations. This course empowers officials to leverage technology for efficient public spending and improved service delivery.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Procurement Process for Products on GeM
desc: This course provides a practical understanding of product procurement through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal, with a focus on efficient, transparent, and compliant government purchasing. It is designed to equip government officials with the knowledge and skills required to navigate the product procurement lifecycle on GeM and make informed purchasing decisions while ensuring value for money. The course covers key procurement methods, including Direct Purchase and L1-based procurement, along with the complete process of creating and managing bids on the GeM portal. Learners will also gain an understanding of Reverse Auctions (RA), including the process of converting a bid into an RA and the role of competitive bidding in achieving better price discovery.

title: Procurement Process on GeM For Products
desc: In an era of digital transformation in governance, efficient and transparent procurement is paramount. This course is designed to equip government officials with the practical knowledge required to navigate the product procurement lifecycle on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal. It addresses the critical need for public buyers to master GeM's functionalities to ensure compliance, efficiency, and value for money in their purchasing activities. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of direct purchasing, the strategic use of L1 bidding, and the complete process of bid creation from start to finish. Participants will also gain a comprehensive understanding of Reverse Auctions (RA), learning when and how to convert a bid into an RA to drive competitive pricing. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently execute various product procurement tasks on GeM, apply different purchasing methods based on specific needs, and contribute to a more transparent and streamlined public procurement ecosystem within their departments.

title: Procurement Process on GeM for Services
desc: This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the service procurement lifecycle on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). It addresses the critical need for government departments to procure services in a transparent, efficient, and standardized manner. The curriculum is structured to build practical skills, starting with an overview of the GeM portal's features for service procurement. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process for executing direct purchases for low-value services and understanding the criteria for L1 (lowest price) based procurement. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the bid creation process. Learners will be guided through identifying service requirements, drafting clear bid specifications, setting estimated values, and attaching necessary documentation and terms and conditions. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to confidently and effectively use GeM for all their service procurement needs, contributing to better public financial management.

title: Procurement Services (Consultancy / Non-Consultancy)
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively manage the procurement of consultancy and non-consultancy services. The curriculum provides a structured walkthrough of the entire procurement lifecycle, emphasizing compliance with established financial rules and guidelines. The course begins by explaining the context and importance of transparent procurement for ensuring value for money in public projects. Key learning areas include the detailed process of shortlisting consultants, the methodologies for evaluating technical and financial proposals, and a comparison of different procurement methods to aid in selecting the most appropriate approach. Furthermore, it covers the critical aspects of contract management and monitoring to ensure that service delivery aligns with the agreed-upon terms and objectives. Upon completion, learners will be able to navigate the complexities of service procurement, mitigate risks, and uphold the principles of fairness and accountability in their official duties.

title: Product Innovation
desc: This course offers a thorough exploration of product innovation, designed to equip learners with the principles and practices needed to drive growth in today's dynamic markets. It delves into the context of why innovation is critical, examining the socio-economic factors and systemic interventions that shape India's innovation landscape. Key learning areas include understanding the full innovation lifecycle, from ideation to execution, and the application of practical tools like user feedback loops and agile methodologies. Learners will analyze the differences between incremental and disruptive innovation and learn to identify opportunities in both technical and non-technical sectors. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply strategic frameworks to foster a culture of creativity, manage innovation projects effectively, and develop sustainable solutions that address both market demands and societal needs, ultimately turning innovative concepts into tangible value.

title: Professional Etiquette and Workplace Excellence in India Post
desc: Professional Etiquette and Workplace Excellence in India Post is designed to develop officers and employees into confident, professional, and citizen-centric leaders. The course strengthens workplace behaviour, communication, grooming, meeting etiquette, dining etiquette, telephone etiquette, email etiquette, and public speaking skills. It also introduces emotional intelligence, creative thinking, problem mapping, role reversal, and the STEAPLE method for practical decision-making. Through interactive learning and real workplace scenarios, participants will enhance their professionalism, service orientation, leadership readiness, and interpersonal effectiveness. The programme enables employees to represent the Department of Posts with confidence, integrity, dignity, and excellence in every professional interaction.
keywords: Workplace Excellence for India Post Officers

title: Professional Social Media Practices for Public Officials
desc: Effective social media management is essential in today’s digital world, particularly for organizations and government institutions. It involves creating, sharing, and managing content in a responsible, professional, and strategic manner. Proper management ensures that information is accurate, relevant, and aligned with organizational goals. Social media handlers must maintain a clear distinction between official and personal accounts, follow ethical guidelines, and safeguard sensitive information. They should engage with the public respectfully by responding to queries, feedback, and criticism in a calm and factual manner. Timely communication and transparency help build trust and credibility among users. Additionally, risks such as misinformation, negative comments, and data privacy concerns must be carefully managed. Effective social media use also includes planning content, selecting the right platforms, and analyzing engagement to improve outreach and communication.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Proficiency in technical and scientific writing
desc: This course is designed to equip academic and professional individuals with the essential skills for effective technical and scientific communication. It addresses the critical need for clarity, precision, and structure when presenting research findings. The curriculum delves into the core components of a well-written research document, starting with the front matter, including crafting an impactful title and abstract. A significant focus is placed on the IMRAD (Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion) structure, providing a systematic framework for organizing the main body of your work. Learners will also understand the importance of the back matter, such as proper referencing and appendices. Throughout the course, you will learn to analyze information sources, synthesize literature, and present your original contributions logically. By mastering these principles, you will be prepared to produce high-quality theses, research reports, and papers that meet the rigorous standards of the scientific community and create a lasting impact.

title: Profit Centricity in Postal Services
desc: For over 169 years, India Post has been a cornerstone of the nation's communication and socio-economic fabric. However, to thrive in the modern era, a strategic shift towards profitability is essential. This course provides a detailed roadmap for this transformation. It begins by establishing the context, outlining the financial challenges and the strategic imperative for a profit-centric model. You will delve into the intricacies of cost management, exploring methods from traditional absorption costing to more precise techniques like Activity-Based Costing (ABC) and Time-Driven ABC (TDABC). The curriculum also covers actionable strategies for revenue generation, such as identifying business synergies, diversifying services, and leveraging technology. Furthermore, the course introduces powerful methodologies for achieving operational excellence, including Value Chain Analysis, Lean Systems, and Six Sigma. By the end, you will be equipped with the knowledge and perspectives needed to drive a culture of profitability, efficiency, and customer satisfaction within the Department of Posts, ensuring its legacy continues for generations to come.

title: Profit or Loss Pre and Post Incorporation
desc: This course delves into the essential financial concepts surrounding company incorporation. It addresses the critical question of how to treat profits earned or losses incurred by a business before it is formally registered as a company. Participants will learn why this distinction is crucial for both accounting accuracy and tax compliance under the Income Tax Act. The course will cover the methodologies for segregating the pre-incorporation and post-incorporation periods and the logical bases for apportioning income and expenses, such as time or turnover ratios. Key learning areas include classifying pre-incorporation profits as non-taxable capital reserves and understanding the revenue nature of post-incorporation profits. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to prepare accurate financial statements and ensure correct tax treatment for newly formed corporate entities, a vital skill for finance and accounts professionals in the public sector.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Programming for Numerical Control Turning Operations
desc: In the field of modern manufacturing, Computer Numerical Control (CNC) turning is a critical process for creating precise cylindrical parts. This course offers a detailed exploration of the programming and operational workflow required for CNC turning using integrated CAD/CAM software like Autodesk Fusion 360. It is designed for individuals seeking to build foundational skills in digital manufacturing, bridging the gap between design and physical production. Learners will delve into the complete process, starting with understanding the turning workspace, setting up stock material, and defining machine configurations. The curriculum covers essential machining techniques, including executing both roughing and finishing operations to achieve accurate component dimensions. Participants will also learn to create and manage a turning tool library, a vital skill for efficient workshop practice. Furthermore, the course addresses advanced operations such as programming grooves, threads, and part cut-offs. A key outcome is the ability to generate, simulate, and validate NC programs (G-code) before sending them to a physical CNC machine. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the practical knowledge to confidently program and execute CNC turning projects, a valuable capability in the manufacturing and engineering sectors.

title: Project Appraisal and Financial Evaluation Techniques
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials and project managers with the critical skills for effective project appraisal and financial evaluation. It addresses the necessity of thorough analysis before committing to significant investments, highlighting how robust evaluation can prevent cost overruns and align projects with strategic goals. The curriculum delves into the multiple facets of feasibility analysis, providing a holistic view of project assessment. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of capital budgeting methods, distinguishing between non-discounting techniques like the Payback Period and discounting techniques such as Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and Modified Internal Rate of Return (MIRR). Through practical examples and case studies, learners will understand how to calculate and interpret these financial metrics. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently assess the financial viability of projects, make data-driven investment decisions, and contribute to the successful execution of public and private sector initiatives.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Project Feasibility and Bankability
desc: In an era of rapid infrastructure and energy development, the ability to accurately assess project viability is a critical skill for public sector officials. This course on Project Feasibility and Bankability offers a comprehensive guide to evaluating large-scale projects, particularly within the dynamic renewable energy sector. It is designed for professionals involved in finance, investment, and project management who need to make informed decisions that ensure economic sustainability and attract funding. Participants will delve into the core components of a successful project evaluation. The curriculum covers essential financial modeling techniques, including the calculation and interpretation of Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and Return on Investment (ROI). Beyond financials, the course emphasizes the importance of a holistic assessment, covering technical specifications, operational risks, market dynamics, and regulatory compliance. Through real-world case studies and strategic frameworks, learners will understand how to structure a project to meet the stringent requirements of banks and investors. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in creating detailed feasibility reports and robust financial models. This will empower them to confidently justify project proposals and secure the necessary financing to drive impactful public and private sector initiatives forward.

title: Project Finance
desc: In an era of ambitious national development, the effective management of project finance is paramount for the success of mega infrastructure projects. This course is meticulously designed to equip public sector professionals with the essential knowledge and skills to navigate the complex financial landscape of such ventures. You will delve into the core principles of project finance, from its initial stages and structuring to the various financing models employed in government initiatives. The curriculum emphasizes practical application, covering how to perform detailed feasibility and viability analyses to ensure a project's long-term success and sustainability. Furthermore, the course will clarify the roles and responsibilities of all stakeholders by examining key project documents. By the end of this program, you will be able to develop and implement robust strategies for project planning, execution, and risk management, empowering you to contribute to the timely and on-budget completion of critical national projects.

title: Project Management
desc: In today's complex environment, effective project management is crucial for successful outcomes. This course offers a detailed exploration of the principles and practices required to manage projects efficiently. It begins with foundational concepts, defining a project's characteristics, stages, and stakeholders, and introduces essential risk analysis techniques. The curriculum then delves into advanced analytical tools, including decision trees and utility analysis, to navigate uncertainty and make informed choices. Participants will learn to master scheduling and sequencing through network diagrams like Gantt charts, PERT, and the Critical Path Method (CPM), enabling them to create robust project timelines. The final modules focus on project control, covering cost management, time-cost trade-offs through crashing, resource leveling, and allocation. By the end of this course, learners will be proficient in applying a structured approach to manage project constraints such as time, cost, and quality, ensuring successful project delivery and stakeholder satisfaction.

title: Project Management
desc: This course offers a foundational understanding of project management within the specific context of e-governance. It is designed for government professionals seeking to build capabilities in overseeing digital projects and transformation initiatives. The curriculum systematically covers the core knowledge areas of project management, including integration, scope, time, cost, quality, human resources, communications, risk, and procurement management. Participants will learn to apply best practices and standard techniques to navigate the unique challenges of public sector projects. By the end of this course, learners will be better prepared to contribute to the successful planning and execution of e-governance projects, ultimately enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of government operations and citizen service delivery.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Project Management
desc: This foundational course on Project Management is designed to equip government officials with the essential skills to navigate the complexities of public sector projects. In today's governance landscape, the ability to deliver projects efficiently is critical for effective public service delivery. This program provides a structured approach to managing projects from conception to completion. Key learning areas include project planning, defining scope, creating a work breakdown structure, resource allocation, and risk management. Participants will learn how to develop realistic timelines, manage budgets, and use monitoring tools to track progress against key milestones. The course emphasizes practical application, enabling learners to apply these principles to real-world scenarios, such as implementing new schemes, managing infrastructure development, or driving digital transformation initiatives. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to lead and contribute to projects with greater confidence and competence.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Project Management
desc: This course on Project Management offers a comprehensive introduction to managing government schemes and interventions effectively. It begins by establishing the context of project management within public service, focusing on creating social value and achieving policy objectives. You will learn the five critical phases of the project lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, and completion. The curriculum delves into managing the six major constraints of any project: quality, time, cost, scope, benefits, and risks, providing a balanced framework for successful implementation. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to equipping learners with powerful analytical techniques for evidence-based decision-making. You will explore how to calculate Return on Investment (ROI) to assess financial viability, use Social Return on Investment (SROI) to measure social impact, and apply Randomized Controlled Trials (RCT) to evaluate the effectiveness of interventions. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to handle projects more strategically, make data-informed decisions, and improve the implementation and outcomes of public sector initiatives.

title: Project Management
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of project management, a critical discipline for ensuring the successful delivery of government initiatives and public sector undertakings. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of projects by understanding their fundamental characteristics, life cycle phases, and performance metrics. The curriculum delves into the crucial process of project formulation, including opportunity studies, techno-economic feasibility analysis, and the creation of a Detailed Project Report (DPR). Learners will be introduced to powerful financial analysis tools like Net Present Value (NPV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR) to assess project viability. Furthermore, the course provides hands-on knowledge of network analysis techniques such as PERT and CPM, enabling participants to effectively schedule, monitor, and control project activities, manage resources, and make informed decisions to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.

title: Project Management and Governance for Public Infrastructure
desc: This course examines the principles, frameworks, leadership capabilities and governance mechanisms required to successfully conceive, plan, execute and deliver major public infrastructure projects. The course positions projects as critical engines of national development and focuses on improving project outcomes beyond the traditional measures of time, cost and technical specifications. Participants will explore the complete project life cycle—from concept and development through execution and close-out—while applying key areas such as scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, procurement, communication and stakeholder management. The course also emphasizes project governance as a framework of rules, responsibilities, policies and decision-making processes that enables projects to be managed efficiently, effectively and with accountability.

title: Project Management with Microsoft Project
desc: In today's results-oriented public sector, the ability to manage projects effectively is a critical skill. This course offers a practical, hands-on guide to using Microsoft Project, a leading software for project scheduling and management. The program begins with the fundamentals, teaching you how to set up a project file, establish a project calendar, and input tasks. You will then learn to structure your project logically by creating summary tasks, setting milestones for key deliverables, and defining dependencies between tasks to create a realistic timeline. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to resource management, where you will learn to assign personnel and materials to tasks and resolve common issues like resource overallocation. Finally, the course covers the crucial aspects of monitoring and reporting. You will learn how to save a project baseline to track deviations, update progress with actual data, and generate insightful reports and visualizations, such as burndown charts and Gantt charts, to communicate your project's status to stakeholders. This course will enable you to get up to speed with Microsoft Project quickly and apply it to your current and future projects.

title: Propulsion System of Metro Trains
desc: Gain an in-depth technical knowledge of the propulsion systems that power modern metro rail networks. This course is designed for engineering and technical professionals seeking to understand the intricate workings of a metro train's traction system. The curriculum begins by establishing the necessity of a sophisticated propulsion system for providing both tractive effort for acceleration and electrical braking for deceleration. You will explore the complete system architecture, from the high-voltage interface to the on-board control systems. The course details the function of critical components, including the Converter/Inverter (C/I) unit, traction motors, master controller, and PWM generator, with a focus on IGBT technology. Participants will learn about the Variable Voltage Variable Frequency (VVVF) control method and how Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) signals are used to manage torque demand. By understanding these mechanisms, learners will be able to appreciate how uniform tractive effort is achieved across all motor cars and how regenerative braking contributes to the system's overall energy efficiency.

title: Prosecution in Customs
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to provide departmental officials with a thorough understanding of the legal and procedural aspects of prosecution under the Customs Act. In the context of safeguarding national economic interests and preventing smuggling, the ability to correctly initiate and manage prosecution is a critical function for customs officers. The course delves into the specific statutory provisions that empower and guide prosecution, ensuring all actions are legally sound. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the procedures for launching prosecution, from gathering evidence to filing a formal complaint in court. Learners will also study the concept of compounding of offences, which provides a mechanism for settling certain cases without a full trial, and analyze various guidelines issued by the board. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the complexities of customs law, make informed decisions regarding prosecution, and ensure procedural compliance in all legal matters, thereby strengthening the enforcement capabilities of the department.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Prosecution under the Customs Act 1962
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal and procedural framework governing prosecution under the Customs Act, 1962. It covers the statutory provisions relating to prosecution, the procedures for initiating prosecution, and the roles and responsibilities of Customs officers in developing and managing prosecution cases. The course covers the process from investigation and evidence collection to the preparation and filing of complaints before the court. It also introduces the concept of compounding of offences, including the applicable provisions and guidelines, as an alternative to prosecution in eligible cases. Learners will develop the knowledge and skills required to identify offences warranting prosecution, follow prescribed procedures, prepare the necessary documentation, and ensure compliance with the relevant legal provisions and Board guidelines.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Protection of Track at Work Site
desc: Ensuring the safety of train operations and personnel during track maintenance is a critical responsibility for railway staff. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the mandatory protection arrangements for engineering works on active railway lines. It provides an in-depth understanding of the Indian Railways Permanent Way Manual (IRPWM-2020) and relevant CE Circulars, which govern all worksite safety protocols. Key learning areas include the classification of works into routine, short-duration, and long-duration categories, and the specific protection methods required for each. Participants will learn the procedures for setting up safety zones on both single and double line sections, including the precise placement of engineering indicators, flags, and detonators at prescribed distances. The course also details the protocols for imposing and removing speed restrictions, handling stop-dead and non-stop restrictions, and coordinating with train operations. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to implement compliant and effective track protection measures, minimizing risks and ensuring the smooth, safe passage of trains through work zones.
keywords: Protection of Track at Work Site

title: Protocol Guidelines for Visits of Foreign Dignitaries
desc: In the realm of international relations, the precise execution of protocol is paramount to conveying respect and strengthening diplomatic ties. This course, 'Protocol Guidelines for Visits of Foreign Dignitaries,' offers a detailed exploration of the official procedures essential for hosting high-level foreign visitors. It addresses the critical importance of protocol in the context of India's foreign policy and its global standing. Key learning areas include differentiating between various types of visits (state, official, working) and understanding the unique requirements associated with dignitaries مثل as heads of state, ministers, and ambassadors. Participants will learn to manage all facets of a visit, from ceremonial welcomes to logistical arrangements and security coordination. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these protocols confidently, ensuring that every official visit is smooth, respectful, and successful, ultimately upholding the nation's image on the world stage.

title: Protocols and Procedures for Dealing with Elected Representatives
desc: This course provides an overview of the protocols, standards of conduct, and official procedures governing interactions between government officials and elected representatives. It covers the expected standards of courtesy and professionalism, procedures relating to official correspondence and the sharing of information, and protocols for public functions and official engagements. The course also highlights the responsibilities of government officials in ensuring responsiveness, transparency, and compliance with established rules and procedures, while fostering constructive and professional working relationships with Members of Parliament and Members of State Legislatures.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Provisions of TCS and TDS in GST
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the legal and procedural aspects of Tax Collected at Source (TCS) and Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) within India's GST framework. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with the knowledge to ensure full compliance with sections 51 and 52 of the CGST Act, 2017. Participants will learn to identify which entities are liable for collection and deduction, understand the specific rates and thresholds, and master the calculation of TCS/TDS on the net value of taxable supplies. The course covers the complete compliance lifecycle, including the process of depositing the collected/deducted tax with the government, filing the mandatory GSTR-7 (for TDS) and GSTR-8 (for TCS) returns, and issuing the necessary certificates. Furthermore, it explains how suppliers can claim the credit of these taxes in their electronic cash ledger and details the penal consequences for non-compliance. This knowledge is crucial for finance and accounts professionals in government and for suppliers engaging with e-commerce platforms.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Provisions Relating to Bail and Bond
desc: This course explains bail in bailable and non-bailable offences and the concept of anticipatory bail. It covers the distinction between bail and anticipatory bail, provisions under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, relevant sections, conditions for grant or refusal of bail, and the powers and discretion of Courts.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: PSTN Overview and Architecture - Part I A
desc: This introductory course delves into the architecture and evolution of the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN), which formed the backbone of global voice communications for over a century. The program is designed for professionals who need to understand the fundamental principles of traditional telephony to better grasp the transition to modern, packet-switched networks. Key learning areas include a detailed discussion on the invention and evolution of the telephone, the definition and function of core PSTN elements like switches and circuits, and the progression from manual exchanges to electromechanical and electronic switching systems. Learners will also gain specific knowledge on the operational mechanics of Strowger and crossbar exchanges. Upon completion, participants will have a clear understanding of the historical and technical foundations of public telephone networks, enabling them to appreciate the complexities and innovations of today's telecommunication landscape.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: PSTN Overview and Architecture - Part I B
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the historical development of telecommunication switching systems, a critical component of public infrastructure. It begins by establishing the context of early telephony, explaining the operational principles of manual exchanges and their inherent limitations, which spurred the need for automation. The curriculum then delves into the pivotal innovations that defined the era of electromechanical switching. Learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of the Strowger (Step-by-Step) switch, the first successful automatic exchange, and the subsequent development of the more efficient crossbar switching system. The course also touches upon the advent of electronic switching with Stored Program Control (SPC), setting the stage for modern digital networks. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the evolutionary path of telephone exchanges and explain the fundamental working principles of key historical switching technologies, providing a solid foundation for roles in telecom network management, maintenance, and engineering.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: PSTN Overview and Architecture- Part II
desc: This advanced course, 'PSTN Overview and Architecture - Part II,' is designed for professionals seeking a deep technical understanding of traditional telecommunications infrastructure. In an era of digital transformation, comprehending the foundational principles of the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) remains crucial for network engineers, planners, and policymakers involved in migrating to next-generation systems. The course systematically breaks down the PSTN ecosystem. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of the access network, which connects subscribers to the local exchange, and the trunk network, which provides interconnection between central offices. Learners will gain insights into the five-class hierarchical architecture that governs call routing, from Class 5 (End Office) to Class 1 (Regional Center). The course also classifies and explains the functions of local, toll (TAX), and tandem exchanges. By exploring the underlying transmission systems like optical fibre, coaxial cables, and microwave links, participants will be able to appreciate the complexity and scale of legacy voice networks. Upon completion, learners will have a robust framework for analyzing PSTN operations and its architectural evolution.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Public - Private Partnership
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs). It is designed for public officials seeking to understand this increasingly popular model for service delivery. The curriculum begins by defining PPPs, highlighting their advantages over traditional public or private models, and exploring the conditions under which they are most effective. You will analyze the distinct motivations and inherent conflicts between public and private partners and learn how successful partnerships align these interests. The course details various PPP structures, including service contracts, management contracts, concessions, Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) arrangements, and joint ventures, using real-world examples like the Delhi International Airport and Hyderabad Metro Rail. A significant portion is dedicated to risk management, covering the identification, analysis, and allocation of construction, operational, demand, and financial risks. By the end of this course, you will understand the fundamentals of structuring, financing, and managing PPP agreements, enabling you to oversee PPP-related work with confidence.

title: Public - Private Partnership (Hindi)
desc: सार्वजनिक-निजी भागीदारी (पीपीपी) पाठ्यक्रम को सरकारी अधिकारियों को सार्वजनिक बुनियादी ढांचे और सेवाओं के विकास के लिए एक प्रभावी उपकरण के रूप में पीपीपी मॉडल को समझने में मदद करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम बताता है कि कैसे सार्वजनिक और निजी क्षेत्र की ताकत का लाभ उठाकर कुशल, लागत प्रभावी और समावेशी परिणाम प्राप्त किए जा सकते हैं। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत पीपीपी की मूल अवधारणाओं और सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र में इसकी बढ़ती लोकप्रियता के कारणों से होती है। इसके बाद, यह विभिन्न पीपीपी मॉडलों, जैसे सेवा अनुबंध, प्रबंधन अनुबंध, रियायतें, बीओटी और संयुक्त उद्यमों की विस्तृत जानकारी प्रदान करता है, जिसमें प्रत्येक की विशेषताओं और उपयुक्तता पर प्रकाश डाला गया है। एक महत्वपूर्ण खंड पीपीपी परियोजनाओं से जुड़े जोखिमों, जैसे निर्माण, परिचालन, मांग और वित्तीय जोखिमों के लिए समर्पित है। शिक्षार्थी इन जोखिमों को पहचानने, आवंटित करने और कम करने के तरीकों को सीखेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम एक सफल पीपीपी समझौते की संरचना, वित्तीय व्यवहार्यता विश्लेषण और आर्थिक मूल्यांकन के महत्व पर भी प्रकाश डालता है, जिससे अधिकारियों को पीपीपी परियोजनाओं की योजना बनाने और उन्हें प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधित करने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान मिलता है।

title: Public Address System and Passenger Information Display System
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Public Address (PA) and Passenger Information Display (PIDS) systems, which are fundamental to communication in metro rail networks. The program begins by defining the purpose of PA and PIDS, highlighting their role in disseminating synchronized audio and visual information. You will learn about the main components of the integrated system, including servers, workstations (MMI), audio matrix routers, amplifiers, speakers, and various display units. The course delves into the system's architecture, explaining its connectivity with the Operations Control Center (OCC), Backup Control Center (BCC), and other vital systems like Automatic Train Supervision (ATS) and Fiber Optic Transmission System (FOTS). Furthermore, it covers the different modes of operation—automatic, manual, and time-based—and the hierarchy of message priorities for routine, special, and emergency broadcasts. By the end of this course, you will have a solid understanding of how these systems function to ensure passenger safety, manage crowd flow, and provide a seamless travel experience.

title: Public Administration
desc: This course, 'Introduction to Public Administration,' serves as an essential guide for public functionaries seeking to understand the fundamental mechanics of governance. It addresses the critical question of why robust public administration is vital for national development and citizen welfare. The curriculum is structured to cover key learning areas, including the historical evolution and theoretical foundations of public administration, the architecture of the government at central, state, and local levels, and the intricacies of administrative law and procedures. Participants will explore the complete policy lifecycle, from design and formulation to implementation and evaluation. Furthermore, the course examines the principles of financial management, human resource management, and the importance of accountability and transparency in public service. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to apply administrative principles in their daily work, improve operational efficiency, and uphold the highest standards of public service, ultimately contributing to more effective and responsive governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Public Administration through the Lens of Indian Knowledge Systems
desc: This course explores Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) as a living framework for value-based public administration. Drawing from the Vedic corpus, Buddhist philosophy, the Mahabharata, and their resonance in initiatives such as Mission Karmayogi, PESA, and Panchayati Raj reforms, it reveals how India's civilizational heritage has long addressed the core challenges of governance: ethical leadership, accountability, transparency, participation, and public welfare. Rather than treating history as distant tradition, the course connects ancient principles directly to the everyday responsibilities of government officers: impartial decision-making, consultative leadership, resource stewardship, and service rooted in public trust. Officers across departments and levels will find practical insight into balancing authority with humility, efficiency with ethics, and institutional duty with citizen-centric governance, equipping them to lead with both competence and character.

title: Public Finance
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices governing public finance in India. It is designed to equip learners with a foundational understanding of how government finances are managed to achieve socio-economic objectives. The curriculum begins with the core components of public finance, including public revenue, expenditure, and debt, and explains the complete public finance cycle from policy formulation to auditing. Learners will delve into the critical roles of fiscal and monetary policy in managing the economy, analyzing their objectives, instruments, and interactions. The course also provides detailed insights into the institutional framework, covering the functions of the Finance Commission and the mandates of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act. Through this course, participants will be able to analyze government budgets, understand the implications of deficit financing, and appreciate the mechanisms that ensure financial accountability and transparency in the public sector.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Public Finance under Co-operative Federalism
desc: Designed for civil servants and public policy professionals, this course offers an in-depth exploration of the intricate financial architecture that underpins India's federal system. It begins by establishing the context of cooperative federalism and its importance for a diverse nation. Learners will dissect the core components of fiscal federalism, understanding how responsibilities and revenue-raising powers are allocated across different tiers of government. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the mechanisms of intergovernmental fiscal transfers, highlighting the role of Finance Commissions in addressing vertical and horizontal imbalances. The course traces the journey of tax reforms in India, providing critical insights into direct and indirect taxation, the rationale behind the Goods and Services Tax (GST), and its impact on the economy. Furthermore, it sheds light on the financial landscape of local self-governments, discussing their revenue sources, dependency on grants, and the goal of strengthening fiscal autonomy at the grassroots level. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to contribute to sound financial policy formulation, efficient resource management, and transparent governance.

title: Public Financial Management System
desc: This course delves into the vision, design, and operational framework of the Public Financial Management System (PFMS), a landmark initiative in India's digital transformation journey. The content explains the critical context of why such a system was necessary to reform public finance, addressing challenges like fund flow delays, leakages, and lack of real-time expenditure data. Key learning areas include an exploration of the core functional modules of PFMS, covering budgeting, payments, accounting, and reporting. The course also examines its pivotal role in the successful implementation of the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme, which ensures funds reach intended beneficiaries directly. Participants will learn how PFMS acts as a powerful instrument for improving fiscal discipline, strengthening governance, and enhancing public service delivery. By understanding its architecture and impact, learners will appreciate PFMS as a successful model of large-scale, tech-enabled public sector reform.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Public Governance Models
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the models and systems that define effective public governance. It addresses common challenges within government administration, such as conflicting objectives and a lack of clear accountability, which often lead to a significant 'implementation gap' between policy promises and delivery. The curriculum is structured around the '12 habits of an effective government,' offering a deep dive into creating and sustaining high-performing public systems. Learners will explore the nuances of performance measurement, including the development of appropriate metrics, weighted success indicators, and multi-point rating scales. The course emphasizes the importance of performance agreements, outcome-based budgeting, and integrating HR and financial systems with performance goals. By analyzing real-world examples from countries like New Zealand, Malaysia, and India, participants will learn how to apply these frameworks to foster a culture of accountability, improve implementation, and ultimately drive national development.

title: Public Grievance Handling and CPGRAM 7.0
desc: This course delves into the critical function of public grievance redressal as a cornerstone of responsive and accountable governance. It provides an in-depth exploration of the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) version 7.0, the government's flagship platform for managing citizen complaints. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the system's architecture, features, and operational workflows. The curriculum covers the entire lifecycle of a grievance, from registration and acknowledgement to analysis, resolution, and feedback. Key topics include adhering to prescribed timelines, managing escalations, and generating analytical reports to identify systemic issues. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in using the CPGRAMS 7.0 portal, enabling them to address public grievances efficiently, transparently, and empathetically, thereby strengthening public trust and improving the quality of governance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Public Grievance Handling through CPGRAMS 7.0
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of public grievance redressal as an essential component of responsive, transparent, and accountable governance. It introduces learners to the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) 7.0, the Government of India’s platform for receiving, processing, monitoring, and resolving public grievances. The course covers the complete grievance lifecycle, from registration and acknowledgement to examination, resolution, closure, and citizen feedback. Learners will explore key features and workflows of the CPGRAMS 7.0 portal, prescribed timelines, escalation mechanisms, and the roles and responsibilities of officials involved in grievance redressal. The course also focuses on analysing grievance patterns, preparing appropriate responses, and using grievance data to identify systemic issues and improve public service delivery.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Public Policy and the VUCA World
desc: In an era defined by rapid and unpredictable change, public policy must adapt to a Volatile, Uncertain, Complex, and Ambiguous (VUCA) environment. This course delves into the core principles of the public policy process, from problem identification to evaluation, providing a framework for effective governance in modern times. It addresses why understanding the policy cycle is critical for all public officials and explores the conditions that necessitate state intervention, such as market and governance failures. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding and tackling 'wicked problems'—complex issues that defy simple solutions and often lead to unforeseen consequences. Learners will explore various policy implementation models, from logistical execution (Policy 1.0) to managing complex behavioral changes (Policy 2.0) and coordinating multi-stakeholder systems (Policy 3.0). By the end of this course, participants will have acquired the analytical skills to deconstruct public problems, design robust policy interventions, and navigate the challenges of implementation in a dynamic world, ultimately contributing to more resilient and responsive governance.

title: Public Policy Basics for Administrators
desc: Public policy is the backbone of effective governance, turning vision into action and intent into meaningful impact. For government administrators, understanding how policies are conceived, designed, implemented, and evaluated is essential to ensure citizens receive timely and effective outcomes. This course introduces the core concepts, stages, and institutions involved in policymaking and demonstrates how evidence, technology, and citizen participation can enhance policy effectiveness. Through seven concise and engaging modules, learners will explore the entire policy ecosystem — from agenda-setting and formulation to implementation, evaluation, and continuous learning. By the end of the course, participants will not only understand what public policy is but also how to leverage it as a tool for transformative administrative work.

title: Public Policy Writing
desc: Public policies are the cornerstone of effective governance, yet their success often hinges on the clarity and precision of their written form. This course is designed to equip public officials with the essential skills for drafting and communicating impactful public policies. You will delve into the entire policy lifecycle, starting with the distinction between a vision, a policy, and a plan, and progressing to the nuances of policy implementation instruments. The curriculum covers the art of drafting various policy-related documents, such as committee reports, internal notes for cabinet approval, and the final policy text for public dissemination. Key learning areas include structuring arguments, using simple and accessible language, avoiding jargon, and tailoring communication for different stakeholders, including the public, legislators, and internal government bodies. By the end of this course, you will be able to analyze policy problems, structure coherent policy documents, and apply effective writing principles to ensure your policies are understood, approved, and successfully implemented, ultimately leading to better governance and public service delivery.

title: Public Privare Partnerships (PPP) for Infrastructure Projects
desc: This comprehensive introductory course delves into the critical domain of financing large-scale infrastructure projects. It begins by establishing the context of modern infrastructure needs, which are often too capital-intensive for governments to fund alone. The curriculum then transitions to the primary solution: Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs). Learners will explore the fundamental principles of PPPs, including their definition, structure, and the enabling environment required for their success. The course details various PPP models, such as Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) and concession agreements, explaining the allocation of responsibilities and risks between government and private entities. Key topics include the role of Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), project bankability, and the characteristics of infrastructure financing from both demand and supply perspectives. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped with the knowledge to understand how PPPs are structured and leveraged to develop and manage essential infrastructure, aligning with national development goals.

title: Public Private Partnerships Beginners eCourse
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) for officials involved in the infrastructure sector. It addresses the growing need for alternative financing and project delivery mechanisms in public service. The curriculum begins by defining PPPs and explaining their importance in bridging the infrastructure gap. You will learn about the various PPP models, such as Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) and its variants, and understand their respective advantages and disadvantages. The course walks through the entire PPP project lifecycle, from initial conception and feasibility analysis to procurement, implementation, and monitoring. Key topics include project financing, risk allocation, and the legal frameworks that underpin these complex agreements. Upon completion, you will be equipped to identify suitable projects for the PPP route and contribute effectively to their planning and oversight within the governmental framework, ensuring value for money and successful project outcomes.

title: Public Procurement for Sustainable Development
desc: This program offers a practical understanding of Sustainable Public Procurement (SPP) as a strategic lever for public sector transformation. It addresses the critical need to align government purchasing power with broader sustainability objectives. The course delves into the policy, regulatory, and institutional frameworks that underpin SPP, providing a clear roadmap for implementation. Key learning areas include integrating environmental considerations like carbon reduction, applying social criteria such as ethical sourcing and support for MSMEs, and ensuring economic viability through value-for-money assessments. Participants will learn to use practical tools and market engagement strategies to embed sustainability into every stage of the procurement cycle. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to design and execute procurement strategies that not only meet operational needs but also contribute significantly to national sustainability targets, fostering innovation and responsible governance.

title: Public Procurement Framework of GOI
desc: In government operations, the procurement of goods, services, and works involves significant public funds, demanding strict adherence to established principles and procedures. This course is designed to equip government officers with a thorough understanding of the public procurement framework. It delves into the core tenets of transparency, fairness, competition, economy, efficiency, and accountability that underpin all procurement activities. The curriculum is centered around the General Financial Rules (GFR), providing a detailed guide for officers in Integrated Finance Divisions (IFDs) and Administration Divisions. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in examining procurement proposals, ensuring compliance with GFRs, and upholding financial propriety in their official duties, thereby contributing to more efficient and accountable governance.

title: Public Procurement in Indian Railways: Principles and Processes
desc: This course provides a detailed examination of public procurement as practiced in Indian Railways, highlighting its significance as a strategic and constitutionally guided process. It is designed for officials involved in procurement to ensure they operate with probity, prudence, and a strong sense of public responsibility. The curriculum delves into the constitutional foundations of tendering, referencing Articles 14, 19(1)(g), 299, and 300A, and explains how judicial review scrutinizes the procurement process. Key learning areas include the classification of procurement needs as stock or non-stock, the selection of appropriate tendering methods, and the proficient use of digital procurement platforms such as IREPS and GeM. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to manage the end-to-end procurement workflow in a digital environment, from requirement identification to final payment, while upholding the highest standards of integrity and public accountability.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Public Procurement of Goods
desc: In the realm of public service, the procurement of goods and services represents a significant expenditure of public funds, demanding the highest standards of integrity and diligence. This course is designed to equip government officers with the essential knowledge and skills for managing public procurement effectively. It delves into the core principles that underpin ethical and efficient procurement: transparency, fairness, competition, economy, and accountability. The curriculum is built around the General Financial Rules (GFRs), providing a detailed exploration of the regulatory framework that governs these processes. Participants will learn how to meticulously examine procurement proposals, ensuring they align with GFRs and other pertinent instructions. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in navigating the complexities of the procurement cycle, ready to apply their skills in roles within Integrated Finance Divisions (IFDs) and Administration Divisions, thereby contributing to robust and accountable public financial management.

title: Public Relations Skills
desc: In today's information-driven world, managing public perception is critical for any organization's success. This course, 'Fundamentals of Public Relations and Media Management,' is designed to equip public sector professionals with the essential skills to excel in this dynamic field. The curriculum provides a structured journey through the core pillars of modern PR, starting with the art of communication. You will learn to craft captivating press releases, speeches, and social media content that resonates with diverse audiences. The course delves into the strategic use of social media platforms for building and maintaining a positive online presence, including how to track analytics to measure engagement and stay ahead of trends. Furthermore, you will understand the importance of research in developing targeted campaigns and the necessity of time management and creativity to stand out in a crowded market. Upon completion, you will not only have a solid grasp of PR fundamentals but also know how to continuously improve your skills and effectively showcase them for career advancement, making you a more effective and strategic communicator for your organization.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Public Sector Leadership through Indian Knowledge Systems
desc: This course is designed for current and aspiring leaders in the Indian public sector who want to ground their leadership practice in culturally rooted, ethically driven principles. At a time when most leadership training relies heavily on Western frameworks, this course takes a thoughtful step toward rediscovering India’s own rich tradition of leadership thought. Across three modules, participants explore enduring leadership ideas drawn from classical Indian texts such as the Bhagavad Gita, Arthashastra, Ramayana, Mahabharata, and Tirukkural. The course brings together diverse perspectives—from the ethical depth of the Raj Rishi model and the strategic realism of Chanakya, to the service-oriented approach of Seva-based leadership and the psychological lens of the Trigunas. Rather than treating these as abstract concepts, the course connects them to contemporary governance challenges in a practical and relevant way.

title: Public Servants and the New Criminal Laws: Offences and Protections
desc: This course offers an essential guide to the reformed criminal laws of India, focusing on their direct impact on public servants. With the introduction of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), it is crucial for every government official to understand the updated legal landscape governing their duties, powers, and accountabilities. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the term 'public servant,' outlining the scope of individuals covered and their specific responsibilities, with a particular focus on police officers. Learners will explore the catalogue of offences that can be committed by public servants, as well as offences related to them. The course also thoroughly explains the legal protections and procedural safeguards available to officials under the new Sanhitas and the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988. By mastering this content, participants will be better prepared to perform their duties confidently and lawfully, ensuring compliance, mitigating legal risks, and upholding the principles of justice and integrity in public administration.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Pulverizer and Boiler Fuel Firing System
desc: This specialized course offers an in-depth exploration of pulverizers and boiler fuel firing systems, essential technologies within thermal power generation. The program is structured to provide a comprehensive overview of the boiler, its function as a major component in a thermal plant, and the critical systems that support its operation. Participants will gain a detailed understanding of the entire fuel firing process, from the fuel flow path to the intricacies of the fuel oil system. The curriculum places a strong emphasis on the practical aspects of boiler operations. It covers the design and function of various types of oil guns and explains the principles behind different atomization processes, which are crucial for efficient combustion and energy output. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to identify key components, understand their operational parameters, and appreciate the importance of proper system management for plant efficiency and safety. This course is ideal for engineers, technicians, and operational staff in the power sector who need to build a solid foundation in boiler and fuel system technology.

title: Punctuality of Passenger Carrying Trains
desc: The “Punctuality of Passenger-Carrying Trains” course provides a comprehensive understanding of key concepts and operational practices related to punctuality management, train timetabling, and the innovative Zero-Based Time Tabling (ZBTT) approach in Indian Railways. Participants will explore the critical importance of punctuality for passenger trains, factors influencing delays, and strategies to improve time adherence through systematic scheduling and operational efficiency. The course also covers the perspective of passengers, staff timetables, classification of punctuality performance metrics, and the role of various committees in implementing Zero-Based Time Tables. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with practical knowledge to enhance train punctuality, improve passenger satisfaction, and optimize operational efficiency.

title: Punctuality of Trains and How to Maintain it in Indian Railways
desc: Gain a foundational understanding of the principles and practices required to maintain train punctuality across the Indian Railways network. This course delves into the significance of running trains on pre-advertised schedules, directly linking it to passenger satisfaction and the railway's public image. You will explore the key factors affecting punctuality, categorized by the departments responsible, including Operations, Commercial, Mechanical, and Engineering. The curriculum covers the methods for calculating and monitoring punctuality, the administrative actions led by figures like the Divisional Railway Manager (DRM) to mitigate delays, and the importance of inter-departmental coordination. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge of the systems, roles, and remedial measures that contribute to the operational effectiveness and service excellence of the Indian Railways, fostering a culture of timeliness and accountability.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Purchasing Process
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the purchasing and procurement framework specific to Indian Railways. It is designed to build a thorough understanding of how materials are acquired in a rule-based and transparent manner. The curriculum begins by outlining the organizational structure for procurement, covering centralized functions at the headquarters and decentralized operations at divisional and depot levels. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process for vendor registration on critical digital platforms like IREPS and the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). Participants will learn to distinguish between different tendering methods, including Open, Limited, Single, and Global tenders, and understand the application of various contract types such as Rate, Running, and Fixed Quantity Contracts. The course also covers the crucial stages of bid evaluation, the criteria for tender acceptance, and the procedures for awarding contracts and issuing purchase orders. By completing this course, officials and vendors will be better prepared to navigate the complexities of railway procurement, manage contracts effectively, and contribute to a more efficient and compliant supply chain.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Purpose of Life and Profession
desc: Designed for personnel in uniformed services, this course provides a reflective journey into the core of professional and personal identity. It addresses the critical need for individuals in high-stakes roles to ground their actions in a strong ethical framework and a clear sense of purpose. The curriculum delves into the symbolic responsibility of the uniform, promoting integrity, accountability, and empathy in every interaction with the public. Key learning areas include understanding the dynamics of the protector-citizen relationship, developing emotional resilience to manage stress, and expanding the concept of patriotism to encompass universal values. By exploring the oath of service as a lifelong pledge, the course aims to deepen the participant's commitment to duty and honour. Ultimately, learners will emerge with a reinforced sense of purpose, better equipped to handle the moral complexities of their profession and serve with distinction.

title: Purpose-Driven Leadership
desc: Embark on a transformative journey with 'Developing Purpose-Driven Leadership for Public Service,' a course designed to empower leaders within the Indian civil services. In an era defined by volatility, uncertainty, complexity, and ambiguity (VUCA), the need for authentic and resilient leadership has never been greater. This course addresses that need by providing a deep dive into the principles that underpin effective governance and public service. You will explore the concept of the Level V leader, characterized by a unique blend of profound humility and intense professional will. The curriculum covers essential capabilities such as developing emotional intelligence, fostering stability and resilience, and cultivating a growth mindset to embrace continuous learning. Through a series of insightful modules, you will learn to analyze and overcome common leadership obstacles, apply frameworks for successful change management, and understand the power of compassionate, collaborative problem-solving. By the end of this course, you will have a robust framework to not only lead with purpose but also to act as a proficient change agent, capable of driving sustainable and meaningful transformations within your sphere of influence.

title: Quality Assurance in Reinforced Cement Concrete Construction
desc: Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) quality is critical to the strength, durability, safety, and service life of infrastructure. This course provides a practical understanding of RCC quality assurance, inspection, and compliance with applicable Indian Standards. Learners cover formwork inspection, stability, dimensions, tolerances, camber, cleaning, and safe removal; reinforcement quality, testing, detailing, anchorage, lap splices, development length, placement, cover, and seismic detailing; and concrete mix design, including nominal and design mixes, water-cement ratio, aggregates, admixtures, workability, target strength, standard deviation, and IS 10262 requirements. The course also covers trial mixes, mix verification, quality documentation, approval processes, and site inspections. By completing the course, learners will be able to perform systematic RCC quality checks, verify construction compliance, and support the delivery of safe, durable, and code-compliant structures.

title: Quality in Healthcare
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles of quality management within the healthcare sector. It addresses the critical need for quality by exploring its impact on patient safety, medical error reduction, and overall organizational efficiency. The curriculum delves into the history of the quality movement, from the industrial revolution to modern healthcare, examining the philosophies of key figures like Crosby, Juran, and Deming. Participants will learn to identify and apply fundamental quality improvement tools, including the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle and Juran's Trilogy. The course also breaks down the six domains of healthcare quality as defined by the Institute of Medicine: Safety, Effectiveness, Patient-Centricity, Timeliness, Efficiency, and Equity. By the end of this session, healthcare professionals will understand how to integrate these quality principles into their daily practice to drive continuous improvement, build community trust, and deliver superior patient care.

title: Quality of Service in 5G - Part I
desc: This course, "Fundamentals of Quality of Service (QoS) in 5G Networks," offers a comprehensive introduction to the mechanisms that govern data traffic and service quality in 5G systems. In an era of increasing digital demand, understanding QoS is critical for professionals in the telecommunications sector to ensure reliable and efficient network performance. The course begins by detailing the 5G core network architecture, explaining the distinct roles of control plane functions such as the Access and Mobility Function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), and Policy Control Function (PCF), as well as the User Plane Function (UPF). Learners will gain a clear understanding of PDU sessions and their importance in establishing data connectivity. The curriculum then explores the intricacies of QoS flows, which are the cornerstone of 5G's service differentiation capabilities. It covers the 5G QoS architecture, different types of QoS flows (including GBR and Non-GBR), and the concept of network slicing, which allows for the creation of virtual end-to-end networks tailored to specific application needs. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to describe the fundamental elements, parameters, and architectures that enable superior Quality of Service in 5G environments.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Quality of Service in 5G - Part II
desc: Building upon foundational knowledge, this advanced course offers a comprehensive analysis of Quality of Service (QoS) in 5G technology. As 5G networks become integral to modern digital infrastructure, understanding QoS is critical for ensuring reliable and efficient service delivery for diverse applications, from video streaming to critical communications. This course is structured to provide a deep technical understanding of the core components that govern service quality in 5G. The curriculum is divided into three key modules. The first module details the specific parameters of 5G New Radio (NR) QoS, such as the 5G QoS Identifier (5QI), Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP), and various flow bit rates. The second module focuses on 5QI characteristics, explaining resource types, priority levels, and metrics like Packet Delay Budget and Packet Error Rate. The final module provides a comparative analysis of QoS architecture, highlighting the fundamental shift from the bearer-based model in 4G to the more flexible flow-based model in 5G. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze and apply complex QoS rules and profiles, contributing to the effective design, deployment, and management of high-performance 5G networks.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Quantum Computing and Communications
desc: Delve into the transformative world of quantum technologies with this introductory course on quantum computing and communications. As classical computing approaches its physical limits, quantum mechanics offers a new paradigm for processing information. This course explains the fundamental principles that give quantum computers their power, such as the behavior of qubits and the phenomena of superposition and entanglement. You will explore the significant advantages quantum systems offer in fields like cryptography, complex optimization, and scientific discovery. The course also provides a clear explanation of quantum communication and its role in creating tamper-proof security through Quantum Key Distribution (QKD). Learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of the potential applications, from developing new drugs to securing global financial systems, while also appreciating the current technical challenges, including system stability, scalability, and error correction. This course is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge to understand the next wave of technological innovation.

title: Quantum Computing and Post-Quantum Cryptography
desc: Delivered in an engaging podcast format, this course delves into the strategic importance of quantum technologies for India's digital sovereignty and national security. It provides a comprehensive, policy-oriented examination of Quantum Computing and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), tracing India's historical contributions and outlining the ambitious goals of the National Quantum Mission. The discussion highlights key advancements in indigenous quantum hardware and the collaborative efforts between government bodies like DRDO, ISRO, and C-DOT, academia, and industry. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to analyzing the profound cybersecurity challenges of the quantum era. It explains critical threats such as 'harvest now, decrypt later' and details the defensive strategies offered by PQC and Quantum Key Distribution (QKD).
