Furthermore, participants will learn to articulate the implementation approach, outline governance structures, and present a thorough risk management plan. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently construct a detailed and persuasive project report that stands up to scrutiny and successfully guides a project from conception to approval.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Representation Before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal
desc: Representation before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) is the process through which an appellant or the Department presents arguments, facts, legal provisions, and judicial precedents before the Tribunal. It is generally undertaken by an authorised representative such as a chartered accountant, advocate, or tax consultant. Effective representation requires clear drafting of grounds of appeal, proper filing of paper books, and precise oral submissions. The objective is to challenge errors in the order of the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) [CIT(A)], support additions or deletions, and persuade the Tribunal through relevant law and evidence. Good representation is concise, factual, and supported by statutory provisions and judicial precedents at every stage of the proceedings.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Requisitioning and Distribution of Stores
desc: A robust material supply system is fundamental to the seamless functioning of a complex organization like Indian Railways. This course provides an in-depth exploration of this critical operational area. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the entire lifecycle of material management, from initial requisition to final distribution. You will learn the correct procedures for requisitioning stores, appreciating the nuances that ensure accuracy and efficiency. The course delves into the pivotal role of nominated depots in maintaining stock flow and managing the vast supply chain. Furthermore, it compares and contrasts different distribution methods, including rail and road transport, and evaluates their respective advantages in various scenarios. Upon completion, you will be able to apply best practices to manage material supply effectively, contributing to the operational excellence of your department and the wider railway network.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Rescue and Recovery in Coal Mines
desc: This course provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of mine emergency management and rescue operations. It covers an overview of mine emergencies and the evolution of mine rescue services, highlighting their critical role in ensuring safety. Learners will gain insights into the additional activities carried out by WCL Mines Rescue Services, understand workload and stress factors encountered during rescue operations, and become familiar with the rescue equipment available with WCL Mines Rescue Services. The course equips participants with essential knowledge to strengthen preparedness, response, and safety practices in mine rescue operations.
keywords: Rescue and Recovery in Coal Mines

title: Rescue Techniques
desc: In critical situations, the ability to act decisively and correctly can mean the difference between life and death. This course is designed to equip learners with the fundamental knowledge and practical skills required for effective rescue operations. It addresses the common challenge where well-intentioned helpers lack the proper training to assist victims safely, particularly in water-related emergencies and scenarios requiring victim transport.The course systematically covers two major areas. The first part focuses on water rescue, detailing techniques for saving individuals from drowning in both calm and strong currents. It includes specific instructions for non-swimmers using reach-and-throw methods, as well as various tow techniques for proficient swimmers. A key component is learning to create and use improvised floating devices from readily available materials. The second part transitions to land-based rescue, demonstrating a range of techniques to lift and move casualties from hazardous locations to safety. Methods such as the fireman's lift, various drags (shirt, sheet, blanket), and multi-person carries are explained step-by-step, emphasizing victim safety and rescuer ergonomics. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to assess an emergency scene and apply the appropriate rescue techniques confidently.

title: Research Ethics
desc: This course is designed to build a strong foundation in the ethical and operational dimensions of health research for researchers, students, and public health professionals. The curriculum delves into the core principles of research ethics, including respect for persons, beneficence, and justice, providing a clear understanding of their application in real-world scenarios. Participants will explore critical international and national regulatory guidelines, such as the Declaration of Helsinki and ICMR standards, to ensure compliance and protect the rights and welfare of research participants. A significant portion of the course addresses research integrity, covering topics like plagiarism, data fabrication, and authorship responsibilities to prevent misconduct. Furthermore, the course integrates the fundamentals of project management, teaching learners how to effectively plan, budget, schedule, and manage resources for their research projects. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to design and execute health research that is not only scientifically sound but also ethically robust and well-managed.

title: Research Study: Biostatistical Study Designs
desc: A well-designed research study is the cornerstone of credible scientific evidence. This course offers a detailed exploration of the statistical methods required to plan and execute sound health research. Participants will delve into the process of defining a study population, setting precise inclusion and exclusion criteria, and understanding the trade-offs between internal validity and the generalizability of findings. The curriculum provides an in-depth look at various sampling methods, including simple random, systematic, stratified, and cluster sampling, explaining the advantages and limitations of each. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the critical task of sample size calculation. Learners will be guided through the formulas and concepts needed to determine an adequate sample size, covering key elements such as desired precision, confidence levels, statistical power, Type I and Type II errors, and design effects. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped with the knowledge to design statistically valid research studies that can produce meaningful and reliable results in the field of public health and clinical research.

title: Research Study: Epidemiological Study Designs
desc: Understanding how diseases occur, spread, and can be systematically studied is the cornerstone of modern public health and clinical practice. This course offers a foundational yet detailed exploration of the primary epidemiological study designs. Participants will begin by learning to differentiate between descriptive studies that observe and report patterns, analytical studies that test hypotheses about associations, and experimental studies that evaluate interventions. The curriculum delves into the practical application of key designs, such as cross-sectional surveys for measuring prevalence, case-control studies for investigating rare diseases, cohort studies for determining incidence and risk, and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) as the gold standard for therapeutic evaluation. Furthermore, the course addresses critical concepts like selecting an appropriate design, recognizing potential sources of bias, and interpreting study results. Through clear explanations and real-world examples, learners will develop the necessary skills to critically appraise and design robust epidemiological research.

title: Research Study: Validation of Epidemiological Study Designs
desc: Expanding on foundational knowledge, this course delves into the complexities of modern epidemiological research. It is designed for professionals seeking to enhance their ability to design, conduct, and critically evaluate health studies. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of clinical trials, covering their phases, ethical considerations, regulatory landscape in India, and key components like randomization and blinding. A significant portion is dedicated to understanding and assessing research validity, teaching learners how to identify selection bias, information bias, and confounding factors that can distort study results. Furthermore, the course offers a comprehensive introduction to qualitative research methods, demonstrating how they complement quantitative data to provide deeper insights into behaviors and social contexts. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the analytical skills to appraise scientific literature, understand the strengths and limitations of different study designs, and contribute to high-quality, evidence-based health research and policy.

title: Reservation Policy - Reservation in Service
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of implementing the reservation policy in government services. It begins by establishing the constitutional and legal context for reservation, outlining its importance for social equity and inclusive governance. The curriculum covers the application of reservation rules in direct recruitment and promotions, the methodology for maintaining reservation rosters, and the procedures for de-reservation. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of calculating vacancies, managing backlogs, and ensuring compliance with the latest government orders and court judgments. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these rules accurately in their administrative roles, contributing to fair and lawful human resource management within the public sector.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Reservation Rosters: Compliance and Implementation
desc: This course aims to help the participants to make them understand the concept of post-based reservation rosters (in case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS), vertical and horizontal reservation principles and implementation of reservation system in the Central Government. Grounded in actual case studies and DoPT guidelines, it covers constitutional provisions regarding reservation in appointments/promotion, assessment of shortfall in representation, application of the own merit principle. Learners will become aware of the Hon’ble Supreme Court directions regarding reservation roster as contained in its judgement in R.K. Sabharwal judgment and the guiding principles in implementation of reservation in promotions as contained in Hon’ble Supreme Court judgement in M. Nagaraj and Jarnail Singh cases. The learners will also be able to understand the principles of vacancy-based reservation roster system applicable in case of PwBDs and Ex-servicemen.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Resilience in Banking: Strategies and Cybersecurity
desc: In an era of increasing digital threats, the resilience of banking infrastructure is paramount. This course delves into the multifaceted world of banking resilience, featuring insights from industry experts. It begins by establishing the context of why financial institutions are prime targets for cyberattacks and the systemic risks involved. The curriculum then explores the essential regulatory and governance frameworks, with a special focus on RBI guidelines that shape the security posture of banks in India. Key learning areas include the strategic implementation of cloud technologies for secure data management, the role of Artificial Intelligence in proactive threat monitoring, and best practices for incident handling and response. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand and contribute to the strategies that ensure trust, accountability, and robust security in the financial ecosystem, making them valuable assets in risk, compliance, and IT roles within the banking industry.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Resolution of Insolvent Companies under IBC
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the legal and procedural framework for resolving corporate insolvency in India under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016. It begins by defining core concepts and contrasting the consolidated IBC framework with previous disparate laws like the SICA and SARFAESI Act. The curriculum then delves into the specifics of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), outlining the triggers for its initiation, the roles of financial and operational creditors, and the functions of the Resolution Professional and the Committee of Creditors. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of different resolution pathways, including the Pre-Packaged Insolvency Resolution Process (PPIRP) for MSMEs and the Fast Track process. The course explains the structure and contents of a resolution plan, the legal effects of a moratorium, and the waterfall mechanism for asset distribution in case of liquidation. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the key provisions of the IBC and appreciate its impact on corporate governance and the ease of doing business.

title: Responsible AI in Action
desc: As Artificial Intelligence continues to reshape public services, it is crucial for government officials to lead its adoption responsibly. This course, 'Responsible AI in Action', offers a comprehensive guide to the ethical and strategic implementation of AI in governance. It delves into the core principles of fairness, transparency, accountability, and security, providing a robust foundation for decision-making. The curriculum examines India's national AI strategies, including MeitY’s Responsible AI framework and NITI Aayog’s 'AI for All' initiative, alongside global best practices. Key learning areas include understanding explainable AI (XAI), implementing data protection measures, and establishing mechanisms for human oversight. Through case studies and practical guidelines, learners will be empowered to design and deploy citizen-centric AI solutions that enhance public service delivery while upholding democratic values and building institutional integrity.

title: Responsible AI in the Generative AI Era
desc: As Generative AI reshapes our world, understanding its ethical implications is no longer optional, but a core necessity for responsible governance. This course provides a comprehensive overview of Responsible AI, specifically tailored for the Generative AI era. It begins by contextualizing the rapid adoption of these technologies and the significant societal challenges they introduce, such as perpetuating data biases, the proliferation of deepfakes and misinformation, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and complex questions of intellectual property. The curriculum then systematically breaks down the foundational principles of Responsible AI: fairness, transparency, accountability, robustness, stability, privacy, and security. Through analysis of real-world case studies and data, learners will explore how these principles can be practically applied to mitigate risks. Upon completion, participants will be able to critically analyze the ethical dimensions of generative systems, discuss the need for robust governance frameworks, and contribute to building a future where AI is harnessed for the greater good while upholding societal values. This course empowers public functionaries to become informed stakeholders in the AI-driven world.

title: Responsible Data Management
desc: In an era of rapid digitization, the ability to manage data responsibly is a critical competency for public sector professionals. This course offers a thorough exploration of the principles and practices essential for ethical data handling. It begins by defining what constitutes responsible data and why it is crucial in the context of governance and social impact, highlighting the risks of mismanagement and the importance of data as a human and civil right. Participants will journey through the entire data lifecycle, from collection and storage to usage and destruction, learning to apply best practices at each stage. The curriculum provides a detailed review of major international and national data protection laws, including Europe's GDPR and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) of 2023, ensuring learners understand their legal obligations. Key topics include data classification, protecting sensitive personal information, data anonymization, and implementing robust data governance frameworks. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to make informed decisions, safeguard citizen data, and foster a culture of data responsibility within their organizations.

title: Responsible Data Management: Privacy and Security and Compliance
desc: In an era of rapid digitization, the ability to manage data responsibly is a critical competency for public sector professionals. This course offers a thorough exploration of the principles and practices essential for ethical data handling. It begins by defining what constitutes responsible data and why it is crucial in the context of governance and social impact, highlighting the risks of mismanagement and the importance of data as a human and civil right. Participants will journey through the entire data lifecycle, from collection and storage to usage and destruction, learning to apply best practices at each stage. The curriculum provides a detailed review of major international and national data protection laws, including Europe's GDPR and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) of 2023, ensuring learners understand their legal obligations.

title: Responsible Social Media Use In Public Service
desc: In an era of digital governance, the responsible use of social media is paramount for public officials. This course, developed by the Karmayogi Digital Learning Lab, offers a comprehensive guide to navigating the complexities of online communication. It addresses the critical need for digital awareness and ethical conduct, providing a framework for using social media as a powerful tool for transparency and citizen engagement. The curriculum is structured into two main modules. The first focuses on engaging responsibly on public-facing platforms, emphasizing smart posting strategies, data privacy, and the avoidance of misinformation and political bias. The second module introduces 'Samvad', a secure government communication platform, detailing its application for effective internal coordination. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to build trust, enhance public service delivery, and uphold the integrity of their office in the digital public sphere.

title: Responsible Use of Social Media in Policing
desc: This course equips police personnel with essential knowledge and practical guidance on the responsible, ethical, and effective use of social media in both professional and personal contexts. It highlights the growing role of social media in modern policing, including building public trust, enhancing community engagement, supporting investigations, and enabling timely information sharing. The course provides clear guidance on managing official and personal social media accounts, maintaining professionalism online, and handling digital communication responsibly. It also emphasizes compliance with legal, ethical, and data protection requirements to safeguard institutional credibility. By the end of the course, participants will be able to use social media confidently, responsibly, and strategically, strengthening both their professional image and public perception of the police force.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Responsible Use of Social Media in Public Service
desc: In an era of digital transformation, social media has become a primary channel for communication and information dissemination. This course is designed to equip government employees with the knowledge and skills to navigate this landscape responsibly. It begins by exploring the evolution of social media and its unique features compared to traditional media. The curriculum then delves into practical guidelines for managing a professional presence online, with specific modules on the etiquette and best practices for using platforms such as X and WhatsApp. A key focus is on distinguishing between official and personal communication, ensuring that all online activities align with the standards of public service. Furthermore, the course explicitly covers the Central Civil Services (CCS) Conduct Rules, providing a clear framework for compliance.

title: Restoration of coal mined land through integrated biological Approach
desc: Opencast coal mining leaves behind vast, inhospitable landscapes characterized by poor soil structure, low organic matter, and high acidity. This course provides a comprehensive guide to an innovative and successful integrated biological restoration technology. It addresses the critical need to restore these degraded lands to their original biodiversity and ecological function. The curriculum is divided into key stages, beginning with essential site stabilization techniques such as contouring and mulching to prevent soil erosion. It then delves into two core methodologies: Seed Ball Technology and Plantation Technology. You will learn the step-by-step process of preparing and broadcasting seed balls enriched with Plant Growth Promoting Rhizobacteria (PGPRs). The course also covers raising and planting seedlings inoculated with Arbuscular Mycorrhizal (AM) fungi, along with the application of soil amendments like lime and farm yard manure (FYM). Upon completion, you will understand how to implement this cost-effective and sustainable technology to achieve high survival rates for native plant species, effectively transforming barren mine dumps into thriving ecosystems.
org: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education

title: Restoring Livelihoods with Psychosocial Support
desc: In many development contexts, particularly those affected by crisis, war, or extreme poverty, participants often face significant psychological barriers that prevent them from fully benefiting from livelihood opportunities. This course addresses this critical gap by equipping practitioners with the knowledge to design and implement programs that are sensitive to the mental health and psychosocial needs of beneficiaries. The curriculum delves into the effects of scarcity, trauma, and stigma on decision-making and behavior. It translates complex concepts from brain science and cognitive psychology into practical, actionable strategies for program design, including creating safe environments, simplifying materials, and fostering supportive staff interactions. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of ethical considerations, such as the 'Do No Harm' principle, confidentiality, and consent, ensuring that interventions are not only effective but also dignifying and empowering for all participants. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to create more inclusive, resilient, and impactful livelihood programs.

title: Restoring Roots of Resilience: Seasonal Migrants into Employers
desc: The case study describes the transformation of Kanfodi village in drought-prone Jalna District from distress migration and poverty to a source of local employment within a decade. Before 2018, households relied only on rainfed crops and faced seasonal migration, poor infrastructure, and socio-economic hardship. Intervention by MSRLM through SHG formation and financial literacy led to the introduction of vegetable farming, which became a turning point due to steady income and reliable markets. Innovations like drip irrigation, staggered planting, and market surveys increased productivity and earnings. Distress migration reduced to 20% by 2024-25, living standards improved, and women emerged as key decision-makers. Landless households were supported through poultry, goat rearing, and a daal mill. Despite challenges like water scarcity and institutional gaps, Kanfodi stands as a model of community-led, sustainable rural development.

title: Restructured Weather-Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)
desc: The Restructured Weather-Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) course offers an in-depth exploration of this innovative agricultural insurance program. It begins by explaining the scheme's objectives and its role as an extension of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), highlighting the key differences in claim calculation methodologies. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of how RWBCIS uses predefined weather triggers, such as rainfall and temperature, measured by a network of Automatic Weather Stations (AWS), to automate and expedite claim settlements. The course details the enrollment process for both loanee and non-loanee farmers, the required documentation, and the structure of premium subsidies. Furthermore, it covers technological advancements supporting the scheme, including the National Crop Insurance Portal and the Weather Information and Network Data System (WINDS). Upon completion, participants will be equipped to navigate the scheme's features, understand its implementation across various states, and appreciate its significance in enhancing agricultural risk management and financial resilience for farmers.
org: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana PMFBY

title: Restructuring of Courts and Their Powers
desc: With the introduction of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), India's criminal justice system has undergone a significant transformation. This course is designed to provide a detailed and structured explanation of this new legal framework, specifically focusing on the constitution and powers of criminal courts. It delves into Chapters III and IV of the BNSS to clarify the newly defined judicial hierarchy, the process for appointing judicial and executive magistrates, and the scope of their authority. Key learning areas include the specific jurisdictions for trying offenses, the sentencing powers of High Courts, Sessions Judges, and Magistrates, and the procedures for handling cases with multiple convictions. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to apply the provisions of the BNSS accurately in their professional roles, ensuring compliance and contributing to the fair and efficient administration of criminal justice under the new legal regime. It is an indispensable resource for anyone involved in the Indian legal system seeking to master the operational aspects of the new Sanhita.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Retail Post
desc: Delve into the operational framework of the Retail Post service, designed to transform Post Offices into vibrant retail hubs. This course details the strategic initiative that enables the sale of diverse products, from gold coins and holy water to financial and travel services. You will learn about the governing regulations, specifically PO Order BD/01/2024/E and Post Office Regulations 2024, which provide the legal basis for these services. The curriculum covers the end-to-end process for participating clients, including the proposal and registration process, agreement terms, and inventory management responsibilities. Furthermore, it explains the financial aspects such as commission structures, service charges, GST compliance, and the payment settlement process between the department and its partners. Upon completion, learners will have a thorough understanding of how Retail Post functions and its role in modernizing India's postal services.

title: Retirement Planning for Government Employees
desc: This course on retirement planning is designed to build crucial financial literacy skills among government employees, enabling them to navigate their post-career financial journey with confidence. The curriculum is structured into three modules, starting with the fundamentals of retirement planning, including the power of compounding, risk assessment, and the risk-return trade-off. The second module delves into the practical process of retirement planning. It details the steps for determining a retirement corpus, formulating an investment plan, and provides an in-depth look at the National Pension System (NPS), including its various schemes and withdrawal rules. The final module focuses on post-retirement investment strategies, analyzing a detailed case study to provide practical insights. It evaluates a diverse range of asset classes, from real estate and stocks to mutual funds and bonds, discussing their merits and demerits. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to make informed financial decisions, build a diversified investment portfolio, and secure their financial future effectively.

title: Return Filing under GST
desc: This course offers a detailed, step-by-step guide to mastering the GST return filing system in India. It begins by explaining the legal provisions under the CGST Act that govern return filing, providing a solid foundation for understanding compliance requirements. The curriculum then delves into the practical aspects of filing GSTR-1, covering the entry of B2B and B2C supply details, the use of the Invoice Furnishing Facility (IFF) for quarterly filers, and the auto-population of data from e-invoices. Learners will discover how the system automatically generates the GSTR-2B statement, which details available and non-available Input Tax Credit (ITC). Finally, the course explains how to utilize the auto-populated GSTR-3B to verify tax liability, claim ITC, and complete the tax payment process. The training also covers procedures for filing nil returns and highlights the importance of timely and accurate filing to prevent late fees and interest.
org: National Academy of Customs, Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN)

title: Revenue Procurement and Audit in Coast Guard
desc: This course is designed to equip personnel with a thorough understanding of the financial regulations governing revenue procurement and audit within the Indian Coast Guard. It delves into the core principles of efficiency, economy, and transparency that must be upheld when utilizing public funds. The content is structured across eight modules, covering key topics such as the definition of goods under GFR-2017, various procurement methodologies, and the specific guidelines detailed in the Manual of Procurement of Goods and Services. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of the procurement lifecycle and understand the distinct functions and objectives of internal and statutory audits. By the end of this course, learners will be proficient in applying these financial rules and audit procedures, ensuring compliance and promoting fiscal discipline in their official duties.

title: Review of Financial Statements and Analysis
desc: This e-learning module offers a detailed guide to reviewing and analyzing financial statements, a critical skill for any professional involved in finance, accounting, or management. The course begins by deconstructing the primary financial statements—the Profit and Loss Account, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement—to build a solid foundational understanding. It then transitions into the core of financial analysis: the application of financial ratios. Participants will learn to calculate and interpret a wide array of metrics, including performance ratios like Return on Assets and Equity, profitability margins such as EBITDA and Net Profit, liquidity measures like the current and quick ratios, and capital structure ratios like debt-to-equity. The course emphasizes how to synthesize this information to assess an organization's overall financial health, identify trends, and pinpoint areas of strength or weakness. Upon completion, learners will be able to transform raw financial data into actionable insights, enabling more effective planning, control, and strategic decision-making in a public sector context.

title: Revisiting Gender Equality through the Indian Spiritual Vision
desc: This course provides a profound re-examination of gender equality, moving beyond conventional social narratives to explore the theme through the Indian spiritual vision. It posits that Spirit is the one essential reality, and from this viewpoint, man and woman are understood as distinct but unified expressions of the same divine consciousness. The curriculum delves into key concepts such as the feminine principle of 'Shakti,' the historical status of women in Indian society, and how ancient wisdom can inform a new, progressive ideal for the future. Participants will be guided to reflect on the relationship between individual choice and collective responsibility, fostering an integral view of feminism that is rooted in Indian thought. Through a series of reflective questions and engagement with curated reference materials, learners will develop a nuanced appreciation for how cultural and spiritual frameworks shape our understanding of selfhood, gender, and social ideals. The course is designed to cultivate a deeper, more conscious perspective on equality and human evolution.

title: Reviving Yantra India Limited: Leading Change in PSU
desc: Yantra India Limited (YIL), formed in 2021 from eight Ordnance Factories, aimed to boost India’s defence manufacturing but faced major hurdles in its transition from a government setup to a corporate entity. With limited orders, a ₹1230 million loss, and low employee morale, the company struggled to stay afloat. The end of overtime pay, manpower shortages, and financial strain deepened challenges. YIL secured a small order from Indian Railways and credit from SBI but needed stronger momentum. Its leadership now faces critical choices—whether to expand exports, diversify products, or enhance customer ties—while motivating employees and balancing cost control with welfare to ensure long-term survival.

title: RF Coverage Planning
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the principles and practices of RF coverage planning. It is designed for professionals entering the telecommunications field, providing a practical walkthrough of planning a network from the ground up. The curriculum begins by explaining the role of specialized software and digital maps, including Digital Terrain Models and clutter classes, which are critical inputs for accurate simulations. Learners will observe how to place a virtual Base Transceiver Station (BTS) on a map, configure its technical parameters like antenna specifications, and run coverage predictions. The course demonstrates how to interpret these predictions, which are visualized using color-coded signal strength levels (in dBm), to assess network performance. Furthermore, it covers the iterative process of optimizing coverage by adjusting BTS locations or antenna orientations and recalculating the results. Upon completion, participants will grasp the core methodology for planning a greenfield network, enabling them to make informed decisions in real-world network rollout scenarios.

title: Right to Information (Prarambh)
desc: This foundational course delves into the critical aspects of the Right to Information (RTI) Act 2005, a landmark legislation for enhancing transparency in public administration. The content is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge to handle RTI applications effectively and in accordance with the law. The course begins by establishing the context of the RTI Act, explaining why transparency and accountability are vital for good governance. It then systematically covers the main features of the Act, detailing the rights of citizens, the obligations of public authorities, and the specific timelines for responding to information requests. A significant portion is dedicated to the practical procedures for Public Information Officers (PIOs), including the correct format for replies, reasons for denial, and the process of transferring applications as guided by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT). Furthermore, the course clarifies the RTI Rules 2012, covering application fees, formats, and the appeal process. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently navigate RTI procedures, ensuring lawful and timely information disclosure while upholding the principles of open governance.

title: Right to Information (RTI)
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005, which operationalizes the fundamental right to freedom of speech and expression. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of the Act's provisions and practical application. Key learning areas include the definition of 'information', 'public authority', and 'third party'; the step-by-step procedure for filing an information request; and the applicable fee structures. The course delves into the specific roles and responsibilities of Public Information Officers (PIOs), the process for disposing of requests, and the various provisions that exempt certain information from disclosure. Furthermore, it explains the complete appellate process available to citizens and details the penalties and disciplinary actions that can be imposed for non-compliance, ensuring a holistic understanding of the RTI framework.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Right to Information Act - Part 1
desc: This course, 'Foundations of the Right to Information Act, 2005 - Part 1,' serves as an essential guide for public functionaries. It delves into the core principles of the RTI Act, a pivotal tool for promoting transparency in government operations. The curriculum covers the fundamental aspects of the Act, including its scope, applicability, and the structure of the information-providing machinery, such as the roles of Public Information Officers (PIOs) and Appellate Authorities. Participants will learn the procedural requirements for responding to RTI applications, the prescribed timelines, and the categories of information that are exempt from disclosure. By the end of this course, learners will not only understand their legal obligations under the Act but also appreciate its significance in building a more informed and participative democracy. This knowledge is crucial for ensuring compliance, reducing administrative ambiguity, and upholding the principles of public accountability.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Right to Information Act - Part 2
desc: Building on the foundational principles of the Right to Information Act, 2005, this second part offers a detailed exploration of its operational and legal intricacies. The course is essential for government functionaries tasked with upholding the principles of transparency and accountability. It delves into the specific responsibilities and duties of Public Information Officers (PIOs) and First Appellate Authorities, providing a clear framework for processing information requests within the stipulated timelines. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of the categories of information exempt from disclosure under Sections 8 and 9 of the Act, the correct application of fees, and the procedural nuances of handling first and second appeals. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to manage RTI-related tasks with greater confidence, ensure full compliance with the Act, and contribute to a more open and responsive administrative culture.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Right to Information Act 2005
desc: The Right to Information Act of 2005 is a landmark legislation that empowers citizens by promoting transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority. This course is meticulously designed to provide a foundational understanding of this pivotal Act. It delves into the core principles, provisions, and operational mechanics of the RTI Act, ensuring that public functionaries are well-equipped to handle their responsibilities effectively. The curriculum focuses on the practical application of the law, highlighting the critical role and responsibilities of the Central Public Information Officer (CPIO). A key feature of this course is an in-depth case study that illustrates real-world scenarios, challenges, and best practices in RTI implementation. By the end of this course, learners will not only grasp the theoretical aspects of the Act but also understand its procedural nuances. This program is essential for all government officers and staff involved in processing RTI applications, aiming to enhance their capacity for timely and appropriate responsiveness, thereby strengthening the pillars of good governance.
org: National Academy Of Defence Financial Management (NADFM)

title: Right to Information and Personal Data: Transparency and Privacy
desc: This course provides a practical, case law–driven understanding of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, with a focus on the public interest test and key exemptions, including Section 8(1)(j). Participants will engage in hands-on exercises and real-world scenarios to develop legal reasoning skills for analyzing RTI applications. The course emphasizes the balance between privacy and transparency, helping learners distinguish personal information from information that warrants public disclosure. It also guides participants in applying legal principles to make informed and lawful decisions. By the end of the course, participants will be able to interpret and decide RTI cases confidently, accurately, and in accordance with legal standards.

title: Right To Information-RTI
desc: This introductory course offers a comprehensive overview of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005, a pivotal legislation empowering Indian citizens. The program is designed to demystify the Act's provisions for government officials and the general public alike. Participants will explore the historical context and objectives of the RTI Act, understanding its significance in containing corruption and enhancing governmental accountability. The curriculum covers the complete lifecycle of an RTI request, from drafting and filing an application (both online and offline) to the prescribed timelines for receiving a response. It clearly defines key terminologies such as 'Public Authority' and the crucial functions of a 'Public Information Officer' (PIO). Furthermore, the course elaborates on the categories of information that are exempted from disclosure, the rights of an applicant to inspect records, and the penalty provisions for non-compliance by officials. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the RTI process effectively, whether as an applicant seeking information or an official responsible for providing it.

title: Risk Assessment for Data Privacy and Information Security
desc:
This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Risk Assessment in the context of Information Security and Data Privacy Management. It introduces key concepts, terminology, and the importance of risk assessment under internationally recognized standards such as ISO 27001 and ISO 27701. The course guides participants through a structured, end-to-end risk assessment methodology, starting from establishing the organizational context to risk identification, analysis, evaluation, and treatment. It covers the systematic process of identifying information assets, mapping associated threats and vulnerabilities, and assessing their potential impact on organizational security. Participants will learn how to calculate Inherent Risk and Residual Risk using standard risk assessment formulas and evaluate appropriate risk treatment strategies, including mitigation, avoidance, transfer, and acceptance, based on defined risk thresholds.

Target Audience: Data Protection Officers (DPO)
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: RISK BASED INTERNAL AUDIT
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of Risk-Based Internal Audit (RBIA) as a modern and essential methodology for effective governance. It begins by differentiating RBIA from traditional internal audits, highlighting its focus on risk management rather than mere transaction verification. Participants will learn to identify and classify various organizational risks, such as strategic, operational, compliance, and reporting risks, and understand how to prioritize them based on potential impact. The course delves into the key components of audit risk, including inherent, control, and detection risks, providing a model for their assessment. Furthermore, it outlines the complete RBIA process, from understanding the entity and its environment to assessing risks, formulating a response, and developing a structured audit plan. By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply RBIA principles to provide assurance that significant risks are being managed effectively, thereby strengthening an organization's internal control framework and overall performance.

title: Risk Management
desc: In an era of increasing cyber threats, effective risk management is crucial for organizational resilience. This course offers a detailed exploration of the structured approach required to safeguard digital assets and information systems. Participants will begin by understanding the significance of risk management and its core terminologies, including assets, vulnerabilities, threats, and the concept of risk itself. The course then delves into the complete risk management process, covering risk assessment (identification, analysis, evaluation) and risk treatment (mitigation, transfer, acceptance, avoidance). Learners will gain insights into qualitative versus quantitative analysis and the importance of defining risk criteria. Furthermore, the course introduces key industry standards, ISO 31000 for enterprise risk management and the risk management components of ISO 27001 for information security management systems. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to contribute to their organization's security posture by applying a structured and proactive approach to managing cyber risks.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Risk Management in Infrastructure Projects
desc: In the domain of public works, managing large-scale infrastructure projects presents unique and significant challenges. This course, 'Effective Risk Management for Infrastructure Projects,' is designed to equip government officials and project managers with the essential competencies to navigate this complex landscape. The curriculum provides a structured approach to risk management, starting from the initial identification of potential financial, operational, and environmental risks, to their systematic assessment based on probability and impact. Participants will explore a variety of proven strategies and tools for risk mitigation, contingency planning, and continuous monitoring throughout the project lifecycle.  By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply a robust risk management framework to their projects, ensuring better decision-making, safeguarding public investment, and improving the overall resilience and success of critical infrastructure development.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Risk Management in Infrastructure Projects
desc: In the domain of public works, managing large-scale infrastructure projects presents unique and significant challenges. This course, 'Effective Risk Management for Infrastructure Projects,' is designed to equip government officials and project managers with the essential competencies to navigate this complex landscape. The curriculum provides a structured approach to risk management, starting from the initial identification of potential financial, operational, and environmental risks, to their systematic assessment based on probability and impact. Participants will explore a variety of proven strategies and tools for risk mitigation, contingency planning, and continuous monitoring throughout the project lifecycle. By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply a robust risk management framework to their projects, ensuring better decision-making, safeguarding public investment, and improving the overall resilience and success of critical infrastructure development.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Risk Mitigation in Public Infrastructure Projects: Rewa Solar Plants
desc: The case of the Rewa Solar Project (RUMSL) highlights the innovative public-private partnership model led by IAS Manu Srivastava, overcoming challenges like financing without viable gap funding, land acquisition, and procurer identification to ensure project success and risk mitigation.

title: River and Wetlands
desc: This foundational course delves into the critical importance of aquatic systems for environmental balance and human well-being. It begins by establishing the context of the hydrosphere and the journey of water, providing a solid understanding of how rivers and wetlands function. The curriculum specifically covers the definition, types, and geographical distribution of wetlands in India, highlighting their ecological and economic value. Learners will explore compelling reasons for wetland conservation and be introduced to systematic approaches for effective management, including policy frameworks and planning strategies. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the fundamental knowledge required to appreciate the complexity of these ecosystems and contribute to their preservation and sustainable use in a public sector context.

title: Road Safety Scenario and Road Accidents Mitigation Measures by MoRTH
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of road safety engineering, focusing on the critical practice of Road Safety Audits (RSA) as a proactive tool for accident prevention. Grounded in the official 'Manual on Road Safety Audit' (IRC:SP:88-2019), the curriculum is designed for professionals involved in the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of road infrastructure. Learners will understand the context of India's road safety challenges and the role of engineering in reducing road trauma. The course details the five key stages of a road safety audit: feasibility, detailed design, construction, pre-opening, and auditing of existing roads. Participants will be guided through the entire audit process, from team selection and commencement meetings to site inspections and report writing.

title: Road Safety Scenario and Road Accidents Mitigation Measures by MoRTH
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of road safety engineering, focusing on the critical practice of Road Safety Audits (RSA) as a proactive tool for accident prevention. Grounded in the official 'Manual on Road Safety Audit' (IRC:SP:88-2019), the curriculum is designed for professionals involved in the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of road infrastructure. Learners will understand the context of India's road safety challenges and the role of engineering in reducing road trauma. The course details the five key stages of a road safety audit: feasibility, detailed design, construction, pre-opening, and auditing of existing roads. Participants will be guided through the entire audit process, from team selection and commencement meetings to site inspections and report writing. Key learning areas include the use of audit checklists, identifying roadside hazards, ensuring safety for vulnerable road users, and applying principles of safer road design for both rural and urban environments. Upon completion, learners will be able to systematically identify potential safety issues in road projects and recommend practical measures to create a safer, more forgiving road environment, contributing to the national goal of reducing road accidents.

title: Road Traffic Signs and Pavement Markings
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of road traffic signs and pavement markings as critical components of road safety and traffic management systems. It explains how various categories of signs and markings—regulatory, warning, and informatory—guide, warn, and regulate road users under different traffic and environmental conditions. The course emphasizes the principles governing the selection, design, placement, and maintenance of traffic control devices to ensure clear communication and safe road operations. It also highlights the importance of visibility, legibility, standardization, and retro-reflectivity in improving driver behaviour and enhancing overall road safety performance.
org: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

title: Robbery and Dacoity Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This comprehensive course provides an in-depth analysis of the offences of robbery and dacoity as codified in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. It is specifically designed to equip law enforcement officers, legal practitioners, and judicial officers with a clear understanding of the new legal framework. The curriculum systematically breaks down Sections 309 to 313 of the BNS, starting with the fundamental definitions of robbery and dacoity and highlighting the critical differences between them, as well as their distinction from theft and extortion. The course elaborates on the various punishments prescribed, including aggravated circumstances such as the use of deadly weapons or causing grievous hurt, which attract more severe penalties. It also covers related offences like attempting to commit robbery or dacoity and belonging to a gang of dacoits. By exploring the significant changes from the Indian Penal Code, 1860, this course ensures that learners can confidently interpret and apply these crucial provisions in their professional duties, fostering greater legal precision and upholding the rule of law.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Role and Application of Data Analytics in the Maritime Sector
desc: Dive into the digital transformation of the maritime world with this comprehensive course on data analytics. In an industry vital to global trade, the ability to make smarter, data-driven decisions is paramount. This course provides a thorough exploration of why data analytics is a critical force for change, driven by advancements in connectivity, sensor technology, and computational power. You will learn about the primary sources of maritime data, including AIS, onboard sensors, and cargo information. The curriculum focuses on four core application areas: optimizing vessel performance for fuel efficiency and predictive maintenance; creating smart ports to reduce turnaround times; enhancing maritime safety and security through collision avoidance and anomaly detection; and increasing supply chain visibility with predictive ETAs. Through real-world case studies like Maersk's Remote Container Management, you will see these concepts in action. By the end, you will understand not only the applications but also the challenges and future trends, such as autonomous vessels and decarbonization, that are shaping a modern, data-centric maritime sector.

title: Role and functions of DDRRR (UNMO STM 3.6)
desc: This course delves into the essential principles and operational functions of Disarmament, Demobilization, Repatriation, Reintegration, and Resettlement (DDRRR) as a cornerstone of modern peacekeeping. In an era of increasingly complex and protracted conflicts, understanding DDRRR is vital for anyone involved in peace and security operations. The module will break down the UN's integrated approach to DDR, explaining how it addresses conflict drivers and supports long-term stability. Participants will learn to identify the various stakeholders, from ex-combatants and armed groups to civilian communities and international partners. A key focus will be on the specific role of UN Military Observers (UNMOs) in supporting and monitoring these sensitive processes on the ground. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand the strategic importance of DDRRR in the broader context of international peace efforts and its practical application in post-conflict zones.
org: Centre of United Nations Peace Keeping

title: Role and Responsibility as part of Disaster Management Plan M-2 Hindi
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम आपदा प्रबंधन में एक मूलभूत प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करता है, जो विशेष रूप से एनटीपीसी जैसे बड़े संगठनों के कर्मचारियों के लिए तैयार किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि प्रत्येक कर्मचारी आपातकालीन स्थिति में अपनी भूमिका को समझे। इसमें आपदा प्रबंधन योजनाओं की संरचना, आपातकालीन अधिकारियों के कर्तव्य और संकट के दौरान संचार प्रोटोकॉल जैसे प्रमुख क्षेत्रों को शामिल किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी न केवल अपनी व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारियों को जानेंगे, बल्कि यह भी सीखेंगे कि मॉक ड्रिल की योजना और निष्पादन कैसे किया जाता है, जो प्रभावी तैयारी के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। पाठ्यक्रम के अंत तक, प्रतिभागी संगठनात्मक सुरक्षा ढांचे में सक्रिय रूप से योगदान करने, जोखिमों को कम करने और किसी भी आपात स्थिति के लिए एक समन्वित और कुशल प्रतिक्रिया सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Role of Aadhaar in DPI: Leveraging Digital Public Infrastructure
desc: Delve into the architecture and impact of Aadhaar, the world's largest biometric identity system. This course details Aadhaar's journey from its inception to becoming the cornerstone of India's digital transformation. You will learn about its key features, including the enrolment and authentication processes, and how it ensures uniqueness and security for every resident. The session explores Aadhaar's critical function in the 'JAM Trinity' (Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, Mobile), which has revolutionized financial inclusion and service delivery. Furthermore, the course examines the broader Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) ecosystem, highlighting how platforms like UPI, DigiLocker, and ONDC are built upon Aadhaar's identity layer. It also addresses the legal frameworks, privacy safeguards, and security compliances that govern the system, making it a robust and trusted public good. This course is essential for officials and professionals seeking to understand and leverage digital identity for effective public service delivery and data-driven governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Role of Anganwadi Functionaries and Officers and Use of Poshan Tracker
desc: This course is designed to equip public functionaries with the knowledge and tools required for the successful implementation of Mission Poshan 2.0. It begins by establishing the context of the Anganwadi Services Scheme and its critical importance in addressing maternal and child nutrition in India. Learners will gain a clear understanding of the defined roles and responsibilities of all key stakeholders, including Anganwadi Workers, Lady Supervisors, CDPOs, and District Magistrates, creating a clear accountability chain. A significant focus is placed on digital governance through an in-depth exploration of the Poshan Tracker application. The course covers its core features, various user modules, and how its dashboard and reports facilitate real-time monitoring and performance analysis. Furthermore, it explains the pivotal role of the District Nutrition Committee (DNC) in steering nutrition governance. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to leverage both administrative structures and digital innovations to strengthen the delivery and impact of nutrition services at the grassroots level.

title: Role of BBC
desc: This course is designed to equip BSNL executives with the knowledge and skills required to excel as a Bharat Fibre Business Champion (BBC). In the context of expanding India's nationwide telecommunication network, the BBC acts as a crucial link between BSNL and its FTTH partners. The curriculum delves into the specific functions of Telecom Infrastructure Providers (TIPs) and Local Cable Operators (LCOs), outlining their registration process and operational roles. Participants will learn about effective customer relationship management, fault clearance procedures, and strategies for growing the Bharat Fiber customer base. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to navigating BSNL's digital infrastructure, including the self-care portal, payment systems like E-pay and InstaPay, and monitoring apps. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to mentor partners, drive business growth, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, uninterrupted FTTH services to customers.

title: Role of CBIC in PM Gati Shakti for Logistics Efficiency
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the PM Gati Shakti mission, a transformative initiative aimed at reshaping India's infrastructure and trade landscape. It begins by establishing the context of the mission, its objectives, and its institutional structure. The primary focus is on the critical role of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) in achieving the mission's goals. Learners will delve into key areas where CBIC contributes, including the facilitation of faster approvals for logistics hubs like Inland Container Depots (ICDs) and Container Freight Stations (CFSs), the implementation of 'Ease of Doing Business' reforms, and the strategic use of technology such as ICEGATE for paperless trade. The course also covers significant trade facilitation measures like the Authorised Economic Operator (AEO) program, Direct Port Delivery (DPD), and 24x7 customs clearance, explaining how these initiatives reduce cargo dwell time and transaction costs. By completing this course, participants will gain a clear understanding of how CBIC's functions directly support national infrastructure development and contribute to making India a more competitive global trade partner.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Role of Cooperatives in Rural Development Women Empowerment
desc: This course explores the role of cooperatives in promoting rural development and women’s empowerment in India. It explains how cooperatives support rural communities by providing access to affordable credit, improved market linkages, and skill development opportunities, particularly for farmers and women entrepreneurs. The course also highlights the structure and functioning of cooperatives and their broader socio-economic impact on rural livelihoods. Through real-life case studies such as the Mann Deshi Mahila Bank and the Indian Cooperative Network for Women (ICNW), learners will understand how cooperative models contribute to financial inclusion, entrepreneurship, and sustainable community development.

title: Role of DoP in PM Gati Shakti
desc: This program is designed to familiarize Karmayogis with the PM Gati Shakti initiative and the integral part the Department of Posts (DoP) plays in its success. The course begins by explaining the vision, objectives, and institutional framework of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, highlighting its seven engines and six pillars for synchronized, holistic development. It then delves into the specific contributions of the DoP, including the mapping of over 1.6 lakh postal assets onto the NMP portal and the use of dedicated data layers for enhanced planning. Participants will receive a detailed walkthrough of the Post Office Asset Mapping Application, understanding the roles of different users—from divisional data makers to directorate-level approvers. The training also covers the functionalities of the NMP and DoP portals, demonstrating default tools and practical use cases for infrastructure planning, route optimization, and site suitability analysis. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to effectively utilize these digital tools, contributing to the modernization of the postal network and improving logistics efficiency across the nation.

title: Role of Government Directors of CPSEs and Independent Directors
desc: This course offers essential insights into the framework of corporate governance that underpins Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs). It is designed for current and aspiring directors to understand the critical functions they perform. The curriculum delves into the specific duties of Government Directors and Independent Directors, highlighting their contribution to strategic oversight and regulatory compliance. Key learning areas include the composition of the Board of Directors (BOD), restrictions on committee memberships as per DPE guidelines, and the legal and ethical obligations of board members. By exploring these topics, learners will be better prepared to navigate complex regulatory environments, uphold high standards of integrity, and contribute to effective board management, ultimately driving the success and public accountability of CPSEs.

title: Role of Inquiry Officer in Disciplinary Proceedings (Hindi)
desc: सरकारी प्रशासन में सत्यनिष्ठा और जवाबदेही बनाए रखने के लिए अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रिया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से जांच अधिकारियों को उनकी भूमिकाओं और जिम्मेदारियों को समझने में मदद करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इसमें जांच प्रक्रिया की शुरुआत से लेकर अंतिम रिपोर्ट सौंपने तक के सभी महत्वपूर्ण चरणों को शामिल किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी सीखेंगे कि आरोप पत्र का विश्लेषण कैसे करें, गवाहों से पूछताछ कैसे करें, और दस्तावेजी साक्ष्यों का मूल्यांकन कैसे करें। पाठ्यक्रम प्राकृतिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों, जैसे निष्पक्ष सुनवाई का अवसर और पूर्वाग्रह के खिलाफ नियम, पर विशेष जोर देता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, अधिकारी किसी भी विभागीय जांच को आत्मविश्वास और प्रक्रियात्मक सटीकता के साथ संचालित करने में सक्षम होंगे, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि निर्णय निष्पक्ष, न्यायसंगत और कानूनी रूप से सुदृढ़ हों।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Role of International Telecommunication Union in Global Spectrum
desc: Gain an in-depth understanding of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), the United Nations' specialized agency for information and communication technologies. This course details the mission, vision, and framework of the ITU, providing critical insights into its function as a global regulatory and standardization body. You will learn about the distinct yet interconnected roles of its three sectors: the Radiocommunication Sector (ITU-R), which manages the global radio-frequency spectrum; the Telecommunication Standardization Sector (ITU-T), which develops technical standards; and the Telecommunication Development Sector (ITU-D), which works to expand access in developing nations. The course specifically explores the history, milestones, and strategic importance of the ITU-R. It examines how this sector's work in spectrum harmonization and policy development enables technological progress and addresses global challenges, including broadband expansion, disaster risk reduction, and climate change mitigation. Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze the ITU's impact on international collaboration and its role in shaping the future of global telecommunications.

title: Role of Liaison Officer in Reservation
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the functions of a Liaison Officer in the context of reservation policies. It begins by establishing the constitutional and legal basis for reservations and the mandate of the Liaison Officer. Learners will explore the core responsibilities, including the maintenance of reservation rosters, preparation and submission of statutory reports, and the process for de-reservation. The curriculum also covers the officer's role in monitoring the implementation of reservation policies, providing guidance to the administration, and acting as a point of contact for grievances from employees. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently execute their duties, ensure procedural correctness, and contribute to the effective and transparent implementation of reservation benefits for SC, ST, OBC, and other specified categories.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Role of Mail Motor Service in Mail Transmission
desc: Delve into the essential operations of the Indian Postal Department with this detailed course on the Mail Motor Service (MMS). This program is designed to illuminate the pivotal role MMS plays in connecting over 1.5 lakh post offices and ensuring the seamless flow of mail across India. The course begins by establishing the context of MMS within India Post's history and its evolution into a modern logistics unit. Key learning areas include a thorough examination of the primary functions of MMS, which extend beyond mail delivery to include transporting cash, departmental stationery, and providing bulk mail pickup services. You will learn about the different modes of transmission, including the integration of MMS with Railway Mail Service (RMS) and Air Mail, and the strategic use of the Road Transport Network (RTN). The curriculum walks through the step-by-step operational processes, from mail bag collection at post offices to sorting at mail offices and final delivery. By completing this course, learners will gain a deep appreciation for the complex logistics that underpin the postal service and the critical contribution of MMS to its efficiency and reliability.

title: Role of Official Languages Wing in Legislative Drafting
desc: This course provides participants with a comprehensive understanding of the functions and significance of the Official Languages Wing (OLW) in the legislative drafting process. It highlights the Wing’s vital role in ensuring uniformity, linguistic accuracy, and legal precision across multiple languages used in official legislation. Participants will learn how the OLW contributes to the development and maintenance of standard legal terminology, preparation of authoritative Hindi texts of principal and subordinate legislation, and coordination of translations of Central Acts, Ordinances, and Regulations into State official languages through the Regional Languages Unit. Through practical insights and case-based learning, this course emphasizes how linguistic and legal alignment across languages upholds legislative integrity and facilitates consistent interpretation of laws throughout the country.

title: Role of Shor's Algorithm in  Post Quantum Cryptography
desc: This course explores Shor’s algorithm, a quantum computing breakthrough that threatens classical public key cryptosystems like RSA, Diffie-Hellman, and ECC. By efficiently factoring large integers and solving discrete logarithms, Shor’s algorithm exposes the vulnerabilities in today’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). The course highlights the urgency of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), which leverages quantum-resistant algorithms to secure digital communications, authentication, and data integrity against future quantum attacks. Learners will understand how Shor’s algorithm drives global research, standardization, and migration strategies for PQC, ensuring trust and security in the quantum era.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Role of the Principal Accounts Office in the National Pension System
desc: This course is designed to equip government finance and accounts officials with a thorough understanding of their functions under the National Pension System (NPS) and NPS-Lite. The curriculum provides essential context on why robust pension management is critical for public financial governance. Learners will explore the key entities involved, including the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA) and Trustee Bank, and their interactions with the Principal Accounts Office (Pr. AO). Key learning areas include the detailed processes for fund flow, contribution management, reconciliation, and compliance. Participants will learn how to navigate the different account structures (Tier-I and Tier-II) and apply best practices for data verification and stakeholder coordination. Upon completion, officials will be better prepared to perform their duties efficiently, ensuring timely and accurate pension fund operations while upholding the principles of transparency and accountability.

title: Roles and Competencies of Branch Officers
desc: This comprehensive course equips Branch Officers in the Central Secretariat with the crucial behavioural and leadership skills needed to excel in their roles. The curriculum delves into the core responsibilities of a Branch Officer, highlighting the behavioural traits that define effective leadership within the government framework. Participants will explore how attributes like sound judgment, team management, and clear communication directly impact departmental operations and team morale. Through the analysis of practical, real-life scenarios, learners will gain a clear understanding of how to apply these competencies in their day-to-day duties. The course also provides valuable information on the various training programs and support systems available, empowering officers to pursue continuous professional development. By completing this course, participants will be better prepared to lead their teams with confidence and drive departmental success.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Roles and Functions of Quasi-Judicial Authorities under Labour Laws
desc: This course is designed for officials who exercise or will exercise quasi-judicial powers, particularly within the domain of labour law. It establishes a strong foundation by explaining the concept of the quasi-judicial process and its significance in the legal and regulatory landscape. The curriculum delves into the core principles of natural justice, which are paramount for fair decision-making, and clearly differentiates between judicial and quasi-judicial proceedings. Key learning areas include understanding the legislative intent behind key legal provisions, the specific roles and responsibilities of quasi-judicial authorities, and the procedural steps required to handle matters effectively. By completing this course, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to interpret legislation correctly, apply procedural fairness, and confidently exercise their authority in compliance with legal standards, thereby strengthening the integrity of administrative justice in the labour sector.
org: V V Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) - Noida

title: Roles and Responsibilities as part of Disaster Management Plan
desc: In any large organization, a well-defined Disaster Management Plan is crucial for ensuring the safety of personnel and the continuity of operations during a crisis. This course addresses the critical need for clarity by detailing the specific roles and responsibilities that individuals must undertake in an emergency. It provides a structured framework for understanding how to effectively respond when a crisis occurs, moving beyond theoretical knowledge to practical application. The curriculum is designed to equip learners with a thorough understanding of emergency preparedness protocols. Key learning areas include the precise definition of duties for all designated personnel, the step-by-step procedures for executing mock drills with accuracy, and the best practices for supervising employees during a critical event. Furthermore, the course covers the essential processes for distributing, communicating, and regularly reviewing the onsite emergency plan to maintain its relevance and effectiveness. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in their designated emergency functions and capable of contributing to a culture of safety and preparedness. They will be able to confidently execute their responsibilities, guide their colleagues, and ensure that the organization's disaster response is swift, coordinated, and effective, thereby minimizing risk and protecting valuable assets.

title: Roles and Responsibilities in Data Protection and Privacy in Design
desc: Dive deep into the legal intricacies of India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the law's impact on data governance for public and private sector organizations. You will learn the fundamental context of why this law is crucial, exploring the balance between protecting individual privacy and fostering innovation. The curriculum covers key learning areas including the definitions of personal data, the obligations of data fiduciaries, and the mechanisms for consent management, data breach notifications, and cross-border data transfers. Participants will also analyze the rights granted to data principals and the tiered grievance redressal process established by the Act. By understanding these components and comparing them with global standards like GDPR, you will be prepared to develop and implement robust data protection strategies, ensuring your organization's compliance and building trust with stakeholders.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Roles and Responsibilities of Technology Vertical of DoT LSAs Part 1
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the operational and regulatory functions of the Technology Vertical within the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) Licensed Service Areas (LSAs). It is designed to provide government officials with a clear understanding of their mandate in ensuring a secure, compliant, and efficient telecom ecosystem. The curriculum is structured around the official charter of duties, detailing the processes for conducting thorough inspections of Telecom Service Providers (TSPs), National Long Distance (NLD), International Long Distance (ILD), and Internet Service Providers (ISPs). Key learning areas include the verification of technical and security parameters, management of interconnect exchanges, ensuring time synchronization across networks, and implementing disaster management protocols. The course also covers recently added responsibilities such as the signing of ISP license agreements, surveillance for MTCTE, and facilitating the PM-WANI framework. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently execute their inspection and oversight duties, understand the legal and procedural requirements of telecom licensing, and contribute effectively to national initiatives like IPv6 implementation and improving the country's ICT development index. This program is essential for personnel involved in the technical governance and regulation of India's telecommunications sector.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Roles and Responsibilities of the Stakeholders under PM GatiShakti
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the operational framework of the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan (NMP) and the roles and responsibilities of stakeholders involved in its implementation. It covers the Compendium for Roles & Responsibilities issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), with a focus on the functions of Central Ministries, States/UTs, and other key stakeholders. The course explains the governance structure of PM GatiShakti, the role of the National Master Plan portal in data integration and visualization, and the importance of inter-agency coordination for synchronized planning and execution.
