It also highlights how the GatiShakti framework seeks to break departmental silos, improve infrastructure planning, reduce logistical inefficiencies, minimize project delays, and strengthen accountability through coordinated decision-making and implementation.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: Roles and Responsibilities of the Stakeholders under PM GatiShakti
desc: This module delves into the operational framework of the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan, serving as an essential guide for all stakeholders involved in India's infrastructure sector. The course unpacks the 'Compendium for Roles & Responsibilities' released by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), clarifying the specific functions assigned to central ministries, states/UTs, and other key entities. The primary context is the national effort to break down departmental silos and foster a culture of synchronized planning and execution. Key learning areas include understanding the governance structure of the GatiShakti plan, the importance of the National Master Plan portal for data integration, and the mechanisms for inter-agency coordination. By completing this course, learners will be able to appreciate how their role contributes to the larger objectives of reducing project delays, optimizing resource allocation, and enhancing the overall efficiency of infrastructure development. This knowledge is critical for officials to align their departmental projects with the national vision, leading to faster, more sustainable, and cost-effective outcomes.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

title: Roles of Secretarial Staff in Central Secretariat
desc: This foundational course delves into the critical functions performed by secretarial staff, who form the backbone of the Central Secretariat's administrative machinery. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear and detailed explanation of the day-to-day responsibilities and procedural requirements inherent in these roles. Key learning areas include the proper management of files and official records (DAK), the protocols for noting and drafting various types of official communications, and an understanding of the hierarchical structure and workflow within the secretariat. The course emphasizes the importance of precision, timeliness, and adherence to established government procedures. By completing this program, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge to perform their duties effectively, ensuring seamless administrative support and contributing to the overall efficiency and integrity of public service delivery. It serves as an essential guide for navigating the administrative landscape of the Central Secretariat with confidence and competence.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

desc: This foundational course delves into the critical functions performed by secretarial staff, who form the backbone of the Central Secretariat's administrative machinery. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear and detailed explanation of the day-to-day responsibilities and procedural requirements inherent in these roles. Key learning areas include the proper management of files and official records (DAK), the protocols for noting and drafting various types of official communications, and an understanding of the hierarchical structure and workflow within the secretariat. org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Roles Principles and Privacy by Design in Data Protection
desc: In an increasingly data-driven world, understanding the legal framework for data protection is crucial for public officials. This course offers a detailed examination of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, establishing a strong foundation in legal compliance and ethical data management. The curriculum delves into the fundamental principles of the act, such as purpose limitation, data minimization, and accountability. It clarifies the specific roles and responsibilities of key stakeholders, including Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors, and outlines the rights of Data Principals. Learners will explore the practical application of 'Privacy by Design' and 'Privacy by Default' to build secure and transparent digital systems. The course also covers procedures for obtaining valid consent, handling data breaches, and navigating the grievance redressal mechanism. By comparing the DPDP Act with international standards like GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA, this course prepares participants to implement robust legal, technical, and organizational safeguards for data privacy.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Roof Top Solar Systems in DMRC including Working Principles
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the implementation and operation of rooftop solar systems within the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It begins by contextualizing the need for renewable energy in large transit networks, highlighting DMRC's significant energy consumption and its innovative energy mix model. The curriculum delves deep into the technical aspects of solar power, explaining how solar radiation is converted into electrical energy through photovoltaic cells, PN junctions, and doping processes. Participants will learn about the critical components of a solar plant, including various types of solar modules like monocrystalline and polycrystalline, inverters, mounting structures, and cabling. The course provides a step-by-step guide to the installation process, covering safety protocols such as lifelines, structural stability, and electrical earthing. Furthermore, it addresses the importance of regulatory clearances, performance monitoring through Capacity Utilization Factor (CUF) and Performance Ratio (PR), and routine maintenance procedures to ensure optimal energy generation. By the end of the course, learners will have a thorough understanding of both the technical and strategic dimensions of deploying solar energy solutions in a major urban infrastructure project.

title: Rope Rescue Techniques and Improvisation-Disaster Response Training
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of rope rescue in disaster situations. It is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge required to assist in or conduct basic rescue operations safely. The curriculum begins by explaining the critical importance of ropes in rescue scenarios and defines key terminology. Participants will learn to identify different types of ropes and the specific equipment used in conjunction with them, emphasizing safety protocols at every stage. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to hands-on techniques, providing detailed instructions on how to create various knots, hitches, and bends, and explaining their distinct applications. The course also clarifies the supportive functions volunteers can undertake, ensuring a well-coordinated effort during emergencies. Upon completion, learners will have a solid understanding of rope rescue fundamentals, enabling them to act effectively and safely in disaster response.

title: Router Architecture And Connection
desc: This course offers a detailed introduction to the architecture and operation of network routers. It begins by defining a router's role within the OSI model's network layer and explains its critical function as a gateway for interconnecting different networks. You will delve into the internal workings of a router, exploring its main hardware components like the CPU and specialized memory types, and understanding the function of the Cisco Internetwork Operating System (IOS). The curriculum covers key router operations such as path determination, packet switching, and the application of security rules through Access Control Lists (ACLs). Furthermore, the course provides practical guidance on how to physically connect to a router using console and auxiliary ports for initial setup and management. Upon completion, learners will have a solid grasp of router fundamentals, enabling them to work with and configure these essential networking devices.

title: Router Initial Configuration
desc: This course offers a detailed, practical walkthrough of a router's initial setup, designed for individuals new to network administration. The curriculum begins by explaining the core function of a router as a device that interconnects distinct networks using IP addressing and subnet masks. Participants will learn why initial configuration is critical and how to establish a connection to a new router using a console cable and a terminal application. The course then demonstrates how to navigate the router's different operational modes, from the basic user mode to the privileged and global configuration modes, which are necessary for making system changes. Key learning areas include the process of assigning IP addresses to router interfaces, such as Gigabit Ethernet ports, and activating these ports using specific commands like 'no shutdown'. By the end of this course, learners will be able to confidently perform the basic configuration needed to bring a router online and prepare it for network traffic, verifying their setup using interface status commands.

title: RRI, PI and Electronic Interlocking
desc: Ensuring the safe and efficient movement of trains is paramount in railway operations. This course delves into the core technology that makes this possible: interlocking systems. It begins by establishing the context of interlocking as a vital safety arrangement that governs signals, points, and track sections to prevent accidents. Learners will journey through the evolution of this technology, from early mechanical systems to the sophisticated, microprocessor-based solutions used today. The course provides a detailed examination of Route Relay Interlocking (RRI), explaining its route-setting methodology and components. It then contrasts this with Panel Interlocking (PI), which is typically used in smaller yards and requires individual point operation. The curriculum culminates with an in-depth look at Electronic Interlocking (EI), highlighting its significant advantages, such as software-based logic, ease of modification for yard remodeling, and advanced self-diagnostic features. Upon completion, participants will have a solid foundational knowledge of how these systems function, enabling them to better contribute to the safety and efficiency of railway networks.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: RSA Algorithm, Tutorials and Use Cases on PKI and Digital Signatures
desc: This detailed module is designed to equip learners with a robust, practical understanding of the technologies that underpin digital trust and security. The course begins with a deep dive into the RSA algorithm, breaking down the steps of prime number selection, key pair generation, and the mathematical processes of encryption and decryption. It clarifies the distinct roles and applications of symmetric and asymmetric cryptography, providing a clear framework for when to use each. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the concept of hashing, demonstrating how algorithms like SHA-256 produce a unique message digest, ensuring data integrity. Learners will follow a step-by-step guide on creating and verifying digital signatures, a critical skill for authenticating documents and transactions in a digital environment. The course culminates in exploring real-world use cases, such as digitally signing official documents and files within an e-office portal. Upon completion, participants will not only grasp the theoretical concepts but also be able to apply them, making this course highly relevant for IT professionals, cybersecurity personnel, and public officials responsible for implementing and managing secure digital workflows.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: RTI And Good Governance
desc: In a democratic society, transparency and accountability are cornerstones of effective public administration. This course, ""Understanding the Right to Information Act and Good Governance,"" delves into the transformative impact of the RTI Act, 2005. It is designed for public officials who need to understand their obligations under the Act and for citizens who wish to leverage it for greater governmental transparency. The course begins by outlining the fundamental principles of good governance and how the RTI Act directly supports these ideals. Key learning areas include the procedural aspects of filing and responding to RTI requests, the roles and responsibilities of Public Information Officers (PIOs), and the legal framework governing information disclosure. Learners will analyze case studies demonstrating how RTI has been instrumental in exposing corruption and improving service delivery. Upon completion, participants will be able to effectively navigate the RTI process, appreciate its significance in reducing administrative opacity, and contribute to a more responsive and accountable governance system.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Rules and Procedure of Central Public Sector Enterprises
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the regulatory and operational framework for Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) in India. It is designed for officials seeking to build a robust understanding of the complex environment in which these enterprises function. The curriculum delves into the critical pillars of CPSE management, starting with corporate governance structures and personnel policies that shape the organizational framework. It then examines the mechanisms for ensuring accountability and transparency through vigilance policies and sound financial management. Participants will also learn about the strategic importance of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) system in linking performance with rewards, the role of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in creating social value, and the intricacies of public procurement procedures. By analyzing these core components, learners will be prepared to navigate the challenges of CPSE operations, drive efficiency, and implement best practices for ethical and compliant public sector management.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Rules and Regulations of Road Safety
desc: This course is designed to build comprehensive awareness of road safety. It establishes the context by explaining the critical importance of adhering to safety protocols to prevent accidents and save lives, a crucial aspect for personnel in public sector undertakings and field operations. Key learning areas include a detailed review of road infrastructure, official rules and regulations, the meaning of various traffic signs, and the correct use of vehicle safety devices. Participants will also learn about the common causes and severe consequences of road accidents. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these safety precautions in their daily commute and professional life, especially adhering to the specific requirements for vehicle movement on operational sites, thereby fostering a culture of safety and responsibility.

title: Rules and regulations of Road Safety Hindi)
desc: बढ़ते शहरीकरण और यातायात के साथ, सड़क सुरक्षा एक महत्वपूर्ण चिंता का विषय बन गई है। यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के पेशेवरों और आम नागरिकों को सड़क सुरक्षा के नियमों और विनियमों से अवगत कराने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इस पाठ्यक्रम में, आप सड़क सुरक्षा के मूल सिद्धांतों, यातायात संकेतों की पहचान और उनके अर्थ, तथा विभिन्न प्रकार के सुरक्षा उपकरणों के सही उपयोग के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में कार्यस्थल, जैसे कि एनटीपीसी साइट्स, और ऑफ-साइट दोनों पर वाहन आवाजाही के लिए आवश्यक सुरक्षा सावधानियों पर भी ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है। इस प्रशिक्षण को पूरा करने के बाद, आप सड़क पर संभावित खतरों का विश्लेषण करने और दुर्घटनाओं को कम करने के लिए सक्रिय कदम उठाने में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे न केवल आपकी बल्कि दूसरों की भी सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित होगी।

title: Rules Applying to Railway Servants Generally
desc: This foundational course is designed to familiarize every railway servant with the essential rules that govern their professional conduct and duties within the Indian Railways. In a complex and safety-critical environment, a shared understanding of these regulations is paramount for operational integrity, discipline, and public safety. The curriculum provides a detailed exploration of Chapter II of the General Rules, covering a wide range of topics critical for every employee. Key learning areas include the responsibility to know and maintain copies of the rules, protocols for attendance and absence from duty, and the absolute prohibition of alcohol or narcotics. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the railway servant's role in ensuring safety. This includes procedures for preventing trespass and damage to railway property, reporting defective equipment or tracks, and responding to unusual circumstances like explosions or severe weather. Learners will understand their obligation to be courteous, to assist the public, and to uphold the highest standards of conduct. Upon completion, railway servants will be equipped to perform their duties with a clear understanding of the legal and procedural framework, contributing to a safer, more reliable, and disciplined railway service for the nation.

title: Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI)
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the Rural Postal Life Insurance (RPLI) scheme, a pivotal initiative for extending financial security to rural India. The content begins by explaining the historical context and objectives of RPLI, emphasizing its role in financial inclusion as recommended by the Malhotra Committee. Learners will delve into the specifics of eligibility for rural residents and explore the diverse range of insurance products offered. The course systematically breaks down six main types of policies, including Whole Life Assurance (Gram Suraksha), Endowment Assurance (Gram Santosh), and specialized plans like Bal Jeevan Bima for children. Key features such as sum assured, premium, bonus, loan facilities, and surrender values are clearly explained for each policy. By the end of this course, participants will be able to compare the different RPLI policies, understand their benefits, and recognize their significance in providing a social safety net and promoting insurance awareness among the rural populace. This knowledge is crucial for officials involved in postal services, financial inclusion, and rural development.

title: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana  (SAGY)
desc: This detailed course is designed for officials tasked with the implementation of the Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY). It delves into the vision of creating 'Adarsh Grams' inspired by Mahatma Gandhi's ideal of self-reliant villages. The curriculum provides a step-by-step guide to the entire SAGY lifecycle, starting from the identification of a Gram Panchayat by a Member of Parliament to the final monitoring of development outcomes. Key learning areas include conducting environment creation and social mobilization activities, using Participatory Rural Appraisal (PRA) techniques for situation analysis, and formulating a robust Village Development Plan (VDP). The course emphasizes the critical strategy of converging resources from central and state schemes, using tools like the 'Samanvay' compendium. Learners will understand the roles of various stakeholders and the use of the 'Saanjhi' web portal for monitoring progress. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in facilitating a participatory, accountable, and holistic development process at the grassroots level.
org: NIRDPR National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj

title: SACFA Clearance
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Standing Advisory Committee on Radio Frequency Allocation (SACFA), the primary body for approving telecom and communication tower installations in India. The curriculum is designed to provide a thorough understanding of why efficient spectrum management is crucial for the nation's growing digital infrastructure. Participants will delve into the key functions of SACFA, including its committee structure, the different categories of clearance, and the eligibility criteria for applicants. The course will walk learners through the step-by-step approval procedures, with a special focus on the Saral Sanchar portal, which has digitized and simplified the application process. Furthermore, it will cover recent reforms, such as the integration with the NOCAS system, that have significantly reduced approval timelines. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the essential knowledge to navigate the SACFA clearance process, ensuring regulatory compliance and contributing to the seamless expansion of wireless services.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Sadharanikarana: Effective Communication for Transformative Leadership
desc: Embark on a journey to unlock your potential as a transformative leader with 'Sadharanikarana: The Art of Effective Communication'. This course delves into the ancient Indian science of communication, presenting it as a vital framework for contemporary public service leadership. You will learn why creating a shared emotional and intellectual space—a state of 'oneness'—is critical for aligning teams with strategic goals and fostering a culture of ownership and empowerment. The curriculum is structured across five modules, beginning with the essence of communication and progressing to the Sadharanikarana model, which emphasizes attentive, empathetic dialogue (Sakala, Sahridaya, Samvada). You will explore the 'Navarasa' (nine emotions) to cultivate deep self-awareness and understand how to channel emotions constructively. The course distinguishes between three levels of communication—transactional, empathetic, and transformative—and uses case studies to illustrate their effective application. By the end, you will be equipped with key practices to integrate Sadharanikarana into your daily interactions, enabling you to communicate with clarity, inspire sustained action, and lead transformative change in your professional environment.

title: Safe Handling of Ammunition During Storage and Transportation
desc: The safe management of ammunition and explosives is paramount for national security and the safety of personnel. Mishandling during storage or transport can lead to catastrophic incidents. This course addresses the critical need for standardized safety protocols across all agencies that handle these sensitive materials, from manufacturing to deployment. The curriculum is structured into three key modules. The first module details the protocols for safe storage, including proper stacking, environmental controls, building safety standards, and electrical fitting requirements. The second module focuses on transportation, covering vehicle specifications, driver instructions, security escorts, and procedures for loading and unloading. The final module provides in-depth knowledge of fire safety, including the classification of fire divisions, hazard identification, and the specific actions required for different types of explosive-related fires. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to apply rigorous safety standards in their daily operations. They will be able to identify and mitigate risks associated with ammunition handling, ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, and respond effectively to emergencies. This training is essential for creating a secure working environment and maintaining the integrity of defence and security logistics.
org: Ordnance Factories Institute of Learning Khamaria (Jabalpur)

title: Safe handling of electric equipment
desc: This comprehensive module is designed to equip personnel with the fundamental principles of electrical safety in the workplace. Understanding and mitigating electrical hazards is critical for preventing accidents, and this course provides the necessary foundation for anyone working with or around electrical equipment. The curriculum begins by defining key electrical dangers, including flashovers, sparks, electrocution, and shocks, and explains the severe injuries and damage that can result from an arc flash incident. Participants will learn to identify potential hazards and implement a range of control measures to mitigate them effectively. The course thoroughly covers essential precautions to be taken during the operation and maintenance of electrical systems. A significant portion of the module is dedicated to Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), detailing its importance, proper selection, and correct usage for various tasks. Upon completion, learners will be able to recognize the severity of electrical risks, apply appropriate safety protocols, and utilize PPE correctly, fostering a culture of safety and minimizing the risk of electrical accidents in their operational environment.

title: Safe handling of electric equipment (Hindi)
desc: विद्युत प्रणालियों के साथ काम करना स्वाभाविक रूप से जोखिम भरा होता है, और सुरक्षा प्रक्रियाओं की गहन समझ दुर्घटनाओं को रोकने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। यह पाठ्यक्रम बिजली से संबंधित खतरों की व्यापक समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी फ्लैशओवर और बिजली के झटके के कारणों, उनसे होने वाले नुकसान और उनकी गंभीरता को समझेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में उपकरणों के सुरक्षित संचालन और रखरखाव के लिए आवश्यक सावधानियों को शामिल किया गया है, जिसमें खतरे को नियंत्रित करने के practical उपाय भी शामिल हैं। एक प्रमुख enfoque व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरणों (पीपीई) के उचित चयन और उपयोग पर है, जो बिजली के खतरों के खिलाफ रक्षा की अंतिम पंक्ति है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने के बाद, प्रतिभागी विद्युत उपकरणों को सुरक्षित रूप से संभालने और एक सुरक्षित कार्य वातावरण बनाए रखने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से सुसज्जित होंगे।

title: Safe practices while doing excavation
desc: Excavation is a fundamental yet high-risk activity in construction and infrastructure projects. This course is designed to provide essential knowledge on managing these risks effectively. It addresses the critical need for safety awareness and regulatory compliance to protect workers and the public. The curriculum offers an in-depth exploration of the entire excavation process, starting with site assessment and planning. Key learning areas include identifying potential hazards such as soil instability, underground utilities, and atmospheric dangers in confined spaces. The course thoroughly covers the required safety protocols, including the use of shoring, sloping, and shielding systems, as well as the importance of regular site inspections and emergency response planning. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply industry best practices and adhere to safety regulations governing excavation. They will be capable of conducting pre-excavation checks, implementing appropriate protective measures, and fostering a safer working environment, thereby minimizing accidents and ensuring project success.

title: Safe procedure for Works to be done at heights.
desc: Working at height is a high-risk activity common in sectors like construction, power, and maintenance. This course is designed to equip personnel with the fundamental principles of height safety. It provides a comprehensive overview of what constitutes 'work at height,' defined as any task where a fall from over 1.8 meters is possible. The curriculum covers hazard identification, risk assessment, and the implementation of control measures. Learners will explore the correct procedures for using safety equipment, including personal protective equipment (PPE), ladders, and temporary structures like scaffolding. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently apply safety protocols, contribute to a safer work culture, and effectively mitigate the risks of accidents in elevated positions.

title: Safe procedure for Works to be done at heights. (Hindi)
desc: ऊंचाई पर काम करना कई औद्योगिक क्षेत्रों में एक उच्च जोखिम वाली गतिविधि है, जिसमें गिरने और गंभीर चोट लगने की काफी संभावना होती है। यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से इन जोखिमों को कम करने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान और कौशल प्रदान करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। यह 'ऊंचाई पर काम' की परिभाषा से शुरू होता है, जो 1.8 मीटर से अधिक की संभावित गिरावट दूरी वाले किसी भी कार्य को कवर करता है। शिक्षार्थी सीढ़ी, मचान, और छतों जैसे विभिन्न परिदृश्यों में खतरों की पहचान करने, जोखिमों का मूल्यांकन करने और नियंत्रण उपायों को लागू करने के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में गिरने से सुरक्षा प्रणालियों, गार्डरेल्स और सुरक्षा जालों सहित सही सुरक्षा उपकरणों के चयन और उपयोग पर जोर दिया गया है। प्रतिभागी न केवल तकनीकी प्रक्रियाओं को समझेंगे, बल्कि कार्यस्थल पर सुरक्षा की संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देने के महत्व को भी जानेंगे, जिससे दुर्घटनाओं को रोका जा सके और सभी के लिए एक सुरक्षित कामकाजी माहौल सुनिश्चित हो सके।

title: Safe Reuse of Treated Wastewater in Mumbai
desc:
Mumbai faces growing water stress despite access to multiple sources. Despite access to multiple water sources, the city’s aging infrastructure, high leakage rates, inadequate storage, and erratic rainfall exacerbated by climate change have resulted in significant stress on its water systems. The water demand increases in such circumstances with growing population. 
The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation has adopted a multi-pronged strategy. It aims to recycle 50% of treated wastewater and has upgraded seven sewage treatment plants to support reuse. It is also investing in supply projects like Gargai and Damanganga–Pinjal.  To operationalise the vision, BMC undertook the upgrade of seven major Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs) to facilitate high-quality recycling of wastewater for both potable and non-potable purposes. The case situates BMC at a pivotal policy crossroads. Should BMC proceed with blending recycled wastewater into the potable supply or be limited to non-potable usage?

title: Safe Transportation of Explosives and Ammunition by Road
desc: This course is designed to equip personnel with the knowledge and skills required for the safe and compliant road transport of explosives and ammunition. The curriculum delves into the specific definitions of explosives, the constructional details of specialized transport vehicles, and the mandatory features they must possess. Participants will learn to apply the rules for mixing compatibility groups and adhere to strict quantity restrictions. The course thoroughly covers security protocols, administrative arrangements, and safety precautions for all stages of transportation, including loading and unloading. Furthermore, it provides vital instruction on recognizing hazard division symbols, actions to be taken in case of fire or other emergencies, and the specific duties of drivers and escorts.

title: Safeguarding Defence Finance Through Forensic Accounting
desc: This foundational course explores the strategic role of defence finance in India’s national security and introduces forensic accounting as a critical tool for ensuring financial integrity. It examines how defence spending addresses threats from China and Pakistan, the strategic significance of the Indian Ocean Region, and the importance of technological superiority. Participants will understand why traditional auditing methods are often inadequate in defence contexts and how forensic accounting techniques help detect deception, corruption, and fraud. The course provides a framework for applying investigative financial methods to safeguard public funds and enhance transparency within defence institutions.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Safeguarding India's Digital Assets
desc: With the increasing frequency of sophisticated cyberattacks on critical sectors, robust digital security is no longer optional but a national imperative. This course delves into the foundational frameworks required to protect India’s digital ecosystem. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including authentication, authorization, and privileged access management (PIM/PAM). The curriculum also covers the fundamentals of encryption and its vital role in data protection. Through the analysis of real-world case studies, such as the Stuxnet worm and the AIIMS ransomware attack, learners will explore systemic vulnerabilities and effective defense strategies like 'Defense in Depth'. Designed for government and public sector professionals, this course equips participants with the practical knowledge and policy insights needed to secure digital infrastructure, mitigate risks from human error and insider threats, and contribute to a safer digital India.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Safety in Industrial Workplaces
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip participants with the essential knowledge and practical skills required to maintain a safe industrial workplace. It begins by establishing the context of occupational safety, detailing the significant human and financial costs associated with industrial accidents and ill health. The curriculum then progresses through the core components of a robust safety management system. Key learning areas include the systematic processes for reporting and investigating incidents, implementing effective fire prevention and emergency response procedures, and understanding the principles of workplace ergonomics to mitigate physical strain and injury. Furthermore, the course provides critical guidance on the safe use of chains, ropes, and lifting tackles. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to identify hazards, assess risks, and apply control strategies, making them valuable assets in promoting a culture of safety, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring compliance with safety regulations. This course is ideal for safety officers, supervisors, and any personnel involved in industrial operations.
org: Yantra Institute of Technology and Management

title: Safety Measures and Train Planning During Non-Interlocked Working
desc: Non-Interlocking (NI) working is a critical and high-risk activity in railway train operations that requires meticulous planning, coordinated execution, and strict adherence to safety procedures. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of NI working, covering work planning and documentation, staff deployment, preparatory arrangements, and the real-time management of train movements, signal working, and Line Clear procedures during NI operations. It also covers the roles and responsibilities of key personnel, activities at critical posts, staff training, reporting of failures and abnormalities, and the issuance and implementation of CRS-approved SWR. By the end of the course, learners will be able to plan, execute, monitor, and safely complete NI work in accordance with prescribed procedures.

title: Safety measures while handling pesticides
desc: As a leading agricultural producer, India's reliance on pesticides is significant, but improper handling poses severe risks. This course is designed to equip agricultural professionals and spray operators with the knowledge and skills for safe pesticide management. It begins by introducing different types of pesticides, their toxicity levels, and their environmental and health impacts, supported by real-world case studies from India. The curriculum then delves into the principles of judicious application, guiding learners on how to select approved chemicals and read labels correctly. A significant portion is dedicated to the agrochemical lifecycle, covering safe storage, transportation, spill management, and container disposal. The course culminates with a detailed focus on Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), explaining its importance as mandated by law and offering practical, low-cost alternatives. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to handle pesticides responsibly, ensuring personal safety, protecting the environment, and contributing to sustainable agricultural practices.
org: National Institute of Plant Health Management (NIPHM)

title: Safety Precautions and Control Measures for Fire
desc: This foundational course on fire safety is designed to build essential knowledge for all public sector employees, particularly those in operational or industrial environments. The curriculum begins by defining what constitutes a fire and categorizes fires based on their source components, providing a critical framework for understanding how to combat them. Participants will delve into the significant hazards and detrimental effects that fires can have on personnel, infrastructure, and the environment. A major focus of the course is on proactive and reactive safety measures. It covers a wide range of fire prevention techniques, safety protocols, and best practices for controlling fire-related risks. Learners will gain a clear understanding of how to implement these measures in their daily work environment.

desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम अग्नि सुरक्षा के महत्वपूर्ण विषय पर एक विस्तृत मार्गदर्शिका है, जो सरकारी अधिकारियों और आम नागरिकों दोनों के लिए आवश्यक है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत आग के मूल सिद्धांतों से होती है, जिसमें इसके घटक और विभिन्न प्रकार की आग का वर्गीकरण शामिल है। यह आग से जुड़े संभावित खतरों और जोखिमों की पहचान करने के महत्व पर जोर देता है, जिससे एक सक्रिय सुरक्षा संस्कृति को बढ़ावा मिलता है। शिक्षार्थियों को आग की रोकथाम के लिए विभिन्न रणनीतियों, जैसे सुरक्षित भंडारण प्रथाओं और नियमित उपकरण रखरखाव, के बारे में गहराई से जानकारी मिलेगी। पाठ्यक्रम में आग लगने की स्थिति में अपनाए जाने वाले नियंत्रण उपायों और आपातकालीन प्रक्रियाओं को भी शामिल किया गया है, जिसमें अग्निशामक यंत्रों का सही उपयोग और निकासी की प्रक्रियाएं शामिल हैं। इस पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों को किसी भी आग से संबंधित आपात स्थिति से निपटने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान से सशक्त बनाना है, ताकि वे अपने और अपने आस-पास के लोगों के लिए एक सुरक्षित वातावरण सुनिश्चित कर सकें।

title: Safety procedures for work at Conveyor belts
desc: This module offers a comprehensive guide to safety procedures for working with and around conveyor belts, a critical component in many industrial environments such as power plants and manufacturing facilities. The course begins by breaking down the fundamental functions of various components within a conveyor system, providing a solid foundation for understanding its operation. A significant focus is placed on hazard identification and risk assessment, teaching learners how to proactively spot potential dangers, from pinch points to moving parts, and evaluate the level of risk involved. Participants will learn to adhere to established safety protocols, including lockout/tagout procedures, emergency stop mechanisms, and proper guarding. The curriculum also covers key aspects of safe maintenance activities to prevent accidents during servicing. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these safety principles directly to their work, contributing to a safer, more compliant, and efficient operational environment.

title: SAFETY, ACCIDENT PREVENTION AND DISASTER MANAGEMENT
desc: In the power distribution sector, ensuring safety is paramount to prevent accidents, protect personnel, and maintain the integrity of equipment. This course provides a comprehensive overview of safety management for Distribution Companies (DISCOMs). Learners will explore the fundamental principles of electrical safety, including the critical role of proper earthing in preventing accidents. The curriculum details essential safety requirements and precautions to be implemented at the workplace. Furthermore, the course covers emergency response procedures, such as administering first aid and artificial respiration, and the correct application of fire protection systems and extinguishers. It also introduces the framework of disaster management plans tailored for the power sector, equipping participants with the knowledge to mitigate risks and respond effectively to emergencies, ultimately contributing to a safer and more resilient power distribution network.

title: Salary Allowance and their Tax Implications
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the tax implications of salary allowances for employees in India. It is structured to provide clarity on a critical component of compensation and tax planning. The curriculum begins by defining allowances and perquisites, then systematically navigates through the three main categories of taxability: fully taxable, partially taxable, and fully exempt. Key learning areas include the specific rules and calculation methods for significant allowances like House Rent Allowance (HRA), Children's Education Allowance, and various special compensatory allowances. The course breaks down complex provisions of the Income Tax Act into four distinct modules, covering everything from basic dearness allowance to allowances for government officials and judges. Upon completion, learners will be able to accurately identify, classify, and apply the correct tax treatment to a wide range of salary allowances.

title: Sales Mastery on Postal Products
desc: Designed for postal employees and marketing professionals, this course offers a deep dive into the art and science of selling postal products. It begins by establishing a strong foundation in sales mastery, covering essential strategies, customer psychology, and the importance of a value-based approach. The curriculum then provides a detailed overview of the Indian Postal Department's service portfolio, with a special focus on high-revenue products such as Speed Post, Parcel Post, and international mail services. Learners will explore the entire customer lifecycle, from initial contact and prospecting to effective objection handling and closing sales. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to customer relationship management, including the process for onboarding and managing contractual clients through the 'Book Now, Pay Later' (BNPL) scheme and using the SAP CRM system for contract and account creation. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to drive revenue growth, build lasting customer relationships, and confidently represent the Department of Posts in a competitive market.

title: Salient Features of the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act
desc:
This course provides a structured overview of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), including its objectives, scope, and key provisions. It explains important definitions such as unlawful activity and terrorist act, along with provisions related to designation of individuals and organizations, investigation, and prosecution.
The course also covers the powers of authorities, procedural aspects, and the role of various agencies in enforcing the Act. By the end of the course, learners will understand how UAPA is applied in addressing unlawful and terrorist activities.

title: Sampling Procedure under NDPS Act
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the procedural framework governing the management of seized narcotic drugs and controlled substances. It is specifically designed for officers involved in the investigation and prosecution of narcotics-related offenses. The curriculum details the mandates of Section 52A of the NDPS Act and the NDPS (Seizure, Storage, Sampling, and Disposal) Rules, 2022. Key learning areas include the step-by-step procedures for recording, storing, sampling, and disposing of seized materials, along with the correct documentation formats required by law. The course uses practical scenarios and highlights key judicial pronouncements to build a strong understanding of legal standards and best practices. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in handling seized substances in a manner that ensures full compliance, maintains the integrity of evidence, and upholds the rule of law in NDPS investigations.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Sanchar VHR - Individual Login
desc: This e-learning course is designed to familiarize government officers with the functionalities of the Sanchar VHR Portal from an individual user's perspective. The primary context is to empower employees, particularly ITS officers, to manage their service-related information and requests digitally, promoting a paperless and efficient administrative environment. Key learning areas include a step-by-step walkthrough of updating personal, family, and career history details; the process for submitting and tracking various applications such as transfer requests, deputation requests, and No Objection Certificates (NOCs); and procedures for uploading and verifying critical documents like joining reports and promotion orders. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently and independently use the Sanchar VHR portal to maintain their service records, reducing dependency on administrative staff and ensuring their data is accurate and up-to-date.

title: Sanchar VHR Portal - Introduction
desc: This introductory course is designed to familiarize government officers with the Sanchar Vigilance & HR (VHR) Portal. The portal represents a significant step towards digitizing and streamlining critical administrative processes within the Department of Telecommunications. The curriculum provides a detailed overview of the portal's structure, objectives, and functionalities. Key learning areas include understanding the four primary user types—Vigilance units, Administration units, Nodal Officers, and Individual Officers—and their respective roles in processes like vigilance clearance, transfer requests, promotions, and departmental complaints. Participants will learn how the portal facilitates these HR activities online, thereby reducing time consumption and increasing overall efficiency. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to navigate the Sanchar VHR portal, understand its core modules, and appreciate its impact on making HR and vigilance administration more transparent and effective.

title: Sanction for Prosecution
desc: This course offers a deep dive into the legal and procedural aspects of 'sanction for prosecution,' a critical safeguard in the Indian legal system concerning public servants. It is designed for officials who navigate the complexities of vigilance and disciplinary proceedings. The curriculum begins by establishing the context and importance of sanction for prosecution, particularly in anti-corruption efforts. Learners will undertake a detailed study of Section 197 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973, and key provisions of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, to build a strong legal foundation. The course then moves to the practical application of this knowledge, detailing the meticulous process of compiling records, the exercise of authority during scrutiny, and the examination of components within a sanction order. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to handle cases requiring sanction with greater confidence, ensuring that all actions are procedurally correct, legally defensible, and contribute to the principles of good governance and accountability.

title: Sanitation Capacity Building Platform
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government functionaries with the core competencies required for managing sanitation initiatives. It delves into the critical aspects of capacity building, providing a comprehensive overview of the sanitation landscape in India, including rural and urban challenges. The curriculum covers the strategic planning of sanitation projects, understanding fecal sludge management (FSM), and the importance of Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) campaigns in driving behavioral change. Participants will learn how to leverage technology and data for effective monitoring and evaluation of program outcomes. By the end of this course, learners will be better prepared to contribute to the development and management of robust, scalable, and sustainable sanitation solutions that improve public health and environmental quality in their respective jurisdictions.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Sanitation Technologies
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the technologies driving modern sanitation. It begins by establishing the importance of sanitation for public health, environmental protection, and socio-economic development. You will delve into the different types of sanitation systems, from basic on-site solutions to advanced centralized treatment plants. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to Fecal Sludge Management (FSM), covering its collection, transportation, treatment, and safe disposal or reuse. The curriculum is designed to equip public officials and engineers with the knowledge to plan, implement, and manage effective sanitation projects. By the end of this course, you will be able to assess the suitability of various technologies for different contexts and contribute to the goals of national sanitation initiatives, ensuring sustainable and inclusive service delivery for all citizens.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Sankalpa Shakti: Timeless Lessons from Women Leaders
desc: Sankalpa Shakti is designed for civil service officers seeking to strengthen their leadership capabilities through the powerful examples of historical women leaders. This course delves into the lives of extraordinary thinkers, warriors, reformers, and institution-builders who shaped Indian history. It provides a unique lens to understand how they discovered their leadership voice, navigated immense challenges, and created lasting social impact. The core of the course is built around the Four Sankalpas of the Karmayogi Competency Model: Vikas (Development), Kartavya (Duty), Garv (Pride), and Ekta (Unity). You will explore how these principles were consistently embodied by these inspirational figures. By examining their stories, you will learn to recognize and apply timeless leadership qualities like courage, vision, and determination in your own professional context. This course is not just a historical overview; it is a call to action. It will inspire you to reflect on your own values and develop a personal plan to create Vikas, fulfill your Kartavya, instill Garv, and enable Ekta within your sphere of influence, ultimately empowering you to lead with greater purpose and resilience.

title: SAP-HR in DOP
desc: This e-learning course is designed to familiarize all cadres of the Department of Posts with the functionalities of the SAP-HR module. In the context of the department's CSI environment, this program provides comprehensive, step-by-step instructions for various employee-centric processes. Key learning areas include navigating the Employee Self-Service portal, submitting leave applications, generating salary statements, and requesting different types of advances such as LTC, TA, and Medical. Furthermore, the course covers the procedure for applying for interest-bearing loans like the Personal Computer and House Building Advance. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the SAP-HR platform to manage their administrative requests digitally, track application statuses, and access personal HR data, leading to greater autonomy and streamlined processes.

title: SARAS (REVENUE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM) : LICENSE FEE SECTION
desc: This course offers a detailed walkthrough of the SARAS portal, the pivotal Revenue Management System used by the Department of Telecommunications. It is designed for staff involved in the license fee (LF) section to build foundational knowledge and practical skills. The curriculum begins with an introduction to SARAS and its importance in the telecom licensing regime. Key learning areas include a deep dive into the user management module, explaining the 'maker' and 'checker' roles for process integrity. Participants will learn the step-by-step procedures for submitting quarterly and annual Adjusted Gross Revenue (AGR) statements, processing LF payments through various methods like online, offline, and demand draft, and managing the entire lifecycle of Bank Guarantees (BGs) from submission to release. The course also covers the grievance redressal mechanism within SARAS. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the SARAS platform for their day-to-day operational activities, contributing to more accurate and timely revenue management.

title: Sarbajanik Nitiyon ka Nirupan
desc: सार्वजनिक नीति निरूपण पर यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों को प्रभावी और कुशल नीतियां बनाने के लिए एक व्यापक मार्गदर्शिका प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। आज के जटिल शासन परिदृश्य में, साक्ष्य-आधारित नीति निर्माण सर्वोपरि है। यह पाठ्यक्रम नीति चक्र के विभिन्न चरणों पर प्रकाश डालता है, जिसमें समस्या की पहचान, एजेंडा-निर्धारण, विकल्प विश्लेषण, निर्णय लेना और कार्यान्वयन योजना शामिल है। प्रतिभागी नीति निर्माण में हितधारकों के विश्लेषण, लागत-लाभ मूल्यांकन और नैतिक विचारों के महत्व को समझेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों को ऐसे कौशल से लैस करना है जो उन्हें मजबूत, व्यावहारिक और नागरिक-केंद्रित नीतियों को डिजाइन करने में सक्षम बनाएगा। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी सार्वजनिक चुनौतियों का समाधान करने और सुशासन के लक्ष्यों में योगदान देने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से तैयार होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Satellite and Terrestrial Networks Integration for Ubiquitous Access
desc: This course provides a practical introduction to 6G Technology Strategies, focusing on the integration of Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) with Terrestrial Networks (TN) to achieve ubiquitous connectivity. Participants will understand why NTNs are essential for extending network coverage beyond traditional terrestrial infrastructure. The course covers the key components of NTNs, including High-Altitude Platform Stations (HAPS/HIBS) and satellite systems (LEO, MEO, and GSO), and explains how these platforms complement terrestrial 5G networks. Learners will also explore Direct-to-Device (D2D) communication, service categories such as Fixed-Satellite Service (FSS) and Mobile-Satellite Service (MSS), and the role of global and Indian NTN operators. By the end of the course, participants will have a clear understanding of NTN capabilities, its support for 5G-Advanced use cases, deployment status in India, and the challenges in delivering reliable satellite-based connectivity.

title: Satellite Communication Overview
desc: Dive into the world of satellite communication and understand its pivotal role in the global telecommunications landscape. This course begins with the core definition of satellite communication, tracing its history from Arthur C. Clarke's concept to the launch of the first geostationary satellites. You will learn about the architecture of a satellite system, including the functions of the space segment and earth stations, and the technical processes involved in transmitting and receiving signals via uplink and downlink paths. The course details the various frequency bands (C, Ku, Ka) and their specific applications. Furthermore, it explores the significant advantages of satellite communication, such as broad coverage and high reliability, especially in comparison to terrestrial methods. Finally, the content looks toward the future, discussing new drivers like LEO constellations, reusable rockets, and the integration of satellite technology into the 5G ecosystem and the Internet of Things (IoT), making it essential for anyone in the telecommunications field.

title: Satyam Case
desc: Delve into one of India's most significant corporate scandals with this detailed case study on the Satyam fraud of 2009. This course is designed for professionals seeking to understand the complexities of corporate governance failures and their far-reaching consequences. The curriculum systematically breaks down the context of the fraud, exploring the timeline of events, the key individuals involved, and the sophisticated techniques used to falsify financial records. It moves beyond the technical aspects to critically examine the ethical breakdowns and the roles of executives, auditors, and the board of directors. Learners will analyze the regulatory response, including the legal actions and reforms that were implemented to strengthen corporate governance in India. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped with valuable insights to identify red flags, appreciate the importance of transparency, and apply lessons learned to foster a culture of integrity and accountability within their own organizations.

title: Satyam: Case Study
desc: The Satyam Case Study offers an in-depth exploration of a landmark corporate fraud that exposed severe vulnerabilities in India's corporate governance landscape. This course delves into the specifics of the scandal, where founder Ramalinga Raju admitted to falsifying accounts by over $1.47 billion. It provides a structured analysis of the contributing factors, including the failure of independent directors, the complicity of auditors, and the inadequacy of internal control mechanisms. The curriculum is designed to provide crucial lessons for public sector officials and leaders. By examining this case, learners will understand the tangible consequences of unethical behavior and weak governance. The key takeaway is the imperative for robust monitoring systems, unwavering ethical leadership, and a culture of accountability to safeguard public and private enterprises from similar debacles, thereby reinforcing trust in the financial system.

title: Schemes for the Welfare of Scheduled Castes
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the various welfare schemes implemented by the Government of India for the upliftment of Scheduled Caste (SC) communities. It establishes the context of social justice and empowerment as a core tenet of governance, addressing historical disparities and promoting equal opportunities. The module is designed to equip learners with detailed knowledge of critical initiatives that span educational, economic, and social domains. Key learning areas include a thorough review of schemes such as the Scholarship for Higher Education for Young Achievers (SHREYAS), National Overseas Scholarship for SCs, and the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY). Additionally, it covers the legal frameworks supporting these efforts, including the implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights (PCR) Act, 1955, and the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.
org: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Schemes for welfare of Safai Karamcharis
desc: This module is designed to empower Safai Karamcharis by providing comprehensive awareness of the welfare schemes and initiatives established for their benefit and social upliftment. In the context of ongoing efforts to eradicate hazardous cleaning and manual scavenging, understanding these support systems is crucial for ensuring the dignity, safety, and economic stability of sanitation workers. The course begins by contextualizing the challenges faced by Safai Karamcharis in their daily work. It then provides a detailed exploration of three pivotal schemes: the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE), which promotes safe and mechanized sanitation practices; the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC), which offers financial assistance for alternative livelihoods; and the Self Employment Scheme for Rehabilitation of Manual Scavengers (SRMS), which supports their transition into new professions. Through clear explanations, infographics, and illustrative scenarios, learners will understand the specific objectives, eligibility requirements, and benefits of each scheme. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the knowledge to navigate these programs and secure the support they are entitled to, fostering a transition towards safer and more dignified employment opportunities.
org: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Schemes for welfare of transgender persons
desc: This course is designed to build awareness and understanding of the legal rights and welfare schemes available to transgender persons in India. It addresses the critical need for public officials to be well-versed in the legislative and programmatic frameworks that support this community. The curriculum delves into the landmark Transgender (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, and the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Rules, 2020, explaining their core objectives and provisions for non-discrimination and recognition. Learners will gain detailed insights into key government initiatives, including the SMILE (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) scheme, the role of the Transgender Welfare Board, and the functionalities of the National Portal for Transgender Persons. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to effectively disseminate information, facilitate access to entitlements, and contribute to the sensitive and just implementation of policies aimed at the empowerment and inclusion of the transgender community, fostering a more equitable society.
org: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: School Safety Beyond Structures: Planning and Mitigation
desc: Ensuring the safety of students and staff goes beyond the structural integrity of buildings. This course provides a deep dive into the critical area of non-structural safety, addressing risks posed by furniture, equipment, utilities, and even socio-economic factors. It is designed for school administrators and educators who are responsible for creating a secure learning environment. Key learning areas include conducting thorough school risk audits, applying effective mitigation strategies, and addressing cross-cutting issues like accessibility and bullying. Participants will be guided through the process of developing and assessing a comprehensive and inclusive School Disaster Management Plan (SDMP). Upon completion, learners will be empowered to proactively enhance school safety, ensuring their institution is not only prepared for disasters but is also a fundamentally safer place for daily activities.
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

title: School Safety: Hazard Risk Vulnerability Analysis
desc: Ensuring the safety and security of students is a paramount responsibility for any educational institution. This course is designed to build the capacity of school stakeholders in creating a resilient and secure learning environment. It provides a detailed walkthrough of the Hazard, Risk, Vulnerability, and Capacity Analysis (HRVCA) methodology, a systematic process for identifying and mitigating potential threats. Participants will explore key aspects of school safety, including structural integrity, non-structural risks, inclusive infrastructure for children with special needs, transport safety, and fire preparedness. The curriculum focuses on practical application, guiding learners on how to conduct thorough safety audits, analyze findings, and develop actionable mitigation plans. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the analytical tools and procedural knowledge to proactively manage risks and ensure compliance with safety standards, contributing to a culture of safety and preparedness within the school community.
org: National Institute of Disaster Management - NIDM

title: Science communication
desc: In an age of information overload, the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts clearly is essential. This comprehensive course is designed to equip scientists, researchers, and educators with the skills to translate their work for the public. Through a structured approach, participants will explore the fundamentals of science communication, from crafting compelling narratives to designing impactful visuals and leveraging social media for broader reach. The course emphasizes the importance of creating informed citizens capable of making evidence-based decisions, a cornerstone of effective governance. Learners will gain a deep understanding of the science communication landscape and acquire practical tools to share research compellingly, foster public discourse, and build trust in scientific evidence. Upon completion, graduates will be adept at creating and curating content that is not only informative but also inspiring, contributing to a more scientifically literate society and increasing the real-world impact of their research.

title: Science Diplomacy
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world facing complex global challenges, the integration of science and technology into foreign policy has become indispensable. This course offers a foundational understanding of Science Diplomacy, a critical field at the intersection of scientific advancement and international relations. It is designed for professionals seeking to grasp how scientific collaboration can be leveraged to build bridges between nations and inform effective policy-making. The curriculum begins by defining science diplomacy and tracing its historical evolution. Learners will delve into its core dimensions, distinguishing between 'science in diplomacy' (using scientific advice for policy), 'diplomacy for science' (facilitating international scientific cooperation), and 'science for diplomacy' (using science to improve international relations). The course also identifies the diverse array of stakeholders, including governments, multilateral institutions, research organizations, and the private sector. Participants will analyze the importance of science diplomacy in addressing global issues like climate change and public health, its specific relevance for the Global South, and its role in strengthening national Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) ecosystems. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to recognize and analyze the opportunities and limitations of using science as a tool in diplomatic engagement.

title: Scientific Packaging and Labelling and Sealing of Evidence
desc: This course covers the essential procedures for packaging, labelling, sealing, and handling different types of evidence in a structured and legally compliant manner. It provides a comprehensive understanding of best practices in evidence management and highlights common procedural errors that may compromise the integrity or admissibility of evidence in judicial proceedings. The course emphasizes the importance of maintaining a strict chain of custody at every stage—from collection, packaging, and documentation to transportation, storage, and presentation in court. It also explains how proper handling ensures that evidence remains intact, reliable, and legally defensible. Participants will gain practical knowledge of handling various types of evidence, including biological, trace, digital, and firearm-related exhibits.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Scope of Total Income
desc: This foundational course delves into the critical aspects of determining taxable income in India. It is designed to provide a clear and structured understanding of how 'Total Income' is computed under the Income Tax Act. The curriculum begins by establishing the basis of charge and defining key terms like 'Assessment Year' and 'Previous Year'. It then progresses through six detailed modules, covering the scope of total income for residents and non-residents, the classification of income under five distinct heads, and the provisions for clubbing income and aggregating incomes. Learners will also analyze the rules for setting off and carrying forward losses. The final module consolidates this knowledge by explaining the calculation of 'Gross Total Income' and the application of various deductions under Chapter VI-A and other exemptions. Upon completion, participants will be able to accurately interpret the provisions that govern the computation of total income, a vital skill for roles in finance, taxation, and public administration.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Scrap Disposal in Railways
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the critical function of scrap disposal management in the context of Indian Railways. It is designed to equip personnel with a thorough understanding of the entire lifecycle of railway scrap, from generation to revenue realization. The curriculum addresses the importance of this process for maintaining operational efficiency, ensuring safety, and optimizing financial returns. Key learning areas include the identification of various scrap types like condemned rolling stock and ferrous materials, the procedural use of Form DS-8 for tracking, and the systematic approach to scrap segregation and lot formation at depots. The course provides in-depth knowledge of disposal methods, with a special focus on e-auctions conducted through the IREPS platform. Learners will also understand the crucial role of survey committees in valuation and the security protocols managed by officials during delivery. Upon completion, participants will be proficient in applying these procedures to enhance transparency, maximize revenue, and support the sustainable objectives of Indian Railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: SDH Technology Introduction
desc: This introductory course delves into the essential concepts of Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH) technology. It begins by establishing the context for SDH, explaining its importance as a global standard for synchronous data transmission over fiber optic networks. The curriculum covers the key learning areas, including the fundamental architecture of SDH, its frame structure, and the intricate multiplexing hierarchy that allows various data rates to be combined and transported efficiently. Learners will be introduced to the primary network elements, such as regenerators, multiplexers, and cross-connects, and understand their specific functions within the network. Furthermore, the course will touch upon the critical aspects of network management, synchronization, and protection switching mechanisms that ensure the reliability and resilience of SDH systems. Upon completion, participants will have a solid understanding of SDH principles, preparing them for more advanced topics in optical networking and telecommunications.

title: Search and Seizure and Arrest under the Customs Act 1962
desc: This detailed course delves into the essential enforcement powers granted to Customs officers under Chapter XIII of the Customs Act, 1962. It is designed to equip officers with the necessary knowledge to conduct search, seizure, and arrest operations lawfully and effectively. The content covers the different types of searches—of persons, premises, and conveyances—and the scrupulous procedures that must be followed, including the option for a search before a gazetted officer or magistrate. Participants will learn about the process of seizing goods, documents, and means of transport, the conditions for confiscation, and the importance of issuing a Show Cause Notice within the statutory time limit. The module on arrest explains the legal basis under Section 104, the distinction between bailable and non-bailable offences, and the mandatory adherence to constitutional safeguards as established in the D.K. Basu guidelines.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Search and Seizure Procedures under the NDPS Act
desc: This course is specifically designed for law enforcement personnel to master the procedural intricacies of the NDPS Act. The content delves into the core legal framework governing search, seizure, and arrest in narcotics cases, highlighting the importance of procedural compliance for successful legal outcomes. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of Section 42, which empowers officers to conduct actions without a warrant based on prior intelligence. It also covers Section 50, which safeguards an individual's rights during personal searches, and Section 57, which mandates timely and detailed reporting to superior officers. By analyzing judicial pronouncements and common procedural lapses, this course equips officers with the practical knowledge to conduct investigations that are not only effective but also fully compliant with legal and judicial standards. Participants will learn to apply these procedures correctly, document their actions meticulously, and build stronger cases against offenders in the fight against drug trafficking.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Search, Seizure and Arrest under The Customs Act, 1962.
desc: This detailed course delves into the essential enforcement powers granted to Customs officers under Chapter XIII of the Customs Act, 1962. It is designed to equip officers with the necessary knowledge to conduct search, seizure, and arrest operations lawfully and effectively. The content covers the different types of searches—of persons, premises, and conveyances—and the scrupulous procedures that must be followed, including the option for a search before a gazetted officer or magistrate. Participants will learn about the process of seizing goods, documents, and means of transport, the conditions for confiscation, and the importance of issuing a Show Cause Notice within the statutory time limit. The module on arrest explains the legal basis under Section 104, the distinction between bailable and non-bailable offences, and the mandatory adherence to constitutional safeguards as established in the D.K. Basu guidelines. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply these enforcement provisions while upholding legal and procedural integrity.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Secondary Suspension System
desc: Dive into the engineering principles behind modern railway suspension with this focused course on secondary suspension systems. The content is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of why this system is vital for the safety and ride quality of passenger coaches and locomotives. You will learn about the two-stage suspension design and the specific functions of its components, including air springs, hydraulic shock absorbers, and levelling valves. The course explains the dynamic process of how the system automatically adjusts to changes in passenger load, ensuring the vehicle body remains stable and aligned with the platform. By the end of this session, learners will grasp the intricate workings of the secondary suspension and its integration with the broader brake and pneumatic systems, equipping them with the foundational knowledge required for maintenance and operational oversight in a railway environment.

title: Secretariat Functioning in File
desc: Gain a foundational understanding of the backbone of government administration with this detailed course on secretariat functioning. This program is specifically designed to clarify the intricate procedures involved in managing official files and correspondence within the governmental framework. You will learn the established protocols for file movement, the importance of accurate record-keeping, and the techniques for effective noting and drafting, which are crucial for clear communication and decision-making. The course delves into the practical aspects of administrative processes, explaining how systematic file management contributes to transparency and organizational efficiency. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in handling official documents, navigating administrative workflows, and applying the principles of good governance to your daily tasks, thereby enhancing your effectiveness in a public sector role.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Secure Coding Practices for Developers and Technical Teams
desc: Secure Coding Practices for Developers and Technical Teams is a comprehensive and systematic approach to writing software that proactively prevents security vulnerabilities during the development process. Instead of treating security as a post-development add-on, this approach integrates security into every phase of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—including design, architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance. This proactive methodology ensures that applications are built with security as a foundational principle rather than an afterthought. It equips development teams with technology-agnostic guidelines and industry best practices to prevent common and critical software vulnerabilities. The course is aligned with widely accepted standards such as the OWASP Secure Coding Practices Quick Reference Guide, which provides a structured checklist covering essential areas of application security.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Securing digital transformation and e-governance
desc: As India rapidly advances its digital infrastructure, securing e-governance platforms and citizen data has become a national priority. This course delves into the multifaceted world of cybersecurity, specifically tailored for the government sector. It begins by contextualizing the scale of digital transformation and the parallel growth of the cyber threat landscape, including nation-state attacks and cybercrime-as-a-service. You will learn to analyze the anatomy of common cyberattacks, such as social engineering, phishing, and ransomware, through real-world case studies. The curriculum emphasizes the 'People, Process, and Technology' framework, outlining a structured approach to building a resilient security posture. Key topics include the importance of regulatory compliance, proactive threat detection, 24/7 monitoring, automated incident response, and the strategic value of a Security Operations Center (SOC). By the end of this session, you will be better equipped to identify security gaps, evaluate solutions, and contribute to a more secure digital ecosystem within your organization.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Securing Digital Transformation: Building Resilient Cloud Architecture
desc: As public sector organizations increasingly migrate to the cloud, securing digital transformation has become paramount. This course provides a comprehensive overview of building and maintaining resilient cloud architectures tailored for government systems. It moves beyond traditional security approaches, emphasizing that security must be an inherent part of the entire cloud journey. You will learn about the core pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework, including operational excellence, security, and reliability. The curriculum delves into the practical application of the shared responsibility model, clarifying roles in securing the cloud infrastructure versus securing data and applications within it. Key learning areas cover implementing least-privilege access, establishing traceability, automating compliance checks, and protecting data both in transit and at rest. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to design, implement, and manage secure cloud environments that protect sensitive citizen data and ensure the continuity of critical public services.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Securing End User Devices in Government Departments
desc: In an era of increasing cyber threats, securing the end-user device is the last line of defense.
