Furthermore, the course explains the critical role of solar inverters in the energy conversion process and outlines the major components of a complete solar PV installation. Upon completion, learners will have a solid technical vocabulary and conceptual framework to understand the design, function, and application of solar energy systems.

title: Solar Energy its Need and Uses
desc: Embark on a journey to understand the power of the sun with this introductory course on solar energy. Designed for a broad audience, this program delves into why solar energy is crucial for India's energy security and environmental goals. You will explore the history of solar technology, the science behind photovoltaic cells, and the distinction between active and passive solar systems. The course covers a wide array of practical applications, from residential rooftop panels and agricultural water pumps to large-scale solar parks and space exploration. It also provides a balanced view by discussing the limitations and challenges of solar energy adoption, such as initial costs and weather dependency. A key focus is on the supportive policy landscape in India, with a detailed look at government initiatives like the 'PM Surya Ghar Free Electricity Scheme,' including its subsidy structures and benefits for citizens. By the end, learners will have a solid foundation in solar energy and its significance in the global transition to cleaner power.

title: Solar Photovoltaic Systems: Components and Performance Analysis
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, focusing on their essential components, configurations, and performance characteristics. It is designed to help learners understand how solar energy is converted into usable electricity and how different system elements work together to ensure efficient and reliable power generation. The course begins with an overview of PV module technologies, including monocrystalline, polycrystalline, thin-film, and bifacial modules, along with their efficiency, material properties, and performance considerations. It then explores key system components such as inverters, charge controllers, batteries, mounting structures, and protection devices, highlighting their roles in system safety, stability, and efficiency.

title: Sole Proprietor Accounts and Company Accounts.
desc: This comprehensive course offers a detailed introduction to the principles of financial accounting, tailored for both sole proprietorships and company structures. The curriculum begins by defining financial statements, outlining their objectives, and identifying their key users, from internal managers to external stakeholders like government bodies and banks. You will learn the step-by-step process of preparing these critical documents. The course covers the creation of a trading account to determine gross profit, the formulation of a profit and loss account to ascertain net profitability, and the construction of a balance sheet to present a snapshot of a company's assets and liabilities. Throughout the modules, the course highlights the specific formats, features, and elements pertinent to each type of financial statement. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to prepare and analyze fundamental financial reports, enabling them to make informed assessments of a business's performance and financial standing, a crucial skill in public finance and regulatory roles.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Solid Waste Management Rules 2026: An Overview
desc: This course offers a comprehensive walkthrough of the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, notified by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change and in force from 1st April 2026. The course explains the various provisions of the Rules, their applicability across urban and rural local bodies, and the duties assigned to every stakeholder such as waste generators, bulk waste generators, processing facility operators, local bodies, State Pollution Control Boards, and the Central Government. Learners will understand the shift toward source segregation, the Extended Bulk Waste Generator Responsibility (EBWGR) framework, the role of Material Recovery Facilities, restrictions on landfilling, the centralised online compliance portal, and the key regulatory deadlines that mark India's transition toward a circular economy in solid waste management.

title: Solid Waste Management under Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0
desc: This course provides an in-depth overview of Solid Waste Management within the framework of Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0, a transformative initiative for urban sanitation in India. The content is designed to explain why effective waste management is critical for public health and environmental sustainability in rapidly growing urban centers. Key learning areas include the evolution of the SBM-U mission, classification of solid waste, and a detailed breakdown of the management lifecycle: source segregation, collection, transportation, processing, and final disposal. The course also delves into advanced waste treatment technologies like composting, recycling, and waste-to-energy solutions. Furthermore, it highlights the collaborative effort required, outlining the roles of municipal bodies, private entities, and citizens. By completing this course, learners will be equipped with the foundational knowledge to understand and contribute to building cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable Indian cities.
org: Regional Centre for Urban and Environmental Studies (RCUES) Mumbai

title: SOP for handling claim cases arising out of loss and fraud cases
desc: This program offers detailed guidance on the official Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for handling public claims related to loss and fraud in postal services. The primary context is to ensure a transparent, uniform, and time-bound process for citizens seeking redressal, thereby enhancing public trust and accountability. Key learning areas include the step-by-step process for submitting and processing claims using the new standardized form, the specific documents required such as ID proofs and passbooks, and the critical timelines for each stage, from initial acceptance to final settlement. The course places significant emphasis on the revised financial sanctioning limits, clearly defining the powers delegated to various authorities like Divisional Heads, Chief Postmasters, and Regional Directors. It also covers special procedures for cases that require forensic examination. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply this SOP correctly, ensuring a seamless and claimant-friendly experience in line with departmental mandates.

title: SOTTO: Transforming Lives through Organ Transplantation in Gujarat
desc: The State Organ and Tissue Transplantation Organisation (SOTTO) in Gujarat, established in 2019, has transformed cadaver organ transplantation by ensuring ethical practices, transparency, and efficient coordination through its online platform, significantly improving life-saving outcomes.

title: Sources Of Finance
desc: This foundational course is designed to provide a detailed understanding of how companies and organizations fund their operations and growth. In today's economic landscape, a clear grasp of financial sources is crucial for ensuring sustainability and strategic expansion. The course begins by establishing the core concepts of corporate finance, systematically breaking down the various avenues for capital acquisition. Key learning areas will include a thorough examination of internal sources, such as retained earnings and the management of internal debt, versus external sources like equity financing and bank loans. Participants will learn to identify the critical factors that affect a company's ability to generate and retain profits for reinvestment. The course also sheds light on contemporary financing methods that have emerged with modern financial markets. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently differentiate between various financing options, analyze the implications of each, and understand the strategic considerations behind choosing an appropriate funding mix. This knowledge forms a critical building block for anyone involved in financial management, accounting, or corporate strategy.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: Sovereign AI and the Citizen of Bharat
desc: This course provides Karmayogis with a practical introduction to sovereign artificial intelligence (AI) and its importance for Bharat’s digital and governance ecosystem. It explains the concept of sovereign AI, the role of sovereignty in government AI deployment, and the key elements of India’s emerging sovereign AI stack. The course introduces the IndiaAI Mission and its five key pillars—Compute, Data, Models, Applications, and Governance—along with platforms and initiatives such as AIKosh, the IndiaAI Compute Portal, BHASHINI, the Unified AI Interface (UAI), and the India AI Governance Guidelines. It also explores Task-Specialised Models (TSMs) and explains how smaller, specialised AI models can support practical and secure departmental use cases. Learners will also understand the relevance of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act to AI deployment and explore a five-step approach for proposing sovereign AI solutions within their departments.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Sovereign Artificial Intelligence Models for India
desc: Embark on a journey to understand India's ambitious vision for establishing sovereignty in Artificial Intelligence. This course delves into the strategic framework guiding the nation's efforts to gain control over its AI future. You will explore the four critical pillars of this strategy: the creation of sovereign data repositories like AI Kosha, the development of indigenous models such as BharatGPT, the scaling of compute infrastructure through the IndiaAI mission, and the implementation of robust ethical governance. The content provides a comprehensive look at the technological landscape, differentiating between the roles of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the agility of Small Language Models (SLMs) for enterprise use. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of advanced techniques like Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and ensuring all developments align with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. By the end, you will have a clear understanding of the roadmap India is following to build an inclusive, secure, and globally competitive AI ecosystem by 2027.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Speaking Effectively
desc: In today's professional landscape, the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively is a critical skill for success. This course, "The Art of Speaking Effectively," is designed to transform participants into charismatic and confident communicators. It addresses the common fear of public speaking by providing structured, actionable techniques that can be applied in any context, from team meetings to high-stakes presentations. The curriculum is built around foundational frameworks. Learners will master the 'Purpose, Audience, Message' (PAM) model to prepare and tailor their communication for maximum impact. The course also revitalizes Aristotle's classic appeals—Logos (logic), Ethos (credibility), and Pathos (emotion)—teaching how to craft arguments that resonate and persuade. Furthermore, it covers the unspoken elements of communication, detailing the power of body language, vocal projection, pitch, and strategic pauses. By the end of this course, learners will be able to structure their ideas logically, engage diverse audiences, handle difficult conversations with empathy, and deliver memorable presentations. This program is ideal for public servants and professionals at all levels who wish to enhance their influence, build stronger relationships, and drive better outcomes through powerful communication.

title: Special Acts
desc: In an increasingly complex legal and digital environment, it is crucial for public servants to have a clear understanding of specialized laws that impact their work. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to various Special Acts, providing essential context on why these laws were enacted and their significance in contemporary governance. The curriculum will delve into the fundamental provisions of critical legislation, including the Information Technology Act, highlighting its role in cyber law and data governance. It will also cover the basics of Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), explaining concepts like copyrights and patents and their application within the public sector. By the end of this course, learners will be able to recognize the legal implications of their actions, make more informed decisions, and ensure their work aligns with key statutory requirements, thereby fostering a culture of legal compliance and administrative integrity.

title: Special Assessment of Search Cases under the New Income Tax Act 2025
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the Special Procedure for Assessment of Search Cases under the Income-Tax Act, 2025, applicable to searches initiated on or after 1 April 2026. It explains the new block assessment regime, including the computation of Total Undisclosed Income (TUI), determination of the block period, execution of search authorisations, evidentiary provisions, assessment timelines, tax treatment, penalties, immunity, and assessment of “other persons.” The course also examines abatement of pending proceedings, procedural safeguards, administrative approvals, and key judicial principles incorporated into the new law. The framework is analysed from the perspective of transparency, legal certainty, efficient tax administration, and effective enforcement against tax evasion.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Specialized Procurement: ICT and Refits and Banking
desc: This course provides an overview of specialised procurement procedures and management approaches for Information and Communication Technology (ICT), ship refits, and banking and financial services. It covers key aspects of ICT procurement, including requirement specification, system architecture, vendor evaluation, cybersecurity and compliance, contract management, testing and acceptance, and service-level monitoring. The course also examines ship refit procurement, with a focus on planning, technical feasibility, scope definition, contract structures, quality assurance, project monitoring, risk management, and change control. In addition, it introduces the procurement of banking and financial services, covering areas such as foreign exchange, treasury management, government securities, letters of credit, guarantees, insurance, and risk management.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Spectrum Auction Methodology
desc: Dive deep into the complex world of spectrum allocation with this detailed course on auction methodologies. The program is designed to equip government officials and public sector professionals with a thorough understanding of how spectrum auctions are planned, designed, and executed. The course begins by establishing the context of spectrum as a finite public good and the role of auctions in its efficient distribution. It then explores various auction formats, such as the Simultaneous Multi-Round Auction (SMRA), and their respective advantages and disadvantages. Key learning areas include the legal and regulatory landscape governed by bodies like TRAI, the economic theories underpinning auction design, and the critical steps in the auction lifecycle, from setting reserve prices to managing bidding rounds. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze auction outcomes, understand their impact on the telecom market and national exchequer, and contribute to the formulation of robust spectrum management policies.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Spectrum Licensing in India: Regulatory and Operational Framework
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of spectrum licensing in India, with a focus on its regulatory, legal, and operational dimensions. It begins by introducing the importance of spectrum as a national resource and the rationale for licensing. Learners will examine key licensing approaches — administrative, market-based, and hybrid — alongside the policy and legal frameworks that govern them, particularly the Telecommunication Act, 2023. The course also covers technical aspects such as auction mechanics, charging methodologies, IMT bands, and post-auction harmonisation. Real-world examples from India’s telecom landscape illustrate how effective spectrum management supports innovation, connectivity, and national priorities.

title: Spectrum Management - Part I
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, efficient management of the radio frequency spectrum is paramount for national development and technological advancement. This course, "Introduction to Spectrum Management Principles and Policies," offers a comprehensive overview of the foundational concepts governing this vital resource. It is designed for professionals who need to understand the regulatory, technical, and policy dimensions of telecommunications. The curriculum is structured into two main modules. The first module introduces the necessity and benefits of spectrum management, detailing the multi-layered governance structure from international (ITU) to national levels (WPC). It delves into the spectrum policy landscape and the importance of harmonisation for interoperability and cost-efficiency. The second module focuses on the technical characteristics of spectrum bands, categorizing them into low, mid, and high ranges. It explains how these bands are deployed for various technologies, including 4G and 5G, and provides an overview of the Base Transceiver Station (BTS) landscape in India. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to articulate the principles of spectrum management, understand the roles of key regulatory bodies, and recognize the technical attributes of different frequency bands. This knowledge is crucial for officials involved in telecom policy, regulation, and technology planning, enabling them to contribute to informed decision-making in the telecommunications sector.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Spectrum Management - Part II
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of spectrum management and its regulatory framework within the Indian context. It begins by establishing the importance of efficient spectrum allocation for the nation's expanding digital and mobile economy. You will explore the key differences between administrative and market-based spectrum assignment models, analyzing India's journey from the 'First Come First Served' policy to a transparent auction-based system. The curriculum provides a thorough analysis of the landmark 2012 Supreme Court ruling on 2G licenses and the series of policy reforms that followed, including spectrum delinking, liberalisation, and sharing. Learners will examine the complete lifecycle of a spectrum auction, from eligibility criteria and roll-out obligations to spectrum charges and trading guidelines. Upon completion, you will be equipped to navigate the complexities of telecom policy and its impact on service providers and national connectivity.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Speech and Hearing Problems
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the field of speech pathology, designed for learners with no prior background. It begins by explaining the physiological process of speech production, from airflow and vocal fold vibration to the articulation of sounds. The curriculum then details the normal developmental milestones for speech in children, providing a baseline against which disorders can be identified. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to classifying and describing different types of speech disorders. This includes articulation issues like substituting or omitting sounds, fluency disorders such as stuttering, and voice disorders affecting pitch and quality. The content delves into potential causes, ranging from structural problems like cleft palate to neurological conditions. By the end of the course, learners will understand the challenges faced by individuals with these disorders and recognize the crucial roles of ENT specialists and speech-language pathologists in assessment and therapy, underscoring the value of early intervention.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: Speech Problems in a Nutshell
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is structured into two modules to provide a clear overview of speech-related challenges. The first module explores the fundamentals of how speech is produced, outlines the normal stages of speech development in children, and introduces the primary categories of speech disorders. Learners will gain insight into articulation issues, fluency problems, and voice disorders, understanding their distinct characteristics and causes such as structural problems, hearing impairment, or neurological damage. The second module offers a focused look at stuttering, also known as stammering. It details the symptoms, typical age of onset, and the significant impact it can have on an individual's confidence and communication. The course underscores the vital role of professional speech therapy in treating these conditions, highlighting that early intervention can lead to complete recovery and significantly improve quality of life. It serves as an essential guide for anyone looking to understand the challenges faced by individuals with speech problems.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: SPEED POST DISCOUNT STRUCTURE
desc: This program is designed to equip postal employees with the necessary knowledge to effectively manage Speed Post services for contractual and corporate clients. The course delves into the operational guidelines for customer registration, including the Book Now Pay Later (BNPL) scheme and the National Account Facility (NAF), outlining the specific revenue thresholds and approval processes. Key learning areas include the detailed discount structures based on monthly business volume, additional incentives for advance payments, and the procedural requirements for booking and billing using departmental software like CSI POS and SAP. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently handle customer agreements, apply the correct discounts, manage billing and payments, and ensure compliance with the latest departmental circulars, thereby enhancing service delivery and customer satisfaction.

title: Speedy Delivery of Justice
desc: This course delves into the transformative changes introduced by the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, replacing the colonial-era criminal procedure code. It is designed for legal professionals, law enforcement officers, and public administrators to understand the shift towards a more efficient, transparent, and victim-centric justice system. The curriculum systematically breaks down the new legal framework, covering key areas such as the revised procedures for First Information Reports (FIRs), which now include electronic submissions to improve accessibility. It details the streamlined judicial processes, including provisions for summary trials, mandatory timelines for investigations and trials, and the use of digital tools like virtual hearings and electronic evidence. Furthermore, the course examines the enhanced role of forensic science, new provisions for absconders, strengthened victim rights, and reforms aimed at reducing prison overcrowding.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Speedy Delivery of Justice
desc: This course delves into the transformative changes introduced by the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, replacing the colonial-era criminal procedure code. It is designed for legal professionals, law enforcement officers, and public administrators to understand the shift towards a more efficient, transparent, and victim-centric justice system. The curriculum systematically breaks down the new legal framework, covering key areas such as the revised procedures for First Information Reports (FIRs), which now include electronic submissions to improve accessibility. It details the streamlined judicial processes, including provisions for summary trials, mandatory timelines for investigations and trials, and the use of digital tools like virtual hearings and electronic evidence. Furthermore, the course examines the enhanced role of forensic science, new provisions for absconders, strengthened victim rights, and reforms aimed at reducing prison overcrowding. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the procedural changes and apply the new legal principles, contributing to a more effective and speedy delivery of justice in India.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: SPORTS INJURY , CAUSE AND MANAGEMENT
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the critical aspects of sports health and safety. It is structured into three modules to provide a systematic learning experience. The first module defines sports injuries and investigates their primary causes, from poor technique and overtraining to inadequate equipment. The second module focuses on diagnosis, teaching learners to recognize common symptoms and understand the examination process, including physical assessments and the role of imaging studies like X-rays and MRIs. The final module is dedicated to management and prevention, detailing immediate care protocols like RICE and outlining long-term strategies for avoiding injuries. These strategies include proper conditioning, warm-ups, stretching, and the importance of rest. By completing this course, participants will be equipped with practical knowledge to handle injuries effectively and foster a culture of safety and health in sports and physical activities.

title: Sports Nutrition - Intermediate
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to build essential nutritional literacy for athletes, coaches, and anyone interested in healthier eating habits. The program begins by demystifying food packaging, teaching you how to read and understand nutrition labels, ingredient lists, and important logos. You will gain insight into the Indian food regulatory landscape, including the role of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) in ensuring food quality and safety. The course delves into the core principles of a balanced diet, exploring the different food groups, their functions, and the science of portion sizes. Through practical guidance, you will learn to apply the 'My Plate for the Day' concept to construct wholesome meals tailored to your needs. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to navigate food choices confidently, manage your diet effectively, and build a strong foundation for optimal health and physical performance.

title: Sports Nutrition : Beginner
desc: This comprehensive introductory course is designed to equip learners with essential knowledge of sports nutrition and hydration. It begins by defining food and its physiological, social, and psychological functions, before delving into the core components of a balanced diet as recommended by the National Institute of Nutrition. You will learn to classify nutrients into macronutrients (carbohydrates, proteins, fats) and micronutrients (vitamins, minerals), and understand their distinct roles in energy provision, tissue repair, and metabolic regulation for both general health and demanding physical activities.The course places a significant emphasis on practical application, exploring topics such as energy and nutrient balance, the causes and effects of nutrient deficiencies and toxicity, and the critical role of fluids in athletic performance. You will gain insights into maintaining optimal water balance, recognizing the signs of dehydration, and implementing effective hydration strategies before, during, and after exercise. By the end of this course, you will be able to apply fundamental nutritional principles to support fitness goals, improve recovery, and enhance overall athletic performance.

title: Springs of Change: Tackling Water Scarcity in Ziro Valley
desc:
This case examines the revitalization of spring water sources and the transformation of a tribal village—Sibbe, situated in Arunachal Pradesh's Ziro Valley—through integrated water resource management, community engagement, and the convergence of government schemes, including the Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM). The protagonist, Smt. Tage Yani, a grassroots leader, mobilizes the community amid ecological stress and water scarcity, ushering in sustainable water governance practices.

The narrative documents challenges including deforestation, declining spring flows, community resistance to water tariffs, and lack of technical expertise, and shows how they were overcome through participative planning, spring shed rejuvenation, capacity-building, and institutional innovations such as Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC) empowerment and water pricing models.

title: SRIJAN DEFENCE PORTAL
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Srijan Defence Portal, a pivotal platform for advancing India's 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' vision in the defence sector. It is designed for professionals, entrepreneurs, and industry partners seeking to engage with the Ministry of Defence's indigenization efforts. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of self-reliance in defence and introduces the portal as a central hub for collaboration. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of the defence procurement process, the strategic importance of the Positive Indigenization Lists, and how they guide domestic manufacturing priorities. The course also covers the 'Mission Raksha Gyan Shakti' initiative, emphasizing the critical role of Intellectual Property (IP) management in fostering innovation within the defence ecosystem. By the end of this course, learners will have a practical understanding of how to navigate the portal, identify opportunities for indigenization, and align their efforts with national defence manufacturing strategies, thereby contributing to a robust and self-reliant Indian defence industry.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: SSTP Architecture in BSNL
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of Standalone Signaling Transfer Point (SSTP) architecture, a critical component of modern telecommunication signaling networks. It begins by introducing the foundational elements of the Common Channel Signaling (CCS7) system, establishing the context in which SSTPs operate. Learners will gain a clear understanding of the key differences between integrated and standalone STPs and their respective roles in network operations. The curriculum focuses on the five core functions of an SSTP: CCS7 message routing, global title translation, network management, network interconnection, and gateway screening. Through this exploration, participants will understand how these functions ensure efficient and secure signal routing. The course also provides a practical case study of the SSTP implementation in BSNL, including the UTSTARCOM iSG6400 hardware, its features, and its deployment for redundancy and high availability. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the technical knowledge to understand and analyze the architecture and importance of SSTPs in ensuring a resilient and reliable telecom network.

title: Staff Welfares Measures in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the extensive staff welfare and social security framework within Indian Railways. It is designed to inform employees about the benefits and support systems available to them throughout their career and into retirement. The curriculum begins by explaining foundational financial security measures such as the Provident Fund, the Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme, and the different pension systems, including the Old Pension Scheme (OPS) and the National Pension System (NPS). Learners will also delve into the specifics of the Death-cum-Retirement Gratuity (DCRG) and the rules for encashment of earned leave. Furthermore, the course covers crucial support initiatives like compassionate appointments for family members and the post-retirement complimentary pass system. It details the Retired Employees Liberalized Health Scheme (RELHS), which ensures continued medical care for retirees. The program concludes by exploring a range of additional welfare schemes funded by the Staff Benefit Fund (SBF), such as educational assistance, vocational training, cooperative societies, and recreational facilities, all of which contribute to the holistic well-being of railway personnel and their families.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Stages and Techniques of Mineral Exploration
desc: This course, 'Stages and Techniques of Mineral Exploration,' is designed to provide a thorough grounding in the systematic process of discovering and evaluating mineral deposits. It begins by establishing the context of mineral exploration in India, differentiating between high-risk greenfield projects in virgin territories and lower-risk brownfield projects that extend existing mines. You will gain a detailed understanding of the internationally recognized United Nations Framework Classification (UNFC) for mineral resources, focusing on the progressive stages from G4 (Reconnaissance) to G1 (Detailed Exploration). The course meticulously breaks down the specific work components for each stage, including geological mapping scales, geophysical surveys, and drilling density. Key learning areas include practical exploration techniques such as detailed surveying, pitting, trenching, borehole planning, and execution. Furthermore, the course offers an in-depth look at various sampling methodologies, from rock chip and channel sampling to core and bulk sampling, explaining how each method contributes to accurate resource estimation. Upon completion, learners will be able to comprehend the entire mineral exploration lifecycle, from initial area selection to detailed deposit delineation, preparing them for roles in geological survey and mining operations.

title: Stakeholders in Governance
desc: In today's complex administrative landscape, successful governance requires active collaboration with a wide array of stakeholders who have a vested interest in public policies and services. Understanding who these stakeholders are, what their interests are, and how to engage them effectively is a core competency for any public functionary. This course is designed to build this essential capability. Participants will delve into the concepts of stakeholder theory as applied to the public sector. The curriculum will cover methods for stakeholder identification and mapping, analyzing their influence and interest, and developing tailored engagement strategies. It will also touch upon the challenges of managing conflicting interests and the importance of transparency in stakeholder relations. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to conduct comprehensive stakeholder analyses, design effective communication plans, foster collaborative partnerships, and navigate complex multi-stakeholder environments, leading to more inclusive decision-making and greater public trust.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Stakeholders in Governance (Hindi)
desc: प्रभावी सार्वजनिक सेवा वितरण और नीति कार्यान्वयन के लिए शासन में हितधारकों की भूमिका को समझना महत्वपूर्ण है। यह पाठ्यक्रम सरकारी अधिकारियों को हितधारक विश्लेषण और प्रबंधन के लिए एक व्यापक ढांचा प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम इस बात पर प्रकाश डालता है कि हितधारकों की पहचान क्यों आवश्यक है और यह कैसे शासन प्रक्रियाओं की पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही को बढ़ाता है। शिक्षार्थी प्रमुख हितधारक समूहों, उनकी अपेक्षाओं और उनके प्रभाव के स्तरों का विश्लेषण करने के लिए व्यावहारिक तरीके सीखेंगे। इसमें सरकारी संस्थाओं, नागरिक समाज, निजी क्षेत्र और आम जनता के साथ प्रभावी ढंग से जुड़ने की तकनीकें शामिल होंगी। पाठ्यक्रम केस स्टडीज और उदाहरणों के माध्यम से यह प्रदर्शित करेगा कि कैसे सफल हितधारक प्रबंधन से बेहतर नीतिगत परिणाम और बढ़ा हुआ नागरिक विश्वास प्राप्त होता है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, अधिकारी हितधारक मानचित्रण करने, संचार रणनीतियां विकसित करने और सहयोगी निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रियाओं को बढ़ावा देने में सक्षम होंगे, जिससे वे अपनी भूमिकाओं में अधिक प्रभावी बन सकें।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Handling Evidence
desc: In an era where digital devices are central to criminal investigations, the correct handling of electronic evidence is paramount. This course offers a detailed framework on the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for managing digital evidence directly at the crime scene. It is specifically designed for police officers who are often the first responders and whose actions determine the viability of crucial evidence. The curriculum provides a step-by-step guide, starting from securing a crime scene to prevent evidence tampering, through to the systematic identification and labeling of digital devices like smartphones, computers, and storage media. Participants will learn the legally compliant methods for seizing different forms of digital evidence, ensuring that every action is documented and the chain of custody is maintained. The course focuses on practical application, aiming to build the proficiency required to preserve the integrity and admissibility of digital evidence for legal proceedings. Upon completion, officers will be equipped to manage digital evidence confidently, ensuring that their work at the crime scene contributes effectively to the judicial process and successful case outcomes.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Standard Operating Procedures
desc: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are the backbone of consistent and high-quality organizational performance. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the knowledge and skills to create and implement effective SOPs. It begins by establishing the context for why SOPs are indispensable for translating policies into action, ensuring regulatory compliance, and minimizing operational errors. You will learn to move beyond simple instructions to develop robust procedural documents that enhance efficiency and maintain institutional knowledge. The curriculum delves into the key learning areas, including identifying the purpose and scope of an SOP, choosing the right format—such as step-by-step, hierarchical, or flowchart—and mastering the art of clear, concise writing. Participants will explore the collaborative process of SOP development, involving stakeholders to ensure accuracy and practicality. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently draft, implement, and manage SOPs that drive process excellence, support employee onboarding, and foster a culture of continuous improvement within your organization.

title: Standard Operating Procedures for Resolving Outstanding Internal Audit
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the procedural knowledge required to effectively manage and resolve internal audit observations. It addresses the critical need for standardized processes to maintain financial integrity and accountability. The curriculum delves into specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for key areas prone to audit irregularities, including travel and allowance claims, income tax compliance, digital receipts, procurement protocols, National Pension System (NPS) management, utilization certificates, government loans, and pay fixation. Learners will explore a structured framework for conducting root cause analysis of audit paras and implementing robust corrective measures. Through real-world examples, the course illustrates how to apply documentation standards and preventive actions to avoid recurring lapses. Upon completion, participants will be capable of developing effective action plans, fostering interdepartmental coordination, and adhering to the latest regulatory guidelines, thereby strengthening financial controls and upholding accountability.

title: Standard Questionnaire for visit to Branch Post Office
desc: This course is designed to equip Inspecting Officers with the necessary skills to perform thorough and effective inspections of Branch Post Offices. With the integration of centralized systems like CBS and CSI, the nature of postal inspections has evolved. This program details the modern inspection process, focusing on the use of the DARPAN app. The curriculum is structured around the four key parts of the standard questionnaire: DARPAN app verification, working procedures, Swachhta (cleanliness) and customer facilities, and India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) services. Participants will learn how to generate transaction reports, verify the wallet balance against physical cash, check stamp inventory, and review mail delivery processes. The course also covers assessing the physical condition of the post office, ensuring customer satisfaction, and confirming the proper functioning of IPPB services. Upon completion, officers will be proficient in conducting standardized inspections that uphold operational integrity and enhance service quality across the postal network.

title: Standard Remarks for Undelivered Postal Articles
desc: This program offers detailed guidance on the correct application of standard remarks for undelivered postal articles, a critical function for all postal delivery personnel. The course begins by establishing the regulatory context under the Post Office Regulations, 2024, and clarifies the definitions of accountable and unaccountable items. The core of the course is dedicated to a scenario-based exploration of the official standard remarks. Learners will be guided through numerous situations, such as 'Refused,' 'Addressee Left Without Instructions,' 'Insufficient Address,' and 'Deceased,' understanding which specific remark to apply in each case. It also covers the corresponding final disposal action for each remark, like 'Returned to Sender' or 'Redirected.' By completing this course, postal officials will be able to confidently and accurately apply these remarks on articles, delivery manifests, and within the Postman Mobile Application, thereby improving sorting efficiency, ensuring regulatory compliance, and facilitating the correct handling of all undelivered mail.

title: Statement and Admission and Confession
desc: This course introduces the legal concepts of statements, admissions, and confessions under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, providing a clear understanding of their definitions, distinctions, and evidentiary relevance. Participants will explore rules for the admissibility of oral and written admissions, safeguards governing confessions, and exclusions arising from inducement, coercion, or police custody. The course also covers special circumstances such as dying declarations and business records, offering a comprehensive understanding of how such evidence is evaluated in judicial proceedings.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Station Outstanding and Means to Reduce it, Indian Railways
desc: This course is designed for railway personnel involved in commercial and financial operations at the station level. It addresses the critical topic of 'station outstandings,' which are the unpaid financial liabilities for which a Station Master is accountable. The program provides essential context on why managing these outstandings is vital for the financial health and operational integrity of the Indian Railways.Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of all types of outstandings, from impressed cash and cashier's debits to complex issues like unadmitted error sheets and freight dues. The course meticulously explains the process of maintaining the 'Register of Outstandings' as per the Indian Railway Commercial Manual (IRCM). It provides step-by-step guidance on the clearance procedures for each type of outstanding, including recovery, write-offs, and handling disputes with the Accounts Office.Upon completion, learners will be able to proactively identify and manage financial discrepancies, implement preventive measures to reduce the accumulation of outstandings, and ensure diligent compliance with accounting procedures. This will directly contribute to enhanced financial discipline and operational efficiency at their respective stations.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Station Redevelopment
desc: The redevelopment of railway stations is a critical component of modernizing national infrastructure, aimed at transforming them into vibrant, efficient, and passenger-friendly transit hubs. This course delves into the intricate process of station redevelopment, providing learners with a robust understanding of both the philosophy and the technical execution involved. Participants will gain in-depth knowledge of the entire station design process, starting from initial planning and passenger flow analysis to the application of advanced modular construction techniques. The curriculum extensively covers the design of key station components as detailed in the Indian Railways Design Manual, including the layout of concourses, platforms, foot-over-bridges (FOBs), and vertical access systems like lifts and escalators. Furthermore, the course explores the integration of essential building services, such as electrical, water, and lighting strategies, and emphasizes sustainability through features like photovoltaic integration and energy-efficient design. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze station redevelopment plans, understand the principles of modular design for rapid construction, and appreciate the importance of creating accessible, safe, and aesthetically pleasing railway stations that serve as modern urban landmarks.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Civil Engineering (IRICEN)

title: Statistical Tools and Data Visualization
desc: In an increasingly data-driven world, the ability to understand and communicate insights from data is a critical skill for public sector professionals. This course, ""Statistical Tools and Data Visualization,"" provides a comprehensive introduction to the foundational concepts and techniques required to turn raw data into meaningful visual representations. It addresses the growing need for data literacy within government by equipping officials with the tools to analyze and present information effectively, thereby supporting evidence-based policy and decision-making. Key learning areas will include a deep dive into descriptive and inferential statistics, understanding different types of variables (nominal, ordinal, continuous, discrete), and mastering the application of various statistical tools. Participants will learn to create and interpret a wide range of visual aids, such as tables, histograms, time series charts, and scatter plots. The course also provides a solid grounding in calculating and understanding central tendencies (mean, median, mode) and measures of dispersion (range, standard deviation, variance). Upon completion, learners will be able to select appropriate statistical tools and visualization techniques for different datasets, analyze basic statistical outputs, and communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences. This skill set is invaluable for roles involving monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and policy analysis.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: STATUTORY AUDIT OF LIMITED COMPANIES
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of the legal framework surrounding statutory audits in India. It is designed for finance professionals, legal practitioners, and corporate officers who need to navigate the complexities of the Companies Act, 2013. The program begins by defining the role of an auditor and the critical importance of statutory audits for ensuring corporate transparency and accountability. Key learning areas include the detailed procedures for the appointment and removal of auditors, including the roles of the board, shareholders, and the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). You will learn to identify the specific qualifications for a Chartered Accountant to be an auditor and the various disqualifications that can arise. The course also thoroughly covers the powers and duties of an auditor, their right to access information, and their responsibility to provide a true and fair view of a company's financial health. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in the legal requirements for statutory audits and capable of ensuring your organization's compliance.

title: STATUTORY PROVISIONS FOR ONLINE SUBMISSION OF MONTHLY AND ANNUAL
desc: This course is designed to enable mining lessees and mineral concession holders to navigate the legal and procedural requirements for filing statutory returns. The curriculum delves into the core provisions of the MCDR 2017 and MMDR Act 1957, clarifying the obligations for all stakeholders registered with the Indian Bureau of Mines. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the structure of monthly (Form F/G) and annual (Form L/M) returns, the step-by-step process for online submission through the Mining Tenement System (MTS), and the correct methodology for calculating the 'X-mine price' for both captive and non-captive mines. The course also highlights common anomalies and data mismatches found during the examination of returns, such as inconsistencies in production data, fuel consumption, and material balance. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to ensure data accuracy, maintain proper records, and submit compliant returns, thereby minimizing the risk of penalties and supporting national mineral accounting.

title: Stay Safe in Cyber Space
desc: In an era of increasing digitalization, understanding how to protect oneself from online threats is crucial for every public servant. This course, 'Fundamentals of Cyber Safety and Online Fraud Prevention,' offers a comprehensive overview of the modern cyber threat landscape. It begins by establishing the importance of cyber safety and then delves into the specific modus operandi of common cybercrimes such as phishing, malware attacks, ransomware, job fraud, sextortion, and various financial scams involving UPI, QR codes, and loan apps. The content is delivered through practical examples and demonstrations, teaching learners how to identify fake websites, emails, and malicious applications. A significant focus is placed on empowering learners with actionable knowledge. This includes best practices for safeguarding personal data, government IDs, and financial information. Furthermore, the course provides detailed guidance on utilizing national resources like the Cybercrime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) and the 1930 helpline for immediate assistance and reporting. Upon completion, participants will be better equipped to protect themselves and their organizations from digital risks, fostering a culture of security and vigilance.

title: Staying Safe in Cyberspace
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding how to protect oneself and one's organization from cyber threats is a critical skill for every public servant. This course, 'Fundamentals of Cybersecurity and Online Safety,' is designed to equip learners with the essential knowledge and practices to navigate the digital landscape securely. The program begins by demystifying cybersecurity, explaining core concepts like the CIA Triad and debunking common myths. You will delve into the anatomy of various cyber frauds, learning to identify and safeguard against financial scams, phishing, ransomware, identity theft, and online harassment. The course also sheds light on the operational hotspots of cybercrime and the tactics used by malicious actors. A significant portion is dedicated to proactive defense, focusing on cyber hygiene best practices such as creating strong passwords, enabling multi-factor authentication, and spotting fake websites.

title: Strategic Leadership: The Indic Way
desc: “Strategic Leadership: The Indic Way” provides a profound journey into leadership principles rooted in Indian philosophy, designed to equip public leaders for contemporary challenges. The course addresses the critical need for leaders who can navigate complexity with wisdom and foresight. It introduces the powerful Raja-Rishi model, which integrates the decisiveness of a ruler (Raja) with the detached wisdom of a sage (Rishi), fostering a balanced approach to power and influence. Key learning areas include understanding the ethical dimensions of power, applying systems thinking inspired by the concept of 'Lokasamgraha' (welfare of all) for comprehensive stakeholder analysis, and cultivating inner mastery for enhanced executive presence. Through reflective exercises and practical frameworks, learners will be empowered to translate ancient wisdom into actionable strategies, leading to more effective, ethical, and impactful governance. This course will enable you to lead with purpose and create lasting positive change within your organization and community.

title: Strategic Management for Businesses and Corporates
desc: In today's dynamic environment, strategic management is crucial for organizational resilience and success. This course provides a comprehensive overview of strategy formulation, designed for executives and managers tasked with guiding their organization's future. You will begin by understanding the critical distinction between business strategy, which focuses on competitive advantage in a specific market, and corporate strategy, which deals with the overall scope of the firm. The course delves into the five key elements of a successful strategy: arenas, vehicles, differentiators, staging, and economic logic. Through this framework, you will learn to perform thorough industry analysis and make informed decisions that are internally consistent and aligned with market realities. Participants will develop the skills to see the interconnectedness of strategic choices, such as acquisitions, and their ripple effects across the business. This program empowers leaders to move beyond isolated functional planning and embrace a holistic, forward-thinking approach to strategy that fosters long-term value and sustainable growth.

title: Strategic Media Management for Law Enforcement
desc: In an era of high public scrutiny and rapid information dissemination, effective media management is a critical function for modern policing. This course is designed to equip law enforcement professionals with the strategic communication skills necessary to build public trust and maintain institutional credibility. The curriculum provides a comprehensive overview of media relations, focusing on the importance of clear, ethical, and proactive messaging. Key learning areas include understanding the pivotal role of Public Relations Officers (PROs), developing robust strategies for crisis communication, and effectively countering misinformation across various media platforms. Participants will delve into the practical application of social media for community engagement and public safety initiatives. The course also offers insights into leveraging emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Virtual Reality (VR) for advanced media training and public interaction.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Strategic Perspectives on National Security
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world, a holistic understanding of national security is paramount. This course offers an immersive exploration of the critical issues shaping the global security environment. Participants will delve into the interplay between socio-political dynamics, economic trends, scientific advancements, and defence capabilities. The curriculum is structured to foster a forward-looking perspective, enabling learners to analyze shifting patterns in international relations, political alliances, and military power. Through interactive sessions and case studies, the course moves beyond theory to practical application, developing the skills needed for evidence-based analysis and strategic decision-making. Ultimately, learners will be equipped to formulate robust recommendations for macro-level security challenges, preparing them for leadership roles in national and international policy-making arenas.

title: Strategic Perspectives on National Security
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world, a holistic understanding of national security is paramount. This course offers an immersive exploration of the critical issues shaping the global security environment. Participants will delve into the interplay between socio-political dynamics, economic trends, scientific advancements, and defence capabilities. The curriculum is structured to foster a forward-looking perspective, enabling learners to analyze shifting patterns in international relations, political alliances, and military power. Through interactive sessions and case studies, the course moves beyond theory to practical application, developing the skills needed for evidence-based analysis and strategic decision-making. Ultimately, learners will be equipped to formulate robust recommendations for macro-level security challenges, preparing them for leadership roles in national and international policy-making arenas.

title: Strategic Planning and Growth
desc: In today's dynamic business environment, strategic foresight is crucial for sustainable growth. This course is designed to equip managers, entrepreneurs, and consultants with a robust toolkit for strategic analysis and planning. You will delve into five powerful frameworks that are fundamental to modern business strategy. The course begins with the Ansoff Matrix to identify growth opportunities and the Product/Technology Life Cycle to align strategies with market maturity. You will then learn to conduct a Core Competency Analysis to pinpoint and exploit unique competitive advantages. A key module focuses on Decision Trees, providing a quantitative approach to evaluating complex choices and mitigating risks. Finally, the course explores Vertical and Horizontal Integration as powerful strategies for controlling the value chain and expanding market presence. Through engaging scenarios and case studies of Indian companies like Zomato, Amul, and Reliance Retail, you will learn not just the theory but also the practical application of these essential strategic tools, enabling you to drive informed and impactful decisions within your organization.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Strategic Procurement: Law Cybersecurity and Emerging Threats
desc: In an increasingly complex global landscape, public procurement is no longer a simple transactional process but a strategic function critical to national security and resilience. This thought-leadership session delves into the multifaceted world of strategic procurement, designed for government officers who manage or oversee acquisition processes. The course provides a robust framework for understanding and mitigating modern risks. Key learning areas include the application of legal strategies ('lawfare') to secure contracts and supply lines, identifying and countering sophisticated cybersecurity threats, and analyzing the impact of geopolitical tensions on procurement decisions. Learners will explore how to 'weaponize procurement' for national advantage, the necessity of indigenization, and the role of innovation in building secure supply chains. Upon completion, officers will be better equipped to design and implement procurement policies that are not only efficient but also secure, resilient, and aligned with India's strategic interests.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Strategic Thinking in the Age of Innovation
desc: This course introduces learners to the principles of technology strategy and its role in shaping competitive advantage, industry evolution, and long-term value creation. It explains how technology strategy differs from conventional competitive strategy by focusing on uncertainty, technological discontinuities, ecosystems, and timing decisions. Through real-world case studies—including Amazon, Google, Kodak, Genentech, Apple, Aadhaar, ISRO, Jio, and India’s defence programs. The course examines technology life cycles, commercialization pathways, and strategic choices such as leading versus following. The course builds a strategic mindset to evaluate technological change, manage innovation risk, and design strategies that convert technological potential into sustainable impact.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Strength and Conditioning : Beginner
desc: Delve into the essential principles of modern athletic preparation with this comprehensive course on Strength and Conditioning. The program is structured around the scientifically-backed Long-Term Athlete Development (LTAD) model, a seven-stage framework designed to optimize training, competition, and recovery from infancy to adulthood. You will analyze the shortcomings of traditional coaching methods, which often prioritize short-term wins over sustainable development, and learn why a focus on developmental age is crucial. The course covers critical topics including the calculation and importance of Peak Height Velocity (PHV) to tailor training programs effectively. It also examines the concepts of early versus late maturation and the 'relative age effect' to ensure fair talent identification and prevent dropout. By the end of this course, you will be able to apply a holistic and evidence-based approach to training, helping athletes reach their full genetic potential while promoting physical literacy and a lifelong passion for sport.

title: Strength and Conditioning : Intermediate
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the principles of strength and conditioning across an athlete's entire developmental journey. It is structured around the internationally recognized Long-Term Athlete Development (LTAD) model, providing a stage-by-stage guide for coaches, physical education teachers, and trainers. The curriculum begins with the 'Active Start' (ages 0-6) and 'Fundamentals' (ages 6-9) stages, emphasizing fun, play, and the development of Agility, Balance, Coordination, and Speed (ABCs). As the course progresses through 'Learn to Train,' 'Train to Train,' and 'Train to Compete,' it introduces more structured training, including sport-specific skills, strength development, and psychological preparation. The final 'Train to Win' stage focuses on optimizing performance for high-level competition. Participants will learn how to apply these principles to prevent injury, avoid premature specialization, and create a solid foundation for lifelong athletic success, making it essential for anyone involved in youth sports and athlete development.

title: Strength and Conditioning Exercises for the Lower Body
desc: This e-learning course offers a detailed exploration of strength and conditioning exercises for the lower body, specifically using resistance bands. It is designed to strengthen and mobilize the legs and hips while enhancing balance, coordination, and overall movement quality. The curriculum focuses on improving joint range of motion, increasing flexibility, and building muscular endurance through a series of structured exercises. Participants will learn safe, effective techniques to develop explosive strength and achieve greater muscle activation. This program is relevant for individuals seeking to improve their physical fitness for demanding professional roles, enhance athletic performance, or support injury rehabilitation. Whether you are a beginner or looking to add variety to your fitness regimen, this course provides a balanced and efficient approach to achieving lasting results in lower body strength and mobility.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Strength and Conditioning Exercises for the Upper Body
desc: This e-learning course is designed to equip participants with the knowledge and techniques to enhance their upper body strength and conditioning through the use of resistance bands. The curriculum focuses on practical, effective exercises that target key muscle groups in the arms, shoulders, chest, and back, while also activating core muscles for improved stability and posture. The course is particularly relevant for professionals in physically demanding roles, such as law enforcement, as it promotes functional fitness that directly supports operational readiness and reduces the risk of injury. The instructional content details the proper form and technique for each exercise, emphasizing smooth, controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and prevent strain. It also provides guidance on selecting the appropriate resistance level and progressing safely. A key benefit of this training is its low-impact nature, making it a safe and accessible option for individuals recovering from injuries or managing joint pain. Upon completion, participants will not only have a versatile workout routine but also a deeper understanding of how to use resistance bands for sustained physical development and injury prevention.
org: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy

title: Strengthening Operating Systems Hardening and Security Best Practices
desc: In today's digital landscape, securing operating systems is paramount to protecting organizational data and infrastructure from malicious attacks. This course offers an in-depth exploration of OS hardening and security best practices. It begins by establishing the context of cybersecurity within a network architecture and introduces core security concepts such as Zero Trust, limiting privileges, and the necessity of encryption and continuous logging. The course then delves into the specifics of hardening the two most common operating systems: Windows and Linux. Learners will be guided through essential procedures for Windows, including managing Active Directory, configuring Group Policy Objects (GPO), and disabling vulnerable protocols like SMBv1. For Linux, the course covers the use of security tools like firewalls and access control mechanisms. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these hardening techniques to create a more resilient, secure, and compliant IT environment, effectively minimizing the attack surface and mitigating security risks.

title: Strengthening Property Tax Systems for Revenue Augmentation
desc: India’s Urban Local Governments (ULGs) depend on reliable revenues to deliver essential services and infrastructure, yet property tax, their largest potential source of income, often remains underutilized. This course provides a comprehensive guide for officials in municipal finance and urban governance to address this gap. It delves into the complete property tax lifecycle, covering enumeration, valuation, assessment, billing, collection, and reporting. Learners will explore proven reforms to expand the tax base, reduce revenue leakages, and improve compliance. Through case studies from cities across India, such as GIS-based tax registers in Uttar Pradesh and valuation reforms in Andhra Pradesh, participants will gain a well-rounded perspective on strengthening property tax administration. By the end of the course, officials will be equipped with practical strategies and actionable knowledge to augment ULG revenues and foster sustainable urban development.

title: Strengthening Security through Identity and Access Management
desc: In an increasingly digital world, securing sensitive information is paramount for government functions. This course delves into the foundational principles of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and encryption, explaining their critical role in safeguarding digital assets. You will explore the context of real-world data breaches across various sectors to understand the severe consequences of inadequate access control. The curriculum focuses on key learning areas including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and essential encryption practices for data at rest and in transit. Participants will learn to identify security gaps related to authentication and access control and apply appropriate mitigation measures. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge to implement robust IAM strategies, thereby enhancing your organization's overall cybersecurity posture and protecting critical digital infrastructure.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Stress Management
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of stress management as an essential life skill for navigating the complexities of modern life. It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of what stress is, differentiating between positive stress (eustress) and negative stress (distress), and examining its physiological and psychological manifestations, such as the 'fight-or-flight' response. The curriculum delves into how chronic stress can impact various body systems and overall mental health. Participants will learn to identify personal and professional stressors and recognize the symptoms associated with them. The core of the course is focused on practical, evidence-based management strategies, including mindfulness, deep breathing exercises, cognitive reframing, and the importance of sleep hygiene and social support. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped with a toolkit of practical techniques to build resilience, foster positive coping mechanisms, and integrate healthy habits for sustained well-being.
org: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad

title: STRESS MANAGEMENT
desc: In today's fast-paced and demanding work environment, stress has become a critical factor affecting both personal health and professional performance. This course is designed to equip public servants with the knowledge and tools to effectively manage stress. It begins by defining stress, examining its root causes in both personal and organizational contexts, and detailing its physical, psychological, and behavioral consequences. You will learn to recognize the warning signs of chronic stress and burnout, and understand different personality predispositions, such as Type A and Type B behaviors. The core of the course focuses on the 'REWARD' strategy, a multi-faceted approach to stress reduction covering Relaxation, Exercise, Watching your breath, Adopting the right attitude, Relationship orientation, and Diet. Through practical guidance, self-assessment questionnaires, and motivational insights, you will learn how to build resilience, control your reactions to stressors, and cultivate a healthier, more balanced life. By the end of this module, you will be empowered to kill stress before it kills you, leading to improved productivity and personal fulfillment.

title: Stress Management
desc: In today's demanding work environment, managing stress is a critical skill for maintaining well-being and productivity. This course, 'Introduction to Stress Management Techniques,' is designed to equip government employees with the knowledge and tools to effectively handle workplace and personal pressures. The curriculum begins by defining stress and exploring its various sources, such as environmental, family-related, and workplace-connected stressors. Participants will learn to recognize the physical and mental symptoms of stress, understanding how it can impact focus, motivation, and overall health. The course then delves into practical, evidence-based methods for stress reduction. These include simple but powerful techniques like controlled breathing exercises, visual imagery for relaxation, and the benefits of regular physical activity and social engagement. Furthermore, it emphasizes the importance of establishing a healthy work-life balance and provides actionable strategies for separating professional and personal responsibilities. By the end of this course, learners will be better prepared to evaluate their own stress levels and apply these techniques to foster resilience and improve their quality of life.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Stress Management through Meditation and Yog Nidra
desc: In the demanding environment of public service, managing stress is crucial for maintaining personal well-being and professional effectiveness. This course, "Stress Management through Meditation and Yog Nidra," offers a comprehensive guide to understanding and mitigating the impacts of stress. It delves into the scientific principles that govern our stress responses and provides a structured approach to developing robust coping strategies. Participants will explore a variety of evidence-based techniques, including guided meditation, the deep relaxation practice of Yog Nidra, and the role of physical activity in mental health. The course is designed to be highly practical, guiding learners to identify their unique stress triggers and build a personalized toolkit for managing them. Upon completion, participants will not only have a deeper understanding of stress but will also be equipped with actionable skills to enhance their resilience, improve focus, and foster a positive mindset. This will empower them to navigate workplace challenges more effectively, leading to improved health, greater productivity, and a higher overall quality of life.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Structured Approach to Problem Solving
desc: Embark on a journey to master the art and science of structured problem-solving. This foundational course is tailored for professionals who want to move beyond intuition and adopt a systematic, repeatable approach to tackling complex issues. You will begin by understanding the critical importance of accurately defining a problem, avoiding common pitfalls like the loop trap and complexity trap. The course then delves into the core stages of a data science project, illustrating how structured thinking is applied at each step, from data analysis to model deployment. You will gain hands-on familiarity with powerful tools such as the Problem Statement Worksheet (PSW), MECE principle for logical grouping, and issue trees for dissecting problems. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to human-centered design (HCD), teaching you how to incorporate empathy and user perspectives to create solutions that are not only technically sound but also truly effective and widely adopted. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to analyze problems with clarity, generate innovative solutions, and make sound, data-informed decisions in any professional context.

title: Structured Finance Instruments and Asset Monetization
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of structured finance and asset monetization, critical components of modern financial engineering. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand how to create value and manage risk through sophisticated financial instruments. The curriculum begins with an introduction to the core concepts of structured finance, differentiating it from conventional financing methods. You will learn about the mechanics of securitization, including the process of transforming assets like loans or receivables into marketable securities such as Asset-Backed Securities (ABS), Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), and Collateralized Debt Obligations (CDOs). The course examines the crucial role of Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) in isolating risk and the application of credit enhancement techniques to improve investor confidence.

title: Structured Finance Instruments and Asset Monetization
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of structured finance and asset monetization, critical components of modern financial engineering. It is designed for professionals seeking to understand how to create value and manage risk through sophisticated financial instruments. The curriculum begins with an introduction to the core concepts of structured finance, differentiating it from conventional financing methods. You will learn about the mechanics of securitization, including the process of transforming assets like loans or receivables into marketable securities such as Asset-Backed Securities (ABS), Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), and Collateralized Debt Obligations (CDOs). The course examines the crucial role of Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) in isolating risk and the application of credit enhancement techniques to improve investor confidence. Furthermore, it covers various asset monetization strategies, including sale-leaseback arrangements, Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), and the use of Infrastructure and Real Estate Investment Trusts (InvITs/REITs). By analyzing risk management frameworks and lessons from the 2008 financial crisis, learners will be equipped to assess and apply these powerful financial tools in corporate and public sector contexts.

title: Structured Problem Solving and Decision Making for Government Officers
desc: This course equips government officials with a systematic approach to analysing complex administrative and policy challenges and making evidence-based decisions. The courseintroduces a structured problem-solving cycle that covers problem identification, root cause analysis, generation of policy alternatives, objective decision-making, effective implementation, and continuous learning. Participants learn practical tools such as SMART problem definition, MECE analysis, Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys), Process Mapping, Stakeholder Analysis, Design Thinking, PESTLE Analysis, Cost-Benefit Analysis, Weighted Decision Matrix, Logic Model, and After Action Review. Through realistic government case studies, the course strengthens analytical thinking, policy formulation, implementation planning, and performance monitoring capabilities, enabling officers to improve governance, optimize public resource utilization, and deliver citizen-centric, transparent, and accountable public services.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Structuring Problems
desc: In any professional role, especially within the public sector, the ability to tackle complex problems is paramount. This course, 'A Practical Guide to Structuring and Solving Complex Problems,' moves beyond simple problem identification to the critical stage of structuring. It provides a comprehensive toolkit for deconstructing challenges into logical, manageable parts. You will learn to apply frameworks like issue trees and hypothesis trees to visualize problem components and their relationships. The course delves into the MECE principle, ensuring your analysis is both complete and free of redundancy.
