A key focus is on prioritization through methods like ease-impact analysis, allowing you to allocate resources effectively. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to move from a well-defined problem to a structured work plan, enhancing your team's efficiency and driving more effective outcomes in your projects and policy work. This structured thinking is an essential skill for navigating the multifaceted challenges of modern governance.

title: Submarine Cable System: A Overview
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of submarine cable systems, the essential infrastructure for the modern digital world. It begins with an introduction to the core concepts, including the principles of optical fiber technology and the historical development of undersea cables from early telegraph lines to today's high-capacity fiber networks. You will learn about the general structure of these systems, differentiating between the land-based 'dry plant' components like cable landing stations and the undersea 'wet plant' components such as repeaters and branching units. The course analyzes why submarine cables are preferred over satellite systems for global data transmission, discussing their immense capacity, speed, and reliability. Furthermore, it examines the economic and strategic aspects, including the global market drivers like data centers and cloud services, the consortiums that finance and manage these massive projects, and the major players involved. A special focus is placed on the Indian context, mapping out the country's cable landing stations, major international cable systems passing through India, and significant national projects like providing high-speed connectivity to the Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep islands.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Submission of Postal Accounts to the Controller General of Accounts
desc: This course is designed to equip personnel in the Department of Posts with the knowledge to navigate the modernized financial reporting framework. The Core System Integration (CSI) project is central to enhancing operational efficiency, and this program details its purpose, scope, and integration with daily financial transactions. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of how CSI-SAP functions as the backbone for managing postal accounts and its critical link to the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) for consolidated reporting to the Controller General of Accounts (CGA). The course delves into practical applications, including the use of specific SAP T-Codes to differentiate between cash-based and accrual-based accounting methods. Key learning areas also cover the procedures for data validation and reconciliation, which are essential for maintaining data integrity and ensuring regulatory compliance. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in using the CSI-SAP system for financial reporting, enabling them to contribute to accurate, transparent, and efficient financial management within the postal system.

title: Subscriber Line Testing
desc: This course offers a comprehensive guide to the essential process of subscriber line testing for landline telephone networks. It begins by deconstructing the subscriber line, explaining the path of a telephone wire from the central exchange, through the Main Distribution Frame (MDF), pillars, and Distribution Points (DPs), to the subscriber's location. This provides the necessary context for understanding where and why faults can occur. The curriculum then delves into the practical aspects of fault diagnosis. Learners will explore the three primary categories of line faults: earth faults, short circuit (or contact) faults, and open circuit (or high resistance) faults. The course provides step-by-step instructions on how to use a voltmeter at the MDF to test for these specific issues by measuring resistance. Furthermore, it covers the use of cable fault locators to pinpoint the exact location of a fault within a cable section, enabling efficient repair. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped with the knowledge to test line health, diagnose faults accurately, and contribute to the overall resilience and reliability of the telecom network.

title: Successful AI Strategies: A CEO's Perspective
desc:
This course equips public-sector leaders with practical frameworks to successfully integrate Artificial Intelligence into their organizations. Built around three core equations, it explores Objective + Vision = AI Adoption Success, helping leaders align AI initiatives with strategic goals; Data Engineering + Design Thinking = Optimal AI Results, demonstrating how strong data foundations and user-centered design create effective, scalable solutions; and Accuracy + Ethics + Governance = Trustworthy AI Implementation, ensuring AI systems are reliable, accountable, and trusted.

Learners will also examine talent development, experimentation, and responsible AI practices. Through practical insights and real-world examples, the course provides a roadmap for improving decision-making, enhancing service delivery, increasing operational efficiency, and driving innovation. Suitable for leaders across government, it enables learners to lead AI-enabled transformation with confidence.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Finacle Workflow
desc: This program offers comprehensive, step-by-step training on the Finacle workflow for the Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA) scheme. The course is structured to guide postal operators and supervisors through the entire lifecycle of SSA management within the Core Banking Solution (CBS) platform. Key learning areas include the initial opening of an SSA account using the CPPF AO menu, followed by the critical verification process performed by a supervisor via the CPPF AV menu. The course details the procedures for processing both cash and cheque deposits using the CPDTM menu, emphasizing the importance of validating transaction details and adhering to annual deposit limits. Furthermore, it outlines the specific conditions under which premature closure of an account is permitted, such as in the event of the account holder's death or on extreme compassionate grounds. By completing this course, postal officials will be equipped to perform their duties with precision, minimize errors, and ensure the secure and efficient management of SSA transactions.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account: Savings for Girl Child Empowerment
desc: The Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA) is a government-backed savings scheme designed to empower the girl child. Guardians can open and operate accounts for a maximum of two girl children per family, with annual deposits ranging from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh. This e-learning course provides a comprehensive overview of the SSA scheme, covering its salient features, account opening, deposits, interest, withdrawals, and closure. Learners will gain a clear understanding of how the scheme works and how it supports long-term financial security for girls.

title: Supervisory Behaviour
desc: Supervisors serve as the critical bridge between an organization's leadership and its employees, making their effectiveness vital for operational success and a positive work environment. This course provides a comprehensive framework for developing the behaviours and skills required for exceptional supervision. It delves into the core responsibilities of a supervisor, from overseeing daily tasks and monitoring performance to guiding teams toward collective goals. Key learning areas include mastering clear and tactful communication, applying sound judgment in decision-making, and using effective problem-solving techniques to navigate workplace challenges. Participants will explore practical methods for motivating diverse teams, fostering collaboration, and building a culture of trust and job satisfaction. The course addresses real-world challenges such as ambitious targets and resource constraints, offering actionable strategies for resolution. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to lead with clarity, fairness, and empathy, empowering them to cultivate motivated, resilient, and high-performing teams.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Supervisory Control and Smart Metering Systems
desc: This course delves into the technical and operational aspects of SCADA and AMI, two cornerstone technologies for modernizing power grids. It begins by explaining the context of grid automation and the critical role of real-time data. Learners will explore the complete architecture of SCADA systems, including Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), and communication protocols. The curriculum then transitions to Advanced Metering Infrastructure, covering smart meters, Head-End Systems (HES), and Meter Data Management Systems (MDMS). The course highlights how the integration of these systems facilitates significant improvements in outage management, energy efficiency, tamper detection, and demand-side management. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze the benefits of deploying these smart technologies and understand their contribution to creating a more resilient and responsive power distribution network.

title: Supply Chain Resilience and Logistics for Viksit Bharat
desc: This course provides an overview of India’s logistics and supply chain ecosystem and examines the Government’s role in building a resilient, technology-enabled and sustainable logistics backbone for Viksit Bharat 2047. It explores the current logistics scenario, logistics costs, transportation and shipping infrastructure, workforce requirements, and the emerging challenges and opportunities shaping India’s logistics sector. The course highlights the role of data analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Internet of Things, Blockchain, robotics, automation, digital twins, cloud computing and other emerging technologies in improving logistics efficiency and supply chain resilience. It also examines the evolving logistics workforce, emerging job roles, future skills, and the importance of continuous upskilling, diversity and industry-academia collaboration.

title: Supply Custody and Sale of Postage Stamps
desc: This comprehensive e-learning session delves into the essential operational guidelines for handling postage stamps within the postal system, as mandated by PO Order No. Phil/01/2024 and Regulation 81 of the Post Office Regulations 2024. The course provides a structured overview of the procedures that govern the entire process, starting from the Directorate's notification for a new stamp issue to its distribution to philatelic bureaus and counters. Key learning areas include the protocols for publicizing a stamp release, ensuring the security of stamps before their official release date, and managing sales of commemorative and special issues. Participants will also learn the correct procedures for stock management, handling of unsold or obsolete stamps, and maintaining both physical and digital records. By completing this course, postal officials will be equipped to manage the supply, custody, and sale of postage stamps with precision, accountability, and adherence to regulatory standards, safeguarding valuable government assets.

title: Supply of Goods and Services by and to the Government
desc: Under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime, government bodies are active participants in the supply chain, making it essential for public functionaries to understand the specific tax implications. This course delves into the legal and practical aspects of GST for government transactions. It begins by establishing the context, explaining the status of government entities under the CGST Act, 2017, and defining core concepts like 'goods', 'services', and 'supply'. Key learning areas include identifying which government supplies are taxable versus those that are exempt, and understanding the GST treatment for supplies made to government departments. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the mechanism of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), detailing its applicability, exclusions, and compliance requirements. By exploring these nuances, learners will be empowered to accurately apply GST provisions, ensuring financial propriety and adherence to tax laws in all government-related procurement and supply activities.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)
keywords: Supply of Goods and Services by and to the Government

title: Supporting Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the Forest Sector: How can we do more? The rationale for a multi-sectoral approach
desc: Dive into the world of forest-based Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and discover their immense potential for driving sustainable and inclusive development. This course provides a comprehensive overview of why supporting these enterprises is crucial for poverty reduction, job creation, and achieving climate goals. Participants will gain a clear understanding of the complex ecosystem in which forest SMEs operate, including the major constraints that hinder their growth, such as insecure land tenure, weak enterprise competitiveness, and limited access to financial services. The course presents a compelling rationale for a multi-sectoral approach, integrating perspectives from trade, finance, and environmental management to create effective support systems. Through expert presentations and real-world case studies from Mexico, China, and Brazil, learners will explore proven strategies and innovative solutions. By the end of this course, development practitioners and policymakers will be better equipped to design and implement programs that unlock the full potential of SMEs in the forest sector, fostering both economic prosperity and environmental stewardship.

title: Surplus Stores in Indian Railways
desc: This course offers an in-depth guide to the principles and procedures of surplus stores management, a critical function for maintaining operational efficiency and financial integrity within Indian Railways. The curriculum is designed to provide a clear understanding of why effective surplus management is essential for a large-scale organization, focusing on minimizing wastage and optimizing resource allocation. Participants will learn to identify and classify surplus stores, distinguishing between 'Moveable Surplus' and 'Dead Surplus.' The course walks through the entire documentation process, including the preparation and use of the 'Advice Note for Returned Stores' (Form S-1539 / D.S.-8). It further clarifies the distinct responsibilities of the Returning, Stores, and Accounts departments, explaining how they collaborate to ensure that returned materials are properly credited and accounted for. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to apply best practices in inventory control, contributing to a more streamlined, accountable, and cost-effective stores management system within Indian Railways.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Suspense Accounts in Defence
desc: This course is designed to equip participants with a thorough understanding of Suspense Accounts as they apply to the Defence sector. The curriculum delves into the critical role these accounts play in managing transactions where funds are temporarily held pending final classification. The course is structured into six key modules: an introduction to suspense accounts, their various categories, and detailed accounting procedures for PAO & AG Suspense, PSB, Reserve Bank & Miscellaneous Suspense, and Defence Payments & Receipts. By exploring these areas, learners will understand the complete lifecycle of suspense account management. The program concludes by addressing the common challenges encountered, enabling participants to navigate the complexities of defence accounting, ensure financial discipline, and maintain transactional integrity within the Defence Accounts Department.

title: Suspension Procedures for AIS Officers
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the suspension procedures applicable to All India Services (AIS) officers under the AIS (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1969. It focuses on the legal framework governing suspension, including grounds for suspension, competent authorities, procedural requirements, financial implications, review mechanisms, and safeguards to ensure compliance with established rules. Designed as an intermediate-level course, it enables learners to understand and apply key provisions related to suspension, including Rule 3 (grounds for suspension), Rule 4 (subsistence allowance), and Rule 5B (financial treatment on reinstatement). The course also covers time-limit provisions, automatic revocation of suspension, and the role of Central Ministry Review Committee processes.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Sustainability Assessment Methods
desc: In an era of rapid urbanization and growing environmental concerns, understanding how to measure and manage sustainability is crucial for professionals in the public sector. This interdisciplinary course offers a detailed exploration of the essential frameworks and tools for sustainability assessment, with a specific focus on the built environment. It is designed for officials and professionals involved in architecture, urban planning, infrastructure, and environmental regulation. The curriculum delves into the principles and applications of major assessment systems, including Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment (GRIHA), Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED), and Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) ratings. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to Lifecycle Analysis (LCA), providing a scientific method to evaluate the environmental footprint of buildings and materials from creation to disposal. By engaging with theoretical foundations and practical applications, participants will be equipped to analyze the triple bottom line—environmental, social, and economic impacts—of development projects. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently apply these assessment methods to drive sustainable design, ensure regulatory compliance, and contribute to building a resilient and resource-efficient future.

title: Sustainable Architecture
desc: In an era of increasing environmental concerns, sustainable architecture offers a path toward creating buildings that are both responsible and resilient. This course delves into the core concepts of sustainability and their direct application to the built environment. You will explore why sustainability is critical for our future, examining foundational ideas like Maslow's hierarchy of needs in the context of building design and the four governing rules of nature: interdependency, efficiency, survival, and change. The curriculum provides a detailed breakdown of the parameters used in green building certifications, covering site selection, water efficiency, energy performance, sustainable materials, and indoor environmental quality. Through an analysis of vernacular architecture from around the world and modern case studies, including a comparison between a green-rated building and a holistically sustainable one, learners will understand how to integrate these principles into practice. This course is essential for professionals in urban development and infrastructure who aim to design and build healthier, more efficient, and socially inclusive communities.

title: Sustainable Development Goals
desc: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) represent a critical global consensus on building a more sustainable, equitable, and prosperous future for all. This introductory course is designed for public officials to develop a clear understanding of this transformative agenda. It delves into the origins and principles of the 2030 Agenda, providing a detailed look at the 17 goals and their associated targets, which span social, economic, and environmental dimensions of development. The curriculum will explore the interconnected nature of the SDGs, emphasizing that progress in one area can catalyze advancements in others. It will highlight the importance of the SDGs in the context of Indian governance, explaining how national and sub-national policies are being aligned with these global objectives. Learners will be introduced to the key frameworks for SDG implementation and monitoring in India, including the role of NITI Aayog and the significance of data-driven tracking. Upon completion, participants will be able to articulate the core components of the SDG framework and recognize its relevance to their roles in public service. This course serves as an essential primer for any official involved in policy formulation, program implementation, or monitoring and evaluation, equipping them with the foundational knowledge to contribute effectively to India's sustainable development journey.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Sustainable Development Goals India Stand (Hindi)
desc: यह परिचयात्मक पाठ्यक्रम लोक सेवकों को सतत विकास लक्ष्यों (एसडीजी) और भारत के विकास पथ के लिए उनकी प्रासंगिकता से परिचित कराने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह पाठ्यक्रम एसडीजी के 17 लक्ष्यों की विस्तृत खोज प्रदान करता है, जिसमें उनके सामाजिक, आर्थिक और पर्यावरणीय आयाम शामिल हैं। शिक्षार्थी भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाए गए प्रमुख नीतिगत ढांचों, कार्यक्रमों और निगरानी तंत्रों के बारे में जानेंगे ताकि राष्ट्रीय और उप-राष्ट्रीय स्तरों पर एसडीजी की प्रगति को ट्रैक किया जा सके। पाठ्यक्रम नीति आयोग की भूमिका पर भी प्रकाश डालता है, जो भारत में एसडीजी के समन्वय और निगरानी के लिए नोडल एजेंसी है। इस पाठ्यक्रम को पूरा करने पर, शिक्षार्थी सार्वजनिक सेवा में अपनी भूमिकाओं में सतत विकास के सिद्धांतों को एकीकृत करने, नीति निर्माण में योगदान देने और भारत के स्थायी भविष्य के लिए प्रभावी कार्यान्वयन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बेहतर ढंग से सुसज्जित होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Sustainable Development Practices
desc: This e-learning module provides a comprehensive overview of sustainable development practices specifically for government administrative buildings. The course sets the context by linking sustainable actions to national and international commitments, such as the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the Paris Climate Agreement. Key learning areas include official advisories on energy conservation, waste reduction, and responsible resource management. Learners will be equipped with a list of general tips and 'doable acts' that can be immediately implemented in the field. By completing this course, participants will not only contribute to their organization's environmental goals but also foster a culture of sustainability and stewardship within the public sector, turning their workplaces into models of green governance.

title: Sustainable Geotechnics
desc: This course delves into the essential principles of sustainable geotechnics, addressing the urgent need for environmentally conscious practices in civil and infrastructure engineering. In the context of global climate change and national sustainability goals, the course explains why transitioning from traditional to sustainable engineering is critical for government bodies. Key learning areas include the application of sustainable materials like geosynthetics and recycled waste, advanced design techniques such as soil nailing and reliability-based optimization, and the management of geo-hazards like landslides and soil degradation. The curriculum also covers the crucial topic of geo-environmental engineering, with a focus on landfill remediation and life cycle analysis to minimize environmental impact. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to design, construct, and maintain resilient, low-carbon infrastructure, contributing to a more sustainable future.

title: Sustainable Organizations: Making Profit with Purpose
desc: In an era of increasing global focus on sustainability, public sector organizations play a critical role in leading the change. This course, "Sustainable Organizations: Integrating Profit with Purpose in the Public Sector," is designed to equip government professionals with the necessary tools and frameworks to embed sustainability into their core functions. The program delves into the foundational pillars of sustainability—environmental, social, and governance (ESG)—and demonstrates their practical application within a public service context. Key learning areas include understanding the circular economy, optimizing resource usage through Industry 4.0 technologies such as AI and IoT, and navigating crucial Indian policy frameworks like the CSR Companies Act and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR). Participants will explore strategies for measuring sustainability performance, improving operational efficiencies, and fostering a culture of innovation. Ultimately, this course empowers learners to design and implement impactful sustainability initiatives that align with national goals and contribute to long-term public value.

title: Sustainable Practices in Construction and Demolition Waste Management
desc: This course provides a specialized understanding of the sustainable management of Construction and Demolition (C&D) waste, one of the fastest-growing and often poorly managed waste streams in urban India. It highlights the environmental challenges arising from improper disposal practices such as illegal dumping, and introduces structured approaches for effective waste management. The course covers waste classification, regulatory frameworks, circular economy principles, and modern material recovery and recycling techniques. Learners will gain practical insights into how C&D waste can be systematically collected, processed, and reused to reduce environmental impact and promote resource efficiency in urban development projects.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: SUSTAINABLE PROCUREMENT
desc: Discover the power of sustainable procurement to drive positive environmental and social change. This comprehensive course is designed for professionals seeking to align their organization's purchasing decisions with global sustainability targets. The curriculum begins by establishing the context, linking procurement practices to pressing issues like climate change and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). You will delve into the key learning areas, including India's public procurement policies, the role of the Government e-Marketing (GeM) platform, and the significance of standards like the Indian Eco Mark. A key focus is the application of the Environment Profit and Loss (EP&L) account, a framework for quantifying environmental impacts. The course examines real-world case studies from various industries, illustrating how multinational corporations implement sustainable practices. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with actionable strategies to evaluate suppliers, analyze the life cycle costs of products, and implement sustainable procurement policies. This course empowers you to transition from conventional purchasing to a strategic function that creates long-term value for your organization and the planet.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Sustainable Sanitation and Water Management
desc: Effective management of sanitation and water resources is fundamental to public health, environmental protection, and sustainable development. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the principles and practices of Sustainable Sanitation and Water Management, tailored for public sector professionals. It addresses the urgent need for integrated solutions to challenges such as water scarcity, pollution, and inadequate sanitation infrastructure, aligning with national priorities like the Jal Jeevan Mission and Swachh Bharat Mission. Participants will delve into key areas including national water and sanitation policies, innovative technologies for water conservation and wastewater treatment, and the importance of fecal sludge management. The curriculum also covers strategies for promoting community participation, ensuring the financial viability of WASH projects, and establishing robust monitoring and evaluation frameworks. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to design, implement, and manage sustainable water and sanitation projects, contributing to healthier communities, a cleaner environment, and more resilient urban and rural infrastructure. This knowledge is crucial for officials involved in planning, public health, and infrastructure development.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Sustainable use of Rainwater and Water Productivity
desc: In an era of increasing water scarcity and climate variability, mastering the art of water conservation is paramount for agricultural sustainability. This course, 'Sustainable Rainwater Use and Water Productivity in Agriculture,' offers foundational knowledge on maximizing the value of every drop of rain. It begins by establishing the context of water management, explaining the hydrological cycle and the challenges posed by different types of droughts. The curriculum then progresses to actionable strategies, covering a range of in-situ and ex-situ rainwater harvesting techniques suitable for diverse agro-climatic conditions. Key topics include understanding catchment areas, estimating evapotranspiration, and the principles behind designing effective water harvesting structures. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze local water challenges, evaluate appropriate conservation measures, and apply principles of water use efficiency. This knowledge is critical for officials and professionals involved in agriculture, rural development, and natural resource management, enabling them to promote and implement practices that enhance crop yields and build climate-resilient farming systems.
org: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE)

title: SVAMITVA Scheme
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the SVAMITVA scheme, a transformative initiative aimed at establishing clear ownership of property in rural inhabited areas. The program is structured to provide a thorough understanding of why the scheme is crucial for rural development and how it contributes to making rural India 'Atmanirbhar' (self-reliant). You will learn about the entire implementation workflow, from pre-survey preparations and community sensitization to the technological aspects of drone-based mapping and the post-survey process of ground verification and property card issuance. The course examines the collaborative efforts between the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, State Revenue Departments, and the Survey of India. Through detailed modules and case studies, learners will analyze the scheme's success in settling land disputes, enabling monetization of property, improving village-level planning, and promoting gender-inclusive property rights. Upon completion, participants will have a robust understanding of the scheme's operational framework, its socio-economic benefits, and its role in strengthening rural governance.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission An Overview
desc: This introductory course delves into the fundamental aspects of the Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM), a transformative initiative aimed at achieving a 'Clean India'. The program provides a detailed look at the mission's context, its critical importance for public health, and its alignment with sustainable development goals. Key learning areas include the distinct components of SBM-Gramin (Rural) and SBM-Urban, the framework for achieving and sustaining Open Defecation Free (ODF) status, and the strategies for managing solid and liquid waste. Participants will explore the pivotal role of Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) activities and community participation in driving behavioral change. Upon completion, learners will be able to articulate the mission's structure, objectives, and its profound impact on governance and citizen well-being, equipping them to support and contribute to this national endeavor.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Swachhata - DoP
desc: This e-learning module delves into the principles and practical application of the Swachhata (Cleanliness) campaign within the Department of Posts. Grounded in the national vision of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, the course begins by establishing the importance of cleanliness for public health, national pride, and creating a positive work environment. It then details the specific action plan formulated by the Department of Posts, providing clear instructions for all employees. Key learning areas include the proper upkeep and maintenance of office spaces, including counters, public halls, and washrooms; systematic procedures for the preservation and timely disposal of official records to declutter workspaces; and the duties of caretakers in maintaining building hygiene. The course culminates with a self-assessment questionnaire, enabling employees to evaluate and report on the implementation of cleanliness standards in their respective offices. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to actively contribute to a cleaner, more organized, and efficient postal service, aligning their daily duties with a vital national objective.

title: Switching Techniques
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the essential switching techniques that form the backbone of modern data communication networks. In an era of digital transformation, understanding how data travels from a sender to a receiver is critical for professionals in the technology and telecommunications sectors. The course begins by defining switching and its importance in network routing. It then systematically breaks down the three major switching paradigms. Learners will first study circuit switching, understanding its dedicated path model. The course then moves to message switching, explaining its store-and-forward mechanism. Finally, it provides an in-depth analysis of packet switching, the dominant technology for the internet, covering its two primary implementations: the connectionless datagram approach and the connection-oriented virtual circuit approach. Throughout the course, the working principles, advantages, and disadvantages of each technique are clearly explained, equipping learners with the analytical framework to evaluate and understand different network architectures.

title: Tableau_L2
desc: Dive deep into the world of advanced data analytics with this comprehensive course on Tableau. In today's competitive landscape, understanding customer behavior is paramount for business success. This course uses a practical case study of churn analysis in the telecom sector to teach you how to transform raw data into actionable business intelligence. You will learn to manage and query data using SQL and Python, preparing it for sophisticated analysis. The core of the course focuses on leveraging Tableau's advanced features. You will build complex visualizations, interactive dashboards, and compelling data stories that clearly communicate findings. Key concepts such as customer lifetime value (CLV), customer segmentation, and identifying churn drivers will be explored in detail. Upon completion, you will not only master advanced Tableau functionalities but also possess the analytical mindset to tackle complex business problems, making you a valuable asset in any data-driven organization. This course is ideal for analysts and professionals looking to elevate their data visualization and strategic analysis skills.

title: Tackling Online Misinformation and Deepfakes
desc: In an era of rapid information flow, the ability to distinguish fact from fiction is a critical skill for public servants. This course is designed to build resilience against online falsehoods, including sophisticated threats like deepfakes and cheap fakes. Participants will begin by understanding the ecosystem of fake news, its various forms, and its potential to cause social unrest, erode public trust, and impact law and order. The core of the course is a detailed walkthrough of the fact-checking process, from initial detection to in-depth investigation and verification. You will learn to use a suite of powerful and accessible online tools, including advanced Google search techniques, reverse image search, video keyframe analysis with InVid, and location verification through geolocation. The course also covers methods for disseminating verified information and pre-bunking potential falsehoods. By the end of this training, you will be equipped to not only identify and debunk misinformation but also to contribute proactively to a more informed public discourse, safeguarding communities from the harms of digital deception.

title: Tackling Violence Against Women and Girls
desc: This course offers a comprehensive examination of Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG) as a critical human rights and public health issue that significantly impedes development. It is designed for public sector professionals seeking to understand and combat this global epidemic. The curriculum delves into the root causes and devastating consequences of VAWG, providing a multi-sectoral framework for action. Key learning areas include analyzing the manifestation of violence in various contexts, such as the lack of safety in public transportation, the heightened risks during disaster scenarios, and the economic disempowerment of women. The course draws from extensive resource guides to present evidence-based strategies for prevention and response. Participants will learn to apply practical guidelines for policy reform, institutional capacity building, and community-level mobilization. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to integrate VAWG prevention measures into development projects, advocate for legal and systemic changes, and contribute to building coordinated support systems for survivors, ultimately fostering a society where women and girls can thrive without fear.

title: Tax Deduction at Source Compliance for Drawing and Disbursing Officers
desc: This course is designed to equip Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) with the knowledge and practical skills required to effectively manage Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) responsibilities in government organisations. It provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal framework, procedures, and compliance requirements governing TDS under the Income-tax Act, 1961. The course begins by introducing the fundamental concepts of TDS and the role of DDOs in ensuring accurate and timely tax deduction and compliance. Participants will explore the relevant legal provisions, rules, and procedures and learn how to determine and calculate TDS for different types of payments, including salaries, contractual payments, and other applicable payments. The course provides practical guidance on key TDS processes, including obtaining a Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN), verifying PAN details, making TDS payments, preparing and filing TDS returns, and using the TRACES portal.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: TCS provisions
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the legal framework and practical application of Tax Collected at Source (TCS) in India. It is structured to build a thorough understanding, starting from the foundational concepts of withholding tax and its history, before focusing specifically on TCS. The curriculum is divided into four modules covering the core aspects of the law. You will learn to identify which transactions fall under the purview of Section 206C of the Income Tax Act, determine the correct tax rates, and understand the exceptions where TCS is not applicable. The course provides step-by-step guidance on the procedures for depositing the collected tax with the government, filing quarterly TCS returns using Form 27EQ, and issuing TCS certificates. Furthermore, it elaborates on the serious consequences of non-compliance, including the imposition of interest, penalties, and potential prosecution. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently navigate and apply TCS provisions in real-world scenarios, ensuring full legal and financial compliance for your organization.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: TDS and TCS Under the Income-tax Act 2025
desc: This course provides a practical and comprehensive overview of the Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and Tax Collected at Source (TCS) provisions under the Income-tax Act, 2025, effective from 1 April 2026. The course focuses on the simplified and restructured withholding tax framework introduced through table-based provisions under Sections 393 and 394, supported by key definitions under Section 402 and compliance mechanisms under Sections 395 to 399. The programme follows a practical compliance-oriented approach, enabling participants to efficiently determine the applicable TDS/TCS provisions by analysing the nature of payment or receipt, the category of payer or collector, applicable thresholds, timing requirements, tax rates, reporting obligations, and certification requirements.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: TDS for DDOs
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) with the necessary skills to effectively handle all aspects of Tax Deduction at Source (TDS). The curriculum delves into the fundamental concepts of the Income Tax Act, explaining the crucial role DDOs play in the government's financial ecosystem. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the legal provisions, rules, and regulations governing TDS. Participants will learn to accurately calculate TDS for different payment types, such as salaries and contractor fees, and understand the correct timing for deductions. The course features practical simulations on obtaining a Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN), filing TDS returns through the TRACES portal, and performing online PAN corrections. It also covers the significant consequences of non-compliance, emphasizing the importance of due diligence and accurate record-keeping. Upon completion, DDOs will be proficient in managing the entire TDS lifecycle, from deduction to final reporting, ensuring full compliance with tax laws.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: TDS under GST
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime, a critical component of financial compliance in public procurement. It is designed to clarify the obligations of government entities that act as tax deductors. The curriculum is built around Section 51 of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017, providing a thorough breakdown of its clauses. Key learning areas include identifying which entities are required to deduct TDS, the standard deduction rate, the monetary threshold for contract values, and the precise procedures for remitting the tax to the government. The course also covers the issuance of TDS certificates to suppliers and outlines the penalties and interest applicable for non-compliance. Special emphasis is placed on the provisions and exemptions relevant to authorities within the Ministry of Defence. Upon completion, learners, especially those in finance and accounting roles, will be proficient in applying TDS rules, ensuring timely compliance, and maintaining accurate financial records, thereby safeguarding their organizations from legal and financial penalties.

title: Team Building
desc: In any professional environment, the ability to work effectively in a team is paramount. While individual skills are valuable, collective success is achieved when team members can collaborate, communicate, and support one another. This course provides a comprehensive framework for understanding and implementing the principles of team building, which is crucial for enhancing organizational productivity and achieving shared objectives in the public sector. The course delves into the core components of a high-performance team. It explains the impact of establishing a common goal, the importance of fostering collaboration, and the mechanisms for improving communication among team members. Participants will learn about situational leadership, the role of trust in achieving success, and strategies for creating a cooperative environment. The content also addresses how to manage team dynamics, encourage diverse viewpoints, and provide constructive recognition to motivate members. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute more effectively to team projects, foster a positive and collaborative work environment, and apply strategies to enhance team cohesion and performance. They will be better prepared to lead and participate in teams that are resilient, innovative, and aligned toward common organizational goals, ultimately improving service delivery and project outcomes.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

desc: In any professional environment, the ability to work effectively in a team is paramount. title: Team Building and Team Management
desc: In today's collaborative work environments, the ability to build and manage effective teams is a critical skill for achieving organizational success. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the foundational knowledge and practical tools needed to foster teamwork and lead with confidence. It addresses the core principles of team dynamics, highlighting why cohesive teams are essential for productivity and innovation in government service. Learners will delve into key areas such as identifying essential teamwork skills, navigating and resolving conflicts constructively, and understanding the pivotal role of a leader in guiding a team towards its objectives. The curriculum also covers strategies for maintaining peak performance, motivating team members, and creating an environment of trust and mutual respect.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Team Building and Team Management
desc: In today's collaborative work environments, the ability to build and manage effective teams is a critical skill for achieving organizational success. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the foundational knowledge and practical tools needed to foster teamwork and lead with confidence. It addresses the core principles of team dynamics, highlighting why cohesive teams are essential for productivity and innovation in government service. Learners will delve into key areas such as identifying essential teamwork skills, navigating and resolving conflicts constructively, and understanding the pivotal role of a leader in guiding a team towards its objectives. The curriculum also covers strategies for maintaining peak performance, motivating team members, and creating an environment of trust and mutual respect. Upon completion, participants will be better prepared to cultivate a positive team culture, enhance communication and collaboration, and apply proven techniques for giving feedback that encourages growth. This course empowers leaders and team members alike to contribute to building resilient, efficient, and goal-oriented teams capable of tackling complex challenges in public service.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Technical Barriers to Trade and Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures
desc: In today's interconnected global economy, understanding the rules that govern international trade is paramount for public sector officials involved in commerce, policy, and regulation. This course delves into two cornerstone agreements of the World Trade Organization (WTO): Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) and Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) Measures. It explains why these measures are crucial for protecting public health, safety, and the environment while preventing them from becoming unjustifiable obstacles to trade. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the core principles and obligations under the TBT and SPS Agreements. You will learn about the importance of transparency, including notification requirements and the establishment of enquiry points. The course also explores the functioning of the TBT and SPS Committees, where member countries collaborate, discuss specific trade concerns, and work towards harmonizing standards. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze how TBT and SPS measures impact trade flows and regulatory autonomy. This knowledge is essential for officials formulating trade policy, participating in international negotiations, or ensuring that domestic standards align with global best practices, thereby fostering a predictable and fair trading environment.

title: Technical Report 069
desc: This course offers a detailed overview of the TR-069 protocol, also known as the CPE WAN Management Protocol (CWMP). It is designed for telecom professionals seeking to understand how this standard facilitates the remote management of broadband devices like routers, ONTs, and gateways. The curriculum delves into the protocol's structure, the workflow of sessions between the ACS and CPE, and the critical security mechanisms that ensure secure communication. Key learning areas include auto-configuration, remote diagnostics, performance monitoring, and firmware upgrades. By understanding these functionalities, participants will grasp how TR-069 streamlines service deployment, minimizes on-site visits, and improves network scalability. The course emphasizes the practical benefits of adopting this protocol, such as significant reductions in operational expenditure and an enhanced customer experience in broadband service delivery.

title: Techniques of Financial Appraisal in Indian Railways Projects
desc: This course introduces the concept and importance of financial and economic appraisal in Indian Railways. It explains the need for financial justification and the identification of direct and indirect economic benefits. Learners will explore key financial appraisal techniques, including Accounting Rate of Return (ARR), Payback Period, and Discounted Cash Flow methods (NPV and IRR), along with basic calculations and interpretations. The course also examines appraisal challenges during the construction, operation, and terminal phases of a project, considering key assumptions such as inflation, Interest During Construction (IDC), and cost escalation.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM)

title: Techno Legal Aspects of Digital Signature Certificate
desc: In an era of digital transformation, ensuring the authenticity and integrity of electronic records is paramount for effective e-governance. This course offers a detailed examination of the techno-legal aspects of Digital Signature Certificates (DSCs), the primary mechanism for securing digital transactions in India. Learners will explore the foundational technologies, including Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), cryptographic methods like RSA and ECC, and hashing functions such as SHA-256. The course provides a structured walkthrough of how digital signatures are created, applied, and verified to guarantee authenticity, integrity, and non-repudiation. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the legal landscape, with an in-depth analysis of the Information Technology Act, 2000. It clarifies the hierarchical structure and responsibilities of the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) and the licensed Certifying Authorities (CAs). Through practical demonstrations and case studies, participants will understand how to apply DSCs in real-world scenarios, such as signing official documents, thereby strengthening the security and legal validity of their digital work.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Technological Advancement for Decarbonisation in the Steel Sector
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the strategies and technologies essential for the decarbonisation of India's steel sector. It addresses the critical need for the industry to align with national and global climate objectives by reducing its carbon footprint. Participants will begin by understanding the primary steel production routes in India and the energy-efficiency tools available to mitigate emissions. The curriculum delves into Best Available Technologies (BATs), analyzing their implementation within the Indian context. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Industrial Carbon Management (ICM) framework, including associated carbon trading schemes that leverage market mechanisms to drive change. Learners will explore advanced concepts such as material efficiency strategies, process transitions to low-carbon alternatives, the potential of green hydrogen, and the application of Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS) technologies. The course also specifically addresses the technological pathways for decarbonising the secondary steel sector. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze and evaluate critical interventions for effective emission reduction across the entire steel production value chain.

title: Technological Advancement for Smart Steel Manufacturing
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the technological advancements driving the transformation of the steel manufacturing sector. In an era of increasing industrial competition, digital innovation is paramount for maintaining efficiency and safety. This program delves into the core principles of smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0, establishing the context for why these technologies are crucial for the steel industry's future. Key learning areas include an exploration of essential terminology, enabling participants to confidently discuss digital concepts. The curriculum focuses heavily on practical applications, examining specific use cases of the Internet of Things (IoT) in steel plants. Learners will analyze how connected sensors, automation, and data analytics support functions like real-time process monitoring, equipment health management, and predictive maintenance. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped to identify high-impact areas for digital integration within their own operational environments, fostering a culture of continuous innovation.

title: Technological Advancement in Delhi Metro Trains
desc: Delve into the engineering and operational innovations that have shaped the Delhi Metro rail network. This course details the significant technological advancements incorporated across different phases of DMRC's rolling stock. The curriculum covers the journey towards full automation, from the initial implementation of the Automatic Train Protection system to the sophisticated Unattended Train Operation (UTO) controlled remotely from the Operations Control Centre (OCC). You will explore critical technical systems, including variable voltage variable frequency (VVVF) propulsion, regenerative braking, advanced traction motors, and redundant auxiliary power supplies. Furthermore, the course examines enhancements in passenger safety and experience, such as modern obstacle detection devices, multi-detector fire alarm systems, improved air conditioning, and dynamic passenger information systems. Upon completion, learners will understand the integral role of technology in creating a reliable, efficient, and world-class urban mass rapid transit system.

title: Technological Foundation of the Prime Minister Gati Shakti Platform
desc: Embark on a learning journey to explore the technological core of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, a transformative initiative for integrated infrastructure planning in India. This course is designed to provide a robust foundational understanding of the entire geospatial data lifecycle, from acquisition and management to sophisticated analysis and visualization, aimed at solving complex, real-world challenges in national development. The curriculum begins with the fundamental pillars of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), explaining how spatial data is used for infrastructure mapping and precise location services. As you advance, the course introduces cutting-edge technologies like cloud computing for managing large-scale datasets and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for predictive modeling and optimization. The course culminates in the specialized domain of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI), where you will learn to apply intelligent algorithms to spatial data for automated feature extraction, change detection, and monitoring infrastructure projects. This comprehensive approach ensures you gain the critical skills to contribute effectively to data-driven, coordinated, and efficient infrastructure development.

title: TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT AND INNOVATION
desc: In today's dynamic environment, the ability to strategically manage technology and drive innovation is critical for public sector organizations to enhance efficiency and service delivery. This course is designed to equip government professionals with the essential frameworks and knowledge to navigate the complexities of the technological landscape. Participants will explore the complete lifecycle of technology management, including technology forecasting, intelligence gathering, and developing robust technology strategies. The course examines various models for fostering innovation, managing intellectual property, and measuring the impact of technological initiatives. It also delves into practical case studies and frameworks used by leading organizations to align their technology roadmaps with strategic objectives. Upon completion, learners will be able to analyze their organization's technological capabilities, identify opportunities for innovation, and formulate actionable strategies to leverage technology for competitive advantage and improved public outcomes. They will be prepared to lead and contribute to digital transformation initiatives, ensuring that technology investments deliver tangible value and support long-term goals.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Technology Management and Innovation: Strategies for the Public Sector
desc: In today's dynamic environment, the ability to strategically manage technology and drive innovation is critical for public sector organizations to enhance efficiency and service delivery. This course is designed to equip government professionals with the essential frameworks and knowledge to navigate the complexities of the technological landscape. Participants will explore the complete lifecycle of technology management, including technology forecasting, intelligence gathering, and developing robust technology strategies. The course examines various models for fostering innovation, managing intellectual property, and measuring the impact of technological initiatives. It also delves into practical case studies and frameworks used by leading organizations to align their technology roadmaps with strategic objectives.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Technology Management in India Post-English
desc: This course is designed to equip all employees of the Department of Posts with the essential knowledge and skills for effective technology management. In an era of rapid digital transformation, the smooth functioning of postal services relies heavily on a wide array of electronic equipment. This program delves into the critical aspects of managing these technological assets throughout their entire lifecycle. Participants will learn to identify and handle various hardware and peripherals, from computers and printers to specialized equipment like franking machines and network devices. The curriculum provides a step-by-step overview of the procurement process via the GeM portal, adherence to GFR 2017, and proper supply chain management to subordinate units. Key learning areas include maintaining accurate records and history sheets, implementing preventive maintenance schedules, and executing the official condemnation and disposal processes for unserviceable items, including e-waste management. By completing this course, postal employees will be better prepared to ensure the longevity and optimal performance of departmental equipment, minimize downtime, and uphold operational excellence.

title: Telecom Analytics using Financial and Operational Data
desc: This course helps participants to built analytical skills in the domain of Finance that support financial planning, improves organizational performance that leads to effective decision making . The names of the companies used is for academic purposes only. All the data presented & analysed in the course has been sourced from publicly shared information such as KPI format, Annual Financial Statement etc. The analysis and any conclusion drawn are merely to show how data can be analysed, co-related and presented to extract useful insights. The Conclusion and insights mentioned in the course are not with the purpose of promoting any company or to show any company in a negative light. Learners may apply discretion while going through the course and should focus upon the spirit and methodology of analysis rather than the conclusions drawn in the course. The Conclusion drawn are merely incidental and should not be taken against the course provider in the court of law.

title: Telecom Infra Maintenance
desc: In the telecommunications sector, ensuring uninterrupted service is paramount. This depends on the robust and reliable functioning of critical support infrastructure. This course, 'Maintenance of Telecom Power and Support Infrastructure,' offers a detailed guide for technical staff responsible for the upkeep of these essential systems. It provides a foundational understanding of why this infrastructure is vital and equips learners with the practical knowledge to perform routine and preventive maintenance effectively. The course is structured into five key modules covering the core components of telecom support systems. You will learn about the working principles of SMPS power plants, including their specifications, installation, and troubleshooting. The curriculum delves into battery technologies like VRLA and Lithium-ion, focusing on charging methods, maintenance schedules, and safety protocols. Furthermore, it covers the types and maintenance of air conditioning units, the operation of engine alternators (DG sets), and the correct use of fire extinguishers. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently manage and maintain power systems, batteries, and environmental control units. This will enable them to minimize downtime, enhance equipment lifespan, and ensure the overall resilience and stability of the telecommunications network, contributing directly to consistent service delivery for customers.

title: Telecommunications Act 2023
desc: The Telecommunications Act, 2023, represents a landmark legislative reform for India, replacing archaic laws like the Indian Telegraph Act of 1885. In an era of rapid technological advancement, this new Act provides a modern, streamlined, and future-ready framework to govern the telecommunications sector. This course is designed for officials and professionals who need to understand the practical implications of this new legislation on telecom operations, policy, and governance. Participants will delve into the core components of the Act, including the updated procedures for authorization, spectrum assignment, and securing Right of Way. The curriculum examines the structure and purpose of new initiatives like the Digital Bharat Nidhi, which aims to enhance universal service obligations, and the Regulatory Sandbox, designed to foster innovation. Furthermore, the course addresses critical aspects of user protection, public safety, national security provisions, and the detailed processes for adjudicating contraventions. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the Act's impact on the telecom ecosystem, from service providers to end-users. They will be able to interpret key legal provisions, ensure compliance within their organizations, and contribute to the effective implementation of the law. This course provides the foundational knowledge required to navigate India's updated telecom regulatory environment with confidence and clarity, connecting legal principles with real-world operational contexts.

title: Telecommunications Bill
desc: This course offers an in-depth analysis of the transition to a new legal era for India's telecommunications sector with the introduction of the Telecommunication Bill, 2022. It begins by establishing the context, detailing why the century-old Indian Telegraph Act, 1885, and associated laws are no longer adequate for a digital-first economy. Learners will dissect the shortcomings of the previous legal regime in handling modern challenges such as spectrum management, right of way, data privacy, and national security.The curriculum guides participants through the entire legislative journey, from identifying the need for a new act to the pre-legislative consultative policy and the drafting process. Key learning areas include a detailed study of the draft bill's provisions on licensing, spectrum assignment, dispute resolution, and user protection. The course also highlights the bill's aim to consolidate multiple laws into a single, simplified, and future-ready framework. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to appreciate the complexities of telecom policy and understand the significant impact of this new legislation on governance, industry, and national interests.
org: National Telecommunications Institute for Policy Research, Innovation and Training (NTIPRIT)

title: Telephone System
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the essential principles of telephone systems, a cornerstone of modern communication. It addresses the critical need for reliable voice interaction in both public and private sectors. The curriculum begins with the fundamental working principles, comparing circuit-switched and packet-switched networks, and explains the transition from analog to digital and VoIP technologies. Key learning areas include an in-depth look at the core components of a telephone network, such as local loops, trunks, and various switching mechanisms. The course also covers technical standards, including the standard voice frequency range of 300 to 3400 Hz. By analyzing the application of these systems within the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC), participants will gain a real-world perspective on how telephony supports mission-critical operations, station coordination, and emergency management. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze the design and function of different telephone networks and appreciate their enduring importance in today's complex communication landscape.

title: Term Cell Instructions on Mobile Connections
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the instructions issued by India's TERM Cells for the regulation of mobile connections. It is designed to equip telecom professionals and government officials with a thorough understanding of the compliance landscape. The curriculum is structured to cover the critical functions of TERM Cells, including the auditing of subscriber verification processes and the imposition of penalties for non-compliance. Learners will be guided through the specific protocols for activating new SIM cards, the stringent requirements for issuing connections to foreigners and outstation customers, and the rules for managing bulk connections for organizations. Furthermore, the course addresses procedures for handling changes in subscriber information, the process for timely disconnection of non-compliant connections, and the steps for lodging complaints or FIRs in cases of fraud. By completing this course, participants will be proficient in applying these regulatory instructions, contributing to a secure and well-regulated telecom environment in line with India's legal framework.

title: Terrorist Act and Organised Crime and Petty Organised Crime
desc: This course provides a detailed understanding of terrorist acts, organised crime, and petty organised crime under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. It explains the legal provisions under Sections 111, 112, and 113, covering the nature of offences, acts constituting these crimes, statutory explanations, and the punishments prescribed, including imprisonment and fines. Participants will gain clarity on differentiating between terrorist acts, organised crime, and petty organised crime, as well as the legal consequences for each, enabling accurate application of criminal law principles.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Test Identification Parades
desc: This course provides an in-depth examination of Test Identification Parades (TIPs), a fundamental component of the criminal investigation process in India. It addresses the critical need for reliable witness identification to ensure fair trials and uphold justice. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the legal and procedural intricacies of TIPs. Learners will explore the statutory provisions, constitutional safeguards under Article 20(3), and the established best practices for conducting these parades. The course delves into the evidentiary value of identification evidence, analyzing how it is weighed by courts and the factors that can impact its admissibility. Through a detailed study of landmark Supreme Court judgments, such as Budhasen vs. State of Andhra Pradesh, participants will gain insights into judicial reasoning and the evolution of legal standards. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to correctly conduct and supervise TIPs, critically evaluate identification evidence, and apply legal principles to real-world investigative scenarios, thereby enhancing procedural integrity and investigative outcomes.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: The Art and Science of Communication
desc: In today's complex professional landscape, effective communication is a critical competency for leadership and success. This course, 'The Art and Science of Communication,' delves deep into the dynamics of human interaction within an organizational context. It begins by establishing a strong foundation, defining the communication process and exploring common hindrances such as psychological noise, personal biases, and ego. The curriculum then progresses to advanced practical skills. You will learn to analyze and interpret non-verbal signals, including body language (kinesics), personal space (proxemics), and the use of time (chronemics). The course provides structured guidance on framing messages for clarity and persuasion, developing robust listening skills to understand intent, and delivering impactful impromptu and planned presentations. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with a strategic toolkit to enhance your interpersonal effectiveness, build stronger professional relationships, and influence outcomes with confidence and clarity.

title: The Art and Science of Managing Negotiation in Public Governance
desc: The course presents negotiation as a structured process of communication, consensus-building, and stakeholder alignment that is essential for advancing the public good. Drawing on contemporary research, historical case studies, and insights from the Mahabharata and Bhagavad Gita, the masterclass explores the psychology of human behavior, conflict resolution, and strategic decision-making. The course introduces a practical framework for understanding conflict through four interconnected levels—Intrapersonal, Interpersonal, Intragroup, and Intergroup—and demonstrates why effective negotiation begins with achieving alignment within oneself and one's team before engaging external stakeholders. Participants will also examine the Five Dimensions of Negotiating Ability—Artfulness, Diplomacy, Detachedness, Fair-mindedness, and Sagacity—which provide a comprehensive framework for negotiation excellence.

title: The Art of Communication
desc: In today's interconnected world, the ability to communicate effectively is more critical than ever, especially within the public sector. This course, 'The Art of Effective Communication,' is designed to equip government officials with the foundational skills needed to excel in their roles. The program delves into the core principles of communication, breaking it down into its essential components: verbal, non-verbal, listening, and writing. Participants will learn why communication is a two-way process that requires active engagement from both the sender and the receiver. Key learning areas include mastering body language, tone of voice, active listening, and crafting clear written messages. The course also covers practical applications, such as delivering effective presentations and navigating workplace interactions with empathy and assertiveness. By the end of this course, learners will not only understand the theory of communication but will also have a clear roadmap to practice and improve these vital skills, leading to stronger professional relationships, better team collaboration, and enhanced service delivery.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: The Art of Listening
desc: Effective listening is a cornerstone of professional success, enabling clear communication, strong relationships, and impactful outcomes. This course provides a comprehensive guide to mastering the art of active listening. It begins by establishing the context of why this skill is vital in today's fast-paced, distraction-filled world, particularly within the public sector where clear communication is paramount for service delivery and collaboration. Key learning areas include differentiating between simply hearing and actively listening, techniques for maintaining focus, and the importance of interpreting non-verbal cues and underlying emotions. Learners will explore practical methods such as making eye contact, paraphrasing to confirm understanding, and asking insightful questions to foster deeper, more meaningful conversations. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped to apply these skills to build trust, resolve conflicts, gather crucial information, and enhance their overall effectiveness in every interaction, leading to improved productivity and stronger professional networks.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: The Asomi Pearl Farming Story
desc: The Asomi Pearl Farming Project in Nagaon, Assam, demonstrates how grassroots innovation can enhance rural livelihoods by integrating freshwater pearl cultivation with traditional aquaculture, creating additional income streams and environmental benefits. Despite technical and market challenges, the initiative succeeded through skill development, cooperative financial support, and buy-back assurances. With the global pearl market exceeding USD 10.5 billion and India’s presence still limited, the project highlights Assam’s potential to become a key player in global pearl value chains. Scaling the model will require advanced training, improved grafting techniques, stronger cooperative governance, branding, and policy-backed market linkages, enabling its transformation into a sustainable, market-driven rural enterprise that strengthens economic resilience.

title: The Banded Iron Formation, a mute spectator of Great Oxidation Event
desc: Delve into Earth's deep past with this comprehensive course on Banded Iron Formations (BIFs) and their connection to the planet's atmospheric evolution. The program is designed to explain why understanding paleoclimate is essential for assessing current environmental trends. You will explore the geological evidence that scientists use to reconstruct ancient climates, with a special focus on BIFs as indicators of the Great Oxidation Event. The course is structured into three modules: the first discusses the transition of Earth's atmosphere and the processes behind it; the second defines BIFs and their relationship to paleoclimate phenomena like 'Snowball Earth'; and the third covers the classification of BIFs, the formation of iron ore from them, and their economic significance. Upon completion, you will have a robust understanding of how these ancient rocks provide a window into billions of years of planetary change.

title: The Basic Seven Tools of Quality
desc: This course provides a practical and comprehensive understanding of the Seven Basic Quality Tools, which are essential techniques for identifying, analyzing, and solving quality-related problems across various processes and industries. These tools form the foundation of effective quality management and continuous improvement initiatives. The curriculum delves into the purpose and application of each tool: Flow Charts, Check Sheets, Histograms, Pareto Charts, Cause-and-Effect (Fishbone) Diagrams, Control Charts, and Scatter Diagrams. Through clear explanations and illustrative examples, learners will gain the knowledge to apply a structured approach to creating and interpreting these tools in real-world scenarios. The course is designed to equip participants with the ability to select the appropriate tool for specific quality challenges, enabling them to drive process optimization, reduce variability, and foster a culture of excellence. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to implement these fundamental techniques in their daily work to achieve higher standards of quality and performance.
org: Yantra Institute of Technology and Management

title: The Civil Procedure Code, 1908
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908, a cornerstone of procedural law in India. It is specifically designed to equip government officials, especially those in the revenue and tax departments, with the necessary legal knowledge to effectively discharge their duties. The content delves into the dual structure of the CPC, comprising Sections that establish general principles and Orders that prescribe detailed procedures. Key learning areas are structured into modules covering the issuance and service of summons (Order V), summoning and attendance of witnesses (Order XVI), the role of affidavits in proceedings (Order XIX), and the critical processes for the attachment of property to execute decrees (Order XXI). The course also explains the powers to issue commissions (Order XXVI) and the grounds for review (Order XLVII), linking these legal provisions to their practical application under the Income Tax Act, 1961. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in navigating key civil procedures relevant to their official functions.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: The Concept of Disinvestment Policies and Processes
desc: Delve into the critical subject of disinvestment and its role in shaping India's modern economic landscape. This course offers a detailed examination of the government's strategic approach to managing public assets, transitioning from a state-controlled to a market-driven economy.
