You will explore the fundamental rationale behind disinvestment, including addressing the underperformance of Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs) and reducing the national fiscal burden. The curriculum covers the complete lifecycle of the disinvestment process, from policy formulation and the establishment of key bodies like the Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM) to the various modes of implementation, such as Initial Public Offers (IPOs), strategic sales, and asset monetization. Through an analysis of landmark cases like Air India and LIC, learners will gain a nuanced understanding of how India balances economic objectives with public interest, aligning with the principle of 'Minimum Government, Maximum Governance'. Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze and interpret the policies that drive public asset management in India.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the protection of personal data has become a critical aspect of governance and citizen trust. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of India's landmark legislation, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. It begins by outlining the evolution and purpose of the Act, setting the context for its implementation. You will delve into the key legal provisions governing the processing of personal data, including the requirements for obtaining consent and other grounds for lawful use. The curriculum clearly defines the roles, rights, and responsibilities of Data Principals and Data Fiduciaries, which are central to the Act's framework. Furthermore, the course explains the establishment and operational mandate of the Data Protection Board of India, covering its role in enforcement, the process for levying penalties, and the procedures for adjudication and appeals.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
desc: In an increasingly digital world, the protection of personal data has become a critical aspect of governance and citizen trust. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of India's landmark legislation, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. It begins by outlining the evolution and purpose of the Act, setting the context for its implementation. You will delve into the key legal provisions governing the processing of personal data, including the requirements for obtaining consent and other grounds for lawful use. The curriculum clearly defines the roles, rights, and responsibilities of Data Principals and Data Fiduciaries, which are central to the Act's framework. Furthermore, the course explains the establishment and operational mandate of the Data Protection Board of India, covering its role in enforcement, the process for levying penalties, and the procedures for adjudication and appeals. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the core components of the DPDP Act, 2023, ensuring compliance and upholding data privacy principles within their organizations.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: The DigiYatra Initiative
desc: In Dec 2022, the Government of India launched the Digi Yatra initiative at three airports (Delhi, Bengaluru, Varanasi)—a first-of-its-kind digital transformation program that aimed to streamline air travel processes and enhance passenger experiences at airports across the country. The program aimed to eliminate long queues, reduce paperwork, and improve security checks by leveraging biometric technology and digital identification. The Airports Authority of India (AAI), along with other airport operators, took on the task of implementing this ambitious project. Starting with three airports, the government rolled out the initiative in a phased manner, and by the end of 2024, it had implemented Digi Yatra across various airports in the country, significantly improving passenger convenience and operational efficiency.

title: The Evolving Role of the CISO in light of Cyber Crime
desc: This comprehensive session delves into the multifaceted and evolving role of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). As cyber threats become more sophisticated, the CISO's position has transformed from a technical oversight function to a strategic leadership role that is integral to business continuity and stakeholder trust. The course provides a detailed exploration of the modern CISO's responsibilities, including strategic planning, incident response, third-party vendor management, and ensuring legal and ethical compliance. Participants will learn to identify and understand a wide array of contemporary cybercrimes, such as deepfakes, social engineering, digital arrest, and threats associated with personal devices (BYOD), smart technology, and improper data disposal. The content offers practical guidance on safeguarding both personal and professional digital assets, emphasizing a proactive and vigilant approach to security. Ultimately, this course equips learners with the knowledge to contribute to a robust security culture, making them a harder target for cybercriminals and strengthening the organization's overall digital integrity.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Fundamentals of Fintech: Revolutionizing the Financial Landscape
desc: Dive into the dynamic world of Fintech and understand how technology is reshaping financial services in India and globally. This course offers a comprehensive overview, beginning with the historical evolution of Fintech from its early stages to the current era of AI and blockchain. You will explore the diverse applications of Fintech, including mobile banking, digital payments, peer-to-peer lending, robo-advisory, and InsurTech. The program specifically highlights the Indian context, analyzing the success of India Stack, UPI, and the rapid growth of the nation's startup ecosystem. Learners will also gain critical insights into the regulatory environment, including challenges related to data security, compliance, and customer trust. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to analyze the opportunities and challenges within the Fintech sector and appreciate its significance for economic growth and financial inclusion.
org: Ministry of Communications- Department of Telecommunications

title: The Future of Cloud and Data Centers - I
desc: Delve into the core of India's digital transformation with this insightful discussion on the future of cloud computing and data centers. This course provides a comprehensive overview for government decision-makers and policy makers on the strategic importance of building a robust national digital infrastructure. The content traces the history of data centers in India, from their enterprise origins to the current era of hyperscale cloud regions. Key learning areas include the concept of sovereign cloud versus data localization, the economic and physical components of building large-scale data center campuses, and the impact of emerging technologies like AI and GPUs. By understanding these foundational elements, learners will be better equipped to formulate policies and make informed decisions that support a secure, scalable, and self-reliant digital India, ensuring the nation can fully leverage its demographic and digital advantages on the global stage.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Future of Cloud and Data Centers - II
desc: Delving into the advanced aspects of modern digital infrastructure, this course examines the evolving landscape of cloud and data centers. The discussion provides a strategic overview of why specialized infrastructure is crucial for supporting India's digital transformation goals. Key learning areas include the technical requirements for enabling AI and ML applications, such as high-density GPU computing and advanced cooling technologies like direct liquid cooling. The course also addresses the critical policy and security dimensions of data sovereignty and data localization, contrasting national strategies with the models of global hyperscalers. Learners will understand the economic and strategic rationale behind initiatives like the India AI Mission and Atmanirbhar Bharat in the technology sector. By the end of this course, participants will be equipped to make more informed decisions regarding technology adoption, procurement, and policy-making in the context of building a resilient and sovereign national digital ecosystem.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Future of Digital Governance: New Innovations and Emerging Trends
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the evolving landscape of digital governance in India and globally. It begins by contextualizing India's position as a leader in GovTech, referencing global benchmarks like the World Bank and UN indices, while also acknowledging challenges such as the digital divide. The curriculum focuses on the architecture and impact of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), analyzing transformative platforms like UPI, ONDC, DigiLocker, and Aadhaar. Learners will explore how these frameworks are designed to break monopolies, enhance accessibility, and foster a more inclusive digital economy. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to emerging technologies, including the practical applications of AI, the importance of data-centricity in policy making, and the strategic shift towards cloud-based infrastructure. Participants will gain insights into designing seamless, omni-channel citizen journeys and the importance of continuous improvement in service delivery. The session also addresses critical governance issues such as the DPDP Act, cybersecurity, and the ethical implications of AI, equipping policymakers and public sector leaders with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of digital transformation.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Future of Transportation: Maglev and Hyperloop Technologies
desc: Embark on a journey into the future of transportation with this in-depth exploration of Maglev and Hyperloop technologies. As the world seeks faster, more efficient, and sustainable travel solutions, this course provides the foundational knowledge to understand these cutting-edge systems. The program begins by tracing the history of high-speed rail and introduces the three major leaps in transport technology: conventional high-speed rail (WHSR), magnetic suspension high-speed rail (MHSR), and the futuristic super-speed rail (SSR) or Hyperloop. Learners will gain a detailed understanding of the core principles of Maglev, including the key differences between Electromagnetic Suspension (EMS) and Electrodynamic Suspension (EDS) systems, covering levitation, guidance, and propulsion. The course also examines the conceptual framework of the Hyperloop, its development, and its potential to revolutionize long-distance travel. Through a comparative analysis of existing and planned projects in countries like Japan, China, and Germany, participants will be equipped to evaluate the technical feasibility, infrastructure requirements, and strategic implications of adopting these transformative technologies.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: The Gauge and Railway Lines
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the technical and historical aspects of railway gauges within the Indian Railways. It begins by establishing the fundamental importance of gauge width for the safety and efficiency of rail operations. You will learn about the different gauge standards, from broad and standard to meter and narrow gauges, and understand their specific applications across diverse terrains and economic contexts. The course provides a detailed historical perspective on the adoption of various gauges in India, including the rationale behind the initial selection of broad gauge and the subsequent introduction of narrower tracks. A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to analyzing the complex challenges of having a multi-gauge system, such as passenger inconvenience and goods transshipment issues. Learners will gain insight into the landmark 'Unigauge' policy of 1992, understanding its objectives, implementation, and the profound benefits of creating a standardized, efficient, and modern national rail network. By the end, you will be able to classify broad gauge lines and appreciate the strategic decisions shaping India's railway infrastructure.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: THE GREAT GEOLOGICAL JOURNEY: EARTH'S STORY THROUGH TIME
desc: This course, 'A Journey Through Earth's Geological History,' offers a detailed exploration of our planet's epic story, from its chaotic origins to the present day. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals of the geological time scale, providing the essential principles for understanding Earth's chronology. You will then delve into the Hadean era, witnessing the planet's fiery birth and the precursors to life. The journey continues through the Archean and Proterozoic eras, where you will learn about the formation of the Earth's crust, the great oxygenation event, and the rise of complex organisms. The Paleozoic module covers the Cambrian explosion and the assembly of the supercontinent Pangaea. Subsequently, the course examines the Mesozoic era, the age of reptiles and the breakup of Pangaea, which shaped modern continents. Finally, the Cenozoic era module discusses the rise of mammals and the climatic shifts that created our contemporary world. Upon completion, you will have a robust framework for understanding the geological, climatic, and biological evolution of Earth.

title: The Haryana Karmayogi Program
desc: The Haryana Karmayogi Program offers a transformative journey for government employees, aiming to instill a renewed sense of purpose and dedication to public service. The course is structured into three insightful modules that build upon each other. The first module, 'Who is a Haryana Karmayogi,' helps learners appreciate the unique mindset and behaviors that define a Karmayogi. The second module, 'What the Haryana Karmayogi seeks from work,' expands on the intrinsic rewards of public service, linking diligent effort to greater personal and professional fulfillment. The final module, 'The choice made by the Haryana Karmayogi,' emphasizes the conscious decision to adopt 'Seva Bhav'—a commitment to serving the greater good of citizens, the department, and the self. By completing this program, participants will be equipped with a positive framework for engagement, leading to more meaningful work and enhanced contributions to the state of Haryana.

title: The Hunt for Benami Property: A Data-Driven Approach
desc: A retired senior civil servant, living a quiet post-service life, drew attention when the Benami Unit in Delhi spotted unusual property records. Quiet checks began—silent, precise, unnoticed. Clues pointed to hidden wealth. A secret search was planned across four cities. When the Income Tax teams struck, they uncovered a web of unreported assets and benami properties worth over ₹240 crores. Behind the calm facade lay a story of evasion—now exposed.

title: The Indian Contracts Act, 1872
desc: The Indian Contract Act, 1872, is the cornerstone of commercial and civil law in India, providing a structured framework for all agreements. This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of this critical legislation. The curriculum begins with the basics, defining what constitutes a contract and differentiating between various types such as valid, void, and voidable contracts. It then delves into the core requirements for a contract to be legally enforceable, including offer and acceptance, lawful consideration, competent parties, and free consent. Learners will analyze complex scenarios involving coercion, undue influence, fraud, and misrepresentation. The course further explains how contracts are discharged, what constitutes a breach, and the various legal remedies available to an aggrieved party, such as damages and specific performance. It also touches upon special contracts like indemnity, guarantee, bailment, pledge, and the law of agency, providing a holistic view applicable to various governmental functions, including procurement and public-private partnerships.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: The Indian Drone Manufacturing and Technology Landscape
desc: Delve into the world of drone simulation technology and understand its pivotal role in the Indian drone manufacturing and technology landscape. This course offers a detailed overview of how virtual environments are revolutionizing drone operations. You will learn about the fundamental architecture of drone simulators, from software interfaces and hardware controllers to the sophisticated physics engines that replicate realistic flight dynamics. The curriculum explores key applications such as training pilots on emergency procedures, rehearsing complex missions like 3D mapping and surveillance, and conducting Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing for cybersecurity validation. By the end of this course, you will appreciate the significant benefits of simulation, including reduced operational costs, minimized hardware damage, enhanced operational safety, and adherence to regulatory standards, equipping you with foundational knowledge for this emerging technological field.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding the legal framework governing online activities is essential for effective public administration. This course offers an in-depth exploration of India's Information Technology Act, 2000, and the significant amendments introduced by the Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code Rules, 2021. The session breaks down the responsibilities and liabilities of online intermediaries, including social media giants, messaging apps, and e-commerce sites. Key learning areas include the scope of 'safe harbor' protection under Section 79, mandatory due diligence practices, and procedures for content takedown upon receiving lawful orders. The course also covers the specific regulations for significant social media intermediaries, online gaming, and the code of ethics for digital news and OTT platforms. Participants will learn about the Grievance Appellate Committee (GAC) and its role in user rights protection. This knowledge is crucial for officials in policy-making, law enforcement, and regulatory roles to ensure compliance and maintain a safe, trusted, and accountable cyberspace.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Jammu and Kashmir Agrarian Reforms Act 1976
desc: This foundational course provides comprehensive introductory knowledge of the structure, provisions, and implementation framework of the J&K Agrarian Reforms Act, 1976. The course is organized into two modules that progressively build understanding—from the background and objectives of the Act to its key substantive provisions. It covers important aspects such as the landmark land ceiling framework of 12.5 standard acres per family, the mechanism for vesting rights in the State, resumption provisions, and the transfer of ownership rights to prospective owners. The course is specifically designed for government officers and officials working in the revenue and agricultural departments, enabling them to understand the legal framework and its practical implications in the administration of land reforms.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: The Law of Evidence
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872, a cornerstone of the Indian legal system. It is designed for professionals who engage with legal proceedings and need a robust understanding of how evidence is presented, admitted, and evaluated in a court of law. The curriculum is structured into modules that cover the entire lifecycle of evidence, from its introduction and definitions to its final proof. Key learning areas include the distinction between relevancy and admissibility, the doctrines of res gestae and estoppel, and the specific rules for oral, documentary, and electronic evidence. A dedicated module explores the interplay between the Evidence Act and the Income Tax Act, making it particularly relevant for tax professionals. Upon completion, learners will be able to navigate the complexities of evidence law, understand procedural requirements for different types of evidence, and apply these principles effectively in their professional roles.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: The Limitation Act, 1963
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of India's Limitation Act, 1963, a cornerstone of procedural law that promotes fairness and finality in legal disputes. The curriculum is designed to provide a thorough understanding of why time limits are crucial in civil and legal proceedings, preventing the indefinite threat of lawsuits. Key learning areas are structured into distinct modules covering the basics of the Act, including its history and definitions; special provisions for the extension of limitation periods due to legal disabilities; rules for the exclusion of time while computing limitation; and the effects of events like fraud, mistake, or acknowledgment on the limitation period. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to correctly interpret and apply the Act's provisions, manage litigation timelines effectively, and understand the extinguishment of rights to property when legal action is not taken in time. This knowledge is vital for ensuring that legal claims are pursued diligently and that judicial processes remain efficient and just.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: The Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, a critical piece of legislation for modern business structures in India. The program is structured to provide a clear understanding of why LLPs are a popular choice for professional firms and how they balance partnership flexibility with liability protection. Key learning areas include the essential requirements for incorporation, the roles and responsibilities of designated partners, and the legal framework governing partner relations and liabilities. Furthermore, the course delves into the mandatory financial disclosures, auditing norms, and annual return filings required for compliance. It also covers procedures for investigation into an LLP's affairs, the process of converting other business forms into an LLP, and the provisions for dissolution. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in navigating the legal requirements of the LLP Act, enabling them to ensure regulatory compliance, manage partnership affairs effectively, and make informed decisions regarding this business structure.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: The Necessity for Decolonization and Its Relevance Today
desc: As India progresses towards its goal of becoming a 'Viksit Bharat,' it is imperative to address the foundational structures of its governance. This course, 'The Necessity for Decolonization and Its Relevance Today,' provides a comprehensive introduction to why decolonizing the administrative mindset is crucial for this national transformation. It delves into the historical context of India's bureaucracy, highlighting how colonial-era constructs—designed for control rather than service—continue to manifest as red tape, rigid hierarchies, and a culture of power that alienates citizens and hampers development. Learners will explore the key characteristics of this colonial legacy and analyze its impact on current administrative inefficiency and lack of transparency. The course introduces the transformative potential of reclaiming Bhartiya wisdom and integrating Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) into public service. By contrasting the inherited 'ruler' mentality with a 'sevak' (service-oriented) approach, participants will understand the principles of people-centric, ethical, and accountable governance. This foundational knowledge will empower public officials to critically assess existing processes and contribute to building a truly modern, responsive, and service-driven bureaucracy fit for a developed India.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: The Power of Simulation: Understanding Purpose and Benefits
desc: Dive into the world of simulation and discover how it is transforming industries and governance. This course offers a structured journey through the core concepts of modeling and simulating real-world systems. You will learn why simulation is a critical tool for modern decision-making, offering a safe and cost-effective environment to test ideas and optimize processes. The curriculum covers key learning areas, including the architecture of simulation models, validation techniques, and analysis of outcomes. You will be introduced to industry-standard software such as ANSYS, MATLAB, and Unreal Engine, and explore their practical applications in engineering, autonomous vehicle research, and public infrastructure management. The course also looks to the future, discussing emerging trends like AI-driven simulation, cloud-based platforms, and the metaverse. Upon completion, you will be equipped to understand and apply simulation principles to solve complex challenges and drive innovation in your domain.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Rail Karmayogi Program
desc: The Rail Karmayogi Program provides essential training for all frontline railway personnel, aiming to cultivate a profound sense of citizen-centricity in their daily operations. In the context of public service, the Indian Railways serves millions of citizens daily, making the quality of interaction at the frontline critical to public perception and satisfaction. This course directly addresses this need by equipping employees with the necessary behavioural skills and service-oriented mindset. Key learning areas include understanding citizen expectations, effective communication, professional conduct, and problem-solving in customer-facing scenarios. The program is structured into eight self-paced modules, specifically tailored for roles such as Station Masters, Ticket Examiners, Booking Clerks, Parcel Clerks, and Goods Clerks. Upon completion, learners will be better prepared to handle public interactions with empathy and efficiency, contributing to a more positive image of the Indian Railways and delivering a superior service experience for every passenger and customer.

title: The Railway Servants (Discipline and Appeal) Rules 1968
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the Railway Servants (Discipline & Appeal) Rules, 1968, a critical legal framework established under Article 309 of the Constitution. It is designed for railway servants and officials who need to understand the procedural and legal aspects of employee discipline. The curriculum systematically breaks down the rules, explaining the scope of their applicability and the specific roles of appointing, disciplinary, and appellate authorities. Key learning areas include the distinction between minor and major penalties, the correct procedures for conducting a formal inquiry, and the conditions under which an employee can be placed under suspension. Furthermore, the course elaborates on the mechanisms for appeal, revision, and review available to employees. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in interpreting and applying these essential service rules, fostering fairness, transparency, and discipline within the organization.

title: The Registration Act,1908
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of The Registration Act, 1908, designed for public officials involved in legal, administrative, and revenue functions. The Act serves as the cornerstone for the public registration of documents, providing transparency and legal certainty, particularly concerning property transactions. This course contextualizes the importance of the Act in modern governance for preventing fraud and perpetuating legally significant documents. Key learning areas are structured into four distinct modules. You will begin with the foundational aspects, including the Act's purpose, key definitions, and the organizational structure of registration offices. The course then delves into the specifics of registrable documents, distinguishing between those requiring compulsory registration, such as gift and lease deeds, and those where it is optional. A significant portion is dedicated to the procedural aspects, outlining the powers and duties of Registrars and Sub-Registrars, from maintaining register-books to the process of admitting a document for registration. Finally, the course covers the practical steps for presenting documents, the grounds for refusal, the appeals process, and the penalties for non-compliance and fraudulent activities. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to navigate the procedural requirements of the Registration Act, ensure compliance in their official duties, and understand the legal framework that underpins the authenticity of public records.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Enhancing Cybersecurity
desc: In an increasingly vulnerable digital world, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a critical tool for reinforcing cybersecurity defenses. This comprehensive course delves into the practical applications of AI in identifying, responding to, and neutralizing cyber threats. It is designed for government officials and IT professionals who need to understand how to leverage emerging technologies to protect sensitive data and critical infrastructure. Key learning areas include the use of AI for advanced threat detection, anomaly identification, and automated incident response. The course features practical demonstrations using tools like Kali Linux to illustrate how cybercriminals operate and how AI can be deployed for proactive defense. Participants will explore AI's role in phishing detection, malware analysis, vulnerability management, and securing endpoints. The session also covers the importance of robust security policies, the risks of social engineering, and the ethical dimensions of using AI in security, empowering learners to build a more resilient and secure digital environment.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Role of Bhamashah State Data Centre in Rajasthan e-Governance
desc: The Bhamashah State Data Centre (BSDC) is a cornerstone of Rajasthan's digital transformation, providing a robust, secure, and scalable platform for hundreds of government services. This course offers an in-depth look into why such infrastructure is critical for modern governance. You will explore the technical excellence of the BSDC, from its Tier-IV certification ensuring maximum uptime to its redundant power and cooling systems that guarantee service continuity. The curriculum covers the comprehensive physical and cybersecurity measures that protect sensitive government and citizen data. Furthermore, the course highlights BSDC's commitment to environmental sustainability through its GRIHA-certified green infrastructure. Participants will also learn about the forward-looking strategy that incorporates artificial intelligence, 5G readiness, and hybrid cloud solutions to meet future demands. By understanding the architecture and operations of BSDC, learners will appreciate how centralized digital infrastructure enables the efficient, secure, and uninterrupted delivery of e-governance services to millions.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: The Rural Employment Framework
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the operational and legal framework of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), a cornerstone of India's rural employment strategy. The program is designed for officials and functionaries involved in rural development, providing them with the necessary knowledge to manage the scheme effectively. The curriculum addresses the critical importance of MGNREGA in providing a legal guarantee for wage employment, thereby enhancing livelihood security for rural households. Key learning areas include the step-by-step processes for job card registration, planning and execution of public works, ensuring timely wage payments, and administering unemployment allowances. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the vital role of transparency and accountability, covering procedures for conducting social audits and managing grievance redressal mechanisms. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to not only implement the scheme according to its legal mandates but also to foster community participation and promote the creation of durable, climate-resilient assets, contributing to holistic rural development.

title: The Sexual Harassment of Working at Workplace
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the legal framework established to combat sexual harassment in the workplace. It begins by tracing the background from the Supreme Court's Vishakha Guidelines to the enactment of the POSH Act in 2013. The curriculum clearly defines key terms such as 'aggrieved woman,' 'employer,' and the specific actions that are classified as sexual harassment, including physical contact, demands for sexual favors, and making sexually colored remarks. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the redressal mechanism. It explains the composition and role of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), the procedure for submitting a complaint, the process of conciliation, and the steps involved in a formal inquiry. Furthermore, the course details the duties of the employer, which include forming an ICC, conducting awareness programs, and displaying the penal consequences of harassment. It also covers the penalties for non-compliance by the employer and for false complaints, ensuring a balanced understanding of the law's provisions to foster a secure and dignified professional environment.
subDomain: Handling matters of Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy

title: The Telecommunications Act 2023
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Telecommunications Act, 2023, which aims to modernize India’s telecommunications sector by enhancing security, promoting competition, and ensuring compliance with digital governance. Learners will explore the evolution of India’s telecom laws, including the replacement of the Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 and Indian Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933, and understand the rationale for the new legislation. The course also covers the Right of Way framework, security and public safety measures, consumer protection regulations, and aspects of digital governance, including e-licensing and regulatory compliance.

title: The Values, Ethos and Spirit of Public Service
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the foundational values, ethos, and spirit that underpin public service in India. Structured across six modules, it guides learners through a systematic understanding of what it means to be a civil servant dedicated to the public good. The curriculum begins by establishing citizen-centric governance as the cornerstone of modern civil services and explores the ethical values that guide the conduct of public servants. It further analyzes how these values translate into a distinct public service ethos, which in turn fosters intrinsic motivation and a profound 'spirit of service'. The course draws upon historical context, administrative reforms, and theoretical frameworks, including case studies from Indian Railways and global examples, to provide a rich, contextual learning experience. Participants will emerge with a renewed understanding of their role and a stronger commitment to serving the nation with integrity, professionalism, and a focus on public interest.

title: Theft Snatching and Extortion Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: This course provides a comprehensive analysis of the legal framework governing theft, snatching, and extortion as defined in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. It is specifically designed for law enforcement personnel, legal practitioners, and judicial officers to understand the nuances of the new criminal laws. The curriculum delves into Sections 303 to 308 of the BNS, systematically breaking down the definitions, essential ingredients, and aggravated forms of each offence. Learners will explore the key distinctions between theft and the newly codified offence of snatching. The course also draws critical comparisons with the corresponding sections of the now-repealed Indian Penal Code, 1860, highlighting significant changes in legal interpretation and application. To ensure practical understanding, the content is enriched with important judicial pronouncements that clarify the scope of these provisions. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to accurately identify, differentiate, and apply the new laws related to theft, snatching, and extortion in their professional duties.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Theory of Railway Curve
desc: This advanced course is designed for railway engineering professionals seeking to master the theory and practical application of railway curve design and maintenance. The content systematically covers the entire lifecycle of railway curves, from initial design considerations to long-term upkeep. Learners will begin by understanding the fundamental physics of curve negotiation, including centrifugal force and its countermeasures like superelevation and equilibrium speed. The course then progresses to the detailed design of circular curves, transition curves (cubic parabola and clothoid spiral), and vertical curves, providing the formulas and methodologies for calculating radius, cant, versine, and shift. It also addresses complex scenarios such as compound and reverse curves, gauge widening, and the use of check rails on sharp curves. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical implementation and maintenance standards as prescribed in the Indian Railway Permanent Way Manual (IRPWM) 2020. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to design, lay out, and maintain railway curves that are safe, efficient, and compliant with the latest Indian Railways standards, ensuring optimal performance and passenger comfort.

title: Thermal Properties and Behaviour of Mass Concrete
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of the thermal properties of mass concrete and their practical implications in large-scale concrete construction. Participants will learn how properties such as specific heat, thermal conductivity, and thermal diffusivity influence the temperature development within concrete during the hydration process. The course explores the phenomenon of cement hydration, where the chemical reaction between water and cement generates heat, known as the heat of hydration. This rise in temperature can lead to thermal stresses and cracking if not properly managed. Special attention is given to the methods and measures used to monitor and control temperature in mass concrete structures, helping to ensure structural integrity and longevity.
subDomain: Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
org: Central Soil and Materials Research Station (CSMRS)

title: THIN CLIENT AND ITS APPLICATION
desc: Dive into the world of efficient computing with this detailed course on thin client technology and its applications. Designed for IT professionals and technology enthusiasts, this program demystifies the concept of desktop virtualization, where lightweight client devices connect to a powerful central server. The course begins by establishing the context, explaining why thin client architecture is a crucial solution for modern organizations seeking to reduce IT overhead, minimize hardware costs by up to 75%, and improve data security by centralizing information.The key learning areas are broken down into practical, easy-to-follow modules. You will learn to identify the components of a thin client system, including the host PC, NComputing devices, and network hardware. The course provides a step-by-step guide to configuring the system, from downloading and installing the V-space software to creating and managing multiple user accounts on a single host. You will also learn how to operate the system and troubleshoot common connectivity issues, such as network problems or antivirus conflicts. Upon completion, you will have the practical skills to set up, manage, and maintain a multi-user thin client environment, making you a valuable asset in any organization looking to optimize its IT infrastructure.

title: Think Before You Share: Spotting Fake News Online
desc: In a world where every click, post, and share can shape public perception, the ability to distinguish truth from misinformation has never been more important. This awareness course equips learners with the knowledge and skills to identify, analyse, and respond to fake news in the digital age. Through relatable examples, engaging storytelling, and practical frameworks, participants will learn how to pause, verify information, and share content responsibly—becoming advocates for digital integrity.

title: THIRD PARTY INFORMATION
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of handling 'Third Party Information' as stipulated in the Right to Information (RTI) Act. In the context of public administration, balancing the citizen's right to know with an individual's right to privacy is a critical challenge. This program is designed to equip public officials with the knowledge and skills to navigate this complex area with confidence and procedural integrity. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of Section 11 of the RTI Act, understanding the definition of a 'third party,' and the legal obligations for consultation. Through a series of landmark case studies from the Supreme Court, various High Courts, and the Central Information Commission (CIC), learners will analyze precedents that have shaped the interpretation of public interest versus confidentiality. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply the correct legal procedures for RTI requests involving third-party information, make informed decisions on disclosure, and ensure compliance, thereby strengthening accountability and citizen trust in governance.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Third Party Inspection in Indian Railways: A Game Changer
desc: On April 25, 2022, Mr. Arun Mehta, Principal Chief Materials Manager of Western Railways, launched a transformative Third-Party Inspection (TPI) initiative to modernize quality assurance in Indian Railways. The program aimed to enhance efficiency, build capacity, and create a competitive inspection ecosystem focused on quality over cost. Presented to top Railway Board officials, it received strong support from the Chairman, Member Finance, and RDSO. On May 8, 2022, the Board authorized Western Railway to engage private TPI agencies for 2–3 years. Tasked with designing the empanelment system, Mr. Mehta sought to integrate private efficiencies without disrupting inspections while reflecting on fairness and possible stakeholder conflicts.

title: Third-Party Data Sharing and Privacy Impact Assessments
desc: In an increasingly digital world, safeguarding personal data is paramount for public trust and effective governance. This course offers a comprehensive exploration of India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) framework, designed to equip public sector professionals with the knowledge to ensure regulatory compliance. The curriculum delves into the core principles of the DPDP Act, providing a detailed guide on conducting Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), a crucial process for significant data fiduciaries. Key learning areas include understanding the roles and responsibilities of consent managers, managing third-party data sharing agreements, and implementing robust security measures and breach notification protocols. The course also examines the emerging ecosystem of data protection services, such as data localization and privacy audits, highlighting new opportunities. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply practical compliance strategies, mitigate privacy risks, and align their organization's data handling practices with India's evolving legal landscape, thereby strengthening governance and citizen trust.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Threat Intelligence and Security Operations Center Monitoring
desc: In an era of escalating cyber threats, establishing a robust defense mechanism is critical for government and public sector organizations. This course delves into the core principles of proactive cybersecurity through the lens of a Security Operations Center (SOC) and the strategic use of threat intelligence. Participants will explore the complete lifecycle of a cyber-attack, from initial access using zero-day vulnerabilities to data exfiltration and ransomware deployment. The curriculum covers the essential components of a modern SOC, including the roles of analysts, key technologies like SIEM, EDR, and XDR, and the processes for effective monitoring and incident response. Furthermore, the session examines the dual role of Artificial Intelligence in cybersecurity, discussing how it can be leveraged for enhanced defense while also securing AI models themselves. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge to contribute to building and managing a SOC, apply threat intelligence to anticipate attacks, and understand the frameworks necessary to protect critical digital infrastructure.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Thriving in the Fast Lane And Lifestyle Management
desc: In today's fast-paced professional world, maintaining peak performance without sacrificing personal well-being is a critical challenge. This course is designed to equip public service professionals with the essential skills for sustainable success and holistic lifestyle management. It addresses the common pressures of a demanding career and provides a structured approach to personal effectiveness. Key learning areas include advanced time management techniques, proven methods for stress and energy management, and the integration of mindfulness and self-care into daily routines. Participants will explore how to set and achieve clear, impactful goals while cultivating mental and emotional resilience. By the end of this course, learners will be able to apply these strategies to not only enhance their job performance and focus but also to lead a more balanced, fulfilling, and healthy life, ensuring long-term career vitality.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Ticket Office Machine Operations in Metro Rail Ticketing System
desc: The Ticket Office Machine (TOM) is a staff-operated, computerized ticketing system used in metro rail networks for selling, recharging, and refunding fare media. It serves as a reliable manual alternative to passenger-operated Ticket Vending Machines (TVMs), enabling trained personnel to handle complex transactions, fare adjustments, and provide customer assistance. Installed in the Ticket Office or Excess Fare Office (EFO), the TOM allows operators to issue tokens and smart cards, manage payments, and ensure secure and accurate fare collection. By connecting to the Station Computer and the Central AFC Server, the TOM supports structured and reliable data exchange, using a batch-synchronization method to maintain accuracy even during intermittent network connectivity.
org: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited

title: Ticket to Transformation: Digitalizing Human Resources in Railways
desc:
This case explores the ambitious digital transformation of the Human Resources function in Indian Railways, one of the largest public sector employers in the world. It follows the shift from a manual, paper-based system to an integrated Human Resource Management System (HRMS) developed by CRIS, the IT arm of Indian Railways.

The case outlines why the change was needed, how it was implemented, and the challenges faced along the way, from managing legacy data and ensuring cybersecurity to handling change in a hierarchical system. It also touches on stakeholder engagement, training, and the wider impact of digitisation in government.

This is a story of transforming scale with strategy, and legacy with leadership.

title: Ticketing System in Metro Railways
desc: Delve into the essential framework of metro railway operations with this detailed course on ticketing systems. Ticketing is more than just fare collection; it is a cornerstone of passenger experience, operational efficiency, and system security. This course begins by establishing the context of why a reliable ticketing system is pivotal for the success of any Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS). You will explore the evolution of ticketing technology, examining the mechanics and benefits of various media. Key learning areas include the functionality of magnetic stripe tickets, the versatility of smart cards, and the convenience of digital platforms such as QR codes and the integrated NCMC. The course further analyzes how these systems facilitate regulated access, prevent fare evasion, and provide valuable data for service planning. Upon completion, you will be equipped to understand how a well-implemented ticketing strategy contributes to a seamless, secure, and satisfactory journey for millions of commuters daily, enhancing the overall effectiveness of public transportation.

title: Ticketless Travelling and Ticket Checking in Railways
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the procedures and regulations governing ticket checking and the prevention of ticketless travel in the Indian Railways. It begins by establishing the context of the commercial department's function in protecting revenue and maintaining order. The curriculum details the specific duties of Traveling Ticket Examiners (TTEs), Station Masters, and other staff, covering the entire process from platform entry to destination checks. Participants will learn to identify various types of ticket irregularities, including fraudulent or expired tickets and incorrect travel classes. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to understanding the legal provisions of the Railways Act, 1989, including the penalties and fines for different offenses. Furthermore, the course emphasizes the importance of professionalism, tact, and politeness in passenger interactions to ensure a positive experience for valid ticket holders while enforcing rules firmly. Upon completion, learners will be prepared to implement efficient ticket checking protocols, contributing to enhanced safety, revenue security, and overall passenger satisfaction.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Tiger Conservation and Collaboration
desc: Tiger conservation is a critical environmental challenge, demanding coordinated action on a global scale. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the multifaceted efforts to protect this endangered species. It begins by establishing the context, outlining the ecological significance of tigers and the primary threats they face, such as habitat loss, poaching, and human-wildlife conflict. The curriculum then delves into the key learning areas, examining the national laws and strategies implemented by tiger range countries, with a special focus on India's leadership. Learners will study the architecture of international cooperation, including the roles of CITES, the Global Tiger Initiative (GTI), and successful transboundary conservation projects. The course also covers practical aspects like anti-poaching operations, modern monitoring techniques, and the importance of community engagement for sustainable outcomes. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with a robust understanding of the collaborative frameworks necessary to secure a future for tigers in the wild.
org: Kundal Academy of Development, Administration and Management (Forests), Kundal, Maharashtra

title: Tilting Trains: Enhancing Speed and Comfort on Curved Tracks
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the engineering principles and practical applications of tilting train technology. It addresses the critical challenge of increasing train speeds on conventional railway networks without the need for extensive and costly track realignment. The curriculum begins with the fundamental physics of motion on curves, explaining concepts like centrifugal force, cant angle, and the different types of acceleration experienced by the train and its passengers. Learners will delve into the history and evolution of tilting trains, from early passive systems like Talgo to advanced active systems such as the Pendolino and the Swedish X2000. The course analyzes the core components that enable tilting, including soft radial bogies, advanced suspension, and sophisticated control systems with actuators. Through a detailed case study of the X2000 project, participants will understand the entire lifecycle of development, testing, and implementation, including the significant performance gains and challenges like increased track forces and motion sickness. Upon completion, learners will be able to evaluate the technical feasibility, operational benefits, and maintenance considerations of deploying tilting trains within a modern railway system.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Time Management
desc: In today's fast-paced professional environment, mastering time is crucial for success and well-being. This comprehensive course is designed to equip public sector employees with practical strategies for superior time management. You will delve into the core principles of productivity, starting with how to set meaningful and structured goals using the SMART criteria. The course then explores powerful prioritization tools, including the Urgent/Important Matrix (Eisenhower Technique), to help you focus on what truly matters. A significant portion of the training is dedicated to overcoming common productivity barriers like procrastination and distractions. You will learn to apply the Pomodoro Technique for sustained focus and discover how to leverage technology, such as calendars and task management apps, to your advantage. By the end of this course, you will be able to build a robust personal time management system that not only boosts your efficiency and output at work but also helps you achieve a healthier work-life balance.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Time Management
desc: In today's fast-paced professional environment, effective time management is a critical skill for all public servants. This course delves into the principles of time management, tracing its origins and highlighting its modern-day relevance. Participants will begin by understanding the core benefits of managing time, including stress reduction, enhanced efficiency, and increased output, which are essential for taking control of professional duties. The course then addresses common obstacles to effective time management, such as disorganization, the inability to decline requests, and frequent interruptions, providing strategies to overcome them. A key feature of this program is the introduction to Covey's Quadrant, a powerful tool for prioritizing tasks by categorizing them as urgent, important, both, or neither. Through practical examples and real-life scenarios featuring various government roles like Assistant Commercial Tax Officers, ASHA workers, and Block Development Officers, learners will see how these concepts apply in a public service context. The course encourages a shift in focus towards larger, more meaningful goals, ensuring that daily activities align with long-term aspirations, ultimately leading to greater professional achievement and personal fulfillment.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Time Management Skills
desc: In an era defined by constant connectivity and demanding schedules, the ability to manage time effectively is more crucial than ever. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the foundational skills to take control of their day and maximize their potential. The curriculum delves into the art of strategic organization, teaching learners how to transform chaotic workloads into structured, manageable plans. You will learn the SMART framework for setting clear and achievable goals, and master the art of prioritization to focus on what truly matters. The course also covers the importance of setting boundaries to minimize distractions, the strategic use of delegation, and leveraging technology to boost efficiency. Upon completion, you will not only be able to meet deadlines consistently but also create more space for personal growth and innovation, leading to a more fulfilling and balanced professional life.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Time of Supply under Goods and Services Tax
desc: Compliance with the Goods and Services Tax (GST) framework requires accurate determination of the Time of Supply, which establishes the point at which the liability to pay tax arises. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal provisions governing the determination of the Time of Supply under the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017, with particular focus on Sections 12, 13, and 14. The course covers the rules for determining the Time of Supply of goods and services, including the relevant provisions relating to the date of invoice, date of payment, and other prescribed events. It also examines the Time of Supply under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) and addresses special situations such as the supply of vouchers and changes in tax rates. Through this course, learners will develop the knowledge and skills required to correctly determine the Time of Supply and apply the relevant GST provisions for accurate tax liability and compliance.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Time of Supply under GST
desc: Proper compliance with the Goods and Services Tax (GST) is fundamental to maintaining a transparent and efficient taxation system. A cornerstone of this compliance is the correct determination of the 'Time of Supply,' which is the specific point in time when tax liability arises. This comprehensive course delves into the legal framework governing the Time of Supply, providing a critical resource for tax officials, finance professionals, and business owners. The curriculum is structured around the core legal provisions of the CGST Act, particularly Sections 12, 13, and 14. Participants will learn to navigate the rules for identifying the time of supply for goods and services, based on factors such as the date of invoice issuance, receipt of payment, or completion of service. The course also addresses more complex scenarios, including transactions under the reverse charge mechanism, the supply of vouchers, and situations involving a change in the tax rate. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to accurately determine tax liability periods, ensure timely remittance of taxes, and confidently manage GST compliance, thereby minimizing legal risks and supporting robust financial governance.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Time Release Study
desc: In an era of global trade, the efficiency of customs clearance is paramount for economic competitiveness. This course delves into the Time Release Study (TRS), a critical instrument for evaluating and improving the speed of cargo movement through customs. Developed by the World Customs Organization, the TRS provides a standardized methodology to measure the actual time from cargo arrival to its final release. This program will guide you through the core principles and practical application of a TRS. You will learn how to measure release times for imports (from arrival to 'out of charge') and exports (from arrival to carrier departure), and understand the roles of various stakeholders in this process. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to interpret TRS data, identify procedural delays, and contribute to evidence-based reforms that strengthen trade facilitation, reduce dwell times, and align with international best practices in customs administration.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Time Release Study: Customs Clearance Efficiency
desc: In an era of global trade, the efficiency of customs clearance is paramount for economic competitiveness. This course delves into the Time Release Study (TRS), a critical instrument for evaluating and improving the speed of cargo movement through customs. Developed by the World Customs Organization, the TRS provides a standardized methodology to measure the actual time from cargo arrival to its final release. This program will guide you through the core principles and practical application of a TRS. You will learn how to measure release times for imports (from arrival to 'out of charge') and exports (from arrival to carrier departure), and understand the roles of various stakeholders in this process. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to interpret TRS data, identify procedural delays, and contribute to evidence-based reforms that strengthen trade facilitation, reduce dwell times, and align with international best practices in customs administration.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Time Tabling for Passenger Trains
desc: This foundational course delves into the intricate process of passenger train timetabling, a cornerstone of efficient railway operations in India. It begins by establishing the context, explaining the statutory obligations under the Railways Act, 1989, and the multifaceted role timetables play in serving passengers, guiding staff, and enabling resource planning. Learners will explore the complete lifecycle of timetable creation, from gathering public suggestions and conducting resource assessments to securing final approval from the Railway Board. The curriculum details the various types of timetables, including public-facing schedules like 'Trains at a Glance' and internal operational tools like 'Working Timetables' and 'Master Charts'. Furthermore, the course analyzes the critical factors that influence scheduling, balancing passenger needs for convenience and connectivity with operational requirements such as track capacity, maintenance time, and crew availability. Upon completion, participants will have a clear understanding of how timetables are developed to optimize the vast railway network, ensuring safety, punctuality, and service reliability.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Timeless Leadership: Ancient Wisdom for the Modern Civil Servant
desc: The course examines leadership beyond formal authority, position, power and privilege, with emphasis on sustainable followership, purposeful action, self-mastery and service to the larger ecosystem. It explores how civil servants can develop an integrated approach to leadership by aligning the head, heart and hands—bringing together cognitive clarity, emotional alignment and effective action. The course is structured around three foundational dimensions of leadership: Purpose, Productivity and Possibility. Purpose, represented through Dharma, focuses on connecting individual and organizational goals with a larger institutional and societal purpose. Productivity, represented through Karma Yoga, focuses on overcoming ego-driven interference, removing barriers to potential, and creating value for others. Possibility focuses on expanding one's horizon of perception through reflection, flexibility and the ability to challenge conventional mental maps.

title: Timelines Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: With the introduction of India's new criminal laws, understanding the revised procedural framework is essential for all stakeholders in the justice system. This course delves into the specific timelines established under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, offering a structured guide to its time-bound processes. The curriculum is designed to equip legal and law enforcement professionals with a detailed knowledge of deadlines related to every stage of a criminal case. Key learning areas include the timelines for electronic FIR registration, arrest and detention protocols, completion of investigations, and court cognizance periods. The course also covers the procedural deadlines for framing charges, pronouncing judgments, handling appeals, and managing undertrial detention. By mastering these statutory timelines, participants will be able to enhance their procedural efficiency, ensure legal compliance, and contribute to a more streamlined and effective criminal justice system.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Timely Issue of Form No 16 and Filing of Quarterly TDS e-return
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the procedures and legal obligations surrounding Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) as per the Indian Income Tax Act, 1961. It is structured to guide learners through the entire TDS lifecycle, from understanding the foundational concepts of TDS and TCS to the practical steps of compliance. Key learning areas include the responsibilities of Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs), obtaining a Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN), and applying the correct TDS rates for various payments. Participants will learn how to remit deducted tax to the government, file quarterly TDS e-returns (Forms 24Q, 26Q), and generate and issue TDS certificates like Form 16 and 16A through the TRACES portal. The course also thoroughly explains the potential penalties and prosecution for non-compliance, emphasizing the importance of adhering to statutory deadlines. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in managing TDS processes, ensuring full compliance and contributing to efficient financial administration.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Tools and Approaches for Fact-checking and Information Verification
desc: This course provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of fact-checking, verification techniques, and tools used to identify and counter misinformation. It covers the core principles of verification—Source, Location, Time, and Authenticity—and introduces tools for validating images, videos, audio, and online content. Learners will develop the skills required to detect manipulated and AI-generated media, analyse digital evidence, apply structured verification workflows, and communicate verified information effectively. The course emphasizes critical thinking, information integrity, and institutional best practices for responding to misinformation and maintaining public trust.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Total Productive Maintenance
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and its strategic role in modern manufacturing and operations. It is designed to provide professionals with the knowledge to implement TPM methodologies effectively, leading to significant improvements in equipment reliability and productivity. The curriculum delves into the eight pillars of TPM, including specialized topics like Office TPM, and covers essential maintenance strategies such as preventive, autonomous, and planned maintenance. Beyond the technical aspects, the course addresses the importance of fostering a proactive and safety-conscious culture among all employees. Learners will understand how to drive organizational change, promote employee involvement in maintenance tasks, and establish standardized, clean, and safe work environments. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to contribute to their organization's goals of achieving zero accidents, zero breakdowns, and zero defects.
org: Yantra Institute of Technology and Management

title: TOTAL QUALITY MANAGEMENT
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of Total Quality Management (TQM) as a strategic tool for enhancing organizational efficiency and effectiveness. The program is structured to provide a holistic understanding, starting with how to operationalize TQM and initiate a culture of quality. Participants will delve into the systematic quality improvement process, learning to identify opportunities, eliminate deficiencies, and prevent defects. A key focus is on the 'Six Cs' of TQM—Commitment, Culture, Continuous Improvement, Cooperation, Customer Focus, and Control—which are presented as the essential pillars for successful implementation. The course also addresses potential pitfalls, known as the 'Four Ps' (People, Process, Problem, Preparation), to help organizations avoid common derailleurs. By the end of this course, learners will be able to analyze existing processes, suggest improvements based on TQM principles, and understand the significant benefits of fostering a quality-centric culture, including reduced costs and increased stakeholder satisfaction. This makes the course highly relevant for public sector professionals aiming to improve service delivery and operational outcomes.

title: Traction System in Metro Rail Transit System (MRTS)
desc: As Indian cities continue to expand, the need for efficient and sustainable urban transportation like the Metro Rail Transit System (MRTS) has become critical. This course delves into the core engineering that powers these systems: the electric traction system. It begins by establishing the context for MRTS and the universal adoption of electric traction. Key learning areas include a thorough analysis of various traction systems used worldwide, with a focus on the technical and financial trade-offs between AC and DC power, as well as third-rail and overhead supply methods. The course provides a detailed examination of the components and design concepts of both Flexible Overhead Catenary Systems (FOCS) for elevated sections and Rigid Overhead Catenary Systems (ROCS) for underground tunnels. By focusing on the implementation within the Delhi Metro, learners will gain practical insights into why the 25 kV AC system was chosen and how it is designed for high performance and reliability. Upon completion, participants will be able to understand and analyze the fundamental principles and components of modern metro traction systems.

title: Trade in Forests: Export and Import of Forest Produce
desc: The global trade in forest products presents both opportunities and challenges. It can support economic growth and livelihoods for forest-dependent communities, while also posing risks such as deforestation and biodiversity loss if not managed sustainably. This course explores the complex relationship between international trade and forest resources, with a focus on India’s role in the export and import of timber, non-timber forest products (NTFPs), and other forest-derived commodities. Participants will examine global trade patterns, India’s forest trade scenario, and the environmental, social, and economic implications of forest product trade. The course also covers key international agreements such as CITES, certification systems such as FSC, and fair trade principles. It equips policymakers, forest managers, and trade officials with the knowledge to design strategies that balance economic development with forest conservation and sustainable resource use.

title: Trade Policies in Fisheries Sector
desc: The fisheries sector is a cornerstone of global trade, contributing significantly to economic development and food security. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the intricate trade policies that shape this vital industry. It provides a detailed examination of export regulations, sustainability standards, and crucial quality control measures that are essential for market access and competitiveness. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the international trade agreements that govern fisheries, alongside the impact of both tariff and non-tariff barriers on the industry. The curriculum also highlights the role of key regulatory frameworks, such as the Marine Fishing Regulation Act (MFRA), and the functions of pivotal organizations like the Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA). By analyzing these components, learners will be equipped to identify and address significant trade challenges. The course concludes by exploring practical solutions, including infrastructure development, market diversification, and capacity building, empowering stakeholders to foster sustainable growth and navigate the evolving landscape of global fisheries trade.

title: Trade Policies in the Fisheries Sector
desc: The fisheries sector is a cornerstone of global trade, contributing significantly to economic development and food security. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the intricate trade policies that shape this vital industry. It provides a detailed examination of export regulations, sustainability standards, and crucial quality control measures that are essential for market access and competitiveness. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the international trade agreements that govern fisheries, alongside the impact of both tariff and non-tariff barriers on the industry. The curriculum also highlights the role of key regulatory frameworks, such as the Marine Fishing Regulation Act (MFRA), and the functions of pivotal organizations like the Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA). By analyzing these components, learners will be equipped to identify and address significant trade challenges.

title: Traffic Accounts in Indian Railways
desc: This course introduces learners to the four main categories of railway earnings—Passenger, Goods, Other Coaching, and Sundry—and the key revenue sources under each category. It explains station-level revenue accounting and the purpose of the Station Balance Sheet in Indian Railways. Learners will explore the compilation and reconciliation of earnings through the Traffic Book, the concept of Traffic Suspense, internal check mechanisms, and the principles of apportionment for passenger and goods traffic. The course also familiarizes learners with major traffic accounting systems such as UTS, PRS, FOIS, PMS, IPAS, and TAMS, and explains the inspection and revenue protection role of Traffic Inspectors of Accounts (TIAs).
org: Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM)

title: Traffic Management System
desc: This course offers an in-depth understanding of Traffic Management Systems (TMS) centered on Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) and Automatic Train Supervision (ATS) technologies. In the context of increasingly complex metro rail networks, this course explains why automated control systems are crucial for enhancing operational efficiency, safety, and punctuality. Key learning areas include the core architecture of CBTC-ATS, the functionality of Automatic Route Setting (ARS) and Automatic Train Regulation (ATR), and the processes for managing system alarms and events. Learners will understand how the TMS processes real-time data to manage train schedules, regulate movement, and interface with subsystems such as Computer-Based Interlocking (CBI), Passenger Information Display Systems (PIDS), and Public Address Systems (PAS). Upon completion, participants will be equipped to appreciate how modern TMS contributes to streamlined operations, improved passenger communication, and a higher standard of railway safety.

title: TRAI Regulations for Telecom Access Services
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of key TRAI regulations governing telecom access services. It covers important regulatory aspects such as Quality of Service (QoS) standards, tariff regulations, interconnection rules, consumer protection, net neutrality compliance, infrastructure sharing, regulatory sandbox frameworks, interconnection usage charges, promotion of broadband connectivity, enhancement of broadband speeds, and the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations. Throughout the course, learners will gain insight into how these regulations are designed and implemented within the telecom sector. By the end of the course, participants will have a clear understanding of the regulatory framework and its impact on fixed access services.

title: Train Control Management System
desc: Dive into the intricate workings of the Train Control Management System (TCMS), the sophisticated onboard computer system that acts as the brain of modern metro trains. In an era of increasing automation and demand for efficient urban transport, understanding TCMS is critical for railway professionals. This course provides an in-depth exploration of how TCMS integrates and manages a multitude of subsystems, including propulsion, braking, door operations, HVAC, passenger information systems, and fire detection. You will learn about the critical safety and redundancy mechanisms that ensure reliable, uninterrupted service. The curriculum covers TCMS hardware controls, its function in real-time diagnostics and fault recording, and its pivotal relationship with Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) systems. A key focus is placed on how TCMS facilitates advanced automation, including driverless (GoA4) and unattended train operations (UTO). Upon completion, you will be equipped to analyze the architecture of TCMS, interpret its operational data, and appreciate its role in building safe, efficient, and sustainable metro rail networks.

title: Train Detection Methods
desc: Developed for professionals in the rail and metro sectors, this course delves into the essential technologies for train detection. The content is structured to build a strong conceptual foundation, starting with the context of why precise train detection is vital for operational safety and system capacity. Key learning areas include the detailed working principles of DC, AC, and Audio Frequency Track Circuits, the mechanics and reliability of Axle Counters, and the advanced capabilities of Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) systems. Participants will learn to compare these methods based on their applications, advantages, and limitations in different operational environments. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to make informed evaluations of train detection technologies, contributing to the design and maintenance of safer and more efficient railway networks.

title: Train Traffic Control Communication in Indian Railways
desc: This technical course offers an in-depth exploration of the Train Traffic Control (TTC) communication systems vital to the operations of Indian Railways.
