Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the system's structure, from the centralized control offices at divisional headquarters to the various way stations along the tracks. The curriculum covers the technical specifications and operational principles of different communication methods, including the legacy two-wire systems and the modern four-wire systems deployed on underground and optical fiber cables. A significant focus is placed on the practical application of technologies like DTMF for selective station calling, the function of essential equipment such as VF repeaters and isolation transformers, and the importance of adhering to RDSO (Research Designs and Standards Organisation) specifications. The course concludes by outlining the standard procedures for installation, testing, and maintenance, equipping learners with the knowledge to ensure the reliability and integrity of railway communication networks.

title: Training Design (DOT)
desc: In the context of public service, the ability to design and deliver effective training is paramount for capacity building and performance improvement. This course serves as a foundational guide to the systematic process of instructional design. It begins by establishing the context and necessity for structured training design within an organization. Participants will delve into key learning areas, including how to articulate training needs, draft comprehensive design briefs, and break down complex topics into digestible learning units. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the principles of assessment, teaching learners how to create and implement tools to evaluate the impact and success of their training initiatives. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply a structured, end-to-end methodology to design training programs that are not only engaging but also aligned with organizational goals and deliver measurable results.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Training Module on Swachata Hi Seva - 2024
desc: This training module provides a comprehensive overview of the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) 2024 campaign, a nationwide initiative to promote cleanliness and sanitation. The course delves into this year's theme, 'Swabhav Swachhata - Sanskaar Swachhata,' which emphasizes fostering cleanliness as a natural habit and cultural value. Learners will explore the three core pillars of the campaign: transforming Cleanliness Target Units (CTUs), encouraging mass public participation (Jan Bhagidari), and ensuring the welfare of sanitation workers through SafaiMitra Suraksha Shivirs. The content is structured to equip all stakeholders, from central ministry officials to urban local body staff and citizens, with the knowledge to actively participate in and sustain impactful cleanliness drives. By completing this course, participants will understand how to contribute to the larger vision of a 'Garbage Free India' by adopting and advocating for responsible sanitation and waste management practices in their communities.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Transfer and Posting
desc: Transfers and postings are a critical component of human resource management within the Government of India, directly impacting administrative continuity, employee development, and organizational health. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of the entire lifecycle of transfer and posting procedures. It delves into the foundational aspects of how transfer policies are formulated and how rotation policies are drafted to ensure equitable distribution of personnel and opportunities. Participants will gain detailed insights into the specific guidelines and regulations that govern these processes, including the criteria for transfers under various circumstances such as routine rotations, compassionate appointments, and tenure-based relocations. The curriculum is structured to equip public officials, particularly those in administrative and establishment roles, with the necessary knowledge to manage these processes effectively. Upon completion, learners will be able to navigate the complexities of transfer and posting rules, ensure compliance with government directives, and contribute to a transparent and efficient administrative system that supports both organizational goals and employee welfare.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Transfer of Defence land for Public Infrastructure Projects
desc: This training module offers an in-depth examination of the process for transferring defence land for the development of public infrastructure. The course begins by establishing the context, explaining why the need for such transfers has grown with rapid urbanization and how the Ministry of Defence has formalized the procedure since 2015-16. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the eligible entities, such as government departments and PPP projects, and the distinct modes of transfer: permanent, lease, and license. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the compensation modalities, including Equal Value Land (EVL), cash compensation, and the more recent Equal Value Infrastructure (EVI) concept. The course meticulously outlines the online application process through the NOC portal, the defined timelines for approvals, and the critical roles of stakeholders like the Directorate General Defence Estates (DGDE) and user agencies. Upon completion, participants will be able to effectively manage and execute the transfer of defence land in a transparent and time-bound manner, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and security considerations.
org: National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM)

title: Transfer of Non-Gazetted Railway Employees
desc: This course offers an in-depth examination of the rules and regulations governing the transfer of non-gazetted Railway employees. The content is designed to provide clarity on why and how transfers are conducted within the vast network of Indian Railways. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of different transfer categories such as administrative, own-request, mutual, and periodical transfers, with a special focus on the rotation of staff in sensitive posts. The curriculum also addresses the complexities of vigilance-related transfers and the specific provisions for office bearers of recognized trade unions. Participants will learn how various types of transfers affect seniority and the timelines for processing requests. By completing this course, learners will be able to confidently apply these policies in their work, ensuring fair and transparent management of employee mobility.

title: Transfer Pricing Comparability Analysis: Methods and Benchmarking
desc: This course is designed to equip tax professionals with the essential knowledge and skills to conduct effective comparability analysis in transfer pricing. The curriculum provides a detailed examination of the legal provisions in the Income Tax Act, 1961, and associated rules governing the computation of the Arm’s Length Price (ALP). Learners will explore the entire comparability process, from understanding the taxpayer's business and identifying controlled transactions to the selection of the most appropriate method. Key learning areas include the five critical factors of comparability: characteristics of property or service, Functions Performed, Assets Employed, and Risks Assumed (FAR) analysis, contractual terms, economic circumstances, and business strategies.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Transformational Leadership
desc: In today's rapidly evolving professional landscape, effective leadership is crucial for navigating complexity and driving organizational success. This course on Transformational Leadership offers an in-depth examination of a visionary leadership style that moves beyond simple management to inspire genuine change and growth. It is designed for leaders and aspiring leaders who seek to create a positive and high-performing work environment. The course begins by tracing the theoretical foundations of transformational leadership before diving into its practical application through the 'Four I's' framework: Idealized Influence, Inspirational Motivation, Intellectual Stimulation, and Individualized Consideration. Participants will explore the essential characteristics of a transformational leader, including strong ethical principles, empathy, and the capacity to encourage creative problem-solving. Upon completion, learners will be able to apply these concepts to foster a culture of trust, boost team morale and performance, and effectively lead their teams through transformation, ultimately developing their own capacity to become inspiring and influential leaders.
org: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad

title: Transforming Agricultural Insurance in India: From Policy to Practice
desc: Featuring insights from Shri Ritesh Chauhan, former CEO of PMFBY, this podcast-based course delves into the significant policy and practical shifts revolutionizing agricultural insurance in India. Learners will explore the evolution of crop insurance, focusing on key technological innovations that are enhancing transparency and efficiency. The curriculum covers the functionality and impact of platforms such as DigiClaim, which automates claim processing, and YES-TECH, which aids in field validation. Furthermore, the course discusses the critical challenges of financial inclusion for remote farmers and the strategies being implemented to overcome these hurdles. It concludes by looking at the future of agricultural risk management, including the expansion into livestock insurance and the ambitious vision of achieving 'Insurance for All' by 2047, providing a holistic view of how data-driven solutions are building resilience for India's farmers.
org: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana PMFBY

title: Transforming Digital Governance with DBT of Fertilizer Subsidy
desc: A quiet revolution had taken India by storm and reshaped how the Government of India transferred benefits under its welfare programmes directly to the intended beneficiaries. In India’s fertilizer sector, the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system had introduced a more transparent and accountable model for subsidy distribution. Under this system, the government disbursed fertilizer subsidies to companies after the actual sale of subsidized fertilizers to farmers by retailers. Farmers were identified using Aadhaar-based authentication at the point of sale, ensuring that benefits reached the intended recipients while minimizing diversion and lowering administrative costs.

title: Transforming Digital India Through User Interface and User Experience
desc: In an era of digital transformation, the effectiveness of government services is increasingly judged by their usability and accessibility. This course provides a comprehensive overview of how User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) design can significantly enhance citizen-facing digital platforms. It delves into the core principles of user-centered design, explaining why putting the citizen at the heart of the development process is crucial for success. Key learning areas include an introduction to the UX4G initiative, a government-led framework designed to standardize and improve the quality of public digital services. Participants will learn about practical tools such as Audit 360 for evaluating user experience, the UX4G Design System for creating consistent interfaces, and Accessibility Widgets for ensuring inclusivity. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to advocate for and apply these design principles, fostering greater adoption, trust, and efficiency in their digital projects and contributing to a more inclusive Digital India.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Transit and Transhipment Procedures for Cargo
desc: This course provides an overview of key customs procedures and regulatory frameworks related to import documentation and cargo movement. Participants will learn the purpose and components of Arrival and Import Manifests, as well as concepts such as transit and transhipment. The course also covers relevant provisions of the Customs Act, 1962, guiding rules and exclusions, the transition to SCMTR, 2018, and important international agreements governing trade and transit with neighboring countries.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Transition to the New Criminal Laws: Repeals and Savings
desc: This course provides a detailed examination of the legal transition from India's erstwhile criminal laws—the Indian Penal Code (IPC), Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), and Indian Evidence Act (IEA)—to the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA). The core of the curriculum focuses on the interpretation and application of repeals and savings clauses, specifically Section 358 of the BNS, Section 531 of the BNSS, and Section 170 of the BSA. It clarifies the critical legal doctrine that ensures pending investigations, trials, and appeals continue under the old laws, while any new case initiated post-commencement will be governed by the new acts. Furthermore, the course explores how overarching statutes like Section 6 of the General Clauses Act support these transitional provisions, preventing legal vacuums. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently navigate the complexities of this legal reform, ensuring procedural correctness and justice in both ongoing and future criminal proceedings.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Transmission System SDH
desc: In an era of ever-increasing demand for data and bandwidth, understanding the underlying transmission technologies is essential for telecom professionals. This course addresses the critical shift from legacy TDM-based transport to modern packet-based networks. It begins by outlining the limitations of PDH systems and introduces Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH) as a foundational solution, detailing its multiplexing structure, frame representation, and network elements. The curriculum then progresses to Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM), explaining how it revolutionizes network capacity by transmitting multiple data streams over a single optical fiber. Finally, the course covers the Convergent Packet Access Network (CPAN), an MPLS-TP-based technology designed to aggregate diverse traffic types from the access network to the core. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the fundamental knowledge of how these key technologies work together to support high-speed voice, video, and data services, forming the bedrock of today's digital communication landscape.

title: Transmission Technologies
desc: In an era of ever-increasing demand for data and high-speed connectivity, understanding the underlying transmission technologies is crucial for telecom professionals. This course offers a detailed examination of the evolution and application of core, metro, and access network technologies. Learners will begin with the foundational principles of Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH) and its multiplexing schemes. The course then progresses to advanced optical technologies, including Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) for maximizing fiber capacity and Optical Transport Network (OTN) for efficient, multi-service transport. Participants will also gain a strong understanding of packet-switched networks by exploring Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS), its architecture, traffic engineering capabilities, and role in quality of service. Finally, the course covers modern aggregation and access solutions like Converged Packet Access Network (CPAN) and the use of Air Fiber for extending broadband services to remote areas. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to compare these technologies and understand their strategic deployment in building robust and scalable telecom infrastructure.

title: Travelling Allowance
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the principles and procedures related to Travelling Allowance (TA) within the government framework. It is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge to navigate the complexities of travel-related claims, ensuring both compliance and proper reimbursement. The curriculum provides a foundational understanding of why these rules are critical for financial accountability and transparency in public expenditure. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of different TA categories such as allowances for official tours, transfers, training programs, and retirement. The course delves into specific components like mileage allowance, daily allowance, and entitlements based on pay levels and mode of travel. Participants will learn how to correctly interpret government orders, fill out the necessary forms, and submit claims with the required documentation. Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently calculate their entitlements, prepare error-free TA claims, and understand the complete lifecycle of claim submission and settlement. This knowledge is vital for all travelling officials and indispensable for personnel in administration, finance, and accounts departments who are responsible for scrutinizing and passing these claims.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Travelling Allowance (Hindi)
desc: यह पाठ्यक्रम विशेष रूप से सरकारी कर्मचारियों को यात्रा भत्ता (टीए) से संबंधित नियमों की विस्तृत जानकारी देने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। पाठ्यक्रम की शुरुआत टीए के मूल सिद्धांतों और इसके महत्व से होती है। इसके बाद, यह विभिन्न प्रकार की यात्राओं जैसे स्थानांतरण, सेवानिवृत्ति और प्रशिक्षण के लिए लागू होने वाले भत्तों पर चर्चा करता है। शिक्षार्थी यात्रा के विभिन्न साधनों (रेल, सड़क, वायु) के लिए अपनी पात्रता और दैनिक भत्ते की गणना करना सीखेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम में टीए दावों को दाखिल करने, आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ तैयार करने और प्रतिपूर्ति प्रक्रिया को समझने के लिए चरण-दर-चरण निर्देश दिए गए हैं। इसे पूरा करने पर, कर्मचारी आत्मविश्वास के साथ टीए नियमों को लागू करने और वित्तीय त्रुटियों से बचते हुए अपने दावों को कुशलतापूर्वक संसाधित करने में सक्षम होंगे।
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Travelling and Daily Allowances for Civilians in Defence Services
desc: This course provides a detailed and practical understanding of the Travelling Allowance (TA) and Daily Allowance (DA) rules for Central Government employees, with a specific focus on civilians in Defence services. The curriculum is based on the Department of Expenditure's O.M. dated 13 July 2017 and subsequent clarifications, ensuring the information is current and accurate. The primary objective is to equip personnel with the knowledge to manage official travel expenses in compliance with financial regulations. Key learning areas include a thorough breakdown of entitlements for various modes of travel such as air, rail, and road for domestic and international tours. The course also covers special provisions, including the Composite Transfer Grant (CTG) for transfers, and TA rules applicable upon retirement. By completing this course, participants will be able to confidently interpret and apply TA/DA rules, prepare accurate claims, and ensure full compliance, thereby preventing common errors and audit objections in the management of public funds.

title: Treatment of Imports and Exports in GST
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regulations pertaining to imports and exports. In the context of India's evolving trade landscape, a precise application of GST is crucial for revenue integrity and facilitating international commerce. This program delves into the foundational aspects of GST, differentiating between Central GST (CGST), State GST (SGST), and Integrated GST (IGST) in the context of cross-border transactions. Participants will learn the specific procedures for calculating customs duties and taxes on imported goods, gaining clarity on complex scenarios such as high-sea sales and the tax implications for goods deposited in a warehouse. The course further illuminates the concept of integrated tax and details the various exemptions granted, for instance, to UN bodies and other specified entities. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in interpreting and applying GST laws to import and export activities, enabling them to handle GST matters with accuracy and confidence, thereby contributing to a more efficient and compliant trade ecosystem.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Treatment of Imports and Exports in GST - Part 2
desc: This specialized course, 'Treatment of Imports and Exports in GST - Part 2,' is designed for officials responsible for GST administration and compliance. In the context of a globalized economy, a thorough understanding of how GST applies to international trade is crucial for maintaining revenue integrity and facilitating lawful commerce. The course delves into the core principles of GST for cross-border transactions, clearly defining concepts such as Central GST (CGST) and State GST (SGST) in this context. Key learning areas include the classification of goods and services, the calculation methodologies for import and export duties, and the nuances of zero-rated supplies. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in applying GST provisions to various import/export scenarios, ensuring compliance and accurate revenue collection. This program will empower officials to handle complex international trade cases with confidence and precision.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Tree Improvement
desc: This course delves into the scientific discipline of tree improvement, a critical field for enhancing the productivity and economic value of forests and plantations. As the demand for timber and wood products grows, this course explains why shifting from natural forest exploitation to scientifically managed tree cultivation is essential. It lays a strong foundation in forest genetics, explaining core concepts like phenotype, genotype, heritability, and the sources of genetic variation that are fundamental to any breeding program. Participants will learn various practical methods for tree improvement, starting with the identification and selection of superior 'plus trees' using techniques such as comparison, regression, and index selection. The course provides detailed modules on progeny and clonal testing to evaluate the genetic worth of selected trees. Furthermore, it covers the strategic establishment and management of seed orchards to mass-produce genetically superior seeds. The curriculum also explores advanced topics like hybridization to harness hybrid vigor (heterosis) and the application of modern biotechnological tools, including molecular markers, QTL mapping, and genetic engineering, to accelerate the breeding cycle. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to design and implement effective tree improvement programs, contributing to the development of high-yielding, resilient, and economically beneficial tree varieties for India's forestry sector.
org: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education

title: Trial balance, Rectification of errors, Bank reconciliation statement
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip learners with the essential skills for accurate financial record-keeping. It is structured into four key modules that cover critical accounting processes. You will begin by learning how to prepare a trial balance, a vital tool for ensuring the mathematical accuracy of a company's ledgers. The course then delves into the rectification of errors, teaching you to identify various types of mistakes—such as errors of principle, omission, and commission—and apply the correct procedures to resolve them, including the use of a suspense account. The third module focuses on the bank reconciliation statement (BRS), guiding you through the steps to reconcile the bank balance as per the company's cash book with the bank statement, a crucial internal control for preventing fraud. Finally, you will gain an understanding of bills of exchange and promissory notes, learning about their features, parties involved, and accounting treatment in trade transactions. Upon completion, you will be proficient in core bookkeeping tasks that ensure financial integrity and compliance.
org: National Academy of Direct Taxes NADT

title: Trial in Absentia
desc: This course offers a comprehensive study of Trial in Absentia under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, emphasizing Sections 355 and 356. It explores how the judicial system allows criminal trials, inquiries, and the delivery of judgments to continue in the absence of an accused, while safeguarding legal rights and maintaining procedural integrity. The course examines the conditions under which personal appearance may be dispensed with, the procedures for handling proclaimed offenders, and the use of technology for recording evidence. Additionally, it covers the role of state legal aid, the rights of the accused in cross-examination and appeals, and highlights key judicial decisions. By comparing the provisions with the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, and referencing related legislation such as the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the course emphasizes the importance of speedy, victim-centric justice in modern legal practice.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Trial in Absentia and Proceedings against Proclaimed Offenders
desc: This course is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of the new legal provisions governing trials in absentia and proclaimed offenders, as introduced in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. The content is crucial for legal professionals and law enforcement officials who must adapt to the updated criminal justice system. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of Section 356 of the BNSS for conducting trials without the accused's presence, the process of declaring an individual a proclaimed offender under Section 209 of the BNS, and the procedures for property attachment under Sections 85-89 of the BNSS. The course also explores procedural safeguards, the right to legal representation for the absconding accused, and the handling of evidence, including the use of audio-video technology. Upon completion, participants will be able to confidently apply these new legal standards in their professional roles, ensuring compliance and upholding the principles of justice within the revised framework.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Tribal Telehamlet: Project Punnagai
desc: Under Project Punnagai, led by IAS officer Mr. Krishnanunni, the remote Kathirimalai hamlet in Tamil Nadu was transformed through the introduction of Wi-Fi, telemedicine, educational resources, skill development programs, and improved agricultural practices, leading to replication across multiple villages in the state.

title: TRINETRA - End to End Cyber Security Solution
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of end-to-end cybersecurity solutions, centered around the TRINETRA platform. The curriculum begins by establishing the foundational concepts of cybersecurity, explaining its critical role and the diverse landscape of digital threats. It provides a detailed examination of the global and national cybercrime scenarios, emphasizing the specific challenges faced within India and building a case for a unified, integrated security approach. Learners will gain an in-depth understanding of the Enterprise Security Operation Center (ESOC) TRINETRA solution. The course breaks down its key features, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA), and Data Loss Prevention (DLP). Through detailed explanations of each component, participants will learn how these technologies work in concert to provide real-time monitoring, threat detection, automated response, and comprehensive data protection. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to appreciate the architecture and strategic value of a holistic cybersecurity framework.

title: TSS: Auxiliary Transformer and Lightning Arrester Maintenance
desc: The Power Supply Installation (PSI) provides power to the Over Head Equipment (OHE), which supplies electricity to electric locomotives and EMUs. PSI consists of various electrical equipment located in Traction Sub-Stations (TSS), Sub Sectioning Posts (SSP), and Sectioning Posts (SP), along with their associated fittings, insulators, and attachments. For optimal utilization of traction assets, outages of overhead equipment must be minimized. This requires properly scheduled maintenance of PSI assets. Since electric traction systems depend on a continuous supply of power, all substations and switching stations must be maintained in full working condition at all times.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Electrical Engineering (IRIEEN)

title: Tsunami-Disaster Response Training
desc: This self-paced course is designed to build a comprehensive understanding of tsunami-related disaster response. It begins by defining what a tsunami is, exploring its scientific causes, and illustrating its potential impact on land and infrastructure. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the Tsunami Warning System, explaining how to interpret alerts and take timely action. Learners will be guided through a structured set of protocols for what to do before, during, and after a tsunami to ensure personal and community safety. The course also specifically elucidates the crucial responsibilities and functions of volunteers within the broader disaster management framework. Upon completion, participants will be equipped with the foundational knowledge to act decisively and effectively during a tsunami-related emergency, contributing to a more resilient community.

title: Turning Around a Stranded Asset : GAIL's Revival of the JBF PTA Plant
desc: This case examines how GAIL (India) Ltd. used India’s insolvency framework to acquire and revive a nearly-complete (95-99%) 1.25 MMTPA PTA plant in the Mangalore SEZ that had become stranded after the original promoter’s financial distress and subsequent insolvency proceedings. The teaching emphasis is on how GAIL executed the turnaround: (i) designing a winning resolution plan under the IBC/CIRP process, (ii) rapidly closing and operationalising the acquisition post-NCLT approval, and (iii) solving two decisive restart constraints: paraxylene (PX) feedstock continuity and licensor/technology alignment.

title: Two Stroke Marine Diesel Engines
desc: Delving into the heart of maritime propulsion, this course offers a comprehensive introduction to the operation of two-stroke marine diesel engines. Recognizing that these engines are vital to the 90% of world trade carried by sea, the program is designed for beginners seeking to build a solid base of industry knowledge. The course systematically breaks down complex topics into understandable modules, starting with an introduction to the maritime sector and the reasons for the prevalence of two-stroke engines. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of the two-stroke cycle, the mechanics of scavenging and turbocharging for enhanced efficiency, and the precise science behind the valve timing diagram. Participants will also learn about the critical conditions for achieving efficient combustion, including fuel treatment, injection timing, and atomization. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with the technical knowledge to understand how a ship's main propulsion engine functions, making it ideal for aspiring marine engineers and technical staff.

title: Type of Telecom licenses and Their Financial Conditions
desc: The telecommunications sector is a critical pillar of modern governance and economic growth, operating within a complex regulatory framework. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the licensing and financial conditions that govern telecom services in India. It is designed for officials who need to understand the legal and commercial architecture of the telecom industry to ensure compliance and effective administration. The curriculum begins with the foundational legal provisions of the Indian Telegraph Act, 1885, and proceeds to a detailed examination of the Unified License Agreement. Learners will dissect the various chapters of the agreement, covering the scope, financial conditions, and technical requirements for key services such as Access Service, Internet Service, National Long Distance (NLD), and International Long Distance (ILD). A significant focus is placed on the financial aspects, including the calculation of Adjusted Gross Revenue (AGR), payment schedules for license fees, and the role of Performance and Financial Bank Guarantees. The course also touches upon security conditions, spectrum allotment, and operational obligations imposed on licensees. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to interpret license agreements, analyze financial compliance, and navigate the regulatory landscape of the Indian telecom sector with confidence.

title: Types and Functions and Key Stakeholders in the Cooperative Sector
desc: This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of the cooperative movement in India and its role in socio-economic development. The course explains the different types of cooperative societies and their significance in supporting both rural and urban economies. It highlights how cooperatives contribute to livelihoods across agriculture, trade, services, and allied sectors, and how they promote collective growth and economic participation. Learners will also gain insight into the internal structure of cooperative societies, the system of cooperation among various cooperative institutions, and the role of key stakeholders in ensuring effective functioning. The course further emphasizes the importance of cooperatives in supporting diverse business activities and strengthening inclusive economic development. Overall, this course aims to build a clear understanding of how cooperatives contribute to equity, livelihood enhancement, and long-term socio-economic progress.

title: Types of Evidence
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023, focusing on the classification and application of evidence in the Indian legal system. The content is structured to provide a foundational understanding of why these new laws are critical for modern judicial processes, especially with the inclusion of electronic and digital records. Key learning areas include a detailed examination of oral, documentary, primary, and secondary evidence, along with their specific legal requirements for presentation and proof in court. The course also delves into crucial legal principles such as the 'best evidence rule,' the admissibility of expert and real evidence, and the nuances of direct versus circumstantial evidence. Learners will gain the ability to differentiate between substantive and corroborative evidence and understand the exceptions to the inadmissibility of hearsay evidence, such as dying declarations. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to correctly interpret and apply the provisions of the BSA, 2023, enhancing their effectiveness in legal, investigative, and judicial roles.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Types of Optical Fiber Cable and there Uses
desc: Dive into the essential technology of modern telecommunications with this detailed course on optical fiber cables. Designed for technical professionals and aspiring engineers, this program explains why optical fiber is critical for high-speed data transmission in networks like FTTH, 5G, and DWDM. The curriculum systematically breaks down complex topics, starting with the fundamental geometry of an optical fiber, including the core, cladding, and coating. You will learn to distinguish between single-mode and multi-mode fibers and understand how their refractive index profiles—step-index versus graded-index—impact performance. The course further details the practical construction of cables, comparing loose-tube designs for harsh outdoor environments with tight-buffered cables for indoor applications. Upon completion, you will be able to analyze the components of various fiber optic cables and recognize key ITU-T standards, enabling you to make informed decisions in network planning and implementation.

title: Udyam Assist Platform: Game-changer for Informal Micro Enterprises
desc:
Micro enterprises play a critical role in India’s economy, contributing to GDP, exports, and job creation. However, over 99% operate informally, limiting access to finance and government benefits. To address this, the Ministry of MSME launched Udyam Registration in 2020, but many informal micro enterprises (IMEs) remained unregistered due to lack of awareness, documents, and digital skills.

To bridge this gap, the Ministry introduced the Udyam Assist Platform (UAP) on January 11, 2023, developed and managed by SIDBI. Unlike the self-registration Udyam Registration Portal, UAP enables banks and microfinance institutions to register IMEs on their behalf, using Aadhaar-based verification and bulk data uploads. The platform enhances reach, ensures data security, and issues an Udyam Assist Certificate, allowing IMEs to later self-register fully.

title: Ultrasonic Testing of Wheels and Axles in Indian Railways
desc: The “Ultrasonic Testing of Wheels and Axles in Indian Railways” course provides a comprehensive understanding of ultrasonic testing (UT), one of the most effective non-destructive testing methods, applied in the inspection and maintenance of critical railway components. The course covers UT principles, wave types, calibration, data interpretation, and the standards and procedures used by Indian Railways, enabling learners to confidently conduct inspections and assess component integrity.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IRIMEE)

title: UMANG- A Digital India Initiative
desc: Dive into the world of digital governance with this detailed overview of the UMANG platform. This course explains the strategic importance of UMANG as a core component of the Digital India mission, designed to fast-track mobile governance and serve as a primary interface for citizen-government interactions. You will learn about the challenges UMANG overcomes, such as the multiplicity of government apps, discoverability issues, and ensuring authenticity in a crowded digital space. The course details the platform's architecture, its user-centric design principles, and the benefits it offers to both citizens and government departments, including a consistent user experience and reduced development overhead for departments. By the end of this course, you will have a thorough understanding of UMANG's role as a scalable Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and its future roadmap towards becoming the single go-to application for all government services, ultimately fostering a more accessible and efficient paperless governance system.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: UNCAC Meetings: Overview and Handling and Follow-up
desc: This course is designed specifically for Section Officers and below to provide a comprehensive understanding of the United Nations Convention against Corruption (UNCAC). Far from being merely a document in a filing cabinet, the UNCAC is a legally binding universal anti-corruption instrument that significantly shapes India’s global engagement. As the central coordinating body, the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) collaborates with key stakeholders such as the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), and Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) to formulate a unified national response. This course aims to equip learners with essential knowledge of the UNCAC framework, its core bodies, and its review and monitoring mechanisms. Recognizing that Section Officers play a critical role in implementation, the curriculum is structured into five concise modules focused on the practical aspects of managing agendas and official workflows.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Under Ground Cable in BSNL
desc: This technical course is designed to equip telecom field personnel with the essential skills for maintaining underground cable infrastructure. The program begins with an introduction to UG cables, their design, and their role in the BSNL outdoor network, emphasizing the direct impact of maintenance on service quality parameters like network stability and data speed. The curriculum is divided into three key areas. First, learners will understand the fundamental structure of PIJF cables. Second, the course provides a detailed guide to identifying specific cable pairs using the standard color-coding system for various cable sizes, a crucial skill for preventing errors during repairs. Finally, it presents a step-by-step walkthrough of the entire cable jointing process, from pit preparation and safety precautions to using a Thermo-Shrink (TSF) joint kit for creating a durable, water-resistant, and mechanically stable connection. Upon completion, learners will be proficient in performing standard cable jointing procedures, contributing to a more resilient and reliable telecom network.

title: Underground Coal Mine Planning and Design
desc: This comprehensive course is designed to equip professionals with the essential knowledge for planning and designing modern underground coal mines. It addresses the growing need for mining operations that are not only productive but also safe and environmentally responsible. The curriculum begins with the fundamentals, exploring the significance and challenges of underground mining and the key geological factors that influence design decisions. Participants will delve into the technical aspects of selecting mining methods, planning mine access and development, and designing crucial support systems like ventilation and dewatering. A significant focus is placed on creating efficient mine layouts that optimize coal extraction while prioritizing worker safety. The course also covers the logistics of underground transportation for both personnel and materials, including hoisting, conveyor, and haulage systems. Furthermore, it thoroughly examines environmental and sustainability considerations, such as waste management, ESG compliance, and mine closure planning, preparing learners to develop holistic and sustainable mining projects.

title: Understand How AI Impacts You and Your Government
desc: As governments worldwide undergo digital transformation, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a pivotal technology with the potential to revolutionize public service delivery. This course is designed for public servants who wish to understand the implications of AI without needing a background in technology. It provides a comprehensive overview of AI's role in the public sector, addressing the common concerns and highlighting the opportunities it presents. Key learning areas include defining AI, recognizing its main benefits and risks, and identifying practical ways to harness its power for the public good. Participants will learn to think critically about AI applications, from automating routine tasks to informing complex policy decisions. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the necessary knowledge and confidence to contribute to discussions on responsible AI adoption and help steer their organizations toward a more efficient, data-driven future.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Understanding Adjudication under Goods and Services Tax
desc: This course provides tax officials with a strong foundational understanding of adjudication under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime. It focuses on the legal framework, procedural requirements, and principles necessary for the fair, consistent, and effective adjudication of GST cases. The course begins with the concept and legal basis of adjudication and examines the role, powers, and responsibilities of the Adjudicating Authority. It covers the complete process relating to a Show Cause Notice (SCN), including its issuance, communication, response, and subsequent proceedings. Participants will also learn about the importance and procedure of conducting personal hearings in accordance with the principles of natural justice. A key component of the course is the practical understanding of drafting an effective Order-in-Original, with emphasis on clarity, reasoning, legal provisions, findings, and enforceability.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Understanding Altman's Z-Score Analysis
desc: Dive into the fundamentals of financial risk assessment with this detailed course on Altman's Z-Score analysis. Designed for financial professionals, investors, and analysts, this program demystifies the process of evaluating a company's likelihood of insolvency. You will begin by exploring the history and conceptual basis of the Z-Score model. The course then provides a step-by-step guide to calculating the score, breaking down each of its five variables (A through E), from working capital ratios to earnings and market equity. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to interpretation, teaching you how to classify companies into 'safe,' 'grey,' or 'distress' zones based on their Z-Score. Through practical examples, including an analysis of the telecom sector, you will learn to apply this powerful tool in real-world scenarios like credit risk evaluation, investment screening, and ongoing financial health monitoring. By the end, you will be proficient in using the Z-Score to make data-driven judgments about corporate financial viability.

title: Understanding and Application of Urban Planning
desc: This course provides a foundational understanding of urban planning for professionals involved in urban governance and development. It explores the importance of planned urban growth in addressing challenges arising from rapid urbanization and unstructured development. Guided by the Urban and Regional Development Plans Formulation and Implementation (URDPFI) Guidelines, the course introduces key planning concepts, methodologies, and their practical applications in city development. Learners will gain insights into land use planning, infrastructure planning, smart growth strategies, zoning, Floor Area Ratio (FAR), and development control regulations. By simplifying complex planning concepts, the course demonstrates how effective urban planning supports sustainable, inclusive, resilient, and economically vibrant cities while enabling informed decision-making and better urban governance.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Understanding and Improving Sleep Health
desc: In today's demanding world, sleep health is often overlooked, primarily due to a lack of awareness about its profound benefits and effective improvement techniques. This course is designed to bridge that gap by providing a comprehensive introduction to the science and practice of healthy sleep. You will explore the various dimensions of sleep, learn what constitutes good sleep quality, and understand the significant advantages it offers for both physical and mental health. The curriculum covers how to recognize common symptoms of sleep deprivation and introduces the core principles of sleep hygiene. A key component of the course is learning to monitor and analyze your own sleep patterns using simple tools like a sleep diary. By the end of this course, you will be empowered with the knowledge and strategies to not only improve your own sleep but also to guide your family and colleagues toward better sleep health, fostering a culture of well-being.

title: Understanding and Managing Stress
desc: In today's fast-paced professional environment, managing stress is a critical skill for maintaining personal health and professional effectiveness. This course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of stress, its causes, and its effects. You will learn to identify different types of stressors and recognize the body's fight-or-flight response, including the roles of the SAM and HPA axes. The curriculum explores the significant long-term impact of chronic stress on cardiovascular, endocrine, immune, and digestive systems. Through a series of structured modules, you will be introduced to various coping mechanisms, including problem-focused and emotion-focused strategies. By the end of this course, you will be able to analyze your personal stress triggers and apply effective techniques such as mindfulness, social support, and cognitive reframing to manage stress proactively, leading to improved mental clarity, emotional balance, and overall well-being.

title: Understanding and Preventing Lifestyle Diseases
desc: This course delves into the escalating crisis of non-communicable diseases (NCDs), which are responsible for a significant majority of premature deaths worldwide. It provides a foundational understanding of why these chronic conditions, though largely preventable, have become a primary public health concern, particularly in rapidly urbanizing nations like India. Learners will explore the key learning areas, including the major categories of NCDs, the distinction between modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors, and the specific socioeconomic drivers contributing to their prevalence. The curriculum is designed to move beyond awareness to practical application. Participants will learn to identify evidence-based prevention strategies and health-promotion practices that can be applied at individual, community, and policy levels. By the end of the course, learners will be empowered to advocate for and implement measures that help mitigate the impact of lifestyle diseases, fostering a healthier future for society.

title: Understanding and Rectifying Accounting Errors
desc: In the realm of financial management, accuracy is paramount. Unintentional mistakes in accounting can distort the financial position of an organization, leading to incorrect reporting and flawed decision-making. This course, 'A Practical Guide to Understanding and Rectifying Accounting Errors,' is designed to address this critical need by providing a detailed walkthrough of error management in accounting. The course begins by establishing the context, explaining why even a matched trial balance is not conclusive proof of accuracy and discussing the common causes of errors, from lack of knowledge to carelessness. Key learning areas include a deep dive into the four main classifications of errors: errors of omission, commission, principle, and compensating errors. You will learn to distinguish between them and understand how each type affects the trial balance. The curriculum then moves to the practical application of rectification. You will learn systematic procedures to correct errors, including making appropriate debit and credit entries and using a suspense account to reconcile discrepancies temporarily. By completing this course, you will be able to confidently detect and rectify accounting errors, ensuring that your financial statements reflect a true and fair view of the financial position.

title: Understanding and Teaching Children with Intellectual Disabilities
desc: This course provides essential knowledge and skills for anyone involved in the education and care of children with Intellectual Disabilities (ID). It begins by establishing a foundational understanding of what ID is, its various causes, and the common characteristics and developmental delays associated with it. The curriculum underscores the profound impact of early and accurate identification, followed by timely and appropriate intervention, which is crucial for maximizing a child's developmental trajectory and quality of life. Participants will delve into a range of effective teaching methodologies and classroom management strategies specifically tailored for children with ID. The course focuses on practical application, enabling learners to foster a nurturing, non-judgmental, and inclusive atmosphere that promotes learning and personal growth. Upon completion, you will be better prepared to support CwID, helping them to not only learn but also to thrive in their educational journey and beyond.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: Understanding Arrest Provisions Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: With the introduction of the new criminal laws, it is imperative for law enforcement and legal professionals to master the updated procedures. This course offers a detailed examination of arrest-related provisions within the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, providing the context and practical knowledge needed for lawful application. Key learning areas include the conditions for warrantless arrest (Section 35), procedures upon refusal to provide identity (Section 39), and the specific protocols for searching premises (Section 44). The curriculum emphasizes the importance of procedural safeguards (Section 43), the duties of arresting officers (Sections 36, 48), and legally mandated medical examinations (Sections 51-53). Upon completion, participants will be equipped to conduct arrests and related procedures with full adherence to due process, ensuring both effective law enforcement and the upholding of citizen rights.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Understanding Arrest Provisions Under the New Criminal Laws
desc: With the introduction of the new criminal laws, it is imperative for law enforcement and legal professionals to master the updated procedures. This course offers a detailed examination of arrest-related provisions within the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, providing the context and practical knowledge needed for lawful application. Key learning areas include the conditions for warrantless arrest (Section 35), procedures upon refusal to provide identity (Section 39), and the specific protocols for searching premises (Section 44). The curriculum emphasizes the importance of procedural safeguards (Section 43), the duties of arresting officers (Sections 36, 48), and legally mandated medical examinations (Sections 51-53). Upon completion, participants will be equipped to conduct arrests and related procedures with full adherence to due process, ensuring both effective law enforcement and the upholding of citizen rights.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD

title: Understanding Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder: ADHD
desc: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is one of the most common neurodevelopmental disorders in children and often persists into adolescence and adulthood. Although many children may occasionally display inattention, hyperactivity, or impulsivity, ADHD is characterized by persistent and developmentally inappropriate patterns of these behaviours. These symptoms are more frequent and severe than typically expected for a child’s age and significantly interfere with functioning at home, school, and in social settings. Effective management of ADHD involves a multimodal approach. Treatment commonly includes medication—both stimulant and non-stimulant—to improve attention regulation and impulse control. In addition, psychosocial interventions such as behavioural parent training, classroom modifications, and school-based strategies play a crucial role in supporting children’s daily functioning.
org: All India Institute of Speech And Hearing AIISH - Mysore

title: Understanding Bharat's Artificial Intelligence Stack
desc: This course introduces Karmayogis to India’s journey in building Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can become the next layer of this public infrastructure. Beginning with foundational platforms such as Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC, and BHASHINI, the course explains the core principles of India’s DPI approach—open standards, shared public infrastructure, and participation by the wider ecosystem. Learners will explore how these principles can be extended to AI and understand the role of the IndiaAI Mission in building an enabling AI ecosystem through initiatives such as AIKosh, the IndiaAI Compute Portal, BHASHINI, and AI governance frameworks. The course also introduces the Unified AI Interface (UAI) and its role in enabling AI agents to discover, interact, and transact through interoperable infrastructure.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding Bonded Labour and the Bonded Labour Act
desc: This course provides a comprehensive overview of bonded labour, including its key elements, various types, and the myths and misconceptions surrounding it. It also covers the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, detailing its salient features, objectives, and penal provisions. Participants will gain a clear understanding of how bonded labour manifests across different sectors and the legal framework designed to prevent and eliminate it.

title: Understanding Carbon Footprint and Climate Impact
desc: In an era of increasing climate volatility, understanding the environmental consequences of energy use is essential for responsible governance and citizenship. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the relationship between energy consumption, carbon emissions, and their tangible impacts on the planet. It is designed for public officials and environmentally-conscious individuals seeking to translate awareness into meaningful action. The course begins by defining the concept of a carbon footprint and demonstrates how to measure it at an individual or organizational level. It explores the science behind climate change, presenting evidence of its ongoing effects. Key modules focus on identifying areas of energy overuse in daily personal and professional life and analyzing how fossil fuel-based systems drive environmental degradation. Upon completion, learners will be equipped with practical strategies to significantly reduce their energy consumption. They will be able to apply this knowledge to promote sustainable practices within their communities and workplaces, contributing directly to national and global climate action objectives, such as the Sustainable Development Goals. This course empowers participants to become proactive agents in building a more sustainable and energy-efficient future.

title: Understanding Children Education Allowance
desc: This course offers a detailed exploration of the Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Hostel Subsidy, crucial financial benefits for central government employees. It addresses the importance of understanding these allowances to ensure proper utilization and administrative compliance. The curriculum is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the scheme's framework under the 7th Central Pay Commission, covering everything from the fundamental objectives to the practical application of rules. Key learning areas include a breakdown of eligibility conditions, annual financial limits, and a clear distinction between reimbursable and non-reimbursable expenses. The course delves into the procedural aspects, outlining the step-by-step process for claim submission, the necessity of self-certification, and the required documentation. Special attention is given to complex scenarios, such as claims for twins, differently-abled (Divyangjan) children, and situations where both parents are government employees. Upon completion, learners, particularly establishment staff and HR personnel, will be equipped to manage, process, and file CEA claims with confidence and accuracy, adhering strictly to the guidelines set by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT).
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding Conservation and Heritage Management in India
desc: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of heritage conservation within the Indian context. It addresses the critical need for structured heritage management as an integral part of urban planning and sustainable development. The curriculum begins by defining what constitutes heritage, covering its various forms such as cultural, natural, tangible, and intangible, and explains why its preservation is vital for national identity and community well-being. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the institutional landscape governing heritage in India. This includes the functions of international organizations like UNESCO and national bodies such as the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) and the National Monuments Authority (NMA). The course details the legal provisions of the AMASR Act, including regulations for protected areas. Furthermore, it explores both conventional and advanced methods for heritage documentation, from manual listing to modern techniques like photogrammetry and drone surveys. A key focus is placed on the role of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in integrating heritage conservation into local governance, supported by a case study of Ahmedabad. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to appreciate the complexities of heritage management and its connection to public policy and urban administration.

title: Understanding Cyber Security and Digital Privacy
desc: In an era of rapid digital transformation, understanding the legal dimensions of cybersecurity and data privacy is critical for effective governance. This course is designed for public officials and digital governance stakeholders, offering a detailed examination of India's regulatory environment. The curriculum is anchored in the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, and the IT Act, 2000, providing context through key legal precedents like the Right to Privacy judgment. Key learning areas include the analysis of major cyber incidents, such as the Aadhaar and Air India breaches, and a comparative study of data protection laws from the US, UK, Canada, and Australia. By exploring advanced topics like encryption, the Dark Web, and digital sovereignty, participants will be prepared to develop robust policies and risk mitigation strategies. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to balance innovation, privacy, and national security in their professional roles.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding Data Protection Rights and Cyber Threat Response
desc: In an increasingly digital world, understanding both the legal and technical aspects of data security is paramount for public sector professionals. This course is designed to provide a dual-focus learning experience, covering the critical intersection of data protection legislation and practical cyber threat response. You will gain a clear understanding of individual rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, contextualized for public service delivery. The course moves from legal theory to applied practice by dissecting a real-world ransomware attack, from initial intrusion to system compromise. You will learn to recognize attacker tactics like privilege escalation and lateral movement. Furthermore, the curriculum introduces User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) as a proactive tool for detecting insider threats and anomalous activity. By completing this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge to ensure legal compliance and implement robust technical strategies, fostering a secure and resilient data management environment within your organization.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding Depreciation on Assets
desc: Depreciation is a critical aspect of financial reporting, taxation, and asset management. This course, 'Principles of Asset Depreciation for Financial Reporting,' offers a detailed exploration of this core accounting principle. It begins by establishing the context of why depreciation is vital for determining the financial health of an organization, covering concepts like useful life, salvage value, and obsolescence. Key learning areas include a clear distinction between depreciation for tangible assets, amortization for intangible assets, and depletion for natural resources. The course provides step-by-step guidance on the two primary methods of recording depreciation: charging it directly to the asset account and creating a provision for depreciation. Learners will engage with practical illustrations to master calculations for both the Straight-Line and Written-Down Value methods. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply these principles to ensure accurate financial reporting and effective asset management within their organizations.

title: Understanding Development Programs
desc: This course is designed for Karmayogis seeking to enhance their capabilities in the practical management of development initiatives. It addresses the critical need for public officials to move beyond theoretical knowledge to the effective execution and sustenance of programs that drive national progress. By focusing on a blend of strategic thinking and actionable tools, the course prepares learners to navigate the complexities inherent in the development sector. Key learning areas are structured across five distinct modules. You will begin with 'Systems Thinking' to grasp the interconnectedness of development ecosystems, followed by 'Understanding Paradoxes' to tackle wicked, multifaceted problems. The course then introduces the 'Logical Framework Approach' for systematically driving and measuring change, emphasizing public participation. Further, it explores leadership techniques for 'Sustaining Change' to ensure long-term impact and delves into 'Behaviour Change Communication' to effectively nudge stakeholder actions. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to analyze complex development challenges, apply robust frameworks for program management, and lead initiatives that deliver measurable and sustainable results, transforming development aspirations into tangible reality.

title: Understanding Digital Marketing for Government Officers
desc: In an era where digital presence is paramount, this course provides government professionals with the critical knowledge to navigate the online landscape. It offers a comprehensive overview of digital marketing, tailored specifically for the public sector's unique challenges and objectives. The curriculum delves into the practical application of digital tools for promoting campaigns, from leveraging social media for real-time engagement to optimizing websites for maximum visibility through SEO. Learners will explore how to measure the success of their outreach efforts using key performance indicators and analytics tools like Google Analytics. A significant focus is placed on crisis management, teaching officers how to counter misinformation and maintain public trust during critical events. By the end of this course, participants will be empowered to develop and execute data-driven digital communication strategies that foster transparency, encourage citizen participation, and strengthen governance.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding DigiYatra: Innovation in Indian Aviation
desc: Delve into the future of travel with this detailed exploration of the DigiYatra initiative. This course explains the critical need for digital transformation in the aviation industry and how DigiYatra addresses this by revolutionizing airport processes. You will learn about the initiative's vision, its sophisticated technical architecture built on AI and decentralized identity, and its implementation roadmap. The curriculum covers key concepts such as self-sovereign identity (SSI), verifiable credentials (VCs), and the importance of privacy-preserving technologies in building digital trust. Furthermore, the course examines the broader implications and potential for adapting the DigiYatra model to other governance sectors, including health, education, and logistics. Upon completion, officials will gain valuable insights into designing and integrating similar large-scale digital trust frameworks to enhance public service delivery across various domains.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding E-Waste Management
desc: As electronic devices become increasingly integral to our daily lives, the challenge of managing e-waste grows in parallel. This course is designed to equip public sector professionals with the foundational knowledge to address this pressing environmental issue. It delves into the entire lifecycle of electronic waste, from its generation to its hazardous impact if not managed correctly. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the circular economy as a sustainable alternative to the traditional linear model of 'take-make-dispose'. The course details the key provisions of both global and national legal frameworks that govern e-waste, emphasizing the importance of compliance and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). Furthermore, it explores innovative strategies, technological advancements, and skill development initiatives that are shaping the future of e-waste management in India.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding Ethical Leadership
desc: In the complex landscape of public administration, ethical leadership is not merely a virtue but a critical component of effective governance. This course is designed to equip public servants with the analytical tools and moral frameworks necessary to navigate challenging ethical situations. It begins by addressing common misconceptions and justifications for unethical behavior, providing clear signposts to identify potential integrity breaches. The curriculum delves into the structural causes of corruption, examining the Principal-Agent-Client dynamic and the societal costs associated with systemic integrity failures. Learners will explore practical strategies for preventing corruption, including how to conduct vulnerability assessments and establish robust internal controls. A key focus is on resolving ethical dilemmas through established principles, such as ends-based, rule-based, and care-based reasoning. By the end of this course, participants will be better prepared to make sound, principled decisions, champion a culture of integrity within their organizations, and contribute to a more transparent and accountable public service.

title: Understanding Financial Position of an organization
desc: In today's governance landscape, a clear understanding of financial principles is essential for accountability and effective decision-making. This course is designed to equip public officials with the foundational knowledge required to navigate the world of organizational finance. It begins by establishing the context of financial transactions and the universally accepted double-entry system of accounting, explaining the core concepts of debits and credits. You will learn the practical steps of recording financial activities through journal and ledger entries, the building blocks of all financial reporting. The course then delves into the two most critical financial statements: the Balance Sheet and the Profit and Loss (P&L) account. You will explore the components of a Balance Sheet, including assets, liabilities, and equity, and learn how to analyze a P&L statement to understand revenues, costs, and profitability. Through examples from public sector entities, this course will empower you to confidently read, interpret, and evaluate financial statements to gauge the financial health and performance of any organization.

title: Understanding Financial Statements
desc: In today's governance landscape, the ability to understand financial data is crucial for informed decision-making. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the core principles of financial statement analysis. It demystifies complex financial documents by breaking them down into their fundamental parts. Participants will explore the Balance Sheet to understand a company's assets and liabilities, the Profit and Loss (P&L) Account to gauge profitability, and the Cash Flow Statement to assess liquidity and solvency. The course also touches upon the importance of explanatory notes that accompany these statements. By the end of this program, learners will not only be able to read these documents but also interpret the stories they tell about an organization's financial stability and operational efficiency.

title: Understanding Financial Statements
desc: In today's governance landscape, the ability to understand financial data is crucial for informed decision-making. This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the core principles of financial statement analysis. It demystifies complex financial documents by breaking them down into their fundamental parts. Participants will explore the Balance Sheet to understand a company's assets and liabilities, the Profit and Loss (P&L) Account to gauge profitability, and the Cash Flow Statement to assess liquidity and solvency. The course also touches upon the importance of explanatory notes that accompany these statements. By the end of this program, learners will not only be able to read these documents but also interpret the stories they tell about an organization's financial stability and operational efficiency. This skill is directly applicable to roles requiring financial scrutiny of public sector undertakings, private vendors, or public-private partnership (PPP) projects, fostering greater accountability and prudence in public financial management.

title: Understanding Global Financial Institutions and Economic System
desc: In an increasingly interconnected world, a thorough understanding of global financial architecture is essential for effective public policy and administration. This course, 'Global Financial Institutions and the Economic System: A Critical Overview,' delves into the complex dynamics of international economic governance. It begins by establishing the historical context, tracing the system's origins from the Bretton Woods Agreement and exploring its transformation through financial globalization and the rise of neoliberal ideologies. The curriculum focuses on the roles, operations, and influence of pivotal institutions, including the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the World Bank, and the World Trade Organization (WTO). It also analyzes the growing impact of new entities like the New Development Bank (BRICS Bank) and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB). By examining the current challenges, power shifts, and calls for reform, this course prepares learners in policy-making, international relations, and development finance to critically assess and navigate the evolving global economic landscape, enabling them to contribute to more equitable and sustainable development strategies.

title: Understanding Government Budgeting
desc: In the realm of public administration, sound financial management is paramount for effective governance and national development. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the critical role that budgeting plays in translating government policies into tangible outcomes. It is specifically designed for public functionaries who need to understand the intricacies of managing public funds with prudence and integrity. The course delves into the entire budgetary lifecycle, starting with the principles of budget formulation, including estimating receipts and expenditures. It examines the legislative procedures for budget approval, the mechanisms for fund allocation, and the protocols for expenditure management as outlined in the General Financial Rules (GFR). Learners will also gain insights into the importance of fiscal responsibility, the structure of government accounts, and the audit process that ensures accountability.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding GST Demands and Recovery under the CGST Act 2017
desc: This course provides an in-depth understanding of the provisions relating to demands and recovery under the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017. It is designed to equip tax administration officers with the knowledge required to effectively handle cases involving non-payment or short payment of tax, erroneous refunds, and wrongful availment or utilization of Input Tax Credit (ITC). The course examines the legal and procedural framework governing demand proceedings, with particular focus on Section 73 for cases not involving fraud, wilful misstatement, or suppression of facts, and Section 74 for cases involving fraud, wilful misstatement, or suppression of facts. Participants will understand the prescribed timelines, procedural requirements, and relevant forms, including DRC-01 and DRC-07, used during demand and recovery proceedings. The course also covers pre-notice communication, issuance and adjudication of Show Cause Notices, payment of tax, interest and penalties.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Understanding Indian Railways
desc: Delve into the intricate world of Indian Railways, one of the largest and most complex rail networks globally. This course provides a foundational understanding of its historical evolution, organizational framework, and operational dynamics. You will learn about the roles of the Railway Board, zonal and divisional systems, and the mechanisms for recruitment and training that power this massive workforce. The course examines both passenger and freight services, highlighting major revenue sources and iconic trains like the Vande Bharat Express. Furthermore, it explores the technological advancements in electrification, signaling, and rolling stock that are shaping the future of rail transport in India. By exploring strategic initiatives, heritage conservation efforts, and the vision for a sustainable railway system, learners will gain a complete perspective on the challenges and opportunities within Indian Railways, making it ideal for officials, professionals, and enthusiasts seeking to understand this critical infrastructure.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Understanding Input Tax Credit under Goods and Services Tax
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Input Tax Credit (ITC) mechanism under India’s Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime. It is designed to help finance and tax professionals understand the legal requirements, procedures, and practical considerations involved in claiming, utilizing, reconciling, and reversing ITC. The course covers key provisions governing ITC, including eligibility conditions, documentation requirements, time limits, utilization of the electronic credit ledger, and identification of ineligible or blocked credits under Section 17(5) of the CGST Act. Participants will also explore the practical aspects of matching and reconciling ITC using GSTR-2A and GSTR-2B.
