The course further addresses important scenarios involving ITC reversal due to non-payment, as well as special provisions applicable to new GST registrations, taxpayers opting out of the composition scheme, and cases where previously exempt supplies become taxable.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Understanding Labour Codes in India
desc: India's labour law landscape has undergone a significant transformation with the introduction of four comprehensive Labour Codes, which aim to simplify and unify a previously fragmented legal system. This course offers an in-depth exploration of these legislations: the Code on Wages, 2019; the Industrial Relations Code, 2020; the Code on Social Security, 2020; and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020. It provides a strong foundation in the purpose, scope, and key provisions of each code, examining common elements like the emphasis on digitization, streamlined registration, and improved ease of doing business. The curriculum is designed to move beyond theory, contextualizing the application of these laws in real-world workplace scenarios. Participants will develop the ability to analyze how these structural changes affect industrial relations, social security benefits, wage structures, and occupational safety standards. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to confidently interpret and apply the new legal framework to ensure compliance and promote fair labour practices within their organizations.
org: V V Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) - Noida

title: Understanding Land Records and Land Administration in India
desc: This course provides an overview of the historical evolution of land records and land administration in India. It explores the development of land ownership systems and land rights from the Mughal period to post-colonial India, highlighting the changes in legal, administrative, and institutional frameworks over time. The course introduces learners to the evolution of land records, including Records of Rights (RoR), land ownership documentation, and mutation processes. It explains the importance of accurate land records in ensuring secure land ownership, effective land management, transparent administration, and protection of the rights of landowners and tenants. Through this course, learners will gain a foundational understanding of the historical context, significance, and present-day relevance of land records in India.
org: Yashwantrao Chavan Academy of Development Administration (YASHADA)

title: Understanding Life Cycle Management for IT Projects
desc: In an era where technology drives governance, mastering the life cycle of an IT project is essential for public officials. This course demystifies the entire process, presenting each stage as a crucial step towards successful project delivery. Participants will delve into the specifics of initiation, where project goals are defined; planning, where roadmaps and resources are allocated; execution, where the plan is put into action; and monitoring, which ensures the project stays on track. The course culminates with project closure, focusing on documentation, handover, and lesson-learning for future endeavors. Specifically designed for the government context, the curriculum addresses unique challenges such as ensuring transparency, maintaining public accountability, and maximizing efficiency. Through case studies and scenario-based learning, officers will gain not just theoretical knowledge but also actionable insights to manage and deliver impactful IT projects that serve the public good.

title: Understanding Marketing: Beyond Advertising
desc: Dive into the essential principles of modern marketing with this comprehensive introductory course. Designed for those new to the field, it demystifies marketing by explaining that it is a strategic process extending far beyond advertising. The curriculum provides a structured overview of the key activities marketers undertake to bring a product or service to the public. You will learn to analyze the marketing environment through the '5 Cs' framework (Customer, Company, Competitors, Collaborators, Context), which is crucial for informed decision-making. The course then delves into the strategic heart of marketing: Segmentation, Targeting, and Positioning (STP), teaching you how to identify and reach the right audience with a compelling message. Finally, you will master the tactical elements of the marketing mix, known as the '4 Ps' (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), and understand how to combine them into an effective marketing plan. This knowledge is vital for anyone looking to enhance their career, launch a new venture, or better understand the forces that shape business success.

title: Understanding Mine Closure Plans and Sustainability
desc: This course provides an overview of Mine Closure Plans in accordance with the Guidelines for Preparation of Mining Plan and Mine Closure Plan for Coal and Lignite Blocks, 2025, issued by the Ministry of Coal on 31 January 2025. The course examines the evolution of mine closure practices, the objectives and key provisions of the 2025 guidelines, and the importance of integrating mine closure planning throughout the mining lifecycle. It covers critical aspects such as financial assurance mechanisms, environmental restoration, land reclamation, sustainability initiatives, mine repurposing, Community Development and Livelihood Plans (CDLP), and Just Transition principles. Participants will gain an understanding of the regulatory framework, stakeholder responsibilities, and practical approaches required to ensure environmentally responsible, socially inclusive, and sustainable mine closure planning.
org: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute (CMPDI)

title: Understanding Mission Karmayogi
desc: Embark on a journey to understand Mission Karmayogi, a landmark reform aimed at reshaping the Indian civil service for the 21st century. This course delves into the fundamental philosophy of a 'Karmayogi' and explains the strategic imperatives that led to the creation of the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB). You will gain a detailed understanding of the mission's architecture, including the roles of the Prime Minister's HR Council, the Capacity Building Commission, and the Karmayogi Bharat SPV. The curriculum explores the three critical shifts driven by the mission: the transition from 'Karmachari' to 'Karmayogi', the focus on the Means-Motives-Opportunity (MMO) framework, and the move towards a role-based HR management system. By examining the official competency model, you will learn how behavioural, functional, and domain competencies are being integrated into lifelong learning pathways. This course will equip you with the knowledge to align your professional development with the nation's strategic goals, fostering a culture of efficiency, accountability, and service excellence to build a future-ready civil service.

title: Understanding Motivation
desc: In any organization, understanding what drives employee performance is crucial for effective leadership. This course, 'A Leader's Guide to Understanding Workplace Motivation,' delves into the psychological principles that govern why people act as they do at work. It moves beyond simplistic assumptions and provides a structured exploration of major motivational theories that have shaped modern management. The curriculum covers Maslow’s hierarchy, Herzberg's hygiene factors and motivators, McGregor's contrasting views of employee nature, and Adams' Equity Theory. Furthermore, it examines how job design itself can be a powerful motivator through the lens of Hackman and Oldham's Job Characteristics Model, and explores the importance of autonomy, competence, and relatedness as described in Self-Determination Theory. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to analyze their teams' motivational climate, identify factors that lead to both satisfaction and dissatisfaction, and apply targeted strategies to enhance job satisfaction, commitment, and overall performance in a public service setting.

title: Understanding of Cash Book
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the principles and practices of cash book management, a critical skill for anyone involved in financial administration. The program begins by defining the cash book and explaining its significance in the accounting process, highlighting why it is treated as both a journal and a ledger. You will learn the fundamental rules of debit and credit as they apply to cash and bank transactions, ensuring you can record receipts and payments with precision. The course provides a detailed walkthrough of different types of cash books, primarily focusing on the single-column and double-column formats. Through practical examples, you will understand how to handle entries for cash deposits, withdrawals, and bank-related transactions, including contra entries. Key topics include initiating the cash book with an opening balance, systematically recording all transactions in chronological order, and accurately calculating the closing balance. By the end of this course, you will be proficient in maintaining a cash book, a skill that is vital for preparing trial balances and ensuring the financial integrity of an organization.

title: Understanding of Double Entry System in Financial Accounting
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the double-entry system of accounting, the standard method for recording financial transactions. You will begin by understanding the core principle of the dual-aspect concept, which states that every business transaction has a two-sided effect. The curriculum delves into the essential rules of debit and credit, explaining how they are used to record changes in various types of accounts, including assets, liabilities, equity, income, and expenses. Through practical examples, you will learn how to analyze transactions and correctly apply debit and credit entries. The course also covers the classification of accounts under both traditional and modern approaches and illustrates how the double-entry system facilitates the preparation of accurate financial statements like the trial balance and balance sheet. By the end of this course, you will grasp why this system is crucial for error detection, financial transparency, and sound decision-making in any organization, particularly within the public sector where accountability is paramount.

title: UNDERSTANDING OF LABOUR LAW
desc: This comprehensive introductory course delves into the critical field of Indian Labour Law, a vital component for ensuring industrial harmony and economic progress. The curriculum is structured to provide a clear overview of the legal landscape governing employment in India. You will begin by exploring the historical background of labour legislation, its purpose, and its deep-rooted connection to the Constitution of India. The course systematically breaks down key definitions and concepts, such as the classification of workers, types of wages, and regulations for working hours. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of various pivotal acts, including the Factories Act, Minimum Wages Act, and Industrial Dispute Act. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to worker entitlements and social security. You will learn about the specifics of compensation for workplace injuries, the structure of the Employees' State Insurance (ESI), and the eligibility and calculation for benefits like bonus, gratuity, and maternity leave. Upon completion, you will be equipped to recognize the fundamental rights and protections afforded to the workforce, fostering a more compliant and equitable work environment.

title: Understanding of Public-Private Partnership
desc: The course “Understanding Public-Private Partnership (PPP)” provides a strong foundation in the planning and management of PPP projects. It introduces PPPs as long-term collaborations between the government and private sector, where private investment is leveraged to deliver public infrastructure or services, with returns generated over the concession period. The course highlights differences between PPPs and traditional procurement, emphasizing shared accountability, performance-based contracts, and collaborative approaches. Key topics include risk allocation and financial structuring, various PPP models such as Design-Build (DB), Operation & Maintenance (O&M), and Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (BOOT), stakeholder management using tools like the Power–Interest Matrix, and the essential legal and contractual frameworks governing PPP agreements.

title: UNDERSTANDING OF RECRUITMENT PROCEDURE
desc: This foundational course is designed to equip government officials with a thorough understanding of the end-to-end recruitment process. In the context of public administration, a compliant and transparent hiring process is paramount for building a robust civil service. This program provides a step-by-step guide to ensure every stage of recruitment is handled correctly. Key learning areas include the initial receipt and checking of candidate dossiers, sending and verifying essential forms, and differentiating between an offer of appointment and a provisional appointment letter. Learners will explore the critical verification processes, such as checking educational qualifications, character antecedents (Police Verification Report), and medical fitness. The course also covers the creation of essential records like the Service Book and Guard File, and concludes with the process of convening a Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) for the confirmation of an employee after their probation period. Upon completion, participants will be able to manage the recruitment cycle efficiently, minimizing errors and ensuring a smooth onboarding experience for new government personnel.

title: Understanding Personal and Organizational Values
desc: Values are the core beliefs that guide our actions and decisions. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the concepts of both personal and organizational values and their critical importance in the public sector. You will begin by exploring personal values—such as honesty, commitment, and respect—and how they form the foundation of individual identity and behavior. The course then transitions to organizational values, explaining how these shared principles create a unified purpose and set the standard for professional conduct. A key focus is placed on the context of government service, where organizational values are derived directly from the Constitution of India. Learners will understand why these constitutional values, including justice, liberty, and equality, must take precedence in their professional roles.
org: Department of Personnel and Training DoPT

title: Understanding Point Machines
desc: Dive into the essential technology of metro railway systems with this comprehensive course on Point Machines. In any modern railway network, the ability to safely and efficiently guide trains from one track to another is paramount. This course explains the critical role of Point Machines—the electromechanical devices that automate this process. It provides the foundational knowledge required for anyone working within railway signaling, operations, or infrastructure management. Participants will explore the core functions of Point Machines, including switching, locking, and detection, which are vital for operational safety. The course details the construction, components, and working principles, covering everything from the motor and gear assembly to the clutch and detection systems. You will learn to differentiate between various types, such as trailable and non-trailable machines, and understand their normal and reverse operational positions. Furthermore, the course addresses procedures for manual operation during system failures or maintenance, ensuring a holistic understanding. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to interpret the function of Point Machines within the larger Signaling and Train Control (S&TC) framework, making them valuable contributors to the safety and efficiency of metro rail operations.

title: Understanding Privacy-Enhancing Technologies for Secure Data Use
desc: This course offers a practitioner-oriented introduction to Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs)—a diverse set of cryptographic, anonymisation, and secure computation techniques that enable lawful data use without compromising individual privacy. It explains the importance of PETs for governments and organisations in minimising trust requirements, enabling secure data collaboration, supporting ethical and legal compliance, and facilitating public-interest data sharing. The course covers seven core PET categories: de-identification (pseudonymisation, suppression, generalisation, redaction), differential privacy, encryption (in transit using TLS and at rest using AES), hashing, tokenisation, k-anonymity, and synthetic data. Each concept is illustrated with real-world examples, including FERPA, the 2020 US Census, and SNAP/Medicare datasets.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding Procurement of Goods and Services
desc: In the context of public administration, efficient and transparent procurement is a cornerstone of good governance. This course, 'Procurement of Goods and Services through Government e-Marketplace (GeM)', is designed to provide a thorough understanding of modern public procurement practices. It addresses the critical need for officials to master the GeM platform, a key initiative for transforming government purchasing. The curriculum delves into the intricacies of the GeM portal, covering everything from registration and vendor selection to placing orders and managing contracts. Key learning areas include understanding different procurement methods for goods and services, adhering to General Financial Rules (GFR), ensuring compliance with public procurement policies, and utilizing GeM's tools for competitive bidding and direct purchasing. Participants will learn how to navigate the platform to streamline procurement workflows, reduce timelines, and enhance transparency.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding Public Administration and Governance
desc: This foundational course provides an overview of the principles, structures, processes, and practices of public administration and their role in effective governance, national development, and citizen welfare. It is designed to help public functionaries develop a comprehensive understanding of how government institutions operate and deliver public services. The course introduces the evolution and theoretical foundations of public administration, along with the structure and functioning of government at the Central, State, and local levels. Participants will explore key aspects of administrative law, government procedures, and the public policy lifecycle, from policy formulation and implementation to monitoring and evaluation. The course also covers the fundamentals of public financial management, human resource administration, accountability, transparency, ethical conduct, and administrative reforms.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding Railway Law  in the Indian Legal System
desc: This course provides a structured understanding of law within the Indian legal system with a special focus on railway administration. It introduces the foundations of law, its objectives, classifications, and role in society, followed by an overview of the Constitution of India and its relevance to governance and public service. Learners will gain practical insights into the Railway Act, 1989 and the functioning of the Railway Claims Tribunal for compensation and dispute redressal. The course also covers two important social legislations—the Right to Information Act, 2005 and the POSH Act, 2013—highlighting transparency, accountability, workplace safety, and gender justice. The programme equips public servants with essential legal awareness for effective and ethical decision-making.
org: Indian Railway Institute Of Transport Management (IRITM)

title: Understanding Refractive Surgery
desc: With the increasing prevalence of refractive errors globally and in India, modern surgical interventions offer precise and reliable solutions for vision correction. This course is designed to demystify the field of refractive surgery, providing a structured and detailed exploration of the available options. It addresses the fundamental causes and symptoms of refractive errors like myopia, hyperopia, and astigmatism, setting the stage for understanding advanced corrective procedures. The curriculum is divided into two main categories: corneal-based surgeries such as LASIK, PRK, and SMILE, and lens-based procedures including ICL and Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE). For each technique, the course explains the underlying mechanism, ideal patient profile, and expected outcomes. Learners will explore the critical aspects of the patient journey, from initial eligibility screening and preoperative tests to understanding the potential risks and benefits. Furthermore, the content addresses common myths and facts, equipping individuals, frontline health workers, and public health personnel with the necessary knowledge to engage in informed discussions and make confident decisions regarding vision correction surgery. This comprehensive guide serves as an essential resource for anyone considering or advising on these life-changing procedures.

title: Understanding Reservation Policy and Implementation
desc: This course delves into the critical aspects of implementing the reservation policy in government services. It begins by establishing the constitutional and legal context for reservation, outlining its importance for social equity and inclusive governance. The curriculum covers the application of reservation rules in direct recruitment and promotions, the methodology for maintaining reservation rosters, and the procedures for de-reservation. Participants will learn to navigate the complexities of calculating vacancies, managing backlogs, and ensuring compliance with the latest government orders and court judgments. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to apply these rules accurately in their administrative roles, contributing to fair and lawful human resource management within the public sector.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: UNDERSTANDING REVENUE RECOGNITION PRINCIPLE
desc: The revenue recognition principle is a critical component of accrual accounting, ensuring that a company's financial statements provide a transparent and accurate representation of its performance. This course is designed to provide a thorough understanding of this fundamental concept, which is essential for anyone involved in financial reporting and analysis. In an era of increasing scrutiny and complex business models, correctly applying revenue recognition standards is paramount for maintaining stakeholder confidence and regulatory compliance. This program delves into the core tenets of revenue recognition, explaining the specific criteria that must be met before revenue can be recorded. Participants will learn how to navigate various scenarios, from simple sales transactions to more complex long-term contracts. The course covers the basic guidelines for recording revenue in the Books of Accounts, ensuring that financial data is both reliable and consistent over time. Upon completion, learners will be able to correctly identify the point at which revenue should be recognized, apply the principle to different business situations, and understand its impact on key financial metrics. This knowledge is vital for finance professionals, auditors, and managers who rely on accurate financial data to make informed strategic decisions and ensure the integrity of their organization's financial reporting.

title: Understanding Right to Information Act
desc: The Right to Information (RTI) Act is a cornerstone of transparent and accountable governance, providing a powerful tool for citizens to access information from public authorities. This course, 'Understanding the Right to Information (RTI) Act', is designed to demystify this crucial legislation for public officials and citizens alike. It establishes the context for why the RTI Act was enacted and its profound impact on promoting openness in government functioning. The curriculum delves into the essential components of the Act, including the definitions of 'information' and 'public authority', the obligations of public authorities, and the specific procedures for requesting information. Participants will learn about the timelines for receiving responses, the fee structure, and the categories of information that are exempt from disclosure to protect national interests and individual privacy. Furthermore, the course explains the roles and responsibilities of Public Information Officers (PIOs) and the appellate process for addressing grievances or denials of information. Upon completion, learners will not only grasp the theoretical framework of the RTI Act but also gain the practical knowledge needed to navigate its procedures, whether as an applicant seeking information or as an official responsible for providing it, thereby strengthening the democratic fabric of the nation.

title: Understanding Rights and Duties of Data Principal under DPDP Act 2023
desc: This course provides a structured and practical analysis of the rights and duties of Data Principals under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025. It explains who qualifies as a Data Principal under Section 2(j), including situations where parents or lawful guardians act on behalf of children and persons with disabilities. The course systematically examines the four statutory rights provided under Chapter III of the Act: the Right to Access information about personal data, the Right to Correction and Erasure, the Right to Grievance Redressal, and the Right to Nominate. It also explains the duties and responsibilities of Data Principals under Section 15, including the consequences of misuse of rights or submission of false information.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding Seniority Fixation for Government Gazetted Officers
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of the legal and procedural frameworks governing seniority fixation for Gazetted Officers in government services, with a special emphasis on the Indian Railways. The curriculum is designed to provide clarity on the complex principles of inter-se seniority that arise from different modes of appointment, including direct recruitment, departmental promotions, and selections through competitive examinations. Participants will delve into the critical provisions of the Indian Railway Establishment Manual (IREM), such as Rules 327, 329-330, and 334-341, which cover the determination of seniority, probation, and confirmation. The course also addresses the importance of adhering to DoPT guidelines and relevant case law to ensure procedural fairness. By completing this training, officials involved in personnel management and administration will be equipped to apply these rules accurately, maintain service records correctly, and make informed decisions that uphold regulatory compliance and prevent litigation.

title: Understanding Seniority Fixation for Non-Government Gazetted Officers
desc: This course offers a detailed examination of seniority fixation for Group C non-gazetted employees within the Indian Railways. It is specifically tailored to equip HR and administrative personnel with the necessary knowledge to manage personnel matters effectively. The curriculum delves into the core principles of the Indian Railway Establishment Rules, covering scenarios from initial recruitment to promotions, transfers, and other special cases. Key learning areas include seniority determination for direct recruits, the effects of training curtailment, rules for mutual and own-request transfers, and procedures for medically unfit or re-employed staff. By completing this course, learners will be proficient in applying these complex rules, enabling them to make informed and compliant decisions that uphold fairness and procedural integrity in railway HR management.

title: Understanding Stakeholders in Governance
desc: In today's complex administrative landscape, successful governance requires active collaboration with a wide array of stakeholders who have a vested interest in public policies and services. Understanding who these stakeholders are, what their interests are, and how to engage them effectively is a core competency for any public functionary. This course is designed to build this essential capability. Participants will delve into the concepts of stakeholder theory as applied to the public sector. The curriculum will cover methods for stakeholder identification and mapping, analyzing their influence and interest, and developing tailored engagement strategies. It will also touch upon the challenges of managing conflicting interests and the importance of transparency in stakeholder relations.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding Telecom Cyber Security Rules 2024
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Telecommunications (Telecom Cyber Security) Rules, 2024 and their role in strengthening India’s digital and telecom infrastructure. Introduced under the Telecommunications Act 2023, these rules establish a robust framework for securing telecom networks, protecting user data, and ensuring effective responses to cyber security threats within the telecommunications ecosystem. The course explores the key provisions, obligations, and compliance requirements outlined in the Telecommunications (Telecom Cyber Security) Rules, 2024. It covers topics such as telecom cyber security governance, incident reporting mechanisms, data collection and sharing processes, digital implementation practices, and security measures for telecommunication identifiers and equipment.

title: Understanding the Administrative Boundary Database
desc: In the context of modern governance, accurate and well-managed administrative boundaries are fundamental to effective planning, resource allocation, and citizen service delivery. This course is designed to provide public officials with a comprehensive overview of the Administrative Boundary Database (ABDB) and its ecosystem. It addresses the critical need for standardized, reliable boundary data to support everything from policy implementation to disaster management. The curriculum delves into the key concepts, starting with the significance of administrative boundaries and differentiating between various boundary types. You will learn the specific terminology and frameworks used in boundary surveys and data management for the ABDB. Furthermore, the course highlights the practical challenges faced in the field, such as data inconsistencies and inter-agency coordination, and presents established best practices to overcome them. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute effectively to the creation, maintenance, and validation of administrative boundaries. They will understand the distinct roles of key stakeholders, from surveyors to administrators, and be able to apply best practices to ensure the accuracy and integrity of this vital national data infrastructure.

title: Understanding the All-India Services (Conduct) Rules 1968
desc: This foundational course delves into the All-India Services (Conduct) Rules, 1968, a critical framework governing the professional and ethical behaviour of officers in India's premier civil services. The content is specifically tailored for members of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS). The course systematically explains each rule, providing clarity on expected conduct in various official and personal situations. Key learning areas include the general provisions of conduct, integrity, impartiality, and devotion to duty. It also covers specific rules related to gifts, private trade or employment, investment, and communication with the media. By completing this course, learners will be equipped to navigate complex ethical scenarios, ensure compliance with statutory requirements, and uphold the dignity and integrity of the All-India Services.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding the Basics of Quantum Computation
desc: Delve into the transformative world of quantum computation, a field poised to redefine the boundaries of information processing. This course begins by contrasting classical computing with the quantum paradigm, explaining the limitations of Moore's Law and the need for a new approach. You will learn the fundamental concepts of quantum mechanics, including superposition and entanglement, and understand how these principles are harnessed in quantum bits (qubits). The course structure covers the theoretical and experimental aspects of creating and manipulating qubits through quantum gates. A significant portion is dedicated to analyzing Shor's algorithm, demonstrating how quantum computers pose a threat to current cryptographic standards like RSA by efficiently factoring large numbers. The discussion also touches upon the challenges of decoherence, the necessity of quantum error correction, and the ongoing research to build stable quantum computers.

title: Understanding the Code on Social Security 2020
desc: The Code on Social Security, 2020, consolidates and amends the laws relating to social security with the objective to extend benefits to all employees and workers in both the organised and unorganised sectors. This introductory course is designed to familiarise public officials with its critical aspects. The curriculum delves into the applicability of the Code, explaining which establishments and worker types are covered. It outlines the structure and responsibilities of the National and State Social Security Boards. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to detailing the provisions for various benefits, including provident fund, insurance, maternity benefits, and compensation for injury. Furthermore, the course clarifies the legal framework surrounding employer obligations, offenses, and the corresponding penalties for non-compliance.
org: V V Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) - Noida

title: Understanding the Code on Wages
desc: This introductory course is designed to familiarize learners with the essential aspects of the Code on Wages. The Code represents a major step in reforming India's labour laws by amalgamating, simplifying, and rationalizing complex provisions of previous wage-related legislation. The curriculum delves into the historical context that necessitated this change and clarifies important terminology used within the new legal framework. Participants will learn about the key features of the Wage Bill, including its applicability and the calculation of wages. The course also details the classification of the four new labour codes to provide a broader context. Furthermore, it outlines the specific offences and penalties for non-compliance and lists the four central labour enactments that have been subsumed by this single, comprehensive code. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to understand the core principles and structure of the new wage legislation.
org: V V Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) - Noida

title: Understanding the Complexity of Inventions and Claim Granting
desc: This course provides a detailed framework for understanding the complexities of patent law and examination. It is designed for professionals seeking to develop practical skills in analyzing patent applications from start to finish. The curriculum is structured to build expertise progressively, beginning with how to dissect an invention disclosure to understand its core purpose and the technical problem it addresses. You will delve into the nuances of patent claims, learning to interpret different formats and drafting styles to determine the precise scope of protection sought. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the substantive examination process. This includes mastering the techniques to evaluate claims for clarity, conciseness, and support within the specification. Furthermore, you will learn the critical skills of assessing an invention's novelty and non-obviousness by comparing it against existing prior art. The course also introduces various patent classification systems to aid in efficient search and analysis. Upon completion, you will be equipped with the critical thinking and practical knowledge required to conduct thorough patent evaluations, making this essential training for aspiring patent examiners, IP managers, and innovators.
subDomain: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
org: Office of Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM)
keywords: Complexity of Inventions and Granting the Claims

title: Understanding the Concept of Decolonization in Governance
desc: This course invites government officers to explore what decolonization truly means for the systems they work within every day. It traces how colonial-era assumptions continue to shape mindsets, institutions, and everyday practices in Indian administration, from language and procedures to institutional culture. Learners will examine the difference between political and epistemic decolonization, understand key misconceptions about modernity and civilisation, and encounter Indian thinkers who shaped this discourse. The course also explores how colonisation touched the psyche, body, knowledge, and lifestyle of individuals, and introduces practical avenues, rooted in Indian knowledge traditions, for governance that is ethical, inclusive, and culturally grounded. By the end, officers will be equipped to recognise colonial legacies in their work and contribute to a more self-aware, rooted, participatory model of public service.

title: Understanding the Depths of Indian Intellectual Traditions
desc: ‘Understanding the Depths of Indian Intellectual Traditions’ is a foundational course designed for public leaders, policymakers, and professionals seeking to engage with India’s profound civilizational wisdom. The curriculum begins by analyzing the lasting effects of colonialism on India's worldview and governance structures, presenting decolonization as a vital process for reclaiming indigenous identity. The course systematically introduces the Indian Knowledge System (IKS) as a living tradition, covering its literary sources like the Vedas and Puranas, as well as non-literary oral and community traditions. It addresses contemporary issues such as biopiracy and the protective role of the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library. Furthermore, learners will explore the practical application of IKS principles in modern governance, drawing on concepts like Dharma, Niti, and Artha, and leadership models from the Bhagavad Gita and Arthashastra. By connecting historical wisdom to present-day challenges, this course empowers participants to appreciate and apply India's unique intellectual heritage in their professional roles.

title: Understanding the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and Rules
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025, equipping learners with the knowledge required to navigate the evolving data protection landscape. It traces India's journey toward a modern data protection framework and explains the phased implementation of the DPDP regime. The course examines the scope, applicability, and exemptions under the Act, including its territorial and extra-territorial reach. Learners will gain clarity on key concepts such as Personal Data, Data Principal, Data Fiduciary, Consent Manager, and Significant Data Fiduciary, along with the lawful grounds for processing personal data, including consent and legitimate uses under Section 7. The course further explores the obligations of Data Fiduciaries, including notice requirements, data accuracy, security safeguards, breach notification, and data retention obligations.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Understanding the E-Mobility Ecosystem
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the rapidly evolving E-Mobility Ecosystem and its role in shaping the future of transportation. It explores the global and Indian electric vehicle (EV) landscape, emerging market trends, EV value chains, battery technologies, charging infrastructure, software-defined mobility, fleet electrification, government policies, and future opportunities in sustainable transportation. The course enables learners to understand the technological, economic, environmental, and policy dimensions of electric mobility, while examining the challenges associated with large-scale EV adoption. Through insights into key stakeholders, innovations, and industry developments, learners will gain the knowledge required to contribute to the growth of sustainable and efficient transportation solutions.
org: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology - NIELIT (formerly DOEACC Society)

title: Understanding the Forest Rights Act 2006
desc: Designed for civil servants and officials involved in tribal welfare and forest administration, this course provides a comprehensive overview of the Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006. It covers the historical context of the Act, the rights of forest-dwelling tribal communities, and the provisions relating to individual and community forest rights. Learners will understand the claim process, required documentation, and the roles of the Gram Sabha, Sub-Divisional Level Committee (SDLC), and District Level Committee (DLC). The course also highlights post-recognition support to promote sustainable livelihoods, forest management, and the Act's objectives of social justice and empowerment.

title: UNDERSTANDING THE FORMAT OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
desc: This course, "Understanding the Format of Financial Statements," offers an in-depth exploration of the standardized formats for corporate financial reporting in India. In a business environment governed by strict regulatory compliance, a clear understanding of financial statements is paramount for transparency and accurate assessment of a company's performance. This program is designed to equip learners with the necessary skills to navigate and comprehend these documents with precision. The curriculum focuses on the vertical formats of the Balance Sheet and the Statement of Profit and Loss as mandated by Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013. Learners will be guided through each section, including the classification of assets and liabilities into current and non-current categories, the components of shareholders' funds, and the structure of revenue and expense reporting. The course demystifies complex terms like deferred tax liabilities, share application money pending allotment, and capital work-in-progress. Upon completion, participants will be able to identify and understand the significance of each line item in a company's financial statements. This knowledge is crucial for roles involving financial analysis, auditing, compliance, and corporate governance, enabling professionals to make informed decisions based on a true and fair view of a company's financial position.

title: Understanding the Government Email System of NIC
desc: This course is designed to equip government employees with the essential skills to effectively and securely use the NIC email system. It begins with foundational knowledge, guiding users through the initial account setup, profile information updates, and an overview of the platform's interface. A significant focus is placed on enhancing account security. You will learn the importance of Mobile Device Management (MDM) and receive detailed, step-by-step tutorials on how to install and configure it on both iOS and Android devices. The course also provides in-depth training on setting up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) with the OneAuth application, a critical layer of protection for your official account. Furthermore, you will explore advanced security options such as generating backup codes for account recovery and enabling geofencing to restrict access based on location. The training also covers practical day-to-day tasks, including managing multiple accounts, accessing quarantined emails, and troubleshooting common issues. By completing this course, you will gain the confidence and skills to manage your government email account securely and efficiently, ensuring the integrity of your official communications.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms

title: Understanding the Indian Union Budget
desc: This course demystifies the Indian Union Budget, providing a foundational understanding of its critical role in national governance and economic planning. It begins by outlining the context of the budget, explaining why a thorough understanding of its structure and priorities is essential for public officials. Key learning areas include a detailed breakdown of the budget's components, the step-by-step formulation process, and the analysis of government revenue and expenditure patterns. The curriculum emphasizes the real-world application of this knowledge by examining sector-specific allocations and their direct impact on developmental outcomes in areas such as agriculture, MSMEs, and infrastructure. Upon completion, learners will be able to critically evaluate budgetary provisions, understand their effects on the economy and society, and contribute more effectively to policy discussions. This course empowers participants to translate complex fiscal data into actionable insights for public service.

title: Understanding the Life Cycle Management of IT Projects
desc: This course provides a foundational understanding of government accounting and public financial management in India, with a focus on the principles, structure, and classification of government transactions. It introduces the key principles of government accounting, emphasizing financial accountability, transparency, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. The course explains the structure of Government Accounts and the distinction between Revenue and Capital Expenditure. It also focuses on the classification of government expenditure using the List of Object Heads under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 2024. Learners will develop the knowledge and skills required to correctly classify and account for government transactions, interpret relevant financial rules, and support efficient, transparent, and compliant management of public funds.

title: Understanding the Mechanics of Corporate Governance
desc: This comprehensive course delves into the essential frameworks and practices that define modern corporate governance. It addresses the critical need for robust governance in ensuring organizational integrity, stakeholder trust, and sustainable performance. Learners will explore a variety of corporate governance models from different disciplinary perspectives, providing a broad and nuanced understanding of the subject. The curriculum focuses on key practical areas, including the analysis of corporate governance ratings and their influence on stakeholders, and the examination of related party transactions to identify and mitigate potential conflicts of interest. Participants will also gain a clear understanding of the relationship between governance practices and the protection of shareholder rights. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the analytical skills to critically assess governance mechanisms, recommend best practices, and contribute to fostering a culture of accountability, transparency, and ethical conduct in corporate settings.

title: Understanding the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act 1985
desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985, its objectives, legal framework, and implementation mechanisms in India. It examines the Act’s dual mandate of preventing illicit trafficking, misuse, and diversion of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances while ensuring their availability for legitimate medical and scientific purposes. Learners will gain an understanding of key definitions, regulatory provisions, compliance requirements, enforcement mechanisms, and the roles of various authorities involved in drug control. The course also explores the legal and public health dimensions of controlled substance use, including opioid substitution therapy (OST), palliative care, pain management, and access to essential medicines.
keywords: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act

title: Understanding the National Education Policy 2020
desc: Dive into the transformative framework of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 with this insightful course tailored for educators, school administrators, and public sector officials. The course demystifies the ambitious vision of NEP 2020, translating its high-level goals into practical, on-the-ground strategies for school education. It addresses the critical need for a paradigm shift in Indian education, focusing on moving away from rote learning towards holistic, inquiry-based, and experiential methods. Key learning areas include the policy's structural changes to the 10+2 system, the emphasis on foundational literacy and numeracy, curriculum and pedagogical reforms, and new approaches to assessment. Learners will explore how to foster an inclusive and equitable classroom environment that supports the diverse needs of all students. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped with the understanding and tools necessary to effectively contribute to the implementation of NEP 2020, driving meaningful change within their schools and communities.

title: Understanding the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
desc: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO Act, 2012), a landmark legislation enacted to protect children from sexual abuse, exploitation, and harassment. The course examines the legal framework, objectives, definitions, and various offences covered under the Act, along with the procedural safeguards and child-friendly mechanisms established to ensure the protection and well-being of children during investigation and trial. Participants will gain knowledge of reporting procedures, investigation processes, evidentiary requirements, presumptions under law, and the functioning of Special Courts under the POCSO framework. The course also highlights the roles and responsibilities of key stakeholders, including police authorities, judiciary, educators, medical professionals, child welfare institutions, and support persons involved in child protection.
org: Bihar Institute of Public Administration and Rural Development (BIPARD) ,Bihar
keywords: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act

title: Understanding the Right to Information Act and Good Governance
desc: In a democratic society, transparency and accountability are cornerstones of effective public administration. This course delves into the transformative impact of the RTI Act, 2005. It is designed for public officials who need to understand their obligations under the Act and for citizens who wish to leverage it for greater governmental transparency. The course begins by outlining the fundamental principles of good governance and how the RTI Act directly supports these ideals. Key learning areas include the procedural aspects of filing and responding to RTI requests, the roles and responsibilities of Public Information Officers (PIOs), and the legal framework governing information disclosure. Learners will analyze case studies demonstrating how RTI has been instrumental in exposing corruption and improving service delivery.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Understanding the Service Book
desc: This course provides comprehensive guidance on the maintenance of a Government Servant’s Service Book, a vital official record documenting an employee’s entire service career. It explains the prescribed rules, procedures, and best practices for opening, maintaining, updating, and verifying the Service Book at various stages of service. The course also covers the types of entries that must be recorded to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with government regulations.

title: Understanding the Telecommunications Act 2023
desc: The Telecommunications Act, 2023, represents a landmark legislative reform for India, replacing archaic laws like the Indian Telegraph Act of 1885. In an era of rapid technological advancement, this new Act provides a modern, streamlined, and future-ready framework to govern the telecommunications sector. This course is designed for officials and professionals who need to understand the practical implications of this new legislation on telecom operations, policy, and governance. Participants will delve into the core components of the Act, including the updated procedures for authorization, spectrum assignment, and securing Right of Way. The curriculum examines the structure and purpose of new initiatives like the Digital Bharat Nidhi, which aims to enhance universal service obligations, and the Regulatory Sandbox, designed to foster innovation.

title: Understanding the Telecommunications Licensing regime
desc: This course offers a comprehensive overview of the legal and regulatory framework governing telecommunications licensing in India, a critical area for officials in the Ministry of Communications and related departments. The program begins by establishing the context for licensing, rooted in the Indian Telegraph Act, 1885, and explains why licensing is essential for regulating market structure, allocating scarce resources like spectrum, and protecting consumer interests. Participants will gain a detailed understanding of the National Telecom Policy 2012 and its vision of 'One Nation, One License,' which led to the creation of the Unified License regime. The course breaks down the structure of the Unified License, explaining how it consolidates various service authorizations and de-links spectrum allocation from the license itself. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the practical guidelines for the grant of a Unified License. This includes eligibility criteria for applicants, the structure of entry fees and annual license fees based on Adjusted Gross Revenue (AGR), foreign direct investment (FDI) norms, and mandatory security conditions. Upon completion, learners will be able to interpret and apply the core principles of telecom licensing, making them better equipped to handle regulatory compliance, policy implementation, and other operational duties within the Department of Telecommunications.

title: Understanding the Trade Facilitation Agreement
desc: This course provides a concise overview of the World Trade Organization’s Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA), focusing on simplifying trade procedures, improving transparency, and reducing trade costs. It covers key provisions such as efficient customs processes, advance rulings, risk management systems, and faster clearance mechanisms. The course also introduces digital trade facilitation tools like the Single Window system and e-SANCHIT, which enable paperless and streamlined documentation. In addition, the course explains transit procedures, coordination among border agencies, and customs cooperation to ensure the smooth movement of goods across borders. It also highlights special and differential treatment provisions that support developing and least-developed countries through flexibility, extended timelines, and technical assistance.
org: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs(CBIC)

title: Understanding Transformational Leadership
desc: In today's dynamic public sector, effective leadership is more critical than ever. This course, 'Foundations of Transformational Leadership,' is designed to equip public officials with a fundamental understanding of what it takes to lead effectively. The curriculum begins by differentiating between traditional, top-down leadership and modern, collaborative approaches, providing a broad context for the evolution of leadership thought. You will explore the foundational trait theory of leadership to understand the inherent qualities often associated with great leaders. The core of the course is a deep dive into transformational leadership. You will learn about its essential pillars: intellectual stimulation, which encourages innovation and creativity, and inspirational motivation, which fosters a shared vision and commitment. The course also examines the principles of power and influence, and how they are leveraged ethically and effectively by transformational leaders. Through the analysis of real-world examples, you will see these theories in action, preparing you to apply these powerful concepts to your own professional journey and drive meaningful outcomes in public service.
org: Mahatma Gandhi State Institute of Public Administration Punjab

title: Understanding Transit-Oriented Development
desc: This course introduces Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) as a sustainable urban planning approach for managing growth in rapidly expanding cities. Anchored in the National Transit-Oriented Development Policy, 2017 issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), the course addresses key urban challenges such as traffic congestion, increasing motorization, and urban sprawl. It explains how TOD promotes the development of compact, walkable, and mixed-use communities that are well-integrated with high-quality public transport systems. The course also covers the principles of integrated land-use and transport planning, along with supportive policy instruments such as enhanced Floor Area Ratio (FAR) and value capture financing mechanisms. Designed for urban planners, transport professionals, and municipal administrators, the course provides practical insights into planning and implementing TOD projects.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Understanding Urban Transport Planning and Capacity Building
desc: This course introduces the fundamental principles of urban transport planning, with a focus on developing sustainable, efficient, and inclusive mobility systems in urban areas. It covers key concepts such as integrated transport planning, public transport systems, non-motorized transport (NMT), and relevant policy and planning frameworks. The course also highlights the importance of integrating land use and transport planning to ensure balanced urban development and improved mobility outcomes. In addition, it emphasizes capacity building for urban officials and planners to design, manage, and improve transport systems effectively, with a focus on sustainability, accessibility, and efficiency.
org: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Understanding Urbanisation in India
desc: This course delves into the multifaceted dynamics of urbanisation in India, providing learners with a foundational understanding of its impact on the nation's developmental trajectory. The curriculum begins by establishing the context of urbanisation as a key driver of economic transformation, explaining how cities foster productivity and innovation. It then demystifies how urban areas are defined and classified in India, comparing national criteria with global practices to offer a broader perspective. Key learning areas include a detailed analysis of the forces shaping India's urban landscape, such as migration, settlement reclassification, the growth of megacities, and peri-urban expansion. Learners will explore the significant challenges and opportunities these trends present for urban local bodies. Upon completion, participants will be equipped to analyze the complex interplay between urban growth, governance, and resource management, enabling them to better contextualize policy, planning, and audit findings within India's evolving urban ecosystem.
org: Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India

title: Understanding Vande Bharat Trainsets and Onboard Technologies
desc: The Vande Bharat Trainsets course provides a comprehensive understanding of India’s modern semi-high-speed train systems. It covers the key components, onboard systems, and operational technologies that power the Vande Bharat Express. Learners will gain practical insights into braking systems, communication interfaces, driver desk operations, and coach-level electronics. The course also explains scheduled maintenance levels and design upgrades in variants such as Vande Metro and Vande Bharat Sleeper, in line with Indian Railways standards.
org: Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IRIMEE)

title: Understanding Vigilance Clearance in Government Service
desc: Vigilance clearance is a fundamental administrative process that safeguards the integrity and accountability of government services. A thorough understanding of its principles is essential for every public servant, as it directly impacts career progression, including promotions, empanelment, and post-retirement assignments. This course offers an in-depth exploration of the vigilance clearance framework in India. Learners will delve into the core criteria and protocols governing the issuance of vigilance clearance, with a specific focus on the distinct procedures for All India Services (AIS) officers and Central Civil Services. The curriculum covers the importance of due process, transparency, and equitable considerations in decision-making. Participants will gain a clear understanding of the procedural steps, from initiation to final approval, and the ethical considerations that underpin the entire system.
org: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management

title: Understanding Wi-Fi Technologies and Standards
desc: This course offers an in-depth exploration of modern Wi-Fi technologies, designed to equip learners with a robust understanding of the current and future landscape of wireless networking. The curriculum begins by tracing the evolution of Wi-Fi standards, leading into a detailed analysis of Wi-Fi 6/6E, Wi-Fi 7, and the ultra-high-speed capabilities of WiGig. Participants will gain critical insights into the core technical principles that power these advancements, including OFDMA, MU-MIMO, beamforming, and advanced modulation techniques. The course clearly differentiates between the various standards, highlighting their unique benefits and ideal use cases. By the end of this program, learners will be able to assess the practical applications of next-generation Wi-Fi in enhancing connectivity for smart devices, improving network security, and enabling high-bandwidth applications in both public and private sector environments. This knowledge is crucial for anyone involved in planning, deploying, or managing modern IT and telecommunications infrastructure.

title: UNIFIED DARPAN ANDROID APPLICATION DAKSHATA
desc: This training program offers a detailed, step-by-step guide to mastering the Unified DARPAN Android Application, a critical tool for modernizing Branch Post Office operations. The course begins with an overview of the application, highlighting the key differences from the legacy RICT device and explaining the end-to-end process flow. Learners will delve into the practical aspects of the 'Utilities' module, covering essential daily tasks like 'Day Begin', 'Day End', and generating BODA reports. The 'Mail Operations' section provides in-depth instructions on booking various articles, managing delivery, and handling bagging procedures. Furthermore, the course covers financial services, detailing how to perform transactions through the Core Banking Solution (CBS) and manage policies via the Postal Life Insurance (PLI) interface. It also includes a vital troubleshooting guide to help users resolve common issues independently. Upon completion, users will be fully equipped to operate the DARPAN application efficiently, enhancing service delivery and operational accuracy at their respective branches.

title: UNIFIED DARPAN ANDROID APPLICATION PRARAMBH
desc: This training program is designed to equip Department of Posts personnel, particularly Branch Postmasters, with the knowledge and skills to effectively operate the new Unified DARPAN Android Application. The course addresses the critical need for digital transformation within postal services, replacing the legacy RICT device with a modern, versatile Android-based solution. Key learning areas covered include a detailed overview of the application's interface and login procedures, end-to-end mail operations such as booking articles and managing delivery, and the execution of financial services. This includes handling Core Banking Solution (CBS) transactions like deposits and withdrawals, and managing Postal Life Insurance (PLI) services such as premium collection. The curriculum also details essential administrative functions like performing 'Day Begin' and 'Day End' procedures and generating the automated Branch Office Daily Account (BODA). Upon completion, learners will be able to confidently navigate and utilize the DARPAN application, ensuring efficient, accurate, and modernized service delivery at Branch Post Offices.

title: Unified Payments Interface as a DPI Democratizing Payments
desc: This course delves into the transformative journey of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), a cornerstone of India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI). Participants will explore the context of UPI's creation, tracing the evolution from traditional POS systems and digital wallets to a scalable, real-time payment ecosystem. The session breaks down the core principles of UPI, including its open architecture, interoperability between banks, and API-driven model that has fostered a vibrant ecosystem of third-party applications like Google Pay and PhonePe. Key learning areas include an analysis of government-led initiatives such as the DigiDhan Mission, the development of the BHIM app, and the strategic push for merchant onboarding and consumer behavior change. The course also covers significant innovations like UPI 123Pay, UPI Lite, and the integration of RuPay credit cards, explaining how they address specific challenges like connectivity and financial access. By the end of this session, learners will be able to appreciate UPI's large-scale impact on financial inclusion, its role in India's international diplomacy, and the future trajectory of digital payments.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Unified Pension Scheme - Enrolment of Subscribers
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the essential knowledge to manage subscriber enrolment in the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS). The introduction of UPS as an option under the National Pension System (NPS) necessitates a clear understanding of its framework and application processes. This program breaks down the scheme's conceptual basis, eligibility requirements, and the specific benefits it offers to Central Government employees. Key learning areas include a detailed walkthrough of the online enrolment process via the CRA portal, covering e-signing, OTP verification, and document submission. It also explains the physical submission process and the various forms required for different employee categories, such as new recruits, existing staff, and superannuated personnel. By completing this course, learners will be proficient in guiding employees through the migration from NPS to UPS, ensuring accurate and timely compliance with all procedural requirements set by the PFRDA.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Unified Pension Scheme: Implementation and Operations
desc: This course is designed to equip government officials with the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively implement the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS). It begins by establishing the context of the UPS as a new option within the National Pension System (NPS), detailing its legal framework and key features such as assured payouts and lump-sum benefits. The curriculum delves into the critical operational aspects, including eligibility criteria for current and future employees, contribution structures for both individual and pooled corpuses, and various investment patterns available to subscribers. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to the specific roles of Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) and Pay and Accounts Officers (PAOs), outlining the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for migration, verification, and authorization within the CRA system.
org: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management- Faridabad

title: Uniform Specification of Food Grains
desc: This course delves into the essential framework of uniform specifications that govern the procurement of food grains for India's central pool. It begins by establishing the context of why standardized specifications are vital for a vast and diverse agricultural landscape, ensuring fair pricing for farmers and quality for consumers under the Public Distribution System (PDS). The curriculum details the committee-based process for formulating these standards annually for Kharif and Rabi seasons, highlighting the roles of the Department of Food and Public Distribution, FCI, and FSSAI. Learners will gain in-depth knowledge of the specific quality parameters, including refraction limits, moisture content, and foreign matter for wheat, paddy, and various types of rice (raw, boiled, Grade A). The course also covers the official BIS testing and sampling methodologies. Upon completion, participants will be able to interpret and apply these crucial specifications, contributing to the efficiency, transparency, and integrity of the national food supply chain.

title: United Nations Framework Classification
desc: This detailed course delves into the principles and application of the United Nations Framework Classification (UNFC) for mineral resources. It is designed to equip professionals with the knowledge to systematically classify mineral deposits according to international standards. The curriculum begins by defining fundamental concepts such as minerals, ores, and resources, before moving to the core of the UNFC system. Participants will learn about the three critical axes of classification: the E-axis (Economic and commercial viability), the F-axis (Feasibility of the project), and the G-axis (Geological assessment). The course thoroughly explains the different levels within each axis, including the four stages of geological exploration (G1 to G4). By understanding how to interpret and apply UNFC codes, learners will be able to assess the potential of mineral deposits, support investment decisions, and ensure regulatory compliance within the mining industry. This knowledge is crucial for geologists, mining engineers, and regulatory officials involved in mineral exploration and management.

title: Universal Human Values Ethics and Indian Knowledge System
desc: This course provides a holistic understanding of ethical principles, value systems, and their application in public service and modern governance. It explores foundational concepts of ethics, classification and evolution of values, and the relevance of Indian Knowledge System (IKS) in shaping ethical decision-making. The course integrates concepts such as Dharma, Purusharthas, Ashramas, and collective coexistence with contemporary governance practices. Through practical examples, case-based insights, and traditional wisdom from texts like Arthashastra, Panchatantra, and Upanishads, learners develop the ability to apply ethical reasoning in professional contexts, build value-based organisational cultures, and demonstrate responsible, citizen-centric leadership.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Unlawful Taking and Exploitation of Children
desc: This course provides an overview of the provisions relating to kidnapping and abduction under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. It explains definitions, types, and punishments under Sections 137 to 140, including kidnapping from India, from lawful guardianship, and abduction. Learners explore offences involving kidnapping or maiming a child for begging, enhanced punishments, and presumptions of guilt. The course also covers kidnapping or abduction for murder, ransom, or confinement, emphasising increased severity and legal clarity introduced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
org: Bureau of Police Research and Development BPRD
keywords: Bureau of Police Research and Development

title: Unleashing Excellence: The Path to Outstanding Performance
desc: Embark on a transformative journey to unlock your peak potential with this course on achieving outstanding performance. Designed for any professional aspiring to excel, this program delves into the core habits and mindsets that define high achievers. You will learn to assess your current standing using tools like the nine-box performance-potential matrix, providing a clear baseline for growth. The curriculum is built around proven high-performance habits, including seeking clarity in your objectives, managing your energy, fostering productivity, and building influence. The course also covers the critical importance of developing resilience to navigate setbacks and maintaining a strong sense of purpose. By the end of this program, you will have a practical roadmap to not only enhance your effectiveness and efficiency but also to cultivate a sustainable and fulfilling path toward continuous personal and professional excellence, making you a valuable asset in any public service role.

title: Unlock AI via Prompt Orchestration Markup Language
desc: This course offers a comprehensive and practical guide to interacting with Artificial Intelligence through the Prompt-Orchestration Markup Language (POML). In an era where AI is becoming integral to professional workflows, understanding how to communicate effectively with these models is a critical skill. This course addresses that need by teaching a structured, repeatable method for prompt design. Key learning areas include the fundamental principles of prompt engineering, advanced techniques like zero-shot and few-shot prompting, and the syntax of POML. Learners will also delve into the inner workings of Large Language Models (LLMs), including tokenization and parameter tuning, and discuss the ethical dimensions of AI, such as bias and hallucination. Upon completion, participants will be able to apply POML to design sophisticated prompts, optimize AI outputs, and confidently integrate AI tools into their work for enhanced efficiency and innovative problem-solving.
subDomain: Digital Tools ( MS office, Excel, & PPT) & Platforms
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Unlocking Digital Transformation at Billion Scale
desc: Dive into the architecture of India's next-generation digital economy with this in-depth exploration of ONDC and DPI. This course addresses the critical challenges of market concentration and digital exclusion in the current e-commerce landscape. You will learn why a shift from closed platforms to open, protocol-based networks is essential for enabling participation at a national scale. The curriculum breaks down the 'platform vs. infrastructure' paradigm, using real-world examples to illustrate how ONDC functions as a common language for digital commerce, allowing any buyer and seller to transact seamlessly regardless of the application they use. Learners will analyze the structural problems that prevent small merchants and weavers from participating in online commerce, such as high commissions, complex onboarding, and cash flow issues. By the end of the course, you will understand the profound economic and social implications of these initiatives and be able to articulate how they collectively drive innovation, empower citizens, and are poised to unlock digital transformation for a billion people.
org: National E-Governance Division (NEGD) MeitY Govt of India

title: Unlocking Your Potential: Self-Awareness and Self-Analysis
desc: Embark on a transformative journey to unlock your full potential by mastering the arts of self-awareness and self-analysis. This course is designed for individuals seeking to build a stronger foundation for personal and professional success. It begins by defining self-concept and its different facets—the basic, social, and ideal self—to help you understand the core of your identity. A key focus is the practical application of the Johari Window, a powerful model for expanding self-awareness by exploring what is known to you and others. You will learn to leverage self-disclosure and feedback to reduce blind spots and uncover hidden potential. The course then provides an in-depth exploration of emotional intelligence, breaking it down into critical components such as self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Unlocking Your Potential: Self-Awareness and Self-Analysis
desc: Embark on a transformative journey to unlock your full potential by mastering the arts of self-awareness and self-analysis. This course is designed for individuals seeking to build a stronger foundation for personal and professional success. It begins by defining self-concept and its different facets—the basic, social, and ideal self—to help you understand the core of your identity. A key focus is the practical application of the Johari Window, a powerful model for expanding self-awareness by exploring what is known to you and others. You will learn to leverage self-disclosure and feedback to reduce blind spots and uncover hidden potential. The course then provides an in-depth exploration of emotional intelligence, breaking it down into critical components such as self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills. To provide a deeper, more resonant learning experience, these modern psychological concepts are enriched with practical insights and self-analysis techniques drawn from Indian philosophy and epics. By the end of this course, you will be equipped with actionable strategies to foster continuous personal growth, enhance emotional balance, and build more effective relationships.
org: National Academy of Defence Production (NADP) Nagpur

title: Urban Development in India: Basic Version
desc: As India undergoes a rapid urban transition, the effective management of cities has become paramount for national development. This course offers a comprehensive overview of the complexities and opportunities within India's urban sector. It begins by exploring the global and national trends in urbanization and its intrinsic link to economic progress. Learners will delve into the core challenges confronting urban India, from inadequate service delivery in water and sanitation to issues of mobility, environmental sustainability, and housing.
